tei:div.tei:p: /༷ ༷/niX/༷༷rte ༷ ༷/ snro minya4 mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang / thodhū /

dkar chagamachod brjod/ (1)gleng gzhi/ (3)skye ba blangs tshul/ (21)rab tu byung tshul/ (44)chos rgyal ngag gi dbang po'i zhabs pad bsten tshul/ (68)rtse gzhung dben pa'i dga' tshal du zab mo'i sgrub pa la gzhol tshul/ (91)dben gnas stag mo rdzong dang / rgod po rdzong / ge tho rnams su song nas sgrub pa byas tshul/ (125)mtsho snying ma hā de wa nas sgrub pa byas tshul/ (182)rma chen sbom ra nas sgrub pa byas tshul/ (317)brag dkar sprel rdzong thugs rje chen po'i gnas nas sgrub pa byas tshul/ (369)1

dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing du yar la song tshul/ (421)tsā ri phag gdong ma nag mo thugs kyi gnas la rong skor brgyab nas sgrub pa byas tshul/ (494)gangs dkar gyi rgyal po te se seng gdong ma dkar mo sku yi gnas nas sgrub pa byas tshul/ (552)bal yul mchod rten chen po rnam gnyis la mjal du song tshul/ (707)la phyi stag gdong ma khra mo gsung gi gnas nas sgrub pa byas tshul/ (802)dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing du tshur la 'ongs nas phyogs med 'gro don byas tshul/ (905)mdo khams smad 'dir 'ongs nas bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i don chen bsgrubs tshul/ (991)mjug byang / (1118)2

mchod brjod/oṃ swa sti/ bstan pa'i bdag po ston pa bcom ldan 'das/ /thun mong ma yin gdul bya'i snang ngo ru/ /dpag med bskal pa'i sngon nas sangs rgyas te/ /rtag tu chos 'khor bskor la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi thog ma ru/ /ston pa kun tu bzang po'i sku ru bzhengs/ /rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs 'khor tshogs la/ /rdzogs chen chos 'khor bskor la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'og min chos kyi dbyengs kyi pho brang du/ /ston pa rdo rje 'chang gi sku ru bzhengs/ /gsang ba'i bdag po la sogs 'khor tshogs la/ /gsang sngags chos 'khor bskor la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thun mong gdul bya rnams kyi snang ngo ru/ /dang po thugs bskyed bar du tshogs gnyis bsags/ /tha mar mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas te/ /mdo yi chos 'khor bskor la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mdo sngags chos kyi 'khor lo rab bskor ba'i/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi thugs sprul pad 'byung rje/ /bod du byon nas bstan pa'i srol chen 1

btsugs/ /o rgyan bka' drin can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bstan pa dus kyi dbang gis nyams pa'i tshe/ /pad 'byung slar yang jo bo'i sku ru sprul/ /mdo sngags bstan pa'i sgron me ches cher sbar/ /jo bo thugs rje can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /jo bo slar yang snyigs ma'i dus skabs 'dir/ /blo bzang rgyal ba gnyis pa'i sku ru bzhengs/ /rgyal bstan mkha' la nyi ma shar ba bzhin/ /dar zhing rgyas par mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sngon gyi rgyal ba rnams kyis gsungs pa'i chos/ /ma lus ston mdzad chos rgyal ngag ji/ dbang //bdag la sangs rgyas las kyang bka' drin che/ /bla ma bka' drin can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal ba gong ma rnams kyis snyigs dus 'dir/ /gang la gang 'dul bshes gnyen skur bstan nas/ /mdo rgyud bstan bcos man ngag ston mdzad pa'i/ /drin can bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bla ma rnams kyi bka' drin dran bzhin bye/ /ci gsung bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i mchod pa 'bul/ /bdag gi rnam thar mgur dbyangs thos tshad kyi/ /rgyud la phan thogs 'byung bar byen gyis rlobs/ /rang nyid dang bo ma las skyes nas bzung / /da lta'i bar gyi rnam par thar pa kun/ /phyi rabs gang zag gzhan la phan pa'i phyir/ /legs par bshad kyis dga' ba'i sems kyis nyon// 2

gleng gzhi/de yang stod na bkra shis g.yang kun chags pa'i sa bcu'i dbang phyug rma chen sbom ra'i gnas/ bar na byin rlabs dngos grub 'byung gnas brag dkar sprel rdzong thugs rje chen po'i gnas/ smad na bde skyid snyan gsum 'dzoms pa'i mtsho snying ma hā de wa'i gnas zhes yongs su grags pa'i nang nas/ gnas phun sum tshogs pa sog po'i yul gye bcud 'dus pa'i g.yang gi mtsho rba rlabs chal chil g.yo zhing chu bya dar dir sgog pa'i mtsho snying dben pa'i dga' tshal na bdag gis zab mo'i sgrub pa la gzhol ba'i skabs su/ dad brtson shes rab snying rje dang ldan pa'i skal ldan snying gi bu mchog bla ma pad+ma rang grol dang /kun bzang rang grol/ a lags bde chen/ sha nye rgan po'i bla ma rnams 'ongs nas/ lo gcig gnas chen der bsdad pas/ nyin gcig khong rnams 'ongs nas bdag la lha phyag mang du byas te/lha rdzas dri ma med pa phul nas/ 'di phyi'i gtan gyi skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang chen po'i snyan gyi dbang po dri ma med pa'i drung du gang zhu na/ bdag cag rjes 'jug bu slob rnams kyi 3

dad gus kyi gsos dang / phyi rabs gang zag gzhan rnams la yang phan phyir/ khyed dang po khyim na bzhugs pa'i dus nas bzung / da lta'i bar gyi rnam par thar pa zhig rgyas par gsung du gsol zhes yan lag bdun pa 'di phul lo//rgyal ba'i rnam 'phrul bla ma rje/ /rje btsun khyed kyi zhabs pad la/ /bstod dbyangs gsol 'debs sgog bzhin du/ /rab tu gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /zang zing longs spyod lus ngag dang / /bka' bzhin bsgrub pa'i mchod pa 'bul/ /nyams chags 'gal 'khrul ci mchis pa/ /bshags shing phyin chad sdom par bgyi/ /mgon khyod gsang gsum rnam thar la/ /rab tu dga' ba'i rjes yi rang / /bdag sogs ma 'ongs rjes 'jug la/ /phan phyir rnam thar chos 'khor bskor/ /bstan 'gro'i don du mgon khyod sku/ /g.yo med bskal brgyar bzhugs gsol 'debs/ /bdag gzhan dge tshogs ci mchis pa/ /mgon khyod rnam thar zin phyir bsngo/ /snyigs dus 'gro ba'i skyabs mgon khyed/ /dang po khyem na bzhugs dus nas/ /da lta'i bar gyi rnam thar zhig /brtse ba chen pos gsung du gsol/ /zhes phul ba'i lan du bdag gis 'di skad ces smras so/4

dad brtson shes rab snying rje dang / /ldan pa'i skal ldan snying gi bu/ /bla ma pad+ma rang grol sogs/ /skal ldan bu rnams tshur nyon dang / /sngon gyi rgyal sras rnam thar gyi/ /rin chen gter kha phyes la ltos/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi rnam thar gye/ /tsig tshang bsgogs nas ci zhig bya/ /sngon gye rgyal sras rta mchog rnams/ /rgyug shul rnam thar thang chen du/ /tshogs drug rang gol bong bu yi/ /'dur tshul bshad na gad mo 'chor/ /de phyir rnam thar dgos pa chung / /khyed rnams gong ma'i rnam thar skyongs/ /rnal 'byor ri khrod dben pa ru/ /sos dal bde bar nyal du chug /ces smras pa'i lan du/ khong rnams kyis 'di skad ces zhus so//e ma snyigs dus 'gro ba'i mgon/ /khyed kyis dang po tshe blos btang / /bar du mtshan ldan bla ma bsten/ /tha ma dben par nyams su blangs/ /da lta nyams rtogs thugs la 'khrungs/ /mgon khyod rnam thar ngo mtshar che/ /nyi ma'i 'od zer shar tsa na/ /'dzam gling yongs la phan pa bzhin/ /khyed kyi rnam thar gsung tsa na/ /ma 'ongs bstan 'gro yongs la phan/ /de phyir gal chung yin ma dgongs/ /brtse bas cis kyang gsung du gsol/ /zhes nan tan chen pos bskul ba'i ngor/ dang po 5

khyim na gnas dus nas bzung / mtsho snying du sdod ring gi bar gyi rnam thar rags rim zin bris su bkod nas bshad pas/khong rnams dga' zhing spro bzhin du phyag byas mthar rnam thar gyi zin bris kyang khyer nas song ngo //rjes su bla ma pad+ma rang grol gyis nga dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing du ma song tshun gyi rnam thar zhig brtsams pa tshig don gnyis ka bzang zhing mang nyung 'tshams pa zhig 'dug pas/rjes 'jug bu slob rnams kyi dad gus kyi gsal 'debs la de kho nas kyang chog par 'dug snyam pa byung ngo //yang de'i rjes su stod na grags che ba gangs dkar gyi rgyal po te se seng gdong ma dkar mo sku yi gnas/ bar na khungs btsun pa la phyi stag gdong ma khra mo gsung gi gnas/ smad na 'gran zla thams cad dang bral ba tsā ri phag gdong ma nag mo thugs kyi gnas te/ yi dam bde mchog 'khor lo'i sku gsung thugs kyi gnas gsum zhes yongs su grags pa'i nang nas/gnas phun sum tshogs pa rje btsun mi la ras pa'i gdan sa/ma dang mkha' 'gro'i do ra/ sprin dang na bun rgyun du 'khrigs pa'i 'brog la phyi gangs kyi ra ba na/ 'khor skal bzang gi gdul bya mang po la chos 'khor skor ba bzhin gnas dus/ dad gtong 6

blo gros mchog tu mnga' ba'i bu chen skal ldan rang grol dang /bla ma sbyin pa nor bu/ bstan 'dzin nyi ma/ ye shes dbang phyug tshul khrims rnam rgyal/ blo bzang dar rgyas/ nye gnas mkhas pa la sogs pa'i bu chen mang pos nyin gcig lha rdzas mar+bhal gser dngul gyi 'bul ba rnams phul nas/ mchog gsum 'dus pa'i bdag nyid 'di phyi'i gtan gyi skyabs mgon rin po che'i snyan lam du bdag sogs slob 'bangs rnams kyis gang zhu na/ sngon byon mkhas grub gong ma'i rnam thar ltar/ khyed kyi rnam thar zhig gsungs na ma 'ongs pa'i dus na/ bstan 'gro'i mig rkyen la mchog tu 'gro bar 'dug pas/ mgon khyed dang po 'khrungs pa'i yul/ yab yum gyi mtshan/ 'byor ba'i che chung ming sring du yod/ sku bltams nas bzung ste lo re bzhin gyi ngo mtshar ba'i mdzad pa bstan tshul dang / 'jig rten 'khor ba'i chos la skyo ba skyes nas/ sku tshe blos btang ste/ mkhas grub kyi bla ma mang po bsten nas mdo sngags kyi chos la thos bsam mdzad tshul dang / thos don tshul bzhin du ri khrod dben pa 'grims nas/ zab mo'i sgrub pa la gzhol te nyams rtogs yon tan 'khrungs tshul/ 'khrungs nas mngon shes dang dzu 'phrul ston bzhin stod smad bar gsum gyi bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i 7

don rlabs chen mdzad tshul sogs/ phyi nang gsang ba'i rnam thar rnams sba bsri med par bstan du gsol zhes slar yang zhu don tshigs su bcad nas 'di ltar phul lo/ /skyabs mgon yid bzhin nor bu la/ /zhu ba don gzhan ma lags te/ /sngon byon gong ma'i rnam thar bzhin/ /khyed kyi rnam par thar pa zhig /gsungs na rjes 'jug bu slob dang / /ma 'ongs bstan 'gror phan par nges/ /de phyir skyabs mgon rin po che/ /dang po 'khrungs yul yab yum mtshan/ /sku bltams nas bzung lo re bzhin/ /ngo mtshar mdzad pa bstan tshul dang / /chos phyir sku tshe blos btang nas/ /mkhas grub bla ma bsten tshul dang / /dben pa'i gnas su nyams len mdzad/ /nyams rtogs yon tan 'khrungs tshul dang / /mngon shes dzu 'phrul ston bzhin du/ /bstan 'gro'i don chen bsgrubs tshul rnams/ /sba gsang med par bstan du gsol/ /bdag cag skal ldan bu slob kyis/ /khyed kyi phyi nang gsang gsum gyi/ /rnam thar zin par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes zhus pa'i lan du/'o khyed rnams kyis de ltar nan tan chen pos zhu na/ nga'i rnam thar gsang dgos pa'i don mi 'dug nga skyes nas bzung da lta'i bar gyi song tshul bsdad tshul chos ldan gyi bya ba bsgrubs 8

tshul rnams legs par bshad kyis/ khyed rnams kyis rab tu dga' ba'i sems kyis nyon cig ces sems la gang nges rnams legs par bshad pas khong rnams dga' zhing spro bzhin phyag dang skor ba du ma byas nas rang rang gi sgom khang du song ngo / /de dus zin bris su 'debs rgyu ma byung kyang / bu chen 'ga' res rnam thar brjed kyis dogs nas zin bris su btab pa re gnyis snang zer ro /yang de'i rjes su mdo smad du yong nas/ 'gro don rgya chen po byas nas lo ngo mthong dgu tsam zhig song ba'i tshe gnas phun sum tshogs pa nags tshal me tog sna tshogs skye zhing / bya dang bye'u'i skad snyan sgog pa'i dben gnas bkra shis 'khyil ba na nga mtshams shig la gnas pa'i skabs su/ dad can gyi slob ma sngags 'chang mang po'i kha gtam la skyabs mgon rin po che'i rnam thar rgyas pa zhig gsungs na/ rang cag rnams kyi dad pa'i gsos dang / phyi rabs rjes 'jug rnams la phan rgya chen po zhig thogs par 'dug ces gleng ba byung / de'i tshe nub gcig mkhan rin po che gnyid du song ba'i rmi lam du/ bkra shis 'khyil ba'i ri rtse bde ba can gyi lha khang gi phyi rol shar gyi khri steng na/ ngas khrom lha mi mang po 'tshogs pa la/ sngon gyi 9

sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rgya bod kyi mkhas grub/da lta'i skyes chen dam pa mang po'i rnam thar gsung ba nyan tshe kho'i bsam pa la/ da ni rang yang nam 'chi nges pa mi 'dug pas/rnam thar 'di rnams kyi 'phro la/ khong gi sku tshe 'di'i rnam thar rgyas pa zhig ci nas kyang zhu dgos snyam pa yod pa'i ngang la gnyid sad pas/ de'i phyi nyin snga mo kha btags shig khyer 'ongs nas zhu don 'di ltar phul lo//'di phyi'i skyabs mgon rin po che/ /khyed kyang dgung lo bgres nas gda'/ /sngon chad rnam thar zhu ba po'i/ /bu chen phal cher gshegs nas thal/ /nga yang rgan po 'chi la nye/ /nam 'chi nges pa mi 'dug pas/ /yun ring bsdad nas zhu khom med/ /ma shi gong 'dir ma zhus na/ /phyin chad rnam thar gsungs na yang / /bdag cag shi na gang nas go /da lta gson pa'i dus skabs 'dir/ /bdag cag rjes 'jug bu slob kyi/ /dad gus dag snang gsal 'debs dang / /ma 'ongs bstan dang 'gro ba yi/ /mig rkyen mchog tu 'gro ba'i phyir/ /rnam thar rgyas par gsung du gsol/ /deng nas bzung ste tshe rabs kun/ /khyed kyi rnam thar rjes zhugs nas/ /lha chos byed pa'i smon lam 'debs/ /smon pa bzhin du 'grub gyur cig /10

ces zhus/yang de'i rjes su bla ma'i bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i nyang gi mtshams pa dang lha khang dbu mdzad/ ye shes bstan 'dzin/bsod nams rin chen/ zhabs phyi grub chen dang / pad+ma dkar dris/ gnas brtan/ stag yan/ sangs rgyas/ kun dga'/rab byung / phun tshogs sogs skal ldan gyi slob ma rnams dang /dad ldan gyi sbyin bdag pho mo thams cad kyis snga phyi rim pa bzhin/ sngon gyi skyes mchog rnams dang / da lta'i bla ma rnams la rnam thar mang po 'dug pas/ khyed kyis kyang rnam thar zhig ci nas kyang gsung dgos zhes yang yang bskul kyang dgos pa chung snyam/ re zhig btang snyoms su bzhag ste mtshams dam po byas nas bsdad skabs/ nyin gcig bsam blo zhig btang tshe/mkhan pos bshad pa bzhin/ rang yang chos byed blo'i ngang la mi tshe rgas nas 'chi la nye dus 'dir/ da skyid khom sdug khom chen po e yod mi shes par gda'/ da lta na tsha med par sgyu lus bde ba'i dus 'dir/ rnam thar zhig bris nas bzhag na/phyi rabs dad can gdul bya skal bzang thar pa don du gnyer ba rnams la phan thogs re 'ong ba'ang sred snyam pa'i blos/rang nyid chung ma las skyes nas da lta'i bar gyi rnam thar 'bri ba 11

la yid phyogs so/ /de la rnam thar skul ba po rnams dang rjes 'jug gdul bya ma 'ongs pa'i gang zag las dang skal bar ldan pa rnams kyi phan bde legs tshogs ma lus pa'i 'byung gnas yid bzhin gyi nor bu lta bu'i bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams ni sangs rgyas mi yi gzugs su shar ba yin snyam pa'i sgo nas/ thog mar dad gus byed pa 'di gal che ste/ de'i rgyu mtshan ni/ 'o skol lha dang bcas pa'i 'gro ba ma lus pa'i rnam 'dren dam pa mnyam med zas gtsang gi sras po de nyid/ thun mong ma yin pa'i gdul bya'i snang ngor/ 'khor 'das thams cad kyi thog mar rdzogs byang bla na med pa'i gong 'phang mngon du mdzad de/ mkha' mnyam 'gro ba yongs la gang la gang 'dul gyi skur bzhengs nas/ rtag tu chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba yin te/ mdo sde pad+ma dkar po las/ bskal ba bye stong bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ /de yi grangs ni sus kyang bzung med par/ /byang chub dam pa de ni ngas rnyed de/ /ngas ni rtag tu chos kyang rab 'chad do/ /gsungs/ de nyid thun mong gdul bya rnams kyi snang ngor dang por thugs bskyed/ bar du tshogs bsags/ tha mar mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i mdzad pa rmad du byung ba bstan nas chos 'khor bskor ba 12

yin cing / da dung ma 'ongs pa na'ang de lta bu'i mdzad pa yang yang ston par gsungs te/ yab sras mjal ba'i mdo las/dpa' bo chen po thabs mkhas che/ /sems can yongs su smin mdzad phyir/ /bye ba phrag brgyar rgyal ba nyid/ /sangs rgyas nyid du bstan gyur kyang / /da dung yang ni 'dren pa khyod/ /sangs rgyas mang por ston par mdzad/ /ces gsungs/ deng sang snyigs ma'i dus 'dir gang la gang 'dul gyi bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen du ma'i sku ru sprul nas 'gro ba'i don mdzad par gsungs te/ rnga bo che'i mdo las/ mya ngan ma byed kun dga' bo/ /nga ni phyi ma'i dus su ni/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen nyid sprul nas/ /khyod la sogs pa'i don byed 'gyur/ /zhes dang / ba tshwa can gyi chu klung gi mdo las/ lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la/ /nga nyid dge ba'i bshes su 'ong / /nga yin snyam du blos zungs la/ /de tshe de la gus pa skyed/ /ces dang / rdo rje gur gyi rgyud las/gang nyid rdo rje sems dpa' zhes/ /de nyid slob dpon gzugs su 'dzin/ /sems can phan gdags dmigs nas ni/ /tha mal pa yi gzugs su gnas/ /zhes sangs rgyas kyis gang gsungs tshad mar bzung nas/ bla ma la sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes bzhag na/ ci mdzad legs par mthong nas/13

bla ma'i rnam thar ngo mtshar ba dang rgya che ba rnams phar zhog /sku'i bzhugs tshul gsung gi 'byon lugs yan chad dran na yang dad pa skye la/ de lta bu'i dad gus gang la yod phyin chad gang zag des sangs rgyas kyi las dang dngos grub thams cad 'grub pa dang / dam chos yon tan myur du skye zhing dgos 'dod ma lus pa 'byung bar 'gyur te/ chos bcu pa'i mdo las/ dad pa ldan pa'i mi dag la/ /sangs rgyas las rnams 'grub 'gyur te/ /zhes dang / sgyu 'phrul dra ba las/ dad pa ldan pa'i gang zag gis/ /rang bzhin dngos grub thams cad 'grub/ /ces dang / rgyal ba garma pas/ dad can slob ma mos gus can/ /dam chos yon tan myur du skye/ /zhes dang / ma cig gis/dad pa yod pa'i mi rnams la/ /dgos 'dod ma lus 'byung bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /'o na nga la sger du lung bstan 'dra yod dam snyam na/ de yang yod de/ mchod rten chen po bya rung kha shor gyi dkar chag tu slob dpon chen po'i ma 'ongs lung bstan las/ rigs gsum mgon po dang / khro gnyer can dang / rje btsun sgrol ma rnams kyi sprul pa 'ga' res zhig gso byed par 'gyur ro/ /de'i dus su skal ba dang las 'phro ru ldan pa'i gang zag gcig gis tshe blos btang nas/ lhag pa'i 14

bsam pa rgya chen po bskyed nas zhig gso byas na 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin grub na lho 'dzam bu gling du lo legs bde skyid mi lo nyer lnga'i bar du 'byung / zhes dang / gter ston bdud 'dul rdo rje'i bstan pa spyi'i lung bstan las/ dpal gyi rdo rje shar gyi phyogs su 'phur/ /rang grol ming can yang dag don la mkhas/ /bya rung kha shor mdog dang ldan par byed/ /ya rabs las ldan thams cad de la mos/ /zhes dang /garma pa rol pa'i rdo rje'i lung bstan bka' rgya ma las/ rje btsun bzhad pa rdo rje/ /mdo khams shar phyogs g.yo zhing / /la phyi gangs kyi ra ba/ /nyams gso legs par byed do/ /zhes dang / gter ston stag sham nus ldan rdo rje'i chos bdag gi lung bstan las/ dbu rtse rigs gsum drod kyis g.yengs pa'i dus/ /zab don tshogs kyi 'khor lo shar nas 'byung / /nga yi zab chos 'di dang 'phrad pa na/ /bar chad kun sel 'gro don rgya cher yong / /snying rje che zhing mthong byed spe ba can/ /the tshom ma byed nyams su longs la spel/ /zhes dang / grub dbang rdzogs chen pa kun bzang gzhan phan rin po che'i lung bstan las/ mgon bstan pa'i 'khor lo stod du 'byung / /lha phyag na pad+ma sgyu 'phrul bzhin/ /yul de dang gzhan yul dag nas 15

'byung / /zhes dang / rig 'dzin chen po dpal ldan bkra shis la ma 'ongs lung bstan byung ba las/ glang chen 'gying 'dra'i ri bo la/ /sprin nag 'khrigs pa'i nags tshal yod/ /ma 'ongs bkra shis 'khyil ba zhes/ /sgrub pa'i sa sde tshugs pa yong /gnas der grub thob 'ga' tsam 'byung / /dper na nyi zla zung gcig la/ /rgyu skar tshogs kyis bskor 'dra ba'i/ /bde chen gsang ba'i sgrub sde 'byung / /zhes gsungs/ gzhan yang mdo rgyud kyi gzhung dang / bka' gdams glegs bam dang / o rgyan rin po che'i gter chos gsar rnying sogs la dad gus can gyis bltas na/ 'di yang lung bstan yin nam snyam pa mang po yod skad/ des na phyi rabs rjes 'jug dad can rnams kyis nga yang dam pa gong ma'i lung gis zin pa'i skyes bu dam pa zhig yin par 'dug snyam pa'i dad gus dag snang khyad par can gyi sgo nas rnam thar 'chad pa dang / nyan pa sogs byas na phan yon rgya chen po 'byung bar 'gyur te/ bka' brgyud gser phreng las/ rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams dang / de yi sprul pa bka' brgyud rin po che dang / gzhan yang skyes mchog dam pa sprul pa'i sku rnams kyi rnam thar dang / 'phrin las mdzad pa ngo mtshar che ba rnams lan re thos pa tsam gyis kyang / las ngan 16

sdig sgrib dpag tu med pa 'dag cing / bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya chen po rdzogs par 'gyur la/ dkar po'i sa bon thebs shing bla ma rnams kyi zhabs drung du skyes nas theg pa chen po'i chos la longs spyod par 'gyur/ sdug khur dang dka' spyad nus shing /blo stobs dang go ba shugs kyis skye/ mang du thos shing yid la 'jags par gyur na/ chos rnam thar gyis bstan pa yin pas spang blang rnams shes shing / lam ma nor bar go bar 'gyur te/rgyud la dad pa med pa rnams la dad pa skye zhing / dad pa yod pa rnams kyang gong du 'phel bar byed la/ zhen log dang /brtson 'grus dang / shes rab la sogs pa yang shugs kyis skye bar 'gyur/ mos gus kyi gdung ba skyes na/ don rgyud kyi byin rlabs zhugs nas nyams dang rtogs pa ma skyes pa rnams la'ang rtsol med du skye zhing / skyes pa rnams kyang gong nas gong du bogs thon par 'gyur/ byang chub sems dpa'i mdzad pa ngo mtshar can de lta bu bdag kyang byed par gyur cig snyam pa byung na/ smon pa sems bskyed kyi sdom pa rgyud la skye la/ dge ba stobs chen po rnams la rjes su yi rangs skyes na/ bsod nams mnyam por 'thob par bshad cing / mdzad pa ngo mtshar ba dang / chos kyi gtam zab mo rnams thos pas 'phral du yang 17

chags sdang mi dge ba dang / sdug bsngal rnams 'gag cing /dga' spro dang dkar po'i dge ba rnams 'phel bar 'gyur/log rtog can 'ga' zhig smod cing skur ba 'debs na yang /sems dpa' chen po rnams kyis rjes su 'dzin cing / gdul byar gyur nas 'khor ba mtha' can du byed do/ /mdor na rang gzhan gyi don gnyis lhun grub tu 'byung bas na/ 'di rnams mthong ba dang / thos pa dang dran pa tsam yang don yod par byed pas na/ 'dri ba dang / 'chang ba dang / klog pa dang /'chad pa dang / nyan pa dang / bsams shing yid la 'dzin pa dang / don nyams su len pa la brtson par bya zhing dad gus khyad par can bskyed par bya'o gsungs/ des na bdag la ni sngon gye sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' dang /rgya bod kyi mkhas grub gong ma'i rnam par thar pa ltar/ rjes 'jug gis nyams len du khyer chog pa chen po zhig med mod/ 'on kyang dam pa gong ma de dag gi rjes su kha mig yar blta byas nas/chos ldan gyi bya ba bsgrubs tshul rnams/ gang bshad par bya ba'i rnam thar ro/ /de ji ltar 'chad na/ mchog dman bar pa kun gyis nyan spro ba'i phyir/ sngon gyi mkhas grub 'ga' zhig gi rnam thar ltar tshig lhug dang tshigs bcad gnyis ka spel ma byas 18

nas/ skabs bco lnga'i sgo nas rgyas par 'chad par bya ste/ dang po sngon gyi las bzang smon lam dag pas mtshams sbyar nas yul phyogs gang du skye ba blangs tshul/ gnyis pa 'jig rten 'khor ba'i chos la snying po med par bsams nas khyim nas khyem med par rab tu byung ba'i tshul/ gsum pa pha yul rgyab tu spangs nas chos rgyal ngag gi dbang po'i zhabs pad bsten tshul/bzhi pa bla mas lung bstan pa'i rtse gzhung dben pa'i dga' tshal nas zab mo'i sgrub pa la gzhol tshul/ lnga pa gnas de dang thag nye'i dben gnas stag mo rdzong dang / rgod po rdzong / ge tho ru song nas sgrub pa byas tshul/ drug pa bde skyid snyan gsum 'dzoms pa'i mtsho snying ma hā de wa'i gnas su song nas sgrub pa byas tshul/ bdun pa bkra shis g.yang kun chags pa'i sa bcu'i dbang phyug rma chen sbom ra'i gnas su song nas sgrub pa byas tshul/ brgyad pa byen rlabs dngos grub 'byung gnas brag dkar sprel rdzong thugs rje chen po'i gnas su song nas sgrub pa byas tshul/ dgu pa a ma shi ba'i rkyen byas nas dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing du yar la song ba'i tshul/ bcu pa smad na 'gran zla thams cad dang bral ba tsā ri phag gdong ma nag mo thugs kyi gnas la rong skor brgyab nas sgrub pa byas tshul/ bcu gcig pa 19

stod na grags che ba gangs dkar gyi rgyal po te se seng gdong ma dkar mo sku yi gnas su song nas sgrub pa byas tshul/ bcu gnyis pa ngo mtshar lha yi yul dang mtshungs pa'i bal yul mchod rten chen po rnam gnyis mjal du song tshul/ bcu gsum pa bar na khungs btsun pa la phyi stag gdong ma khra mo gsung gi gnas su song nas sgrub pa byas tshul/ bcu bzhi pa dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing du tshur la 'ongs nas phyogs med 'gro don byas tshul/ bco lnga pa mdo khams smad 'dir 'ongs nas bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i don rgya chen po bsgrubs pa'i tshul lo//20

sgye ba blangs tshul/de la dang po sngon gyi las bzang smon lam dag pas mtshams sbyar nas yul phyogs gang du skye ba blangs tshul ni/ 'gro ba yongs kyi sngon nas ma 'dris pa'i mdza' bshes chen po mnyam med rgyal ba shākya thub pa'i gdul bya'i zhing / lho 'dzam bu gling gi sa yi lte ba rgya gar rdo rje gdan gyi byang phyogs sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas dang / phyag na pad+mo ngur smrig gi rnam rol rgyal ba yab sras rnam gnyis bzhugs pa'i dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing gi shar phyogs/ rgyal ba gnyis pa khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa chen po'i 'khrungs yul mdo smad tsong kha'i skyes ri'i lho phyogs/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi rnam 'phrul rje btsun skal ldan rgya mtsho'i gdul bya'i zhing / reb gong gser mo ljongs zhes bya ba'i sa'i cha mi rnams rang bzhin gyis rnam rig bkra zhing dpa' rtsal che ba/ lha bzo dang sman rtsis sogs rig gnas la mkhas shing / chos phyogs la dga' ba'i yul gru chen po mang po yod la/ de rnams kyi thag nye ba na/ reb gong grub pa thob pa'i gnas brgyad dang / rje skal ldan rgya 21

mtsho'i sgrub gnas mang po yod pa'i nang nas mchog tu gyur pa/shar kuḥ thog nas byon pa'i sngags 'chang chen po mtshan kwa ba rdo rje 'chang dbang zhes bya ba/ yi dam bde mchog dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la brten nas tshe gcig lus gcig la 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku brnyes pa'i gnas/ bde mchog 'khor lo'i pho brang / bcu gcig shel gyi dgon pa'i nye 'dabs/ brag ri dang nags tshal me tog sna tshogs pa skye zhing / rong 'brog gnyis ka 'dzoms pa'i yul zho 'ong la kha zhes grags pa de la/ phyogs phyogs na sde ba che chung bcu yod pa'i nang nas/ yul lha ja sgron gyi ri yi 'dabs na gnyan rgya zhes bya ba'i grong sde zhig yod pa de nyid nga skyes pa'i pha yul yin la/ cho rigs ni rnam 'dren thams cad gzigs pa'i spyan sngar dang po thugs bskyed pa'i sa bcu'i dbang phyug rma chen sbom ra bzhugs pa'i ri rgyud/ rma chu'i ngogs dang thag nye ba na yul lha rma chen gyi 'khor khri ga'i yul lha zhes lha btsan po mngon sum lta bu zhig yod pa'i thag nye na/khri ga'i yul sde chen po rgyal khrims la gnas shing chos phyogs la dkar ba mang po yod pa'i nang nas/ dme rgya zer ba'i sde tshan zhig gis pha spun nang ma 'grigs par mi btsan phyug 'dzoms pa'i nam mkha' rgyal po zhes bya ba'i khyem tshang zhig yul thon 22

nas byung ba/ de gnyan rgya'i sa der chags pa las/ yul lha'i ngo bltas nas nor longs spyod rgyas shing / de la bu nyi ma seng ge dang / zla ba seng ge byang chub seng ge zhes bya ba'i seng ge'i ming can gsum byung ba re re la yang bu mang po byung / de gsum gyi rigs rgyud 'phel nas phyis sngags skor/ dam gtsang /dgongs pa zer ba'i pha tshan gsum byung / nga ni byang chub seng ge'i bu rgyud dam gtsang zer ba de'i yin/ a mes byang chub seng ge zer ba de la bu dang tsha bo yang tsha skyes nas mi thog gsum song ba'i rjes su bu gzugs mjes shing skad snyan pa bsam pa bzang ba zhig byung bas/ ming la a bo yag ces btags shing / bu de chung ngu'i dus phyugs 'tsho ru phyin pas/rgyangs yag mtsher zer ba'i sa nas bum pa chen po zhig gser gyis gang yod pa sogs sa 'og gi gter mthong ba byung / mi rabs gsum tsam gyi bar la phas bu rnams la bstan cing / phyi rabs mi rgyud nor gyes phongs pa byung na gser blangs chog pa'i ngag rgyun gda'/ a mes de la bu chos 'jig rten la mkhas pa'i bkra shis rgyal zer ba gcig byung / de la bu tshe dang bsod nams che ba'i tshe dbang zer ba byung / de la bu drang po g.yo sgyu med pa/ sgrung dang glu dbyangs la mkhas pa'i ngag dbang 23

zer ba byung / de nga'i a ma'i pha de yin la/ de la bu mo lnga dang bu gcig byung bas/ bu de ni sring mo kun gyi chung shos su snang /ming la skyabs go zer zhing / chos kyi bag chags bzang po can zhig byung / bu mo spun lnga'i nang nas bar pa gsum pa de nga'i a ma yin/ nga'i a ma ma skyes pa'i gong du bu gcig 'ong du re nas/ rgyal ba'i gsung rab bkra shis brtsegs pa shig blangs pas/ bu tsha ma skyes par bu mo skyes pas/ ming la bkra shes brtsegs zhes btags/ de nga'i a ma yin/ phyis gces ming la brtsegs go zhes 'bod pa byung / 'byor pa ni shā ri'i bus/ ha cang phyug po'i khyim dang rmi/ /dbul po'i khyim du mi skye bar/ /bar ma'i khyim du skyes nas kyang / /rab tu 'byung ba byed par shog /gsungs pa'i smon lam dang mtshungs par/ ha cang phyug po yang min la/ dbul po yang min par/ 'byor pa che chung 'tshams pa zhig yod pa la/ nga'i a ma'i pha ma gnyis la bu mo mang po yod kyang / bu chung shos gcig las ma byung ba'i stabs kyis/ nga'i a ma de shes rgya che la/ gsog bsrung dang / gnyen 'khor skyong ba la mkhas shing / go chod po byung tshe pha ma gnyis kyis kyang gtsigs che zhing / bu gcig pu'i las grogs su dmigs nas mi la ma byen par yul nas bzhag spun bu mo 24

rnams mi gzhan la byen/ nga'i a ma la ched du gnyer nas mag pa ma bzhag pa'i stabs kyis/ nga'i pha la nges 'jog chen po zhig mi snang yang / phal che ba kha mthun par/ byang chub sems dpa' khye'u chu 'bebs kyi sprul pa rgyal rigs su gtogs shing /rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas pa'i pha rol tu son pa rgyal khams yongs la phan pa'i char chen po nam dgos pa'i dus su 'bebs nus pa'i grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po 'tsho 'du'i mkhan chen rin po sngags 'chang rdo rje rnam rgyal yin zhes grags la/ nga'i a ma de yang cher song nas yul phyogs kyi bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang po'i drung nas las rgyu 'bras sogs kyi chos la nyan pas/ chos phyogs la dga' zhing sdig la 'dzem pa/ nya stong brgyad gsum la bsnyen gnas yan lag brgyad pa'i sdom pa bsrung zhing / rgyun ldan du sgrol ma kha ton byed cing phyag 'tshal bas/ sgrol ma 'bum ther song zhing / phyag kyang bye ba gcig tsam 'tshal bar gda'/ mdor na tshe 'di'i so nam la mkhas shing /rnam dkar dge ba la brtson pa zhig byung 'dug a ma la nga ma skyes pa'i snga rol tu/ nub gcig ge rmi lam na/nged kyi dpon a khu sngags phrug bya bas sku 'dra zhig khyer 'ongs nas 'di re zhig khyed kyi nang du zhog dang / rjes su mi thams cad 25

kyi mgo thog tu 'jog dgos pas/ rgyun du khyed kyi nang du 'jog rgyu mi yong zhes sku lag tu gtad pa'i snang ba byung /gzhan yang rmi lam du pad+ma dkar po rnyed nas mgo rgyan byed pa dang / dung dkar po rnyed nas 'bud pa dang / khyad par nub gcig gi rmi lam du spyan ras gzigs kyi sku 'od zer 'phro ba tshon gang ba zhig spyi bor thim pa zhig rmis pa nas bzung ma'i mngal du zhugs pas lus sems la bde ba dpag med byung / de nas 'phar ba zhes pa lcags mo glang gi lor ma la gnod pa cher med par bdag skyes/ skyes ma thag nas mig phye zhing / byis pa gzhan las kyang skyed che ba dang / mi ngu bar dga' zhing 'dzum bzhin gnas pa kun gyis yid du 'ong ba byung / de'i dus gnyen tshan skyabs lo zer bas rtsis byas pas/ mi gcig la mi brgya 'bros zer ba'i nyi ma zhig la btsas 'dug pas btsas skar bzang / bu 'di 'jig rten byas na/ dmag brgya yang thub pa'i dpa' bo zhig 'ong la/ chos byas na nyon mongs brgyad khri bzhi stong 'joms pa'i grub thob cig 'ong zer bas/dpon sngags phrug gis/ skyes lha mchod cing tshe thar phul nas/ming la ngag dbang bkra shis zhes btags/ nga skyes pa'i lo de la rgyal khams yongs la lo legs po dang bkra shis po byung tshe/26

rjes su btsas ston byas pas/ rgan pa bsam shes rnams kyis/bu tsha'i ming la ngag dbang bkra shis zhes btags pa ming don mthun pas bzang / kun gyis tshe ring bkra shis zhes kha g.yang bkra shis brjod cing yul mi thams cad dga' mgur gyur skad/ chung ngu'i dus su dzun dang tshig rtsub mi smra zhing /mi dge ba'i rtsed mo'i rigs tsam yang gtan nas mi byed par/chos 'don pa ma ṇi pad dbyangs 'then pa/ rnga brdung rol mo dkrol ba sogs chos dang mthun pa'i rtsed mo sna tshogs pa byed cing / rang bzhin gyis rgyud drang zhing bsam pa bzang la rtsed grogs la byams pa/ zan cig za na yang gzhan la bgos nas ster ba zhig yin zer/ mtshan mo a ma'i pang du nyal ba'i dus su mun nag gi nang du bltas tshe skabs skabs su lha khang nang gi ri mo lta bu'i 'ja' 'od thig le lha sku du ma mthong bas de dus a ma la gnam la bltas na khra khra mang po mthong gi byas pas/ a mas khyod kyis dzun ma bshad dang / mun nag gi nang la bltas pas de 'dra gang nas mthong / kha rog par nyol la sdod zer/ yang nyi ma kha shas re'i 'phro la bltas na mthong gi bshad pas/ dzun e yin zer/ dzun min ngo thog yin bshad pas/ a mas nged tshang gi dpon sngags phrug la zlos pas/ de 27

bden yong grib la 'dzems dang / chos pa bzang po zhig gi skye ba 'dra yin na/ rjes nas chos byas na rang gzhan gnyis ka la phan thogs yong nges zer skad/ rjes su ri khrod rnams su thod rgal sgom dus sngar gyi de 'dra ba mang po shar byung tshe/ ngas chung ngu'i dus su mthong ba de sngon gyi bag chags shig sad pa yin nam snyam pa byung / de nas lo drug bdun tsam zhig lon pa'i dus/ nged tshang gi dpon des dpyid ka zhing btab tshar ba'i dus su nyi ma ring ba'i dus shig la/ mdo sde mdzangs blun zhig khyer 'ongs nas/ nyi phug dro sa zhig tu skye bo pho mo mang po 'tshogs pa la/ las rgyu 'bras kyi chos bshad byed pa la ngas kyang nyan pas/ khong gis/ 'o dal 'byor gyi mi lus rin po che 'di 'dra phyin chad rnyed par dka'/ da res rnyed pa'i dus 'dir myur du chos shig bya dgos/ ma byas na nam 'chi cha med/ do nub tsam la yang mi 'chi ba'i gdeng su la'ang med/ shi na phyi mar gshin rje chos rgyal gyi drung du song na/ las dge sdig gi shan phyes nas/ sdig can rnams dmyal bar btang nas sdug bsngal myong zhing / dge ba byas pa rnams mtho ris su btang nas bde skyid myong bas/ da res lus thog 'di la thams cad kyis sdig pa byed mi rung / de'i nang nas srog gcod byas na 28

dmyal bar 'gro bas shin tu 'dzem dgos/ mchod sbyin dang dge 'dun la bsnyen bkur sogs dge ba bsgrub dgos/ de'i nang nas phyag skor kha ton dang bsam pa bzang po byas na bde ba can du skyes yong bas 'bad pa gal che/ de'i rgyu mtshan 'di yin zhes mdo sde mdzangs blun bton nas/ skabs skabs su 'di 'dra gsung rgyu red ces 'grel bshad byas pas/ der 'tshogs pa kun gyi sems la phan cing / ngas kyang de go nas bzung sdig pa la 'dzems nas dge ba bsgrub dgos par 'dug snyam/ rgyun ldan du yid kyis ma brjed par byas/ sa'i srin bu yan chad rkang 'og tu gcur gyis dogs nas 'dzem/ sha sbrang gzhan gyis gsod pa yang gsod du ma bcug par rang gi khrag 'thung du bcug nas btang / a mas phyag 'tshal dus ngas kyang 'tshal/ mchod khang du spos dang me tog phul/ ma ṇi dang dmigs brtse ma sogs rang gi gang shes kyi kha ton 'dra byed rgyu byung / de'i ston kha lo yag po zhig byung bas/ khyim tshang yod med gnyis gas skyid po bya rgyu yin zer nas/ lug mang po gsod pa mthong bas/nga rang skrag pa dang /lug la snying rje nas/lug gsod pa'i khang ba'i nang du yang sdod ma thub par phyi sgor thon nas bsdad/ bsad tshar tshe nang du 'ong dus/ lug 29

bsgyel nas bsha' ba mthong bas nga'i bsam pa la mi 'di tshos tshe phyi ma yod pa shes bzhin sdig pa byed par 'dug ste/ nga cher song na sdig pa spangs te chos shig byed dgos snyam nas zhe dam yang yang byas/ de dus nga'i a ma'i spun a lce zhig gi bu gnam lha zer ba de la/ nga'i a ma'i pha rgad po ngag dbang gis yi ge slob pa'i phyi rgyab thag nyer bsdad nas bltas pas/dka' tshegs med par ngas yi ge shes pa byung / khos yun ring ma shes tshe/ gnam lha byams la khyod kyis bslabs kyang mi shes/ tsha bo chung chung 'di la ma bslabs kyang shes par 'dugakhyod la ci byung zer nas mang po bsdigs par gda'/ nga la 'di rig yag cig red zer nas gang byams byams byas byung /gzhan yang byis pa klog slob pa la bltas pas ched du gnyer nas slob ma dgos par yi ge gzab gshar gnyis ka tshegs med du shes pa byung / de nas a mes rgad po de shi/ jo mo zhig yod pa de shi/ de'i rjes su a ma'i ming po skyabs go zer ba de yang lo nyi shu rtsa gcig thog nas glo bur du shi / de sogs gzhan yang a ma'i mgo la skyid sdug sna tshogs pa mang po zhig byung ba'i rkyen gyis mgyogs por rgas pa byung / ngas lo dgu dang bcu tshun la zho 'ong sngags mang gi 'don cha dang / yi ge 30

dkar nag gnyis ka 'bri tshul bslabs pas/ rang chung chung tshod kyi yi ge yag po zhig bri shes pa byung / lo bcu gcig thog nas gsang sngags snga 'gyur la mi phyed pa'i dad pa dang dam tshig gtsang ba'i zho 'ong la kha'i sngags mang gi chos thog gi gral du zhugs nas/ cho ga rnams sgra dag po byas nas bton pa'i tshe/sngags 'chang rgan pa phal cher thugs mnyes nas/ sngags phrug 'di 'don mkhan zhig red/ tshe ring bkra shis zer ba byung /nyin gcig nged kyi nye ba a yes klu mo dpal zer ba'i rabs chad rgan mo zhig yod pa de/ sgo yi nyi ma dro sa zhig na gcig pur bsdad yod pa'i sar song nas/ khyod kyi sems ma sdug dang / nga cher song na khyod la phan gang thogs byas chog ces bshad de yul du 'ongs nas/ a mas ma shes pa byas te mar zhig khyer nas mo la byen/ nga yang cher song nas skabs skabs phan thogs 'dra byas pas/ mo'i sems shin tu dga' nas/rjes su nga nam mthong yang bos te/ za ma gtsang ma re yod na nga la byin nas rang gi bu ltar byams par byas tshul dus da lta yang skabs rer dran pa byung / de dus nyin gcig rang gi yul phyogs kyi skya ser rnams kyi rtsa ba'i bla ma gtsug gi nor bu/ chu dmar rin po che dge 'dun bkra shis rgya mtsho phebs nas skya 31

ser mang po la/ skyabs 'gro/ ltung bshags/ dga' ldan lha brgya/ khong gis thun mong gi chos bshad/ dmigs brtse ma ma ṇi sdom lung rnams gnang ba la nyan pas/ khong gis thun mong gi chos bshad/ dal 'byor rnyed dka'/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa/las rgyu 'bras/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs rnams rgyas bsdus 'tshams pa zhig gnang bas/ kun gyi sems la phan pa byung /de dus khong gi zhal nas/ khyed rgan rgon rnams kyis bu tsha cha re yod na/ thams cad khyem thab tu ma 'jug par/ phal cher rab byung gyis la chos byed du chugs dang bzang / sngon bdag cag gi ston pas kyang rga ba dang / na ba dang 'chi ba gzigs pas thugs skyo/ dge slong zhig gzigs pas thugs spro nas/rgyal srid spangs te mchod rten rnam dag drung nas rab tu byung /rgya gar rdo rje gdan gyi byang chub shing drung du sangs rgyas pa'i rnam thar la ltos dang / nged rnams kyis kyang de ltar chos byed thub na skal ba bzang gsungs pa thos nas yul du 'ongs/ nged tshang la ston pa'i rnam thar mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi bdun thang zhig yod nga/ la bltas nas/ khong gis 'di ltar gsungs pa red snyam/ ngas 'di lta bu zhig yong ba'i smon lam thobs zhes yid smon shor ba byung / sku gzhogs rin po che de nyid kyis yul 32

phyogs la ma ṇi btsugs/ thams cad kyi blo kha chos la bsgyur bas yul phyogs la bka' drin che bar byung / ngas kyang de nas bzung nya stong brgyad gsum la yan lag brgyad pa'i sdom pa ma chag par bsrungs/ nga cher song nas khong gi gzim khang gi sgo 'gram gyi ngos la skye bo gso thig gi gtam rgyud ltar sdebs bris kha shas kyang bris pas khong gi thugs mnyes/ de dus chos kyi gleng mo byas pa da lta yang dran pa byung / rjes su khong gshegs khar yang zhal chems 'di ltar gsungs par gda'/gang la brten nas bslu ba med pa'i skyabs/ /'di phyi'i legs tshogs ma lus 'byung ba'i gnas/ /dngos grub kun gyi gter mdzod drin can rje/ /dngos brgyud bla mas byang chub bar du skyongs/ /chu bo'i rgyun bzhin 'khor ba'i 'gro ba tsho/ /skye rga na 'chi'i sdug bsngal sems mdzod la/ /mi dge bcu spongs dge bcu bsgrub la brtson/ /rtag tu 'chi bdag kha ru 'gro ba soms/ /phyi ru blo rgya ma che nang du ltos/ /nang gi sems nyid gtan la phab na dga'/ /gsal stong rjen pa'i dga' ston ma myong yang / /don spyi tsam gyi nges pa ma rnyed na/ /gzhan gyi yar 'dren de yang long khrid yin/ /nam zhig 'chi bdag kha ru phyogs pa'i tshe/ /gdams ngag gcig chog phub 33

chung 'di med na/ /gdams ngag phal cher sdar ma'i lag cha bzhin/ /gal la bab tshe phan thogs 'byung ba dka'/ /don gyi gtso bo ma 'phyug tsam re mdzod/ /rang gi spyi bor thugs rje chen po sgoms/ /ngag gis yi ge drug ma'i gzungs sngags bgrongs/ /yid kyis sdug bsngal can la snying rje sgoms/ /de ltar byas na 'di phyi dge ste bzang / /phyi rabs mos ldan rnams kyis yid la zungs/ /bdag la 'phrad kyang kha chems 'di las med/ /bdag la 'brel thogs dad ldan pho mo rnams/ /g.yu lo bkod pa'i zhing du skye bar shog /yul phyogs 'dir yang bkra shis lo yag cing / /kun kyang bde skyid dpal la spyod par shog /ces gsungs pa la go rgyu chen po 'dug de nas lo bcu gnyis bcu gsum gyi dus na/ gsang sngags rnying ma'i zhi rgyas dbang drag gi phyag len la mkhas pa'i bla ma o rgyan 'phrin las rnam rgyal bkra shis 'khyil 'og ma na bzhugs pa'i drung du song nas/ bka' brgyad bde 'dus/ phur pa yang gsang bla med/ gshin rje gshed dregs pa 'joms byed kyi rta mgrin sogs kyi cho ga'i 'don rim/ gtor ma dang / bsrung bzlog gi 'khor lo 'bri tshul sogs phyag len rnams bslabs pas tshegs med du shes pas thugs mnyes pa byung / khong la ngas 34

chos spyod kha shas kyi lung zhus pas/ khong gis nga la chos dgos na sngon du dka' ba spyad thub na de nas ster gsungs/ ngas de lags zhus nas/ khong gi mtshams khang nang la 'dam rgyag pa'i chu nyi ma re re la yang lan bcu gsum tsam re blangs 'dam badzis/ khong gis 'dam brgyab/ chu nyi ma mang por blangs pas sked pa tsha ba byung / da sked pa tsha zhus pas/ sngon rje btsun chen pos khyod kyi 'dis mi tshad sa rdo mang po khur nas sku rgyab la sgal ba gsum tsam byung ba de ma go 'am gsungs pas/ de bden snyam nas nyi ma bco lnga tsam la chu blangs pas khong gi thugs dgyes nas/ chos spyod thar lam dkar po dang / o rgyan bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ 'jam dbyangs zhi ba'i bsgom bzlas/bsangs mchod bkra shis 'khyil ba/ dam can spyi'i gtor 'bul gyi lung sogs gang 'dod rnams gnang nas/ da khyod kyis 'jig rten ma byed par chos rnam dag cig gyis dang yong bar gda' gsungs/ chos ji ltar byas na legs zhus pas/chos rnam dag cig byed na rje btsun mi la ras pa'i rnam thar la ltos/ khong gi rjes su kha mig yar lta gyis la chos sgrubs dang bzang gsungs/ de nas lo bcu bzhi'i steng du gsang sngags rdo rje'i theg pa'i bskyed rdzogs rdzogs chen gye rtogs pa mngom/ du 35

gyur pa'i grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po 'jam dpal rdo rje rin po che la/ zho 'ong sngags mang gis rdor sems kyi dbang dang /rdzogs chen a ti zab don gyi khrid zhag bdun gyi bar du zhus pa'i dus su/ nga yang gral du bsdad nas nyan pas/ khong gis thun mong gi chos bshad gnang ba'i skabs su thams cad la nges 'byung dang skyo shas skyes pa byung / dngos gzhi'i skabs su sems tshol byas nas/ sngags pa re re bzhin mdun du bos nas dris/ skabs shig nga yang mdun du bos nas song tshe/sems ci 'dra zhig red gsungs/ ci yang mi rnyed gi lags zhus pas/ khyod da dung lo chung chung red/ ma rnyed na yang chog gsungs/ de nas sngags pa thams cad 'dus nas khong gis sems ngo sprod pa'i skabs su/ rang gi sems kyi gnas lugs stong gsal 'dzin med nam mkha' lta bur ngo 'phrod pa byung bas/ bla ma dang sngags rgan phal che bas sngon gyi las 'phro can zhig yin par 'dug ces gleng / de'i rjes su lo re bzhin sngags mang dang / tshes bcu'i a mchod rnams kyis chos zhu dus ngas kyang nyan pas/ phur pa'i dbang dang / mkha' spyod ma'i rjes gnang / gu ru le'u bdun/ bsam pa lhun 'grub/rig 'dzin gdung sgrub/ sgol ma/ mdo gdugs dkar/ seng 36

gdong ma/ tshe gzungs sogs kyi lung thob pa byung / de nas bzung ste shes rgyud je 'jam du song / bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams dang ldan zhing mi su dang 'grogs kyang mthun pa zhig byung / lo bco lnga'i thog la byen rlabs kyi rtsa ba slob dpon rin po che la gsol ba 'debs dgos snyam nas/ rig 'dzin gdung sgrub kyi cho ga la brten nas badz+ra gu ru sa ya gcig bton pas/ rmi lam du nam mkha' la 'phur ba dang / nyi zla mthong ba/ gyen la 'gro ba/ rin po che'i gter rnyed pa sogs rmis/de nas bzung ste o rgyan chen po'i thugs rjes bla ma la mos gus/mched grogs la brtse gdung / sems can la snying rje/ chos la dag snang skyes nas chos gang byed kyang bar chad med par bsam pa'i nang ltar byed rgyu'i skal ba byung / de'i rjes su lo bcu drug gi steng du shes rab kyi lha gcig bsgrub dgos snyam nas/ smin gling gi gter kha'i 'jam dbyangs zhi ba'i bsnyen mtshams la yang lo gcig bsdad pas mtshams g.yog a mas byas te/ a ra pa tsa sa ya gcig bton pas/ rmi lam du gser dang dngul gyis bris pa'i glegs bam rnyed pa byung / 'khor lo dang / ral gri rdor dril rnyed pa sogs rmis/ de nas bzung rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi thugs rjes shes rab che ru song 37

nas zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos kyi don phal cher rags rim go ba byung / lo bcu bdun gyi steng gling rgya'i lha bzo bstan pa dar rgyus bsten nas lha bris shig kyang bslabs pas ri mo legs po zhig kyang shes/ sngags 'chang 'dus spyi'i don la mkho ba'i bsrung bzlog gi 'khor lo dang liṅga sogs mang du bris/mched grogs dang dad pa can mang po la tsakli dang btags grol yang mang po bris nas byin/ rang gzhan la mkho ba'i dpe cha yang mang po bris pas/ skabs shig yi ger shin tu byang nas dpyid kyi nyi ma re la shog gu sna thung brgya re 'bri thub pa byung bas kun ngo mtshar bar gyur/ de'i skabs su gsar rnying gnyis ga'i chos kun mkhyen pa'i grub pa'i dbang phyug 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho rin po che de nyid rgyal mkhan chen mchog gis bkra shis 'khyil du gdan drangs pa dang mjal nas/ sngags mang dang lhan du stag tshang phur ba'i dbang dang rdzogs chen kun bzang snying thig gi khrid lan gsum tsam thob/ gzhan yang ban+de dang sngags pa mang pos chos zhu dus su zhi khro dam pa rigs brgya'i dbang dang / kun rigs kyi dbang / bla ma mchod pa/ lam rim bsdus don/ blo sbyong don bdun ma/zhus lan bdud rtsi'i sman mchog thos grol/ rig pa gcer 38

mthong ngo sprod/ gol shor tshar gcod/ kun mkhyen zhal lung bdud rtsi'i thig pa/ rdor sems rigs lnga rgyan gcig la brten pa'i gtum mo'i lung khrid sogs bka' chos mang du thob/rdzogs chen gyi sngon 'gro 'don rim grangs tshang ba btang bas/khong gi thugs rjes rgyal ba'i gsung rab kyi gzhung don la go ba chags pa byung / de nas lo bco brgyad kyi thog tu zas nor la snying po mi 'dug pas chos shig bya dgos snyam pa'i skabs shig la/ gser mgar mkhas pa zhig gis o rgyan rin po che'i sku mtsho pad sdong lha lcam mtsho rgyal dang bcas pa'i gser sku zhig khyer 'ong ba la/ mdzo mo gnyis las med kyang gcig dang dā dkar bcas blu yon bzang po byen nas mnyes par byas/rab gnas la drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma rje btsun 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho rin po che gdan drangs nas sngags mang dang bcas pas rab tu gnas pa'i me tog 'thor zhing / dga' ston rgyas par byas pas yul mi kun kyang rjes su yi rang bar gyur/ de la brten nas ka shul gnyan rgya sogs kyis gser mgar de tshur bos nas sku mang po blugs pa byung ngo / /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho de nyid bkra shis 'khyel na bzhugs pa'i dus su yang yang sku mdun du song nas ci 'byor gyis mchod pa 39

phul/ ci gsung gi bka' bzhin bsgrubs pas thugs gtsigs che ba byung ngo //smras pa/ bstan pa'i bdag po ston pa bcom ldan 'das/ /bstan 'dzin zhabs dkar spyi bo'i rgyan du bzhugs/ /bstan la rab dga' rnal 'byor rnam thar 'di/ /bstan 'gro yongs la phan par byin gyis rlobs/ /bla mas rnam thar slob mas skyong ba la/ /thog mar bla ma'i rnam thar shes dgos pas/ /de phyir rang nyid gang du skyes pa'i tshul/ /slar yang glu ru len gyis dga' bas nyon/ /gling bzhi'i dbus kyi ri rab lho yi phyogs/ /rgya gar rdo rje gdan gye byang gi phyogs/ /dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing gi shar gye phyogs/ /tsong kha'i skyes ri mthon po'i lho yi phyogs/ /reb gong gser mo ljongs kyi sa yi cha/ /grub gnas brgyad kyi nang nas shel dgon gyi/ /nye 'dabs zho 'ong gnyan rgya zhes bya ba'i/ /sde ba de nyid skyes pa'i pha yul yin/ /pha ni grub dbang tsho 'du'i mkhan po dang / /ma ni bkra shis dpal brtsegs zhes bya las/ /lcags mo glang gi lo la skyes pa'i tshe/ /dpon gyis ming la ngag dbang bkra shis btags/ /rjes su sring mo gnyis kyang skyes pa'i ming / /klu mo byams dang klu mo skyid ces zer/ /cher song klu 40

mo byams ni mi la byin/ /klu mo skyid kyis rang gi pha yul bzung / /rang nyid skyes pa'i lo der yul khams la/ /lo phyugs legs shing bkra yang shis bo byung / /chung nas mi dge'i rtsed mo mi byed par/ /chos dang mthun pa'i rtsed mo sna tshogs byed/ /bsam pa bzang zhing zan cig za na yang / /gzhan la bgos nas ster ba yin zhes zer/ /ma yi pang na gnas dus 'ja' 'od dang / /thig le lha sku mang po'i mthong snang byung / /dpon gyis chos bshad byas pa thos nas bzung / /sdig la 'dzem zhing dge ba byed 'dod byung / /byis pa gzhan la yi ge slob pa'i dus/ /rang gis bltas pas tshegs med shes pa byung / /zho 'ong sngags mang chos thog gral du song / /chos 'don thams cad dga' nas tshe ring zer/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma chu dmar rin po ches/ /bdag cag ston pa rab tu byung tshul sogs/ /gsungs pa go nas rang yang de ltar du/ /rab tu byung na snyam pa yang yang byung / /drung nas bsnyen gnas sdom pa blangs nas bsrungs/ /rje btsun o rgyan 'phrin las rnam rgyal gyi/ /drung nas cho ga phyag len rgyas par bslabs/ /khong gis khyod kyis chos shig byas na yong / /rje btsun mi la lta bur gyis zhes gsungs/ /grub dbang 'jam dpal rdo rje'i zhabs drung 41

nas/ /rdzogs chen a ti zab don dbang khrid sogs/ /nyan dus sems kyi gnas lugs shes pa byung / /bla ma mched grogs 'ga' res sngon sbyangs kyi/ /las 'phro can zhig yin par 'dug ces gleng / /de nas bzung ste shes rgyud 'jam du song / /su dang 'grogs kyang kun dang mthun pa byung / /lo gcig badz+ra gu ru'i bsnyen pa btang / /bar chad med par bsam don chos bzhin 'grub/ /phyir lo 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi bsnyen pa byas/ /zab rgya'i chos don phal cher go ba byung / /skabs der lha bris shig kyang bri tshul bslabs/ /ri mo yi ge bris nas gzhan la byen/ /yi ge mgyogs pas shog gu brgya re tsam/ /nyin rer bris pas thams cad ngo mtshar skyes/ /tshe 'dir yi ge bris tshad thams cad po/ /bsam na bka' 'gyur tsam zhig bris sam snyam/ /de nas gsar rnying gnyis ka mkhyen pa yi/ /bla ma 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho'i zhal snga nas/ /rdzogs chen kun bzang snying thig dbang khrid sogs/ /gsar rnying mdo sngags bka' chos mang bo thob/ /gzhung don rnams la go ba chags pa byung / /bsags pa'i nor la snying po mi 'dug snyam/ /snying po len phyir pad 'byung sku zhig bzhengs/ /de la brten nas bzheng mkhan mang po byung / /rtsa ba'i bla ma 'jam 42

dbyangs rin po cher/ /yang yang mjal zhing ci 'byor mchod pa phul/ /lus ngag zhabs tog ci gsung bka' bzhin du/ /bsgrubs pas bdag la thugs gtsigs chen po gnang / /mdor na skyes nas bzung ste pha yul nas/ /dge ba'i bshes bsten sdig spangs dge ba bsgrubs/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi rnam thar de ltar lags/ /rjes 'jug rnams kyang de bzhin skyong bar mdzod/ /glu 'di thos tshad skye bo pho mo yis tshe rabs kun tu bla ma'i rnam thar bzhin/ /chung nas bzung ste dge ba'i bshes gnyen sten/ /mi dge spangs nas dge la gzhol bar shog /ces pa'ang bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o//43

rab tu byung tshul/gnyis pa 'jig rten 'khor ba'i chos la snying po med par bsams nas khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung ba'i tshul ni/nyin gcig rtsa ba'i bla ma 'jam dbyangs rin po che'i sku mdun du song tshe/ khyod kyis ci 'dod chung ma zhig len rgyu ma yin nam gsungs pa'i lan du bdag gis 'di skad ces zhus/ 'jig rten 'khor ba 'di'i nang du mi skye ba'i smon lam thobs/ 'jig rten khyem thab byas nas sdug bsngal myong ba tsho la bltas na/bdag gis chung ma zhig blangs na mi 'dod par ma zad/ tshe blos btang nas bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams kyi gsung bzhin ri khrod dben pa'i dga' tshal bsten nas dam pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsi zhig 'thung na snyam pa lags zhus pas/ de la khong shin tu mnyes nas/ 'o bu de yin khyod kyis ma 'phyugs 'dugasha chang 'dod yon longs spyod 'khor ba'i phun tshogs 'di rnams 'phral du nyams dga' la/ gzugs dang lang tsho rgyas pa'i na chung gzhon nu ni bslu brid mkhas pas/ gzhon grogs lha yi bu mo byung yang ma chags shig ma zhen cig de'i rgyu 44

mtshan gang yin zhe na/ spyir 'jig rten 'khor ba'i chos thams cad la snying po med cing mi rtag mi brtan cing sdug bsngal gye rang bzhin du snang / sgos su 'jig rten khyem thab 'di me'i 'obs/ srin mo'i gling / dug sbrul gyi tshang lta bu yin la/'khor ba'i phun tshogs nor longs spyod 'dzom po rnams kyang dug dang 'dres pa'i kha zas/ spu gri'i kha yi sbrang rtsi/ dug sbrul mgo yi nor bu ltar reg na yang phung na/ de nyid bsten pa smos ci dgos dgongs nas/ sngon yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nas bzung / da lta'i skyes bu dam pa yan chad kyis tshe blos btang ste bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen gye drung nas mdo sngags chos kyi bdud rtsi blangs te/ ri khrod dben pa'i lngon shing gi bsil grib tu 'khod nas dam pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsi ngoms med du 'thungs pas/ nyams rtogs kyis lus stobs rgyas tshe rang gzhan gyi don gnyis bsgrub pa yin/ khyod kyis kyang dam pa gong ma'i rnam thar skyong rgyu zhig byung na rang gzhan gye don gnyis tshe 'dir 'grub par gdon mi za zhes slar yang tshigs su bcad nas 'di skad ces gsungs so//bla ma dam pa spyi bo'i rgyan du bzhugs/ /bdag gzhan yongs la thugs rje spyan gyis gzigs/ /bu bu de yin chung mas 45

ci zhig bya/ /chung ma 'khor bar 'ching ba'i zhags nag 'dra/ /mi 'dod sna dgu 'dren pa'i dgra dang 'dra/ /chung ma blangs na bde ba'i go skabs med/ /dug sbrul pang du blangs la bde yod dam/ /da ni blo sna bzang po ma 'gyur bar/ /sus thob 'tshengs pa dam pa'i chos la 'bod/ /chos la 'bad na bde skyid ngang gis 'byung / /spyi bo'i rgyan gyi mtshan ldan bla ma rje/ /mos pa'i bu yi shes rgyud byen gyes rlobs/ /zhes gsungs nas spyan cung zad zum nas/ bu khyod lo nyi shu'i nang la dam pa'i mgon dang mjal zhing / ri khrod dben pa'i bsil grib tu 'khod nas 'di ltar bsdad yod mod ces/ sku drang bor bsrang / spyan mi btsum par ha re byas te cung zad cig gnas lugs kyi ngang la mnyam par bzhag nas cig bzhad par gda'/ de da lta bsam na lung bstan du 'dug rjes nas khong gis gsungs pa nang ltar ri khrod nas sgom sgrub byed rgyu'i skal ba byung / de dus yul gyi pha spun gzhon nu rnams kyis khyod la bud med cig len ran zer/ a ma dang sha nye rnams kyis kyang / a ma'i ming bo lo nyi shu rtsa gcig gi steng nas shi song bas chung ma gzhon nu zhig yod pa de la bdag gyis/ yang na chung ma gzhan zhig len dgos/ de gnyis la gdam kha gyis 46

zer/ de'i lan du ngas 'di skad ces/ kye drin can gyi ma dang /sha nye rnams nyon dang bdag gis chos shig byed snyam yod pas/chung ma mi dgos zhes bshad pas/ cis kyang len dgos yul gzhi khang ba rnams la sus bdag byed/ bdag ma byas na bu ma skyes pa dang khyad ci yod/ chos byed na pha yul nas kyang byas chog a khu 'di tshos kyang chos 'di 'dra byed kyin 'dug zer/dpe 'jog dang tshad 'jog mang po byed par 'dug ngas chos pa de tsho'i chos de 'dras ci bya/ de bas chos ma byas pa dga'/ gal te chung ma len na/ ya rabs kyi bu mo/bltas na gzugs mdzes pa/ nyan na skad snyan pa/ 'grogs na sems bzang ba/ bshad na kha la nyan pa/ kun gyi yid du 'ong ba zhig len dgos/ de ma yin par bud med btsog pa kha la mi nyan pa zas zos nas nyal sdod pa zhig gis ci bya spras pas/ mi 'ga' re rgod cing 'dzum/ sha nye zhig na re/ khyod kyis 'dod pa ltar bud med bzang mo ci 'dra zhig len dgos rung / nged rnams kyis rgyu snon zas snon byas nas len zer ba la/ 'o ngas khyed rnams la rtsed mo byas pa yin/ 'jig rten gyi khams 'di na pha phyug gi bu mo gzugs mdzes pa/ skad snyan pa/sems bzang ba/lha'i bu mo mi yul du 'phos 'dra/ me tog pad+ma kha phye ba lta bu/47

blta bas chog mi shes pa/ 'jig rten khams na 'gran zla dang bral ba/ lha mi thams cad kyis smon pa'i gnas su 'gro ga 'ga' re/ khyim tshang phyug cing btsan pa gzhan gyi bu tsha lha phrug 'dra ba tshos chung mar blangs/gnyis gas mdzes pa'i gos gyon/mchor ba'i rgyan btags/ byi ru'i rna cha g.yo bzhin khrom thag gcod pa mthong tshe/ bu tsha bu mo 'di tsho la na rgyu rgas rgyu med par 'di ltar du yun ring bsdad na dga' ba la snyam na yang /lo 'ga'i 'phro nas/ khong gnyis la dgos pa'i bu dang / mi dgos pa'i bu mo byung nas/ na tsha skyid sdug mang bo'i thog tu byung ba dang / gnyis ga'i sems sdug pa'i stabs kyis mgyogs por rgas nas/ dang po'i gzhon nu de yin bshad na su'i rna bar 'gro/ lo lon rgan rgon btsog pa kun gyis yid du mi 'ong ba rer gnas 'gyur song ba mthong tshe/ ngas kyang chung ma gzhon nu zhig blangs kyang / nam zhig nged gnyis kyang lo na so rgas pas gtugs tshe/ rgan rgon btsog pa ga tsho lta bu rer 'gyur yong rgyu red snyam nas sems la skyo ba skyes song /da khyed rnams bsdebs nas nga la chung ma lha mo 'dra ba zhig blangs na yang 'dod pa mi skye bar/ deng sang gzhon dus 'dir dam pa gong ma'i rnam thar bzhin chos shig byas nas/ phyi mar 'khor ba'i nang 'dir 48

mi skye bar bde chen dag pa'i zhing du skyes nas/ skye 'chi 'du 'bral med pa'i 'khor dang 'grogs te dam pa'i chos kyi dga' ston la longs spyod pa'i smon lam thobs snyam pa byung zhes slar yang tshigs su bcad nas smras pa/rje rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang / /sprang lha chos nus par byin gyis rlobs/ /mi bdag gis rang la gros shig 'debs/ /khyed rnams kyang 'di la dar cig nyon/ /spyir phyi rol dngos po gang la yang / /bsam bsams na mi rtag snying po med/ /de'i nang nas 'khor ba'i khyim thab la/ /ngas bsam zhing skyo ba gting nas skyes/ /gzhan rgan rgon lo lon mthong ba'i tshe/ /rang chung ma gzhon nu blangs na yang / /dus nam zhig 'di ltar rgas yong snyam/ /ngas bsam zhing skyo ba gting nas skyes/ /gzhan grong ba'i sdug bsngal mthong ba'i tshe/ /rang 'jig rten khyim thab byas na yang / /dus nam zhig 'di ltar sdug bsngal snyam/ /ngas bsam zhing skyo ba gting nas skyes/ /rje gong ma'i rnam thar mthong ba'i tshe/ /yar dam pa'i lha chos byed nus na/ /dus nam zhig 'di ltar skyid yong snyam/ /ngas bsam zhing dad pa gting nas skyes/ /rje rgyal ba gong ma'i rnam thar bzhin/ /ngas lha chos byed pa'i smon lam 'debs/ /rje rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo 49

rje 'chang / /sprang lha chos nus par byen gyis rlobs/ /zhes smras nas thabs du ma'i sgo nas gzhan gyi bu mo yang ma blangs/sngar bdag po gyes zer ba'i bud med gzhon nu ma de la yang bdag po ma byas pas/ sha nye zhig gi bus bdag byas pas mo yang dga' zhing / ngas kyang chos bsgrub pa'i grogs su song /skabs shig a ma dang / mched grogs sha nye ban+de zer ba gnyis 'khon dus/ ngas bar bshol nas dam tshig ma dkrugs/ phyi nas kho'i khro ba zhi dus nga yang khyim du bos nas nged gnyis kyis ja chang 'thung zhor la chos 'jig rten gyi gleng mo mang po byas tshe/kho na re nga'i khong khro 'di zhes rang la gshe zhing / nga la khyod bzang zhes bstod ra brjod par gda'/ nga yul na sdod dus kyang bsam bzhin gzhan la gnod pa'i tshig ngan tsam yang smra ma myong / chos thog dang / chos nyan byed pa'i dus su byeng rmugs gnyid gsum sangs pa'i phyir/ ngas ngo mtshar ba'i gtam rgyud dang ku re sna tshogs byas pas/ kun bzhad sgra di ri ri byed cing / la las bsam blo gtong bzhin yang yang rgod/ngas e zhes gtam gyi 'go gleng dus nas phal cher rgod cing /sngags 'chang rgan pa 'ga' res ja mtshams su yang ngag dbang bkra shis kyis ku re zhig shod zer spro spro byed/ ngas kun gyi 50

sems la mi gnod pa'i gtam rgod rgyu mi thub par 'chor ba du ma smras/ gzhan yang sde ba kun 'tshogs thog dang / ston mo sogs kyi steng nas skye bo pho mo kun dga' zhing spro ba 'phel ba'i ku re dang rtsed mo sna tshogs pa byas pas/ phyis ngas tshe blos btang nas song ba'i rjes su yang / rgan rgon 'ga' res gleng nas rgod par gda' zer/ yang skabs rer rgan rgon mang po la rje btsun skal ldan rgya mtsho'i gsung mgur dbyangs byas blangs te ma ṇi 'don du bcug shes tshad kyi don bshad nas rgan rgon rnams kyi blo kha chos la bsgyur/ gsung mgur nang na/khyed dben pa'i ri la yid spro na/ /ri na bun can gyi skyibs shed na/ /g.ya' rdza brag gi phug pa rang byung yod/ /gnas de 'dra bsten na 'phral phugs skyid/ /ces pa la sogs pa'i ri khrod dben pa'i bsngags brjod kyi skor rnams 'don pa'i tshe/gnas dben pa 'di 'dra zhig bsten pa'i skal ba nam zhig na 'ong ngam snyam yid smon shor ba byung / dus nam zhig rtsa ba'i bla ma 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho rin po che'i sku snyung tshul bstan tshe/bkra shis 'khyil du ma bzhugs par sgom phug zer bar phebs shing snyun g.yog dang zhabs brtan mang po bsgrubs kyang ma phan par zhing brjes song bas/ rang nyid bzod glags med pa'i 51

mya ngan gyis gdungs te/ yul du 'ongs te a ma la 'thams nas mya ngan shugs drag byas smre sngags kyang 'di ltar thal lo//lha rnams kun gyis re ltos pa'i/ /dpag bsam ljon shing glo bur 'gyel/ /dpag bsam ljon shing 'gyel shul nas/ /nyam thag lha yis ci zhig bya/ /dbul po rnams kyis re ltos pa'i/ /yid bzhin nor bu gzhan gyis brkus/ /yid bzhin nor bu med shul nas/ /nyam thag dbul pos ci zhig bya/ /slob ma rnams kyis re ltos pa'i/ /drin can bla ma zhing gzhan gshegs/ /mtshan ldan bla ma gshegs shul nas/ /nyam thag bdag gis ci zhig bya/ /cang shes rta mchog la zhon nas/ /sa steng kun tu btsal gyur kyang / /de 'dra'i bla ma gang nas rnyed/ /da ni bla mar gang nas mjal/ /zhes yun ring ngus pas a mas yang mchi ma 'byin zhing nga'i sems gso ba'i phyir du/ ma yis chung nas bskyangs pa'i bu gcig po/ /mya ngan ma byed a ma'i gtam la nyon/ /sku drin khyod la che ba phar la zhog /ngar yang chos 'brel che ba'i bla ma yin/ /glo bur bla ma gshegs la sems skyo yang / /shul nas mya ngan byas pas ci la phan/ /bla ma'i thugs dgongs yongs su rdzogs pa'i phyir/ /ci yod nor gyis gdung mchod byas na legs/ /zhes a mas de 52

skad smras pa la brten nas mya ngan cung zad zhi/ da gdung mchod la nor gyi nang nas mdzo mo bzang po zhig yod pa de phul na snyam nas/ a ma la smras pas/ ngas kyang de ka bsam pa yod de chog gi zer/ nangs par sha nye zhig 'ongs nas/ sha tsha ba'i phyir mdzo mo gdung mchod du 'bul rgyu red zer ba e bden zer/ ngas bden smras pas/ kho na re/ sngags mang tshos ci 'dra 'bul ltos/ de'i cha 'dra zhig phul dang chog khyod kyi pha ma ni min mdzo mo ma 'bul zer ba'i lan du ngas 'di skad ces smras so// sha nye khyod kyis snying nye'i gtam/ /tshig 'di bshad pa yin mod kyang / /nga yi sems dang 'gal nas gda'/ /pha ma min pa khyod bden yang / /sku drin pha dang ma las lhag /'bad rtsol med par zab rgya'i chos/ /gang 'dod bdag la lhug par bstsal/ /nyams len nus na mngon mtho dang / /nges legs go 'phang 'thob nus pa'i/ /skal pa can du bdag byas so/ /gtan gyi bde ba ster mdzad pa'i/ /bla ma'i drin lan 'jal dgos na/ /stong gsum gser phyes bkang nas kyang / /phul yang gzhal bar dka' 'o ang / /mdzo mo med par de ring nas/ /khyem tshang 'thor yang nga mi 'gyod/ /sha nye 'gyod pa ga 53

la 'ong / /sangs rgyas brgya mchod stong mchod las/ /bla ma'i ba spu gcig mchod lhag /dus gsum rgyal bas mgrin gcig gsungs/ /zhes smras pas/ sha nye na re/ khyed ma bu tsho'i kha mi sos snyam nas bsam pa dkar po'i ngos nas bshad pa yin/ kha la mi nyan na ngas dge ba'i kha 'gags byed don med zer nas song ngo / /ngas mdzo mo khrid de gdung mchod kyi thebs su phul nas thugs dgongs rdzogs shing yang sprul 'byon pa'i smon lam yang mang po btab bo/ /gzhan yang sngags rgan tshe 'bum rgyal gyis gro sgo ba bdun dang / grogs po sngags 'chang gzhan rnams kyis phye dang rtsam pa gang 'dzoms sgo ba gang re phul nas/zho 'ong ban brgya la rtsam pa go re 'gyed mang ja bcas gdung mchod phun sum tshogs pa zhig btang / rgyal mkhan chen rin po ches kyang gdung mchod gnang /sog po'i yul pa rnams kyis kyang go nas gdung mchod btang skad/ gzhan skye bo pho mo thos tshad phal cher gyis ngag dbang bkra shis kyi mdzo mo gcig bo yang gdung mchod du phul ba ngo mtshar zer ba byung / ngas de'i rjes su dpe cha zhig bris pas mdzo mo gcig 'byor/ sring mo gcig gzhan la byen pa'i rin du yang mdzo mo gcig chos shig bton nas mdzo mo gcig byung bas de rnams kyang bla ma'i 54

thugs rje red snyam/ de nas sku gdung bzhus pa'i nyin/ nam mkha' g.ya' dag cing / shar phyogs nas gdung khang gi steng du 'ja' kha dog lnga ldan yin pa la cung zad dkar shas che ba zhig 'then yod pa der 'tshogs pa'i bu slob kun gyis mthong bas/ bla ma la sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes 'bad rtsol med par skyes so/ /rtags de rnams la bltas na re zhig mngon dga'i zhing du gshegs pa yin nam snyam pa byung / de nas bla ma zhing gzhan du gshegs pa la sems skyo zhing pha yul du bag phebs po zhig ma byung bar brten/ chos grogs mthong sa'i mtshams pa dang/ stobs tshang bla ma sogs mched grogs 'ga' dang 'grogs nas/ gnas chen tan tig yang tig dang /byams pa 'bum gling / lo rgya dun bde mchog rang byon/ gad mgo su'i thugs rje chen po rang byon/ a 'gang rta mgrin rang byon/ mchod rten dkar po dang / lha lung gi gnas sogs rgya phyogs kyi rten rang byon byin chen dang / gnas chen rnams la mjal nas chos ldan gyi bya ba rnams 'grub pa'i smon lam yang yang btab/ yang lo gcig rgya lo'i smon lam dang / bdun pa'i rigs grwa gnyis la bla brang bkra shis 'khyil ba'i dgon par mjal du song / brkyangs phyag dang skor ba mang po byas/55

gser khang jo bo'i drung du mar me phul nas tshe 'dir lha chos rnam dag yong ba'i smon lam gyis mtshams sbyar zhing / de yang paṇa chen blo bzang ye shes kyi zhal nas/ dbus gtsang mnga' ris bar gyi grub pa'i mtha'/ /kun kyang rgyal bstan kho na yin pas na/ /phyogs lhung gdon gyis sdang shugs ma mdzad par/ /dag snang nor bu'i 'od kyis khyab na legs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ chos dang gang zag yongs la dad gus dang dag snang sbyong bzhin/ ris med bstan pa'i bdag po bse'i khri rgan ngag dbang 'jam dbyangs bkra shis rin po che'i drung nas/ chags med rā ga a gyes mdzad pa'i phyag rab cho ga dang / bde smon gnyis kyi lung thob/ lang 'gro'i sprul pa ngag dbang blo bzang bstan 'dzin rin po che'i drung nas/ gshin rje dregs pa 'joms byed kyi dbang dang / gsang bdag dregs pa kun 'dul gyi dbang / sde brgyad srog dbang dang / cho ga'i lung yang mang po thob/ mkhas grub gnyis 'dzoms be'u thang dpal ldan rin po che'i mdun nas/ thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal gye dbang dang / sgyung gnas cho ga'i lung thob/ grub dbang tsho 'du'i mkhan chen mchog gi drung nas/ phyag rdor dang /khyung khra/ khyung nag gi mngon rtogs/ sngags 'bum rdo rje'i go 56

khrab/ sha za hor mo'i gtor 'bum gyi lung bcas thob/ gso rig dbang phyug dge 'dun tshogs 'phel rin po che'i drung nas/blo sbyong snyan brgyud chen mo dang / phyir bcos bshags pa/ tsha bsur/ brgya rtsa/ dzam la'i chu sbyin/ za byed mkha' 'gro'i sbyin sreg rnams kyi lung thob/ nyang pa'i rab 'byams pa'i drung nas/ 'pho ba dpa' bo g.yul 'jug dang / gnas rang snang don gyi 'og min ma'i lung thob/ lha bzo 'jam dbyangs mchog gi drung nas/ dza bhir gye rlung khrid thob/ gzhan yang rang gi yul phyogs kyi bla ma mang po'i drung nas gsar rnying gnyis ga'i dbang lung mang du nyan nas/ lo nyi shu rtsa gcig gi thog la/da chos rnam dag cig myur du bya dgos par 'dug drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho rin po che yang / gdul bya rtag 'dzin can rnams chos la bskul ba'i phyir gzugs sku mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshul ston na/ bdag cag lta bu myur du 'chi ba smos ci dgos/ da pha yul dang ma sring sogs tshe 'di'i bya ba rnams blos btang ste/ yul gzhan thag ring zhig tu song nas chos rnam dag cig bya dgos pas mi tshad 'phyis song snyam pa dang / skyo ba tshad las 'das pa zhig skyes nas ma la 'di skad smras/ a ma spyir 'chi ba myur du 'ong zhing / sgos su nam 57

'ong cha mi 'dug pas/ da ngas chos rnam dag cig bya rgyu yin/chos rnam dag cig byed pa la/de yang mdo las/ 'khor ba khab kyi rtse mo na/ /bde ba nam yang yod ma yin/ /gsungs pa ltar/spyir 'khor ba'i gnas 'di'i mtho dman gang du skyes kyang sdug bsngal gyi gnas/ su dang 'grogs kyang sdug bsngal gye grogs/ ci la longs spyad kyang sdug bsngal gyi longs spyod/ bya ba ci byas kyang sdug bsngal bsgrub pa'i thabs 'ba' zhig las mi 'dug khyad par khyem na gnas pa ni me yi 'obs/ srin mo'i gling / dug sbrul gyi tshang lta bu'i sdug bsngal gye 'byung gnas su sangs rgyas kyis gsungs 'dug pas/ da nga khyem nas khyim med par rab tu byung nas chos ma byas thabs rang mi 'dug pas/ de la a ma'i gnang ba zhig dgos byas pas ma na re/ bu spyir snyigs dus su song / sgos su reb gong lung ba 'dir rang la bu re nang na med na/ gzhan kun gyis sdang bar 'dug yang sgos su nga la bu khyod las med pas na ma nga rgas na kha mi sos/ de bas ma nga snying rje na/ chung ma zhig blangs nas/ khyim nas chos sgrubs dang / sngar bas lhag pa'i mthun rkyen bsgrub zer ba'i lan du/ slar yang tshigs su bcad nas 'di skad ces smras/ 58

drin can a ma bdag la cung zad gson/ /'jig rten 'khor ba'i gnas na bde ba med/ /de yi nang nas khyim 'di me yi 'obs/ /chung ma thar pa'i srog 'phrog bdud mo yin/ /nga ni khyim nas rab tu byung nas su/ /ma bu'i gtan bde'i btsan sa zin pa'i phyir/ /tshe 'dir dam pa'i lha chos byed pa la/ /ma yis cis kyang brtse ba'i gnang ba zhu/ /zhes smras pas/ a ma na re/ bu khyod la gnang ba ma byen na chos kyi bar chad du 'gro/byen na ma nga rjes nas dka' rgyu red mod kyang / da dka' rung gnang ba byin pa yin/ chos mgo mthar thon pa'i smon lam thobs zer nas mig nas mchi ma zhig gtong bar gda'/ nga dga' nas a ma drin can ma da bzang / khyod kyis sems ma sdug dang / nged ma bu gnyis kyi 'di phyi'i bsam don 'grub par nges so smras te a ma la spro ba bskyed/ de nas dben gnas bkra shis 'khyil du 'ongs te/ rgyal mkhan chen rin po cher mjal nas/ rgyu mtshan rnams zhus tshe thugs shin tu mnyes te/de yin na yongs 'dzin a rig dge bshes rdo bis dgon par gdan 'dren zhu rgyu yin/ de dus sku gzhogs la kha sprul sku tshang yang bsnyen rdzogs bsgrub rtsis yin pas/ de dang lhan du stabs kyang 'phrod pa'i rten 'brel bzang / de nas khyod dpon tshang 59

chos rgyal ngag gi dbang bo'i drung du song na bzang / de phyogs la ngas 'khrid/ khyod kyi blo ma 'gyur/ sngags pa 'di'i phal cher blo 'gyur ldog mang / khyod blo ma 'gyur ba gyis gsungs/de dus ngas chos rgyal mchog gi mtshan go ba tsam gyis lus kyi ba spu g.yo zhing mig nas mchi ma 'khrugs pa'i dad pa skyes/mjal 'dod skom pa chu 'dod pa ltar byung nas/ der ci la thug kyang 'gro snyam pa yang yang byung / rgyal mkhan chen rin po ches nga la/ khyod la gzan sham gyi rgyu e yod gsungs/ bdag gis med de da thabs shig byed dgos rgyu red zhus pas/ da gzhan la btsal du 'gro mi dgos gzan sham ngas ster/ chos ci 'dra zhig byed khyod la gsal gsungs/ de dus slar yang yul du 'ongs nas a ma dang / sha nye stobs tshang ban+de zer ba'i drin can zhig yod pa de gnyis kyi drin gzo ru btags grol grong khyer sgol ba re bris nas mgul du btags/ de nas rdo bis dgon du song nas/ gzan sham sogs gon pa rnams bzos/ de dus nga la ral ba mtho lnga tsam yod pa ri khrod pa dge slong zhig gis/ thog mar bal 'breg pa'i has gri rnon po zhig gis blangs tshe/ dge slong na re/ zho 'ong gi lug shed ci zhig bzang ni red/ 'breg mtshams phyes 'dug ces ku re byas 60

pas/ kun bzhad gad thag ge byung / de'i mtshan mo nga'i rmi lam du ri mgo mthon po zhig tu phyin pas la mgo nas sbra yol zhig gis lam bcad 'dug pa de mi zhig gis bkrol nas nga ri rtse ru song dus nyi ma yang shar 'dug mtshams khang zhig na jo bo rje'i sku zhig bzhugs pa la mjal ba rmis/ de nas lcags mo bya'i lo spron zla'i dkar phyogs kyi tshes brgyad kyi nyin snga dro'i cha la/ shing rta'i srol 'byed 'phags mchog klu sgrub kyi sprul pa/mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi yon tan kun dang ldan pa'i gnas brtan 'dul ba 'dzin pa chen po a rig dge bshes rin po che mtshan brjod par dka' ba byams pa dge legs rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas kyis mkhan po dang /bstan pa'i gsal byed dam pa rgyal mkhan chen dge 'dun bstan pa'i nyi ma rin po ches gsang ston mdzad de/ dge 'dun grangs tshang ba'i dbus su/ la kha sprul sku rin po che la sogs pa'i rab byung bsnyen rdzogs pa mang po dang lhan du/ bstan pa'i go rim bzhin rab byung dge tshul bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa yang dag par nos/ ming la byams pa chos dar du btags/ mkhan po'i zhal nas/ bstan 'gro la phan thogs chen po yong gsung thugs dgyes par mdzad do/ /gzhan yang tshogs mang gis 61

zhus nas kun rigs kyi dbang dang / bde lam gye lung yang thob pa byung / de yang / khrims ni rgyu dang mi rgyu'i sa bzhin du/ /yon tan kun gyi gzhi rten lags par gsungs/ /zhes pa ltar/ dge legs thams cad kyi gzhi rten so so thar pa'i bslab pa rin po che yin par go nas/ gung tshigs lham phud chab len yan chad chos bzhin 'dul ba bzhin byas/ de nas yar rang yul du 'ong dus lam kha zhig na/ sha nye a yes klu mo yag ces bya ba 'jig rten pa'i gtam la mkhas pa/ dgra gnyen la chags sdang gi rus thon pa/ nga la yang sha tsha ba zhig yod pa des mthong nas/ nga ngo ma shes par khyod su yin zer/ ngas nga ngag dbang bkra shis yin smras pas/ mo na re/ a ma khyod kyi bya ba 'di btsog ang / gnyan rgya'i tshe dbang ngag dbang gi shul chad pa 'dra/ khyod bu ma skyes/ rjes nas a ma'i kha mi sos par sdug mthong tshe/ sde ba'i dpe dang tshad 'jog byed dus btsog mod zer ba'i lan du ngas 'di skad ces smras so/ /sha tsha snying nye a yes nga la nyon/ /de ring tshig 'di bshad pa ma 'khrul lam/ /nga yis btsog 'dre thams cad spangs nas ni/ /legs pa'i 'go bo da nas tshugs pa yin/ /'khor ba'i gnas na bde ba med bzhin du/ /zhen cing chags pa rnams kyi 62

bya ba btsog /'khor bar 'ching byed pha ma chung mar chags/ /pha yul btson rar lhung ba'i bya ba btsog /khyim tshang bza' mi'i lto rgyab gnyis kyi phyir/ /mi dge sdig las byed pa'i bya ba btsog /mi tshe yad ma yud kyi ngang la shor/ /chos med pha rol 'gro ba'i bya ba btsog /pha rol song na mi dge'i las dbang gis/ /ngan song gsum du 'gro ba'i bya ba btsog /nga yis khyem pa'i gos hrul thang la 'phangs/ /rab mdzes ngur sprig 'chang ba'i lus po legs/ /ngag gis don med ngag 'khyal smra ba dor/ /kha ton bzlas brjod byed pa'i ngag kyang legs/ /yid kyis mi dge'i bsam pa thams cad spangs/ /dge ba'i bsam pa skyes pa'i sems kyang legs/ /khyem gye me ma mur gyi 'obs nas 'thon/ /rab byung bsil khang thob pa'i bya ba legs/ /tshe 'dir skyid la phyi mar song na yang / /gyen nas gyen du 'gro ba'i bya ba legs/ /zhes smras pas mo na re/ da lta gzan sham gyon nas sham sham byas 'gro ba legs te/ a yes lo kha shas ma shi bar bsdad na go rgyu 'dra yong mod snyam/ sngar chos mdzad phal cher gye bya ba 'ga' re a mas mthong / chos mgo mthar thon pa 'di dka' mo zhig red/ da bzang gi bzang gi i ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ zhes ma ṇi ring 'don thung 'don byas nas song ngo / /de dus 63

a yes rgan mo'i gtam de mi snyan yang / rjes su sems la phan thogs po byung / gzhan dad can rgan rgon 'ga' res mthong nas/ las can po zer/ yul du 'ongs pas ma dang sring mo gnyis kyis mthong nas sems shin tu dga' bar gyur to//smras pa/ rgyal srid spangs nas rab byung dka' thub mdzad/ /rgyal ba'i go 'phang brnyes nas chos 'khor bskor/ /rgyal ba shākya thub par gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyal khams bde zhing skyid par byin gyis rlobs/ /bla ma'i rnam thar skyong bar 'dod pa yi/ /rjes 'jug dad can yongs la phan pa'i phyir/ /rang nyid ji ltar rab tu byung ba'i tshul/ /slar yang glu ru len gyis dga' bas nyon/ /mkhas grub gong mas byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas/ /bkra shis 'khyil ba'i gzims chung nyams dga' ru/ /phan bde legs tshogs ma lus 'byung ba'i gnas/ /rje btsun 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho bzhugs dus su/ /rang nyid nyin gcig mjal du song ba'i tshe/ /thugs ni dgyes bzhin zhal ras 'dzum bzhin du/ /skal ldan bu khyod sems la ci zhig 'dod/ /chung ma zhig kyang len rgyu ma yin nam/ /gsungs pa'i lan du bdag gis 'di skad zhus/ /'khor ba'i nang 'dir mi skye smon lam thobs/ /khyim thab byas nas sdug bsngal 64

myong ba tshor/ /bltas pas khyim thab byas na mi 'dod cing / /tshe 'di blos btang dge ba'i bshes bsten nas/ /dben par lha chos byas na 'dod pa lags/ /zhes pas de la khong gi thugs mnyes nas/ /zhal nas bu bu de yin ma 'phyugs 'dug /sha chang 'dod yon longs spyod nyams re dga'/ /na chung gzhon nu ma rnams bslu brid mkhas/ /grogs su lha mo byung yang ma chags par/ /sngon byung bdag cag ston pa'i rnam thar bzhin/ /khyem gyi nang nas rab tu byung bar gyes/ /ring min myur du dam pa'i mgon dang mjal/ /dben pa bsten rgyu'i skal ba yod tshul gyi/ /lung bstan zhu yang ma dgos shugs kyis gsungs/ /rjes su bsam tshe dad gus lhag par skyes/ /de dus kun gyis chung ma len dgos zer/ /de dag rnams kyi kha la ma nyan par/ /rab tu byung dgos snyam pa yid la bcang / /kha nas rtsed mo rnam pa sna tshogs byas/ /de nas rtag‘ 'dzin can rnams dger bskul phyir / /rje btsun 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho gshegs tshul bstan/ /sems sdug skyo ba tshad las 'das pa byung / /gang yod nor gyis thugs dgongs rdzogs thabs byas/ /bla ma de nyid gshegs pas sems skyo nas/ /yul du bag phebs sdod snying ma 'dod par/ /chos mthun snying grogs 65

'ga' dang lhan cig tu/ /smad kyi gnas chen rnams la gnas bskor du/ /song bas rang byon rten kyang mang por mjal/ /dngos 'byor yid kyis sprul pa'i mchod pa phul/ /lha chos rnam dag 'ong ba'i smon lam btab/ /de nas phyir yong grub mtha' ris med kyi/ /bla ma mkhas grub skyes mchog mang po yi/ /zhabs la gtugs nas mdo rgyud man ngag gi /zab chos zhus nas ring bor ma lon par/ /ma la rab tu byung ba'i gnang ba blangs/ /drin can bla ma rgyal gyi mkhan chen la/ /brten nas rdo bis grwa tshang dgon par song / /lcags mo bya yi sgron zla'i yar ngo'i tshes/ /brgyad kyi nyin par snga dro'i dus kyi char/ /shing rta'i srol 'byed 'phags mchog klu sgrub kyi/ /sprul pa mkhas btsun bzang gsum kun 'dzoms pa'i/ /gnas brtan 'dul ba 'dzin pa dge ba'i bshes/ /byams pa dge legs rgyal mtshan zhabs drung nas/ /gsang ston dge 'dun kha grangs tshang dbus su/ /rab byung bsnyen rdzogs sgrub mkhan mang po dang / /lhan du so thar sdom pa yongs rdzogs blangs/ /ming la byams pa chos dar zhes byar btags/ /bstan 'gror phan thogs yong ba'i lung bstan byung / /tshul khrims chos kyi rtsa ba yin par go /gung tshigs lham phud chab len yan chad byas/ /66

yul la yong tshe rgan mo gcig tsam gyis/ /sha tsha'i kha nas rnar snyan ma byung yang / /yul mi khyim mtshes ma dang sring mo sogs/ /dga' nas gtam snyan mang po'i yong sgo byung / /mdor na 'khor ba snying po med tshul bsam/ /tshe 'di blo yis btang nas rab tu byung / /rnal 'byor bdag gi rnam thar de ltar lags/ /rjes 'jug rnams kyang de bzhin skyong bar mdzod/ /glu 'di thos tshad skye bo pho mo yis/ /tshe rabs kun tu bla ma'i rnam thar bzhin/ /'khor ba'i phun tshogs thams cad blos btang nas/ /rab tu byung nas chos la spyod par shog /ces pa'ang bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o//67

chos rgyal ngag gi dbang po'i zhabs pad bsten tshul/gsum pa pha yul rgyal tu spangs nas chos rgyal ngag gi dbang po'i zhabs pad bsten tshul ni/ rab tu byung nas yul du 'ongs pa'i phyi nyin/ me tog mang po khyer nas/ mdun ri'i phar rgyab bkag nags 'dabs kyi dgon phug ces bya ba na/rang gi drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho rin po che'i gdung rten sa las bzhengs pa zhig yod pa der mjal/me tog gi mchod pa phul nas/ da ni pha yul rgyab tu bzhag nas/da dung mtshan ldan gyi bla ma bsten te/ zab mo'i sgrub pa la gzhol ba'i skal ba yod pa'i phyir bla ma la gsol ba btab/smon lam yang de bzhin brgyab nas phyir 'ong dus/ rdo 'bum nyag kha zer ba na grogs po zhig 'gro ba mthong tshe/ rgyang nas rtsed mtshar du skad gseng mthon pos/ a khu bo zhes bos nas/gnyan rgya'i ngo gong ma gang yin/ brtsegs go tshang gi khang ba gang yin/ de pa'i bu sngags pa zhig yod pa yul na e yod smras pas/ kho na re/ sde ba ya ki yin/ khang ba 'dabs ma po de yin/ kho yul na e yod ma shes/ khyod gang nas yin zer/68

tshur 'ongs nas ngo shes nged gnyis bgad/ de nas sa der bsdad nas gtam gleng mang po byas pa'i mjug tu tshigs su bcad nas 'di skad ces smras/e ma skal ldan snying grogs nyon/ /grogs po ngag dbang bkra shis ngas/ /snying po med pa'i bya ba spangs/ /snying po'i lha chos bya snyam nas/ /lus po ngur sprig gos kyis g.yogs/ /ming spor byams pa chos dar zer/ /bsam pa dkar po'i chos la bsgyur/ /da ni bkra shis 'khyil ba sogs/ /dben pa'i gnas su dge sbyor byed/ /khyod kyang gzhon pa'i dus skabs 'dir/ /tshe 'di'i bya bas ma g.yengs par/ /yi dam lha la bsnyen bsgrub gyes/ /bla ma dam par chos 'brel zhog /rdo rje spun gyi dam tshig srungs/ /dbul po rnams la byams par mdzod/ /las 'bras rtsis la spang blang gyis/ /mdor na sgo gsum chos dang stun/ /'chi khar mi 'gyod tsam zhig mdzod/ /nged gnyis tshe ring nad med par/ /yang yang mjal ba'i smon lam 'debs/ /zhes smras pas/ kho na re/ khyod las can po thag ring tsho la ma 'gro zer bzhin song / nga yul du 'ong tshe chung nas 'dris che zhing / sems mthun pa'i snying grogs rdo rje tshe brtan gyis bos te khyim du song nas ja 'thung zhor la rab tu 69

byung tshul sogs gleng mo mang po byas pa'i mthar/ da nga sog po ru song nas chos rgyal ching wang rin po che'i zhabs la gtugs nas/ phyogs de'i ri khrod cig tu nyams len byas na snyam pa yod smras pas/ kho na re khyod kyi bsam don 'grub/ las can po/ ngas kyang khyod kyi rjes shig e zin blta/ da lo de 'dra'i skal bar ma ldan zer/ rjes su 'ong bar khas blangs/ de nas yul du 'ongs te ma la slar yang chos byed du bcug pa'i bka' drin che/ da ngas chos kyi sgo nas phan thogs pa zhig byed pa la/da dung thag ring gi bla ma mtshan dang ldan pa zhig bsten nas gdams pa zab mo nyan te dben par rtse gcig tu bsgom dgos par gda' bas/ de la sring mo gnyis kyi gcig mi la byin tshar kyang / da dung gcig yod par gda'/ nga lo kha shas yul phyogs gzhan zhig tu song na snyam pas gnang ba zhig sbyin dgos byas pas/ de'i lan du ma na re/ sngar gnang ba byen nas chos byed du bcug pa yin/ da ma nga ma shi'i bar du thag nye zhig tu bsdad na sems la phan par gda' zhes rgyu mtshan rnams 'di skad ces smras byung /ma ngas chung nas bskyangs pa'i snying gi bu/ /a ma bskyur nas yul phyogs gang du 'gro/ /dud 'gro'i be'u yin yang mar 70

mi 'bral/ /bu khyod ma dang 'bral bar ga la phod/ /bu khyod ma nga'i dpral ba'i mig dang 'dra/ /thag ring song na ma nga long dang 'dra/ /bu khyod ma nga'i khog pa'i snying dang 'dra/ /thag ring song na ma nga shi dang 'dra/ /bu khyod ma nga'i yan lag rnams dang 'dra/ /thag ring song na ma nga zha dang 'dra/ /de phyir ma nga'i rna bas thos sa dang / /mig gis mthong sa zhig nas cis kyang sdod/ /ces smras pa'i rjes su sring mo klu mo skyid na re/ mo yul du bsdad na a ma'i zhabs tog ma dgos rang gi kha yang mi sos gzhan gyis go rgas ma zer sdang po yong bas nga mi sdod ces 'di skad smras byung /ming pos a ma bzhag nas 'gro phod na/ /nga yis bsgyur nas 'gro ba cis mi phod/ /pha yul bu mos zin pa dka' mo yin/ /nga yang mi sdod mi khyem gzhan du 'gro/ /dus ngan bu mo phal cher rang gi kha/ /sos par dka' na a ma ga la sos/ /go rgas ma zer kun gyis rab tu sdang / /a mar skyid sdug ci gtong khyod rang shes/ /zhes zer zhing ngus pa'i lan du ngas 'di skad smras/ma ngu sring mo nga la nyon/ /tshar bu'i gos las dro ba med/ /gser g.yu'i rgyan las mdzes pa med/ /tsan dan dri 71
