las zhim pa med/ /ma yi gam las skyid pa med/ /nyon dang sring mo klu mo skyid/ /ngas kyang khyod dang ma rgan gnyis/ /thag ring song rung cis mi skyong / /nyi ma rgyang ring gnas na yang / /pad tshal rgyun du skyong la ltos/ /lo tog phyir du 'bad gyur na/ /sog ma zhor la 'byung ba ltar/ /phyi ma'i don du ngas 'bad na/ /tshe 'di'i bde skyid zhor la 'byung / /nyon dang sring mo klu mo skyid/ /mi khyim song na bde snyam pa/ /dong nang bde'o snyam pa 'dra/ /a nes zas mnar chu mnar byed/ /a myes kha log tshig log rgyag /grogs kyis rdo dang dbyug pas brdungs/ /khyim mtshes de tshad de nyos zer/ /nyin gcig sdod pa'i rang dbang med/ /g.yog nag byas kyang ngo med bsdigs/ /nyon dang sring mo klu mo skyid/ /rang gi yul las skyid pa med/ /gong na gnya' gnon med pas bde/ /ci byed rang dbang 'thob pas bde/ /bag phebs bde bar nyal bas bde/ /zas rnams ci bder spyad pas bde/ /gang yod gon pa gyon pas bde/ /sring mo rang gi yul du sdod/ /rgyun du a mar brtsi bkur gyes/ /bkur gnas 'di las bzang ba med/ /nga yang thag ring mi 'gro bar/ /ma dang sring mos zer bzhin byed/ /ces smras nas/ da a ma dang sring mo la drang por 72

bshad na mi gtong bar gda'/ rdzun cig bshad dgos/ yul gye thag nyer bsdad pas chos mi yong / chos phyir dzun bshad pa la nyes pa chung snyam/ ma dang sring mo gnyis la/ nga da lo rgyal mkhan chen rin po che'i rjes su sog por 'gro mthun rkyen zhig btsal nas khyer yong la/ de nas bkra shis 'khyil ba nas 'dug ces bshad pas/ a mas de yin na chog gi zer/ sring mo gnyis na re/ 'di song na phyir mi 'ong / de bas da lta 'gro ru ma 'jug zer ba la/ a mas da kho rang shes zer bas ngas kyang 'gro bar thag bcad de/ yul nas zhag po bdun tsam zhig sdod ring la ma dang sring mo rnams kyi sems la phan pa'i chos dang 'jig rten 'di'i bslab bya gang phan byas/ nangs par 'gro ba'i dgong mo gogs po rdo rje tshe brtan yod sar song nas/ nga nangs par 'gro rgyu yin pas/ da phyin chad khyod kyis chang ma 'thung / mthu ma byed/ rang rgyud chos dang ci mthun gyis/ gzhan yang chos la skul/ chos thog dang tshes bcu je bzang du thongs/ dus rgyun du sems bzang po gyes zhes smras/khos kyang nga la sha tsha ba'i gtam sna tshogs pa smras pa'i bar de nas nged gnyis kyang 'bral ba la sems 'phreng nas mang po ngus pa'i mthar bdag gis 'di skad smras/73

bya rgyal rgod las skyes pa yi/ /chung nas 'grogs pa'i rgod phrug gnyis/ /da lta 'dab gshog rgyas dus 'dir/ /nga ni tshang la mi chags par/ /yul phyogs gzhan du 'phur nas 'gro /khyod ni da lta bde bar bzhugs/ /myur du nga phyir 'ong thub ltos/ /slar yang mjal ba'i smon lam 'tshal/ /bre ser 'brong las skyes pa yi/ /chung nas 'grogs pa'i 'brong phrug gnyis/ /da lta rtsal stobs ldan dus 'dir/ /nga ni rdza rir mi chags par/ /shod kyi spang gshong 'grim du 'gro /khyod ni da lta bde bar bzhugs/ /myur du nga phyir 'ong thub ltos/ /slar yang mjal ba'i smon lam 'tshal/ /bla ma gcig drung chos nyan pa'i/ /chung nas 'grogs pa'i grogs po gnyis/ /da lta na so gzhon dus 'dir/ /nga ni yul la mi chags par/ /dam pa'i lha chos byed du 'gro /khyod ni da lta bde bar bzhugs/ /myur du nga phyir 'ong thub ltos/ /slar yang mjal ba'i smon lam 'tshal/ /dper na ljon shing phung bo la/ /bya bye'u mang po dgong dus 'tshogs/ /nam langs so sor gyes pa ltar/ /chos rnams mi rtag de dang mtshungs/ /de la soms la lha chos mdzod/ /ces smras pas kho na re/grogs ngan khyim bya 'dra ba nga / /khyem du lus pas zhe re 74

skyo/ /grogs po bya rgod 'dra ba khyod/ /chos phyir sog por bde bar bzhud/ /grogs ngan glang rgan 'dra ba nga / /khyem du lus pa yi re mug /grogs po 'brong sngon 'dra ba khyod/ /chos phyir sog por bde bar bzhud/ /grogs grogs nged gnyis so so ru/ /la la 'bral mi phod na yang / /'o 'o 'khor ba'i mtshan nyid red/ /myur myur mjal ba'i smon lam 'debs/ /zhes smras pa'i mthar/ 'bral mi phod bzhin du so sor bral nas 'ong /mtshan mo ma yi drung nas bsdad/ nangs par 'gro ba'i tshe/ma yis ja bzang po zhig bskol nas byin pa de 'thung ba'i bar la/ a ma na re/ bu lam skabs tshor sems chung gyis la sogs pa'i sha tsha ba'i gtam mang po bshad pa'i rjes su/ da nga ma rgan mo lo lon 'chi la nye ba 'di red/ kha ri ngo mdog tshor ltos dang bu khyod kyi shul na nga lus yod tshul soms la ma nga la snying rje yod pa zhig gyis/ myur du phyir la shog ces bshad de ngus/ sring mo gnyis kyang ngu bar gda'/ de nas ma sring gsum gyis nga nang sgo'i phyi rol tu bskyal ba'i tshe ma'i mig nas mchi ma re gnyis re 'thor ba byung tshe/ nga'i bsam pa la mi yi skye 'chi la khrigs khrigs med pas/ a ma'i mgo bskor nas song na/ da phyin chad nged ma bu rnams e 'phrad ci shes snyam 75

nas sems kyi gting nas ngu rgyu zhig byung ste/ ma zungs par mig mthar chu 'khyil ba dang / ngas a ma la da nga skyel mi dgos/ khyod sdod dang nga phyir la los 'ong sems ma sdug ces bshad nas so sor gyes pa las nga a ma la sems 'phreng ste/tshur lam la yong dus yang yang phyi mig lta bzhin mchi ma mang po shor ba byung / a mas yang nga bu gcig pu la sems 'phreng nas nga nam mthong gi bar du mig ce re bltas nas ngu zhing bsdad 'dug grogs po rdo rje tshe brtan yang khong rang gi khang thog nas bsangs shig btang ste sgo ru thon nas nga la lta bzhin 'dug nga lab lung kha so zer bar bslebs nas kha phyir phyogs nas bltas tshe/ da dung yang ma rgan mo dang grogs po yang sgo na bsdad 'dug de nas nga lab lung nang du phar song ba dang a ma ma mthong tshe/ nga yang phar 'gro ma phod par a ma dang yud tsam zhig 'phrad pa la phyir log gam snyam pa'i sems shin tu 'phreng ba zhig byung ste/ de ni nged ma bu gnyis phyis mi 'phrad pa de sems kyis tshor ba yin par 'dug nga ma mthong ba dang a ma yang sems 'phreng bzhin nang du log nga'i rjes su chung dus yi ge dang gtor ma sogs bslabs pa'i dge phrug rin chen rgyal nga skyel du byung ba dang / nged gnyis lhan du 76

bkra shis 'khyil du song / kho la nga'i ma dang sring mo la khyod kyis lta rtog 'dra gyis/ nga sog por song nas chos shig byed rgyu yin pas/ lo kha shas 'gor 'gro na'ang thang bcol gdams byas pa yin smras pas/ khos kyang zhing 'debs pa dang log rgyag pa sogs phan gang thogs byas 'dug de dus khos nga la chos dang mthun pa'i bslab bya zhig dgos zer ba'i lan du ngas 'di skad smras/chung nas 'grogs pa'i rin chen rgyal/ /mi lus rin chen rnyed par dka'/ /nam mkha'i glog bzhin 'jig kyang sla/ /shi nas pha rol 'gro ba'i tshe/ /dam chos ma gtogs phan pa med/ /nges par lha chos mdzad mi mdzad/ /nges par lha chos mdzad 'dod na/ /gdams ngag mtshan ldan bla mar zhus/ /gsol ba yi dam lha la thobs/ /dam tshig rdo rje'i spun la srungs/ /mchod pa dkon cog gsum la phul/ /gtso bo rang gi sems la ltos/ /sbyin pa dbul phongs rnams la thongs/ /snying rje ma nus pa la gyis/ /zhabs tog mkhas btsun bzang la gyis/ /bkur sti pha dang ma la rems/ /gnas skabs kun tu bkra shis shing / /tshe ring nad med smon lam 'debs/ /zhes smras nas/ khyod yul du song na nga 'di ltar 'gro ba red ces 77

ma dang sring mo la ma bshad ces smras te/ rgyal mkhan chen rin po che'i zhabs 'bring ba 'ga' dang 'grogs nas song bas/rong khung dog sa nas sa kha zheng che sa sog por bslebs pa dang / nam langs song ba dang 'dra ba'i snang ba yangs po zhig byung / dpon tshang wang rin po che'i urge dang thag nye sa na/sku gzhogs rin po che gzims gur mang po phub nas bzhugs yod sar slebs dus/ sbrang char 'jam po zhig dal bus babs pa'i rjes su/ 'ja' tshon gyi ri mo zhig kyang shar/ nyi ma tsha mo zhig 'od lam lam shar ba'i rten 'brel la brtags pas skyid pa'i nyi ma 'char snyam nas dga' bzhin du/ khong gi mdun du song nas mjal tshe/ zhal 'dzum bzhin/ ngo mtshar che 'ja' tshon gyi ri mo zhig kyang shar 'dug dpon tshang rin bo ches khyed brtse bas rjes su 'dzin pa'i rten 'brel red gsungs/ de yang o rgyan chen pos lung bstan las/ mtsho yi phyogs su bdud 'dul gyiḥ karma gu ru'i sprul pa 'byungaḥ de la chos 'di 'phrod gyur naḥ longs spyod dbyar mtsho lta bur rgyasaḥ zhes gsungs pa ltar dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs sprul slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas mi yi gar gyi rnam rol/ lung rig yon tan rgya mtsho'i pha mthar son cing / gnas lugs 78

zab gsal rdo rje snying po'i rtogs pa mngon du gyur pa 'jam dbyangs gong ma'i lung gis mngon par mngags shing / stobs kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba mtshan snyan pa dpon tshang tā le te'i ching wang ngag dbang dar rgyas dpal bzang po'i zhabs drung du/rgyal mkhan chen rin po che dang lhan du song bas/ ston mo chen po zhig byas nas glu dbyangs du ma len pa'i dkyil du thon/bdag gis chos rgyal rin po che la phyag gsum btsal rdzogs chen sangs rgyas lag bcang dang lha rdzas dri med bcas phul nas mjal/ yum sras gnyis la kha btags re phul nas bde zhus byas/ chos rgyal yab yum la mjal ma thag nas sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes skyes/ dad gus dang dga' spro tshad las 'das pa byung / yab yum gnyis kyis kyang / thugs brtse ba'i zhal gsung du ma byon/ chos rgyal rin po ches rdzogs chen sangs rgyas lag bcang kha phye ste cung zad cig gzigs par gda'/ de'i dgong mo nas bzung ste/ gur 'gol bo zhig tu bdag sdod du bcug gnyer pa la 'di nga bsams nas 'ongs pa red/ 'di la do dam legs po gyes gsungs/phyi nyin nyi dros tsam la rje bdag nyid chen po'i legs bshad sa gsum gyi sgon me lta bu'i byang chub lam rim chen mo mchan bu gsum can gyi 79

glegs bam zhig gsol dpon bzang po la 'khyer du bcug nas byon/ khyod kyis chos shig dran nas 'ongs pa la nga dga' ba yin/ nges 'byung sad sud re tsam skyes nas chos byas rung rjes nas blo 'gyur ldog che/ da khyod kyis byang chub lam gyi rim pa 'di la blo sbyong ba 'di gal che/de yi nang nas kyang dang po skyes bu chung 'bring 'di gnyis kyi skor la nan tan gyis blo sbyongs la 'khor ba'i phun tshogs la yid smon skad cig tsam yang mi skye bar/ thar 'dod kyi blo bcos ma ma yin pa zhig e skye la 'bod gsungs nas/ nyin der dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten tshul legs par gsungs nas phebs/ zla ba gcig tsam la nyin rer lan gcig gnyis re byon nas/ dal 'byor rnyed dka' nas zhi lhag gi bar du zab khrid rgyas par gnang nas/khyod shes rab che bar gda' bas/ da skyes bu che 'bring chung gsum yongs su rdzogs pa la blo sbyongs gsungs/ de ltar blo sbyong bzhin bsdad pa'i zla ba gnyis kyi 'phro la/ rgyal mkhan chen rin po che/ nga dang a khu mthong sa'i dge slong sogs don gnyer can mang pos/ gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i smin byed kyi dbang gnang bar gsol ba 'debs pa'i skabs su ngas kyang yan lag bdun pa 'di phul lo//80

e ma chos rgyal rin po che/ /bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i slob ma'i tshogs/ /'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la/ /zol med gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod pa 'bul/ /nyams chags sdig sgrib mthol lo bshags/ /mdzad spyod kun la rjes yi rang / /bla med chos 'khor bskor du gsol/ /mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs gsol 'debs/ /dge tshogs 'gro kun don du bsngo/ /thams cad sangs rgyas myur thob shog /ces phul bas khong gis dbang gi sta gon gnang ba'i mtshan mo nga'i rmi lam du a mas chang kā pa la gang byin pa yongs rdzogs 'thungs pa zhig rmis zhus pas/ de bla ma'i gdams pa ma lus par nyams su len thub pa'i rten 'brel du 'dug pa'i rmi lam bzang po red gsungs/ de'i phyi nyin nyi dros tsam la/ gnam la rig 'dzin gyi gral rim ma zhig pa/ sa la dkyil 'khor gye thig tshon ma yal ba/ bar du sgrub rdzas tshom bu'i rgya ma nyams pa/ dam nyams dang 'dres 'khyer gyes bsre bslad ma zhugs pa/ ma dang mkha' 'gro'i zhal rlangs thol le ba'i zab chos khyad par can gter gsar gyi skor las/ bcom ldan 'das rta phag yid bzhin nor bu'i smin byed kyi dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs pa gnang dus lha la me tog phul skabs 81

byang du babs pa tshogs drug gi zhen 'dzin rang sar grol ba'i brdar ming la tshogs drug rang grol zhes btags/ mjug tu lung kha shas gnang nas grol/ de nas nyin re bzhin dbang bzhi dang 'brel ba'i nyams len/ thog mar bum dbang dang 'brel ba bskyed rim lha'i khrid/ de nas gsang dbang dang 'brel ba rtsa rlung gtum mo'i khred/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang dang 'brel ba bde stong phyag rgya'i khrid/ tshigs dbang dang 'brel ba khregs chod thod rgal gyi khrid dang de'i bka' srung rnams kyi rjes gnang dang bcas pa yongs rdzogs rgyas par gnang / gzhan yang skabs skabs su lho brag grub chen las kyi rdo rje la phyag rdor gyis dngos su gsungs pa'i phyag rdor bdud rtsi thig pa'i dbang dang / gsang bdag gi gsung gces phreng rdo rje'i rtsa 'brel sogs phyag chen gyi khrid/ rdzogs chen ye shes bla ma/nyi ma grags pa'i rdzogs chen/ mkha' 'gro'i snying thig la sogs pa'i smin byed kyi dbang dang / grol byed kyi khrid/ rgyab rten gyi lung dang bcas bstsal pa'i dus khong gi zhal nas/gsang sngags kyi chos 'di rten 'brel la rag las pas/ sngon rje btsun mi las zangs stong bar phul ba'i rten 'brel gyis rjes su sgrub pa rgyag dus zas dkon po byung yang / lho brag mar 82

pas zangs de mar khus bkang ba'i rten 'brel gyis sku tshe'i smad dang bu rgyud la longs spyod rgyas pa byung /de'i phyir na khyod la cang med rung lag stong byas chos zhus na mi rung gsungs te/dngul gyi maṇ+ḍal gser dngul g.yu bye ru mu tig sogs rin po che'i rigs dang / rin po che'i phreng ba 'bru sna dar zab sogs gnang nas 'di rnams maṇ+ḍal skabs su phul gsungs pa ltar byas pas/ rjes su rang gzhan gyi don gang bsgrub kyang nor longs spyod thogs pa med par 'byung ba de'i rten 'brel yin nam snyam pa byung / yang mjug tu tshogs sna 'dzoms po byas tshogs 'khor rgya chen po zhig bskor ba'i skabs su yab yum lhan rgyas la tshogs phud 'di ltar phul lo//rang gzhan gtsug rgyan chos kyi rgyal po la/ /rang sems rnam par dag pa'i tshogs mchod 'bul/ /rang dang skal ba ldan pa'i gdul bya la/ /rang blor 'tsham pa'i chos char dbab tu gsol/ /a ti yang gsang rdzogs pa chen po yi/ /a don skye med rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor ma/ /a bī rin po che la tshogs mchod 'bul/ /a ma bzhin du brtse bas bskyang du gsol/ /zhes dbyangs su blangs nas phul ba'i tshe/ chos rgyal yab yum sras blon bcas mdun na 'tshogs tshad thams cad bzhad gad 83

thag ge ba zhig byung / der nga'i bsam pa la/ chos rgyal yab yum sras bcas gzhan gyis gser dngul mang po phul rung de 'dra ga nas bzhad/ da re yab yum sras bcas bzhad pa rang nyid brtse bas rjes su 'dzin pa'i rten 'brel red snyam pa byung /de dus lugs gnyis kyi mkhyen rgya che ba'i a r+pā rin po ches sngon yum bdag med mas/ rje btsun mi la la brtse ba ltar/ nga la zas gos gang dgos gnang / thugs brtse bas bskyangs pa'i bka' drin shin tu che/ de'i skabs su nub gcig bdag gi rmi lam du/ lag na me long ngo gnyis mkhar rnga tsam pa zhig 'duganam mkha' na nyi zla gnyis kyang shar 'dug ngas me long ngo gcig nam mkha' la bstan tshe/ nyi ma'i g.yon phyogs su zla ba gcig 'char ba/ thang na mi skya ser mang po 'tshogs pas mthong nas/ nyi zla gnyis kyi g.yon na'ang zla ba gsar pa zhig 'dug ltos zer ro/ /nga'i bsam pa la 'di rnams kyis nga'i me long gi 'phrul yin pa ma shes par 'dug snyam/ ngos gcig sa la bstan pas sa gzhi thams cad 'od dkar pos gang ba zhig rmis pa zhus pas/ rmi lam shin tu legs/ bsgoms na nyams rtogs skye ba'i snga ltas red gsungs/de nas re zhig bar du urge steng nas bsdad/ kun mkhyen klong chen rab 'byams pa'i 84

mdzod bdun dang / shing rta chen mo gsum sogs gsung 'bum nang ma rnams la bltas/ dka' gnad rnams chos rgyal rin po cher zhus shing gtan la phab pas/ rang gzhan gyi grub mtha' so so'i lam gyi rim pa rnams shes pa byung / chos rgyal mchog gi mchod gnas bla ma sbyin pa tshang la/ nga la 'dul ba khrid ces bka' phebs par brten/ der khong gis 'dul ba rgya mtsho'i snying po la/ 'dul ba'i gleng 'bum sogs kyis brgyan nas gsungs pas/ 'dul ba'i gzhung la go ba chags pa byung bas khong thugs mnyes/ de skabs bla ma pad+ma rang grol sogs la chos rgyal rin po ches sman gyi rgyud bzhi 'khrid pa'i skabs/ngas kyang zhor la nyan cing lta rtog 'dra byas pas/ tsha grang ngos zin pa tsam byung bas/ rjes su ri khrod la song dus dang /gzhan gyi don byed dus nad pa mang po la phan pa byung / de yang / gang zhig gser gyi ri la gnas bcas na/ /de yi 'dab chags thams cad gser du 'gyur/ /gsungs pa ltar/ urge nas sdod pa'i ring la yon tan mang po shugs kyis 'gos pa byung / rang nyid urge nas sdod pa'i ring la/ spyir mtho ba la bkur shes/ dma' ba la skyong shes/ thad ka la 'grogs shes byas/ khyad par khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon po chos rgyal 85

rin po che bsam sbyor gnyis kyi sgo nas tshul bzhin du bsten/ci mdzad legs par bltas/ ci gsung dang du blangs nas bka' bzhin du bsgrubs pas/ khong gi thugs kyi sras dam par dgongs nas/ gsar rnying gi gdams pa gang yod bum pa gang byo'i tshul du gnang ba rnams lhag lus med par thob pa byung /de'i skabs su gcod yul ba chen po dkon mchog chos 'phel gyi mdun nas/ gcod nam mkha' sgo 'byed kyi dbang dang /khros nag lha lnga'i dbang / gcod gdan thog gcig ma sogs gcod kyi lung mang po dang / stag tshang phur pa'i chos tshan las rdor sems rigs lnga rgyan gcig la brten pa'i gtum mo dang /thabs lam bde stong gi khrid bcas thob/ rje btsun 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i yang sprul blo bzang 'jigs med rgya mtsho rin po che urgo ru gdan drangs dus su mjal nas/ rigs gsum mgon po dga' ldan lha brgya ma dang dmigs brtse ma rnams kyi lung thob/ gzhan yang snga phyi rim pa byas bla ma dam pa mang po'i zhal snga nas zab rgya'i dbang lung khrid gsum mang po thob pa'i skal ba bzang po byung nas/ rang rgyud dam pa'i chos kyis phyug par gyur to//smras pa/ yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag bcom 86

ldan 'das/ /yongs 'dzin dam pa'i tshul 'dzan gdul bya'i rigs/ /yongs la mdo sngags phyogs re ma yin par/ /yongs rdzogs 'doms mdzad mgon khyod gtsug na mdzes/ /bla ma'i rnam thar tshul bzhin skyong 'dod pa'i/ /skal bzang slob ma yongs la phan pa'i phyir/ /pha yul spangs nas chos rgyal bsten pa'i tshul/ /slar yang glu ru len gyis dga' bas nyon/ /sku drin 'khor med 'jam dbyangs rin po che'i/ /gdung rten mjal nas khong gi lung bstan bzhin/ /dam pa'i mgon dang mjal nas mdo sngags kyi/ /chos la longs su spyod pa'i smon lam btab/ /pha yul ma sring gnyen grogs brtse na yang / /yun ring mi sdod 'chi ba'i tshul bsams nas/ /yul nas zhag bdun tsam las ma bsdad par/ /phan tshun gcig gis gcig la snying gtam smras/ /'gro ba'i nangs par ma dang sring mo yis/ /nga la bltas nas mchi ma mang po zhig /btang bas nga yang 'bral glags ma phod par/ /langs nas bsdad tshe mig sgo mchi mas gang / /so sor gyes khar re gnyis sa la lhung / /de nas ma la phyi mig lta bzhin du/ /lab lung kha so'i bar du sos dal 'ong / /phyir la bltas pa'i ma dang grogs po yang / /sgo na 'dug pa mthong nas cung zad bsdad/ /de nas lab lung 87

nang du phar la song / /yul phyogs ma sring grogs rnams ma mthong tshe/ /'gro yang ma phod a ma yud tsam zhig /'phrad du phyir la log gam log gam snyam/ /lhag par ma la rang sems 'phreng ba byung / /de ni ma bu phyin chad mi 'phrad pa/ /de dus sems kyis tshor ba yin pa 'dug /ma la 'phreng bzhin bkra shis 'khyil du song / /rin chen rgyal la ma sring bcol gdams byas/ /phan pa'i bslab bya byas nas phyir la log /bdag ni gnas der zhag po kha shas bsdad/ /de nas rgyal gyi mkhan chen zhabs phyi dang / /'grogs nas sa bzang sog po'i yul du song / /dus gsum sangs rgyas thugs sprul pad 'byung dang / /dbyer med chos rgyal ngag gi dbang por mjal/ /rab dga'i sa thob lta bu'i dga' spro 'phel/ /khong gis rab tu brtse bas rjes su bzung / /byang chub lam gyi rim pas rgyud sbyangs nas/ /gsang sngags smin grol gdams pa dgyes bzhin gnang / /lugs gnyis gang la'ang mkhyen rgya che ba yi/ /rgyal yum rig 'dzin dbang mos brtse ba'i sgos/ /sngon dus mar pa'i gsang yum bdag med mas/ /rje btsun mi la brtse bas bskyangs pa ltar/ /lto gos gnang ba'i bka' drin gzhan las che/ /de skabs klong chen rab 'byams mdzod bdun sogs/ /88

gsung 'bum rnams la bltas nas dka' gnad rnams/ /chos rgyal rje la zhus shing gtan la phab/ /grub mtha' so so'i lam rnams shes pa byung / /chos rgyal mchod gnas bla ma sbyin pa yi/ /drung nas 'dul ba'i gzhung la cung zad sbyangs/ /chos rgyal chen pos gzhan la sman slob pa'i/ /zhor la sman yang phran tshegs tsam zhig shes/ /rjes su ri khrod dben par song dus dang / /'gro don byed dus gzhan la phan thogs byung / /gang zhig gser gyi ri la gnas bcas pa'i/ /de yi 'dab chags thams cad gser du 'gyur/ /gsung ltar chos rgyal drung nas sdod ring la/ /yon tan mang po shugs kyis skyes pa byung / /de dus mtho ba rnams la brtsi bkur dang / /dma' ba skyong shes thad gar 'grogs shes byas/ /khyad par skyabs mgon chos rgyal rin po che/ /bsam dang sbyor ba'i sgo nas tshul bzhin bsten/ /ci mdzad legs par mthong ba'i mos gus kyis/ /ci gsung dang du blangs nas bsgrubs pa'i mthus/ /khong gis thugs kyi sras mchog dam par dgongs/ /gsar rnying mdo sngags chos kyi gdams pa rnams/ /bum pa gang byo'i tshul du thob pa byung / /gzhan yang rtogs ldan dkon mchog chos 'phel sogs/ /bla ma skyes chen mang po'i zhal snga nas/ /89

gcod sogs dbang lung khrid gsum mang po thob/ /rang rgyud dam pa'i chos kyis phyug par gyur/ /mdor na pha yul spangs nas sog por song / /chos rgyal bsten nas mdo sngags gzhung la sbyangs/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi rnam thar de ltar lags/ /rjes 'jug rnams kyang de bzhin skyong bar mdzod/ /glu 'di thos tshad skye bo pho mo yis/ /tshe rabs kun tu bla ma'i rnam thar bzhin/ /pha yul spangs nas mkhas grub mang po sten/ /mdo sngags gzhung la thos bsam byed par shog /ces pa'ang bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o//90

rtse gzhung dpen pa'i dga' tshal du zab mo'i sgrub pa la gzhol tshul/bzhi ba bla mas lung bstan pa'i rtse gzhung dben pa'i dga' tshal du zab mo'i sgrub pa la gzhol tshul ni/ nyin gcig bka' drin mtshungs med chos rgyal rin po che'i zhal nas/ da khyod kyis sgrub pa byed pa la/ sngon grub thob garma tshe dbang rig 'dzin zhes bya ba gnam gyi thog babs pa thu ba'i nang du len pa sogs grub rtags mang po bstan nas/ phyogs 'di'i gdul bya las dang skal bar ldan pa rnams smin grol gyi lam la bkod pa'i skyes mchog chen po de nyid kyi zhabs kyis bcags shing byin gyis brlabs pa'i gdan sa rtse gzhung dben pa'i dga' tshal/ kha lhor lta dgun dus nyi 'od 'khyel zhing / dbyar sos dus bsil zhing rig pa dwangs pa/ chu me shing sogs mthun rkyen 'dzoms pa'i gnas khyad par can/ ming la sog skad du thā yan chi zer ba bod skad du ri khrod pa'i sgom khung zer ba'i brag phug nyams dga' ba zhig yod khyod der song la sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan tshugs shig gsungs/ de nas khong gis lung bstan 91

pa'i gnas chen der 'gro dus/ yum a r+pā rin po che nas/ ri mo mdzes pa'i gos kyi dpe thum zhig dang / dpon tshang nas chos 'byung brgya rtsa yod pa'i phreng ba zhig gnang ba rnams rten 'brel gyis khyer/ zla ba kha shas kyi bro kha snod cha dang bcas pa phyag mdzod dang gnyer pa nas byen te/ mi gnyis la skyel du bcug nga gcig pu thog mar 'jigs 'ong dgongs nas/ khyed gnyis kyi nang nas gcig do nub ri khrod pa'i rtsa nas sdod la sang shog gsungs/ nged gsum song nas brag phug tu slebs pa ngang /sgyel mi gnyis ka 'dug dgos pa la skrag nas/ gcig gis gcig la khyod sdod ces ma 'grigs tshe ngas khyed gnyis kyi su yang 'dug mi dgos/ nga mi skrag gnyis gas phyags dar yag po zhig rgyob/thab kha zhig 'chos la song / 'di na nga gsod pa'i 'dre zhig yod na do dgong ma bsad rung sang dgong gsad 'ong da snga phyi la khyad med/ dpon tshang rin po ches khyed gnyis la 'dri na/ 'dug mi dgos zer tshul zhus dang / bka' bkyon mi yong smras pas/gnyis ka dga' nas song / der ngas gnyis ka song ba'i rjes nas brag khung chen po de'i gru kha zhig nas mal sa gru bzhi chung chung zhig bzos/ 'og tu g.yung drung zhig bris/ de'i steng du rtswa dang gdan gding ba btings/ gong du bstan pa'i 92

bdag po thub dbang gi sku gcig bzhag mchod pa bshams te stan bde ba la 'khod de/ dam bca' 'di ltar byas so/ /bdag gi rgyud la nyams rtogs khyad par can zhig ma skyes kyi bar du bla mas lung bstan pa'i gnas 'di nas gzhan du mi 'gro ba dang /mtshan mo yang lus gnad rdo rje'i skyil krung bcas te 'dug pa las/ phal pa ltar ro nyal mi byed pa dang / dus rgyun du ngag mtshams sdom pa las/ don med kyi ngag 'khyal mi smra ba dang /gung tshigs ma gtogs pa'i dus gzhan du zas mi za ba dang /gcig pur sdod pa ma gtogs/ grogs gzhan su dang lhan du mi sdod pa dang / bla ma'i gdams ngag ma gtogs/ gzhan dran rgyu mi mang ba dang / dka' spyad snying rus ma gtogs/skyid chos mi byed pa dang / brtan pa ma thob bar du 'jig rten 'du 'dzi mi bsten pa dang / mdor na sgo gsum tha mal du mi 'chor bar nyin mtshan med par nyams len la 'bad par bya'o/ /de ltar nus par rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams kyis byin gyis rlobs shig yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyis dngos grub stsol cigamakha' 'gro dang chos skyong dkar phyogs pa'i lha rnams kyis rtag tu g.yel ba med par de lta bu'i grogs mdzad du gsol zhes dam bca' sgon lam gye mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so//93

pha rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang / /bus ri khrod zin par byen gyis rlobs/ /rje rgyal ba gong ma'i rnam thar bzhin/ /chos zab mo tshul bzhin sgrub nus shog /lam thun mong sngon 'gro gtong ba'i tshe/ /gang btang tshad gnad du 'gro bar shog /lam dngos gzhi'i nyams len byed pa'i tshe/ /nyams rtogs pa'i yon tan 'char bar shog /tshe 'di ru sa lam mthar phyin nas/ /ma 'gro ba'i don la brtson par shog /rang gzhan gyi don gang bsgrub pa'i tshe/ /gegs bar chad gang yang med par shog /gnas 'di ru bkra shis byin chags shing / /phyis sgrub brgyud kyi bstan pa dar bar shog /ces smon lam btab nas/bde ba'i stan la lus rnam snang chos bdun byas/ sems rnal du phab/ dge sems khyad par can gyi ngang nas thog mar/skyabs 'gro dang / sems bskyed/ yig brgya/ maṇ+ḍal/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ phyag 'bum rnams sngon du btang nas tshogs rdzogs sgrib pa dag pa'i rtags ci rigs pa rmi lam du byung /dngos gzhi byang chub lam gye rim pa'i lus yongs su rdzogs pa la 'bad pa chen pos yang yang sbyangs pas nges 'byung dang byang chub kyi sems yang dag pa'i lta ba'i gzhi zin pa byung / de nas rta phag yid bzhin nor bu'i bskyed rim bsgoms/ sngags 94

kyi bsnyen pa grangs tshad las lhag btang bas/ tha mal gyi snang zhen dag gang snang lha skur shar/ gter bsrung 'khor ba'i rtags mtshan sna tshogs pa byung / de nas rdzogs rim rtsa thig rlung gsum gye nyams len la sbyangs pas gtum mo'i bde drod 'bar/ ras rkyang thub pa byung / rlung sems dbu mar zhugs/dbu ma'i rtsa mdud grol nas/ bde stong gi nyams rgyun chad med pa byung / khyad par rdzogs chen gyi thun mo nga ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro la zla ba mang por sbyangs/ khregs chod thod rgal kho na la lo gsum tsam sbyangs pas/ khregs chod kyi gnas lugs rtogs/ thod rgal gyi nyams snang sna tshogs pa shar ba'i tshe/nyin gcig chos rgyal rin po che'i zhabs drung du song nas/nyams len byas tshul dang nyams snang 'char tshul rnams rim pa bzhin du zhus pas/ khong gi thugs rab tu dgyes pas zhal ras bco lnga'i zla ba lta bu de bstan nas/ 'dzum pa dang bcas te/ 'o bu khyod snying rus dang bsgom bsran che bas/ byer nges 'byung byang sems yang dag pa'i lta ba rim gnyis kyi nyams rtogs yon tan khyad par can rgyud la skyes 'dug pas/ tshe 'dir mi lus thob pa don dang ldan pa byung / khyad par rgyal dbang pad+ma'i ring lugs/'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po'i khregs 95

chod gnas lugs kyi lta ba rtogs shing / lhun grub thod rgal gyi gdams pa la brten nas snang bzhi'i ye shes rgyud la shar ba ngo mtshar che ste/ kun mkhyen klong chen pa'i nyams mgur las/'od gsal lhun grub kyi bsgom pa ni/ /lus mi g.yo 'od kyi khang bu na/ /rtsa dri med shel gyi sbu gu can/ /de rgyang zhags chu yi sgron mar 'brel/ /gnas rin chen rgya mtshor 'brel ba'i gdangs/ /phyi sprin bral nam mkha'i dkyil du shar/ /nang ye shes 'od lnga kha dog lnga/ /za 'og ber khyim ris su snang / /de thig le stong pa'i sgon mas brgyan/ /dbus rigs pa rdo rje lu gu rgyud/ /thig le thig phran 'brel ba ni/ /'dzam bu chu bo'i gser skud la/ /rma bya'i mdongs kyis brgyan pa 'dra/ /sum bsgrigs 'od kyi snang ba ni/ /chos nyid mngon sum gyi rang snang yin/ /de gong du 'phel ba'i snang ba la/ /ye shes mkhar thabs kyi snang ba dang / /lnga ldan 'od kyi pad+ma stong / /rtsibs rgyud rin chen dra ba dang / /'od lnga shel gyi mchod rten mthong / /thig le stong pa'i khang pa ru/ /rig pa'i sa bon yig 'bru dang / /rnam pa sna tshogs kyi phyag mtshan dang / /yongs rdzogs sku yi snang ba la/ /phyogs mtshams 'od lnga'i zer mdangs 'phro/ /rig pa tshad phebs kyi snang ba la/ /de rnams lnga lnga zung 96

'brel mthong / /gang bltas 'od kyis 'jig rten khyab/ /snying khar zer thag zug pa mthong / /de tshe rang lus gcig g.yo bas/ /phyogs bcu'i zhing rnams g.yo ba dang / /rang lus ting 'dzin mnyam gzhag pas/ /thams cad mnyam par 'jog pa dang / /sku rnams tshangs pa'i gsung dbyangs kyis/ /chos kyi rnga chen sgog pa dang / /sa dang lam gyi yon tan rdzogs/ /de bzhin rim gyis pa rnams kyi/ /yon tan gong du 'phel ba dang / /der 'dzin zad pa'i snang ba gnyis/ /mi 'gal gcig tu 'du ba ni/ /chos nyid zad pa'i sar phyin te/ /gdos bcas lus dang rtog tshogs zad/ /rnam smin las dang bag chags zad/ /ma rig 'khrul gzhi'i sa bon zad/ /snang ba rnams la 'dzin pa zad/ /gdos bcas dag pas 'phel sgo zad/ /rang lus shel gyi khang pa ru/ /'od lnga yul gyi 'phro 'du ltos/ /'od dang rig pa gar 'jug kyang / /lhun grub ka dag ngang la thim/ /ka dag gzhi la btsan sa zin/ /nang gsal sku gsum 'du 'bral med/ /chos sku'i ngang las gzugs sku bzhugs/ /gdul bya'i 'jig rten gang yod du/ /chos sku'i dbyings las ma g.yos par/ /longs spyod rdzogs dang sprul pa'i sku/ /'gro ba'i don gnyis rgyun mi 'chad/ /tshe 'dir grol 97

ba'i gdams pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i nang nas/ khyod gang gi mtshams la slebs yod snyam na/ yongs rdzogs sku yi snang ba la/ /phyogs mtshams 'od lnga'i zer mdangs 'phro/ /gsungs pa'i tshod la sleb par gda'/ der slebs na bar do tshe 'dir chod pa yin te/ klong gsal las/ sku shar nyams kyi 'phel rdzogs na/ /bar do'i snang ba 'dir chod pas/ /longs spyod ngos zin bar do stongs/ /gsungs pas/ khyod da lta shi rung bar do longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku ru 'tshang rgya bar 'dugad dung tshe dang sgrub pa snyoms dang tshe 'dir 'ja' lus 'od skur grol ba'am/ yang na 'chi ba chos sku ru grol bar gdon mi za zhes lung bstan pa byung / de'i dus nub gcig gi rmi lam la/ shel gyi ri chen po zhig la rin po che bai ḍūr+ya sngon po las byas pa'i skas shig btsugs yod pa la/nga rim gyis gyen du 'jegs nas bltas pa'i tshe/ steng gi lho phyogs nas nyi ma shar ba shel la phog pas shel gyi ri'i byang gi phyogs su 'od dkar po 'phros te/ byang gi sa gzhi thams cad dkar por song ba'i nang nas/mi mang po dga' bzhin phar rgyug tshur rgyug byed pa zhig rmis pa zhus pas/ khyod kyi rmi lam de shin tu legs/ de la brten nas lung yang bstan chog par gda' bas/ sngon rje btsun mi 98

la ras pa'i rmi lam la lho brag mar pas lung bstan pa ltar/ngas kyang khyod la lung ston zhes/ rtse mtshar lta bur 'di skad ces gsungs so//e ma skal ldan bu gcig pu/ /dri med shel gyi ri bo de/ /rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa red/ /'od gsal nyi ma shar ba de/ /pha rgan nga rang yin nam snyam/ /skas la bu khyod 'jeg pa de/ /sa lam rim gyis bgrod pa'i brda/ /byang du 'od zer 'phro ba de/ /bu khyod gdul bya byang na yod/ /mi mang 'od nang rgyug pa de/ /gdul bya'i nyams len nus par go/ /go bar gyis la yid la chongs/ /zhes gsungs/ de nas khong gis bdag la byang sgra mi snyan gyi tshe sgrub kyi dbang lung khrid zhal shes dang bcas pa gnang / zla ba gcig la/ nged dpon slob gnyis gas tshe sgrub byas/ nyin gcig khong gi phyag na saṃ ṭa zhig bsnams yod dus shig la nged gnyis kyis ma bsam par tshig bzhi re rtsom zhes 'di bdag la gsungs/ kun rdzob 'khor bas mi bslu med/ /gcig tu dam pa'i chos la 'bad/ /thar med 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las/ /grol 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /gsungs/ ngas 'di zhus/ 'khor ba'i gnas na bde ba med/ /sdug bsngal chu bo'i gnyer ma 'dra/ /da res bla ma'i 99

bka' bzhin du/ /gcig tu dam pa'i chos la 'bad/ /ces phul/ de dus shin tu 'gol bo byung bas/ khong gis thugs brtse ba chen po'i sgo nas chos 'jig rten gyi gleng mo mang po gnang ba rnams dus da lta yang dran pa gda'/ de dus bla ma gzhan las sku drin che ba'i rgyal mkhan chen rin bo che bo re bzhin sog por phebs dus/ chos gos phrug gzan sogs bdag rkyen dang / zhal gdams mang po gnang zhing / nyin gcig grub thob garma tshe dbang rig 'dzin gye sgrub gnas thā yan chi ru phebs nas/ zhag gcig bzhugs pas/ nged dpon slob gnyis kyis nyams myong go bsdur byas/ rgyal ba'i gsung rab mdo sngags chos kyi gtam sna tshogs pa gleng bas thugs yid gcig tu 'dres/ nyams dga' zhing snang ba spro ba byung / khong nangs par snga mo 'byon khar bdag gis bde zhus tshigs bcad 'di phul lo//bstan pa'i sgor 'jug bdag nyid la drin can/ /bstan pa thams cad ris med du skyong ba'i/ /bstan 'dzin skyes mchog snyigs dus kyi 'gro mgon/ /bstan 'gro'i don du bde mo ru bzhud cig /ces phul ba'i lan du/ mkhan chen mchog gi zhal nas/ e ma hoḥ bde la yangs pa'i rtse gzhung gi dben 100

gnas/ /bde skyid 'byung ba'i brag phug gi khang bur/ /bde chen sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug /bde bar bzhugs dang ring min du mjal yong / /rten 'brel bkra shis kyi mtshan ma dben gnas 'dir bsgrigs so/ /zhes gsungs nas phebs so/ /de dus drin can gye a mas yul du shog ces skad yi ge nan tan bskur kyang / bdag gi bsam pa la/ sngar ma bu gnyis lo nyi shu'i bar du lhan du bsdad pas phan ma thogs na/da bdag gis nyams len bzhag nas lan cig 'phrad pas ga la phan snyam/ ma la 'di skad ces ngas bla ma'i bka' bzhin 'o skol ma bu gnyis gtan du bde ba'i thabs su lha chos rnam dag cig sgrub bzhin yod/ da lo 'ong ma thub/ lo rjes ma la 'phrad du 'ong zhes 'tshams rtags 'dra bskur nas yul la ma song / yang de dus 'brog mi lo tsā'i rnam 'phrul gter ston bdud 'dul rdo rje'i gdung rabs lnga pa/ gter ston bsod nams snyan grags dpal bzang po urge ru phebs/ chos rgyal rin po ches dbang lung mang po zhus pas/ khong gis zhi khro dam pa rigs brgya'i dbang dang / bsam pa lhun grub ma'i dbang /rig pa'i rtsal dbang sogs/ dbang mi 'dra ba bdun dang /klong gsal chos skor yang tig nag po gser gyi 'bru gcig 101

sogs kyi lung khrid sogs bka' chos mang po gnang ba rnams kyang thob pa'i skal ba bzang po byung / gter ston rin po che 'byon khar thā yan chir phebs nas mdo sngags spyi dang khyad par 'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po'i khregs chod thod rgal gyi dka' gnad las brtsams te dri ba phul bar bka' lan mang du gnang zhing thugs dgyes pa byung / gzhan yang sems la phan pa'i thun mong gi bka' chos mang po gnang / der bzhugs pa'i ri khrod pa rnams kyis dad rten zhig 'jog dgos zhus par/ rdo la phyag rjes shig kyang gnang ba de rjes nas gcig gis khyer nas mi snang / dpon slob rnams skye ba nas tshe rabs thams cad du yang yang mjal ba'i smon lam btab nas thugs yid 'phreng bzhin du phebs so/ /yang dben gnas der bsdad dus/ nyin gcig nam mkha' g.ya' dag pa'i nyi ma'i gung zhig la rgyab ri'i rtser khams bsangs su song nas gcig pur bsdad yod pa'i tshe/ byang phyogs kyi ri bo mthon po'i rtse nas sprin dkar po zhig 'o ma 'phyur ba bzhin gyen du langs pa'i dus/ pha bla ma 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho rin po che yid la shar te dran nas bzod glags med pa'i tshe/ rje bla ma dran pa'i gdung dbyangs 'di ltar blangs so//102

byang phyogs ri bo mthon po'i rtse mo na/ /chu 'dzin sprin dkar 'o ma 'phyur bzhin langs/ /de nyid mthong bas drin can bla ma dran/ /chu 'dzin sprin dkar lding ba'i 'og phyogs na/ /dben gnas bkra shis 'khyil ba'i rtse mo ru/ /yid 'ong bsam gtan khang bzang gdan steng na/ /mtshan ldan bla ma bzhugs tshul yid la shar/ /bka' drin bsams nas mig nas mchi ma shor/ /snying nas gdung ba skyes nas dran pa 'khrul/ /yid kyang phyad phyod gyur pa'i snang ba kun/ /mig gis gang bltas za zi ban bun g.yo/ /da lta'i dus 'dir bzhugs na dga' ba la/ /mi nga mos gus zhan rung mjal snying 'dod/ /da lta bla ma chos sku'i dbyings na bzhugs/ /bu ngan skal med 'khor ba'i 'dam du lus/ /spang la me tog mang po rgyas dus su/ /mtshan ldan bla ma'i mdzes sgu yid la shar/ /gzugs sku da mthong ma red de mthong red/ /bsam zhing bsam zhing bla ma dran nas byung / /khu byug skad snyan lhang lhang sgog pa'i dus/ /mtshan ldan bla ma'i gsung dbyangs yid la shar/ /gsung dbyangs da thos ma red de thos red/ /bsam zhing bsam zhing bla ma dran nas byung / /nyi gzhon 'od snang lam lam 'char dus su/ /mtshan ldan bla ma'i mkhyen brtse yid 103

la shar/ /thugs rjes da skyong ma red de bskyangs red/ /bsam zhing bsam zhing bla ma dran nas byung / /mtshan ldan bla ma zhal ni bzhugs pa'i dus/ /dbang khrid man ngag gnang tshul yid la shar/ /dbang khrid da zhu ma red de zhus red/ /bsam zhing bsam zhing bla ma dran nas byung / /bla ma'i gsang gi bdud rtsi ngoms med du/ /'thung dus zhabs pad bsten tshul yid la shar/ /bla ma da sten ma red de bsten red/ /bsam zhing bsam zhing bla ma dran nas byung / /de nas lo zla'i dus su mjal dus su/ /'dzum 'dzum bsu ba byed tshul yid la shar/ /lha zhal da mthong ma red de mthong red/ /bsam zhing bsam zhing bla ma dran nas byung / /yul phyogs gang du phyin kyang bla ma dran/ /dben gnas gang du bsdad kyang bla ma dran/ /brda ni ji ltar mthong yang bla ma dran/ /dus kun rtag tu mtshan ldan bla ma dran/ /bla ma dran nas sems kyis mi nus gi /dbugs kyang stod du 'tshangs nas mi non gi /mig sgo mchi mas gang nas mi zum gi /pha yis mi mngon dbyings nas gsan lags sam/ /gsan na dag pa chos sku'i mkha' dbyings nas/ /da lta'i dus 'dir gzugs sku'i snang ba ston/ /bu yi gdung ba sol cig rin po che/ /zhes ngu ma 104

dbyangs kyis blangs nas mang po ngus tshe/ /sprin kyang mang du 'phyur nas nor bu'i dbyibs lta bu mang por song ba'i dbus ma'i rtser/ 'ja' 'od kha dog lnga ldan gyis gur phub pa'i dbus na bka' drin mnyam med rtsa ba'i bla ma de nyid sku yi gzi brjid sngar bas lhag pa/ phyag gnyis skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgya bdag la bstan nas gar stabs ling ling bsgyur zhing / zhal 'dzum bzhin tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyis 'di skad gsungs pa'i nyams shig shar/nga yi bu mchog snying dang 'dra ba khyod/ /mya ngan ma byed pha yi gsung la nyon/ /sngon smon las kyis 'brel ba'i pha bu gnyis/ /'od gsal chos nyid ngang la 'du 'bral med/ /da ni bu khyod tshe dang sgrub pa snyoms/ /phyogs med ri khrod 'grim zhing dka' thub gyis/ /skal ldan gdul bya'i tshogs la phan thogs mdzod/ /mthar thug tshe yi 'phen pa zad pa'i tshe/ /pha yis dag pa chos sku'i mkha' dbyings nas/ /bu la lhun grub gzugs sku'i snang ba ston/ /'chi ba 'od gsal gsal 'debs pha yis byed/ /bu yi sems la zungs la dga' bar gyis/ /yang cig zhal gyi 'dzum mdangs shig bzhad nas/ /phyin chad 'o dod drag pos nga ma 'bod/ /dus ngan mi yis 105

tshor na log lta skye/ /mya ngan ma byed byed mkhan sems la ltos/ /sems las ma gtogs bla ma gzhan na med/ /bla ma sems kyis dran pa sems su thim/ /sems nyid ma bcos chos sku'i ngang la zhog /ces gsungs nas/ gar stabs ling ling shig shig bsgyur zhing / je mtho je mthor song nas nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba ltar song / sprin rnams kyang nam mkha' la yal/ bdag gi mya ngan yang sangs te/ rtog med kyi nyams bzang po skyes pa'i ngang la yun ring lus song / yang nyin gcig me tog mang po zhig gi khrod du/ khams bsangs su song nas/ te lo pas paṇa chen nā ro ba la gdams pa'i lta mgur rang byung bsam gyis mi khyab pa de lta ba skyong bzhin pa'i ngang nas blangs pa'i tshe/ nga yi mdun gyi thad na me tog mang po skyes yod pa'i nang nas me tog bong rke ring ba zhig dri bzhon gyes dal bus bskyod tshe/ g.yas g.yon rnams su ldem ldem gyis gar mang po byas te shag shog 'dab ma'i sgra la drangs nas bdag la 'di skad zer/mchod/ pha ma lha lam 'dzin ma bzang mo yis/ /drod gsher bcud kyis bskyangs pa'i bu nga yis/ /yid 'ong 'dab ma thams cad legs brkyangs nas/ /phang phung phyogs bcur 106

g.yo bas dkon mchog mchod/ /ri la rgyun du 'dug pa'i mi khyod nyon/ /snang srid dpe char shar ba'i rnal 'byor la/ /gdams ngag dpe cha phyi rol yul gyis mchog /dpe sna mang po gsog pa'i bya btang khyod/ /dpe hrul mang na khur po'i snon pa yin/ /gdams ngag —dpe cha sems la ma rdzogs na/ /be'u bum mang po khur bas ga la lang / /ri khrod 'grim pa'i sdug yus su la bshad/ /da ni mi khyod sems la ma gnod dang / /khyod kyis stong nyid rtogs pa phar la zhog /mi rtag 'chi ba khyod kyis ma shes 'dug /shes na phyi yi dngos po thams cad kun/ /mi rtag 'chi ba ston pa'i slob dpon yin/ /me tog ngas kyang 'chi ba mi rtag pa'i/ /chos shig rnal 'byor khyod la phan phyir bshad/ /ne'u gsing spang la skyes pa'i me tog nga / /da lta'i dus 'dir yid 'ong 'dab ma yi/ /bkrag dang mdangs rnams rgyas te shin tu bde/ /sred ldan bung ba mang po'i 'khor gyis bskor/ /dal bu'i rlung gis bskyod tshe dga' bro 'khrab/ /zim bu'i sbrang char 'bab dus zim mer bsdad/ /'dzam gling nyi ma shar tshe 'dzum zhing bzhad/ /da lta'i dus 'dir bltas tshe nga re spro/ /yun ring mi sdod mi 'dod ba mo yis/ /bkra mdangs phrogs nas sku mdog smug por 'gro /107

tshul 'di bsams na da lta nga re skyo/ /de nas gdug rtsub kha rlung 'tshub pa yis/ /dbang med bcom nas rdul phran tsam du 'gro /tshul 'di bsams na da lta nga re 'jigs/ /khyod kyang nga yi rang bzhin 'di dang mtshungs/ /reb gong smad du skyes pa'i bya btang khyod/ /da lta'i dus 'dir sha khrag lus po yi/ /bkrag dang mdangs rnams rgyas te shin tu bde/ /dad ldan slob ma mang po'i 'khor gyis bskor/ /gzhan gyis ngo bstod byas tshe dga' bro 'khrab/ /dad ldan yon bdag 'ong dus lhan ner bsdad/ /dad zas mang po byung tshe 'dzum zhing bzhad/ /da lta'i dus 'dir bltas tshe khyod re spro/ /yun ring mi sdod mi 'dod rga ba yis/ /lus kyi mdangs 'phrog skra dkar rgur por 'gro /tshul 'di bsams na mi khyod mi skyo 'am/ /de nas gdug rtsub na 'chis gtugs pa yis/ /dbang med bcom nas 'jig rten pha rol 'gro /tshul 'di bsams na mi khyod mi 'jigs sam/ /ri khrod 'grims pa'i bya btang khyod dang gcig /ri la skyes pa'i me tog nga dang gnyis/ /ri yis bsdus pa'i mched grogs yin pa'i phyir/ /ri pa nga yis legs bshad 'doms pa yin/ /zhes bshad nas ci yang mi smra bar zhe smreng ba'i tshul du 'jam ldem me 'dug pa'i tshe/ de yi lan du 108

bdag gis 'di skad smras/mdog rab mdzes me tog khyod nyid kyis/ /chos mi rtag bshad pa ngo mtshar che/ /da nged gnyis ji ltar byas na 'thad/ /thabs shig kyang yod na bsgrub na ang / /zhes dris pa'i tshe/ yang me tog gis 'di skad zer/mchod do bslu med dkon mchog mchod/ /da ni nged gnyis 'di ltar mdzad/ /'khor ba'i bya ba thams cad la/ /rtag pa'i chos ni gang yang med/ /skyes pa 'chi zhing 'dus pa 'bral/ /bsags pa 'dzad dang mthon po ltung / /de 'dra'i gnas tshul bsam byas nas/ /nga yang bkrag mdangs rgyas dus 'dir/ /ne'u gsing spang la mi chags par/ /yid 'ong 'dab ma brkyangs nas kyang / /dkon mchog lha khang drung du 'gro /nga dang dkon mchog lha khang gnyis/ /lhan cig myur du 'grig par smon/ /khyod kyang rtsal stobs ldan dus 'dir/ /rnyed bkur ro la mi chags par/ /dben par nyams len byas nas kyang / /bde chen thar pa'i zhing khams snyogs/ /khyod dang dag pa'i zhing khams gnyis/ /lhan cig myur du 'grig par smon/ /zhes bshad nas mthar khyed kyis gnas lugs lta ba'i ngang la mnyam par 'jog na 'di ltar zhog zer ba ltar/me 109

tog de nyid g.yo 'gul med par rtog med kyi ngang la lhan ner gnas song ngo / /yang der sdod dus nub gcig rmi lam du khye'u dkar po 'od 'dom gang tsam 'phro ba blta bas chog mi shes pa zhig byung nas/ nga'i thad kyi brag steng zhig tu bzhengs nas bzhugs te/ phyag g.yas pas nyid kyi gsang ba'i rdo rje'i sked pa nas bzung ste/ zhal 'dzum pa dang bcas te 'di skad gsungs/rang lus rin chen bum bzang nang / /zag med bde chen bdud rtsis gtams/ /bum pa'i dbang chen bskur ba'i mthus/ /gzhan don rgya chen 'byung bar shog /ces gsungs pa dang dus mnyam du rdo rje'i bu ga nas bdud rtsi kha dog dkar po zhig byung ba/ bdag gi mgo thog tu bab sa pa lus kyi nang du sib sib thim pas gar song thams cad shes pa/ bde ba chen po'i ros tshims shing / lus kyi skra sen tshun chad gang song snyam pa byung / de nas yang khye'u de'i phyag g.yon pas sdigs mdzub nam mkha' la gtad nas spyan gyis lta stangs mthon po byas te 'di skad gsungs/rang rig khyab gdal chos kyi dbyings/ /rang gsal nam mkha'i dbyengs dang 'dra/ /rang byung rig pa'i dbang bskur 110

bas/ /rang don phun sum tshogs par shog /ces gsungs pa dang smra bsam brjod yul las 'das pa'i mnyam bzhag nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang la rang bzhin gyes gnas pa byung / de nas khye'u de shar phyogs kyi nam mkha' la je mtho je mthor song nas mi snang bar gyur pa zhig rmis so/ /yang nub gcig rmi lam du rkang pa skyil krung bcas/ rlung bum pa can bzung nas yar nam mkha' la 'phags nas je mtho je mthor nyi zla'i go mtshams bar du song nas bltas pas/ nyi ma shar dang zla ba nub na gnas pa'i nang gi lha'i grong khyer yang mthong de bzhin du phyogs thams cad la bltas pas 'jig rten khams kyi yul ljongs sogs ltad mo sna tshogs pa mthong / de nas phyir yong snyam nas mar la mnan pas yar rlung zhig gis btegs nas/ yong ma thub par bsdad pa'i tshe/ nam mkha'i sprin gseb nas lha'i bu zhig lus kyi phyed tsam thon nas/ mar 'gro dus skyil krung bshig rlung btang rkang lag brkyangs te bya ltar 'phur dgos zer ba ltar byas 'phur nas yong bas bde bar rgyab ri'i rtser babs pa'i snang ba byung / de bzhin du rmi lam yag po rkyang pa byung / de rnams tshe 'dir lam sna zin pa'i snga ltas yin nam snyam pa byung / yang yon bdag cig 'ongs nas/111

mo rtsis ci byas kyang nged tshang la gdon rdzas shig 'dug zer ba ngos mi zin par 'dug pas/ khyed kyis thugs brtags shig gnang dgos lags zer/ der ngas gnas lugs kyi ngang la mnyam par bzhag ste/ mnyam bzhag nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang nas gdon rdzas gang yin bltas tshe/ khong tshang gi mar sgam gyi 'og na/ mchod kong kha chag pa/ yu ba thung ba rnying pa zhig 'dug pas/ de gang nas 'ongs bltas pas chu 'khyil zhig gi nang nas khyim bdag mas rnyed nas lo lnga song / de'i stabs kyis bud med de'i lag pa g.yas pa skabs rer na ba red snyam pa zhig yid la wa ler shar ba byung bas/ de ka ltar smras pas kho dad pa lhag par skyes nas/ skyabs su mchi/ khong gis ma gsungs pa ma gtogs/ mngon shes la thogs pa mi 'dug zer dga' bzhin du song ngo / /de nas bzung ste gzhan gyis thugs brtags shig gnang dgos zer dus/ mnyam par bzhag nas brtags na legs nyes thams cad shes tshod na 'dug ste/ pho tshod mngon shes des phugs mi thub cing / bar skabs su 'du 'dzis g.yeng nas sgom gyi bar chad du 'gro bar 'dug snyam/ngas mi shes zhes de nas bzung gtan nas ma bshad par kha rog tu bsdad pa lags/ yang nor nad yong nas sgo phyugs 112

mang po shi bas/ rang gi thag nye na yod pa'i yon bdag gnyis kyis skyabs 'jug zhus par/ ngas nangs nub yi dam lha'i srung 'khor bsgoms/ nyin par khregs chod thod rgal gye 'od gsal sgom dus/ de phyogs su kha bltas nas bsgoms pas nor nad ma byung bas yon bdag gnyis dga' nas zhabs tog yag po byas byung / yang gnas der sdod dus nyin gcig sog sprang nyam thag cig 'ongs nga'i bro kha rnams la lag pas reg nas gcig brku bar rtsom pa'i tshe/ ngas 'di skad smras/khyod rkun ma 'ongs pa ngo mtshar che/ /ming bya btang zer ba'i ri ba ngas/ /da don mthun mdzad dam da res blta/ /chos gnad du e song da lta blta/ /mi khyod kyis ja skol nged gnyis 'thung / /yul thag ring yin na do nub sdod/ /chos 'jig rten gnyis kyi gleng mo byed/ /de'i 'phro la gang yod khyod la ster/ /zhes rkun ma dang nged gnyis kyis ja bskol nas 'thung ba'i tshe/ rkun mas khyed kyi pha yul gang yin/ dgon pa gang nas bsdad/ yul na nye 'brel e yod/ khyed kyi ming la ci zer zhes dris pa'i lan du bdag gis 'di skad smras/nga'i pha yul rgyal khams phyogs med yin/ /dgon nges med dben gnas ri khrod yin/ /gnyen nye 'brel rigs drug 113

sems can yin//nga'i ming la bya btang dkon mchog skyabs/ /zhes rtsed mo'i tshul du smras tshe rkun ma de cig rgod cing / bla ma khyod kha rgod cig yin par 'dug zer/ de nas yod byad cung zad yod pa rnams byin nas glu 'di blangs so//pha chos kyi rgyal por gsol ba 'debs/ /sems zhen chags med par byen gyis rlobs/ /snyan lhan ne mi khyod bdag la nyon/ /ngas thams cad mi bden sgyu mar mthong / /nor gsog 'jog zhen pa ma byas pas/ /nga sgyu ma'i nor rdzas yod ma myong / /'di ma gtogs zas nor gang yang med/ /da yod med khyod kyis ltos dang shes/ /mi nga ngo khyod kyis ma shes na/ /da khyod la yin tshul drang bor smra/ /nga'i pha yul reb gong zho 'ong yin/ /pha chos rgyal wang gi slob ma yin/ /chos rdzogs chen nyams su len mkhan yin/ /nga'i ming la tshogs drug rang grol zer/ /ma 'gro kun pha mar bsgoms bsgoms nas/ /dgra gnyen gyi gnyis 'dzin bdag la med/ /nang 'phags pa'i nor la mnga' brnyes pas/ /phyi'i zas nor longs spyod ci yod kun/ /rang gang 'dod rnams la ster snying 'dod/ /da mi khyod 'tshams por bde mor lags/ /dge 'dis mtshon dus gsum bsags pa kun/ /mi khyod kyis gtso byas 'gro kun 114

gyis/ /mchog sangs rgyas 'thob pa'i rgyu ru bsngo/ /'di rgyal sras gong ma'i lag len yin/ /zhes blangs pas kho dga' zhing spro bzhin phyag gsum btsal nas/ da khong sku bde mor bzhugs zer rang gnas su song ngo / /yang nyin gcig u rge steng du song ba'i tshe grogs mched cig gis/ khyed brag khung nang na mtshams la bsdad yod pa da grol ba e yin zer ba'i lan du/nga yi mtshams kyi lugs ni 'di lta bu zhig yin zhes rtse mtshar lta bur 'di skad ces smras so/ /kun tu bzang dang thugs dgongs dbyer med pa'i/ /mtshungs med 'gro mgon bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /ma yengs nyon cig skal ldan grogs po khyod/ /yang gsang rdzogs pa chen po'i rnal 'byor pa'i/ /mtshams la grol med grol na sdom rgyu med/ /spros med spros bral mtshams las 'da' ba med/ /grol rgyu sdom rgyu mang dus mtshams pa min/ /nga yi mtshams kyi lugs ni 'di ltar yin/ /mtshan nyid drug ldan rang lus mtshams khang gi /sgo gsum mi dge'i mi gtsang nyal nyil rnams/ /sdom gsum rnam par dag pas phyag dar byas/ /dbang bzhi'i chu bos ma dag dri ma sbyangs/ /phra rags rnam rtog kun gzhi'i 'bol gdan btings/ /rang rig rang gsal rig pa'i rnal 115

'byor nga / /ma bcos rang bab ngang du mtshams la bsdad/ /rtog med rang gnas bsam gtan mtshams nang du/ /bying rgod skye bo pho mo byung gis dogs/ /yengs pa med pa'i dran pa'i mtshams tho bzhag /shar grol dus mnyam stong pas mtshams g.yog byas/ /nga yi bskyed rim lugs ni 'di ltar yin/ /rang byung ka dag gzhal yas chen po na/ /snod bcud snang stong lha yi rol par shar/ /sgra rnams grag stong bzlas brjod rgyun 'chad med/ /dran rtog rang grol zang thal chos sku'i ngang / /bza' btung skye med chos sku'i zhal du bstabs/ /zos tshad lha yi tshogs 'khor tshogs bsags yin/ /'gro 'chag nyal 'dug spyod lam la sogs pa/ /bsam gtan bsre ba sngags kyi phyag rgya'o/ /rta bdun bdag po'i dkyil na mun med bzhin/ /snod bcud lha skur shar ba'i rnal 'byor bde/ /rin chen gser gyi gling na rdo med bzhin/ /sgra rnams sngags su shar ba'i rnal 'byor bde/ /stong gsal mkha' la bya 'phur rjes med bzhin/ /dran rtog chos skur shar ba'i rnal 'byor bde/ /thun mtshams byar med rgya yan rig pa'i ngang gu yangs sos dal sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor bde/ /ye nas bskyed rdzogs dbyer med zung 'jug ngang / /bsgrub kyang chog la rang 116

bzhin bzhag kyang chog /nan tan byas na bya rgyu med pa lags/ /nga yis chos rnams bsam 'das chos skur rtogs/ /grogs mched khyed kyang de bzhin rtogs par mdzod/ /blos btags chos la bden par ma 'dzin par/ /gzhi bral mnyam pa chen po'i don la sbyongs/ /de ltar bsgrub pa'i mtshams las grol ba'i tshad/ /mthar thug lus rgya'i 'ching ba zhig pa dang / /'chi ba 'od gsal chos skur grol ba'i tshe mtshams las grol zhes tha snyad btags pa yin/ /tshe mtshams thun mtshams med pa'i dge sbyor 'di/ /sngags 'chang gong ma'i mtshams kyi khyad chos yin/ /ha ha rang la med kyang ku re rtse/ /zhes smras pas/ grogs mched na re/ khyed kyi mtshams kyi lugs de shin tu legs/ de ltar lus kyi mtshams khang du sems kyi sgrub pa po dben par gnas pa'i smon lam thobs zer/ yang mi zhig gis khyed dang po sngags pa yin dus pha yul nas so nam log rgyag pa sa bon 'debs pa sogs e byas zer ba'i lan du/ tshig lhug par ngag drang po'i sgo nas bshad pa'i mthar glu 'di yid la shar ba ltar rtsed mo'i tshul du tshigs su bcad nas smras pa/chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs la 'dud/ /mi khyod rnal 'byor 117

ngag la nyon/ /bya btang tshogs drug rang grol ngas/ /gtan gyi so nam byas byas nas/ /tshe 'di'i so nam ngas ma byas/ /thar pa'i sa bon btab btab nas/ /'khor ba'i sa bon ngas ma btab/ /'khor bar zhen pa log bog nas/ /sra log nyis log ngas ma brgyab/ /sems nyid gtsang ma'i zhing sa ru/ /nyon mongs 'jag skya 'phyur ba la/ /ka dag chos sku'i mkha' dbyings su/ /brgyud pa'i bla ma'i lho sprin 'dus/ /gsol 'debs drag po'i g.yu 'brug ldir/ /thugs rje lcags kyu'i glog dmar 'khyug /byen rlabs bdud rtsi'i sbrang char phab/ /dag snang mos gus dor bsdebs nas/ /bla ma'i gdams ngag thong gshol btsugs/ /brtson 'grus drag po'i g.yog po yis/ /thos bsam sra log nyis log brgyab/ /dkar po dge bcu'i so nam byas/ /log rtog rdo dang nyal nyil bsal/ /rdzogs pa chen po'i sa bon btab/ /slar yang snying rus sdug bsran gyi/ /dor bsdebs bsgom pa'i thong gshol btsugs/ /yengs pa med par zhib tu rmos/ /man ngag gnad kyi bo brdung gis/ /gegs dang gol sa 'i bo ti brdungs—/ /nyams rtogs myu gu 'khrungs pa'i tshe/ /yengs med dran shes g.yog mo yis/ /bying rgod phra rags ldum bu bsal/ /bcos min snying rje'i ljang 118

bu dang / /g.yo med ting 'dzin myu gu rgyas/ /don gnyis lhun grub 'bras bu smin/ /sa zhing rmo na 'di ltar rmos/ /so nam byed na 'di ltar gyis/ /sa bon 'debs na 'di ltar thobs/ /'di ni bya btang rnal 'byor ngas/ /thar pa'i so nam byas tshul yin/ /zhes smras so/ /yang mi skya zhig gis reb gong gi mi rnams gdug rtsub che rab yod/ khyed pha yul na yod dus dgra la 'thab ya byas pa e yod zer ba'i lan du gtam drang por bshad nas/ glu 'di de dus yid la shar ba ltar rtse mtshar du blangs/chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs la 'dud/ /mi khyod rnal 'byor ngag la nyon/ /'khor ba'i reb gong sa 'phrang dog /nyon mongs mi rnams gdung rtsub che/ /bya btang byams pa chos dar ngas/ /thar pa'i grong khyer snyeg snyam nas/ /dam chos lam la zhugs pa'i tshe/ /bdag 'dzin zer ba'i phung rgan gyis/ /nyon mongs brgyad khri'i dmag dpung bsdus/ /chos brgyad dkar nag ru mtshon 'phyar/ /lam la bar chad rtsom pa'i tshe/ /nga yang nges 'byung rta la zhon/ /byang chub sems kyi go khrab gyon/ /yang dag lta ba'i mdung ring thogs/ /rgyab rten dkon mchog gsum la bcol/ /tshe 'dir phyi mig ma bltas par/ /119

ri khrod dben pa'i thang thog nas/ /nyon mongs dmag gi nang du brgyugs/ /dran shes lag par mchil ma btab/ /byeng rgod med pa'i mdung rnon de/ /bdag 'dzin dmag dpon snying la btab/ /thams cad chos nyid ngang du bsgral/ /snang stong sgyu ma'i ltad mo byung / /bslu med rten 'brel dpa' gdeng rnyed/ /rgyab rten bslu med mchog gsum gyis/ /'di phyi'i bde skyid dpa' dar dang / /dpa' bo khrom gshog cho lo gnang / /de dus 'khrug las rnal 'byor rgyal/ /zhes blangs pas/ mi skya des don ma go yang 'phral du nyams dga' bar gyur to//smras pa/ sku la mtshan dang dpe byad rgyan gyis spras/ /sku mdog gser ltar mdzes pa'i sangs rgyas kyi/ /sku mchog 'bral med spyi bo'i rgyan du bzhugs/ /sku gsung thugs kyi sgo nas byin gyis rlobs/ /bla ma'i rnam thar bzhin du chos bsgrub pa'i/ /skal bzang gdul bya yongs la phan pa'i phyir/ /rtse gzhung dben par sgrub pa byas pa'i tshul/ /slar yang glu ru len gyis dga' bas nyon/ /bka' drin mtshungs med chos rgyal rin po ches/ /nyin cig khyod kyis sgrub pa byed pa la/ /grub thob garma tshe dbang rig 'dzin gyi/ /zhabs kyis bcags shing byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas/ /rtse gzhung ri khrod dben pa'i 120

dga' tshal du/ /song na bzang zhes lung bstan gnang ba bzhin/ /der song gcig pur drang srong spyod tshul gyis/ /bde ba'i stan la rnam snang chos bdun byas/ /sgrub pa'i dam bca' smon lam mgur dbyangs blangs/ /sngon 'gro tshad ldan nyams su blangs pa'i tshe/ /tshogs rdzogs sgrib pa dag pa'i rmi lam byung / /dngos gzhi byang chub lam gyi rim par sbyangs/ /nges 'byung byang sems lta ba'i gzhi ma tshugs/ /gsang sngags bskyed rim bsgom tshe tha mal gyi/ /snang zhen dag nas gang snang lha skur shar/ /rdzogs rim bsgom tshe gtum mo'i bde drod 'bar/ /bde stong nyams la rgyun 'chad med pa byung / /rdzogs chen khregs chod bsgoms pas nyon mongs sangs thod rgal bsgoms pas nyams snang 'phel zhing rgyas/ /de ltar nyams su blangs pas lo 'ga' song / /nyin cig chos rgyal ngag gi dbang po yi/ /drung du song nas nyams len byas tshul dang / /nyams rtogs skyes tshul rim gyis zhus pa'i tshe/ /khong gi thugs dgyes zhal ras 'dzum bzhin du/ /bu khyod snying rus gzhan las che ba byung / /spyir ni nyams rtogs bzang po skyes par gda'/ /khyad par rdzogs chen khregs chod lta ba rtogs/ /thod rgal bsgoms pas nyams snang gong du 'phel/ /bar do tshe 121

'dir chod pa'i rten 'brel gyis/ /phyi mar bar do longs skur grol bar 'gyur/ /da ni tshe dang sgrub pa snyoms nus na/ /tshe 'dir 'ja' lus 'od skur grol ba 'am/ /yang na 'chi ba 'od gsal chos kyi skur/ /grol bar 'gyur zhes lung bstan dbugs dbyung mdzad/ /de nas nub gcig bdag gi rmi lam du/ /shel gyi ri la bai ḍūr+ya yi skas/ /btsugs pa zhig gi steng du phyin pa rmis/ /khong la zhus pas ma 'ongs lung bstan gnang / /rjes su khong gi lung bstan nang bzhin du/ /byang phyogs gdul bya rnams la phan thogs byung / /sgra mi snyan gyi tshe sgrub zhal shes dang / /bcas pa gnang bas zla gcig tshe sgrub byas/ /de dus lugs gnyis gleng mo byas tshul rnams/ /da lta'i dus 'dir skabs re dran pa byung / /drin can rgyal gye mkhan chen gnas der phebs/ /nyams rtogs bsdur pas thugs yid gcig tu 'dres/ /phan tshun bde zhus mgur dbyangs len bzhin phebs/ /de dus ma yis shog ces yi ge zhig /byung yang rang gis nyams len bzang ba'i 'phro /gcod par ma phod yul la 'gro ba bshol/ /'tshams rtagasabayig lan phul bas ma sring dgyes/ /gter ston bsod nams snyan grags rin po che/ /gnase der phebs dus rdzogs chen 122

dka' gnad rnams/ /'di 'dra yin nam ma yin dris pa'i tshe/ /thugs dgyes lan du zhal gsung mang po byon/ /snyigs ma'i dus 'dir rdzogs chen rnal 'byor pa/ /khyod 'dra yod pa shin tu ngo mtshar gsungs/ /phebs khar kun la thun mong bka' chos gnang / /dad rten zhus pas rdo la phyag rjes bzhag /rjes su mi snang zhig gis khyer nas gda'/ /drin can bla ma dran pa'i gdung dbyangs blangs/ /nyams la mjal ba'i snang ba shar nas dga'/ /spang gshongs shig tu song dus me tog gis/ /mi rtag chos bshad byas tshul mgur dbyangs blangs/ /rmi lam nyams la lha yis dbang bskur byas/ /rlung bzung mkha' la 'phur ba'i snang ba byung / /rig pa dwangs pas mngon shes phra mo shar/ /yon bdag 'ga' rer bshad pa thog tu song / /sog sprang zhig 'ongs rku zhig byed pa mthong / /snying rje mgur blangs gang yod byin nas btang / /gzhan yang rdzogs chen mtshams la bsdad tshul dang / /dam pa'i chos kyi so nam byas tshul dang / /nyon mongs dgra rnams btul tshul mgur dbyangs blangs/ /de dus na tshod gzhon zhing mthun rkyen 'dzoms/ /bla ma'i thugs rjes nyams rtogs rgyas pa'i mod/ /skyid pa'i rgyangs glu mang po len rgyu byung / /mdor na rtse 123

gzhung dben par sgrub pa byas/ /mdo sngags gzhung dang mthun pa'i nyams rtogs shar/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi rnam thar de ltar lags/ /rjes 'jug rnams kyang de bzhin skyong bar mdzod/ /glu 'di thos tshad skye bo pho mo yis/ /tshe rabs kun tu bla ma'i rnam thar bzhin/ /dben pa'i gnas su sgrub la gzhol ba'i mthus/ /nyams rtogs 'khrungs nas tshe gcig sangs rgyas shog /ces pa'ang bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o// 124

dben gnas stag mo rdzong dang / rgod po rdzong /ge tho rnams su song nas sgrub pa byas tshul/lnga ba gnas de dang thag nye ba'i dben gnas stag mo rdzong dang / rgod po rdzong / ge tho rnams su song nas sgrub pa byas tshul ni/ sngar sgrub pa'i rkang tshugs pa'i dben gnas khyad par can der mtshams sgrub byed mi mang ba'i stabs kyis/ mi mang po 'dus nas 'du 'dzi cher song nyams len ma 'phel tshe/gnas 'gol po zhig tu gcig pur bsgom na snyam/ chos rgyal rin po che la rgyu mtshan zhus pas/ 'o na bro kha zhig khyer la dben gnas stag mo rdzong du song gsungs pas/ de'i skabs su khong gi sku drin bsab phyir gsung las nam yang mi 'da' ba'i dam bca' 'di ltar phul lo//mkhyen pas shes bya kun gyi de nyid gzigs/ /brtse bas legs bshad dga' ston 'gro la stsol/ /mdzad pas rgyal ba mnyes pa 'ba' zhig bsgrubs/ /rgyal sras dam pa yud tsam bdag la dgongs/ /pha yul rgyab tu bzhag nas pha khyed drung / /snyeg dus thugs kyi brtse bas rjes bzung nas/ /thun mong lam gyis bdag rgyud legs par sbyangs/ /blo kha chos la phyogs pa pha 125

yi drin/ /smin byed dbang bskur grol byed khrid btab nas/ /rang gi sems nyid skye ba med pa'i don/ /gnas lugs mngon sum bstan nas ngo sprod byas/ /sangs rgyas gzhan nas mi 'tshol pha yi drin/ /mdor na dbang khrid man ngag gnang ba dang / /'tsho ba'i yo byad lto rgyab gnyis la sogs/ /lugs gnyis kyis bskyangs bka' drin thugs rje ni/ /stong gsum gser gyis bkang yang gzhal bar dka'/ /da ni drin lan sgrub pas 'jal ba'i phyir/ /phyogs med ri khrod 'grims shing tshe mjug 'dir/ /tshe dang sgrub pa snyoms pa'i mchod pa 'di/ /pha khyed thugs mnyes phyir du 'bul bar zhu/ /sems la g.yo med brtan pa ma thob bar/ /'jig rten 'du 'dzi'i gnas su mi 'dug par/ /dben par gcig pur 'dug pa'i mchod pa 'di/ /pha khyed thugs mnyes phyir du 'bul bar zhu/ /'tsho ba'i yo byad lto rgyab gnyis las kyang / /lhag pa'i yo byad mi 'dzin ming don gnyis/ /mthun pa'i bya btang byed pa'i mchod pa 'di/ /pha khyed thugs mnyes phyir du 'bul bar zhu/ /bdag gis smon pa'i gnas rnams 'di bzhin du/ /nges par 'grub pa'i legs smon 'debs pa dang / /ka dag zab gsal thugs kyi dkyil 'khor nas/ /nam yang mi 'dor ba yi 126

skyabs 'jug zhu/ /zhes phul bas khong gis bdag la tshe blos gtong tshul gyi zhal gdams 'di gsungs so//dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi yang mes po/ /gdod ma'i mgon po kun tu bzang po dang / /dbyer med dpal ldan bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /bu yi tshe blos thongs par byin gyis rlobs/ /e ma gson dang skal ldan snying gi bu/ /phan pa'i snying gtam pha yi zhal gdams shig /snying nas bshad kyis bu yis dang du longs/ /snying gtam legs pa snying gi dkyil du chongs/ /nyon mongs skye ba'i gzhi ma pha yul yin/ /pha yul bdud kyi btson rar shes bzhin du/ /phyogs med ri khrod 'grims shig snying gi bu/ /sha tsha'i gtam yin khyod kyis sems la chongs/ /'dod yon longs spyod dgra bo'i dngas ma yin/ /nye 'brel 'khor bar 'ching ba'i zhags pa 'dra/ /gnyen gzhi rtsa lag spongs shig snying gi bu/ /sha tsha'i gtam yin khyod kyis sems la chongs/ /'khor dang g.yog ni chags sdang gsog pa'i rgyu/ /rang nyid gcig pu'i g.yo bskol sus kyang shes/ /'khor med g.yog med mdzod cig snying gi bu/ /sha tsha'i gtam yin khyod kyis sems la chongs/ /rnyed dang bkur ste bdud kyi zhags pa yin/ /bstod dang grags pa'i tshig rnams bslu brid yin/ /127

bsnyen bkur snyan grags spongs shig snying gi bu/ /sha tsha'i gtam yin khyod kyis sems la chongs/ /dad zas gshin zas dge sbyor 'grib pa'i rkyen/ /ro zhim zas kyi sred pa rtsad nas chod/ /'tsho ba ngan ngon tsam sten snying gi bu/ /sha tsha'i gtam yin khyod kyis sems la chongs/ /tshe 'di rlung la bskur nas snying khams dang / /blo sna mi la mi 'chor rang tshugs gnyis/ /bya btang byed na dgos so snying gi bu/ /sha tsha'i gtam yin khyod kyis sems la chongs/ /dben par sdod tshe don med rnam g.yeng rnams/ /dge ba'i chos spyod g.yeng ba'i rgyu yin pas/ /bya rgyu byed rgyu ma mang snying gi bu/ /sha tsha'i gtam yin khyod kyis sems la chongs/ /blo phugs chos gtod chos phugs sprang la gtod/ /sprang phugs ltogs grir shi la gtod pa dang / /shi phugs brag la gtod cig snying gi bu/ /sha tsha'i gtam yin khyod kyis sems la chongs/ /'jig rten mi yi khyu nas ro ltar bud/ /khye gral snyogs dang lha gral ngang gis 'thob/ /bud snyeg thob gsum mdzod cig snying gi bu/ /sha tsha'i gtam yin khyod kyis sems la chongs/ /sgom chen 'khyags sam bkres nas shi ba'i gtam/ /sngon chad ma thos phyis kyang mi thos pas/ /snying rus sdug bsran ma chung snying gi bu/ /sha tsha'i 128

gtam yin khyod kyis sems la chongs/ /mdor na tshe 'di'i bya ba blo yis thongs/ /mi nor zas gsum thams cad dug bzhin spongs/ /kun spangs sprang po mdzod cig snying gi bu/ /sha tsha'i gtam yin khyod kyis sems la chongs/ /bsdad na 'phongs rjes 'gro na rkang rjes las/ /med par gyis la lham ni gyon gyur na/ /lus rgyu med par mdzod cig snying gi bu/ /sha tsha'i gtam yin khyod kyis sems la chongs/ /tshe 'di'i bya ba blo yis gtong tshul 'di/ /rgya bod mkhas grub du ma'i phyag srol yin/ /gong ma'i rnam thar zungs shig snying gi bu/ /sha tsha'i gtam yin khyod kyis sems la chongs/ /dge 'dis las can gang zag mang po yis/ /tshe 'di'i bya ba thams cad blos btang nas/ /dben pa'i gnas su sgrub la gzhol ba yi/ /'bras bu tshe 'di nyid la 'thob par shog /ces gsungs/ gzhan yang zhal gdams gang gnang rnams mgur 'bum na gsal lo/ /de nas dben par 'gro khar bde zhus su 'di phul/bde skyid kun 'byung gzims gur na bzhugs pa'i/ /bde legs kun stsol chos rgyal ni yab yum/ /bde bar bzhugs la dad ldan gyi bu nga / /bde gsal thugs nas mi 'dor bar zhu lags/ /bde gshegs kun 'dus bla ma yi 129

gsung bzhin/ /bde bar dben gnas gang bzang la chas 'gro/ /bde ba'i blo gdeng nyams rtogs kho skyes tshe/ /bde zhus phyir du 'ongs pa yin zhu lags/ /bde med 'khor ba'i bya ba rnams spangs nas/ /bde chen thar lam sgrub mkhan ni yod na/ /bde bar nga phyir dben pa ru shog dang / /bde skyid nyi ma nang nas rang 'char ro/ /zhes phul bas/ khong gis bdag la sku gsung thugs kyi byen rlabs mdzad nas 'di skad gsungs/zhing phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba ma lus kun/ /bdag tha mal snang ngor bla ma yi/ /skur shar te chos kyi sman mchog gis/ /nyon mongs pa'i nad kun sel la 'dud/ /khyed thugs rje chen pos nyer gzigs te/ /skal ldan gyi bu slob 'di nyid kyis/ /gnas dben par sgrub par 'gro ba la/ /phyi dgra dang bgegs sogs mi 'byung zhing / /nang nyon mongs nad sogs med pa dang / /chos zab mo myur du mthar phyin nas/ /dus ring min dga' spro'i mjal ba ru/ /byen rlabs kyi mtshan ma mngon gyur mdzod/ /ces gsungs pa'i mthar bdag gis bla ma yab yum la phyag 'tshal/ 'gro khar chos rgyal rin po che'i zhabs spyi bor blangs nas myur du mjal ba'i smon lam 'di ltar btab/e ma ho/ byin rlabs kun stsol rtsa brgyud bla ma dang / /130

dngos grub kun ster yi dam zhi khro'i lha/ /bar chad kun sel dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ma/ /'phrin las kun sgrub chos skyong tshogs rnams kyis/ /pha yi sku tshe bskal brgyar brtan pa dang / /bu yi nyams rtogs yon tan gong 'phel nas/ /myur du dpon slob lhan cig 'dzoms nas kyang / /'bral med rgyun du gnas pa'i dge legs stsol/ /ces zhus pas thugs mnyes pa'i gsung mang po gnang ba'i mthar/ nga dben gnas thā yan chir song nas de na bzhugs pa'i mkhas btsun bzang gsum 'dzoms pa'i sku gzhogs la kha rin po che dang / rtogs ldan dkon mchog chos 'phel/ bu chen pad+ma rang grol/ 'jam dpal/ rab rgyas/ rigs ldan/ dag ge/ chos grags sogs dad brtson shes rab snying rje dang ldan pa'i mched grogs rdo rje'i spun rnams la/ gegs sel bogs 'don sogs byas nas 'gro khar dge ba'i gsal 'debs su zhal gdams 'di yang byen no//skyabs gnas bslu ba med pa dkon mchog gsum/ /kun 'dus chos rgyal ngag gi dbang po la/ /sgo gsum gus pas snying nas gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag gzhan smin cing grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /skal ldan dam tshig ldan pa'i grogs rnams 131

la/ /bya btang bdag gis snying gtam tshig 'ga' bshad/ /dal 'byor rten bzang mi lus thob dus 'dir/ /don chen byang chub sgrubs shig mched grogs rnams/ /don med tshe 'di'i bya ba blos thongs la/ /dben gnas ri khrod 'grims shig mched grogs rnams/ /'chi ba glo bur nam 'ong cha med pas/ /shi yang 'gyod med dgos so mched grogs rnams/ /'chi tshe zas nor longs spyod shul du 'jog /nor la ser sna ma byed mched grogs rnams/ /bar do'i 'phrang la gcig pur 'gro dgos pas/ /gnyen la gdung sems ma che mched grogs rnams/ /'gro kun pha mar ma gyur gcig kyang med/ /dgra la zhe sdang ma che mched grogs rnams/ /nang 'dre rang sems thul na phyi dgra med/ /rang sems gyong po thul cig mched grogs rnams/ /las kyi 'bras bu nam yang mi bslu bas/ /sdig spongs dge ba sgrubs shig mched grogs rnams/ /'khor ba'i gnas na bde ba'i go skabs med/ /me yi 'obs ltar ltos shig mched grogs rnams/ /mi nor zas gsum gang la'ang snying po med/ /'dre 'dul grong chog spongs shig mched grogs rnams/ /'jig rten 'du 'dzi'i gnas su dge sbyor g.yeng / /gcig pur dben pa sten cig mched grogs rnams/ /chos 132

mdzad grogs dang lhan cig 'grogs dus su/ /phan sems dag snang gyis shig mched grogs rnams/ /re ltos ngo bsrung med na bya btang yin/ /rang dbang mi la ma 'chor mched grogs rnams/ /rang rgyud nyon mongs thul na grub thob yin/ /rang skyon rang gis thon cig mched grogs rnams/ /sgo gsum zhi zhing dul na grub rtags yin/ /nye ring chags sdang spongs shig mched grogs rnams/ /bslu ba med pa dkon mchog rnam gsum yin/ /snying nas skyabs 'gro mdzod cig mched grogs rnams/ /theg chen chos kyi rtsa ba sems bskyed yin/ /byang chub sems mchog sgoms shig mched grogs rnams/ /sdig sgrib sbyangs pa'i gtso bo stobs bzhi yin/ /rdor sems bsgom bzlas mdzod cig mched grogs rnams/ /tshogs bsags bsod nams mchog ni maṇ+ḍal yin/ /rgyun 'chad med par phul cig mched grogs rnams/ /byin rlabs myur 'jug bla ma'i rnal 'byor yin/ /rtag tu gsol ba thobs shig mched grogs rnams/ /mtshan ldan bla ma'i gsung la bslu ba med/ /ci gsungs tshad mar zungs shig mched grogs rnams/ /mchog thun dngos grub rtsa ba yi dam yin/ /yi dam bskyed rim sgoms shig mched grogs rnams/ /bar chad kun sel mkha' 'gro 133

chos skyong yin/ /tshogs dang gtor ma phul cig mched grogs rnams/ /rang rig rang gsal skyong ba khregs chod yin/ /gsal stong 'dzin med skyongs shig mched grogs rnams/ /gdos bcas 'od skur grol ba thod rgal yin/ /lhun grub 'od gsal sgoms shig mched grogs rnams/ /tshul bzhin bsgoms na tshe gcig 'ja' lus 'grub/ /snying nas dga' ba sgoms shig mched grogs rnams/ /'di ni ma nor drang po'i ngag gis smras/ /tshul bzhin nyams su longs shig mched grogs rnams/ /'dis mtshon dus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba'i mthus/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs pad brtan pa dang / /grogs mched rnams kyang nyams rtogs gong 'phel nas/ /tshe gcig sku gsum go 'phang mngon gyur shog /ces smras pas mched grogs thams cad dga' mgu yi rang bar gyur to/ /de dus sngon sbyangs las 'phro can gyi bu chen seng bzang rgya mtsho 'am/ rig 'dzin zla ba/ mtshan yongs grags bla ma pad+ma rang grol mchog la/ chos rgyal rin po ches dbang dang gdams pa gnang ba'i khar/ bdag gis gsal ba'i jog tu sgon me lta bur/ lung khrid mang po byas/ zhal gdams kyang byen nas dbus gtsang gnyis pa bla brang bkra shis 'khyil ba'i dgon chen 134

brgyud nas/ reb gong gser mo ljongs su song / lha bla mas lung bstan pa'i dben gnas bkra shis 'khyil nas lo mang po'i bar du sgrub pa snying por byas/ sgrub 'bras kyis bstan 'gro'i don rgya chen mdzad tshul rnams rgyas par khong gi rnam thar na gsal lo/ /de nas bro kha dang cog bu rnams rgyab tu khur te lam du zhugs nas song tshe/ mi zhig gis khyed gang nas yin/gang du 'gro zer bar lan drang por smras nas/ de dus yid la shar ba ltar mgur dbyangs 'di blangs/mi nga ni seng ge dkar mo'i bu/ /dang po seng ma'i 'o mas bskyangs/ /bar du sna tshogs zan gyis gsos/ /da lta rtsal gsum lus la rdzogs/ /seng g.yu ral rgyas pa pha ma'i drin/ /da mi sdod gangs stod 'grim du 'gro /gangs dkar po seng ge 'gying sa yin/ /mi nga ni bya rgyal khyung gi bu/ /dang po bya ma'i drod kyis bskyangs/ /bar du sna tshogs zan gyis gsos/ /da lta gshog rtsal thams cad rgyas/ /khyung mkha' la lding ba pha ma'i drin/ /da mi sdod dgung sngon 'grim du 'gro /mkha' yangs pa gathog rlabs rkyong sa yin/ /mi nga ni chos kyi rgyal po'i bu/ /dang po rjes bzung gdams ngag gnang / /bar du ri la bsgom du bcug /da lta nyams rtogs yon tan skyes/ /sprang ri khrod 135

thub pa bla ma'i drin/ /da mi sdod ri khrod 'grim du 'gro /gnas dben pa bya btang 'dug sa yin/ /zhes blangs nas gtsang dgon par song / grwa pa zhig gi nang g.yar nas zhag po bdun tsam zhig bsdad/ sku gzhogs gtsang pa tshang gi phyag dpe'i khrod nas grub thob brgyad cu'i rnam thar la bltas pas/nang na grub thob phal che ba zhig gis bskyed rdzogs kyi gdams pa zab mo nyung nyung re bsgoms pas/ grub pa thob song ba mang po mthong bas nyams len rang gis byed nus na gdams pa mang po mi dgos par gda' snyam/ nyams len byed 'dod kyi blo shed cher song / de nas nyin cig sku gzhogs gal gor tshang la mjal/ thog ma'i blo sbyong chos kyi sgo 'byed kyi lung zhus/yang sku gzhogs mtshams gor tshang la mjal/ ma ṇi dang dmigs brtse ma'i lung zhig zhus/ de nas rgyab ri'i ri khrod pa 'jam dbyangs a dzi'i tshang gi mdun du song mjal nas zhag kha shas bsdad/ rje btsun mi la ras pa'i rnam mgur dang / rje skal ldan rgya mtsho'i mgur 'bum/ rgyal sras lag len/ ang yig bdun cu rnams kyi lung zhus pas/ thugs dgyes bzhin gnang / de'i zhor la sems la phan pa'i gsung yang mang po byon pa byung / 'gro khar bde zhus byas nas dben gnas stag 136

mo rdzong du song / brag phug che chung gnyis yod pa'i chung ba'i nang du mal sa bcas rtswa gdan btings nas bsdad pas/ nyi ma gcig song ba'i phyi nyin dgong mo gnyid ma gnyid kyi mtshams shig la/ sa g.yo ba lta bu'i 'ur sgra dang / skar ma lta bu'i 'od khra chem chem pa zhig gis nang thams cad gang nas rang gi lus kyi mgo nas mjug gi bar bal gsed gsed byas ban bun lang long shag shig la btang nas re zhig bsdad/yang sgra 'od sogs snga ma de las che ru song / yang de'i che zhig btang nas bsdad pa'i tshe nga'i bsam pa la/ gnas 'di ni sngon bla ma pā rin pa tshang gis mthu bsgrubs pa red zer bar gda'/ de'i gnod pa 'dra min nam/ phyag rdor zhig 'don snyam ma thag sems la bdag 'dzin blos ma thongs par gda'/bdag 'dzin blos ma thongs pa'i chos kyis ci bya/ srungs shig skyobs shig brgya brjod pa las/ zo zhig thungs shig gcig dga' zer ba yin snyam/ gcod dmigs yag po zhig btang nas chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs chos dbyings stong gsal nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang la nyal bsdad pa'i mtshan mo rmi lam du/rang gi bem rig phral nas/ rang rig rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i phyag g.yas pa'i gri gug gis/ rang gi bam po sa la 137

bsgyel ba'i mgo bo dang steng gi sha bcad nas/ mi nag po gcig bla rgan gcig bud med gcig dang gsum la byen pas rngams nas za bar gda'/ ngas kyang mi sha 'di ci 'dra zhig yin snyam kha la bzhag pas/ rang sha rang gis za ba rten 'brel btsog pa snyam ma zos par sa la 'phangs tshe/ de yang mi nag po des blangs nas zos pa dang / bdag gis 'di rnams shin tu ltogs 'dug snyam/ bem po ma lus pa dum bur gtubs nas byen pas/ gsum po ngoms shing tshims nas dga' di ri ri song ba zhig rmis/ de nas bzung ste 'tshub de med song /bdag gi bsam pa la/ bdag 'dzin blos gtong rgyu yin na lha 'dres mi gnod pa'i khar dga' nas grogs byed par gda' snyam pa byung / yang mgar rtse'i dge slong thogs med kyis gnas 'di e spro gi lags zer ba'i lan du gnas spro tshul gyi yon tan brjod pa'i mgur dbyangs 'di de dus yid la shar ba ltar blangs so//rje dus gsum sangs rgyas thugs kyi sprul/ /pha chos rgyal ngag gi dbang po la/ /dus rgyun 'chad med par gsol ba 'debs/ /sprang ri khrod thub par byen gyis rlobs/ /mi nga dang dbe+en gnas stag mo rdzong / /lhan cig tu 'grigs pa'i 138

dga' spro skyes/ /sems ri khar phyogs pa'i ri pa ngas/ /gdangs snyan mo'i glu dbyangs 'di ltar 'then/ /sa bkra shis g.yang chags stag mo rdzong / /sngon skyes chen mang po bzhugs pa'i gnas/ /brag phyi dbyibs ri la nang khang pa/ /kha lhor lta dgun dus nyi 'od 'khyil/ /dbyar sos dus bsil zhing rig pa dwangs/ /chu me shing la sogs mthun rkyen sla/ /dus kun tu spro zhing snang ba skyid/ /steng mtha' dbus med pa'i mkha' dbyings su/ /bya rgod po'i gshog rtsal go ro ro/ /rgyab brag ri lha shing shug pas brgyan/ /dri zhim pa'i dri bzang thu lu lu/ /mdun spang ri me tog mang po'i rtse/ /rkang drug ldan bung ba di ri ri/ /mdo chu rgyun gtsang ma babs pa las/ /skad snyan pa'i lhung sgra si li li/ /ngos kun na ri dwags bag phebs rgyu/ /kun rtse zhing bang rtsal sha ra ra/ /shing ljon shing yal ga'i rtse mo na/ /bya sna tshogs skad snyan kyu ru ru/ /steng chu 'dzin bla re 'then 'dra las/ /dbyar zim bu'i sbrang char da la la/ /bar na bun dar dkar bkram pa las/ /'ja' lnga ldan ri mo ya la la/ /gnas 'di yi gzhi bdag chos la dkar/ /rang gang 'dod yo byad kyi li li/ /grong dgon pa thag nyer med pa yi/ /sgra 'a 'ur med pas dal cag cag /gnas dben cing bla ma'i 139

byin rlabs kyis/ /rgyud nyams rtogs yon tan 'u ru ru/ /de'i stobs kyis bya btang ri pa ngas/ /gdangs snyan mo'i glu dbyangs lhang lhang lhang / /blo chos la phyogs pa'i chos mdzad rnams/ /gnas 'di 'dra bsten na ngo mtshar che/ /glu 'di 'dra len na ri la shog /dge 'dis kyang chos mdzad skye bo kun/ /gnas dben pa bsten nas 'tshang rgya shog /ces dang /yang nyin cig snang ba spro ba'i shugs kyis skyid nyi zla zung 'brel gye glu chung 'di ltar blangs/rje mtshan ldan bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /chos tshul bzhin sgrub pa'i bya btang pa/ /ming tshogs drug rang grol zhes bya ngas/ /skyid nyi zla zung 'brel glu zhig len/ /ngas 'khor ba'i bya ba blos gtong tshe/ /sems skyo shas nges 'byung shugs drag dang / /chos snying nas 'dod pa'i nyi zla shar/ /'di skyid pa'i nyi zla dang po yin/ /skyabs chos dang bla ma btsal ba'i tshe/ /chos zab lam rdzogs pa chen po dang / /mgon chos kyi rgyal po'i nyi zla shar/ /'di skyid pa'i nyi zla gnyis pa yin/ /mgon de yi zhabs pad sten dus su/ /rje sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes dang / /sems 'gyur med dad pa'i nyi zla shar/ /'di skyid pa'i nyi zla gsum pa yin/ /gnas dben par nyams su 140

blang sa pa'i tshe/ /ma 'gro la bcos min snying rje dang / /nyams rtogs pa bzang po'i nyi zla shar/ /'di skyid pa'i nyi zla bzhi ba yin/ /skyid nyi zla zung 'brel glu chung 'di/ /mi rang la spro ba bskyed phyir blangs/ /dge 'dis kyang ma gyur sems can kun/ /dus gnas skabs bde zhing skyid par shog /ces blangs/ yang skabs shig a ma rgan mo dran nas 'phrad snying 'dod pa'i tshe/ rang la 'di skad ces smras pa/yon tan kun gyi gter chen po/ /drin can bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /zhen chags a 'thas 'khrul pa rnams/ /rtsad nas chod par byin gyis rlobs/ /bya btang tshogs drug rang grol khyod/ /ma yengs lhan ne rna bas nyon/ /yul gyi gdung sems ma chod na/ /ri la 'ongs pas ci la phan/ /zhen chags mkha' ltar ma dag na/ /bya btang ming gis ci la phan/ /dal 'byor snying po mi len na/ /mi lus thob pas ci la phan/ /shi yang 'gyod med mi byed na/ /'che bar shes pas ci la phan/ /sdig spong dge ba mi bsgrub na/ /las 'bras shes pas ci la phan/ /'khor ba blo yis mi gtong na/ /nyes dmigs shes pas ci la phan/ /snying nas skyabs 'gro mi byed na/ /kha tsam skyabs 'gros ci la phan/ /bla mas ci gsung mi bsgrub na/ /141

lags so mang pos ci la phan/ /brtson 'grus byas nas mi bsgom na/ /gdams ngag zab pas ci la phan/ /tshe dang sgrub pa mi snyoms na/ /lo zla'i mtshams kyis ci la phan/ /phyogs med snying rje ma skyes na/ /a mar gces pas ci la phan/ /'gro kun a mar ma shes na/ /a ma dran pas ci la phan/ /'khor 'das ro gcig ma rtogs na/ /a mar 'phrad pas ci la phan/ /rnam rtog chos skur ma shar na/ /'gyu ba bzhag pas ci la phan/ /ro gcig lta ba'i pha yul nas/ /'gro 'ong med par ma 'phrad na/ /ro la 'phrad pas mi phan steng / /gnod par 'gyur bas cog ge zhog /a ma'i gtso byas 'gro kun sems/ /rang gi sems dang bla ma'i thugs/ /bsres nas nyams su blangs gyur na/ /don dam ngang la thug tshul yin/ /zhes tshig 'dis gsal btab nas khyod 'khrul gyin yod par 'dug ma gyur 'gro kun don du sangs rgyas thob 'dod kyi bsam pas dben gnas 'dir 'ongs pa ma yin nam zhes a ma dran pa'i rkyen byas/ ma gyur 'gro ba nyam thag yongs la bcos ma ma yin pa'i snying rje bzod glags med pa zhig skyes nas/ cog bu gsar ba zhig yod pa gtsang dgon pa'i mtha' na rgan mo rkang zha ma zhig yod pa de la byin pas/ mos btsongs nas ras bcu 142

drug tu brjes te rin gyi phyed dgon pa la mang ja zhig btang /rtsag 'gags gsar pa zhig yod pa sprang po zhig la byin pas/ras drug gi rin gyi ja mar dang rtsam pa blangs nas dgon par phyag skor kyang byas skad/ bro kha cung zad cig yod pa'i nang nas mang po brdzis te khwa ta dang skya ka mang po la byen nas/ ma gyur 'gro kun don du myur ba myur du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob nas bstan 'gro yongs la phan rgya chen po thogs pa'i smon lam btab ste nyams len la zhugs so/ /yang nyin cig nyi ma nub mtshams su khwa ta pho mo gnyis kyis skad rigs mi 'dra ba mang po bsgrags pa'i tshe/ bdag gis rang la khwa ta 'di gnyis kyis ci zer bar 'dug khyod glu ba bzang na 'di gnyis kyis bshad tshul dang 'dra ba'i glu zhig longs dang zhes rang la bskul nas/de gnyis kyi pho yis mo la 'di skad zer/a a/ da ni nged gnyis 'gro ran 'dug /'dzam gling nyi ma nub nas thal/ /pha yul lngon shing rtse mo ru/ /sos dal bde bar nyal du 'gro /zhes bshad pa'i tshe/ ngas khwa ta pho mo gnyis la 'di skad smras/nags la gnas pa'i khwa ta khyod/ /brag la gnas pa'i mi ngar nyon/ /khyod kyis pha yul ma shes sam/ /ljon shing khyod kyi 143

pha yul min/ /pha yul ma shes dgod re bro/ /zhes bshad pa'i tshe/ khwa ta pho bdag la ma dga' ba'i rnam 'gyur byas spu shig shig byed cing 'di skad zer/ga ban rgan zhig gis ci zer snang / /nga'i pha yul 'di nyid yin par nges/ /'di min na yul med sprang po khyod/ /nga'i pha yul shes na spros shig dang / /zhes zer ba'i lan du bdag gis 'di skad smras/ma 'phur khā ta bde bar bzhugs/ /gtan gyi pha yul ma shes na/ /ngas bshad khyod kyis sems la zungs/ /nged rnams pha yul 'di min te/ /pha yul kun bzang zhing khams yin/ /a ma kun tu bzang mo'i bu/ /btsas nas yun ring ma lon par/ /sha nye ma rig rgan mo yis/ /nyon mongs las rlung rtar bskyon te/ /khams gsum 'khor ba'i gnas 'dir khrid/ /nged rnams ma song sa cha med/ /ma skyes lus ni gcig kyang med/ /yul med khwa ta pho mo gnyis/ /pha yul ma shes snying re rje/ /zhes bshad pa'i tshe/ yang pho yis 'di skad zer/he he/ yul med sprang po khyod nyid kyis/ /bshad kyang nga nyid dgod re bro/ /'o na khyod kyis shes gyur na/ /yul med sprang po khyod nyid kyang / /pha yul de la myur 'gro mod/ /nga 144
