dang 'grogs ya ci la byas/ /zhes bshad pa'i tshe/ ngas 'di skad smras/yid gnyis mkhan gyi khwa ta nyon/ /nga dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang po yis/ /pha yul 'di min bshad pa'i tshe/ /lam ston mtshan ldan bla ma la/ /bsam sbyor gnyis kyi phyag rten phul/ /dag snang mos gus thal mo sbyar/ /lam ston lam mkhan skyel ma zhus/ /bla mas rdzogs chen nye lam bstan/ /gdams ngag bzang po'i rta phor bskyon/ /bogs 'don rta lcag lag tu gtad/ /bdag gis brtson 'grus lcag gis brabs/ /thar pa'i lam du dkyus thag bcad/ /rta pho rang nyid bzang stabs kyis/ /gtan yul kun bzang zhing khams su/ /dka' tshegs med par myur du slebs/ /a ma kun tu bzang mor mjal/ /gnyis su med par dga' spro skyes/ /ka dag chos sku'i rgyal sa ru/ /rang byung rig pa'i khye'u ngas/ /'gyur med ting 'dzin rgyal srid bzung / /'phags pa'i nor gyis bang mdzod bkang / /'od gsal rab mdzes btsun mo dang / /zhen chags med par 'grogs nas yod/ /dga' bde lhun grub 'bral med kyis/ /gtan gye btsan sa zin pa 'dra/ /khwa ta khyod kyis ci zhig sems/ /zhes bshad tshe/ khwa 145

tas 'di skad zer/ga re/ de yin na mi khyod ngo mtshar che/ /da khyod kyi pha yul de nyid dang / /'di gnyis la da dung 'di bzang 'dug /da chung ma bzang mo yar la bzhengs/ /zhes ka a la sogs pa'i skad rigs sna tshogs byas nas 'phur 'gro ba'i lam bar nas/mo yis pho la 'di skad zer/brag la gnas pa'i sgom chen des/ /gtan yul zin pa ngo mtshar che/ /nged gnyis gtan yul ma zin par/ /'khor bar 'khyams pa zhe re smreng / /zhes cung zad spreng ba'i tshul byas tshe/pho na re/yid 'ong chung ma nga la nyon/ /yid ches de la cung zad med/ /dpon med g.yog med de 'dra yis/ /pho ba zas kyis 'grangs pa'i tshe/ /'dra 'dra 'grig 'grig bshad pa yin/ /de la ya mtshan che rgyu med/ /de bas nged gnyis ngo mtshar che /zhes mo yi sems gso byed bzhin 'phur song ngo / /zhes pa 'di ni rang gi khams bsangs pa'i ched du smras pa'o/ /yang nyin cig chu khar song bas chu 'khyil nang du 'bu gshog thogs brgya phrag cig lhung nas 'ga' zhig shi/ gzhan rnams ma shi bar chu nang nas 'gul ba mthong tshe snying rje nas/ thur ma zhig gis 146

'bu rnams skam sar bton nas yar 'phur du bcug chu 'khyil kha phral te chu mar 'gor bcug nas/ nyam thag 'bu rnams chu nang du/ /lhung ba skam sar bton pa bzhin/ /'gro kun 'khor ba'i mtsho las bsgral/ /sangs rgyas sa la 'god par shog /ces smon lam btab/ gnas chen der zla ba bzhi tsam zhig sdod pa'i ring la/ mi yi rgyu 'grul med pa'i stabs kyis nyams len 'phel po byung / de nas yang drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho rin po che'i gdan sa a byes ge tho ru song nas gnas 'brel zhig 'jog snyam/ stag mo rdzong nas thon te rwa rgya'i dgon par song / shing bza' thams cad mkhyen pa blo bzang dar rgyas dpal bzang po mchog la mjal skyabs 'gro'i lung khrid zhus pas/ thugs brtse bas lam thun mong gi chos bshad bcas khrid rgyas par gnang bas sems la phan po byung / thar shul khri rgan rin po cher mjal/ drung nas bde lam myur lam gnyis kyi lung zhus/ a rig khri pa byams pa 'phrin las rab rgyas tshang la mjal/ ja mar rtsam pa'i gsol ras shig zhus pas yag po gnang ba byung / de nas gzings thog nas rma chu'i pha khar song a byes ge tho'i mgul du bla ma'i bzhugs gnas nas zla ba gcig lhag bsdad/ gnas de na ri 147

khrod pa bla rgan zhig gis rje yab sras gsum gyi gsung 'bum klog par gda'/ ngas kyang rje rin po che'i gsung 'bum la mjal nas/ rags rim tsam zhig bltas pas go rgyu chen po byung / rjes su zhib tu bltas tshe mdo sngags bstan pa yongs su rdzogs pa gsal bar mdzad pa'i legs bshad kun gyi mchog tu go ste/ /rma pa kun mkhyen chos kyi grags pas/ dus phyis bka' phyag sa skya pa yi ni/ /bla ma mkhas grub rnams la gtugs pa las/ /mkhas pa blo bzang grags pa'i dpal zhes pa/ /mdo sngags bstan pa gsal bar mdzad pa byung / /gsungs pa'i thog tu babs 'dug snyam sngar bas dad gus dag snang tshad med pa zhig skyes pa byung / gnas der sdod pa'i ring la wal rga su'i sog po'i sprang mo rnams kyis gro ma yag po rtsam pa dang brje rgyu e yod zer mkhan byung nas brjes/ la lar rtsam pa byin nas kun gyi sems dga' bar byas/ nyin cig sog po'i mi skya zhig gis bdag la nad cig byung 'dug pas khyed kyis mo zhig thobs zer ba'i lan du/ ngas mo mi 'debs khyod kyi 'phral rkyen gye nad de la skyon med de/ de bas khyod la nad gzhi rnying ba zhig yod pa de khyod kyis ma shes par 'dug de la mo zhig 'debs dgos na 'debs zhes rgyal ba'i bka' mo 148

btab tshul gyi mgur dbyangs snyan la ring ba 'di blangs so//chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs la 'dud/ /bya btang tshogs drug rang grol ngas/ /'khrul med rgyal ba'i bka' mo 'debs/ /dang po dkon mchog bden pa bdar/ /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang / /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ /gsol 'debs drag pos mo 'di bdar/ /khams gsum 'khor ba'i khang pa na/ /nyon mongs nad kyis rtag btab pa'i/ /mi 'di'i tshe rabs las nad 'di/ /dang po ci las byung tshul dang / /bar du ji ltar na tshul dang / /tha ma bsrung bzlog myur 'bad na/ /srog stor skyon ni yod med rnams/ /gsal bar ston pa dkon mchog mkhyen/ /de nas lag mthil sa gzhi ru/ /rgyal ba'i gsung rab mo gdan btings/ /rab gsal mig gi rde'u bkram/ /shes rab mo yi dpyad pa byas/ /mo ni mi bzang mo ni ngan/ /dang po nad pa khyod nyid kyis/ /ma rig 'khrul ba'i zas ngan zos/ /sems nyid gtsang ma'i pho bar bsdad/ /bdag gzhan chags sdang na zug langs/ /de la dug lnga'i gdon chen dang / /brgyad khri bzhi stong la sogs pa'i/ /gdon rnams kun gyis rgyab rten byas/ /zug gzer nad tshabs cher rgyas nas/ /dam chos zas kyi dang kha 'gags/ /149

sdig pa'i chu la skom dad che/ /nad dang gdon ni de 'dra 'dug /nad pa khyod nyid nyon mongs pa'i/ /gdon gyis yid dkrugs rab myos pas/ /nad rnams ngos ni ma zin nges/ /sman dang rim gror myur 'bad na/ /srog myur skyon ni nges par med/ /myur du dam chos bsrung ba la/ /ma 'bad nad tshabs cher song nas/ /thar pa'i srog rtsa gcod par nges/ /de phyir khe nyen shin tu che/ /nad kyi bcos thabs rim pa la/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen sman pa sten/ /bsam sbyor gnyis kyi phyag rten phul/ /ma rig 'khrul ba'i sha dug la / /dang po thos bsam sbyong zhig rgyob/ /de nas dbu rdzogs phyag chen gsum/ /gang rung gdams pa'i sman bzang thungs/ /myur du grol bar je tshom med/ /gdon gyi bcos thabs rim pa la/ /bag yod dran shes sngags pa yis/ /zhe sdang pho gdon rgyal po la/ /byams pa'i rgyal mdos legs par rdzongs/ /'dod chags mo gdon bsen mo la/ /mi sdug bsen mo dgu mdos bsngos/ /gti mug klu dang sa bdag la/ /shes rab sa bdag gdon grol gyis/ /phrag dog steng gdon gza' bdud la/ /dag snang dug dbyung ci mang mdzod/ /nga rgyal shi 'dre gshed 'khyams la/ /khengs sgyungs gshed 'dul drag po gyis/ /log par lta ba'i 150

btsan rgod la/ /dad gus bzang bo'i btsan mdos bsngos/ /ser sna'i bse rag 'gong po la/ /gtong phod sbyin pa'i yas sbyin gyis/ /de min gzhan ma'i gdon rnams la/ /dge bcu'i bsrung bzlog gang mang gyis/ /rjes gcod stong nyid snying rje yi/ /yi dam bsnyen sgrub tshad ldan gyis/ /de rnams byas na nad sos shing / /'khun bu thams cad dwangs nas kyang / /mi khyod nad las grol bar nges/ /bsrung ba 'di rnams ma byas na/ /khyod ni nad tshabs cher song nas/ /khams gsum 'khor ba'i mal du lhung / /skye 'chi gnyis la sngas mgo byas/ /bde sdug gnyis kyi g.yang lugs gyon/ /chags sdang zug gzer na tsha de/ /nam yang bde bar mi 'gyur ro/ /des na nad pa khyod nyid kyis/ /da lta bcos su yod thog 'dir/ /myur du bcos na mi legs sam/ /dge 'dis mkha' mnyam 'gro kun gyis/ /rgyal ba'i bka' mo btab nas kyang / /dge ba'i bshes gnyen sman pa sten/ /dam chos zab mo'i sman 'thungs nas/ /nyon mongs nad las grol bar shog /ces mtshar mtshar lta bur dbyangs su blangs pas/ mi kho yang ngo mtshar skyes nas/ rgyal ba'i bka' mo de shin tu legs/ da kho bo yang nam 'chi cha mi 'dug pas khyed kyis ma ṇi'i lung zhig thugs rjes gzigs 151

thugs dam skyabs 'og nas ma 'dor zer/ ngas kho la byen rlabs byas te lam thun mong gi chos skor dang ma ṇi'i phan yon rnams bshad nas lung byin/ gzhan yang mgur dbyangs sna tshogs pa mang po blangs pas kho'i snang ba chos la 'gyur/ dad gus bzang po skyes nas ma ṇi 'don bzhin rang yul du song ngo / /de nas lha gnyan rgod rtse'i ri sul gye bdag gi yongs 'dzin dam pa a rig dge bshes rin po che'i sgrub gnas der gnas 'brel zhig 'jog snyam/ ge tho nas rma chur brgal nas tshur 'ongs pas/ rwa rgya'i dgon pa'i mtha' na/ gad skyibs thog khebs med pa zhig na/ sog po'i rgan mo rtsib logs g.yon bskams nas 'khum pa/ lag mgo g.yon rmar song nas rnag khrag 'dzag pa'i dri ngan pa bro ba rgyang nas tshor ba/ bza' btung gang yang med pa zhig 'dug pa mthong nas snying rje chen bo sgyes te/ rwa rgya'i dgon pa'i grwa pa rnams 'a zas bslangs pas/ zla ba gcig tsam gyi bro kha rnyed pa rnams rgan mo'i sngas mgor bzhag ste 'di skad smras/bla ma dkon mchog thugs rje can/ /thugs rje'i spyan gyis rgan mor gzigs/ /pha mar ma gyur gcig kyang med/ /nyam thag rgan mo snying re rje/ /sdug tshe phan pa'i gnyen bshes 152

med/ /ltogs tshe za rgyu'i za ma med/ /'og nas sa yis gyen du brlan/ /steng nas mi 'dod char ba babs lus la 'tsho med nad kyis btab/ /sprang na 'dod kyang 'gul mi nus/ /lus la rnag khrag dri ngan bro/ /sngun du 'khor mkhan mi gcig med/ /gshang gcis gos pa'i mal sa las phar la mi 'chi tshur mi gson/ /'di 'dra mthong na mchi ma 'chor/ /zhes smras pas/ mo yang ngu bzhin khyed gang nas yin gang du 'grokhyed 'dir byon pa sngon mo la bu gces phrug cig yod pa shi song ba de phyir 'ongs nas phrad pa dang khyad ma byung zer/ bu yang dran nas mang po ngus pa'i tshe/ nga yang mig nas mchi ma shor ba byung / de nas ngas yin tshul smras pas/ mo na re/ da 'di phyi bar do gsum du thugs dam skyabs 'og nas ma 'dor zer/ngas sangs rgyas kyi 'phel gdung o rgyan gyi byang sems sogs rten byin rlabs can 'dus pa'i myong grol ril bu byin/ skye 'chi 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bshad de 'pho ba btab pa'i rjes su/mgon po 'od dpag med gtso 'khor la bcol gdams 'di ltar byas so/ /bcom ldan mgon po 'od dpag med pa dang / /spyan ras gzigs dang mthu chen thob rnams kyis/ /bdag la re 153

ltos byed pa'i rgan mo la/ /nyin mtshan med par thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /'chi tshe mgon po khyed dang khyed kyi sras/ /rnams dang lhan cig 'grogs nas dga' spro bzhin/ /bde skyid dpag med ldan pa'i mgon khyod zhing / /nub phyogs bde ba can du 'khrid du gsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab nas/ da rgan mo khyod kyis 'chi rag gi bar du spyi bo na mgon po 'od dpag med 'khor bcas khra lam mer bzhugs yod snyam du gsol ba thobs dang / nub phyogs bde ba can du rnam shes drangs yong zhes bshad de tshur 'ongs pa'i phyi nyin tshe'i dus byas song 'dug de nas lha gnyan rgod rtse'i mgul du mtshungs med dge ba'i bshes gnyen rgyal mtshan 'od zer dpal bzang po'i sgrub gnas der rtsa gdan zhig btings nas bsdad pa'i zhag bdun song ba'i mtshan mo mgo bo nas gzer zhig snying ka dang / lte ba rkang mthil gyi bar du lan gsum brgyab byung tshe/ rdzogs chen gyi thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro'i nang ltar/ phyi snang ba dang nang phung bo la rtsal sbyong ba'i dmigs pa brtan po byas/ hūṃ drag tu brjod pa'i rjes su ci yang ma byung / mtshan mo rmi lam du mi ma yin mang po 'tshogs pa'i nang nas gcig na re/ phyin chad ban min bon min pha gi 154

'dra ba la nyams tshad 'dra ma byed/ kho gang yin tshod mi thig pa zhig red/ mdang nga kho la nyams tshad du song bas/ khos hūṃ hūṃ zer ba dang dus mnyam du hūṃ che chung bgrang las 'das pa bung ba tshang zhig pa ltar lus kyi nang nas phyir byung / nga 'bros sa'i khung mi rnyed pa zhig byas byung / 'dug rgyu yin na gsod mi gsod la the tshom mi 'dug zer dgod di ri ri song ba zhig rmis/ de nas bzung rmi lam ngan pa zhig kyang ma byung /zla ba gcig gi ring la nyams len 'phel po dang / khyad par sems can la dmigs pa'i snying rje chen po byung / tshe 'dir ma gyur sems can la phan thogs pa'i smon lam rgya chen po yang yang btab/ de dus chos rgyal rin po che nas da ri khrod gzhan du ma 'gro rtse gzhung dben pa'i dga' tshal 'dir gcod pas bkod pa btang nas mtshams khang 'gol po mang po brgyab yod/gang nas bsdad kyang chog pas myur du shog ces bka' shog 'byor nas/ lha gnyan rgod rtse'i g.yas phyogs kyi lung pa'i nang gi brag sna phug pa'i kha der zhag gcig bsdad pa'i nub mo bdag gi nyams snang la ser mo zhwa ser gyon pa zhig gis gtso byas skya ser mang po 'ongs nas/ bdag la ban rgan khyod nged rnams 'gro ba'i lam nas ma 'dug zer thams cad 'tshogs 155

nas bsdad pa'i tshe/ de'i nang nas ser mo zhwa ser gyon pa de na re/ song zhes mi 'gro na bca' rgyu zhig yod pa de 'chos zer/ de ma thag mi nag po gnyis kyis sgye snod chen po zhig nas sol ba sa la blugs nas yar spungs te g.yas g.yon nas sbud pa gnyis brgyab/ de'i nang du khro mi tshad las mi zhan pa gnyis bzhag nas bzhus te/ dmar hang nge song ba dang / mi gnyis ka yar la langs nas ban rgan bu bzang na da sdod zer/ bso sgra dang bcas te tho ba gnyis phyar khro yi mgo la brgyab pa'i tshe skad ni dbyar gyi 'brug drag tu ldir ba lta bu dang / khro zhag phyogs bcur 'phyur bas lung pa'i phu mdo thams cad gzhob thu lu lu 'gro ba'i snang ba shar ba'i tshe/ ngas gnas lugs kyi ngang la mnyam par bzhag nas bltas pa'i tshe khro yang je chung dang khro zhag kyang je nyung la song ba'i mthar de rnams la byams snying rje'i sgo nas mgur dbyangs 'di blangs/rje bka' drin can la gsol ba 'debs/ /mi mthun rkyen rnams grogs su sgyur/ /'dir 'dus lha 'dre bgegs kyi tshogs/ /dar cig rnal 'byor glu la nyon/ /steng mtha' dbus med pa'i mkha' dbyings su/ /lho sprin 'khrigs pa mkha' yi rgyan/ /sbrang char babs na de bas legs/ /dbri bsnan med 156

pa'i rgya mtsho la/ /chu gnyer 'khrugs pa mtsho yi rgyan/ /rba rlabs che na de bas legs/ /g.yo 'gul med pa'i ri bo la/ /rtsi shing rgyas pa ri bo'i rgyan/ /phang phung g.yos na de bas legs/ /nga gnas lugs rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor la/ /khyod lha 'dre 'ongs pa rnal 'byor rgyan/ /gdug rtsub bstan na de bas legs/ /khyod da res 'ongs pa ngo mtshar che/ /da de bas lhag pa'i cho 'phrul ston/ /dus da nas nam langs bar du sdod/ /nga ban rgan sa med rdul med gyis/ /zhes blangs nas lta ba la mnyam par bzhag tshe/ gcig na re da ban rgan la ci yang ma zer/ nged rnams phyir la 'gro zer nas ki ri ri song / des lta ba la bogs thon pa byung / nangs par snga mor langs nas lung ba'i mdo na mgar rtse 'brog pa'i ru khag gnyis 'dug pa'i rtsar song ja zhig bslangs pas nang du yar bos nas song tshe/ khyed mdang gang nas bzhugs zer/ brag sna phug yod pa'i kha'i brag skyibs shig nas bsdad smras pas/ yon bdag rgan pa zhig na re/ sa der su gang yin sdod mi nyan/ sngon ri khrod pa gnyis brag de'i rtsa ba nas gur phub nas bsdad pas/ dgong zhig 'dabs nas me 'bud pa zhig byung / de'i phyi'i mtshan mo yang me de bas chen po 'bar ba'i mthar/ 'dre mo 157

lcags kyi mchu ring po can zhig byung nas/ sgo 'gram gyi gur gyi phying ba phral te/ mchu nang du btang nas bltas tshe ri khrod pa gcig po skrag nas/ phyi nyin grogs po de la da 'gro gnas 'di 'tshub par gda' smras pas/ des skyon med zer nas nyal bsdad/ gcig po des mar me zhig sbar te dmigs brtse ma 'don gyin bsdad pa'i tshe/ skabs shig 'dre mo de yong nas grogs mched gnyis yod pa'i thad kyi gur rgyab nas lcags kyi mchu ring po zhig brkyangs te/ grogs mched kyi snying gar brgyab pas kho gnyid kyang sad long med par gnyid khung nas skad ngan zhig bton nas shi song tshe/ de'i phyi nyin ri khrod pa gcig po de bros yong ba'i skad cha 'dug khyed la mdang 'tshub 'dra ma byung ngam zer/ ngas 'tshub yong tshul rnams bshad pas/khos ya mtshan khyed rtogs ldan zhig red zer dad pa skyes nas mar zhig kyang byin/ tshur bskyal nas khyi kha nas phud de phyir song / de nas tshur la 'ong ba'i lam nas mgar rtse'i yin zer ba'i mi gzhon zhig gis khyed la rta zhig med pa e yin zer ba'i lan du/ rta yod ces shing gi dbyug pa sba dbyug 'dra ba zhig yod pa de rta la sbyar nas mgur 'di blangs so//chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs la 'dud/ /'gro ba kun gyi gnyen 158

gcig pu/ /bcom ldan shākya thub pa dang / /rnal 'byor dbang phyug mi la sogs/ /sngon byon mkhas grub thams cad kyis/ /bsod snyoms byed tshe zhon pa yi/ /rta rgyud bzang po de nyid las/ /chad pa'i rta zhig bdag la yod/ /yar sna gser gyi srab kyis bcings/ /sked par gzer stan gser sga bstad/ /lcags kyi gzer ma'i glo yis mnan/ /mar sna sra ba'i lcags rmed bzhag /dar tshon sna lnga'i sga phyar btings/ /lag pa g.yas pa rta la zhon/ /rnal 'byor phyogs med ri khrod 'grims/ /lo zlar song yang ngal dub med/ /gang du bzhag kyang dgra rkun med/ /'dam la mi yi rta bas bzang / /khyi khar slebs tshe de bas lhag /ces blangs tshe kho dgod bzhin song /nga yang slar urger slebs chos rgyal yab yum la mjal nas/nyams len byas tshul dang lha 'dre'i 'tshub lhongs byung tshul rnams zhus pas/ 'o bu khyod mi mthun pa'i phyogs las rnam par rgyal bas sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan bsgrengs thub pa shin tu legs/ da phyin chad bgegs dang bar chad gang gis kyang mi tshugs pa zhig 'ong gsungs thugs mnyes mnyes mdzad/ nyi ma kha shas ngal gsos nas bsdad/ nyin re bzhin sku mdun du song nas mdo sngags kyi dka' gnad dogs pa 'dra yod pa 159

rnams zhus pas bka' lan rgya cher gsungs te nyin mtshan dus 'da' bar mdzad/ ri khrod thā yan chir song nas/ mched grogs rdo rje spun rnams dang mjal zhing dga' spro'i gleng mo sna tshogs byas/ ngas chos rgyal rin po che'i gsung bzhin khong rnams la 'dod mos ltar gyi chos lung dang mgur dbyangs blangs/ khrid btab nas mtshams pa mang po zhig rang rang gi mtshams khang du bsdad/ gcig gis gcig la ngo mi gtugs par chig mtshams bsdams nas/ rdzogs chen kho na la nyams len byas pa'i bar dor grol tshad rnyed pa mang po byung / ngas kyang phug pa 'dag 'byar byas yang tig nag po gser gyi 'bru gcig gi mun khrid ltar nyams su blangs pas/ snang nyams dang shes nyams sogs mun khrid kyi gzhung nas bshad pa ltar gyi rtags mtshan sna tshogs mthong bas/ rang yang shin tu ngo mtshar bar gyur/ de nas nyin cig sbrang char 'jam po babs/'ja' tshon gye ri mo shar/ rgod bo mang po gnam gyi mtho sa nas lho byang 'grims pa mthong / de nas nyi ma tsha mo zhig shar ba'i tshe rgyab ri'i rtser khams bsang du song nas gnas bstod kyi mgur dbyangs 'di blangs/e ma ya mtshan dben pa'i gnas/ /mkhas grub mang po 160

bzhugs pa'i shul/ /mkha' 'gro chos skyong 'du ba'i sa/ /nga rang gcig pu 'dug pa'i yul/ /rtse gzhung dben pa'i ri khrod kyi/ /steng nas sbrang char si li li/ /rgod po mang po lho byang 'grims/ /bar na 'ja' tshon ya la la/ /co ga ma bus gshog rtsal sbyong / /'og na rtse chu gya ma gyu/ /ngang bas mgrin pa 'khyogs nas lta/ /rgyab ri'i rtse mo mkha' la bsnyegs/ /logs la ri dwags rtsed bro brdungs/ /mdun ri spang la brag gis spras/ /khu byug skad kyis yid rtsa skyo/ /g.yas g.yon spang gshongs me tog bkra /rkang drug mang po gar stabs byed/ /stod smad yon bdag dad ldan gyi/ /phyugs lug mang pos sa gzhi khebs/ /de dag skyong byed na chung rnams/ /glu gar rtsed 'jo sna tshogs ston/ /de ltar ngo mtshar mtha' yas pa'i /yid 'ong dben pa'i gnas mchog gi /rgyab ri kun gsal rtse mo ru/ /nyin gcig ltad mo blta ru phyin/ /kha yar la 'khor nas yar la bltas/ /ya gi sprin med nam mkha' mthong / /mtha' bral chos dbyings lta ba dran/ /mtha' dbus med pa'i nyams shig shar/ /phyogs ris lta ba bor nas thal/ /kha phar la 'khor nas phar la bltas/ /pha gi 'dzam gling nyi ma mthong / /gsal 'grib med pa'i sgom pa dran/ /stong gsal 161

'dzin med nyams shig shar/ /sems 'dzin sgom pa bor nas thal/ /kha lho ru 'khor nas lho ru bltas/ /bar snang 'ja' tshon ri mo mthong / /chos rnams snang stong zung 'jug dran/ /'dzin med rang gsal nyams shig shar/ /rtag chad 'dzin pa bor nas thal/ /steng 'og phyogs mtshams kun tu bltas/ /snod bcud mkha' la brten par go /rang chas lhun grub 'bras bu dran/ /blang dor med pa'i nyams shig shar/ /re dogs 'bras bu bor nas thal/ /zhes blangs pas nyams spro bar gyur/ yang me tog mang po zhig gi khrod du khams bsang du song ba'i tshe/ rje btsun mi la'i mgur 'bum nas/ rten kun nas grub pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /de ma bcos rig pa'i ngang du rdzogs/ /de la gsol ba 'debs kyang ma dgos so/ /ngag bzlas brjod dang bral ba'i rnal 'byor bde/ /dngos grub rnam gnyis ster ba'i yi dam lha/ /lha bsgrub med 'od gsal gye ngang du rdzogs/ /de la bskyed rim sgom yang ma dgos so/ /rang lus lha skur shar ba'i rnal 'byor bde/ /rkyen ngan bar chad sel ba'i mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ /rang bzhin gnyug ma'i ngang du rdzogs/ /de la gtor ma gtong yang ma dgos so/ /tshogs drug lhugs par 'jog pa'i rnal 'byor bde/ /162

rnam rtog bgegs kyi 'gong bo 'di/ /'dre snang chos nyid kyi ngang du rdzogs/ /de la dza brdung bya yang ma dgos so/ /rnam rtog chos skur shar ba'i rnal 'byor bde/ /tha snyad tshig gi lung rig kun/ /nyams myong 'od gsal gye ngang du rdzogs/ /de la slob gnyer bya yang ma dgos so/ /snang ba dpe char shar ba'i rnal 'byor bde/ /zhes pa'i mgur de bdag gis blangs pa'i tshe/ bung ba lus chung zhing skad snyan pa shin tu mdzes pa zhig gis/ang nge / ang gi skal ldan gzhon po khyod/ /kha pho ma che kha rog sdod/ /snang ba dpe char shar gyur na/ /sbrang ma nga yi lus po dang / /kun spyod kun dang mthun pa yi/ /rnal 'byor khyod kyis glu zhig longs/ /des na snang ba dpe shar yin/ /zhes zer ba'i lan du/i yid 'ong bung ba nga la nyon/ /khyod lus po chung la bung sgra che/ /nga nyams myong med rung kha pho che/ /khyod dang nged gnyis mthun par 'dug /bung ba khyod kyi sgyu lus dang / /kun spyod kun dang mthun pa yi/ /rnal 'byor nga yis glu zhig len/ /bya btang rnal 'byor bung ba nga'i/ /ka dag rig pa'i lus po la/ /thabs shes gnyis kyi gshog sgo rgyas/ /'od 163

gsal nyams kyi thig le bkra /pha rol phyin drug rkang lag thogs/ /nyams rtogs yon tan rwa co skyes/ /blang dor 'byed pa'i mig dang ldan/ /yon bdag me tog sar 'gro tshe/ /rin chen mgur gyi bum pa nas/ /glu dbyangs bung ba'i sgra bzhin sgog /zas gos bcud rnams sdud shes pas/ /mdangs ldan yon bdag me tog gi /dad pa'i mdangs la nga mi gnod/ /rgas pa'i sprin nag 'thibs pa dang / /zug gzer char skya babs pa'i tshe/ /stong gsal chos sku'i mkha' dbyings su/ /thabs shes gnyis kyi gshog brkyangs nas/ /gzhon nu bum sku'i tshang nang du/ /phyir mi ldog par 'phur snying 'dod/ /i go bar gda' ye byas pas/ bung bas lan du/ rjes su yi rang / /go bar 'dug go /glu dbyangs snyan byung / /zhes g.yas skor lan gsum byas te rgyang ring por phyi mig mi blta bar 'phur ro/ /yang de dus la kha sprul sku tshang gi gzims khang gi gyang rdung dus/ grogs mched cig gis khyed kyis sgom khang 'bub pa'i gyang brdung e shes zer ba'i lan du bdag gis gyang brdung shes zhes ku re'i tshul du mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so//chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs la 'dud/ /zhen med bya btang 164

rnal 'byor ngas/ /don dam gyang gi rdung tshul rnams/ /mdor bsdus bshad kyis legs par nyon/ /mtshan ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma yis/ /gdams ngag zab mo'i gtsos rwa bsnams/ /rang sems gyong bor sa 'dul gnang / /bsam pa dkar po'i thang thog tu/ /brtson 'grus bzang po'i skyes bu yis/ /dkar po dge ba'i sa rnams spungs/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma yis/ /dbang bzhi'i chu yis rlan par byas/ /rang byung rig pa'i gyang dpon gyis/ /zhi gnas brtan po'i gyang thig blangs/ /rdzogs pa chen po'i gyang gzhong bzhag /ka dag 'gyur med gyang ru btsugs/ /yengs med dran pa'i thag pas bsdams/ /gegs sel bogs 'don bar khyi'u btab/ /brtson 'grus zab mo'i gyang brdung gis/ /yengs pa med par gyang bcag byas/ /lta ba'i sa mkhar mtho dang gcig /sgom pa'i rmang gzhi brtan dang gnyis/ /spyod pa'i gyang bcag song dang gsum/ /'di gsum 'dzoms pa'i sa mkhar de/ /rnam gzhag gtan gyi sa mkhar yin/ /zhes blangs pas grogs kyang dga' bar gyur to/ /yang mi zhig gis khyed kyi pha yul sbra dang khang pa gnyis kyi gang yin zer ba'i lan drang por bshad nas/ bdag la sbra dang shing khang ma yin pa'i 'od gsal gyi khang bzang 'di lta bu 165

yod ces mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so//chos rgyal ngag gi dbang po yi/ /zhabs la gus pas gsol ba 'debs/ /'dod rgu'i dngos grub kun 'byung ba'i/ /'od khang 'grub par byen gyis rlobs/ /nga'i pha yul khang pa shing khang yin/ /bya btang gu yangs blo bde ngar/ /rang byung 'od lnga'i khang pa yod/ /pha yul khang pa zhig gis dogs/ /don dam 'jigs med khang pa phub/ /shing bzo rig pa'i khye'u chung gis/ /'khrul snang sna tshogs shing cha rnams/ /shes rab rnon po'i lag cha yis/ /bden med stong pa nyid du bzos/ /lta ba'i sa mkhar rmang gzhi btings/ /rgyang zhags sgron ma'i ka rdo bzhag /dbyings kyi sgon ma'i ka ba btsugs/ /thig le stong sgon phog kyang bzhag /'char sgo sna tshogs thog 'geb byas/ /shes rab rang byung sgon ma yi/ /gsal stong 'dzin med bla bre 'then/ /lhun grub 'od gsal khang bzang nang / /stong gsal zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor bkod/ /zhen chags med pa'i mchod pa phul/ /deng sang 'jig rten mi rnams kyis/ /shing khang bzang po phub na yang / /yun ring mi sdod myur du 'jig /rang byung 'od gsal khang bzang la/ /sa chu me rlung 'byung ba'i dgras/ /'di nyid gzhig cing gzhom mi nus/ /'jig med rdo rje'i khang 166

pa 'di/ /nga la yod de kun la med/ /skal bar ldan pa'i gdul bya rnams/ /dbub na 'od gsal khang pa phubs/ /dge 'dis skal ldan gdul bya yis/ /thod rgal khang bzang dbub par shog /ces blangs/ yang grogs mched cig gis khyed kyis nang rnams phyags lha sku bkram mchod pa phul te/ spro mo zhig byas na legs mod a kha btsog pa red zer ba'i lan du/ngas pha bla ma'i gsung bzhin 'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po'i lugs kyi nang rnams phyags lha sku bkram mchod bshams bzang po byas te spro mo zhig byas yod ces mgur 'di blangs so//dus gsum sangs rgyas thugs kyi sprul/ /chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs la 'dud/ /rdzogs pa chen po'i rnal 'byor pa/ /bya btang tshogs drug rang grol nga / /mtshan ldan bla ma'i byin rlabs kyis/ /mchod bshams phyi na med de nang na yod/ /'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po yi/ /mchod khang nyi ma rang shar gye/ /mchod bshams byed tshul 'di ltar ro/ /rang lus lha yi mchod khang gi /nyon mongs rnam rtog sa rdul rnams/ /shar grol dus mnyam mchod g.yog gis/ /skye med chos sku'i klong du phyags/ /bzo bos ma byas rang byung gi /ka dag lhun grub lha sku rnams/ /gsal stong 'dzin med ngang du bkram/ /zhi gnas 167

brtan po'i mchod khri'i steng / /stong gsal ka dag mchod yon phul/ /'gyur med ting 'dzin zhabs bsil phul/ /rang gsal 'dzin med me tog phul/ /gang shar rang grol bdug spos phul/ /nyin mtshan kha sbyor snang gsal phul/ /'dzin med rang shar dri chab phul/ /snang stong zung 'jug zhal zas phul/ /grag stong skye med sgra snyan phul/ /'char sgo sna tshogs maṇ+ḍal phul/ /lha sku dgram na 'di ltar khroms/ /mchod pa 'bul na 'di ltar phul/ /kun gyi mchod khang phyi na yod/ /nga rnal 'byor mchod khang nang na yod/ /'di dpal ldan bla ma'i bka' drin yin/ /nyams dga' 'o skyid do rdo rje spun/ /zhes blangs pas grogs po na re/ de yin na ngo mtshar che zer dad gus byas so/ /yang rang gis bzo mi shes pas sog phyogs kyi slob ma kha shas kyis/ ngas gzan chad pa slar btsem gyen yod pa'i dus shig khyed kyi bzo mi bzang bar gda'/ khyed dang po yul na yod pa'i tshe gon pa 'dra ma bzos pa yin nam zer ba'i lan du mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so//bka' drin gsum ldan bla ma yi/ /zhabs kyi pad+mor gus pas 'dud/ /'od gsal snang bzhi'i gos chen gyi/ /bzo la mkhas par byin gyis rlobs/ /ngas 'dus byas gon pa zad 168

kyis dogs/ /kun rdzob gos phrug btsem ma myong / /don dam 'dus ma byas kyi gos/ /da lta bzos te gyon nas yod/ /bzo ba shes rab don 'grub kyis/ /thos bsam gnyis kyi sru gri yis/ /'od gsal rdzogs chen gos bzang la/ /gnas lugs rtogs pas bzo gcod byas/ /snying rus sdug bsran mtheb lcibs gyon/ /brtson 'grub chad med skud pa de/ /bla ma'i gdams ngag khab tu brgyus/ /ka dag chos dbyings khang pa nas/ /'dug stangs lta stangs mdzub mo yis/ /sgon ma bzhi yi khab skud drangs/ /'od gsal gos chen legs par bzos/ /nyin mtshan med par gyon nas yod/ /skal bar ldan pa'i bu slob kun/ /bzo na 'od gsal gon pa bzos/ /nyon mongs tsha grang skyob pa la/ /'di 'dra'i gon pa gzhan na med/ /gyon na yang la mtshon khar sra/ /theg dgu'i yang rtse rdzogs chen gyi/ /khyad chos gon pa yin no bu/ /dge 'dis mkha' mnyam 'gro kun gyi/ /nyon mongs tsha grang yongs skyob pa'i/ /'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po yi/ /snang bzhi'i gos chen gyon par shog /ces blangs pas bu slob rnams kyang dad pa gong 'phel du gyur to/ /yang mi zhig gis khyed sman pa e yin lag na sman re med dam zer ba'i lan du glu dbyangs 'di 169

yid la shar ba ltar blangs so//pha rgan chos kyi rgyal por 'dud/ /rnal 'byor tshogs drug rang grol nga'i/ /byang khog stod kyi sman khang na/ /dug lnga'i nad sel sman gyi mchog /rdzogs chen a ru rnam rgyal dang / /mdo sngags zab chos sman mang yod/ /bla ma'i zhal shes sdeb sbyor tshang / /rig pa'i 'tsho byed gzhon nu yi/ /mgrin pa rin chen gser skyogs kyis/ /legs bshad sman ni gang 'dod ster/ /dad gus don gnyer dkar yol nas/ /rnam dpyod ljags kyis gsol nus na/ /nga bdag 'dze+en pa'i gcong nad zhi/ /dug gsum rlung mkhris bad gan sel/ /chags sdang na zug kun sangs nas/ /dam chos zas la nyer len 'byung / /nyams rtogs lus stobs myur du rgyas/ /gzhan gyi nad la'ang phan thogs 'byung / /zhes blangs/ yang sngags pa zhig gis khyed kyis mthu e shes/ sngon tsho mthu 'dra e byas zer ba'i lan du glu 'di yid la shar ba ltar blangs so//chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs la 'dud/ /bya btang tshogs drug rang grol ngar/ /bdag 'dzin zer ba'i dgra zhig gis/ /mi 'dod sna dgu yang yang btang / /de la nga yis mthu zhig byas/ /mthu ni ji ltar byas zer na/ /dang po bla ma mthu mkhan 170

la/ /dad gus bzang po'i phyag rten phul/ /dgra bo pham thabs mthu dgos zhus/ /bla mas bdag la dgyes bzhin du/ /mdo sngags mthu ni mang po bslabs/ /de nas ri khrod sgrub khang du/ /bya btang drag po'i chas su zhugs/ /cis kyang dogs med drag sngags bgrangs/ /zhi gnas brtan po'i 'brub khung brtsigs/ /sor rtog pho nyas dbang med bkug /stong nyid ye shes mtshon gyis bsgral/ /skye med chos sku'i zhal du bstabs/ /mthu 'di slob pa'i mi yod dam/ /yod na phangs med ster ba yin/ /zhes blangs/ yang 'ga' res khyed pha yul yod dus chung ma e blangs zer ba'i lan du/ 'jig rten chung ma ma blangs/ rjes nas chos kyi chung ma 'di ltar blangs zhes rnar snyan yid 'bab kyi mgur 'di blangs so//chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs la 'dud/ /bya btang tshogs drug rang grol ngas/ /'jig rten sdug gi chung ma de/ /skyo ba skyes nas ngas ma blangs/ /dam chos skyid kyi chung ma de/ /bdag gis blangs tshul bshad kyis nyon/ /mtshan ldan bla mas bar pa byas/ /'khor ba'i phun tshogs rin du 'jal/ /mchog gsum rtsa gsum pha mes kyis/ /stong nyid na chung mjes 'dzum ma/ /bde gsal mi rtog gos rgyan btags/ /'phags nor bdun 171

gyi skyes dang bcas/ /chos dbyengs lam la bskyal nas 'ongs/ /sbyor ba'i chos kyi sngun nas bsus/ /dad pa brtan po'i gdan la bzhag /mos gus dag snang sha chang drangs/ /zab rgyas chos kyi ston mo bshams/ /bden pa gnyis kyi bshad pa byas/ /rten cing 'brel 'byung glu dbyangs blangs/ /bde chen nyams kyi bro gar 'khrab/ /mtshan ldan bla ma bar pa yis/ /'dzad med byin rlabs mag lwa bskon/ /dngos grub sna tshogs phywa g.yang bos/ /bar pa drin can bla ma la/ /bsam sbyor gnyis kyi phyag rten phul/ /thabs mkhas bsdu bzhi'i ston mjug bsdus/ /mgron rnams chos kyi dbyings su gyes/ /gtan gyi bde ster gzhon nu mar/ /thabs shes gnyis kyi lag pas 'khyud/ /bde stong 'o dang sbyor ba byas/ /bcos min snying rje bu gcig byung / /bsgom byung shes rab bu mo byung / /nyams rtogs yon tan 'dzad med kyi/ /nam mkha' mdzod la mnga' dbang bsgyur/ /da lta blo sems bde mor gda'/ /e ma rmad byung skal ba bzang / /bdag gis chung ma blangs pa bzhin/ /chos mdzad kun gyis len par gyis/ /glu 'di thos tshad thams cad kyis/ /chos kyi chung ma len par smon/ /zhes blangs/ yang ben+da zhig gis/ khyed kyis ri mo bris pa legs 172

pas/ khyed lha bzo zhig ma yin nam zer ba'i lan du 'di skad ces smras/chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs la 'dud/ /rnal 'byor tshogs drug rang grol ngas/ /bsam pa bzang bo'i ras dkar de/ /tshad med bzhi yi shing gis brgyangs/ /tshul khrims gtsang mas ras 'dul byas/ /dad pa 'gyur med ka rag btang / /dge bcu'i gzi yis yang yang brdar/ /dang po thos pa'i skya thig brgyab/ /bar du bsam pas legs par bris/ /tha mar sgom pa'i tshon rtsis byugs/ /nyams rtogs kha dog sna tshogs shar/ /e ma lha bzo mi bzang ngam/ /zhes smras/ yang dge slong zhig gis khyed kyis yi ge e 'bri zer ba'i tshe lan drang por smras nas 'di yid la shar ba ltar blangs so//drin can mtshan ldan gyi bla mar 'dud/ /tshogs drug rang grol gyi ming can ngas/ /sems nyid gyong bo yi shog gu de/ /thun mong lam rim gyis brdung shad byas/ /bskyed rdzogs rdzogs chen gyis thig btab nas/ /bsgom dang snying rus kyi pir smyug gis/ /ri khrod dben pa yi khyams ra na/ /nyams myong gser yig de rtag tu 'bri/ /zhes pa la sogs pa'i nyams kyi rtsal snang la gang shar thams cad ma bkag par glu dbyangs 173

su blangs pas zad pa med pa 'dra ba zhig byung ngo / /yang bdag gi mkhan chen dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po mtshan brjod par dka' ba a rig dge bshes rin po che byams pa dge legs rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po gzugs sku mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshul bstan pa/ sku gzhogs rgyal mkhan chen rin po ches gsan nas bdag la phyag bris 'di bskur snang /kye hud yang gcig tshur gson/ /gsum ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa/ /mkhan chen dge ba'i bshes gnyen/ /dag pa'i zhing du gshegs song / /mi rtag ston pa'i bla mar/ /shes par gyis la dgongs mdzod/ /phyogs bcu'i rnam 'dren yongs las /bka' drin lhag par che ba'i/ /bka' bzhin bsgrub pa'i mchod par/ /gnang ba'i sdom gsum bcas mtshams mig bzhin bsrung bar mdzad thog /tshe dang sgrub pa snyoms la/ /byang chub chen po sgrubs dang / bla ma'i thugs dgongs rdzogs shing / /'phral phugs bzhed don 'grub yong / /bzang spyod sgol ma gnyis kyang / /ci lcogs gsung sgrog mdzod cig /rdzogs chen lta ba mtho ste/ /rim gnyis nyams len zab kyang / /sdom gsum dkar chos gzhi ma/ /rten gyi sgo nas stobs che/ /sa lam bgrod par myur bas/ /pham lhag ltung 174

bas dben na/ /ma bsgoms par yang zung 'jug /grub ces rgyud nas gsungs so/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga la/ /ma chags chags yul tshol la/ /med gshis cer gyis ltos la/ /rang sar grol bar mdzod cig /nyon mongs dug lnga'i dgra la/ /ma sdang sdang yul tshol la/ /med gshis cer gyis ltos la/ /rang sar grol bar mdzod cig /khor yug rtog med lta ba/ /gnyis med ngang du grol na/ /blang dor dgag sgrub med par/ /'khor 'das ro mnyam yin kyang / /bden gnyis thabs dang thabs 'byung / /rang bzhin med dang ltos grub/ /'gag med grogs su shar na/ /mtha' bral dbu mi' lta ba/ /de phyir las 'bras phra zhib/ /tshogs gsog sgrib sbyong bzlas brjod/ /kun rdzob tha snyad tsam du/ /zhen med blang dor mdzad na/ /bslu med rten 'brel 'tshogs pas/ /sku gnyis mngon du 'gyur zhing / /rnam dkar mdun ma'i yang rtse/ /bzhed don ji bzhin 'byung ngo / /gtan bde bsgrub pa'i grogs la/ /la lung nyul ba'i rig 'dzin/ /'dzin med mkhan po pad+mas/ /ma ltar brtse bas phul lo/ /zhes gsungs pa go nas/ bla ma'i thugs dgongs rdzogs pa'i phyir ci 'byor gyi mchod pa phul nas gsol 'debs byas/ sgol ma dang bzang 175

spyod bton nas rjes su gdung dbyangs 'di blangs/rje zla med bla ma rin chen des/ /gting mtha' med srid pa'i mtsho chen la/ /tshad bzung med bsod nams gru chen btang / /rtag chad med ye shes dar chen 'phyar/ /smon dri med rlung gis shugs chen bskyod/ /skyid dpag med ldan pa'i bde ldan zhing / /'pho 'gyur med gser gyi gling chen bsnyegs/ /'bangs skal med 'khor ba'i mtsho chen lus/ /pha srid mtsho sgrol ba'i ded dpon mchog /zhing dag pa rab 'byams gar bzhugs kyang / /bus mgon skyabs bor ba'i smre sngags kyi/ /dbyangs 'di la dar cig gsan par zhu/ /sngon smon lam rta ljang stobs kyis drangs/ /bod gangs can lha yi lam la mdzes/ /'phrin las kyi 'od stong dra ba can/ /rje thub bstan pad tshal gnyen gcig nub/ /phran skal med nub kyi sa 'dzin rtser/ /mgon nyin byed khyod kyis bor ba'i mod/ /yid dga' ba nyams pa'i zla zer dang / /sems gdungs pa'i ku mud mnyam du g.yos/ /bdag yid la bud shing med na yang / /sdug bsngal gye me chen rab tu sbar/ /gdong mig gi mkha' la sprin med kyang / /mchi ma yi char rgyun drag tu babs/ /mgon khyod kyi rjes su 'jug 'dod bdag /stobs 176

ldan gyi nyon mongs dgra bo yis/ /dbang med du 'khor ba'i btson rar khrid/ /bdag 'dzin gye lcags sgrog dam pos bcings/ /nyin re re bzhin du na rga dang / /'byor rgud kyi chad pas yang yang mnar/ /bu 'di 'dra'i nyam thag gnas gyur pa/ /phas mi mngon dbyengs nas ma gzigs sam/ /sngon byon gyi rgyal ba thams cad kyis/ /las skal dman spangs nas thar par gshegs/ /da 'jigs sar skyel mas bslus pa banin / /ngaman kun la ches cher brtse ba yi/ /mgon khyod kyis bdag cag 'dor phod dam/ /sngon thugs bskyed dam bca' ji bzhin du/ /thugs chos dbyings mkha' las ma g.yos bzhin/ /slar yang sprul nyi ma gzhon nu zhig /'od lam lam myur bar bstan du gsol/ /thub bstan gye pad tshal bskyang du gsol/ /bdag blo yi mun pa bsal du gso pa / /dge legs kyi nyin mor byed du gsol/ /mgon khyod kyi rjes 'jug bdag cag rnams/ /mgon khyod ni zhing khams gar bzhugs kyang / /mgon khyod kyi drung du skyes nas kyang / /mgon khyod dang nam yang mi 'bral shog /mgon khyod mnyes 'ba' zhig bsgrub pa dang / /mgon khyod gsung bdud rtsi ngoms med myangs/ /mgon khyod bzhin sgrub la rtag gzhol 177

nas/ /mgon khyod dang myur du mtshungs par shog /ces tshe rabs kun tu rjes su 'dzin pa'i smon lam kyang btab bo//smras pa/ mtshan bzang sum cu dpe byad brgyad cu'i skur/ /mtshan pa'i thub dbang spyi bo'i rgyan du bzhugs/ /mtshan nas brjod bzhin gus pas gsol ba 'debs/ /mtshan thos tsam gyis grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /bla ma'i rnam thar yang yang ma bshad na/ /slob ma rnams kyi yid la mi gcags pas/ /de phyir thag nye'i dben pa bsten pa'i tshul/ /slar yang glu ru len gyis dga' bas nyon/ /gnas der mtshams sgrub byed mkhan mang stabs kyis/ /'du 'dzi cher song nyams len ma 'phel tshe/ /ri khrod dben pa zhig tu song na snyam/ /chos rgyal rin po che la zhus pa'i tshe/ /khong gis stag mo rdzong du song zhig gsungs/ /bka' bzhin bsgrub pa'i mchod pa'i mgur dbyangs phul/ /de yi lan du khong gis thugs brtse'i sgos/ /tshe 'di blo yis gtong tshul zhal gdams gnang / /'gro khar bde zhus phul dus byen rlabs mdzad/ /ring min myur du mjal ba'i smon lam btab/ /rtse gzhung dben par bzhugs pa'i mched grogs la/ /dge ba'i gsal 'debs bslab bya'i mgur dbyangs phul/ /pad+ma rang grol bkra shis 178

'khyel du brdzangs/ /rang nyid stag mo rdzong la 'gro zhor la/ /gtsang gi dgon par song nas zhag bdun bsdad/ /grub thob brgyad cu'i rnam thar zhig la bltas/ /nyams len byed 'dod blo shed che ru song / /bla ma rnams la mjal nas chos 'brel zhus/ /stag mo rdzong song zhag gcig song ba'i nub/ /lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul 'jigs pa'i sgra yang byung / /gcod dmigs btang bas lha 'dre dga' bar gyur/ /nyams dga' spro nas gnas bstod mgur dbyangs blangs/ /a ma dran nas 'gro la snying rje skyes/ /nyam thag sprang po sogs la sbyin pa btang / /khams bsang ched du khwa ta'i bstan bcos brtsams/ /gnas de 'gol bas nyams len 'phel po byung / /de nas thon te rwa rgya'i dgon du song / /bla ma skyes chen rnams la chos 'brel zhus/ /ge tho'i ri la song nas gnas 'brel bzhag /bla rgan zhig gis rgyal ba yab sras kyi/ /gsung 'bum klog pa mthong nas g.yar po byas/ /rgyal ba gnyis par gsol ba 'debs bzhin du/ /bltas pas sems la phan thogs chen po byung / /mdo sngags bstan pa gsal bar mdzad pa yi/ /legs bshad 'di 'drar mjal ba skal bzang snyam/ /yon bdag cig la rgyal ba'i bka' mo btab/ /kho rang snang ba dam pa'i chos la 'gyur/ /de 179

nas tshur 'ongs rwa rgya'i dgon pa'i mtha'i/ /nad ma zhig mthong snying rje 'pho ba btab/ /lha gnyan rgod rtser 'ongs nas gnas 'brel bzhag /dgong zhig lha 'dres gnod pa'i gzer zhig byung / /hūṃ sbyang byas pas lha 'dre skrag nas bros/ /de dus chos rgyal mchog gis shog cig gsungs/ /tshur la 'ong khar lha gnyan rgod rtse yi/ /g.yas phyogs lung ba'i brag sna zhig tu bsdad/ /mtshan mo lha 'dre mang po'i cho 'phrul byung / /gnas lugs ngang la bzhag nas lta mgur blangs/ /lha 'dre phyir log rang rang gnas su song / /de dus lta ba bogs kyang thon pa byung / /lam nas mgur 'dra len bzhin urge ru/ /slebs nas chos rgyal mchog la mjal ba'i dus/ /nyams len byas tshul lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul sogs/ /'ongs tshul zhus pas khong gis thugs dgyes bzhin/ /khyod ni mi mthun phyogs las rnam rgyal ba'i/ /sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan tshugs pa shin tu legs/ /phyin chad bar chad gang gis mi tshugs par/ /'dug ces lung bstan gnang bas lha phyag phul/ /nyi ma kha shas ngal gsos mdun du song / /mdo sngags dka' gnad dogs pa mang po zhus/ /lan kyang rgya cher gsungs pas nyin mtshan kun/ /dam pa'i chos kyis 'da' ba'i skal ba byung / /de nas rtse gzhung dben pa'i gnas su 180

song / /mched grogs rnams dang mjal bas dga' spro shar/ /ngas kyang chos rgyal mchog gi bka' bzhin du/ /khong tshor khrid byas mtshams la sdod du bcug /nyams len gtso bo rdzogs pa chen por byas/ /nyams rtogs yon tan mang po skyes pa byung / /bdag kyang mun khrid cig la bsdad pa'i tshe/ /rtags mtshan sna tshogs mthong bas ngo mtshar skyes/ /nyin cig khams bsang gnas bstod mgur dbyangs blangs/ /sbrang ma'i bstan bcos gyang gi brdung tshul sogs/ /rang gi nyams la gang shar glu ru blangs/ /yongs 'dzin a rig dge bshes zhing gzhan du/ /gshegs pa thos pas thugs dgongs rdzogs pa'i phyir/ /ci 'byor mchod pa phul nas gdungs dbyangs blangs/ /tshe rabs kun tu mjal ba'i smon lam btab/ /mdor na thag nye'i dben par lha 'dre yis//cho 'phrul bstan kyang bar chad kun las rgyal/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi rnam thar de ltar lags/ /rjes 'jug rnams kyang de bzhin skyong bar mdzod/ /glu 'di thos tshad skye bo pho mo yis/ /tshe rabs kun tu bla ma'i rnam thar bzhin/ /dben par bsgoms tshe lha 'dre ci byung yang / /bar chad mi nus grogs su 'char bar shog /ces pa'ang bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o//181

mtsho snying ma hā de wa nas sgrub pa byas tshul/drug pa bde skyid snyan gsum 'dzoms pa'i mtsho snying ma hā de wa'i gnas su song nas sgrub pa byas tshul ni/ bka' drin mtshungs med chos rgyal ngag gi dbang po'i thugs dgongs la/rang gi sras bkra shis 'byung gnas rgyal sar bton te/ /rje nyid ri khrod cig nas bzhugs te bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i don mdzad par dgongs nas/ de lugs kyi rgyu mtshan yum blon 'bangs rnams la gsungs pas/ kun gyis gros mthun par 'di skad zhus/ chos rgyal rin po che khyed ni bdag cag rnams kyi rten gzhi tsam du ma zad/ mtsho g.yas ru g.yon ru kun gye mgon skyabs yin gshis/ khyed ri khrod dben par phebs tshe/nged rnams grog tshang kha'i rdo blangs pa bzhin thams cad mgon med skyabs med du 'gro bas de 'dra gnang thabs ga la yod/khyad par khyed kyang sku na smin stabs/ ri khrod la phebs pa'i skabs min zhes kun gyis bshol btab pas/ thugs kyi dgongs bzhed ltar ri khrod la phebs su ma bcug blon po 'ga' res ngas ri khrod la phebs zhus pa yin snyam/ nga la khyed kyis dpon 182

tshang rin po che ri khrod la phebs zhes ma zhu/ khong tsho snying mi rje'am zer/ ngas sngar de 'dra gtan nas ma zhus byas rung khong tsho yid ma ches par da dung khyod la gsal mod zer/ der nga'i sems la da nga yun ring bsdad na mi bzang bar 'dug snyam pa byung / de dus khong gis kyang thugs skyo tshul mdzad pas/ngas kyang nyid rin po che bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i sngon rol nas sangs rgyas te/ snyigs dus 'gro ba'i don du bsam bzhin phebs pa yin pas/ khyed gang du bzhugs kyang sems can gyi don las gzhan med gshis/ ri khrod du phebs rgyu ma byung rung / sngar rgyun ltar bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i don mdzad par zhu/ 'di rnams bzhag nas ri khrod du phebs na nga la yang yum dang blon 'bangs 'khor bcas kyi khag ngan yong bar 'dug zhus pas/ re zhig ci yang mi gsung bar gda'/ de'i phyi nyin nas bzung snga sor ngas zhus pa'i rdzogs chen ma rig pa'i mun pa sel ba'i ye shes kyi sgron me zhes bya ba de ljags bsgrigs gnang nas/ mjug tu mi rgan nga'i kha chems yin sogs zhing khams gzhan du dgongs pa gtad pa'i gsung dogs gzhi can mang du gsungs tshe/ bdag gis de skad ma gsung bar zhu/ da dung bdag sogs gdul bya'i don du yun 183

ring bzhugs pa'i thugs 'dun gnang dgos zhus pas/khong gi zhal nas/ gang la dbang yod de la sdig pa yod ces pa ltar/chen po'i go sar gnas phyin mi dge ba ngang gis 'byung ba dang / bde ba'i rjes la sdug bsngal 'byung gsungs pa ltar gnas skabs su bde ba ltar snang rung / phugs su sdug bsngal bskyed pa'i tshe 'di snang gi 'khor ba'i phun tshogs la kho bo mi chags gser dang sa rdo gnyis la khyad par med pa zhib nga rang dbus su song ba nas bzung ste rgyud la yod/ chung ngu'i dus nas ri khrod dben pa zhig tu 'dug snyam pa yod kyang las smon gyi dbang gis bsam pa'i nang ltar ma byung / da lta ni na tshod yang rgas shing / lha bla ma'i lung bstan dang bstun pa'i tshe tshad kyang rdzogs zin/ da tshe lhag yin stabs chen po bsdad ga la 'ong / 'on kyang lo kha shas re 'dug pa'i smon 'dun 'dra los byed gsungs pa tsam las zhal bzhes chen po ma gnang bar rgyal mkhan chen rin po che dang / la kha sprul pa'i sku/ bdag la sogs pa don gnyer can mang po la lho brag bka' 'bumagyi lung / gter gsar dang phur pa'i chos skor gyi dbang lung /bka' bsrung so so'i srog gtad dang bcas bum pa gang byo'i tshul du gnang ste/ da khyed rnams kyis le lor ma song bar rgyal 184

ba'i bstan pa spyi dang / khyad par snga 'gyur rgyal dbang pad+ma'i ring lugs 'di nyid thugs la bcangs te/ 'dzin skyong spel gsum gnang dgos tshul gyi bka' nan tan phab nas/ phyag dpe rnams cha tshang bar rgyal mkhan chen rin po cher gnang /ngas chos lung gi thun gseng dang bar mtshams rnams su la kha sprul pa'i skur gter gsar gyi lung kha shas phul/ de nas nyin cig ja mtshams shig tu/ chos rgyal rin po che'i snyan lam du bdag gis 'di ltar zhus/ sngar yin na zhal nam bzhugs kyi bar du bsdad na snyam kyang / da sdod yun ring na gzhan gyis kha dbyen lta bus bla ma yab yum gyi thugs nas 'dor nyen gda'/ dben gnas thā yan chir yang mtshams pa mang ba'i stabs kyis 'du 'dzi je che red/ da nga mtsho snying lta bu'i ri khrod dben pa zhig tu song nas gcig pur rtse gcig tu nyams len kho na la 'bad na snyam pa lags pas/ bdag lo lnga'i bar du lto gos chos gsum gyis bskyangs pa bka' drin shin tu che gdams pa rnams kyang lhag lus med par thob/ da rang gi bsgom la rag las par gda' zhus pas/ rgyal mkhan chen mchog gi zhal nas kyang / da ri khrod pa 'di la gnang ba zhig byen na thugs rje che zhus pas/ chos rgyal rin po che'i zhal nas/185

'o ri khrod pa sa phyogs 'dir bsdad na gzhan la'ang phan thogs pa yong bar gda' ste/ de phal cher gyis mi shes par 'dug khyod mtsho snying du 'gro ba la nga yang 'thad po byung bas song na bzang zhes dgongs khrol gnang / 'on kyang re zhig gi bar du 'o skol dpon slob gnyis kyis mtshams shig gi khong nas/dogs pa 'dra yod na chod/ lugs gnyis kyi gleng mo 'dra yang byed/ nga mi rgan red nam 'chi cha med/ khyod ri khrod pa red/ gar 'gro cha med/ da phyin chad yang yang e 'phrad mi shes gsungs/ de nas nged dpon slob gnyis lhan cig tu zla ba gcig dang phyed kyi bar du mtshams la bsdad/ gsol ja'i mtshams rnams su kun mkhyen klong chen rab 'byams dang /rje btsun tā ra nā tha'i mgur sogs sngon gyi skyes bu dam pa rnams kyi gsung mgur gyi lung dang zhal ta gnang ba rnams la bdag gis nyan nas yid la bzung / nub re bzhin gzims gur la skor ba brgya phrag du ma byas/ phyag mang du 'tshal/ skye ba nas tshe rabs thams cad du nam mjal na 'dod pa'i dus skabs rnams su dngos dang nyams dang rmi lam gyi gnas skabs tshun chad du zhal mjal gsung thos pa'i smon lam yang yang btab/ khong gi dbu lo dang zhal rgyan rnams dkar por song 186

ba mthong tshe nga'i bsam pa la/ khong dgung lo 'di bas gzhon dus su ngas mjal ba yin na dga' ba la/ da dgung lo yang bgres nas gda'/ nga mtsho snying du yang 'gro ran 'dugaphyin chad sa kha thag ring pos bar chod/skye 'chi la khrigs khrigs med pas/ tshe 'dir da re tsam ma gtogs phyin chad mjal lam mi mjal ci shes/ gal te khong zhal bzhugs mi bzhugs 'dra byung na/ sku tshe 'di'i rjes ma de la/ zhing khams gang du thugs 'dun yod dam de gcig zhu dgos snyam pa ma gtogs /gzhan sems la 'char rgyu ma byung bas/ bdag skye ba nas tshe rabs thams cad du thugs dam skyabs 'og nas ma 'dor/nyid rin po che'i sku'i skye ba rjes ma de la zhing khams gang du thugs 'dun yod/ de gcig gsungs zhus pas/ 'o bu khyod kyis nga nam yang ma brjed par gyis gsol ba thobs dang /ngas khyod mi brjed par sems la bzhag yong / nga da lta ri khrod la 'gro ba'i dbang med na/ phyi mar zhing khams gzhan du 'gro ba'i dbang e yod ci shes/ 'on kyang dpal ldan sa skya pa bdag chen dbang 'dus snying pos lung bstan bzhin mkha' spyod dag pa'i zhing du skye ba'i smon lam re 'debs bzhin yod/re zhig mkha' spyod du song na snyam gsungs/ da nga'i tshe gang 187

bo 'di nyid la don gyi gtso bo de la ji ltar byed dgos thugs bkod cig gnang bar zhu zhus pas/ bu da mang po bshad ci dgos/ sngar kha sos dal ba'i sgang la bshad pa de tsho sems la zhog de'i nang du 'dus yod/ mdor bsdu na/ rgyal ba gong ma'i rnam thar ltar tshe 'di blo yis thongs/ phyogs med ri khrod 'grims/ tshe dang sgrub pa snyoms/ sgrub 'bras kyis bstan 'gro yongs la gang phan mdzod/ khyad par chos dang gang zag yongs la dag snang sbyongs/ nyam thag sems can rnams byams snying rje byang chub sems kyi sgo nas bu bzhin du skyongs/ gzhan yang sku gsung thugs rten bzhengs pa sogs bstan 'gro'i bde thabs gang byed kyang / thabs mkhas la thugs rje che ba'i sgo nas sgrubs dang gegs med bde blag tu 'grub yong zhes dad rten du kha btags kyi thog tu phyag gnyis kyi rjes dang zhal gdams 'di yang gsungs so/ /kun bzang yab yum rdo rje sems dpa' dang / /ye shes ḍā k+ki las kyi dbang mo che/ /hūṃ chen kā ra lab kyi sgon ma dang / /pad 'byung mtsho rgyal dpal seng bde chen rgyal/ /o rgyan bstan 'dzin la sogs rtsa brgyud kyi/ /dpal ldan bla ma rnams kyi byen rlabs kyi/ /dngos grub char phob skal ldan slob 188

ma yi/ /sgo gsum rdo rje gsum du byen gyes rlobs/ /snying nas dam chos byed rnams skyong mdzad pa'i/ /dam can mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs/ /mthun rkyen bsam don yid bzhin 'grub pa dang / /mi mthun rkyen rnams zhi ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /cher snyigs lnga bdo'i dus kyi 'gro ba rnams/ /las 'bras khyad gsod ngan 'gro'i sgo 'byed cing / /rgyal ba'i bka' dang bla ma'i dam 'das pa/ /bsam na skyo ba skye zhing sems rgyud 'khrugs/ /tshul 'di soms la byams dang snying rje dang / /byang chub sems kyis mkha' mnyam 'gro ba'i ched/ /nyin mtshan dus kun byang chub bsgrub la 'bod/ /'dir yang smra ba mang pos ci zhig bya/ /sngon byon dam pa'i rnam thar ji bzhin du/ /dam bca' zhe bcad drag pos nyer blangs nas/ /ma yengs brtson 'grus chen pos 'bad par rigs/ /de ltar rnam dkar dge ba ci mchis pa/ /mkha' mnyam 'gro kun byang chub 'thob pa dang / /bstan 'dzin skyes bu'i zhabs brtan 'phrin las rgyas/ /gsang chen bstan pa rgyas pa'i ched du bsngo/ /bkra shis dge legs sarba maṅga lam/ /zhes gsungs/de nas mtsho snying du 'gro la nye ba'i tshe/ nyin cig yum a r+pā rin po che rig 'dzin dbang mo'i sku mdun du song nas/ mtsho 189

snying la 'gro ba'i rgyu mtshan rnams rgyas par zhus nas mjug tu 'di skad zhus/e ma tshe 'di'i ma las kyang / /lhag pa'i drin can a r+pā rje/ /bdag gis skyes pa'i pha yul spangs/ /chos rgyal yab yum zhabs drung du/ /'ongs nas mjal dus rab dga'i sa/ /thob pa lta bu'i dga' spro shar/ /chos rgyal yab yum gnyis kyis bdag /sras gcig bzhin du brtse bas bskyangs/ /bka' drin che'o a r+pā rje/ /drin lan bsgrub pa'i mchod pa 'bul/ /da ni mi nga 'gol bo yi/ /mtsho snying dben pa'i ri la 'gro /slar yang yab yum sras bcas la/ /mjal du 'ong nges 'ongs pa'i dus/ /sngar bzhin brtse bas bskyang du gsol/ /zhes zhus pas/ gsol ras su dngul srang bcu tsam gnang ba blangs pa'i tshe/ dbus gtsang nas bsnams yong ba'i byin rlabs rten gsum gang mang dang tsan dan dkar dmar gur kum sogs dri bzang bcas gos sngon po kha do'i nang du btums te phyag gis gnang nas 'di skad gsungs/chung nas 'khor bar skyo shas skyes/ /cher song chos rgyal snyan pa thos/ /zhabs pad bsten snyam drung du 'ongs/ /lo lnga'i bar du tshul bzhin bsten/ /chos la thos bsam sgom 190

gsum byas/ /bar dor grol ba'i gdeng tshad rnyed/ /rgun ring 'dris pa'i ri khrod pa/ /thag ring ri la 'gro ba la/ /sems la skyo dga' sna tshogs shar/ /da ni 'gro ba'i lam bar dang / /sdod sa gang du'ang lus 'di 'tshos/ /chos byed pa la lus 'di mkho/ /yun ring ma sdod slar yang shog /chos rgyal dgung lo bgres nas gda'/ /sngar bzhin chos kyi mthun rkyen bsgrub/ /deng nas tshe rabs thams cad du/ /yang yang phrad pa'i smon lam 'tshal/ /gsungs/ gzhan yang thugs brtse ba'i zhal gsung rgyas par gnang / lo gsum gyi 'phro nas 'dir shog gsungs/ de nas chos rgyal rin po che'i drung du 'ongs nas zhag 'ga' song ba'i sang nyin 'gro rgyu'i dgong mo phyag dang skor ba mang du byas te nang du song nas sku mdun du bsdad pa'i tshe/ khong gis sman khug chen po zhig yod pa de bslogs te nang nas dngul dang kha btags gang yod rnams bton te/ do dgong gzhan su med sa nas bu la rdzongs pa rgyag pa yin gsungs/ dngul srang dgu/ kha btags che chung nyi shu tsam zhig gnang nas/ 'di khyod kyis khyer la bro kha nyos gsungs te gnang bas/ ngas tshur lag tu blangs te/ nang nas kha btags gnyis rten 'brel gyis zhus/ gzhan rnams slar sku 191

mdun du phul nas/ da re nga la yod skabs shig yin na khyed kyi sku drin bsab pa'i ched du 'bul ba chen po 'degs dgos kyang / de nga'i bsod nams kyis ma grub rung / da re gsol ras gnang ba 'di rten 'brel gyi gnad cig gis mi zhu/ de'i rgyu mtshan sngon gyi skyes bu dam pa rnams kyi rnam thar gang na yang /bla ma'i mdun nas gdams ngag thob ste/ ri khrod la tshe blos btang nas 'gro dus/ bla ma spyi bor bsgoms/ gdams ngag sems la bcangs/ gsal 'debs be'u bum khur/ sba dbyug lag tu thogs nas phebs pa ma gtogs/ gser dngul la sogs pa'i nor rdzas mang po khur nas song zer ba zhig mi gda'/ da re nga yang dam pa gong ma'i rnam thar bzhin tshe blos btang nas ri khrod la 'gro ba lags na dngul mi 'khyer/ rje nyid kyis gnang na dus rgyun du gsol ras gnang ba'i snying rje'i yul/ mtha' na yod pa'i rgan mo de la mdzo mo zhig nyo ba'i rin zhig bstsal na thugs rje che lags zhus pas/ de red gsungs dngul srang lnga gnang byung / nangs par snga bar bzhengs nas gsol ja bzhes pa'i dus su/ da ri khrod pa ja 'di 'thungs nas 'gro ba yin nam gsungs/ yin lags zhus pas/ ja bzhes 'phro bdag la gnang nas 'thungs tshar tshe/192

nga'i mgo thog tu phyag g.yas pa bzhag nas byin rlabs gnang mthar/ 'o ngas chos bshad kun gyi mjug sdud/ zhal gdams kun gye tha ma 'di yin zhes 'di skad gsungs so//phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba kun gyi byin rlabs dang / /tshogs gnyis yongs rdzogs mnga' thang chen po dang / /chos dbyings rnam dag bsam mi khyab pa'i mthus/ /skal ldan slob bu'i bsam don mthar phyin shog /yid las skyes pa'i skal ldan slob bu khyod/ /yid la nges 'byung skyes nas chos phyir du/ /yid dga'i dben par 'gro bar byed pa la/ /yid ni skyo dga' gnyis kyis 'khrugs par 'gyur/ /de phyir rnam kun legs smon 'debs pa dang / /chu shel dbang por ri dwags gzugs brnyan bzhin/ /gtong min phan bde 'od dkar 'gyed pa la/ /khyod yid ku mud 'dab brgya bzhad par mdzod/ /gsungs dus/ ngas khong gi zhabs spyi bor blangs ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang zhus/ da ni bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'di dang tshe 'dir yang yang e mjal ci shes/ de ring nas bzung zhal ma mthong na phyin chad ngas ci bya snyam nas mchi ma mang po shor/ zhal ras la lta bzhin/ bde zhus kyi dbyangs 'di ltar phul lo/ /193

dus gsum sangs rgyas thugs kyi sprul/ /snyigs dus 'gro mgon bde bar bzhugs/ /o rgyan chen po'i lung zin pa'i/ /bka' babs chos bdag bde bar bzhugs/ /ma rig mun pa sel ba yi/ /gsal ba'i sgon me bde bar bzhugarme/ /nyon mongs zug rngu 'byen mdzad pa'i/ /sman gyi sdong bo bde bar bzhugs/ /dug lnga'i tsha gdung sel ba yi/ /chu shel zla ba bde bar bzhugs/ /ci 'dod dngos grub stsol ba yi/ /gtsug gi nor bu bde bar bzhugs/ /'khor ba sdug bsngal rgya mtsho las/ /sgrol ba'i ded dpon bde bar bzhugs/ /ma nor thar pa'i lam ston pa'i/ /mtshan ldan bla ma bde bar bzhugs/ /'bangs rnams bde la 'god mdzad pa'i/ /chos kyi rgyal po bde bar bzhugs/ /bdag gi 'di phyi'i gtan gyi skyabs/ /drin can bla ma bde bar bzhugs/ /bka' bzhin bsgrub pa'i slob bu nga / /bu bzhin brtse bas yun ring skyongs/ /zhes slar yang zhabs la mgo bos gtugs nas phyir cung zad cig bkyed nas/ skye ba 'di dang skye ba gzhan/ /ji srid byang chub ma thob bar/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs drung du/ /'bral ba med par skye bar shog /ces smon lam btab pa'i dus nga'i dbugs stod la 'tshangs/ gdong mchi mas g.yogs pa de khong 194

gis gzigs nas spyan chab g.yo zhing thugs kyis ma bzod par/dus rgyun du thugs gtsigs che ba'i 'ja' shel khyad 'phags shig yod pa de blangs nas/ 'ja' shel 'di spyir khyod smon lam gyes mthu grub pa'i skal ldan las can gyi slob ma yin pa dang / sgos 'o skol pha bu gnyis dam gtsang sel med yin pa'i stabs kyis byin pa yin/ 'di khyod kyis zungs dang rten 'brel gye gnad cig yod gsungs te/ bdag la gnang nas ri khrod pa da mchi ma ma gtong nged pha bu gnyis nam zhig phrad 'ong gsungs/ ngas gzims gur nas phyi sgo ru phyi 'gros byas thon te rje'i zhal ras la bltas tshe khong yang spyan chab nyil le gzigs pa mthong nas yong mi phod pa zhig byung / de nas a r+pā rin po che dang sras gnyis kyi gzims gur du song ste/ bde zhus su kha btags shig phul nas 'di skad zhus/skye 'gro yongs kyi gtsug gi rgyan/ /chos kyi rgyal mo bde bar bzhugs/ /'bangs 'khor thams cad legs skyong ba'i/ /byams brtse'i mnga' bdag bde bar bzhugs/ /sku gzugs lha sgu bas kyang mdzes/ /kun dga'i dpal ster bde bar bzhugs/ /bdag la sku drin ma las lhag /a r+pā sku khams bde bar bzhugs/ /rgyal srid 'dzin pa'i sras po 195

dang / /blon 'bangs thams cad bde bar bzhugs/ /zhes zhus nas yab yum sras dang bcas pa 'bral mi phod bzhin du bral nas lam la zhugs te urge nam mthong gi bar du phyi mig lta bzhin 'ong / de nas urge ma mthong tshe phar 'gro ma phod par yang phyir log nas bltas pas/ urge khra chags se 'dug pas sems 'phreng drags nas log gam snyam pa'i ngang nas yang bsam mno zhig la gdams ngag ni thob da res phyir log pa la dgos pa mi gda'/ re zhig mtsho snying du song nas slar yang mjal du 'ongs na chog snyam skye ba nas tshe rabs thams cad du yang yang mjal ba'i smon lam btab nas da dung yang yong ma phod par bsdad/ de nas yid skyo phyod de ba zhig gi ngang la lam du zhugs nas 'ongs/ de'i nyin par lus sems sdug pa zhig tshe 'dir ma byung / de ni rjes nas mi mjal ba'i snga ltas yin par 'dug de nas sems sdug bzhin sngar sdod sa'i rtse gzhung gi grub gnas thā yan chir song nas/ zhag bo kha shas la dam gtsang rdo rje'i srun grogs rnams dang lhan du bsdad/ la kha sprul sku tshang dang / ma go gcod pa/ 'jam dpal/rigs ldan/ dag ge sogs der bzhugs pa'i mched grogs rdo rje'i spun rnams la 'di skad ces smras so/ /phan bde'i 'byung 196

gnas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che'i sgor zhugs te/thos bsam sgom gsum gyi sgo nas rang don sngon du bsgrubs te/rgyud la nyams rtogs dang yon tan rgyas pa'i tshe/ thabs mkhas bsdu bzhi'i sgo nas skyo ngal med par gzhan don rgya chen po mdzod la/ tshe 'dir rang gzhan yongs la phan pa zhig la rem zhes phyag 'gyed mtshon byed du kun la kha btags re phul thams cad kyis brtse zhing dung ba'i gtam gyi gleng mo mang po byas/ 'gro ba'i nangs par thams cad snga mo nas 'tshogs te/bsang mchod rgya chen po phul/ sbub chol dang / rnga bo che brdungs/zangs kyi dung chen dang / dung dkar rnams bus nas/ snyan grags phyogs bcur rgyas pa'i rten 'brel bsgrigs/ de nas mched grogs rnams kyis nga phar cung zad bskyal ba'i sar/ngas 'o skol rnams 'dus nas lo mang por chos ldan gyi bya ba lhan du bsgrubs nas da so sor gyes te song nas kha thag ring pos bar chod/ skye 'chi la khrigs khrigs med/ tshe 'dir da re tsam ma gtogs phyin chad mjal mi mjal yang ci shes/ de'i phyir chos thams cad mi rtag pa 'di'i rang bzhin yin tshul soms la/ khyed rnams kyis phyin chad bla ma la mos gus/mched grogs la brtse dung / sems can la snying rje/ chos la dag 197

snang phyogs med du sbyongs la nyams len la 'bod/ nga yang de ring nas bzung ste khyed rnams kyis mig gis bltas na mi mthong zhing / rna bas nyan na mi go ba'i thag ring dben pa'i gnas su song yang nged rnams tshe 'dir mjal zhing phyi mar dag pa'i zhing nas mjal te/ sangs yang mnyam por rgya ba'i skyabs 'jug bsngo smon yang yang bya zhes smras pas/ a khu rigs ldan dang / dag ge la sogs pa'i grogs po phal cher gyi mig nas mchi ma mang po btang tshe/ nga yang mig nas mchi ma shor/ thams cad kyis yang yang mjal ba'i smon lam btab pa'i mthar/ khong rnams der bzhugs su bcug nga yar langs sba dbyug la 'khen te kun la bde zhus kyi dbyangs 'di blangs so//mdog byi ru ltar mdzes brag stod kyi/ /bya rgod pos bskyangs pa'i rgod phrug tsho/ /zhal mjal rag bar du bde bar bzhugs/ /nga 'dab rgyas rgod phrug 'phur nas 'gro /g.yu'i mdog ltar mdzes pa'i nags tshal gyi/ /stag ma yis bskyangs pa'i stag phrug tsho/ /zhal mjal rag bar du bde bar bzhugs/ /nga rtsal ldan stag phrug langs nas 'gro /mchong khra bo 'dra ba'i rdza khrod kyi/ /'brong ma yis bskyangs pa'i 'brong 198

phrug tsho/ /zhal mjal rag bar du bde bar bzhugs/ /nga 'brong chung rwa sngon mi sdod 'gro /sa bde la yangs pa'i rtse gzhung na/ /rje bla mas bskyangs pa'i snying grogs tsho/ /zhal mjal rag bar du bde bar bzhugs/ /nga mtsho snying dben par chas nas 'gro /zhes blangs nas sems 'phreng bzhin du 'ongs/ de nas skyel mi zhig dang nged gnyis chen po 'gro ma thub par nyin mtha' zer ba'i lung ba'i nang du zhag cig —bsdad/ dad ldan du mas 'tsho chas kyi rtsam pa dang mar mang po byen pa mi theg par 'dug pas/ nang nas rtsam pa phal che ba zhig badzis nas/ lha bshos dang tshogs gtor du ma byas/mar kyang bzhus nas ba ma dang de'i kha gcod/ skyogs dang kong bu gcig yod pa rnams kyi nang mar khus bkang sdong ras mang po btsugs te/ mtshan mo mar me sbar nas/ bla ma mchog gsum la phul te gsol ba btab/ de'i 'phro ma nangs par nam langs nas skyel mi dang / sprang po 'ga' zhig la rdzogs par byin/ de nas rim bzhin gtsang gi dgon pa brgyud nas g.yu rngogs dang mgar rtse'i ru nang du song / dad can sngags rgan ba le dang rta mgrin sogs phyogs de'i slob ma sbyin bdag rnams la drang don las rgyu 'bras kyi chos dang / nges don zab 199

mo stong pa nyid kyi mthar thug sems khrid byas pas khong rnams kyis rta nor longs spyod mang po phul kyang ma blangs/ yon bdag cig gi nang du song nas bkra shis brjod pas/ der yon bdag ma des khyed tshang gis pha yul dang a ma sogs e dran gi zer ba'i lan du/ /rtse mtshar lta bur brjed pa bcu yi glu 'di blangs so// —chos kyi rgyal po'i bka' drin gyes/ /bya btang tshogs drug rang grol ngas/ /chos sku'i gtan yul bzung bzung nas/ /pha yul ngang gis brjed de thal/ /'gro kun a mar bsgoms bsgoms nas/ /a ma ngang gis brjed de thal/ /'phags pa'i nor bdun bsogs bsogs nas/ /zas nor ngang gis brjed de thal/ /chos nyid grogs dang 'grogs 'grogs nas/ /grogs po ngang gis brjed de thal/ /dam tshig sdom pa bsrungs bsrungs nas/ /g.yo sgyu ngang gis brjed de thal/ /'od gsal ltad mo bltas bltas nas/ /ltad mo ngang gis brjed de thal/ /nyon mongs dgra bo btul btul nas/ /dgra ya ngang gis brjed de thal/ /chos kun sgyu mar bltas bltas nas/ /chos brgyad ngang gis brjed de thal/ /spros med ting 'dzin bsgoms bsgoms nas/ /spros bcas ngang gis brjed de 200

thal/ /dben gnas ri khrod 'grims 'grims nas/ /tshe 'di ngang gis brjed de thal/ /zhes blangs/ yang bud med gzhan zhig na re/ khyed kyi pha yul na ci yod zer ba'i lan drang por smras nas yod pa bcu gsum gye mgur 'di blangs so//nyon dang phyug mo dad can ma/ /rang rig rang gsal rnal 'byor nga'i/ /ka dag chos sku'i pha yul na/ /a pha kun tu bzang po yod/ /a ma kun tu bzang mo yod/ /byang chub sems kyi a khu yod/ /mchod gnas dkon mchog gsum po yod/ /zhang po lha dang bla ma yod/ /chung ma stong nyid mdzes ma yod/ /nyams rtogs yon tan khye'u yod/ /mos gus dag snang sha nye yod/ /dkar po dge bcu'i sa zhing yod/ /'dzad med 'phags pa'i nor bdun yod/ /dam tshig gtsang ma'i sring mo yod/ /dad pa brtan po'i khyim mtshes yod/ /brtson 'grus spun zla bzang po yod/ /e go bar gda' yi zhes pas/ der yod pa kun dad cing gus par gyur to/ /de nas slob ma yon bdag 'gas 'bal gyi thang bar du bskyal nas so sor gyes khar/ de rnams kyis mgur zhig gsungs zer ba'i lan du ngas skyid pa'i rgyang glu 'di blangs so//rnyed dka'i rten bzang ni thob 'dug /mtshan ldan bla ma 201

dang mjal snang / /rtse gcig sgrub pa la gzhol ba'i/ /bya btang rnal 'byor nga'i skyid pa/ /skyid pa'i rgyang glu zhig 'jen nas/ /dben gnas gang bzang la chas 'gro /nga bzhin byed mkhan ni yod na/ /skyid pa'i nyi ma zhig 'char nges/ /dbang can dpon bo ni mi 'dug /dbang med g.yog po yang mi snang / /sdig pa'i grogs po dang bral ba'i/ /bya btang rnal 'byor nga'i skyid pa/ /skyid pa'i rgyang glu zhig 'then nas/ /dben gnas gang bzang la chas 'gro /nga bzhin byed mkhan ni yod na/ /skyid pa'i nyi ma zhig 'char nges/ /dgon pa skyong rgyu ni mi 'dug /rgyu nom gsog 'jog rgyu ni mi snang / /yon bdag ngo bsrung dang bral ba'i/ /bya btang rnal 'byor nga'i skyid pa/ /skyid pa'i rgyang glu zhig 'then nas/ /dben gnas gang bzang la chas 'gro /nga bzhin byed mkhan ni yod na/ /skyid pa'i nyi ma zhig 'char nges/ /'dul rgyu'i dgra bo ni mi 'dug /skyong rgyu'i bza' tshang ni mi snang / /nye ring chags sdang dang bral ba'i/ /bya btang rnal 'byor nga'i skyid pa/ /skyid pa'i rgyang glu zhig 'then nas/ /dben gnas gang bzang la chas 'gro /nga bzhin byed mkhan ni yod na/ /skyid pa'i nyi ma zhig 'char nges/ /bsdad na chags rgyu ni mi 'dug /'gro na 202

lus rgyu ni mi snang / /gar song 'dri mi dang bral ba'i/ /bya btang rnal 'byor nga'i skyid pa/ /skyid pa'i rgyang glu zhig 'then nas/ /dben gnas gang bzang la chas 'gro /nga bzhin byed mkhan ni yod na/ /skyid pa'i nyi ma zhig 'char nges/ /gsal 'debs be'u bum ni 'dzoms 'dug /dpe hrul mang po ni mi snang / /dge sbyor g.yeng rkyen dang bral ba'i/ /bya btang rnal 'byor nga'i skyid pa/ /skyid pa'i rgyang glu zhig 'then nas/ /dben gnas gang bzang la chas 'gro /nga bzhin byed mkhan ni yod na/ /skyid pa'i nyi ma zhig 'char nges/ /'khor bar zhen pa ni log 'dug /'phags pa'i nor bdun gyes phyug snang / /chos brgyad chom rkun dang bral ba'i/ /bya btang rnal 'byor nga'i skyid pa/ /skyid pa'i rgyang glu zhig 'then nas/ /dben gnas gang bzang la chas 'gro /nga bzhin byed mkhan ni yod na/ /skyid pa'i nyi ma zhig 'char nges/ /gzhan phan byang sems dang 'grogs 'dug /'khrul med nyams rtogs ni skyes snang / /'brel thogs thams cad la phan pa'i/ /bya btang rnal 'byor nga'i skyid pa/ /skyid pa'i rgyang glu zhig 'jen nas/ /dben gnas gang bzang la chas 'gro /nga bzhin byed mkhan ni yod na/ /skyid pa'i nyi ma zhig 'char nges/ /deng 203

sang gangs can gyi khrod 'dir/ /nga 'dra'i skyid pa zhig mi 'dug /skyid pa'i rgyang glu zhig 'then nas/ /dben gnas gang bzang la chas 'gro /nga bzhin byed mkhan ni yod na/ /skyid pa'i nyi ma zhig 'char nges/ /de 'dra'i rgyang glu de 'then mkhan/ /tshogs drug rang grol kho yin snang / /zhes blangs pas khong rnams kyis rab tu dad pas phyag dang skor ba byas nas slar log go /der ngas 'bal mdo na sog po tshe go zer ba'i phyug po dad can zhig yod zer ba rtsad bcad nas song bas khos nang du bos/ 'tsho ba zhabs tog yag po byas/ ngas kyang khong rnams kyi sems la phan pa'i chos bshad mgur dbyangs sna tshogs blangs te blo kha chos la bsgyur/ nangs par 'gro khar bkra shis brjod tshe/ rta gcig dang dā dmar bcas byin pa ma blangs pas ja mang po brdungs nas gla khug gcig gi kha gang / gzhan mar dang rtsam pa mang po byin nas/ rma chu'i kha bar du mi gcig skyel du btang / de nor med cig red/de la ngas ja mar dang rtsam pa dga' chen byin nas phyir btang / ngas theg tshod cig khur nas rnga mong thang du song bas/thang de la gzhan 'grul pa zhig gis me brgyab ste/ rtswa thams cad tshig nas phyogs phyogs kyi mtshams mtshams na bsang gi du 204

ba 'dra ba brgya lhag cig yong bar 'dug ngas de rnams ci yin nam snyam song nas bltas pas/ grog tshang gi rtswa lud kyi nang du me lhung nas grog ma rnams tshig par ma zad/ sa thams cad kyang tshig ste me ma mur du song ba mthong bas snying rje chen po skyes/ thang chen de na chu med rung dkyil nas zhag cig bsdad/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed yan lag bdun pa sogs tshogs gsog sgrib sbyong gang shes byas/ bla ma dkon mchog gsum la tshe 'das grog ma ji snyid cig mchis pa 'di rnams dag pa'i zhing du 'dren par mdzad du gsol zhes gsol ba btab ste bdud rtsi'i 'bebs sbyangs byas/ de nas dgong mo lus gnad drang bor bsrang /dran pa gsal ba byas nas grog ma rnams kyi sems rang sems la bsres/ rang sems bla ma dang dus gsum rgyal ba'i thugs la bsres te/ thugs chos sku nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag nas/ tshe 'das grog ma rnams kyi las nyon sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa skye med chos kyi dbyengs su byang zhing dag par byas te/ tho rangs khar 'od gsal gyi ngang las tshur tshe 'das grog ma rnams shin tu phra ba'i rlung sems tsam las grub pa'i sgyu lus kyi sku thugs rje chen po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa mtshan dpe gzi byin 'bar 205

ba re re'i rnam par bzhengs nas/ bya brgya 'ur rdo gcig gis ded pa ltar phaṭa gcig brjod pa'i sgra dang dus mnyam du rang rang gang 'dod kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams rnams su tshe 'das grog ma lhar gyur pa rnams gcig kyang ma lus pa thams cad 'ur ding gis 'phur song snyam pa'i dmigs pa yag po byas/ bsngo ba smon lam btab ste/ hang nga'i ri rgan gyi lung pa'i chu khar 'ongs te ja bskol nas zhag gis bsdad/ phyi nyin ri hang nga brgyud de phar song bas/ phyi dro kha skom tshe phyug po zhig gi sbra mthong nas thag nyer btud de ja zhig bslangs pas/nang nas bud med skad phra mo can zhig gis/ 'dir ma yong ja med zer/ pho skyes yar zag cig gis/ khyod phar song la sdod dang ja zhig 'khyer 'ong zer/ nga der yun ring bsdad pas ja min chu min zhig la rdza chung gang dang / sder ma zhig gi nang du rtsam pa spar gang / mar phye ma leb kyi gshog pa tsam pa gnyis bzhag ste khyer 'ongs nas byin te/ nged tsho'i sa phyogs 'dir rtsam pa dkon zhing / phyi dro ster mi dpe/ khyed thag ring nas yong ba la byin pa yin pas/ nged mi phyugs kyi sku rim la rem zer bas/ nga khong 'dzum zhig shor nas/ yon bdag la ngas dgong srung yod pas rtsam pa mi dgos/ sgu rim 'don zhes 206

ja 'thungs nas sku rim kha shas bton tshar ba'i rjes la yong bdag gis go bar byas te 'di skad ces smras/rgyal ba rnams ni thugs rje che/ /chos skyong rnams ni nus mthu che/ /phyug po rnams ni ser sna che/ /sprang po rnams ni sred pa che/ /dal 'byor tshang ba'i mi lus dkon/ /lus thob lha chos byed pa dkon/ /chos byed mchod pa'i yon bdag dkon/ /mchod rgyu'i mar dang rtsam pa dkon/ /ban min bon min ras pa ngar/ /ja min chu min blud pa yis/ /rgan min gzhon min yon bdag la/ /lha min 'dre min mi gnod shog /ces rtse mtshar du smras pas/ kho'i mtshang la phog nas/ 'dzum bzhin nang du song / ja phon che ba zhig khyer 'ongs nas 'di khyed kyis lam nas bro ja gyis zer phul byung / de dus dbul po zhig gis nga la ja mang po yod pa mthong nas/ slong mo byas tshe/yon bdag mang pos sngar byen pa'i ja brdungs ma gla ba'i khug ma chen po zhig gi gang tsam 'dug pa de/ dbul po de la snod cig yod pa'i nang du/ gla khug gi zhabs nas bzung mgo mjug bslogs te ja yongs rdzogs blugs pas/ sprang po kho na re/ ja thams cad kho la byen na/ khyed ri khrod du song na dka' zer/ja spar ba kha shas phyir nan gyis byin pa blangs nas/ kho la 207

rtsag chad cig ma gtogs gon pa gang yang mi 'dug pas/ngas phying 'gag rnying ba zhig yod pa de gyon/ rtsag 'gag gsar ba srab 'jam yang zhing dro ba zhig yod pa de lus las phud nas kho la byen pas kho dad pa skyes te/ chos pa zhig la da lta khyed 'dra ba'i snying rje can dkon par gda' zer phyag 'tshal nas phyin chad thugs dam skyabs 'og nas ma 'dor zer/ mig mtha' tshor chu 'khyel bar gda'/ de ltar sbyin pa btang ba mthong nas sngar gyi yon bdag de dang gzhan phyogs de'i yon bdag phal cher dad pa skyes nas/ nga la chos 'brel zhu ru byung bar/ ngas ma ṇi dang dmigs brtse ma'i lung byas te/ 'o tshe 'dir dbul ba ni sngon sbyin pa ma btang bas lan la/ phyug pa ni tshe sngon mar bsod nams bsags pa'i 'bras bu smin pa yin pas na/ phyi mar skyid par 'dod na khyed rnams kyis ser sna'i mdud pa khrol la mchod sbyin dang phyag skor kha ton sogs rnam dkar dge ba'i las la 'bod/ khyad par dbul po rnams la snying rje skyed la sbyin pa thongs zhes glu 'di blangs so//drin can bla ma rin po che/ /'gro ba yongs la thugs rjes gzigs/ /phyug po'i ser sna'i mdud pa khrol/ /dbul po nyam thag brtse bas skyongs/ /tshe sngon bsod nams ma bsags 208

pas/ /tshe 'dir dbul po'i mi ru skyes/ /tshe 'dir bsod nams ma bsags na/ /phyi mar dbul por skye bar gsungs/ /da ni tshe mjug 'di nyid la/ /phyi mar skyid pa'i lha chos mdzod/ /pha mar ma gyur gcig kyang med/ /dbul po thams cad snying re rje/ /phyug po ser sna ma che bar/ /dbul po rnams la sbyin pa thongs/ /bya btang tshogs drug rang grol nga / /nyam thag 'gro la phan don du/ /sangs rgyas go 'phang 'thob bya'i phyir/ /snying po med pa'i bya ba spangs/ /snying po'i lha chos byed du 'gro /zhes blangs nas bla ma rgya lu hu thog thu rin po che'i dgon par song nas/ der khong la mjal nas chos 'brel zhus pas/ ma ṇi dmigs brtse ma sgol ma tshe gzungs bcas kyi lung gnang / gsol ras la ja mar dang rtsam pa gnang ba rnams kyi nang nas rang la dgos pa cung zad tsam blangs gzhan rnamyo/sa phyir phul/ skyabs 'jug zhus te tshur la 'ongs pas/ sog sprang rgan mo ma bu gnyis dang phrad pa'i tshe/ nga la kha btags chen po steng na/ nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs/ /zhes pa bkra shis pa'i tshigs bcad bzhi'i ri mo can gyi ring po zhig yod pa de byin nas/ 'di khyed gnyis kyis tshongs la kha rgyab cig gyes/ bu la chos shig slobs dang / khyed ma bu gnyis tshe 209

'di phyir skyid po yong zhes smras pas/ lags so zer ma bu gnyis ka sems dga' yal le ba'i ngang du song / de nas tshur yongs sto bu'i nang du thon tshe/ sngon nas reb gong gi bon po zhig dang mi skya gcig gnyis kyis/ ba lang kha shas ded nas yul du 'gro ba la thug pas nga la khyed gang nas yin zer/ der ngas rgyu mtshan rnams bshad tshe/ khong gnyis dga' nas mjal/ chos 'brel zhig dgos zer ba la/ bsam pa myur 'grub kyi lung zhig byin nas/ chos bshad bsdus pa zhig byas pa'i mjug tu mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so//bla ma spyi bo'i rgyan du bzhugs/ /dad can shes rgyud byen gyis rlobs/ /chos phyir ri la 'khyams pa dang / /nor phyir 'khyams pa'i reb gong mi/ /nged gsum r+sā bu'i thang nas mjal/ /de sngon chad smon lam btab pa 'dra/ /khyed gnyis dam chos byed mi byed/ /khyed gnyis dam chos byed snyam na/ /nged gsum chos 'brel byas pa'i mthar/ /so sor gyes nas 'gro ba ltar/ /chos rnams mi rtag 'di dang 'dra/ /de la soms la lha chos mdzod/ /bla ma dkon mchog mchod bstod bkur/ /nyam thag dbul por phan thogs rem/ /rgyun du phyag skor kha ton gyis/ /'chi khar mi 'gyod tsam re mdzod/ /nga ni mtsho snying 210

dben par 'gro /khyed gnyis yul la bde bar bzhud/ /tshe 'dir tshe ring nad med cing / /phyi mar skyid pa'i smon lam 'debs/ /zhes blangs nas kha btags ring po re byin pas/gnyis ka dad bzhin rang yul du song / nga mtsho srib tu slebs pas kha ba che zhing / sog po'i ru sde ni med/ bro kha tshar/rkang pa yang lham gyis bshus te/ sdug bsngal myong bzhin du mtsho nyin na a rig gi ru sde yod pa'i nang du slebs nas ngo shes rgad po 'dzi ris zer ba'i nang du song / bsnyen bkur legs po byas/ zhag ma re gnyis bsdad/ khos nga la 'tsho ba'i mthun rkyen du dmigs te/ nas tshwa sgye chung ba zhig gi gang dang / mar rgya ma gsum byin pa de khar bzhag nas/ a rig gi ru sder slong mo byed pa'i thog mar/ lam kha na gur chung zhig 'dug pa la ma bslangs par bzhag nas/ pha ri na phyug po sbra can kha shas yod sar teb langs nas song bas/ ru skor de la khye bco lnga tsam zhig 'dug pa thams cad dmag bzhin shor nas yong dus rang la 'di skad smras/dad med mi ngan thams cad kyis/ /sgo yi khyi ngan 'gog mi sred/ /bya btang tshogs drug rang grol khyod/ /mkho ba dam pa'i lha chos yin/ /de la mkho ba lus 'di yin/ /lus 'dir mkho 211

ba'i zas kyi phyir/ /'ong la khyi rnams phrag dog skyes/ /mtshon cha kha na thogs pa'i khyi/ /mgo ser zhig gis sna drangs nas/ /khyi yi dmag dpung yong gin gda'/ /rdo dang dbyug pa'i mtshon cha gsog /mar gyi thang thog 'di nyid nas/ /khye ngan dmag dpung pham par mdzod/ /ces spras nas khur bo phog rdo mang po btus nas bsdad pa'i tshe/ khyi rnams steng du rub byung ba'i dus rdo 'phangs tshe phal cher thar re long nge song / khye rgan mgo ser gyis nga'i gzan la bzung nas gzan ral/ yang khye nag po zhig gis lham gyi yu ba nas bzung bas/ de la rdo gcig brgyab pas/ snying rje zhig kyang byung / de nas khyi rnams ded nas song dus/ mi zhig gis nor lhas nas/ i khyi 'ur gyis ded nas khyod ci la 'ong / nged tsho la 'grul pa mi chud/ dga' ldan po/ tshur nor lug gi lhas la ma yong zer/ phye phor ba gang mi tshang zhig gis byen nas phyir log dus 'di skad smras/bya btang tshogs drug rang grol khyod/ /phyug po'i sgo ru heb langs song / /khyi ngan dmag dpung steng du blugs/ /steng nas gyon pa'i gzan hrul gted/ /do dgong skyi ser rlung po dang / /thang nas 'khrug pa 'chor nyen gda'/ /khab skud gnyis kyis btsem na bzang / /zhes dro sa zhig nas bsdad de gzan 212

btsems/ de nas sngar bzhag nas song ba'i sog po'i gur chung yod pa'i sgor song nas bslangs tshe/ nang nas sog mo rgan mo sha kha smug sang nge ba zhig gis khyi bkag phyag 'tshal mjal te nang du song bas/ chu ra sder ma chen po zhig gi gang mar sgrog gcig dang bcas pa byen pas/ de'i nyin par rta zhig phul ba tsam gyi dga' spro skyes/ bsngo ba smon lam btab/de nas sbra chung zhig yod pa'i sgor song bas phye sder ma gang byen nas/ kho la cang med/ lung pa 'di'i phu na phyug po zhig yod zer/ der song bas slebs ma thag khyi gnyis glo bur du rgyug byung bas 'dzin grabs byas tshe/ bo co zhig yod pa g.yugs pas rdo la phog pas dkyil nas chag khyim tshang des rtsam chur sder ma gang tsam byen pa khyer nas/ phyir log nas 'di skad smras/lung ring gyen du yar la song / /rtsam chur sder ma gang gi phyir/ /rta bas lhag pa'i dbyug pa chag /rnal 'byor rkang thang lta bur btang / /zhes smras nas dum bu gnyis ka lag pa g.yas g.yon du bzung nas dgod kyin dgod kyin 'ong / de nas gshin po la dge rtsa byed pa'i thog cig tu song nas phye rtsam shing tse do tsam rnyed pa'i tshe rang la 'di skad smras/213

bya btang dge rtsa bca' sar rgyug /mi yi 'phya smod mang na yang / /bza' btung lag tu yong bar snang / /khyi yis mi 'dzin bde bar gda'/ /zhes smras/ de dus mnga' ri dgon gyi grwa pa bstan dar zer ba'i rmi lam du/ mi 'ga' res rgya gar gye pha dam pa 'dir phebs 'dug mjal du 'gro zer bas kho yang song nas bltas pas/ rnal 'byor pa sha mdog smug pa dbu skra thor cog byas shing / sked pa na gser gyi 'khor lo zhig bsnams yod pa de las 'od zer 'phros nas 'gro ba gzhan la phog cing / kho la yang phog pas lus la bde nyams kyang byung /'khor lo de lan gcig skor dang byas pas/ rjes nas bskor 'ong de dus shog zer ba zhig rmis pas phyi nyin nga dang mjal tshe/mdang gi rmi lam de dran nas dad pa chen po skyes te/ zhal gdams gsung mgur zhig gnongs zer bas/ ngas rje mi la la pha dam pas gsungs pa'i mgur de blangs pas/ rjes sor kho mtsho snying du 'ong ste chos nyan nas lo mang por bsdad pas chos pa dge sbyor mkhan bzang po zhig byung / de nas yang dgon gong 'og gnyis su song bas khong rnams kyis phye rtsam phar phor re byen/ de'i sngar lo ri khrod pa brdzus ma zhig 'ongs nas gzungs shul dge bshes tshang gi dngul srang brgya tsam zhig rku 214

thabs kyis khyer song ba'i nang der nga phyin pas gnyer ba bzang po zhig 'dug nang du bos ja blud nas bsdad yod pa'i tshe/ gzhan grwa pa 'ga' re yong gcig gis 'di su red zer/ gnyer bas rtsed mo byas nas 'di na ning gi ri khrod pa de'i sku skyes yin byas pas thams cad dgod par gda'/gzhan yang grwa pa zhig gi nang du song bas/ khyod 'dras nged tshor sngar yang phan btags sha da phar phar zer go re ser bo gyong do chag po 'ga' zhig khyer 'ongs nas/ lag tu yang mi 'jog par/ nga'i brang gi ngos la shed kyis brgyab nas mig log cig bltas nas song / nga cig 'dzum nas bsdad/ de nas phyir log nas/ sbrul gyis gtses sar gser dngul gyi/ /nyag thag mthong yang 'bros pa bzhin/ /skye bo ngan pas sun dbyung bas/ /skyes bu dam pa yin yang spong / /zhes smras/ kho la khag med snyam/ de dus a rig gi khong rnam pa mang pos khyed kyi ral pa 'di ci la bzhag rgyu mtshan ci yod shod dang zer rtsed mo byas pa'i lan du bdag gis 'di skad ces smras/drin can gyi bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /'dir 'tshogs kyi dge 'dun tshogs rnams nyon/ /mgo bo la 'khur ba'i ral pa 'di/ /bzhag tshul gyi rgyu mtshan 'di ltar lags/ /drin can gye 215

bla ma brjed pa'i tshe/ /rang nyid la dran gso'i phyir du bzhag /phyogs med kyi rgyal khams 'grim pa'i tshe/ /jag rkun gyi 'jigs las skyob phyir bzhag /lo gsar gyi lhags pa slebs pa'i tshe/ /rna ba la phan pa'i phyir du bzhag /nyin mtshan du kha ba babs pa'i tshe/ /mig gnyis ni mi phyid phyir du bzhag /zang zing gi bsod snyoms 'du ba'i tshe/ /rnam g.yeng gi dgra las dben phyir bzhag /mi med kyi lung stong 'grim pa'i tshe mi gral du mi tshud phyir du bzhag /mi ngan nga'i tshe 'di dran pa'i tshe/ /mi la yi rnam thar dran phyir bzhag /ces smras pas/ grwa pa rgan pa zhig na re/ de 'dra chags po byung zer/ de nas yang a rig gi khyim tshang mang po'i sgor song nas bslangs pas/rgad po zhig gis khyed bon po'am/ sngags pa zhig e yin/ral pa 'di ci la dgos/ gdos 'dis khyed rkang thang zhig la ched zer ba'i lan du 'di ltar smras/chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs la 'dud/ /'di nyid mgo la bzhag pa yis/ /thams cad yid gnyis the tshom 'gyur/ /the tshom skyes na dad pa med/ /dad pa med na dkor mi 'du/ /dkor ma 'dus na zang zing med/ /zang zing med na nyams len 'phel/ /nyams len 'phel na nyams rtogs skye/ /nyams 216
