rtogs skyes na gzhan la phan/ /gzhan la phan pa'i ral pa 'di/ /bzhag pa'i rgyu mtshan de ltar lags/ /zhes smras/ yang bud med cig gis 'di ltar sprang dgos pa zhig min par snang /khyed sngon nas mo rtsis shig tu 'di ltar song zhes babs nas 'ongs pa ma yin nam zer ba'i lan du 'di skad ces smras/chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs la 'dud/ /bya btang tshogs drug rang grol ngas/ /rang gis rang la rtsis shig byas/ /mdo sngags chos kyi rtsis gdan btings/ /rten 'brel bcu gnyis lo skor brtsis/ /rnam shes tshogs brgyad spar kha bsdebs/ /theg pa dgu yi sme bas bskor/ /dge sdig gnyis kyis dgra grogs 'thab/ /rtsis ni mi bzang rtsis ni ngan/ /dang po nad kyi byung tshul ni/ /blo ma rig 'khrul ba'i thab gzhob byas/ /thab gzhob dme des rkyen byas nas/ /chos dbyings ye shes lha srung gyes/ /lha de gyes pa'i rang bzhin gyis/ /bdag 'dzin gdon de khog tu zhugs/ /chags sdang gnyis kyi zug rngu langs/ /gdon gyi rang bzhin de ltar gda'/ /de nyid bcos pa'i thabs bstan pa/ /ye shes lha srung gyes pa la/ /bla ma rtogs ldan bzang po yis/ /sems nyid ngo sprod grib sel gyis/ /bdag 'dzin gdon de 'dul ba la/ /pha yul rgyab tu spangs nas kyang / /217

'di bzhin bza' btung slong mo la/ /brten nas phyogs med ri khrod 'grims/ /bdag pas gzhan gces sems mchog sbyongs/ /bdag med lta ba'i gnas lugs skyongs/ /zhes pa rtsis kyi nang du babs/ /bdag gis de ltar byas pa'i mthus/ /chos dbyings ye shes lha srung 'khor/ /bdag tu 'dzin pa'i gdon dang bral/ /chags sdang na zug thams cad zhi/ /da dung 'phar bu cung zad 'dug /'on kyang sngar bzhin mi gnod do/ /zhes smras pas/ mo dad pa skyes nas phye rtsam yag po zhig byen byung / de ltar bsod snyoms la mang po song ba'i stabs kyis/ rkang pa yang lham gyis bshus pa la nyen byas nas skrangs/ltogs 'khyags ngal dub kyi sdug myong bzhin du btsal bas/khyim tshang brgya lhag tsam gyis phye rtsam phar phor re byin pa kun bsdus pa'i phye sgye gang dang / rtsam pa dang nas gnyis sgo ba gang gi tshad/ ja nag bzhi thig cig gi tshad/ mar rgya ma dgu tsam rnyed pa rnams khyer nas me stag zla ba dang bo'i tshes gsum la klu'i rgyal po ma dros pa'i blon byang chub sems dpa' gnas pa'i mtsho khri gshog rgyal mo'i dbus/ ma dang mkha' 'gro dkar phyogs pa rnams rang bzhin gyis 'du zhing / sngon byon dam pa gong mas byen gyis brlabs pa'i mtsho snying ma hā dre wa zhes 218

yongs su grags pa'i gnas mchog der slebs tshe/ da gnas 'dir sdod rgyu'i skal ba bzang po byung snyam nyams dga' ba'i shugs kyis mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so//pha chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs la 'dud/ /sprang ri khrod zin par byen gyes rlobs/ /bya btang tshogs drug rang grol ngas/ /skyes pa'i pha yul rgyab tu bzhag /gnyen dang mdza' bshes ring du spangs/ /'khor dang g.yog sogs blos btang nas/ /mtshan ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma ni/ /bsam dang sbyor bas tshul bzhin bsten/ /dbang khrid man ngag gdams pa thob/ /bla ma'i gsung bzhin mtsho snying bsnyegs/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i bka' drin gyis/ /gnas 'dir dam chos bsgrub pa la/ /'gal rkyen bar chad med pa dang / /mthun rkyen zas gos gnas mal sogs/ /dka' tshegs med par legs 'grigs nas/ /rgya lo'i tshes la bde bar slebs/ /nyams dga'i glu dbyangs lhang lhang blangs/ /skyid pa'i lus kyis rkang bro 'khrab/ /shin tu bde'o ngo mtshar che/ /chos nyid ngang du dga' yal le/ /zhes blangs/ de nas gnas chen de'i ri rtse na bzhugs pa'i smyung gnas pa bstan 'dzin nyi ma rin po cher mjal/ rgyu mtshan rnams zhib tu zhus pas thugs mnyes/ lo der bstan 'dzin nyi 219

ma dpon slob gnyis la yang mthun rkyen phye rtsam chen po mi 'dug ja bubs gcig dang phyed cig 'dug der nged rnams kyi bro kha gang yod rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdus nas khong dpon slob gnyis dang nged gsum gyis 'dra 'dra byas bgos nas/ nga shar gyi brag phug cig tu gcig pur bsdad pas/ bya btang bstan 'dzin nyi ma rin po che'i thugs kyi rjes su bzung ba'i dad pa dang blo gros kyi nor gyis phyug pa'i nye gnas blo bzang don 'grub kyis gnas bstod cig dgos zhes bskul ngor/ thog mar gnas la bstod pa'i mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so//gdul dka'i gdul bya thams cad la/ /gang la gang 'dod mdo sngags kyi/ /chos smra chos rgyal zhabs pad la/ /yang dang yang du gus pas 'dud/ /chos brgyad skyon gyis ma gos pa'i/ /chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po dang / /mtsho skyes rdo rjes lung bstan pa'i/ /mtsho snying ma hā dre wa yi/ /gnas 'di'i yon tan shes ma shes/ /gnas 'di'i yon tan ma shes na/ /rba rlabs g.yo ba'i khri gshog mtsho'i/ /dbus kyi g.yo med ri bo yi/ /stong gsal lha lam yangs pa ru/ /'od gsal rta bdun dkyil 'khor rgyas/ /snga dro myur du 'char ba dang / /phyi dro nub 220

pa'i nyi tshe ring / /rang nyid gnas khang gang 'dod kyi/ /rang grub brag khung sra ba mang / /me shing chu yi mthun rkyen 'dzoms/ /me tog sna tshogs gnas 'dir skyes/ /rnal 'byor lus srog 'tsho ba yi/ /ke'u sogs tshod ma'i 'tsho ba mod/ /rab mdzes me tog khor yug na/ /lus mdzes bung bas glu dbyangs len/ /phang phung g.yo ba'i lngon shing gis/ /shag shog 'dab sgra mang po sgrog /spu rigs mi gcig bye 'u yis/ /skad rigs mi 'dra mang po bsgyur/ /dri bzhon dal bus langs pa'i tshe/ /dri med mtsho la ri mo 'char/ /chu gtsang mtsho la gnas bcas pa'i/ /chu bya mang pos skad snyan sgog /zas kyi rjes 'brang gser mig nyas/ /lus kyi rnam 'gyur sna tshogs ston/ /phyi rkun mi dang khyi gnyis med/ /nang rkun bye ba'i ming yang med/ /mi sdug sdom dang sbrul la sogs/ /mi 'dod nyer 'tshe'i ming yang med/ /g.yang can mtsho yi phyi rol na/ /dad can 'byor ldan yon bdag mang / /gnas 'dir dam chos bsgrub rnams la/ /gnas bdag stongs grogs rgyun du byed/ /de ltar ngo mtshar mtha' yas gnas/ /de la 'dug pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /reg bya'i bde bar yid spro na/ /rab tu bde ba'i rtswa gdan yod/ /gzugs mdzes ltad mor yid spro na/ /mdog mdzes gser nya'i rtsed 'jo yod/ /dri zhim 221

dri la yid spro na/ /dri ngad ldang ba'i me tog yod/ /ro mngar zas la yid spro na/ /ro mchog ldan pa'i tshod ma yod/ /sgra snyan nyan la yid spro na/ /skad snyan 'byin pa'i bya rigs yod/ /'dod yon lnga tshang dben gnas 'di/ /'dod khams lha yi yul dang mtshungs/ /'di ltar yon tan kun tshang ba'i 'di 'dra'i dben gnas gzhan na dkon/ /chos brgyad skyon du mthong ba yi/ /chos mdzad dam pas gnas 'di bsten/ /sgrub brgyud gong ma'i rnam thar bzhin/ /sgrub pa byed rnams gnas 'di bsten/ /bde skyid ri khrod gnas 'dir yod/ /bde skyid 'dod rnams gnas 'di bsten/ /yul 'di bstod pa'i dge ba yis/ /yul phyogs 'di yi mi phyugs la/ /nad dang mu ge mi 'byung zhing / /chos dang bkra shis 'phel bar shog /ces blangs pas mtshan mo rmi lam la rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i lha'i khang pa zhig tu song ba'i tshe/ rin po che'i khri zhig gi steng na/ bud med mdzes ma dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis spras pa dpon mo'i tshul du gnas pa zhig la/ bu dang bu mo gzhon nu mang pos bskor nas ston mo chen po zhig byed cing /glu gar rol mo sna tshogs pa byed par gda'/ skabs shig la dpon mos nga la bltas nas 'dzum bzhin kha sang khong gis 222

gsungs pa'i gnas bstod de longs zer ba'i tshe/ bran mo gzhon nu zhig gis thams cad mi shes par 'dug zer/ shes tshod cig longs dang zer bas/ der bran mo yar langs nas/'dod yon lnga tshang dben gnas 'di/ /'dod khams lha yi yul dang mtshungs/ /'di ltar yon tan kun tshang ba'i/ /'di 'dra'i dben gnas gzhan na dkon/ /zhes nang nas shes pa 'ga' zhig blangs pas/ kun bzhad sgra di ri ri byed cing / nga la dpon mos ka ra dang shing thog sogs zhim mngar gye zas mang po byin pa zhig rmis pas/ nga'i bsam pa la nga gnas gang du 'dug kyang / gtor ma btang ba las/ gnas la bstod pa dga' bar 'dug snyam pa byung / de'i lo ngas nyi ma re la gung tshigs kyi ja gcig po de ma gtogs pa mang po ma bskol bar/zla ba brgyad kyi bar du ngag mtshams byas nas shin tu spros med 'od gsal rdo rje snying po'i gnas lugs la mnyam par 'jog pa kho na la 'bad pas/ mnyam bzhag gi ngang nas grong khyer dang zhing khams lta bu'i ngo mtshar ba'i ltad mo sna tshogs pa mthong bas sems spro/ yang bla ma skyes bu dam pa gong ma rnams kyi zhal nas/ zhi gnas dang lhag mthong bskyed rdzogs la brtan pa thob pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ mnyam bzhag gi ngang nas grong 223

khyer dang zhing khams lta bu'i ngo mtshar ba'i ltad mo sna tshogs pa mthong bas sems spro/ yang bla ma skyes bu dam pa gong ma rnams kyi zhal nas/ zhi gnas dang lhag mthong bskyed rdzogs la brtan pa thob pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ lam rtags kyi yon tan sna tshogs pa 'byung ba'i phyir/ sprul sgyur sna tshogs la rtsal sbyang dgos zhes gsungs pa ltar/ de'i lo dbyar dus nyin re bzhin skabs skabs su sprul sgyur sna tshogs pa 'di ltar byas te/de yang / rang lhar gsal ba'i ngang nas/ ye shes rang snang las grub pa'i seng ge dkar mo srab med la zhon nas/ rdo rje phag mos sna khrid/ rgyal chen sde bzhis seng ge'i rkang lag bzhi btegs te yar nam mkha' la 'gro ba dang / yang glang chen dang / rta mchog dang / khyung dang / 'brug dang / nyi ma dang /zla ba'i thog tu zhon nas/ nam mkha' la je mtho je mthor 'gro ba dang / yang gzan la gshog pa byas/ mtsho'i pha ri tshur ri la 'phur ba dang / yang nam mkha' la rin po che bai ḍūr+ya dang shel gyi skas ring po btsugs nas lha yul du 'gro ba dang / phyir babs pa dang / ri brag rnams 'ja' tshon lta bu'i snang stong du bsgoms nas phar thal tshur thal du bgrod pa dang / pha bong rnams 'dam ltar brdzis shing zan ltar gcod pa dang / phyag 224

rjes dang zhabs rjes 'jog pa dang / lus kyi stod nas chu 'khrugs shing smad nas me sbar ba chus me mi gsod par 'bar ba dang / lus la rma med par phyi nang slog pa dang / lus bal ltar g.yengs shing / chu ltar 'phyar ba dang / lus yid bzhin gyi nor bu/ gter chen po'i bum bzang / dpag bsam gyi shing rnams su sprul nas/ dgos 'dod kyi char 'bebs pa dang / lus lhar gsal ba gcig nas gcig tu bsgyur nas bsgoms pa'i mthar/ gcig po de yang yar nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba ltar song nas/ mi dmigs pa stong nyid nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang la 'jog pa sogs byas pas/ de dus mtsho yi phyi rol nas gang zag las dang skal bar ldan pa rnams kyis/mtsho snying gi steng gi nam mkhar 'ja' tshon gyi gur phub cing /'od dkar po gnam la 'phyo ba dang / bya rgod mang po 'phur ba mthong ba dang / lug rdzi zhig gis/ nga mtsho snying nas 'phur te mgon po gdong sna'i phyogs su 'gro ba dang / zhabs drung tshang gi shing bzo zhig gis dbyar kha nga mtsho yi phyi rol gyi ha ra wol gyi brag phug na yod pa dngos su mjal nas/ gnas 'di'i lha shing ma gcod gsungs pa sogs dag snang can gyi rigs la mthong snang sna tshogs pa zhig byung skad/ yang dbyar 225

kha gnam dgra rgod zer bas/ 'brug grag tshe/ thog srung gi dmigs pa yang 'di ltar byas/ rang nyid gnas pa'i sa phyogs dag pa'i zhing khams su gsal ba'i dbus su rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i ri rab bang rim bzhi ba rgya khyon dpag tshad bsam las 'das pa'i steng du/ gnam lcags kyi rdo rje rwa stong dang ldan pa/ mar gyi rwa stong 'og gzhi dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi la zug cing / yar gyi rwa stong nam mkha'i dbyengs su zug pa/ rdo rje'i lto ba ri rab kyi khar gnas pa'i nang du rang nyid yi dam phyag na rdo rje'i skur bsgoms nas/ rdo rje'i yar gyi rwa'i rtse mo na gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong dang ldan pa gcig gi dbus na bdag cag gi ston pa sangs rgyas dang / phyogs phyogs kyi rtsibs steng na bskal bzang gi sangs rgyas stong rtsa gnyis kyis srung ba dang skyob pa'i tshul du bzhugs pa/ 'khor lo'i mtha' ma rnams su sangs rgyas rnams kyi thugs las sprul pa'i seng ge dkar mo stong gis rngams pa'i nga ro phyogs bcur bsgrags pas/ nam mkha'i 'brug rnams 'jigs shing skrag ste phyogs gzhan du 'bros par dmigs nas phyag rdor gyi bzlas pa byas tshe/ 'brug sgra gang byung rnams sgra mi grag par song ba lan 'ga' byung bas/ bskyed rim yang dga' mo yin nam snyam pa 226

byung / yang hor zla bzhi pa'i nang la nyin zhig khu byug cig 'ongs nas byang ngos kyi nags khrod nas skad lhang lhang grag pa thos tshe/ sems la dga' ba dang skyo ba sna tshogs pa zhig skyes/de'i tshe rje btsun smyung gnas pa bstan 'dzin nyi ma rin po che'i zhal nas/ nga 'dir 'ongs nas lo bcur bsdad kyang khu byug gcig kyang ma yong / da lo khyed kyang phebs/ de'i khar khu byug 'di yang yong ba ngo mtshar che gsungs/ nyin gcig las ma bsdad par 'phur song ba'i tshe nga yang ngo mtshar skyes nas/ kha sang gi bya de/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen zhig gi sprul pa zhig yin par snang / kha sang gi sgra grag dus chos gsung ba yin par gda'/ da khyod rtsom pa la mkhas na bya de'i bshad tshul 'dra ba'i bstan bcos shig rtsoms zhes/ rang la bskul te/ de'i lan du/ 'o kha sang gi lha bya khu byug sngon mo des 'di skad zer/gu khu gu khu/ 'dir 'dug mi khyod ma yengs nyon cig gu khu/ / kho bo'i go lugs cung zad bshad kyis gu khu/ /bla mas grong chog byed tshul 'di la gu khu/ /gzhon dus thos bsam byas pa'i ha go gu khu/ /rgyal bo'i bka' khrims nyams tshul 'di la gu khu/ /bstan dang 'gro ba'i bde skyid ha go gu khu/ /gcod pas 227

'dre 'dul byed tshul 'di la gu khu/ /gnyan sa ri khrod 'grims pa'i ha go gu khu/ /sngags pas mthu gtad byed tshul 'di la gu khu/ /yi dam bsnyen sgrub byas pa'i ha go gu khu/ /khyes pas sdig las byed tshul 'di la gu khu/ /phyi mar gang du 'gro ba'i ha go gu khu/ /mi khyod ro nyal byed tshul 'di la gu khu/ /gcig pur ri khrod 'grims pa'i ha go gu khu/ /snyigs ma'i mi rnams spyod pa'i ha de gu khu/ /go tshe bsam na dgod rgyu yong gi gu khu/ /zhes cig dgod cing 'dug pa'i tshe/ bdag gis 'di skad smras/e ma ngo mtshar lha yi bya/ /dus kyi skad rigs nyams kyi grogs/ /khu byug zer ba'i skad snyan po/ /legs bshad smra ba ngo mtshar che/ /da ni nged rnams 'jig rten pa'i/ /skyon can skyon de ngos 'dzin phyir/ /de ni shin tu bden par 'dug /snyam pa'i ming re thogs shog ang / /zhes smras pa'i tshe/gu khu gu khu/ ri dwags rmas ma bzhin du gu khu/ /ri khrod 'grims pa'i rnal 'byor gu khu/ /ri klung gnyis gar 'phur ba'i gu khu/ /ri bya bdag la nyon cig gu khu/ /dgon pa skyong zer kha g.yar gu khu/ /dgon du yo byad bsags nas gu khu/ /dgon la 'gyed phogs med tsho gu khu/ /dgon pa'i bla ma rnams red gu khu/ /blon po ngan pa'i khar nyan gu khu/ /dkar po'i mi 228

la chad pa gu khu/ /mang po gcod kin 'jug tsho gu khu/ /rgyal po'i blon po rnams red gu khu/ /chos spyod 'chal 'chol bslabs nas gu khu/ /chos gos rgyab tu khur te gu khu/ /chos min lto phyir rgyug tsho gu khu/ /chos med grong dge rnams red gu khu/ /mi nag skye bo'i khyim na gu khu/ /lug nag g.yang gzhi brgyangs nas gu khu/ /rnga nag bskor brdung byed tsho gu khu/ /snying nag gcod pa rnams red gu khu/ /sems ngan gzhan la bzung nas gu khu/ /rdzas ngan mang po bsags te gu khu/ /las ngan mthu gtad byed tsho gu khu/ /sems ngan sngags pa rnams red gu khu/ /mi lus rin chen rnyed dka' gu khu/ /mi dge sdig la sbyar nas gu khu/ /mi tshe sdug zade byed tsho gu khu/ /mi nag pho mo rnams red gu khu/ /yengs med brtson 'grus med la gu khu/ /bla med byang chub ma thob gu khu/ /'di med phyi med byed tsho gu khu/ /cang med ras pa khyod red gu khu/ /zhes bshad tshe/ ngas 'di skad smras/a a byang chub sems dpa'/ /a'o gar yod mi shes/ /a rog tshig 'di kun la/ /a kha bshad pa min nam/ /a go bya rgyal khu byug /ces bshad pa'i tshe/ yang 'di skad zer/gu khu gu khu/ kun mkhyen sangs rgyas ma gtogs gu khu/ /229

kun gyi skyon yon mi shes gu khu/ /kun la bshad pa min no gu khu/ /kun spangs tshogs drug rang grol gu khu/ /zhes zer/ yang bdag gis 'di skad smras/kha dog sngo zhing mdzes pa/ /kha bde khu byug sngon mo/ /kha rog sdod pa bdag la/ /kha ta tshig gsum smros shig /ces bshad pa'i tshe 'di skad zer/gu khu gu khu/ nam yang mi khyod nga bzhin gu khu/ /nam zhig pha rol 'gro'o gu khu/ /nam 'gro cha yang mi 'dug gu khu/ /nam yang tshe 'dir ma chags gu khu/ /tshig ka gang nas bshad kyang gu khu/ /tshig rtsub ngag 'khyal 'khyogs gtam gu khu/ /tshig ngan nam yang ma smra gu khu/ /tshig 'jam nga bzhin smros shig gu khu/ /dben par 'ongs pa'i don go gu khu/ /nyal bar ma dga' nyams len gu khu/ /legs par mdzod dang bde nas gu khu/ /bde bar nga bzhin 'gro'o gu khu/ /de de nam yang ma brjed gu khu/ /yang yang e thug mi shes gu khu/ /grogs grogs 'tshams por bde mor gu khu/ /da da nga ni 'gro'o gu khu/ /zhes 'phur bar rtsom pa'i tshe/ yang bdag gis 'di skad smras/nga nga ma shi lus na/ /khyod khyod sang phod da tshod/ /myur myur sa 'dir shog la/ /lhang lhang skad snyan sgogs shig /da 230

da nged gnyis 'bral ba/ /dung dung snying gi dkyil nas/ /la la 'bral mi phod kyang / /'o 'o 'khor ba'i mtshan nyid/ /yang yang 'phrad par smon no/ /da da grogs khyod bde mor/ /zhes smras pa'i tshe/ 'di skad zer/gu khu gu khu/ grogs khyod ngar ltos ngar ltos gu khu/ /nam zhig khyod kyi tshogs gnyis gu khu/ /'dab ma legs po brgyangs nas gu khu/ /rnam mkhyen 'chi med lam la gu khu/ /ngar ltos nga bzhin 'phur zhig gu khu/ /legs bshad chos kyi dbyings snyan gu khu/ /ngar nyon nga bzhin sgogs shig gu khu/ /zhes mkha' la 'phur te 'ga' grag ste/ de nas bdag la zhe chags pa'i tshul gyes phyi mig mang po lta bzhin 'phur song ngo / /zhes rang gzhan dge la bskul ba'i cha rkyen du smras so/ /de nas ston mjug der smyung gnas pa bstan 'dzin nyi ma rin po che'i mdun du song nas sems la phan pa'i mgur zhig gsung zhes zhu don tshigs su bcad nas glu ru phul ba/e ma snyigs dus sgye mchog rje/ /chos dang mthun pa'i gtan grogs khyod/ /chung nas rab byung tshul khrims gtsang / /mtshan ldan bla ma mang po bsten/ /mdo sngags zab chos mang du gsan/ /spangs dka'i 'jig rten blo yis btang / /spyad 231

dka'i snying rus drag po yis/ /thos bsam tshul bzhin bsgrub la gzhol/ /thugs la 'khrungs pa'i zhal gdams mchog /sba bsre med par bstan du gsol/ /zhes bskul bas/ de'i nyin ngas sngar mgur len ma myong bas de ma thag tu mi 'char bar gda' gsungs/ phyi nyin yang 'di ltar zhus/e ma mtshan ldan snying grogs lags/ /mdo sngags chos kyi rgya mtsho ni/ /yod kyang khyod thugs shel dkar gyi/ /bum bzang nang 'khyil legs bshad kyi/ /bdud rtsi 'thung 'dod grogs po nga'i/ /skom pa'i tsha gdungs bsal du gsol/ /zhes zhus pas/khong gis thugs brtse ba'i sgo nas 'di skad gsungs/e ma blo ldan grogs po lags/ /khyed cis kyang lta ba la bzhed na/ /sprang nga yi go lugs cung zhig brjod/ /phyogs cha che na lta ba min/ /a 'thas che na sgom pa min/ /blang dor che na spyod pa min/ /re dogs che na 'bras bu min/ /'o na ci 'dra zer tsa na/ /lta ba rig stong rtsa bral yin/ /sgom pa stong gsal 'dzin med yin/ / spyod pa shar grol bya lam yin/ /'bras bu 'khor 'das sems rdzogs yin/ /de thugs la 'thad dam snying grogs lags/ /zhes gsungs de'i lan du bdag gis 'di phul/ang gi skye mchog rin po che/ /'o na rgyal ba'i gdung 'dzin 232

khyod/ /bde stong thugs kyi shel bum las/ /thon pa'i legs bshad bdud rtsi'i chus/ /bdag sems yid bzhin nor bu yi/ /ma rig nyon mongs dri ma rnams/ /bkrus nas don gnyis lhun grub kyi/ /dgos 'dod ma lus 'byung ngam snyam/ /zhes phul/ gzhan yang chos mthun gyi gtam mang po gleng bas thugs yid gcig tu 'dres/ sku mdun nas bka' gdams pha chos bu chos dang / rje rin po che'i gsung gi gsang 'dus rim lnga gdan rdzogs/ rim lnga gsal sgon/ yig chung nyer gcigapaṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan dang / lcang skya rin po che'i gsung gi sgyung gnas cho ga'i lung bcas thob pa'i bka' drin can gyi bla mar gyur to/ /de'i lo rje btsun bstan 'dzin nyi ma rin po che'i nye gnas blo bzang don grub kyis skabs skabs su ra ma'i 'o ma re dang / zho re tsam byin/ dbyar sngo 'dra yang zos /ston mjug 'tsho chas zad pas/ zla ba gnyis tsam la rtsam thang 'thung dgos byung / de dus dka' spyad dang snying rus yang dga' mo byas/ deng sang bsam na skal ba bzang po red snyam pa byung / de nas mtsho la dar chags nas phyi rol tu thon/ sog po bā ge tshang gi nang la song / de dus chos rgyal yab yum sras bcas sku khams dwangs pa'i ngos nas 'tshams rtags la dngul 233

srang bdun dang ja nag gcig zhal gsung gi yi ge rnams bskur yod pa lag tu 'byor ba'i dngos mjal ltar spro/ dngul srang bdun po nya bda' rnams la byen nas nya stong dang lnga brgya'i srog blu byas/ lo de'i dbyar thog bka' drin 'khor med rgyal mkhan chen rin po che a rig gi ru nang du phebs nas/nga'i rgyu mtshan rnams gsungs/ bsngags brjod mang po gnang /khong las can red ces nga'i phyogs su phyag mdzad/ a rig gi mchog dman bar gsum kun la mthun rkyen sgrubs zhes zhal gsung byon 'tshams rtags su/ ja nag gcig mar thud phying dkar dang yi ge 'di yang bzhag par gda'/rab 'byams rgyal kun spyi gzugs pad 'byung rje'i/ /rab mang 'gro la brtse chen gzigs pa yis/ /rab sprul gar bsgyur chos rgyal ngag gi dbang / /rab tu dad pas rigs kyi bdag po bsten/ /ma hā dre war yongs grags dben pa'i rir/ /ma rmad gzhan phan byang chub sems bzang gis/ /mar gyur 'gro ba sgol ba'i khur 'khyer zhing / /ma rig mun sel bshes gnyen gang de la/ /ma rungs bdag 'dzin rje bo'i bran gyur te/ /ma rig 'khrul pa'i sbubs su brten bcas nas/ /ma dag 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i btsun gzugs ngas/ /ma la bu bzhin dung 234

bas 'di skad zhu/ /e ma ring nas goms pa'i lam bzang de/ /de bzhin nyid du thogs med mngon gyur zhing / zhing mchog bla ma du ma'i rjes bzung bas/ /bas mthar tshe dang sgrub pa snyoms pa'i khur/ /khur du ma song rgyan du bzhes pa'i tshul/ /tshul ldan dam pa'i rnam thar 'di rang la/ /la lung phyogs med 'gro rigs mchog dman kun/ /kun kyang dad gus ngo mtshar phyogs brgyar bzhad/ /ma rgan sring mo mched grogs sngags 'chang sogs/ /nged dang seng bzang bcas pa bde ngos nas/ /kha tsam min par nyams len gnad smin la/ /gzhol bzhin khyod drung mngon du phyogs nas yod/ /slar yang gsol 'debs zhu ba'i snying po ni/ /dam pa ma lus mgrin gcig bsngags pa'i lam/ /skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi rim pa la/ /'khrul med nges pa rnyed phyir da dung yang / /nan tan rim bzhin rtogs pa mngon gyur thog /zhi bar mi gnas phyogs med snying rje dang / /gzhan phan byang chub sems mchog gis drangs te/ /srid par mi gnas bdag 'dzin gcod byed lam/ /kun las khyad 'phags zab lam rdzogs pa che'i/ /khregs chod gnas lugs don las mi g.yo bar/ /thod rgal lam gyi grol rtags mthar mdzad nas/ /chos nyid zad sar myur du phebs pa dang / /sor 235

mor rig pa gtad pa'i sgyu lus 'dir/ /'gro drug srid las sgrol ba'i grub pa'i rtags/ /mngon sum rjes 'jug gdul byar nyams len du/ /myur ba myur bar dgongs shig bya btang pa/ /bdag can ltos bcas spro bas gar bsgyur phyir/ /sa lam gar phyin nyams mgur bzang po dang / /nyams len byed rgyur zhal gdams gang rgyas shig /ral pa'i rgyan bzhin spyi bor stsol ba mkhyen/ /phran kyang 'di snang bya ba myur bral nas/ /dben par khyod kyi rjes su 'brang nus shing / /sgrub brgyud bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa la/ /dam pa khyod dang mtshungs par byen gyis rlobs/ /de 'dra'i skal bzang tshe 'dir med srid tshe/ /bar do shar tshe thugs rjes nyer drangs te/ /las dang nyon mongs dkor gyes mi bsgrib par/ /yang srid phyi mar lam mchog mngon gyur mdzod/ /mthun rkyen ja bubs mar gdar thud ril dang / /phying dkar bcas phul a rig mchog dman kyang / /ci lbogs 'bul chad byas yod dgyes bzhes ngos/ /nyams len yar ngo'i zla ltar gong 'phel mkhyen/ /lha rdzas rab dkar rten ldan zhu 'phrin zhig /brtse sems rab dkar smon 'brel dar brkyangs nas/ /mtsho chen dar dkar na bza' gsol ba'i dus/ /zla tshes rab dkar zhig la khyod drung bsnyegs/ /zhes 236

gsungs snang bas/ dngos mjal lta bu'i dga' spro tshad las 'das pa yang yang byung / de dus a rig gi mchog dman so so'i gdan 'dren pa 'ongs nas/ snga mo nged tshos khyed sbas pa'i rnal 'byor pa chen po zhig yin pa ngo ma shes/ lo snga mar rgyal mkhan chen rin po che'i zhal nas khyed kyi gnas tshul zhib tu go bas sngar ma dad pa cung zad byas pa rnams shin tu gnong / da ni ci nas kyang phebs dgos zer ba ltar a rig gi ru sder song / phyogs de'i bla dpon mchog dman skya ser pho mo rgan rgon byis pa thams cad mjal du 'ong ba la/ thun mong gi chos bshad ma ṇi dang dmigs brtse ma sgol ma sogs kyi lung byas/ mgur dbyangs blangs nas thams cad kyi snang ba chos la bsgyur bas/ sdig pa spong ba dang / dge ba sgrub mkhan mang du byung / khyad par lo re bzhin ru sde so so'i nang du ma ṇi dung phyur 'don pa'i khas len byas/ de bzhin du bsgrubs pas phyis bshad na ma ṇi dung phyur brgya song skad/ gzhan rta nor gser dngul longs spyod gang phul ba rnams la bsngo smon gyis mtshams sbyor byas nas ma blangs par phyir byin/ ja mar rtsam pa chu ra rnams blangs pas 'tsho chas mang po 'dus/ de dus sngar lo bla rgan go re chag pos nga'i brang la rgyag mkhan de yang 237

'gyod de/ mar dang chu ra byin nas sngar ma dad pa byas pa la mthol bshags byas/ gzhan bud med 'ga' re'i khyem du ma bsnyen pa dang / ci yang ma byen pa rnams kyis khyem du bos nas/ ja mar chu ra sogs byen nas sngar 'dod yon gyi nga rgyal dang dregs pas myos te/ ma shes pa'i dbang gis brnyas pa mthol lo bshags/ khyed kyi thugs la ma gnod bzod par bzhes/ phyin chad thugs dam skyabs 'og nas ma 'dor/ sku tshe brtan rgyu tshang / sang phod kyang phyogs 'dir re re phebs dang bsnyen bkur phun sum tshogs pa byed zer/ ngas kyang yong zhes smon lam bkra shis brjod pas thams cad sems dga' bar gyur to/ /de nas mkhas pa'i dbang po nags tshang sprul sku rin po cher mjal du song / sku drung nas/ rje btsun tre+e lo/nā ro/ mar pa/ ras chung ba rnams kyi rnam thar/ spyan snga ba'i gsung gi blo sbyong zhen 'khris kun gcod sogs blo sbyong kha shas kyi lung rnams zhus shing bgro gleng byas pas thugs mnyes te/ gsol ras kyang mang po gnang nas tshur 'ong ba'e lam nas mi gzhon zhig gis/ khyed la rta zhig yod na bzang zer ba'i lan drang por bshad nas/ rtse mtshar du nga la rta yod ces mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so//238

chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs la 'dud/ /kun gyis spyod yul ma yin cing / /skye 'chi bral ba'i rta zhig yod/ /skye med khyab gdal chos dbyings kyi/ /mo gsham bu yi rta pho la/ /bsgom med ma bcos rang bab kyi/ /ri bong rwa yi sga zhig bstad/ /blang dor rtsol sgrub kun bral ba'i/ /rus sbal spu yi srab kyis bcings/ /mnyam pa nyid kyi thang thog tu/ /'gro 'ong med pa'i rta rgyug byas/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi bya bral rta/ /'gro 'ong med par sus brgyugs pa/ /sangs rgyas sa la slebs par nges/ /zhes blangs/ de nas mtsho snying du 'gro khar dpon po bī hu dang / yon bdag zla grags sogs dad can yon bdag pho mo rnams la bde zhus mgur 'di blangs so//khyod brag stod shin tu sra dang gcig /nga rgod po skyid nyal byas dang gnyis/ /dus gnas skabs phan tshun 'brel ba bzang / /da brag stod sku khams bde bar bzhugs/ /bya rgod po mi sdod 'gro rgyu yin/ /nga 'gro ba dgung sngon mkha' la 'gro /zhal yang dang yang du mjal bar smon/ /yid smon pa bzhin du 'grub par shog /khyed spang gshongs rab tu bde dang gcig /nga sha ba bde bar nyal dang gnyis/ /dus gnas skabs phan tshun 'brel ba bzang / /da spang gshongs sku khams 239

bde bar bzhugs/ /sha smug po mi sdod 'gro rgyu yin/ /nga 'gro ba rtswa chu bzang sar 'gro /zhal yang dang yang du mjal bar smon/ /yid smon pa bzhin du 'grub par shog /khyed ljon shing yal ga mnyen dang gcig /nga khu byug steng nas grag dang gnyis/ /dus gnas skabs phan tshun 'brel ba bzang da ljon shing sku khams bde bar bzhugs/ /bya khu byug mi sdod 'gro rgyu yin/ /nga 'gro ba yul phyogs gzhan du 'gro /zhal yang dang yang du mjal bar smon/ /yid smon pa bzhin du 'grub par shog /khyed yon bdag dad pa bzang dang gcig /ngas dam chos legs par bshad dang gnyis/ /dus gnas skabs phan tshun 'brel ba bzang / /da khyed rnams sku khams bde bar bzhugs/ /nga rnal 'byor mi sdod 'gro rgyu yin/ /nga 'gro ba mtsho snying ri la 'gro /zhal yang dang yang du mjal bar smon/ /yid smon pa bzhin du 'grub par shog /khyed 'dir 'tshogs skal ldan pho mo rnams/ /las mi dge spongs la dge ba sgrubs/ /khyed dad ldan yon bdag zla grags sogs/ /'dir 'tshogs pa'i skal ldan pho mo la/ /ngas phan pa'i snying gtam byas pa yin/ /dge 'dis kyang kun la phan par shog /ces blangs/ de nas mtsho mjug tu 'ongs pas skyel mi rnams na re/240

mtsho dar gyi steng na kha ba med pas nangs par khal ma rnams mi thar zer bas/ ngas bla ma dkon mchog la gsol ba btab/bsang phul nas a ma khri gshog rgyal mo sogs la 'phrin bcol byas pas/ dgong mo kha ba chen po babs pas nangs par kun gyes dga' bzhin rta sogs la zhon nas bde bar mtsho snying du slebs nas kun gyis gnas la skor ba byas te rang yul du song ngo / /nga a rig gi ru nang du bsod snyoms la song ba'i shul na/ gzhan gang yang med par/ rtswa'i mal stan dang / sngo zos pa'i 'phro skam nas yod pa rnams mthong bas/ gnas mjal ba rnams dad pa skyes/ kha shas kyis nga la phul zhes mar dang rtsam pa re bzhag 'dug de dus pha yul reb gong na bzhugs pa'i bu chen pad+ma rang grol gyis/ 'tshams rtags su ja khug ma gang / ske rags gcig kha btags yi ge bcas stobs tshang ban+de dge 'dun 'byung gnas bde zhus byed du btang ba nga'i rmi lam du byung bas nye 'khor ba rnams la nga'i pha yul nas sang mi zhig 'ong bar 'dug smras pas/ de bzhin du 'byor ba la kun dad gus skyes pa byung / de la yul phyogs kyi skad cha rnams dris pas/ bla ma mched grogs ma dang sring mo sogs gzhan thams cad bde mo yin/ a khu rdo rje tshe brtan 241

gshegs song zer/ shi ba'i rus pa byen pas/ chung dus kyi snying grogs gcig po de gshegs pa la 'gyod pa chen po skyes/de'i don du tshogs bsags sgrib sbyong dang thugs yid bsres nas mnyam par 'jog par sogs byas/ rus pa la tshwa tshwa btab dag pa'i zhing du skye ba'i smon lam btab pas 'khor ba las grol ba'i rmi ltas bzang po byung / bu chen pad+ma rang grol gyis bdag la snga sor gsungs pa'i legs bshad rnams skur zhes yi ge'i nang gsal ltar/ spyir rang dang skal ldan gyi slob ma dad ldan gyi sbyin bdag pho mo mang po la phan pa'i mgur dbyangs mang po dang / khyad par du lta mgur mkha' lding gshog rlabs/ thod rgal gyi mgur ma le'u tshan gnyis/ zhal bkod kyi yi ge rgyas pa dang bcas bang chen stobs tshang ban+de la bskur bas/ thams cad ma nyams par 'byor ba la dngos mjal ltar dga' dad dpag med thob skad/ chos rgyal yab yum dang / rgyal mkhan chen gsum la yang / tshig lhug dang tshigs bcad gnyis kyi sgo nas zhu shog rgyas par phul ba 'byor bas thugs dgyes par gyur to/ /yang de'i lo rtsa ba'i bla ma bstan 'dzin nyi ma rin po che dpon slob gnyis la 'tsho chas bzang po gang dgos phul/ gzhan gnas der bzhugs pa'i a 242

rig gi rgyud pa sku skyes/ bstan pa phan bde/ dge slong bstan dar/ 'jigs med r+pā la'i rab 'byams pa/ zhabs drung bla rgan/ su ne'i a lags rnams la/ dbang khrid 'tsho chas gang dgos byen nas brag phug so so ru mtshams la bzhugs/ ngas kyang de'i lo bug sgor 'dag sbyar byas/ ngag mtshams bsdams nas sngar rgyun ltar nyams len la gzhol ba'i dus su/ gsum pa'i tshes pa bcu yi mtshan mo rmi lam du/ dpon tshang nas btang ba yin zer ba'i rta sngon po la zhon pa'i mi nag 'jigs rngams can zhig gis/ khyod kyi 'di phyi'i gtan gyi skyabs gcig chos rgyal ngag gi dbang po yul khams thag ring zhig la phebs kyin yod pas/ khyod myur du mjal ba la 'gro zer/ nga yang kho rang gi rta'i 'phongs su zhon nas song ba'i skad cig yud tsam la urge ru slebs pa'i tshe/ chos rgyal rin po che rta sngon po rin chen rgyan cha du mas mdzes pa zhig la chibs/'khor mi bzang sre dod dang / skyes pho mo gzhon nu lang tsho dar la bab pa mang pos gdugs rgyal mtshan ba dan du ma sgreng bzhin/ lho nub phyogs su ri mthon po zhig yod pa'i rtsar slebs tshe/ ngas kyang phebs rjes zin nas mjal ba'i tshe/chos rgyal rin po che'i zhal dgyes 'dzum gyi nyams dang bcas 243

te/ khyod la mgon pos brda' byas pa bzang / nga da lo khyod la sngar bshad pa bzhin/ dag pa mkha' spyod du 'gro ba yin te/khyod sems sdug mi dgos/ nga yang gdul bya'i don du slar myur du slebs 'ongs zhes 'di skad gsungs/'dzin med stong gsal nam mkha' khyod sdod dang / /gzi brjid rab 'bar phyi dro'i nyi ma nga / /mi sdod nub kyi ri rtser nub nas 'gro /slar yang myur du shar ri'i rtse nas 'char/ /thogs med bar snang yangs pa khyod sdod dang / /kha dog lnga ldan 'ja' tshon ri mo nga / /mi sdod bar snang khams la thim nas 'gro /slar yang myur du bar snang khams las 'char/ /rogs med dwangs bsil rgya mtsho khyod sdod dang / /yid 'ong skad snyan sgrog pa'i ngang ba nga / /mi sdod thag ring yul du 'phur nas 'gro /slar yang myur du dpyid kyi dus su 'ong / /'gyur med dad ldan slob ma khyod sdod dang / /gangs can bod du skyes pa'i mi rgan nga / /mi sdod da lo mkha' spyod zhing du 'gro /slar yang myur du sprul pa'i sku zhig 'ong / /zhes gsungs nas/ yar phebs par brtsam tshe/ ngas zhabs la mgo bos gtugs nas/gdungs pa'i smre sngags 'di ltar zhus/sngon dus ston pa shākya thub pa yis/ /lha mi'i 'khor tshogs 244

thams cad gson bskyur byas/ /'og min dag pa'i zhing du gshegs pa bzhin/ /de ring sangs rgyas gnyis pa gang du 'byon/ /skye 'chi mi mnga' pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis/ /bod yul rje 'bangs nyer lnga gson bskyur byas/ /lho nub srin po'i gling du phebs pa bzhin/ /de ring pad 'byung gnyis pas 'jog gam ci/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug mi la ras pa yis ras pa mang po'i 'khor tshogs gson bskyur byas/ /shar phyogs mngon dga'i zhing du gshegs pa bzhin/ /de ring mi la gnyis pas bsgyur phod dam/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs dngos blo bzang grags pa yis/ /skal bzang gdul bya mang po gson bskyur byas/ /dga' ldan dag pa'i zhing du gshegs pa bzhin/ /de ring blo bzang gnyis pas nga ma 'dor/ /zhes ngu ma dbyangs byas nas zhus pa'i tshe/ phyag nga'i mgo thog tu bzhag ste/ da dung khyod 'gro ma ran/ tshe dang sgrub pa snyoms la bstan 'gro'i bde thabs gyes zhes gsungs pa'i mthar ri ngos gyen la yar lam chen dkar po zhig 'then nas yod pa la zhugs te dpon slob 'khor bcas ri rtser slebs pa dang / nam mkha' nas dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa byon nas/ yar nam mkha' la mkha' 'gro ma dkar ser dmar ljang bzhi'i rdzu 245

'phrul gyis rta'i rkang lag bzhi nas btegs te/ je mtho je mthor 'gro ba'i tshe/ skyel mi rnams kyang phyir log ngas sa de nas smre sngags 'di skad ces bton no//sum cu rtsa gsum lha dbang brgya byin gyis/ /khang bzang khri stan la sogs shul du bzhag /bde 'jam lha lam brgyud nas bzhud de thal/ /skyed mos tshal gye lha rnams skyid la ang / /kun la phan pa'i mun sel nyi ma yis/ /lho phyogs 'dzam bu'i gling pa smag tu btang / /nub kyi ri rtse brgyud nas bzhud de thal/ /ba lang spyod kyi mi rnams skyid la ang / /dgos 'dod kun 'byung yid bzhin nor bu yis/ /rgya mtsho chen po'i gling de stong par bzhag /ded dpon bzang po brgyud nas bzhud de thal/ /rgyal mtshan rtser mchod mi rnams skyid la ang / /snyigs dus 'gro mgon chos kyi rgyal po yis/ /skal dman slob ma bdag ni gson bskyur byas/ /rab dkar lam chen brgyud nas bzhud de thal/ /mkha' spyod dag pa'i zhing gi skyid la ang / /zhes mang po ngus pa'i snang ba byung ba'i mthar gnyid las sad tshe sngas mgo yang mig chus cung zad brlan pa byung 'dug der nga'i bsam pa la rmi lam yag po rmi yang mi rmi/rmis na yang thog la 'gro dka'/ 'di 'dra'i rmi lam btsog 246

pa'i thog tsho la 'gro nyen yod snyam de nas bzung sems mi bde 'khyags log ge ba zhig byung / phyis su bshad na chos rgyal rin po che dag zhing du gshegs pa'i dus tshod dang mtshungs pa byung bas bu slob rnams kyang ngo mtshar dad par gyur to/ /de dus dbyar kha lnga ba'i nang la/ byang ngos kyi brag phug na sdod pa'i zhabs drung bla rgan ngag dbang blo bzang phung po ma bde ba thos nas/ yi ge 'di bris nas bskur/kye kye nyon dang chos mthun snying gi bu/ /bu khyod sgyu ma'i lus po mi bde na/ /na 'chi las skyob bsrung ba thub tshad gyes/ /gyis dang ma bde 'dug na nga yang 'ong / /sngon smon las kyis 'brel ba'i gnas 'dir 'tshogs/ /'tshogs nas dam chos tshul bzhin sgrub pa'i tshe/ /tshe srog la gnod nad gdon byung ba'i dus/ /dus min 'chi ba bzlog thabs cis mi bya/ /zhes bskur ba'i nyi ma kha shas song ba'i 'phro la kho shin tu na nas 'chi tshad pa byung tshe/ rje btsun bstan 'dzin nyi ma rin po che dang nged gnyis mtshams grol nas song glud cig btang ste bgegs bskrad pa'i tshe/ phug pa'i nang nas rlung zhig langs nas phyi sgor song ba'i 'tshub ma nag po zhig tu gyur te/mtsho yi kha nas 'khor bzhin phyi rol tu 'gro ba de na yod pa 247

kun gyis mthong / phyi nyin bla rgan drag song bas/ kun gyis gdon zhig yin rgyu red/ khong rnam gnyis kyi thugs rjes 'dre mngon sum du song ba ya mtshan che zer ba byung / yang 'jigs med r+pā la'i rab 'byams pa kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyi snying khams sogs phung po mi bde ba zhig byung ba'i dus su/mtshams nang du yi ge 'di phul byung /bde ma lus stsol ba'i yid bzhin nor/ /bde ldan zhing du 'khrid pa'i lam rgyus mkhan/ /bde gshegs 'dus sku pha yi sgra 'dzin gyis/ /bde bas phongs pa'i bu la brtse bas dgongs/ /bde ba 'dod nas mgon khyod gsung bzhin du/ /bde zhing nyams dga'i ri khrod dben pa bsten/ /bde rgyu'i dam chos sgrub pa'i dus skabs 'dir/ /bde med sdug bsngal mang po byung 'dug pas/ /bde legs kun stsol drin can bla ma las/ /bde rung sdug rung re sa gzhan na med/ /bde gsal thugs nas nam yang nga ma 'dor/ /bde zhing skyid pa'i dga' ston myur du stsol/ /zhes phul ba'i lan du/ /bdag gis 'di skad ces smras/e ma sngon sbyangs bag chags shin tu legs/ /legs pa'i chos la chung nas thos bsam byas/ /byas pa de don nyams 248

su len par 'dod/ /'dod yon ro la cung zad tsam ma chags/ /chags sdang kun bral ri khrod bsten pa'i bu/ /bu khyod snying khams cung zad mi bde yang / /yang dag bsgom bsgrub gyis dang myur du bde/ /bde legs kun stsol dkon mchog gsum po la/ /la lung nyul mkhan bdag kyang gsol 'debs bya/ /bya ba btang nas phyi ma'i don chen du/ /du ma'i ri khrod dben par chos byed dus/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas yi dam mkha' 'gro ma/ /ma yi bu bzhin skyong mdzad chos skyong rnams/ /rnam dag thugs kyi bu la brtse bas gzigs/ /gzigs nas 'gal rkyen bar chad ma lus pa/ /ba mor nyi ma phog bzhin bsal du gsol/ /gsol ba snying nas 'debs pa'i bdag cag kun/ /kun la dbang bsgyur 'chi bdag ma slebs bar/ /bar du gcod pa'i nyer 'tshe kun bral bas/ /bas mthar tshe dang sgrub pa snyoms par shog /ces smras/skyabs 'jug byas kyang nad bab lci ru song tshe mtshams grol nas song / grub rgyal ma'i lugs kyi tshe dbang zhig bskur bas/rmi lam du rgya mi kha shas kyis lug gcig gsod par rtsom pa na/ngas ma gsod ces srog blus pa zhig rmis pas/ de'i mtshan mo nas bzung kho nad las grol/ yang thams cad sngar rgyun ltar 249

mtshams dam po byas/ ngas kyang slar bug sgo 'dag sbyar dang ngag mtshams byas te/ byang chub kyi sems gnyis dang / gsang sngags kyi bskyed rdzogs/ yang gsang rdzogs pa chen po'i khregs chod dang thod rgal gnyis la nyams len gyi mthil du byas nas nyin mtshan med par rtse gcig tu nyams su blangs pas/ zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes brgyad kyi mtshan mo'i srod thun la/ ma gyur 'gro ba yongs la snying rje chen po sgom pa'i tshe/ rang gi bsam pa la/ma gyur 'gro ba'i don du byang chub bsgrubs kyang rang la snying rus med pas sangs rgya ba'i dus mi gda'/pha ma sems can re re'i sdug bsngal la bsam na bzod glags mi 'dug rang la ma sems can gyi sdug bsngal la phan pa'i nus pa med/ da su la yod na/ bod kyi lha skal 'phags pa sbyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la yod snyam/ ma sems can thams cad kyi skyid sdug khyed mkhyen snyam pa'i mos gus gdung shugs drag pos ma ṇi gsol 'debs kyi tshul du bgrangs pas/ phug pa'i nang kun je dwangs je dwangs su song ba'i mthar gnas khang 'od dkar pos khyab pa'i rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar 'ja' 'od kyi klong na 'phags pa thugs rje chen bo kha sar pā ṇi/ sku mdog dkar gsal zhi zhing 'dzum pa'i nyams can/ g.yas mchog 250

sbyin dang g.yon pad+ma dkar po'i sdong bu 'dzin pa dar dang rin bo che'i rgyan can mtshan dpe gzi brjid mchog tu 'bar ba zhig gi zhal nas mgur 'di gsungs so//bod kyi lha skal spyan ras gzigs dbang ngas/ /bod la rtag tu thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /bod yul dbus skyes las 'phro can khyod dang / /bod khams mi rnams kun gyis 'di ltar gyis/ /sngags pa rnams kyis dam tshig mig bzhin srungs/ /khyad par mthu gtad dmar mchod las ma byed/ /btsun pa rnams kyis 'dul khrims tshul bzhin srungs/ /khyad par chang dang bud med bsten pa spongs/ /khyim pa rnams kyis mi dge bcu la 'dzems/ /khyad par srog gcod 'thab rtsod jag ma byed/ /phyug po ser sna ma che sbyin pa thongs/ /chos byed grong yul ma 'grim ri khrod sten/ /pha ma rgas khar ma brnyas mchod bkur gyis/ /phyugs dang sgo khyer ma rdungs byams par mdzod/ /bla ma dkon mchog mchod na dngos grub 'byung / /phyag dang skor bas lus kyi sdig sgrib 'dag /kha ton zlas brjod byas na ngag sgrib 'dag /bsam pa bzang na gang byas chos su 'gro /de ltar mdzod cig bod kyi gdul bya rnams/ /khyad par kun gyes nga la gsol ba thob/ /che chung med par yi 251

ge drug ma thon/ /dad pa can gyi mdun na nga nyid bzhugs/ /sngon chad nga la dad tshad skye bo kun/ /bde ba can gyi zhing du nga yis drangs/ /'di bzhin gyis dang khyed rnams 'chi ba'i tshe/ /bar dor mngon sum byon nas lam sna 'dren/ /bde ba can nam po ta la ru skyel/ /the tshom ma byed nga yi gdul bya rnams/ /zhes gsungs nas mi snang bar gyur to/ /gzhan yang dngos nyams rmi lam du bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha mang po'i zhal mthong ba byung /de nas ston mjug rgyud pa sku skyes rin po che la nged mtshams pa kha shas kyis zhus nas/ rje rin po che'i gsung gi lam rim chen po'i bshad lung zhig gnang / dgun mtsho la dar chags nas mjal ba kha shas 'ongs pa'i kha nas bstan 'dzin nyi ma rin po ches/ bdag gi skyabs mgon bka' drin gsum ldan 'khor lo'i mgon po chos rgyal rin po che zhal mi bzhugs par zhing gzhan du gshegs pa'i gtam gsan pas khong gis kyang thugs 'gyod gnang bzhin nga'i nang du phebs nas cung zad cig bzhugs te/ de nas khong gi zhal nas/ 'o rje btsun mi las/ re 'ga' bla ma'i snang ba 'char/ /bla ma'i snang ba shar tsa na/ /'bral med spyi bor gsal thob la/ /brjed med snying gi dkyil du sgoms/ /lar bla ma yang sgyu mar 252

shes par mdzod/ ces gsungs pa ltar yin tsa na/ khyed thugs 'gyod chen po ma gnang / chos rgyal rin po che zhing brjes song zer ba zhig bdag gis thos gsungs pa dang /bdag yug cig sems la ci yang 'char rgyu med par had de lus song / de nas bla ma yid la wa ler shar ba dang dran drags mig nas mchi ma mang po shor ba'i tshe/ der khong gis nga'i lag pa nas bzung ste/ da mya ngan chen po ma gnang bar/thugs dgongs rdzogs phyir mchod 'bul 'dra gyis la gsol ba thob/ khong gis 'dus byas kyi chos thams cad mi rtag pa 'di'i rang bzhin can yin zhes/ rtag 'dzin can nged rnams chos la bskul ba'i phyir gzugs sku mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshul bstan pa tsam las don dam par 'das grong ga la mnga'/ nged rnams kyis mi rtag 'chi ba ston pa'i slob dpon du go nas/ da ni bla ma'i zhabs tog pha ma'i drin gzo/sems can gye 'gro don du dmigs nas dben par sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan btsugs na/ bla ma'i thugs dgongs yang des rdzogs/ phyi mar dag pa mkha' spyod du mjal 'ongs pas de khyed kyis mi mkhyen pa ga la yin te/ ngas gsal btab pa yin pas thugs la zhog gsungs nas phebs song / ngas phebs shul 253

nas lhag par bla ma dran nas mang po ngus pas mthar smre sngags dbyangs su 'di ltar blangs/kye ma kye hud drin can rje/ /mtshan thos tsam gyis mos gus skye/ /zhal mthong tsam gyis sgrib pa byang / /gsung thos tsam gyes byin rlabs 'jug /phyag skor byas na tshogs rdzogs pa/ /gdul bya'i don du mi bzhugs par/ /'gro ba'i skyabs mgon gang du gshegs/ /kye hud dbus kyi ri bo 'gyel/ /'dod lha'i rten sa gang la byed/ /rgya mtsho chen po rmang nas bskams/ /nya mo skam la ji ltar tshugs/ /nyi ma nub kyi ri rtser nub/ /dus kyi so nam ji ltar bgyi/ /bco lnga'i zla ba gza' yis bzung / /mtshan 'gros rnams kyis ci zhig bya/ /bya rgyal rgod kyi gshog pa chad/ /sder mos mkha' la ji ltar bgrod/ /ldum ra'i me tog ha lo bskams/ /bung bas sbrang rtsi gang nas 'tshol/ /yid bzhin nor bu 'dam du bying / /dgos 'dod re ba su la slong / /sdug phongs bu yi pha ma grong / /dwa phrug bu yis su la re/ /byang khog stod kyi snying dang bral/ /snying med dran pa su yis gso/ /yan lag dang po'i mgo bo chad/ /mgo med lus pos ji ltar bya/ /dbang po'i dwangs ma mig gnyis ldong / /mig med long khrid su yis byed/ /bla ma mi mngon 254

dbyings su gshegs/ /bdag gi mgon skyabs su la re/ /kye hud khang chen ka ba 'gyel/ /mun pa'i gling gi sgron ske gzims/ /chu bor sgol ba'i gru zam chag /'jigs sar sgol ba'i skyel mas bor/ /'dren mchog chos rgyal mya ngan 'das/ /kye ma kye hud dzi ltar bya/ /snying yang mi dga' phya ma 'phyo/ /lus kyang bye'u phrug bzhin du 'dar/ /dran pa'ang res gsal res mi gsal/ /rang dbang med par mchi ma shor/ /gdungs pa'i sems la tshugs thabs med/ /'khor 'das gzigs pa'i mkhyen rgya can/ /mi mngon dbyings nas bdag la gzigs/ /zhal ston sems gso mdzad du gsol/ /dngos su mjal ba'i skal med kyang / /nyams sam gnyid kyi rmi lam du/ /zhal ston zhal gdams tshig gcig gsungs/ /skye ba 'di yi 'og rol tu/ /mgon khyod bzhugs pa'i zhabs drung du/ /sras kyi thu bor bdag gyur nas/ /mdzes pa'i spyod lam sna tshogs kyis/ /mnyes pa'i zhabs tog legs bsgrubs te/ /rtag tu 'bral med bsten par shog /ces ngu ma dbyangs byas nas blangs/de'i nyin khog pa'i snying phyir phyung ba lta bu'i sdug bsngal tshad las 'das pa byung / de nas dngos 'byor yid sprul gyi mchod tshogs rgya chen po bshams/ lhag pa'i lha rta phag yid bzhin 255

nor bu'i dkyil 'khor zhal phyes nas/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i drung nas bdag 'jug blangs/thugs rje bskul ba'i gsol 'debs sprul sku myur 'byon dang /thugs dgongs rdzogs pa'i smon lam nyin re bzhin yang yang btab/ nyin cig mtsho snying gi dbu rtser song nas bla ma'i gdan sa'i phyogs su kha bltas te gdung ba'i smre sngags 'di ltar blangs/lhag bsam rtsa ba rab tu brtan/ /gzhan phan bsil grib phyogs bcur brgyangs/ /yon tan 'bras bu rab rgyas pa'i/ /'dren mchog 'od gsal nyi ma nub/ /kye hud gdul bya pad+ma nga'i/ /gnyen de glo bur gang du thal/ /bslab gsum 'dzin ma'i khyon yangs su/ /snying rje'i chu rgyun 'chad med 'bab/ /spyod bzang me tog gis mdzes pa'i/ /rje btsun nyams dga'i dzing bu bskams/ /kye hud gdul bya ngang ba nga / /chu med skam la ji ltar tshugs/ /thos bsam sgom pa'i lus stobs rgyas/ /nyams myong bde ba'i spang la nyal/ /gdams ngag 'o ma rab ster ba'i/ /bla ma 'dod 'jo'i ba mo gshegs/ /kyi hud gdul bya be'u nga'i/ /gdams ngag 'o ma'i 'thung 'phro chad/ /ces pa la sogs pa'i bla ma dran pa'i smre sngags du ma blangs nas 256

mang po ngus pa'i tshe/ rang gi mdun ngos lho phyogs kyi nam mkha'i khams la glo bur du sprin dkar po gsar ba zhig 'o ma 'phyur ba bzhin langs pa'i yar sne na/ seng ge dkar mo rin po che'i rgyan du mas spras pa zhig gi steng na/ rtsa ba'i bla ma de nyid sku sngar bas gzi mdangs rgyas shing / dar sna tshogs kyi na bza'/ rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa zhig gi zhal nas 'di skad gsungs/nga ni chos sku'i dbyings las ma g.yos bzhin/ /nga yi gzugs sku'i bkod pa cir yang ston/ /nga la gdungs pa'i dbyangs kyis gsol 'debs mkhan/ /nga yi bu mchog tshogs drug rang grol nyon/ /bu bu mi lus rnyed dka' 'jig par sla/ /nges nges nga bzhin 'gyur ba'i tshul soms la yang yang sngon chad bdag gis ji skad bshad/ /de de bzhin du gyis dang ci bsam 'grub/ /ces gsungs nas mi snang bar gyur pa'i nyams shig shar bas/ bdag gi mya ngan cung zad cig sangs pa byung / yang rje btsun bstan 'dzin nyi ma rin po ches mdo sngags spyi dang khyad par gsang sngags bskyed rdzogs gnyis nyams bzhes kyi gtso bor mdzad pa la rjes su yi rang skyes nas glu 'di blangs so//257

rang gzhan gnyis kyi don du thugs bskyed nas/ /bsam sbyor gnyis kyis mtshan ldan bla ma bsten/ /bskyed rdzogs gnyis kyi dbang dang gdams ngag thob/ /rim pa gnyis la bag chags bzhag pa la/ /dad gus gnyis kyis bdag yid rab g.yos nas/ /lag pa gnyis kyi sor bcu spyi bor 'khyer/ /mdo sngags gnyis la bag chags 'jog pa la/ /sangs rgyas gnyis pa khyed rang lta bur mkhyen/ /zhes phul bas thugs shin tu mnyes pa byung / lo gnyis kyi bar du pha bu gnyis lhan du bsdad nas/ lo rjes ma der zla ba dang po'i tshes bzang por mtsho snying nas/ rgya nag ri bo rtse lngar gnas 'brel 'jog tu phebs par nye ba'i tshe/ phrug gzan rdor dril sman rtsi yug bcas phebs rdzongs su phul nas 'di ltar zhus/lho 'dzam bu gling gi rgyan gcig pu/ /steng nyi ma sku khams bde bar bzhud/ /gling gzhan gsum bskor nas ring min du/ /zhal myur du mjal ba'i smon lam thobs/ /shar chu bo gaṅgā'i rgyan gcig pu/ /nya gser mig sku khams bde bar bzhud/ /phyi'i rgya mtsho bskor nas ring min du/ /zhal myur du mjal ba'i smon lam thobs/ /shing 'dab rgyas yal ga'i rgyan gcig po/ /bya khu byug sku khams bde bar bzhud/ /yul thag 258

ring bskor nas ring min du/ /zhal myur du mjal ba'i smon lam thobs/ /bu bdag gi spyi gtsug rgyan gcig po/ /pha bla ma sku khams bde bar bzhud/ /yul thag ring bskor nas ring min du/ /zhal myur du mjal ba'i smon lam thobs/ /zhes phul bas de'i lan du khong gis bdag la gsol ras dang zhal ta mang po gnang nas phebs khar kha btags 'jam thag ring po zhig bstsal nas 'di skad gsungs so//'dzam gling sku khams bde mo ru sdod dang / /nyi ma gling bzhi bskor ba la chas 'gro /da lta yud tsam so so ru bral yang / /myur du 'dzam gling nyi ma gnyis 'phrad yong / /gaṅgā sku khams bde mo ru sdod dang / /gser nya rgya mtsho 'grim pa la chas 'gro /da lta yud tsam so so ru bral yang / /myur du gaṅgā gser nya gnyis 'phrad yong / /ljon shing sku khams bde mo ru sdod dang / /khu byug yul phyogs thag ring la chas 'gro /da lta yud tsam so so ru bral yang / /myur du ljon shing khu byug gnyis 'phrad yong / /bu khyod sku khams bde mo ru sdod dang / /pha rgan ri bo rtse lnga la chas 'gro /da lta yud tsam so so ru bral yang / /myur du rnal 'byor dpon slob gnyis 'phrad yong / /zhes gsungs shing / der 'tshogs pa'i yon bdag pho mo sngar yun 259

ring 'dris pa rnams la chos dang mthun pa'i bslab bya mang po gnang bas/ thams cad kyis khong thag ring la phebs pa la sems 'phreng nas/ mchi ma gtong mkhan mang po byung / khong rin po che mtsho'i dar dkar gyi lha lam brgyud nas phebs/ nyi ma kha shas kyi 'phro nas slob bu thub bstan rgya mtsho dang / lha rams pa gnyis kyang khong dang lhan du ri bo rtse lngar 'gro ba yin zhes song ba'i shul du nyi ma re gnyis sems kyang skyo ba zhig byung / de dus gnas chen de na 'dug pa'i dad can zhabs drung bla rgan na re/ khyed kyis lo 'di snyed cig la sgom brgyab pas mngon shes shig shar los yod/ da nga sang gnangs tsam la lo rjes ma'i bro kha 'tshol du 'gro ba yin pas song na lag tu cang e 'byor/ bgegs bar chad 'dra med dam lung bstan gsal po zhig cis kyang gnang dgos zer ba la/ ngas kho la ci 'dra yong mnyam par bzhag pas/ khos bro kha mang po rnyed cing /khong tshang dang khyim mtshes kyi g.yag gnyis la bkal nas dar thog tu 'ong bas/ mtsho snying mig gis mthong ba'i mtshams shig nas dar la ser kha gas nas g.yag gnyis mi thar bar 'ong / de dus a rig gi yon bdag rta pa gnyis nga la mjal du 'ongs pas/ de la rta g.yar nas blangs chog pa'i nyams 260

shig me long la gzugs brnyan shar ba bzhin du smras pas/phyis de ji lta ba bzhin byung bas/ kho rab tu dad de lung bstan rgyag na de byas rgyob/ skyabs su mchi zer ba byung / de 'dra kha shas bshad pas khong gis ma gsungs pa ma gtogs mngon shes thogs med red zer mkhan kyang byung / de dus a rig gi slob bu bstan pa phan bde slob gnyer byed du dbus su 'gro ba la phan pa'i bslab bya mang po byas 'gro khar rdzongs su mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so//bla ma rgyal ba sras bcas rnams/ /mos pa'i bu la byen gyis rlobs/ /bu khyod dbus su 'gro ba'i tshe/ /bla ma spyi bor bsgoms la song / /ngas bshad sems kyis ma brjed song / /'phags pa'i nor bdun khyer la song / /lam skabs sems chung gyis la song / /bu khyod dbus su slebs pa'i tshe /mtshan ldan dge ba'i bshes gnyen mchog /bsam dang sbyor bas tshul bzhin sten/ /bsten nas thos bsam byed pa'i tshe/ /nyin par rnam g.yeng mtshan mo gnyid/ /gnyis kyi dbang du ma song bar/ /brtson 'grus gyis shig sems kyi bu/ /thos bsam legs po zhig byas nas/ /gnas su gong ma'i sgrub phug zungs/ /grogs su bya dang ri dwags 'grogs/ /'tsho ba bsod 261

snyoms dag la gyes/ /yengs pa med par rtse gcig sgoms/ /sgom yun ma thung tshe dang snyoms/ /sgyu ma'i lus po ri la zhog /ngas kyang mi brjed sems la 'dzin/ /khyod kyang nga la gsol ba thobs/ /da dung nged gnyis yang yang du/ /'phrad pa'i sgon lam ngas kyang 'debs/ /khyod kyang smon lam thobs la song / /dus 'di nas bzung byang chub bar/ /pha dang bu gnyis 'phrad 'dod dus/ /gang na gnas kyang ma bu bzhin/ /phan tshun myur du 'phrad par shog /ces blangs pas/ lan du khos kyang skyabs 'jug zhu rten mar thud kha btags bcas bde zhus su 'di phul byung / snying sdug bu la ma bzhin du/ /byams brtse'i mnga' bdag drin can rje/ /bu nga dbus su 'gro ba la/ /rdo rje sku yi byen gyis rlobs/ /tshangs dbyangs gsung gi byin gyes rlobs/ /'khrul med thugs kyi byen gyis rlobs/ /byang chub go 'phang ma thob bar/ /mgon khyod thugs kyis nga ma 'dor/ /tshe 'di'i ci 'dod re ba kun/ /skong ba'i nor bu bde bar bzhugs/ /chos kyi 'gal rkyen bar chad dgra/ /pham mdzad dpa' bo bde bar bzhugs/ /grogs med bar do'i 'phrang 'grim tshe/ /mdza' ba'i gnyen bshes bde bar bzhugs/ /phyi mar thar 262

pa'i grong khyer du/ /'khrid pa'i sa mkhan bde bar bzhugs/ /mdor na 'di phyi bar do yi/ /re sa'i skyabs mgon bde bar bzhugs/ /skye ba 'di dang skye ba gzhan/ /bla med byang chub ma thob bar/ /sku drin 'khor med pha khyod la/ /bu nga yang yang 'phrad ba ra shog /ces skyabs 'jug zhus/ phyag dang skor ba byas nas dbus su song ste lo mang por mtshan nyid la sbyangs pas rjes su nga song dus dge bshes bzang po zhig byung 'dug pa nga dang mjal nas zhabs tog yag po phul byung / de'i lo mkhan chen dge ba'i bshes gnyen byams pa dge legs rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i thugs sras lung rtogs yon tan du mas thugs rgyud yongs su gtams pa'i snyigs dus 'gro mgon mtshungs med byams pa zla 'od rin po che mtsho snying du phebs pa'i drung nas/ lam rim 'jam dpal zhal lung gi lung gnang ba'i mjug tu/ ku re byas nas khyed mgur len pa la thogs pa mi 'dug zer/ de ring e thogs shig blta dgos/ mgur dbyangs tshig 'ga' da lta rang longs dang gsungs pa'i lan du/rje mtshan ldan bla ma rin po che/ /thugs brtse ba chen pos bdag la dgongs/ /nga glu la thogs pa med pa rdzun/ /sngar glu dbyangs mang po blangs pa bden/ /da glu ba tshogs drug rang 263

grol ngas/ /mgon khyod la gtang rag glu zhig 'bul/ /gnas mtsho snying dben pa'i dga' tshal du/ /khyed da lo byon 'di skal ba bzang / /chos snying po 'jam dpal zhal lung 'di/ /dus da re gnang ba bka' drin che/ /rang gang nus bsgrub pa'i mchod pa 'bul/ /sems chos dang 'dres par byen gyis rlobs/ /dus da dung mgon khyod zhabs bsten nas/ /chos zab rgyas gdams pa nyan par smon/ /glu 'di nyid khyed la phul ba'i mthus/ /rje bla ma shin tu mnyes par shog /ces phul bas/ shin tu legs zhes thugs dgyes par gyur/ yang khyed kyi cha lugs 'di la bltas na ban bon gang yin mi shes par gda'/ gang yin zhes ku re mdzad pa'i tshe/ de'i lan du 'di skad zhus/ri rab rtse yi khyung chen gyi/ /lus kyi dbyibs ni mi dang 'dra/ /gshog sgro rgyas pas bya dang 'dra/ /mi min bya min mkha' lding yin/ /bar snang khams kyi g.yu 'brug de/ /lus kyi dbyibs ni sbrul dang 'dra/ /mkha' la 'gro bas bya dang 'dra/ /sbrul min bya min g.yu 'brug yin/ /mi med ri yi rnal 'byor nga / /lus kyi cha lugs ban dang 'dra/ /ral ba bzhag pas bon dang 'dra/ /ban min bon min rnying ma yin/ /zhes 264

zhus pas/ khyed kyis sngar mgur dbyangs blangs pa rnams nga la cig ston dang lan cig blta gsungs pas lan du 'di skad ces zhus/mkhas shing grub pa mchog brnyes pa'i/ /mtshan ldan bla ma rin po che/ /bya btang tshogs drug rang grol ngas/ /glu dbyangs mang po blangs pa rnams/ /mdo rgyud gzhung la ma sbyangs pas/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis gzigs nyan med/ /'on kyang blta rgya can rnams kyis/ /bltas kyang gzhung dang mi 'gal snyam/ /rang la nyams myong cang med pas/ /rtogs ldan rnams kyis gzigs nyan med/ /'on kyang nyams mgur blangs rnams la/ /gzigs kyang thugs kyis mi khrel snyam/ /snyan dngags sdeb sbyor ma bslabs pas/ /tshig sbyor ma dag ma tshang yang / /'on kyang blun po bdag 'dra'i rigs/ /'ga' re'i sems la e phan snyam/ /de lta nyams su len pa la/ /grub thob zer ba ma byung kyang / /'on kyang skye ba bzang po brgyud/ /byang chub go 'phang 'thob bam snyam/ /de phyir lus ngag ngal ba dang / /shog gu snag tsha 'dzad pa la/ /ma bltas bsam pa thag pas bris/ /gzigs nas bka' bkyon mi gnang zhu/ /zhes zhus nas mgur phal che ba zhig phul ba la zhib tu gzigs nas 265

shin tu legs gsungs/ ngas khyed kyis sngar mgur 'dra e gsungs zhus pas/ ngas slob ma zhig la 'di 'dra zhig bshad ces mgur 'di gsungs so//kwa ye gson dang rnam dpyod ldan pa khyod/ /kha tsam ma yin snying nas bskul bas na/ /ga le zhal gsung lta bur chos kyi gtam/ /nga yis shes tshod tsam zhig bshad par bya/ /ca co'i gtam dang zang zing 'du 'god kyi/ /cha shas tsam yang phyi mar phan dka' bas/ /ja sogs sred zhen dor nas chog shes gyis/ /nya mo mtshor 'grogs bzhin du chos shig sten/ /ta thā ga ta'i gsung la thos bsam dang / /tha mar phan nges nyams len byed nus na/ /da lta mi lus thob pa don dang ldan/ /na 'chis gtugs tshe dgos pa'i gtso bo lags/ /pa sangs ltar dkar chos kyi rang rgyud dben/ /pha mthar mi mngon las nyon rgya mtshor byeng / /ba sru g.yo 'gul med par chos bshad kyang / /ma rnams lta zhog rang la'ang phan pa dka'/ /tsā ri lta bu'i dpen gnas ri sul du/ /tsha grang khyad bsad sdig spong dge bsgrub dang / /dza lang las nyon lcags kyus yid drangs pas/ /wa sogs 'gro la snying rje tu re mdzod/ /zhwa ser bstan pa'i nyi ma nub rir nye/ /za byed gshin rje nam yong cha med 266

pas/ /'a 'ur ma che nges 'byung sems bskyed gnyis/ /ya bral ma yin zung 'jug bsgom par mdzod/ /ra lug la sogs sems can sna tshogs la/ /la lar chags dang la lar sdang ba sogs/ /sha za'i bsam sbyor bor nas bu gcig bzhin/ /sa gsum 'gro la byams brtse tu re mdzod/ /ha cang sdug bsngal gsum gyis rab mnar ba'i/ /a ma'i thogs drangs ma gyur 'das gson rnams/ /sred zhi sdug bsngal rgya mtsho las sgrol phyir/ /zung 'jug sku gsum myur du 'thob par shog /'dis mtshon rnam dkar phung po ci mchis pas/ /dpal ldan bla ma zhing gshegs thams cad kyi/ /thugs dgongs zab mo myur du rdzogs pa dang / /thugs kyi bzhed don lhun gyis 'grub phyir bsngo/ /bstan 'dzin zhabs brtan dge 'dun bshad sgrub 'phel/ /'gro rnams tshe ring nad med dpal 'byor rgyas/ /gnas skabs mthar thug 'dun ma 'grub gyur nas/ /skyid pa'i rgyang glu yang yang len gyur cig /ces gsungs/ gzhan yang thugs mnyes pa'i zhal gsung mang du byon/ zhag shas bzhugs nas gnas 'brel bzhag ste 'byon khar bdag gis bde zhus su dbyangs 'di phul/mtshan ldan bla ma mang po'i zhabs pad bsten/ /mdo rgyud 267

man ngag mang por thos bsam mdzad/ /ri khrod dben pa mang por bsgoms pa'i mthus/ /nyams rtogs yon tan mang po thugs la 'khrungs/ /mtshungs med bla ma sku khams bde bar phebs/ /'do med bdag kyang dben gnas nyams dgar 'gro /mi med dben par lha chos byed pa'i dus/ /gegs med dge sbyor 'phel ba'i skyabs 'jug zhu/ /zhes phul ba'i lan du khong gis 'di skad gsungs/ dben par bskyed rdzogs rdzogs chen bsgoms pa'i mthus/ /ring min myur du dbu ma'i rtsa mdud grol/ /mdo rgyud bstan bcos dgongs pa glu ru len/ /glu pa tshogs drug rang grol glu re snyan/ /phyi nas mjal rag bar du bde bar bzhugs/ /ring min myur du mjal ba'i sgon lam 'tshal /khyed bzhin snyan pa'i glu dbyangs ngas mi shes/ /spro bas bde zhus dbyangs su blangs pa lags/ /zhes gsungs nas gdul bya'i zhing sgo me phyogs kyi ri khrod du phebs song ngo / /de'i rjes su mtsho nyin srib gnyis kyi a rig dang / mtsho mjug nas sog po mang po'i gnas mjal ba bar ma chad par nyi ma re re bzhin du mang po byung nas/ mtsho sreb phyogs dang / mtsho mjug gnyis ga'i dar thog tu lam nag sha re bton pa byung / de'i lo 268

mthun rkyen mang po byung nas phyi rol tu 'gro dgos pa ma byung /nyin cig nom pa kha shas 'ong tshe/ bdag 'dzin gyis blangs nas bsam blo mang po gtong gin yod pa'i tshe/ shes rab kyis mthong nas/ bdag 'dzin la 'di skad smras/thar par 'dod pa'i skyes bu/ /'khor ba'i btson rar bcings nas/ /mi 'dod sdug bsngal du mas/ /chad las sna tshogs gcod pa'i/ /snying nag phung rgan dgra bo/ /sngon chad gar yod ma shes/ /de ring mngon sum mthong byung / /sngon chad nyes pa gang byas/ /khyod rang rgyal du chug cig /da ni 'di nas ma sdod/ /mi mthong yul du song zhig /ma song yan par btang na/ /shes rab nga nyid bu min/ /de bas da lta song zhig /ces bshad tshe/ lan du bdag 'dzin gyes 'di skad zer/u hu ha ha ya ya/ /rgod rgyu lu rgyu gnyis ka /ma thub shor nas bud thal/ /a khu shes rab ngar nyon/ /sngon chad khyod nyin gang gi /'dam du 'gyel nas lus byung / /nga yi phyogs su ma 'khor/ /da lta phebs pa ngo mtshar/ /ma rings glod la bzhugs shig /'o skol gsung gleng zhig byed/ /a khu shes rab ngar nyon/ /sngon chad khyod 'dra mang pos/ /phud dang 269

gsod pa'i grabs shom/ /mang po mang po byas rung / /da lta'i bar du lus byung / /khyod kyang ngal ba ma len/ /don go sna gcig mi 'byung / /de bas sngar bzhin sos dal/ /bde bar nyal na legs mod/ /mi tsho'i sems la gnod pa'i/ /tshig ngan de 'dra ma lab/ /khyod kyi stong skad smras kyang / /nga yi spu tsam mi g.yo/ /'on kyang khyod la de yi/ /rgyu mtshan ma bshad mi go /nga yis cung zad bshad kyis/ /shes rab 'dzing grabs ma byed/ /sngon du 'di la nyon dang / /'dzing ba'i dus ni 'ong gi /nga nga nga las che btsan/ /'jig rten khams na su yod/ /spyir du sems can thams cad/ /sgos su thar 'dod skyes bu/ /thams cad nga yi 'bangs yin/ /nga yi gsung zhig byon tshe/ /char chu mun nag yin rung / /ri thang gnyis ka 'grims nas/ /rta rnga khye khar g.yengs bzhin/ /g.yog ni dkar dkar la khar/ /nag nag bzhag nas rgyun du/ /deng sang bla ma rnams kyis/ /nga yi bka' bzhin sgrub bo/ /chos ra bor nas grong 'grims/ /tshul khrims bor nas nor gsog /sdom pa bor nas bag ma/ /len pa'i deng sang rab byung / /bsnyen rdzogs pa rnams kun gyis/ /nga yi bka' bzhin sgrub bo/ /ri khrod blo yis dor te/ /grong du brgyugs nas khyi dkrog /bya 270

byed gzhan las je mang / /ri khrod gzhan du spor tshe/ /'asel rgyu 'khur rgyu mang ba'i/ /deng sang bya btang rnams kyis/ /nga yi bka' bzhin sgrub bo/ /nyams len cung zad byas tshe/ /nyams rtogs nyag nyug byung ba/ /dga' nas gzhan la sgog cing / /bstod ra cung zad byung na/ /nga rgyal khog pa khengs pa'i/ /deng sang sgom chen rnams kyis/ /nga yi bka' bzhin sgrub bo/ /'phral du gus gus ltar byas/ /zab dgu'i chos zhus gnang kyang / /bza' btung tsam zhig ma byung / /bla mar log lta bsgom pa'i/ /deng sang slob ma rnams kyis/ /nga yi bka' bzhin sgrub bo/ /kha la chos zhu ltar byed/ /khog nas sems la nor 'dod/ /'bul ba zhabs tog byas nas/ /chos zhus zab chos gnang kyang / /gdab lan zas nor ma byung / /bla mar log lta byed pa'i/ /deng sang yon bdag rnams kyis/ /nga yi bka' bzhin sgrub bo/ /ras kha gang ngam kha btags/ /phyir du gsang sngags dbang bskur/ /za ma kham gang rin du/ /zab mo'i rjes gnang btsongs shing / /gshin chog gcig gi phyir du/ /'di phyi gnyis ka btsong ba'i/ /deng sang ston chen rnams kyis/ /nga yi bka' bzhin sgrub bo/ /pags pas gtums pa'i shing de/ /mtho sa'i gnam la 271

btags nas/ /rgyun 'chad med par rdung zhing / /hūṃ phaṭa bh+yo bzlog rgyob sod/ /gtubs sogs nga ro sgrog bzhin/ /dmar mchod mang po byed pa'i/ /deng sang ban gcod rnams kyis/ /nga yi bka' bzhin sgrub bo/ /las 'bras cung zad mi 'dzem/ /khrims rnams nor phyir 'tshong zhing / /mnga' 'og 'bangs rnams kun la/ /mi 'dod sna dgu gtong ba'i/ /deng sang rje dpon rnams kyis/ /nga yi bka' bzhin sgrub bo/ /rgas rung da dung 'dug snyam/ /las su phyugs kyi 'tsho skyong / /thang ma brdal zhing bya dkrog /bu yi g.yog po byed pa'i/ /deng sang rgad po rnams kyis/ /nga yi bka' bzhin sgrub bo/ /phyi ma nam yang mi dran/ /rgas rung bal gsed me 'bud/ /tsha bo yang tsha'i 'tsho rdzi/ /mna' ma'i g.yog mo byed pa'i/ /deng sang rgan mo rnams kyis/ /nga yi bka' bzhin sgrub bo/ /nam yang lha chos mi dran/ /mi bsad rta ded rkus dang / /zhing las khe tshong rem pa'i/ /deng sang pho skyes rnams kyis/ /nga yi bka' bzhin sgrub bo/ /phyugs kyi btang 'dogs zho bzho/ /chu len bal 'khel thags 'thag /shing 'thu thal 'bo ja bskol/ /nam yang khom skabs med pa'i/ /deng sang bud med rnams kyis/ /nga yi bka' bzhin sgrub bo/ /spyir ni sems 272

can thams cad/ /khyad par snyigs dus chos mdzad/ /nga yis gang la mngags kyang / /phar la gru gu 'dril 'dril/ /tshur la 'phang lo 'khor 'khor/ /byed pa sngon chad e go /a khu shes rab khyod kyi/ /gsung la da lta kun gyis/ /e nyan bsam blo thongs dang / /khyod la deng sang kun gyis/ /brtsi bkur med pa e gsal/ /nga ni deng sang kun gyis/ /bkur gnas yin no e go /deng sang chos mdzad rnams kyis/ /kha nas khyod 'dod smras kyang / /khog na kun gyis nga 'dod/ /shes rab khyod dang nged gnyis/ /gdam du bcug na nga gdam/ /ci'i phyir zhe na khyod ni/ /'phrad du za rgyur mi phan/ /btung rgyu gon rgyur mi phan/ /'jig rten phyi mar phan kyang / /phyi ma zer ba phyi tsho/ /grod pu rlon pa sngun tsho/ /nga ni kun la nyer mkho/ /ja chang za ma'i bzang ngan/ /bkur ste zhabs tog che chung / /'bul ba'i bzang ngan legs nyes/ /nga yis 'phral du rtogs nas/ /gdab lan bzang ngan ngas byed/ /mtho dman kun la nga mkho/ /nged dang chos mdzad gnyis ka /dpon g.yog yin pa e mkhyen/ /'on kyang nga yi bka' bcag /khyod kyi rjes su phyogs pa'i/ /thar 'dod re re byung kyang / /nga yis dug lnga btang tshe/ /mdzub mo'i 'og gi shig bzhin/ /cung zad 'phag 273

par mi nus/ /sngon chad thar pa'i grong du/ /mang po song ba e mthong / /nyin mo'i skar ma bzhin dkon/ /'on kyang stabs legs 'phrod nas/ /re re song na'ang thang mod/ /da lta snyigs ma'i dus su/ /thar par 'gro ba phar zhog /mi gcig mngon mtho'i phyogs su/ /btang na nga nyid bu min/ /snyigs dus sems can spyi dang / /khyad par bla ma sngags pa/ /gcod pa bya btang sgom chen/ /de dag rnams la skyid sdug /ci gtong nga yis shes so/ /deng sang snyigs ma'i dus 'dir/ /nga yi 'phrin las rgyas byung / /mtho ba bla dpon man chad/ /dma' ba sprang po yan chad/ /nga yi 'bangs 'khor g.yog po/ /nga las che btsan su yod/ /shes rab khyod kyis shod dang / /zhes bshad pa'i lan du/ shes rab kyis/phung rgan bstan bshig ngar nyon/ /nga zhes khyod khengs mi dgos/ /khyod las che ba nga yin/ /nga yi ming tsam thos kyang / /khyod nyid dngangs shing brgyal na/ /stong nyid mdung gis brgyab tshe/ /khyod la 'chor sa gar yod/ /song zhes mi 'gro bsdad nas/ /da lta skad 'go mtho ste/ /thal ba'i rdul phran bzhin du/ /ma brlag bzhag pa'i dus na/ /shes rab shi dang khyad med/ /e go bdag 'dzin phung rgan/ /zhes smras 274

pas lan du/ bdag 'dzin gyis/go go ya ya de yin/ /nged gnyis bu yi bzang ngan/ /ring min myur du thag chod/ /khyod kyis sngon chad nga yi/ /'khor g.yog 'ga' zhig khyer la/ /ngas kyang khyod nyid rtsad gcod/ /mang po mang po byas rung / /gang na yod pa ma go /da ni rtsad gcod ma dgos/ /'di ru 'ong la nga dga'/ /nga yis chos brgyad mtshon char/ /rgyun chad med par phab na/ /khyod la 'chor ba'i skabs med/ /sngon chad khyod 'dra mang po/ /yan par btang ba gcig med/ /khyod kyang yan par btang na/ /nga yi ske rags khyir 'ching / /de skad bshad dang lhan du/ /shes rab yar la bzhengs te/ /lta ba'i mdung ring thogs tshe/ /bdag 'dzin phung rgan skrag nas/ /mi mthong yul du bros song / /zhes rang gzhan la phan phyir rtse mtshar du smras pa'o/ /de nas zla ba dang po'i yar tshes la slob bu kun gye thog mar byung ba'i sngon sbyangs las kyi 'phro can skal ldan snying gi bu mchog pad+ma rang grol dpon slob 'ga' dang bcas te phebs nas/ bdag la lha rdzas dri med sngon du phul nas mjal te bde zhus 'di ltar byas byung /dus gsum sangs rgyas 'dus pa'i sku/ /'gro ba rnams kyi 275

mgon gcig pu/ /mtshan ldan bla ma rin po che/ /gzugs sku bde bar bzhugs lags sam/ /zhes phul ba'i lan du/ bdag gis dbyangs snyan po'i sgo nas 'di skad smras/ mi bde ma mchis bde bar mchis/ /chos sku'i dbyengs na gzugs sku bde/ /skal ldan las 'phro can gyi bu/ /bde bar gnas 'dir byon lags sam/ /zhes smras pa'i lan du yang 'di skad phul byung /mtshan ldan bla ma'i bka' drin gyis/ /gzhi dang lam bar thams cad du/ /lus sems duḥ khas ma mnar bar/ /bde nas bde bar 'ong ba lags/ /zhes phul ba'i rjes su chos kyi gtam yun ring du byas/ de'i phyi nyin khong rnams kyis gser dngul gyi dngos po phul nas sems la phan pa'i dbang lung khrid gsum gnang dgos zhes snyan gsan phul bas/ de'i nyin blo sbyong zhen 'khris kun gcod kyi lung khrid byas/ de nas spros bcas kyi dbang sngar thob pas 'thus pa byas/ spros med ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang dang / rig pa'i rtsal dbang bskur nas/'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po'i lung khrid dang / bka' gdams bu chos sogs kyi lung byen te/ lto gos chos gsum gye sgo nas bskyangs/ de'i lo nga rtse nas bsdad/ nga'i 'dug sa 276

nas bu chen pad+ma rang grol bzhugs/ gzhan mtshams pa brgyad tsam 'dug pa rnams phug pa so sor bsdad de/ khong rnams kyis dka' spyad snying rus kyi sgo nas nyams len byas pas bla ma la sangs rgyas dngos kyi dad gus tshad med pa skyes/ dug gsum nyon mongs rags pa thams cad zhi nas/ sgo gsum zhi ba dul ba chos dang mthun pa byung / ngas kyang gcig pur ngag mtshams byas spros med mnyam bzhag gtso bor bton/ rjes thob kyi dus su rang gzhan gyi rgyud la phan pa'i mgur dbyangs mang po blangs/ dbyar thog der rang gzhan gyi tshogs bsags sgrib sbyong dang / bstan 'gro yongs kyi bde thabs su dmigs nas mtsho snying ri rtse nas/ gtsug lag khang bre zhabs tsam zhig bzhengs pas sa rdo len pa sogs las ka gang dgos rnams bu chen pad+ma rang grol sogs der 'tshogs pa'i mtshams pa thams cad kyis mdzad/ phyis su lha khang 'grub pa dang / nang du thugs rje chen po phyag stong spyan stong can gyi sku gcig dang /de'i g.yas su gnas bdag ma hā dre wa/ g.yon du mtsho sman khri gshog rgyal mo gnyis kyi 'dra sku re dang de gsum gyi rgyab tu/dus gsum rgyal ba bskyed pa'i yum chen mo'i glegs bam po ti bcu gnyis rnams bzhugs su bcug nas/ slob ma mched 277

grogs rnams kyis mchod rdzas na bza' snyan dar gang yod rnams phul/ rab gnas dga' ston bsngo ba smon lam rgya chen po byas pas lha khang de dus da lta'i bar ma zhig par yod skad/lo der sos dal po byung ba'i shugs kyis rig pa dwangs pa byung /dam pa'i chos kyi bgro gleng mang po byas pas/ bu chen pad+ma rang grol sogs der 'tshogs pa blo bskyed chen po dang / mdo sngags gsar rnying gi chos la mi phyed pa'i dad pa brtan po thob ste/ chos mdzad skyes bu dam pa yongs la dag snang phyogs med du skyes pa byung / der 'tshogs pa rnams kyis mgur zhig gnang dgos zhus pas 'di ltar blangs/'gran zla med pha rgan chos rgyal gyi bka' drin/ /bzang po de dran bzhin gus pa'i bus 'dud do/ /rnal 'byor rang rgyud la nyams rtogs ni gang shar/ /mgrin pa ru btegs nas cung zad cig 'then no/ /drin can gyi bla mar rgyun 'chad med gsol ba/ /btab pa'i mthus byen rlabs rang rgyud la zhugs byung / /'khor ba yi nyes dmigs yang yang du bsams pas/ /mi nor dang zas la zhen pa ni log byung / /'gro ba kun drin can pha ma ru bsgoms pas/ /bdag pas ni gzhan gces byang chub sems skyes byung / /rig stong ni zang thal rjen pa de 278

bskyangs pas/ /'khrul med kyi nyams rtogs bzang po ni skyes byung / /rdzogs chen gyi khyad chos thod rgal la sbyangs pas/ /rang snang de don gye 'og min du 'dug go /rnal 'byor nga mtsho skyes rdo rje yi bu rgyud/ /nyams rtogs kyi glu dbyangs 'di 'dra rang 'jen no/ /dam tshig dang ldan pa'i snying gogs ni rnams kyang / /nyams mgur zhig len na 'di 'dra rang 'then mdzod/ /dben gnas ni khyad 'phags mtsho snying gi gnas na/ /nyams rtogs kyi glu dbyangs 'brug sgra de ldir mkhan/ /rnal 'byor pa tshogs drug rang grol kho yin snang / /dge 'di yis 'gro kun sangs rgyas su gyur cig /ces blangs pas kun kyang nyams dga' bar gyur to/ /nyin cig mgur ma rnams khyer nas spang gshong 'jam po zhig tu song / dbyangs snyan mo byas gcig pur bton pa'i tshe/ nam mkha' nas gzugs mi mthong ba'i sgra zhig gis/ ngo mtshar che zer ba zhig kyang thos pas/ phyin chad lha 'dre mi gsum gang gis thos kyang sems la phan rgyu red snyam dga' zhing spro ba byung / nub cig rmi lam la rje btsun skal ldan rgya mtsho'i sprul sku yin zer ba'i skyes bu gzhon nu lang tsho bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod can dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa blta bas mi ngoms pa dge slong gi cha lugs 279

can/ 'khor zhabs phyi gang yang med par gcig pur sba 'khar bsnams nas 'gro ba zhig la/ spang gshong nyams dga' ba zhig nas mjal/ khyed gang du 'gro zhus tshe/ da sgom la 'gro ba yin gsungs/ nga'i bsam pa la da lta'i sprul sku 'dis kyang ri khrod 'grim gyin yod rgyu red bka' drin che lan cig mjal ba bzang zhes so sor gyes pa zhig rmis pa'i phyi nyin khong gi sku thog snga ma'i dus reb gong gi yul du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i sgon me sbar ba'i bka' drin dran nas mgur dbyangs 'di ltar blangs so// mkhyen pa'i 'od zer gyis kun la khyab/ /brtse ba'i tsha drod kyis 'gro kun skyong / /rje btsun skal ldan gyi nyi ma yis/ /chos dbyings nam mkha' nas bdag la dgongs/ /dmu rgod reb gong gi mun gling du/ /dam chos sgon me de rab sbar mthus/ /rgya gar 'phags yul las ches cher du/ /gsal bar gyur pa 'di e ma mtshar/ /da lta reb gong gi sa steng mkhar/ /sgrub sde bco brgyad sogs dgon pa yi/ /nyi zla gza' skar ni du ma shar/ /bde skyid 'od zer gyis khyab 'di mtshar/ /ri phug sa gtsang gi gos chen steng / /grub gnas ri mo yis mdzes pa de/ /sgom chen rgyal blon gyis legs gyon nas/ /dam chos 280

bdud rtsi ni gsol ba mtshar/ /dmu rgod skye bo yi rta rgod rnams/ /dam chos srab sgrog gis legs par btul/ /mi dge tsab tsub bor mngon mtho dang / /nges legs lam bzang la chud 'di mtshar/ /thos pa rgya mtsho yi gling nas 'khrungs/ /blo gros klu dbang gis legs bzung ba'i/ /mgur dbyangs 'dod 'byung gi rin chen gter/ /kun la 'jog pa ru bzhag 'di mtshar/ /da dung byang chub ni ma thob bar/ /bod khams sems can spyi khyad par du/ /reb gong rjes 'jug gi gdul bya rnams/ /ma yis bu bzhin du brtse bas skyongs/ /mgon khyod rnam thar mtsho'i chu thigs shig /bdag gi blo gros kyi sor rtser blangs/ /mgon khyod mchod pa'i mthus tshe rabs kun/ /'bral med rjes su bdag gzung du gsol/ /zhes blangs/yang dbyar gyi dus su slob ma rnams la byang ngos kyi spang gshong zhig tu nyin cig chos dang gang zag yongs la dad gus dag snang sbyangs nas/ /rang gang mos kyi chos la nyams len byed dgos tshul rgyas par bshad pa'i mjug tu sems la shar ba ltar mgur dbyangs 'di yang blangs so//gangs can khrod du sngon gyi/ /dam pa gong ma'i drin las/ /zab chos mang po dar kyang / /chos pa phal gyis tsha 281

grang / /bzhin du 'gal bar bzung nas/ /sdang zhen phyogs ris byed pa/ /dam pa 'ga' res zhal nas/ /dbu ma rdzogs chen phyag chen/ /ka ra bu ram sbrang rtsi/ /gang gi gang bzang red gsung / /des na bdag gis kun la/ /phyogs med thos bsam byed pas/ /sdang zhen phyogs ris mkhan gyis/ /bdag la bka' bkyon ma gnang / /dbu ma rdzogs chen phyag chen/ /lhun stug rab dkar gangs la/ /dag snang nyi 'od brdal na/ /byin rlabs chu rgyun 'byung nges/ /zhes blangs pas der 'tshogs pa'i slob ma rnams la de nas bzung ste chos dang gang zag yongs la dag snang phyogs med du 'byongs pa byung / yang ston kha ri mgor kha ba babs dus shig la 'chi ba mi rtag pa dran nas nyin zhig rang la 'di skad smras/phar ri'i ri mgo gsar du/ /kha bas dkar por btang bzhag /a rog tshogs drug rang grol/ /mgo yi skra tshor ltos dang / /spang rgyan me tog sngon po'i/ /mdzes pa'i 'byung bag glod bzhag /a rog tshogs drug rang grol/ /rang gi kha ngor ltos dang / /chu bya rim bzhin bzhud thal/ /mtsho 'gram stong par bsgyur bzhag /a rog tshogs drug rang grol/ /gnyen grogs rnams tshor ltos dang / /la la shar ba'i nyi ma/ /la rtse la 282

mgor bsnyegs bzhag /a rog tshogs drug rang grol/ /khyod lo du yin ltos dang / /zhes smras nas dge sbyor la zhugs so/ /de nas ston kha bcu ba'i nyi shu lnga'i mtshan mo mar me gsal bo zhig sbar te/ rje bla ma tsong kha pa rin po che la gsol ba btab nas nyal ba'i mtshan mo rmi lam la/ rin po che du ma las grub pa'i ri chen po zhig la shel gyi skas ring po zhig btsugs yod pa la yar 'dzegs nas song bas steng du slebs tshe/ sa gzhi khod snyoms pa me tog sna tshogs pa bkra zhing dri ngad ldang ba'i dbus su/ gos kyi gur sngon po ri mo sna tshogs pas spud pa dar tshon sna lnga'i chon thag la gser dngul gyi chon phur gdab pa zhig phub pa'i dbus na/ rab tu mtho zhing mdzes pa'i khri zhig gi steng na dar zab 'bol gdan brtsegs pa'i gdan la/ gzi brjid 'od zer rab tu 'bar ba'i bla ma blta bas chog mi shes pa zhal mthong ba tsam gyis 'khrul ba'i blo sna mtha' dag 'gag nus pa zhig bzhugs nas/ 'khor skal bzang bye ba ther 'bum la chos lam rim bsdus don zhig gi lung gnang ba'i gral du bsdad nas yongs rdzogs nyan pa'i mthar/ bdag gis bla ma khong la phyag dpe g.yar bas/ dpe cha g.yor mi dgos byen chog gsungs te gnang ba rum du bzung nas dga' bzhin phyi 283

rol tu 'ongs nas bltas tshe/ gangs can bod kyi yul phyogs rnams mthong bas ltad mo cung zad bltas/ de nas skas de gzar bas mar 'bab ma nus par cung zad bsdad tshe/ g.yon nas mi gcig na re/ ri rtse 'dir 'ongs pa'i mi rnams mar lam skas la 'gro mi dgos/ 'phur song na chog zer bas/ngas gzan la gshog pa byas nas nam mkha' la 'phur te bod yul gye gzhung thams cad la ltad mo lta bzhin 'ong ba zhig rmis pa la brten nas/ der 'khod pa'i bu chen rig 'dzin zla bas gtso byas skal ldan slob ma rnams kyis gser gyi maṇ+ḍal dang bcas te lam rim go sla nyung bsdus tshigs bcad 'khyer bde zhig dgos zhes bskul ba'i ngor/ lam rim gsal ba'i sgron me zhes bya ba brtsams te lung byen nas nyin rer shar sgom re las ma byung na yang gyis zhes gdams pas/ kun gyis nyams su blangs pas rgyud la phan thogs rgya chen po byung / de nas skabs shig nyams snang la rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi zhal gzigs pas thugs ka nas 'od zer zhig 'phros te bdag gi snying gar zug pas bde gsal mi rtog stong pa'i ngang du lhan lhan 'gro ba zhig byung / lta ba'i dogs pa zhig zhu snyam pa'i tshe/'od du zhu nas rang gi snying khar thim pa'i snang ba shar/ de 284

nas gnyid du song ba'i rmi lam du/ nga'i lag na rin po che'i snod kha dog sngon po 'od can zhig gda'/ de'i nang nas chang ser zhig byung ba mi gsum tsam zhig gis 'thung / de nas yang zho mang po byung ba mi mang pos 'thungs pas/ nga'i bsam pa la snod 'di dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i nor bu rin po che'i snod cig yin par snang / da nga dbul po mang po yod sa zhig tu 'gro dgos snyam pa zhig yid la shar ba byung / yang nyin zhig mtsho 'gram gyi pha bong zhig gi steng nas mtsho nang du bltas pas/ pha bong re re'i rtsa ba na srog chags che chung bgrangs las 'das pa 'dug de bzhin du bltas pas pha bong thams cad kyi rtsa ba dang mtsho yi kha gting thams cad srog chags mang pos khengs pa mthong nas snying re rje 'di rnams la ma 'ongs pa na phan thogs pa'i thabs shig bya dgos snyam nas/ nang du 'ongs te a r+pā rin po che sogs kyis gnang ba'i rten gsum byen can thams cad brdungs nas zhib por byas chu nang du sbangs nas rgya cher btang / mtsho snying gi phyogs bzhi'i mtsho nang du phar brgal te byen rten rnams mtsho nang du blugs nas smon lam rgya chen po btab bo/ /yang gnas der sdod dus chu glag sdig can zhig gis sos ka chu bya'i phrug gu 'phur mi thub pa stong phrag mang 285

po yod pa rnams kyi nang nas gsum bzhi re nyin re bzhin du bzung nas gson por snying brus nas za ba mthong bas snying rje nas/ lo gnyis la zla ba gnyis re'i bar du bdag gis bya phrug chung chung de rnams chu glag la gsod du ma bcug par bsrungs pas bya phrug rnams kyis kyang ngas bsrung ba shes nas/ thams cad nga'i thag nye'i mtsho khar 'ongs nas bsdad/ chu glag nam 'ong dus skad ngan drag po rgyag pa byung / nyin zhig 'ur rdo zhig khyer nas brgyugs pas/ chu glag gis nga mthong ba dang tshod ma zin par chu nang du lhung ste/ gshog pa gnyis thang sha bcad nas chu la cab cab brgyab pas mar nang du nub nas 'chi la khad byas tshe/ mig ce re nga la lta ba mthong/ snying rje nas mtsho nang nas tshur blangs te/ 'gram du bzhag nas cung zad skam tshe/ rke la 'ur rdo bskon dbyug pa chung chung zhig khyer yong nas nga'i bya phrug gsod dus khyod dpa' ang zhes kho'i mchu dang sder mo la lan mang po brdungs nas re zhig gi bar du btags nas bzhag de nas kho rang btang bas re zhig bar du der ma 'ongs/ yang nyin zhig 'ong ste bya phrug cig bzung ba'i rjes su brgyugs pas/ kho yar sne'i pha bong zhig gi thog tu babs pa dang / ngas 'ur rdo 'phen pa dus mnyam byung bas rdo phog ste kho 286

gsod la khad byas tshe/ khos bya phrug bzhag nas 'phur so/nga ba'i shul na bya phrug de da dung gan rkyal du log 'dug pas/nga'i bsam pa la da snying brus tshar ba yin nam snyam lag tu blangs nas bltas tshe/ kho sngar glag la skrag ste brgyal song ba red/ brgyal sangs pa dang nga la bltas chu nang du brgyugs nas song / de ltar bsrungs pas lo de gnyis la bya phrug stong phrag mang po'i srog thar nas nam mkha' la 'phur te 'gro ba byung dus/ 'di skad ces smras so//bya phrug glag gi 'jigs pa las/ /bsgral nas bde bar 'gro ba ltar/ /'gro kun 'jigs pa mtha' dag las/ /bsgral nas bde la 'god par shog /ces smon lam kyang btab bo/ /de'i lo jes ma rnams su/ gnas chen der 'dug pa'i mtshams pa rnams la yang bshad pas/ khong rnams kyis kyang bsrungs nas tshe thar pa byung skad/ gzhan yang ri khrod gang du sdod kyang /bye'u khras gsod pa dang / srin 'bus srin bu gsod pa mang po thar par byas/ mdor na sems can nyam thag la snying rje nas srog skyob gang thub byas pas mthar rang gis rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rlabs po che la slob nus pa'i smon lam btab pa'i rten 'brel gyis blo'i mthu je cher song 287
