nas sems can mang po la phan thog sa byung bas na/ khyed bu slob rnams kyis kyang de lta bu'i rgyal sras kyi spyod pa chung ngu la yang slobs la smon lam thobs dang rjes su kun la phan thogs pa 'ong zhes bshad/ de nas mtsho la dar chags dus bro kha gzhan rnams tshar nas/ rtsam pa gcig pu zos pas nyi dros shig la/bro kha gzhan med rung / rtsam pa drin can 'di yod na/ 'di kho nas chog par 'dug snyam de dus mgur dbyangs 'di yid la shar ba ltar blangs so//bla ma gcig gis chog pa/ /chos rgyal ngag gi dbang po/ /grogs po gcig gis chog pa/ /pad+ma bzhad pa'i rdo rje/ /slob bu gcig gis chog pa/ /bya btang rig 'dzin zla ba/ /dben gnas gcig gis chog pa/ /mtsho snying ma hā dre wa/ /gon pa gcig gis chog pa/ /g.yang mo lug gi bal 'ja ma za ma gcig gis chog pa/ /dkar 'jam zhim pa'i rtsam pa /chog drug glu dbyangs snyan mo/ /tshogs drug rang grol blangs so/ /zhes smras so/ /de'i lo kun gyis 'dod chung chog shes byas nas mtshams bzang po byed rgyu byung / mtsho la dar chags pa dang /sngar gyi yon bdag rnying pa dang gsar pa gzhan mang po mjal du byung ba dang / mtshams pa sdod mkhan yang mang po byung ba'i 288

tshe/ nga'i bsam pa la mtsho snying gi ri 'di rgya chung mi mang na rnam g.yeng 'du 'dzi'i dbang du song nas nyams len 'phel po mi yong bar 'dug da ni 'di bas kyang dben pa mi med kyi lung stong zhig la 'gro dgos snyam nas/ mno bsam zhig btang tshe/ gangs dkar gyi rgyal po ri bo rma chen las 'gol ba zhig mi 'dug pas/ der sos ka 'gro bar thag bcad de slob ma yon bdag rnams la bshad tshe/ bu chen pad+ma rang grol sogs rang yul gyi slob ma rnams kyis/ sngar nged rnams 'ongs dus/yul gyi bla ma dang a ma grogs mched rnams kyis khyed rnams song la gdan drongs shog ces bshad pas/ nged rnams kyis kyang gdan ci 'drongs bya zhes khas blangs yod pas/ lan cig yul du phebs nas a ma sogs ltos bcas rnams kyi re ba zhig bskang na mi dga' ba'ang chos red zer/ mtsho sngon po'i phyogs kyi slob ma sbyin bdag rnams kyis mtsho snying 'di las 'gol ba zhig la phebs sa med/ 'di nas da dung bzhugs dgos zhes smra ba rnams la ma nyan par 'gro bar thag rbad kyis bcad tshe/bu chen pad+ma rang grol na re/ gal te khyed yul du mi phebs par ri bo rma chen du phebs rgyu yin na kho bo yul nas 'ong dus yi ge mang po khyer 'ongs pa rnams la 'byor lan re gnang 289

dgos zer bas/ de yong zhes/ thog mar rgas pa'i a mas bu khyod lan cig yul du yong mod snyam pa'i ngang la lo bdun thal khyod la yong rgyu mi gda'/ nga la na rgyu mang gi shi 'dra song na khyod la zhe thogs par 'dug pas da lo cis kyang shog ces skad nan can dang yi ge 'di ltar btang 'dugaskyes pa'i yul spangs 'dus pa'i gnyen rnams bskyur/ /chos rgyal zhabs bsten zab mo'i gdams pa thob/ /ri khrod gnas na grogs med gcig pur bsdad/ /rtse gcig nyams len mdzad pa'i bu'i drung du/ /lus srog bskyed pa'i a mas zhu 'bras ni/ /bu khyod bde zhes thos pas dga' spro shar/ /ma nga'i sgyu lus na zug mang po snang / /da dung ma shi tsam du gnas nas yod/ /mi tshe gang bor 'grogs pa'i skal dman yang / /lan cig tsam zhig ma la 'phrad du shog /yul na yod dus rgas nas 'chi rag bar/ /ma bu lhan cig 'grogs snyam yid na yod/ /na rga 'chi bas non nas mkho ba'i dus/ /gzhan gyi bu dang mi 'dra snyam nas dga'/ /da ni rgas nas langs 'dug bsgul bskyod dka'/ /bza' btung med pas ngan ngon zas mi 'phrod/ /dro 'jam gos med dug hrul gyon pa'i ma/ /lo mang yal bar dor nas sdod phod dam/ /bya rgyal khu byug sngon 290

mo grag dus dang / /khyod 'dra'i chos mdzad mthong ba'i rkyen byas nas/ /yid la dran nas mig nas mchi ma btang / /mtshan gang gnyid ma khug pa'i dus kyang byung / /sngon chad shog ces lan mang bskul na yang / /mi 'phrad phyugs las glen du song ngam ci/ /dud 'gro yin yang ma yis kha grag na/ /bu de myur du sngon la rgyug pa mthong / /ma ngas drin gyes bskyangs la khyod sems na/ /da lo nga la cis kyang 'phrad du shog /phrad nas gang 'dod gnas su khyod gtong zhes/ /da nas ma ngas khas len byas pa yin/ /sngon chad khyod kyi chos ldan bya ba la/ /bar chad gcig tsam byas pa yod dam med/ /da ni 'chi la thug pa'i dus skabs su/ /'phrad na 'dod pa ma gtogs gzhan ci yod/ /rgas te 'chi la nye ba'i ma rgan nga / /snying rjes lan cig 'phrad du ma yong na/ /bu khyod 'gro la byams dang snying rje gnyis/ /sngon chad bsgoms pa'ang de 'dra tsam du thal/ /'di ltar bu la yi ge bskur ba'i mthus/ /ring min myur du ma bu 'phrad pa dang / /yul 'di'i nad mug 'khrug rtsod kun zhi zhing / /dge legs phun tshogs zla ltar 'phel bar shog /ces pa'i lan du 'di skad smras/bu ngas chos ldan bya ba gang bsgrub la/ /bar chad cung 291

zad tsam yang byed ma myong / /grogs byas gzhan gyi ma las drin lhag pa'i/ /lus srog bskyed pa'i a ma rgan mo lags/ /khyod kyi yi ge ma nyams legs par 'phrod/ /sgyu lus bde zhes thos pas dga' spro skyes/ /nga yang bla ma mchog gsum bka' drin gyis/ /sgyu lus bde zhing nyams len 'phel bzhin mchis/ /sngon chad shog ces dus su ma phrad pa/ /sems la ma gnod phan tshun bde ba'i gtam/ /thos na 'phrad dang khyad par ga la yod/ /snyam nas ma phrad da ni myur du 'ong / /don med khyim tshang bza' mi'i lto rgyab phyir/ /thag ring yul la 'dre 'dul grong chog tu/ /bu gcig song nas lo mang 'gor na yang / /pha ma la las shul nas mi dran na/ /ma khyod gtan bde byang chub bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /yul gzhan ri khrod dben pa'i gnas rnams su/ /bu nga song nas lo 'ga' 'gor ba la/ /yang yang dran nas sems sdug ci phyir dgos/ /tshe 'dir zas gos nor gyis pha ma la/ /phan 'dogs byed pa'i bu ni mang na yang / /phyi mar pha mar phan pa'i dam pa'i chos/ /ri la byed mkhan bu ni du yod soms/ /pha mar rtag tu sdang ba'i bu ngan pa/ /drung du bsdad kyang phan las gnod pa mang / /pha mar byams pa'i bu ni thag ring du/ /gnas kyang 292

phan nam mi phan ltos dang gsal/ /tshe 'dir phrad 'ong gal te ma 'phrad na/ /dge sbyor gang byas ma khyod don du bsngo/ /phyi mar dag pa'i zhing khams nyams dga' ru/ /phrad nas 'bral med 'grogs pa'i smon lam 'debs/ /zhes rten gsum byen can 'tshams rtags bcas bskur ro/ /yang zho 'ong sngags mang gis yul du phebs dgos zhes yi ge 'di ltar bskur 'dugalas nyon chang gis yid myos dmu rgod kyi/ /gdul bya glang spyon 'khor ba'i nags klong du/ /'jug pa thugs rje lcags kyu rnon po yis/ /thar pa'i lam du 'jug mkhan bla ma la/ /sdug bsngal gsum gyi lci ba'i khur gyis non/ /dug lnga'i skom tshad drag pos gdungs bzhin du/ /srid pa'i thang du rtag 'khyams sngags mang gi /nyam thag nga ro dgongs shig thugs rje can/ /nges legs bde ba'i zas gos nor gyis phongs/ /'khor ba'i khyim na sdug bsngal du mas mnar/ /chags sdang smre sngags 'don pa'i dbul po kun/ /ded dpon khyod cig e phebs bltas nas yod/ /mtsho snying gser gling yun ring ma bzhugs par/ /lung rtogs yon tan rin chen gser dang bcas/ /snying rje'i gru ru zhugs la myur byon zhes/ /'o dod drag pos yang yang gsol ba 'debs/ /ma rig ling tog gis bsgribs 293

yang dag lam/ /ma mthong las ngan rlung gis rgyab nas bdas/ /ngan song gsum gyi g.yang khar phyogs pa rnams/ /thugs rjes mi 'dzin yal bar 'dor phod dam/ /bdag cag mtha' med 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho cher/ /las nyon rba rlabs chen po 'khrugs pas g.yengs/ /sdug bsngal chu srin khar tshud mi skyob na/ /kun la brtse zhes gleng ba dzun nam ci/ /dam gtsang mched grogs me tog pad+ma'i tshal/ /gzhon nu dar bab 'dab brgya bzhad skabs 'dir/ /rje btsun bung ba yud tsam ma 'khor na/ /na 'chi'i ba mos non tshe 'khor kyang 'phyis/ /de'i phyir 'gro mgon ngang pa'i rgyal po khyod/ /sngags 'chang tshogs mang 'o ma'i rgya mtsho'i dbus/ /myur du byon nas theg chen chos kyi sgra/ /snyan pa'i dar dir sgog pa'i dus la bab/ /zhu yig bde 'jam yangs pa'i spang lngongs su/ /spyan gyi ri dwags yud tsam 'khyu rten du/ /dri med lha rdzas sngo ljang rtsi thog bcas/ /yar ngo'i tshes grangs bzang por legs par phul/ /zhes bskur 'dug pa'i lan du/ bdag gis 'di skad ces smras so//bdag gi skyabs mgon chos rgyal zhabs la 'dud/ /mched grogs rnams la 'di phyir dge legs stsol/ /chung nas 294

'grogs pa'i dam gtsang sngags 'chang rnams/ /grogs po tshogs drug rang grol tshig 'dir nyon/ /rang don ma rdzogs gzhan don yong ba dka'/ /mnyam du 'grogs na skyon mthong dad pa 'grib/ /de'i phyir nged rnams phrad la dgos pa chung / /mi ngas bsgrub la gzhol na rang gzhan 'tshengs/ /sngon chad nga yis khyed tshor ji skad bshad/ /de min phrad kyang bshad rgyu gzhan ma mchis/ /de bzhin mdzod dang mi nga rab tu dga'/ /khyed rnams rtag tu bde zhing skyid par nges/ /skye ba 'di dang tshe rabs thams cad du/ /phan tshun phrad na 'dod pa'i dus rnams su/ /gang na gnas kyang ma bu phrad pa bzhin/ /brtse gdung ngos nas phrad pa'i smon lam 'tshal/ /nam zhig bdag ni mngon par sangs rgyas tshe/ /khyed rnams 'khor gyi thog mar 'gyur ba dang / /de ma thob pa'i tshe rabs thams cad du/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen nga yis byed par shog /ces 'tshams rtags dang bcas te bskur/ de bzhin du yul phyogs kyi bla ma mched grogs sngar yi ge skur mkhan thams cad la 'byor lan yi ge tshigs bcad phul ba rnams 'dir mang du dogs nas ma bris/ rgyas par mgur 'bum na gsal lo/ /de ltar 'byor lan bris tshe slob bu sha nye ngag dbang bkra shis kyis 295

da dung gsol ba btab na lan gcig e phebs kyi re ba byas nas/ rang yul du 'byon dgos tshul gyi rgyu mtshan rnams tshigs su bcad nas 'di ltar phul byung / tshe 'di'i bya ba kun dor nas/ /mtsho snying dpen par bzhugs mdzad pa'i/ /rig 'dzin tshogs drug rang grol la/ /mos pa'i bu ngas zhu ba'i 'bras/ /yul mi rgan gzhon thams cad dang / /khyad par a ma nye du kun/ /gros byas mi nga 'tshogs thog nas/ /gdan 'dren zhu ru btang ba yin/ /phebs zhes yang yang zhus pa la/ /da lo khong gi snyan ma g.yar/ /sang phod cis kyang 'byon par zhu/ /rang re yul pa thams cad kyis/ /bla ma gdan 'dren btang ba'i mi/ /shi 'am yang na phyag skor du/ /song ngam yang na sog yul du/ /ldom nas rgyu nom cung zad re/ /e rnyed blta zhing yod pa 'am/ /yang na bla ma'i mdun du bsdad/ /kho rang skyid tshe 'o skol brjed/ /gdan 'dren zhu ba phar la zhog /bzhugs zhes zhu yin yod kyang thang / /yang na nad kyis btab pa 'am/ /yul du mi 'ong ci byung zer/ /sems la mang po 'char gyin yod/ /de bas yul du 'byon par zhu/ /khyad par a ma snying re rje/ /ma phrad lo bdun tsam song 'dug /la mgo'i nyi ma 296

'grib la khad/ /a ma rgan mo 'chi la nye/ /phyi mar a ma skyid mod kyang / /tshe 'dir mjal na bsams nas 'phreng /yod pas lan cig mjal ran red/ /'di skyid phyi skyid byas na legs/ /de bas yul du 'byon par zhu/ /dben pa'i ri la thugs spro na/ /'a 'ur 'du 'dzi kun bral ba'i/ /ri khrod gang gi gang skyid yod/ /de bas yul du 'byon par zhu/ /dben pa'i nags la thugs spro na/ /nags tshal gang gi gang bzang yod/ /rang grub shing thog kha zas mod/ /ma zhus na yang sa ler mkhyen/ /de'i phyir yul du 'byon par zhu/ /yul gyi grub gnas gang yod tshad/ /thams cad byen gyis brlab dgos pas/ /de'i phyir yul du 'byon par zhu/ /'khrungs yul gdul bya'i zhing yin pas/ /thugs kyis ma dor rjes su zungs/ /rjes su 'dzin na 'dzin re ran/ /phebs mod bsam gyin bltas nas yod/ /de'i phyir yul du 'byon par zhu/ /chos kyi bar chad byed mi med/ /tshe 'di blo yis gtong ba dang / /ri khrod dben pa sten mkhan mang / /thams cad khyod drung phyogs nas yod/ /de'i phyir yul du 'byon par zhu/ /bdag gi lhag bsam dag pa'i mthus/ /bla ma gdan 'dren nus par shog /yul du bla ma byon pa'i mthus/ /yul phyogs bde zhing skyid par 297

shog /yul gyi gdul bya'i 'dzin ma la/ /lhun grub chos char 'bebs par shog /kun gyis gsung bzhin nyams blangs nas/ /sangs rgyas go 'phang 'thob par shog /ces zhu ba nan tan byas pa'i ngor rma rgyal gangs nas lo gcig las mi 'dug par yul du 'ong ba'i khas len byas pas kho cung zad dga' ba byung / de'i dus zhabs drung tshang gi yon bdag dad can zhig gis khyed yul du lo mang por ma song na/ khyed kyi ma yi sems la bu de na ba 'am shi nas mo la 'di tshos gsang ba yin nam snyam mod zer ba'i lan du/ don la nga na nas shi ba dang khyad med ces rnal 'byor na shi ro bsreg byas tshul gyi mgur 'di blangs so//yon tan thams cad rab rdzogs pa'i/ /chos rgyal ngag gi dbang po yi/ /zhabs la gus pas gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag 'dzin 'chi bar byen gyis rlobs/ /rdzogs pa chen po'i rnal 'byor pa/ /bya btang tshogs drug rang grol nga / /na bas mi tshad shi yang shi/ /na shi ro bsreg byas tshul rnams/ /khyod la legs par bshad kyis nyon/ /nga bdag 'dzin sems kyi phung po la/ /bla ma'i byen rlabs nad kyis btab/ /rang rig 'gyur med gdon gyis zin/ /nyams dang rtogs pa'i zug 298

gzer langs/ /kha nas mgur dbyangs 'khun bu shog /'jig rten chos brgyad kha zas 'gag /dam chos rdzogs chen nyal sar lhung / /na bas mi tshad shi yang shi/ /rang rig ye shes gdon gyis ni/ /'chor med ting 'dzin zhags pas bcings/ /yang dag lta ba'i mtshon cha yis/ /bdag 'dzin phung po'i srog bcad tshe/ /zhe sdang lus drod mtha' nas shor/ /'dod chags kha chu sna chu 'dzag /gti mug mgo bo thur du gug /nga rgyal rkang lag ngar ngar g.yob/ /phrag dog dbugs kyi 'gyu ba chad/ /skye med chos sku'i klong du shi/ /shi bas mi tshad ro yang bsregs/ /shar grol dus mnyam skyes bu yis/ /mnyam nyid zang thal thang thog tu/ /chos kyi dbyengs kyi gdung khang brtsigs/ /zhi gnas brtan po'i yam shing bzhag /ye shes lnga yi me sbar bas/ /ma rig dug lnga'i bem po bsregs/ /rus pa skyes med sa ru bskyal/ /kun tu bzang po'i dur du sbas/ /zhes blangs pas kho'i dad pa ches gong 'phel du gyur to/ /de nas bde chen gar dbang rtsal la sba dbyug btags grol zhal gdams bcas byin te/ sgo me'i phyogs nas dben par sgrub pa snying por gyis zhes der mngags pas/ rjes nas sgom chen gangs kyi seng ge 'dra ba bsgrubs 'bras kyis bstan 299

'gror phan thogs pa zhig byung / mdzo dge'i mtshams pa kun bzang 'gyur med dang kun bzang rang grol/ rab 'byams pa kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ dge slong bstan dar/ mang ne ban+de sogs mtshams pa dgu tsam zhig la 'tsho chas bzang po byin te bkod pa rgyas par byas nas mtsho snying du sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin du bcug grub dbang pad+ma rang grol slar yang rang yul reb gong du nga'i sku tshab tu btang nas/ reb gong gi dad can slob ma yon bdag rnams la yi ge 'di ltar btang /nga yi mgon skyabs chos kyi rgyal por 'dud/ /nga dang 'brel tshad rnams la thugs rjes gzigs/ /nga la re ltos rang yul dad can rnams/ /nga yi bu mchog pad+ma rang grol 'di/ /nga dang khyad par med kyi mchod bstod bkur/ /nga la ma phrad bar du khyed rnams kyis/ /nga yi mgur dbyangs gang bskur nang ltar gyis/ /nga dang phrad kyang de min lab rgyu med/ /nga shi song yang kha chems 'di min med/ /nga ni nyams len gang 'phel gnas su 'gro /nga yi grogs rnams tshe 'di blos thongs la/ /nga bzhin gyis dang gtan du bde bar 'gyur/ /zhes bskur zhing bu chen pad+ma rang grol la 'di skad bshad/ 'o ngas mgur dbyangs blangs pa rnams kyang / rang blor gang shar bris pa ma 300

yin par rgyal ba'i gsung rab thams cad gdams par shar ba'i jo bo yab sras kyi gsung bka' gdams glegs bam dang /thugs rje chen po'i sprul pa chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i gsung ma ṇi bka' 'bum dang / rje mi la'i mgur 'bum/'jam dbyangs sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta'i legs bshad/ rje rin po che'i lam rim/ kun mkhyen klong chen pa'i mgur dang / rje btsun skal ldan rgya mtsho'i mgur sogs sngon byon skyes bu dam pa rnams kyi gsung ltar blangs pa yin pas/ blo ldan khyod kyis tshad mar zungs la/ gzhan la spel dang dad can gyi skye bo pho mo chos la bskul ba'i thabs su 'gro ba yin zhes sngar mgur dbyangs stong phrag gcig blangs pa'i po ti rnams byin nas 'phral phugs gang du'ang phan pa'i bslab bya mang po byas te/'gro khar bu slob 'gro mkhan kun la tshe 'di phyir mjal ba'i sgon lam gye mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so//bdag spyi gtsug rgyan mchog yid bzhin nor/ /pha drin can bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /nged dpon slob gar song bkra shis shing / /gang bsam don 'grub par byin gyes rlobs/ /rje khyad 'phags 'ga' yi drung ngas bsnyegs//grogs khyad 'phags 'ga' dang lhan cig tu/ /chos khyad 'phags 'ga' rer thos 301

bsam byas/ /gnas khyad 'phags 'ga' bsten bsgoms byas pa/ /khyed rnams thos thos tshe dad gus skyes/ /sems 'gro 'dod 'dod pa gting nas skyes/ /gzhan mi mang mang pos bshol btab kyang / /khar ma nyan nyan na chos nyan snyam/ /dus na ning da tsam gnas 'dir yong / /mi ngas kyang shes tshod dam chos bshad/ /khyed rnams kyis lo gcig nyams su blangs/ /da so sor 'gro yang skal ba bzang / /tshe yun thung rkyen ngan bar chad mang / /tshe tshad kyang ci yod mi shes pas/ /tshe blos thongs ri khrod zhwa ltar sten/ /tshe sgrub pa snyoms dgos bu slob tsho/ /tshe bar chad med par dpon slob rnams/ /tshe 'di ru da dung mjal bar smon/ /tshe 'di ru gal te ma mjal na/ /tshe phyi mar cis kyang mjal bar smon/ /sngar ma song ba yi zhing du 'gro /sngar ma mjal ba yi sangs rgyas mjal/ /sngar ma thos pa yi dam chos nyan/ /sngar ma mthong ba yi ltad mo blta/ /da khyed rnams sku khams bde bar bzhud/ /mi nga ni dben gnas gang dgar 'gro /phyis nged rnams bkra shis chos mthun sgos/ /zhal mjal ba'i smon 'dun yang dag 'tshal/ /zhes blangs pa'i lan du bu chen pad+ma rang grol gyis 'di skad ces zer ro/sku legs pa'i spyod pa 'ba' zhig byed/ /gsung legs 302

bshad chos kyi sgra dbyangs sgrog /thugs legs pa'i nye ring chags sdang med/ /pha legs tshogs 'byung gnas bdag la dgongs/ /nga tshe 'di'i bya bas rtag g.yengs tshe/ /tshe mi rtag 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs gsungs/ /gsung de thos mi nor zas gathum spangs/ /spang me tog bkra ba'i rtse gzhung du/ /rje chos rgyal gsung gi bdud rtsi myang / /mgon khyod zhabs lo gcig bar du bsten/ /skabs de ru yab sras zhal mthun par/ /yul reb gong bkra shis 'khyil du song / /chos sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan zungs shig gsungs/ /nga der song lo gsum zla bcu bsdad/ /rang gang nus bsgrub pa'i mchod pa phul/ /gzhan dad can rnam dkar dge la bkod/ /de'i skabs su chos rgyal gshegs pas skyo/ /mgon khyod la mjal 'dod gting nas skyes/ /dus na ning khyed la mjal du yong / /dpe ma bu phrad 'dra'i dga' spro shar/ /lo gcig la lus dang grib bzhin 'grogs/ /rang smin grol zab rgya'i gdams pa thob/ /dus da lo skal pa shin tu bzang / /gzhan mngon mtho nges legs la 'god pa'i/ /mgur mang po gnang ba ngo mtshar che/ /nga slar yang reb gong phyogs su 'gro /pha bla ma sku khams bde bar bzhugs/ /bu bdag dang grwa slob grogs mched dang / /rang yul phyogs re 303

ltos byed pa rnams/ /thugs brtse bas nam yang mi 'dor zhu/ /mgon khyod min re sa gzhan na med/ /zhal ring min myur du mjal bar smon/ /rang smon pa bzhin du 'grub par shog /ces phul nas lus kyi ba spu g.yo zhing mig nas mchi ma 'khrugs pa'i dad gus kyi ngang la phyi 'gros byas skye ba nas tshe rabs thams cad du mi 'bral ba'i smon lam 'debs shing sems 'phreng bzhin du phebs song ngo / /khong rnams song ba'i rjes nas sems la sngar med pa'i skyo shas dang nges 'byung skyes te nang nas kyang sdod snying ma 'dod par 'gro 'dod pa zhig byung nas/ mtsho snying la skor bar song ba'i tshe/ sngon bla ma chos rgyal yab yum sras blon mched grogs dang bcas pa tshogs nas chos dang 'jig rten mi chos kyi gsung gleng du ma byas tshul rnams yid la dran nas/ dus da lta bzhugs na ci ma rung / mjal du song na dga' ba la snyam bla ma dran pas skyo shas tshad las 'das pa zhig skyes te mchi ma mang po gtong bzhin pa'i ngang nas/ bla ma dran drug gi mgur 'di blangs so//dbus rab brjid ri rab lhun po'i lho/ /lho 'dzam bu gling pa rnams kyi byang / /byang phyogs kyi gangs can bod kyi sa/ /sa bde la yangs pa'i rtse gzhung gi /spang me tog bkra ba'i ljongs 304

shig na/ /mdog gangs ri ltar dkar gzims gur na/ /khra shigs se 'khor 'bangs 'tshogs gong na/ /gdan 'jam mdzes brtsegs pa'i khri steng na/ /rje 'gran gyis do med rin po che/ /sku mthong na yid la dga' bde 'char/ /su mdun du song yang 'bral mi phod/ /pha chos rgyal bzhugs tshul yid la shar/ /'jam ldem me nyan pa'i 'khor bzang la/ /gsung lhang lhang byon tshul yid la shar/ /pha gzhan las lhag pa'i ngag dbang wang / /dus da lta bzhugs na dga' ba la/ /nga mos gus chung rung mjal snying 'dod/ /sa thag ring yin yang mjal snying 'dod/ /ngas bsam zhing pha rgan chos rgyal dran/ /yum 'khor bcas 'tshogs pa dran nas byung / /gdan 'jam mjes brtsegs pa'i g.yon phyogs na/ /sku rab mdzes blta bas mi ngoms pa/ /lha'i bu mo mi yul 'phos 'dra ba'i/ /yum a r+pā bzhugs tshul yid la shar/ /'khor mi bzang sre sdod mang po la/ /gsung snyan mo byon tshul yid la shar/ /yum ma las lhag pa'i a r+pā de/ /dus da lta bzhugs na dga' ba la/ /nga dung sems chung rung mjal snying 'dod/ /lam bgrod par dka' yang mjal snying 'dod/ /ngas bsam zhing pha rgan chos rgyal dran/ /yum 'khor bcas 'tshogs pa dran nas byung / /phyogs 305

phyogs nas phebs pa'i skyes chen dang / /mi bdag dang bdag 'dra'i dad 'dus rnams/ /thugs brtse ba chen pos rjes bzung nas/ /chos gsang chen rdo rje theg pa yis/ /rgyud smin par byed pa'i dbang bzhi de/ /skabs skabs subaskur tshul yid la shar//chos rdo rje theg pa'i dbang bzhi de/ /dus da lta bskur na dga' ba la/ /nga zhabs tog chung rung zhu snying 'dod/ /yon 'bul rgyu med rung zhu snying 'dod/ /ngas bsam zhing pha rgan chos rgyal dran/ /yum 'khor bcas 'tshogs pa dran nas byung / /sus thos kyang ngan 'gror ltung mi srid/ /tshig re re'ang bskal brgyar thos dka' ba'i/ /rgyud grol bar byed pa'i gsang sngags kyi/ /chos bskyed rdzogs rdzogs pa chen po yi/ /khrid zab mo gnang tshul yid la shar/ /chos bskyed rdzogs rdzogs pa chen po'i khrid/ /dus da lta gsung na dga' ba la/ /nga shes rab chung rung nyan snying 'dod/ /sgom brtson 'grus zhan rung bsgom snying 'dod/ /ngas bsam zhing pha rgan chos rgyal dran/ /yum 'khor bcas 'tshogs pa dran nas byung / /phyogs phyogs nas yong ba'i skyes chen dang / /sa sog po'i mched grogs dad 'dus la/ /skabs skabs su ma bu phrad pa bzhin/ /sems spro ba'i gleng mo mang po byas/ /lhan cig tu bsdad tshul yid la 306

shar/ /yul thag ring nas 'ong dam pa dang / /sa soka po'i mched grogs dad 'dus de/ /dus da lta bzhugs na dga' ba la/ /nga brtse gdung chung rung mjal snying 'dod/ /gnas gang na bzhugs kyang mjal snying 'dod/ /ngas bsam zhing pha rgan chos rgyal dran/ /yum 'khor bcas 'tshogs pa dran nas byung / /dpe tshong 'dus mgon bzhin yud tsam la/ /sa sog por tshogs nas so sor bral/ /pha chos rgyal zhing khams gzhan du gshegs/ /grogs dam gtsang so so rang yul phebs/ /nga skal dman mtsho snying ri la lus/ /chos 'jig rten dga' ston myang 'phro chad/ /ngas bsam zhing pha rgan chos rgyal dran/ /yum 'khor bcas 'tshogs pa dran nas byung / /pha chos rgyal snying nas dran pa yi/ /sems 'dod pas gdungs nas bzod glags med/ /dbugs stod du 'tshangs nas skad ma thon/ /gdong mig nas mchi ma dbang med shor/ /bus pha ma 'bod 'dra'i gdungs dbyangs la/ /phas gar bzhugs zhing nas gsan lags sam/ /ma bzang mo bu la brtse ba bzhin/ /bur ye shes spyan gyis rgyang nas gzigs/ /zhes blangs nas mang po ngus pas/ mtshan mo rmi lam du/ dpon tshang gi urge ru slebs nas/ khong gi zhabs phyi sngar ngo shes pa rnams kyis bsus nas 307

gzims gur chen mo'i nang du song bas/ chos rgyal rin po che yab yum sras blon 'bangs mched grogs rdo rje'i spun rnams dang bcas pa sngar rgyun ltar 'tshogs pa mthong bas/ dga' ba tshad med pa skyes te rab tu gus pa'i sgo nas chos rgyal rin po che la phyag 'tshal nas mjal bas/ khong gis sngar rgyun ltar zhal 'dzum zhing bzhad bzhin pa'i ngos nas/ ri khrod pa khyod kyis nged rnams dran nas 'dir lan cig 'ong ste da res phrad pa bzang / da 'dir ga le gyis la skyid por sdod gsungs nas/khong gi thag nyer bzhag nas bsdad pa'i tshe/ sde pas ston mo chen po zhig byas te mi mang 'tshogs pa'i gral gsham du/gzhon nu gnyis re yar langs nas skad 'dril byas te bod glu mang po blangs pas tshig 'bru bzang zhing skad snyan la ring ba byung / skabs shig sog glu blangs pa'i rjes su/ du ral dbon po zer bas gos chen zhig gyon/ zhwa mo lcags mda' ma ja la bzang po can zhig mgo la gyon te/ gral dbus nas yar langs bod pa'i gzhas btang nas zhabs bro brgyab pas der 'tshogs pa thams cad bgad pas/ nga yang ngo mtshar zhing dga' nas shed kyis bgad pas rkyen byas te gnyid las sad pa byung ba'i dus su yang sems dga' ya le ba zhig byung / de 308

nas zla ba dang po'i mjug tu bdag mtsho snying nas ri bo rma chen du 'gro khar/ der 'dus pa'i skal ldan snying gi slob bu rnams la tshogs shig btang ba'i thog nas/ 'o nged rnams sngon gyi las smon dag pas mtshams sbyar ba'i mthus thams cad su yis ma bos bzhin du rang 'dus brgyab nas lo re gnyis kyi bar la lhan du bsdad de/ da ni so sor gyes nas 'gro ba 'di bzhin du/chos thams cad mi rtag pa 'di'i rang bzhin yin tshul soms la/ dngos po gang la yang ma chags ma zhen par thams cad chos phyogs su thongs/ khyad par da lo ma gtogs khyed rnams kyang gnas 'dir gtan du mi sdod pas sdod ring la/ khyed rnams kyi la la ltogs pa dang / la la 'grangs pa ma byed par ston dgun gyi mtshams la bro kha yod pas med pa tshor byen la skyid sdug snyoms po gyis/ thams cad gcig gis gcig la spun zla bzhin brtse gdung gi sgo nas 'grogs la rang nyid gang mos kyi chos nyams su len pa la nyin mtshan med par 'bad pa gal che zhes rnal 'byor 'gro kha'i mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so//rje bla ma dkon mchog rin po che/ /bu 'dir bzhugs sgo gsum byin gyis rlobs/ /gnas mtsho snying dben pa'i gzhi bdag kun/ /gnas 'dir bzhugs rnams la stongs grogs 309

mdzod/ /khyed dwangs bsil rgya mtsho bde bar bzhugs/ /nga ngang pa ser po 'dab gshog brgyangs/ /gzhan pad+mas brgyan pa'i mtsho khar 'gro /slar skad snyan sgog bzhin 'ong bar smon/ /khyed dpag bsam ljon shing bde bar bzhugs/ /nga 'jol mo smug ril gshog chung brgyangs/ /gzhan sngo ljang nags tshal nyams dgar 'gro /slar skad snyan sgog bzhin 'ong bar smon/ /khyed dad can bu rnams bde bar bzhugs/ /nga rnal 'byor ras pa sba dbyug thogs/ /gzhan dben pa'i dga' tshal nyams dgar 'gro /slar mgur dbyangs len bzhin 'ong bar smon/ /khyed chos mthun snying gi bu rnams la/ /da 'gro khar mang po smra ci dgos/ /sngar nga yis gang smras bzhin du gyis/ /'phral bde zhing phugs su sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /glu 'di nyid blangs pa'i dge ba'i mthus/ /bu bya btang ri pa thams cad la/ /gnas dben par 'gal rkyen mi 'byung bar/ /chos nyams len skal ba ldan par shog /ces blangs pa'i lan du slob bu kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis bde zhus skyabs 'jug gi dbyangs 'di phul/rnam 'dren rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob mi la yi/ /rnam thar dri med ji bzhin legs skyong ba'i/ /rnam dkar dge legs ma 310

lus 'byung ba'i gzhi/ /rnam kun bdag gi skyabs mgom bla ma la/ /rab rmongs phran chung slob bu'i tha shal ba/ /rab byung rtags 'dzin kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyes/ /rab mdzes sor bcu'i 'dab ma 'byed zum byas/ /rab gus phyag dang bcas te bde zhus zhu/ /khyed sku g.yu 'brug sngon mo bde mor lags/ /slar yang bdag gzhan pad tshal mgon du byon/ /nyam chung pad+ma ser bas ma brdungs na/ /'dab brgyangs phang phung g.yo bzhin legs par bsu/ /khyed sku g.yu 'brug sngon mo bde mor lags/ /slar yang bdag gzhan rma bya'i mgon du byon/ /nyam chung rma bya rgya khras ma bzung na/ /gshog brgyangs gar stabs byed bzhin legs par bsu/ /khyed sku rab mdzes gzhon nu bde mor lags/ /slar yang bdag gzhan grwa slob mgon du byon/ /nyam chung grwa slob na 'chis ma bcom na/ /lag brkyangs phyag mang 'tshal bzhin legs par bsu/ /phyogs 'di'i grwa slob yon bdag 'brel tshad kun/ /deng nas bzung ste byang chub ma thob bar/ /mgon po khyod kyis rtag tu rjes bzung nas/ /mthar thug rnam mkhyen 'thob pa'i skyabs 'jug zhu/ /bslu med bla ma mchog gsum byin rlabs dang / /'di ltar bde zhus skyabs 'jug zhus pa'i mthus/ /da dung bdag gis bla ma yun 311

ring bsten/ /tshe dang sgrub pa snyoms nas 'tshang rgya shog /ces phul ba'i mthar der 'tshogs pa'i slob ma yon bdag gnas skor ba rnams kyis bskyal nas 'gro ba'i tshe/ mtsho snying gi ri rtse nas bsang btang ba lta bu'i sprin sngon po kha dog mjes pa zhig nam mkhar song ste gdugs ltar chags pa'i nang nas kha ba pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi ba dang lnga ba 'dra ba mang po babs/ de yul lha mnyes nas me tog gi char ba phab pa red snyam/ so sor gyes khar slob bu kun bzang rang grol mang po ngus pas/ der 'tshogs pa'i gnas skor ba sems chung ba dad pa can kun mig nas mchi ma 'khrugs bzhin bsdad/ ngas phyi mig lta bzhin gnas dang der 'dug pa rnams la sems 'phreng bzhin 'ongs so//smras pa/ chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong gsung ba po/ /chos kyi rgyal po mnyam med zas gtsang sras/ /chos mdzad bdag gi spyi bo'i rgyan du bzhugs/ /chos kun sems la 'char bar byen gyis rlobs/ /phyi rabs dad ldan dang ba 'dren pa dang / /bstan 'gro'i mig rkyen mchog tu 'gro ba'i phyir/ /mtsho snying dben par sgrub pa byas pa'i tshul/ /slar yang glu ru len gyis dga' bas nyon/ /bka' drin mtshungs med chos rgyal rin po 312

ches/ /bstan dang 'gro ba'i don chen mdzad par dgongs/ /rang gi sras po bkra shis 'byung gnas de/ /rgyal sar bton nas khong rang ri khrod du/ /bzhugs rtsis gnang bas a bī blon 'bangs kun/ /gros byas bshol btab bzhugs su ma bcug pas/ /blon po 'ga' res bdag gis ri khrod du/ /phebs bsgul byas pa yin snyam ma dga'i gtam/ /smras tshe ngas kyang blon pos 'di zer dus/ /bsdad na mi bzang 'gro dgos snyam pa byung / /khong yang thugs skyo de yi phyi nyin nas/ /legs bshad brtsams shing kun la bka' chos gnang / /ngas kyang mtsho snying dben par 'gro snyam nas/ /dgongs pa zhus pas dgyes bzhin gnang ba byung / /de nas re zhig bar du dpon slob gnyis/ /mtshams la bsdad nas gsung bgros mang po gnang / /phyag tham zhal gdams zhus nas 'gro kha ru/ /a r+pā'i mdun du song nas rgyu mtshan zhus/ /yum gyis sems la phan pa'i zhal ta gnang / /'gro ba'i snga nyin dgong mo phyag skor byas/ /gzims gur nang du song nas bsdad pa'i tshe/ /khong gis dngul dang kha btags mang po zhig /gnang ba phyir phul phyag 'tshal skyabs 'jug zhus/ /nangs par sngar bar bzhengs nas gsol ja bzhes/ /bzhes 'phro nga la gnang nas 'thungs 313

tshar tshe/ /'di ru shog gsung mgo la phyag bzhag nas/ /byin rlabs gnang mthar rab tu brtse ba'i sgos/ /zhal gdams kun gyi tha ma'i gsung mgur gnang / /ngas kyang mdun du bde zhus tshig 'ga' phul/ /so sor gyes khar 'bral glags ma phod par/ /mang po ngus pas khong yang spyan chab shor/ /thugs gtsigs che ba'i 'ja' shel bdag la gnang / /sems sdug mi dgos pha bu phrad yong gsungs/ /gzims gur sgo ru thon tshe khong gis ngar/ /gzigs pa mthong bas 'gro yang ma phod par/ /zhal ras la bltas cung zad tsam zhig bsdad/ /de nas gur la g.yas skor zhig byas nas/ /yum sras blon bcas bde zhus byas pa'i mthar/ /lam la zhugs nas urge nam mthong bar/ /kha phyir phyogs nas phyi mig lta bzhin 'ong / /ma mthong ba dang 'gro yang ma phod par/ /phyir 'ong urge mthong sa zhig nas bsdad/ /tshe rabs kun tu mjal ba'i smon lam btab/ /de yi nyin par sems sdug tshad med byung / /rjes su mi mjal snga bltas yin nam snyam/ /de nas rtse gzhung dben pa'i gnas su song / /zhag po kha shas bar du mched grogs dang / /mnyam du bsdad nas phan tshun snying gtam smras/ /'gro ba'i nangs par kun gyis skyel thung byas/ /dag ge rigs ldan la sogs 314

mched grogs la/ /brtse gdung gtam dang bde zhus mgur dbyangs blangs/ /phan tshun brtse zhing dung ba'i ngang nyid nas/ /bral nas song tshul da dung yid la shar/ /de nas skyel mi nged gnyis tshur la 'ong / /nyin mja'i lung pa'i nang du song nas bsdad/ /za ma mi theg pa rnams mchod sbyin btang / /de nas rim bzhin mtsho snying dben pa ru/ /'gro ba'i lam nas chos bshad mgur dbyangs blangs/ /dad can snang ba dam pa'i chos la bsgyur/ /mtsho snying dben par slebs nas gnas bstod byas/ /khri gshog rgyal mo dgyes pa'i rmi lam byung / /yi dam bskyed rim sprul bsgyur sna tshogs byas/ /phyi rol las snang dag pas cir yang mthong / /rje btsun bstan 'dzin nyi mar bka' chos zhus/ /dpon slob thugs yid gcig tu 'dres pa byung / /dngos nyams rmi lam skabs su bla ma dang / /lhag pa'i lha rnams zhal mjal gsung chos thos/ /slob ma rnams kyi las sgrib dag pa'i phyir/ /thugs rje chen po'i lha khang zhig kyang bzhengs/ /rang gzhan rgyud la phan pa'i mgur dbyangs blangs/ /nam mkha'i lhas kyang tshor nas ngo mtshar skyes/ /'gro khar der bzhugs bu slob thams cad la/ /chos kyi mthun rkyen byin nas bslab bya byas/ /mthar ni mi rtag tshong 'dus bzhin du gyes/ /315

de nas bzung ste 'phrad rgyu ma byung ba/ /phan tshun gcig gcig dran pa'i yul du song / /mdor na mtsho snying dben par bsgrub la gzhol/ /ting 'dzin mang po'i sgo phyes lha zhal mjal/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi rnam thar de ltar lags/ /rjes 'jug rnams kyang de bzhin skyong bar mdzod/ /glu 'di thos tshad skye bo pho mo yis/ /tshe rabs kun tu bla ma'i rnam thar bzhin/ /dben pa'i gnas su ting 'dzin sgo brgya phyes/ /ngo mtshar lha zhal mang po mjal bar shog /ces pa'ang bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o//316

rma chen sbom ra nas sgrub pa byas tshul/bdun pa sa bcu'i dbang phyug rma chen sbom ra'i gnas su song nas sgrub pa byas tshul ni/ rje btsun skal ldan rgya mtsho'i mgur las/ klu byang chub sems dpa' gnas pa'i mtsho/ /mtsho sngon po khri gshog rgyal mo de/ /dus dgun gsum dar dkar na bza' gsol/ /dar dkar po'i lam de lha yi lam/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dkar po zhes pa sa mo sbrul gyi lo'i mchu zla'i phyogs phyi mar bkra shis g.yang kun chags pa'i mtsho kha'i dar dkar po'i lam la 'ong ba'i tshe/ lham gyis rkang ba bshus tshe ras zhig yod na snyam nas su la e yod dris pas mi 'dugangs rtsed mo lta bur/ a ma mtsho sman rgyal mo zhes bos te/ nga'i rkang ba lham gyis bshus nas 'gro mi thub par 'dug pas/ ras kha gang do tsam zhig gnongs byas pas/ de nas mar song bas ras dmar po kha do rlung gis bskyod nas sngon du byung ba kun gyes mthong nas/ mtsho sman rgyal mos gnang ba yin par 'dug snyam/ thams cad ya mtshan pa zhig byung / de nas mtsho yi phyi rol tu thon mtsher ba ri nas ja bskol te gung tshigs blangs/317

de'i nyin par sog po ba ge tshang gi nang du song / de na slob bu sman pa mkhas pa zhig yod pa des/ ngas khyim pa rnams la phan pa'i mgur dbyangs blangs pa mgur tshan sum cu tsam zhig sog yig tu bsgyur te bshad/ khos lo tsā ba byas/ ngas chos bshad pa rnams kyang sog skad du bsgyur nas bshad pas phyogs de'i sog po'i yon bdag pho mo dad can kun gyi snang ba dam pa'i chos la 'gyur ba byung / rta nor gser dngul gos dar sogs rgyu nor mang po byin kyang bsngo ba dang smon lam byas nas ma blangs par phyir byin/ yon bdag ba ge nang mi rnams kyis rta gcig byin pa mi 'khyer byas rung ma nyan par blangs nas mtsho skor la 'gro dus gon pa dang bro chas bkal nas khyer te mtsho skor byas tshar ba dang phyir bskur/ 'gro khar sba dbyug lag tu thogs yar langs nas/ dbyangs snyan la ring ba byas te mgur dbyangs 'di ltar 'then no//rje bla mas yon bdag pho mo la/ /thugs brtse bas gzigs la byin gyis rlobs/ /nga reb gong phyogs nas 'khyams pa la/ /khyed yon bdag pho mo bka' drin che/ /da dad can yon bdag bde bar bzhugs/ /mi nga ni ri khrod dben par 'gro /nged yon mchod so sor gyes pa bzhin/ /chos thams cad mi rtag 318

'di dang 'dra/ /nor zas gos gang la'ang ma chags par/ /chos gang nus sgrubs shig yon bdag tsho/ /mi ngas kyang mi brjed sems la 'dzin/ /'phral phugs gnyis gang la'ang e phan blta/ /tshe 'di ru da dung mjal bar smon/ /tshe 'di ru gal te ma mjal na/ /tshe phyi mar cis kyang mjal bar smon/ /yid smon pa bzhin du 'grub par shog /ces pa dang / yang /steng mtho la yangs pa'i lha lam gyi/ /khyed nyi zla gza' skar bde bar bzhugs/ /nga g.yu 'brug sngon mo rdza rir 'gro /slar sgra dbyangs sgrog bzhig slebs nas 'ong / /sa bde la yangs pa'i skyel tshal gyi/ /khyed tsan dan ljon shing bde bar bzhugs/ /nga khu byug sngon mo gzhan du 'gro /slar skad snyan sgrog bzhin slebs nas 'ong / /mtsho bkra shis g.yang chags khor yug gi /khyed dad can yon bdag bde bar bzhugs/ /nga rnal 'byor rma rgyal gangs la 'gro /slar mgur dbyangs len bzhin slebs nas 'ong / /zhal mjal dus dge legs bkra shis shog /bkra shis pa'i phyogs 'dir khyab gyur cig /ces blangs/ de dus nga na so gzhon skabs yin gshis skad gdangs shin tu snyan pas/ sog mo rnams kyis don ma go yang skad kyi gdangs la nyan pas kyang sems 'gul nas mchi ma 319

gtong mkhan mang po byung / thams cad dad nas phyag dang skor ba du ma byas/ /de'i lan du slob bu sman pa mkhas pa dad can des slar phebs dgos tshul rgyas par zhus nas mjug tu bka' drin gtang rag gi dbyangs 'di yang phul byung /rje mtshan ldan bla ma rin po che/ /nor zang zing 'bul bar mi blta bar/ /nged mtsho sngon phyogs kyi skya ser kun/ /blo chos la bsgyur ba bka' drin che/ /da khyed sku nyi ma bde bar phebs/ /nged pad tshal rgyang na gnas kyang skyongs/ /mgon khyod kyi gsung bzhin chos bsgrubs nas/ /mchog sangs rgyas 'thob par byin gyis rlobs/ /mtsho bkra shis g.yang chags sa phyogs 'dir/ /khyed yang yang phebs zhes gsol ba 'debs/ /rje bla mar phyogs 'di'i 'brel thogs kun/ /dus yang yang mjal ba'i smon lam 'tshal/ /zhes phul nas kun kyis sems 'phreng 'bral ma phod par mig nas mchi ma g.yo bzhin yun ring gi sar bskyal bas/ de nas khong rnams la da thams cad phyir log dang nga yang phyir myur du yong zhes smras pas/ kun gyis skye ba nas tshe rabs thams cad du mjal ba'i smon lam btab nas re zhig nga nam mthong gi bar du 'gro ma phod par bsdad/ de nas sems 'phreng bzhin du le lo'i 320

'gros kyis rang rang gi yul du song nas sdig spong dge bsgrub la gzhol bar gyur to/ /de nas nged dpon slob rnams kyis mtsho la g.yas bskor byas te mtsho nyin du song nas a rig gi thad ga'i mtsho 'gram nas bsdad pas/ a rig gi rgad po dad can zhig pho nad kyis na nas sang 'chi gnangs 'chi la thug pa zhig gi bu yong nas nga'i pha la do nub rgyangs 'pho zhig thugs rjes gzigs zer bas/ der ngas mi nyal rgyab la 'pho ba brgyab yong de dus khyed kyi rgad po la dad pa gyis shod ces 'pho ba btab pa'i tshe/ rgad po'i snang ba la/ mi nag bo zhig 'ongs te gsang ba nas lcags kyi sbu gu zhig btsugs nas 'khyags sib sib yar lte ba'i bar du byung dus/ khong phebs byung bas mi nag pos sbu gu brgyab pa phyir phyung nas bros song ba'i tshe/khong gis zangs kyi sbu gu zhig spyi gtsug nas lte ba'i bar du btsugs pas/ lus thams cad bde bas gang ba'i snang ba zhig byung zer ba'i 'phro la chen po ma bsdad par dbugs chad song bas/ de dus ngas 'pho ba byas pa dang gnyis ka dus mtshungs pa/ khong tshang la bla rgan zhig yod pa der dad pa skyes nas/ ja mar rtsam pa sogs bsngo 'brel mtshon pa zhig khyer 'ong ste rgyu mtshan rnams zhus/ 'chi khar khong lta bu'i bla ma re 321

dang phrad par shog ces smon lam 'debs bzhin yul du song /yang mtsho skor byas song bas a rig dang sog po'i mjal ba mang po byung / thams cad la sngar rgyun ltar chos bshad mgur dbyangs blangs pas rab tu dad pas rta nor mang po phul kyang ma blangs/ yang sa phyogs thag ring zhig nas sog po zhig rkang btsugs te mjal du byung nas/ mjal rten du rta bzang po sga stan srab gsum dang bcas te byin pa ma blangs kyang bzhag nas song bas/ de'i phyi nyin 'jigs med r+pā la'i yin zer ba'i sprang po cang med nyam thag ma bu lnga tsam zhig 'ong ba dang phrad de slong mo byas tshe ngas snying rje drags nas rta'i srab mda' lag tu bzhag ste/ khyod la byen pa yin byas tshe/ kho yid ma ches par/ khong gis sku rtsed byas pa min nam zer/ de min nges par byin pa yin khyer chog byas pas/ khong ma bu rnams kyis phyag 'tshal zhing mjal nas dga' zhing spro bzhin du khyer nas song ngo / /de nas mtsho mgo bskor nas tshur mtsho srib tu 'ongs pas/ zhabs drung tshang gi bud med gzhon nu ma zhig la rgya rma byung ste lo gcig tsam song ba lce chad nas 'chi ma thub par 'dug pa zhig la 'pho ba btab pas/ de'i 'phro la ja yun gcig tsam las ma 'gor bar tshe'i dus byas pas/ rta sga stan 322

srab gsum bcas phul bas de blangs nas/ rgyu nor gang yang med pa'i mang ne'i rgad po zer ba zhig la byin/ de nas rgan mo 'chi la nye ba zhig gis 'pho lung zhus pas/ ngas 'pho ba brgyab pa'i tshe/ mo dran med du 'gyel ba byung / slar dran pa sos nas bus a ma'i drin gzo ru dmigs te rta zhig byen pa mdzo dge'i phyogs nas 'khyams 'ong ba'i grwa pa ci yang med pa zhig la byin/de ltar pho ba brgyab cing chos bshad pa dang mgur dbyangs blangs pa go tshe/ zhabs drung tshang gi skyes pho mo dad can thams cad mjal du 'ong / ngas thams cad la 'chi ba mi rtag pa dang las rgyu 'bras kyi chos bshad pas thams cad kyi nang nas sdig pa spong mkhan dang / dge ba bsgrub pa'i khas len byed pa mang du byung / de dus zhabs drung gi sde ba dar yod pa'i dus yin pas rgyu nom len rgyu yin na mang bo ster bar 'dug ste gtan nas ma blangs/ blangs pa rnams kyang sprang por byen tshe yon bdag 'ga' zhig gis/ sprang po rnams la rta ster mkhan gye bla ma khong ma gtogs sngar yang ma byon/ da dung yang mi 'byon zhes bstod bsngags kyi me tog kyang 'thor/ de nas yon bdag rnying ba gnyis la g.yag gnyis g.yar te bro kha bkal nas mang ne'i rgad po dang / mdzo dge'i grwa pa gnyis kyis bskyal nas 323

'gro khar yon bdag pho mo der 'tshogs pa rnams la bde zhus kyi mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so//mchog thun mong dgos 'dod kun mnga' ba'i/ /rje mtshan ldan bla ma yid bzhin nor/ /sprang bdag gi spyi gtsug bde chen rgyan/ /rgyan de la snying nas gsol ba 'debs/ /mi 'dir 'tshogs yon bdag pho mo la/ /tshe 'di phyir skyid pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /khyed me tog pad tshal bde bar bzhugs/ /nga nyi ma mi sdod chas nas 'gro /sprin smug po dgra ru ma langs na/ /slar 'od stong 'gyed bzhin 'ong bar nges/ /khyed pad tshal ser bas ma bcom na/ /kun 'dzum bzhin bzhad nas bsu ba gyis/ /khyed ku mud tshal rnams bde bar bzhugs/ /nga zla ba mi sdod chas nas 'gro /gza' khyab 'jug dgra ru ma langs na/ /slar 'od dkar 'gyed bzhin 'ong bar nges/ /khyed ku mud kha bas ma non na/ /kun sdem ldem gar gyes bsu ba gyis/ /khyed yon bdag pho mo bde bar bzhugs/ /nga rnal 'byor mi sdod chas nas 'gro /na 'chi ba dgra ru ma langs na/ /slar sba dbyug thogs nas 'ong bar nges/ /khyed yon bdag pho mo ma shi na/ /kun sngon du brgyugs nas bsu ba gyes/ /nga dam chos bsgrub pa'i rnal 'byor dang //khyed 'tsho ba sbyor ba'i yon bdag 324

gnyis/ /sangs mnyam por rgya ba'i rten 'brel yod/ /da khyed rnams dga' zhing spro bar mdzod/ /zhal chos mthun sgo nas yang yang mjal/ /zhal mjal dus dge legs bkra shis shog /ces blangs pas der 'tshogs pa kun dad cing gus par gyur nas thams cad kyis phyag 'tshal skor ba byas so//de nas bdag gi sngon nas slob mar gyur pa'i dad can sman pa dge slong chos la mkhas pa zhig yod pa des nga'i mgur dbyangs kyi lan gyi tshul du bde zhus kyi tshigs bcad 'di dbyangs su phul lo//khams dar rgud bar ma'i sems can gye/ /mgon skyabs gnas bla ma rin po che/ /nged 'dir 'tshogs dad can pho mo yi/ /sems chos la phyogs par byen gyis rlobs/ /zhal mjal dka'i bshes gnyen khyed dang mjal/ /gsung bdud rtsi myong ba skal ba bzang / /da rje khyed gzugs sku bde mor byon/ /nged 'brel thogs byang chub bar du skyongs/ /dus da lta'i 'brel ba yud tsam gda'/ /dus da dung lan mang mjal bar smon/ /dus snyigs ma'i tshe la nges 'jog med/ /dus da nas dpon slob ma mjal na//zhing bde ba can dang mngon dga' sogs/ /zhing zhig nas phyi mar mjal bar smon/ /zhing de nas chos thos rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /zhing ma dag 'gro rnams 'dren par shog/325

ces phul bas mthar yon bdag rnams kyis skyabs 'jug zhus nas rang rang gi yul du log yon bdag rnying ba kha shas kyis yar re zhig gi bar du bskyal 'ong bas/ der ngas da khyed rnams 'gro mi dgos zhes bka' bsgo byin rlabs dang bsrung mdud byen nas phyir log nged dpon g.yog gsum bcas dbus lam chen mo la zhugs nas ri bo rma chen gyi phyogs la ga le sos dal byas song ba'i nyin gcig phyi dro bab nas bsdad tshe/lam 'gram gye spang gshong zhig na rkyang ma bu brgyad cu tsam zhig bag phebs par rtswa za zhing 'ga' re rtse ba mthong bas/sngar mthong ma pyong ba'i stabs kyis lta 'dod cig byung nas bltas pas/ de dus sems la 'di kun snying re rje chos kyi sgra tsam yang ma thos snyam nas ma ṇi dbyangs ring po byas nas bton pa'i tshe/ mi 'drog par tshur thag nyer 'ongs tshogs nas nyan bsdad tshe ma ṇi'i dbyangs de la bskyon nas mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so//sngon dus rgya gar 'phags yul nas/ /chos kyi 'khor lo lan gsum bskor/ /sangs rgyas bdag gi spyi bor bzhugs/ /rkyang 'di yongs la thugs rjes gzigs/ /chos kyi sgra tsam ma thos pa'i/ /'gro ba 'di kun bdag gi ma/ /'dir 'tshogs 326

rkyang rnams snying re rje/ /sangs rgyas bden pa'i gsung 'dir nyon/ /sdig pa ci yang mi bya zhing / /dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyad/ /rang gi sems ni yongs su 'dul/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin/ /ston pa sangs rgyas thugs rje can/ /chos sgra thos pas sgrib pa sbyangs/ /rkyang rnams phyi mar mi lus thob/ /dam pa'i chos la spyod par shog /ces smras pas/ de dus skyel mi gnyis kyis mthong nas rab tu dad pas mig nas mchi ma dor zhing rkyang 'di rnams mi 'drog par tshur la 'dus nas gsung la nyan pa 'di ni ngo mtshar/ khyed mi la ras pa dngos lags/ nged gnyis kyis phyag g.yog sgrub pa skal ba bzang da ni shi rung gson rung khyed kyis nged gnyis thugs dam skyabs 'og nas nam yang ma 'dor zer phyag du ma byed par 'dugangs kyang bla ma dkon mchog gsum gye byin rlabs kyis dud 'gro tshos chos nyan tshul 'di la bltas na mi rnams la chos bshad rgyu yin na phan thogs rgyu red snyam pa byung / de nas yang mi 'ga' re la thug nas khyed su yin sogs skad cha dris tshe lan drang por smras nas mgur dbyangs 'di yang blangs so//mi khyod dris lan glu 'dir nyon/ /mi nga ri khrod pa zhig yin/ /pha yul rgyal khams phyogs med yin/ /dpon po mtshan 327

ldan bla ma yin/ /a khu sangs rgyas byang sems yin/ /zhang po yi dam lha mchog yin/ /grogs po dpa' bo mkha' 'gro yin/ /sha nye chos skyong srung ma yin/ /khyim mtshes yul lha gzhi bdag yin/ /chung ma stong nyid mjes ma yin/ /bu tsha rig pa'i khye'u chung yin/ /khang pa brag khung 'gol bo yin/ /sa zhing 'gyur med dad pa yin/ /so nam chos spyod rnam bcu yin/ /rgyu nor 'phags pa'i nor bdun yin/ /yon bdag rgya bod sog gsum yin/ /rnal 'byor yin tshul de ltar lags/ /zhes blangs so/ /yang rngon pa 'ga' re la lam nas thug pas/ khyed su yin gang du 'gro zer dus 'di skad ces smras/chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs la 'dud/ /dris lan rnal 'byor glu 'dir nyon/ /mi nga bya btang pa zhig yin/ /sdom pa can gyi ban+de yin/ /dam tshig gtsang ma'i sngags pa yin/ /brag la 'dug pa'i sgom chen yin/ /rang rgyud thul ba'i chos pa yin/ /gzhan chos bskul ba'i bshes gnyen yin/ /ming ni tshogs drug rang grol yin/ /rma chen gangs la 'gro ba yin/ /song nas byang chub sgrub pa yin/ /rnal 'byor yin tshul de ltar gda'/ /zhes smras pas dad cing gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs 'jug zhus nas song / nged rnams yar song nas ri bo rma chen gangs ri'i rtse mo 328

mthong ba'i nyin/ sa phyogs der bsang btang zhing phyag phul bas/ nam mkha' la glo bur du sprin 'ja' nyi ma dus gcig la 'dzoms te me tog dmar ser gyi char babs nas bsu ba byas byung / gangs ri'i 'dabs su slebs pa'i nyin par/ gangs kyi nang nas 'brug ldir ba lta bu'i gdangs snyan pa'i sgra chen po zhig ldir ba byung / bdag gis kyang gangs la bltas pas dga' zhing spro bar gyur/ de nas skyel mi gnyis nyi ma gnyis tsam zhig bsdad nas nged gsum gyis brag skyibs dro sa zhig nas/ rang shong rdo yi khang chung zhig brtsigs te/ skyel mi gnyis kyis g.yag gnyis phyir la ded nas song / rang nyid gcig pur bsdad pa'i tshe sems spro ba'i shugs kyis mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so//mtshan ldan bla ma dam pa/ /spyi bo'i rgyan du bzung nas/ /tshogs drug rang grol rma chen/ /ri la 'gro 'dod skyes byung / /gangs dkar rma chen ri bo/ /rang shong rdo yi khang pa/ /tshogs drug rang grol lhan cig /'dzoms pa'i rten 'brel 'grig byung / /skad snyan sgrog pa'i bya dang / /lus mdzes yid 'ong ri dwags/ /rnams dang tshogs drug rang grol/ /'grogs pa'i rten 'brel 'grig byung / /bla mas gnang ba'i gdams ngag /329

yon bdag rnams kyi phul zas/ /na tsha med pa'i sgyu lus/ /'tshogs pa'i rten 'brel 'grig byung / /'gal rkyen bar chad med par/ /mthun rkyen tshang ba'i sgo nas/ /dam pa'i lha chos tshul bzhin/ /sgrub pa'i rten 'brel 'grig byung / /mthun rkyen legs po 'grig tshe/ /nyams dga' gcig pur 'dug dus/ /rab dkar gangs ri'i mgul nas/ /rgyangs glu len 'dod skye byung / /phyin chad bdag dang bdag 'dra'i/ /chos byed rnams la 'di 'dra'i/ /rten 'brel legs par 'grig na/ /snyam pa zhig kyang sgyes byung / /zhes blangs so/ /de nas nyams len la rtse gcig tu gzhol nas/ nyin gcig gnas bstod kyi mgur dbyangs 'di yid la shar ba ltar blangs so//mchog gsum kun 'dus bla ma la/ /sgo gsum gus pas bdag phyag 'tshal/ /skyon zad yon tan ldan pa'i rir/ /cung zad tsam zhig bstod dbyangs len/ /lho rgyal 'dzam gling sa yi rgyan/ /rma rgyal sbom ra zhes bya'i ri/ /e ma ya mtshan che'o zhes/ /bla ma gong mas bsngags brjod mang / /rab dkar gangs ri chags pa de/ /dar dkar na bza' gsol bzhin mdzes/ /gangs ri dkar po mthong ba'i mi/ /bsam pa dkar chos phyogs la dga'/ /gangs la nyi 'od phog pa'i mod/ /330

gangs chu gtsang mas lhung sgra sgog /sus 'thung skom gdungs lus nad sel/ /mi 'thung skye 'gro gcig kyang med/ /yongs la grags pa'i rma chu yi/ /rgyun la 'chad med gaṅgār 'gran/ /chu der brten nas sa steng gi /chu rnams phyi yi rgya mtshor 'bab/ /ri ngos 'dabs kyi spang ljongs na/ /ri dwags du ma bag phebs rgyu/ /gcig gis gcig ded rtse bro brdungs/ /bltas na gcig pur rgod kha 'chor/ /brgya stong mang po'i rkyang 'brong gis/ /thang stong khebs pa de mthong na/ /'brog gi phyug po phal cher la/ /mang po'i phyugs yod zer ba'ang dzun/ /rkyang bu rtse zhing 'gyel log byed/ /'brong bu rtse zhing mar nu ngur/ /de la bltas na nyi ma 'tshor/ /rgyud la byams dang snying rje skye/ /me tog mang po bkra ba'i mtshor/ /che chung mang po'i ngang bas brgyan/ /mig tu de dag snang ba'i tshe/ /rtag tu nyams dga' snang ba spro/ /dkar dmar sngo ser me tog rtser/ /bung ba dmar ser 'phur lding g.yo/ /glu blangs me tog 'grims tsa na/ /rnal 'byor rgyal khams 'grim snying 'dod/ /zwa sgog gro ma ri dwags thed/ /za rgyu'i rigs ni sna tshogs ldan/ /'tsho ba chad kyang mi 'chi tsam /'tsho ba rnyed snyam sems dpangs mtho / /rang la mkho ba'i rdo khang dang / /rang grub g.ya' leb chu shing mang / /nye bar mkho 331

ba 'dzoms pa'i mod/ /nye gnas dgos zer dzun du gtong / /lha mchog rma rgyal de na bzhugs/ /lha mang rgyun du de la 'du/ /chos byed mi la lha rnams dgyes/ /chos mthun 'phrin las lha yis bsgrub/ /bkra shis g.yang kun ri 'dir 'khyil/ /bkra mi shis pa'i ming yang med/ /de la gnas nas sgom byed pa'i/ /mi la nyams rtogs nyi ma 'char/ /lha mi'i go 'phang bsgrub 'dod rnams/ /lha gnas rma rgyal ri bo sten/ /bla med byang chub bsgrub 'dod rnams/ /mtshungs med rma rgyal ri bo sten/ /bsten na tshe blos thongs la sten/ /sten dang bde skyid snyan gsum 'byung / /ri bo rma chen bstod pa'i mthus/ /ri 'di'i phyogs kyi mi phyugs kun/ /nyin bde mtshan bde nyin gung bde/ /nyin mtshan rtag tu bde skyid shog /ces blangs pa'i mtshan mo'i tho rangs khar nyams snang la/ mi dkar po zhig byung ste bos nas song bas/gur dkar po brgya phrag du ma phub pa'i dbus na/ shin tu mjes shing yid du 'ong ba'i gur chen po zhig phub yod pa'i nang du song ba'i tshe/ rab tu mtho ba'i khri chen po zhig gi steng na rgyal po chen po zhig bzhugs/ mdun gyi g.yas phyogs su khri zhig yod pa'i khar nga sdod ces zer der bsdad pa'i tshe/ rgyal po de yar la bzhengs nas dri ma med pa'i kha btags ring bo 332

zhig dang / rab tu mdzes pa'i zhwa zhig gnang nas/ khyed kyis deng sang dam pa gong ma'i rnam thar bskyangs te dam pa'i chos kyi mgur dbyangs len pa ngo mtshar che/ khyed kyi mtshan la gangs can bod kyi glu dbyangs mkhan zhes gsol ba yin/mgur 'bum bod la 'jog pa ru bzhag pa bka' drin che/ ma 'ongs pa na dad can gyi gdul bya rnams la phan thogs rgya chen po 'ong / da dung sgrub pa snying por mdzod la sgrub 'bras kyis bstan 'gro yongs la gang phan mdzod/ de'i zhor la rgyal ba'i gsung rab kyi dgongs don glu ru longs dang / khyed kyis phyin chad chos ldan gyi bya ba gang sgrub dus bdag gis grogs byed par khas blangs pa yin gsungs pa'i snang ba shar/ de nas nyin re bzhin bla ma la gsol ba btab cing dbang bzhi blangs rig pa kha yan du glod nas mnyam bzhag nam mkha' lta bu'i stong pa nyid la mnyam par bzhag pas/ nyin zhig mnyam bzhag gi ngang nas sngar ma mthong ba'i yul ljongs dang / zhing khams 'dra ba mang po mthong / yang nyin zhig rang gi nye 'khor na mtsho chung gnyis yod pa'i kha na ngang ba ser bo gnyis dang rkyang gcig bcas rgyun du 'dug pa de yang / mig gis bltas pa bzhin gsal bar mthong bas/ ngas bden mi bden brtag 333

phyir phyi rol tu song nas bltas tshe/ sngar mnyam bzhag gi ngang nas mthong ba ji lta ba bzhin 'dug de bzhin du nyin re bzhin mnyam par bzhag tshe/ me long la gzugs brnyan shar ba ltar/ nyams snang sna tshogs pa zhig shar ba byung ngo / /nyin gcig sbrang ma zhig gis sgra snyan mo bsgrags nas gnas khang du 'ong ba'i tshe sems spro ba'i shugs kyis 'di skad ces smras so//a ma a me/ /grogs po sbrang ma/ /'tshams por bde mor/ /gang nas slebs byung / /rnal 'byor skyid la/ /grogs po slebs bzhag /gcig pur skyo ba/ /lhag med sangs thal/ /glo bur dga' spro'i/ /nyi ma shar bzhag /da dung glu dbyangs/ /ring po longs dang / /zhes smras pas sbrang ma gdan khar babs nas/ gshog chung bskums mgo bkug rwa bsnyal nas/ phyag 'tshal ba'i rnam 'gyur byas/ tshur 'ong sham thabs la mgo gtugs nas mjal te/ slar mdun gye bar snang la 'phur nas gar stabs bsgyur zhing 'di skad zer/e ma gu ru/ /sku gzugs bde ang / /nged tsho thams cad/ /shin tu bde lags/ /nged kyi a pha/ /a byes ring nas/ /glu ba rkyang yin/ /nga yang glu ba/ /sngon dus rje btsun/ /skal ldan sogs la/ /nged tsho'i glu ba/ /gong ma 'ga' res/ /skabs 334

skabs spro tshe/ /glu yi mchod pa/ /snyan du phul zhes/ /rna thos tsam yod/ /nged tsho rang dgar/ /thang stong rnams su/ /rgyangs glu len na/ /rje khyed dgyes pa'i/ /mchod par 'gyur na/ /ci'i phyir mi len/ /blangs na gtan gyi/ /so nam yin snyam/ /da ni glu yi/ /mchod pa 'bul bas/ /rje btsun chen po/ /cung zad snyan gson/ /zhes yar cung zad bstod nas 'di skad zer/ sred ldan sbrang mas/ /mdangs ldan me tog /bcud bzang 'thungs nas/ /'dab bzang brgyangs te/ /lha khyed mdun gyi/ /lha yi lam nas/ /dga' ba'i gar byas/ /dga' glu len bzhin/ /ma 'ongs dus na/ /ma rig dbang gyur/ /sbrang ma nga yis/ /e ma khyed gsung / /dri med bdud rtsi/ /ngoms med 'thungs nas/ /nyams rtogs skyes tshe/ /nyams mgur lhang lhang / /dben par bsdad nas/ /'then par smon ang / /zhes blangs nas slar je dma' ru btang nas yang 'di zer/ da ni glu ba/ /rang yul bsnyeg pas/ /mjal rag bar du/ /khyed sku bde mo/ /skabs skabs 'ongs nas/ /spro tshe glu yi/ /mchod pa snyan du/ /yang yang 'bul ang / /tshe 'di 'i bar chad/ /phyi ma'i lam sna/ /rje btsun mkhyen zhes/ /skyabs 'jug zhu ang / /zer ba'i lan du ngas 'di skad smras/ grogs 335

po sbrang ma/ /yang yang shog la/ /rnal 'byor spro ba'i/ /glu dbyangs longs dang / /ma 'ongs mi nga / /sangs rgyas tshe na/ /grogs khyod 'khor du/ /'gyur bar smon ang / /da khyod 'gro na/ /rnal 'byor nga la/ /skor ba zhig gyis/ /rang gnas song ang / /zhes spras pas sbrang ma dga' nas g.yas skor g.yon skor gnyis byas phyi mig mi blta bar rgyangs ring du 'phur song ngo zhes rang nyid khams bsangs pa'i phyir smras pa'o/ /de nas rang la phan phyir grong las nyin gcig 'das pa'i pha rol ri khrod dgon par bsdad nas sangs rgyas kyi gsung bzhin dam pa'i chos la nyams len byas na/ lam rtags kyi yon tan 'char ba'i tshul mdo sde ting nge 'dzin rgyal po na yod pa rnams tshigs su bcad nas dbyangs su 'di ltar blangs so//sangs rgyas thugs rje can la 'dud/ /dgon pa zin par byin gyes rlobs/ /mi rtag 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs mthong / /dam chos rnam dag bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /gcig pur dgon pa la gnas na/ /phan yon ting 'dzin rgyal po las/ /bcu gsung ba ni 'di lta ste/ /rtag tu bya ba nyung bar 'gyur/ /'du 'dzi dag kyang ring du spong / /rtsod pa dag kyang de la med/ /gnod pa med par gnas pa dang / /zag pa rnam par 'phel mi byed/ /336

rtsod pa'i gzhi mi byed pa dang / /rtag tu nye bar zhi bar spyod/ /sgo gsum bsdams par gnas pa dang / /thar pa dang ni mthun gyur zhing / /rnam par grol bar myur du reg /gzhan yang mdo sde de nyid las/ /rtag tu dgon pa sten mkhan gyis/ /lha'i mig lha yi rna ba dang / /pha rol gzhan sems shes pa dang / /sngon gnas rjes su dran pa dang / /dzu 'phrul dag kyang 'thob par 'gyur/ /shar dang lho nub byang phyogs kyi/ /sangs rgyas grangs med dpag med mthong / /sangs rgyas mthong ba de dag dang / /nam yang 'bral ba med par 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas de dag phyogs bcu na/ /dam chos ji snyed ston pa kun/ /lha yi rna ba'i khams kyis thos/ /chos nyan pa dang mi 'bral 'gyur/ /chos kun blor gzung mi brjed cing / /sems can rnams la dam chos ston/ /don gang yin yang rab tu shes/ /'das dang ma 'ongs da ltar gye/ /'gro kun sems can spyod pa shes/ /zhes gsungs tshogs drug rang grol khyod/ /gcig pur dgon par gnas par gyis/ /gtan gyi don chen 'grub par nges/ /glu 'di thos tshad thams cad kyis/ /dgon pa bsten nas chos byed shog /ces blangs nas brtson 'grus cher bskyed de mnyam bzhag la 'bad pas dgong mo zhig nyams snang la/ rang 337

gi sgo yi nang du 'tshub ma nag po zhig byung ba la phar zhes mchil ma zhig btab pas/ 'tshub ma de mi snang bar skad cig de nyid la gnas 'gyur nas mi nag po 'jigs su rung ba mche ba ring po yod pa shin tu khros pa ma mgal la so btab pa zhig tu gyur te gri thung kha gnyis yod pa'i mdung 'dra ba zhig 'phyar nas/ nga da snga yan chad su'i drung du'ang song ste mchil ma 'debs ma myong / da re rnal 'byor pa skyugs bro khyod kyis mchil ma btab pa'i lan la/ nga khyod kyi khog tu zhugs nas snying la gri brgyab ste ma bsad na nga bu min zer nas/ skad cig la gnas 'gyur nas sran ma nag po zhig tu gyur te bdag gi kha nas zhugs te khong du song / der nga'i bsam pa la 'khrul snang 'di ya mtshan khyod kyis de ltar byed na/ ngas kyang 'di ltar byas chog snyam rang lus skad cig nyid la/ gzhom zhig dang bral ba'i gnam lcags kyi khang pa zhig tu dmigs nas rlung bzung ste 'og gi ram las me shin tu tsha ba sbar bas dmigs pa drag tu byas pa dang / kho nga'i khog nas je cher song nas 'phag ste byang khog stod du 'tshangs pas lus zhig 'gro ba lta bu'i nyams shig byung bar/ me lce cher sbar nas bsregs pa'i tshe/ khos ma bzod par kho ma sreg a tsha tsha da tshig 338

thal zer smre sngags mang po phul bas/ ngas khyod kyis sngar yang 'dir yong ba'i sgom chen pa dang / phyogs 'di'i yon bdag mang po bsad yod par snang / da khyod la 'tshor sa med ces me de bas ches cher sbar nas gson bsreg byas rnam shes chos kyi dbyengs su 'dren pa yin smras tshe/ kho skad snyom du song nas a tsha tsha khyod chos pa zhig gis da nga snying mi rje ba yin nam/ da res ma sreg par thongs dang / phyin chad gzhan la gnod mi skyel ba'i mna' skyel zer bas/ ngas 'o na da phyin chad gnas 'dir 'ong ba dang / phyogs 'di na 'dug pa'i yon bdag rnams la gnod pa mi skyel ba'i mna' skyol byas pas/ der khos mna' mang po bskyal ba'i mthar/ da phyir gtong na da snga yan chad la rnal 'byor pa nga sa gang du song yang 'dre skyugs bro khyod 'dra ba kha nang du 'dzul ma myong / da khyod gtong na'ang nga'i kha nas yong sa med khyod mar song dang bshang lam nas gtong zhes/ steng rlung bzung nas ded de mar 'og sgor bton pa'i dmigs pa byas tshe/ mtho gang tsam gyi mi ro zhig 'og sgo nas sa la lhung ba de je che je cher song nas mi tsam zhig tu gyur pa'i tshe/ ngas bltas pas skra dang kha spu rnams tshig nas 'chi la khad pa zhig 'dug de nas ngal zhig gsos nas slar 'tshub 339

ma zhig tu gyur te/ ga le 'khor gyin song ba'i nyams shig shar/phyi nyin nga'i phung po kun nyab nyob cig tu song nas khog pa yang mi bde ba zhig byung ba la ngas rdor sems bsgom bzlas byas pas bde bar gyur to/ /de'i phyi dgong mo nyams snang la mi dkar po zhig dgod kyin 'ongs nas/ kha sang dgong mo nged tshang gi mi ngan de khyed la nyams tshad du song bas khyed kyis ngo tsha rgyu zhig bcos 'dug da nged tsho yang bshad 'ong phyin chad su la yang gnod mi skyel/ kha sang khyed la brnyas bcos byas te khog tu zhugs pa bzod par gsol/ phyin chad kho yang khyed kyis thugs dam skyabs 'og nas ma 'dor zhes zer ba'i snang ba shar/ yang de dus nga'i mdun phyogs kyi g.yas g.yon gnyis na mtsho che chung gnyis yod pa'i kha na/ dus rgyun ngang pa ser po gnyis bsdad yod pa nyin zhig phyi dro ngang pa gcig glag gis bsad/ gcig po de yang skrag ste bros song ba'i tshe/ yun ring 'grogs pa'i stabs kyis skyo snang drag po shar tshe mgur 'di blangs so//e ma ya mtshan rmad byung bya/ /rin chen gser gyi lus po la/ /dung dkar g.yu yi gshog pa rgyas/ /mchu rkang bung ba ltar gnag mdzes/ /rkang pa'i sor mo dra bas 'brel/ /rin chen 340

mgul gyi bum pa na/ /bai ḍūr+ya yi do shal 'ching / /pho mo gnyis ka zung du 'brel/ /gshog steng gzi brjid 'bar bzhin du/ /gdangs snyan 'gyur khug lhang lhang skad/ /bsgrags te lha lam yangs pa nas/ /dga' ba'i gar stabs bsgyur 'ongs dus/ /'dab chags gzhan las khyad chos che/ /sus mthong dbang med yid 'phrog pa'i/ /lha bya ngang ba'i rgyal po mchog /sngo ljang mtsho nang babs pa'i dus/ /gru dkar g.yu yi maṇ+ḍal steng / /'dzam bu chu bo'i gser bzang las/ /grub pa'i bum bzang bzhag las mdzes/ /rgyun du mtsho 'gram na gnas dus/ /chos mthun grogs dang 'grogs pa las/ /rnal 'byor nyams dga' snang ba spro/ /de ring dus kyi phyi dro la/ /glo bur sdig can glag gis bsad/ /kyi hud mtsho yi rgyan gcig stor/ /rgyan med zangs nang chu bzhin gyur/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi grogs dang bral/ /grogs med pho yugs bzhin du gyur/ /gcig pur skyo snang drag po shar/ /yun ring 'grogs pa'i ngang ba la mchi ma g.yo ba'i snying rje skyes/ /kha nas smon lam tshig 'di shor/ /'khor ba'i gnas na bde ba med/ /skye rga na 'chi'i sdug bsngal mang / /'di nas nub kyi phyogs rol na/ /bde ba can gyi zhing khams yod/ /bdag gis legs byas dge ba'i mthus/ /341

mthun grogs tshe 'das ngang ba 'di/ /'khor ba'i gnas su mi skye bar/ /bde ba can du skye bar shog /u shi a ho snying re rje/ /'khor ba'i chos 'di ci zhig red/ /da nangs ngang ba pho mo gnyis/ /mtsho khar lhan cig 'phur lding rtse/ /da ni gcig po glag gis bsad/ /gcig po skrag nas phyogs gzhan bros/ /lhan cig 'du ba'i 'brel ba chad/ /'brel med so sor bral nas thal/ /a bo tshogs drug rang grol la/ /de ring mi rtag slob dpon byung / /slob dpon bzang po'i brda' chos la/ /lung dang rig pa'i nges shes 'drongs/ /chos rnams mi rtag 'di dang 'dra/ /khyod kyang 'di yi rang bzhin yin/ /rtag 'dzin che na chos skal 'chad/ /rtag tu dben par sgrub pa gyis/ /zhes rang nyid sgrub pa la bskul phyir blangs so/ /de nas bag phebs te bde bar bsdad yod pas nyin gcig glo bur du mgo log gi jag pa 'ga' re byung nas nga'i bro kha tshor bltas tshe/nga'i bro khar blta mi dgos nga la yod khyed tsho'i gcig gis nga'i gung tshigs kyi ja skol dang nged rnams kyis 'thungs nas/ bro dgos na gros mthun gyi sgo nas khyer chog ces ja 'thung kha brda 'dra byas/ de nas bro kha gang yod rnams bstan nas bgos te/phyed de rnams la byin nas mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so//342

'dod 'byung nor bu las lhag pa'i/ /bla ma spyi gtsug rgyan du bzhugs/ /rnal 'byor tshogs drug rang grol la/ /skyid sdug gnyis kyi gang byung yang / /glu dbyangs 'jen pa rang gshis yin/ /khyed rnams nga yi glu 'dir nyon/ /mi lus lan cig ma gtogs pa/ /phyi nas yang yang thob par dka'/ /'chi ba nam yong nges 'jog med/ /'chi bdag nangs par yin yang 'ong / /dkar nag las la bslu ba med/ /shi dus gang byas rjes su 'brang / /dkar po dge ba'i las byas na/ /mtho ris gnas su skyes nas bde/ /nag po mi dge'i las byas na/ /ngan song gsum du skyes nas sdug /bde sdug gdam kha yod dus 'dir/ /mi dge'i las la ma rngams par/ /dge ba che thub chung thub rem/ /spyir na gzhan gyis ma byen pa/ /blangs na mi bzang ma len ang / /sgos su sgrub pa po yi zas/ /dug dang 'dra bas zos na phung / /'dod chung chog shes ma mchis na/ /rgyal khams rgyu nom mi gcig gis/ /thob kyang sems kha gang mi 'gyur/ /'dod pa'i dbang du gyur tsa na/ /tha ma rang nyid gri ru 'chi/ /'tsho na rang gi srog 'di 'tshos/ /'dod chung chog shes sten cig ang / /khyed rnams bdag la de ring bzang / /sbyin dang bzod pa'i lag len byas/ /tha mal nor kyang mchog tu gyur/ /343

e ma rnal 'byor skal ba bzang / /mthu dang ngan sngags ngas mi shes/ /shes kyang byed na dkon mchog gsum/ /phyin chad na tsha god kha 'dra/ /byung na nga'i mthu yin ma snyam/ /bdag la bzang ngan 'brel thogs kun/ /rtag tu bde zhing skyid par shog /ces blangs tshe nang nas rgan pa zhig na re/ nged tshor bro kha med pas blangs pa yin/ de min ga la len/ khyed kyis sha bzhes na gtsang ma yin zer nas sha lhu 'ga' re byin nas/ phyag 'tshal zhing kun gyes bdag la mjal nas/ chos pa bzang po khyed la zer/ dgongs lo brgya lon/ sku tshe brtan rgyu tshang thugs dam skyabs 'og nas ma 'dor zer bzhin song ba'i shul nas glu 'di blangs so//rtsa ba'i bla ma byin rlabs can/ /mi rtag dran par byin gyis rlobs/ /kha sang dus kyi snga dro la/ /rma chen gangs ri'i nye 'dabs na/ /rkyang 'brong thang na bag phebs nyal/ /'ga' res rtswa za chung chung rtse/ /ngang ba dkar ser mtsho khar 'dus/ /la las gshog brgyangs skad snyan sgog /sgo phyi'i me tog ser po rnams/ /la la bzhad nas gar stabs bsgyur/ /rang gnas khang chung zas kyis bkang / /che ba bzhag nas chung ba zos/ /mi 'dod nyer 'tshe'i ming yang med/ /thams cad shin tu bde 344

zhing skyid/ /de ring dus kyi nyin gung la/ /mgo log phyogs nas yin zer ba'i/ /bsam log jag pa mi skya brgyad/ /lung log brgyud nas glo bur slebs/ /dus log ri pa rnams la byung / /rkyang 'brong bros nas yar mar song / /bya rnams 'phur nas gzhan du song / /sgo yi me tog rta yis bcag /nang gi zas rnams jag pas brgyab/ /sprang po tshogs drug rang grol la/ /de ring mi rtag slob dpon byung / /chos rnams mi rtag pa e go /rtag par ma 'dzin ri khrod pa/ /zhes blangs/ de'i phyi nyin jag pa mi bcu gsum byung nas kun dad cing gus pas phyag 'tshal/mjal nas bro kha'i snon pa byen/ gang nas yin gang gi byon sogs skad cha mang po 'dri ba la lan smras/ mjug tu 'gro khar glu dbyangs 'di blangs so//bla ma dkon mchog rin po che/ /bdag gzhan sgo gsum byin gyis rlobs/ /'dir 'dus jag pa dad can rnams/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi glu 'dir nyon/ /mi nga ri khrod pa zhig yin/ /ming la tshogs drug rang grol zer/ /pha yul reb gong smad kyi yin/ /sde ba'i ming la zho 'ong zer/ /chung nas gsar rnying chos la dad/ /mtshan ldan bla ma mang po bsten/ /khyad par chos rgyal ngag dbang wang / /lo lnga'i bar du 'bral med 345

bsten/ /mdo rgyud man ngag mang po thob/ /bka' drin che ba'i bla ma rje'i/ /drin gyis tshogs drug rang grol ngas/ /mi rtag 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs dang / /'gro kun pha ma yin par shes/ /'gro ba'i don du sangs rgyas kyi/ /go 'phang 'thob 'dod gting nas skyes/ /'thob thabs sgom sgrub byed snyam nas/ /tshe 'di'i bya ba blo yis btang / /ri khrod 'grims nas lo 'ga' song / /mtsho snying ri nas lo gsum bsdad/ /de nas gnas 'dir 'ong ba lags/ /rnal 'byor yin tshul de tsam gda'/ /khyed rnams bdag la dad pa 'di/ /sngon gyi las 'phro smon lam bzang / /mi lus rin chen rnyed par dka'/ /mi tshe yun thung myur du 'chi/ /nub phyogs bde ba can zhing du/ /sgyes pa'i mi la bde skyid che/ /dge ba byas na de ru skyes/ /dge ba sgrubs dang dad ldan tsho/ /ma ki dmyal khams bco brgyad du/ /skyes pa'i mi la sdug bsngal che/ /zhes blangs pas kun gyes phyag 'tshal byen rlabs zhus/ lam la zhugs nas 'ga' res skyabs su mchi o rgyan dngos red/ las med nang gi las can red lan cig mjal ba skal ba bzang / kha sang gi de tshos ma bzang 'dug 'di pa gyan gyen zhig ma red/ de pa'i spyan gyis gzigs tshul la ltos dang khyad chos che gi ang / khong 'dug sa 346

ma rnyed par rma chen gangs 'dabs su 'ong ba ni ma red/ phyin chad nged tshos blta dang / de cha bo la mi bzang zer bzhin song ba'i shul nas yang glu 'di blangs so//bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byen gyis rlobs/ /kha sang dus kyi nyin gung la/ /dad med jag pas bro kha blangs/ /de ring dus kyi snga dro la/ /dad can jag pas bro snon byin/ /skyid sdug lam chen mgron po red/ /da lta med kyang da lta byung / /snga sor rang gis cher ma zos/ /lha la tshogs gtor tsam ma phul/ /sdug btsir byas pa'i bro kha rnams/ /jag pa rnams kyi brgyags phyer gyur/ /bro kha yod dus za dgos pa/ /de ring ma gtogs ngas ma shes/ /yod dus zo dang ri khrod pa/ /seng ge gangs nas 'khyags pa med/ /bya rgod mkha' nas lhung ba med/ /nya mo chu yis 'tshubs pa med/ /chos pa ltogs nas shi ba med/ /de'i phyir tshe 'di blo yis thongs/ /de'i phyir phyis kyi bsam sbyor bor/ /zhes smras so/ /de'i lo dbyar zla ba drug pa'i nang la'ang char ma babs chu 'khyil mang po bskams nas/ khyad par nga'i sngun na yod pa'i mtsho chung de yang bskams nas song tshe nang na 'bu che chung mang po chang gi sbang ma bzhin du bcu rgyu 'dug bdag gis rkyal ba zhig yod pa de'i nang du 347

mtsho chen po zhig yod pa'i nang nas chu khyer 'ong ste/ 'bu rnams lag pa gnyis kyis bcus nas rkyal bar blugs te mtsho chen po de'i nang du bskyal bas rkyal ba sum cu tsam zhig byung /de dus 'bu bye ba dung phyur mang po zhig tshe thar ram snyam pa byung / 'bu kha shas shi song ba la phan pa'i bsngo smon gyi rgyas 'di ltar btab/ 'dis mtshon bdag gi dge ba'i mthus/ /srin bu shi tshad ma lus pa/ /phyi mar lha mi'i lus thob nas/ /lha chos byas nas sangs rgyas shog /ces so/ /yang gnas der dgong ma'i grangs kyi 'ug pa zhig 'ong ste nga'i brag steng nas 'khun tshe sems la gnod pa zhig red/ dgong mo zhig mi nyal rgyab la rdo kha shas khyer te kho 'khun pa'i thag nye'i brag skyibs shig tu yibs nas bsdad/ kho 'ong ba dang dgod rgyu zhig byung kyang ma bgad/ de nas kha grag tu bcug nas rdo rgyag dgos snyam bsdad pas/ re zhig gi bar du ma grags tshe shes song ba yin nam da kha ma grag rung rgyag dgos snyam pa yod tshe/ shed kyis ung zer nas grag pa'i tshe da dung lan gnyis grag tu bcug lan gsum pa grag ma grags kyi mtshams la rdo gcig brgyab pa dang khos ung zer ba dus mnyam byung bas/ nga dgod rgyu chen po zhig byung ste gcig pur yun ring bgad/ de nas ༄ 348

bsam blo zhig btang bas kho bo lta ba bsgom zer/ 'ug pa 'khun pa'i sgra tsam zhig gis gnod pa mi bzod pa ya cha de dus khyod kyi lta ba de gar song / yang kha nas snying rje sgom gyin yo da pa skad zer te/ 'ug par rdo brgyab nas shi song na ci 'dra zhig red/ 'ug pa de skye ba sngon ma'i pha ma min nam/ de la snying rje mi dgos sam/ da khyod ri khrod du bsdad de gzhan la ga nas cha ste/ 'di na gnas srung 'ug pa zhig yod pa 'dis skad ngan 'ga' brgyab pa yang ma bzod par do nub 'khrug pa shor bas bya ba btsog pa 'di la ltos dang / da dung khyod kyi rgyud la stong nyid snying rje la sogs pa'i yon tan gang yang ma skyes pa'i rtags do nub bstan song zhes rang gis rang la khrel bdas mang bo byed bzhin nang du 'ong / da phyin chad 'ug pa mgo thog tu 'ong ste grag na'ang gnod pa mi byed pa'i dam bca' bzhag pas de'i rjes su kho yang skrag nas der ma yong bar lung mdo zhig na grag par gda'/ de nas gnas der mnyam bzhag gi rjes su snying rje shugs drag bsgoms pas skabs re bsgom mi dgos bzhin bcos ma ma yin pa'i snying rje chen po sdod mi tshugs pa lta bu skyes tshe/ sems can gyi don du bla ma dkon mchog la nyin re bzhin gsol ba shugs drag btab cing / ma 349

sems can thams cad la tshe 'dir yang phan pa'i bsngo ba dang smon lam rgya chen po btab pa'i rten 'brel la brten nas/nyin zhig gnas lugs kyi ngang la mnyam par bzhag pa'i dus su nyams snang la/ ston pa sangs rgyas kyis gtso byas pa'i phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rgya bod kyi mkhas grub mang po zhig gi zhal gzigs pas lha thams cad kyi zhal 'dzum zhing bzhad bzhin du/ thugs ka nas 'od zer byung ba thams cad phyogs gcig tu 'dus/ de rgyal mtshan chen po zhig tu gyur pa rang gi lag tu gtad pa'i snang ba byung ba phyi nyin rgyal ba rgyal sras bzhad pa'i glu dbyangs 'di blangs so//'o 'o bza' tshang tha ma 'bral snyam/ /a'u mtshan ldan bla ma btsal na/ /kho re rgyal ba rgyal sras bzhad nas/ /he he rgyal bstan rgyal mtshan gtad ya/ /ya yi ya yi/ /'o 'o dal brgyad tshang la dga' nas/ /a'u rnams dkar las la 'bad na/ /kho re rgyal ba rgyal sras bzhad nas/ /he he rgyal bstan rgyal mtshan gtad ya/ /ya yi ya yi/ /'o 'o gang yang rtag par dka' snyam/ /a'u gang la'ang ma chags spangs na/ /kho re rgyal ba rgyal sra4bzhad nas/ /he he rgyal bstan rgyal mtshan gtad ya/ /ya yi ya yi/ /'o 'o pha mar gnang ba blangs nas/ /a'u skra bcad 350

gzan sham blangs na/ /kho re rgyal ba rgyal sras bzhad nas/ /he he rgyal bstan rgyal mtshan gtad ya/ /ya yi ya yi 'o'o bka' bstan rnams la sbyangs nas/ /a'u bka' gdams rnam thar bskyangs na/ /kho re rgyal ba rgyal sras bzhad nas/ /te he rgyal bstan rgyal mtshan gtad ya/ /ya yi ya yi/ /'o 'o gsang ba sngags la nyan nas/ /a'u gsang nas nyams su blangs na/ /kho re rgyal ba rgyal sras bzhad nas/ /he he rgyal bstan rgyal mtshan gtad ya/ /ya yi ya yi/ /'o 'o yan lag ma tshang lam spangs/ /a'u lam bzang cha tshang bslabs na/ /kho re rgyal ba rgyal sras bzhad nas/ /te he rgyal bstan rgyal mtshan gtad ya ya yi ya yi 'o 'o bzang bzang cha tshang lam la/ a'u yang yang bag chags bzhag na/ /kho re rgyal ba rgyal sras bzhad nas/ /he te rgyal bstan rgyal mtshan gtad ya/ /ya yi ya yi/ /'o 'o gzhan la bsam pa ma gnag /a'u gzhan phan bsam pa ldan na/ /kho re rgyal ba rgyal sras bzhad nas/ /he he rgyal bstan rgyal mtshan gtad ya/ /ya yi ya yi/ /'o 'o phan btags ma btags gang la'ang / /a'u phan btags ngan ma byas na/ /kho re rgyal ba rgyal sras bzhad nas/ /he he rgyal bstan rgyal mtshan gtad ya/ /ya yi ya yi/ /'o 'o pham kha thams cad 351

blangs nas/ /a'u rgyal kha gzhan la btang na/ /kho re rgyal ba rgyal sras bzhad nas/ /he te rgyal bstan rgyal mtshan gtad ya/ /ya yi ya yi/ /'o 'o ma rabs bya ba spangs nas/ /a'u ya rabs bya ba byas na/ /kho re rgyal ba rgyal sras bzhad nas/ /he te rgyal bstan rgyal mtshan gtad ya/ /ya yi ya yi/ /zhes blangs/yang nyin zhig nyams snang la mkhyen rab kyi bdag po rje btsun 'jam dbyangs dang / ngag dbang lha mo dbyangs can ma gnyis kyi zhal gzigs pas/ lha gnyis ka zhal ras 'dzum zhing bzhad bzhin du thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros te/ nam mkha' la sprin ltar 'khrigs pa'i dkyil nas/ lha sku yig 'bru phyag mtshan thig le bum pa me tog cod paṇa sman sna 'dra ba gzhan yang ming mi thogs pa'i khra khra shig shig legs legs mang po char ltar babs pa rang gi lus la sib sib thim pas bde stong gi rtogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phel nas/ lus ban bun lang long shag shig tu gyur pa zhig byung bas phyi nyin bla ma 'jam dbyangs dang dbyangs can ma gnyis kyang bzhad pa'i glu dbyangs 'di blangs so//'o 'o phul byung sprul skur rgyun du/ /a'u dung dung gdungs shugs gus 'dud/ /kho re bla ma 'jam dbyangs bzhad nas/ /352

te he ya mtshan gang bzang gnang ya/ /ya yi ya yi/ /'o 'o tshur mgu kun 'byung rgyu bsgrub/ /a'u tshur sdug kun 'byung rgyu bskyur/ /kho re bla ma 'jam dbyangs bzhad nas/ /he he ya mtshan gang bzang gnang ya/ /ya yi ya yi/ /'o 'o yul phyugs phu nu kun bskyur/ /a'u khu byug 'phur lung phu zungs/ /kho re bla ma 'jam dbyangs bzhad nas/ /he te ya mtshan gang bzang gnang ya/ /ya yi ya yi/ /'o 'o rgyun du rtsub rtsub rgyud thul/ /a'u phul byung thub gsung kun bsgrub/ /kho re bla ma 'jam dbyangs bzhad nas/ /he he ya mtshan gang bzang gnang ya/ /ya yi ya yi/ /'o 'o thub gsung bcud bsdus glu chung / /a'u sgyu lus dngul bum dbus bzung / /kho re bla ma 'jam dbyangs bzhad nas/ /he he ya mtshan gang bzang gnang ya/ /ya yiya yi/'o 'o bsten tshe nyer 'tshe gegs med/ /a'u bde ster bshes gnyen de bsten/ /kho re dbyangs can ma yang bzhad nas/ /te te ya mtshan gang bzang gnang ya/ /ya yi ya yi 'o 'o bde gshegs mnyes byed sems bskyed/ /a'u bde legs khe che dge rem/ /kho re dbyangs can ma yang bzhad nas/ /he he ya mtshan gang bzang gnang ya/ /ya yi ya yi/ 'o 'o sdig sgrib 353

sprin 'di bshig phyin/ /a'u skyid kyi nyi 'di rig gi /kho re dbyangs can ma yang bzhad nas/ /he he ya mtshan gang bzang gnang ya/ /ya yi ya yi/ 'o 'o sgrib gnyis shig shig 'jig phyir/ /a'u rim gnyis ting 'dzin dmigs shig /kho re dbyangs can ma yang bzhad nas/ /te he ya mtshan gang bzang gnang ya/ /ya yi ya yi/ /'o 'o chos 'dod pho mor chos shod/ /a'u chos spyod spyod 'phro bsngo mdzod/ /kho re dbyangs can ma yang bzhad nas/ /he he ya mtshan gang bzang gnang ya/ /ya yi ya yi/ /zhes blangs so/ /yang mtshan gcig gi rmi lam du sngar 'gro ma myong ba'i thag ring gi ri khrod dben pa shin tu nyams dga' ba lha yul lta bu zhig tu slebs nas der gzhi phab nas bsdad de/ rje mi la'i gsung mgur sogs dam pa gong ma'i gsung gi mgur dbyangs mang po zhig blangs pas/ rje btsun mi la yab sras rnams dran drags nas gsol ba btab pas mdun du byon te zhal 'dzum zhing bzhad bzhin/ thugs brtse ba chen po'i sgo nas phyag gnyis bdag gi mgo thog tu bzhag ste ljags mchil btab nas mgo la byugs pa zhig gnang tshe/ 'khrul ba'i blo sna mtha' dag 'gags nas/ bde gsal mi rtog pas brgyan pa'i rnam par mi rtog pa'i 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po'i 354

ngang la lhan lhan gnas pa zhig rmis pa'i phyi nyin yang / mi la yab sras bzhad pa'i glu dbyangs 'di yang blangs so//'o 'o bla ma rnams la mjal nas/ /a'u sangs rgyas bka' la sbyangs na/ /kho re mi la yab sras bzhad nas/ /te he mi 'bral yab ltar byams ya/ /ya yi ya yi/ /'o 'o gsang sngags lam bzang nyan nas/ /a'u lha sngags bzlas pa mdzad na/ /kho re mi la yab sras bzhad nas/ /he he mi 'bral yab ltar byams ya/ /ya yi ya yi/ /'o 'o tshang ra 'bar rag bar la/ /a'u a haṃ 'bar 'dzag byas na/ /kho re mi la yab sras bzhad nas/ /te te mi 'bral yab ltar byams ya/ /ya yi ya yi/ /'o 'o lag pa mnyam bzhag byas nas/ /a'u lta ba mnyam par bzhag na/ /kho re mi la yab sras bzhad nas/ /he he mi 'bral yab ltar byams ya/ /ya yi ya yi/ /'o 'o rang gzhan sangs rgyas thabs la/ /a'u rang na tsha yang 'bad na/ /kho re mi la yab sras bzhad nas/ /he he mi 'bral yab ltar byams ya/ /ya yi ya yi/ /'o 'o bya ba thams cad spangs nas/ /a'u bya bral sprang nag byas na/ /kho re mi la yab sras bzhad nas/ /he he mi 'bral yab ltar byams ya/ /ya yi ya yi/ /'o 'o gang la'ang chags sdang ma byas/ /a'u gang phan gzhan la byas 355

na/ /kho re mi la yab sras bzhad nas/ /he he mi 'bral yab ltar byams ya/ /ya yi ya yi/ /'o 'o gnas ngan thams cad spangs nas/ /a'u gnas bzang rnams la bsdad na/ /kho re mi la yab sras bzhad nas/ /te he mi 'bral yab ltar byams ya/ /ya yi ya yi/ /'o 'o lag g.yas 'gram par sbyar nas/ /a'u ngag dbyangs snyan par blangs na/ /kho re mi la yab sras bzhad nas/ /he he mi 'bral yab ltar byams ya/ /ya yi ya yi/ /'o 'o gangs dkar brag dmar rtsa nas/ /a'u gang phan dbyangs snyan blangs na/ /kho re mi la yab sras bzhad nas/ /he he mi 'bral yab ltar byams ya/ /ya yi ya yi/ /'o 'o nyams dga' g.ya' spang nags nas/ /a'u nyams shar dbyangs snyan blangs na/ /kho re mi la yab sras bzhad nas/ /he he mi 'bral yab ltar byams ya/ /ya yi ya yi/ /'o 'o rnar snyan dbyar rnga grags skabs/ /a'u dbyangs snyan lhang lhang blangs na/ /kho re mi la yab sras bzhad nas/ /te he mi 'bral yab ltar byams ya/ /ya yi ya yi/ /'o 'o dpag tshad rgyang la gnas nas/ /a'u dbyangs snyan rgyang nas blangs na/ /kho re mi la yab sras bzhad nas/ /he he mi 'bral yab ltar byams ya/ /ya yi ya yi/ /zhes dbyangs snyan la ring ba byas nas blangs so/ /356

yang mtshan mo zhig lha tshangs pa yin zer ba'i mi 'dra ba zhig gis/ 'dzum zhing bzhad bzhin gos kyi sman khug 'dra ba shin tu mdzes pa zhig na a ru ra la sogs pa'i sman sna du mas bkang ba zhig bdag la byin nas/ khyed kyis sman 'di kun la byen dang phan thogs chen po yong nges zer ba zhig rmis pa'i phyi nyin lha tshangs dbang bzhad pa'i glu dbyangs 'di yang blangs so//'o 'o bzang gnang bla mar dad pa/ /a'u phan btags pha mar byams na/ /kho re lha dbang tshangs pa bzhad nas/ /he he ya mtshan gang bzang gnang ya/ /ya yi ya yi/ /'o 'o phyogs brgyar mkhyen rgyas phyag gis/ /a'u skyid myong bya byed rgya bskyed/ /kho re lha dbang tshangs pa bzhad nas/ /te he ya mtshan gang bzang gnang ya/ /ya yi ya yi/ /'o 'o srog 'phrog 'gran bral dgrar bros/ /a'u spro brod 'grig 'phrod 'gror 'grogs/ /kho re lha dbang tshangs pa bzhad nas/ /he he ya mtshan gang bzang gnang ya/ /ya yi ya yi/ /'o 'o 'dod log srog gcod sogs spongs/ /a'u gtso bo nyon mongs tshogs choms/ /kho re lha dbang tshangs pa bzhad nas/ /te he la mtshan gang bzang gnang ya/ /ya yi ya yi/ /'o 'o rang gzhan gang la 357

phan pa'i/ /a'u dbyangs snyan gang bzang blangs na/ /kho re lha dbang tshangs pa bzhad nas/ /he he ya mtshan gang bzang gnang ya/ /ya yi ya yi/ /zhes rje btsun skal ldan rgya mtsho'i gsung mgur dbyangs kyi lad mo byas bya dka' ba'i tshig dang sbyar nas rang gzhan yongs la phan pa'i lhag bsam gyi ngang nas blangs pa'o/ /de ltar nyams snang sna tshogs shar ba la sems spro ba'i shugs kyis 'di skad ces smras so//chos kyi rgyal pa'i zhabs la 'dud/ /e ma skal ldan slob bu tsho/ /'khor 'das gnyis ga'i gnas bcas nas/ /bde sdug sna tshogs myong ba yi/ /sems nyid chos dbyings mkhar chen sgo/ /phye na phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas zhal/ /ma mthong las kyi rang mthong yin/ /'khor ba'i sems can bde sdug kun/ /ma rig las kyi rang rig yin/ /ban rgan ngas kyang bla ma'i gsung / /bzhin du rang sems chos dbyings sgo/ /e phye bltas pas zur tsam phyes/ /bde gshegs nam mkha'i skar tshogs tsam/ /zhal mthong zer ba dzun che yang / /skabs skabs dngos nyams rmi lam du/ /lha zhal tsam re mthong dus mang / /sems can skyid sdug legs nyes kun/ /shes zhes bshad na dzun che yang / /bar bar sems can 'ga' re la/ /legs nyes 358
