gang byung 'byung ba shes/ /'on kyang sgo kun ma phyed par/ /sgo srubs cung zad tsam phyes nas/ /bltas pa red mod zhad che gi /ban rgan gsal 'grib mang bar gda'/ /tshe mjug sgo de legs phyes nas/ /ngo mtshar ltad mo blta nus par/ /chos kyi rgyal pos byin gyes rlobs/ /'di thos slob bur phan par shog /ces slob ma yongs la phan phyir gdams pa'o/ /de nas nyin zhig ri bo rma chen gye ri rtse zhig tu khams bsangs su song nas/ sems kha yangs po byas phyogs kun tu mig gis bltas nas khams sangs pa dang / lus gnad drang por bsrang mig gis nam mkha' yangs pa'i klong la ha re bltas nas/ nam mkha' dang rang sems dbyer med du bsres te gnas lugs stong gsal 'dzin med zang thal khyab gdal klong yangs mtha' bral nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang du mer gyis glod nas mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so//mtha' dbus khyab gdal 'od gsal chos kyi dbyings/ /gdod nas lhun grub phyam phyam me re re/ /phyi dang nang med rang rig mkha' ltar yangs/ /rgya chad phyogs lhung med par zang thal le/ /dbyings rig dbyer med skye med klong yangs na/ /chos rnams bar snang 'ja' bzhin 'al ma 'ol/ /ma dag dag 359

zhing sangs rgyas sems can rnams/ /so sor ma 'dres klong na khra shigs se//nam mkhas gar khyab thams cad rig pas khyab/ /rig pas gar khyab chos kyi dbyengs kyis khyab/ /nam mkha' rig pa chos dbyengs dbyer med 'dres/ /shin tu yangs so che'o 'khor 'das gzhi/ /'di yi ngang du nyin dang mtshan med par/ /nam yang mer gyis song na dga' ba la/ /e ma ho/ /rnal 'byor pa/ /'di'i ngang la/ /kha rog pa/ /glod la thongs/ /yan par zhog /chos sku 'thob/ /gzugs sku 'byung / /phaṭa a a/ /zhes blangs nas mnyam bzhag nam mkha' lta bu'i stong pa nyid la rtse gcig tu mnyam par bzhag pas/ byeng rgod phra rags thams cad nam mkha' la sprin dwangs pa bzhin rang sar yal nas/ ston gnam g.ya' dag pa la nyi ma shar ba bzhin/ sems kyi gnas lugs stong gsal rjen la bud de nam mkha' ltar stong la mtha' dbus med pa de'i ngang la snang grags kyi chos thams cad nyi zla gza' skar ltar bkra zhing lhun gyis grub pa/ ri snang sems thams cad dbyer med ro gcig tu 'dres nas/ dgra dang gnyen la khyad med/ gser dang sa rdo khyad med/ 'di dang phyi ma khyad med/sems dang nam mkha' khyad med pa'i dpal nam mkha' lta bu'i 360

rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi gral dbus su bzhag chob/ pa zhis tu gyur to/ /yang nyin zhig phyi dro nam mkha'i mthongs nas bya rgyal rgod ngo/ gnyis snga phyi byas nas bla ma'i gdan sa'i phyogs su 'gro ba mthong tshe/ kye ma bdag la bya rgod ya ki gnyis bzhin rdzu 'phrul gye gshog pa zhig yod rgyu yin na/ bla ma'i gdan sa ru yud tsam zhig la 'phur te song chog pa la/ rang la de lta bu'i nus pa ni mi 'dug snyam/ bla ma yab yum mched grogs rdo rje'i spun dang bcas pa yid la dran drags nas bla ma dran pa'i gdungs dbyangs 'di blangs so//rtsal ldan bya rgyal rgod gnyis snga phyi byas/ /bla ma'i gdan sa'i phyogs su 'gro ba mthong / /sa phyogs bla ma grogs rnams tur gyis dran/ /dang po'i mdzad spyod kun bsam mchi ma shor/ /u shu da lta'i dus 'dir 'al bzhugs na/ /mjal na snyam pa'i 'dod gdungs me bzhin 'bar/ /bla ma'i yon tan rang la drin che tshul/ /bsam zhing bsam zhing dad gus gting mas skyes/ /nam mkha' bzhin du thugs dgongs rab tu mtho/ /nyi zla bzhin du thugs rje phyogs ris med/ /nor bu bzhin du yon tan dpag med mnga'/ /ci 'dod bzhin du re skong drin can rje/ /sngon dus bskal ba bye ba brgya stong bar/ /361

bsod nams rin chen bsags pa'i zong gis lon/ /da ni bskal ba brgyad khri'i bar btsal yang / /de 'dra'i mtshan ldan bla ma gang nas rnyed/ /kye ma kye hud skal dman las ngan ngas/ /nor bu lan cig rnyed pa lag nas shor/ /lag pa stong pa'i slong mo ba bzhin gyur/ /sems la nam yang bde ba'i skabs ma byung / /sngon du rkang thang song yang slebs pa'i dus/ /mi mjal phyis mjal snyam pa'i ngang ring po/ /da ni mjal bar 'dod nas cang shes kyi/ /rta mchog gong nas song yang gang nas slebs/ /u shu sngon dus yun ring bsten na yang //da ni bla ma'i zhal ras gang nas mthong / /gsung dbyangs tshe 'dir rna bas gang nas thos/ /bsam zhing bsam zhing 'gyod pa gting nas skyes/ /kye hud rje btsun 'dzam gling nyi ma yis/ /lho rgyal 'dzam bu gling pa smag tu btang / /mi mngon chos dbyings nub rir 'then nas song / /bdag sems nam mkhar sdug bsngal sprin nag 'khrigs/ /smre sngags u shu sngam pa'i g.yu 'brug ldir/ /mchi ma'i char ba bzhin ras sa gzhir lhung / /lus kyi sa 'gul ba spu'i rtse shing g.yos/ /lag pad 'byed 'dzum byed pa'i dus gcig byung / /bla ma ma gtogs bsam rgyu ci yang med/ /bla mas rjes bzung tshogs drug rang grol ngas/ /bla ma dran pa'i 362

gdungs dbyangs blang pa'i mthus/ /bla mas rtag tu rjes su 'dzin par shog /ces blangs so/ /de nas nyi ma kha shas kyi 'phro nas zhag po brgyad kyi bar du kha ba nyin mtshan gnyis gar babs pas srab mthug khru do lhag tsam zhig byung / nyi ma mang por ja bskol rgyu yang ma byung bar sgrub pa'i sku mtshams kha bas bsdams tshe/ nang nas nyi ma mang por rtsam pa 'dra khar btab nas kha ba dang chu cung zad re 'thungs nas mnyam par bzhagade yang dal 'byor rnyed dka' nam 'chi nges med 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs 'gro kun pha ma yin tshul rnams bsams nas bdag pas gzhan gces kyi blos/ dman pa'i sa bzung hrul po'i gos gyon/ gyong lto gos gtam gsum la btang / mi med pa'i gangs dang ri sul rnams 'grims nas/ ci nus kyi sgom sgrub byed dus a ma chen po mi dran la/ dran kyang gnyen po bsten tshe zhi 'gro ba yin kyang / ri bo rma chen gye mgul na yod dus ma 'chi ba sems kyis shes pa 'dra/ zla ba brgyad lhag ngo mthong dgu song ba'i dus bro kha yang tshar/dgong mo gcig la ma yang dran nas lan cig thug na snyam pa skom pa chu 'dod pa ltar byung ste gnyen po bsten kyang ma non tshe/ ga re a mar ma phrad par lo ngo mthong dgu tsam thal/ gter ston bsod nams snyan 363

grags rin po che'i lung bstan steng du yang slebs 'dug pas/da a ma e yod ci shes/ yod na a ma/ la lan cig thug dgos/sngar a mas 'gro ru mi 'dzug gis dogs nas/ mgo bskor rdzun bshad nas 'ong dus lhod lhod byas nas kha ta yag pa zhig byed rgyu yang ma byung / mi'i skye 'chi la nges pa mi snang / da thug mi thug gang yin rung / lan cig 'gro dgos pas mi tshad 'phyis 'phyis 'dra/ nga da bar ma song bar ci la bsdad/ sngar lo nas cig thug rgyu yin snyam pa yid la shar nas rma rgyal gangs nas tshur la 'ongs so//smras pa/ sangs rgyas kun gyis pad dkar ltar bsngags pa'i/ /sangs rgyas thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /sangs rgyas rjes 'jug bdag dang bu slob kyis/ /sangs rgyas rnam thar zin par byin gyes rlobs/ /ma 'ongs chos mdzad yongs la phan pa'i phyir/ /rang gi rnam thar yang yang brjod la spro/ /rma chen gangs la sgrub pa byas pa'i tshul/ /slar yang glu ru len gyis dga' bas nyon/ /dar dkar lha lam brgyud nas 'ong ba'i tshe/ /rkang ba lham gyis bshus tshe mtsho sman gyis/ /ras zhig gnang ba rlung gis khyer nas 'ong / /de nyid mthong bas thams cad ya mtshan skyes/ /mtsho yi phyi rol thon nas g.yas 364

skor byas/ /sog po a rig zhabs drung yon bdag la/ /chos bshad mgur blangs blo kha chos la bsgyur/ /zas gos mthun rkyen khyer nas lam la zhugs/ /song nas nyin zhig phyi dror babs pa'i tshe/ /lam 'gram ngos kyi spang gzhong zhig na rkyang / /ma bu brgyad cu tsam zhig 'dug pa mthong / /ma ṇi dbyangs byas bton pas mtha' la 'dus/ /chos bshad mgur la nyan pa'i tshul du bsdad/ /de la skyel mi gnyis kyang dad pa skyes/ /yar song gangs ri mthong bas lha bsang btang / /lha phyag 'tshal dus me tog char gyis bsus/ /'dabs su slebs pa'i nyin par gangs nang nas/ /snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs 'brug bzhin ldir ba byung / /brag skyibs shig nas rang shong rdo khang brtsigs/ /skyel mi gnyis dang khal ma phyir la log /rang nyid gcig pur nyams dga'i mgur dbyangs blangs/ /rtse gcig sgom la gzhol nas nyin zhig dus/ /gnas bstod mgur dbyangs blangs pa'i mtshan mo yi/ /tho rangs nyams la a byes rma chen gyis/ /bos nas rin chen gser gyi khre la bzhag /gser mdog paṇa zhu bskon nas ming yang btags/ /bstan dang 'gro ba'i don du mnga' gsol mdzad/ /mnyam bzhag ngang nas srid pa'i rtsa rtse dang / /khyad par nye 'khor thams cad gsal bar mthong / /365

sbrang mar sbyar ba'i mgur blangs khams bsangs byas/ /dben pa'i bsngags brjod bsams nas nyams len rem/ /dgong zhig 'adz+ra zhig 'tshub mar badzus nas 'ong / /mchil ma btab pas gzugs bstan khog tu zhugs/ /rang lus lcags khang nang du me dpung bsgoms/ /'dre bsregs tshig ro mi gtsang bzhin du btang / /mdun phyogs mtsho chung kha na gnas pa yi/ /ngang ba gnyis kyi gcig de glag gis bsad/ /gcig po'ang phyogs gzhan bros nas ma mthong tshe/ /skyo nas mi rtag mgur blangs smon lam btab//nyin zhig mgo log phyogs kyi jag pa 'ga'/ /lung log brgyud nas glo bur thog tu byung / /sbyin dang bzod pa'i lag len byed du bcug /phan pa'i mgur blangs rjes su bsngo smon byas/ /mtsho chung bskams nang 'bu rnams snying rje nas/ /mtsho chen nang bskyal bsngo smon mtshams sbyor byas/ /'ug pa 'khun par rdo brgyab dgod kha shor/ /rang la khrel bdas 'ug par snying rje skyes/ /thub pa'i dbang pos gtso byas phyogs bcu yi/ /sangs rgyas byang sems mang po'i zhal gzigs dus/ /thugs ga'i 'od byung rgyal mtshan zhig tu gyur/ /de nyid rang la gtad pa'i nyams snang shar/ /'jam dbyangs dbyangs can lha mo'i zhal gzigs dus/ /thugs ga'i 'od byung mkha' 366

la sprin ltar 'khrigs/ /lha sku yig 'bru phyag mtshan sna tshogs char/ /babs pa rang la thim pa'i nyams snang byung / /mtshan zhig dben gnas lha yul lta bu nas/ /rje btsun mi la yab sras mdun du byon/ /mgo la phyag bzhag ljags mchil btab pa'i tshe/ /'od gsal ngang la gnas pa'i rmi lam byung / /lha chen tshangs pa byon nas sman rkyal byen/ /gzhan la byin dang phan thogs rgya chen po//'byung zhes gsungs pa'i rmi lam yag po byung / /de dag rnams la dga' nas nyin re bzhin/ /rgyal ba rgyal sras 'jam dbyangs dbyangs can ma/ /mi la tshangs pa bzhad pa'i mgur rnams blangs/ /nyin zhig rma chen ri yi rtse zhig la/ /phyin te phyogs kun bltas nas khams bsangs byas/ /mnyam bzhag nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang nyid du/ /bzhag pa'i lta ba mkha' dang mnyam pa byung / /bla ma'i gdan sa'i phyogs su rgod 'gro ba/ /mthong nas bla ma dran pa'i gdungs dbyangs blangs/ /ston dus kha babs bro chad ma yang dran/ /brag dkar sprel rdzong phyogs su yong dgos byung / /mdor na rma chen gangs nas sgrub pa byas/ /bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gtad pa'i snang ba shar/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi rnam thar de ltar lags/ /rjes 'jug rnams kyang de bzhin skyong bar mdzod/ /367

glu 'di thos tshad skye bo pho mo yis/ /tshe rabs kun tu bla ma'i rnam thar bzhin/ /sgrub la gzhol tshe lha yi zhal mthong zhing / /bshad sgrub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan bsgreng bar shog /ces pa'ang bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o// 368

brag dkar spre' rdzong thugs rje chen po'i gnas nas sgrub 7 pa byas tshul/brgyad pa byen rlabs dngos grub kyi 'byung gnas brag dkar sprel rdzong thugs rje chen po'i gnas su song nas sgrub pa byas tshul ni/ de nas phar bltas dpon med tshur bltas g.yog med/ bsdad las rgyu 'gro na lus rgyu med par gang bde stabs bde rang byed pa'i rnal 'byor pa ngas gnas mchog de'i lha mkha' 'gro chos skyong la phyag dang mchod pa byas nas/ myur mor lam la zhugs nas 'ong ba'i nyin zhig nyi ma'i gung la/dred mong ma bu gnyis tsam mthong ba la/ 'jigs pas lta ba'i bogs 'don kyang byas/ yang nyin zhig thang zhig nas 'brong g.yag btsan po zhig nga'i sngun nas glo bur du yar langs te rnga gzengs sna shugs dus gcig la byas nas/ tshur nga'i steng du thog ltar brgyugs byung bas sngun du nga yang phar brgyugs pas/'brong gi mgo bo dgye nas yong ba dang thag nyer btud dus mgo bsgur nas byung tshe/ gom gang tsam nas nga phar mchongs pas rwa gnyis kyi bar du slebs pa dang 'brong gi rwa yar g.yug 369

pa'i shugs kyis gnya' steng du son tshe/ gnya' bar zhon te rkang ba gnyis rwa gnyis la bkan/ lag pas ze ba'i rtsid pa la 'jus nas yid kyis bla ma dkon mchog la gsol ba btab cing / 'brong de'i snying gi phyogs su kha gtad de ki btab nas skad drag po bton nas/ kho shin tu skrag cing dngangs te thag rgyang gang do tsam du khur nas brgyugs/ de nas shed kyis cig sprugs pas ze ba'i rtsid pa zhig dang / nga dang / rgyab kyi khur bo/ lag gi sba dbyug 'brong dkrog pa'i rnga chung zhig yod pa rnams phyogs phyogs su rtswa ltar gtor nas/ phyi mig tsam yang mi blta bar bros song / nga la skyon gang yang ma byung ba'i tshe/yar langs te 'brong gi phyogs su brgyugs nas ki btab tshe 'brong kho ri chung zhig gi mgo la song nas lci ba zhig btang / kha phyir phyogs nas nga la blta ba'i tshe ngas khur bo bcings zhor la glu 'di blangs so//bla ma dkon mchog yi dam lha/ /mkha' 'gro chos skyong spyi bor bzhugs/ /'brong g.yag btsan po kha phyir phyogs/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi glu 'dir nyon/ /dang po nyes med rnal 'byor nga / /gsod snyam thog bzhin rgyug dus dpa'/ /rnal 'byor nga yang 'jigs par gyur/ /bar du rdung khar rnal 'byor nga / /370

steng du zhon nas gnod ma 'khyol/ /sems kyi dpa' zhum skrag pa sgyes/ /tha mar khye rkun btang ba bzhin/ /phyi mig tsam yang mi blta bros/ /'brong khyod de ring shi las thu/ /rtsal shugs che ba don re chung / /gshags ma thub pa ngo re gnong / /khyod kyang mgo la rwa skyes nas/ /bzur te kher nyal byas par snang / /ngas kyang mgo la ral ba 'di/ /bzhag nas gcig pur bsdad pa yin/ /da dung ma 'bro phyir la shog /nged gnyis rtsal dang blo gnyis 'gran/ /mi dang dud 'gro'i che khyad 'byed/ /bla ma dkon mchog thugs rje che/ /mkha' 'gro chos skyong nus mthu che/ /rtsal ldan 'brong g.yag btsan po zhig /blo ldan bdag gis de ring btul/ /dngos sam rmi lam gnyis kyi gang / /da dung bdag gis ngo ma shes/ /rmi lam yin rung 'brong g.yag la/ /zhon nas 'gro ba'i rmi lam dkon/ /dngos shig yin na mi zhig gis/ /de ring mthong na ngo mtshar che/ /'brong gi rwa gnyis bar nas thar/ /e ma rmad byung skal ba bzang / /zhes blangs nas rnga chung rdung zhing ki btab tshe/ rnga zing zhig byas nas lung ba'i phar rgyab tu bros song tshe/ bdag gi khur bo khur nas tshur la 'ong ba'i lam bar du/ rang gis rang la 'di skad ces smras so/ /da nam 'chi la nges pa ni mi 'dug 'chi na khyod 371

kyi slob ma yon bdag tsho la kha chems shig 'jog los dgos/ kha chems 'jog rgyu yin na ci 'dra zhig 'jog rgyu yin zhog dang zhes rnal 'byor kha chems kyi glu 'di ltar blangs so//'chi ba'i 'jigs pa las grol rgyal rnams kyis/ /'chi bdag dbang gyur bdag gi lam sna drongs/ /'chi kha'i kha chems glu dbyangs 'di nyid la/ /'chi bas ma bcom slob ma yon bdag nyon/ /'chi ba zer ba'i 'brug bzhin yongs la grags/ /'chi bdag bzlog med thog ltar byung ba'i tshe 'chi blu rim gro sogs kyis phan mi thogs/ /'chi nges nam 'chi cha med nga dang 'dra/ /'chi ba soms la tshe 'dir ma chags par/ /'chi brod dam pa'i chos la kun gyis 'bod/ /'chi khar kha chems mang po 'jog mi dgos/ /'chi bas ma bcom bde dus glu blangs tshad/ /'chi kha'i kha chems 'dra bas de lugs kyis/ /'chi med rdo rje'i sgu brnyes sangs rgyas kyang / /'chi tshul ston na bdag 'dra smos ci dgos/ /'chi ba mi rtag slob dpon yin soms la/ /'chi bdag dbang song nga phyir ma sdug bar/ /'chi rag bar du dge la 'bod cig ces/ /'chi ba'i lam la tshogs drug rang grol song / /'chi sdug mi mnga' mngon dga'i zhing du 'gro /zhes pa'ang rtse mtshar du blangs so/ /de nas tshur 'ong 372

bas ston ka ri mgo thams cad kha bas non tshe 'brong dang ri dwags thams cad shod du babs nas/ 'brong g.yag btsan po mang pos lam bkag nas/ nyal 'dug pa rnams la skor gyin 'ong / dgong zhig lung stong zhig tu bsdad tshe phu na sha ba ngu zhing /mdo na wa mo brgyal ba/ bar na 'ug pa 'khun pa sogs bar do'i skabs su slebs pa 'dra ba zhig kyang byung / de nas dbus lam chen po la zhugs nas 'ong tshe tshong dpon rnams kyi khal ma chad pa rnams spyang kyis bsad nas zos te/ spyang ki bcu tsam zhig ri zur zhig nas 'gro ba la ngas kyang bltas ki btab tshe phyi mig log log lta bzhin bros nas song / de nas brag dkar sprel rdzong gi thag nyer slebs tshe dad can 'ga' res/ khyed bzhugs gnas gang yin mtshan la ci zer sogs rgyu mtshan dris pa'i lan du mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so//seng phrug gu'i dus su tshang nas bsdad/ /stobs rgyas dus seng ma'i phyi la 'brangs/ /yar gangs bstod 'grims nas lus rtsal sbyangs/ /mar gangs mthar lhung gis dogs pa med/ /dus da lta gangs dkar mgul na gnas/ /ming gcan gzan rgyal po seng ge zer/ /bya phrug gu'i dus su tshang nas bsdad/ /sgo rgyas dus bya ma'i phyi la 'phur/ /yar nam 'phang bstod nas 373

gshog rtsal sbyangs/ /mar g.yang sar lhung gis dogs pa med/ /dus da lta brag dmar them na gnas/ /ming 'dab bzang bya rgyal rgod po zer/ /sprang chung ngu'i dus su yul nas bsdad/ /lo gzhon dus bla ma'i zhabs pad bsten/ /yar chos sgor zhugs nas sems rtsal sbyangs/ /mar ngan 'gror lhung gis dogs pa med/ /dus da lta dben pa'i ri na gnas/ /ming bya btang tshogs drug rang grol zer/ /zhes blangs pas kun dad cing gus par gyur to/ /de nas brag dkar sprel rdzong du slebs pas/ gnas chen de na mgon po phyag drug pa'i rnal 'byor pa bla brang bkra shis 'khyel nas yin pa'i a lags mgon po ri khrod pa dang / mdo sde thar pa chen po blo nas 'don pa'i jo mo bde chen/ gzhan rgya lu'i sha bu nar gye jo rgan ma dad can gcig dang / bong rtag ban lo chos skyabs spun sogs/ yon bdag pho mo rnams la phrad pas/ gtam gleng mang po byas/ngas a ma yod med dris pas ma yod pa'i skad cha 'dug zer/de yin na nga a ma la lan cig phrad du 'gro ba yin zhes chas pas/ khong tsho na re/ khyed gnas 'dir phebs pa nged rnams skal ba bzang / gnas 'dir zla ba 'ga' la nged tsho'i mchod gnas su bzhugs dgos/ deng sang dgun lo gsar tsag che/374

phebs pa'i dus min/ a mar phrad na lo rjes ma'i nang la sa la drod babs ri klung sngon por song nas/ bya khu byug sngon mos skad snyan sgrog dus phebs na bzang zer/ yang yon bdag gcig na re/ khyed kyi ma lo du yin zer bas/ lo lnga bcu nga gnyis yin/ lo rjes ma lon na nga gsum du thon rgyu yin byas pas/ a ma lo lon ma red/ khyed kyis nged tsho 'jig rten pa'i lad mo ma byed/ thugs lhod lhod gyis la bzhugs dang nged tshos mthun rkyen khyer 'ong zer nas/ kun gyis bshol btab nga 'i ngo ma chog par kha la nyan nas sdod dgos pa byung / de nas khong tshos mthun rkyen sbyar ngas khong tsho'i rgyud la phan pa'i las rgyu 'bras kyi chos bshad mgur dbyangs kyang mang po blangs nas/ skye bo pho mo thams cad kyi blo kha dam pa'i chos la bsgyur/gnas chen der bzhugs pa'i bslab gsum rgyan ldan a lags mgon po'i drung nas/ mgon po phyag drug pa'i cho ga'i lung zhus/ de nas slob bu kun bzang rang grol mtsho snying nas 'ongs pa dang phrad/ kho la mkho ba'i lung khred 'dra byas/ de dus drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma rje btsun bstan 'dzin nyi ma rin po che/ ri bo rtse lnga nas slar mtsho mjug mtsher ba rir byon nas/tshigs su bcad pa'i bka' yi glegs bu 'di bdag gi spyi bor bstsal 375

byung /lha dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi/ /sprang ri 'dzin rnams la byen gyis rlobs/ /sngon bsags 'bras bzang deng smin bu/ /seng phrug bde bar byon lags sam/ /nyams rtogs yon tan rgyas lags sam/ /lus srog thed la bor lags sam/ /dmu rgod jag pas gtses lags sam/ /nges 'byung skyo shas shar lags sam/ /byams dang snying rje bskyed lags sam/ /bdag gzhan mnyam brjes bsgoms lags sam/ /bzod pa'i go cha gyon lags sam/ /snang ba sems su shar lags sam/ /sgyu ma'i cho 'phrul go lags sam/ /'khor ba'i chos la skyo lags sam/ /thar pa'i yon tan dran lags sam/ /dgra gnyen dbyer med go lags sam/ /chos dang rkyen gnyis bsdur lags sam/ /chos la rgyal kha lon lags sam/ /mi rtag brda' ru go lags sam/ /rtag 'dzin 'ching thag bcad lags sam/ /dbyings rig gcig tu bsres lags sam/ /sgye med rgyal sa zin lags sam/ /lam la 'o brgyal byung lags sam/ /gcan 'phrang chu la ma 'jigs sam/ /sgom la bogs 'don byung lags sam/ /da lta bde bar bzhugs lags sam/ /lha dang bla ma'i thugs rje yis/ /bdag cag dpon slob thams 376

cad ni/ /ri bo rtse lngar bde bar slebs/ /bsam pa mtha' ru phyin nam snyam/ /kho bo'i go cha 'dzin tshul ni/ /gnas der rus gong bzhag na rab/ /min kyang lo shas 'dug thag bcad/ /sngon gyi bsags pa'i las dbang gis/ /'phral rkyen nye gnas shig la ni/ /sa chu ma 'phrod srog la thug /snying rjes ma bzod yong dgos shar/ /rin chen rnam gsum bka' drin gyis/ /lam la byang chub sems ldan pa'i/ /rigs rgyud bzang po'i dpon dang phrad/ /drin can de yi thugs rje yis/ /dka' las ngal dub med par slebs/ /deng dus mtsho mjug ri bo na/ /blo phab bde bar gnas pa'i skabs/ /a ma'i na bza' gsol tsa na/ /gnas der mjal du 'gro 'dod yod/ /a ma'i pho brang nyams bde na/ /kho bo de ru 'dug 'dod yod/ /bu khyod sems na ji ltar mchis/ /dngos mjal bgros sogs thub na rab/ /min kyang gang dgongs gsal bor smros/ /gzigs rten stong pa min tsam du/ /kun bzang me tog sna tshogs dang / /bkra shis lha rdzas bcas te phul/ /zhes bstsal pa'i lan du tshigs su bcad pa'i glu dbyangs 'di nyid phul/rje mtshan ldan bla ma rin po che/ /sku bde bar phebs la shin tu spro/ /bus gangs dkar rma rgyal ri bo yi/ /gnas de ru 377

bde tshul rje la zhu/ /ngas pha yul rgyab tu bskyur ba'i mthus/ /gnas de ru chags sdang ma byung bde/ /gnyen nye 'brel kha thag ring ba'i mthus/ /gnas de ru skyong khur ma byung bde/ /nor longs spyod mchod sbyin byas pa'i mthus/ /gnas de ru bro chad ma byung bde/ /rje bla ma mchog gsum byin rlabs mthus/ /gnas de ru na zug ma byung bde/ /rang snying rus byas nas bsgoms pa'i mthus/ /gnas de ru 'chi brod gdeng rnyed bde/ /nged pha bu ma shi bde ba legs/ /chos 'jig rten kha ta rim pas bya/ /bus bde tshul pha la zhus pa'i mthus/ /ma 'gro kun bde zhing skyid par shog /e ma rje btsun rin po che/ /byang chub bar du bdag cag skyongs/ /bdag ni rab dkar gangs khrod du/ /song tshul bsdad tshul rgyas par zhu/ /mtsho snying dben pa'i dga' tshal du/ /rnam g.yeng 'du 'dzi je cher song zla ba nyi mas non pa bzhin/ /nyams la yar bskyed cher ma byung / /dben gnas gangs dkar rma rgyal du/ /song nas rtse gcig bsgom na snyam/ /zas gos mthun rkyen khyer nas song / /nyin zhig phyi dro lam bar nas/ /bsdad tshe lam 'gram spang gzhong na/ /rkyang bu brgyad cu 'dug pa mthong / /sngon chad ma mthong lta 'dod skyes/ /bag phebs rtse bro brdung la bltas/ /378

'di rnams snying rje chos kyi sgra/ /nam yang rna bas ma thos snyam/ /ma ṇi dbyangs byas bton pa'i sgra/ /thos tshe 'drog pa phar la zhog /rkyang rnams thag nye'i mtha' la 'tshogs/ /bag phebs bsdad nas nyan pa'i tshe/ /tshig bzhi'i chos bsgrags smon lam btab/ /skyel mi gnyis ka ngo mtshar dad/ /mchi ma 'khrugs shing phyag mang byas/ /rma chen gangs ri'i rtse mthong nyin/ /nam mkhar 'ja' tshon ri mo 'then/ /me tog dmar ser char ba babs/ /gangs ri'i 'dabs su slebs pa'i nyin/ /gangs ri'i nang nas gdangs snyan gyi/ /ngo mtshar sgra zhig 'brug bzhin ldir/ /rang nyid dga' zhing spro ba 'phel/ /de nas zla gcig bsdad pa'i 'phror/ /nyin zhig mnyam bzhag cig gi dus/ /nyams la mi dkar zhig gis bos/ /gur dkar brgya phrag du ma'i dbus/ /shin tu mdzes pa'i gur nang song / /rab tu mtho ba'i khri zhig na/ /rgyal po chen po zhig bzhugs snang / /g.yas kyi khri zhig yod pa'i khar/ /rang nyid bsdad tshe rgyal po bzhengs/ /dri med kha btags ring po dang / /rab tu mdzes pa'i zhwa zhig gnang / /khyed kyis dam pa'i rnam thar bskyangs/ /mgur dbyangs len pa ngo mtshar che/ /gangs can bod kyi glu dbyangs mkhan/ /khyed kyi mtshan du gsol ba yin/ /379

da dung sgrub pa snyeng por gyis/ /zhor la mgur gsung 'gro don mdzod/ /mgur 'bum bod la 'jog pa che/ /ma 'ongs 'gro la phan che gsungs/ /de nas zla gsum song ba'i 'phro/ /dgong zhig nyams kyi snang ngo la/ /'tshub ma nag po mdun du byung / /phar zhes mchil ma zhig btab pas/ /mi nag gri thung can du gyur/ /su yin dris tshe rab tu khros/ /sran ma nag po zhig tu gyur/ /bdag gi khar zhugs khog tu song / /rang lus lcags khang zhig tu dmigs/ /lte ba'i ram las me sbar bas/ /de nyid khong nas cher song 'phag /byang khog smad nas stod du 'tshangs/ /lus po 'jig 'dra'i nyams snang byung / /me lce cher sbar sreg pa'i tshe/ /ma bzod kho bo ma sreg zer/ /smre sngags zhu ba mang po phul/ /phyin chad 'gro la mi gnod pa'i/ /mna' blangs 'og sgor mar la btang / /phyi nyin khog pa'i nang rnams kun/ /cung zad mi bde ba zhig byung / /rdor sems bsgom bzlas byas pas bde/ /de nas zla ba bzhi'i nang la/ /mgo log jag pa mi 'ga' byung / /bro kha'i phyed ka khyer nas song / /'gro kun pha ma yin tshul bsam/ /byams dang snying rje yang yang bsgoms/ /khe dang rgyal kha gzhan la byen/ /gyong dang pham kha rang gis longs/ /gsungs pa de yang tur gyes dran/ /nor 380

rdzas dgra 'dre'i g.yab mo yin/ /mi rtag rtswa kha'i zil ba 'dra/ /gsungs la nges shes lhag par skyes/ /de nas zla ba lnga'i nang la/ /nyams la lha tshogs mang po mthong / /rgyal ba rgyal sras bzhad glu blangs/ /zla bdun nang nas zhag brgyad bar/ /kha ba nyin mtshan med par babs/ /rje btsun mi las gsungs pa bzhin/ /che ste che ba bal 'dab tsam/ /'dab chags bya ltar lding zhing 'bab/ /chung ste chung ba 'phang lo tsam/ /bung ba lta bur 'khor zhing babs/ /yang chung sran ma yungs 'bru tsam/ /khu 'phangs bzhin du 'dril zhing babs/ /mthug rngams khru do tsam zhig byung / /nyi ma mang por ja ma bskol/ /nang nas sdod dgos dus shig byung / /de nas zla ba brgyad song tshe/ /bro chad tshur la yong dgos shar/ /lam nas nyin zhig nyin gung la/ /dred mong ma bu gnyis tsam mthong / /'jigs pas lta ba'i bogs 'don byas/ /nyin zhig phyi dro sngun tsho nas/ /'brong g.yag btsan po zhig yar langs/ /rnga zing sna shugs dus gcig byas/ /tshur la nam mkha'i thog ltar byung / /stabs kha yag pa zhig 'phrod nas/ /'brong gi steng du rang nyid zhon/ /kha phyir phyogs nas ki skor byas/ /'brong kyang skrag nas rgyug skor byas/ /des kyang ma bsad pa de mtshar/ /da lta brag dkar sprel 381

rdzong na/ /blo phab bde bar bsdad nas yod/ /a mar ma thug lo brgyad song / /rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang / /gter ston bsod nams snyan grags kyi/ /lung bstan thog tu slebs nas gda'/ /da ni lo 'di song ba'i 'phror/ /lus srog bskyed pa'i drin can ma/ /shi 'am ma shi blta ru 'gro /ma shi yod na thug tu 'gro /shi rung smon lam 'debs su 'gro /thugs yid 'dres pa'i pha bu gnyis/ /myur du mjal ba'i smon lam 'tshal/ /gangs rir song tshul bsdad tshul 'dis/ /mtshan ldan bla ma mnyes par shog /ces rgyas par phul bas sku mdun du 'byor nas gzigs pas thugs mnyes pa'i mchod pa'i mchog tu gyur to/ /de nas mtshams la sdod khar gnas la bstod pa'i mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so//chos rgyal ngag gi dbang po la/ /lus ngag yid gsum gus pas 'dud/ /gnas mchog brag dkar sprel rdzong la/ /gnas bstod cung zad tsam zhig bya/ /e ma brag dkar sprel rdzong ri/ /rin chen shel dkar spungs ltar mdzes/ /rgyal dbang pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis/ /byin gyes brlabs pa'i dben gnas mchog /lha dang mi sogs 'gro kun skyabs/ /lha sku rang byon dpag med bzhugs/ /sgom chen bya btang phal che ba/ /gnas 382

chen 'di nas grub pa brnyes/ /nyi ma bzhin du gzhan phan can/ /bla ma mang po gnas 'dir 'byon/ /gnas gsum dpa' bo mkha' 'gro 'du/ /gnas bdag dkar phyogs chos la dgyes/ /brag ngos rtsi shing me tog bkra/ /brag gseb du mar sgrub chu 'byung / /ri dwags rnams 'ong bag phebs rtse/ bod sog kun 'ong phyag skor byed/ /mkhas grub du mas gsol zas za/ /rang grub rtsi thog sna tshogs 'khrungs/ /lha shing shug pas gar stabs bsgyur/ /lha bya du mas skad snyan sgog /ri klung sngon por song ba'i dus/ /khu byug sngon mo 'ongs nas grags/ /gnas 'dir 'dug pa'i gang zag la/ /mi mthun 'gal rkyen gang yang med/ /sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen zas gos sogs/ /bsgrub mi dgos par tshur la 'ong / /tshe 'dir bde zhing skyid 'dod rnams/ /tshe blos thongs la gnas 'di sten/ /gtan du bde zhing skyid 'dod rnams/ /rtag tu dben pa 'di nyid sten/ /gnas 'di cung zad bstod pa'i mthus/ /gnas 'di'i phyogs kyi 'gro rnams kyi/ /'gal rkyen bar chad zhi ba dang / /mthun rkyen bsam don 'grub par shog /ces blangs so/ /yang nyin zhigamatshan ldan bla ma 'dod 'byung nor bu la/ /log rtog 383

g.ya' yis nam yang gos ma myong / /'on kyang dad gus mos pas bye dor byas/ /spyi bor brgyan nas snyan pa'i rgyang glu len/ /e ma stod kyi dbus gtsang lha lam nas/ /skyabs mgon rgyal ba paṇa chen nyi zla yis/ /legs bshad 'od snang spros pas skye rgu yi/ /ma rigs mun sangs blang dor gnas rnams mthong / /smad kyi rgya nag gser khang gangs ri la/ /gnam skyong gong ma dar seng dkar mo 'gyings/ /bka' khrims dam pa'i nga ro cher bsgrags tshe/ /'bangs 'khor ri dwags bye ba zil gyis gnon/ /bar gyi reb gong lha khang nyams dga'i rtser/ /rje btsun chen po skal ldan rgya mtsho yis/ /mi nub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan btsugs nas gshegs/ /slar yang sprul sku byon nas ches cher bsgrengs/ /skabs 'dir ri khrod dben pa'i bsil grib na/ /reb gong smad du skyes pa'i bya btang ngas/ /mdo sngags chos kyi bdud rtsi 'thung bzhin du/ /rnar snyan yid 'bab rgyang glu ring po len/ /e ma stod smad bar gsum dad can kun/ /da res bod du skyes pa skal ba bzang / /rgyal dbang paṇa chen gnyis la 'brel ba zhog /bzhag na 'brel tshad dag pa'i zhing du 'dren/ /gnam skyong gong ma rgyal po'i bka' khrims rtsis/ /brtsis na rgyal khams thams cad bde zhing skyid/ /rje btsun 384

skal ldan yang sprul gsung bzhin sgrubs/ /bsgrubs na reb gong bstan pa ches cher rgyas/ /nga bzhin dben pa sten la sgom sgrub gyis/ /bgyis na skyid pa'i nyi ma khong nas 'char/ /gangs can bod kyi glu dbyangs mkhan nga yi/ /gangs ri ltar dkar sems kyis glu 'di blangs/ /dge 'dis sangs rgyas bstan pa dar zhing rgyas/ /rgyas mdzad bstan 'dzin zhabs brtan yun ring gnas/ /gnas gsum skye 'gro thamarā cad bde zhing skyid/ /skyid pa'i sgo nas chos byas 'tshang rgya shog /ces blangs/ de nas mtshams dam por bsdams nas zla ba gnyis tsam song ba'i tshe/ nyin zhig sde dge'i mi tshang 'ga' zhig gi mi skya lnga 'grul lam zhig la song ba/ rgya mi 'ga' res rkun ma yin snyam nas bzung ste zi ling du khyer song ba'i bud med rnams nga'i mtshams khang gi sgor yong nas mang po ngus pas/ der ngas snying rje nas/ khong rnams la yul phyogs de'i mi drag shos po su yin dris pas/ bud med rgan pa zhig na re/ zhabs drung tshang gi dpon po rgyal mtshan dmar dris zer ba de rgya mi la ngo che/des rkun ma ma red thongs zhes yi ge zhig bskur na mi de rnams btang yong zer bas/ ngas de yin na nga'i yon bdag dad can zhig yin pas/ 'dir bos nas 'ong bas khyed rnams 385

sems ma sdug dang / mi rnams lon 'ong zhes sems gso btang nas song / de 'bod du 'gro mkhan su yang mi 'dugader nga'i bsam pa la dbang sdud cig byas na e khug snyam/ rang yi dam gyi lhar gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros te/sbyin bdag gi snying khar phog pa tsam gyis lus sems la sngar med pa'i bde stong gi rtogs pa khyad par can 'khrungs/ de'i ngang nas nga yid la dran nas mjal 'dod skyes te tshur 'ong ba'i dmigs pa yang yang byas pas/ nyi ma kha shas kyi 'phro nas yon bdag kho dang gzhan mang po mjal du 'ong ba la ngas sngar gye rgyu mtshan rnams bshad pas/ yon bdag rgyal mtshan dmar dris zer ba des yi ge btang bas sde dge'i mi lnga bzung song ba slar btang nas thams cad dga' zhing spro ba byung ngo / /de'i rjes nas slob ma yon bdag 'ong dgos pa rnams la de ltar byas pas 'ong ba byung tshe/ nga'i bsam pa la da phyin chad skye pho mo su yong dgos rung dka' rgyu mi 'dug snyam pa byung / de nas rang gzhan la phan phyir zur za skyon gtam gyi tshul du mgur dbyangs sna tshogs pa 'di ltar blangs so//byams dang snying rje byang chub sems bskyed nas/ /rgyal sras spyod pa slob mkhan yongs la 'dud/ /dpe cha'i rgyal 386

khams 'grims pa'i ban rgan nga / /nyin zhig blo sbyong lam chen zhig la song / /song tshe chags sdang zer ba'i 'phrang zhig na/ /byang chub sems dpa' byams pa rin chen dang / /snying rje tshad med zer ba'i zhi dul can/ /bla ma dpon slob rnam gsum bzhugs pa mthong / /mjal nas khyed rang rnam gsum gang nas yin/ /gang du 'byon zhes dris tshe 'di skad gsungs/ /nged gsum nges legs rdo rje gdan gyi yin/ /mngon mtho bod kyi 'ga' res shog zer 'ong / /'bod mkhan rnams tshos phyogs 'di'i sde dgon la/ /nged gsum bzang tshul snyan pa cher bsgrags kyang / /sde dgon mang rung gdan 'dren mkhan ma byung / /brag 'phrang 'di ru 'o brgyal mang po byung / /da ni mi sdod phyir la ldog go gsungs/ /lags so mi nga skal ba shin tu bzang / /phyir la phebs na ban rgan nga gcig khrid/ /zhus pas byang chub sems mchog cig 'dzum nas/ /ban rgan snying rje khyod 'dra mang po zhig /sngar yang khrid pas rgyal sras spyod pa'i la/ /brgyag tshe ngal nas phyir la log pa mang / /khyod kyang bltas na de yi rigs shig red/ /rgyal sras spyod pa'i la thur shin tu ngan/ /la der ma bud mchongs nas 'gro sa med/ /kha rog mngon mtho'i phyogs 'dir ga ler sdod/ /gsungs nas 387

ga shed cig tu bzhud de thal/ /glu 'di thos tshad rnams kyis byams snying rje/ /byang chub sems bskyed spyod phyogs la 'jug shog /ces byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems bskyed nas rgyal sras kyi spyod pa rlabs po che mthong tshe dpa' zhum nas slob mi nus pa'i rang gzhan gyi chos pa 'ga' re la skyon gtam byas pa'o yang /thabs shes zung 'brel nyams blangs nges legs kyi/ /sangs rgyas go 'phang thob pa rnams la 'dud/ /mi nga nyin zhig byang chub lam rim gyi/ /dbus lam chen mor zhugs nas ltad mo bltas/ /bltas tshe thabs kyi bro kha chen po khur/ /shes rab rta med rkang thang mi zhig mthong / /a khu 'khur shed can po gang du 'gro /dris pas kho bo nges legs dbus 'gro zer/ /khyod kyi 'og rta lam nas shi song ngam/ /jag pas 'phrog gam rkun mas khyer smras pas/ /kho bo yul nas 'ong dus rta med zer/ /rta pho med na dbus la mi sleb dka'/ /dbus pa sngon mas bshad do zhes smras pas/ /rta la zhon na khe nyen che'o zer/ /khur po stod sprugs byas nas khur bud song / /shul nas a ho rta zhig khyer na ched/ /'gro tshul ka cig ma red snyam pa byung / /de nas yar la cung zad song ba'i tshe/ /shes rab 388

rta bzang sngon po zhig la zhon/ /dran pas srab bcings shes bzhin lcag gis bskul/ /myur mo byas nas 'gro ba'i mi zhig mthong / /a khu 'gro shed can khyod gang du 'gro /dris pas nges legs dbus su yar 'gro zer/ /khyed kyi thabs kyi bro kha'i khal rta de/ /sngon du song ngam phyi na yod dris pas/ /kho bo mi rkyang rta rkyang cang med zer/ /bro kha med par dbus su mi sleb dka'/ /kun gyi kha na yod do zhes smras pas/ /khal rta khrid na lan chags lci gi zer/ /rta pho lcag gis brabs nas bzhud de song / /shul nas a ho khal rta khrid na ched/ /'gro tshul 'di yang ma red snyam pa byung / /de nas bar der cung zad bsdad pa'i tshe/ /shes rab rtar zhon thabs kyi khal rta 'khrid/ /mchog gsum rtsa gsum lam mkhan grogs dang 'grogs/ /legs bshad rgyang glu len pa'i mgron po slebs/ /e ma a khu khyed tsho gar 'gro dris/ /nges legs dbus gtsang zhing du yar 'gro zer/ /'di tsho'i 'gro tshul 'di ka shin tu legs/ /phyin chad nges legs dbus la 'gro rnams ni/ /'di bzhin song na bde'o snyam pa dang / /rang yang de ltar 'gro dgos snyam pa byung / /glu 'di thos tshad thabs shes phyogs re spangs/ /gnyis ka zung 'brel nyams su len par shog /ces thabs 389

shes phyogs re ba la skyon gtam byas pa'o//yang /khrims ldan dam pa gong ma rnams la 'dud/ /dad ldan ser mo'i blo kha chos la sgyur/ /mi nga ri khrod cig tu 'gro lam na/ /dge slong lus la chos gos rnam gsum gyon/ /thugs ni zhi zhing dul ba zhig la thug /e ma dge slong e khyed gang du 'byon/ /khyed la dge slong sdom pa su yis gnang / /khyed kyi bsrung rgyu'i sdom pa mang tshul la/ /bltas na khyed rang gcig pu'i e yin nam/ /'ga' res bcol nas khyed kyis srung yod dam/ /yang na dge slong sdom pa mang nyung 'dra/ /cang yod e dpe dris pas ci red gsungs/ /lan du lags so nged tsho'i yul phyogs 'di'i/ /dge slong 'ga' zhig las kyang brgya lhag gis/ /khyed la bsrung rgyu'i sdom pa yod ka zhes/ /smras pa'i lan du khong gis 'di skad gsungs/ /'dul khrims nyis brgya lnga bcu rtsa gsum yin/ /kho bo de ka bsrung ba'i dge slong ste/ /sdom pa len dus mang nyung khyad par med/ /kho bo 'di nas yon bdag dga' ldan po/ /tshang du 'gro ba yin zhes byon nas song / /dge slong de nyid mthong bas yid smon shor/ /de nas phar la song ba'i lam zhig nas/ /rtsag rgan zhig gyon bud med cig dang 'grogs/ /ngag 'khyal lab pa'i yar zag mi zhig 390

mthong / /a rog rgad po e khyod gang gi yin/ /chung ma yan chad khrid nas gang du 'gro /smras pas kho bo dge slong zhig yin zer/ /a ho khyod kyi gzan sham su yis 'phrog /sdom pa len dus khyod la ma them mam/ /len dus snga nas da ni tshad song ngam/ /bsrung ba don go med nas btang bzhag gam/ /smras pas de nyid spro langs ci red zer/ /lan du dge slong gzhan dag 'ga' re la/ /bltas na khyed la bsrung rgyu cang med ka /smras pas gang yang mi smra mar la song / /dge slong de nyid mthong bas yi mug skyes/ /glu 'di thos tshad dad can ser mo rnams/ /dga' bzhin spro bzhin tshul khrims bsrung bar shog /ces pa'ang dge slong 'ga' re la skyon gtam byas pa'o/ /yang /rtogs ldan sngon byon gcod pa rnams la 'dud/ /dad can gcod pa'i blo kha chos la sgyur/ /mi nga nyin zhig lung stong zhig tu song / /chu mig nyams dga' zhig gi 'go bo na/ /gcod pa zhig gis ḍā ru khro lo lo/ /dkrol zhing bro gar 'khrab nas 'dug pa mthong / /e ma gcod pa e khyod 'chams tsho byas/ /lung stong 'di ru 'dug pa'i dgos pa ci/ /khyed kyi gcod 'dis ci yang mi chod dam/ /yang na sngon chad grong du bcad tshar nas/ /ri mgo tshor yang gcod rgyu e yod snyam/ /391

'di ru 'ong ngam smras pas ci red gsungs/ /de yi lan du nged tsho'i yul phyogs kyi/ /gcod pa 'ga' rer bltas na khyed kyis da/ /ra mgo lug mgo ma mo sogs kyi mgo /gcod ki 'breg gi mi 'gro khom yod ka /smras pas kho bos bdag 'dzin gcod do zer/ /da khyed 'di nas gang du 'byon dris pas/ /kho bo ya ki grong khyer mkha' spyod du/ /'gro ba yin zhes ḍā ru dkrol nas bzhud/ /gcod pa de nyid mthong bas yid smon shor/ /de nas phar song lam chen gzhi mdo na/ /rta rgod cig la zhon te g.yang gzhi 'ga'/ /sha btags byas nas 'ong ba zhig dang phrad/ /a rog yon bdag e khyod gang nas 'ong / /lug gi nang du nad cig byung ba 'am/ /smras pas kho bo gcod pa zhig yin zer/ /a me khyod kyi gcod de'i rno res ltos/ /gcod byed gri'am sta re zhig yin nam/ /da re bcad tshad ma mo rkyang ba red/ /thar pa'i srog rtsa khyed kyis mi gcod dam/ /smras pas kho bor spro langs ci red zer/ /de yi lan du ra mgo lug mgo rnams/ /gcod ki 'breg gi 'gro dus khyod bzang ka /smras pas mthu sdig byed bzhin mar la song / /gcod pa de nyid mthong bas yi mug skyes/ /glu 'di thos tshad dad can gcod pa rnams/ /dga' zhing dgod bzhin g.yang gzhi 'dor 392

bar shog /ces gcod pa 'ga' re la skyon gtam byas pa'o/ /yang /sngon byon ri khrod pa rnams zhabs la 'dud/ /bdag gzhan ri khrod zin par byin gyis rlobs/ /mi nga ri khrod cig tu song ba'i tshe/ /ri skyibs shig na brag phug nyams dga' ba'i/ /nang na lus bsrang lag gnyis mnyam bzhag mdzad/ /'dug pa'i bya btang ri khrod pa zhig mthong / /e ma ri khrod pa khyed sku bde 'am/ /'di nas rgyun du bzhugs pa'i dgos pa ci/ /deng sang grong du rgyug pa'i ri khrod pa/ /kun gyi 'tshab tu sdod dgos byung ba'am/ /yang na grong du mi chud nyes can 'dra/ /e yin smras pas lan du ci red gsungs/ /ltogs rung 'khyags rung grong du bro kha'i phyir/ /mi 'gro rtag tu ri nas bzhugs 'dug ka /smras pas kho bo bsdad nas sgom byed zer/ /da khyed 'di nas gang du 'byon pa yin/ /dris pas kho bo 'di nas rim gyis yar/ /dag zhing dbus gtsang mthil du 'gro'o gsungs/ /ri khrod pa de mthong bas yid smon shor/ /de nas phar la song bas rgyang ring nas/ /rtar zhon mdung thung bzung ba'i bla rgan mthong / /a khu mdung 'dzin po khyod gang du 'go /bor stor zhig 'dra byung ba ma yin nam/ /smras pas 393

kho bo ri khrod pa yin zer/ /a ho khyed kyi sku khams ma bde 'am/ /jag rkun byung nas bro kha khyer lags sam/ /gcan gzan ma rungs pa zhig byung ba 'am/ /lha 'dre mang pos gdug rtsub bstan lags sam/ /brag khung glo bur thog gis bshigs btang ngam/ /smras pas kho der ma dga' ci red zer/ /de yi lan du khyed rang ri khrod du/ /bsdad nas sgom sgrub mi byed grong yul du/ /nangs nub kun tu rgyug gi rkyang 'dug ka /smras pas de yi kha sha skad tsho 'dar/ /smyon pa zhig gis ci zer zer nas song / /thag nyer btud pas mdung min sba dbyug mthong / /'o de ltas ngan snyam nas dgod kha shor/ /glu 'di thos tshad dad can ri pa rnams/ /dga' zhing 'dzum bzhin ri khrod bsten par shog /ces ri khrod pa 'ga' re la skyon gtam byas pa'o/ /yang /skyon gyis ma gos bla ma spyi bor bzhugs/ /skyon yod rnams kyi skye bo pho mo la/ /skyon gtam gang byas phan par byin gyes rlobs/ /bla mas dgon par dom zhig ster dgos sam/ /ci red zer na lo re zla re bzhin/ /'gyed phog brgyab rung da dung ngan bshad ka /khri pa dgon pa'i g.yog po ma yin nam/ /ci red zer na dka' tshegs dka' las myang bya ba las 394

don bsgrubs kyang ngo med ka /ri khrod pa rnams jag pas ma brgyab bam/ /ci red zer na ri nas mi 'dug par/ /yang yang grong nas bro kha rkyang 'tshol ka /bla rgan gdon zhes mo rtsis babs pa 'am/ /ci red zer na bza' tshang 'ga' zhig gis/ /mi 'dod dgon sde gzhan tshor bskyal gtong ka /a khu ming dang bcas pa gshegs song ngam/ /ci red zer na bla mar bsngo zhu dus/ /a khu'i ming de kun gyis mi shes ka /pha mas chung dus bu la ngan byas sam/ /ci red zer na bu tsha cher song na/ /sdang mig bltas nas sdig rdung rkyang byed ka /mal stan steng na tsher ma zhig yod dam/ /ci red zer na steng nas 'dug mi thub/ /ser mo 'ga' re sgo dang sgor rgyug ka /g.yang gzhi med na sku rim mi rung ngam/ /ci red zer na gcod sngags 'ga' re la/ /g.yang gzhi ma len bshad na spro langs ka /sman thun che na nad par mi phan nam/ /ci red zer na sman pa kha cig gis/ /sman thun a dur chung chung rkyang ster ka /a mchod zer no g.yog po ma yin nam/ /ci red zer na zhwa rnying lham chad gyon/ /mi phyugs gnyis ga'i snga phyir rgyug dgos ka /sdom pa bsrungs na don go cang med dam/ /ci red zer na ser mo 'ga' zhig de/ /lo 'ga'i 'phro nas skya sar 395

babs 'jog ka /skad cha kun gyis tshar du 'jug snyam mam/ /ci red zer na nyi phug bo kha nas/ /rgan rgon tshogs nas skad cha rkyang bshad ka /phyug po'i kha la skyag dri mi bro 'am/ /ci red zer na skad cha bshad tsa na/ /de 'dra khyi yi skyag pa yin zer ka /rta tsho gsos nas bsha' rgyu ma yin nam/ /ci red zer na phyug po kha cig gis/ /mchod sbyin mi gtong rta gsos shed phud ka /phyug po 'ga' re'i lag pa 'khum mam chag /ci red zer na gzhan gyis cig bslangs dus/ /ster mi thub par kum kum rkyang byed ka /g.yog po g.yog mos zas bzang mi 'ju 'am/ /ci red zer na khyim tshang kha cig gis/ /g.yog po g.yog mor ngan ngon rkyang ster ka /gshin rje chos rgyal rgas nas shi song ngam/ /ci red zer na las 'bras mi 'dzem par/ /mi dge sdig pa byed pa'i mi mang ka /nub phyogs bde ba can na skyid med dam/ /ci red zer na de ru skye ba'i rgyu/ /dge ba'i las la 'bad pa'i mi nyung ka /sangs rgyas gsung la khrigs khrigs cang med dam/ /ci red zer na rgyal ba'i gsung rab las/ /mo ba zhig gis gang bshad khar nyan ka /sangs rgyas e 'gro snyam nas dogs pa 'am/ /ci red zer na ma ṇi 'don mkhan la/ /'don du mi 'jug skad cha shod zer ka /396

skyon 'di rnams kyi gang yod pho mo yis/ /skyon gtam go nas dga' zhing dgod bzhin du/ /skyon rnams tsher ma bzhin du 'don par shog /ces grong dgon gyi skya ser pho mo 'ga' re la skyon gtam byas pa'o/ /yang /bla ma dam pa rnams la 'dud/ /bsod snyoms mkhan la 'phrin 'di 'bul/ /mi nga nyin zhig spang ljongs shig /dbus na khams bsangs byas yod dus/ /ra lug mang po phyogs phyogs nas/ /'ongs nas nga yi mtha' la 'dus/ /nang nas lug rgan gcig na re/ /dge med sdig med ban rgan tshang / /khyed la zhu rgyu zhig yod zer/ /ya ya shod dang ci red smras/ /deng sang bla ma sku bsod can/ /dbyar ston bsod snyoms byed mkhan la/ /skyabs 'jug 'di skad zhu bar gda'/ /bla ma'i ban dmar bkal ba'i rta/ /grwa pa gnya' thung smug ril po/ /nged tshang sgo la slebs pa dang / /khong gi mi skyas mi zhig khrid/ /lug nang 'ong ba tho thug red/ /bla mas phyag mdud gnang ba de/ /zhags pa zhig dang khyad mi gda'/ /bskon pa yon bdag rker bskon rung / /'dzin pa nged tsho'i rke nas 'dzin/ /ra dang sha gzan ma rgan la/ /skyid sdug legs nyes ci gtong de/ /bla ma 'ga' re'i phyag na gda'/ /'di phyi bar 397

do gsum po la/ /bla ma ma gtogs re sa med/ /re ba'i dus su re log ge /ma gtong nged tsho snying re rje/ /tshe 'dir nged tsho tshe thar gyis/ /yang na phyi mar yar la drongs/ /de min 'di sdug phyi sdug gnyis/ /byas na bsad thog bsad bzhag red/ /mkhyen brtse nus pa zhig ma chung / /phyi mar 'gro yang bla ma tshor/ /'o dod drag po bos nas 'gro /bla ma rnams mkhyen bla ma mkhyen/ /yon bdag 'ga' res zhwa tsho phud/ /nged kyi khyim du khyed byon zhes/ /gdan 'dren zhu dus lug gsod pa/ /mkhyen rung ma mkhyen tshul ma gnang / /zhal gsung snyan mo de dus byon/ /bla ma 'ga' re byon pa dang / /nged tsho gsod pa dus mnyam yin/ /gzigs rung ma gzigs tshul ma gnang / /lug ka ma bsha' thongs shig ces/ /zhal gsung snyan mo de dus byon/ /bla ma kha cig khyim du 'dzul/ /khri khar bde bar bzhugs yod dus/ /sgo nas nged tsho gsod pa yin/ /de dus ma mkhyen tshul ma gnang / /mi mkhyen dgu mkhyen bla ma tshos/ /de yis mi tshad tsho mkhyen na/ /de dus mi mkhyen sa na med/ /ra 'am lug gnyis gang rung zhig /bsgyel tshe ra 'ba' lug 'khun pa/ /khyim mtshes g.yas g.yon rnams kyis thos/ /'tsho ba ra 'am lug red ces/ /ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ tsho zer/ /de dus 398

zhal gsung bzang po zhig /phebs zhes snying nas gsol ba 'debs/ /kha bsum yod dus dbugs sar re/ /btang na de bas dge ba zhig /'dzam gling 'di na dkon par gda'/ /nged tsho'i las 'di shin tu ngan/ /ston kha lug shed bzang dus su/ /ma rgan las 'di lhag par ngan/ /bla ma thugs rje che zer ba'i/ /thugs rje de dus chung 'gro na/ /chung ba rnams tsho bshad mi dgos/ /tshig de'i nang du 'dus nas yod/ /bla ma dmar dmar byon tsa na/ /sha khrag dmar dmar 'di'i phyir du/ /srog rtsa dmar dmar gcod tsa na/ /nyi ma dmar dmar 'char bar gda'/ /zer ba'i lan du ngas 'di smras/ /a rog ra lug ma rgan tsho/ /skyes pa'i lus 'di tha ma 'dor/ /sngon chad sa yi rdul snyed kyis/ /lus blangs dor ba'i sha rus rnams/ /spungs na ri rab bas kyang mtho/ /bla ma dam pa'i 'tsho ba'i phyir/ /gcig kyang ma song don med song / /da re bla ma'i 'tsho ba'i phyir/ /lus 'di dor na don chen 'grub/ /chos phyir dor na mi legs sam/ /'on kyang khyed tshos bshad pa'i 'phrin/ /bla ma 'ga' rer ngas cig zhu/ /zhus na bla ma 'ga' zhig gis/ /bsdigs nas nga yang gsod la byed/ /smras pas kun gyis a ho ho/ /khyod kyang de'i gral min nam zer/ /399

skrag nas kun 'drog bros bud thal/ /glu 'di thos tshad bsod snyoms pas/ /dmigs sha nam yang mi bzhes shog /ces dbyar ston bsod snyoms gnang ba'i bla ma sku bsod che ba 'ga' re la skyon gtam byas pa'o/ /yang / mi med ri yi rtse ru/ /mi nga nyin zhig song dus/ /skye med dbyings nas 'ong ba'i/ /bdag med lta ba'i khye'u chung / /gang zag snod ldan rgyud la/ /gang na yod rung 'jug snyam/ /gcig pur gros dang gros byed/ /gros la 'di dang 'di zer/ /bla chen rnams tsho red da/ /shes rab mig ni gsal yang / /chos brgyad gcong gis zin pas/ /de la zhugs nas ched zer/ /btsun pa rnams tsho red da/ /cha lugs gzugs byed mdzes rung / /'dod sred grang gzhi che bas/ /der yang zhugs nas ched zer/ /grong gi ban rgan red da/ /rab byung bsil khang bsdad kyang / /dkor nag dug chus myos pas/ /der yang zhugaso nas ched zer/ /skye bo pho mo red da/ /gtong phod lag pa 'dzoms rung / /bdag 'dzin skran gyis zin pas/ /der yang zhugs nas ched zer/ /ban rgan nga nga zhus tshe/ /ban rgan khyod rang snying rje/ /nga zer skad 'go mtho yang / /nga 'dra can po ma red/ /nad med rgyu gtsang ma 400

rnyed/ /nad can rgyud la ma zhugs/ /slar yang chos kyi dbyengs su/ /da yang 'gro zhes gshegs thal/ /zhes rang gzhan kun la zur za btang nas ku re dang bzhad gad nyams spro phyir smras pa'o/ /yang chos mdzad rnams skyo ba sangs phyir rje btsun mi la ras pa'i gsung dang sgo bstun nas sha chang gi ston mo byas tshul gyi mgur ma'i skor la thog mar ston sha bshas tshul ni/ pha rgan chos rgyal rin po che/ /bde chen 'khor lo'i rgyan du bzhugs/ /gangs can bod kyi mi rnams kyis/ /ston dus sha chang ston mo byed/ /rnal 'byor ngas kyang ston mo bya/ /bya btang tshogs drug rang grol ngas/ /thog mar ston sha mang po bsha'/ /dam chos rdzogs chen ri bo nas/ /rig pa'i khye'u chung rdzi bo yis/ /theg pa rim dgu'i g.yag dgu ded/ /rgyud sde bzhi yi lug bzhi dang / /sde snod gsum gyi ra gsum 'khred/ /chos nyid yangs pa'i ra mo cher/ /ra lug g.yag gsum bskyil nas bzhag /bshan pa kun mkhyen ye shes kyis/ / shes rab rnon po'i ral gri brdar/ /dad pa brtan po'i sa la bsgyel//bsod nams tshogs kyi thag pas bsdams/ /ye shes tshogs kyis lto ba phye/ /sgrib gnyis srog rtsa rbad kyis bcad/ /rnam rtog phyi yi pags pa bshus/ /mdo rgyud dgongs 401

pas gzugs phung phral/ /lung rig gnyis kyi lhu ru gsil/ /man ngag sta gris dum bur bcad/ /chos can sna tshogs sha lhu rnams/ /chos nyid yangs pa'i zangs nang 'phangs/ /sku gsum lhun grub sgyed pu btsugs/ /tshad med bzhi yi me zhig sbar/ /nyams rtogs mtha' ru phyin par btsos/ /mnyam rjes zung 'jug phyar bar bton/ /de nas ston chang btsag tshul ni/ /pha rgan chos rgyal rin po che/ /thugs rje spyan gyis yongs la gzigs/ /bya btang tshogs drug rang grol ngas/ /da ni ston chang bzang po btsag /dad pa'i bu mo chang btsag mkhan/ /bos na sa nges 'byung thab kha'i khar/ /byang chub sems kyi zangs chen btsugs/ /pha rol phyin drug nas chu blugs/ /zhi gnas brtan po'i shing brtsigs nas/ /lhag mthong ye shes me sbar btsos/ /dbang bzhi rnam dag thang dkyil du/ /dam tshig gtsang ma'i phyar bar brdal/ /bskyed rdzogs rdzogs chen phab btab nas/ /thos bsam sgom pa'i mal du bsnyal/ /nyams rtogs yon tan chang langs dus/ /rlom sems med pa'i rdza mar blugs/ /mi smra rtswa 'dam kha bcad nas/ /ri khrod dben pa'i dro sar bzhag /btsag pa'i dus la bab tsa na/ /gzhan phan bsam pa'i zangs nang blugs/ /skyo ngal med pa'i dam bu 402

btsugs/ /sor rtog shes rab me zhig sbar/ /lung rig dri med them khung nas/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i chang mang btsags/ /thabs mkhas bsdu bzhi'i snod mang bkang / /de nas gong ma'i mgron la ston mo byas tshul ni/ pha rgan chos rgyal rin po che/ /bdag gzhan sgo gsum byen gyis rlobs/ /bya btang tshogs drug rang grol ngas/ /da ni sha yi ston mo 'gyed/ /chos sgu yangs pa'i khang bzang du/ /sna tshogs khrom gyes mgron cig gsog /lag bde ye shes lnga yis mdzod/ /mtshan nyid ldan pa'i bla ma la/ /bsam sbyor gnyis kyi tshang ra drongs/ /skye med rtogs pa'i sgom chen la/ /stong nyid ye shes brla de drongs/ /gsang sngags thabs lam bsgom pa la/ /bde chen nyams kyi dpyi de drongs/ dam chos gtso bor byed pa la/ /'dun ma gru bzhi'i sog pa drongs/ /rgyu 'bras shes pa'i gang zag la/ /bdag gzhan 'tshengs pa'i dpung pa drongs/ /bstan pa skyong ba'i gnas brtan la/ /kun la phan pa'i lcags de drongs/ /grub mtha' phyogs ris med pa la/ /kun dang mthun pa'i nam tshong drongs/ /mi rtag bsgom pa'i gang zag la/ /phyi rtsis med pa'i brang rtse drongs/ /'tsho byed byang sems sman pa la/ /'di phyi bde ba'i dal mo drongs/ /dad ldan brtson 'grus 403

che ba la/ /thabs shes gnyis kyi mkhal ma drongs/ /snod dang ldan pa'i slob ma la/ /man ngag gnad kyi snying rtse drongs/ /'dul khrims bsrung ba'i dge 'dun la/ /zhi zhing dul ba'i mkhal tshil drongs/ /chos sgor gsar zhugs gang zag la/ /drang don khred mkhas rtsibs thur drongs/ /dge ba 'bral med dad ldan la/ /rgyu 'bras mi bslu'i mchin pa drongs/ /nyams len byed pa'i rnal 'byor la/ /bcud ldan gdams pa'i rdzi sha drongs/ /de nas 'og ma'i mgron la sha sna drangs tshul ni/ pha rgan chos rgyal rin po che/ /bdag gzhan sgo gsum byen gyis rlobs/ /bya btang tshogs drug rang grol ngas//'og ma'i mgron la sha sna 'gyed/ /nye ring che ba'i bla dpon la/ /chags sdang gnyis kyi mig chu drongs/ /tshig phyir 'brang ba'i ston pa la/ /phyi ther nang btsog pho sul drongs/ /khengs dregs che ba'i slob dpon la/ /mtho la bza' med gnya' rtse drongs/ /drag po mthu gtad byed pa la/ /bdag gzhan phung ba'i mkhris pa drongs/ /phyogs lhung kha 'dzin grwa pa la/ /mi mthun rtsod pa'i kha sha drongs/ /dga' yan lto phyir rgyug pa la/ /bsgom pa chud gzon sna rtse drongs/ /grong yul 'grims pa'i chos pa la /thos lo bsgrub pa'i rna ba drongs/ /dad chung log lta'i slob ma 404

la/ /phan las gnod pa'i mtsher ba drongs/ /gnas gzhi sde 'khrug byed pa la/ /bdag gzhan rdzob pa'i slo khu drongs/ /nyams len kha phyir shor ba la/ /bongs che don chung glo ba drongs/ /dmar chog byed pa'i ban bon la/ /sdig sdug khrag dang chu ser drongs/ /mang po'i dzun gtam mo ba la bzang ngan lab pa'i lce rtse drongs/ /rgyu 'bras stong lta'i gang zag la/ /rtag chad mthar lhung mjug ma drongs/ /zhi gnas sems 'dzin byed pa la/ /gti mug ma rig klad pa drongs/ /pha mar mi byams bu tsha la/ /kun gyis khrel ba'i sha rmen drongs/ /chos dang 'jig rten kun spangs la/ /sha min tshil min khrab khrab drongs/ /thos chung slob dpon byed pa la/ /phu mda' thug pa'i long ga drongs/ /gtso bo dkor nor gsog pa la/ /mar 'gro lam gyi mid pa drongs/ /kha 'bar lag dam bud med la/ /ser snas bcings pa'i skyag khung drongs/ /phyug po ser sna che ba la/ /bsags shing 'bo ba'i grod pu drongs/ /tshe 'dir zhen pa'i chos pa la/ /phyi legs nang btsog rlig pa drongs/ /bud med kha dkar gting nag la/ /kha yag khog nag rgyu ma drongs/ /bud med smad 'chal byed pa la/ /sbom la ring ba'i rdo rje drongs/ /ban+de sdom pa shor ba la/ /chu dang 405

bcas pa'i bha ga drongs/ /bza' tshang mang po'i pha ma la/ /thang sha chad pa'i pags pa drongs/ /cang med khyem thabs byed pa la/ /'di phyi gnyis med rgyu sna drongs/ /phyi bshol byed pa'i gang zag la/ /le lo ngan chags 'bag lhag drongs/ /de nas mjug tu kun la chang gi ston mo byas tshul ni/ pha rgan chos rgyal rin po che/ /bdag gzhan sgo gsum byen gyis rlobs/ /bya btang tshogs drug rang grol ngas/ /da ni chang gi ston mo byed/ /ye shes lnga yi lag bde longs/ /bka' drin sum ldan bla ma la/ /ci gsung bka' sgrub bdud rtsi drongs/ /yi dam rgyal ba zhi khro la/ /bsnyen bsgrub zab mo'i bdud rtsi drongs/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong la/ /tshogs dang gtor ma'i bdud rtsi drongs/ /chos kyis bsdus pa'i spun grogs la/ /dam tshig gtsang ma'i bdud rtsi drongs/ /lus srog bskyed pa'i pha ma la/ /mchod bkur bzang po'i bdud rtsi drongs/ /'gro drug sems can thams cad la/ /'phral phugs bde ba'i bdud rtsi drongs/ /rab 'bring tha ma'i gdul bya la/ /byang chub lam rim bdud rtsi drongs/ /khyad par dbang po yang rab la/ /bskyed rdzogs rdzogs chen bdud rtsi drongs/ /thog mar nyung ngu gyis la drongs/ /lan cig ma yin yang yang drongs/ /rnal 406

'byor rang yang sha chang rol/ /thams cad shas 'grangs chang gis bzi/ /phan tshun rgyags gtam di ri ri/ /dga' spro'i bzhad gad thags se thag /kun la bde skyid nyi ma shar/ /e ma rmad byung bskal ba bzang / /zhes chos mdzad pho mo skyo ba bsangs phyir nyams dga' snang ba spro ba'i ched du rtse mtshar lta bur smras pa'o/ /gzhan slob bu dge slong kha shas kyis/ khyed kyis gnas bzang sa zhig nas dgon chung zhig btab na phyis nas dpon slob rnams rgas na mkho zer ba'i lan du/ 'o de yin na dgon chung mi dgos dgon chen zhig btab tshar yod/khyed rnams kyis kyang thob dang rgas khar skyid ces rnal 'byor dgon pa brgyab tshul gyi mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so//chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs la 'dud/ /bya btang tshogs drug rang grol ngas/ /rang lus ri bo'i dgon pa na/ /chos spyod bcu yi grwa tshang btsugs/ /nges 'byung rnam dag lcags ris bskor/ /byams dang snying rje'i ka ring btsugs/ /byang chub sems kyi 'du khang phub/ /dkar po dge bcu'i mang ja btang / /'phags nor bdun gyi 'gyed phogs brgyab/ /mdo sngags chos kyi 'chad nyan btsugs/ /dam tshig sdom pa'i bca' yig bsgrags/ /nam 'chi cha med dge bskos bzhag /nyams 407

rtogs dgon pa rgyas su re/ /mi ngas dgon pa btab tshar yod/ /khyed rnams nga bzhin dgon pa thobs/ /'phral phugs bde zhing skyid par 'gyur/ /zhes blangs pas kun gyes dgon pa de shin tu legs/ bdag cag rnams kyis kyang khong gi dgon pa de ltar mi res dgon pa re 'debs e thub blta bas/gegs med bde blag tu 'debs nus pa'i skyabs 'jug zhu zer rab tu dad cing gus pa'i sgo nas phyag dang skor ba byas te song ngo / /de nas bdag gi mtshams grol nas mjal mkhan mang po byung / ma ṇi sgol ma sgyung gnas bsnyen gnas sogs kyi lung byen/ las rgyu 'bras kyi chos bshad/ 'chi ba mi rtag tshul gye mgur dbyangs sna tshogs pa blangs nas/ kun gyi blo kha chos la bsgyur/ rta nor lug gsum ja ras gos dar 'bul mkhan byung ba rnams ma blangs par/ bsngo smon byas nas yon bdag rang rang la phyir byen/ mdzo gcig blangs nas zhabs drung tshang gi bud med cig nga la mjal du 'ong ba la glang gcig ma gtogs nor gang yang med pas glang de rkun ma zhig gis brkus song ba de nga la bshad nas mang po ngus pas snying rje nas de la byen/ ras yug mdog mi 'dra ba brgya tsam zhig blangs nas ma ṇi jo dar stong tsho gcig btab nas gnas khang gi sgo yi 408

pha ri tshur ri la lnga tshar cig 'then/ de nas gnas mchog brag dkar sprel rdzong nang gi lha sku sogs rang byon mang po yod pa rnams la mjal nas phyag mchod skor ba byas te/ a ma yod med blta ru rma chu'i tshur khar 'ong bas/ sngar gyi a ma dran pa'i 'dod gdungs de yal nas/ song na mi 'dod pa zhig byung bas/ rma 'gram de na kya phug pad+ma rdzong zer ba'i phug pa nyams dga' ba zhig 'dug de ru song nas zhag kha shas bsdad pa'i tshe/ yul du a ma drin can ma de nyid la nga brag dkar sprel rdzong du slebs nas zla ba gcig lhag tsam song ba'i skabs su/ glo bur du rlung zhig langs nas phung po ma bde ba'i tshe/ sring mo dang sha nye snying po byams a lags ban+de sogs la/a mas nga la kha sang dgong mo nas phung po mi bde ba zhig byung 'dug bter ston rin po che'i lung bstan dang / bu yis da lo thug tu 'ong rgyu yin zer tshul gyis/ da lo nga 'chi rgyu e yin/bus sngar khyod 'chi na 'di ltar gyis zhes yi ge zhig bskur yod pa de gang na 'dug ltos la/ nga'i rna bas thos sar lan cig sgogs dang / bu la ma 'phrad rung / sems la phan pa'i khyad 'dug zer/ der yi ge bton tshe mig nas mchi ma sran rdog tsam 'ga' btang nas/ da nga shi song na bu 'dir mi 'ong 409

bas kho rang gis bshad pa ltar/ nga'i rus pa bu la 'phrod thabs shig gyis/ de ma gtogs kha chems med zer/ na zug chen po med bzhin du tshe'i dus byas song 'dug sngar rang nyid brag dkar sprel rdzong na yod dus yon bdag tsho'i kha la ma nyan par 'gro rgyu yin na/ a ma ma na bar khams bde mo byas nas bsdad yod pa'i sgang la slebs tshod na 'dug ste/ sngon las kyis bsgribs/ 'phral rkyen gyi dbang du song nas/ a ma la tshe 'dir dngos su mjal rgyu'i skal ba ma byung / de dus grub dbang pad+ma rang grol rin po che bkra shis 'khyel na bzhugs pa gdan drangs/ khong phebs nas zhi khro dam pa rigs brgya'i dkyil 'khor zhal phyes/ dngos 'byor yid kyis sprul pa'i mchod sprin rgya chen po phul nas/ bla ma dkon mchog gsum la ma'i lam sna 'dren pa'i gsol 'debs dang tshogs gsog sgrib sbyong yang dag pa mdzad/ khyad par 'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po'i ring lugs ltar rigs drug gi sa bon sbyangs nas/ ma'i rnam shes a dkar po'i rnam par khong gi thugs chos sku nam mkha' lta bu'i dbyings su bsres nas/ gnas lugs lta ba'i gdeng la mnyam par bzhag pas/ ma'i sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa skye med chos kyi dbyengs su byang zhing dag par 410

byas/ chos sku'i dbyengs las ma'i sems kyi ngo bo ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa blta bas chog mi shes pa zhig gi rnam par gyur nas/ thogs pa med pa'i rdzu 'phrul la brten nas skad cig yud tsam la nub phyob/sa bde ba can gyi zhing khams su song nas/ mgon po 'od dpag med kyi zhal mjal gsung thos lung bstan dbugs dbyung nas phyir mi ldog pa'i sa thob song snyam pa'i dmigs pa brtan po dang / bsngo smon gyes mtshams sbyor byas nas phung po sbyin bsreg tu blugs/de nas sring mo la dngos po gang yod kyi khar sha nye dang yul phyogs kyi dad can rnams kyis zas nor mang po bsdus nas yul dus dang mthun pa'i dge rtsa btang / de dus rang yul na yod pa'i dad ldan mched grogs tshe dbang rab brtan gyes/ a ma'i pur sbyangs pa'i nyin de'i mtshan mo rmi lam du/ ma sngar bas gzi mdangs dang ldan pa la gos rgyan sna tshogs pas mdzes par byas nas/ 'khor dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas te/ nam mkhar 'phags nas nub phyogs su 'od kyi lam chen po yod pa'i nang du zhugs nas song ba zhig kyang rmis tshe/phyi nyin gzhan la bshad pas 'ga' res a ma las can ma bu'i drin gyis bde ba can du 411

song ba los yin zer mkhan yang byung / de nas a ma'i rus pa rnams kha chems kyi nang ltar bu chen pad+ma rang grol gyis do dam mdzad nas/ slob bu lhun grub rig 'dzin dang dge slong smyung gnas pa sogs mi 'ga' la 'khyer du bcug ste 'ong ba nga yod pa'i gnas der 'byor nas/ a ma drin can ma shi tshul dang kha chems bzhag tshul sogs rgyu mtshan rnams zhib tu bshad nas ma'i rus pa rnams lag tu bzhag tshe/ der ngas a ho ho 'khor ba'i bya ba 'di ci zhig red/ sngar a ma rgan mos bu gcig pu nga dran te brtse gdung bzod glags med pa'i ngang nas mig nas mchi ma btang / bu khyod lan cig shog ces skad dang yi ge nan tan bskur dus ngas sgrub pa blos ma thongs/ da dung a ma ha cang lo lon ni min/ lo kha shas ma thug kyang mi 'chi mod snyam nas rtag 'dzin can ngas phyi bshol rkyang byas/ sang phod 'ong sang phod 'ong zhes ma'i mgo bskor nas de'i tshe de'i ngang la tshe'i dus byas nas ma thug da lta bu ngan ngas a ma dran te thag ring nas rgyab la khur bo khur lag tu dbyug pa bzung nas rgyu nom pa med rung / rnar snyan yid 'bab kyi gtam ma la bshad rgyu rnams bsgrigs nas 'ong dus nga bsod nams dman pas a ma rgan mo de yang / yongs grags 'chi ba zer ba'i lam 412

po che la zhugs nas/mig gis bltas nas mthong sa dang / skad kyis bos nas go sar ma bsdad par/ thag ring 'jig rten phyi ma'i yul der song tshar/ nged ma bu gnyis chos byas na phyi mar 'phrad kyang / tshe 'dir lan cig 'dzoms nas gcig gcig gis sems brod pa'i skad cha tshig re bshad rgyu'i skal ba ma byung ba la sems 'phreng ste/ skyo ba tshad las 'das pa zhig skyes nas mchi ma mang po gtong bzhin a ma dran pa'i gdungs dbyangs 'di blangs so// rje bla ma sangs rgyas spyi bor bzhugs/ /spyir ma gyur 'gro la thugs rjes gzigs/ /sgos a ma'i skyid sdug khyed rang mkhyen/ /ngas a ma lan cig 'phrad snyam 'ong / /mar ma phrad shi ba'i rus par 'phrad/ /ngas bsam zhing a ma dran nas byung / /gtam snyan mo tshig 'ga' bshad snyam 'ong / /gtam bshad yul a ma shi ba thos/ /ngas bsam zhing a ma dran nas byung / /bu 'phrad 'dod re ba su yis skong / /gtam tshig 'ga' yod pa su la smra/ /ngas bsam zhing a ma dran nas byung / /yul khang chung sgo yi phyi nang na/ /sngon a ma yod tshul yid la shar/ /ngas bsam zhing a ma dran nas byung / /ma bzang mo'i lus dbyebs rnam 'gyur dang / /ngag bshad tshul 413

yid la wal ler shar/ /ngas bsam zhing a ma dran nas byung / /dus da lta yod na dga' ba la/ /nga brtse gdung sgo nas phrad snying 'dod/ /ngas bsam zhing a ma dran nas byung / /dus da lta yod na skyid pa la/ /gtam snyan mo tshig 'ga' bshad snying 'dod/ /ngas bsam zhing a ma dran nas byung / /nged kha sems mthun pa'i ma bu gnyis/ /tshe 'di ru mi 'phrad zhe re 'phreng / /ngas bsam zhing a ma dran nas byung / /da tshe 'dir mi 'phrad kho thag chod/ /tshe phyi mar 'phrad pa'i smon lam 'debs/ /ngas bsam zhing a ma dran nas byung / /da bu ngas snying po'i lha chos byed/ /ri dben pa'i dga' tshal nyams dgar 'gro /ngas bsam zhing a ma dran nas byung / /mgon skyabs gnas bla ma rdo rje 'chang / /nga'i a ma thar pa'i lam la drongs/ /sprang ri khrod zin par byen gyis rlobs/ /zhes blangs nas mya ngan byas te/ de nas bla ma dkon mchog la dngos 'byor yid sprul gyi mchod sprin rgya chen po phul te/ ma'i lam sna 'dren par mdzad du gsol zhes snying nas gsol ba btab/ma la phan pa'i tshogs bsags sgrib sbyong nyi ma kha shas la gang thub byas te/ ma'i rus pa la tsha tsha btab/ dge rtsa gang byas rnams a mar phan pa'i phyir 'dun pa drag pos bsngo ba dang 414

smon lam gyes mtshams sbyor yang dag bgyis pa'i mthus/ ma 'khor ba ngan song gi sdug bsngal las grol nas/ nub phyogs bde ba can gyi zhing khams su sgye ba'i rmi bltas bzang po byung /de nas tsha tsha rnams mi'i mi mthong brag gseb zhig tu bskyal nas mar song rma chu'i 'gram na kyal ta dmar po'i shing sogs rtsi shing nags tshal skyes pa'i spang kha zhig yod pa der sa la bsdad pas/ dang po a ma drin can ma yod dus kyi ma'i lus kyi dbyibs/ ngo yi mdangs/ skad kyi gdangs dang spyod lam rnam 'gyur rnams yid la shar nas/ de lta bu'i a ma drin mo che de da lta shi nas rus gong spar ba gang du gyur/ de tsha tsha zhig tu gyur/ de yang mis mi mthong ba'i sar bskyal nas/ da phyin chad nga yang thag ring gi sa mthar 'khyams tshe/ ma la 'phrad pa phar zhog ma'i rus pa'i tsha tsha 'di la yang gang nas 'phrad/'chi ba mi rtag pa rang gis bsgom ma dgos par a mas bstan nas song / da ni chos mi byed na gang byed snyam nas slar yang ma dran drags nas skyo ba tshad las 'das pa zhig gi ngang nas mchi ma gtong bzhin ngu ma dbyangs kyis 'di ltar blangs so//dang po lus srog bskyed pa'i ma/ /bar du zas gos ster ba'i ma/ /tha ma chos sgor 'jug pa'i ma/ /da lta mi rtag ston 415

pa'i ma/ /shi nas rus gong zhig tu gyur/ /rus pa de yang tsha tshar gyur/ /tsha tsha de yang brag gseb bskyal/ /da lta mig gis mthong mi 'gyur/ /phyin chad sa mthar 'khyams pa'i tshe/ /a mar 'phrad pa phar la zhog /tsha tsha 'dir yang 'phrad par dka'/ /bsam zhing skyo ba gting nas skyes/ /da ni mi rtag bsgom ma dgos/ /rgas pa'i a mas bstan nas song / /bsam zhing bu nga blo ma bde/ /des na dam pa'i lha chos byed/ /ces blangs nas da ni sems la 'phreng ba'i a ma ni med/ sa 'di ru bsdad nas ci bya/ yul thag ring zhig tu song nas/chos rnam dag cig bya dgos snyam pa'i 'dod gdungs khong nas me 'bar ba tsam byung ngo //spras pa/ sa gsum 'gro ba'i gtsug rgyan nyi ma'i gnyen/ /sa mthar 'khyams mkhan bdag gi spyi bor bzhugs/ /sa steng khyab pa'i chos mdzad thams cad kyis/ /sa lam mtha' ru phyin par byen gyis rlobs/ /chos mdzad rnams kyis dben pa'i dga' tshal du/ /sgrub la gzhol bzhin nyams mgur 'jen pa'i phyir/ /sprel rdzong dben par sgrub pa byas pa'i tshul/ /slar yang glu ru len gyis dga' bas nyon/ /rma chen gangs nas yong khar lha bsang btang / /phrin bcol byas nas myur du lam 416

la zhugs/ /nyin zhig nyi ma gung gi tshad tsam la/ /dred mong ma bu gnyis tsam 'gro ba mthong / /nga 'jigs snyam pa'i bdag 'dzin phung rgan langs/ /ngo bor bltas pas lta ba'i bogs 'don byas/ /nyin zhig phyi dro spang gshong zhig la slebs/ /sngun nas 'brong zhig rnga zing sna shugs byas/ /kha gdangs lce brkyangs tshur la rgyug pa mthong / /rang yang ki btab lag brgyangs sngon du brgyugs/ /thag nyer slebs tshe rgyangs nas steng du mchongs/ /gnya' bar zhon tshe 'brong rgod skrag nas bros/ /dgong zhig lung stong zhig nas bsdad pa'i tshe/ /phu na sha ngu mdo na wa mo brgyal/ /bar na srin bya 'ug pa dgod pa sogs/ /bar do'i skabs su slebs pa 'dra zhig byung / /de nas dbus lam chen mor zhugs nas 'ong / /tshong pa'i g.yag chad lus pa spyang kis zos/ /spyang ki mang bo 'gro bar 'jigs bslangs pas/ /phyi la mig log lta bzhin bros te song / /brag dkar sprel rdzong thag nyer slebs pa'i tshe/ /yon bdag 'ga' res gar bzhugs gang nas phebs/ /mtshan la ci zer la sogs dris pa'i tshe/ /lan du rnal 'byor yin tshul mgur dbyangs blangs/ /gnas der slebs nas yon bdag 'ga' zhig la/ /a ma yod med dris pas yod pa'i gtam/ /khong tshos thos zer 417

de dus phrad snyam kyang / /ma la mi thug pa yi snga ltas su/ /yon bdag rnams kyis bshol btab gnas der bsdad/ /khong tshor phan pa'i chos bshad mgur dbyangs blangs/ /gnas der 'dug pa'i a lags mgon po la/ /mgon po phyag drug pa yi lung zhig zhus/ /slob bu kun bzang rang grol mtsho snying nas/ /'ongs par 'phrad nas mkho ba'i lung khrid byas/ /rje btsun nyi ma ri bo rtse lnga nas/ /phyir phebs gsung shog bstsal pa'i lan kyang phul/ /brag dkar sprel rdzong gnas la bstod pa byas/ /zla ba kha shas sgrub pa snying por bgyis/ /dgos pa'i dbang gis yon bdag 'ga' re la/ /dbang sdud btang bas dad pa skyes nas 'ongs/ /phyin chad thams cad dbang du 'du dgos kyang / /dka' rgyu mi 'dug snyam pa yid la shar/ /rang dang gzhan gye rgyud la phan pa'i phyir/ /skyon gtam tshul du mgur dbyangs sna tshogs blangs/ /mjal du 'ong ba'i bud med cig gi glang / /gcig gis brkus pas tshab tu mdzo gcig byin/ /ras yug gshags nas dar lcog mang po brgyab/ /brag dkar sprel rdzong nang gi rang byon gyi/ /rigs la mjal nas phyag skor byas pa'i mthar/ /a ma yod med blta ru 'gro dgos snyam/ /rma chu'i tshur khar 'ongs pas 'gro snying zhig /ma 418

'dod kya phug zer ba'i phug pa ru/ /bsdad tshe slob bu lhun grub rig 'dzin gyis/ /a ma shi ba'i rus pa khyer nas slebs/ /mjal nas kha ta 'ga' re byas pa'i mthar a ma rgan mo shi 'dra ma song ngam/ /dris pa'i lan du a ma shi tshul dang / /kha chems nang bzhin rus pa khyer yong zer/ /lag tu bzhag pas mig nas mchi ma shor/ /a ho 'khor ba'i bya 'di ci zhig red/ /sngon dus a mas 'phrad na 'dod pa'i dus/ /bu ngas chos shig byed snyam dben par song / /da ni bu ngas 'phrad na 'dod pa'i tshe/ /a ma'i tshe yis ma lcogs phyi mar song / /tshe 'dir ma bu 'phrad pa'i skabs ma byung / /bsam zhing a ma dran pa'i gdungs dbyangs blangs/ /de nas bla ma dkon mchog rnam gsum la/ /dngos 'byor yid kyis sprul pa'i mchod tshogs phul/ /a ma'i lam sna drongs zhes gsol ba btab/ /ma la phan pa'i tshogs gsog sgrib sbyong byas/ /rus chog byas nas tsha tsha 'ga' zhig btab/ /dge ba byas tshad ma la phan phyir bsngos/ /tsha tsha de yang brag dbar zhig la bskyal/ /da ni sems la 'phreng ba'i ma yang med/ /thag ring zhig tu song nas chos bya dgos/ /snyam pa'i 'dod gdung me bzhin 'bar ba byung / /mdor na sprel rdzong gnas su sgrub la 419

gzhol/ /rang byon lha la mjal zhing nyams dbyangs blangs/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi rnam thar de ltar lags/ /rjes 'jug rnams kyang de bzhin skyong bar mdzod/ /glu 'di thos tshad skye bo pho mo yis/ /tshe rabs kun tu bla ma'i rnam thar bzhin/ /sgrub la gzhol zhing rang gzhan sems rgyud la/ /phan pa'i mgur dbyangs sna tshogs len par shog /ces pa'ang bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /420

dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing du yar la song tshul/dgu ba a ma shi ba'i rkyen byas nas dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing du yar la song tshul ni/ gnas der bsdad pa'i nub cig gi tho rangs khar bdag gi rmi lam du/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma sngo bsangs dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyes brgyan pa blta bas chog mi shes pa rje btsun sgol ma'i sprul pa zhig e yin snyam pa zhig byung nas/ bu khyod 'ong ba 'phyis nas ma rgan mos tshes ma lcogs par 'das song rung sems ma sdug thams cad mi rtag pa de'i rang bzhin las ma 'das/ rkyen ngan dge ba'i bskul mar go dgos pas/ da 'di nas ma sdod par/ dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing du song la sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan tshugs dang / ma yi drin gzo dang dge rtsa'i mchog tu 'gyur zhes lung bstan nas mi snang bar gyur to/ /de nas rang gi bsam pa la yang / sngar yin na ma'i mig gis mthong sar ma bsdad kyang /sems brod pa'i khyad byas nas rna bas go sar bsdad de lan cig thug snyam pa yod kyang / mi yis bsams sar rta mi rgyug zer ba'i dpe ltar song nas/ ma la tshe 'dir 'phrad pa'i kho 421

thag yang chod song / da ni lo gzhon thog 'dir rmi lam gyi lung bstan ltar dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing du song nas sgrub pa byed dgos snyam dbus su 'gro bar blo thag bcad de/ de bzhin du grwa bu slob yon bdag 'ga' re la bshad pa'i rjes su/dbus su yar 'gro'i mgur 'di blangs so//sngon a ma yod dus thug mi 'dod/ /da thug na 'dod dus a ma med/ /de gnyis ka 'dzom pa'i dus ma byung / /nga 'di ru mi sdod dbus su 'gro /sngon a ma'i drung nas 'dug mi 'dod/ /da bsdad na 'dod dus a ma med/ /de gnyis ka 'dzom pa'i dus ma byung / /nga 'di ru mi sdod dbus su 'gro /sngon a ma'i tshig la nyan mi 'dod/ /da nyan na 'dod dus a ma med/ /de gnyis ka 'dzom pa'i dus ma byung / /nga 'di ru mi sdod dbus su 'gro /rje mi la'i sgrub gnas la sogs su/ /chos zab mo tshul bzhin bsgrub tu 'gro /mi nga yi rjes 'jug bu slob rnams/ /mi nga bzhin tshe dang sgrub pa snyoms/ /sprang nga la blo gtad yon bdag tsho/ /las sdig pa spongs la dge ba sgrubs/ /kun tshe ring nad med chos mthun sgos/ /slar da dung mjal ba'i smon lam 'tshal/ /zhes blangs nas dbus gtsang phyogs su chas so/ /de nas a ma shi ba'i mya ngan sangs 422

par byas te/ sngon sbyangs las 'phro can gyi skal ldan snying gi bu mchog lhun grub rig 'dzin nam/ skal ldan rang grol la thog mar rgyud smin byed spros med ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bzhi bskur bas/ byin 'bebs kyi dus su kho rang la byin babs pa'i dag pa'i snang ngo ru/ mdun gyi bar snang la 'ja' zer 'od phung 'khrigs pa'i klong na/ bdag nyid chos sku kun tu bzang po'i rnam par bzhugs pa'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros kho rang gi snying gar zug pas sgyu lus rags pa'i snang ba 'gag cing / bla ma kun bzang gi snang brnyan yang rang yal du song bas gsung gi sgra tsam ma gtogs tshig don kyang ma go bar/thugs sems nam mkha' sprin thag chod pa lta bu'i ngang la yug cig gnas pa byung zer de nas zhag kha shas kyi bar la rdzogs chen ma rig mun sel gyi lung khrid rgyas par byas pa'i mjug tu zhal gdams 'di byen no//steng spyi gtsug pad+ma nyi zla'i steng / /rje rtsa ba'i bla ma byin rlabs can/ /spyir sems can yongs la thugs rjes gzigs/ /sgos chos mthun slob bu bu bzhin skyongs/ /sngon las dang smon lam bzang po'i mthus/ /nged rnam gnyis pha yul gcig tu sgyes/ /dus da lo gnas 'dir 'dug sa gcig /'brel legs 423

po bzhag pa skal ba bzang / /lar skyes pa mi rtag tha mar 'chi/ /gnyen 'dus pa mi rtag tha mar 'bral/ /nor bsags pa mi rtag tha mar 'dzad/ /mthar song ba mi rtag tha mar ltung //bu khyod kyis chos rnams mi rtag pa'i/ /tshul soms la tshe 'di blo yis thongs/ /rje dam pa gong ma'i rnam thar skyongs/ /mi nga yang gang du song na yang / /bu khyod kyi ci bsam 'grub pa'i phyir/ /lha dkon mchog gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /dpal chos skyong srung mar phrin bcol bya/ /zhal mjal rag bar du bde bar bzhugs/ /dus ring min myur du mjal bar smon/ /slar bkra shis nyi mar mjal ba'i dus/ /bkra shis pas phyogs 'dir khyab gyur cig /ces blangs pa'i lan du slob bu skal ldan rang grol gyes dbyangs 'di phul lo//gnas mi med dben gnas nyams dga' na/ /rje gong ma'i rnam thar skyong mkhan gyi/ /pha bla ma tshogs drug rang grol rje/ /bu bdag gi zhu don brtse bas dgongs/ /mgon khyod kyi slob bu'i tha shal nga / /chos zab dang rgya che mang gsungs mthus/ /sems cung zad chos la phyogs pa 'di/ /pha bla ma khyed kyi bka' drin yin/ /drin che bar nges so bla ma rje/ /dus da nas bzung ste ri khrod nas/ /tshe gang bor sgrub la brtson pa 424

'di/ /pha bla ma khyed nyid mnyes phyir 'bul/ /dus da nas byang chub ma thob bar/ /pha bla ma khyed rang ma gtogs pa/ /bu bdag la re ba'i skyabs gzhan med/ /thugs brtse bas 'bral ba med par skyongs/ /da drin can bla ma bde bar byon/ /slar mjal na 'dod pa'i dus skabs su/ /bu bdag ni khyed la mjal bar smon/ /zhal mjal dus dge legs bkra shis shog /ces phul ba'i rjes su nyi ma kha shas shig song tshe/ sa cha de dang thag nye ba'i 'bal mdo dang / brjid par sogs phyogs phyogs na yod pa'i yon bdag rnams kyis bdag gnas der mi sdod par yul thag ring zhig tu phebs rgyu red zer ba go nas/ mjal mkhan gyi skye bo pho mo mang po byung / de rnams la dal 'byor rnyed dka' tshul/ nam 'chi cha med tshul/ las rgyu 'bras brtsi dgos tshul rnams zhib la rgyas par bshad pas/sdig pa spong ba dang dge ba sgrub mkhan mang du byung bas kun la 'gro khar zhal gdams mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so//sprang bdag gi gtsug rgyan bla ma la/ /bdag mos gus gdungs pas gsol ba 'debs/ /rje dpal ldan bla ma byen rlabs can/ /mi 'dir 'tshogs snang ba chos la sgyur/ /sngon las dang smon lam bzang po'i mthus/ /nged dpon slob skye 425

yul mi gcig rung / /dus da lo gnas 'dir thams cad 'dus/ /chos zang zing gnyis kyis 'brel ba bzhag /da dpon slob so sor 'gro ba bzhin/ /chos thams cad mi rtag 'di dang mtshungs/ /dus da nas yul 'di'i dad ldan kun/ /dus rtag tu gang nus dge ba sgrubs/ /jag rkus rdzun kha dbyen tshig rtsub dang / /srog gcod pa'i las la dug ltar 'dzem/ /bya khu byug 'ongs nas skad snyan bsgrags/ /yul thag ring gzhan du 'gro ba ltar/ /nga phyogs 'dir 'ongs nas chos bshad byas/ /da mi sdod thag ring dben par 'gro /slar khu byug phyir la 'ong ba ltar/ /mi nga yang phyir la yang yang 'ong / /zhal mjal rag bar du bde mor sdod/ /zhal mjal dus dge legs bkra shis shog /ces blangs pas kun dad cing gus par gyur nas phyag dang skor ba byas mthar rang rang gi yul du song ngo / /der bdag gis reb gong stod kyi jag pa dang /reb gong smad kyi 'khrug pa 'di gnyis zhi ba'i thabs shig yod na bsgrub dgos snyam pa'i ngang la gnyid du song ba'i nam gung rmi lam du gter ston bsod nams snyan grags rin po che'i zhal gzigs te lung bstan 'di gsungs pa ngas gzhan la gsal bor 'di skad bsgrags so//426

sangs rgyas byang sems sprul ba dngos/ /sngon byon bla dpon rgyal blon dang / /da lta zhal bzhugs zhabs la 'dud/ /sems can yongs la thugs rjes gzigs/ /khyad par reb gong stod smad kyi/ /jag rkus dmag 'khrug kun zhi nas/ /thams cad bde bar byen gyis rlobs/ /bya btang tshogs drug rang grol ngas/ /'phral phugs phan pa'i kha ta bya/ /dad can skye bo pho mo kun/ /ma yengs nyon la yid la zungs/ /mi ngas nyin zhig dgong dus shig /reb gong 'di phyir phung ba'i gzhi/ /reb gong stod kyi jag rkus dang / /reb gong smad kyi 'khrug pa gnyis/ /zhi ba'i thabs shig yod na ang / /snyam pa'i ngang la gnyid du song / /song tshe nam gung rmi lam la/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang / /grub dbang thams cad mkhyen pa'i gter/ /gter ston bsod nams snyan grags kyi/ /zhal nas reb gong stod phyogs de'i/ /bla ma dpon po bsam shes kyis/ /gong ma'i gsung brtsis jag khrims bsdams/ /sde ba tsho bas khrims brtsis nas/ /da nas jag la ma song na/ /mi rabs bdun gyi bar du yang / /thams cad je bzang je legs 'gro /da nas jag khrims 'chol song na/ /sog po'i rgyal po sbrul lo'am/ /yang na glang lo ba zhig gis/ /gnam skyong gong 427

ma rgyal por zhus/ /lo ba dun tshun la kun mi bde/ /sdug bsngal nya mo bye tshan la/ /'phangs pa lta bu yong ngo gsungs/ /reb gong smad kyi bla dpon gyes/ /gzhan gyes nyes skyon che chung gang / /byas tshad bla dpon bsam shes tshos/ /bshad nas gyod sna kha mchu'i thag /gcod pa ma gtogs dmag 'khrug gang / /byed sa med ces khrims bzhag nas/ /lo ni nyi shu bco lnga 'am/ /ma mtha' bcu stod tsam zhig la/ /dmag 'khrug gang yang ma byas na/ /mi yi sha khrag srog dbugs la/ /rngams pa'i gyod 'dre zhig yod pa/ /de ka byang gi phyogs shig gam/ /yang na nub phyogs rgyang ring 'gro /mi rabs mang po zhig la bde/ /dmag 'khrug mang po byas gyur na/ /sad ser mu ge than pa dang / /nad rims la sogs je mang 'byung / /reb gong stod kyi jag rkus dang / /reb gong smad kyi 'khrug long gnyis/ /zhi ba'i phyir du thams cad kyis/ /bde ba can gye zhing bkod dang / /thugs rje chen po'i 'dra sku bzhengs/ /snying po yi ge drug ma bgrongs/ /che chung gnyis gas yi ge slobs/ /dkar nag las 'bras zhib tu rtsis/ /kun gyis bsam pa dkar po gyis/ /de ltar byas na tshe 'di dang / /phyi ma'i dus na bde skyid kyi/ /nyi ma 'char zhes gsungs pa rmis/ /428

snyigs dus mi tshe shin tu thung / /mi gzhon glo bur 'chi la ltos/ /nam 'chi cha med 'chi ba'i tshe/ /jag rkus dmag 'khrug byed mkhan rnams/ /dmyal khams bco brgyad nang du ltung / /sdug bsngal bzod glags med pa myong / /yar la thon pa'i dus mi 'byung / /de'i phyir reb gong stod smad kyi/ /dad can blo ldan mchog dman kun/ /'di phyir sdug bsngal bskyed pa'i gzhi/ /jag dang rkus dang 'khrug rtsod gsum/ /nam yang cung zad ma byed par/ /gang thub dge la gzhol cig ces/ /gtam 'di tshogs drug rang grol ngas/ /reb gong stod smad thams cad kyi/ /dad can pho mo yongs la smras/ /thos tshad rnams la phan par shog /ces yi ger bkod nas reb gong stod smad thams cad la bskur bas phan thogs rgya chen po byung /de nas mang ra'i chu bzang phyogs su 'ong ba'i lam bar brjid par gyi nags khrod cig tu tsha 'bog brgyab gung tshigs blangs nas 'ongs pa'i rjes su mdun lcog gi rdo la phyag rjes dang / rma chu'i pha ri nas tshur khar 'phur ba dang / lus thugs rje chen po la sogs pa'i lha sku ru mthong ba sogs gang zag las snang dag pa rnams kyis sangs rgyas dngos su mthong nas/ phyogs phyogs su snyan pa dang grags pa bsgrags pa byung / chu bzang du 'ongs 429

pas mkhas btsun bzang gsum 'dzoms pa'i rkang tsha'i bo tsug a lags dge 'dun shes rab dang mjal/ khong gis dag snang rgya chen po mdzad de khri mthon por bzhag sbra nag khag gsum gyi mi dmu rgod rnams kyi rgyud cig e thul dgongs nas/ nga la khyed kyis 'di rnams la chos gsung dgos/ thams cad kyis khong gi gsung la nyan dgos zhes rten 'brel legs tshogs thams cad bsgrigs/ der khong gis thang zhig nas khri mthon po zhig brtsigs nas bzhag phyogs phyogs su brda brgyab ste/ khong zla ba gcig las mi bzhugs par dbus su phebs rgyu red/ de tshun la mjal mkhan thams cad slebs pa gyis dang / khong gis thams cad la snying rje chen po'i sgo nas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor rgyu yin zhes yang yang bsgrags pas/ de dus sbra nag khag gsum dang zhabs drung gi ru sde rnams dar yod pa'i dus yin pas/ skye bo pho mo thams cad kyis mchor ba'i rgyan cha btags rta bzang po la zhon/ sbis dkar bzang po khyer nas nyin re bzhin mjal mkhan brgya stong mang ngo 'ongs nas/ chu bzang gi lung ba thams cad sbis dkar dang thab rdos gang ba byung /de'i dus mi 'ga' zhig gis khyed kyis chu ge e bzhes zer/ngas mi 'thung byas pas/ khyed kyis chu ge ci la ma bzhes pa yin 430
