zer ba'i lan du/ nga la de bas lhag pa'i chu ge 'thung rgyu yod ces rnal 'byor chu ge 'thung tshul gyi mgur 'di blangs so//pha chos kyi rgyal por gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyud chos dang 'dres par byin gyis rlobs/ /gnas lugs rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /rig 'dzin byams pa chos dar ngas/ /mi yi chu ge 'thung ma myong / /kun la med pa'i chu ge yod/ /dam chos chu ge 'thung snyam blos/ /'khor ba'i chos la skyo ba skyes/ /'jig rten phun tshogs rin du 'jal/ /rdzogs pa chen po'i rgod ma nyos/ /snying rje'i rte'u mngal nas thon/ /rang chas lhun grub 'o ma byung / /stong nyid bu mo gzhon nu mas/ /sku gsum 'dug stangs dag gis bsdad/ /sgo gsum gnad kyi bzho snod du/ /sgon ma bzhi yi mdzub mo yis/ /nyams snang bzhi yi 'o ma bzhos/ /zang thal rjen pa'i snod du blugs/ /ka dag lhun grub zung 'brel gyi//nyams len gser gyi thur mas dkrugs/ /rang babs ngang du ltems kyis bzhag /da ni bdag gis phud cig mchod/ /bu pho rig pa'i khye'u chung khyod/ /rang babs ngang du lhan ne+e bzhengs/ /ma yengs dran pa'i skyogs kyis chus/ /e ma ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos/ /mya ngan grol ba'i chu ge'i phud/ /bla ma yi dam lha tshogs mchod/ /skye med chos sku'i ngang du 431

bzhes/ /bka' drin che ba'i dga' ston yin/ /bar pas mkha' 'gro chos skyong mchod/ /blo las 'das pa'i ngang du bzhes/ /'phrin las 'grub pa'i dga' ston yin/ /tha mas rdo rje'i spun rnams mchod/ /ma bcos rang babs ngang du bzhes/ /dam tshig gtsang ba'i dga' ston yin/ /de 'og bdud rtsi'i lhag ma de/ /skal ldan bya btang bdag gis 'thung / /mgron rnams bdud rtsi bzang pos mnyes/ /phun sum tshogs pa'i bkra shis brjod/ /rnal 'byor rang yang bdud rtsis bzi/ /na chung bde bas myos pa bzhin/ /bdud rtsi'i ro yis gting nas myos/ /lkugs pas rmi lam rmis pa bzhin/ /brjod du med pa'i nyams shig shar/ /bu ram zos pa'i ro bzhin du/ /dbye ru med pa'i don cig rtogs/ / mkha' la chu 'dzin dengs pa bzhin/ /ma rig nyon mongs dbyings su yal/ /rtsal po che yis mda' 'phangs ltar/ /phyir mi ldog pa'i gdeng zhig rnyed/ /dbul pos sgyed rdo gser shes bzhin/ /dpag tu med pa'i dga' spro shar/ /nyams dga' 'o skyid do rdo rje'i srun/ /zhes blangs pas dad cing gus par gyur to/ /de nas sbra nag khag gsum dang zhabs drung tshang gi sog po dang / yul phyogs gzhan khri ka dang / reb gong mar nang tsho 432

lnga sogs phyogs phyogs nas mjal mkhan mang po 'ongs te khrom chen po 'tshogs pa'i dus/ thang nas khri brgyab yod pa'i khar song bla ma dkon mchog la gsol ba btab ste byam sa snying rje byang chub sems kyi sgo nas nyin re bzhin skye bo pho mo yongs la chos bshad gzhan phan nyi ma'i nang ltar las rgyu 'bras kyi chos zhib la rgyas pa skad cha byas nas bshad/ gzhan skyabs 'gro ltung bshags ma ṇi bsnyen gnas smyung gnas sgol ma gdugs dkar rdo rje gcod pa sogs kyi lung dgos pa rnams bu chen skal ldan rang grol gyis byen pas/ sngar sangs rgyas grangs med byon pas ma thul ba'i sbra nag khag gsum zhes grags pa'i mi bsrun pa'i skye bo mtho dman su la yang 'phrog bcom dang mi dge ba'i las 'ba' zhig la brtson pa rnams kyi blo kha dam pa'i chos la 'gyur nas/ lo re bzhin bya dang ri dwags ra lug mang po gsod pa rnams kyis sdig rgyun dang jag rkus bcad/ lo mang bo'i bar du mdzo mo'i ltol bu dang / lug gu mi gsod par 'jog pa'i khyem tshang mang po byung / sngar g.yog po ltol bu gsod mkhan tshos kyang ma bsad pas thams cad ngo mtshar zhing dge ba sgrub pa'i skye bo pho mo mang po byung / skal ba dang ldan pa'i bu slob mang po la rta phag yid bzhin nor bu'i dbang dang /433

rdzogs chen ma rig mun sel gyi khrid byas/ tshe blos btang gi slob ma nyi shu tsam byung / yon bdag pho mo rnams kyis phul ba'i rta nor lug gsum ja ras gos dar lus kyi rgyan cha sogs nor rdzas len rgyu yin na lung bar mi shong ba tsam 'bul bar gda' ste/ de byang lam nas sdug dka' las red snyam ma blangs par bsngo ba smon lam byas nas phyir la byen/rgyu nom blangs pa'i nang nas phal cher skabs der 'phral du mchod sbyin du btang /dngul srang stong phrag gcig dang g.yu byi ru dkar yol do tsam dang / kha btags tshe sku ma brgya phrag mang po byung ba rnams dbus su 'khyer rgyu la dmigs nas tshags byas/ zhabs drung nas yin pa'i dge slong ngag dbang dar rgyas dang kun bzang rang grol/ a lags brtson 'grus/ zho 'ong ban+de/ bong stag gcod pa rnams kyis zhabs phyi byas nas dbus su 'gro ba'i mthun rkyen grogs khal rta mang po dang bcas te dka' tshegs med par myur du 'grigs tshe/ rkang tsha'i bo tsug a lags dge 'dun shes rab rin po che'i mdun du song ste mjal nas zas nor gyi 'phro gang yod phul nas chos 'brel zhus/ khong gis rta gcig dbus rdzongs su gnang / thugs mnyes pa'i gsung gleng mang po byas pa'i mthar so sor gyes khar bde zhus su tshigs 434

bcad kyi dbyangs 'di phul lo//stong gsal nam mkha' khyed sku khams bde ba ru bzhugs dang / /'dzam gling nyi ma nga gling bzhi bskor ba la chas 'gro /nam zhig 'od zer dang bcas te myur du rang slebs 'ong / /dpag bsam lngon shing khyed sku khams bde ba ru bzhugs dang //bya rgyal khu byug nga yul phyogs gzhan du rang chas 'gro /nam zhig skad snyan dang bcas te myur du rang slebs 'ong / /stong ldan me tog khyed sku khams bde ba ru bzhugs dang / /yid 'ong bung ba nga phyogs bcur zas phyir la chas 'gro /nam zhig bung sgra dang bcas te myur du rang slebs 'ong / /mtshan ldan bla ma khyed sku khams bde ba ru bzhugs dang / /skal ldan slob ma nga dben gnas gang dga' ru chas 'gro /nam zhig mjal dar dang bcas te myur du rang slebs 'ong / /zhes phul bas khong gis gzims gur gyi phyi logs su skyel thung byas nas nang du phebs so/ /de nas nga chu bzang du 'ongs nas 'gro khar skye pho mo dad can der 'tshogs pa rnams la lugs gnyis kyi bslab bya mang po byas pa'i mthar bde zhus tshigs su bcad nas 'di ltar dbyangs su blangs so//steng spyi gtsug pad+ma nyi zla'i steng / /rje rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 435

'chang / /mi 'dir 'tshogs yon bdag pho mo la tshe 'di phyir skyid pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /mdog sngo zhing 'phur na rab bde ba'i/ /khyed lha lam yangs pa bde mor sdod/ /nga bya rgod thang dkar yul gzhan 'gro /slar nam 'phang bstod du yang yang 'ong / /mdog dkar zhing bab na rab bde ba'i/ /khyed 'o ma'i rgya mtsho bde mor sdod/ /nga lha bya ngang ba yul gzhan 'gro /slar skyid nyal byed du yang yang 'ong / /sems dkar zhing 'grogs na rab bde ba'i/ /khyed grwa slob yon bdag bde mor sdod/ /nga rnal 'byor dbus gtsang zhing du 'gro /slar sgom sgrub byed du yang yang 'ong / /da khyed rnams tshe ring lo brgya lon/ /nga rnal 'byor sku tshe ring bar smon/ /bkra shis pa'i nyi mar slar mjal dus/ /bkra shis pas phyogs 'dir khyab gyur cig /ces blangs pa'i lan du bu chen skal ldan rang grol gyes dbyangs 'di phul lo//rje dam pa gong ma'i rnam thar de/ /tshul bzhin du skyong ba'i drin can rje/ /pha bla ma tshogs drug rang grol gyis/ /sprang bdag gis dbyangs la gsan par mdzod/ /sngon smon lam bzang po btab pa'i mthus/ /nged rnam gnyis da lo 'dir bzhugs nas/ /las ci byas chos su song ba de/ /pha bzang po 436

khyed kyi bka' drin yin/ /phyogs gzhan du phebs pa thos pa'i mod/ /pha khyod la 'bral glags mi phod rung / /gnyen 'dus pa'i tha mar 'bral nges pa/ /de bsam na 'gyod pas ci la phan/ /gnas dag zhing dbus gtsang phebs pa la pha bzang po sku khams bde mor byon/ /bu ngas kyang khyed kyi bzhed don kun/ /dus myur du 'grub pa'i smon lam 'debs/ /de bzhin du dam pa khyed kyis ni/ /mi nged rnams rjes su 'dzin phyir du/ /bkra shis pa'i gnas mchog 'di nyid du/ /zhal myur du mjal ba'i thugs smon mdzod/ /skyabs dkon mchog gsum gye thugs rje dang / /lha chos skyong srung ma'i mthu stobs kyis/ /grwa bu slob rnams kyi bsam pa'i don/ /yid smon bzhin 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog /ces phul ba'i mthar thams cad kyis bskyal nas chu bzang mar kha'i thang gi phyed tsam la 'ongs nas/skyel mkhan gye grwa bu slob yon bdag sum brgya tsam zhig yod pa rnams sa la 'dug tu bcug nas thams cad la bka' bsgo byin rlabs byas mthar/ 'o nged rnams sngon gye las smon dag pas mtshams sbyar nas bkra shis chos mthun gyi sgo nas mjal te//chos dang zang zing gnyis kyi sgo nas 'brel ba zab mo bzhagad yang bkra shis chos mthun gyi sgo nas so sor gyes pa 'di 437

bzhin chos thams cad mi rtag mi brtan snying po med pa 'di'i rang bzhin can yin la/ khyad par bza' tshang pha ma bu gsum 'dzoms pa yang mi rtag par snga phyi rim pa byas nas/ tshe phyi ma'i yul du 'gro bar nges pas khyed rnams kyis da phyin chad 'chi ba mi rtag pa soms la chos gyis/ nga yang gang du song kyang khyed rnams mi brjed par sems la bzhag nas tshe 'di phyir phan pa'i skyabs 'jug bsngo smon bya/ zhes yar langs sba dbyug la 'khen nas rnal 'byor 'gro kha'i zhal gdams kyi mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so//gnas snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo nas/ /rje rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang / /rtsa dbu ma'i lam nas yar byon la/ /steng spyi gtsug bde chen rgyan du bzhugs/ /mi 'dir 'tshogs lus kyi na tsha dang / /sems sdug bsngal gang yod kun bsal nas/ /lus bde ba sems la dga' ba bskyed/ /blo chos la phyogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /nged thams cad yar mar kun nas 'ongs/ /dus da re gnas 'dir yud tsam 'tshogs/ /da mi sdod so sor gyes pa ltar/ /chos thams cad mi rtag 'di dang 'dra/ /sngar yul mi khyim mtshes rgan rgon dang / /mi'i smon gnas pho mo gzhon nu yang / /lo ring bor ma lon shi tshul soms/ /nged 438

thams cad de yi rang bzhin yin/ /da mi lo brgyad cu tshun chad la/ /nged 'dir 'tshogs gcig kyang mi lus par tshe 'di nas 'jig rten pha rol 'gro /phyis khrel yod 'ga' res dran nas ngu/ /tshe phyi mar 'gro dus lag stong 'gro /rgyu nom pa bsags nas gang du 'khyer/ /grogs bzang po yod kyang 'grogs dbang med/ /'phrang ri bor bar dor gcig pur 'gro /de'i dus su 'dren mkhan bla ma dang / /phan nges pa dam pa'i chos yin pas/ /khyed dad can 'dir 'tshogs pho mo kun/ /dus da nas nam 'chi cha med soms/ /las mi dge bcu bo dug ltar spongs/ /rgyu nor la ser sna ma byed par/ /yar bla ma dkon mchog gsum por mchod/ /mar dbul po rnams la sbyin pa thongs/ /bar pha ma a khur brtsi bkur rem/ /bran g.yog por ma sdig lto gos byin/ /khyi phyugs la ma rdung legs par skyongs/ /khyim bza' tshang ma 'khon mthun par 'grogs/ /grogs khyim mtshes ma gnod phan thogs gyis/ /lus dal bar ma sdod phyag skor rem/ /kha dal bar ma 'dug ma ṇi bgrongs/ /skabs skabs su smyung gnas sdom pa srungs/ /dus rgyun du bsam pa dkar po gyis/ /mi nga yang gang du song na yang / /khyed thams cad sems kyis mi brjed 439

par/ /tshe 'di yi bar chad e sel dang / /tshe phyi ma'i lam sna 'dren thub blta/ /nga ri la 'dug pa'i sgom chen dang / /khyed 'brel ba 'jog pa'i skya ser rnams/ /sangs mnyam po rgya ba'i smon lam 'debs/ /khyed rnams kyang de ltar yid smon gyes/ /dus da dung tshe mjug 'di nyid la/ /zhal yang nas yang du mjal bar smon/ /dus da nas mjal rgyu'i ma song na/ /tshe phyi mar mjal ba'i smon lam 'tshal/ /khyed 'dir 'tshogs dad can pho mo la/ /ngas phan pa'i snyeng gtam smras pa yin/ /skabs skabs su thon la dran gso gyis/ /dus da res phan tshun 'brel ba zab/ /da khyed rnams 'tshams por bde mor lags/ /glu 'di nyid bton dang thos tshad kun/ /dus rtag tu bde zhing skyid par shog /ces dbyangs snyan la ring ba byas nas blangs pas de dus thams cad kyi lus kyi ba spu g.yo ba dang mig nas mchi ma 'khrugs pa'i dad gus tshad med pa skyes so/ /de nas ngas sba dbyug gis sa la rtags shig brgyab nas/ /da 'di man la ma 'ong bar sdod dang rten 'brel gye gnad cig yod ces bshad pas thams cad kyis phyag gyang 'gyel ba ltar 'tshal te/skyabs 'jug zhus nas rang rang gi yul du song / bu chen skal ldan rang grol khri ga'i phyogs su song / nga yang gzings 440

thog nas rma chu'i phar khar song ri hang nga'i phar ri brag dkar sprel rdzong gi yar phyogs na rkang tsha yod pas dbon po ban+de thar dang / tshe ring rgyal spun gnyis kyi thag nyer gur phub nas zhag po kha shas bsdad/ khong rnams kyis mdzo rta dngul gos g.yu byir sogs nor rdzas mang po phul ba blangs nas bsngo smon bkra shis byas/ rkang tsha'i ru skor gyi skya mi thams cad kyis la mthon po zhig gi mgor bskyal nas/ dbon po ban+de la sogs pa'i yon bdag phyir ldog pa rnams la slar yang mjal ba'i smon lam gyi mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so//steng spyi gtsug 'ja' gur 'od klong gi /rje bla ma dkon mchog byen rlabs can/ /nged 'dir 'tshogs tshe ring nad med par/ /slar yang yang mjal bar byin gyis rlobs/ /khyod shar phyogs ri bo bde mor sdod/ /nga zla ba mi sdod gling gzhan 'gro /gza' khyab 'jug dbang du ma song na/ /slar shar ri'i rgyan du slebs nas 'ong / /khyed byang gi rdza ri bde mor sdod/ /nga 'brong chung mi sdod spang rir 'gro /stag rngon pa'i dbang du ma song na/ /slar rdza ri'i rgyan du slebs nas 'ong / /khyed mdo smad dad can bde mor sdod/ /nga rnal 'byor dbus gtsang zhing du 'gro /na 'chi ba'i dbang du ma song na/ /slar dad 441

can rgyan du slebs nas 'ong / /khyed 'dir 'tshogs tshe ring nad med cing / /nga rnal 'byor sku tshe ring bar smon/ /bkra shis pa'i nyi mar slar mjal dus/ /bkra shis pas phyogs 'dir khyab gyur cig /ces blangs pas der 'tshogs pa kun gyis lam skabs su chu kha rab kha tsho la thugs chung gyis sogs phan pa'i gtam bshad cing / yang yang mjal ba'i smon lam btab nas song ngo / /de nas skyel mi bcu tsam gyes bskyal/gzhan yang dbus la 'gro rogs bra tsha'i phyag rdor dang /mkhar byams/ rkang tsha'i tshe ring rgyal sogs sbra nag khag gsum gyi mgron po lnga bcu khal rta mang po dang bcas te/ rab myos zhes pa lcags pho rta'i lo chu stod zla ba'i yar tshes dge bar dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing du yar la chas nas song / de dus g.yon zhis ban+de thar gyis phul ba'i rta dkar po zhig yod pa de la zhon nas song tshe/ nga rta la mi chags pa'i stabs kyis rnal 'byor rta rgyug gi mgur 'di blangs so//pha bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyud smin cing grol bar byen gyis rlobs/ /nga mi yi rta la mi chags kyang / /mtshan ldan bla ma'i bka' drin gyis/ /mi yi rta pho de bas kyang / /bdag la stong nyid rta pho yod/ /mi yi bde legs de bas 442

kyang / /bdag ni rta yi gong na bde/ /stong pa nyid kyi rta pho la/ /tshul khrims rnam dag srab cig 'jog /byang chub sems kyi sga cha la/ /dad pa brtan po'i sga stan bting / /dag snang mos gus glo rmed rgyag /snang stong zung 'jug 'ob chen 'dogs/ /sga bzang rta bzang thog tu bstad/ /bu rang byung rig pa'i khye'u chung ngas/ /tshad med bzhi yi gos chen gyon/ /dam tshig gtsang ma'i ske rags bcings/ /mtshan ldan bla ma'i zhwa bzang dang / /khro med bzod pa'i sag lham gyon/ /bdag ni rta yi gong du zhon/ /mnyam nyid zang thal thang thog nas/ /bu rig pa'i khye'u chung rta rgyug byed/ /bla ma'i gdams ngag lcag gis brabs/ /brtson 'grus srab kha gyen du bsgyur/ /the tshom med par rta kha gtong //'khor 'das gnyis kyi ltad mo ltos/ /'gro ni thar pa'i lam la 'gro /bgrod ni 'khor ba'i 'dam nas bgrod/ /rtag chad sa la ltung ma myong / /thogs rdugs bral ba'i rta bzang 'di/ /bros na gshin rje'i kha nas thar/ /ded na skyi bser rlung yang zin/ /ang gi skal ldan gzhon nu tsho/ /nyo na stong nyid rta bzang nyos/ /rgyug na rta la 'di ltar rgyugs/ /zhes blangs nas rta de la zhon nas song ngo / /de nas dbus lam rdza zor ba nas zhag po bcu lhag tsam la smad phyogs 443

kyi dbus pa yar 'gro ba rnams la bsgugs nas sdod dgos byung / de'i lo dbus nas mar 'ong ba'i tshong dpon 'ga' res lam nas bzhag pa'i/ khri ga'i mi gcig 'chi la nye bar yod pa go nas nyi ma gnyis su btsal ba'i rjes su rnyed pa la lto gos byin nas srog bskyabs te rang yul du btang / der bskyal yong mkhan rnams la slar mjal ba'i bkra shis smon lam gyi mgur 'di blangs so//drin can gye bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /'dir 'tshogs kyi sgo gsum byen gyis rlobs/ /'dir 'dus kyi dad can pho mo kun/ /rnal 'byor nga'i glu 'dir dar cig nyon/ /sngon bsags kyi las bzang smon lam mthus/ /'dir 'tshogs kun ston pa sangs rgyas kyi/ /bstan pa dang mjal ba skal ba bzang / /mngon mtho dang nges legs go 'phang gang / /bsgrub na yang rang gi lag na yod/ /rang nyid kyi lag na yod dus 'dir/ /'dir 'tshogs kun nges legs sangs rgyas kyi/ /go 'phang de 'thob thabs myur du sgrubs/ /bung ba yis rgyang glu ring po blangs/ /rgyang ring du 'phur nas 'gro ba ltar/ /rnal 'byor ngas skyid pa'i rgyang glu blangs/ /thag ring gi dbus su chas nas 'gro /phyir la yang bung ba 'ongs pa 444

ltar/ /rnal 'byor nga phyir la myur du 'ong / /'ongs pa'i dus dge legs bkra shis kyis/ /yul phyogs 'dir rtag tu khyab gyur cig /ces blangs pas kun dad cing gus pa'i sgo nas phyag dang skor ba byas te mjal nas sku bde mo lags zhes bde zhus byas nas slar rang yul du log go /de'i dus mar nang be'u thang nas yin zer ba'i klu nad pa zhig rma chen gangs chu 'thung du 'gro ba yin zer ba la snying rje nas/ mdzo gcig sga thag pa cog pu zla ba gcig gi lto dang / ba ma khol mo me lcags bcas byen nas btang bas/ phyis kho nad las thar te mdzo la zhon nas glu len bzhin yul du log skad/ de nas lam skabs rnams su gung tshigs dang dge sbyor 'chag med byas/ 'grul ba rnams la jag rkus ri dwags bsad mi chog pa la sogs pa'i bslab bya rgyas par bshad nas song tshe/ dad can slob bu dge slong ngag dbang dar rgyas kyis da lta'i mgon po rnams kyis gtso byas ma 'ongs pa na dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing du 'gro ba rnams la/ gzhi dang lam bar gang du'ang phan pa'i bslab bya zhib la rgyas pa zhig mgur du bzhengs dgos zhes bskul ngor/bshul ring mgron po'i lam glu zhes bya ba'i mgur ma'i skor la/dang po bya spyod ngan pa spang dgos tshul gyi mgur ni/445

'gro ba yongs kyi phyag mchod zhing / /rgyal ba yab sras zhabs la 'dud/ /dbus su mjal 'dod thag ring gi /mgron po yongs la thugs rjes gzigs/ /dang po mgron po ngan pa yis/ /khal rtar stan ngan sga ngan bstad/ /khal yang phyi mo rkyang ba bkal/ /ga ler mi 'gro mgyogs por 'gro /bro lug yin zer lug mang ded/ /lam nas ri dwags mang po gsod/ /bro lug tshar tshe lam nas nyos/ /sdig pa byed kyin byed kyin 'gro /'gro tshul 'dug tshul kha 'go de/ /gcig gis byas na de min zer/ /yar mar 'then nas gros mi mthun/ /'gro myong can gyi khar mi nyan/ /lam skabs bya ba phal cher nyes/ /lam yang nor nas log par 'gro /nub thun mi byed nyal nas sdod/ /rkun mas khyer tshe skor rgyug byed/ /khal rta rtswa khar mi 'ded 'jog /lam nas lus tshe sdug gtam mang / /chu shing mi len ba khar nyul/ /'bud shing chad tshe grogs la 'khon/ /sos dal sdod dus pho tshod mtho/ /so thun mi dgos drag drag zer/ /jag pa slebs tshe snying rtsa 'dar/ /'thab sar mi 'gro song na yibs/ /lam skabs mgron po thams cad kyis/ /skog nas ngan smra shub shub shub/ /phyi yi dgra la ngan mi thub/ /nang 'khon byed dus sus mi thub/ /lto che ltogs 446

'khyags tshegs mi theg /za mar che chung mtho dman zhig /shor na spro langs sdang mig blta/ /kho rang tsho tsho snum snum za/ /gcig la skal zhig ster mi dpe/ /gal te ster na kham bu gang / /byin nas khyod kyis 'di zo zer/ /za rin mi dgos mid rin med/ /len mkhan ngo tsha langs nas 'gro /kha bde 'ga' res la yog na/ /mi des za tshul bshad tshul gyi/ /lad mo byas nas thams cad dgod/ /lam nas g.yog por ltogs skom 'ong / /cang med mgron po nyam chung la/ /rtsam pa spar gang ster mi shes/ /gzhan gyis ster la ser sna 'chor/ /grogs la phan thogs g.yor skyi zhig /phar zhog rgyu nor bza' btung dang / /thag sgog thi gu shing phur yan/ /rku 'phrog slong gsum sgo nas 'khyer/ /grogs kyis ka ngo mi rig gis/ /chug zer skabs re a ho ho/ /ci tsho 'grogs nas 'ong bzhag zer/ /bar du mgron po ngan pa yis/ /dbus su slebs tshe gang yod kyis/ /zhwa snam g.yu byir bla phor sogs/ /rang la mkho ba'i nom pa nyo/ /'bul ba mang ja 'gyed phogs med/ /phyag skor mi byed tshong ra nyul/ /kha ton mi byed nom pa gleng / /dad gus mi byed 'dang log rgyag /tshong ra'i nor la nyin re bzhin/ /mthong tshe 'dod sred je cher song / /grogs kyi dngul zho ṭaṃ kha 447

brku/ /rkus bud lan du bshags pa byed/ /smad tshong ma la nom pa byen/ /chags pa spyad nas rma ngan 'gos/ /dbyen dang dzun tshig mang po smra/ /mthun grogs 'khon 'dzing byed du bcug /grogs dang khams tshan shes tshad kyis/ /lkog nas ngan smra di ri ri/ /gtam ngan mang pos dbus gtsang khyab/ /tha ma mgron po ngan pa yis/ /dbus nas rang yul 'gro ba'i tshe/ /sku gsung thugs rten gcig mi 'khyer/ /nom pa mang po bkal nas 'gro /lam nas grogs kyi khal rta zhig /ngan lus shi na g.yor ster zhig /phar zhog las ngan 'di zer dmo/ /grogs la na tsha mi bde zhig /byung na mi 'dod bskyur thub blta/ /lam kha'i khyim tshang snyoms chung gi /rgyu nor 'phrog gam rku thub blta/ /kha ngan khog ngan bya spyod ngan/ /'grogs kyin 'grogs kyin je ngan 'gro /mi ngan rang mtshang thams cad ston/ /kun gyes mi ka khye gsang na/ /nges nges mchod cig med ki zer/ /yul gye thag nyer slebs pa'i tshe/ /thag ring mgron por skyel bsu zhig /mi dgos bde zhus mi byed par/ /gcig bsgyur gnyis bskyur byas nas 'gro /yul mis kun la skad cha 'dri/ /mnyam 'grogs 'ga' res mi ngan de/ /dbus su song ba don med song / /bya ba ngan pa 'di 448

'dra byas/ /kun la sdug re bskol rab zer/ /rang yul slebs pa'i phyi nyin nas/ /gtam ngan mi khas lung ba 'gengs/ /phyin chad sde bas gtam dper 'then/ /de'i phyir dbus su 'gro mkhan tsho/ /de 'dra'i bya spyod ma byed ang / /glu 'di mthong thos thams cad la/ /dbus su 'gro dus phan par shog /de nas bya spyod bzang po byed dgos tshul gyi mgur ni/'gro ba yongs kyi skyabs mgon rje/ /rgyal ba yab sras zhabs la 'dud/ /dbus su mjal 'dod thag ring gi /mgron po yongs la thugs rjes gzigs/ /dang po mgon po bzang po yis/ /khal rtar stan bzang sga bzang bstad/ /khal kyang bde la yang ba bkal/ /mgyogs por mi 'gro ga ler 'gro /yul nas bro lug gcig mi 'ded/ /lam nas ri dwags gcig mi gsod/ /mnyam 'grogs mgron po thams cad la/ /dbus su yang yang 'gro ba dka'/ /'gro yang 'grogs nas 'gro ba dka'/ /da res 'grogs nas 'gro ba yang / /zla ba 'ga' nas so sor gyes/ /zla ba re gnyis 'di'i bar la/ /kun gyis skyid sdug gcig byed dgos/ /gcig gis gcig la ci phan gyes/ /kha 'khon rdung res ma byed zer/ /kun la phan pa'i kha ta byed/ /'gro tshul 'dug tshul dbus phyogs su/ /449

'gro myong can gyi ngag bzhin byed/ /ltogs 'khyags tshegs theg las ka bzang / /sbis 'bubs dos brtsigs ba chu len/ /me 'bud khol 'then 'bud rgyu 'thu/ /'gro bsdad gang la'ang kho 'gro zer/ /'gro la khad dang langs la khad/ /so thun khal rta 'tsho dus bzang / /char chu mun nag 'thibs pa'i dus/ /kun la sems chung gal che zer/ /jag pa mthong na rgyu mtshan smra/ /ma nyan mdung bzung nang du rgyug /rang nor phar la 'chor mi dgos/ /jag pa'i sga ma tshur la len/ /lam bar mgon po thams cad kyis/ /de ring a ma'i bu rgod pos/ /bzang zer dga' gtam di ri ri/ /ming snyan dpa' bo'i cho lo ster/ /gzhan gyes ma thub las grogs byed/ /nyam chung mgon por zas nor ster/ /gzhan gyi nom pa che chung gang / /sa la lhung ba zhig mthong na/ /yar la blangs nas su'i yin zer/ /'ga' res nga'i yin drin can zer/ /bar du mgron po bzang po yis/ /dbus su slebs dus ci yod kyi/ /'bul ba mang ja ci thub gtong / /jo bor zhal gser brgya mchod 'bul/ /dbul por bza' btung sbyin pa gtong / /ra lug bshan pas gsod pa blu/ /lus kyis phyag dang skor ba byed/ /ngag gis kha ton bzlas brjod brtson/ /sems kyis dad gus dag snang 450

sbyong / /lha rten yod tshad kun la mjal/ /bla ma rnams la rten gsum zhu/ /ci yod chos phyogs btang ba'i mthus/ /gtam snyan dbus gtsang yongs la khyab/ /tha ma mgron po bzang po yis/ /dbus nas yul la 'gro ba'i dus/ /dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing khams su//slar yang mjal ba'i smon lam 'debs/ /nom pa ci yang mi 'khyer bar/ /sku gsung thugs rten byin can 'khyer/ /lam nas mnyam 'grogs mgron po la/ /rgyu nom zas kyis ci phan byed/ /grogs la spun zla las kyang byams/ /na 'dra bzhag na lhag par gces/ /gal te shi na ro shun dbye/ /bla ma yod na bsngo smon zhu/ /kha bzang khog bzang bya spyod bzang / /'grogs kyin 'grogs kyin je bzang 'gro /bzang po'i yon tan thams cad ston/ /kun gyis tshe ring bkra shis zer/ /mnyam 'grogs 'ga' res drin can zer/ /yul gyi thag nyer slebs pa'i tshe/ /thag ring mgron po phar la skyel/ /so sor 'bral glags mi phod par/ /'bral khar mig nas mchi ma gtong / /phan tshun 'tshams por bde mor zhes/ /bde legs gtam snyan sgrog bzhin gyes/ /yul mis kun la skad cha 'dri/ /mnyam 'grogs rnams kyis las can de/ /dbus su song ba don go che/ /chos ldan bya ba 'di 'dra byas/ /kun la 451

lam nas phan btags zer/ /rang yul slebs pa'i phyi nyin nas/ /gtam snyan mang po'i yong sgo yod/ /phyin chad sde bas gleng nas smon/ /de'i phyir dbus su 'gro mkhan tsho/ /de 'dra'i bya spyod gyis shig ang / /glu 'di mthong thos thams cad la/ /dbus su 'gro dus phan par shog /de nas lam bar nas sdig pa byed mi rung ba'i tshul gyi mgur ni/nyi zla zung gcig shar 'dra ba'i/ /jo shāka rnam gnyis phyag byas nas/ /jo bor mjal 'dod thag ring gi /mgron por kha ta tshig 'ga' bshad/ /khal rtar lci mo rkyang ba bkal/ /ma song rdo dang dbyug pas brdungs/ /lus po thams cad na tshas gang / /phyi dro rtswa chu med sar bzhag /khal rtar rgyab phud rmed rtsa bshus/ /rkang lag zha 'theng lam nas lus/ /gson por pho rog spyang kis za/ /sdig pa de'i thu gzhan na med/ /khal rtar gang byams gyis shig ang / /bro lug 'ga' re yun ring du/ /ded na 'ded mkhan mi la 'dris/ /mi de gang song phyogs su 'gro /gar bsdad dus su nyal nas 'dug /mi de ma mthong tshe na 'ba'/ /mthong na dga' nas tshur la rgyug /blo phab bde bar bsdad yod dus//kha bsum khog tu lag pa btang / /srog rtsa dmar po 'then pa'i dus/ /mnyam 'grogs grogs 452

shig bsad dang mtshungs/ /de 'dra'i khrel med bsam na med/ /dbus su mjal du song ba de/ /chos su ma song sdig tu song / /bro lug ded nas ma 'gro ang / /mi med lung ba stong pa na/ /nyes med ri dwags mang po bsdad/ /bdag med rtswa za chu 'thung la/ /snying rje'i ltad mo mi blta yang / /me mdas brgyab nas gsod mi rung / /phal cher yul lha'i sgo phyugs yin/ /bsad na na tsha god kha 'ong / /rdza 'drog thog ser kha ba babs/ /chu brub kun gyes sdug bsngal myong / /me mdas ri dwags ma gsod ang / /jo shāka rgyal ba yab sras kyis/ /'gro ba yongs la bu ltar brtse/ /srog gcod byas na rgyu nor gang / /phul kyang de rnams thugs mi dgyes/ /jo shāka rnam gnyis mjal ba'i dus/ /sdig pa byas na skyon med snyam/ /mi dge sdig pa'i las byas na/ /chos la brten pa'i sdig pa yin/ /sdig pa de ka shin tu phyi/ /jo shāka rnam gnyis zhabs drung nas/ /sngar byas sdig pa bshags 'dod mis/ /dbus su 'gro ba'i lam bar nas/ /sdig pa byas na sdig thog gi /sdig yin sdig pa 'dag mi 'gyur/ /nam yang sdig pa ma byed ang / /glu 'di thos tshad mgon po yis/ /sdig pa nam yang mi byed shog /de nas gzhi dang lam bar thams cad la phan pa'i bslab bya 453

mdor bsdus kyi mgur ni/nyi zla zung gcig shar 'dra ba'i/ /jo shāka rnam gnyis phyag byas nas/ /jo bor mjal 'dod thag ring gi /mgron por kha ta cung zad bya/ /rgyal ba yab sras jo shāka dang / /ser 'bras dge gsum dge 'dun la/ /lan cig ma gtogs mjal bar dka'/ /tshe 'dir dbus las thag ring gi /yul la nam yang 'gro ba dka'/ /nom pa yod na de dus su/ /mi 'khyer bzhag nas nam zhig 'khyer/ /phyi mar khyer nas 'gro sa med/ /rgyu nom yod na khyer cig ang / /lam nas ltogs 'khyags tshegs mi theg /spro langs gzhan la sdig skor byed/ /sha lhu rtsam pa go re mar/ /'thung phor che chung yan chad bshad/ /'grangs na ngo 'dzum dga' gtam dang / /ltogs na ngo gnag sdug gtam lab/ /thun la bsdad na mi dgos dus/ /langs rgyug 'phyo zer 'gyur ldog che/ /dgos dus gnyid nas shi las thu/ /'ga' res bos na ang mi khug /de 'dra nam yang ma byed ang / /pho ngan phal cher yul dung che/ /gnas mjal mi byed pha yul gleng / /rang gis phyag skor mi byed kyang / /grogs la'ang phyag skor byed mi 'jug /yul la 'gro ran da 'gro zer/ /dbus nas de 'dra ma zer ang / /yul du slebs tshe 454

thams cad dga'/ /'ga' res brgyugs nas 'tshams 'dri byed/ /a mes a khu las can po/ /khyod kyis gang dang gang la mjal/ /phyag dang skor ba ci tsam byas/ /rgyu nom chos phyogs ci 'dra btang / /rten gsum los yod cig byin zhes/ /zer dus de la lan med na/ /ngo re tsha zhig de na yod/ /de'i phyir dbus pa drin can tsho/ /yul mi khyim mtshes rgan gzhon gyi/ /mgo la sku gsung thugs rten zhog /mgul du phyag mdud dkar dmar skon/ /lag tu rten gsum ril bu blugs/ /rnar snyan yid dga'i gtam gsar ba/ /shod la yul mir dga' spro skyed/ /kun gyis a khu las can po/ /song ba don go che gi zer/ /yid smon 'chor ba gyis shig ang / /glu 'di mthong thos thams cad la/ /dbus su 'gro dus phan par shog /ces blangs pas mgron po kun gyi rgyud la phan thogs chen po byung ngo / /de dus byang lam nas bra tsha'i phyag rdor la sogs pa'i glu ba mang po 'tshogs pa'i nang nas/ 'ga' res skyo glu 'di 'dra len par gda'/sa chu gcig brgyab nas 'gro dus su/ /kha phyi phyir 'khor nas pha lo dran/ /ngas rang ka pha lo ci la dran/ /pha dang rta pho na tshod mtho/ /sa chu gnyis brgyab nas 'gro dus su/ /kha phyi 455

phyir 'khor nas ma lo dran/ /ngas rang ka ma lo ci la dran/ /ma dang mdzo mo drin re che/ /sa chu gsum brgyab nas 'gro dus su/ /kha phyi phyir 'khor nas nu byis dran/ /ngas rang ka nu byis ci la dran/ /nu dang rte'u na tshod chung / /zer/ yang gcig na re/ sga'i snga ru 'di la dpe blangs na/ /stod dbus gtsang pang la blangs 'dra red/ /lcag tsha mos brgyab nas 'dur snying 'dod/ /sga'i phyi ru 'di la dpe blangs na/ /yul pha ma mjug tu bskyur 'dra red/ /srab sil mas 'then nas sdod snying 'dod/ /sga dang a 'jog deb tse gsum/ /spun gsum gyis ba kha btab 'dra red/ /sar babs te bsdad nas rtse snying 'dod/ /ces blangs pa'i tshe a ma 'ga' res yul dran nas mchi ma gtong bar gda'/ yang glu ba 'ga' res skyid glu 'di 'dra len par snang / ser po gser gyi khri thog na/ /yon tan can gyi bla ma skyid/ /dkar po dngul gyi khri thog na/ /bsod nams can gyi dpon po skyid/ /glu 'di 'dra blangs na ci mo red/ /zer nas dgod/ yang gcig gis/ stod ri mgo rdza mgo shug pas bzung / /lha bsang shug mi 'bral skyid cig yod/ /ri sked rdza sked dgon pas bzung / /sems dmyal bar mi 'gro skyid cig yod/ /ri shod thang shod nas kyis 456

bzung / /kha ja chang mi 'bral skyid cig yod/ /glu shes ni min da rtse 'dod yin/ /zer yang gcig na re/ ser kyi li nyi rtse shar 'dra bo/ /stod dbus gtsang gser gyi rgya phibs red/ /sa ka tsho'i skye ba'i smon lam thobs/ /khra shigs se skar chen 'tshogs 'dra bo/ /dbus ser 'bras dge gsum dgon pa red/ /dgon ka tshor mjal ba'i smon lam thobs/ /gral bsgrigs nas khyung ldang gshar 'dra bo/ /dbus yar la 'gro ba'i mgon po red/ /dbus 'di bzhin 'gro ba'i smon lam thobs/ /glu yag gi zer na da dung len/ /yang gcig gis/stod ka na bstan pa'i mgo khungs la/ /gcig bzhugs pa rgyal ba yab sras red/ /rje ka tshor mjal ba'i smon lam thobs/ /smad ka na bstan pa'i srog shing la/ /gcig bzhugs pa gong ma rgyal po red/ /dpon ka tshor mjal ba'i smon lam thobs/ /bar 'di na bstan pa'i sbyin bdag la/ /gcig yod pa bod sog mgron po red/ /dbus myur du mjal ba'i smon lam thobs/ /zer/ yang gcig na re/ stod ka na bla ma rnam gsum bzhugs/ /ban khri ma 'bum gyi bkra shis shog /smad ka na rgya nag rgyal po bzhugs/ /rgya shes bzhin 'bum gyi bkra shis shog /bar 'di na 'dzam gling seng chen bzhugs/ /gling 457

mtheb sa 'bum gyi bkra shis shog /zer/ yang gcig gis/nga gos kyi lung ba'i 'ongs pa yin/ /rgyab gos dang mi 'bral bkra shis shog /nga zas kyi lung ba'i 'ongs pa yin/ /kha zas dang mi 'bral bkra shis shog /nga chos kyi lung ba'i 'ongs pa yin/ /sems chos dang mi 'bral bkra shis shog /zer ba la sogs pa'i glu blangs gar byed bzhin du dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing du song / de'i skabs bdag gis mgron po yar 'gro dang tshong dpon rnams kyis bro lug ded yod pa nyin re bzhin bsad nas/ je nyung du 'gro ba snying rje nas/ lug re la dngul srang do gsum re byin nas srog blus pas/ lug sum cu so lnga tsam tshe thar du btang ste yar ded nas song / dbus pa yar 'gro'i tshong dpon zhig gis/ sku 'bum gyi grwa pa lag rdo pa gnyis na nas bzhag yod pa dang / khams pa khyem tshang nang mi lnga tsam zhig mdzo rta chad nas lus yod pa rnams/ zas gos kyis bskyangs/ so sor gyes khar snying rje nas khyem tshang de la rta gcig dang / grwa pa gnyis la mdzo gcig dang bro kha byin nas btang / de'i lo dbus la song ba'i mgron po rnams las skyid pa zhig ma byung zhes phyis su gleng ba byung / de nas mgron po de dag rnams dang zla ba mang po'i bar 'grogs nas yar lha sa'i 458

thag nyer slebs pa'i tshe/ snga phyi rim pa byas nas 'tshams por bde mor zer nas thams cad phyogs phyogs su 'thor song tshe/chos thams cad mi rtag pa 'di yi rang bzhin can red snyam skyo mgur 'di blangs so//dgung mkha' la shar ba'i nyi ma de/ /dgong phyi dros gtugs dus nub rir yibs/ /chos mi rtag ston pa'i blo ma yis/ /sku mi rtag tshul bstan zhing gzhan gshegs/ /skad rnar snyan yid 'bab khu byug gis/ /skad mi grag gar song cha med thal/ /lus bskyed pa'i drin can pha ma yis/ /lus longs spyod bzhag nas phyi mar song / /phyi'i mthong yul rtsi shing lo tog rnams/ /nyin re re bzhin du gzhan gyis blangs/ /rang ngo shes rgan gzhon bar ma'i mi/ /lo re re bzhin du je nyung 'gro /mdog rab mjes me tog tshogs rnams kyis/ /mdog gsar rnying brjes nas smug por song / /stobs lang tsho rgyas pa'i sgyu lus kyis/ /lo rgan gzhon brjes nas rgan par gyur/ /chu shing kha'i mthun grogs bya bye'u rnams/ /skad dar dir sgog bzhin phyogs bzhir 'phur/ /dbus yar 'ong mthun grogs mgron po yis/ /tshig tha ma bde zer so sor gyes/ /chos gang la bltas kyang mi rtag par/ /kun gnas 'gyur song 459

tshe blo ma bde/ /sems dam pa'i lha chos byed 'dod dang / /ngag skyo mgur lhang lhung 'then 'dod byung / /rje bla ma drin can pha ma la/ /tshe 'di ru mi mjal kho thag chod/ /grogs grwa slob dad can sbyin bdag la/ /tshe 'di ru lan cig mjal bar smon/ /zhes blangs nas dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing gi lha ldan du slebs pa dang blo sems bde 'bol gyis song / dag pa'i zhing la slebs pa lta bu'i dga' spro rang shugs kyis shar/'jam dbyangs shag la babs pas/ mgron gnyer sde ba ma chen gyes mgo 'dren yag po gnang / de yang chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i zhal nas/ dus kyi mtha' la sdig spyod mang mod kyang / /nga yi ra sa mthong thos reg pa yis/ /'gro ba phal cher 'khor ba'i gnas las thar/ /de yang 'phags pa rnams kyi thugs rje dang / /nga yi bod 'bangs rnams kyi bsod nams yin/ /de phyir nga yi gdul bya pho mo kun/ /rtsol ba ma zhan snying stobs bskyed mdzod la/ /nga yi ra sa mthong thos reg par mdzod/ /skyon rnams gang zhig sel bar 'dod pa dang / /yon tan gang zhig bsgrub par 'dod pa yis/ /nga yi ra sar zhabs tog mos byas na/ /bsam pa thams cad yid bzhin 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar mthong thos 460

dran reg 'brel tshad don dang ldan pa'i ra sa 'khrul snang gtsug lag khang gi rten gyi gtso bo 'dzam gling rgyan gcig phyag mchod zhing mchog jo bo rin po che la de'i nyin par mjal ba'i skabs sangs rgyas dngos su mjal ba lta bu'i dad gus bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung / de'i phyi nyin jo bo ra mo che dang thugs rje chen po rang byung lnga ldan sogs rten thams cad la mjal/mar me phul nas gsol 'debs byas smon lam btab/ de nas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug ngur smrig gar gyis rnam rol rgyal ba lung rtogs rgya mtsho'i gser zhal nam tshod mjal chog ces/ mgron gnyer ma chen brgyud nas rtse la snyan gsan phul bas/ nyi ma gnyis tsam song ba'i nyin mjal du shog zer/ smad sog dpon po stobs can mang po dang /'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i mgon gnyer bstan 'dzin sogs dang lhan du skyabs mgon rin po che'i drung du song / sku gsung thugs rten maṇ+ḍal lha rdzas dngul srang bco lnga byi ru'i rgyan ldan gyi shel phreng rta sga stan srab gsum bcas phul nas/ gral du 'khod pa dang gsol ja'i 'phro cung zad re phor ba'i nang du blugs pa 'thung dus/ skyabs mgon rin po ches/ smad sog dpon po dang / 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i mgron gnyer 461

gnyis la rim bzhin bka' phebs dang / de'i rjes su nga la yang / a mdo bla ma lam skabs rnams su dka' las ma byung ngam/ gsungs pa dang / ngas kyang khong gnyis kyi lad mo byas nas/ yar langs te lag pa thal mo sbyar cung zad bsgur nas/skyabs mgon rin po che'i thugs rjes bde mo byung lags zhus pas/ nga'i skad 'go cung zad mtho se byung ba dang / a mdo'i skad yin pa'i stabs kyis skyabs mgon mchog dang / mgron gnyer 'ga' res nga la bltas nas cig 'dzum par gda'/ de nas smad sog dpon po des rigs gsum mgon po'i lung zhig zhu ba'i sngon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul dus/ ngas kyang kha btags shig dang bcas te yan lag bdun pa dang 'brel ba'i zhabs brtan gsol 'debs 'di nyid phul lo//bod kyi lha skal 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs/ /bsam bzhin ngur smrig gar gyis rnam rol pa/ /skyabs mgon rgyal dbang lung rtogs rgya mtsho yi/ /zhabs kyi pad+mo gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /sku gsung thugs rten zhing khams rgya mtsho yis /thog drangs rin chen gser dngul dar zab 'bul/ /bdag dang 'gro kun sngar byas sdig pa rnams/ /phyag dang bcas te spyan sngar mthol lo bshags/ /khyed kyi sku gsung thugs kyi mdzad 462

pa la/ /thal mo sbyar nas rjes su yi rang bya/ /gser gyi 'khor lo dung dkar g.yas 'khyil 'bul/ /zab rgyas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul/ /sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa'i khri gdan 'bul/ /bskal ba rgya mtshor bzhugs zhes gsol ba 'debs/ /'dis mtshon dus gsum bsags pa'i dge tshogs rnams/ /khyed kyis rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyu ru bsngo/ /'di phyi gtan gyi skyabs mgon rin po che/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byen gyis rlobs/ /tshe 'di'i rkyen ngan bar chad zhi ba dang / /phyi mar bde ba can du drang du gsol/ /gangs ri'i ra bas bskor ba'i zhing khams 'dir/ /phan dang bde ba ma lus 'byung ba'i gnas/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang lung rtogs rgya mtsho yi/ /zhabs pad srid mtha'i bar du brtan par shog /skye ba kun tu yang dag bla ma dang / /'bral med chos kyi dpal la longs spyod cing / /sa dang lam gyi yon tan rab rdzogs nas/ /rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang myur thob shog /ces phul bas skyabs mgon rin po ches/ tshangs pa'i dbyangs lta bu'i gsung gdangs snyan po'i sgo nas/ chos nyan pa'i kun slong yag po gsal btab nas nyan dgos tshul rnams gsungs te lung gnang ba'i dus su/ ri bo ta la'i 'phags pa'i drung du slebs 463

pa lta bu'i dga' spro tshad las 'das pa byung / 'gro khar bsrung mdud re gnang / rjes su nyin gcig sku mdun du bos nas sder kha dang phrug gcig byin rten le'u tshan bsrung mdud kha btags bcas bstsal nas zhal gsung kyang mang po gnang ba byung / de nas sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas ngur smrig 'chang ba'i tshul 'dzin skyabs mgon paṇa chen rin po che la/ dngul srang bcu g.yang ṭa'i phreng ba bye ru'i rgyan can zhig dang / rta gcig kha btags nang mdzod gcig dang bcas te skyabs 'jug gi zhu shog 'di phul lo//ma lus 'gro ba'i mgon khyod sngon dus su/ /ma gyur sems can don du sangs rgyas nas/ /ma skyes chos sku nam mkha' lta bu las/ /ma 'dres 'ja' bzhin gzugs sku so sor ston/ /ma dag dag pa'i zhing khams rab 'byams na/ /ma nges sprul pa bsam gyis mi khyab kyang / /ma dag zhing 'di'i don du sprul pa'i sku/ /ma las btsas dus ngo mtshar bltas bzang byung / /ma dang 'grogs nas zla ba 'ga' song tshe/ /ma sring bzhin du blang dor gnas rnams shes/ /ma las lhag pa'i yongs 'dzin bsten pa'i dus/ /ma bslabs bzhin du rig gnas phal cher mkhyen/ /ma nor chos kyi gnad 'dus lam rim de/ /ma lus 464

thugs su dka' tshegs med par chud/ /ma dag phung khams lhar bsgyur gsang sngags chos/ /ma shes gcig med thams cad sa ler mkhyen/ /ma smras bzhin du pha rol bsam pa go /ma bsgrubs bzhin du lha zhal mang po gzigs/ /ma tshogs mkha' 'gro chos skyong bran ltar 'khor/ /ma rungs log 'dren dgra bgegs thams cad 'dul/ /ma rig dbang gis legs nyes blang dor gnas/ /ma mthong 'gro ba gcig la chos gsungs kyang / /ma gyur sems can thog mar gsungs pa de/ /ma bzhin 'gro la dus kun byams pa'i rtags/ /ma rgan ra lug 'bri g.yag gsod pa la/ /ma gsod sdig pa byas na mi rung gsungs/ /ma rtogs log rtog dbang du song ba la ma red 'di yin gsungs nas legs lam bstan/ /ma rnyed dbul phongs nyam thag sprang slong la/ /ma ki snying rje gsungs nas zas gos gnang / /ma dang pha sogs shi nas ngu ba la/ /ma sdug ma ngu gsungs nas sems gso mdzad/ /ma lan bzhin du gnod pa byung ba la/ /ma khro ma sdang sngon gye las yin gsungs/ /ma shes ma mthong ma go sdug pa la/ /ma dris na yang drang por shod cig gsungs/ /ma nus ma thub las gas non pa la/ /ma bcol na yang 'a sa grogs gyes shig gsungs/ /ma ki ya ki long gtam 465

lab pa la/ /ma ṇi la sogs kha ton gyis shig gsungs/ /ma dang pha la mi byams bu tsha la/ /ma rabs bya ba de 'dra ma byed gsungs/ /ma shes dbang gis sdig pa byas pa la/ /ma 'dug bshags sdom gyis dang 'dag go gsungs/ /ma la bu bzhin dung bas bla ma bsten/ /ma shi bar du yon tan slobs shig gsungs/ /ma gyur 'gro ba'i don du sems bskyed la/ /ma gnod rtag tu ci phan gyis shig gsungs/ /ma nges ri khrod dben pa'i dga' tshal du/ /ma yengs mdo sngags nyams su longs shig gsungs/ /ma gyur 'gro la de 'dra'i chos gsungs mthus/ /ma rnams yongs la bde skyid nyi ma shar/ /ma 'dra'i drin can khyed la 'gro kun gyis/ /ma bas lhag pa'i bsnyen bkur cis mi byed/ /ma dad skyon kun spangs nas gus phyag 'tshal/ /ma legs nyes skyon bral ba'i mchod tshogs 'bul/ /ma shes dbang gis sdig ltung byas tshad bshags/ /ma rmad gsang gsum mdzad par rjes yi rang / /ma rtogs 'gro la chos 'khor bskor bar bskul/ /ma gshegs gzugs sku bskal brgyar bzhugs gsol 'debs/ /ma gyur 'gro ba'i dge tshogs ci mchis kun/ /ma lus rje khyed sku tshe brtan phyir bsngo/ /ma rungs bdag 'dzin bran gyur dbang chung nga / /ma gyur 'gro ba 466

gcig kyang ma lus pa/ /ma nor chos sgor zhugs nas sa lam kun/ /ma 'thob bar du rjes su gzung du gsol/ /zhes phul bas thugs brtse ba chen pos 'byor lan gsung shog bsrung mdud byin rlabs le'u tshan bcas bstsal/ de'i lo rjes mar lha sa ru phebs nas bla brang steng na bzhugs dus mkhan po zhi ba tshe ring gis tshe dbang zhig zhu ba dang mnyam du song nas mjal tshe dbang yang thob pa byung / de nas dga' ldan gser khri ngag dbang snyan grags rin po cher mdzo gcig dngul srang lnga rin chen phreng ba gcig dri ma med pa'i lha rdzas bcas phul nas mjal/ chos 'brel dgos tshul gyi zhu shog 'di phul 'o chos gos ngur sprig 'bral med 'chang ba'i sku/ /chos sgra snyan mo 'gag med sgog pa'i gsung / /chos dbyings ngang las g.yo med gnas pa'i thugs/ /chos kyi rgyal po zla med tsong kha ba'i/ /chos lugs gtsang mar thos bsam byas pa'i mthus/ /chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong gnad 'gag rigs/ /chos tshig 'bru gcig yan chad gdams par shar/ /chos bzhin mdzad pas kun gyis mchod bstod bkur/ /chos gling dga' ldan gser khrir bzhugs su bcug /chos rnams kun mkhyen blo bzang rnam thar bzhin/ /chos mthun skal bzang bye ba ther 467

'bum la/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rgyun 'chad med par bskor/ /chos mkhas dbus na rgyal mtshan tog ltar mtho/ /chos gang 'chad kyang rgyal ba gnyis par mtshungs/ /chos bshad byas tshad gzhan gyi rgyud la phan/ /chos mang shes kyang nga rgyal cung zad med/ /chos gzhan mi smod gang la'ang dag snang che/ /chos min bya ba nam yang gcig mi byed/ /chos pa rab 'bring tha gsum kun la byams/ /chos mdzad yongs kyi gtsug gi rgyan du 'dzin/ /chos bshad byed mkhan rtsi shing ltar mang yang /chos sbyin mchog dman yongs la gnang ba'i mthus/ /chos kyi spyan ldan khyed kyi slob ma zer/ /chos bzhin byed pas phyogs 'di gang ba mtshar/ /chos 'chad 'dod na dga' ldan gser khre bzhin/ /chos sde chen po lha sa'i smon lam dus/ /chos byed dge 'dun khri rer dus gcig tu/ /chos char phab na bzang zer kun gyis smon/ /chos shes chos rnams gzhan la 'chad bzhin du/ /chos min chos pa 'ga' res byed mthong tshe chos brgyad chos min bya ba rgyang bsrings nas/ /chos gsungs chos rje khyed la lhag par dad/ /chos kyi sgor zhugs chos par ming btags kyang / /chos nyan byas nas chos gsungs bla mar 'phya/ /chos 'brel mi rtsi chos grogs rnams la 'khon/ /chos 468

gos gyon nas chos brgyad khol po byed/ /chos gzhan smad nas chos spong las ngan gsog /chos dang bstun tshe chos sems rgyab 'gal ba'i/ /chos dzu mkhan ngas chos bzhin byed snyam nas/ /chos rje khyed la chos shig zhu 'dod skyes/ /chos gang zhu na myur lam dmar khrid lags/ /chos med byams pa chos dar zhes bya ngar/ /chos de nam gnang phran kyang nam zhig 'ong / /chos pa'i gzugs brnyan bdag la gsung du gsol/ /chos ldan bya ba gang dang gang byed kyang / /chos sgo mtha' ru thon pa'i skyabs 'jug mkhyen/ /chos brgyad g.yeng ba'i dbang du mi 'gro bar/ /chos la thos bsam sgom gsum byed par smon/ /zhes phul bde zhus byas rgyu mtshan rnams zhus pas/thugs shin tu mnyes nas/ nyi ma kha shas kyi 'phro la shog gsungs pa bzhin/ nyin gcig shog ces bos nas song bas myur lam dmar khrid kyi lung dang skabs skabs su khrid kyang 'or la gsungs pa byung / yang rjes nas song paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan gyi gsung gi nā ro chos drug gi lung zhus/skabs skabs su mdun du song nas/ lugs gnyis kyi gleng mo mang po byed rgyu'i skal ba byung / de nas grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po mkhar rdo chos kyi rdo rje rin po cher mjal/ rta gos 469

dngul dang g.yu byir rin chen phreng ba lha rdzas dang bcas te zhu shog 'di yang phul lo//rgyal kun sngon du sangs rgyas kun tu bzang / /rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang dang shākya thub/ /rgyal tshab pad 'byung jo bo blo bzang sogs/ /rgyal dang rgyal sras yongs kyis dge legs stsol/ /rgyal ba'i gsung rab 'chad pa'i bla ma rnams/ /rgyal ba las kyang rang la bka' drin che/ /rgyal pos 'bangs 'khor skyong bzhin da dung yang / /rgyal ba'i go 'phang ma thob bar du skyongs/ /rgyal kun thugs sras bla ma khyed kyis sngon/ /rgyal ba'i go 'phang rin chen brnyes tshar nas/ /rgyal blon paṇa grub sna tshogs sku ru sprul/ /rgyal khams yongs la ci phan byed pa mtshar/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa spyi dang khyad par du/ /rgyal dbang pad+ma'i gsang chen bstan pa yi/ /rgyal mtshan phyogs 'dir 'dzin mkhan snyigs dus 'dir/ /rgyal dbang rnam 'phrul grub chen khyed min su/ /lha 'dre mi gsum gang gis thos na yang / /nyon mongs dug gsum rtsub rags zhi ba dang / /mkhas blun bar gsum gang gis nyams blangs kyang / /lus ngag yid gsum smin grol gdams pa mnga'/ /dag dang ma dag zhing khams rab 'byams mthong / /snyan dang mi snyan sgra 470

rnams sa ler mkhyen/ /bde dang mi bde legs nyes blang dor mkhyen/ /mgon med bdag mgon khyod ni yon tan gter/ /ci mdzad bstan dang 'gro don 'ba' zhig mdzad/ /ci gsung zab rgyas chos gsungs bla ma la/ /ci nus bdag gzhan sgo gsum gus phyag 'tshal/ /ci gsung bka' bzhin bsgrub pa'i mchod pa 'bul/ /lus ngag yid gsum sngar byas sdig ltung bshags/ /phyi nang gsang gsum mdzad par rjes yi rang / /'chad rtsod rtsom gsum chos 'khor bskor bar bskul/ /gzugs sku dus gsum brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ /bdag gzhan rnam dkar dge ba ci bsags kun/ /bdag gi bla ma'i sku tshe brtan phyir bsngo/ /bdag la 'brel thogs 'gro ba mtha' dag dang / /bdag kyang tshe rabs kun tu rjes su zungs/ /bslu med rtsa gsum kun 'dus bla ma'i gsung / /'khrul med sgo gsum brtson pas nyams su blangs/ /bla med sgu gsum go 'phang myur thob nas/ /mtha' med khams gsum 'gro kun 'dren par smon/ /zhes phul/ gzhan yang rgyu mtshan rnams legs par zhus pas thugs brtse ba chen po'i sgo nas rjes su bzung / de'i dus a rig khrom tsha'i gcod pa yang yod pas smad sog mang po dang lhan du thugs rje chen po nam mkha' rgyal 471

po'i dbang zhus/ rjes nas lan cig mjal dus thang stong snyan brgyud kyi tshe dbang thob/ yang rjes shig la dgongs gter gye lung kha shas thob/ khong la mjal ba'i dus su chos rgyal gter bdag gling ba sogs sngon byon gter ston rnams tshor yang mjal na 'di 'dra zhig los yin snyam pa'i dad gus rtsol med du skyes/ khong gis gsol ras dang byen rten rdzas rgod ril bu sogs gnang / de nas bod kyi rgyal po de mo rin po cher mjal/ rta gcig dang dngul srang lnga lha rdzas bcas phul/ nā ro chos drug yid ches gsum ldan gyi lung zhus/yongs 'dzin par+bhe ta'i yang sprul mchog la mjal/ dngul srang gsum lha rdzas bcas phul/ skabs gsum pa dang tsong kha brgyad cu'i lung zhus/ rwa sgreng khri chen rdo rje 'chang la mjal mdzo gcig dang dngul srang kha shas phul/ blo sbyong don bdun ma'i lung khrid zhus/ khri byang chub chos 'phel rin po cher mjal/dngul srang kha shas g.yu bye ru gos chen gcig bcas phul/mdun nas bde mchog dril bu lha lnga'i dbang dang / bla ma mchod pa dang lam rim bsdus don gnyis kyi lung khrid rgyas par thob/ smin grol gling gdung ba rin po cher mjal/gter chen gong ma'i 'khrungs rabs rnam thar gsol 'debs 472

kyi lung zhus/ rdo rje brag rig 'dzin chen por mjal/ phyag rten phul/ bsam pa lhun grub ma dang bar chad lam sel gyi lung zhus/ lcags zam sprul sku rin po cher mjal phyag rten phul thang stong snyan brgyud kyi thugs rje chen po'i chos skor kha shas kyi lung zhus/ ri sna dgon gyi gter ston bde chen rgyal po'i yang sprul o rgyan bstan 'dzin rin po cher mjal rta gos dngul bcas phul/ stag tshang phur ba'i dbang dang gter gsar chos skor gyi lung zhus/ rgyal ba garma pa lha ldan du phebs pa dang mjal phyag rten phul thugs rje chen po'i bsgom bzlas kyi lung zhus/ las slong dpa' bo rin po che'i sprul skur mjal phyag rten phul/ phyag chen gsol 'debs kyi lung zhus/ sku gzhogs 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i sprul skur mjal/ rta sga stan srab gsum dngul srang dgu lha rdzas bcas phul/ rten 'brel bstod pa dang dpal ldan sa gsum ma'i lung zhus/ gzhan yang ser 'bras dge gsum gye bla ma mkhan po thams bcad la mjal/ rta gos dngul dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis mdzes pa'i phreng ba kha btags 'jam dar tshe sku can kho na'i phyag rten phul chos 'brel sna tshogs zhus te thugs mnyes par byas/ rtse'i po ta la dang / lha sa mthil/ lcags po ri/ gling gsum/ rgyud 473

stod smad/ rme ru gzhi sde/ ser 'bras kyi sku gsung thugs rten rnams la mjal mchod 'bul dang / kha btags brgya phrag du ma'i snyan shal phul smon lam btab/ dge 'dun gyi sde rnams la mang ja btang skyabs 'jug zhu/ khams tshan la 'gyed btang sbyor 'jags byas/ khyad par dngul srang brgyad brgya dang g.yu byer dkar yol gang rtse'i rnam sras mdzod khang du phul/ rtse nas gser sbyangs btso ma srang lnga bcu tham pa gnang / gzhung gi 'dod dpal mkhan po zhi ba tshe ring dang /lcags zam mkhan po gnyis kyis do dam mdzad/ 'dod dpal nas gser kong gsar bzo byas/ gser kong gsham gye smon tshig la/'dzam gling rgyan gcig phyag mchod zhing gi mchog /jo bo rin po che yi zhabs drung du/ /dad can tshogs drug rang grol phyag rdor sogs/ /mdo smad skye bo du mas gser kong 'di/ /phul mthus sangs rgyas bstan pa dar bar shog /bstan 'dzin skyes bu'i sku tshe ring bar shog /'gro kun gnas skabs kun tu bde bar shog /mthar thug sangs rgyas go 'phang 'thob par shog /ces bris nas/ rtse'i skyabs mgon mchog la gzigs rtog phul bas thugs mnyes te/ bkra shis kyi phyag nas gtor/474

thugs bskyed smon lam gnang / bdag la khyod kyis bsod nams bsags 'dug jo bo'i mdun du 'jog dus thugs bskyed smon lam yag po gyis zhes kha btags nang mdzod gcig dang bcas bstsal/ de nas rgya lo'i smon lam chen mo'i bco lnga'i nyin bla brang steng na bka' blon rnams bzhugs sar khyer nas gzigs rtog phul dus khong rnams kyis gzhung gi deb la bris pa'i tshe/ khrom lha mi 'tshogs pa phal cher gyis bsod nams bsags 'dug ces rjes su yi rang byed pa mang po byung /bka' blon rnams kyis gser kong gsham gyi smon yig bton nas mgo thog tu bzhag smon lam btab ste/ bka' blon khri mon nas khyod kyi bsod nams bsags 'dug da ni 'jog dus skyabs mgon rgyal ba yab sras/ gnam skyong gong ma rgyal po'i zhabs brtan dang bstan 'gro yongs kyi bde thabs su dmigs nas phul/ bsngo ba smon lam gyi mtshams sbyor yang dag mdzod dang don che gsungs nas/ thugs mnyes mnyes mdzad cing gser kong kha btags shig gis dkris nas gnang /de'i nyin jo bo shākya mu ne'i zhabs drung du gser kong mar khus bkang ste phul/ gzhan yang mchod pa rgya chen po bshams/ klu 'bum khams tshan gyi dge 'dun pa mang po gdan drangs nas/475

ja thug drangs dngul ṭaṃ re phul/ khong rnams kyis bla mchod gsungs smon lam dri ma med pa'i mtshams sbyor yang dag mdzad/bdag cag dpon slob rnams kyis kyang smon lam rgya chen po btab tshul rnams mar me'i smon lam 'dod 'byung nor bu 'od 'bar na gsal lo/ /de nas a lags brtson 'grus/ dge slong ngag dbang dar rgyas/ gcod pa gsum mdo smad rang yul du btang /a lags brtson 'grus kyis khri ga'i phyogs kyi ri khrod nas tshe dang sgrub pa bsnyams/ sgrub 'bras kyis bstan 'gro la phan pa'i bla ma zhig byung / dge slong ngag dbang dar rgyas kyis mang ra sogs kyi ri khrod nas dge sbyor byas chos pa bzang bo zhig byung / gcod pas dmar chog spangs nas grong chog sku rim byas pas/ yon bdag nad pa mang po la phan thogs pa byung / slob bu kun bzang rang grol gyis/ mkhar rdo chos kyi rdo rje/ gter ston sā la rin po che/ chos rgyal lha rgya ri sogs dbus lho kha'i phyogs kyi bla ma mang por dbang dang gdams pa zhus nas lo gcig bsdad slar mdo smad du song nas/ gsang sngags rim gnyis dang / zab lam gcod kyi nyams len byas pas rtogs ldan 'khrul zhig nam mkha'i rnal 'byor pa zhig tu gyur nas/ gcod kyi sgo nas 'gro don rgya chen 476

po byung / zho 'ong ban de gnas skor la btang bas/ gnas bzang gsum bskor bla ma bzang gsum la mjal ba'i chags med zhen med kyi bya btang pa zhig byung / ngas zla ba kha shas kyi bar du lha ldan jo bor phyag dang skor ba byed bzhin yang yang mjal/ nyin gcig jo bo'i drung nas yun ring bsdad de gsol ba shugs drag btab/ ting nge 'dzin gye dbang blangs pas rjes su phyi skor du song ba'i tshe/ skor lam nas ra lug shan pas gsod pa mang po mthong bas rkyen byas/ de ltar 'jig rten khams na gsod pa rnams la snying rje shas mi bzod pa zhig skyes nas slar jo bo'i mdun du song / phyag 'tshal nas/ phyin chad sdig zas pha ma'i sha mi za ba'i dam bca' phul ba nas bzung da lta'i bar du 'gro don ci tsam byas na yang / bdag la dmigs nas srog gcod pa phar zhog nga yong rgyu yin zhes bshad na yang /sbyin bdag dad pa can gyis/ bla ma khong gis shi sha yang mi bzhes pa red/ sha 'dra yod na gzigs sa nas ma 'jog ces sbed mkhan yang byung ba'i skad cha 'dug bdag la brten nas gzhan gyis srog gcod kyi sdig pa je nyung du song ba 'di jo bo chen po'i thugs rje rang yin snyam pa byung / de nas lha ldan gyi thag nye chos lung phu'i zwa lung zer ba bla ma zhang g.yu brag 'gro 477

ba'i mgon po'i bzhugs gnas/ mgon po phyag bzhi ba'i sku byin can zhig yod pa der song nas dkor gnyer mgon po zer ba la/ nga gnas 'dir lo gcig mtshams la sdod dgos zhes rgyu mtshan bshad pas/ kho dga' nas sdod du bcug sna len phan thogs bzang po byas/ phyis slob mar gyur dbang dang gdams pa byin nas bsgoms pas rang grol gyi rnal 'byor pa zhig byung / de'i dbyar kha 'bras spungs klu 'bum khams tshan gyis bos nas song / zhag kha shas bsdad/ gsar rnying chos kyi gleng mo mang po byas pas dge bshes rnams kyang thugs dgyes par gyur/ 'ong zhor la 'bras spungs lha sa gnyis la phyag skor rten mjal byas phyir 'ong dus/ 'bras spungs dang lha sa na tshad pa yod pa/ mgon po la 'gos nas/ yar zwa lung du 'ongs nas nyi ma kha shas na ba la ngas bka' bsgo byin brlab byas nas sman 'thungs pas drag kho drag pa dang nga na nas zhag kha shas nas tsha ba rgyas pa'i 'khrul snang la/ lha khang zhig la me 'bar bas nang gi lha rten rnams mi 'tshig par je gsal du 'gro ba dang / phyogs bzhi'i zhing khams rnams mthong nas 'gro snyam tsa na/ mi nag po brjid bag can zhig gis ma 'gro zer nas bsdad pa'i snang ba shar/ de dus bdag gis bla ma dkon 478

mchog la gsol ba btab bdud rtsi bsil pos 'beb sbyangs lan mang du byas/ mgon po song nas/ lha sa'i rdo ring sman pa'i sman khyer 'ongs pa 'thungs pa'i rten 'brel la brten nas myur du drag ste/ nged gnyis kyis mgon po phyag bzhi ba'i rten gye mdun nas tshogs shig btang nas dga' ston byas so/ /skabs shig bro kha chad nas/ ngas nyi ma kha shas la sran ma 'dra ba brngos nas zos/ kho chos lung gi yon bdag yod sar song nas sku rim byas nga la 'tsho ba chad yod tshul bshad pas sku gzhogs 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i gzhi ka dang tshong dpon nam mkha' mdzod pa'i gzhi ka tshal sde pa rnams kyis ja mar rtsam pa byen pa rnams khyer byung / sngar lung ba der chu dkon po yod kyang nga bsdad pa'i lo de nas bzung chu mod po byung nas lo yag skal bzang byung bar brten chos lung phu'i yon bdag yod med gnyis ga'i dad pa cher song nas der sdod ring dang /phyis song dus rnams su zhabs tog yag po byed pa byung / de'i skabs dad brtson shes rab snying rje dang ldan pa'i dge slong blo bzang 'od zer gnas skor du song nas/ stod kyi mtsho pad ma can man chad bskor nas bal yul mchod rten chen po bya rung kha shor gyi drung nas smon lam btab tshad 'grub par go nas/479

phyag dang skor ba byas mar me mang po phul nas bdag ni tshe 'dir myur ba myur du mtshan ldan gyi bla ma zhig dang mjal nas zab mo'i gdams pa thob ste dam pa gong ma'i rnam thar bzhin ri khrod dben par tshe dang sgrub pa snyoms pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig ces smon lam btab/ de nas tshur rim gyis lha ldan du 'ong / rtse'i rgyal ba'i yongs 'dzin dga' ldan gser khri a mdo bya khyung ba ngag dbang snyan grags rin po cher mjal nas/ nga'i rgyu mtshan rnams gsung pa go ba tsam gyes dad gus chen po skyes nas nga la mjal du 'ong ba'i dus su/ ngas phyi sgo'i se phung chen po lo ma me tog gis mdzes shing bung ba'i sgra dbyangs dar dir sgog pa'i bsil grib zhig la 'khod nas/nyon mongs g.yul las rgyal ba'i mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so//e ma bod kyi rnal 'byor pa/ /bya btang tshogs drug rang grol ngas/ /dad gus gsol 'debs spyan 'dren btang / /rtsa gsum lha yi dmag dpung bsdus/ /thos bsam pho nya phyogs kun mngags/ /mdo rgyud man ngag go mtshon bsags/ /mi med gangs dang ri sul nas/ /nyon mongs dmag la 'di ltar 'thab/ /nges 'byung shugs can rta la zhon/ /nam 'chi cha med lcag gis bskul/ /byams dang snying rje'i khrab rmog gyon/ /byang 480

chub sems kyi mdung ring thogs/ /sbyin sogs thabs kyi gzhu mo la/ /yang dag lta ba'i mda' sbyar nas/ /'bad brtson drag pos 'dom la 'jal/ /nyon mongs dmag gi dkyil du 'phangs/ /bdag 'dzin dmag dpon snying la phog /ma rig 'khrul ba'i srog rtsa bcad/ /bdag med sa la 'gyel ba'i mod/ /nyon mongs brgyad khri bzhi stong dmag /thams cad dngangs skrag 'jigs nas bros/ /da res 'khrug las rnal 'byor rgyal/ /g.yul rgyal dam chos rnga chen brdung / /nyams dga' spro ba'i dar chen 'phyar/ /'khor ba'i 'jigs pa yal nas song / /bde chen thang la yan pas chog /e ma bu nga a re dga'/ /a mas tshor na dga' ba la/ /e ma slob bu a re skyid/ /bla mas gsan na skyid pa la/ /zhes len bzhin gnas pa dang thug pas/ 'khrul ba'i a 'thas kyi snang ba tu re ba de 'gags nas/ rnam par mi rtog pa'i ngang du lhan ne gnas pa byung tshe/ rten 'brel bzang snyam dad gus dga' spro tshad las 'das pa byung / phyag 'tshal nas/ dzā ti dgu lha rdzas bcas phul/ rab tu gus pa'i sgo nas rgyu mtshan rnams zhib tu zhus/dbang dang gdams pa gnang dgos zhes gsol ba btab par/khyod kyis sman phul ba bzhin ngas khyod la dam pa'i chos kyi sman 48

byin nas nyon mongs pa'i nad gso bar bya'o zhes dbang dang gdams pa rnams rim bzhin byin/ phan bde'i 'byung gnas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'dzin cing / 'gro ba yongs la phan thogs pa'i rten 'brel du ming bstan 'dzin nyi ma zhes btags shākya'i sras su mnga' gsol nas zhal gdams 'di yang byen no//sangs rgyas thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag gzhan chos dang mthun par byin gyis rlobs/ /phan pa'i snying gtam tshig 'ga' bshad kyis nyon/ /brjed med snying la chongs shig shākya'i sras/ /byen rlabs dngos grub 'byung gnas bla ma rje/ /'bral med gtsug tu khur cig shākya'i sras/ /bsten na nam yang mi bslu dkon mchog la/ /glo snying brang gsum gtod cig shākya'i sras/ /dal 'byor mi lus rin chen gling phyin 'dra/ /don med stong log ma byed shākya'i sras/ /ston pa bla med bstan pa rin chen la/ /yang yang mjal bar dka' 'o shākya'i sras/ /'chi bdag bdud po nam yong nges pa med/ /dogs zon da lta gyis shig shākya'i sras/ /'chi bas nangs par gang gis phan pa med/ /phan nges chos yin 'bungs shig shākya'i sras/ /tshe 'di blos thongs phyi ma bde thabs gyes/ /'dun ma'i 482

yang rtse yin no shākya'i sras/ /dkar nag las la nam yang bslu ba med/ /sdig sgongs dge ba sgrubs shig shākya'i sras/ /gang la nor yod de la ser sna yod/ /nor med bya btang gyis shig shākya'i sras/ /grogs bzang bsten na rang yang je bzang 'gro / /grogs bzang ya rabs sten cig shākya'i sras/ /grogs ngan bsten na rang yang je ngan 'gro/ /grogs ngan ma rabs spongs shig shākya'i sras/ /bsam pa bzang na sa dang lam yang bzang / /bsam pa bzang po gyes shig shākya'i sras/ /bsam pa ngan na sa dang lam yang ngan/ /bsam ngan yid la ma bcangs shākya'i sras/ /yul mis lkog nas ngan gtam brgya byas kyang / /ma go ba ltar gyis shig shākya'i sras/ /mi mang khrod nas rang skyon mtshang brus kyang / /de yi skyon mtshang ma 'bru shākya'i sras/ /bdag gis bu bzhin bskyangs pas dgra bzhin du/ /blta yang sdang sems ma skye shākya'i sras/ /rang la nyes pa med bzhin khag ngan 'dra/ /byung yang sngon las yin soms shākya'i sras/ /'ga' zhig khros nas rang la bsdigs brdungs kyang / /ngan lan 'khon 'dzing ma byed shākya'i sras/ /chos kun sgyu ma rmi lam bzang ngan 'dra/ /bde sdug zhum khengs ma byed shākya'i sras/ /sems can thams cad drin can pha ma yin/ /ngan slong brtse 483

bas skyongs shig shākya'i sras/ /khog pa ya ngas na kha mchu rtsod pa med/ /dga' ka khro ka ma sla shākya'i sras/ /byang chub sems dpa' khro yang 'dzin pa med/ /kha 'khon khog tu ma 'dzin shākya'i sras/ /bla ma lha yis thams cad gzigs shing mkhyen/ /spyod ngan phag tu ma byed shākya'i sras/ /phyag dang skor bas lus kyi sgrib pa 'dag /skabs skabs phyag skor gyis shig shākya'i sras/ /kha ton bzlas pas ngag gi sgrib pa 'dag /khom dus kha ton gyis shig shākya'i sras/ /mos gus gdung bas yid kyi sgrib pa 'dag /bla mar mos gus mdzod cig shākya'i sras/ /dben pa'i gnas su dam pa'i rnam thar skyongs/ /bde skyid nyi ma 'char ro shākya'i sras/ /bslab bya mang rung nyung rung lag len dgos/ /'di rnams lag tu longs shig shākya'i sras/ /'dis mtshon dus gsum bsags pa'i rnam dkar dge /bdag gzhan chos dang mthun pa'i rgyu ru bsngo/ /tshe rabs kun tu ston pa'i gsung rab dang / /mjal nas tshul bzhin bsgrub pa'i smon lam 'tshal/ /bslab bya ji bzhin mdzad pa'i gang zag la/ /rtag tu bde zhing skyid pa'i bkra shis shog /ces gdams pas rjes su tshe dang sgrub pa snyoms nus pa'i chos pa bzang po bstan 'gro la phan thogs pa zhig byung / de'i lo ston kha bu 484

chen skal ldan rang grol dang kun bzang gzhan phan/ sbyin bdag tshe ring rgyal sogs grwa slob yon bdag pho mo mang po mjal du 'ongs nas bde zhus byas pa'i lan du rnal 'byor bde tshul gyi mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so//chos bde legs stsol mdzad bla ma rje/ /steng spyi gtsug 'ja' 'od klong du bzhugs/ /sngon bsod nams bsags pas mi lus thob/ /nor zang zing longs spyod mang po 'dzoms blo dge ba'i grogs dang lha yis bskyod/ /sa dbus su yong 'dod yid la shar/ /spang dka' ba'i pha yul rgyab tu bskyur/ /bgrod dka' ba'i byang lam ring mo bcad/ /sa dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing khams su/ /dus da lo 'ong ba skal pa bzang / /dus de ring ma bu 'phrad pa ltar/ /mi nga yang dga' spro dpag med skyes/ /sprang tshogs drug rang grol ming can ngas/ /tshe 'di snang blo yis thongs pas bde/ /gnas dben pa'i dga' tshal nyams dga' ru/ /rang gcig pur sos dal gnas pas bde/ /rje bla ma dkon mchog thugs rje yis/ /lus sems la sdug bsngal med pas bde/ /khong yon bdag pho mo'i sku drin gyis/ /chos sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen 'dzoms pas bde/ /chos zab mo tshul bzhin bsgrubs pa'i mthus/ /tshe 'dir yang bde la phyi mar 485

bde/ /dus gtan du bde ba'i rnal 'byor pa/ /nga'i bde tshul bshad na brjod mi lang / /mi nga 'dra'i lus sems bde ba zhig /lha tshangs dbang gis kyang rnyed par dka'/ /khyed dad can grwa pa bu slob rnams/ /mi nga bzhin mdzod dang gtan du bde/ /glu 'di nyid blangs pa'i dge ba'i mthus/ /ma 'gro kun bde zhing skyid par shog /ces blangs pa'i lan du bu chen skal ldan rang grol gyis glu dbyangs 'di phul lo//rje byams mgon tshogs drug rang grol khyed/ /bdag spyi bo'i rgyan du bzhugs nas kyang / /dus deng nas byang chub snying po'i bar/ /thugs brtse ba chen pos skyong ba mkhyen/ /bdag tshe sngon las 'phro sad pa'i mthus/ /sdug 'khor ba'i rkyen ngan grogs su shar/ /yul bdag 'dzin bdud kyi btson rar mthong / /yid zhen log nges 'byung bskyed de 'ong / /lam ring po la lung brgal ba'i dus/ /phyi dgra 'jigs skyo ngal 'ga' ma byung / /zhing bod yul dbus kyi mchog gsum dang / /rje mtshan ldan bla ma rin po cher/ /blo gtad pas byin rlabs nus mthu yis/ / deng bsam don 'grub pas rab dga' 'thob/ /pha bka' drin mnyam med rje btsun khyed/ /dpal rgyal bstan yid can gdul bya la/ /phan bde legs stsol bzhin 'tsho bzhes 486

kyis/ /gnas ri khrod drang srong chen po'i tshul/ /sku bde ba'i rnam thar ngo mtshar can/ /gsung snyan mgur bu ngas thos pa'i mod/ /thugs yid dang 'dres nas phyag mang 'tshal ming skal ldan rang grol rten 'brel bzang / /bdag lus dang longs spyod 'di dag kun/ /rje khyed la gus pas 'bul lags na/ /thugs brtse bas bzhes nas bdag cag 'gro /mchog rnam grol myur du 'thob pa mkhyen/ /pha bla ma ci mnyes sgrub par gsol/ /blo 'jig rten chos brgyad 'gag tu gsol/ /las dang por dben gnas thub par gsol/ /chos zab don snying po bstan du gsol/ /sems ma rig nyon mongs bsal du gsol/ /rang zhi bde lam gol mi 'byung gsol/ /ma 'gro la snying rje tshad med gsol/ /gegs gol sa ma lus bsal du gsol/ /nyams rtogs pa myur du mthar phyin gsol/ /dus nam yang thugs rje 'bral med mkhyen/ /zhes khong gnyis la gang yod kyi gser dngul gos dar ras kha btags gcig kyang ma lus pa phul/ yon bdag tshe ring rgyal gyis dre'u gnyis dang dngul srang kha shas/ gzhan grwa slob yon bdag thams cad kyis 'brel ba mang po bzhag pa rnams kyi phal che ba gser du bsgyur nas/ gser srang bdun gyis thub dbang gi sku gcig blugs/487

khri rgyab yol rnams dngul la blugs nas/ g.yu byi ru'i phra bkod pa mtho gang yod pa zhig bzhengs nas rab gnas byas nged dpon slob kun gyi mgo thog tu bzhag nas sangs mnyam por rgya ba'i smon lam btab/ lo kha shas kyi bar du bdag gis 'bral spang du bcangs/ rjes nas bod kyi rgyal po tshe smon gling ba la phul/ gzhan khong gnyis la rta nor dngul dang ras kyi nang nas tsā ri rong skor gyi bro kha'i thebs bzhag nas gzhan rnams skyabs mgon rgyal ba yab sras dang / mkhar rdo chos kyi rdo rje sogs bla ma rnams la phul chos 'brel zhus/ ser 'bras dge gsum la mang ja'i zhal 'debs dang / khams tshan la 'gyed mang ja bcas btang nas dge ba rdzogs byang du bsngo bar mdzad/ de dus slob bu kun bzang rang grol dang / skal ldan rang grol/ bstan 'dzin nyi ma/ brtson 'grus rgya mtsho sogs dad can gyi slob ma yon bdag mang pos lha rdzas dri med bcas/ khyed sbra nag khag gsum sogs yul stod smad bar gsum la byon dus/ gzhan skya ser pho mo mchog dman 'bring gsum la skad cha lta bur las rgyu 'bras gtso bor bton nas chos bshad byas pa de/ nyi ma bzhin du thams cad la phan thogs pa byung / da de kun phyogs gcig tu 'khod pa'i yi ge 488

zhig byung na/ phyi rabs rjes 'jug gdul bya rnams la bka' drin lhag par che bar gda' zhes snga phyi rim pa byas yang yang bskul ba'i ngor/ gtam rgyud dang lung 'dren phal cher gyi dpe cha ma 'dzoms kyang / dper na sbyin gtong mkhan gyi snod nang na ci yod la ser sna med par snod ngo yan chad sprugs nas ras sa la brdal ba'i steng du blugs pa ltar/ bdag gi blo na gang yod yongs su rdzogs pa shog gu'i steng du yi ger phab nas/mtshan la chos bshad gzhan phan nyi ma zhes bya ba btags nas mdo smad phyogs su khyer bas 'gro ba yongs la phan thogs chen po byung ngo //smras pa/ rnam grol lam ston bu ram shing pa la/ /rnam pa kun tu gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam mang 'gro ba yongs kyi chos bsgrubs nas/ /rnam mkhyen sangs rgyas 'thob par byin gyes rlobs/ /dbus gtsang jo bo rgyal ba yab sras la/ /phyi rabs dad can mjal du 'gro ba'i phyir/ /rang nyid dbus gtsang zhing du song ba'i tshul/ /slar yang glu ru len gyis dga' bas nyon/ /a ma shi bas skyo shas skyes pa'i khar/ /tho rangs rmi lam lha mos lung bstan byung / /dbus gtsang zhing la 'gro bar thag bcad nas/ /dbus su yar la 'gro ba'i mgur dbyangs 489

blangs/ /a ma shi ba'i mya ngan sangs par byas/ /sngon gyi las 'phro can gyi skal ldan bur/ /smin byed ting 'dzin dbang bzhi bskur ba'i tshe/ /bla ma thog ma'i sangs rgyas dngos su mthong / /'bal mdo brjid par yon bdag mjal du 'ong / /chos bshad mgur blangs snang ba chos la bsgyur/ /rmi lam skabs su gter ston zhal mjal nas/ /reb gong stod smad bde thabs lung bstan gnang / /chu bzang gnas su 'ongs nas re zhig bsdad/ /rgya yi mi dpon bod kyi bla dpon gyis/ /ma thul sbra nag khag gsum dzag rkun la/ /chos bshad mgur blangs blo kha chos la bsgyur/ /lo re bzhin du ra lug ri dwags sogs/ /gsod pa'i sdig rgyun jag rkus thams cad bcad/ /tha na rtol bu re'u lug gu yan/ /gsod mkhan med tshe lha mi ngo mtshar skyes/ /grub rtags shig la de phan mi dgos zer/ /thams cad dad pas zas nor char bzhin phab/ /phal cher blangs nas dbus su 'khyer rgyu byas/ /gzhan rnams bsngo smon byas nas phyir la byen/ /las can mang por dbang lung khrid byas pas /tshe 'di bloso btang slob ma nyi shu byung / /'gro khar kun la mi rtag skyo mgur blangs/ /tshong 'dus mgon po bzhin du gyes nas song / /dbus lam chen mor zhugs nas song ba'i tshe /490

mgron po mar yong rnams kyis bskyur song ba'i/ /mi gcig mu ges 'chi ba gsos nas btang / /rma chen gangs rir 'gro ba'i nad pa la/ /mthun rkyen byen nas song bas nad las grol/ /tshong dpon yar 'gros bzhag pa'i mi gnyis dang / /khams pa nang mi lnga tsam gsos nas song / /de dus bshul ring mgron po'i lam glu blangs/ /mgron po rnams kyang glu dbyangs len bzhin song / /bro lug gsod nges mang po'i srog blu byas/ /de nas dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing du slebs/ /jo bo yid bzhin nor bu rnam gnyis la/ /mjal bas sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes skyes/ /skyabs mgon rgyal ba yab sras rnam gnyis mjal/ /snang mtha' phyag na pad+mo dngos su mthong / /sangs rgyas byang sems rgya bod mkhas grub kyi/ /skyes mtha' dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang po dang / /mjal nas chos kyi 'brel ba bzhag pa'i skabs/ /ngo mtshar dag pa'i snang ba ci yang shar/ /jo bo chen po'i drung du gser kong phul/ /ser 'bras dge gsum yongs la mang ja btang / /yod tshad thams cad mchod sbyin byas pa'i mthar/ /phyi skor chen mo zhig la song ba'i tshe /ra lug bshan pas gsod pa mang po mthong / /de la brten nas snying rje chen po skyes/ /slar yang jo bo chen po'i drung du song / /491

phyag 'tshal sha mi za ba'i dam bca' phul/ /de yi rjes su 'gro don byed pa'i tshe/ /sems can mang po'i srog la phan pa byung / /jo bo'i thugs rje yin snyam dad pa skyes/ /chos lung phu ru song nas sgrub la gzhol/ /skabs shig rang nyid tshad pas na ba'i dus/ /snang ngor lha khang zhig la me shor bas/ /lha sku thams cad ma tshig je gsal gyur/ /phyogs bzhi'i zhing khams mthong nas 'gro snyam tshe/ /mi nag gcig gis ma 'gro zer ba byung / /de nas lus po sngar bzhin bde ba'i tshe/ /rig pa dwangs pas chos la nges shes skyes/ /nyon mongs g.yul las rgyal ba'i glu dbyangs sogs/ /mgur dbyangs mang po len bzhin yod pa'i tshe/ /bstan 'dzin nyi ma 'ongs pa rjes su bzung / /shākya'i sras zhes bya ba'i zhal gdams byin/ /rjes ma'i lo la skal ldan dpon slob phebs/ /yod tshad phul ba'i phud la gser sku bzhengs/ /sangs yang mnyam por rgya ba'i smon lam btab/ /dad can slob ma rnams kyis bskul ba'i ngor/ /chos bshad gzhan phan nyi ma zhes bya sbyar/ /skye bo pho mo mang por phan thogs byung / /mdor na dbus gtsang lha rten yongs la mjal/ /jo bor gser kong la sogs mchod 'bul byas/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi rnam thar de ltar lags/ /rjes 492

'jug rnams kyang de bzhin skyong bar mdzod/ /glu 'di thos tshad skye bo pho mo yis/ /tshe rabs kun tu bla ma'i rnam thar bzhin/ /dbus gtsang zhing gi lha rten kun la mjal/ /gser dngul dar zab sogs kyis mchod par shog /ces pa'ang bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o//

tsā ri phag gdong ma nag mo thugs kyi gnas la rong skor brgyab nas sgrub pa byas tshul/bcu ba smad na 'gran zla thams cad dang bral ba tsā ri phag gdong ma nag mo thugs kyi gnas la rong skor brgyab nas sgrub pa byas tshul ni/ de yang sprel lor tsā ri rong skor la 'gro snyam/lcags mo lug lo'i mgo zla ba'i yar tshes la chos lung nas thon te 'dod dpal mkhan po zhi ba tshe ring gi phyag nas/ skyabs mgon 'brug pa rin po che'i phyag mdzod sde chung la/ nga tsā ri nas sdod ring la phan gang thogs gyis dang rjes nas sku drin bsab chog ces pa'i yi ge zhig blangs/ e dkyil 'khor sde ba stobs ldan lha sa ru 'ongs pa de slar yul du 'gro ba dang lhan du 'grogs nas song / de yang slob dpon chen po'i zhal nas/khri gdugs 'og na 'gran zla ma mchis pa'i/ /rgya gar rdo rje gdan mtshungs bsam yas 'di/ /mig gis mthong tshad ngan song skye sgo chod/ /gang dag 'di la skor ba sus bskor ba/ /bshan pa yin yang mtho ris gnas su skye/ /gang zhig bsam yas 'di la phyag 'tshal ba/ /thun mong khyad par ches cher 494

'phags par 'gyur/ /zhes pa la sogs pa'i bsngags brjod mtha' yas pa mnga' ba'i dpal bsam yas mi 'gyur ba'i gtsug lag khang rten dang brten par bcas pa yongs rdzogs la mjal nas zhag gcig bsdad/ khri ba la mjal phyag rten du dngul srang gang phul phur ba'i rjes gnang zhig zhus/ mchod 'bul byas gsol ba btab nas/ yon bdag bsod nams can ya rabs rtswa chang dga' ru song / dre'u shed ngan zhig yod pa khong tshang la byen 'tsho chas gang dgos tshad de nas khyer/ne'u ring gter ston mā la rin po che sku snyung yod pa dang mjal/dre'u shed dga' ba de ru phul nas chos 'brel zhus/ nyi ma kha shas zhabs brtan phul/ gsol ras bdag rkyen gang dgos gnang / de nas chos rgyal lha rgya ri'i 'brog ru yod sa brgyud de byar gsang sngags chos gling du song / skyabs mgon 'brug pa thams cad mkhyen par mjal dngul srang dgu phul rgyu mtshan rnams zhus pas thugs mnyes pa byung / phyag mdzod sde chung la mkhan pos gnang ba'i yi ge byen pas gcig gzigs nas zhabs tog do dam legs po mdzad/ de nas nyi ma kha shas kyi 'phro nas tsā ri chos zam rdo mtshan tshul pa gnyis brgyud de tsā ri'i dkyil 'khor thang du song ste/ zhag po mang po bsdad pa'i 495

dus su phyogs phyogs nas mjal mi mang po 'tshogs pas phyag mchod kha ton byed pa dang / la las glu gar len cing rol mo dkrol/ la las tshogs mchod 'bul/ gzhung nas g.yag gnyis nyi ma snga phyi byas glo kha khrar byen pa de btags nas bzhag yod pa'i thog tu/mtha' 'khob glo ba mang pos rub nas gri ring thung mang pos brgyab ste gson por rkang lag sogs sha dang pags pa bcad nas 'khyer ba sogs las bzang ngan gnyis ka byed pa mthong ba'i tshe/ sems la dga' skyo sna tshogs pa shar nas rang gzhan yongs la phan phyir mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so//skyabs bslu med rtsa gsum lha tshogs la/ /yid mos gus gdung bas gsol ba 'debs/ /mi 'dir 'tshogs tshe 'di'i bar chad sol/ /tshe phyi mar dge ba'i zhing du drongs/ /sngon las bzang smon lam dag pa'i mthus/ /sa dge legs bkra shis g.yang chags pa/ /gnas tsā ri'i dkyil 'khor thang gi dbus/ /yul mi gcig skad rigs mi mthun pa'i/ /skyes pho mo dad can 'bum phrag lhag /sus ma bsdus bzhin du shugs kyis 'dus/ /phyogs phyogs su gur bkram spyil bu phub/ /sho ma btang gong gi zhag 'ga' la/ /mi la las phyag 'tshal bsgom bzlas sogs/ /las de 'dras dal 'byor don ldan mdzad/ /496

gzhan 'ga' res glu gar rol mo dkrol/ /ma mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i tshogs mchod 'bul/ /yul mtha' 'khob glo pa mang po yis/ /mtshon thogs nas sems can srog la 'tshe/ /las bzang ngan gnyis la spyod mthong tshe/ /nang sems la dga' skyo sna tshogs shar/ /glo rnams kyis mna' bskyal rang yul bsnyegs/ /gnas mjal mis dag pa shel ri bskor/ /kun mi sdod so sor gyes pa ltar/ /chos thams cad mi rtag 'di dang mtshungs/ /yul pha ma nye 'brel grogs mched la/ /tshe 'di ru 'grogs pa yud tsam yin/ /kun mi sdod 'jig rten pha rol 'gro /rang 'gro ba'i nangs par chos shig dgos/ /don de la soms la lha chos mdzod/ /lus srog la babs kyang sdig la 'dzems/ /'di bzhin du byed mkhan skyes bu la/ /tshe 'di phyir bde skyid nyi ma 'char/ /glu 'di nyid blangs pa'i dge ba'i mthus/ /gnas skor mi'i skya ser pho mo kun/ /lus sems la sdug bsngal mi 'byung bar/ /gnas 'khor nas gnyen bshes mjal bar smon/ /yul mi gcig gnas skor grogs mched kun/ /gnas dag pa mkha' spyod zhing khams su/ /tshe phyi mar mjal ba'i smon lam 'debs/ /yid smon pa bzhin du 'grub gyur cig /ces blangs/ yang nyin gcig dad can gyi skye bo pho 497

mo rnams la phan phyir gnas kyi yon tan la bsngags pa'i mgur 'di blangs so//gnas dag pa shel ri'i lha tshogs la/ /bdag gsol ba 'debs so byen gyes rlobs/ /sprang bya btang tshogs drug rang grol ngas/ /rang sems la gang shar glu ru len/ /dpal he ru ka yi gzhal yas khang / /ma mkha' 'gro sprin bzhin 'du ba'i zhing / /yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i ya gyal mchog /gnas khyad 'phags dpal gyi tsā ri tra/ /lha'i sku gzugs yig 'bru rang byon dang / /dgun sngo ljang rtsi shing me tog sogs/ /ngo mtshar ba'i ltad mo sna tshogs snang / /gnas 'di 'dra mjal ba skal ba bzang / /phyag skor ba byas na sgrib gnyis 'dag /tshogs mchod pa phul na tshogs gnyis rdzogs/ /sgom sgrub pa mdzad na nyams rtogs 'char/ /gnas 'di 'dra 'dzam gling 'di na dkon/ /nyams rtogs pa 'char 'dod sgom chen kun/ /gnas 'di ru bzhugs la sgom sgrub gyis/ /las sdig sgrib che ba'i pho mo kun/ /gnas 'di la phyag dang skor ba gyis/ /rgyu tshogs gnyis gsog pa'i gang zag rnams/ /gnas 'di la ci 'byor mchod 'bul gyis/ /glu 'di nyid mthong thos 'gro kun gyis/ /chos byas nas myur du sangs rgyas shog /ces blangs 498

pas der 'tshogs pa kun gnas la dad cing gus par gyur to//de nas maṅga ra zhes pa chu pho spre'u'i lo zla ba dang po'i tshes gsum la sho btang /sho'i nang ltar thams cad tsā ri'i rong skor la song ba'i tshe/ lam bar na la la na nas 'chi la khad pa 'dugal la shi ba'i ro yang mthong nas/ de tshor phan pa'i skyabs 'jug dang 'pho ba btab/ 'ga' res rang gi grogs po na ba bzhag nas song bas rjes nas 'gro ma thub par bsdad nas ngu ba mthong / de tsho'i thag nyer song nas da dung gnas bskor ba'i mjug rdzogs sa mi 'dug nyi ma kha shas sdod dang / rjes nas drag tshe yong chog ces sems gso btang sman dang bro kha bzhag nas 'ong / 'ga' res grogs po na ba khur/ la las de'i khur po khur nas 'ong ba mthong tshe/ nga thag nyer song nas khyed tsho khrel yod red ga le sos dal gyis la shog dang /shag chu'i khar thag nye bar gda' zhes sems dpangs bstod/gzhan yang dka' las myong mkhan rnams la phan gang thogs byas/ de dus mi phal che ba zhig gis dka' las myong ba mthong ba'i tshe snying rje skyes pa byung / rang gis kyang dka' las myong bzhin 'ong tshe sdig sgrib thams cad dag yod snyam/ de nas yul smad du slebs dus sems dga' ba byung / chos zam du 'ong ste 499

skor mi thams cad kyis ja bskol nas 'thung / rang rang gi khur bo rnams bsdams te pha tshad du bzhag nas/ gnas skor pa phal che ba nga'i mtha' la 'dus nas/ khyed gang du phebs pa yin/ nged tsho'i yul kong po dang khams phyogs tshor lan re phebs zer/ der ngas da res gangs te se dang la phyi bcas gnas gsum bskor du 'gro khyed tsho'i yul phyogs tsho la yang 'ong ba'i smon lam 'debs/ 'on kyang mi'i skye 'chi la nges pa med/ sa kha thag ring pos bar chod nas phyin chad ma 'phrad na yang / ngas khyed rnams la tshe 'di phyir phan pa'i skyabs 'jug bya/ khyed rnams kyis kyang nam 'chi cha med soms la tshe 'dir ha cang mi chags par tshe phyi mar phan pa'i chos re gyis/ gal te chos rgya chen po ma nus kyang / srog gcod kyi sdig pa ma byed/'chi khar bla ma dkon mchog yid la dran par gyis la gsol ba thob dang / phyi mar dag pa'i zhing du mjal ba'i skal ba yod ces sems la phan pa'i kha ta mang po byas pas kun kyang nga la sems 'phreng bzhin du 'gro ma phod par sdod dus/ khams chags med dgon gyi thag nye'i yin zer ba'i jo mo dad can zhig gis phyag 'tshal zhing mchi ma mang po gtong bzhin du/rje skyabs mgon yid bzhin nor bu la/ /bdag gsol ba 500

'debs so byen gyis rlobs/ /khyed dpon slob sku khams bzang po'i sgos/ /stod gangs dkar phyogs su bde bar phebs/ /nged rnams kyang rang rang yul la 'gro /bgegs bar chad med pa'i skyabs 'jug zhu/ /tshe 'di ru da dung mjal bar shog /tshe phyi ma'i yul du'ang mjal bar shog /zhal bar do'i skabs su'ang mjal bar shog /dus yang dang yang du mjal bar shog /ces pa la sogs pa'i tshigs bcad dang tshig lhug gnyis kyis smon lam mang po 'debs bzhin song tshe/ gzhan rnams kyang snga phyi byas phal cher gyi mig nas mchi ma g.yo bzhin mi rtag pa'i rnam 'gyur bstan nas mthar thams cad so sor gyes nas rang rang gi yul du song ngo / /nged dpon slob rnams 'brug pa rin po che'i gdan sa byar gsang sngags chos gling du tshur 'ong /skyabs mgon 'brug pa thams cad mkhyen par mjal tshe rta zung 'brel gyi rjes gnang dang phyag chen gyi sngon 'gro dngos gzhi cha tshang ba'i lung khrid zhus/ zla ba gcig tsam la ngal gsos nas bsdad/ de nas skal ldan sogs zhabs phyi slob ma rnams dbus lho kha'i ri khrod du mtshams sgrub byed du btang /bdag gis 'brug pa thams cad mkhyen pas gsol ras mthun rkyen gnang ba rnams khyer nas slar snga gnas dag pa mkha' 50 1

spyod dpal gyi tsā ri tra'i byang phyogs klu bdud nag po zhes bya ba skye 'gro gang gi khar song na klu nad sogs nad kun sel zhing mchog thun gyi dngos grub kun ster ba'i ngo mtshar can gye rtswa de skye ba'i sa/ nyams rtogs yon tan kun cig char du 'khrungs pa'i brdar sa'i ming yang cig char zhes 'bod pa'i dben gnas/ phyag na pad+mo'i rnam 'phrul kun mkhyen pad+ma dkar pos bzhengs pa'i gzi brjid rab 'bar phag mo zhal gnyis ma dngos dang mtshungs pa'i sku rgyu rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i mi tshad las lhag pa gcig sogs sku gsung thugs rten byen can du ma bzhugs pa'i gtsug lag khang gser gyi rgya phibs tog gis kun nas mjes par byas pa'i thag nye yang dgon zhes pa ri ngos ljon shing sna tshogs g.yu dang mu men mu tig gi dra ba dra phyed ltar bres pa'i gseb/ rang shong bsam gtan khang bu nyams dga' ba zhig nas/ rang nyid gcig pur lo gcig dang zla ba gcig sdod pa'i ring la nyams len sha stag byas pas nyams snang la/ dus bzang rnams su pho brang g.yu mtsho'i phyogs su dpa' bo mkha' 'gro mang po phar phebs tshur phebs byed pa mthong ba dang / dpa' bo mkha' 'gros tshogs 'khor skor ba'i gral du song nas tshogs la rol zhing rdo rje'i glu 502
