dbyangs thos pa sogs mkha' 'gro'i byin rlabs kyis gsang sngags bskyed rdzogs nyams su len pa'i rnal 'byor pas thabs lam bsten pa sogs chos dang gang zag mchog dman yongs la dad gus dag snang rtsol med du skyes pa byung / nyin gcig phyogs phyogs kyi gtam mang po thos pa la brten nas 'di skad ces smras so//gañca'i yul gye rgyal phran 'gas/ /pha rgan bsad nas rgyal sa 'dzin/ /lho mon yul gye mtha' zhig na/ /ma rgan bsad nas mna' ma len/ /bal po 'ga' res pho shi na/ /mo yang lhan du gson sreg byed/ /phyi rol rgyal po kha cig gis/ /mi bsad gu lang dbang phyug mchod/ /mtha' 'khob glo na pha dang ma'i/ /dge rtsar srog chags ci gsod byed/ /kong po'i phyogs na dug gis mi/ /bsad nas bsod nams skye bar rlom/ /'jig rten khams na de 'dra yis/ /go log byed mkhan mang po thos/ /sdug bsngal sdig pa'i 'bras bu ru/ /ma shes 'gro ba snying re rje/ /da re dam pa'i chos dar ba'i/ /yul du skyes pa skal ba bzang / /mtshan ldan dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi/ /drin gyis dge sdig ngo shes bzhin/ /mi dge sdig pa byed pa'i mi/ /shes bzhin g.yang la mchongs pa 'dra/ /de 'dra'i smyon pa gzhan na med/ /dge ba 503

sgrubs shig shes ldan rnams/ /zhes smras nas las rgyu 'bras go ma log pa zhig shes pa 'di yang bla ma rnams kyi bka' drin yin par gda' snyam/ sdig spong dge sgrub la sngar bas brtson par byas te/ rje mi las/ nga shi yang dga' ste sdig ma byas/ /gson yang dga' ste dge sbyong 'phel/ /gsungs pa'i don thog tu babs pa'i tshe/ da shi 'gro yang 'gyod pa mi 'dug snyam dga' tshor chen po byung / yon bdag dad can phyug mo yid 'dzin lha mos dge ba'i gsal 'debs su zhal gdams shig dgos zhes bskul ngor 'di skad ces phul lo//gser g.yu bye ru'i rgyan cha/ /da lta 'dogs dus dga' yang / /rgyan cha ci yod bzhag nas/ /phyi mar 'gro dus skyo yong / /gzugs mjes sems bzang grogs la/ /da lta 'grogs dus dga' yang / /bza' mi bye bral byas nas/ /phyi mar 'gro dus skyo yong / /zas nor longs spyod gang dgos/ /da lta 'dzom dus dga' yang / /ci yod shul du bzhag nas/ /phyi mar 'gro dus skyo yong / /dal 'byor mi lus rin chen/ /da lta thob dus dga' yang / /chos med lag stong byas nas/ /phyi mar 'gro dus skyo yong / /de'i phyir yid 'dzin lha mo/ /yun ring sdod gshoms ma mdzad/ /mi nor zas gsum gang la'ang / /ha 504

cang chags zhen ma che/ /nam 'chi cha med soms la/ /g.yu byir rgyan char ma dga'/ /nam yang bza' 'khon ma byed/ /nor la ser sna ma che/ /don med rnam g.yeng ma byed/ /lus kyis phyag dang skor ba/ /ngag gis kha ton bzlas brjod/ /sems kyis dad gus dag snang / /byams dang snying rje sgoms shig /bla ma dkon mchog mchod pa/ /dbul bo rnams la sbyin pa/ /dge 'dun rnams la bsnyen bkur/ /bran g.yog rnams la gang byams/ /de ltar byas na tshe 'dir/ /bde skyid snyan gsum 'byung zhing / /phyi mar bde nas bde bar/ /'gro zhes thub pas gsungs snang / /rnal 'byor dpon slob 'khor bcas/ /tshe 'dir mjal ba yud tsam/ /phyi mar dag pa'i zhing nas/ /mjal ba'i smon lam 'tshal lo/ /zhes phul ba 'phrod nas bzung zhal gdams kyi nang ltar byas nas 'chi khar lam sna zin pa byung ngo / /nyin gcig slob bu kun bzang gzhan phan gyis gnas bstod cig dgos zhes bskul ngor/ skal ldan las snang dag pa'i snang ngor dag pa mkha' spyod dngos dang mtshungs shing /zhi khro'i lha tshogs dpag tu med pa til gyi gang bu kha phye ba lta bur bzhugs pa'i zhing khams chen po gnas chen dpal gyi tsā ri tra'i yon tan rgya mtsho lta bu'i nang nas chu thigs tsam dang 505

mtshungs pa'i bstod pa nyung ngu 'di smras/dkar zhing dwangs la shel dkar mdog /dbus ri rgyal po gdan bzhugs 'dra/ /mtha' na ri brag blon bzhin mang / /me tog sna tshogs gcal du bkram/ /ljon shing me tog 'bras bus mdzes/ /spang ljongs ne'u gsing gser gzhong 'dra/ /mtsho g.yu'i malcol ji bzhin bshams/ /chu rnams dar dkar bzhin du 'then/ /ngang bas mgrin pa'i rdza rnga rdung / /bya bye'u pi wang gling bu 'bud/ /bung bus glu blangs gar yang bsgyur/ /nyams dga' rig pa dwags pa'i sa/ /grub thob gong ma bzhugs pa'i gnas/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i zhing / /gnas chen nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i mchog /dag pa mkha' spyod dang mtshungs pa'i/ /ngo mtshar dpal gyi tsā ri tra'i/ /dbus kyi dag pa shel ri la/ /lha tshogs nyis stong brgyad brgya bzhugs/ /mtha' bskor ri brag mtsho shing rer/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro grangs med gnas/ /'dir 'dus skye bo pho mo rnams/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i rigs can yin/ /gnas 'dir bzhugs nas chos sgrub pa'i/ /rgyud la nyams rtogs yon tan skye/ /dngos sam nyams dang rmi lam la/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i zhal gzigs 'byung / /tshogs mchod mar me gcig phul na/ /506

gnas skabs tshe dang bsod nams rgyas/ /shi tshe dpa' bo mkha' 'gro yis/ /mkha' spyod dag pa'i zhing du 'dren/ /phyag dang skor ba gcig byas kyang / /shin tu sdig can mi yin yang / /ngan song gsum gyi skye sgo chod/ /mtho ris lha mi'i gnas su skye/ /'di ru gnas pa'i srog chags rnams/ /dmyal ba'i gnas su ltung mi srid/ /rtswa zos chu 'thung dud 'gro rnams/ /sgrib byang ma 'ongs mi lus 'thob/ /gnas 'di mthong thos dran reg dang / /dad mos mchod bstod bkur ba sogs/ /'brel tshad thams cad don ldan zhes/ /tshad ldan mkhas grub du mas gsungs/ /gnas 'di'i phyi nang gsang gsum gyi/ /yon tan yod tshad ma lus pa/ /bdag gis lce stong rab sprul nas/ /bskal ba stong phrag gcig tsam la/ /bshad kyang brjod kyis ga la lang / /de'i phyir dad can pho mo rnams/ /gnas mchog 'di nyid mchod bstod bkur/ /phyag dang skor ba rgyun du gyis/ /zhes dam pa gong ma'i gsung ltar smras pa yin pas kun gyis tshad mar zungs la gnas la phyag mchod skor ba gyis shig ces gdams so/ /skabs shig gnas der cig char rdor 'dzin rnga sgra sprul sku rin po che'i drung nas kun mkhyen pad+ma dkar po'i rnam thar dang mgur 'bum gyi lung 507

zhus/ gzhan yang grub chen dam chos bzang bo la/ nā ro chos drug dang 'khrul 'khor bsre ba brgya brgyad pa'i khrid zhus/cig char sgrub sde'i grub chen bcu gsum gyis gtum mo'i che ba 'don phyir dgun shin tu grang ba'i sgang la gzan rkyang re gyon zhag re tsam gangs ri'i thag nye'i kha ba'i thang nas bzhugs/nangs zhogs snga mo nas tsā ri'i yon bdag tshul pa rnams kyis gdugs dang rgyal mtshan 'phyar nas bsu ru song ba dang /thams cad kyi sku rlangs pa phyur re bzhengs nas phebs pa mthong bas mi la ras pa'i bu rgyud la dad pa rang dbang med par skyes pa byung / de nas sngon sbyangs las 'phro can skal ldan snying gi bu mchog kun bzang rang grol dang / dad gtong shes rab sogs 'phags pa'i nor gyis phyug pa'i skal ldan rang grol gnyis kyis/ da lta'i rjes 'jug rnams dang ma 'ongs pa'i ri khrod pa rnams la phan thogs pa'i chos bshad rgyas pa zhig brtsam dgos zhes bskul ngor/ bka' brgyud gong ma'i lung gis brgyan te chos bshad gzhan phan zla ba zhes bya ba brtsams/grub mtha' ris med kyi chos dang gang zag yongs la dad gus dag snang 'byung ba'i chos bshad cig dgos tshul gye rgyu mtshan rnams rgyas par zhus pa'i ngor/ lung rigs gnyis kyis brgyan 508

pa'i chos bshad gzhan phan nor bu dang legs bshad kun bzang mchod sprin gnyis brtsams nas slob bu kun bzang la lung byed pa'i skabs su/ rang nyid byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i skur gsal btab thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi mchod 'os skyabs yul ma lus pa spyan drangs nas/ dngos 'byor yid kyis sprul ba'i mchod sprin nam mkha'i khams gang bar spros te mchod bstod gsol ba btab/ bstan 'gro yongs la phan pa'i byin rlabs zhus/sems can thams cad rang gi mdun du gsal btab/ stong gsum mi mjed kyi 'gro ba yongs kyi rna lam du chos kyi sgra snyan pa'i dbyangs kyis bsgrags pas kun gyis thos/ tshig don gye gnas kun rtogs par dmigs te sgra dag par bton nas lung byen glegs bam mgo thog tu bzhag ste/ chos 'di mthong thos dran reg gi 'gro ba yongs la phan pa'i smon lam rgya chen po byas tshe/ gnas kyi lha mkha' 'gro'i byin rlabs las/ rang nyid gnas pa'i sa phyogs dag pa'i zhing khams chen por gsal ba'i mdun gyi nam mkhar rgyal ba sras bcas khra lam mer bzhugs pa rnams thugs dgyes pa'i rtags su zhal ras 'dzum zhing thugs ka nas 'od zer mang po 'phros pas/ 'jig rten gye 509

khams thams cad gsal bar byas te/ kye rgyal ba'i sras po de de bzhin no/ /de de bzhin te/ rgyal ba rnams kyi thugs dam skong zhing / 'gro ba kun gyi yid tshim pa'i sngon med legs bshad bzang po de yin pas ngo mtshar che/ rigs kyi bu khyod rgyal ba kun gyi sras kyi thu bo/ 'gro ba yongs kyi skyabs mgon du mnga' gsol ba yin no zhes dbugs dbyung gzengs bstod cing / dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams rab tu mjes pa'i gar stabs sna tshogs sgyur bzhin/ mi 'gyur lhun po ma sogs bkra shis pa'i glu dbyangs blangs/ 'ja' 'od kyi sprin 'dus/ me tog gi char babs/ rol mo'i sgra bsgrags pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i nyams snang sna tshogs pa shar zhing /dngos su yang nam mkhar 'ja' tshon kha dog lnga ldan shar/ me tog dkar po'i char babs/ dung dang rnga sogs rol mo'i sgra grags pa nye 'khor ba phal cher gyis mthong zhing thos pa byung /nged dpon slob gnyis kyis rten 'brel bzang / chos 'dis ma 'ongs pa'i gang zag mang po la phan thogs par 'dug snyam rab dga'i sa thob pa lta bu'i dga' spro shar nas/ nyams dga' zhing skyid pa'i rgyang glu mang po blangs so/ /de dus cig char sgrub sde'i grub chen 'ga' res khyed kyis bla ma su bsten/510

dam chos gang zhus/ nyams len gang la byas zer ba'i lan drang por smras nas mjug tu mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so//dang po bla ma bla mar bsten/ /bar du dpe cha bla mar bsten/ /tha ma rang sems bla mar bsten/ /bla ma thar pa'i lam ston la/ /dam chos so so thar pa zhus/ /nyams len sdig spong dge sgrub byas/ /bla ma byang chub sems dpa' la/ /dam chos theg chen sems bskyed zhus/ /nyams len bdag pas gzhan gces byas/ /bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa la/ /dam chos gsang sngags dbang khrid zhus/ /nyams len bskyed rdzogs rdzogs chen bsgoms/ /bla ma rnam pa sna tshogs la/ /dam chos 'brel ba sna re zhu/ /nyams len dad gus dag snang sbyangs/ /zhes ku re rtse mtshar gyi tshul du smras pas khong rnams kyang rab tu dga' zhing dad par gyur to/ /yang 'ga' res khyed kyi mgur dbyangs klong nas brdol ba red gzhan ltar 'bad rtsol mi dgos par nam 'dod dus thogs pa med par 'then chog pa ya mtshan che zer ba'i lan du yid la shar ba ltar mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so//drang srong thang dkar rgod po de/ /tshang gi nang nas gshog sgro rgyas/ /g.yang sa chod dus nam mkhar 'phur/ /da lta nam 511

'phang ches cher bstod/ /mtshan ldan bla ma'i slob bu ngas/ /bla ma'i drung nas thos bsam byas/ /sgo 'dogs chod dus ri khrod 'grims/ /da lta bsgom la ches cher brtson/ /lha bya yid 'ong gong mo yis/ /g.ya' spang khrod nas rtswa chu btsal/ /da lta gangs g.ya'i mtshams na bsdad/ /na bun khrod na skad snyan bsgyur/ /gangs can bod yul glu pa ngas/ /rong dang 'brog nas lto gos btsal/ /da lta dben pa'i ri na bsdad/ /bu slob khrod na glu dbyangs len/ /rwa bcu rgyas pa'i sha ba yis/ /ri bo'i rtse nas rgyang so bltas/ /shod du 'ongs nas dkyus rtsed byas/ /slar yang rdza ri mthon po bsnyegs/ /rig pa rgyas pa'i rnal 'byor ngas/ /ri khrod dben par phan sems sbyangs/ /grong du song nas chos bshad byas/ /slar yang dben pa'i ri khrod bsnyegs/ /btung ba 'bab chu bsil ma de/ /'bad cing rtsol ba mi dgos par/ /rnal 'byor mgrin las rang rdol byung / /sus thos nyon mongs gdung ba sel/ /zhes blangs/ yang 'ga' res sngon gyi bya btang sgom chen pa dang da lta'i bla ma chos pa 'ga' res mgur dbyangs mang po len pa de ci yin nam zer ba'i lan du de nyams rtogs yon tan khong nas rgyas pa'i rtags yin zhes de dus yid la shar ba ltar mgur 'di blangs 512

〈〈//spang gser gyi mdangs 'dzin ri bo na/ /sha rgyas pa'i ri dwags glu dbyangs len/ /de rtswa chus khog pa 'grangs pa'i rtags/ /dbyar me tog ser po'i gling khams na/ /rkang drug ldan bung bas glu dbyangs len/ /de sprang rtsis lus sems tshims pa'i rtags/ /dgung sngon po chu 'dzin 'khrigs dbus na/ /dbyar g.yu 'brug sngon mos glu dbyangs len/ /de 'byung ba tsha grang 'dzoms pa'i rtags/ /g.yu'i mdangs 'dzin spang gshong 'jam po na/ /phyugs 'tsho ba'i na chung glu dbyangs len/ /de lus kyi lang tsho rgyas pa'i rtags/ /rong 'brog gi phyug po'i sgo 'gram na/ /dman sprang slong ma ṇi'i glu dbyangs len/ /de bzang btung mang po byung ba'i rtags/ /mi shi ba'i ro yi sngas 'go na/ /rje bla mas cho ga'i glu dbyangs len/ /de 'bul ba mang po phul ba'i rtags/ /ri na bun 'khrigs pa'i dben gnas na/ /khong bya btang rnal 'byor glu dbyangs len/ /de nyams rtogs yon tan shar ba'i rtags/ /zhes blangs/ yang 'ga' res sngon gyi skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis rdo rje'i glu blangs pas phan pa mang bo byung 'dug kyang deng sang khyed kyis glu blangs pas gzhan la phan thogs 'dra e byung zer ba'i lan du/513

gdul bya mang po la phan thogs byung tshul gyi mgur 'di blangs so//sngon rgya bod mkhas grub thams cad kyis/ /chos mdo rgyud dgongs pa glu ru blangs/ /'khor gdul byar phan thogs dpag med byung / /mi ngas kyang dam pa'i gsung bzhin du/ /pha bla ma sten tshul glu dbyangs blangs/ /rje tshul bzhin sten mkhan mang po byung / /rten dal 'byor tshang ba'i mi lus 'di/ /phyis rnyed dka' don chen glu dbyangs blangs/ /yar chos sgor zhugs mkhan mang po byung / /tshe lo zla zhag song myur du 'dzad/ /kun myur du 'chi tshul glu dbyangs blangs/ /tshe blo yis gtong mkhan mang po byung / /las rgyu 'bras dkar nag mi bslu smin/ /de 'dor len byed dgos glu dbyangs blangs/ /sdig spangs nas dge byed mang po byung / /mar 'khor ba sdug bsngal rgya mtsho la/ /bde cung zad med tshul glu dbyangs blangs/ /skyo nges 'byung skyes pa mang po byung / /gzhan 'gro ba rigs drug ma lus pa/ /ma drin can yin tshul glu dbyangs blangs/ /byams snying rje skyes pa mang po byung / /chos mdo rgyud man ngag mang po nyan/ /sgom sgrub pa byas tshul glu dbyangs blangs/ /chos nyan cing sgom mkhan mang po byung / /rje gong ma'i gdan sa ri khrod nas/ /514

chos byas na yong tshul glu dbyangs blangs/ /gnas dben pa sten mkhan mang po byung / /sa bod du dar ba'i grub mtha' rnams/ /chos rnam dag yin tshul glu dbyangs blangs/ /mi dag snang byed mkhan mang po byung / /zhes blangs/ yang 'ga' res dbus phyogs na rnal 'byor pa gcig pur dur khrod dang mi med lung stong gi ri khrod 'grims pa de khyad chos che bar gda' zer ba'i lan du glu dbyangs 'di blangs so//khyab 'jug mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul can/ /gza' skar nyi zlar mi 'jigs par/ /bar snang khams la 'phyo ba de/ /gshog sgo bzang ba'i khyad chod yin/ /ri dwags rgyal po g.yu ral can/ /gcan gzan yongs la mi 'jigs par/ /ri klung khyab par nyul ba de/ /rtsal stobs che ba'i khyad chos yin/ /dung dkar g.yas su 'khyil ri can/ /chu sren nya la mi 'jigs par/ /rgya mtsho'i kha gting nyul ba de/ /gzhan 'bigs nus pa'i khyad chos yin/ /nyams len mkhan gye rnal 'byor pa/ /lha 'dre gang la'ang mi 'jigs par/ /dur khrod ri khrod 'grims pa de/ /nyams rtogs ldan pa'i khyad chos yin/ /zhes blangs/yang 'ga' res khyed kyi thugs rgyud dang mdzad spyod legs shing / mgur dbyangs snyan pa'i shugs kyis nyan na 'dod cing 515

sems la phan par 'dug zer ba'i lan du glu dbyangs 'di blangs so//gangs can bod kyi glu dbyangs mkhan/ /rnal 'byor tshogs drug rang grol ngas/ /mtshan ldan bla ma bsten pa'i tshe/ /ci gsung bka' gcig bcag ma myong / /snying nas gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshe/ /mig nas mchi ma dbang med g.yo/ /nam 'chi cha med dran pa'i tshe/ /thos bsam bsgom la brtson 'grus byung / /'dod yon nyes dmigs bsam pa'i tshe/ /'khor ba'i bde la zhen pa log /dben pa'i ri la sdod pa'i tshe/ /chos min bsam pa gcig mi 'gyu/ /gnas lugs ngang la mnyam bzhag tshe/ /sngar ma mthong ba'i ltad mo mjong / /mi rtog ting 'dzin la gnas tshe/ /thag nye'i mi yang lhan ner gnas/ /'gro la snying rje skyes pa'i tshe/ /lto gos yin yang phangs med ster/ /rgyu 'bras chos bshad byed pa'i tshe/ /lha 'dre mi gsum dad pa g.yo/ /snyan pa'i glu dbyangs blangs pa'i tshe/ /dri za rnams kyang 'dzum chung byed/ /ces blangs pas dad cing 'dun par gyur to/ /nyin gcig nam mkha' na bya rgyal rgod po gcig gis nam 'phang dgung la bstod pa mthong nas mgur 'di blangs so//phyogs bzhi gcig la 'gro 'dod nas/ /dgung sngon dkyil 516

na 'khor bzhin du/ /nam 'phang bstod pa'i bya rgyal rgod/ /khyod kyis nga yi 'phrin 'di skyol/ /shar gyi phyogs su khyod 'gro na/ /shar phyogs rdo rje sems dpa' la/ /mi rnams 'chi dus khyod byon la/ /mngon par dga' bar drongs shig gyis/ /shar phyogs lus 'phags yul gyi mi/ /gzugs byad mdzes pa tshe rabs sngon/ /bzod pa bsgoms pa'i 'bras bu yin/ /da dung bzod pa sgoms shig gyis/ /lho yi phyogs su khyod 'gro na/ /lho phyogs rin chen 'byung ldan la/ /mi rnams 'chi dus khyod byon nas/ /dpal dang ldan par drongs shig gyis/ /lho phyogs 'dzam bu gling ba'i mi/ /dge sdig shes pa tshe rabs sngon/ /chos la sbyangs pa'i 'bras bu yin/ /da dung chos la sbyongs shig gyis/ /nub kyi phyogs su khyod 'gro na/ /nub phyogs snang ba mtha' yas la/ /mi rnams 'chi dus khyod byon nas/ /bde ba can du drongs shig gyis/ /nub phyogs ba glang spyod kyi mi/ /longs spyod che ba tshe rabs sngon/ /sbyin pa btang ba'i 'bras bu yin/ /da dung sbyin pa thongs shig gyis/ /byang gi phyogs su khyod 'gro na/ /byang phyogs don yod grub pa la/ /mi rnams 'chi dus khyod byon la/ /las rab rdzogs su drongs shig gyis/ /byang phyogs sgra mi snyan gyi mi/ /tshe thag ring ba tshe rabs sngon/ /517

gzhan srog bskyabs pa'i 'bras bu yin/ /da dung gzhan srog skyobs shig gyis/ /zhes blangs pa'i tshe yar je mtho je mthor song nas/ shar phyogs su 'gro ba la mig gis nam mthong bar bltas nas ma mthong ba dang / nga la yang rdzu 'phrul thogs pa med pa zhig yod na bya rgod ya ki ltar/ shar phyogs mngon dga'i zhing du 'gro rgyu byung na dga' ba la snyam pa byung nas/phyogs bzhi'i zhing khams rnams yid la byas te phyogs de rnams su phyag mang po btsal/ nam zhig 'chi dus zhing khams de dag rnams su song ste 'brel thogs rnams kyang zhing khams de dag tu 'dren pa'i smon lam kyang btab bo/ /yang 'ga' res sngar tsā ri rong skor byed dus su khyed kyi thugs la ci 'khrungs zer ba'i lan du 'di skad ces smras/ ngo mtshar rtsa gsum lha yi zhing / /sar gnas dag pa mkha' spyod dngos/ /tsā ri'i rong skor byed pa'i dus/ /sems la 'di 'dra snyam pa byung / /glo yul lam 'phrang chu zam sogs/ /bgrod dka' brgyud nas song ba'i tshe/ /bar do'i 'phrang la 'gro ba'i dus/ /'di 'dra los yin snyam pa byung / /lto yod dbang yod thams cad po/ /dga' bzhin 'gro ba mthong ba'i ma chos yod phyi mar 'gro ba rnams/ /'di 'dra los yin snyam pa 518

byung / /lto med dbang med thams cad po/ /sdug bzhin 'gro ba mthong ba'i tshe/ /chos med phyi mar 'gro ba rnams/ /'di 'dra los yin snyam pa byung / /'ga' res grogs po na ba de/ /bskyur nas 'gro ba mthong ba'i tshe/ /khrel med grogs po zer ba de/ /'di 'dra los yin snyam pa byung / /'ga' res grogs po na ba de/ /khur nas 'gro ba mthong ba'i tshe/ /khrel yod grogs po zer ba de/ /'di 'dra los yin snyam pa byung / /'ga' res nyam thag sprang po la/ /zas sbyin skyong ba mthong ba'i tshe/ /byang chub sems dpal zer ba de/ /'di 'dra los yin snyam pa byung / /skor mi mang po mu ge dang / /nad kyis shi ba mthong ba'i tshe/ /chos phyir lus srog gtong ba de/ /'di 'dra los yin snyam pa byung / /skor mi khri 'bum gang yod tshad/ /so sor bral nas song ba'i tshe/ /chos rnams mi rtag zer ba de/ /'di 'dra los yin snyam pa byung / /zhes smras pas kun skyo shas dang snying rje skyes pa byung / nyin gcig rang gi sems la shar ba ltar nyams dbyangs 'di blangs so// brag ri yi khang bzang / /ljon shing gi bsil grib/ /sngo ljong rtswa'i spyil chung / /ras dkar gye gur sogs/ /gang dga' ru sdod pa'i/ /rnal 'byor pa gu yangs/ /blo bde ngas skyid 519

pa'i/ /rgyang glu zhig len no/ /rang nyid la bka' drin/ /sangs rgyas las lhag pa'i/ /mtshan ldan gyi bla ma/ /dam pa la brten nas/ /'khor 'das kyi chos rnams/ /snang stong ni zung 'jug /gang snang kun sems kyi/ /cho 'phrul du go song / /'khor 'das kyi rtsa ba/ /rang sems kyi gnas lugs/ /dngos bzung med stong gsal/ /'dzin med du rtogs song / /dben gnas su bsdad de/ /gnas lugs kyi ngang la/ /ras bal bzhin shes pa/ /glod nas rang bzhag pas/ /ma rig pa'i mun pa/ /rang dwangs la song nas/ /chos dbyings kyi nam mkha'/ /yangs pa de langs byung / /gnas lugs de yin min/ /the tshom gyis dogs pa/ /rgyal ba rnams byon kyang / /'dri rgyu zhig mi snang / /rtsa gsum lha'i zhing khams/ /mkha' spyod dngos tsā ri/ /nyams rtogs kun cig char/ /'khrungs gnas na bzhugs pa'i/ /ming don gnyis mthun pa'i/ /phyag chen gyi rnal 'byor/ /gnas lugs kyi rang zhal/ /mjal ba yi tshogs rnams/ /nam mkha' bzhin sang nge / /nyi ma bzhin sa le/ /me long bzhin wal le/ /mig 'bras bzhin hrig ge /chos kyi sku'i khyad chos/ /bzhi ldan 'di skyongs dang / /chos dbyings kyi zhing la/ /dus mnyam du chas 'gro /dbu ma ba lung rigs/ /kun 520

mkhyen gyi dge bshes/ /chos grwa ru bgro gleng / /btang ba de snyan bzhin/ /phyag rdzogs pa gcig shes/ /kun grol gyi rnal 'byor/ /dben pa ru nyams mgur/ /blangs pa yang snyan yang / /zhes blangs pas der bzhugs pa'i rtogs ldan 'khrul zhig rnams thugs dgyes par gyur to/ /de nas mi 'ga' res ri khrod na 'dod pa slong ba'i yul rkyen med pas khyed la 'dod chags skye rgyu ma red zer ba'i lan du/ rkyen mang po byung /'dod pa skyes par ma zad spyad song zhes rtse mtshar du mgur 'di blangs so//ri khrod dben pa'i dga' tshal na/ /rkang drug gzhon nu'i gar stabs bsgyur/ /'dam skyes na chung mdzes ma yis/ /mgul du 'khyud nas 'o byed cing / /gnyis skyes gzhon nu mang po yis/ /rab tu mdzes pa'i mgrin pa 'khyogs/ /phan tshun zur mig g.yo bzhin du/ /gcig steng gcig zhon gar gyis rol/ /de nyid mthong bas rnal 'byor pa/ /nga yang 'dod pa rab tu skyes/ /chos dbyings na chung mdzes ma la/ /gnyis su med par 'khyud song bas/ /bde gsal mi rtog bde ba'i ros/ /lus sems gting nas myos pa byung / /da ni lha yi bu mo zhig /mthong yang 'dod pa skye mi 'gyur/ /'jig rten bu mor 521

'grogs pa de/ /'jigs shing bslu bas snying bo med/ /gtan gyi bde ba ster mdzad pa'i/ /gtan grogs 'di 'dra yod na legs/ /zhes blangs so/ /yang mi 'ga' res khyed kyis nyams shar gyi mgur zhig gsungs dang zer ba'i lan du 'di blangs so//ngas mtshan ldan bla ma bsten pa'i tshe/ /dpe sangs rgyas lta bu'i nyams shig shar/ /ngar zab rgyas gdams pa thob pa'i tshe/ /dpe bdud rtsi lta bu'i nyams shig shar/ /ngas 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsgom pa'i tshe/ /dpe btson ra 'dra ba'i nyams shig shar/ /ngas 'gro la byang sems bsgom pa'i tshe/ /dpe ma bu 'dra ba'i nyams shig shar/ /ngas stong pa nyid la mnyam bzhag tshe/ /dpe nam mkha' lta bu'i nyams shig shar/ /ngas bskyed rdzogs rdzogs chen bsgom pa'i tshe/ /dpe 'og min slebs 'dra'i nyams shig shar/ /nga dben pa'i ri la sdod pa'i tshe/ /dpe lha yul 'dra ba'i nyams shig shar/ /nga grogs med gcig pur gnas pa'i tshe/ /dpe drang srong lta bu'i nyams shig shar/ /nga rgyal khams phyogs med 'grims pa'i tshe/ /dpe pha yul lta bu'i nyams shig shar/ /nga sems can su dang 'phrad pa'i tshe/ /dpe mdza' bshes mjal 'dra'i nyams shig shar/ /zhes blangs/ de 522

nas skal ldan slob bu kun bzang gzhan phan gyis/ bsgom med chu bo rgyun gyi ting nge 'dzin gyi ngang la ji ltar gnas dgos/chu bo'i rgyun ci'i phyir zer/ de gzhan dang nor sa e yod zer ba'i lan du/grangs med rgyal ba sras bcas bgrod gcig lam/ /'khrul med phyag rdzogs gang rung khrid thob nas/ /bsgom med chu bo'i rgyun gyi ting 'dzin la/ /'bral med gnas par 'dod na 'di bzhin gyis/ /lus ni mi g.yo ngag ni mi smra zhing / /sems yang mi sdug kha yan glod la thongs/ /shes pa lhod kyis glod nas bzhag pa'i tshe/ /bsgom dang mi bsgom zhen pa kun dag nas/ /sems la bzo bcos dmigs gtad gang yang med/ /shes pa rang gsal rgya yan zang thal le/ /gnas pa de nyid phyag rdzogs lta ba yin/ /phar la blo yis bcos pa ma yin par/ /tshur la rtsa brgyud bla ma'i byen rlabs las/ /shar ba'i mkha' ltar dag pa'i lta ba de/ /rgyun 'chad med pa chu bo'i rgyun bzhin du/ /ma yengs dran pas rgyun du skyong ba la/ /bsgom med chu bo'i rgyun gyi ting 'dzin zer/ /de ngos ma zin thams cad blos btang bas/ /btang snyoms tha mal ci yin 'di yin yang / /med pa'i lung ma bstan du 'byams na nor/ /'di gnyis bsgom med 523

ngos nas khyad med kyang / /bsgom med chu bo'i rgyun gyi ting 'dzin ni//phyogs ris med par khyab gdal zang thal gnas/ /sprin med mkha' ltar gsal la yangs cha che/ /ci yin 'di yin med pa'i lung ma bstan/ /gsal cha mi snang phyogs gcig dum bur gnas/ /han ne hon ne thom me ba zhig yin/ /de dang ma nor nor sa gzhan ma mchis/ /zhes smras pas/ /kho na re/ 'o na bsgom med chu bo'i rgyun gyi ting nge 'dzin la gnas dus ci 'dra zhig dgos zer ba'i lan du/ dper na mthong rgya che ba'i ri bo nas/ /nam mkha' yangs pa'i mtha' la bltas pa ltar/ /shin tu gsal zhing dwangs la yangs khrol ler/ /gnas pa zhig dgos de yi rgyu mtshan ni/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug rje btsun tre+e lo pas/ /lta stangs nam mkha'i khams la phar bsgyur nas/ /paṇa chen nā ro pa la 'di skad gsungs/ /nam mkha'i rang bzhin gang gis gang la brten/ /rang sems phyag rgya che la brten yul med/ /bcings pa glod na grol bar the tshom med/ /ma bcos gnyug ma'i ngang du glod la zhog /sems ni nam mkha' bsam pa'i yul las 'das/ /de yi ngang la btang bzhag med par glod/ /sems la gtad med phyag rgya chen po dngos/ /de la goms pa bla med 'bras bu yin/ /de bzhin sgra bsgyur mar pa lo 524

tsā yis/ /paṇa chen nā ro me tra'i bu rgyud la/ /nam mkha' lta bu'i rnal 'byor mang zhes gsungs/ /rig 'dzin chen po shrī sirnya yis/ /sprin med nam mkha'i dkyil du sdigs mdzub bstan/ /slob dpon pad 'byung nyid la 'di skad gsungs/ /ye stong ye stong rnam stong rnam par stong / /steng 'og bar mtshams phyogs med kun shar 'di/ /shrī sirnyas don dam gnad de'i mdzod/ /lta spyod dbyer med snod rung ngang gis 'char/ /zhes gsungs rdo rje lta bu'i klong du thim/ /de bzhin kun mkhyen klong chen rab 'byams pas/ /mkha' ltar phyal yas bsgom dang mi bsgom med/ /'di ni kun bzang dgongs pa'i klong chen po/ /zhes dang bka' gdams gsung 'gros thor bu las/ /yangs sar yangs dgos lta ba yangs dgos gsungs/ /des na 'khor 'das nang du bzhag na yang / /shong bar ma zad da dung yangs khrol le/ /gnas pa lta bu'i lta ba yangs po dgos/ /zhes smras pas/ 'o na de 'dra ma yin par rang ka tham thom lta bur bsdad pas sa lam gar yang mi phyin pa yin nam zer ba'i lan du/ phyag na pad dkar 'chang dngos rgyal dbang gis/ /deng dus phyag chen zer ba'ang sems gnas tsam/ /lta ba yin gye phyag chen dngos gnas min/ /'jam dpal dbyangs dngos sa 525

skya paṇ+ḍi tas/ /zhal nas blun pos phyag rgya che bsgom pa/ /phal cher dud 'gro'i rgyu ru gda' zhes gsungs/ /de bzhin dbu rdzogs phyag gsum bla ma yis/ /ci yang dran med tham thom tshom 'jog gis/ /sa lam gar yang ma phyin lan mang du/ /gsungs pa bden par ma zad gnad 'gags zab/ /mnyam bzhag nam mkha' lta bu'i ting 'dzin la/ /gnas na skabs shig bsgom byung shes rab brdol/ /spyan dang mngon shes rdzu 'phrul dpag med 'char/ /mthar thug chos sku mngon du 'gyur mod kyang / /de nyid ma shes nor nas tham thom du/ /gnas na skabs shig sgom rgas gnyid du song / /dran brjed che zhing bying rmugs gnyid gsum 'phel/ /mthar thug shi na dud 'gror skye bar mkhyen/ /brtse bas gsungs pa yin pa ha go dgos/ /chu dang 'o ma 'dres pa 'thung ba ltar/ /'di gnyis bsres nas bsgom pa blun po'i lugs/ /so sor phye nas bsgom na mkhas par bzhed/ /ces smras pas/ 'o na mnyam bzhag ngang la gnas dus lung ma bstan gye non na ji ltar bya dgos zer ba'i lan du/dper na dri med mkha' la sgrib byed sprin/ /byung tshe rlung gis bskyod nas phyogs bcur gtor/ /nam mkha' sngon po'i rang mdog mthong ba ltar/ /ting 'dzin sgrib byed lung ma bstan 526

byung na/ /lus kyi gnad ni sngar bas drang bor bsrang / /smin ma lta stangs gzengs kyang ches cher bstod/ /shes pa rgya bskyed dpangs bstod phyal yas su/ /thongs la zhog dang dwangs snyigs so sor phyes/ /lung ma bstan de sprin bzhin rang sar dwangs/ /ting 'dzin rgyal po mkha' ltar sgrib med gsal/ /'di ni gegs sel bogs 'don mchog tu grags/ /gzhan yang rig 'dzin shrī sirnya yis/ /sems can rnams kyi sems ni dum bur gnas/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi thugs ni khyab gdal gnas/ /sems nyid nam mkha' lta bur rgya bskyed pa/ /bogs 'don man ngag yin zhes gsungs pa ltar/ /skabs rer so sor rtog pa'i shes rab kyis/ /dpyad nas sems la ngo bo ngos bzung med/ /mtha' dbus med par thag bcad rgya bskyed cing / /skabs rer sprin med dwangs pa'i nam mkha' dang / /rang sems bsres nas rgya bsgyed dpangs bstod la/ /khyab gdal klong yangs chen por phyam gyes zhog /de ltar bzhag na bying rmugs gnyid gsum gyi/ /skyon gyis mi gos lta ba bogs thon yongs/ /rang sems shog dril bzhin du slar bskums na/ /yang yang brdar sha gcod pa man ngag zab/ /mnyam bzhag nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang de la/ /kyi le me re gnas na dga' ba 527

la/ /khang ba'i phyi nang mig gnyis 'byed btsum dang / /nyin mtshan khyab par med na skyid pa la/ /chos sku mkha' ltar g.yo ba med bzhin du/ /gzugs sku 'ja' ltar shar na dga' ba la/ /sangs rgyas sa la 'gro ba kun drangs nas/ /'khor ba dong nas sprugs na skyid pa la/ /mkha' ltar yangs shing nyi ltar sgrib med gsal/ /shel ltar dwangs shing mi g.yo ri ltar brtan/ /de 'dra'i dgongs pa ldan pa thams cad la/ /phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi'o byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes smras pas kho rang gi lta ba la bogs thon rtogs pa nam mkha' dang mnyam pa byung ngo / /de nas 'od gsal lha'i gdung rgyud chos rgyal chen po lha rgya ri ba bkra shis tshe ring dpal 'bar nas/ zhabs brtan tshe bsgrub gnang dgos zhes mkho ba'i yo byad dang bcas bstsal ba'i lan du zhu yig 'di phul lo//snying bo med pa'i nor rdzas 'dzad pa mthong / /'dzad med 'phags nor bdun gye bang mdzod 'dzin/ /thabs mkhas bsdu bzhi'i 'dod 'byung nor bu bsnams/ /'khor 'bangs sde rig yongs kyi re ba skong / /lung dang rigs pa'i gnam lcags sder mo yis/ /rgol ngan gdol ba klu yi snying khrag 'byin/ /chos khrims dam pos dbyar rnga drag tu ldir/ /log spyod the'u rang 528

stong gi snying rtsa gzer/ /zab dang rgya che'i chos kyi sman mchog gis/ /'gro ba'i nyon mongs na tsha'i zug rngu sel/ /sngon med chos rgyal zhabs pad rin chen khri/ /mi 'jigs gdong lngas btegs pa'i 'dun sa der/ /dal 'byor rten thob bla ma bzang dang mjal/ /zab rgyas chos thob dben par gnas bcas kyang / /bsgom la brtson pa'i snying rus ma mchis pas/ /gsang sngags myur lam ring lam mdo ltar btang / /gzhan don lta zhog rang don ma grub pa'i/ /gnyis med bya btang tshogs drug rang grol gyis/ /kha min snying nas gus rtags lag gnyis kyang / /spyi bo'i phyogs su khyer nas zhu yig 'bul/ /mgon khyod gzugs sku rab tu bde ngos nas/ /dri med gsung shog mkho ba'i yo byad bcas/ /gnang ba rgya yang ma nyams 'byor ba'i mod/ /sems la sngon med dga' spro gsar du shar/ /phran kyang mchog gsum thugs rjes sgyu lus bde/ /'tsho bas ma phongs lus sems bde ba'i mod/ /thog mtha' gnyis su sems bskyed bsngo smon gyes/ /brgyan nas gang nus dge sbyor byed bzhin mchis/ /ngo mtshar chos rgyal khyed kyis gang gsungs pa'i/ /tshig gi me tog spyi bo'i rgyan du len/ /don gyi snying bo snying dbus bzung nas bsgrub/ /tshe yi ril bu phyi nas 529

mdun du 'bul/ /mgon khyod sngar bas da dung brgya 'gyur gyis/ /bstan dang 'gro ba'i don la brtson par rigs/ /khyad par khral dang 'u lag cher ma 'jog /rang sde dbul por bu bzhin gang byams gces/ /gdul bya 'dod lha'i re ba yongs skong ba'i/ /mgon khyod gzugs sku dpag bsam ljon pa'i shing / /bdag gzhan bsod nams ra bar yongs bsrungs pas/ /nam yang nyams pa med pa'i yid smon bya/ /zhu yig 'degs rten lha rdzas dri med bcas/ /dpal chen he ru ka dpal rol ba'i zhing / /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i do ra tsā ri tra'i/ /nyams rtogs cig char 'khrungs pa'i nags nas phul/ /zhes phul bas thugs shin tu dgyes pa byung / de nas 'gro khar nye ba'i tshe glo me khyem bdun gyi thag nye o rgyan sgrub phug nas zhag po bdun tsam la gnas 'brel bzhag skabs a ma mkha' 'gro ma'i nang la bos nas song ste tshe dbang bskur sems la phan pa'i chos bshad pas/ mo dad pa skyes nas khal 'gel ba'i mdzo bzang bo gcig ja mar mthun rkyen gang dgos byin/ kong po'i sde pa dpal rgyas nas kyang ja mar gyi mthun rkyen byung ba de rnams la brten nas cig char sgrub sde'i grub chen rnams la/ phag mo lha khang nas nyin gcig ja thug 530

btang / tshogs 'khor bskor/ chos bro brgyab pas thams cad nyams dga' snang ba spro ba byung / a ma mkha' 'gro ma mi 'gyur dpal sgon dang sde pa dpal rgyas/ cig char nor bu mkha' spyod sogs phyogs de'i dad can yon bdag rnams la 'gro khar phan pa'i mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so//rje rtsa gsum lha yi tshogs rnams kyis/ /mi 'dir 'tshogs sgo gsum byin gyis rlobs/ /sa byin ldan gnas chen tsā ri yi/ /khyed dad can yon bdag pho mo rnams/ /bya ri dwags bsad nas kha ma gso/ /dzun g.yo sgyu byas nas tshong ma byed/ /bu bsad nas mdzo mo 'bri ma bzho/ /rkus 'phrog bcom byas nas nor ma bsog /tshe 'di ru ngasdod dus sdig byas na/ /tshe phyi mar song dus sdug bsngal che/ /lus na zug med dus phyag skor gyis/ /ngag smra lce bde dus bzlas brjod mdzod/ /blo rnam rig gsal dus chos la nyon/ /pho na tshod gzhon dus sgom sgrub rem/ /nor longs spyod 'dzom dus mchod sbyin thongs/ /dbang rang la yod dus snyom chung skyongs/ /gzhon so dkar dus su chos byas na/ /rgan mgo dkar dus su blo re bde/ /nged rnal 'byor dpon slob 'khor bcas la/ /khyed yon bdag pho mo bka' drin che/ /kun gnas skabs tshe ring nad med 531

cing / /mthar sangs rgyas go 'phang 'thob par smon/ /sprang 'gro kha'i snying gtam glu dbyangs 'di/ /sus thos kyang rgyud la phan par shog /ces blangs pas kun gye sems la phan pa byung nas rjes su sdig spong dge sgrub kho na la gzhol bar gyur to/ /'gro ba'i nyin grub chen rnams nged dpon slob kyi skyel thung ngu byon pa la bde zhus smon lam gyi mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so//ngo mtshar rmad byung gi gangs rir/ /ya mtshan g.yu ral kun rgyas pa'i/ /dar seng dkar mo yi tshogs rnams/ /g.yu ral ngom bzhin du bzhugs shig /dgung sngon mthon po la 'gro ba'i/ /'dab bzang bya rgyal gyi rgod po/ /kun la mig gis rang lta bzhin/ /thag ring yul phyogs su chas 'gro /ngo mtshar rmad byung gi tsā rir/ /ya mtshan nyams rtogs kun rgyas pa'i/ /chos grogs rdo rje yi spun rnams/ /nyams rtogs ngom bzhin du bzhugs shig /rgyal khams phyogs med la 'gro ba'i/ /bya btang tshogs drug gi rang grol/ /kun la dag snang rang sbyong bzhin/ /thag ring dben gnas su chas 'gro /dam gtsang rdo rje yi spun dang / /tshe 'dir mjal ba ni yud tsam/ /phyi ma dag zhing nas mjal te/ /nam yang mi 'bral bar gyur cig /ces blangs pa'i mthar rgan pa rnams dag snang mos gus kyi ngang 532

nas bzhugs/ ras pa gzhon pa rnams kyis yar bskyal nas so sor gyes khar phan tshun brtse gdung je cher song phal cher gyi mig nas mchi ma g.yo bzhine phyag 'tshal mjal te yang yang 'phrad pa'i smon lam btab/ 'bral mi phod bzhin du so sor gyes nas song / de nas nged dpon slob rnams yar rdo mtshan du 'ong / rdo rje'i rwa bar song / gzhan su gang yang med pa byas/ bsang mchod tshogs dang gtor ma phul te gsol ba btab pa'i rjes su slob bu skal ldan la/ nga'i nyams la bltas na dpa' bo mkha' 'gro mang po phebs yod pa'i tshod red/khyod kyis 'jig rten pa'i glu shes na yang longs dang dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams thugs dgyes yong zhes bshad pas/ skal ldan gyis skad gdangs snyan pas glu mang po blangs te/ gar yang byas pas nged gnyis kyang bgad/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams kyang bzhad kyin yod mod snyam mo/ /de nas chos zam brgyud de gong mo la'i rtsa ru 'ongs nas bsdad pa'i mtshan mo tho rangs kyi rmi lam du/ nga dang skal ldan tshul khrims gsum gyis rta gcig la lto gos bkal nas khrid de/ dwags po dga' ldan rab brtan phyogs kyi la brgyab ste song bas/ la de'i bar mtshams shig na/ rgan mo lo lon 'gro mi nus par nyal nas 533

'dug pa zhig mthong bas/ ngas snying rje nas khyod yar cig longs dang smras pas/ yar mi langs par mgo btegs te gsol ras gang drag cig gnang dgos zer/ der ja mar rtsam pa rnams byin pas gon pa zhig kyang dgos zer/ gon pa zhig byen pas/ khyed rnams 'gro thub par gda'/ nga 'gro mi thub pas/ khyed rnams kyi rta de nga la gnang rgyu byung na bka' drin thugs rje che bar gda' zer bas/ snying rje nas rta yang byen pa dang / mo dga' nas yar langs te/ khyod kun la snying rje che bar 'dug zer ba de bden mi bden brtag phyir nyams sad byas pa yin/ nga la rta sogs dgos pa zhig min nga'i ngo khyed rnams kyis e shes zer/ mi shes smras pas/ nga ngo khyod kyis mi shes na/ /nga ni rdo rje phag mo yin/ /khyod la dngos grub ster du 'ongs/ /the tshom za na 'di la ltos/ /gsungs te/ skad cig de nyid la gnas 'gyur nas rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar mo zhal gnyis rtsa zhal khro mo/ de steng phag zhal nag mo can gcer bu rus pa'i rgyan dang thod pa bskams rlon gyis spras pa/phyag g.yas kyis gri gug dang / g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa/ gru mo g.yon gyi nang du kha ṭ+wāṃ ka bsnams shing gar stabs kyis 'gyeng ba zhig tu gyur pa'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pa nged 534

rnams la phog pas bde stong gi ngang la lhan lhan 'gro ba zhig byung / dngos grub 'di yin gsungs/ gos kyi sman khug 'dra ba'i snod khra khra zhig gi nang na dngul gyi ṭaṃ ka lta bu'i che chung sna tshogs brgya stong mang po 'dug pa zhig byen nas/ 'di khyer la las dang skal bar ldan pa mang po la byin dang thams cad rang rang gis dpag tshod kyis yar nam mkha' la 'phur thub pa 'ongs zhes yar nam mkha' la 'phur ba dang / ngas kyang dngos grub gnang ba de am phrag g.yon du bcug nas nam mkha' la 'phur song ba dang / skal ldan tshul khrims gnyis kyang 'phur nas yar rjes su 'ong bar gda'/ sa yi mi thams cad kyis mthong nas phyag byed par 'dug der rdo rje phag mos khyed rnams da dung ma yong / dngos grub de rnams kun la byin la/ rjes su khyed rnams 'chi dus gsol ba thobs dang /nga yang 'khor dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas te bsu ba la 'ong gsungs nas je mtho je mthor song ste mi snang bar gyur to/ /nged gsum dga' zhing spro bzhin 'phur nas/mi rnams kyis mthong sa'i ri zhig gi rtser babs pas kun dad nas mjal du 'ong zas nor mang po phul tshe/ nga'i bsam pa la/da rdo rje phag mos dngos grub byin yod/ zas nor med dus 535

gnam la gcig 'phur btang na des chog par 'dug snyam/gang phul tshad po ma blangs par phyir byen pas mi kun sngar bas kyang dad bzhin song / de nas nged gsum tshur 'ong 'gol sa zhig nas dngos grub gnang ba'i snod kyi kha phye nas bltas pas/dngul dkar gyi ṭaṃ ka lta bu'i sgor sgor che ba brgya lhag tsam/'bring bo stong tsho/ chung chung khri phrag tsam yod dam snyam pa 'dug de'i che ba rnams bzung nas 'phur na/ gang 'dod du thogs med 'gro thub par gda'/ 'bring bo de re re bzung nas 'phur na/ bar snang gi khams mi yis mi mthong ba tsam la 'phur nus par gda'/ chung chung rnams bzung nas 'phur na/thog tshad bzhi lnga re tsam gyi nam mkha' la phar 'gro tshur 'gro byed thub pa byung ba dang / nga'i sems la da phyin chad thams cad la byin nas 'phur du 'jug snyam rab tu dga' ba'i ngos nas tshur 'ong ba'i snang ba byung / phyis su bsam blo btang na/ma mkha' 'gro'i kha rlangs ma yal ba'i gsang sngags kyi gdams pa zab mo byin na/ rjes 'jug bu slob rnams kyi nang nas/yar mngon mtho lha mi'i go 'phang dang / nges legs thar ba dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang thob pa'i slob ma 'di tsam 'ongs zhes grangs lung bstan pa yin nam snyam pa 536

byung / de'i phyi nyin dga' ldan rab brtan dgon par 'ongs nas bsdad de mang ja zhig btang phyag skor 'dra byas/ de'i phyi nyin gtsang por ko gru btang nas phar khar song / klung dkar dgon nas zhag gcig bsdad 'tsho ba zhabs tog yag po byin/de'i phyi nyin gnas chen dwags la sgam por slebs/ dgon pa'i gtsug lag khang rnams la mjal te mchod 'bul byas/de'i phyi nyin ri ngos kyi sgrub sder phyin te/ shar dwags po bkra shis rnam rgyal sogs dam pa gong ma mang po bzhugs pa'i mtshams khang zhig g.yar nas/ zla ba bzhi tsam la mtshams la bsdad/ de dus char dkon po byung nas phyogs de'i sde mi ser rnams kyis char 'beb zhig dgos zer bas/ der ngas char 'beb 'dra mi shes te/ 'on kyang bla ma dkon mchog la gsol ba 'debs dang char babs yong zhes/ mtshams khang gi thag nyer shug sdong zhig gi rtsa na chu mig ne'u gsing gis brgyan pa kha lhor lta zhig yod pa'i khar song nas/sa gzhi byin rlabs byas te/spyan 'dren khrus gsol/ gtor ma brgya rtsa klu gtor rnams btang ba'i mjug tu/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi byen rlabs/ ma gyur sems can rnams kyi dge tshogs/ bdag gi lhag bsam rnam par dag pa'i sgo nas dge ba bgyis pa dang 537

ting nge 'dzin bsgoms pa'i bsod nams rnams/ char dgos pa'i dus su nam mkha'i khams la sprin gyi phung po chen por gyur nas ci 'dod kyi char chen po 'bab par gyur cig dro dgos pa'i dus su dro 'jam nyi mar gyur nas lo tog rnams la phan thogs rgya chen po 'byung bar gyur cig mi 'dod pa'i ser ba 'ong ba'i dus su bar snang khams su me dpung chen por gyur te ser ba thams cad bzhus nas 'dod pa'i char chen po 'bab par gyur cig sad rgyag pa'i dus su sprin chen por gyur te bar snang khams su 'khrigs nas sad mi 'byung bar gyur cigagazhan yang lo tog la gnod pa'i ri bong bye'u srin 'bu sogs kyi gnyen por gyur nas/ zhing la gnod pa'i rigs su gyur pa gtan nas mi 'byung bar gyur cig lo re bzhin du lo yag phun sum tshogs pa byung nas/ 'bru yis nang gi snod cha thams cad yongs su gang bar gyur cig snod du ma shong bar sgo'i phyi nang bar gsum la 'bru yi phung po zad mi shes pa spungs nas/ kun gyis rdzogs ldan gyi dus bzhin bde skyid kyi dpal la nyin mtshan khor mo yug tu spyod pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig ces pa la sogs pa'i smon lam btab/ nang du 'ongs nas mnyam bzhag nam mkha' lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin la 538

mnyam par bzhag pa'i rjes su sprin chen po'i ting nge 'dzin la bsdad pa'i mod la char chen po babs/ 'o/ yag po byung bas kun dad par gyur nas mthun rkyen kyang mang po phul lo/ /der sdod pa'i ring la/bdag gis kyang bka' brgyud kyi bla ma gong ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs bzhin/ thabs lam gtum mo dang 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po gnyis la nyams len byas pas bde stong gi rtogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung / bu chen skal ldan dang / bstan 'dzin nyi ma/ kun bzang gzhan phan gsum gyis 'khor 'das thams cad kyi rtsa ba rang sems gdod ma gshis kyi gnas lugs stong gsal 'dzin med zang thal rgya yan khyab gdal klong yangs chen po'i ngang la mnyam par 'jog pa gtso bor byas/ rjes thob skabs su mkha' khyab kyi 'gro la snying rje bsgoms pas/ nyams rtogs yon tan mang po rgyud la skyes pa byung / de nas sgrub sde'i bla ma bstan 'dzin chos dbang rin po che la dwags po bkra shis rnam rgyal gyis mdzad pa'i nā ro chos drug phyag rgya chen po/ bla sgrub 'khrul 'khor dbu ma 'dzugs tshul rdo rje chu 'thung gi gdams pa sogs lung khrid mang po zhus/ bla ma brtson 'grus chos 'bar gyi drung nas dwags po lha rje'i bka' 'bum sogs kyi lung dang / sgrub sde'i 539

khri pa rin po che'i drung nas dung mtsho ras pa'i gter chos yang tig nag po gser gyi 'bru gcig gi chos skor sngar ma thob pa 'ga' zhig zhus/ gzhan yang sgrub pa dam chos la sogs pa'i rtsa rlung 'khrul 'khor nges pa'i grub chen rnams bos nas/rlung bzung 'khrul 'khor rgyag tu bcug pas ltad mo yag po byung / sngar mi shes pa'i 'khrul 'khor rnams bslabs pas skal pa bzang po byung / yang nyin gcig bu chen skal ldan rang grol gyis gnas chen bzang po 'di la bstod pa zhig dgos zhes bskul ngor 'di skad ces smras/rje dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /lha zhi khro rab 'byams pho brang dngos/ /gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dang / /dpal chos skyong srung ma 'du ba'i zhing / /chos sgrub brgyud bstan pa dar ba'i sa/ /rje mkhas grub mang po bzhugs pa'i gnas/ /lha mi rnams bsod rnams bsags pa'i rten/ /yul rgya gar rdo rje gdan gnyis pa/ /bod gangs can khrod kyi rgyan gcig pu/ /shar gnas chen dwags la sgam po zhes/ /mtshan yongs grags ngo mtshar dpal gyi ri/ /rgyab brag ri rtse mo mkha' la bsnyegs/ /phyogs gang nas bltas kyang yid du 'ong / /kha lhor lta rtsi shing nags tshal rgyas/ /bya ri dwags 540

spu sdug mang po 'khor/ /sman nus pa can gyi rigs rnams skye/ /mdog rab mdzes me tog sna tshogs bkra /zas rang grub shing 'bras zwa tshod mod/ /ngos kun nas rdza chu bsil ma 'bab/ /sdod bde ba'i brag phug spyil bu mang / /phar bltas na nam mkha' kha zheng che/ /mdun gtsang po yon chab bzhin du 'khyil/ /zhing lo yag maṇ+ḍil bshams pa 'dra/ /yul de yi gzhi bdag chos la dkar/ /char dus babs lo phyugs rtag tu legs/ /dus dgun dus nyi 'od 'khyil bas dro/ /dbyar sos dus bsil drod khod snyoms bde/ /dus rtag tu nyams dga' rig pa dwangs/ /gnas de na chos mdzad skyes bu mang / /lha'i sku gsung thugs rten byen can bzhugs/ /mdo g.yas g.yon dad ldan yon bdag mod/ /chu me shing la sogs mthun rkyen 'dzom/ /chos dge ba'i bar chad byed mkhan med/ /nyams rtogs pa'i yon tan dbang med skye/ /gnas 'di 'dra bsten na tshe 'dir bde/ /sgom sgrub pa nus na phyi mar skyid/ /tshe 'dir bde phyi mar skyid 'dod pas/ /gnas 'di nyid bsten la sgom sgrub gyis/ /dge 'dis kyang rang gzhan la phan nas/ /chos sgrub brgyud bstan pa 'dzin par shog /ces smras pas der 'tshogs pa rnams kyang dga' ba byung / de nas 'gro 541

khar grwa tshang la mang ja btang / sgrub sde la tshogs 'khor bskor/bsngo ba dang smon lam rgya chen po byas pas bla ma bstan 'dzin chos dbang rin po ches nga'i rmi lam la/ khyed kyis rgya mtsho chen po zhig la gru btang nas pha rol tu 'gro ba zhig rmis/ khyed 'di nas gar phebs kyang longs spyod rgya chen po yong bar 'dug ste/gang la yang ma chags par mchod sbyin gyis la phebs dang /skyon gyis mi gos par gda' gsungs/ 'gro ba'i nangs par der bzhugs pa'i dam gtsang mched grogs dang / slob ma yon bdag mang po skyel thung du byung ba la phan pa'i sems kyis glu dbyangs 'di blangs so//steng spyi gtsug bde chen 'khor lo'i rgyan/ /rje rtsa ba'i bla mar gus pas 'dud/ /tshe blos btang tshogs drug rang grol ngas/ /gzhan chos la bskul phyir glu dbyangs len/ /dbyangs 'di la dam gtsang mched grogs dang / /nga'i slob bu thams cad gus pas nyon/ /dus deng sang snyigs dus sems can gyi/ /tshe thung zhing tshe la bar chad mang / /lus 'jig sla nam 'jig nges pa med/ /rang gang la bsam kyang 'chi la nye/ /lo brgya stong 'dang ba'i zas yod kyang / /rang 'chi ba'i nangs par bsgyur nas 'gro /lo brgya stong 'dang ba'i gos yod 542

kyang / /rang 'chi ba'i nangs par phud nas 'gro /gser dngul sogs brgya stong mang yod kyang / /rang 'chi ba'i nangs par lag stong 'gro /grogs mdza' bshes brgya stong mang yod kyang / /rang 'chi ba'i nangs par bral nas 'gro /don de phyir grogs mchod slob bu rnams/ /rang 'chi kha bar do phyi ma la/ /phan med pa'i mi nor zas gos sogs/ /da ma chags tshe 'di blo yis thongs/ /rje dam pa gong ma'i rnam thar bzhin/ /byams snying rje byang chub sems kyi blos/ /las mi dge spongs la tshogs bsags gyes/ /mjug bsngo ba smon lam mtshams sbyor mdzod/ /don de ltar kun gyes mdzad nus na/ /tshe 'dir yang bde la phyi mar skyid/ /yar sangs rgyas zhing nas zhing du 'gro /tshe phyi mar dag pa'i zhing khams su/ /nged dpon slob mjal ba'i rten 'brel yod/ /thugs dgyes par gyis la nyams su longs/ /glu 'di nyid mthong thos thams cad kyi/ /blo dam pa'i chos la phyogs par shog /ces blangs pa'i tshe kun gyi snang ba dam pa'i chos la 'gyur te mi phyed pa'i dad pa chen po'i sgo nas gnas 'dir yang yang phebs dgos zhes gsol ba 'debs bzhin bsdad tshe/ nged dpon slob rnams kyis kyang gnas dang bla ma mched grogs rnams la dad gus kyis phyi mig 543

bltas nas dus yang yang mjal ba'i smon lam 'debs bzhin 'ong ste bla ma blo chen pa'i nang la song nas zhag gcig bsdad chos 'brel du tshe dbang zhig zhus/ dwags po bshad sgrub gling la mjal mang ja btang mchod 'bul byas smon lam btab/ de nas dwags po hūṃ pa'i gzhi ka gong 'og gnyis la bkra shis brjod lcam sras la tshe dbang bskur/ chos bshad pas khong rnams kyis 'tsho ba zhabs tog yag po byas/ tshe dbang gi yon du mar ltang gcig dang dngul srang kha shas byen/ de nas tshur log nas e rig pa'i 'byung gnas su 'ongs/ chos rgyal chen po lha rgya ri yab sras la mjal/ phyag rten la mdzo gcig yod pa phul/ mdun nas yang zab dkon mchog spyi 'dus dang /gsang ba ye shes kyi dbang / gsang ye'i cho ga dang sems khrid yungs 'bru nam mkha' sogs kyi lung zhus/ phar la tshe dbang dang rje mi la'i rnam mgur gyi lung phul/ zab mo ri nas mtshams la bsdad/ chos rgyal ma yum la sems khrid btab/sems kyi gnas lugs ngo 'phrod pa byung / tshur la gsol ras bdag rkyen mang po gnang / phyogs de'i sde ba khang gsar/sde ba dkyil 'khor/ rtswa chang dga' g.yu khang sogs dad can yon bdag pho mo mang po la tshe dbang bskur/ de dus las 'bras kyi 544

chos bshad pas/ skye pho mo thams cad dad pa skyes/ rtswa chang dga' nas rgya dngul rdo tshad gcig de bzhin du gzhan rnams kyis gser dngul g.yu byis sogs nor rdzas mang po phul ba rnams blangs nas lha sar 'ongs pas sog po'i chos rgyal ching wang rin po che 'di dpon mo a r+pā'i mchog gi tsha bo the ji dang /phyag mdzod dar han/ a rgya bde legs la sogs pa'i sog phyogs kyi yon bdag dad can mang po slebs yod pa dang mjal/ de rnams kyis dngul rdo tshad bcu gsum tsam phul ba gser du bsgyur/ gser srang lnga bcu tham pa'i mchod kong 'dod dpal nas bzo ru bcug de'i bar la lcags po ri'i mdun ngos rgyal po srong btsan sgam po'i sgrub gnas brag lha klu phug tu zla ba gnyis tsam bsdad de/ bod kyi rgyal po de mo rin po che la zhabs brtan tshe sgrub byas/ de dus dad brtson shes rab snying rje dang ldan pa'i e yi dkyil 'khor sde ba stobs ldan gyi sras 'ong ba chos sgor zhugs nas rab tu byung ste ming skal bzang tshul khrims su btags/ khos tshe blos btang nas gser phug gangs ri dang / la phyi sogs nas tshe dang sgrub pa snyoms pas chos pa bzang bo zhig byung / mchod kong 'grub nas yon bdag nam mkha' mdzod pa dang 'grogs dpal gyi bsam yas 545

su song / jo bo byang chub chen po'i drung du gser kong mar khus bkang mar me sbar nas phul/ gzhan yang stong mchod chen mo phul/ bsam yas dge 'dun rnams la nyin khag btang 'gyed ṭaṃ ka re phul/ sprang po brgya lhag tsam la rtsam pa'i sbyin pa btang / de'i nang nas nyam thag gos med lham med 'ga' re la gos lham re byin/ mjug tu bsngo ba smon lam rgya chen po btab pas/ bsam yas chos skyong chen po thugs dgyes sku rang phebs brgyab nas mdun du bos/ grub dbang khyod kyis dpal bsam yas la sngar med pa'i gser kong gi sbyor 'jags byas pa shin tu legs/ da dung kyang zhabs tog gang thub mdzod/bdag kyang lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs nas grogs byed pa yin zhes kha btags phyi mdzod cig gnang byung bar brten/bsam yas chos rje la dang / rdzong dpon sde pa sogs bsam yas pa rnams nga la dad pa lhag par skyes nas rang rang gi nang du bos/ zas nor longs spyod 'bul mkhan mang po byung /bsam yas has po ri'i lha khang nas zhag shas bsdad nas tshogs shig gtong ba'i nyin lha 'dre mthong ba'i bu mo gcig gis bltas tshe snang srid lha srin sde brgyad phyogs phyogs nas nam mkha' la sprin bzhin du 'du ba mthong skad/ de nas 546

bsam yas mchims phu'i lte ba 'og min mkha' 'gro'i tshogs khang mjal du song / brgya mchod phul tshogs brgya btang mtshams pa rnams la mang ja btang dngul ṭaṃ re phul/ brag dmar g.ya' ma lung gi dben gnas su mjal/ mchod pa phul/mtshams pa grwa btsun rnams la mang ja btang / de nas dga' ldan du song / gser gdung rin po'i drung du brgya mchod phul/dge 'dun pa rnams la mang ja zhig btang khams tshan la spyi 'jog bzhag gser zho gnyis yod pa gser gdung dang dam can chos rgyal gnyis la phul/ 'dod gsol mang po byas smon lam rgya cher btab nas brag yer par 'ong zhag gcig bsdad de rten rnams la mjal mchod 'bul byas/ slob dpon rin po che'i sku drung nas tshogs 'khor bskor dgon par mjal mang ja zhig btang / de nas lha ldan du 'ong jo shāka rnam gnyis la mjal mar me phul nas phyag skor byas sprang po rnams la sbyin pa btang / ra lug bdun tsam gyi srog blu byas te gang du song kyang tshe ring nad med chos rnam dag yong ba'i smon lam kyang btab pa lags so//smras pa/ mngon mtho nges legs thob thabs dam pa'i chos/ /mngon sum ston mdzad nyi ma'i gnyen la 'dud/ /547

mngon par rtogs pa'i yon tan ma lus pa/ /mngon du 'gyur bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /bla ma'i rnam thar mthong ba tsam gyis kyang / /las ngan sdig sgrib thams cad dag pa'i phyir/ /tsā ri'i rong skor sgrub pa byas pa'i tshul/ /slar yang glu ru len gyis dga' bas nyon/ /spre'u'i lo la tsā ri'i rong skor du/ /'gro dus phar lam mthong thos dran reg sogs/ /'brel tshad don ldan dpal gyi bsam yas dang / /grub dbang gter ston sā la rin po che/ /'brug pa thams cad mkhyen pa rnams la mjal/ /tsā ri'i dkyil 'khor thang du slebs pa'i tshe mi sna mang po 'tshogs pas phyag mchod byed/ /la las glu blangs gar byed sgra snyan 'khrol/ /mtha' 'khob glo ba mang pos mtshon thogs nas/ /g.yag gnyis gsod pa mthong nas snying rje skyes/ /rang gzhan sems la phan pa'i mgur dbyangs blangs/ /gnas bstod gsol 'debs byed bzhin rong skor brgyab/ /shi ba'i ro dang na nas lus pa dang / /la las khur nas dka' las myong ba mthong / /rang yang dka' tshegs mang po myong bzhin song / /de dus sdig sgrib thams cad dag yod snyam/ /de nas shag chu'i kha dang yul smad du/ /slebs dus sems la dga' ba chen po byung / /chos zam thang du slebs nas gnas skor ba/ /548

thams cad bsdad nas ja bskol 'thung ba dang / /khur po bsdams nas nga yi mtha' la 'dus/ /phyag 'tshal khyed ni gang la phebs rgyu yin/ /khong tsho'i yul la phebs zhes gsol ba 'debs/ /nga ni da res yar la gangs rir 'gro /khyed rnams yul du song la lha chos gyis/ /phyin chad khyed tsho'i yul la'ang 'ong thub blta/ /smras pas thams cad sems 'phreng 'bral mi phod/ /mig nas mchi ma g.yo bzhin gyes nas song / /rang yang skyo bzhin gsang sngags chos gling 'ongs/ /skyabs mgon 'brug pa thams cad mkhyen par mjal/ /tshe dbang phyag rgya chen po'i gdams pa zhus/ /slar yang tsā ri'i cig char dben par song / /gcig pur lo gcig zla gcig sgrub pa byas/ /gnas bstod nyams mgur legs bshad mang po brtsams/ /rgyal ba sras bcas dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dgyes/ /'ja' 'od me tog char babs rol mo 'khrol/ /lta ba'i gsal 'debs dri ba dris lan byas/ /'gro la nye tshe o rgyan sgrub gnas mjal/ /mi khyim bdun pa'i a ma mkha' 'gro ma'i/ /nang du bos nas chos bshad bkra shis brjod/ /de nas mthun rkyen khyer nas phyir la 'ongs/ /grub chen rnams la ja thug tshogs 'khor bskor/ /kun kyang thugs mnyes chos bro sna tshogs gnang / /549

thams cad nyams dga' snang ba spro ba byung / /'gro khar yon bdag rnams la zhal gdams byen/ /grub chen mang pos bdag la skyel thung byas/ /bde zhus smon lam mgur blangs phyir la phebs/ /nged rnams 'ongs nas rdo rje'i rwa bar song / /gnas kyi lha la bsang dang tshogs gtor phul/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i glu dbyangs blangs/ /chos zam brgyud nas gong mo la'i rtsa ru/ /bsdad pa'i mtshan mo tho rangs rmi lam du/ /rdo rje phag mos zhal bstan dngos grub gnang / /slob ma mang po 'ong ba'i lung bstan thob/ /de nas dga' ldan rab brtan klung dkar gyi/ /dgon par mjal nas dwags la sgam por song / /dgon pa'i gtsug lag khang la mchod 'bul byas/ /phyi nyin sgrub sder song nas mtshams la bsdad/ /lo la phan pa'i char phab dad pa skyes/ /bla ma gnyis la bka' brgyud gdams pa zhus/ /yong khar slob mar phan pa'i mgur dbyangs blangs/ /tshur 'ong lo chen mchog la tshe dbang zhus/ /dwags po bshad sgrub gling la mang ja btang / /bye pa'i gzhi gar song nas tshe dbang bskur/ /'od gsal lha yi gdung rgyud chos rgyal la/ /mjal nas dbang zhus yum la sems khrid btab/ /phyogs de'i yon bdag yongs la chos 550

bshad pas/ /gser dngul rgyan gos yo byad mang po phul/ /de nas rim bzhin lha sar 'ong ba'i tshe/ /sog po'i chos rgyal yum gyi tsha bo zhig /dbus su phebs pas rgya dngul mang po phul/ /de yis gzhi byas bsam yas gser kong phul/ /de nas dga' ldan yer ba lha rir mjal/ /mchod 'bul gsol 'debs smon lam 'debs bzhin du/ /lha sar 'ongs pas 'du 'dzis yid sun te/ /thag ring ri khrod cig la 'gro 'dod byung / /mdor na tsā ri'i rong skor sgrub pa byas/ /bstan 'gror phan pa'i legs bshad mang po brtsams/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi rnam thar de ltar lags/ /rjes 'jug rnams kyang 'di bzhin skyong bar mdzod/ /glu 'di thos tshad skye bo pho mo yis/ /tshe rabs kun tu bla ma'i rnam thar bzhin/ /gnas chen rnams su sgrub la bzhol bzhin du/ /bstan 'gror phan pa'i legs bshad 'doms par shog /ces pa'ang bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o//551

gangs dkar gyi rgyal po te se seng gdong ma dkar mo sku yi gnas nas sgrub pa byas tshul/bcu gcig pa stod na grags che ba gangs dkar gyi rgyal po te se seng gdong ma dkar mo'i sku'i gnas su song nas sgrub pa byas tshul ni/ rnam g.yeng 'du 'dzi la yid sun te bdag gi bsam pa la/ rang don shor ba'i gzhan don ltar snang 'dis mthar rang gzhan gnyis ka la mi phan pa zhig yong nyen 'dug pas/ da ni tshe mjug 'di la stod kyi gangs te se lta bu'i yul thag ring zhig la song ste tshe dang sgrub pa bsnyams nas 'ja' lus 'od sku zhig e 'grub blta dgos/ gzhan ci yang dgos pa mi 'dug snyam yod pa'i dus/ stod kyi spu trengs bshad 'phel gling gi phyag mdzod dang gtong blo ldan sde pa dbang bo lha sar 'ongs pa dang 'phrad de gangs ri'i phyogs kyi lo rgyus rnams bshad pa'i tshe/ kho dang lhan du 'gro bar thag bcad pas/mkhan po lcags zam pas sde pa dbang bo la bcol gdams mdzad/ mkhan po zhi ba tshe ring dang lcam gnyis kyis nga la mkho ba'i yo byad cog pu la sogs pa byen nas/ sde pa dbang bo dang 552

'grogs te yar lam snye thang sgrol ma dang rong byams chen sogs la mjal mar me phul smon lam btab/ bkra shis lhun po ru song rten thams cad dang skyabs mgon paṇa chen rin po che dang / khong gi yongs 'dzin dang bcas par mjal/ chos 'brel dang skyabs 'jug zhus nas yar song ba'i lam du dngul srang nyi shu rtsa lnga yod pa sprang po la sbyin pa btang / sag ru slebs nas mkhan po lcags zam pa'i nye ba rdzong dpon dang / lcam dad can gnyis yod pas tshe dbang zhus ṭaṃ ka dang rtsam pa ja mar sogs gang phul ba rnams khyer nas song ba'i lam skabs rnams su mi 'ga' res gang du 'gro dris pa'i lan du gangs ri la 'gro ba yin zhes rgyu mtshan tshigs su bcad de 'di skad ces smras so//ri rab ri yi rtse mo yi//ngo mtshar rnam rgyal khang bzang la/ /sngon chad ltad mo lta ma myong / /da res ltad mo blta ru 'gro/ /mtha' yi rgya mtsho chen po yi/ /ngo mtshar yid bzhin nor bu la/ /sngon chad dgos 'dod zhu ma myong/ / /da res dgos 'dod slong du 'gro /gangs ri'i khrod na 'phyo ba yi/ /ngo mtshar dar seng dkar mo la/ /sngon chad zhon nas 'gro ma myong //da res steng la zhon du 'gro /g.yal spang mtshams na rgyu ba yi/ /ngo mtshar 'brong mo rwa sngon la/ /sngon chad 'o ma 'jo ma myong / /da res 'o ma bzho 553

ru 'gro/ /'dzam gling gangs dkar te se yi/ /ngo mtshar bde mchog pho brang la/ /sngon chad ltad mo lta ma myong //da res ltad mo blta ru 'gro /gnas chen de ru bzhugs pa yi/ /ngo mtshar dgra bcom lnga brgya la/ /sngon chad chos shig zhu ma myong / /da res chos shig zhu ru 'gro/ /gnas chen de ru 'du ba yi/ /ngo mtshar dpa' bo mkha' 'gro mar/ /sngon chad lhan cig 'grogs ma myong / /da res lhan cig 'grogs su 'gro /gnas chen de yi shar phyogs kyi/ /ngo mtshar rdzu 'phrul phug pa ru/ /sngon chad byang chub sgrub ma myong / /da res byang chub bsgrub tu 'gro /zhes sems la shar ba ltar rtse mtshar lta bur blangs pas kun dad cing gus par gyur nas/ de yin na ngo mtshar che sogs bstod bsngags kyi me tog 'thor/ yang yar song dus rang yul dang lha sa sogs shul du bskyur nas thag ring du ring du song ba'i tshe/ nyin gcig chos thams cad mi rtag par 'gyur zhing 'gyur zhing 'gro ba'i tshul la bsams nas skyo mgur 'di blangs so/ /sgyes pa'i pha yul gyi lung ba/ /dar rgud sna tshogs shig byung nas/ /sngar gyi sa na rang mi snang / /'gro ba'i kho thag ni chod song / /rgas pa'i drin can gye pha ma/ /'jig rten pha rol tu bzhud nas/ /sngar gyi sa na rang mi snang / /'phrad pa'i kho thag ni 554

chod song / /dam gtsang rdo rje yi spun grogs/ /phyi ma'i lam chen la zhugs nas/ /sngar gyi sa na rang mi snang / /'grogs pa'i kho thag ni chod song / /bka' drin gsum ldan gye bla ma/ /dag pa'i zhing khams su gshegs nas/ /sngar gyi sa na rang mi snang / /mjal ba'i kho thag ni chod song / /rnal 'byor rang gi yang sgyu lus/ /rgas pa'i mtshan ma yis non nas/ /sngar gyi sa na rang mi snang / /gzhon pa'i kho thag ni chod song / /mdor na gang la rang bsam tshe/ /thams cad mi rtag par 'gyur nas/ /sngar gyi sa na rang ma snang //tshe 'di'i kho thag ni chod song //da ni gang la rang mi chags/ /tshe 'di'i 'khri ba kun bcad nas/ /lho rgyal 'dzam gling gi lte ba/ /ri bo gangs can la chas 'gro /gangs ri'i dzu 'phrul gye phug tu/ /sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan ni mthon po/ /srid pa'i rtse mo yi bar du/ /bsgrengs pa'i sgon lam rang 'debs so/ /zhes blangs pas skyo shas dang nges 'byung cher song nas sgrub pa byed 'dod kyi blo shugs drag sgyes pa byung / gro shod kyi lam kha na sprang mo sgol ma zer ba zhig yod pa de sprang du song shul nas/mo'i nang du rkun ma mgar ba ya slong 'ga' 'dzul nas sbra chung gi ka ra yan chad khyer song ba'i shul na mo ngu zhing 'dug pa mthong bas/ snying rje nas ṭaṃ ka bcu ja mar rtsam pa'i 'phro gang 555

yod rnams byen nas/ zhabs brtan du sgol ma thon zhes bshad pas/ mo gzhung lam chen po der bsdad de/ yar 'gro mar 'gro rnams la/ stod gangs ri la bla ma grub chen sangs rgyas dngos shig byon thal zhes snyan pa bsgrags pa'i rkyen byas/ gro shod kyi 'go pa drung rtse sogs 'brog sde phyug po phal cher dad pa skyes nas mjal/ phyis cher dad de gangs ri la mjal du 'ongs nas zhabs tog yag po byas/ de nas yar ma pham g.yu mtsho'i khrus sgo lho ru song tshe/ nged rnams tsho bshad 'phel gling gi mkhan po red snyam/ dge 'dun pa rnams kyis bsu ba ser phreng tshar du dngar ba zhig byas rten 'brel yag po byung / de nas dngos po zhes pa shing pho khye'i lo nag pa zla ba'i yar tshes la spu hrengs bshad 'phel gling gi dgon par slebs/ nyi ma kha shas bsdad de mthun rkyen rnams khyer nas gangs dkar gyi rgyal po te se rdzu 'phrul phug gi zhabs rjes dkar mo'i 'og gi sgrub phug tu song ste/thog mar gnas la bstod pa'i mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so/ /chos mdo rgyud lung gis zin pa'i ri/ /rje rab 'byams rgyal ba'i pho brang dngos/ /ma mkha' 'gro zhing skyong 'du ba'i zhing / /lha drang srong rnams kyis bsten pa'i gnas/ /mtshan yongs grags gangs dkar te se de/ /gangs bzo dbyibs shel 556

dkar mchod rten 'dra/ /sngon bcom ldan 'das kyis lung bstan las/ /mtshan ri bo gangs can zhes byar gsungs//gangs shel gyi mchod rten 'dra ba de/ /lha bde mchog 'khor lo'i gzhal yas khang / /de'i mtha' ma gangs ris bskor ba de/ /khong dgra bcom mang po bzhugs pa'i gnas/ /spyir dus gsum sangs rgyas sprin ltar gtibs/ /ma mkha' 'gro chos skyong bran ltar 'du/ /gser mig la g.yu yis phra bkod bzhin/ /gnas phug pa re na sgom chen re/ /lha'i sku gzugs thub dbang zhabs rje sogs/ /ngo mtshar ba'i mjal rgyu sna tshogs dang / /rje mi la nā ro bon chung gi /ya mtshan pa'i grub rtags cir yang snang / /mtsho ma dros la ngag mtsho chen gnyis/ /dpe yon chab bshams bzhin mdun na mdzes/ /phyogs phyogs na dad can sbyin bdag mang / /chos bsgrub pa'i mthun rkyen 'dzoms pas skyid/ /bya'i rgyal po ngang ba gser mdog sogs/ /bya bye'u'i skad snyan 'byin pas spro/ /gnas khyad 'phags gangs dkar te se yi/ /shar dzu 'phrul phug gi dben gnas su/ /sprang bya btang tshogs drug rang grol ngas/ /chos bsgrub pa'i skal ba byung bas bzang / /gnas 'dir bzhugs bka' brgyud bla ma yis/ /rgyud smin cing grol bar byen gyis rlobs/ /lha yi dam rgyal ba zhi khro yis/ /mchog thun mong 557

gnyis kyi dngos grub stsol/ /ma mkha' 'gro chos skyong gzhi bdag gis/ /sprang byang chub bsgrub pa'i grogs mdzod cig /ces blangs/ de nas bug sgor 'dag sbyar byas/ sgrub pa rgyag pa'i dam bca' smon lam gyi mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so//pha mar ma gyur sems can med/ /'khor ba'i gnas na bde ba med/ /ngan song sdug bsngal bzod glags med/ /sdug bsngal de las thar dus med/ /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal bsam tsa na/ /rang dbang med par shes pa 'phyo/ /kye ma kye hud ji ltar bya/ /bshad na drag gam sgom na drag /sems can 'di yi mang lugs kyi/ /lung chung re re tshogs dpon mdzad/ /chos bshad sems can 'ga' zhig la/ /phan kyarnga 'khor ba ga la stongs/ /bsgoms nas sangs rgyas thob tsa na/ /'od zer re re spros pas kyang / /sems can dpag med 'dren par nus/ /drangs na 'khor ba cis mi stongs/ /sngon yang sangs rgyas byang sems kyis/ /stong gsum zhing 'di'i 'gro ba drug /thams cad sangs rgyas sar bkod nas/ /'khor ba dong sprugs yang yang byung / /ma 'ongs sangs rgyas mos pa'i dus/ /stong gsum 'jig rten sems can nam/ /thams cad 'khor ba dong sprugs nas/ /sangs rgyas 'gyur bar mdo las gsungs/ /da lta rang yang sgom nus na/ /sangs rgyas 558

'thob par gdon mi za/ /sangs rgyas thob na ma 'ongs dus/ /'khor ba dong nas sprugs par nus/ /bshad las sgom na drag par gda'/ /da ni rtse gcig sgom la gzhol/ /nam zhig sprul ba dpag med bkye/ /'khor ba dong nas sprugs par smon/ /zhes blangs nas mtshams bsdams smra bcad byas/ bskyed rdzogs rdzogs pa chen po'i lam bzang la rtse gcig tu gzhol ba'i tshe/skal ldan snying gi bu mchog sbyin pa nor bu sogs las dang skal bar ldan pa'i gdul bya mang po dbyar dus kyi sprin ltar du 'dus nas gser gyi maṇ+ḍal la g.yu byir gyi tshom bu bkod nas phul te/ bka' chos gnang dgos zhes gsol ba yang yang btab pa'i tshe/ da ni bdag gis rang gzhan gnyis kyi don gang byas na dga' snyam rtsa gsum lha la gsol ba btab pas/ nub gcig gi tho rangs khar ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong ba can la 'khor mkha' 'gro ma mang pos bskor ba zhig gi zhal nas/ kye rgyal ba'i sras po khyed kyi sku tshe dang sgrub pa bsnyams nas 'ja' lus bsgrub pa'ang shin tu ngo mtshar mod/'on kyang sku tshe 'dir 'gro don rgya chen po mi 'byung bar gda'/de bas khyed kyis sngon gyi thugs bskyed smon lam rgya che ba'i mthus/ gdul bya 'dul ba'i dus la bab nas phyogs phyogs na 559

gdul bya mang po'i sgo phye nas bsdad 'dug pas/ las dang skal bar ldan pa'i gdul bya rnams smin grol gyi lam la khod dang bstan 'gro'i don rgya chen po 'byung / bdag cag rnams kyang lus dang grib ma bzhin 'grogs nas grogs bya zhes mi snang bar gyur to/ /de nas bdag gi bsam pa la mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan bzhin bstan 'gro yongs la phan pa zhig byung na 'ja' lus ma grub na'ang 'gyod pa med snyam/ nyams len byed bzhin du skabs rer bug sgor chos bshad nas rang gzhan gyi don gnyis bsgrub dgos pa byung / nyin gcig phyi dro bla ma'i gdan sa pha yul sogs kyi sa cha dang bla ma pha ma mched grogs rnams dran tshe skyo mgur 'di blangs so//gang bzang rgyal khams tsho 'grims te/ /gang legs ltad mo 'dra mthong kyang / /drin can bla ma yi gdan sa/ /da dung yang yang du dran byung / /gang bzang bla ma tshor mjal tshe/ /gang 'dod dam chos 'dra gnang kyang / /chos rgyal ngag gi ni dbang bo/ /da dung yang yang du dran byung / /chos mthun grogs po tshor 'grogs nas//chos gtam ku re 'dra byas kyang / /snying grogs rdo rje yi tshe brtan/ /da dung yang yang du dran byung / /dad can yon bdag ni pho mos/ /snying nas ma ltar du byams kyang / /rgas pa'i 560

drin can gyi pha ma/ /da dung yang yang du dran byung / /drin can bla ma yi gdan sa/ /da lta mi rtag par 'gyur song / /da ni blta rgyu zhig med rung //da dung blta 'dod cig shar byung //bka' drin gsum ldan gyi chos rgyal//da lta mi rtag par gshegs song //da ni mjal rgyu zhig med rung / /da dung mjal 'dod cig shar byung / /chung 'dris chos mthun gyi grogs po/ /da lta mi rtag par 'das song //da ni 'grogs rgyu zhig med rung //da dung 'grogs 'dod cig skyes byung / /lus srog skyed mkhan gyi pha ma/ /da lta mi rtag par shi song / /da ni 'phrad rgyu zhig med rung / /da dung 'phrad 'dod cig shar byung / /drin can bla ma grogs pha ma/ /thams cad mi rtag par 'gyur ba'i//tshul de zhib tu rang bsam tshe//skyo shas tshad med cig skyes byung //rang yang mi rtag par 'chi bltas/ /skra dkar gnyer ma sogs shar song / /ring min myur du rang 'chi snyam//blo sna thung thung zhig shar byung / /da ni bya bral gye rgad po/ /kun spangs gang la rang ma chegs/ /dben pa'i dga' tshal ni nyams dgar/ /rtse gcig nyams len la 'bod ang / /zhes blangs/yang nyin gcig gangs can bod yul 'gro ba yongs kyi skyabs mgon rgyal dbang lung rtogs rgya mtsho rin po che zhing brjes song zer ba'i mi snyan pa'i gtam thos pa'i tshe skyo ba tshad 561

las 'das pa skyes nas gdungs dbyangs 'di blangs so//a ho/ byang phyogs bod la nyi ma lan cig nub//thub bstan khang chen 'degs pa'i ka ba 'gyel/ /ma rig mun pa sel ba'i sgron me gzims/ /srid zhi'i dbul ba sel ba'i nor bu stor/ /nyon mongs nad rnams 'joms pa'i sman pa grongs/ /'khor ba'i chu bo sgol ba'i mnyan pha 'das/ /'di phyi gtan gyi skyabs mgon zhing gzhan gshegs/ /chos kyi bdud rtsi myong ba'i skal ba chad/ /kye hud grog tshang kha yi rdo blangs bzhin//gangs can 'gro rnams skyabs med mgon med gyur/ /'jigs pa'i sa ru skyel mas bslus pa bzhin/ /kye ma kye hud da ni ji ltar bya/ /'khor 'das chos kun gzigs pa'i mkhyen rgya can/ /mgon khyod mi mngon dbyings nas brtse bas dgongs//bdag 'dra'i nyam thag skal dman gdul bya la/ /khyed min nam yang re sa gzhan ma mchis/ /da dung khyed la re ltos gsol ba 'debs/ /brtse chen khyed kyis yal bar mi 'dor bar/ /sngon gye thugs bskyed dam bca' ji bzhin du/ /slar yang yang sprul 'khrul med myur du byon/ /bla ma rgyal ba sras bcas byen rlabs dang / /bdag gzhan dad mos dus gsum dge ba'i mthus/ /rgyal ba'i yang sprul gsal po myur byon nas/ /gdul bya smin grol lam la 'god 562

par shog /ces blangs pas rjes nas yang nyin gcig skyabs mgon rin po cher snga sor mjal ba'i skabs kyi sku'i dbyibs gsung gi gdangs sogs yid la shar nas dbyangs 'di blangs so//gzugs sku lha las mjes shing / /zhal gsung tshangs dbyangs las snyan/ /thugs rgyud dar las 'jam pa'i/ /rgyal ba lung rtogs rgya mtsho/ /sku na phra mo yin rung / /rtag 'dzin phyi bshol mkhan rnams/ /dam pa'i chos la bskul phyir/ /dag pa'i zhing du gshegs song / /snga sor mjal ba'i skabs kyi//ngo mtshar sku yi bzhengs bzhugs/ /rab snyan gsung gi 'byon lugs/ /da lta yid la shar byung / /kye hud da nas bzung ste/ /sprul ba'i sku mchog de la/ /dngos su mjal ba phar zhog /rmi lam du yang mjal dka'/ /da ni 'khor 'das yongs la/ /bskal pa brgyad khrir btsal kyang / /de 'dra'i ngo mtshar sprul sku/ /gang gi sa nas rnyed dka'//kye hud de ltar bsam tshe/ /sprul sku nyi ma gzhon nu/ /shar ba'i dga' spro de bas//nub pa'i sdug bsngal che byung / /nam 'chi nges med ma dran//tshe 'di'i khol bo bdag la/ /mi rtag ston pa'i slob dpon/ /'di 'dra min na ci yin/ /rdo rje sku yang glo bur/ /mi rtag rnam 'gyur ston na/ /chu shing lta bu'i bdag lus//563

nam 'jig nges pa ci yod/ /de phyir tshogs drug rang grol/ /nam 'chi cha med soms la/ /da lta myur ba myur du/ /dam pa'i chos la 'bod cig /ces blangs/ nyin gcig skal ldan gyi slob ma bla ma sbyin pa nor bu sogs slob bu mang po la/ lam rim blo sbyong sogs nyams len skor gyi lung khrid 'dra byas pa'i tshe/ slob bu 'ga' res khyed phyogs phyogs su phebs dus nyams len ci 'dra mdzad ces zer ba'i lan du mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so//bya btang tshogs drug rang grol ngas/ /rang yul spangs nas gzhan yul bsnyegs/ /phyogs phyogs rgyal khams mang por song / /song dus nyams len 'di ltar byas/ /shar gyi phyogs su song ba'i tshe/ /shar phyogs rgya mo dar 'thag gis/ /dar la mnye btul byed byed bzhin/ /rang sems gyong po ci thul byas/ /lho yi phyogs su song ba'i tshe/ /lho phyogs mon pa shing bzo yis/ /shing gi ya yo srong srong bzhin/ /rang sems g.yo med drang por bsrangs/ /nub kyi phyogs su song ba'i dus/ /nub phyogs mtha' mi bur 'tshong gis/ /bur dkar ro la myong myong bzhin/ /bsgoms nas chos kyi ro mchog myang / /byang gi phyogs su song ba'i dus/ /byang phyogs hor pa sha gzan gyis/ /gang yong sgo phyugs skyong skyong bzhin/ /gang shes nyams len rgyun du bskyangs//564

dbus kyi phyogs su song ba'i dus/ /dbus phyogs sde dpon phal cher gyis/ /sdang dgra thub tshad 'dul 'dul bzhin/ /bdag 'dzin nyon mongs ci thul byas//mdor na gang du song na yang / /skyid sdug gnyis po ro bsnyams nas/ /nyams len bde sdug kun la byas/ /bu slob rnams kyang de bzhin gyis/ /zhes blangs pas kun la blo bskyed thon pa byung / yang byang thang gi 'brog pa mgon med skyabs med rnams kyi don du bsam bzhin du sku'i skye ba bzhes pa/ byang mar sprig bla ma gnas brtan nam gsang mtshan gang shar rang grol du 'bod pa khong dbyar kha zhig la gnas chen der phebs nas gangs mchod mdzad/ bdag la 'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po'i lugs kyi sems khrid dgos gsungs pas/ ngas kyang shes tshod kyis gsal 'debs gegs sel bogs 'don zhus pas/ khong gi thugs kyi sgo 'dogs thams cad chod nas rtogs pa nam mkha' dang mnyam pa byung /gser zho bdun tsam zhig phul nas zhal gdams zab mo zhig dgos zhes bskul ngor 'di skad ces smras/gzugs sku bar snang 'ja' ltar mdzes/ /zhal gsung tshangs pa'i dbyangs ltar snyan/ /thugs dgongs nam mkha'i klong ltar yangs//bla ma'i sku gsung thugs la 'dud//mtha' med 565

ma gyur 'gro ba la/ /sgrib med ye shes spyan gyis gzigs//chos sku myur du mngon gyur nas/ /gzugs sku 'byung bar byen gyis rlobs/ /rnal 'byor tshogs drug rang grol ngas/ /gnad kyi gdams ngag dbyangs su len/ /skal bzang tshe gcig lus gcig la/ /sangs rgyas 'dod rnams gus pas nyon/ /snang srid 'khor 'das chos kun gyi//rtsa ba rang sems gdod nas stong / /stong gsal 'dzin med chos kyi dbyengs/ /nam mkha' lta bur mnyam par zhog /mig gnyis 'byed btsum sgo phyi nang / /nyal langs nyin mtshan khyad par med/ /mnyam rjes snang sems thams cad 'dres/ /btang bzhag med par dus rtag tu/ /mnyam bzhag nam mkha' lta bu yi//ngang la mer re gnas tsa na/ /da lta 'chi yang 'gyod pa med/ /'chi ba 'od gsal chos skur grol/ /chos sku'i dbyings las gzugs sku 'byung / /lam la nor gyes dogs pa med/ /'on kyang de 'dra tsam zhig gis/ /da dung chog par mi 'dzin par/ /sems la brtan pa thob nas bzung / /tshe 'di'i lus kyang 'od sku ru/ /bsgyur ba'i gdams pa bsgom nus na/ /'chi med pad 'byung lta bur 'gyur/ /de phyir skal ldan snying gi bu//rang lus snang stong lha yi sku//phyi snod dag zhing gzhal yas khang / /'gro kun lha dang lha mo ru/ /gsal ba'i yi dam 566

bskyed rim dang / /rang lus lhar gsal sku'i dbus su/ /rtsa gsum 'khor lo mdī gsal/ /bum can rlung gis sbyor ba byas /rdzogs rim gzhung shing gtum mo sgoms/ /sgo gsum bya ba dgu phrug btang / /'dug stangs sgo yul rlung rig gnad/ /brten nas rdzogs chen thod rgal sgoms/ /dper na sa nas nyi ma brgyar/ /mi brgyas 'dren dgos gru bo che/ /rgya mtsho'i kha nas nyin gcig la/ /nyin brgya'i sa lam chod pa ltar/ /sems la brtan pa ma thob la/ /nyin brgyar bskyed rdzogs bsgoms pa bas sems la brtan pa thob pa'i dus/ /nyin gcig bsgoms pa de bogs che/ /bsgoms na ring por mi thogs par/ /tshe gcig lus gcig 'di nyid la/ /phung po 'ja' lus 'od skur grol//gal te brtson 'grus chung ba yis/ /tshe gcig 'jal lus ma grub kyang / /'chi khar gnad gcod sdug bsngal med/ /ngo mtshar ltas dang cho 'phrul 'byung / /bskyed rdzogs thod rgal bsgoms pa'i mthus/ /bar do longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur//grol 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /gal te bar dor ma grol na/ /mngon dga' la sogs sangs rgyas kyi//zhing khams gang 'dod gnas su bgrod//'khor bar skye ba'i dogs ma mchis/ /de phyir skal ldan snying gi bu/ /bshad pas mkhas pa ma 'dod par/ /bsgoms nas grub thob e 567

'ong ltos//myur du grub rtags ma 'dod par/ /sgom yun shi dang snyoms par mdzod/ /mar pas mi la phebs kha ru/ /mang po thob 'dod g.yeng ba'i rgyu//gnad kyi gdams ngag sems la chongs/ /gsungs ltar zhal gdams sems la zungs/ /'di ltar nyams su len pa la/ /rtsa brgyud bla mas byen gyis rlobs/ /yi dam lha yis dngos grub stsol//mkha' 'gro srung mas 'phrin las sgrubs/ /dge 'dis byang chub sgrub pa la/ /gegs dang gol sa med par shog /skal ldan snying gi slob ma rnams/ /pha bas lhag pa'i bkra shis shog /ces spras pa bzhin du nyams len gnang bas rjes su gshegs dus 'ja' 'od dang gdung ring bsrel sogs bar do longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku ru mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i rtags yang dag pa byung / bu chen sbyin pa nor bus khyed kyi sku tshe 'di'i rnam par thar pa mdor bsdus shig gsung dgos zhes bskul ngor 'di skad ces smras so// pha yul mdo khams smad nas yin//yul gyi ming la reb gong zer/ /a ma yul 'dug bu mo yin/ /ming la bkra shis brtsegs zhes zer/ /pha ni su yin ngo ma shes//bu tsha ming sring gsum tsam yod/ /nang nas che shos nga rang yin/ /ming la ngag dbang bkra shis zer/ /chung nas chos dang bla mar dad/ /lo bdun thog nas 568

yi ge shes/ /lo bcu'i thog nas bla ma bsten/ /da lta bla ma brgya tsam yod//nang nas drin can bla ma de//chos rgyal ngag gi dbang bo lags//dbu rdzogs phyag gsum gcod chos sogs//chos kyang zab mo mang po thob//nyi shu rtsa gcig thog nas bzung //tshe 'di'i bya ba blo yis btang //mdo smad dbus gtsang la sogs pa'i/ /ri khrod dben pa mang po bsten/ /byang chub sems gnyis bskyed rdzogs sogs//zab mo'i gdams pa yengs med bsgoms//bla ma rnams kyi byin rlabs kyis/ /nyon mongs dug lnga'i nad kyang sangs/ /byams dang snying rje byang sems 'byongs//chos rnams sgyu ma lta bur shes//lus la gtum mo'i bde drod 'bar/ /bde stong nyams la rgyun 'chad med//mgrin pa longs spyod rtsa kha phyes/ /rdo rje'i glu la thogs pa med//tha mal snang zhen kun dag nas//rang snang 'og min dag pa'i zhing / /dngos sam nyams dang rmi lam la/ /ngo mtshar lha zhal zhing khams mthong / /spyan dang mngon shes dzu 'phrul sogs/ /lam rtags yon tan cir yang byung / /gang la'ang zhen chags ma byas pas//gser dang sa rdo khyad mi snang //pha nga'i rnam thar de ka tsam/ /bu khyod dad pa'i gsal 'debs gyis//zhes smras pas kun dad cing gus par gyur to//de dus a mdo'i khri ga'i phyogs kyi grwa pa gnas skor ba zhig 'ongs pa slar 569

rang yul du log nas 'gro ba la/ khyod yul du slebs na yul phyogs kyi mi dad can rnams la/ nga yang ma shi tshe ring byung na pha yul mdo smad du lan cig yong rgyu red ces shod la yi ge 'di yang ston zhes springs yig 'di bskur ro//byang sems ded dpon nga bde bar/ /rin chen gling mchog tu slebs nas/ /nor bu 'tshol ba la zhugs yod/ /'dod 'byung nor bu de rnyed tshe//chu srin 'tshe ba 'dra med na//mthun pa'i rlung po dang 'grogs nas/ /sngar 'dris mdza' bshes kyi tshogs la/ /dgos 'dod skyel ba la slebs 'ongs/ /dbyed kyi pho nya nga bde bar//tsan dan nags klong du slebs nas/ /kha zas 'tshol ba la zhugs yod//lus stobs bzang po 'dra rgyas tshe/ /rgya khra'i 'tshe ba 'dra med na/ /dbyar gsum nam zla dang 'grogs nas/ /sngar 'dris bya bye'u yi tshogs la/ /skad snyan skyel ba la slebs 'ongs/ /bya btang rnal 'byor nga bde bar/ /gnas chen gangs ri la slebs nas/ /byang chub bsgrub pa la zhugs yod/ /nyams rtogs yon tan 'dra shar tshe/ /'chi bdag 'tshe ba 'dra med na/ /yid mthun grogs po dang 'grogs nas/ /sngar 'dris dad can gyi tshogs la/ /gdams ngag skyel ba la slebs 'ongs/ /dad can pho mo yi tshogs la//'tshams rtags rgyang glu ru phul lo//sems pa ma 570

skyo bar bzhugs dang //mi ring myur ba ru mjal yong //tshe 'dir ma mjal bar gyur na/ /skye ba 'di nyid kyi 'og tu/ /shar phyogs mngon dga' yi zhing du/ /thams cad mjal ba zhig bya'o/ /zhes springs pa'o/ /nyin gcig dad gtong blo gros che ba'i sgar dpon sban tsa lho pas gos tshar gyi gon pa gsar ba zhig phul ba ma blangs par phyir byin pas/ slar nan tan chen pos khyed la mi mkho ba ngas shes te/ kho bo'i tshogs rdzogs pa'i phyir de ring cig bzhes nas/ rjes sor su la gnang kyang chog ces yar phul ba lus la gyon nas mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so//bya btang tshogs drug rang grol ngas/ /phyogs med rgyal khams 'grims pa dang / /nges med dben par sdod pa'i dus/ /'khyags kyis dogs nas gos gcig bzos/ /rab mdzes snang stong lha sku yi/ /srab 'jam gos chen phyi ma byas/ /rab gsal rtsa gsum 'khor lo yi/ /spu sdug tshar bu'i nang ma sprad/ /a shad rnon po'i rgya khab la/ /haṃ yig phra mo'i skud pa brgyus/ /steng 'og rlung gis srubs kha bsdus/ /bum pa can gyis srub gnyis bsdams/ /lo zla mang po'i bar du bzos/ /bzo yang legs te 'grub nas byung / /da lta lus la gyon nas yod//rang lus gting nas dros pa byung / /lus sems gnyis ka bde bar gda'/ /bde 571

drod gtum mo'i gos bzang 'di/ /dam pa gong ma'i na bza' yin/ /gyon na yang la 'dzad rgyu med//khyed kyang 'di 'dra'i gos shig gyon/ /bzo tshul nga yi 'di bzhin gyis//gos tshar 'bul ba che na yang / /sprang po bdag la mkho ba chung / /'on kyang khyod kyi dad pa bzang / /re zhig tshogs gnyis rdzogs phyir gyon/ /dge 'dis slob ma'i tshogs rdzogs nas/ /mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i sku 'thob shog /ces blangs pas kho dga' zhing spro bzhin phebs song / re zhig nang du bzhag nas rjes su slob ma zhig la byin pas de yang gting nas dga' song / yang bla ma la dad gus che zhing / tshe blos btang nas bla ma'i bka' bzhin dben pa'i gnas su tshe dang sgrub pa snyoms pa'i rnal 'byor ma jo mo g.yu sgon gyis/ kho mo la bla ma'i bka' drin dran nas gus pa bskyed tshul gyi ngag 'don zhig dgos zhes bskul ba'i lan du/ 'o de yin na ngas rtsom mi dgos/ sdong bo bkod pa'i mdo nas gsungs pa 'di thon dang / sangs rgyas thugs rje can gyi bka'i byin rlabs kyis rgyud la phan thogs yong zhes smras pa/'di ni bdag gi dge bshes chos smra ba/ /chos kun yon tan yongs su ston byed de/ /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod lam yongs ston pa/ /yin zhes sems gcig bsams nas 'dir 572

—'ongs so/ /'di dag bskyed pas bdag gi ma lta bu//yon tan 'o ma ldud pas ma ma 'dra/ /byang chub yan lag yongs su sbyong ba yin/ /dge bshes 'di dag gnod pa rnam par bzlog /rga shi mthar byed sman pa lta bu ste//bdud rtsi'i char 'bebs lha dbang brgya byen 'dra/ /zla ba lta bur dkar po'i chos kyis rgyas/ /zhi ba'i phyogs ston nyi ma gsal ba 'dra/ /dgra dang grogs la ri bong 'dra ba ste/ /rgya mtsho bzhin du mi 'khrugs sems dang ldan/ /yongs su skyong dang mnyan pa 'dra ba zhes//de 'dra'i sems kyis nor bzang 'dir 'ongs so/ /'jig rten skyob pa'i dpa' bo lta bu ste/ /ded dpon mgon dang skyabs su gyur pa yin//'di dag bag la bde stobs mig yin zhes/ /'di 'dra'i sems kyis dge bshes bsnyen bkur byed/ /gsungs pa ltar tshigs su bcad pa de dag snyan pa'i dbyangs kyis brjod cing / de dag gi don rnams dran par byas te/ nor bzang ni rang la 'don par bsgyur ro/ /de ltar byas na bla ma rnams kyi bka' drin dran te gus pa khyad par can skye bar 'gyur ro zhes smras pa'o/ /de nas rang nyid mtshams dam po byas yod pa'i dus shig la/ dad gtong blo gros mchog mnga' slob bu sde ba dbang pos/ 'tsho ba'i yo byad mang po dang bcas te slebs byung zer ba la sna len du 573
