tshigs su bcad pa 'di bris nas phul lo//tshul khrims gos la bag yod ske rags bcings/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen nor bus gtsug na mdzes/ /thos pa'i rna rgyan legs bshad mgul rgyan 'chang / /gtong ba'i gser gyi gdu bu 'khrol ba'i tshe/ /phal ba'i rgyan la blta ba'i go skabs bcom /kun gyi yid 'phrod slob bu dbang bo khyod//gnas 'dir byon pa thos pas bdag gi yid/ /rab dga'i sa thob bzhin du rab tu spro//pha nga 'chi bdag bdud la shin tu 'jigs/ /nang du zhugs nas bug sgo tshun chad bcad//nam zhig dgra de slebs dus rang rgyal phyir/ /bla ma'i gdams ngag go khrab mtshon cha thogs/ /thos bsam sgom pas rtsal sbyong byed bzhin mchis/ /bu khyod 'khor ba'i chos la yid skyo nas/ /tshe blos btang nas 'ong ba ma lags sam/ /thugs brel chen po med na bar skabs 'dir/ /nga yis bcad rgya dam po byas yod pas/ /sang gnangs tsam la mjal na chog lags sam/ /'on kyang mar la myur du phebs dgos pa'i/ /don 'dra yod na do nub mjal bar zhu/ /zhes bskur ba'i lan du kho rang gis 'di bris nas phul byung /rmad byung rgyal ba'i mkhyen brtse nus pa'i bdag /bdag sogs 'gro ba'i skyabs mgon bla ma rje/ /rje btsun khyed kyis 'gro 574

la dam chos bshad/ /bshad sgrub rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa bka' drin che/ /bdag kyang o kyi thugs rjes rab bde zhing / /khyed zhal lan cig mjal na snyam nas 'ong / /sang nyin lo gsar tshes gcig thog tsam la/ /'dzum zhal dgyes pa'i dkyil 'khor bstan du gsol/ /skabs thog sgrub pa byed pa'i skal dman kyang / /ring min bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i skyabs 'jug zhu/ /de bar bya spyod kun slong spang blangs sogs//ji ltar bya dgos zhal gdams stsal du gsol/ /dam pa dgyes pa'i spyod pas dben pa'i stabs/ /dam pa khrel ba'i rgyu las ma mchis kyang / /dam pas rjes 'dzin snyan zhu tshigs bcad 'di/ /dam pa'i phyag rten lha rdzas bcas te phul/ /zhes pa'i lan du lugs gnyis kyi bslab bya 'di phul lo//nga yi bu mchog snying dang 'dra ba khyod/ /'di phyir phan pa'i snying gtam 'di la nyon/ /mi thub dgra dang chu la phod ma btsongs/ /khog tu mi 'ju ba yi zas ma za/ /kha dkar khog nag mi la blo ma 'dri/ /phra ma rdzun tshig che ba'i gtam ma nyan//bden dzun gang yin mi shes thag ma gcod/ /min rung nga'i 'di yin zhes mna' ma skyel//khrel dang ngo tsha med la blo ma gtod//rang la blo phugs gtad pa'i mi ma bslu//bre rgya g.yo sgyu byas nas tshong ma 575

byed/ /rkus dang 'phrog bcom sgo nas nor ma gsog /dug dang mnol btsog shor ba'i zas la 'dzem/ /'thab dang rtsod gzhi can gyi nor ma len/ /srog gcod byas nas nam yang chos ma byed//mi yi sems la gnod pa'i tshig ma smra//mi ma yin la gnod pa'i sngags ma bzla/ /mi nus pa la dka' ba'i las ma bcol mi theg bzhin du phyugs la khal ma 'gel/ /nyes pa'i rtsa ba chang dang bud med spongs/ /'go ba'i nad dang sdig pa'i phyogs la 'dzem/ /blo phugs rgan la dris na babs mi brdal/ /blo yis gros byas lad na 'gyod pa chung / /mi la na tsha byung dus sku rim gyis/ /phyugs la god kha byung na srung ma mchod/ /khyem du ltas ngan byung na bzlog pa gyis/ /shi chad byung dus ma ngu dge rtsa thongs/ /grogs la na tsha byung dus yang yang dris/ /khyim mtshes bor stor byung na 'tshol rogs gyis/ /ma nus nyam thag 'gro la snying rje skyed/ /mya ngan can gye mi la sems gso thongs/ /gtan gyi skyabs su bla ma dkon mchog sten/ /'phral rkyen sel phyir yul lha gzhi bdag brngon/ /pha ma rgas khar ma brnyas drin gzo gyes/ /bran dang g.yog por ma bsdig lto gos byen/ /grogs dang khyim mtshes ma gnod phan thogs gyis/ /khyi dang phyugs la ma rdung gso skyong rem/ /nor la ser sna ma che mchod sbyin thongs//lus ni dal bar 576

ma sdod phyag skor gyis/ /kha yang dal bar ma 'dug ma ṇi bgrongs/ /rgyun du mi la bsam pa dkar po gyis//mdor na 'chi ba soms la lha chos mdzod/ /mi dge sdig pa spongs la dge ba sgrubs/ /skyid sdug gang yang sngon gyi las su soms//bya ba ci byed chos dang bstun la gyis/ /nga ni gang du song yang bslab bya 'di/ /nga nyid bsdad dang khyad med sems la chongs/ /zhes pa'i lan du kho rang gis 'di phul byung /ji lta ji snyed mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyis/ /ma rig tshogs drug 'khrul ba rang sa ru/ /grol ba'i drin can bla ma rin po che'i/ /zhabs kyi pad+mo dri ma med drung du/ /sgo gsum gus pas phyag bcas zhu ba'i 'bras/ /rmongs pas bcings pa'i slob bu snying rul ngas/ /lha chos lta zhog mi chos bya spyod kyang / /mi shes pa la zhal gdams bka' drin che/ /sngon chad mgon gyis gang gsungs ma bsgrubs par/ /bya spyod ngan pa gang byas mthol zhing bshags/ /phyin chad bka' bzhin ci thub bsgrub pa dang / /khyad par 'khrig chang srog gcod spang bar zhu/ /da res mgon khyod zhal gyi bum bzang las/ /legs 'ongs lam gyi rim pa'i lung zhus nas/ /zhor la dag bris gang thub cig byas te/ /rang nyid grol nas gzhan la ston nus zhu/ /de yis gzhi bzung lam gyi 577

yon tan la//mnga' brnyes lus 'dir byang chub rab thob nas//khyed bzhin 'gro ba'i ded dpon mchog gcig tu/ /'gyur ba'i skyabs 'jug thugs rjes gzigs par zhu/ /zhes phul byung / de nas nang la 'ong du bcug nas rang nyid kyis brtsams pa'i byang chub lam gye rim pa'i lung khrid byas pas grogs dang bcas te rang yul du bzhud song ngo / /nyin gcig gang bcol go chod kha nyung lag pa gtsang ba'i yon tan kun ldan pa'i nye gnas blo bzang shes rab kyis/ bla ma rin po che de ring khyed kyis nye gnas bzang ngan shan 'byed kyi mgur zhig gsung bar zhu zer ba'i lan du 'di skad ces smras so//nye gnas ngan pa'i mtshan nyid ni/ /langs mi nus shing nyal la dga'/ /za grogs 'tshol zhing lkog nor gsog /rdzun dang g.yo sgyu nga rgyal che/ /gsar ba byung na khros nas sdod/ /rnying ba lus na tshig ngan smra/ /ma mgu ba la mig log byed/ /bzang bo rnams la brnyas shing smod//ya bo byung na zas nor ster/ /bla ma'i gsung la bzo bcos byed/ /gle gleng dug gsum phyogs la gtong / /yar gyi bla ma'i zhabs 'dren byed/ /mar gyi ngan slong rkang bas phul/ /bar gyi mched grogs 'khor la sdang / /nam zhig mi chos las la 'jug /nye gnas ngan pa'i mtshan nyid lags/ /578

ngan pa de 'dra ma byed ang / /nye gnas bzang po'i mtshan nyid ni/ /dgong mo nyal 'phyi nangs par snga/ /nangs nub dge sbyor gang nus byed//dal la 'khyug cing bo 'gyel med//gtsang sbra che la bza' btung zhim/ /za la mi dga' ster la mos bsam pa bzang zhing spyod lam mdzes/ /khog pa yangs shing dman la byams/ /bzhin mdangs 'dzum zhing gtam rnams 'jam/ /mchog dman 'bring gsum ngang gis skyong / /thabs mkhas 'jam pos 'khor g.yog 'dul/ /dad rdzas thams cad don ldan byed/ /bya ba gang byed bla mar 'dri/ /spyod lam chos dang bstun nas spyod/ /mtha' mjug sgrub pa byed pa 'ongs/ /nye gnas bzang po'i mtshan nyid yin/ /bzang bo 'dod na de bzhin gyis/ /zhes smras pas kho na re/ de yang bka' drin che blo bskyed cig kyang byung / da 'dir sdod ring la bla ma dus gsum sangs rgyas khyed kyi zhabs tog cig ma byung yang zhabs 'dren du ma song ba zhig dang / thugs zin ma byung kyang thugs kyis mi khrel ba zhig bya snyam kyang / bdag blo dman nyon mongs pa rags pa'i dbang gis sngar bya spyod mi mkhas pa byas shing thugs dang 'gal ba 'dra byung na bzod par bzhes/ da ni khyed kyi thugs dang mthun pa'i zhabs tog sgrub tshul gyi bslab bya kha gsal po 579

zhig dgos zer ba'i lan du/ 'o bla ma'i zhabs tog byed pa la sngar bshad ltar nye gnas ngan pa'i mtshan nyid spangs nas/ nye gnas bzang po ltar byas na de gas kyang yong mod/ 'on kyang nyin re bzhin gyi bya rgyu rnams lag len dmar khrid du ston pa la 'di ltar gyis/ nangs nub tu dge sbyor gang nus dang / nyin par gyi dus su bla ma'i thugs mi dgyes shing zhabs 'dren du 'gyur ba thams cad spongs/ thugs dgyes shing zhabs tog tu 'gyur ba rnams gyis/ gang gsungs la bcos bsgyur gyis lhad ma 'jug mched grogs rnams la nye ring med par gang phan gyis/ dman pa ngan slong byung ba rnams rang gi bu bzhin du byams pas skyongs zhes tshigs su bcad de smras pa/nye gnas blo bzang shes rab khyod/ /tho rangs snga bar yar la longs/ /gos gyon gdong dang lag pa khrus/ /skyabs sems gsol 'debs gang shes thon/ /gnas khang thab kha bye dor gyis/ /dud pa chung ba'i me chen sbor/ /rang yang bya ba'i las la brtson/ /gzhan yang las la so sor bkye//smra dgod sprid dus kha yi chu/ /snod du 'gro bas dogs zon gyis/ /bza' btung gang la'ang gtsang sbra dang / /bo 'gyel chud zos med par gyis/ /de nas kun la rim bzhin drongs/ /de rjes rang gis lto yang zo/ /580

bza' btung tshar rjes zas kyi snod/ /bye dor 'khrud dgos yod rnams khrus/ /mgron po byung na sngon nas bsus/ /gtam snyan ja yi sna len gyis/ /zhal mjal chos kyi zhu sna drongs/ /'gro na skyel zhing gtam snyan brjod//slob ma gsar ba'i gnas mal 'chos//ngo dga'i gtam gyis me tog 'thor/ /rnying ba 'gro na sun ma dbyung / /ci yod zas byen sgyel thung byas/ /kha 'jam tshig gis rdzongs pa gyis/ /kun la nye ring mi byed par//mchog dman bar gsum thams cad skyongs/ /dgong ma'i dus su nyal 'phyi gyis/ /mgron bo gang yod mal du snyol/ /las dang bya ba tshar rjes la/ /nangs par ci byed bsam blo thongs/ /'dri dgos gang yod bla mar zhus/ /gzhan la bcol na skad brda thongs/ /de rjes rang gi mal du song / /yan lag bdun pa smon lam sogs/ /dge sbyor gang nus byas rjes la/ /bde ba'i lam du gnyid log cig /nyin gcig bya ba shes gyur na//nyi ma gzhan yang de ltar lags//zhes bshad pas kho rang gis kyang de bzhin byas pas/ nye gnas byed ring la zhabs tog yag po byas/ phyis bya btang ri khrod pa bzang po zhig byung ngo / /yang bla ma la mos gus/ mched grogs la dag snang / sems can la snying rje che ba'i chos mthun gyi slob ma mtha' yas rgya mtsho la mdo sngags gnad kyi gdams pa rnams 581

bstan nas bsgoms pas/ zhi gnas dang lhag mthong / gtum mo dang 'pho ba rnams kyi nyams rtogs khyad par can rgyud la skyes pa byung / nyin gcig bka' drin gtang rag tu snam bu zhig phul nas/ sngar yang bka' drin che ba byung / da dung yang kho bo la phan pa'i zhal gdams bslab bya zhig dgos zhes zhu don tshigs su bcad nas phul ba/ston pa 'jig rten 'dir byon dus/ /lha mi'i gus pas phyag 'tshal bzhin/ /bdag kyang dpal ldan bla ma la/ /rab tu gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /bu mo dga' mo dga' stobs kyis/ /ston pa 'o mas mchod pa ltar/ /bdag kyang drin can bla ma la/ /dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod pa 'bul/ /ston pa'i drung du ma skyes dgra/ /'ongs nas sdig bshags phul ba ltar/ /bdag kyang bla ma'i spyan snga ru/ /sdig pa thams cad bshags par bgyi/ /rgyal po gsal rgyal dge ba la/ /sprang pos rjes su yi rang ltar/ /bdag kyang bla ma'i mdzad pa dang / /skye 'phags dge la rjes yi rang/ /ston par tshangs pa brgya byen gyis/ /chos 'khor bskor bar bskul ba ltar/ /bdag kyang mtshan ldan bla ma la//chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul/ /ston par ded dpon bzang po yis mya ngan mi 'dar gsol ba ltar//bdag kyang dpal ldan bla ma la/ /582

bskal brgyar bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyal po gsal rgyal tshogs bsags la/ /ston pas bsngo ba mdzad pa ltar/ /bdag kyang 'dis mtshon dge tshogs rnams/ /rang gzhan sangs rgyas 'thob phyir bsngo/ /skyabs mgon yid bzhin nor bu khyod/ /brtse ba chen pos bdag la dgongs/ /rje btsun khyed kyi snyan lam du/ /zhu ba don gzhan ma lags te/ /deng sang snyigs ma'i dus skabs 'dir/ /tshe thung nad dang bar chad mang / /gzhon pa mang po 'chi ba mthong / /do nub yin yang 'chi nyen gda'/ /mi tshe ring rung tshe yi phyed/ /don med gti mug gnyid la zad/ /phyed la bza' btung rnam g.yeng byas/ /lha chos byed pa'i long ma mchis/ /bdag gis chung nas chos ma dran/ /gzhon dus dgon pa'i dkor la chags//da lta rgas dus chos mi nus/ /lha chos byed pa 'phyis song yang / /khyim bdag dpal skyes rnam thar gyi/ /rjes su kha mig yar blta byas/ /bdag kyang 'chi khar gang nus kyi/ /dam pa'i lha chos byas na snyam/ / da ni bla ma thugs rje can/ /chos min bsam sbyor kun spangs nas/ /chos bzhin byed na ji ltar byed/ /brtse bas bslab bya bstan du gsol//deng nas byang chub ma thob bar/ /'bral ba med par rjes su zungs/ /byang chub thob kyang drin can rje/ /khyed dang 'bral ba med par 583

shog /ces phul ba'i lan du/yon tan 'byung gnas mtshan ldan bla ma sten/ /rtag tu gsol ba btab na ci bsam 'grub//rang tshugs ma thub bar du grogs dang 'grogs/ /grogs po bzang na chos sgo mtha' ru thon/ /dal 'byor mi lus thob pa da res tsam//dam pa'i lha chos byas na don ldan 'ong / /'chi nges nam 'chi cha med nor ma gsog /'jig rten mi chos spangs na lha chos 'ong / /'dod yon nyes dmigs soms la chags zhen chod/ /zhen pa nang nas log na nor mi dgos/ /yo byad gtor na nye 'brel kho thag chod/ /pha yul spangs na chags sdang ngang gis zhi/ /ri khrod bsten na dge sbyor ngang gis 'phel/ /gcig pur bsdad na rkyen ngan bar chad med/ /bsam pa bzang na ci byas chos su 'gro /phan sems yod na su dang 'khon mi srid/ /chos bzhin byas na dkon mchog thugs rjes skyong / /zhi lhag bsgoms na bdag 'dzin nyon mongs thul/ /dam tshig gtsang na mkha' 'gro'i byen rlabs 'byung / /yi dam bskyed rim bsgoms na dngos grub 'thob/ /gtum mo'i bde drod sbar na nyams rtogs skye/ /nyams rtogs ldan na snang ba dpe char 'char/ /skyid chos bor la 'tsho ba bya 'tshol gyis/ /rang la rngan bgrongs khe rgyal gzhan la byen/ /mkho ba byin la thams 584

cad 'khor du bsdus/ /snying rje chen po'i chos ston 'gro don gyis/ /de ltar byas na chos sku mngon du byas/ /gzugs sku 'gro ba'i don la 'byung bar 'gyur/ /zhes smras pa'o/ /yang bsam pa bzang zhing dad gus che ba gtong la goms pa 'i slob bu 'jigs med rgyal mtshan la gdams pa spyi dang / khyad par phyag chen sems khrid byas nas/ zla ba ngo mthong drug tsam la bsgoms pas/ spyir dam pa'i chos la nges shes dang / sgos sems la bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams khyad par can sngar yod ma myong ba skyes tshe/ 'di bla ma'i bka' drin yin snyam nyin gcig dgun dro ba'i gos dang mar bcas zhu don 'di glu ru phul lo//sku gzi mdangs rgyas shing spyan ras mdzes/ /gsung 'jam la snyan pa'i chos sgra sgog /thugs gsal stong ngang la rtag bzhugs pa'i/ /rje tshogs drug rang grol zhabs la 'dud/ /sngon bod yul gangs kyi ra ba na/ /seng dkar mo srab med 'phyo 'dra ba'i/ /rje 'gran bral mi la ras pa de/ /slar mi yi gzugs su shar ba mtshar/ /chung ma las skyes nas da lta'i bar/ /rje mi la bzhad pa'i rdo rje la/ /yid mos gus gdung bas gsol ba btab//da gsol ba btab pa thebs nas gda'//mtshan bsgyur ba tsam zhig ma gtogs pa/ /don khyad med rje btsun khyed nyid 585

la//gnas khyad 'phags gangs dkar te se nas//zhal dngos su mjal ba bskal ba bzang / /thugs brtse ba chen pos rjes su bzung / /spyir sems la phan pa'i shadams ngag dang / /sgos don dam sems kyi ngo sprod gnang / /de rang gar ma bzhag nyams su blangs//rje bla ma khyed kyi byin rlabs kyis/ /spyir rgyu 'bras chos la nges shes skyes/ /sgos spros bral sems kyi rang ngo mthong da gsal stong nyams la rgyun 'chad med/ /sngar zla drug bsgoms pa'i rtogs pa de/ /pha bla ma mnyes pa'i mchod par 'bul//dus da nas sangs rgyas ma thob bar/ /mgon khyod kyi thugs rjes gzung du gsol/ /nang rgyud ngan gyong bo 'dul ba la/ /slar da dung zhal gdams stsal tu gsol/ /dus nam zhig sgyu lus 'jig pa'i tshe/ /mgon gar bzhugs zhing der bdag drongs shig /'khor lnga sde bzang po ji bzhin du/ /bdag 'khor gye thog mar 'gyur bar shog /ces phul ba'i lan du/ chos thams cad mdor bsdu na phar phyin drug la 'dus pas da res khyod la phar phyin drug dang mthun pa'i zhal gdams shig ster zhes glu 'di blangs so//slob bu 'jigs med rgyal mtshan nyon//gzhan la smra ba rnam drug ni/ /gang yod gzhan la ster phod na//gtong phod yod ces 586

smras na chog /mi dge bcu pos ma gos na//tshul khrims yod ces smras na chog /mi 'dod rkyen ngan theg tsa na/ /bzod pa yod ces smras na chog /yengs med dge la brtson nus na/ /brtson 'grus yod ces smras na chog /nyon mongs rnam rtog mgo non na/ /bsam gtan yod ces smras na chog /bla ma'i gdams ngag go tsa na//shes rab yod ces smras na chog /slob bu 'jigs med rgyal mtshan nyon//gzhan la mi smra rnam drug ni/ /sprang por sgo rtsam mi ster bar//gtong phod che zhes ma smra zhig /dzun dang g.yo sgyu ma spangs pas/ /tshul khrims yod ces ma smra zhig /tshig ngan tsam re mi bzod par/ /bzod pa bsgoms zhes ma smra zhig /nyi shar bar du mi langs par/ /brtson 'grus che zhes ma smra zhig /ja yun tsam la'ang mi sdod par/ /ting 'dzin brtan zhes ma smra zhig /rgyu 'bras rags rim mi shes par/ /shes rab che zhes ma smra zhig /slob bu 'jigs med rgyal mtshan nyon/ /nan tan byed pa rnam drug ni/ /ser sna'i mdud pa ma grol bar/ /spyin pa 'di la nan tan mdzod/ /g.yo sgyu'i khong skran ma thon bar/ /tshul khrims 'di la nan tan mdzod//khong khro'i zug rngu ma zhi bar/ /bzod pa 'di la nan tan mdzod/ /le lo'i dgra dang ma bral bar/ /brtson 'grus 'di la nan tan mdzod/ /rnam rtog dug 'di ma zhi bar/ /587

ting 'dzin 'di la nan tan mdzod/ /mi shes mun pa ma sangs bar/ /shes rab 'di la nan tan mdzod/ /ces smras pas grwa bu slob thams cad la sngar bas blo bskyed thon pa byung ngo / /yang nyin gcig mdo rgyud man ngag gi thos pa dang ldan zhing / thos don sgrub pa la gzhol ba'i bya btang ri khrod pa slob bu bstan 'dzin rab rgyas kyis/ snam dkar zhig dang mar thud gzhan gyis bsngo 'brel du phul ba'i g.yu kha shas lha rdzas dri med bcas rab tu gus pa'i sgo nas/ bdag la dam pa gong ma'i rnam thar dang mthun pa'i bstod bsngags mang po brjod pa'i mthar tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs 'di phul lo/ /sngon 'das pa'i dus su sangs rgyas kyang / /dus snyigs ma'i sems can 'dren pa'i slad/ /slar bya btang rnal 'byor tshul 'dzin pa'i/ /rje rtsa ba'i bla ma bdag la dgongs/ /sa mdo smad phyogs su sku 'khrungs kyang / /las smon lam dbang gis gangs rir phebs/ /phyogs grub mtha' ris med mchog dman la/ /chos gang la gang 'dod dga' ston 'gyed/ /rten rab gnas med la rab gnas byas/ /yon bsngo ba med la bsngo ba mdzad/ /sdom dam tshig nyams la bslab skyor gnang / /nor zas gos med la zas gos sbyin/ /las rgyu 'bras mi shes rnam dbye 588

bstan/ /stod mnga' ris phyogs kyi gdul bya kun/ /yar mngon mtho nges legs lam la bkod/ /spyir yul phyogs 'di ru bka' drin che/ /sgos chos med dkor gzan ser gzugs bdag /blo cung zad chos la phyogs pa 'di/ /mgon khyod kyi bka' drin yin par go/ /drin 'khor bar dka' 'o drin can rje/ /dus deng nas byang chub snying po'i bar/ /mgon khyed kyis 'bral med rjes su zungs/ /sngar zab rgyas gdams pa bstsal ba la/ /slar gsal 'debs zhal gdams stsal du gsol/ /dus da nas ji srid 'tsho yi bar/ /mgon khyod mnyes 'ba' zhig bsgrub pa dang / /mgon khyod gsung thams cad bsgrub par smon/ /yid smon bzhin 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes pa'i lan du/'o bu khyod chung nas chos sgor zhugs/ /thos bsam kyang mang po byas pas skal ba bzang / da ni snyigs dus kyi tshe thung nam 'chi la nges pa med pas/ rig gnas kyi phyogs la blo ma 'brang bar kha nang du ltos la nyams len gyis/ nyams len byed tshul sngar bshad pa ltar yin/ de ltar byed pa la tshe blos btang nas gcig pur ri khrod du gnas dgos tshul rnams bshad de/ slar yang tshigs su bcad pa'i glu dbyangs 'di blangs so/ /slob bu bstan 'dzin rab rgyas khyod/ /chung nas rab byung 589

tshul khrims gtsang / /bla ma che chung mang po bsten/ /dbang lung khrid gsum thob par gda'/ /skal ba bzang ngo rigs kyi bu/ /da ni na so gzhon thog 'dir/ /chos shig snying nas mdzad 'dod na/ /tshe 'di'i bya ba blo yis thongs/ /rtag tu ri khrod dben pa sten/ /bla ma dkon mchog rin po che'i/ /thugs rje myur bas gsol ba thob/ /yi dam zhi khro'i lha tshogs kyis/ /dngos grub stsol bas bsnyen sgrub 'bungs/ /chos skyong dam can rgya mtsho rnams/ /mthu rtsal che bas 'phrin las bcol/ /sdug bsngal nyam thag sems can rnams/ /pha ma yin pas brtse bas skyongs/ /'dzad med 'phags pa'i nor bdun de/ /pha nor yin pas kun la dgos/ /zag pa med pa'i ting 'dzin zas/ /pha zas yin pas rgyun du sten/ /gtum mo'i bde drod rang 'bar 'di/ /pha gos yin pas 'bral med gyon/ /rnal 'byor pa yis 'dul rgyu'i dgra/ /nyon mongs yin pas 'bur 'joms thongs/ /chos kun rtsa ba rang sems la/ /ltad mo che bas rgyun du ltos/ /r+sha yul rgyal khams phyogs med la/ /gu yangs yod pas nyams dga' skyongs/ /de ltar byas na dal 'byor gyi/ /mi lus thob pa don ldan 'gyur/ /zhes smras pas kho rab tu dga' nas song ngo / /de nas dad can yon bdag dpal le dang /590

sman bla bstan 'dzin sogs dad can yon bdag pho mo rnams la las rgyu 'bras kyi chos 'di ltar bshad do/ /'o yon bdag rnams tshe snga ma las bzang ngan gang byas kyi 'bras bu tshe 'dir smin zhing / tshe 'dir byas pa phyi mar smin pas/ las rgyu 'bras brtsi ba gal che ste/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi bka' dri ma med pa dge sdig rnam par 'byed pa'i mdo las/ da lta byad bzhin bzang po ni bzod pa bsgoms pa las 'ongs so mi sdug pa ni zhe sdang dang khong khro las 'ongs so/ /dbul zhing phongs pa ni ser sna las 'ongs so/ /btsan zhing che ba ni sangs rgyas la gus pas phyag 'tshal ba las 'ongs so mi ma rabs tha chad ni rgyags shing dregs pa las 'ongs so/ /lus ring zhing bzang ba ni bkur ste byas pa las 'ongs so/ /lus thung ba ni chos la le lo byas pa las 'ongs so/ /blun pa ni lug las 'ongs so/ /skam la gnag pa ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku bsgribs pa las 'ongs so/ /mchu dma' ba ni ston pa'i zas la myang ba las 'ongs so/ /mig tshag pa ni me bslangs pa mi ster ba las 'ongs so/ /mun bsres nas mig gis mi mthong ba ni khra'i mig brus pa las 'ongs so/ /lkugs pa ni dam pa'i chos la skur ba btab pa las 'ongs so/ /'on pa ni chos thos rgyu mi dga' ba las 'ongs 591

so/ /so sto ba ni rkang dang rus pa bsregs pa las 'ongs so/ /sna gnyer ba ni spos mi zhim pa bsregs te sangs rgyas mchod pa las 'ongs so/ /sho re ni nya'i mchu ba phug pa las 'ongs so/ /skra ser ba ni phag gi spu btogs pa las 'ongs so/ /rna ba ral ba ni rna ba phug pa las 'ongs so/ /thang sbrul 'dra ba ni gos mi gtsang ba gyon zhing sangs rgyas la rnyog pa las 'ongs so rme nag ni sangs rgyas kyi sku gzugs khyem mam khyams su bzhag pa las 'ongs so/ /zhar ba dang gyol bo ni mkhan po dang bla ma mthong ste mi ldang ba las 'ongs so/ /sgur ba ni gos mi gtsang ba gyon zhing sangs rgyas kyi sku la rgyab kyis phyogs pa las 'ongs so/ /dpral ba 'bur ba ni sangs rgyas mthong nas phyag gus par mi 'tshal zhing lag pa dpral bar gtugs pa las 'ongs so/ /mjing ba thung ba ni btsun pa dang bla ma mthong nas mgo smad cing byol ba las 'ongs so/ /mchin pa na ba ni sems can gyi lus gtubs shing gtsags pa las 'ongs so/ /mje can ni gzhan gye nor mi 'os par blangs pa las 'ongs so/ /lud pa mang ba ni dgun mi gzhan la zas grang mo byin pa las 'ongs so/ /bu tsha med pa ni bya phrug mang po bsad pa las 'ongs so/ /bu tsha mang ba ni sems can mang po gsos pa las 'ongs so/ /592

tshe ring ba ni snying rje che ba las 'ongs so/ /tshe thung ba ni srog bcad pa las 'ongs so/ /phyug po ni sbyin pa byas pa las 'ongs so/ /rta dang shing rta bdog pa ni dkon mchod gsum la yon phul ba las 'ongs so/ /dbang bo rno ba ni slob pa la 'grus pa dang mdo sde kha ton tu byas pa las 'ongs so/ /blun po ni byol song las 'ongs so/ /bran pho dang bran mo byed pa ni bu lon ma gzhal ba las 'ongs so/ /spro thung ba ni spre'u las 'ongs so/ /yang mje can ni dkon mchog gi rten bshig pa las 'ongs so/ /yan lag ma tshang ba ni sems can gyi rkang lag bcad pa las 'ongs so/ /gdug pa ni sbrul dang sdig pa las 'ongs so/ /dbang bo drug tshang ba ni tshul khrims bsrungs pa las 'ongs so/ /dbang bo drug ma tshang ba ni tshul khrims bshig pa las 'ongs so/ /gtsang sbra chung ba ni 'phags pa ma mchod pa las 'ongs so/ /glu gar dang rol mo la dga' ba ni rol mo mkhan du skye'o/ /'dod chags che ba ni bya las 'ongs so lnga ba can ni sgog pa las 'ongs so/ /khas dman pa ni tshig rtsub mo smras pa las 'ongs so/ /mtshan ma mi ldang ba ni khyi dang phag dang rta'i 'bras bu bton pa las 'ongs so/ /lce thung ba ni btsun pa dang bla ma la kha byas pa dang / lkog tu 'phyas pa las 593

'ongs so/ /gzhan gyi chung ma la g.yem byas pas ni ngang mo dang ngur bar skye'o/ /gnyen dgu la g.yo byas pas ni bye'u mchil bar skye'o/ /mdo sde dang gtsug lag khang gi yi ge spyod cing ser snas gzhan la mi ston pa ni tshe'i dus byas nas thang gi srin bur skye'o/ /mda' gzhu thogs pa dang rta la zhon pa la dga' ba ni tshe phyi ma la 'phar ba dang spyang kir skye'o/ /skra thung ba dang mgo rgyan btags pa la dga' ba ni tshe phyi ma la srin bu mchu ring du skye'o/ /nyal zhing za ba la dga' ba ni tshe phyi ma la phag tu skye'o/ /dar tshon gyi gos la dga' ba ni bye'u khri 'ur skye'o/ /mi snyan pa bzlas shing ku re la dga' ba ni bya ne tso ru skye'o/ /phra ma byed pa la dga' ba ni tshe phyi ma la lto 'phye mgo drug par skye'o/ /ma 'ongs par ku re byed par dga' ba ni tshe phyi ma la srin bu rmongs par skye'o/ /gtam ngan skyel ba la dga' ba ni tshe phyi ma la srin byar skye'o/ /mi la gnod pa dang ngan du dga' zhing gtam la sred pa ni tshe phyi ma la war skye'o/ /mi dngangs pa la dga' ba ni tshe phyi ma la srin bu do log tu skye'o/ /tshe snga ma la shing lham gyon cing lha khang du song na tshe phyi ma la rtar skye'o/ /tshe snga ma la 'phyen bag med par btang bas ni tshe 'di la sbur bar skye'o/ /tshe snga ma la dge 'dun gyi rang 'thag dang gtun la 594

spyod pa ni/ tshe 'di la srin bu mgo rdebs su skye'o/ /sems can gyi zas la gegs byas pas ni bya shing rta mor skye'o/ /tshe snga ma la dge 'dun gye chu brkus pas ni nya dang rus sbal la sogs chu'i nang na gnas pa'i sems can du skye'o/ /tshe snga ma la dge 'dun rme bar byas pa ni gtsang sbra'i srin bur skye'o/ /dge 'dun gyi shing tog brkus pas ni mchin pa za ba'i srin bur skye'o/ /dge 'dun gyi nor brkus pas ni rang 'thag bskor ba'i bong bu dang ba glang du skye'o/ /dge 'dun gyi nor nan gyis bskyi brnya byas pas ni bya phug ron du skye'o/ /dge 'dun la spro byas pas ni glang gi gnya' bar srin bur skye'o/ /dge 'dun gye ldum sgyur zos pas ni ldum bu'i rtsa ba gang gi srin bur skye'o/ /dge 'dun gyi khri stan la 'dug pas ni srin bu mgo dmar du skye'o/ /dgu 'dun gyi nor sna tshogs la spyad pas ni srin bu phye bor skye'o/ /mgo la rus pa'i thur ma gtur nas lha khang du 'gro na bya mchu ring du skye'o/ /dkar rtsi dang dmar rtsi byugs te lha khang du 'gro na bya lcung shar skye'o/ /dar tshon gyi gos gyon te lha khang du 'gro na bye'u se rur skye'o/ /khyo shug zhag lon te lha khang du nyal na srin bu mgo sngon du skye'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten la mjug stegs 'cha' zhing 'dug pa ni rnga mor 595

skye'o/ /lham dang 'bob gyon zhing gzhal med khang du 'gro na sbal bar skye'o/ /chos nyan pa'i tshe long gtam zer na bye'u ldan dkar du skye'o/ /dge slong khrims dag pa la mi gtsang ba bskyed pa ni lcags kyi sems can dmyal bar skye'o/ /ral gri'i 'khor lo khri phrag brgya snyed du char ba lus kyi steng du 'bebs shing de'i lus gtubs par 'gyur ro zhes gsungs so/ /des na dad can yon bdag pho mo kun gyis/ tshe phyi mar sdug bsngal mi 'dod par bde skyid 'dod na sangs rgyas thugs rje can gyis gsungs pa de ltar sdig spong dge sgrub la 'bad 'tshal zhes slar yang tshigs su bcad de smras pa/drin can bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /las 'bras blang dor shes par byen gyis rlobs/ /bzod pa bsgoms pas gzugs byad mdzes pa 'ongs/ /zhe sdang khong khros mdog mi sdug pa 'ongs/ /nor la ser sna byas na dbul po 'ongs/ /sangs rgyas gus phyag 'tshal na btsan po 'ongs/ /rgyags shing dregs las ma rabs tha chad 'ongs/ /bkur ste byas na lus po ring zhing bzang / /chos la le lo byas na gzugs po thung / /tshe sngon lug tu skyes na tshe 'dir blun/ /lha sku bsgribs na bskams shing mdog nag 'ongs/ /chos ston zas la myang na mchu ba 596

dma'/ /bslangs la me ma byin na mig tshag 'ongs/ /khra yi mig brus mtshan mo gzugs mi mthong / /chos la skur ba btab na lkugs pa 'ongs/ /dam chos thos la mi dga' 'on pa 'ongs/ /rkang dang rus pa bsregs las so sto 'ongs/ /spos mi zhim pas mchod na sna gnyer 'ongs/ /nya yi mchu ba phug na kha sho 'ongs/ /phag gi spu btogs pa las skra ser 'ongs/ /rna ba phug las rna ba ral ba 'ongs/ /bla ma mthong nas ma langs zha long 'ongs/ /sangs rgyas sku la rgyab phyogs sgur po 'ongs / /bla mar mgo smad byol na mjing ba thung / /gzhan lus gtubs shing gtsags las mchin pa na/ /gzhan gyi mi 'os nor blangs mje can 'ongs/ /dgun dus zas grang byen na lud pa mang / /bya phrug mang po bsad na bu tsha med/ /sems can mang po gsos na bu tsha mang / /'gro la snying rje che na mi tshe ring / /sems can gzhan srog bcad na mi tshe thung / /sbyin pa mang po btang na phyug po 'ongs/ /yon mang phul na rta dang shing rta 'ongs/ /mdo sde kha ton byas na dbang bo rno/ /byol song las ni tshe 'dir blun pa 'ongs/ /bu lon ma gzhal bran pho bran mor sgye/ /spre'u las ni tshe 'dir spro thung 'ongs/ /dkon mchog rten gsum bshig na mdze nad 'ongs/ /rkang lag bcad na yan lag ma 597

tshang 'ongs/ /sbrul dang sdig pa las ni gdug pa 'ongs/ /tshul khrims bsrungs las dbang po tshang ba 'ongs/ /tshul khrims bshig las dbang po ma tshang 'ongs/ /'phags pa ma mchod gtsang sbra chung ba 'ongs/ /glu gar rol mo la dga' de 'dra 'ongs/ /tshe sngon bya ru gyur na 'dod chags che/ /sgog pa zos na lba ba can du skye/ /tshig rtsub smras na khas dman mi ru skye/ /'bras bu bton na mtshan ma ldang mi 'gyur/ /bla mar lkog tu 'phyas na lce thung 'ongs/ /gzhan gyi chung mar spyad na ngang bar skye/ /gnyen la g.yo byas bye'u mchil bar skye/ /chos kyi ser snas thang gi srin bur skye/ /mda' gzhu zhon par dga' na spyang kir skye/ /mgo rgyan la dga' srin bu mchu ring skye/ /za zhing nyal la dga' na phag tu skye/ /gos la dga' na bye'u khri 'ur skye/ /mi snyan ku rer dga' na ne tsor skye/ /phra mar dga' na lto 'phye mgo drug skye/ /ku rer dga' ba srin bu rmongs par skye/ /gtam ngan skyel la dga' na 'ug par skye/ /gnod ngan gtam la dga' na wa mor skye/ /dngangs la dga' na srin bu do log skye/ /bag med 'phyen mang btang na sbur bar skye/ /rang 'thag gtun spyad srin bu mgo rdebs skye/ /zas la gegs byas bya shing rta mor skye/ /chu brkus nya sogs chu yi nang du skye/ /dge 'dun 598

rme byas gtsang sbra'i srin bur skye/ /shis tog brkus pas mchin za srin bur skye/ /nor brkus rang 'thag bskor ba'i bong bur skye/ /nan gyis bskyi brnya byas pas phug ron skye/ /mchod rten kha ru bsdad na rnga mor skye/ /lham gyon lha khang phyin na sbal bar skye/ /chos nyan dus su gtam lab bye 'ur skye/ /mdor na ci 'dra ba yi las byas kyang / /'bras bu de 'dra smin pa sangs rgyas gsungs/ /sangs rgyas gsung la nam yang bslu ba med/ /tshad mar bzung nas blang dor byed pa gces/ /dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che/ /las 'bras blang dor nus par byen gyis rlobs/ /zhes tshig bton nas don bsam na las 'bras la brtsi 'jog che bar 'gyur ro zhes smras so/ /yang rang nyid la gangs ri nas tshe blos btang gi slob ma rnams kyi thog mar byung ba rang bzhin gyis shes rgyud 'jam zhing g.yo sgyu chung ba/ dad gtong shes rab snying rje che ba'i skal ldan slob bu sbyin pa nor bus mjal ma thag nas mi phyed pa'i dad pa skyes/ de la lam thun mong ma yin pa'i sngags kyi bskyed rdzogs gnad kyi gdams pa rnams bstan nas bsgoms pas nyams rtogs khyad par can skyes te/ mtshams grol nas nyin gcig tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po bskor/ bdag la rtsam pa dang mar sogs mkho ba'i yo 599

byad kyi bka' drin gtang rag phul nas/ nang du nyams rtogs skyes tshul gyi rim pa tshigs su bcad de 'di ltar phul lo/ /sangs rgyas kun dngos bla ma rin po che'i/ /snyan gyi dbang po'i drung du 'di skad zhu/ /rje btsun khyed kyi bka' drin thugs rje yis/ /sgom kyang shes te sgom pa'i skal ba'ang byung/ /skye 'chi 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal bsgoms tsa na/ /'khor bar zhen log nges 'byung drag po byung / /byams dang snying rje byang sems bsgoms pa'i tshe/ /bdag pas gzhan gces bsam pa yang yang byung / /zhi gnas bsgoms tshe rnam rtog rgyun chad nas/ /dmigs rten steng du lhan ne gnas pa byung / /de tshe lus kyang 'bol le shig ge ba/ /sems la bde gsal mi rtog nyams myong byung / /zhi gnas ngang las so sor rtog pa yis/ /brtags shing dpyad nas lhag mthong sbar ba'i tshe/ /'khor 'das chos kun rnam pa cir yang snang/ /ngo bo gdod nas stong pa nyid du go/ /de yang rang gi sems kyi rtog pa yis/ /phar la btags pa tsam du blo thag chod/ /sems kyi rang bzhin skye 'gag gnas gsum dang / /bral ba'i dngos med stong pa nyid du shes/ /shes mkhan la yang dpyad pas stong bar song / /stong sang ngang der mnyam par bzhag tsa na/ /ngo bo stong kyang rnam pa gsal sang nge / /gsal stong brjod 600

du med pa'i nyams shig shar/ /ma dag snang ba stong pa nyid du sbyangs/ /stong pa'i ngang las 'byung bzhi rim brtsegs steng / /rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor bsgoms tsa na/ /gsalasnang nga rgyal brtan po yang yang byung / /rdzogs rim rmang rdo gtum mo bsgoms tsa na/ /zhag po bcu nas bde drod rang 'bar byung / /ras rkyang gyon rgyu med pa ma gtogs pa'i/ /yod na ras rkyang thub pa'i gdeng tshad rnyed/ /'on kyang drod kyi tshod kyi bde ba cher/ /mi 'dug bde chen 'bar ba'i gdams pa dang / /bde chen 'bar tshe bde stong dbyer med du/ /sbyor ba'i gnad kyi gdams pa bstan du gsol/ /zhes phul ba'i lan du/ bde ba 'bar phyir zas kyang bcud can bsten na bzang tshul dang / spyi bo'i haṃ las byang sems ches cher byung nas rtsa khams dang lus kun 'o brgyal bzhin khengs te/ bde ba mi bzod pa skye ba'i dmigs rim bstan nas bsgoms pas bde ba chen po rgyas/byang sems gsang gnas su babs pa 'dren pa dang dgram pa'i gnad bstan pas/ yungs 'bru tsam phyir ma shor bar byas te byang sems gyen du drangs 'grem thub pa byung tshe sngar bas bde ba ches cher 'bar nas lus kun bde ba chen pos khyab pa byung /bde ba'i ngang nas sngar gtan la phab pa'i gnas lugs lta 601

ba'i nyams myong gi steng du 'jog tu bcug pas/ bde stong dbyer med kyi nyams rtogs khyad par can rgyud la skyes/ phyis ting nge 'dzin gyi zas kyis 'tsho ba byung ste/ zhag po mang po'i bar du bza' btung gang yang ma byas kyang ltogs skom gyi snang ba mi 'byung zhing lus kyi bkrag mdangs kyang bzang snyam pa byung ngo / /yang dad gtong blo gros che ba'i slob bu sgar dpon sban tsa lho pa tshe dbang stobs rgyas 'khor bcas 'ong ba la dbang lung khrid gsum mang po byas pas/ kho rang yang mi phyed pa'i dad pa sngar bas che ba byung nas/ rta dang rgyan gos gser dngul mang po dang / rtsam 'bras do bo bco lnga sogs nor sna mang po phul te/ skyabs 'jug rgyas par zhus pa'i mthar tshigs bcad rtsom pa 'di yang bris nas phul byung / rje mi bskyod kyi ngo bo thugs rje can/ /pha bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /sprang bdag gi skyid sdug khyed rang mkhyen/ /dus rgyun 'chad med par byin gyis rlobs/ /rten dal 'byor mi lus rin chen thob/ /rje bla ma sangs rgyas dngos dang mjal/ /chos zab mo'i mthar thug gsang sngags thob/ /'di rnyed pa kun gyi do zla min/ /rje bka' drin che'o thugs rje can/ /drin lan du sgrub pa'i zhabs tog 'bul/ /sprang tshe dang sgrub pa snyoms pa 602

dang / /don rgyud kyi rtogs pa bskyed du gsol/ /gnas ri khrod dgon pa bzung lags kyang / /rgyud chos dang ma 'dres tha mal lus/ /de gang gis lan na le los lan/ /sprang le lo bzlog par byin gyis rlobs/ /chos zab mo thos kyang nyams len med/ /chos byed blo'i ngang la mi tshe gron/ /de gang gis lan na rtag 'dzin lan/ /sprang 'chi ba dran par byin gyis rlobs/ /lus chos par byas nas sdig la rem/ /ming bya btang btags kyang lto rgyab 'tshol/ /de gang gis lan na zhen pas lan/ /tshe blo yis thongs par byin gyis rlobs/ /phyi tshul 'chos gzhan sems 'phrog mkhas kyang/ /rkyen re res tha mal ngos rtags ston/ /de rang rgyud chos dang ma 'dres lan/ /rgyud chos dang 'dres par byen gyis rlobs/ /nang bsam ngan rang rgyud ma thul bas/ /tshig phra mo res kyang chags sdang 'phel/ /de gang gis lan na nyon mongs lan/ /sprang nyon mongs thul bar byin gyes rlobs/ /tshe sdig par bskyal yang 'gyod sems med/ /las ngan pa'i bya bas zin med brel/ /de rgyu 'bras nges shes ma skyes lan/ /sprang las 'bras dran par byin gyis rlobs/ /gnas 'khor ba sdug bsngal rgya mtsho la/ /sems mngon zhen thag pa chod dus med/ /de sdug bden snying nas ma bsam lan/ /sprang sdug bden dran par byin 603

gyis rlobs/ /chos byed blo byas kyang gnad ma song / /tshe thog med dus nas 'khor bar 'khyams/ /de gang gis lan na kun 'byung lan/ /sprang kun 'byung 'gog par byen gyis rlobs/ /sems 'khor ba 'di la zhen zhen nas/ /tshe gtan gyi 'dun ma log nas nyes/ /de nges 'byus rgyud la ma skyes lan/ /sprang nges 'byung skye bar byen gyis rlobs/ /drin che ba'i pha mar nye ring che/ /rgyud chags sdang 'phel nas las ngan gsog /de byang sems rgyud la ma skyes lan/ /sprang byang sems 'byongs par byen gyis rlobs/ /'dus byas kyi dge la 'bad 'bad kyang / /gnas 'khor ba'i sa bon stongs dus med/ /de yang dag lta ba ma rtogs lan/ /sprang gnas lugs rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /pha bla ma'i sku yi byen gyis rlobs/ /lus sgyu lus lha ru 'grub pa dang / /pha bla ma'i gsung gi byen gyis rlobs/ /ngag rdo rje'i bzlas par 'char bar shog /pha bla ma'i thugs kyi byin gyis rlobs/ /sems gnyug ma'i rang zhal mthong ba dang / /pha'i sku gsung thugs kyi byin gyis rlobs/ /don thugs yid gcig tu 'dres par shog /rang don du chos sku'i btsan sa zin/ /gzhan don du gzugs sku'i sa bon thebs/ /thugs rje dang 'phrin las klong brdol nas/ /ma 'gro ba'i don chen 'grub par shog/ byin 604

rlabs kyi tshan kha gzhan las lhag /grub gnyis dngos grub kyi gter kha phye/ /thugs rje la rgyun chad phyogs ris med/ /'khor ba 'di dong sprugs nus par shog /mi nga rang ngan te bla ma bzang / /zhing dam pa bla ma'i byen rlabs dang / /las rgyu 'bras mi bslu bden stobs kyis/ /sprang bsam don myur du 'grub par shog /ces phul bas bdag gis kyang bsngo ba smon lam byas mthar rang yul du phebs song ngo / /yang nyin gcig slob bu 'jigs med rgyal mtshan na re/ sngon goms bag chags ngan pa'i dbang gis kho bo la zhe sdang 'di shas che bar 'dug pas ci drag zer ba'i lan du/ de la bzod pa bsgom pa las gal che ba gzhan med/ de yang ma 'ongs tshe lo bcu pa nad mtshon mu ge'i bskal pa'i dus su rgyal ba byams pa'i sprul ba ngur sprig gi na bza' can zhig byon pa na/ tshe lo bcu pa de dag ngo mtshar du gyur te/ rgyal ba byams pa byon lags sam/ /chos gos tshon can gang las byung / /sku gzugs mdzes pa ci las byung / /zhes gsol bas ngas ni bzod pa bsgoms pas so/ /khyed rnams kyang 'thab rtsod spongs la/ bzod pa sgoms shig gsungs pas/ tshe lo bcu pa de dag gis byams pa'i sprul pa de'i gsung ltar byas pas/ rim gyis tshe lo nyi shu ba la sogs par gyur/ de nas tshe lo 605

yar 'phel te/ brgyad khri pa'i tshe rgyal ba byams pa dngos su phebs nas chos 'khor bskor bar gsungs/ des na bzod pa bsgoms pas gzugs mjes shing tshe ring ba la sogs phan yon che bas ci thu ba tu bsgom dgos te/ slob dpon zhi ba lha'i zhal nas/ zhe sdang 'dra ba'i sdig pa med/ /bzod pa 'dra ba'i dka' thub med/ /de phyir bzod la nan tan du/ /sna tshogs tshul gyis goms par bya/ /gsungs pa ltar bzod pa bsgom pa la nan tan gyis zhes 'di skad smras/drin can rtsa ba'i bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag gi zhe sdang zhi bar byerga gyis rlobs/ /zhe sdang lan cig tsam zhig skyes na yang / /bskal pa stong du bsags pa'i dge rtsa 'joms/ /tshe 'dir kun gyis sdang zhing yid mi 'ong / /shi na dmyal ba ma gtogs 'gro sa med/ /khro med bzod pa bsgoms na tshe 'dir yang / /lha mis byams shing ngang gis 'du ba dang / /phyi mar gang du skyes kyang gzugs byad mdzes/ /mthar thug mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i sku 'thob 'gyur/ /de phyir zhe sdang 'dra ba'i dgra zhig med/ /skyes tshe dgra ru bltas nas 'bur 'joms kyis/ /bzod pa'i rten la dgra las lhag pa med/ /dge ba'i bshes su bltas nas bzod pa sgoms/ /dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po 606

che/ /khro med bzod pa bsgom par byin gyis rlobs/ /bdag gis dus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba rnams/ /bzod pa'i phar phyin rdzogs pa'i rgyu ru bsngo/ /deng nas bzung ste bzod pa'i go cha la/ /brten nas zhe sdang dgra las rgyal gyur cig /ces zhe sdang nam skyes pa'i dus su tshig 'di ngag tu thon don yid la soms dang zhe sdang rang sar zhi bar 'gyur ro zhes gdams so/ /yang mched grogs bu slob lnga bcu tsam gyis mtshams mdzad pa'i dus su 'di skad smras/tshe thung nam 'chi nges pa med/ /do nub yin yang 'chi nyen yod/ /smra ba mang po sdig pa'i rgyu/ /bsam blo mang po bdud kyi las/ /'gro 'dug mang po dge sbyor sad/ /'dug sa gnon pa man ngag yin/ /mtshams bsdams smra bcad nus gyur na/ /bar chad med cing dngos grub myur/ /sngon 'gro gtong ba rnams kyis kyang / /nyin mtshan med par rem la thongs/ /ting 'dzin sgom pa'i sgom chen rnams/ /sgo gsum g.yo ba med par sgoms/ /thabs lam gtum mo'i rnal 'byor kun/ /brtson 'grus bskyed la bde drod sbor/ /tha na ma ṇi 'don mkhan kyang / /phyi la ma thon nang nas bgrongs/ /chos phyir ltogs nas shi yang bzod/ /phyi mar skyid pas sdug bsran skyed/ /mdor na bsam blo ma mang 607

bar/ /kun gyis nyams len hur thag gyis/ /zhes dge bskul btang bas/ thams cad kyis brtson pa cher bskyed nas la las lo re dang / la las lo gnyis tsam gyi bar du nyams su blangs pas/ sngon 'gro gtong mkhan rnams kyi sdig sgrib dag pa'i rtags rmi lam du byung ba dang / kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems sbyong ba rnams kyi rgyud la byams snying rje gzhan phan byang chub kyi sems skyes pa dang / don dam byang chub kyi sems sbyong ba rnams la sems kyi gnas lugs stong gsal 'dzin med spros bral nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang la brtan pa thob pa dang / 'pho ba sbyong mkhan rnams kyi spyi bo za ba dang skrangs pa dang / chu ser brdol ba mang po byung / rlung sgom pa rnams kyi lus la gtum mo'i bde drod 'bar bde stong gi rtogs pa khyad par can 'khrungs/ gcod la nyams len byed mkhan rnams la lhongs tshad tshar tshad chod tshad dngos nyams rmi lam ci rigs pa byung / 'phags pa thugs rje chen po la gsol ba btab nas ma ṇi 'don mkhan rnams kyi rgyud la'ang 'phags pa'i byin rlabs zhugs nas bdag 'dzin nyon mongs je chung du song /nges 'byung byang sems yang dag pa'i lta ba sogs nyams rtogs khyad par can skyes pa byung / yang rnam dkar dge ba la 608

brtson pa'i tshe blos btang gi ri khrod pa dkon mchog chos ldan dang / blo kha chos la phyogs pa'i bon po rgyal ba lhun grub gnyis kyis/ bdag cag sngon gyi bag chags ngan goms kyi dbang du song nas/ rgyud gyong po 'di thul ba'i dus mi gda' bas/ 'di la mnye btul byed tshul gyi bslab bya zhig dgos zhes zhu don tshigs su bcad nas phul ba/sku ni mtshan dpe'i gzi brjid che/ /gsung ni 'gags med tshangs pa'i dbyangs/ /thugs ni gsal stong mkhyen brtse'i gter/ /rje sangs rgyas lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa/ /'khor 'das nyi zla gza' skar rnams/ /gsal stong thugs kyi mkha' dbyings su/ /so sor ma 'dres sa ler gsal/ /rje nam mkha' lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa/ /'gro ba chos kyis dbul ba yis/ /dad cing gus pas gsol btab na/ /gang 'dod chos kyi dgos 'dod stsol/ /rje nor bu lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa/ /legs nyes blang dor gsal bar ston/ /lto gos chos gsum phangs med ster/ /byams dang ba rtse bas rgyun du skyong / /rje pha ma lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa/ /bdag cag chos kyi sgor zhugs kyang / /sngon goms bag chags ngan drags pas/ /skyid 'dod tshe 'di'i dbang du song / /lha chos 'ong ba dka' mor gda'/ /lto 609

'grangs nyi mas dros pa'i tshe/ /mig spu zim zim lha sgom zhing / /mchu ba leb leb sngags bgrang dus/ /chos pa'i bzo lta yod na yang / /ltogs 'khyags ngal dul dgra 'dre sogs/ /mi 'dod rkyen ngan phra mo re/ /mi bzod chos pa'i bzo lta shor/ /mi ngan rang mtshang rang gis ston/ /kha zhim zas dang 'jam pa'i gos//dga' bas lha chos zhor la lus /bla mas bka' chos gnang ba yis/ /mi chog gsol ras gnang du re/ /grogs la bza' btung tsam byen kyang / /de la kha lan 'ong du re/ /dben par bsdad kyang nam zhig dus/ /gzhan gyis bza' btung ster du re/ /chos de skyid skyid 'dra na byed/ /sdug sdug 'dra na bshol snying 'dod/ /de dang de 'dra'i chos min gye/ /bsam sbyor ngan pa gang yod tshor/ /da ni rang rgyud ko skam 'di/ /bla ma'i gdams ngag chu la sbangs/ /thabs shes gnyis kyi lag pas mnye/ /mnye tshul da dung bstan du gsol/ /bdag cag deng nas tshe rabs kun/ /khyed dang nam yang mi 'bral zhing / /gsung gi bdud rtsi rab myang nas/ /rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub par shog /ces phul ba'i lan du/nyon dang skal ldan slob bu gnyis/ /mi lus thob kyang 610

'jig par sla/ /'chi bdag glo bur thog tu 'ong / /bar dor 'khyams na 'jigs pa che/ /ngan song sdug bsngal ya re nga / /mtho ris na yang bde ba med/ /gtan bde byang chub bsgrub re ran/ /bsgrub na bsam sbyor 'di kun spongs/ /mtho ris thar ba'i lam ston pa'i/ /mtshan ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma yi/ /yon tan mi rtogs skyon la rtog /dang po yin na 'di ltar gda'/ /da lta 'di lta bya zhes zer/ /lkog nas bla mar ngan smra byed/ /bla ma'i bka' bkyon mi theg par/ /slar yang bla mar ngan shags gtong / /bla ma las kyang rang la gces/ /yid la tshe 'di'i bsam blo 'char/ /tshong dang g.yo sgyus zas nor 'tshol/ /log 'tsho'i sdig zas dkor la rngams/ /ri khrod dben par gnas na yang / /nyams len ma byas rnam g.yeng byas/ /nyams rtogs ma skyes 'dod sred skyes/ /rang nyid gzhan gyes chos par mthong / /rnyed bkur byung na ci ma rung / /snyam pa'i ngang du ri la bsdad/ /lo gsum gtong bar khas blangs kyang / /nyin re'i nyi ma chod dus med/ /ma tshugs brgyags phyer khag bzhag nas/ /grong du babs nas chags sdang byed/ /chos shig snying nas mdzad 'dod na/ /de 'dra nam yang ma byed cig /e ma mi lus thob dus 'dir/ /bla ma bsam sbyor gnyis kyis 611

sten/ /byang chub mchog tu sems skyed la/ /phar phyin drug la rgyun du slobs/ /gsang sngags smin grol dbang bzhi nos/ /grol byed bskyed rdzogs gdams pa sgoms/ /mdor na skyid 'dod blo yis thongs/ /tshe 'di'i 'dun ma ma bsgrub par/ /ri khrod dben pa'i gnas mchod du/ /tshe dang sgrub pa snyoms par mdzod/ /ces spras pa'o/ /yang chos dang bla ma la dad cing dam tshig sdom pa gtsang ba/ sdig spong dge sgrub la brtson pa'i jo mo bstan 'dzin bzang mo dang don 'grub sgrol ma gnyis kyis zhal gdams dgos tshul gyi zhu don 'di ltar phul lo/rje bka' drin can gyi bla ma yi/ /zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod tshogs 'bul/ /sngar byas sdig ltung mthol lo bshags/ /bla ma'i mdzad par rjes yi rang / /'gro la chos 'khor bskor bar bskul/ /mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs su gsol/ /dge tshogs sangs rgyas 'thob phyir bsngo/ /e ma skyes mchog rin po che/ /snyan gye dbang po cung zad dgongs/ /spyir na snyigs dus jo mo rnams/ /chos dang mthun pa dka' mor gda'/ /sgos su bdag cag rnam thar 'di/ /zhus na dam pas khrel ba'i rgyu/ /612

gnyid dang bza' btung sems sems nas/ /dam pa'i lha chos dran par dka'/ /kha ngoms grod pa 'grangs pa'i tshe/ /kha ton sgom rnams yong yong 'dra/ /rtsam pa yod nas mar chad rung / /sgom zhog kha ton yong ba dka'/ /yid du 'ong ba'i nor mthong na/ /'di 'dra nga la yod na snyam/ /bal skud tsam zhig rnyed la dga'/ /khab cig stor kyang 'gyod pa che/ /tshig ngan tsam zhig mi bzod par/ /khong khro langs nas dge rtsa bcom/ /sdom pa dam tshig bsrung snyam kyang / /rkyen dang 'phrad tshe 'chor nyen gda'/ /nam 'chi cha med mi dran par/ /lo mang sdod pa'i bsam blo gtong / /'dod yon nyes dmigs mi dran par/ /da dung zas nor gsog 'jog dran/ /'gro kun pha mar mi shes par/ /kun la nye ring chags sdang che/ /mtshan mo gti mug gnyid du log /nyin par lto gos khol po byas/ /mdor na rang rgyud lha chos gnyis/ /rgyab bsnol nyid du song ba tshor/ /da ni bla ma thugs rje can/ /chos sems 'dres par byen gyis rlobs/ /sngon chad bka' chos mang gsungs kyang / /da dung zhal gdams bstsal du gsol/ /bdag cag deng nas tshe rabs kun/ /bla ma khyed dang mi 'bral shog /khyed kyi gsung bzhin chos byas nas/ /rnam mkhyen go 613

'phang myur thob shog /ces phul ba'i lan du/dad can bstan 'dzin bzang mo dang / /don 'grub sgol ma rnam gnyis la/ /bya btang tshogs drug rang grol gyis/ /zhal gdams tshig 'ga' bshad kyis nyon/ /mtshan ldan bla ma gus pas sten/ /chos mthun brtse ba'i grogs dang 'grogs/ /ngo lkog med par sdom pa srungs/ /bzod pa tshig ngan byung dus sgoms/ /sbyin pa zas nor yod dus thongs/ /phyag skor sgyu lus bde dus gyis/ /gdams ngag blo rig gsal dus sgoms/ /dur rgyags dang kha bde dus zo/ /kha chems smra lce bde dus zhog /snying rje nyam thag sprang por gyis/ /yi dam thugs rje chen po sgoms/ /snying po yi ge drug ma bgrongs/ /skabs skabs nam 'chi cha med soms/ /rgyun du rang gi sems la ltos/ /mdor na tshe 'di blo yis thongs/ /bla ma'i bka' bzhin lha chos gyis/ /gdams ngag zab na mang mi dgos / /lag len dgos pas nyams su longs/ /nyams su blangs na tshe 'dir bde/ /phyi mar thar pa'i lam la 'gro /zhes smras so/ /gzhan yang skal ldan gyi slob ma rnams la rjes thob sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin sbyong dus/ mdo sde ting nge 'dzin rgyal po las gsungs pa'i tshigs bcad 'di rnams skabs skabs thon dang 614

bzang zhes smras pa/ji ltar smig rgyu dri za'i grong khyer dang / /sgyu ma ji bzhin rmi lam ji lta bur/ /mtshan ma bsgom pa ngo bo nyid kyis stong / /chos rnams thams cad de bzhin shes par gyis/ /ji ltar nam mkha' dwangs par zla shar na/ /de yi gzugs brnyan dwangs pa'i mtshor snang ste/ /zla ba chu yi nang du 'phos pa med/ /chos rnams thams cad de bzhin shes par gyis/ /ji ltar mi rnams brag ri'i khrod 'dug nas/ /glu len smra dang dgod dang ngu ba dang / /brag cha thos kyang snang ba med pa ltar/ /chos rnams thams cad de bzhin shes par gyis/ /glu dang rol mo de bzhin ngu ba yang / /de la brten nas brag cha 'byung mod kyi/ /sgra la dbyangs de nam yang yod ma yin/ /chos rnams thams cad de bzhin shes par gyis/ /ji ltar rmi lam na yang 'dod bsten pa/ /skyes bu sad par gyur nas mi mthong ste/ /byis pa shin tu 'dod la chags shing zhen/ /chos rnams thams cad de bzhin shes par gyis/ /sgyu ma byed pa dag gis gzugs sprul te/ /rta dang glang po shing rta sna tshogs byas/ /de la ji ltar snang ba gang yang med/ /chos rnams thams cad de bzhin shes par gyis/ /ji ltar bu mo gzhon nu'i rmi lam na/ /bu pho byung zhing shi ba de 615

mthong nas/ /byung na dga' zhing shi na mi dga' ltar/ /chos rnams thams cad de bzhin shes par gyis/ /ji ltar mtshan mo chu yi zla ba ltar/ /dwags shing rnyog pa med pa'i chu nang snang / /chu zla stong pa gsog ste bzung du med/ /chos rnams thams cad de bzhin shes par gyis/ /ji ltar sos ga'i nyi ma phyed dus su/ /skyes bu skom pas gdungs shing 'gro ba yi/ /smig rgyu dag la chu yi phung por mthong / /chos rnams thams cad de bzhin shes par gyes/ /smig rgyu la yang chu ni yod med na/ /sems can rmongs pa de la 'thung 'dod de/ /mi bden chu ni btung bar 'ongs mi nus/ /chos rnams thams cad de bzhin shes par gyes/ /ji ltar chu shing rlon pa'i sdong po la/ /snying po 'dod phyir skye bus de gshags kyang / /nang dang phyi rol kun na snying po med/ /chos rnams thams cad de bzhin shes par gyis/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar mdo sde zab mo'i tshig 'di ngag tu brjod cing / don yid la bsam na sgyu ma'i ting nge 'dze+en 'byongs par 'gyur ro zhes smras so/ /de nas phyogs phyogs nas skal bzang gi slob ma tshe blos btang brgya phrag dang / skyes pho mo dad can stong phrag mang po 'dus pa la snga phyi rim pa byas/ drang don du las rgyu 'bras mi bslu bar nges pa'i kun rdzob bden pa'i chos dang /616

nges don du chos thams cad rang ba/zhin gyis rdul tsam yang ma grub par nges pa'i don dam bden pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po lo zla ba byas nas bskor ba'i mthar/ rgyal ba'i gsung rab kun gyi nying khu skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi rim pa rnams bka' gdams gong ma'i gsung sgros gtam rgyud dang sbyar nas bshad pa bka' gdams sprul pa'i glegs bam dang / yang lam rim blo sbyong phyag rdzogs do ha rnams kyi gnad kyi gdams pa dri ba dris lan gyi tshul du tshigs bcad lhug spel mar bshad pa 'jam dbyangs sprul pa'i glegs bam gnyis kyi lung khrid nyi ma mang po'i bar du byas pa'i dus su/ nam mkha'i khams la 'ja' 'od kyi gur/ me tog gi char/ ngo mtshar gyi dri bzang po 'thul ba dang nam mkha' lha'i chos nyan gyis gang yod snyam pa byung / de ltar bshad pas skal ldan dbang bo yang rab rnams kyis rgyal ba'i gsung rab kun gyi gnad rnams go nas/rang gzhan bstan 'gro yongs la phan thogs pa'i slob ma mkhas btsun bzang gsum 'dzoms pa mang po byung / 'o na sprul pa'i glegs bam zer ba'i don de gang yin snyam na/ sngon rje bdag nyid chen pos rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs la/ phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa tshad med pa phul te/617

gsol ba shugs drag btab pas/ rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis mdo sngags gnyis ga'i lam gyi lus yongs su rdzogs pa'i snyan brgyud kyi man ngag sprul pa'i glegs bam chen mo dang bcas pa gnang / der khong gis grub pa'i dbang phyug 'jam dpal rgya mtsho la gnang / des ba so chos kyi rgyal mtshan la gnang / des grub chen chos kyi rdo rje la gnang / des rgyal ba dben sa pa blo bzang don grub la gnang ba de dngos ma yin kyang / de'i nang nas gsungs pa'i mdo sngags kyi gnad rnams 'dir 'dus pas/ de yi cha 'dra yin te/ bdag cag gi ston pa sangs rgyas kyi bka' yi ge na gcig yan chad ma lus pa gdams par shar ba'i bka' gdams bstan pa'i mes bo mnyam med jo bo rje dang / 'brom ston pa yab sras rnams kyis chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong gi nying khu rnams skyes bu gsum gyi rim par dril nas/ nyams su blangs chog chog byas yod pa'i glegs bam rnams kyi nang nas/ gsung bgros dang gtam rgyud rnams bdag gis tshur blangs nas mgo mjug bsgrigs te glegs bam du byas pa yin pas na/ dper na mar me gcig las gnyis mched kyi tshul du bka' gdams gsung gi glegs bam las tshur rang 'dra gnyis pa zhig sprul pa dang 'dra ba yin 618

zhes chos khungs btsun pa'i phyir/ mtshan de skad ces btags pa yin/ de bzhin du 'jam dbyangs sprul pa'i glegs bam yang /mkhyen rab bdag po rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs gdul bya'i don du gtsug phud dor nas byon pa ngur sprig gar gyis rnam par rol pa/ 'jam mgon bla ma tsong kha pa chen pos mdzad pa'i sa gsum gyi sgon me lta bu'i byang chub lam rim chen mo sogs la gzhi byas te brtsams pa yin/ de las tshur rang 'dra gnyis pa zhig sprul pa dang 'dra zhes tshos khungs btsun pa'i phyir/ de skad ces mtshan du gsol ba yin/ gzhan yang rgyal sras sprul pa'i glegs bam yang / spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul pa rgyal sras thogs med rin po che'i rnam thar gsung 'bum la gzhi byas nas brtsams pa yin pas na de skad btags shing /ngo mtshar sprul pa'i glegs bam yang rgyal ba'i gsung rab rgya bod kyi mkhas grub rnams kyi gsung 'bum las gtam rgyud rnams bsdus nas brtsams pa yin pas na/ de skad ces btags pa yin pas/ de la sogs pa'i bdag gis brtsams pa'i glegs bam rnams kyi mtshan ma 'ongs pa'i gdul bya rnams la phan pa'i byin rlabs dus gsum sangs rgyas rnams kyis mdzad yod pas/ kun gyis nyams su longs dang rgyud la phan 619

nges zhes bshad pas/ der 'tshogs pa'i skal bzang gdul bya rnams rab tu dad cing gus par gyur te sprul pa'i glegs bam rnams la gtsigs che ba byung ngo / /gnas chen der sdod pa'i skabs shig slob ma yon bdag rnams kyis las sgrib sbyong ba dang tshogs kyang rdzogs pa'i phyir rdo yi byang chub mchod rten zhig kyang bzhengs nas rab gnas byas te smon lam btab/tshe mtshams pa rje btsun sangs rgyas rdo rje gnas der phebs pa'i drung nas lho brag mar pa'i snyan brgyud kyi gdams pa lus med mkha' 'gro'i chos skor rnams kyi lung zhus/ gzhan yang gnas der phyogs phyogs kyi bla ma phebs tshad la chos 'brel zhus/ bsngo 'brel bzhag gangs mchod kyang yang yang phul nas gsol ba btab pas/ nub gcig rmi lam la gangs ri'i bla ma rdor 'dzin rin po che phebs nas/ da khyed gnas gzigs la phebs na khrid chog ces gsungs nas phebs pa'i rjes su rang nyid kyang song ba'i tshe dpal ldan sa skya'i lha khang chen mo lta bu'i gzhal med khang chen po rgyu rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa zhig gi dbus na shel gyi mchod rten chen po dri ma med pa/ phyi nas bltas na nang gsal ba/ nang nas bltas na phyi gsal ba dwangs gsal 'od kyi rang bzhin can zhig gi nang 620

na yi dam bde mchog 'khor lo'i gtso byas pa'i/ rgyud sde bzhi'i lha tshogs ma lus pa me long la gzugs brnyan shar ba ltar so sor ma 'dres par khra lam mer bzhugs pa zhig la mjal nas phyag 'tshal skor ba byas mchod pa phul te gsol ba btab pas/lha tshogs de dag thams cad kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros rang la phog pas lus sems la bde stong gi ye shes khyad par can skyes pa zhig rmis pa byung / yang nyin gcig mnyam bzhag la bsdad dus nyams snang la nam mkha' na/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro mang pos yi dam bde mchog gi pho brang la skor ba byed pa yin zhes mchod rdzas sna tshogs pa thogs nas/ gangs te se'i nam mkha' nas skor ba byed pa zhig mthong / yang gnas der yod dus/ rong shel mo gangs kyi thag nye'i yon bdag rnams kyis khong tsho'i yul du phebs dgos zer bas/ der ngas nga yong mi thub par gda'/ khyed rnams kyis dad pa gyis la gsol ba thob dang / nga 'ong ba dang khyad med pa'i skyabs 'jug bya zhes bshad pas der yon bdag rnams kyis khong dzu 'phrul gyis phebs yong mod snyam pa'i dad pa byas gsol ba btab pa dang / bdag gi yid kyis khong rnams gnas pa'i sa phyogs der song nas byin gyis brlabs pa'i dmigs pa yang 621

yang byas pa'i rten 'brel la brten nas/ nyin gcig las snang dag pa'i shing 'thun dang phyugs rdzi 'ga' zhig gi mthong snang la/ gangs te se'i phyogs kyi nam mkha'i khams nas nga'i lag pa gnyis su dar lcog dkar po re bzung ste 'phur nas 'ongs/ shel mo gangs kyi rtser babs nas dar lcog de btsugs nas slar song ba mngon sum du mthong nas yul mi la bshad nas bltas tshe/ shel mo gangs kyi rtse mo na sngar med pa'i dar lcog dkar po chen po zhig btsugs yod pa kun gyes mthong nas dad pa chen po byas skad/ de nas bzung ste yul der sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa ches cher dar ba'i rten 'brel 'grig pa byung / yang gnas der bdag gis lo gsum du byang chub kyi sems gnyis dang rim gnyis kyi ting nge 'dzin bsgoms pa'i byen rlabs dang / yon bdag rnams kyis dad mos chen po byas pa gnyis kyi rten 'brel la brten nas slob ma yon bdag phal cher gyi dag pa'i snang bar ci yang shar cing / khyad par nga song sa dang bsdad sa nas rdo la nga'i zhabs rjes babs yod pa rnyed nas/ ri dgon gyi dad pa'i rten byas/ de dus dad can 'ga' res khong gis mnyam bzhag nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang nas shel mo gangs la 'phur/ rjes thob sgyu ma lta bu'i ngang nas rdo 622

la zhabs rjes bzhag pa red zer snyan pa sgog pa'ang byung /gzhan yang bla ma dkon mchog gi thugs rje dang / yon bdag rnams kyi dad mos/ bdag gi lhag bsam dag pa'i mthus/yul phyogs thams cad la bkra shis shing lo phyugs legs/gser kha brdol ba la sogs pa sngar med pa'i bde skyid kyi nyi ma gsar du shar bas/ phyogs de'i skya ser pho mo rnams kyis bla ma dkon mchog gi bka' drin du go nas dad pa chen po'i sgos dam pa'i chos la longs spyod pa'i skal ba bzang bo byung / lar gdul bya la dad gus dag snang yod na rang la lung rtogs kyi yon tan rgya chen po med rung / khong tsho'i snang ngor grub rtags tsho yong bar gda' bas/ kun gyis dad gus dag snang byed pa 'di gal che/ ngas kyang kun la dad gus dag snang sbyangs pas mthong snang yang legs po mang po byung / khyed bu slob rnams kyis dad gus dag snang 'ba' zhig mdzod dang /dag pa'i snang ba 'ba' zhig 'char bar 'gyur zhes bshad pas/der 'tshogs pa kun gyi rgyud la dad gus dag snang skyes pa byung /de nas byang chub kyi sems dang ldan pa'i slob ma dge rgan ngag dbang seng ge dang / blo kha chos la 'gyur ba'i bon po bstan 'dzin dbang phyug 'khrul zhig kun bzang rang grol 623

dang / nye gnas skal bzang shes rab sogs tshe blos btang gi slob bu bcu tsam gyis lo gcig gi bar du chos zhus mtshams mdzad pa la ngas lto gos chos gsum gyis legs par bskyangs te lo gcig song ba'i tshe nyin gcig kun 'ongs nas/thugs rje chen po'i dkyil 'khor gyi bris thang zhig gis thog drangs/ rang rang la gang yod nor gyis 'brel ba sna re phul te/rab tu gus pa'i sgo nas/ bla ma rin po che khyed kyis da lo lto gos chos gsum gyi sgo nas bskyangs pas bka' drin shin tu che/da ni gnas nges med 'grims nas 'gro na ji ltar bya dgos kyi zhal gdams shig thugs brtse bas gzigs zhes zhu don glu ru phul ba/sku sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo nyid/ /gsung zab rgyas chos kun 'byung ba'i gnas/ /thugs zab yangs mkhyen brtse nus gsum gter/ /rje rtsa ba'i bla ma bdag la dgongs/ /mgon khyed ni sngon nas sangs rgyas kyang / /dus snyigs ma'i sems can nyam thag la/ /thugs brtse bas ma bzod srid pa 'dir/ /slar bsam bzhin mi yi skye ba bzhes/ /thabs mkhas po bsdu ba rnam bzhi'i sgos/ /'dul dka' ba'i 'gro ba yin na yang / /yar mngon mtho nges legs lam la bkod/ /spyir snyigs dus 624

'gro la bka' drin che/ /sgos bsod nams dman pa'i sprang po rnams/ /chos bla ma bsams nas sa mthar 'khyams/ /sngar bla ma mang por mjal na yang / /mgon khyod las lhag pa ngas ma mthong / /dus da lo mgon khyod thugs rje yis/ /sprang yongs la lto gos chos gsum 'dzom/ /chung ma las skyes nas da lta'i bar/ /skyid 'di bas lhag cig yong ma myong / /'di khyed kyi bka' drin yin par go /nor zang zing 'bul ba ma mchis kyang / /dus da nas ji srid 'tsho yi bar/ /thugs dgyes phyir sgrub pa'i mchod pa 'bul/ /sprang phyogs med rgyal khams 'grims pa'i tshe/ /nang sems la phan pa'i zhal gdams zhu/ /rje rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang / /tshe blo yis thongs par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes smras pa'i lan du/ 'o bu kun spyir skye 'chi 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsams nas tshe blos btang ste yar thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang 'thob 'dod kyi bsam pa shugs drag gi sgo nas/ chos rnam dag cig byed par 'dod na/ blo phugs chos la gtad/ chos phugs sprang la gtad/ sprang phugs shi la gtad/ shi phugs brag la gtad zer ba'i gtad pa bzhi dang / mi gral nas bud/ khye gral bsnyegs/ lha gral 'thob zer ba'i bud bsnyegs thob gsum 625

dang / thebs med rdo rje sngon la btang / khrel med rdo rje rjes la bzhag ye shes rdo rje rang dang 'grogs zer ba'i rdo rje gsum ste/ 'di bcu la dam pa gong ma'i phugs nor bcu zer/ dad gtong tshul khrims thos dang khrel yod/ ngo tsha shes rab ste 'phags nor bdun dang / zas ngan ngon/ gos ngan ngon/ gnas ngan ngon/ mkho ba'i yo byad ngan ngon te 'phags pa'i rigs bzhi dang / tshur khro yang slar mi khro/ tshur gshe yang slar mi gshe tshur mtshang brus kyang slar mi 'bru/tshur rdeg kyang slar mi brdeg pa ste dge sbyong gi chos bzhi la gnas pa zhig dgos/ de dag rnams yod na phyogs gang du song kyang chos yong / khyad par chags zhen gyi 'khri ba gcod phyir/ phyogs med kyi rgyal khams 'grim dus 'di ltar gyis zhes glu 'di blangs so//phyogs med rgyal khams 'grim pa'i tshe/ /spyi bor rtsa ba'i bla ma sgoms/ /skyid rung sdug rung gsol ba thob/ /lto gos chos gsum 'dzoms nas 'ongs/ /skyid na bla ma'i thugs rje yin/ /sdug na sprang po'i las 'phro yin/ /lto gos gnyis kyis phongs na yang / /mi ngan khrel med ma byed cig /gzhan la bslang bas ma byin kyang / /khong khro'i tshig ngan ma smra zhig /gar skyid pha 626

yul lta bur gyes/ /su byams pha ma ltar du sten/ /sku gsung thugs rten mthong ba la/ /mchod pa med rung phyag skor gyis/ /bla ma bzang bor mjal ba'i tshe/ /phyag rten med rung phyag dbang zhus/ /lus dang srog la 'tshe ba yi/ /jag rkun khye la dogs zon gyis/ /sha chang bud med sgog btsong rnams/ /chos pa'i btsan dug yin pas spongs/ /grong dang dgon sde skyid na yang / /'dug yun ring na chags sdang 'byung / /chos pa'i sdod sa ri khrod yin/ /rtag tu ri khrod dben pa sten/ /sdug bsngal nyam thag mthong ba la/ /snying rje skyed la ci phan gyes/ /gzhan skyon mang po mthong ba la/ /rang skyon yin soms dag snang sbyongs/ /tshe thung nam 'chi cha med pas/ /sang gnangs ci za ma snyam zhig /rin chen srog dang ma bral na/ /sgyu ma'i nor rdzas btsal na'ang rnyed/ /ma rnyed ltogs nas shi song yang / /chos phyir yin pas phyi mar skyid/ /nam yang 'chi ba mnyam po la/ /chos phyir shi na shin tu legs/ /mdor na bsam blo ma mang bar/ /bla ma'i gdams ngag nyams su longs/ /le lo snyoms las ma byed cig /brtson 'grus shin tu myur ba gces/ /zhes smras nas khong rnams la cog pu zas gos sogs mkho ba'i yo byad rnams sprad pas/ mched grogs rnams 627

kyi nang du bos nas ja drangs snying gtam byas te kha btags g.yogs nas/ 'gro ba'i nyin tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po bskor/ mched lcam yongs la dngul gyi 'gyed btang /de nas tshogs gral du 'khod pa rnams la rang gi sems skyo ba'i shugs kyis glu 'di blangs so// bka' drin 'khor med kyi bla ma/ /spyi gtsug bde chen du bzhugs la/ /'di phyi bar do yi gnas skabs/ /skyabs dang skyel ma rang mdzod cig /las dang smon lam gyi dbang gis/ /yar mar thams cad nas 'ongs pa'i/ /dad pa dam tshig dang ldan pa'i/ /skal ldan slob ma rnams nyon dang / /gangs ri'i dar chen du 'dzom pa'i/ /tshong 'dus mgron po yi tshogs rnams/ /dbyar kha nyo tshong 'dra byas nas/ /ston mjug so so ru gyes bzhin/ /gnas chen 'di ka ru bzhugs pa'i/ /rnal 'byor dpon slob kyi tshogs rnams/ /lo mtshams zla mtshams 'dra mdzad nas/ /da ni so so ru gyes tshe/ /sngar bas brtse gdung zhig skyes byung / /nam zhig nges pa ru 'di bzhin/ /'jig rten pha rol tu 'gro dus/ /gcig pur ga 'dra rang mdzad snyam/ /mi rtag 'chi ba rang dran byung / /'di dang 'di 'dra yi tshul la/ /bsam blo zhib tu rang btang tshe/ /snying po 628

gang la yang mi 'dug /snying po'i lha chos shig mdzad na/ /kun spangs gtsang ma zhig byas nas/ /ri khrod dben pa yi gnas su/ /rtse gcig nyams len la 'bungs dang / /rang re dpon slob kyi tshogs rnams/ /da ni mi mjal bar gyur kyang / /phyi mar dag zhing du mjal ba'i/ /rnam dag smon lam rang 'debs so/ /zhes blangs pas/ khong rnams kyi mig nas mchi ma g.yo bzhin nga'i zhabs spyi bor blangs nas bde zhus smon lam gyi mgur 'di phul lo//dgra nyon mongs g.yul las rnam rgyal zhing / /rje 'gran gyi do med bde bar bzhugs/ /nged ma rig ling thog sel mkhan gye/ /rje 'tsho byed gzhon nu bde bar bzhugs/ /sprang yongs la lto gos chos gnang ba'i/ /rje mtshan ldan bla ma bde bar bzhugs/ /mchog thun mong dngos grub kun stsol ba'i/ /rje yid bzhin nor bu bde bar bzhugs/ /ma 'gro kun kha lo chos la bsgyur/ /rje 'khor los bsgyur rgyal bde bar bzhugs/ /skyon kun zad yon tan kun ldan gyi/ /rje dus gsum sangs rgyas bde bar bzhugs/ /dus deng nas byang chub snying bo'i bar/ /mgon khyod kyis rjes su 'dzin par shog /ces dang gzhan yang smon lam mang po 'debs bzhin phyir 'gros byas 629

mig nas mchi ma mang po gtong bas rkyen byas te/ der 'tshogs pa'i grogs mched rnams kyi mig nas kyang mchi ma byung / de nas mched grogs rnams kyis skyel thung byas te/ bal yul sogs gnas nges med 'grim du song ngo / /yang gnas chen der lo gnyis lhag tsam song tshe slob ma rnams la rang nyid 'gro ba'i gtam mang po byas nyin gcig glu dbyangs 'di 'dra blangs so// khu byug lcang gling gru bzhir/ /rgyu ba dga' mo 'dug ste/ /thag rnyi phra mos nam zin/ /mi shes pa de skyo byung / /lcang gling 'khri ba bcad nas/ /bar snang bde mo skor gyin/ /thang dkar rgod po'i 'grims sa/ /dgung sngon dbyings su chas 'gro /nya mo chu mtha' bsil mor/ /rgyu ba dga' mo 'dug ste/ /lcags kyu sngon mos nam 'debs/ /mi shes pa 'di skyo byung / /chu mtha'i 'khri ba bcad nas/ /gtsang chab bde mo skor gyin/ /nya chen yor mo'i gnas sa/ /rgya mtsho'i nang du chas 'gro /rnal 'byor bu slob khrod du/ /rgyu ba dga' mo 'dug ste/ /'chi bdag bdud po nam sleb/ /mi shes pa 'di skyo byung / /tshe 'di'i 'khri ba bcad nas/ /rgyal khams bzang bo skor gyen/ /dam pa gong ma'i gdan sa/ /dben gnas 630

gzhan du chas 'gro /zhes blangs pas slob bu rab rgyas sogs slob bu rnams kyis ring min myur du 'gro ba'i 'dun pa 'dug snyam/ da dung nged rnams kyi don du lo re gnyis bzhugs dgos tshul gyi zhu ba mang po byas mthar glu dbyangs 'di 'dra phul byung /'khrungs sa phyi yi rgya mtshor/ /'khrungs pa'i me shel nyi ma/ /gling bzhi'i mun pa sel phyir/ /'gro ba dga' mo 'dug ste/ /'bral ba'i skyo ba ldum ra'i/ /me tog nged la 'ong bas/ /da dung 'od zer spro bzhin/ /dgung sngon 'di ru bzhugs shig /'khrungs sa gangs ri mthon por/ /'khrungs pa'i dar seng dkar mo/ /gcan gzan khrims la 'god phyir/ /'gro ba dga' mo 'dug ste/ /'bral ba'i skyo ba nags kyi/ /ri dwags nged la 'ong bas/ /da dung g.yu ral ngom bzhin/ /ri ngos 'di ru bzhugs shig /'khrungs sa mdo khams smad du/ /'khrungs pa'i mtshan ldan bla ma/ /'gro ba gzhan don mdzad phyir/ /phebs pa dga' mo 'dug ste/ /'bral ba'i skyo ba rjes 'jug /slob ma nged la 'ong bas da dung bka' chos gnang bzhin/ /gnas chen 'di ru bzhugs shig /ces phyag bcas kun gyis zhu ba nan gyis phul tshe 'dun 631

pa bzlog ma nus par/ re zhig sdod par khas blangs nas glu dbyangs 'di 'dra blangs so//nags ljongs phal mo 'grims pa'i/ /rgya stag khra bo'i sems pa/ /tsan dan nags la shor yang / /nags mtha' 'grims pa bzhag nas/ /rgya stag 'dzum phrug ston sa/ /tsan dan nags la byas yong / /gangs kyi zur kha 'grims pa'i/ / seng ge dkar mo'i sems pa/ /gangs stod mthon por shor yang / /zur kha 'grims pa bzhag nas/ /seng ge'i g.yu ral ngom sa/ /gangs dkar ltongs la byas yong / /rgyal khams phyogs med 'grims pa'i/ /bya btang rnal 'byor sems pa/ /dben pa'i ri la shor yang / /rgyal khams 'grims pa bzhag nas/ /rnal 'byor sgom sgrub byed sa/ /gnas chen 'di ru byas yong / /zhes smras pas/ bu slob thams cad dga' zhing spro bzhin bdag la 'bul ba dang tshogs kyi dga' ston bzang bo byas/ kun gyis skyid pa'i glu dbyangs 'di blangs so//dri ldan me tog pad+mas/ /zil mngar zhim po byen byung / /byen kyang sbyin na chog snang //ze'u 'bru 'dab ma rgyas 'dug /de la bsam gyin dga' nas/ /stag chung bung ba nged tsho/ /bar snang bde mor 'phur nas/ /dga' ba'i dar dir bsgrags 632

song / /bsil ldan lho sprin smug pos/ /sbrang char 'jam po phab byung / /phab kyang babs na chog snang / /chu 'dzin rab tu g.yo 'dug /de la bsam gyin dga' nas/ /mdongs ldan rma bya nged tsho/ /dog mo'i sa la 'khod nas/ /dga' ba'i gar stabs bsgyur song / /mtshan ldan rtsa ba'i bla mas/ /zab mo'i gdams pa gnang byung / /gnang kyang gnang na chog snang / /thugs rgyud chos kyis gang 'dug /de la bgam gyin dga' nas/ /skal ldan slob ma nged tsho/ /gnas khang bzang bor 'khod nas/ /dga' ston glu gar byas song / /zhes gang spro spro byas/ yang bu slob 'jigs med rgyal mtshan sogs bu slob kha cig gis de ring skal ba bzang bo byung / da dung bla ma rin po ches kun gyi sems la phan pa'i mgur zhig dang / gnas chen gangs mtsho gnyis la bstod pa nyung 'dus shig dgos zhes bskul ngor glu dbyangs 'di rnams blangs so//chu bo chen po rnam bzhi/ /'ongs pa'i chu yi 'go bo/ /mtsho chen ma pham g.yu mtsho/ /de na bzhugs pa'i klu dbang / /sa 'dir bkra shis dge legs/ /stsol ba'i bdag po los yin/ /mi rigs mi gcig rnam bzhi/ /rgyu ba'i sa yi lte ba/ /bya rgod phung po'i ri bo/ /de na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas/ /'gro la 633

chos kyi 'khor lo/ /bskor ba'i bdag po los yin/ /'dod 'byung yid bzhin nor bu/ /'gro kun dbul ba sel phyir/ /phyi yi rgya mtshor 'khrungs kyang / /da lta rgyal mtshan rtse na/ /dgos 'dod char bzhin 'bebs dus/ /len mkhan yod na longs dang / /bya btang tshogs drug rang grol/ /bstan dang 'gro la phan phyir/ /mdo khams smad du skyes kyang / /da lta gangs ri'i mgul nas/ /gang 'dod chos char 'bebs dus/ /nyan mkhan yod na nyon dang / /dri ldan yid 'ong pad+ma/ /nam zhig ba mos bcom dus/ /yal ga thams cad ltung bas/ /da lta bkrag mdangs mtshar dus/ /skal bzang bung ba'i tshogs rnams/ /zil mngar sbrang rtsi longs dang / /dal 'byor tshang ba'i mi lus/ /nam zhig 'chi bas bcom dus/ /sha rus thams cad 'jig pas/ /da lta gzhon nu'i dus su/ /skal bzang slob ma'i tshogs rnams/ /zab rgyas gdams pa sgoms dang / /me shel nyi ma tsha yang / /ngang ba'i grogs su shar song / /dbyangs snyan sgog bzhin pad mtshor/ /'jug la dga' spro yod drag /skyed mos tshal na zlos gar/ /rtse la ltad mo ltos dang / /mi 'dod rkyen ngan byung kyang / /chos pa'i grogs su shar song / /byang sems sgom bzhin sa 634

lam/ /bgrod la dga' spro yod drag /dben pa'i gnas su blo sbyong / /sgoms la ltad mo ltos dang / /'khor lo sdom pa'i pho brang / /dgra bcom lnga brgya'i bzhugs gnas/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i zhing khams/ /grub thob gong ma'i gdan sa/ /'dzam gling sa yi lte ba/ /gnas chen gangs dkar te ser/ /skor ba lan cig byas rung / /tshe gcig sdig pa dag yong / /klu chen brgyad kyi pho brang / /ma dang mkha' 'gro'i do ra/ /dkar phyogs lha yi 'du sa/ /'dzam bu tri sha'i skye gnas/ /chu bo bzhi 'dus 'go bo/ /mtsho chen ma pham g.yu mtsho/ /khrus byas 'thung ba tsam gyis/ /las ngan sgrib pa dag yong / /dad can yon bdag gangs mtshor/ /phyag mchod skor ba gyis dang / /las ngan sdig sgrib dag nas/ /byin rlabs dngos grub thob yong / /zhes blangs pas kun dad cing gus pas phyag dang bcas te/ tshig gi gtang rag mang po phul nas rang rang gi gnas su song ngo / /yang gnas chen de nas lo gsum 'gro ba la thag nye ba'i dus kyi tshe slob ma rnams la/ sngon gyi skyes bu dam pa gong ma rnams kyis kyang / gnas rer lo re gnyis las mi bzhugs par phebs pa de/ bzhugs ma tshugs pa ma yin/de la rang gzhan la phan pa'i dgos pa chen po yod pa ltar/635

bdag kyang gnas bzang bo 'dir slebs nas lo gsum tsam 'gro bar gda'/ de'i bar la khyed rnams la rang gis gang shes kyi gdams pa rnams sba gsang med par bstan song /nyams su len na khyed rnams kyi don kyang de gas 'grub yong /ngas kyang khyed bu slob yon bdag rnams kyi drin la brten nas/lo gsum gye bcad rgya yang mthar thon pas nga'i don kyang 'grub cing / da ni rang gzhan gnyis ga'i don 'grub nas 'dun ma legs pa'i sgang la song na bzang / 'gro tshad la slebs 'dug pas bshol kyang khegs mi yong / 'gog dgos kyang mi dgos tshul rgyas par bshad pa'i mthar glu dbyangs 'di 'dra blangs so//nyin mtshan dus tshod kyis gtugs nas/ /gzhan gyis bshol thabs shig mi gda'/ /zla ba gling gzhan du chas 'gro /me tog ku mud kyi tshal la/ /gnod pa'i sad ser gyi rigs rnams/ /nus ldan sngags 'chang gis srungs shig /char dang bser bu yis bskul nas/ /gzhan gyis bshol thabs shig mi gda'/ /bung ba nags gseb tu chas 'gro /spang rgyan me tog gi tshogs la/ /gnod pa'i ba mo yi rigs rnams/ /lho sprin smug po yis srungs shig /'gro ba'i dus tshod la slebs nas/ /636

gzhan gyis bshol thabs shig mi gda'/ /rnal 'byor gzhan yul la chas 'gro /skal ldan slob ma yi tshogs la/ ri /gnod pa'i nad gdon gyi tshogs rnams/ /mthu ldan chos skyong gis srungs shig /ces blangs pas slob bu mtho lding ba/ bkra shis sgang ba/ spu trengs pa rnams kyis gus pas phyag byas snyan pa'i ngag gis/ bla ma rin po che khyed ni rang don mngon du gyur nas sa phyogs gar phebs kyang byed rgyu gzhan don las mi 'duganged mtha' 'khob mun pa'i gling lta bu'i 'gro ba gcig la phan btags pa dang / gzhan chos dar ba'i yul dbus gtsang gi phyogs lta bu'i sems can brgya la chos kyis phan btags pa gnyis kyi phan yon mi 'dra/ dper na 'grangs pa'i mi la mar zan gcig byen pa bas/ ltogs pa'i mi la zan chang gcig byin pa dga' ba dang 'dra/ nged rnams la sngar bka' chos gnang ba bka' drin mi che ba ma yin kyang / nged rmongs pa rnams kyis dus gcig la ga la shes/ da dung blang dor shes rag gi bar du bka' chos kyang yang yang gnang dgos/ nyi ma yang dus tshod kyis gtugs kyang grub thob gong mas bzung ba mang /khyed phebs dus su slebs rung lo re gnyis cis kyang bzhugs pa'i gsol ba 'debs pa lags/zhes bzhugs dgos tshul rgyas 637

par zhus mthar mdor bsdus mgur dbyangs tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag kyang phul lo//steng 'dzam gling rgyan gcig nyi ma de/ /nub ba lang spyod du bskyod song na/ /lho 'dzam bu gling ba'i mi re'i mgo'i/ /nyi re re nub pa'i snang ba byung / /rje 'gro ba'i bla ma thugs rje can/ /khyed yul phyogs gzhan du phebs song na/ /nged mgon med slob ma re re la/ /mgon re re bral ba'i mya ngan 'ong / /steng mun pa sel ba'i nyi ma yang / /gling gzhan du 'gro ba'i dus slebs kyang / /khong grub thob gong mas bzung tsa na/ /nyin mang por bsdad pa'i dus kyang byung / /rje grub thob gong ma phal cher kyang / /gzhan gdul bya'i don du chas na yang / /khong dad can rnams kyis gsol btab nas/ /slar lo mang bzhugs pa'i rnam thar snang / /rje 'gro ba'i mgon po thugs rje can/ /khyed gdul bya'i don du phebs dgos kyang / /nged bu slob rnams kyi dad mos ngor/ /lo re gnyis cis kyang bzhugs par zhu/ /dpe bsam med bu chung mang po la/ /lto za tshul la sogs bya spyod rnams/ /dus lan cig bslabs pas ga la shes/ /dus yang yang ma yis bslab dgos bzhin/ /nged gdul bya blo gros rmongs pa la/ /las rgyu 'bras la sogs zab 638

rgyas chos/ /dus lan cig bstan pas ga la shes/ /dus yang yang bka' chos stsol bar zhu/ /zhes smras pa'i lan du/ dus da re lan 'bul rgyu ma rnyed song / sdod dgos par gda' smras pas/ kun rab tu dga' nas/ rgyal pos smras pa lan cig yin zer ba ltar/ bla ma dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas khyed kyis da bzhugs par zhal gyis bzhes nas slar 'gyur na mi rung bas thugs la 'jags 'tshal/ da yang nged bu slob rnams la phan pa'i mgur bzhes par zhu zer ba'i lan du glu 'di 'dra blangs so/drang srong bya rgyal rgod po/ /ltogs nas shi ba ma mthong / /sgom chen bkres nas shi ba'i/ /rus pa btsal na'ang mi rnyed/ /rgya yis zo chun khyud mos/ /chu bo la la drangs song / /chos pa ri la chags na/ /zan sgong gyen la 'gril yong / /khye rgan lam du nyal na/ /rdo log rin gyis nyos yong / /sgom chen grong du babs na/ /gtam ngan mi kha slebs 'ong / /bye la sha gnyis gtugs na/ /mi za zer yang rdzun yin/ /rab byung btsun ma nye na/ /sdom pa rim gyis shor yong / /kha yis zhim po za na/ /lag pas dka' las myang dgos/ /gtan bde sangs rgyas 'dod na/ /chos phyir dka' ba spyad 'tshal/ /bya dang ri 639

dwags tshogs rnams/ /gar skyid sa na bsdad yod/ /chos pa rnams kyang dge sbyor/ /'phel ba'i sa nas sdod dgos/ /seng ge gangs la gnas pas/ /g.yu ral legs po rgyas song / /sgom chen ri la bzhugs dang / /thugs dam rim gyis 'phel yong / /byi la lkog na nyal rung / /tsi tsi sems kyis ma brjed/ /sgom chen ri la bsdad rung / /lto gos brjed rgyu ma byung / /nya mo chu la gnas kyang / /lcags kyus skam la drangs song / /sgom chen ri la gnas kyang / /'dod pas grong du phab song / /khyi dang lhan du nye na/ /rma dang nye ba chos nyid/ /grogs po ngan par 'grogs na/ /spyod ngan shugs kyis 'gos yong / /grog ma 'gro 'dug mang na/ /rkang lag thang chur sbyar yong / /chos pa byed rgyu mang na/ /chos 'go mthar thon mi yong / /sa bon zhing la btab na/ /sog ma zhor la thon yong / /snying nas chos bzhin byas na/ /lto rgyab zhor la 'dzom yong / /dgra la thub tshad 'dzings na/ /dpa' bo'i mi de thob yong / /chos phyir dka' ba spyad na/ /snyan pa lha mis brjod yong / /'phags pa rnams la gser dang / /sa rdo khyad par mi snang / /chos pa'i 'dod pa zad na/ /'phags pa rnams dang khyad med/ /ljon shing sngo ljang rgyas dus/ /me tog 'bras bus 640

brgyan byung / /ston kha ser skyar song dus/ /me tog 'bras bu yal song / /rang nyid na so gzhon dus/ /pha ma gnyis ka 'dzom byung / /da lta rgas nas mkho dus/ /drin can pha mar bral song / /rgya mos legs par btags pa'i/ /gos chen kha dog legs kyang / /rim pas rnying bar gyur nas/ /ras dang khyad med gyur song / /pha mas legs par bskyangs pa'i/ /rang lus bkrag mdangs rgyas kyang / /rim par na so rgas nas/ /shi dang khyad med byung song / /dbyar gyi dus kyi me tog /ba mos yang yang mnar tshe/ /mdzes pa'i 'gying bag glod nas/ /mgo bo sa la gug song / /gzhon nu'i dus kyi lus bo/ /na bas yang yang mnar tshe/ /mthu stobs nus pa nyams nas/ /drang po'i lus po sgur song / /kā pa la yi skra dkar/ /kha yi nang gi so lhung / /ga nas bltas kyang 'chi snyam/ /nga ni dbang med skyo byung / /rnam dpyod dpag bsam ljon pa/ /mi rtag bser bus bskul tshe/ /skyo mgur tshig gi me tog /'di 'dra mang po 'thor song / /zhes pa 'di rnams blangs pas/slob ma rnams la blo bskyed dang / nges 'byung skyes pa mang po byung ngo / /de nas mtshams grol nas gnas skor la 'gro khar/ma pham g.yu yi mtsho la/ /gnas pa'i nya mo gser mig /641

mtsho la g.yas skor byas nas/ /gaṅgā'i chab la chas 'gro /gangs ri'i rdzu 'phrul phug na/ /gnas pa'i bya btang rnal 'byor/ /gangs la g.yas skor byas nas/ /dben gnas gzhan du chas 'gro /'dzam gling rgyan gcig gangs mtsho/ /lha yi pho brang yin pa/ /der bzhugs lha dang ḍāk+kis/ /'gro kun bu bzhin skyongs shig /dam pa gong ma'i gdan sa/ /gnas chen gangs mtsho yin snang / /chos mdzad skyes bu thams cad/ /gnas chen 'di ru bzhugs shig /ma dros mtsho las gyes nas/ /phyogs bzhir 'bab pa'i chu bo/ /sa 'dir 'phrad rgyu med rung / /rgya mtsho'i nang nas 'phrad yong / /gnas chen 'di las gyes nas/ /phyogs bzhir 'gro ba'i dpon slob/ /tshe 'dir mjal rgyu med rung / /phyi ma'i yul nas mjal yong / /'od gsal 'dzam gling nyi ma/ /thag ring mkha' la gnas kyang / /lho phyogs pad+ma'i tshal la/ /nangs nub gnyis gar phan yong / /mtshan ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma/ /thag ring rgyang na gnas kyang / /dad can slob ma'i tshogs la/ /'di phyi gnyis gar phan yong / /skal ldan slob ma rnams la/ /tshe 'dir mjal ba yud tsam/ /phyi mar mjal ba'i dus su/ /yun ring 'grogs par gyur cig /ces smras pas dad can slob ma kha 642

shas kyis dpon slob so sor gyes pa la sems 'a phreng ste mig nas mchi ma g.yo ba byung / de nas dbang phyug gi lo'i snron zla'i yar tshes la gangs la g.yas skor byas te/ thog mar lho ngos kyi rgyang grags dgon du song / gangs mchod phul 'gyed mang ja btang / gser phug bla ma rin po cher mjal/ rgyal ba 'bri khung ba'i lnga ldan khrid kyi sngon 'gro'i lung zhus/ nub ngos kyi gnyan po ri rdzong du song / chos sku rin po cher mjal gangs mchod phul 'gyed mang ja btang / der bzhugs pa'i sa thob kyi byang chub sems dpa' rdor 'dzin rin po che la dang po zhal mjal ba tsam gyis thugs yid gcig tu 'dres pas/lo gsum gyi bar du gang dgos kyi 'tsho brgyags gnang bas bka' drin shin tu che ba byung / khong gi mdun nas bde mchog lha bcu gsum ma'i dbang zhus/ gser dngul dang nor rdzas kyi 'bul ba phul skyabs 'jug zhus/ 'gro khar bde zhus kyi glu 'di yang bris nas phul lo//sku 'gyur ba med pa rdo rje'i sku/ /gsung 'gags pa med pa tshangs pa'i dbyangs/ /thugs g.yo ba med par ting 'dzin bsgoms/ /rje sbas pa'i sangs rgyas bdag la dgongs/ /khyed sngon nas zung 'jug sku brnyes kyang / /slar rdo rje 'dzin pa'i 643
