gzugs su shar/ /ma 'gro kun sgol ba'i khur 'khyer ba/ /'di bsam na rnam thar kun gyis phul/ /sprang bdag kyang gnas 'di bsams nas 'ongs/ /gnas bzang bo 'di ru lo gsum bar/ /sgom sgrub pa byed pa'i skal ba byung / /'di bsam na bla ma rje yi drin/ /rje 'gro ba'i skyabs mgon thugs rje can/ /mtshan snyan pa bstan 'dzin rgyal mtshan khyed / /phyogs 'di yi gdul bya'i gtsug rgyan du/ /lo kha shas bar du bzhugs su gsol/ /rlung chen pos khyer ba'i sbur ma bzhin/ /sprang bya btang tshogs drug rang grol nga / /las smon lam dbang gis gnas 'dir slebs/ /da yul phyogs gzhan du chas nas 'gro /bya khu byug skad snyan sgrog bzhin du/ /sa thag ring gnas su 'gro ba ltar/ /ngas legs bshad zab mo 'doms bzhin du/ /sa thag ring dben pa'i gnas su 'gro /rgod mkha' la 'phur nas je mthor btang / /rang gang 'dod gnas su 'gro ba ltar/ /ngas gnas chen 'di la skor ba byas/ /rang gang 'dod gnas su bzhud nas 'gro /mgon khyod kyis phyogs 'di'i gdul bya rnams/ /thugs brtse bas ma 'dor byams pas skyongs/ /dus da dung tshe rabs thams cad du/ /mgon khyod dang yang yang mjal bar shog /ces phul bas 644

khong gis kyang bdag la thugs brtse ba'i sgo nas zhal gsung du ma byon/ lam chas sogs mkho ba'i yo byad du ma gnang ba byung / de nas byang ngos 'bri thim phug la mjal/ gangs mchod phul 'gyed mang ja btang / grub chen rnams kyis tshogs kyi skabs su rdo rje'i glu dbyangs blangs chos bro 'khrab gang spro spro mdzad/ shar ngos dzu 'phrul phug tu 'ongs/ gangs mchod rgyas par phul 'gyed mang ja btang / der gnas pa'i ngan slong rnams la sbyin pa btang / grwa bu slob der sdod mkhan rnams la sgrub brgyags kyi snon pa byin/ de nas 'gro khar tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po skor ba'i tshogs gral nas grwa bu slob 'tshogs pa yongs la/ chos la bar chad med pa'i byin rlabs byas te/ 'o skal ldan bu kun legs par nyon la yid la zungs shig nged rnams sngon gyi las dang smon lam dag pas mtshams sbyar nas/ gnas chen bzang bo 'dir su yis ma bos bzhin du/ phyogs phyogs nas rang bzhin shugs kyis 'dus te/lo gsum gye bar du kun gyis mtshams sgrub pa lhan du byas mthar/ da ni mi sdod so sor gyes nas 'gro ba 'di bzhin du/spyir 'jig rten 'khor ba'i chos rnams mi rtag mi brtan lo re bzhin 'gyur zhing 'gro bas yid brtan med/ khyad par 'o 645

skol rnams tshe phyi ma'i yul la/ lo brgyad cu tshun la snga phyi go rim med par 'gro dgos shing nam 'gro cha med/ do nub yin yang gnyen mdza' bshes kun dang bral nas bar dor gcig pur mi 'gro ba'i nges pa med pas na/ rtag 'dzin phyi bshol byas na chos skal 'chad pas/ da ni gang la yang ma chags ma zhen pa byas nas/ myur du dam pa'i chos kho na la 'bad dgos/snying nas chos bzhin byed na sngon jo bo rje lha gcig 'byon khar lha btsun byang chub 'od la gdams pa snying gtam lhug par smra ba seng ge'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba 'di bzhin byed 'tshal zhes de'i lung blo thog nas byas pa'i mthar/ da ni nga'i chos bshad kun gyi mjug bsdu/ zhal gdams kun gyi tha ma/'gro kha'i bslab bya 'di la nyon zhes glu 'di blangs so//rje rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang / /steng spyi gtsug bde chen rgyan du bzhugs/ /bu 'dir 'tshogs blo kha chos la sgyur/ /blo chos min snang ba 'gag tu gsol/ /khyed 'dir 'tshogs dad can bu slob rnams/ /nga'i phan pa'i snying gtam 'di la nyon/ /rje bka' drin 'khor med bla ma la/ /dus rgyun 'chad med par gsol ba thobs/ /rten mi lus yang yang rnyed par dka'/ /da rnyed dus chos kyi snying bo longs/ /kun 'chi nges 646

nam 'chi nges pa med/ /tshe 'di yi bya ba blo yis thongs mar ngan song sdug bsngal bzod par dka'/ /'jigs de las skyob phyir skyabs 'gro gyis/ /las rgyu 'bras nam yang bslu ba med/ /sdig mi dge spongs la dge ba sgrubs/ /spyir 'khor ba'i gnas na bde ba med/ /gnas 'di las thar pa'i thabs la 'bod/ /thabs bslab gsum yin yang khyad par du/ /gzhi tshul khrims mig gi 'bras bzhin srungs/ /gzhan 'gro kun drin can pha ma yin/ /byams snying rje byang chub sems la sbyongs/ /lam phar phyin drug la chos kun 'dus/ /'di drug la rgyun du lag len gyis/ /lam shin tu myur ba gsang sngags yin/ /'di gsang nas nyams su len pa gces/ /chos 'di bzhin nyams su len 'dod na/ /dus rgyun du ri khrod dben pa sten/ /lo zla mtshams tsam gyis sangs mi rgya/ /tshe sgrub pa snyoms pa shin tu gces/ /'di zhal gdams kun gyi mthar thug yin/ /shi song yang kha chems 'di las med/ /chos 'di bzhin nyams su len pa la/ /gegs gol sa med pa'i smon lam 'tshal/ /zhes smras pas/ kun gyis lus 'phreng ba'i rnam 'gyur/ ngag 'phreng ba'i snying gtam/ sems 'phreng ba'i skyo shas tshad med pa'i ngang nas rang rang la ci yod kyi nor phul/647

skyabs 'jug rgyas par zhus pa'i mthar slob ma rnams kyis dbyadas 'di yang phul byung /tshe 'di phyi bar do'i gtan gyi skyabs/ /nged ma rig dmus long rnams kyi mig /nad nyon mongs sel ba'i sman pa mchog /rje rtsa ba'i bla ma bka' drin can/ /khyed mi bzhugs gzhan du phebs gyur na/ /dpe long ba thang dkyil lus pa bzhin/ /kun 'gro yang mi phod sdod mi tshugs/ /nged bu slob rnams kyis ji ltar bya/ /mas bu chung bskyur nas song tsa na/ /mig mchi mas gang nas ngu ba bzhin/ /mgon khyod dang 'bral glags mi phod rung / /gdong mchi mas gang bzhin 'bral dgos byung / /dpe bu chung shul du lus na yang / /ma dran nas yang yang 'bod pa ltar/ /nged bu slob shul du lus rnams kyis/ /rje dran bzhin gsol ba yang yang 'debs/ /ma bzang mo ri la phyin na yang / /bu mi brjed sems kyis dran pa ltar/ /mgon khyod ni sa phyogs gar phebs kyang / /nged thams cad brtse ba'i thugs kyis skyongs/ /mar 'khor ba'i mtsho las sgol mkhan gyi/ /rje mnyan pa bzang bo bde bar phebs/ /yar thar pa'i sa lam ston mkhan gyi/ /rje ded dpon chen po bde bar phebs/ /nang nyon mongs dug lnga'i nad sel ba'i/ /rje sman 648

pa'i rgyal po bde bar phebs/ /nor yod dgu byin nas ngan dgu skyong / /rje chos kyi rgyal po bde bar phebs/ /sku'i bkod pa gdul bya yongs la snang / /rje lha dbang brgya byen bde bar phebs/ /gsung tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyis chos sgra sgrog /rje tshangs pa'i dbang bo bde bar phebs/ /thugs gsal stong ngang nas chos kun gzigs/ /rje kun mkhyen sangs rgyas bde bar phebs/ /dus da dung 'di phyi bar do ru/ /zhal yang dang yang du mjal bar shog /rje gang du bzhugs pa'i zhing khams der/ /nged bu slob thams cad skye bar shog /ces phul grub pa dang / bdag gis kun la bsngo ba dang bkra shis rgyas par byas nas/ ma 'ongs pa na dpon slob kun dag pa'i zhing nas mjal ba'i mtshams sbyor smon lam gyi glu 'di blangs so//'di phyi bar do yi skyel ma/ /skyabs mgon yid bzhin gyi nor bu/ /'bral med spyi gtsug tu bzhugs la/ /byen rlabs dngos grub kyi char phob/ /stod smad bar gsum nas 'ongs pa'i/ /rang re dpon slob kyi tshogs rnams/ /da ni so so ru gyes tshe/ /skyo ba rang shugs kyis skyes byung / /gangs stod mthon po la 'phyo ba'i/ /dar seng dkar mo yi tshogs rnams/ /g.yu ral legs po de ngom bzhin/ /gangs stod de 649

ka ru bzhugs shig /de la lan cig tsam 'khor ba'i/ /drang srong thang dkar gyi rgod po/ /gangs la phyi mig rang lta bzhin/ /thag ring sa phyogs la chas 'gro /gangs ri'i phyogs bzhi na gnas pa'i/ /mched lcam bu slob kyi tshogs rnams/ /dge sbyor gong 'phel du gtong bzhin/ /gnas chen 'di ka ru bzhugs shig /de la lan cig tsam 'ongs pa'i/ /bya btang tshogs drug ni rang grol/ /gang la'ang dag snang rang sbyong bzhin/ /thag ring rgyal khams la chas 'gro /phyi nas gnas tshul 'dra go yang / /dngos su mjal rgyu zhig mi 'ong / /mjal ba da lan tsam yin pas/ /snying gtam sems la rang zhog dang / /da nas mjal rgyu zhig med rung / /skye ba 'di nyid kyi 'og tu/ /shar phyogs mngon dga' yi zhing nas/ /mjal ba'i smon lam rang 'tshal lo/ /zhes blangs pas/ der 'tshogs pa'i grwa bu slob phal cher gyi mig nas mchi ma byung / kun gye smra ba rnams chag nas yud tsam lus pa byung / de nas kun gyis bdag rdzong mdo bar du skyel thung mdzad mthar sa de ru phyag 'tshal skor ba byas nas bsdad song / ngas kyang skabs rer phyi mig lta bzhin 'ong / kun nga mthong rag gi bar du bsdad nas/ mthar snga phyi rim pa byas rang rang gi gnas su song ngo / /gangs ri 650

nas thon te de'i thag nye gang zag pa dang / bar kha rta zam du 'gro don la song ba'i mtshan mo rmi lam du mtsho chen po la gru btang nas 'gro ba dang / mi gtsang ba'i thang chen po la rta zhon nas 'gro ba sogs/ 'dod yon longs spyod mang po 'ongs pa'i rmi lam sna tshogs pa rmis pa byung / de nas rtse brgyad dgon pa dang / 'go pa rin chen gyi skor/ gnyal la phyug po'i skor/ rdo chu'i dgon pa/ pre ta pu ri/ khyung lung dgon bar du gnas mjal dang 'gro don sbrags ma la song /gnas rten rnams la mjal mchod 'bul byas/ yon bdag rnams la chos bshad pas/ 'go pa rin chen nas dngul srang bzhi bcur 'gro ba'i gzims gur chen po gcig dang / gser zho lnga phul/ gzhan yon bdag rnams kyis gser dngul lus gos rgyan cha sogs zas nor longs spyod mang po phul/ de nas phyir 'ong / ma pham g.yu mtsho'i 'gram gyi gad pa gser gyi bya skyibs dgon/ bon ri dgon/ ser ra lung dgon/ bon mo phug gi dgon pa rnams la mjal/ 'gyed mang ja btang /mchod 'bul byas smon lam btab/ de nas 'brog pa hor stod pa kha shas dang rong phyogs kyi gli mi ru song / der rong shel mo gangs kyi yon bdag mang po mjal du 'ong ba la chos 651

bshad pas kun gyi snang ba chos la 'gyur zas gos mang po 'bul mkhan byung / yang rong lho ngos phyug po dang / spu trengs stod smad bar gsum la rim gyis song nas/ grwa bu slob yon bdag brgya stong du ma la/ tshe dbang dang thugs rje chen po'i dbang / yi dam lha'i bskyed rdzogs kyi lung khrid dang /gzhan yang gang la gang 'tshams kyi chos mang po bshad dus/thog mar chos kyi snod rung du rdor sems bsgom bzlas dang / slob ma rnams kyi spyi bor bla ma sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang gi rnam par bsgoms nas byin rlabs byas te/ de nas thun mong gi chos bshad kyang 'di ltar byas so/ /'o de yang ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du 'thob bya bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che ci nas kyang myur ba myur du thob par bya/ de'i phyir du dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i 'di'i drung nas chos zab mo gsan nas/ phyin chad nyams su blang bar bgyi'o snyam pa'i bsam pa bzang po'i sgo nas gsan dgos te/ de yang rgyude rdo rje rtse mo las/ rtog pa thams cad legs par bsdus nas ni/ /shin tu bsam pa bzang po ldan pas nyon/ /zhes dang / tshoms las/ gnyid rmugs le lo rnams spongs la/ /rab tu dga' ba 652

bskyed de nyon/ /zhes dang / skyes rabs las/ nad pas sman pa'i tshig nyan bzhin/ /rim gro bāskyed la chos nyon cig /ces gsungs pa ltar/ sems kyi kun slong bzang po dang / lus kyi kun spyod kyang rab tu gus pa'i sgo nas gsan par 'tshal/ de yang 'o skol rnams kyis da res dal 'byor gyi gru bo che 'di rnyed pa'i dus 'dir/ 'jigs rung 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho chen po 'di las thar pa zhig bya dgos/ de'i rgyu mtshan gang yin zhe na/rang re rnams kyi sngon gyi dge ba'i mthu zhig la brten nas stabs ka yag pa tsam zhig 'phrod de/ da res mi lus rin po che thob/ dbang bo sgo lnga tshang / smra bsam dbang dang ldan/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis zin/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa dang mjal/chos byed dbang yod/ byed thabs shes pa'i dus 'dir 'khor ba las thar nges pa'i chos rnam dag cig ma byas na/phyis 'di lta bu'i rten shin tu rnyed par dka' zhing chos dang mjal ba yang shin tu dkon te/ sangs rgyas kyi zhal nas/'jig rten khams ni grangs mang yang / /'dzam gling sog khar skye ba dkon/ /gtsang ma'i mi lus ni shin tu dka'/ /zhes dang / rnam snang mngon byang las/ 'jig rten du na kun mkhyen dag /u duspra ra'i me tog bzhin/ /brgya lam nang na 653

re 'ga' zhig /'byung 'gyur yang ni mi 'byung ste/ /gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul 'di ni/ /de bas kyang ni dkon pa'o/ /zhes dang / rje bdag nyid chen pos/ mi yi lus dang bstan dang mjal ba ni/ /yang yang mi rnyed da res tsam lags shing / /'di na don chen sgrub pa'i gnas yod pas/ /tshul 'di soms la mi lus snying bo longs/ /zhes dang / kun mkhyen klong chen rab 'byams pas/ dal 'byor 'di ni thob pa brgya lam tsam/ /de bas chos dang 'phrad pa nyin skar tsam/ /theg mchog chos dang mjal ba srid mtha' tsam/ /snying nas dam pa'i chos shig mdzad re ran/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin chos shig byed dgos/ gal te ma byas na ded dpon rgya mtsho'i gling du phyin nas lag stong du 'ongs pa las kyang ches shin tu blun te/ srog ma chad kyang ro/ 'dres ma khyer kyang smyon pa yin te/ dper na rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i bum pa zhig mi gtsang ba kha lud dang bshang gci la sogs pa'i snod byed pa las kyang ches shin tu blun te/ bshes springs las/gang zhig gser snod rin chen spras pa yis/ /mi gtsang phyags dar phyed pa de bas ni/ /gang zhig mi ru skyes nas sdig pa'i las/ /bgyid pa de ni ches rab blun pa nyid/ /ces gsungs/654

de lta bu'i blun po tha chad rnams kyis phyin chad thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam rnyed pa phar zhog ngan song gsum gyi g.yang du lhung nas/ bskal pa bye ba mang po'i bar du bde 'gro'i sgra tsam yang thos par mi 'gyur te/ spyod 'jug las/ dge ba dag kyang ma byas la/ /sdig pa dag kyang nyer bas/gas pas/ /bskal pa bye ba brgyar yang ni/ /bde 'gro'i sgra yang thos mi 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs/ des na tshe 'di'i lto gos cung zad re'i phyir sdig bsags nas/ phyi mar bde 'gro'i sgra tsam yang mi thos par byed pa'i mi de las blun pa zhig 'jig rten gye khams 'di na med de/ spyod 'jug las/ 'di 'dra'i dal ba rnyed gyur nas/ /bdag gis dge goms ma byas na/ /'di las bslus pa'ang gzhan med cing / /'di las rmongs pa'ang gzhan med do/ /gsungs/ de lta bu'i blun po tha chad kyi sdig can de 'chi ba'i dus su sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi snying rje ba'i gnas su 'gyur te/ slob dpon chen pos/ dal 'byor 'di ni shin tu rnyed par dka'/ /'chi bdag nad kyis nye bar btab pa'i tshe chos med stong log mkhan rnams snying re rje/ /gsungs/ des na pho mo mdo don che chung kyang chos yod med kyi steng nas 'byed 655

dgos te/ pha dam pa'i zhal nas/ snying rus med pa'i mi la sangs rgyas dkon/ /dka' ba dang du longs shig ding ri ba/ /da lta mi khom khom dus nam zhig 'ong / /dus brgya za ma gcig yin ding ri ba/ /pho mo mdo don che chung da res shes/ /tshe la stong log ma byed ding ri ba/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin du tshe 'dir chos kyi yul dbus su skyes nas tshe phyi mar stong log tu mi 'gro bar/ pho spyang grung 'dzom pa rnams kyis da res mi lus rin po che 'di dam pa'i chos kyi sgo nas don dang bcas pa nom pa dang bcas pa zhig byed 'tshal/ de yang ga le sos dal du byas na chog gam snyam na mi chog ste/ de yi rgyu mtshan/ rang re rnams kyis mi lus rin po che thob kyang yun ring mi sdod par 'chi ba yin te/ sangs rgyas kyi zhal nas/ skye ba yod na 'chi ba yod/ /dar ba yod na rgud pa yod/ /lang tsho de yang mi rtag ste/ /dar ba'i mdog kyang nad kyis 'phrog /'tsho ba'i tshe yang 'chi bas 'phrog /rtag pa'i chos ni gang yang med/ /ces dang /slob dpon chen pos/ mi rtag blo gtad med par ma shes na/ /da dung 'khor ba 'di la zhen cing chags/ /skyid 'dod ngang la mi tshe sdug gis 'da'/ /yengs ma lam la dal 'byor mi tshe zad/ /'chi ga'i nad pa snum zad mar me 'dra/ /tshe yi 656

'phel rkyen zad pas bsdad dbang med/ /ces gsungs pa bzhin skyes phan chad ma shi bar tshe thar du lus pa'i sems can gcig tsam yang med la/ yod dam med dam snyam pa'i the tshom gyi blo 'jug pa tsam yang mi srid pa yin te/ slob dpon rta dbyangs kyi zhal nas/ sa 'am 'on te mtho ris na/ /skyes nas gang zhig ma shi ba/ /'ga' zhig khyod kyis mthong ba'am/ /thos sam 'on te the tshom za/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin du/ che ba dge ba'i bshes gnyen nas/ bzang ba sa bdag rgyal po yan chad/ phyug po 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po nas ltogs pa slong sprang yan chad chung ngu ma las skyes 'phral nas/ rgan po lo lon lo brgyad cu man chad/ 'chi bdag gi dbang du ma song ba gcig kyang med la/ de yang rang re rnams kyi yul mi grong ba/rgas pa'i pha ma/ skyes pa'i bu tsha/ 'dza' ba'i gnyen bshes/phal che bas tshe 'dir sdod gshom mang du byas kyang / 'chi bdag bdud po kho byung tshe/ sdod dbang skad cig tsam yang ma byung bar/ tshe phyi ma'i yul la chos med lag stong du song ba rnams soms dang / 'o skol rnams kyang de'i rang bzhin las ma 'das/ de yang deper na gsod sar 'khrid pa'i sems can gyis gom pa spos pa ltar/ lo zla zhag dang snga dro phyi dro tsam 65 7

gyis 'chi bdag bdud po 'jigs su rung ba'i kha nang du thag je nye je nyer 'gro ba yin te/ tshoms las/ dper na nges par gsod pa dag /gom pa gang dang gang bor ba/ /gsod pa'i drung du bsnyegs pa ltar/ /mi rnams tshe yang de bzhin no/ /zhes dang / bu mo sa le 'od kyis/ tshe sngon bsod nams bsags pa'i mthus/ /dus lan cig thob pa'i mi lus 'di/ /lo dang zla bas rgyab nas ded/ /zhag dang za mas mdun nas khrid/ /skad cig mi 'dod 'chi la nye/ /bsam zhing bu mo blo ma bde/ /des na dam pa'i lha chos byed/ /ces gsungs la/ 'chi bar nges kyang nam 'chi la nges pa med de/ dus de ring yang kha bkrag yal le ba/ phyi dro dgong kha 'am/ sang gnangs lta bu la yang ro nag thul le byung ba grangs med de/ de rnams la sang gnangs nga 'chi bsam pa zhig med kyang / 'byung bzhi'i lus 'di la blo gtad zan rdog cig za ba'i yun tsam yang med la/ dbugs rlangs pa tsam/ drod me stag tsam pa 'di skad cig la 'chad nyen yod pas/ chos lo snga ma phyi ma gnyis kyi snga ma/ de ring nangs par gnyis kyi de ring yin yang chos byed rgyu'i skal ba byung na byed pa'i dus yin la/ sdod pa'i dus ma yin te/ rgyal ba skal bzang rgya mtsho'i zhal nas/ dus da nangs dgra 'dul 658

gnyen skyong gi /gros byed dus lus bde sems kyang rgod/ /dgong srod la babs tshe dur khrod du/ /lus bya khyes za ba cang bden nam/ /zhes dang / spyod 'jug las/ de ring kho na mi 'chi zhes/ /bde bar 'dug pa rigs ma yin/ /zhes dang /tshoms las/ sang dang 'jig rten phyi ma gnyis/ /sngon du gang 'ong gtol med pas/ /sang gi rtsis la mi 'bad par/ /phyi ma'i don la 'bad par rigs/ /gsungs/ 'chi ba'i dus la bab pa'i tshe/ dam pa'i chos ma gtogs gzhan tshe 'dir rang gis brtsigs pa'i khang khyem/ bsags pa'i nor rdzas/ 'grogs pa'i gnyen 'brel/ bu dang chung ma 'khor dang longs spyod kyi rigs gang gis kyang phan pa med de/ 'jam dpal rnam par rol ba las/ pha ma khyod kyi skyabs ma yin/ /mdza' bshes rtsa lag rnams kyang min/ /de dag gis ni khyod bor nas/ /rang nyid gcig pur phyi mar 'gro /zhes dang / slob dpon chen pos/ sman pa'i rgyal po dngos su byon gyur kyang / /tshe yi 'phen zad srog la mthud mi shes/ /dbang po che yi khrims la gtug tu med/ /smra mkhas can gyis yus shags 'debs su med/ /mi 'theb yod pas blus ma btang du med/ /zas nor bro zan gcig dang 'grogs dbang med/ /mar gyi dkyil nas spu 659

bton bzhin du 'gro /zhes gsungs pa bzhin du 'chi ba'i dus la bab pa'i tshe/ stobs dang mnga' thang 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po tsam zhig yod kyang / rang la phan pa rdul tsam yang med/ nor dang longs spyod rnam thos sras kyi 'byor ba lta bu yod kyang til 'bru tsam yang 'khyer dbang ni med/ pha ma gnyen bshes grogs mched mang pos mtha' bskor yang gcig kyang 'khrid dbang med/ mar gyi dkyil nas spu bton pa bzhin/rgyus med cha med kyi bar do'i 'phrang ring bo la/ skyabs med mgon med du rang nyid gcig pur 'gro dgos pa'i dus shig nges par 'byung la/ byung ba tsam du ma zad bar do'i 'khrul snang 'jigs skrag drag po bsam gyis mi khyab/ brjod kyis mi lang ba myong bar 'gyur la/ de'i dus su yang / phan pa dam pa'i chos dang 'dren mkhan bla ma dkon mchog ma gtogs tshe 'di'i rgyu nom pa gnyen mdza' bshes gang gis kyang phan pa med la/ de tsam du ma zad las dang nyon mongs dbang gis slar yang khams gsum 'khor ba'i gnas 'dir 'khor phyin chad sdug bsngal ma gtogs bde ba'i go skabs skad cig tsam yang med de/ de yang dmyal bar skyes na tsha grang gi sdug bsngal bzod dka'/ yi dwags su skyes na bkres skom gyi sdug bsngal 660

nyam thag dud 'gro'i gnas su skyes na gsod za bkol spyod glen rmongs kyi sdug bsngal yi mug mi yi nang du skyes na skye rga na 'chi'i sdug bsngal ngu bro/ lha ma yin du skyes na 'thab rtsod kyi sdug bsngal ya nga / lha'i gnas su skyes na yang 'chi 'pho ltung ba'i sdug bsngal sogs bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ dran pa nyer bzhag las/ sems can dmyal ba dmyal mes nyams/ /dud 'gro gcig la gcig zos nyams/ /yi dwags bkres shing skom pas nyams/ /mi rnams 'tsho ba thung bas nyams/ /lha min 'thab cing rtsod pas nyams/ /lha dag bag med pa yis nyams/ /'khor ba khab kyi rtse tsam na/ /bde ba nam yang yod ma yin/ /zhes dang / slob dpon chen pos/ thar med las kyi grong khyer drug po der/ /gcig nas gcig tu zo chun khyud mo bzhin/ /mtha' med 'khor ba'i 'gro rnams snying re rje/ /zhes dang / lho brag mar pas/ bu yis 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal soms/ /'khor ba'i rang bzhin 'di 'dra zhes/ /bdag gis lce brgyar rab sprul nas/ /bskal pa bye ba bsam yas su/ /bshad kyang brjod kyis mi lang bas/ /ngas bshad dam chos chud ma zon/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal bshad na brjod mi lang bas/ mdor na khams gsum 'khor ba 661

'di'i nang gi mtho dman gang du skyes kyang sdug bsngal gyi gnas/ su dang 'grogs kyang sdug bsngal gyi grogs/ ci la longs spyad kyang sdug bsngal gyi longs spyod/ bya ba ci byas kyang sdug bsngal bsgrub pa'i thabs 'ba' zhig las mi 'dug pas/nag can btson dong nas bros pa ltar/ da res 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las nyon gyi rba klong chen po drag tu 'khrug cing / sdug bsngal gsum gyi chu srin 'jigs su rung bas gang ba 'di las thar pa zhig bya dgos/ de yang rang nyid gcig pu thar pa tsam gyis mi chog par sems can thams cad kyang tshe rabs sngon ma'i drin can gyi pha ma yin pas 'di dag rnams kyang 'khor ba las bsgral dgos/ de yang rang nyid 'khor ba las thar nas sems can rnams kyang 'khor ba las sgrol ba la/thog mar rang nyid skyon kun zad yon tan kun ldan yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che 'thob dgos/ de 'thob pa'i thabs su sngon sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis chos kyi sgo mo mtha' yas pa gsungs kyang / mdor bsdu na/ so so thar pa'i mdo las/ sdig pa ci yang mi bya zhing / /dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyad/ /rang gi sems ni yongs su 'dul/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin/ /zhes 662

gsungs pa bzhin sdig pa spangs nas dge ba bsgrub dgos/ de yang mi dge ba ni/ rang phyogs la chags pa dang / gzhan phyogs la sdang ba dang / mi shes gti mug ste/ dug gsum gang rung gi dbang gis/ sems can gzhan gyi srog gcod pa/ ma byin pa len pa/ mi tshangs par spyod pa/ rdzun phra ma tshig rtsub ngag 'khyal/ brnab sems gnod sems log lta ste/ mi dge ba bcu po 'di rang gis byed pa dang / gzhan la byed du 'jug pa dang / byas pa la rjes su yi rang ba tsam yang mi byed par dug bzhin du spang bar bya'o/ /sdig pa chung ngu yang ma spangs na khong du dug song ba bzhin/ sdug bsngal rgya chen po bskyed de/tshoms las/sdig pa chung ngu byas pas kyang / /'jig rten pha rol 'jigs chen dang / /phung khrol chen po byed 'gyur te/ /khong bar song ba'i dug bzhin no/ /gsungs/ des na sngar byas kyi sdig pa bshags pa dang / phyin chad sdom sems byed pa gal che ste/ dper na snga dro dug zos pa phyi dro sman btang na 'tsho ba bzhin du/ bshags sdom byas na sdig pa dag nas/ sdig can rnams la yang mtho ris thar par bgrod pa'i skal ba yod pas kun gyis ma shi gong der rig pa bsgrims nas bshags sdom la 'bad 'tshal/ de ltar mi dge ba spangs nas dge ba bsgrub 663

dgos pa'i dge ba de gang yin snyam na/ sems can thams cad skye ba sngon ma'i drin can gye pha ma ru bsams nas/ sgo rtsa ru 'ong ba'i ngan slong sogs sdug bsngal can rnams la snying rje dang / bde ba med pa rnams la byams pa dang / sems can gyi sdug bsngal bsal nas bde ba la 'god pa'i phyir sangs rgya bar bya/ de'i ched du bdag gis dam pa'i chos bya'o snyam du/byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems kyi sgo nas sems can gzhan gyi srog skyob pa/ ma chags par sbyin pa gtong ba/ sdom pa bsrung ba/ bden par smra ba/ mi mthun pa bsdums pa/ gtam 'jam par smra ba/ gzhan gyi yon tan brjod pa/ chog shes pa/gzhan la byams pa/ las rgyu 'bras la yid ches pa ste/ dge ba bcu dang / gzhan yang phyag 'tshal ba/ skor ba bya ba/ sku gsung thugs kyi rten bzhengs pa/ bka' bklags pa/ mchod pa 'bul ba/ tshig don 'dzin pa/ gzhan la 'chad pa/ tshig don la rtog cing dpyod pa/ yang dag pa'i don la mnyam par 'jog pa sogs rnam dkar dge ba'i las rang gis byed pa dang / gzhan la byed du 'jug pa dang / gzhan gyis byas pa la rjes su yi rang bar bya'o/ /de ltar dge ba chung ngu nas bsgrubs kyang chu yi thigs pas bum pa gang ba bzhin rim gyis 664

sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang 'thob par 'gyur te/ sdud pa las/ chu yi thigs pas bum pa dang po tha ma'i bar/ rim gyis nyung ngu nyung ngus de yongs gang ba ltar/ de bzhin dang po byang chub sems kyi rgyu yin te/ rim gyis dkar po'i yon tan rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'gyur gsungs/ des na dge ba gang bsgrubs kyang dpa' mi zhum par dpa' bo g.yul la 'jug 'jug bar mtshams med pa mgal me'i 'khor lo bskor bskor/ rgyun chad med pa chu bo gaṅgā'i rgyun ltar gyis dang / tshe 'dir yang bde zhing phyi mar skyid la/ nam phugs sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang 'thob par 'gyur zhes gdul bya so so rang rang gi blo kha dang 'tshams pa'i rgyal ba'i bka' dang bla ma'i gsung rnams slar tshigs su bcad nas dbyangs su blangs pa ni 'di ltar ro//na mo gu ru/ ston pa thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag gzhan rjes 'jug yongs la thugs rjes gzigs/ /mgon po khyed kyi rnam thar zin pa dang / /gsung bzhin bsgrub par nus par byin gyis rlobs/ /rnam 'dren bzhi pa ston pa sangs rgyas kyi/ /skye ba snga phyi'i rnam thar mtha' yas kyang / /bsdu na dang po byams dang snying rje bsgoms/ /smon 'jug byang chub mchog tu thug bskyed nas/ /bar du rang don thams cad 665

yal bar dor/ /ma gyur 'gro ba'i don la 'bad pa'i mthus/ /tha ma myur du mngon par sangs rgyas nas/ /da lta 'gro kun gtsug gi rgyan du gyur/ /ston pa thugs rje can gyi rnam thar bzhin/ /ma gyur 'gro la byams dang snying rje'i sgos/ /smon 'jug byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas/ /khe dang rgyal kha thams cad gzhan la byen/ /gyong dang pham kha thams cad rang gis longs/ /ston pas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba rnams/ /rgyas par phye na bsam gyis mi khyab kyang / /bsdu na mi dge spangs nas dge ba bsgrubs/ /rang rgyud nyon mongs thul zhes gsungs pas na/ /ston pa thugs rje can gyi zhal gsung bzhin/ /srog gcod ma byen len dang mi tshangs spyod/ /dzun dang phra ma tshig rtsub ngag 'khyal dang / /brnab sems gnod sems log par lta ba ste/ /mi dge sdig pa bcu po dug bzhin spongs/ /sems can gzhan gyi srog skyob sbyin pa thongs/ /sdom pa bsrung zhing bden par smra ba dang / /'khon pa bsdums shing gtam rnams 'jam por spros/ /gzhan gyi yon tan brjod cing chos shes bya//'gro la byams shing las 'bras yid ches bskyed/ /rnam dkar dge ba bcu po dang du longs/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug nga rgyal dang / /phrag dog ser sna la sogs rang 666

rgyud la/ /nyon mongs gang skyes gnyen pos ci thul gyis/ /bya btang rnal 'byor tshogs drug rang grol gyis/ /ston pa thugs rje can gyi rnam thar dang / /gsung rab mdor bsdus glu ru blangs pa 'di/ /thos tshad rnams kyi rgyud la phan par shog /ces pa la sogs pa'i mgur dbyangs rnam pa sna tshogs blangs/khyad par sems can thams cad skye ba sngon ma'i drin can gyi pha ma yin pas na/ sdig zas pha ma'i sha khrag 'di'i don du srog gcod pa gtan nas byed mi rung zhes nan tan byas bshad pas phyug po thams cad kyis sdig rgyun bcad/ phyin chad srog mi gcod pa'i dam bca' phul/ ra lug 'bri g.yag mang po'i tshe thar ba byung / yul mi thams cad tshogs nas tshogs brgya btang / ston mo rgya chen po byas te mthar glu 'di 'dra gtong bar gda'/ skyabs mgon yid bzhin nor bu/ /rin chen khri la bzhugs dang / /glu dang gar gyi mchod pa/ /spyan gyis gzigs sar phul yong / /po ta la yi rtse na/ /rgyal ba yab sras bzhugs yod/ /skor ba lan gsum gyis dang / /lus kyi sgrib pa dag yong / /g.yu thog zam pa'i steng nas/ /rgyal ba'i chibs kha bsgyur song / /zam pa'i 'og gi nya mo/ /ngan song myong dgos mi 'dug /dga' dga' 'dra la gangs dkar rtse la nyi ma shar 667

yod/ gcig gnyis gsum/ skyid skyid 'dra la mtsho mo'i kha la dar kha chags song / bzhi lnga drug dga' skyid 'dzom byung dpag bsam shing la lo 'dab 'khrungs yod/bdun brgyad dgu byas zhabs bro mang po brgyab byung / yang 'ga' res/ longs spyod chang la byas rung / /chang la 'dzad rgyu mi 'dug /sgo yi ya them yan chad/ /sngon mo nas kyi bang mdzod/ /phyi ma lha lus thob kyang / /yon chab chu las mi 'dug /da lta mi lus thob dus/ /dga' dga' spro spro gyis dang / /'jig rten 'khor ba 'di la/ /bsam na snying po mi 'dug /skyabs mgon yid bzhin nor bus/ /skra phud bzhes rogs gnang dang / /dga' dga' 'dra la gangs dkar rtse la nyi ma shar yod ces sngar ltar zhabs bro 'khrab/ gzhan yang sa gzhi lha mo sa gzhi lha mo zer ba sogs glu gar mi 'dra ba rnam pa sna tshogs pa zla ba mang po'i bar du byas pas/ rgan gzhon thams cad nyams dga' snang ba spro bas bde skyid lha dang 'gran pa byung / zas nor longs spyod char ltar babs/ de yang gli mi rdo rje dbang phyug gis gser zho lnga bcu/ lho ngos phyug po mas gser zho bco lnga/ log pa phyug po/rgya zhang phyug po/ skyid thang dmag dpon la sogs pa'i spu hrengs kyi phyug po rnams kyis gser zho bco lnga nyi shu sum cu re 668

dang / med pos kyang gser zho gnyis gsum res 'go byas lus kyi gos rgyan nor rdzas gang yod rnams phul ba'i gser kho na rta rgyab gcig byung / gser gyi ṭaṃ ka sum cu/ dngul gye ga'u che chung brgya/ dngul gye maṇ+ḍal che chung lnga/ dngul kong gnyis/ gtor snod gsum/ mu tig dang bye ru'i rna rgyan brgyad cu/ g.yu bye ru spos shel gyi mgo rgyan rkyal ba gang / gos chen dang mgo snam gyi gon pa gsar ba bzhi bcu rtsa gsum/ rnying ba bcu/ rta bzang po nyi shu rtsa lnga/ dre'u gnyis/ gzhan yang dngul gyi ṭaṃ ka 'ja'u/ snam bu/ ras dang kha btags grangs kyis mi zin pa 'bul mkhan byung / de'i lo de las nor longs spyod che ba dang / skyid pa zhig chung ma las skyes nas ma byung /rgyu nom pa de rnams kyi nang nas/ dgon pa bshad 'phel gling gi 'du khang steng la/ gser zho bdun brgya'i rgyu song yod pa'i gser zangs kyi rgyal mtshan chen po gnyis/ gañji ra gciga'akhor lo chen po rtsibs stong can ri dwags pho mo dang bcas pa btsugs/ na4du dngulo rdo tshad mang po'i rgyu song yod pa'i mar me rgyun sbar bye dadrel kong chen po gsum/ gos chen rgyan bzhi mdog mi 'dra ba'i ka ring gi 'phan ring po gnyis/ stong mchod 'bularasnod rag kong stong phrag gcig bzhag dngul 669

srang stong gi rtsis kyi rgyu nom pas spyi 'jog byas/ 'gyed mang ja btang / mkhan po la 'jigs byed kyi dbang zhus/ gser la sogs pa'i 'bul ba chen po btegs pas thugs mnyes pa byung / spu hrengs mkho chags jo bo dngul sku mched gsum la gnod pa'i chu la rdo'i rag chen po rgyag pa'i 'go pa sde ba dbang pos byas/ rdo chen po phyogs phyogs nas shing rtar drangs te zla ba gnyis la brgyab pas/ de nas bzung chus gnod pa ma byung /jo sku rnam gsum gyi zhabs tog gi mchog tu gyur/ steng la gser zangs kyi rgyal mtshan gnyis 'dzugs pa'i nang du gser zho bcu'i zhal 'debs byas/ rag gi kong bu dang khro zangs chen po'i nang du mar khus rgya mtsho bskyil/ stong mchod rgya chen po phul nas smon lam btab/ rjes su bu chen rig 'dzin o rgyan rnam rgyal gyis jo bo mched gsum la phyag mtshan pad+ma phul/de'i rjes su khams pa sprul skus dngul 'jangs brdungs kyi glegs ral phul/ de'i rjes su bu chen sbyin pa nor bu la gser zho sum brgya'i mchod kong phun sum tshogs pa zhig 'bul du bcug de'i lo dgun thog der bshad 'phel gling gi bka' 'gyur lha khang du bsdad/ bka' 'gyur dang bstan 'gyur rje yab sras sogs kyi gsung 'bum la bltas/ sngon byung ston pa'i 670

rnam thar phyis 'byung rjes 'jug rnams kyis nyams len du 'khyer tshul dang / ston pa'i gsung bzhin chos dang 'jig rten gyi lugs gnyis kyi spang blang bya tshul ngo mtshar ba'i gtam rgyud mang po dang sbyar nas bshad pa ngo mtshar sprul pa'i glegs bam zhes bya ba brtsams/ khong rnam pas 'tsho ba zhabs tog legs po byas/ 'gro khar gzhung gi spyi thog nas lus chas cha tshang /rta sga stan srab gsum/ gser zho brgya dang brgyad phul/gzhan grwa pa phyug po rnams kyi nang du bos/ gser zho drug bdun byas gser mang po 'bul mkhan byung / lo rjes ma'i dbyar kha spu hrengs kyi slob ma sbyin bdag mang pos skyel ma byas yar song dus/ dbus lho kha'i phyogs na bzhugs pa'i bla ma skal ldan dang / la dwags mkhan po/ bstan 'dzin nyi ma/ chos mdzad skal bzang tshul khrims/ rig grol rnams dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing nas yar 'ongs pa dang spu hrengs stod kyi dkar dung nas mjal/ la dwags mkhan pos tshe blos btang nas ri khrod 'grim rgyu byas/ dngul rdo tshad lnga/ gos chen kha dog mi 'dra ba mang po phul/ ming la bya btang rin chen zhes btags/bsngo ba smon lam rgya chen po btab/ grub dbang skal ldan nas dngul rdo tshad gcig kha btags nang mdzod mang po dang /671

gzhan rnams kyis kyang de'i cha 'dra phul nas/ khyon bsdoms rdo tshad bdun gyi rtsis byung / de'i nang nas dngul srang brgya tham pa spu hrengs bshad 'phel gling gi spyi 'jog tu bzhagagazhan rnams dga' ldan gser kong gi zhal 'debs byas/nged dpon slob yon mchod thams cad lhan du ma pham g.yu mtsho'i 'gram khrus sgo lho ru song / nyi ma mang por bsdad/ dgon pa la 'gyed phogs mang ja btang / g.yu bye ru spos shel mang pos sbyor 'jags byas/ bkra shis g.yang 'khyil ma pham g.yu mtsho chen mo'i nang du/ 'bru sna dang rin po che sna tshogs pas bkang ba'i bum pa nyi shu rtsa bdun tsam phul nas/ rgyal khams la char chu dus su 'bab cing lo phyugs rtag tu legs pa'i 'dod gsol dang smon lam gyis mtshams sbyor byas te/ 'gram nas khams bsang byas dus su/ dmigs gtad chos med har sang rgya yan bdag gi nyams la shar ba ltar/ skal ldan snying gi slob bu rig 'dzin o rgyan rnam rgyal la 'di skad ces gdams so//thugs dgongs nam mkha' las yangs pa'i kun mkhyen gyi bla ma/ /thugs yid dbyer med du 'dres par byen gyis rang rlobs shig /sgyu ma rmi lam dang 'dra ba'i 'khor 'das kyi chos kun/ /rang sems nam mkha' dang 'dra ba'i rang rtsal du go 672

byung / /'khor 'das chos kun gyi rtsa ba rang sems kyi gnas lugs/ /stong gsal 'dzin med kyi khyab gdal klong yangs su rtogs song / /rtogs mkhan rang rig la bltas kyang nam mkha' dang 'dra bas/ /skye med chos dbyings kyi klong du 'dzin med du grol song / /grol ba de nyid kyi ngang du rgya yan du glod pas/ /spros bral chos sku yi mkha' klong yangs pa ru slebs song / /nam mkha' yangs pa bzhin gu yangs sang nge rang bzhag pas/ /blos byas sdug btsir gyi 'ching ba lhod grol la langs song / /stong sangs mkha' ltar du shar ba'i ngang la rang gnas pa'i/ /smra bsam brjod yul las 'das pa'i dga' ston zhig myang ngo / /mtha' yas mu med kyi stong gsal klong yangs su 'byams nas/ /sems dang nam mkha' la khyad par 'byed rgyu zhig ma byung / /kun khyab nam mkha' las yangs pa'i shes rab kyi mig gis/ /'khor 'das ltad mo 'dra mthong ba'i dga' spro la gzigs dang / /'bad dang rtsol ba yang mi dgos 'od gsal gyi ngang du/ /ngam ngam rang shugs kyis lhod lhod 'gro ba 'di skyid do/ /mi blta snyam na yang gsal stong rjen pa kho mthong byung / /mthong ba nam mkha' bzhin 'gyur ba med pa 'di ngo mtshar/ /lam rtags yon tan ni dngos nyams rmi lam la yong 673

snang / /tshe gcig sangs rgyas ni zer ba yong tshod na gda' 'o/ /ma gyur 'gro ba la snying rje gting nas rang skyes byung / /kha tsam tshig tsam yang min par 'gro don la chas 'gro /don dam gnas lugs kyi ngo bo rang babs su skyong dus/ /'di dang 'di 'dra yi glu dbyangs rang shugs kyis thon song / /skal bzang las 'phro can yod na gnas lugs kyi ngang nas/ /glu dbyangs 'di 'dra rang longs dang nyams rtogs ni 'bar yong / /zhes pa dang / yang mtsho 'gram gyi spang gshong nyams dga' ba zhig tu gcig pur khams bsangs byas yod dus slob bu skal ldan rang grol 'ongs nas/ da lta gzhan su yang mi 'dug pas nyams mgur zhig longs dang zer bas/ rig pa gu yangs yan pa blo bde bdag gi nyams la shar ba ltar mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so//stong gsal 'dzin med kyi thugs ni nam mkha' las yangs shing / /ci yang sa le rang gzigs pa'i sa ra ha mkhyen no/ /lta ba phyogs lhung dang bral ba khyab gdal gyi klong yangs/ /sgom pa bying rgod dang bral ba rig stong gi zang thal/ /spyod pa gza' gtad dang bral ba gu yangs kyi yan pa/ /'bras bu re dogs dang bral ba 'khor 'das kun sems rdzogs/ /rgyu 'bras rtsol 674

sgrub las 'das pa do ha yi lam bzang / /ma bsgoms 'tshang rgya yi gdams pa 'di 'dra la gzigs dang / /rong khung dog sa nas la kha mthon po la bud bzhin/ /gu yangs yan pa nga'i snang ba'i bde zhad la gzigs dang / /mnyam bzhag nam mkha' dang 'dra ba'i lta ba'i ros myos nas/ /'khor 'dis zil gyis rang gnod pa'i lta stangs la gzigs dang / /bde stong ye shes kyi ngang nas 'dod yon la rol bzhin/ /chags med bde nas rang bde bar 'gro ba la gzigs dang / /glu gar rtsed 'jo yi ngang nas lam bzang la bslabs nas/ /'bad med sangs rgyas kyi sa ru 'gro ba la gzigs dang / /skal bzang las 'phro can yod na nga drung du shog dang / /tshe gcig sangs rgyas kyi sa ru dus mnyam du chas 'gro /'chi ba chos sku ru grol ba'i blo gdeng zhig yod pas/ /'chi bdag bdud po kho nam tshod 'ong na yang shog gyis/ /bya btang rnal 'byor nga sa ra ha pa yi bu rgyud/ /nyams kyi rtsal sbyong gi dus su glu dbyangs 'di blangs so/ /phyogs med ri khrod la 'gro ba'i sgom chen pa'i tshogs rnams/ /nyams dga'i rgyang glu 'dra len na 'di 'dra rang longs shog /rig pa nam mkha' bzhin dpangs bstod phyal yas su thongs la/ /khyab gdal klong yangs kyi ngang nas glu dbyangs 'dra 675

longs dang / /bying rmugs gnyid gsum kun sangs nas rang sems kyi gnas lugs/ /gsal ston rjen pa kho ston gnam g.ya' dag bzhin 'char nges/ /zhes blangs pas kho rang gi lta sgom la sngar bas bogs thon pa byung ngo / /de dus khrus sgo lho ru stod mnga' ris phyogs kyi tshe blos btang gi slob ma brgya phrag mang po 'tshogs byung ba la/ phan dang bde ba'i 'byung gnas bstan pa'i bdag po ston pa sangs rgyas dngos dang mtshungs pa'i rje bdag nyid chen pos chos rnams kun gyi snying po bsdus pa lam rim bsdus don nam thugs nyams la shar ba mgur gye tshul du bzhes pas na rje rin po che'i nyams mgur zhes bya bar yongs su grags pa de dang / lam gyi gtso bo rnam gsum/mnyam med jo bo chen po stod mnga' ris nas lam du phebs khar/ lha btsun byang chub 'od kyis zhal gdams zab mo zhig gnang dgos zhes yang yang nan tan byas nas bskul ngor/thos pa tsam gyis kyang nyon mongs pa ri dwags lta bu zil gyis gnod nus pa'i/ snying gtam lhug par smra ba seng ge'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba dang / bka' gdams bla ma gong ma rnams kyi thugs dam gyi mthil byang chub sems dpa' nor bu'i phreng ba dang / grub thob kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba pha dam pa rin po che 676

sgu gshegs khar mdun du bla ma char chen po byon nas/ dam pa rang nyid mkha' spyod du 'byon pa bde ste/ nged shul lus ding ri na yod pa'i hral hrul rnams kyis ci tsug byed na zer zhing bshums pa'i tshe/ pha dam pas ding ri ba rnams la zhal chems su gsungs pa'i ding re brgyad cu pa dang / rgyal ba'i bka' yi ge na gcig yan chad 'dor rgyu med par thams cad gdams par shar ba'i bka' gdams yongs kyi rgyan gcig kha rag sgom chung pa rin po ches rgyal ba'i gsung rab thams cad kyi dgongs don mtha' dag thugs su chud nas/ kha rag gi brag na thugs nyams su bzhes pa'i dus/ gzhan mnyam med po to ba sogs mkhas pa mgu ba bskyed cing / skal bzang gi gdul bya rnams kyi rgyud la phan thogs 'byung ba'i phyir lhag bsam dag pas kun nas bslangs te nyid kyi thugs la mnga' ba sba gsang med par gsal bar yi ger bris pa'i ang yig bdun cu pa dang / phyag na pad+mo'i rnam 'phrul rgyal sras thogs med dpal bzang bos mdo dang dam pa'i gsung rnams dmar khrid lag len du bstan pa'i rgyal sras lag len sum cu pa dang /rgyal ba'i gsung rab mdo rgyud bstan bcos kyi glegs bam las tshur la rang 'dra gnyis par sprul 'dra'i rang gis brtsams chos 677

sprul pa'i glegs bam sogs rnar snyan yid 'bab ngo mtshar khyad 'phags can gyi gdams pa mang po'i lung khrid kyang byas/ 'gro khar tshe blos btang gi slob ma mnga' ris pa yongs la phan pa'i zhal gdams kyang 'di ltar byen no//rgyal ba sras dang bcas la gus phyag 'tshal/ /rgyal ba'i gsung bzhin nus par byen gyis rlobs/ /dal 'byor mi lus rin chen thob dus 'dir/ /thos bsam sgom gsum gyis shig mnga' ris pa/ /dug gsum nyon mongs ches cher 'phel ba'i gnas/ /pha yul rgyab tu spongs shig mnga' ris pa/ /dge sbyor 'phel zhing rig pa dwangs pa'i gnas/ /ri khrod dben pa sten cig mnga' ris pa/ /'chi dus gnyen bshes nor rdzas shul du 'bor/ /tshe 'di blo yis thongs shig mnga' ris pa/ /dug gsum 'phel zhing thos bsam sgom nyams pas/ /grogs ngan myur du spongs shig mnga' ris pa/ /nyes kun zad cing yon tan 'phel 'gyur ba'i/ /bshes gnyen dam pa sten cig mnga' ris pa/ /skyabs gnas bslu ba med pa dkon mchog yin/ /rtag tu skyabs 'gro gyis shig mnga' ris pa/ /ngan song sdug bsngal sdig pa'i 'bras bu yin/ /nam yang sdig pa ma byed mnga' ris pa/ /'khor ba'i gnas na bde ba gang yang med/ /678

thar pa don du gnyer cig mnga' ris pa/ /'gro rnams 'khor ba'i gnas nas 'dren pa'i phyir/ /byang chub sems mchog skyed cig mnga' ris pa/ /rang bde dor nas bdag pas gzhan gces blos/ /bdag gzhan bde sdug rjes shig mnga' ris pa/ /rang gi longs spyod gzhan gyis 'phrog na yang / /de la bsngo ba gyis shig mnga' ris pa/ /gzhan gyis rang mgo gcod kyang sdig pa de/ /rang gi steng du longs shig mnga' ris pa/ /gzhan gyis rang skyon brjod kyang rang nyid kyis/ /de yi yon tan rjod cig mnga' ris pa/ /rang gi bu bzhin bskyangs pas dgra bzhin du/ /blta yang lhag pas brtse dgos mnga' ris pa/ /mang po'i nang nas rang gi mtshang brus kyang / /de la gus pa gyis shig mnga' ris pa/ /gzhan gyis rang la brnyas thabs byed na yang / /rang gi spyi bor khur cig mnga' ris pa ci tsam sdug kyang gzhan gyi sdug bsngal dag /len la zhum pa ma byed mnga' ris pa/ /ci tsam skyid kyang snying po med mthong nas/ /de la khengs pa ma byed mnga' ris pa/ /rgyun du byams dang snying rje'i dmag dpung gis/ /zhe sdang dgra bo thul cig mnga' ris pa/ /'dod yon spyad kyang ngoms med sred pa 'phel/ /chags zhen skyes tshad spongs shig mnga' ris pa /679

chos kun rtsa ba rang sems gdod nas stong / /stong gsal ngang du zhog cig mnga' ris pa / /yid 'ong yul rnams bden med 'ja' tshon 'dra/ /de la zhen chags ma che mnga' ris pa mi 'dod sdug bsngal rmi lam bu shi 'dra/ /de la sdug bsngal ma byed mnga' ris pa/ /sangs rgyas 'thob phyir lus dang longs spyod kun/ /chags med sbyin pa thongs shig mnga' ris pa/ /tshul khrims yon tan kun gyi gzhi rten yin/ /rtag tu tshul khrims srungs shig mnga' ris pa/ /gnod byed dgra yang sngon gyi pha ma yin/ /kun la bzod pa sgoms shig mnga' ris pa/ /yon tan thams cad brtson 'grus byas las 'byung / /chos la brtson 'grus rtsoms shig mnga' ris pa/ /zhi gnas bsgoms na nyon mongs mgo bo non/ /dben par bsam gtan sgoms shig mnga' ris pa/ /lhag mthong bskyed na nyon mongs rtsad nas 'byin/ /shes rab stong nyid sgoms shig mnga' ris pa/ /rgyun du rang gi rgyud la brtag dpyad nas/ /chos min bsam sbyor spongs shig mnga' ris pa/ /theg pa che la zhugs pa'i gang zag gi /nyes pa nam yang ma gleng mnga' ris pa/ /mdza' bshes khyim dang sbyin bdag khyim la sogs/ /nam yang chags par ma byed mnga' ris pa/ /gang zag gzhan gyi yid du mi 'ong ba'i/ /680

tshig rtsub gtan nas spongs shig mnga' ris pa/ /chags sogs nyon mongs dang po skyes ma thag /gnyen pos 'bur 'joms gyis shig mnga' ris pa/ /rgyun du dran dang shes bzhin ldan pa yis/ /gzhan don legs par sgrubs shig mnga' ris pa/ /dge ba ci bsags sangs rgyas go 'phang mchog /'thob pa'i rgyu ru sngos shig mnga' ris pa/ /de ltar byas na gnas skabs kun tu bde/ /mthar thugs sangs rgyas 'thob bo mnga' ris pa /glu 'di thos tshad skye bo pho mo yi/ /blo kha dam pa'i chos la phyogs par shog /ces smras pas der 'tshogs pa thams cad kyi rgyud la rnam dkar gyi bag chags bzhag pas/ dge ba la ngang gis brtson pa'i tshe blos btang gi slob ma ri khrod 'grim mkhan chos dang mthun pa sha stag byung ngo / /nyin gcig bla ma skal ldan gyis gnas skor ba zhig gi kha nas mdo smad kyi rtsa ba'i bla ma 'jam dpal rdo rje can de nyid zhing khams gzhan du gshegs song 'dug ces thos pa bdag la bshad tshe/ sems sdug pa'i shugs kyis 'di skad ces smras so//rtswa mchog drung gi sa gzhi ru/ /'gro mgon sangs rgyas mya ngan 'das/ /mang yul gung thang la kha nas/ /pad 'byung lho nub srin yul bzhud/ /bod kyi yul dbus snye thang nas/ /jo bo 681

mi mngon dbyengs su gzims/ /chu dbar sprul pa'i pho brang nas/ /rje btsun mngon dga'i zhing du phebs/ /ri bo dge ldan dgon pa nas/ /rgyal ba gnyis pa dga' ldan theg /pho brang gru 'dzin gnyis pa nas/ /skyabs mgon sku yi me tog 'thor/ /da ni mdo khams smad nas kyang / /rtsa ba'i bla ma zhing gzhan gshegs/ /kye hud rje btsun nyi ma nub/ /thugs rje'i nyi 'od gang nas 'char/ /dam chos sman gyi sdong po 'gyel/ /nyon mongs nad rnams su yis sel/ /smin byed dbang bzhi'i gangs ri nyil/ /byin rlabs chu rgyun gang nas 'byung / /grol byed khrid kyi gter mdzod stongs/ /skal med dbul ba su yis sel/ /zab rgyas chos kyi rnga chen ral/ /mdo sngags chos sgra su yis sgog /yang zab man ngag dar chen 'gyel/ /snyan brgyud ba dan su yis g.yo/ /mdor na gtsug gi nor bu stor/ /da ni dgos 'dod su la slong / /kye hud long ba thang dkyil lus/ /long khrid byed la 'o dod 'bod/ /dwa phrug bu yis mgo mi thon/ /'don mkhan a ma dran nas ngu / /nya mo chu med skam la lus/ /chu yi phyogs su bltas nas 'phag /skal med 'khor ba'i 'dam du bying / /'dren mkhan rje la gsol ba 'debs/ /mgon khyod zhing khams gar bzhugs kyang / /shul lus bdag 682

la thugs rjes gzigs/ /da ni rgan po 'chi la nye/ /'chi dus byon la lam sna drongs/ /ma 'ongs dag pa'i zhing khams nas/ /mngon sum mjal ba'i smon lam 'debs/ /smon lam de bzhin 'grub pa zhig /rje btsun khyed kyis byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes smre sngags su blangs nas thugs dgongs rdzogs phyir tshogs gsog byas smon lam btab pas rjes su nyin gcib/ yang sems skyo nas mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so//'khor ba'i 'jigs pa las sgol ba'i/ /skyel ma bla ma ni gshegs song / /bdag cag mgon med kyi tshogs rnams/ /mya ngan thang dkyil du lus byung / /rgyun du yun ring du 'grogs pa'i/ /yul mi rgad po rnams shi song / /rgas pa'i a ma yang 'das nas/ /lan cig 'phrad rgyu yang ma byung / /lo zla nyin zhag rnams gar shor/ /ma tshor yad yud la lang song / /don med rnam g.yeng gi ngang nas/ /mi tshe zad pa 'di skyo byung / /dal 'byor mi lus ni thob kyang / /dam pa'i lha chos ni ma byas/ /mched grogs phal cher ni 'das kyang / /mi rtag 'chi ba yang ma dran/ /skra dkar gnyer ma yis non kyang / /rgas pa'i snang ba yang mi 'dug /na rgyu tsha rgyu 'dra byung kyang / /shi 'gro snyam pa yang mi gda'/ /bza' dga' 'thung skyid la dga' 683

ba'i/ /nga dang nga 'dra yi tshogs rnams/ /'chi bdag bdud po kho byung tshe/ /ci 'dra gang 'dra rang mdzad snyam/ /'di dang 'di 'dra yi tshul la/ /skabs re bsam blo 'dra btang tshe/ /kha tsam tshig tsam yang min par/ /skyo shas dbang med du skyes byung / /kye ma mi tshe ni yun thung / /nam 'chi nges pa ni mi 'dug /phyi mar phan nges shig byed na/ /dam pa'i lha chos la 'bungs shig /ces blangs/ de nas grwa bu slob yon bdag pho mo rnams kyis skyel thung byas pa'i sar thams cad 'tshogs su bcug nas/bka' bsgo byen rlabs byas te de nas 'di skad ces smras so//de yang 'o skol rnams skye dka' ba'i gling bzhi'i nang nas mchog tu gyur pa lho 'dzam bu gling zhes bya ba/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs kyis bcags shing byin gyes rlabs pa'i gdul bya'i zhing khams khyad par can du skyes/ /thob par dka' ba'i dal 'byor gyi chos bco brgyad tshang ba'i mi lus rin po che yid bzhin gyi nor las lhag pa 'di thob/ mjal bar dka' ba u dusba ra'i me tog las kyang dkon pa'i phan bde 'byung gnas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che dang mjal/ /'phrad par dka' ba'i nyin mo'i skar ma las kyang dkon pa'i bla ma dge ba'e bshes gnyen dang 'phrad pa'i dus 684

'dir/ dkar po dge ba'i las la 'bad nas/ yar mngon mtho lha mi'i go 'phang nges legs thar pa dang thamus cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang thob pa zhig bya dgos te/ dper na gru yod dus chu chen po las bsgral dgos pa dang / dpa' bo'i dpung tshogs 'dzom dus dgra 'dul dgos pa dang / 'dod 'jo'i ba mo yod dus 'o ma bzho dgos pa dang / cang shes kyi rta mchog yod dus thag ring gi lam du 'gro dgos pa de bzhin du/ 'dir dal 'byor gye mi lus rin po che ni thob/ bla ma dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas dang mjal ba'i dus 'dir/ dam pa'i chos kyi gzhung lam lta bu la brten nas/ mngon mtho lha mi'i go 'phang nges legs thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang mthon por yar yar snyeg tu yod pa 'di a re dga' dang sa re spro snyam du/ tshe 'di'i 'khor 'dabs gnyen 'dun lus longs spyod gang la yang ma chags par da res thar pa'i lam sna zin thabs dam pa'i chos kho na la 'bad dgos te/ gal te ma 'bad na ded dpon rgya mtsho'i gling nas lag stong du phyir 'ong ba las kyang ches shin tu blun te 'dres ma khyer kyang smyon pa/dbugs dang ma bral kyang be+em po yin te/ de bas na bsam blo yod med grung mi grung / spyang mi sbyang / pho rgod mo rgod thams 685

cad da res shes te/ da res mi lus rin po che 'di chud zos dang stong lag tu ma btang bar bla ma dam pa'i gsung bzhin du dam pa'i chos shig byas nas/ 'chi ba'i dus su bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha khyad par can rnams mngon sum du byon nas lam sna drangs te/ dag pa mkha' spyod mngon par dga' ba bde ba can la sogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams rnam par dag pa ru bu pha khyim dang bu mo ma khyim du 'gro ba ltar/ dga' zhing spro la thogs pa med par bgrod pa'i skal ba can zhig byas song na mi de pho grung bo yin/ spyang po yin/ pho rgod po yin/ da res chos shig ma byas pa'i khar bla ma dam pa'i gsung la yang mi nyan par tshe 'dir rang gi lto gos dang bu bu mo sogs kyi don du sdig pa mi dge ba'i las nyin re bzhin bre gsog dang phul gsog byas nas/ nam zhig 'chi ba'i dus su gshin rje'i pho nya mdog mi sdug pa snying rje med pa khro zhing gtum pa mang po byung nas/ zhags nag rke la btags/ mtshon rnon lus la brgyab nas khrid de mar dmyal khams bco brgyad sogs ngan song gsum gyi gnas su nag can btson dong du 'gro ba bzhin 'jigs skrag dang bcas te rang dbang med par 'gro dgos pa zhig byas song na/ mi de skye bo pho mo mchog dman su yin yang 686

mi de'i khog pa na don snying med pa yin/ spyo 'tshab rang che ba yin/ rang gis rang bslus/ rang gis rang mgo bskor/ rang gis rang 'phung ba yin pas/ rin chen gling du phyin nas lag stong du phyir mi 'ong ba ltar da res dam pa'i chos kyi yul dbus su skyes nas chos shig mdzad pa gal che/ de yang myur du brtson pas ma 'bad na/ rang re rnams kyi da res rnyed dka'i mi lus rin po che 'di thob tu zin kyang yun ring mi sdod par 'chi ba yin te/ skyes phan chad ma shi bar tshe thar du lus pa gcig kyang med la/ de yang rang re rnams kyi yul mi grong pa pha spun/gnyen nye rigs bla ma mched grogs pha ma spun zla sogs 'chi ba mi rtag pa slebs nas song ba thams cad kyis tshe 'di la sdod rtsis mang du byas kyang / 'chi bdag bdud po bsam log po kho byung tshe/ 'dug dbang zhag gcig tsam yang ma byung bar tshe phyi ma'i lam po che la chos med lag stong du song ba thams cad soms dang /'o skol rnams kyang de'i rang bzhin las ma 'das/ltag chu chad pa'i rdzing bu'i mthil brdol ba ltar tshe 'dzad/ nyi ma nub pa'i grib so ltar tshe 'grib/ 'bru'i bang mdzod bcus pa ltar tshe 'dzad/ gsod sar 'khrid pa'i sems can gyis gom pa spos pa ltar lo zla zhag dang snga dro phyi dro song ba tsam gyis 'chi 687

bdag bdud po 'jigs su rung ba'i kha nang du thag je nye je nyer 'gro ba 'di ya re nga zhe re 'jigs ci re drag gso ba'i thabs ni sman dang zas gos la sogs pa yin kyang / de dag rang yang bsten nyes na 'chi ba'i rgyu ru gyur te/ zas gos bsgrub phyir shi ba/ byes pa gos kyis srubs pa/ zas kyis dug pa/ sman log par song ba/ mdza' bos bslus pa/ gnas khang brdibs pa/ rta yis drud pa sogs sngar gson pa'i rkyen thams cad kyang / phyis 'chi ba'i rkyen du 'gyur la/ de yang nad bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi/ gdon stong phrag brgyad bcu sogs tshe la gnod cing 'chi ba'i rkyen byed pa grangs mang bas/ da lta rang yang gza' gdong thug lta bu'i 'chi ba thog rgyugs su mi 'ong ba'i gdeng cung zad kyang med la/ de ring yang kha bkrag yal le ba'i mi/ sang gnangs lta bu la ro nag thul le byung ba grangs med de/ de rnams la sang gnangs nga 'chi bsam pa zhig med kyang / 'byung bzhi 'dus pa'i lus 'di la blo gtad zan rdog cig za ba'i yun tsam yang med la/ dbugs rlangs pa tsam/drod me stag tsam pa 'di skad cig tsam la chad nyen yod pas/'chi ba'i nang nas kyang nam 'chi cha med kyi tshul 'di legs par bsams nas/ chos lo snga ma phyi ma gnyis kyi snga ma/ de ring 688

nangs par gnyis kyi de ring / snga dro phyi dro gnyis kyis kyang snga dro tsam la dam pa'i chos re byed rgyu'i skal ba byung na byed pa'i dus yin sdod pa'i dus ma yin/ gzhan yang sngar skyes pa thams cad 'chi/ phyis 'byung ba thams cad 'chi/ da res sa thog 'di na yod pa'i 'o skol thams cad 'chi/ rgan gzhon la go rim med/ pho mo la bzang ngan med/ gzugs byad la legs nyes med par nges par 'chi zhing nam 'chi cha med/ nye ba dang lab 'phro/ las kyi byed 'phro/ gos kyi gon 'phro/ zas kyi za 'phro/ nyal mal lus chas lto phor yan chad 'phro long nge / shul hang nge / thab skor gye gral nas ha re 'gro dgos te/ kho shi'o mo shi'o zer ba'i gtam gyi rjes shig min pa mi 'dug pas/mdor na tshe ston ga'i na bun las kyang yun thung / mdza' bshes gnyen 'dun tshong 'dus mgron po bas kyang gyes sla/ 'dod yon longs spyod sgyu ma bas kyang rtag mi thub/ 'chi bdag bdud po kho dgong kha'i grib so bas kyang mgyogs par 'ong ste zhe re 'jigs/ de yang yongs la 'chi ba zer ba'i 'brug bzhin grags pa'i 'chi bdag bzlog med thog dang 'dra ba de glo bur thog tu babs pa'i tshe/ stobs dang mnga' thang 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po tsam zhig yod kyang / rang la phan pa 689

rdul tsam yang mi 'byung / nor dang longs spyod rnam thos sras kyi 'byor ba lta bu yod kyang til 'bru tsam yang tshe phyi ma'i lam la 'khyer dbang ni med/ pha ma gnyen bshes grogs mched 'bum phrag mang pos mtha' bskor kyang mar gye dkyil nas spu bton pa bzhin du/ rang gis brtsigs pa'i khang khyim/bsags pa'i nor rdzas/ 'grogs pa'i nye 'brel/ mkho dgu'i yo byad/ bu dang chung ma snying dang 'dra ba/ lha dang lha mo 'dra ba yod pa rnams kyis kyang 'bral glags skad cig tsam yang mi phod rung / lag pas nom nom gos la reg cing / mig gis trig trig gnyen la lta bzhin/ kha chems re gnyis re bzhagamachi ma re gnyis re dor nas sngar yang mi mang po chos med lag stong du song ba dang / 'o skol rnams la mthong thos mang du yod la/ da 'o skol rnams kyang de bzhin du tshe phyi ma'i yul la nges par 'gro zhing nam 'gro cha med/ do nub yin yang chos med lag stong du 'gro nyen yod pas/ da ni tshe mjug la mgo'i nyi zer tsam yun thung ngu 'di'i ring la/ tshe 'dir yun ring sdod gshom byed pa'i blo rgya thams cad cham gyis bzhag nas/ dus de ring nyi ma phar bzhud nas bzung ste/ kha tsam tshig tsam yang ma yin par/snying khong rus pa'i gting nas tshe phyi ma'i brgyags 690

phye/ skye ba gtan gyi so nam/ nam gzhag gtan gyi 'dun ma/rang gzhan thams cad skyid pa'i thabs dam pa'i chos rnam dag cig ci nas kyang myur ba myur du byed dgos/ gal te ma byas na shi ba'i 'og tu/ rgyus med cha med kyi bar do'i 'phrang ring po la skyabs med mgon med du 'gro ba'i dus skabs su/bar do na 'khrul snang 'jigs skrag drag po bsam gyis mi khyab brjod kyis mi lang ba glo snying 'dar ba mang du yod la/ de'i dus su phan pa dam pa'i chos dang 'dren mkhan bla ma dkon mchog ma gtogs tshe 'di'i rgyu nom pa gnyen mdza' bshes bu bu mo gang gis kyang phan pa med de/ de yang rjes na ki lhang lhang btab nas ra mdar rgyugs pa'i bu tsha bo bzang po zhig dang /zas nor mang po khur nas phan 'dogs mkhan gyi bu mo bzang mo gcig tsam yang med pa'i khar/ de dag rnams la zhen cing chags nas khams gsum 'khor bar 'khyams pas/ gnod pa'i rkyen 'ba' zhig tu 'gyur la/ de tsam du ma zad tshe 'di'i lto gos dang bu bu mo'i don du sdig pa mi dge ba'i las bsags pa rnams gshin rje'i pho nya mdog mi sdug pa 'ongs nas khrid de dmyal khams bco brgyad sogs ngan song gsum gyi gnas su mar mar song nas sdug bsngal myong zhing / chos byas pa'i las 691

can gyi skye bo pho mo thams cad kyi mdun du bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha mang po mngon sum du byon nas lam sna drangs te/ mtho ris thar pa'i gnas su yar yar song nas bde skyid myong la/ des na yar lha'i bdud rtsi 'thung ba dang / mar dmyal ba'i khro chu 'thung ba dang / yar sangs rgyas kyi sa ru 'gro ba dang / mar dmyal ba'i yul du 'gro ba gnyis kyi gdam dbang 'o skol rnams kyi lag na yod pa'i dus 'dir bsam blo gzhig 'brel zhib tu btang nas/ gdam kha ma nor ba zhig byas te mar 'gro mi dge ba'i sdig pa thams cad spangs nas/ yar 'gro dam pa'i lha chos shig bya dgos/ de yang mi dge sdig pa spangs te dge ba byed tshul rnams sngar kha sang phan chad la rgyas par bshad zin pas/ da 'gro khar mang po smra mi dgos la/ 'on kyang kha thag ring pos bar chod/ skye 'chi 'di la khrigs khrigs med pas da phan chad 'o skol rnams chu bur mig gi lam la yang yang e mjal mi shes pas da ni ngas chos bshad kun gyi mjug sdud/ zhal gdams kun gyi tha ma tshigs su bcad nas dbyangs su len pas khyed rnams kyis kyang bla ma dang da lan ma gtogs yang yang e mjal ci shes snyam du dkon pa'i 'du shes zhog la/yid gzhan du ma yengs par legs par nyon la phyin chad lag 692

len la ci thebs byed 'tshal zhes mgur dbyangs 'di rnams blangs so//drin can bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /mi rtag 'chi ba dran par byen gyis rlobs/ /tshe 'di mi rtag ston ga'i sprin dang 'dra/ /pha ma gnyen 'brel tshong 'dus mgron po 'dra/ /nor rdzas mi rtag rtswa kha'i zil ba 'dra/ /nyam chung lus 'di chu yi chu bur 'dra/ /'jig rten 'khor ba'i chos la snying po med/ /snying po yod pa dam pa'i lha chos yin/ /dam chos byed pa'i dus ni da res tsam/ /'dir 'tshogs dad can yon bdag pho mo rnams/ /ma byed ma byed mi dge'i las ma byed/ /byed na byed na dge ba'i las la 'bod/ /phyug po phal cher rang gis za mi phod/ /gzhan la mi ster cho ga phyog sa gtong mi nus/ /shi dus zas nor don med lag tu 'gro /ma yin ma yin phyug po'i bya ba nor/ /yin na yin na yod dus mchod sbyin thongs/ /tshe 'di'i bya ba bsams na mkho ba mang / /rta gcig rnyed na sga gcig 'tshol dgos pas/ /mi dgos dgu dgos 'jig rten 'khor ba'i chos/ /byas kyang ma tshar tshar kyang snying po med/ /'dir 'tshogs dad can yon bdag pho mo rnams/ /ma byed ma byed tshe 'di blo yis thongs/ /byed na byed 693

na phyi mar bde thabs gyis/ /phyi mar dkar po dge ba byas pa'i mi mtho ris thar pa'i lam la gyen du 'gro /nag po mi dge sdig pa byas pa'i mi/ /ngan song gsum gyi lam la thur du 'gro /da lta yar mar gang la 'gro ba'i dbang / /rang gi lag na yod pa'i dus skabs 'dir/ /'dir 'tshogs dad can yon bdag pho mo rnams/ /ma byed ma byed mar 'gro'i sdig ma byed/ /byed na byed na yar 'gro'i dge ba gyis/ /glu 'di thos tshad yon bdag pho mo rnams/ /blo kha dam pa'i chos la phyogs par shog /gnas snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo yi/ /rje rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang / /rtsa dbu ma'i lam nas yar byon la/ /steng spyi gtsug bde chen rgyan du bzhugs/ /mi 'dir 'tshogs lus kyi na tsha dang / /sems sdug bsngal gang yod kun bsal nas/ /lus bde ba sems la dga' ba skyed/ /blo chos la phyogs par byin gyes rlobs/ /nged thams cad yar mar kun nas 'ong / /dus da res gnas 'dir yud tsam 'tshogs/ /da mi sdod so sor gyes pa ltar/ /chos thams cad mi rtag 'di dang 'dra/ /sngar yul mi khyim mtshes rgan rgon dang / /mi'i smon gnas pho mo gzhon nu yang / /lo ring po mi lon shi tshul soms/ /nged 694

thams cad de yi rang bzhin yin/ /da mi lo bdun cu tshun chad la/ /nged 'dir 'tshogs gcig kyang mi lus par/ /tshe 'di nas 'jig rten pha rol 'gro /phyis khrel yod 'ga' res dran nas ngu / /tshe phyi mar 'gro dus lag stong 'gro /rgyu nom pa bsags nas gang du 'khyer/ /grogs bzang bo yod kyang 'grogs dbang med/ /'phrang ring bo bar dor gcig pur 'gro /de'i dus su 'dren mkhan bla ma dang / /phan nges pa dam pa'i chos yin pas/ /khyed 'dir 'tshogs yon bdag pho mo rnams/ /dus da nas nam 'chi cha med soms/ /rje bla mar snying nas gsol ba thob/ /lha dkon mchog gsum la skyabs 'gro gyis/ /las mi dge bcu po dug bzhin spongs/ /yar bla ma byon dus 'brel ba zhog /mar dbul po byung na sbyin pa thongs/ /bar dge 'dun rnams la bsnyen bkur gyis/ /lus bskyed pa'i pha mar brtsi bkur rem/ /khyim bza' tshang ma 'khon mthun par 'grogs/ /bran g.yog por ma bsdig lto gos byin/ /khye phyugs la ma brdung gso skyong rem/ /grogs khyim mtshes ma gnod phan 'dogs gyis/ /lus dal bar ma sdod phyag skor rem/ /kha dal bar ma 'dug ma ṇi bgrongs/ /dus rgyun du bsam pa dkar po gyis/ /mi nga yang gang du song 695

na yang / /khyed 'dir 'tshogs sems kyis mi brjed par/ /tshe 'di yi bar chad e sel dang / /tshe phyi ma'i lam sna 'dren thub blta/ /da yon bdag pho mo bde bar bzhugs/ /nga rnal 'byor mi sdod chas nas 'gro /dus da dung tshe mjug 'di nyid la/ /zhal yang dang yang du mjal bar smon/ /dus da nas mjal rgyur ma song na/ /tshe phyi mar mjal ba'i smon lam 'tshal/ /'di dad can yon bdag pho mo la/ /ngas 'gro khar snying gtam byas pa yin//glu 'di nyid thos tshad pho mo rnams/ /dus gtan du bde zhing skyid par shog /'di phyi bar do yi skyel ma/ /skyabs mgon yid bzhin gyi nor bu/ /'bral med spyi gtsug tu bzhugs la/ /byen rlabs dngos grub kyi char phob/ /yar mar thams cad nas 'ongs pa'i/ /rang re yon mchod kyi tshogs rnams/ /da ni so so ru gyes tshe/ /skyo ba rang shugs kyis skyes byung / /yul phyogs bzang bo 'dir 'khod pa'i/ /dad can yon bdag gi tshogs rnams/ /dam pa'i lha chos la spyod bzhin/ /thams cad bde ba ru bzhugs dang / /rnal 'byor tshogs drug ni rang grol/ /dad pa dam tshig ni can la/ /chos 'brel smon lam rang 'debs bzhin/ /thag ring rgyal khams la chas 'gro /phyis nas gnas 696

tshul 'dra go yang / /dngos su mjal rgyu zhig mi yong / /mjal ba da lan tsam yin pas/ /snying gtam sems la rang zhog dang / /da ni mi mjal bar gyur kyang / /skye ba 'di nyid kyi 'og tu/ /shar phyogs mngon dga' yi zhing du/ /mjal ba'i smon lam rang 'tshal lo/ /zhes dbyangs su blangs te kun la mgul dar g.yogs pas/ der 'tshogs pa thams cad la nges 'byung dang skyo shas skyes/ dad gus dang mos pa cher 'phel nas lus kyi ba spu g.yo zhing mig nas mchi ma 'khrugs pa mang du byung / yang de'i dus su 'di skad ces smras so/ /'o skol rnams skyes pa'i pha yul mi gcig kyang / sngon gyi las dang smon lam dag pa'i mthus nga yang 'bod mi dgos bzhin du zla ba mang po'i lam nas 'dir 'ongs/ nga'i chos lugs dang cha lugs la nges pa med cing / grub pa yin nam grwa pa yin ngo mi shes pa la su gang yin dad pa skye dka' yang / nga bzang rung ngan rung khyed rnams kyi tshe rabs sngon gyi bla ma zhig yin pa'i rtags su nga'i ming thos/ gdong mthong ba tsam gyis dad pa dbang med du skyes nas/ nga gangs ri nas lo gsum lhag sdod ring la/ nga'i sgrub rgyags tsam du ma zad/ bu slob tshe blos btang brgya lhag tsam la lto gos gnyis kyi mthun rkyen sbyar/ da 697

ni 'gro khar yang / khyed yod pa rnams kyis zhon rgyu'i rta/gyon rgyu'i gos/ za rgyu'i zas/ 'khyer rgyu'i gser sogs gang yod phangs med par phul/ lam la skyel thung kyang byas/ nga yang khyed yon bdag pho mo rnams kyi bka' drin la brten nas/sa gang du 'gro yang bde nas bde bar song chog tshul sogs la bsams nas/ dus nam yang sems la dga' rgyu zhig ma gtogs mi dga' rgyu zhig gang nas 'ong ste/ 'on kyang da ni nga yang na so ni rgas/ 'chi la ni nye/ khyed yon bdag pho mo rnams kyi nang na rgan pa ni mang / sa kha thag ring pos bar chod skye 'chi la nges pa med pas/ da nas bzung ste ci gsung dang du len cing ci zer kha la nyan pa'i slob bu yon bdag pho mo drin can khyed rnams tshe 'dir chu bur mig gi lam la dngos su mi mjal zhing / phyi mar yang las nyon gyis bdas nas rigs drug gi gnas so sor gang du 'gro ci shes/ mjal ba da lan tsam red snyam na sems 'phreng ste/ nga yang mig nas mchi ma 'ong ba'i rgyu mtshan de yin/ khyod yon bdag rnams kyang sngon gyi bsod nams kyi mthus tshe 'dir da lta mi nor zas gsum 'dzom/ bde skyid snyan gsum che ba'i sgang la nga dang mjal/mjal ba'i dus su zang zing gi nor/ lus ngag gis zhabs 698

tog bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i mchod pa gsum gyi sgos mnyes par mdzad/ mi mnyes pa skad cig tsam yang ma byas pas sems la 'gyod pa spu tsam yang med/ bla mas kyang brtse bas rjes su bzung ste phas bu la nor 'bog pa bzhin/ sba gsang med par zab pa dang rgya che ba'i gdams pa rnams bum pa gang byo'i tshul du gnang / rang gis nyams su len nus na/thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang thob par gdon mi za/ sangs rgyas dngos su mjal yang de las lhag pa gsung rgyu ni med/ da ni 'gro khar thugs brtse ba'i byin rlabs/ tshe rabs thams cad du mjal zhing rjes su 'dzin pa'i smon lam dang zhal bzhes bzang bo ni yod pas/ skye ba'i phyi mar bla ma'i thugs rjes dag pa'i zhing khams nas mjal te/ de tsam du ma zad rang la dad pa yod nas gsol ba 'debs nus na tshe 'di la yang da dung dngos nyams rmi lam la yang yang mjal yong / da ni bla ma'i thugs rjes yul la bkra shis/ sa la byen chags/zas la bcud byung / nor la g.yang 'khyil/ mi la nad med/ phyugs la god med par thams cad skyid pa'i sgang la bla ma dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas sku khams bzang bo'i ngang nas/ skal bzang gi gdul bya gzhan smin grol gyi lam la 'god du phebs pa 'di 699

skal ba bzang snyam na dgo' rgyu zhig ma gtogs mi dga' rgyu zhig ma mchis mod/ 'on kyang rang la bka' drin sangs rgyas las lhag pa'i rtsa ba'i bla ma/ gtsug gi nor bu/ tshe 'di phyi bar do gtan gyi skyabs dang skyel ma 'di dang gtan du 'grogs rgyu'i skal ba zhig med rung / lo kha shas 'grogs rgyu zhig byung na ci ma rung / da ni thag ring gi yul la phebs song na phyin chad gzhan bla ma mang por mjal rung / rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas 'di dang gang nas mjal/ rang yang nam shi 'gro ci shes/ 'chi khar dgos pa'i bla ma ni de ring phebs rgyu red/ da ni bla ma'i zhal ras de ring nas bzung /gang nas mthong / gsung yang tshe 'dir rna bas gang nas thos da skal ba re chung snyam na/ khyed rnams kyi mig nas mchi ma 'ong ba yang bden te/ nga yang sngon chos rgyal ngag gi dbang bo dang bral nas 'ong dus mang po ngus/ rjes nas kyang nyi ma gsum tsam la ngus/ de'i rjes nas kyang bla ma nam dran pa'i dus su mig nas mchi ma 'chor zhing / da lan kyang khyed rnams kyis nga bsams nas ngus tshe ngas kyang bla ma dran nas ngu snying 'dod pa byung / nged tsho ngus pa de 'jig rten pa zas goso med par sdug thug pa bla mar zhus nas ngu ba dang / gnyen mdza' bshes kyi 700

don du ngus pa dang mi 'dra/ bla ma'i phyogs su mchi ma lan cig btang na yang dmyal ba chu bur can du mi skye ba'i go chod gsungs/ gzhan yang bla mar bral nas ngu ba dang / pha ma shi nas ngu ba/ 'jig rten na khrel yod ya rabs kyi gral yin pas/ mi'i sgon rgyu mchis kyang / 'phye smod bya rgyu med pas/des na khyed mi ngu ba rnams kyis kyang / gzhan mang po ngu ba la rnam rtog bya mi dgos/ ngu dus da lan tsam yin pas khyed ngu ba rnams kyang ngo tsha mi dgos/ gzhan ngu 'dod pa su yod kyang ngus chog skyon med byas pas/ thams cad kyi mig nas mchi ma 'byen par gda'/ da 'o skol rnams phyin chad 'phrad rgyu ma byung rung khyed rnams kyi sems ha cang skyo mi dgos/ sngar gyi 'di bzhin dad pa ma 'gyur ba gyis/ ngas kyang phyogs gang du phyin kyang khyed rnams sems kyis mi brjed par byas/ nged rnams kyi don du byang chub bsgrub/ nga sangs rgyas na khyed rnams sangs rgyas pa dang khyad med ngas khyed rnams bzhag mi yong / tshe 'di la ma mjal kyang yud tsam gda'/ skye ba rjes ma de la 'o skol rnams shar phyogs mngon par dga' ba'i zhing khams sogs/ rigs lnga'i zhing khams gang rung zhig nas mjal ba zhig ci nas kyang bdag gis bya bas/ kun gyes 701

dga' ba sgoms zhes langs nas skabs skabs phyi mig lta bzhin 'ong tshe/ grwa bu slob yon bdag rnams kyang rjes na khra shig ge'ajam sdem me 'dug pa'i nang nas la la ngu zhing snabs 'byed/la las shugs ring 'don zhing phyag 'tshal/ thal mo sbyar nas gsol ba 'debs shing smon lam rgyag pa dang / yun ring 'grogs pa'i sprang po mang pos skad chen po brgyab nas ngu ba mthong tshe/ ngas kyang snying rje'i sems 'phreng drag ste/ mig nas mchi ma mang po shor zhing / khong rnams kyis kyang nga dang 'bral mi phod par nga nam mthong gi bar du bltas nas bsdad/de nas ma mthong ba dang / khong rnams kyang so sor gyes nas rang rang gi gnas su rim pa bzhin log nas song ngo / /bla ma skal ldan dpon slob rnams kyis tshe blos btang nas gangs dkar gyi rgyal po te se'i shar phyogs dzu 'phrul phug gi zhabs rjes dkar mo'i grub gnas su phebs nas lo gsum sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan btsugs nas bsgrubs 'bras kyis bstan 'gro yongs la gang phan byas so//smras pa/ gang gis mchod bstod bkur ba thams cad la/ /gang 'dod dngos grub stsol ba'i sangs rgyas mchog /gang de'i zhabs kyi pad+mor gsol ba 'debs/ /gang bsam don kun 702

'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /bla ma'i rnam thar lan re thos na yang / /bsgrub la brtson 'grus snying stobs skye ba'i phyir/ /gangs ri'i gnas su sgrub pa byas pa'i tshul/ /slar yang glu ru len gyis dga' bas nyon/ /dbus nas rnam g.yeng 'du 'dzi cher song tshe/ /rang don shor ba'i gzhan don ltar snang 'dis/ /nam phugs rang gzhan gnyis ka bslu nyen gda'/ /da ni gnas chen gangs ri lta bu la/ /song nas gcig pur tshe mjug sgrub pa byas/ /'ja' lus 'od kyi sku zhig e 'grub blta/ /de min gang gi'ang dgos pa mi 'dug snyam/ /yod pa'i dus su stod phyogs spu hrengs dgon/ /bshad 'phel gling gi sde ba dbang bo de/ /lha sar 'ong dang nyin gcig 'phrad pa'i tshe/ /kho dang mnyam por gangs rir 'gro chad byas/ /lcags zam mkhan pos khong la bcol gdams mdzad/ /zhi ba tshe ring lcam gyis mthun rkyen byin/ /lha sa nas thon yar lam 'gro zhor la/ /snye thang sgol ma rong gi byams chen mjal/ /paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa yongs 'dzin gnyis/ /mjal nas blo sbyong chos dang skyabs 'jug zhus/ /gro shod gzhung gi sprang mo sgrol ma sogs/ /lam skabs sprang por sbyin pa gtong bzhin song / /ma pham g.yu mtsho'i khrus sgo lho ru slebs/ /dge 'dun rnams kyi 703

ser phreng rten 'brel 'grig /de nas spu hrengs bshad 'phel gling du song / /nyi ma kha shas ngal gsos mthun rkyen bsgrubs/ /de nas gangs dkar rgyal po te se yi/ /rdzu 'phrul phug gi zhabs rjes dkar mor song / /thog mar gnas la bstod pa'i mgur dbyangs blangs/ /de nas sgrub pa'i dam bca' sngon du btang / /tshe thung nam 'chi cha med tshul bsams nas/ /rtse gcig sgrub la gzhol ba'i dus skabs su/ /slob ma'i thog ma sbyin pa nor bu sogs/ /las dang skal bar ldan pa'i gdul bya'i rigs/ /sprin bzhin 'dus nas gser dngul maṇ+ḍal la/ /g.yu byer rin chen tshom bu bkod nas phul/ /bka' chos dgos zhes gsol ba btab pa'i dus/ /da ni rang don bsgrub bam gzhan don bya/ /snyam nas lha la gsol ba btab pa'i tshe/ /nub gcig tho rangs kha la ye shes kyi/ /mkha' 'gro seng ge'i gdong can zhal gzigs nas/ /'ja' lus 'od sku bsgrub pa ya mtshan yang / /de bas 'gro don bsgrub pa ngo mtshar che/ /khyod kyi sngon gyi thugs bskyed rgya che bas/ /gdul bya mang pos sgo yang phye nas 'dug /snying rje chen pos 'gro don mdzod cig gsungs/ /lung bstan nang ltar sgrub pa byed bzhin du/ /bug sgor phyin nas mdo sngags chos bshad pas/ /rang gzhan 704

don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa byung / /rje btsun sangs rgyas rdo rje zhabs drung nas/ /snyan brgyud lus med mkha' 'gro'i chos skor zhus/ /yi dam bde mchog gtso byas rgyud sde bzhi'i/ /pho brang shel gyi mchod rten mjal ba dang / /dpa' bo mkha' 'gros skor ba byed pa sogs/ /ngo mtshar nyams snang rmi lam sna tshogs byung / /shel mo gangs kyi yon bdag la sogs pa'i/ /dad can snang ngor mkha' la 'phur ba dang / /rang nyid song sa bsdad sa 'ga' zheg nas/ /sa yi rdo la phyag zhabs rjes kyang byung / /lo gsum grol nas gangs la g.yas skor byas/ /gangs ri'i rdor 'dzin gser lung bla ma la/ /dbang lung zhus shing phyogs bzhir gangs mchod phul/ /phyogs de'i rong 'brog yongs la chos bshad pas/ /kun gyi snang ba dam pa'i chos la 'gyur/ /skye bo kun dga' glu gar sna tshogs byas/ /ra lug khri phrag mang po'i tshe thar btang / /gser dngul zas nor longs spyod char bzhin babs/ /bshad 'phel gling du rgyal mtshan 'khor lo btsugs/ /dngul kong ka 'phan spyi 'jog mang po bzhag /mkho chags jo bor gnod pa'i chu chen la/ /rdo yi rag brgyab phar phyogs shig la bsgyur/ /khrus sgo lho nas mtsho la bum gter phul/ /kun la chos bshad zhal gdams byin pa'i 705

mthar/ /'gro khar thams cad 'bral glags ma phod par/ /sprang po yan chad mig nas mchi ma shor/ /ngas kyang snying rje sems 'phreng 'bral ma phod/ /phyi mig lta bzhin bal yul phyogs la song / /skal ldan dpon slob gangs dkar te ser phebs/ /yon bdag rnams kyang rang rang yul la theg /mdor na gangs ri'i gnas song sgrub pa byas/ /chos bshad rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub pa byung / /rnal 'byor bdag gi rnam thar de ltar lags/ /rjes 'jug rnams kyang de bzhin skyong bar mdzod/ /glu 'di thos tshad skye bo pho mo yis tshe rabs kun tu bla ma'i rnam thar bzhin/ /dben par sgrub la gzhol bzhin chos bstan nas/ /rang gzhan don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub par shog /ces pa'ang bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o//706

bal yul mchod rten chen po rnam gnyis la mjal du song tshul/bcu gnyis pa ngo mtshar lha yi yul dang mtshungs pa'i bal yul mchod rten chen po rnam gnyis la mjal du song tshul ni/ sa pho stag gi lo'i chu stod zla ba la nged dpon slob mang bo dang bcas te chas nas hor nang du song / hor dpon phrug sogs yon bdag rnams la chos bshad sdig rgyun bcad/ dge rgyun btsugs pas/ rta dang gser dngul ja mar mang po 'bul mkhan byung / thams cad kyis srog gcod kyi sdig pa ma byas pas/ de'i lo gzhung tshong pa yar 'gro mar 'gro rnams kyis sha dkon po byung zer/ gro shod du slebs nas 'go pa drung rtse'i bu/'go pa blo bzang 'phrin las kyi nang du song / gser dngul g.yu byi ru mu tig gi rgyan cha dngul rdo tshad mang po'i rtsis phul/gzhan yang gro shod gzhung gi phyug po rnams kyis rta gos g.yu byer sogs nor sna mang po phul/ bdag gis dngul srang stong phrag lhag tsam gye rgyu nom pa mang po byin nas/ ri dwags gtsod gsod pa'i khyim tshang nyi shu rtsa lnga tsam gyes/ lo re la gtsod stong phrag mang po gsod pa la las rgyu 'bras kyi chos bshad 'jig rten 'di'i kha ta bcug pas khong rnams kyis phyin chad 707

gtsod mi gsod pa'i dam bca' byas/ ri dwags 'dzin pa'i thag rnyi g.yag khal lnga drug tsam yod pa bsdus nas me la bsregs/ gsod mkhan gyi khyim tshang de rnams gro shod gzhung gi phyug po tsho'i mtha' la bzhag /ri dwags ma bsad na phan thogs gyis zhes bcol gdams byas/ rjes nas phyug po tshos kyang / ri dwags mi gsod pa dang las ka byed du bcug zas gos byen nas skyid po byas bsdad yod skad/ de nas nged dpon slob 'ga' zhig dga' chos dgon par song / 'gyed mang ja btang skyabs 'jug zhus zhag kha shas ngal gsos nas bsdad/de nas sde pa dbang bo dpon g.yog 'gas/ gser dngul sogs nor longs spyod gang yod phal che ba khyer nas dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing du mchod 'bul la song dus/ thog mar dpal ldan sa skya rin po che yab sras rnams la mjal/ rta bzang po gcig dngul gyi maṇ+ḍal la g.yu bye ru'i tshom bu bkod nas phul/ sprul pa'i lha khang chen mo'i nang du gser srang nyi shu tham pa'i gser kong bzhag mar me rgyun sbar gyi sbyor 'jags la dngul ṭaṃ lnga brgya tham pa phul/ de nas skyabs mgon paṇa chen rin po cher mjal/ rta bzang po gsum/ dngul gyi maṇ+ḍal chen po la gser g.yu byi ru'i tshom bu bkod nas phul/708

paṇa chen blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi gser gdung rin po che'i drung du/ gser srang nyi shu tham pa'i gser kong gcig bzhag de nas lha sa ru song / rgyal ba lung rtogs rgya mtsho rin po che'i gdung 'bul du rta gsum dngul gyi maṇ+ḍal la gser g.yu byi ru sogs rin po che du ma'i tshom bu bkod nas phul/ de nas bod kyi rgyal po de mo rin po che la/ dga' ldan gser kong gi mgo 'dren bcol phyir/ rta lnga gser zho bcu gsum/ dngul gyi maṇ+ḍal la g.yu byi ru mu tig gi tshom bu bkod nas phul/ de nas dga' ldan gser kong gi rgyu la/ gser zho stong phrag gcig phul/ bod kyi rgyal pos bka' khyab gnang / 'dod dpal mkhan po gnyis kyis bkod pa btang /po ta la'i shod kyi 'dod dpal nas bzos pa'i stegs dang bcas te bzo bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa zhig byung / dga' ldan gser gdung chen mo'i drung du stong mchod dang bcas pa/ dga' ldan gser khri rin po ches thugs bskyed smon lam rgya chen po gnang nas phul/ de nas dga' ldan dge 'dun sde la 'gyed phogs mang ja btang nas smon lam dri ma med pa'i mtshams sbyor byas/ gser kong de la gser srang byas na srang brgya dang brgyad cu tham pa tsam gyi rtsis yod skad/ de dus dpal bsam yas lha khang gsar bzheng byed 709

pa'i zhal 'debs su gser zho brgya tham pa rta lnga g.yu bye ru spos shel rdo tshad gcig gi rtsis/ bod kyi rgyal po brgyud nas phul/ de nas phyag mdzod sde pa dbang bo lha sa'i yer ba lha ri snying po'i mgul du song nas/ re zhig bsdad de dge sbyor gang nus byas pas blo bde ba byung ngo //nged dpon slob kha shas kyis rnam rgyal lha rtse brgyud nas glo yul gyi chu mig brgya rtsa rdo la me 'bar/chu la me 'bar ba la mjal du 'gro ba'i lam skabs su/gnas chen tsā ri na yod pa'i bu chen kun bzang gzhan phan yar 'ong ba dang 'phrad de/ kho na re khyed stod gangs ri na bzhugs pa'i dus su/chos mang po e gsungs/ slob ma chos byed mkhan mang po e byung zhes dris pa'i lan du tshig lhug par bkral nas rgyas par bshad pa'i mthar tshigs su bcad de smras pa/rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /rjes 'jug yongs la thugs/ rjes gzigs/ /chos bshad byas tshad thams cad kyis/ /chos bzhin nus par byen gyis rlobs/ /gangs ri'i phyogs kyi dad can mi/ /gang la'ang chos bshad 'di ltar byas/ /mtshan ldan bla ma dkon mchog gsum/ /mchod bstod bkur zhes chos bshad byas/ /mi lus snying po len pa'i phyir/ /dal 'byor rnyed dka'i chos bshad byas/ /phyi ma don gnyer skye 710

ba'i phyir/ /mi rtag 'chi ba'i chos bshad byas/ /'khor bar zhen pa ldog pa'i phyir/ /rigs drug sdug bsngal chos bshad byas/ /nor la zhen chags spong ba'i phyir/ /'dod yon nyes dmigs chos bshad byas/ /sems can yal bar mi 'dor phyir/ /snying rje bsgom tshul chos bshad byas/ /snying rje chen po'i kun bslangs nas/ /sems bskyed byed tshul chos bshad byas/ /mi dge bcu la sogs pa yi/ /nyes byed sdom pa'i chos bshad byas/ /phar phyin drug sogs dge ba'i chos/ /sdud la rem zhes chos bshad byas/ /bsdu bzhi'i sgo nas gzhan gyi don/ /ci nus mdzod ces chos bshad byas/ /tshe gcig lus gcig sangs rgya ba'i/ /gsang sngags zab mo'i chos bshad byas/ /'bad rtsol med par 'tshang rgya ba'i/ /yang gsang snying po'i chos bshad byas/ /gzhan yang mchog dman mang po la/ /nga yis chos bshad 'di ltar byas/ /bla mas grub mtha' ris med la/ /phan thogs mdzod ces chos bshad byas/ /dpon pos mi ser thams cad la/ /byams skyong gyis zhes chos bshad byas/ /mi ser rnams kyis dpon po la/ /brtsi bkur gyis zhes chos bshad byas/ /pha ma gnyis las drin can med/ /zhabs tog gyis zhes chos bshad byas/ /srog la rang gzhan kun gyis gces/ /srog — 711

gcod spongs zhes chos bshad byas/ /phyug pos ser sna ma byed par/ /mchod sbyin thongs zhes chos bshad byas/ /chos lugs grub mtha' thams cad la/ /dag snang sbyongs zhes chos bshad byas/ /de ltar chos bshad byas pa'i mthus/ /slob ma chos pa mang po byung / /dad pa can yang mang po byung / /tshe 'di blos btang mang po byung / /ri khrod pa yang mang po byung / /snying rje can yang mang po byung / /gtong phod can yang mang po byung / /mkhyen pa can yang mang po byung / /'gro don can yang mang po byung / /dag snang can yang mang po byung / /byung rab bshad na mang po gda'/ /de tsam gyis la zhog la thongs/ /da dung de ltar chos bshad nas/ /'gro la phan thogs 'byung bar shog /ces smras pas kho dga' mgu yi rang bar gyur to/ /yang de'i dus su 'gro zhor la glo man thang rgyal po 'jam dpal dgra 'dul dang / khri thog rgyal po khro bo dpal mgon/ sgyu lung sde pa yon tan sangs rgyas sogs dad can gyi skye bo pho mo mang bo la tshe dbang skur dus chos bshad kyang 'di ltar byas so//'o skol rnams la da res mi lus rin po che thob pa'i dus 'dir/ tshe 'dir yun ring bo mi sdod par tshe phyi ma zhes bya ba'i sngar 'gro ma myong ba'i yul der kun nges par 'gro zhing nam 712

'gro cha med/ do nub yin yang 'chi ba mi rtag pa zhes bya ba'i lam po che de la zhugs nas 'gro nyen yod/ 'gro ba'i dus su chos byas pa rnams mtho ris thar pa'i gnas la yar yar song nas bde skyid myong zhing / sdig pa byas pa rnams ngan song gsum gye gnas su mar mar song nas sdug bsngal myong bas/da lta yar mar gang la 'gro ba'i dbang rang gi lag na yod pa'i dus skabs 'dir mar 'gro mi dge'i sdig pa spangs nas/ yar 'gro dam pa'i chos shig ci nas kyang bya dgos/ de yang mi dge sdig pa ni sems can ra lug dang ri dwags la sogs pa'i srog gcod pa dang / g.yo sgyu rku 'phrog gi sgo nas gzhan gyi lag nas nor 'phrog pa dang / zhe sdang langs nas g.yog po dang g.yog mo sogs la kha ngan dang tshig ngan rgyag pa bsam ngan dang sbyor rtsub byed pa thams cad sdig pa mi dge ba yin pas 'dzem dgos/ dge ba bsgrub pa ni/ yar bla ma dkon mchog la mchod pa 'bul ba/ mar dbul bo ngan slong la sbyin pa gtong ba/ bar dge 'dun pa dang pha ma rgan rgon la zhabs tog byed pa/ gzhan yang lus kyis phyag dang skor ba/ ngag gis kha ton bzlas brjod/ sems kyis dad gus dag snang / byams snying rje stong nyid dang lha bsgom pa sogs yin pas na bsgrub dgos/713

de ltar mi dge'i sdig pa spangs nas dge ba bsgrubs tshe 'dir yang bde zhing phyi mar skyid la/ nam phugs 'o skol rnams kyang dag pa'i zhing nas mjal te/ sangs yang mnyam por rgya ba'i rten 'brel yod ces mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so//rkang gnyis gtso bo thub dbang zhabs la 'dud/ /don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /'di phyi gnyis gar bde zhing skyid pa'i thabs/ /blang dor gnyis kyi rnam dbye bshad kyis nyon/ /'o skol rnams kyis dal 'byor mi yi lus/ /thob kyang yun ring tshe 'dir mi sdod par/ /phyi ma zhes bya 'gro yang ma myong ba'i/ /yul der 'gro zhing nam 'gro'i nges pa med/ /do nub yin yang 'chi ba mi rtag pa'i/ /lam po che la zhugs nas 'gro nyen che/ /rgyus med cha med bar do'i 'phrang ring la/ /skyabs med mgon med rang nyid gcig pur 'gro /song na bar do'i 'phrang la 'khrul snang gi /'jigs skrag drag po bsam gyis mi khyab yod/ /de dus phan pa dam pa'i lha chos dang / /'dren mkhan bla ma dkon mchog ma gtogs pa/ /tshe 'di'i mi nor zas gsum gang gis kyang / /de yi dus su phan pa gcig kyang med/ /tshe 'dir lha chos byas pa'i las can rnams/ /mtho ris thar pa'i gnas su yar la 'gro /mi dge 714
