sdig pa byas pa'i las ngan rnams/ /ngan song gsum gyi gnas su mar la 'gro /yar 'gro mar 'gro gnyis kyi sa mtshams na/ /'o skol yod pas 'gro sa ma nor cig /de yang mar 'gro mi dge'i sdig pa spangs/ /yar 'gro'i dge ba byed na 'di bzhin gyis/ /mchog gsum rtsa ba gsum la dad gus gyis/ /khams gsum sems can yongs la snying rje skyed/ /pha ma'i phyir yang srog gcod las mi byed/ /lus srog phyir yang dkon mchog gsum mi spong / /sku gsung thugs rten rnams la me tog dang / /bdug spos mar me zhal zas 'phan gdugs phul/ /khrims ldan dge 'dun sde rnams mchod bstod bkur/ /tshad ldan rgyal ba'i gsung rab 'dri 'don klogs/ /ma gyur dbul phongs rnams la sbyin pa thongs/ /ma nus nyam thag nad par sman yang byin/ /gsod nges nag can mi la ngo chen zhus/ /'chi nges dud 'gro rnams kyi srog blu gyis/ /phyi mar lha mi'i rten bzang 'thob pa'i rgyu/ /tshegs chung don che bsnyen gnas sdom pa srungs/ /rang rgyud bsreg cing gzhan rgyud dkrugs pa'i rgyu/ /tshig rtsub byung dus khro med bzod pa sgoms/ /le lo che na bsam pa'i don mi 'grub/ /'bad pa chen pos dam pa'i lha chos gyis/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku sogs dmigs rten 710

la/ /ma yengs sems zhog rtse gcig bsam gtan sgrubs/ /chos rnams thams cad sgyu ma rmi lam ltar/ /rang bzhin med pa'i tshul rnams shes par gyis/ /bstan dang 'gro ba gang la'ang gang phan gyis/ /phan ma thogs rung gnod pa ma byed cig /yi dam bsgos bzlas chos skyong bskang gso sogs/ /'phral phugs bde ba'i thabs la 'bad par mdzod/ /de bzhin byed kun kun mkhyen myur thob nas/ /ma gyur 'gro rnams rnam mkhyen sar 'dren shog /ces blangs pas rgyal blon 'bangs 'khor thams cad kyi blo kha chos la 'gyur te/ zhal gdams nang bzhin mdzad pas gnas skabs tshe 'dir tshe bsod mnga' thang rigs rgyud rlung rta snyan grags ches cher rgyas shing / mthar thug 'thob bya bla na med pa sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rim gyis 'thob pa'i skal ba can du gyur to/ /khong rnams kyis gser gyi ṭaṃ ka gor ṭaṃ g.yu byi ru rgyan dang yo byad mang po phul/ glo chu mig brgya rtsa ru slebs nas zhag po kha shas bsdad gnas 'brel bzhag tshogs btang chu la khrus byas chu la me 'bar rdo la me 'bar ba'i rten rnams la mjal/ de nas yar lam yang gnas dang dgon pa rnams la mjal zhing /grong pa so sor 'gro don byed bzhin 'brog pa 'ab chen pa dang 716

mnga' ris rdzong dkar 'od dad can gyi skye bo pho mo yongs la chos bshad 'di ltar byas so// de yang 'o skol rnams skye dka' ba gling bzhi'i nang nas mchog tu gyur pa lho 'dzam bu'i gling du skyes/ thob par dka' ba dal 'byor gyi mi lus rin po che thob/ mjal bar dka' ba sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa mtshan ldan gyi bla ma dang mjal ba'i dus 'dir dkar po dge ba'i las la brtson dgos te/ da re gtan gyi lam sna zin thabs dam pa'i chos shig ma byas na/yang nas yang du dal 'byor gyi mi lus mi 'thob/ thob kyang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang mi mjal/ mjal kyang dam pa'i chos sgrub pa'i rang dbang rang la e thob mi shes pas na/ da lan rang dbang thob pa'i dus 'dir dal 'byor don ldan zhig mdzad dgos/ de yang myur du brtson pas ma 'bad na/ sang bya gnangs bya'i ngang la lus na 'chi khar 'gyod kyang phan pa med de/ ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag pa'i rang bzhin/ snod bcud thams cad 'pho 'gyur gyi khor yugasha khrag gi lus 'di ni chu yi lbu ba lta bu/ tshe srog dang dbugs ni la kha'i na bun bzhin du yal bar sla zhing / do nub tsam yang mi 'chi snyam pa'i blo gtad thub pa ni ci yang med de/ 'chi 717

ba'i rkyen ni nam mkha'i thog ltar 'byung zhing / de la bros shing gzur ba'i thabs ni gang yang med de/ 'chi ba'i dus la bab pa'i tshe/ stobs dang mnga' thang 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po tsam zhig yod kyang rang la phan pa rdul tsam yang mi 'byung /nor dang longs spyod rnam thos sras kyi 'byor ba lta bu yod kyang til 'bru tsam yang 'khyer dbang ni med/ pha ma gnyen bshes grogs mched mang pos mtha' bskor yang gcig kyang 'khrid dbang med par mar gyi dkyil nas spu bton pa bzhin du rang nyid gcig pur 'gro dgos/ song ba tsam du ma zad/ bar do'i 'khrul snang 'jigs skrag drag po bsam gyis mi khyab pa myong la/ de'i dus su phan pa dam pa'i chos dang 'dren mkhan bla ma dkon mchog ma gtogs/ gzhan tshe 'di'i mi nor zas gsum gang gis kyang phan pa spu tsam yang med la/ de tsam du ma zad/ tshe 'di'i lto gos bu bu mo'i ched du sdig pa mi dge ba chen po byas na dmyal bar skyes nas tsha grang gi sdug bsngal bzod dka' ba myong zhing / 'bring tsam byas na yi dwags su skyes nas/ bkres skom gyi sdug bsngal nyam thag pa myong / tha na chung ngu tsam zhig las ma byas kyang dud 'gro'i gnas su skyes nas gsod za bkol spyod glen rmongs kyi sdug bsngal yi mug pa 718

mang po myong ba'i mthar ngan song gsum gyi gnas nas thar te/gal te mi yi gnas su skyes na yang sdig can las ma dag pa'i mi de rnams tshe thung ba dang / nad mang ba dang / dug dang mtshon khar 'chi ba dang / zha long 'on lkugs bran g.yog sprang po khas dman dbang chung brgya bsam na gcig kyang mi 'grub pa'i khar/ sdig sdug gtam ngan gsum gyi mtsho brdol nas/nam yang bde ba'i go skabs skad cig tsam yang med pa'i lus ngan blangs nas las ngan bsags te/ slar yang ngan song gsum gyi gting rdo byas nas kha yar 'khor ba'i dus mi 'byung bas na/ sdig pa mi dge ba spang dgos zer ba'i rgyu mtshan yang de yin/ rnam par dkar ba'i las rgya chen po byas na rab tshe gcig lus gcig la sangs rgyas nas mthong thos dran reg gi sems can thams cad smin grol gyi lam la 'god nus/ 'bring tsam byas pa rnams kyang / 'chi ba'i dus su bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha khyad par can rnams mngon sum du byon nas/ lam sna drangs te dag pa mkha' spyod mngon par dga' ba/ bde ba can sogs sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams rnam par dag pa ru bgrod nus/ tha na dge ba chung ngu tsam zhig las ma bsgrubs kyang / slar yang mi lus gtsang ma thob nas/ rten de la rigs 719

gzigs 'byor dang dbang phyug shes rab tshe ring nad med bde dang ldan zhing / 'gro na rta thog 'dug na gdan thog za na gang 'dod kyi zas/ byed na dam pa'i chos byed pa'i rang dbang rang la thob ste skyid pa'i sgo nas chos byas pa'i mthar/phyir mi ldog pa'i sa la gnas nas mtha' yas pa'i 'gro ba'i don byed nus pa'i skal ba yod pas/ dge ba bsgrub dgos zer ba'i rgyu mtshan yang de yin/ 'o mi dge spangs nas dge ba bsgrub dgos na/ spang rgyu'i mi dge ba de gang yin snyam na/nyon mongs pa 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gi dbang gis pha ma sems can mang po'i srog gcod pa/ gzhan gyi nor 'phrog pa/ 'dod log spyod pa/ rdzun dang phra ma tshig rtsub/ ngag 'khyal/ brnab sems gnod sems log par lta ba ste/ mdor na bla ma dkon mchog gi thugs kyis khrel zhing sems can gzhan la gnod pa'i las thams cad sdig pa yin pas 'dzem dgos/ sdig pa chung ngu byas na yang nyes dmigs rgya chen po 'byung ste/ sngon mi zhig gis gzhan zhig la khyod spre'u 'dra'o zhes smras pas spre'u'i skye ba lnga brgya blangs pa dang / dge tshul zhig gis dge slong dbyangs mi snyan pa zhig la/ khyod kyi dbyangs de khye zug pa dang 'dra'o smras pas/ khye'i skye ba lnga brgya blangs pa 720

dang / bud med zhig gis bud med gzhan tsho la khyed tsho khyi mo dang 'dra ba yin smras pas/ skye ba lnga brgyar khye mor skyes pa dang / rdzun pham gyis rab 'jigs la dzun zhig smras pas/ skye ba lnga brgyar srin bur skyes pa byung / khyad par sems can ra lug ri dwags la sogs pa gsod snyam pa'i bsam pa lan cig rgyud la skyes kyang de ma thag nas rang gi tshe bsod nams 'dzad cing / skye ba phyi mar rang lan cig gsod do/ /brgya stong yid la shar na de tsam gsod cing / sems can gzhan bsad na tshe 'dir tshe thung zhing nad mang / shi na dmyal ba yang sos su skyes nas nyin re la yang lan grangs brgya stong bye ba'i bar du mtshon chas gshags nas yang shi yang sos par 'gyur la/ gzhan la snyad brkos nas lag gi nor 'phrog na/tshe 'dir mdze nad sogs nad ngan pa thebs shing phyi mar dmyal bar song nas lce dpag tshad lnga brgya ru gyur pa'i steng du lcags kyi thong gshol me 'bar ba stong btsugs nas rmo dgos pa dang /pha ma gnyis la kha ngan smras na lce lkog ma'i 'og nas phyung ste lcags kyi phur pa 'dom gang tsam brdabs te sa la btags nas sdug bsngal myong ba dang / bre dang rgya ma la g.yo sgyu byas nas tshong ngan rgyag pa'i mi de gson por sha bcad de bre dang rgya 721

ma la tshad nas bu lon du 'jal dgos pa dang / zhe sdang skad cig tsam zhig skyes na yang bskal ba stong gi dge rtsa 'joms shing / shi nas dmyal bar skyes mthar mi'i nang du skyes na yang mdog mi sdug cing gzhan gyi yid du mi 'ong bar 'gyur ro/ /des na sdig pa mi dge ba byas pa'i nyes dmigs bsams nas sngar byas kyi sdig pa la dug chu khol ma khog tu shor ba lta bu'i gnod 'gyod kyi bshags pa byed cing / phyin chad srog la babs kyang mi byed snyam pa'i sdom sems byed pa gal che/ de ltar byas na snga dro dug zos kyang phyi dro sman bzang po bsten na 'tsho ba ltar/ tshe stod sdig pa byas rung tshe smad bshags pa byas na sdig pa dag nas sdig can rnams kyis kyang mtho ris thar par bgrod pa'i skal ba yod pas bshags sdom yid ches pa re byed 'tshal/ de ltar mi dge ba spangs nas dge ba bsgrub dgos na dge ba de ji ltar bsgrub dgos snyam na/ byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems kyi sgo nas/ dam pa'i chos 'dri ba/ dkon mchog gsum mchod pa/ sbyin pa gtong ba/ chos nyan pa/gsung rab klog pa dang / blo la 'dzin pa/ gzhan la 'chad pa/kha ton byed pa/ nan tan du bsgom pa ste/ mdor na bla ma dkon mchog gi thugs dgyes shing / sems can gzhan la phan 722

pa'i las thams cad dge ba yin pas na bsgrub dgos/ dge ba chung ngu zhig byas kyang phan yon rgya chen po 'byung ste/ sngon rgan mo zhig gis sangs rgyas la dmigs nas mar me zhig phul bas/ma 'ongs pa na sangs rgyas mar me 'od ces bya ba dbang bcu dang ldan par 'gyur zhes sangs rgyas kyis lung bstan pa dang /grong dpon zhig gis srog gcod kyi sdom pa nyin gcig bsrungs pas/ mthar sangs rgyas phan bzhed ces bya bar sangs rgyas pa dang / bram ze'i bu mo zhig gis dge slong zhig la khab gcig phul bas 'phags pa shā ri'i bur gyur pa dang / bud med cig gis ngan slong zhig la lto zhig byin pas/ rin po che'i khang bzang du ro brgya ldan pa'i kha zas la spyod par skyes pa dang /khye zhig phag gis bdas nas mchod rten zhig la skor ba gcig byas pas/ mthar khyim bdag dpal skyes zhes bya bar gyur nas dgra bcom pa'i go 'phang thob par gsungs/ khyad par srog blu tshe thar byas na tshe rabs thams cad du tshe ring zhing nad med par 'gyur ro/ /bla ma dang pha ma la phyag dang zhe sa byas na mthon po'i rigs su skye bar 'gyur/ bzod pa bsgoms na tshe rabs thams cad du gzugs mdzes par 'gyur zhing mthar thug mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i sku mchog 'thob par 'gyur ro/ /723

mchod sbyin lan gcig byas kyang longs spyod che bar 'gyur ro/ /des na dge ba byas pa'i phan yon rnams la bsams na sngar byas kyi dge ba rnams la dga' ba bsgom zhing / phyin chad bsgrub pa la 'bad 'tshal/ de ltar byas na tshe 'dir yang mi nor zas gsum 'dzom/ bde skyid snyan gsum byung nas/ 'o skol yon mchod kun bde zhing skyid la/ phyi mar yang shar phyogs mngon par dga' ba'i zhing khams sogs/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams rnam par dag pa nas sngar 'dris kyi mi la mi phrad pa bzhin mngon sum du mjal nas/ dga' spro'i gleng mo sna tshogs pa byed bzhin du thogs pa med pa'i rdzu 'phrul la brten nas/dag dang ma dag zhing khams bye ba phrag rab 'byams 'grims te/ sangs rgyas thams cad mchod cing sems can thams cad 'dren pa'i skal ba yod pas kun gyi sems la bzhag 'tshal zhes mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so// rje rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang / /steng spyi gtsug 'khor lo'i rgyan du bzhugs/ /gnas 'dir 'tshogs skal ldan pho mo yi /blo chos la phyogs par byen gyis rlobs/ /nga rgyal khams 'grims pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /gdangs snyan mo'i glu dbyangs 'di ltar 'then/ /nga'i phan pa'i snying gtam 'di nyid la/ /snyan 724

lhan ner gson dang skal ldan kun/ /rten dal 'byor mi lus rnyed par dka'/ /phyis yang yang 'thob pa'i dpe ma mchis/ /dus da re lan cig thob dus 'dir/ /tshe stong log ma byed skal ldan kun/ /dpe gsod sar 'khrid pa'i bsha' lug bzhin/ /nyin re re song gin 'chi la nye/ /dus yun ring sdod pa'i gdeng ma mchis/ /tshe mi rtag soms shig skal ldan kun/ /nor mi rtag rtswa kha'i zil ba 'dra/ /yun ring por mi rtag myur du 'dzad/ /sems chags zhen ser sna ma che bar/ /kun chos phyogs thongs dang skal ldan kun/ /khyim bza' tshang tshong 'dus mgon po 'dra/ /yun ring por mi sdod so sor gyes/ /tshe phyi ma'i yul du myur du 'gro /da mthun par 'grogs shig skal ldan kun/ /dgra tshe rabs sngon ma'i pha ma yin/ /tshe 'di ru cung zhig gnod na yang / /yun ring por mi sdod kho yang 'chi/ /sems zhe sdang ma che skal ldan kun/ /tshe phyi ma'i yul la 'gro ba'i tshe/ /mar ngan song gsum gyis sdug bsngal de/ /rang thog tu babs na bzod par dka'/ /las mi dge spongs shig skal ldan kun/ /yar mtho ris thar pa'i gnas mchog tu/ /bgrod nus na gtan du bde zhing skyid/ /der bgrod pa'i thabs mchog lha chos yin/ /chos dge ba 725

sgrubs shig skal ldan kun/ /skyabs bslu ba med pa dkon mchog la/ /dus nangs nub kun tu skyabs 'gro gyis/ /sems bzang na ci byas chos su 'gro /yar sems bskyed mdzod cig skal ldan kun/ /tshogs rdzogs shing sgrib pa kun byang ba'i/ /thabs maṇ+ḍal yig brgyar nan tan gyis/ /rje byen rlabs can gye bla ma la/ /rang gsol ba thob dang skal ldan kun/ /bod kha ba can gyi lha skal mchog /lha 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang sgoms/ /chos kun gyi snying po ma ṇi yin/ /dus rgyun du bgrongs shig skal ldan kun/ /bod kha ba can gyi rgyal khams na/ /drin che ba o rgyan pad+ma yin/ /lha gzhan las thugs rje byen rlabs myur/ /der gsol ba thob cig skal ldan kun/ /dus snyigs ma'i sems can bsod nams chung / /nor dgra 'dre 'bod pa'i g.yab mo yin/ /gzhan nor la brnab sems ma che bar/ /sems chog shes sten cig skal ldan kun/ /mi skyon med yon tan ldan pa de/ /da dus kyi dbang gis dka' mo gda'/ /grogs gzhan gyi skyon la ma rtog par/ /kun gong du khur cig skal ldan kun/ /rang dman sa zungs la dge sbyor gyis/ /dge gang byas rnams kyi mjug de la/ /bsngo smon lam rang gis gang shes thob/ /dge 'dzad med 'phel lo skal ldan 726

kun/ /glu 'di nyid blangs pa'i dge ba'i mthus/ /ma 'gro kun bde zhing skyid par shog /yul 'di ru bkra shis g.yang chags shing / /bkra shis pas sa gsum khyab gyur cig /ces blangs tshe kun sngar las dad cing mos par gyur te sdig spong dge sgrub kyi skye bo pho mo las dang skal bar ldan pa mang po byung ngo / /yang oṃ phug bla ma sogs slob ma yon bdag 'ga' res/mnga' ris rdzong kha pa 'di rnams kyis lugs gnyis gang dang mi mthun pa'i/ mi ngan khrel med kyi bya ba mang po byed par 'dug pas/ 'di rnams la da dung thugs brtse ba'i zhal gdams skyon mtshang thon pa zhig gsung dgos zhes bskul ngor/mchog dman yongs la phan pa'i mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so//nam yang bslu med bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /nam 'chi cha med dran par byin gyis rlobs/ /skyes pa'i rjes su 'ong ba 'chi ba yin/ /mi rtag 'chi ba soms shig rdzong kha pa/ /gzhon nu mang po glo bur 'chi la ltos/ /nam 'chi nges pa med do rdzong kha pa/ /shi na las can thar pa'i lam la 'gro /sdig can dmyal bar 'gro 'o rdzong kha pa/ /yar 'gro mar 'gro'i sa mtshams 'di rang yin/ /'gro sa nor nyen che'o rdzong kha pa/ /mar la mi 'gro yar la 'gro 'dod na/ /blang dor 'di bzhin mdzod cig 727

rdzong kha pa/ /bla mar snying nas mos gus ma skyes kyang / /rjes nas dad log ma byed rdzong kha pa/ /rgyun du dkon mchog mchod rgyu ma byung kyang / /skabs rer mar me phul cig rdzong kha pa/ /pha mar drin gzo chen po ma mchis kyang / /rgas khar zur du ma 'don rdzong kha pa/ /dge 'dun yongs la mang 'gyed mi gtong yang / /ston kha bsod snyoms phul cig rdzong kha pa/ /gang yod sbyin par gtong ba ma nus kyang / /sprang por sgo rtsam byin cig rdzong kha pa/ /mi dge bcu spong tshul khrims mi bsrung kyang / /ra lug srog gcod ma mang rdzong kha pa/ /nyin mtshan med par chos la mi brtson kyang / /nyin par gnyid nas ma 'dug rdzong kha pa/ /dgra la bzod pa bsgom par ma nus kyang / /gnyen la khong khro ma byed rdzong kha pa/ /dben par ting 'dzin bsgom par ma nus kyang / /mi dran dgu dran ma byed rdzong kha pa/ /shes rab stong nyid bsgom pa mi shes kyang / /rgyu 'bras shes par gyis shig rdzong kha pa/ /gnas skor ba la byams po mi byed kyang / /khral bzhag khres po ma 'phrog rdzong kha pa/ /dpon pos g.yog por bdag rkyen mi ster yang / /don med rdzig rdzig ma gtong rdzong kha pa/ /mi ser rnams la chad pa gcod na yang / /sna dang yan lag ma gcod rdzong kha pa/ /'brog pa'i tshwa la nas gtsang 728

mi ster yang / /rtswa dang thal ba ma mang rdzong kha pa/ /chos pa gzhan la dad pa mi byed kyang / /don med gshe skur ma mang rdzong kha pa/ /yul mi khyim mtshes nang mir ma 'chams kyang / /rdzong la gtugs nas ma brlag rdzong kha pa/ /grwa pas khe tshong 'jog par ma nus kyang / /tshong log rkyang ba ma brgyag rdzong kha pa/ /yul mi thams cad gros mthun ma byung yang / /khag ngan gcig la ma 'gel rdzong kha pa/ /gcig gis gcig la bstod ra mi brjod kyang / /gcig skyon gcig gis ma 'don rdzong kha pa/ /gzhan gyi nor la ham pa che na yang / /dge 'dun dkor la ma rngams rdzong kha pa/ /sgo phyugs drin can rgas dus mi gso yang / /ston kha bshas nas ma za rdzong kha pa/ /khye la rgyun du bza' btung mi ster yang / /'khyags dang ltogs su ma 'jug rdzong kha pa/ /yul mi khyim mtshes phan zhig mi thogs rung / /gnod pa ci 'khyol ma byed rdzong kha pa/ /drin can yongs la drin gzo ma nus kyang / /pha ma'i drin lan 'jal dgos rdzong kha pa/ /gzhan la gnas mjal 'gro ba ma byung kyang / /skyid grong jo bor mjol cig rdzong kha pa/ /jo bor rang gis mchod rdzas mi 'bul kyang / /gzhan gyis phul ba ma 'khyer rdzong kha pa/ /kha ton bzlas brjod mang po ma nus kyang / /rgyun du ma ṇi 729

bgrongs shig rdzong kha pa/ /a ne rgan mos ma ṇi mi bgrong kyang / /mna' mar kha tshags ma mang rdzong kha pa/ /ma gyur 'gro la phan thogs ma nus kyang / /phan sems yang yang sbyongs shig rdzong kha pa/ /rnal 'byor snying gtam gser dang 'dra ba 'di/ /khyed rnams snying la chongs shig rdzong kha pa/ /de ltar byas na 'di phyi gang du'ang bde/ /mtho nas mtho ris 'gro'o rdzong kha pa/ /dam chos 'di bzhin byed pa thams cad la/ /dam can chos skyong srung mas grogs byed shog /ces blangs pas de nas bzung ste rdzong dpon gyis mi ser la chad pa chen po mi rgyag pa dang / gnas skor pa la lam khral mi len pa sogs phan thogs chen po byung 'dug ces yul mi dang gnas skor pa snyems chung thams cad dga' bar gyur to/ /zas nor kyang mang po 'bul mkhan byung / de nas rje mi la'i sgrub gnas 'od gsal phugarkang tshugs phug 'khrungs yul skya rnga rtswa'i khang ba ka bzhi gdung brgyad shul gyi mchod rten rnams la mjal/ zhing 'or ma gru gsum dang spre pe stan chung la bltas/ de nas skyid grong jo bo la mjal du song ba'i lam skabs su/ rgyus med kyi mi 'ga' res rgyang nas bltas te/ 'di pa tshang rnying ma yang ma red grwa chas byas 'dug dge lugs pa yang ma red dbu ral bzhag 'dug730

gang dang mi 'dra ba'i bla ma 'di pa ngo mtshar/ su 'dra zer ba zhig yin nam zer ba go nas/ de dus sems la shar ba ltar mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so//seng ge dkar mo ma yin khyung yang min/ /de gnyis mthun las byung ba'i phrug gu yin/ /ming la seng ge rkang ba brgyad pa zer/ /gang dang mi 'dra kun dang mthun par mtshar cang shes rgod ma ma yin bong bu min/ /de gnyis mthun las byung ba'i phrug gu yin/ /ming la gzhan gyes dre'u kha dkar zer/ /gang dang mi 'dra kun dang mthun pa mtshar/ /'brog pa'i 'bri mo ma yin glang yang min/ /de gnyis mthun las byung ba'i phrug gu yin/ /ming la rong bas khyung dkar mdzo bo zer/ /gang dang mi 'dra kun dang mthun pa mtshar/ /rnying ma ma yin dge lugs pa yang min/ /de gnyis mthun las byung ba'i rnal 'byor yin/ /ming la phyogs 'dir zhabs dkar bla ma zer/ /gang dang mi 'dra kun dang mthun pa mtshar/ /zhes blangs nas mar song skyid grong jo bo wa ti bzang po zhes bya ba 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi snang brnyan tsan dan sbrul gyi snying po las rang byung du grub pa gsung byon la mjal/ mchod 'bul 'dra byas zhag shas bsdad/ de nas grogs bzang drung yig g.yu kha 731

ba dang 'grogs nas bal yul mchod rten chen po bya rung kha shor dang 'phags pa shing kun rnam gnyis la mjal du 'gro khar skyid pa'i rgyang glu 'di blangs so//phyi yi rgya mtsho yi gling na/ /rin chen mang po zhig yod kyang / /yid bzhin nor bu las lhag pa'i/ /gzhan pa'i nor bu zhig mi snang / /'dod pas kun nas rang bslangs te/ /rgyal mtshan rtse mo ru bkur nas/ /mchod bstod gsol ba rang 'debs so/ /dgos 'dod char bzhin du phob cig /mtha' yi skyid grong gi phyogs na/ /sku gsung thugs rten 'dra mang kyang / /wa ti bzang po las lhag pa'i/ /gzhan pa'i sku 'dra zhig mi snang / /dad pas kun nas rang bslangs te/ /zhabs gnyis spyi bo ru blangs nas/ /rtse gcig gsol ba rang 'debs so/ /byin rlabs dngos grub cig stsol cig /dgung sngon mthon po yi dkyil na/ /gza' skar grangs med cig snang yang / /'od zer phyogs kun tu khyab pa/ /nyi zla rnam gnyis las mi snang / /pad+ma ku mud kyi mgo bo/ /nyi zla rnam gnyis la phyogs yod/ /nyi zla rnam gnyis kyi 'od zer/ /bkyes nas me tog kun skyongs shig /sa bzang bal yul gyi phyogs na/ /rten bzang mang po zhig snang yang / /mtshan snyan phyogs kun tu khyab 732

pa/ /mchod rten rnam gnyis las mi snang / /rnal 'byor dpon slob kyi sems pa/ /mchod rten rnam gnyis la phyogs yod/ /mchod rten rnam gnyis kyi chos skyong / /byon la dpon slob kun skyongs shig /phyogs med rgyal khams la 'gro ba'i/ /chags med rnal 'byor nga'i skyid pa/ /skyid grong jo bo la mjal zin/ /skyid pa'i rgyang glu 'dra len bzhin/ /grogs bzang drung yig dang 'grogs nas/ /yul bzang bal yul la chas 'gro /nga bzhin 'gro mkhan 'dra yod na/ /nga dang lhan du rang chas 'gro /mchod rten rnam gnyis kyi drung nas/ /smon lam lhan du rang btab yong / /zhes skyid pa'i rgyang glu 'dra len bzhin rong mtshams brgyud nas song / thog mar bal yul mchod rten chen po 'phags pa shing kun la mjal/ dngul go ṭaṃ lnga brgya lhag tsam gye sa dkar dri bzang dang sbyar ba'i na bza' bsgon/ tshogs mchod mar me rgya chen po phul dus smon lam 'di ltar btab bo//dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di dang dge ba'i rtsa ba gzhan dag gi mthu la brten nas/ rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pas 'bad pa dang rtsol ba gang yang blta mi dgos par/ myur ba myur du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang bde blag nyid du 'thob par gyur cig dus da nas bzung ste 733

bdag ni gang du song ba'i yul thams cad la bkra shis par gyur cig gang du bsdad pa'i sa thams cad la byin chags par gyur cig su dang 'grogs tshad thams cad la yon tan 'go bar gyur cig dngos po gang la reg tshad thams cad la g.yang chags par gyur cig sku gsung thugs rten gang mthong tshad la rab tu gnas pa 'byung bar gyur cig dad can mjal mi thams cad la dbang dang byin rlabs 'byung bar gyur cig gzhan su zhig gis 'jigs pa'i dus yid la dran kyang 'jigs skrag gi sdug bsngal zhi bar gyur cig sgo gsum gyi bya ba gang byas kyang bstan pa dang 'gro ba la phan rgya chen po thogs par gyur cig dge ba'i rtsa ba ci bsags tshad thams cad gzhan don dang bla med byang chub kho na'i rgyur gyur cigabla ma rgyal kun tshogs gnyis rlabs po che/ /bdag gzhan 'gro kun dus gsum dge ba'i tshogs/ /yongs rdzogs bdag gi rgyud la myur smin nas/ /bdag ni myur ba myur du sangs rgyas shog /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba rab 'byams thams cad kyi/ /sku gsung thugs yon thams cad phyogs gcig tu/ /bsdoms 'dra'i yon tan zhing gi rdul snyed kyi/ /bgrangs las 'das pa bdag la 'byung bar shog /grogs gzhan mi dgos bdag nyid 734

gcig pu yis/ /sngon gye rgyal bas 'dren par ma nus pa'i/ /ma gyur sems can gcig kyang ma lus pa/ /thams cad sangs rgyas sa la 'god par shog /bdag gis 'od zer dpag tu med pa spros/ /nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam snod bcud yongs la phog /ma dag nyes skyon mun la nyi shar bzhin/ /lhag ma med par yongs su sbyong bar shog /slar yang 'od zer dpag med ches cher spros/ /snod bcud la phog gser 'gyur rtsi mchog gis/ /lcags la reg bzhin snod rnams dag pa'i zhing / /bcud rnams lha dang lha mor 'gyur bar shog /ma dag gnas kun dag pa'i zhing du gyur/ /'gro kun mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i lhar gyur nas/ /rin chen gser gyi gling na rdo med bzhin/ /khams gsum 'khor ba'i ming yang med par shog /sems can thams cad gcig med gdul byar rdzogs/ /sangs rgyas byang sems yongs kyi 'phrin las rdzogs/ /thugs bskyed mthar phyin thugs dgongs yongs su rdzogs/ /dgyes bzhin sangs rgyas yongs rdzogs bzhugs par shog /bdag gis sems can sangs rgyas sar bkod nas/ /da dung mi sdod chos dbyengs nam gnas par/ /sangs rgyas yongs la mnyes pa'i mchod pa'i sprin/ /bsam gyis mi khyab sprul nas mchod par 735

shog /skyo ngal med par nyin mtshan dus drug tu/ /dpag tu med pa'i mchod sprin phul ba'i mthus/ /rgyal ba kun gyis bu gcig ltar brtse zhing / /bdag gi bsngags pa'i zhing kun 'gengs par shog /mdor na bdag gis gang 'dod kun byin nas/ /sems can kun gyi re ba yongs skong zhing / /mchod sprin bsam gyis mi khyab kun phul nas/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs dgongs yongs rdzogs shog /bdag gis lhag bsam rnam par dag pa'i sgos/ /smon lam rnam par dag pa btab pa bzhin/ /bla ma rgyal ba sras dang bcas rnams kyis/ /gegs med myur du 'grub par byen gyes rlobs/ /rmad byung sras bcas rgyal ba'i byin rlabs dang / /rten 'brel bslu ba med pa'i bden pa dang / /bdag gi lhag bsam dag pa'i mthu stobs kyis/ /rnam dag smon pa'i gnas kun myur 'grub shog /ces brjod gzhan yang bsngo ba gser gyi phreng ba'i sgo nas smon lam rgya cher btab bo/ /de nas mchod rten chen po bya rung kha shor la mjal/ go ṭaṃ drug brgya tsam gyi sa dkar dri bzang dang sbyar ba'i na bza' bsgron/ tshogs sha'i ched du ma he gsod pa'i tshab la/ sha nyos nas ma te tshe thar du btang /tshogs mchod mar me rgya chen po phul dus smon lam 'di ltar 736

btab bo//'dis mtshon pa'i dus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba'i mthu la brten nas/ rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa la 'brel ba thogs tshad thams cad kyis 'bad pa dang rtsol ba gang la yang blta mi dgos bzhin du/tshe gcig lus gcig pu 'di nyid la sku bzhi ye shes lnga yi bdag nyid rgyal ba khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang mngon du byas nas/ mthong thos dran reg gi sems can thams cad smin grol gyi lam la 'god nus par gyur cig dus da nas bzung ste bdag gis bsdu ba rnam pa bzhi'i sgo nas sems can thams cad la phan pa dpag tu med pa thogs par gyur ciga'achad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi sgo nas sems can thams cad la phan pa dpag tu med pa thogs par gyur cig thos bsam sgom gsum gyi sgo nas sems can thams cad la phan pa dpag tu med pa thogs par gyur cig lam bslab pa gsum gyi sgo nas sems can thams cad la phan pa dpag tu med pa thogs par gyur cig lung sde snod gsum gyi sgo nas sems can thams cad la phan pa dpag tu med pa thogs par gyur cig bskyed rdzogs rdzogs pa chen po'i sgo nas sems can thams cad la phan pa 737

dpag tu med pa thogs par gyur cig spyan dang mngon shes dzu 'phrul gye sgo nas sems can thams cad la phan pa dpag tu med pa thogs par gyur cig mdor na lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgo nas sems can thams cad la phan pa dpag tu med pa thogs par gyur cig rig 'dzin rnal 'byor pa bdag nyid mthong ba dang / thos pa dang dran pa dang reg pa thams cad/dad pa'i spu long g.yo zhing byang chub mchog gi sa bon rgyud la bskrun nus par gyur cig rig 'dzin rnal 'byor pa bdag nyid mthong thos dran reg rnams kyi lus kyi na tsha sems kyi sdug bsngal gang yod nye bar zhi nas lus la bde ba sems la dga' ba dpag tu med pa 'char bar gyur cig rig 'dzin rnal 'byor pa bdag nyid mthong thos dran reg rnams kyi blo kha dam pa'i chos la 'gyur nas dam chos tshul bzhin bsgrub pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig rig 'dzin rnal 'byor pa bdag nyid mthong thos dran reg rnams gnas skabs bde zhing mthar thug sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang bde blag nyid du 'thob par gyur cigabla ma rgyal ba sras dang bcas rnams kyis/ /rnam dag smon lam 'grub pa'i byen rlabs stsol/ /phyogs bcu'i drang srong 738

bden tshig 'grub rnams kyis/ /smon lam ci btab 'grub pa'i mthun 'gyur mdzod/ /sngon tshe phag dzi'i bu yis mchod rten la/ /bum pa btags nas smon lam btab pa'i mthus/ /mkhan po chen po bo rnyi sa twa ru/ /rgyur nas mdo sde'i bstan pa dar bar mdzad/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyis/ /mchod rten chen por na bza' gsol ba'i mthus/ /mkhan po chen po bo rnyi sa twa bzhin/ /'dul ba mdo sde'i bstan pa 'dzin par shog /sngon tshe khye rdzi'i bu yis mchod rten la/ /bum pa btags nas smon lam btab pa'i mthus/ /slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas su/ /gyur nas gsang sngags bstan pa rgyas par mdzad/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyis/ /mchod rten chen por na bza' gsol ba'i mthus/ /slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas bzhin/ /gsang sngags bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel bar shog /sngon tshe rta dzi'i bu yis mchod rten la/ /bum pa btags nas smon lam btab pa'i mthus/ /chos kyi rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan du/ /gyur nas mdo sngags bstan pa'i sbyin bdag mdzad/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyis/ /mchod rten chen por na bza' gsol ba'i 739

mthus/ /chos kyi rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan bzhin/ /mdo sngags bstan pa'i sbyin bdag byed par shog /bla ma rgyal ba sras bcas byin rlabs dang / /bdag gzhan dus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba'i mthus/ /bdag ni deng nas tshe rabs thams cad du/ /bstan dang 'gro ba'i dpal du 'gyur bar shog /nor bu dar zab nang du sbas bzhag kyang / /kun la phan bde bkra shis 'byung ba ltar/ /bdag ni deng nas tshe rabs thams cad du/ /dben par bsdad kyang 'gro la phan par shog /nyi zla mi sdod phyogs bzhi bskor na yang / /gling bzhi'i 'gro ba yongs la phan pa ltar/ /bdag ni deng nas tshe rabs thams cad du/ /rgyal khams bskor yang 'gro la phan par shog /rmad byung sras bcas rgyal ba'i byin rlabs dang / /rten 'brel bslu ba med pa'i bden pa dang / /bdag gi lhag bsam dag pa'i mthu stobs kyis/ /rnam dag smon pa'i gnas kun myur 'grub shog /ces brjod/ gzhan yang bsngo ba gser gye phreng ba'i nang ltar bsngo ba dang smon lam rgya chen po btab bo/ /yang bal yul mchod rten du 'gro ba'i lam kha dang /mchod rten rnam gnyis kyi drung rnams su/ yul mi dad can dang / gnas skor ba kha shas kyis/ shi gson gnyis ga'i don 740

du bsngo 'brel 'jog mkhan byung ba rnams la bsngo ba 'di ltar byas so//phyogs bcu'i zhing khams rab 'byams mtha' yas mu med pa na bzhugs pa'i bla ma rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams kyis bdag gzhan sems can thams cad dang / khyad par du yang dad ldan gyi sbyin bdag pho mo 'di dag rnams la thugs brtse ba chen pos nyin mtshan dus drug tu gzigs shing dgongs su gsol/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba'i byen rlabs/ bdag gzhan dus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba/ khyad par du yang dad can gye sbyin bdag pho mo 'di rnams kyis sngon dge ba bgyis pa/ phyin chad dge ba bgyid 'os/ da lta yang zang zing nor gyi 'brel ba phun sum tshogs pa bzhag pa 'dis mtshon pa'i dus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba rnams kyi mthu la brten nas/ spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar zhing sgos sems can thams cad la bde skyid 'byung bar gyur cig yang sgos su dad can gyi sbyin bdag pho mo 'di rnams dang / gzhan yang 'di rnams la gnyen nye ba ru 'gro ba ji snyed cig mchis pa de thams cad kyi shes rgyud la dge ba'i rtsa ba mtha' dag yongs su rdzogs par smin nas tshe 'dir yang nad gdon bgegs bar chad thams 741

cad nye bar zhi bar gyur cig tshe dpal bsod nams thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas par gyur cig nam zhig tshe yi 'phen pa zad pa'i tshe mnar gcod kyi sdug bsngal gang yang mi 'byung bar gyur cig tshe 'phos ma thag tu bla ma dang spyan ras gzigs mngon sum du byon nas khrid de bde ba can gyi zhing du skye bar gyur cig gal te de lta bu'i skal ba dang mi ldan na/slar yang mi lus gtsang ma thob nas/ rten de la rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug rje btsun mi la ras pa bzhin du dam pa'i chos la thos bsam sgom gsum byas nas tshe gcig lus gcig la sangs rgyas par gyur cig gzhan yang dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis yul phyogs 'dis thog drangs pa'i rgyal khams thams cad kyi bkra mi shis pa thams cad zhi zhing / bkra shis dang dge legs bde skyid chen pos sa phyogs yul phyogs thams cad la yongs su khyab par gyur cig de de bden du 'grub par gyur cigasangs rgyas sku gzugs brnyes pa'i byen rlabs dang / /chos nyid mi 'gyur bden pa'i byin rlabs dang / /dge 'dun mi phyed 'dun pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /bsngo ba smon lam btab tshad 'grub par shog /ces gson bsngo la de ltar brjod/ shi ba la 'di ltar/ phyogs bcu'i zhing khams rab 'byams mtha' 742

yas mu med pa na bzhugs pa'i bla ma rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams kyis bdag gzhan sems can thams cad dang / khyad par du yang 'jig rten 'di nas pha rol tu song zhing tshe las 'das pa 'di nyid srid pa bar do rigs drug 'jig rten gye khams gang na gnas kyang thugs brtse ba chen pos gzigs shing dgongs su gsol/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba'i byin rlabs bdag gzhan dus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba/ khyad par du tshe las 'das pa 'di yi don du rjes na yod pa'i gnyen nye ba rnams kyis sngon dge ba bgyis pa/ phyin chad dge ba bgyid 'os/ da lta yang bdag la bsngo 'brel bzhag pa 'dis mtshon pa'i dus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba'i mthu la brten nas spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar zhing / sgos mkha' mnyam gyi sems can la bde skyid 'byung bar gyur cig yang sgos su 'jig rten 'di nas pha rol tu song zhing tshe las 'das pa 'di nyid srid pa bar do rigs drug 'jig rten gye khams gang na gnas kyang dge ba'i rtsa ba mtha' dag rjes su song ste shes rgyud la yongs su rdzogs par smin nas/ de'i mthu la brten nas ngan song gsum dang ngan 'gro'i rigs su nam yang mi skye zhing / sngon chad skyes zin pa zhig yin na yang skye gnas ngan pa 'dra yin na 743

de las slar log nas nub phyogs bde ba can gyi zhing khams su pad+mo las badzus te skyes nas rigs kyi bdag po 'od dpag med kyi zhal mngon sum du mthong bar gyur cig gal te de lta bu'i skal ba dang mi ldan na slar yang mi lus gtsang ma thob nas rten de la dam pa'i chos la thos bsam sgom gsum byas nas myur du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas par gyur cigagazhan yang dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis yul 'dis thog drangs pa'i rgyal khams thams cad kyi bkra mi shis pa thams cad zhi zhing /bkra shis dang dge legs bde skyid chen pos sa phyogs dang yul phyogs thams cad la yongs su khyab par gyur cig de de bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig shākya'i dbang po 'dren pa 'od dpag med/ /mi pham 'jam dbyangs gsang bdag spyan ras gzigs/ /bde gshegs 'khor bcas rten 'brel mi bslu bas/ /bden pas smon lam ci btab myur 'grub shog /ces so/ /yang bal yul yam bu na yod pa'i yo lag tshong shag kha che tshong dpon dang / la khang thog shing zer ba'i tshong dpon dad can gnyis kyis bos pa'i dus/ nang du song nas sems la phan pa'i chos bshad byas/ 'gro khar bkra shis kyang 'di ltar byas so//744

nam mkha'i khams na rtsa ba gsum gyi lha tshogs srid pa gsum gyi gzhi bdag dkar phyogs la mngon par dga' ba thams cad bzhugs nas gnas 'dir bkra shis pa'i me tog dang / 'dod dgu'i 'bru nor longs spyod kyi char chen po 'bebs shing / ngo mtshar gyi dri bzang po 'thul ba dang / rol mo'i sgra yang phyogs mtshams kun tu bsgrags par gyur/na mo rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams kyi bkra shis shog /yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi bkra shis shog /sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyi bkra shis shog /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams kyi bkra shis shog /chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi bkra shis shog /yul lha gzhi bdag rnams kyi bkra shis shog /mi 'gyur lhun po sku yi bkra shis shog /yan lag drug cu'i gsung gi bkra shis shog /mtha' bral dri med thugs kyi bkra shis shog /rgyal ba'i sgu gsung thugs kyi bkra shis shog /mi la na tsha med pa'i bkra shis shog /phyugs la god kha med pa'i bkra shis shog /zhing la sad ser med pa'i bkra shis shog /mdzod la gang stong med pa'i bkra shis shog /mi rnams tshe ring nad med bkra shis shog /phyugs la g.yang kun 'khyil ba'i bkra shis shog /zhing la ston thog 'byung ba'i bkra shis shog /bang mdzod nor gyis gang ba'i 745

bkra shis shog /mi nor zas gsum 'dzoms pa'i bkra shis shog /bde skyid snyan gsum 'byung ba'i bkra shis shog /kun kyang chos bzhin spyod pa'i bkra shis shog /dge legs rgyun mi 'chad pa'i bkra shis shog /bkra shis dang dge legs bde skyid chen pos sa phyogs yul phyogs thams cad la yongs su khyab par gyur cig ces brjod bzhin nang kun tu 'bras gtor bas/ tshong dpon gnyis kyis thog drangs nang mi thams cad dga' zhing rab tu dad cing gus par gyur to/ /de dus bal yul gyi gnas thams cad bskor rgyu ma byung / mchod rten rnam gnyis la thag nye ba'i gnas yam bu'i rgyal sa na jo bo 'ja' ma li zer ba'i thugs rje chen po zhig yod pa la mjal/ rgyal khang dang / rta mchog glang po che ri dwags bse ru stag dang gzig gsos yod pa tshor ltad mo 'dra bltas/ mchod rten rnam gnyis la phyag skor byas zla ba gcig tsam bsdad/ slar log nas skyid grong du 'ong / jo bo wa ti bzang po la gser srang sum cu so bzhi'i gser kong g.yu phra can zhig dang / stong mchod phul dus smon lam 'di ltar btab bo//mchod kong 'di yi phyi nang gnyis ka gtsang zhing rgyu yang bzang ba bzhin du/ skye ba nas tshe rabs thams cad du bdag 746

gi sdom pa dang dam tshig gtsang zhing byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems bzang po dang ldan par gyur cig mchod kong nang kun mar khu gtsang mas gang ba bzhin/ rang gzhan sems can thams cad kyi shes rgyud yon tan du mas gang bar gyur ciga'ajig rten gye khams 'di thams cad bde skyid kyis gang bar gyur cig sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad mchod pa'i tshogs kyis yongs su gang bar gyur cig mar me sbar ba bzhin du bdag gi tshe rabs thams cad du/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i sgron me chen po sa gsum gyi 'gro ba'i ma rig pa'i mun pa sel phyir dus rtag tu sbor nus pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cigamar me'i 'od kyis mun pa sel ba bzhin du/ bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyi ma rig las nyon sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad byang zhing dag par gyur cig mar me'i 'od kyis phyogs kun mthong ba bzhin du/bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyis 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad ma 'dres par sa ler mthong ba'i ye shes kyi spyan thob par gyur cig mar me'i 'od kyis phyogs kun tu khyab pa bzhin du/ bkra shis dang dge legs bde skyid chen pos sa phyogs yul phyogs thams cad la yongs su khyab par gyur cig 747

tshe 'dir dkon mchog la mchod pa phul ba 'di bzhin du ma 'ongs pa'i tshe rabs thams cad du yang bslu med dkon mchog gsum po rgyun du mchod pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cigabadag pas gzhan gces bla ma dkon mchog gsum/ /bdag dang 'gro ba yongs la thugs rjes gzigs/ /'dis mtshon dus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba rnams/ /bstan 'gro yongs la phan pa'i phyir du bsngo/ /mtha' med 'gro ba yongs la phan pa'i phyir/ /dri med smon lam lhag bsam dag pas 'debs/ /bslu med dkon mchog gsum gyi byen rlabs kyis/ /gegs med smon lam ci btab 'grub gyur cig phan mdzad drang srong bden tshig 'grub rnams kyis/ /phan pa'i smon lam 'di bzhin gdab tu gsol/ /mchod kong phyi nang gtsang zhing bzang ba bzhin/ /dam sdom gtsang zhing bsam pa bzang bar shog /mchod kong nang kun mar khus gang ba bzhin/ /shes rgyud yon tan du mas gang bar shog /'jig rten khams kyang bde dang skyid kyis gang / /sangs rgyas zhing kun mchod pas gang bar shog /sgrib med mar me gsal bar sbar ba bzhin/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i sgon me sbar bar shog /mar me'i 'od kyis mun pa sel ba bzhin/ /ma rig las nyon sgrib pa dag gyur 748

cig /mar me'i 'od kyis phyogs kun mthong ba bzhin/ /ye shes spyan gyis chos kun mthong bar shog /mar me'i 'od kyis phyogs kun khyab pa bzhin/ /bkra shis chen pos phyogs kun khyab gyur cig /tshe 'dir dkon mchog gsum po mchod pa bzhin/ /tshe rabs kun tu dkon mchog rmachod par shog /ces dang gser kong gi zhabs kyi ngos la yang / 'dzam gling rgyan gcig phyag mchod zhing gi mchog /jo bo wa ti bzang po'i zhabs drung du/ /tshogs drug rang grol 'jam dpal bde legs sogs/ /dad can skye bo du mas gser kong 'di/ /phul mthus sangs rgyas bstan pa rgyas par shog /bstan 'dzin skyes bu'i sku tshe ring bar shog /'gro kun gnas skabs kun tu bde bar shog /mthar thug sangs rgyas go 'phang 'thob par shog /ces bris/gzhan yang bstan 'gro spyi bye brag la phan pa'i bsngo ba smon lam rgya chen po byas so/ /de'i lo 'dod dgu'i nor longs spyod thams cad 'byung ba'i tshong 'dus/ skad rigs mi gcig pa bal bod gnyis kyi sa mtshams/ rtsi bcud lo tog dus rtag tu phun sum tshogs pa'i yul/ dbyar gangs mi zhu la/ dgun me tog mi skam pa'i sa/ 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug rang byung wa ti bzang po bzhugs pa'i mang yul skyid pa'i grong gi 749

phyogs kyi sgrub gnas/ sngon tsa mi lo tsā ba sangs rgyas grags la mgon po'i zhal gzigs nas/sdod sa pha gi gyis zhes pha bong gru bzhi chen po zhig bstan pa'i thog tu sgrub khang brtsigs pa'i mgon gnang zhes bya ba dge sbyor 'phel ba'i dben pa'i ri khrod rgyab ri sra brtan brag gis mjes pa/ mdun ri gangs ri'i phreng bas bskor ba/ phyogs mtshams su na bun skyi bun 'thibs shing / 'ja' tshon sna lnga'i ri mo 'char ba/ ljon shing sna tshogs pas mchod pa'i lha mo sgeg pa'i tshul gyis gar stabs bsgyur zhing yal gas dud pa/ me tog du mas mdzes ma'i bslu brid byed bzhin rab tu dga' ba'i 'dzum zhal ston pa/ chu gtsang rnams gtsang gtsang 'thung 'thung zer bzhin lhung lhung gi skad snyan po 'byin zhing 'bab pa/ shug pa dang ba lu la sogs pa'i dri ngad rgyun du 'thul ba/ 'jol mo dang khu byug sogs spu sdug bya dang bye'u du mas skad snyan mi 'dra ba du ma gyur kyur sgrog bzhin dga' zhing 'phyo la lding ba/ kha lhor blta dgun dus nyi 'od 'khyil zhing / dbyar sos ga'i dus bsil zhing rig pa dwags pa/ chu me shing la sogs mthun rkyen 'dzom zhing / mdo 'tsho ba sbyor ba'i yon bdag mang ba/'dug sa sdod bde zhing mthong rgya che ba/ rang bzhin gyis nyams dga' zhing 750

shes pa spro ba/ blo bde zhing bag phebs pa bkra shis shing byen chags pa/ lha yul gyi skyed tshal mi yul du 'phos 'dra'i ngo mtshar ri khrod dben pa'i dga' tshal de ru zla ba kha shas mtshams la bsdad pas/ yul phyogs gzhan gyi dben gnas las khyad par du 'phags pa'i sgom sgrub 'phel po byung tshe gnas la bstod pa'i mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so//dben pa'i gnas su ting 'dzin sgo brgya phyes/ /ngo mtshar ltad mor gzigs pa'i bla mar 'dud/ /bdag dang bdag 'dras ting 'dzin 'phel ba'i gnas/ /ri khrod dben pa zin par byin gyis rlobs/ /e ma rgyab ri'i brag rnams sra brtan mjes/ /ya mtshan mdun ri'i rtse la gangs kyis brgyan/ /phyogs mtshams na bun 'khor zhing 'ja' tshon 'char/ /de 'dra'i ngo mtshar dben pa'i gnas mchog 'dir/ /'bab chu rnams kyis skyes bu'i tshe 'gro ba/ /'di dang mtshungs zhes myur du mgyogs par 'gro /sgom sgrub rgyun mi 'chad du gyis shig ces/ /nyin mtshan med par bar ma chad du 'bab/ /yi dam sgom zhing grag stong sngags kyi sgra/ /'di ltar sgogs zhes skad snyan lhung lhung sgog /ljon shing rnams kyis skal bzang las 'phro can/ /ri la shog ces yal 'dab phyogs kun g.yob/ /751

ting 'dzin sgom dus lus po sa gcig tu/ /'di ltar sdod ces g.yo 'gul med par gnas/ /nyams rtogs yon tan 'di bzhin 'char dgos zhes/ /sna tshogs me tog shar bas kun la ngom/ /'chi ba mi rtag yang yang dran pa'i phyir/ /ston dus mi rtag rnam 'gyur mang po ston/ /bser bus nyi mas 'o brgyal byed kyis dogs/ /yar mar nas 'ong bsil yab yang yang g.yab/ /ri khrod pa la spos rengs ma mchis zhes/ /dri bzang mang po sna yi sgo ru skyel/ /nor rdzas gang la'ang chags zhen ma che bar/ /nga bzhin gyis zhes chags med bzhud nas 'gro /bya dang bye'us gcig pur skyo yis dogs/ /thag nyer 'khor nas skad snyan mang po 'byen/ /gsog 'jog mi dgos bza' btung las sla zhes/ /gang byung zas la brten nas bde bar rgyu/ /gang la'ang chags pa med pa 'di bzhin du/ /song zhes sdong rtse gcig nas gcig tu 'phur/ /me tog sna tshogs lang tsho dar la babs/ /mdzes mas bslu brid byed bzhin rtse dga' rgod/ /bung ba gzhon nus glu dbyangs len bzhin 'ong / /mchu yis gtugs shing shab shub byed bzhin 'gul/ /dben par 'dug dus 'di bzhin mgur dbyangs 'dra/ /longs zhes rgyang glu snyan la ring ba len/ /dben par gnas pa'i rnal 752

'byor ngo mtshar zhes/ /yang yang bskor zhing gos la byen rlabs zhu/ /yid 'ong mdzes ma la yang ma chags zhes/ /phyi mig tsam yang mi blta rgyang ring 'phur/ /e ma ri khrod dben pa'i gnas mchog 'dir/ /dngos po rnams kyis brda chos cir yang ston/ /lha yul skyed tshal mi yul 'phos pa bzhin/ /ngo mtshar nyams dga'i ltad mo ci yang snang / /de 'dra'i ngo mtshar dben pa'i dga' tshal na/ /phyi ru nyi mas bsros pas sgyu lus bde/ /nang du 'od gsal shar bas yid kyang bde/ /bar nas glu dbyangs len pas ngag kyang bde/ /bdag gis lus ngag yid gsum bde tshul 'di/ /gzigs rgyu yin na bal yul rgyal pos kyang / /thugs ngal 'o brgyal byung ba'i dus skabs tshor/ /thugs smon 'chor snyam gzhan tsho smos ci dgos/ /'di 'dra'i gnas su chos pa mi sdod par/ /grong yul rnams su 'khyams nas ci bya zhes/ /skad gseng mthon pos rgyal khams yongs la sgog /skal bzang las 'phro can gyis go bar shog /ces nyin gcig sems la shar ba ltar blangs pa'o/ /yang dben gnas nyams dga' der nyin gcig ri zur zhig na gcig pur khams bsangs byas yod dus/ rang gi sems la da ni rang na so ni rgas/ mgo yang dkar por 753

song nas 'chi la nye/ da ri khrod re nas sdod pa ma gtogs 'chi khar 'gro rgyu yang mang na mi bzang / 'gro 'dod rung rgas nas 'gro yang mi thub pas/ phyogs thag ring gi slob ma yon bdag rnams kyis phal chero la mi mjal bar thag chod snyam/ 'du 'bral dang skye 'chi 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs rnams la bsams pas sems skyo tshe skyo mgur 'di blangs so//sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo/ /chos phung brgyad khri yi 'byung gnas/ /'phags tshogs dge 'dun gye rgyan gcig /drin can bla ma rang mkhyen no/ /dbyar gsum than pa kho'i rkyen gyes/ /lo tog skyo mo rang 'dug pas/ /g.yu 'brug sbrang char dang bcas te/ /zhing mo'i skyo rogs la byon cig /dpyid gsum tsha gdungs kho'i rkyen gyis/ /gser mig skyo mo rang 'dug pas/ /gangs chu bsil ngar dang bcas te/ /nya mo'i skyo rogs la byon cig /na so rgas pa kho'i rkyen gyis/ /bu nga skyo mo rang 'dug pas/ /bla ma byin rlabs dang bcas te/ /sprang po'i skyo rogs la byon cig /'ja' tshon sprin char gyis skyong dus/ /legs legs 'dra mo zhig 'dug ste/ /skyi bser rlung po kho slebs tshe/ /legs rung sdod dbang zhig mi gda'/ /me tog drod gsher gyis skyong dus/ /mjes mjes 'dra mo zhig 'dug 754

ste/ /ston bser ba mo kho slebs tshe/ /mdzes rung sdod dbang zhig mi gda'/ /sgyu lus zas gos kyis skyong tshe/ /bde bde 'dra mo zhig 'dug ste/ /'chi bdag bdud po kho byung tshe/ /bde rung sdod dbang zhig mi gda'/ /nya mo'i tshe srog la 'tshe ba'i/ /nya rgya mtsho 'gram na gda' 'o/ /zas phyir mtsho mtha' ru ma 'gro /mtsho dkyil gting ring du bzhugs shig /rgod po'i tshe srog la 'tshe ba'i/ /thag rnyi sa 'og na gda' 'o/ /grong ba'i rta ro'i rtsar ma 'gro /brag stod mthon po ru bzhugs shig /chos pa'i sku srog la 'tshe ba'i/ /lha 'dre grong yul na gda' 'o/ /'dre 'dul grong chog la ma 'gro /ri khrod dben pa ru bzhugs shig /ces blangs tshe/ steng nas nam mkha'i lhas dro 'jam nyi ma'i gos bskon/ 'og nas sa'i lha mo brtan mas sngo ljang rtswa 'jam me tog gi gdan phul/ /bar snang nas rlung lhas dri zhim zhig khyer nas bsil sang sang 'ong dus lus sems la bde ba byung ba'i nyams dga' ba'i shugs kyis rlung lha la 'di skad ces smras so//e ma rlung lha gang la yang / /chags med rgyu ba ngo mtshar che/ /da res dri zhim skyel dang bcas/ /'di ru yong la bdag yid spro/ /mi rgan na so rgas pa'i mthus/ /phyogs kun 'khor 755

ba dka' mor gda'/ /khyod kyis phyogs rnams thams cad kyang / /dka' tshegs med par 'khor bar gda'/ /gtam rnams phyogs kun skyel ba yi/ /bang chen 'os su khyod nyid bzang / /bdag gis phyogs kun 'phrin zhig skur/ /dgos pas khyed kyis skyel rogs gyis/ /bdag gi yul mi khyim mtshes dang / /phyogs phyogs dad can pho mo la/ /mi nga na so rgas nas gda'/ /mgo yang dkar por song 'dug gyis/ /kho bo smra lce bde dus su/ /'di 'dra'i 'phrin zhig bskur song gyis/ /bla mar mos gus mdzod cig gyis/ /grogs la brtse gdung skyed cig gyes/ /'gro la snying rje sgoms shig gyis/ /chos la dag snang mdzod cig gyis/ /sdig pa ci yang ma byed gyis/ /dge ba ci nus sgrubs shig gyis/ /rang rgyud gyong po thul cig gyis/ /yang yang nan tan bshad song gyis/ /da dung tshe mjug 'di nyid la/ /yang yang mjal bar smon no gyis/ /gal te tshe 'dir ma mjal kyang / /khyed rnams sems la 'jog go gyis/ /'di nas tshe 'phos gyur ma thag /mngon dga'i zhing du 'gro'o gyis/ / de nas dpal dang ldan pa'i zhing / /bde ba can du 'gro'o gyis/ /de nas las rab rdzogs pa'i zhing / /'og min zhing du 'gro'o gyis/ /slar yang 'ongs nas khyed 756

rnams kyang / /zhing de rnams su 'khrid do gyis/ /gzhan yang sprul pa mang po zhig /'jig rten khams su 'ong ngo gyis/ /tshe 'dir dngos su mjal na yang / /bshad rgyu 'di ka yin no gyis/ /gal te ma mjal shi song yang / /kha chems 'di lhag med do gyis/ /ma mjal ba la sems ma skyo/ /skye ba phyi mar mjal lo gyis/ /mjal nas dag pa'i zhing khams su/ /da lta'i gtam rnams gleng ngo gyis/ /de 'dra 'ong ba nga yis byed/ /khyed rnams dga' ba sgoms shig gyis/ /byas pas kho na re/ legs so skyes mchog rin po che/ /khyed kyis gang gsung 'phrin 'di rnams/ /kun la bdag gis cis kyang skyel/ /nyan nam mi nyan khong tshos shes/ /yang yang dri bzang 'bul dus 'ong / /myur myur mjal ba'i smon lam 'tshal/ /mjal dus gnas tshul zhib tu zhu/ /mjal rag bar du bde bar bzhugs/ /zhes dngos po gang la yang chags pa dang lus pa med par shugs sgra dang bcas te bzhud song tshe/ nga yang dngos po gang la yang chags pa med par 'di bzhin 'gro dgos snyam pa byung ngo / /yang gnas mchog nyams dga' der sdod dus slob ma yon bdag 'ga' zhig gis bde zhus byas pa'i lan du/757

ngo mtshar ri ngogs sngo ljang rtswa yis khengs/ /stod na ri dwags smad na sgo phyugs gnas/ /'bab chu'i skad snyan lhung lhung sgog bzhin 'bab/ /ljon shing sna tshogs yal gas gar stabs g.yo/ /yid 'ong bya dang bye'us skad snyan bsgyur/ /me tog gzhon nus dga' ba'i 'dzum zhal ston/ /bung ba khra mos snyan pa'i glu chung len/ /ba lu shug pa'i dri bzang ngad pa 'thul/ /de 'dra'i ngo mtshar dben pa'i ri ngogs na/ /rnal 'byor bde ba'i bde tshul dbyangs su len/ /pha yul spangs pas zhen chags med pas bde/ /gnyen bshes spangs pas chags sdang med pas bde/ /nor rdzas spangs pas sdug bsngal med pas bde/ /'phrad mjal spangs pas g.yeng ba med pas bde/ /phung khams lha ru gsal bas sgyu lus bde/ /yi dam snying po bzlas pas ngag kyang bde/ /gsal stong ngang la bzhag pas sems kyang bde/ /mdor na lus ngag yid gsum tshe 'dir bde/ /tshogs gnyis bsod nams bsags pas phyi mar bde/ /'di phyi gnyis gar bde ba bla ma'i drin/ /drin lan sgrub pa'i mchod pa rgyun du 'bul/ /rnal 'byor bde tshul dbyangs su blangs pa la/ /dgyes par mdzod cig slob bu yon bdag rnams/ /zhes blangs pas dga' mgu yi rang bar gyur to/ /758

yang gnas bzang po der sdod pa'i dus/ nyin gcig slob bu kun dga' legs pa/ skal bzang 'phrin las/ skal bzang don 'grub/ blo bzang tshul khrems/ 'jam dbyangs rang grol sogs skal ldan gyi slob bu rnams la phan pa'i chos bshad 'di ltar byas so//kye skal ldan rigs kyi bu rnams ma yengs par nyon la yid la legs par zungs shig de yang 'o skol rnams kyi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas spyir 'khor ba dang / khyad par ngan song gi gnas rnams su skye ba grangs med pa blangs pas/ dper na dud 'gro nag po kha cig gi lus kyi spu rnams las lhag cing / da res lan cig thob pa'i dal 'byor gyi mi lus rin po che 'di ni spu de rnams kyi dkyil nas dpral ba'i spu mdog dkar po dang 'dra la/ da res lus thog 'di la chos rnam dag cig byas te gtan du bde ba'i gzhi zhig ma thongs na/ phyi nas 'di lta bu'i lus rten shin tu rnyed par dka' ste/ spyod 'jug las/ dal 'byor 'di ni shin tu rnyed par dka'/ /skyes bus don 'grub thob par gyur pa la/ /gal te 'di la phan pa ma bsgrubs na/ /phyis nas yang dag 'byor bar ga la 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin du rgyu dang / dpe dang grangs kyi sgo gang nas bsams 759

kyang rnyed par dka'/ rnyed par dka' ba tsam du ma zad 'di la brten nas chos byas na mngon mtho dang nges legs kyi go 'phang gang yang 'thob pas don chen po dang ldan pa'i tshul bsams nas/ tshe 'di'i mi nor zas gsum gang la'ang mi chags par dam pa'i chos kho na la 'bad nas/ chos pa rab 'chi ba la brod/ 'bring mi 'tsher/ tha ma mi 'gyod gsungs pa ltar/ 'chi ba'i dus su brod pa dang mi 'tsher ba ma byung kyang /mi 'gyod pa tsam re ma byung na/ pha mas gso skyong byas pa dang /bla mas dbang chos gnang ba'i la yog kyang ga nas theg sor bcu brang la khrems la soms dang rang re bu slob rnams/ spyir skyes pa'i tha ma 'chi/ 'dus pa'i tha ma 'bral/ bsags pa'i tha ma 'dzad/ mthon po'i mthar ltung ba bzhi las ma 'das te/de'i nang nas kyang / skyes pa'i nangs par nas bzung / 'chi ba'i phyogs su 'gro ba yin te/ skyes rabs las/ dang po mngal du zhugs pa'i nub mo nas/ /deng nas bzung ste 'jig rten 'di dag kun/ /lam du zhugs nas lam gzhan ma nor bar/ /'chi bdag drung du de ni nye bar 'gro /gsungs so/ /de nas rang re rnams kyi mi tshe ni lug gi mjug ma las thung / blo sna ni rta rnga las ring / 'chi bdag kho nam yong cha med de/ sang 760

gnangs dang 'jig rten phyi ma gnyis kyi gang sngon du 'ong mi shes pas/ de na 'chi rtsis kyi blo sna bstungs nas/ tshe 'di'i bya bzhag thams cad gcig bsgyur gnyis bskyur byas nas bzhag ste/ kye ma bdag lo rjes ma dang / zla ba phyi ma dang / sang gi da tsam la yang sdod rgyu yod dam med ci shes/ do nub yin yang mi 'chi ba'i nges pa ci yod/ lo rjes ma dang zla ba phyi ma sang gnangs kyi bya ba dran nas ci zhig bya da lta nyid du 'chi brod tshags su tshud pa'i chos shig bya snyam pa'i blo sna thung rbud pa zhig dus rgyun du gal che/ shi ba'i 'og tu sdig pa byas pa rnams ngan song gsum du skyes nas sdug cing / dge ba byas pa rnams mtho ris thar pa'i gnas su skyes nas bde bar 'gyur te/ dper na sa bon mngar ba btab pa las 'bras bu mngar ba dang / sa bon sgyur ba btab pa las/ 'bras bu sgyur ba 'byung ba dang 'dra'o/ /las rgyu 'bras gnyis las bden pa zhig med kyang /deng sang kha cig na re/ rgyu 'bras zhib zhib byed pa 'di rnams theg dman nyan rang gi lugs yin/ 'o skol theg chen gyi lta ba rtogs pa rnams kyis rgyu 'bras phra mo la ltos ga la dgos zer ba yod de/ de ni stong ba nyid la blta nyes na/ shes rab chung rnams phung bar 'gyur gsungs pa dang / theg chen gyi spyod pa/761

theg dman gyi srog gcod zer ba'i phyogs su song ba yin pas/de 'dra zhig tu ma song ba gal che ste/ slob dpon chen pos/lta ba nam mkha' bas kyang mtho/ /las rgyu 'bras bag phye bas kyang zhib/ /nga bla ma pad+ma 'byung gnas yin/ —/chos rgyu 'bras shan 'byed kyi gdams ngag bdog /ces dang / de bzhin du dwags po lha rje rin po ches kyang / lta ba nam mkha' las mtho yang / rgyu 'bras bag phye las zhib pa gal che gsungs/ mi dge ba'i dbang gis ngan song gsum du skyes na sdug bsngal yod pa smos ci dgos/ mi dge bcu spong sogs dge ba chung ngu'i mthus mtho ris mi'i nang du skyes na yang / skye rga na 'chi yod med 'du 'bral brdeg brdung dbang che chung sogs dang / de bzhin du lha ma yin la 'thab rtsod/ lha la 'chi 'pho ltung pa'i sdug bsngal sogs sdug bsngal bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ dran pa nyer bzhag las/ 'khor ba khab kyi rtse tsam na/ /bde ba nam yang yod ma yin/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin 'khor ba 'dir skyes phyin chad sdug bsngal kho na ma gtogs bde ba'i go skabs skad cig tsam yang mi 'dug pas/ des na 'khor ba'i bde ba tshe 'di'i phun tshogs thams cad sgyugs nad cam gyes zas mthong ba dang / pha bsad kyi bus dgra mi sha bo mthong ba ltar 762

zhen pa ldog cing rgyab tu bsgyur ba dang / thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang thob na yon tan yod tshul bsams nas/ de thob 'dod kyi blo dper na skom pas chu 'dod pa'am/'dod chags can gyis mdzes ma mthong ba ltar yid la dung nge ba zhig dus rgyun du med thabs mi 'dug pas snying nas yang yang soms dang kho re tsho/ 'khor ba las thar nas sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa la/ rang stobs kyis 'thob pa'i re ba dang bral 'dug pas/ gzhan zhig gi mthu la brten nas 'thob dgos te/ dper na 'jig rten na khas dman gyi mis dpon dpon po la re zhing ltos pa ltar/ bla ma dkon mchog gsum la re zhing bltos dgos/ de la re na spyir 'khor ba dang khyad par ngan song gsum gye 'jigs pa las bskyabs nas/ thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang la 'god nges pas snying thag pa nas blo bkal te skyabs su 'gro dgos/ sangs rgyas thob pa'i sa bon lta bu ni sems bskyed yin pas/ byams snying rjes kun nas bslangs te smon 'jug gi sems bskyed dgos/ tshogs gnyis ma bsags na sangs rgyas mi 'thob pas/ tshegs chung ngu la don che ba tshogs gnyis bde blag tu rdzogs pa'i thabs kyi mchog maṇ+ḍal yin pas ‘nabul dgos/ sgrib pa ma dag na sangs 763

mi rgya bas/ sdig sgrib nyes lhung thams cad 'khru ba'i chu rgyun lta bu'i dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas yang dag pa bya dgos/ bla ma'i byen rlabs ma zhugs na sangs mi rgya bas/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor sgoms la snying thag pa nas gsol ba 'debs pa gal che/ deng sang kha cig gis sngon 'gro 'di rnams la yang ha cang nan tan chen po mi dgos/ spros pa mang pos ci bya/spros bral phyag rgya chen po gcig pu bsgoms pas chog zer ba yang yod de/ de mar ma chod par rdo mur zer ba dang 'dra/bal yul du ma phyin pa'i mi la rgya gar gyi rgyus gang nas 'ong / de 'dra bshad pa'i kha la yang nyan mi rung / sngon 'gro zab na dngos gzhi zab zer bas sngon 'gro 'di rnams nyams rtogs ma skyes pa skye ba dang / skyes pa rnams mi nyams par gong 'phel du gtong ba'i thabs med mi rung yin pas thog mtha' bar gsum du gal che/ de nas myur du sangs rgya ba'i thabs gsang sngags kyi lha gang rung zhig gi smin byed kyi dbang thob/ dbang dus su khas blangs pa bzhin dam tshig dang sdom pa gtsang bar byas nas bskyed rdzogs kyi lam la bag chags ci nus 'jog khyad par rdzogs rim gyi mthar thug sems nyid stong gsal 'dzin med khyab gdal klong yangs spros bral nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang 764

la yun ring gi bar la mnyam par 'jog dgos/ de ltar chos byed dus tshe 'di'i bya ba blos thongs la/ dman pa'i sa bzung hrul po'i gos gyon/ gyong lto gos gtam gsum la thongs/ rtag tu ri'i bu gyis/ na bun gos ltar gyon/ brag phug zhwa ltar sten/g.yas nas shing chag g.yon nas brag nyil/ steng nas gnam rdib/ 'og nas sa 'gul yang stan gyi thog tu spang la phur ba btab pa bzhin sdod tshugs pa'i snying rus dgos/ gzhan yang bla ma la mos gus/ grogs mched la brtse gdung / sems can la snying rje/ chos la dag snang rnams dgos/ spyir sems can thams cad/ sgos su chos sgor zhugs tshad/ yang sgos su bla ma gcig gi bka' chos la lhan du nyan pa'i grwa rogs grogs mched mchog dman 'bring gsum thams cad gong du 'khur dgos/ rang gis dman sa bzung nas/ gzhan thams cad la bsnyen bkur ci nus dang / che brjod ci lcogs/ rang gis pham kha len ci thub/ gzhan la khe gtong ci nus byed dgos te/sngon rgyal ba rgod tshang bas/ mched grogs 'ga' dang bcas/stod phyogs la phebs pa'i lam bar rnams su/ khur bo che shos re yod na khong gis bsnams/ nyin par gnas bde ba re yod na khong tsho bzhugs su bcug mi bde ba'i sar khong rang 765

bzhugs/ nub mo mal bde ba rnams su grogs rnams spor/grang ba re yod na khong rang bzhugs/ gsol zas zhim pa re yod na gzhan la 'dren/ mi zhim pa rnams khong rang gsol ba sogs byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa de 'dra mdzad 'dug pas skyabs su mchi/ de 'dra ma byung yang de'i cha 'dra re ci nas kyang bya dgos te/ rang re rnams ni mnyam du tshogs la 'gro na thog mar gral 'go gang mtho re blta/ de la bshos len na yang zan gang che la mig gzhug skom 'thung na phor ba la che 'dam byed/'gyed kha len na khe gang che blta/ gtam gyi bzang ngan 'dres na pha rol po'i tshig rtsub sna re yang mi bzod/ rgyu bar du bcug na phul gang gi pham kha yang len mi nus pa/ de lta bu ni kha dal nang nas lce dal g.yug rkyang gi chos pa ma gtogs/ rkyen dang 'phrad na 'jig rten mi nag pa las lod pa yang yong srid pas de 'drar ma song bar gong du bshad pa ltar rang dman sar 'dug cing / gzhan thams cad gong du 'khur nus pa'i dam bca' bzhag nas lag len la ci thebs byed 'tshal/de ltar chos dang mthun pa'i dge ba gang byas thams cad gzhan don dang bla med byang chub 'thob pa'i rgyu ru bsngo zhing /mjug tu bstan 'gro spyi la phan pa dang / khyad par rang nyid 766

myur ba myur du sangs rgyas nas bstan 'gro'i don rlabs chen 'byung ba'i rnam dag smon lam gyi mtshams sbyor byed pa gal che/de ltar byas na myur du sangs rgyas nas bstan 'gro yongs la phan zhing / bdag gzhan don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /zhes mgur dbyangs 'di rnams blangs so//rje rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang / /steng spyi gtsug pad zla'i gdan la bzhugs/ /bu 'dir 'tshogs yongs la thugs rjes gzigs/ /mchog sangs rgyas 'thob par byin gyis rlobs/ /khyed skal ldan snying gi slob bu rnams/ /yid ma yengs pha yi glu 'dir nyon/ /rten dal 'byor mi lus rnyed par dka'/ /dpe u dusba ra'i me tog 'dra/ /de rnyed pa'i dus su chos byas na/ /don chen po 'byung ba'i nor bu 'dra/ /nyin re re song gin 'chi la nye/ /dpe gsod sar 'khrid pa'i dud 'gro 'dra/ /rang nam 'chi cha med 'chi rkyen mang / /dpe char rlung gseb kyi mar me 'dra/ /las dkar nag gnyis kyi phan gnod de/ /dper bzhag na dug dang bdud rtsi 'dra/ /las sdig spangs dge ba bsgrub pa de/ /dpe dug spangs bdud rtsi blangs pa 'dra/ /spyir 'khor ba'i gnas na bde ba med/ /dpe khab kyi rtse la gnas pa 'dra/ /sgos ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal de/ /dpe rab tu tsha 767

ba'i me 'obs 'dra/ /de bsams nas 'jigs skrag skye ba de/ /dpe btson rar 'khrid pa'i mi dang 'dra/ /sdug de las thar par 'dod pa de/ /dpe btson rar tshud pa'i nag can 'dra/ /der thar phyir skyabs 'gro byed pa de/ /dpe nag can rgyal por skyabs 'tshol 'dra/ /yang sems bskyed byed pas sangs rgyas rgyu/ /dpe ston thog rgyu yi sa bon 'dra/ /tshogs bsags thabs tshegs chung maṇ+ḍal de/ /dpe bong chung rin chen gser dang 'dra/ /sdig sbyong thabs rdor sems bsgom bzlas de/ /dpe dri ma 'khru ba'i chu rgyun 'dra/ /rje mtshan ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma de/ /dpe yid bzhin nor bu rin chen 'dra/ /rang spyi bor bla ma bsgom pa de/ /dpe nor bu rgyal mtshan rtser bzhag 'dra/ /rje bla mar gsol ba 'debs pa de/ /dpe nor bur gsol ba 'debs pa 'dra/ /mchog thun mong dngos grub 'byung ba de/ /dpe nor bur dgos 'dod 'byung ba 'dra/ /rgyud smin byed dbang bzhi thob pa de/ /dpe rgyal bu rgyal sar bton pa 'dra/ /lam grol byed bskyed rdzogs bsgom pa de/ /dpe nye ba'i gsang lam zhugs pa 'dra/ /nang rang gi sems kyi gnas lugs de/ /dpe stong gsal nam mkha' yangs pa 'dra/ /de'i ngang la mnyam par 'jog pa de/ /dpe khyung chen mkha' la lding ba 768

'dra/ /chos thams cad snang la rang bzhin med/ /dpe bar snang shar ba'i 'ja' tshon 'dra/ /rje bla mar mos gus byed pa de/ /dpe rtag tu ngu dang nor bzang 'dra/ /grogs rnams la brtse gdung byed pa de/ /dpe rgyal ba rgod tshang pa dang 'dra/ /ma 'gro la snying rje byed pa de/ /dpe bu gcig na ba'i ma dang 'dra/ /snying brtse bas 'gro kun skyong ba de/ /dpe ma yis bu gces skyong ba 'dra/ /gzhan thams cad gong du 'khur ba de/ /dpe bka' gdams gong ma'i rnam thar 'dra/ /rang rtag tu dman sa 'dzin pa de/ /dpe rigs ngan dbul po'i bu dang 'dra/ /dge gang bsags rdzogs byang bsngo ba de/ /dpe rta kha gyen du bsgyur ba 'dra/ /mjug smon lam rnam dag 'debs pa de/ /dpe zhing la sa bon 'debs pa 'dra/ /chos byas pas sangs rgyas 'thob pa de/ /dpe rgyal ba shākya thub pa 'dra/ /'bad rtsol med 'gro la phan pa de/ /dpe dpag bsam shing dang nor bu 'dra/ /rang de 'dra 'dod na bu slob rnams/ /don de ltar mdzod dang 'thob par nges/ /glu 'di nyid blangs pa'i dge ba'i mthus/ /grwa bu slob thams cad 'tshang rgya shog ces dang / yang ang yig sum cu ma 'di yang byen no//bla ma rgyal ba sras bcas kyis/ /skal ldan bu rnams rjes su 769

zungs/ /rjes su phan pa'i kha ta la/ /da lta ma yengs nyon cig ang / /bla ma long ba'i lam mkhan 'dra/ /nam yang 'jus nas ma gtong ang / /gdams ngag sman mchog bdud rtsi 'dra/ /nyon mongs nad sel 'thungs shig ang / /mched lcam lam grogs bzang po 'dra/ /brtse ba'i grogs dang 'grogs shig ang / /mi lus yid bzhin nor bu 'dra/ /don med chud gzon ma byed ang / /mi tshe la mgo'i nyi zer 'dra/ /yun thung 'chi chos gyis shig ang / /dge sdig lus kyi grib ma 'dra/ /shi dus rjes su 'brang ngo ang / /'khor ba srin mo'i gling dang 'dra/ /myur du thar thabs gyis shig ang / /nye 'brel 'khor ba'i zhags pa 'dra/ /dung sems zhen pa ma che ang / /pha yul bdud kyi btson ra 'dra/ /rgyab tu skyur la bros shig ang / /'gro kun tshe 'di'i pha ma 'dra/ /byams dang snying rjes skyongs shig ang / /sdang dgra ston mjug me tog 'dra/ /rang yal 'gro bas ma khro ang / /nor rdzas sbrang ma'i sbrang rtsi 'dra/ /bsags kyang 'dzad pas ma chags ang / /bya bzhag chu yi ri mo 'dra/ /zin pa med pas zhog cig ang / /bzang ngan gtam rnams brag cha 'dra/ /don med dga' sdug ma byed ang / /skyed sdug dbyar dgun res mos 'dra/ /bde sdug zhum khengs ma che 770

ang / /phyug po yi dwags gter srung 'dra/ /'dod chung chog shes gyis shig ang / /che 'gying dmag mi'i dpon po 'dra/ /dgos med dman sa zungs shig ang / /dkor nag dug gi chu dang 'dra/ /ha cang sred pa ma che ang bza' tshang tshong 'dus mgron po 'dra/ /rtag 'dzin zhen pa ma che ang / /zhe sdang khang bar me shor 'dra/ /rang rgyud bsreg pas sod cig ang / /thos pa mun sel sgon me 'dra/ /bla ma'i bka' chos nyon cig ang / /sbyin pa phyi ma'i brgyags phye 'dra/ /gang yod sbyin par thongs shig ang / /tshul khrims thar pa'i them skas 'dra/ /mig 'bras bzhin du srungs shig ang / /bzod pa g.yul ngo'i go cha 'dra/ /khro med bzod pa sgoms shig ang / /brtson 'grus rta bzang zhon pa 'dra/ /sa lam bgrod pas rem zhig ang / /zhi gnas brtan pa'i mkhar dang 'dra/ /yengs med bsam gtan sgoms shig ang / /lhag mthong mun la nyi shar 'dra/ /shes rab sgon me sbor cig ang / /sems kyi gnas lugs nam mkha' 'dra/ /de yi ngang la zhog cig ang / /chos rnams bar snang 'ja' tshon 'dra/ /bden med sgyu mar ltos shig ang / / nyams snang mdzes ma'i bslu brid 'dra/ /de la zhen chags ma che ang / /chos rnams lo yag snye ma 'dra/ /kun 771

la dag snang mdzod cig ang / /ang yig sum cu'i zhal gdams 'di/ /khyed rnams sems la chongs shig ang / /'dis mtshon dge bas 'gro kun gyis/ /'di bzhin chos byas 'tshang rgya shog /ces smras pas der 'tshogs pa'i grwa bu slob thams cad la sngar bas blo bskyed thon pa byung ngo / /de dus lung rtogs yon tan du ma dang ldan pa'i brag dkar sprul ba'i sku rje btsun chos kyi dbang phyug rin po che la 'tshams zhus su zhu shog 'di phul lo//lung rtogs yon tan du ma'i gter mdzod 'dzin/ /mkhas shing grub pa mchog gi pha rol tu/ /son pa'i rje btsun chos kyi dbang phyug gi /zhabs kyi pad+mo dri ma med drung du/ /phyogs med rgyal khams 'grims pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /nges med dben par sdod pa'i ri khrod pa/ /chos med zhabs dkar bla ma'i ming can gyis/ /zol med sgo gsum gus pas 'di skad zhu/ /mgon khyod bskal pa dpag med sngon rol nas/ /sangs rgyas mang po'i drung du thugs mchog bskyed/ /tshogs gnyis bsags nas sangs rgyas tshar zin pas/ /da ni yang sangs rgyas rgyu ma mchis mod/ /'on kyang bdag 'dra'i gdul bya'i snang ngo ru/ /slar yang dge ba'i bshes gnyen gzugs su shar/ /rje btsun rang 772

gi rnam thar ji bzhin du/ /rjes 'jug rnams kyis lam la slob pa'i phyir/ /sku tshe 'dir yang na tshod gzhon dus nas/ /bla ma mang bsten thos bsam sgom gsum la/ /'bad nas slar yang yang sangs rgyas rgyu zhig /yod yod lta ba'i mdzad pa ston tshul la/ /legs par bsams tshe go rgyu chen po byung / /ngo mtshar rnam thar kun gyi mchog tu mthong / /bka' drin che'o bla ma rin po che/ /da dung de 'dra'i mdzad pa ci yang ston/ /gus phran bdag gi mi tshe cha gsum byas/ /cha gnyis chos nyan rnam g.yeng ngang la zad/ /da ni tshe mjug la mgo'i nyi zer tsam/ /yun thung cha gcig tsam gyi ring 'di la/ /yun ring mi sdod nam 'chi nges pa med/ /yar 'gro mar 'gro mang po cham gyis bzhag /shes blo thob blo'i spros pa rbad kyis bcad/ /gcig pur ri khrod dben pa'i dga' tshal du/ /sgyu ma rmi lam lta bu'i 'khor 'das kyi/ /chos rnams kun gyi rtsa ba rang gi sems/ /stong gsal 'dzin med khyab gdal klong yangs po/ /spros bral nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang du bzhag /de ltar ma rtogs 'gro la snying rje bskyed/ /phan pa'i bsngo ba smon lam mtshams sbyor byas/ /bsdad na rang gzhan 'tshengs pa'i lam rnyed snyam/ /'on kyang 'brel tshad don ldan dge ba'i bshes/ /lan rer mjal yang 773

skal ba bzang tshul dang / /chos rgyun dkon pa'i lung rgyun ma chad na/ /phyin chad bstan pa'i rgyun la phan nam snyam/ /lan re da dung chos la nyan 'dod byung / /de phyir snyom las bdag ni der son tshe/ /nges don yang gsang zab chos stsol dgos zhes/ /da nas bzung ste thal sbyar gsol ba 'debs/ /mngon sum mjal dus brtse bas gnang du gsol/ /zhu yig me tog pad+ma'i dga' tshal la/ /spyan gyi bung ba 'khor zhing g.yo ba'i rten/ /stong min dngos po lha rdzas bcud kyis gtams/ /lha yi lha mchog bla ma mnyes phyir phul/ /zhes phul ba'i lan du 'di skad ces bka' bstsal 'dugaswa ste/ mang thos ha ri'i tsan dan nags klung du/ /sdom gsum bsung zhim dngar bo'i ngad 'thul zhing / /lung rtogs yon tan lo 'dab 'bras bus brjid/ /bshes gnyen dpal gyi ljon pa chen po'i drung / /mkhas pa'i yon tan blun rmongs rkun pos 'phrog /btsun pa'i go cha 'khor ngan grogs kyis bshus/ /bzang po'i ras gos gzhan rkyen rlung gis khyer/ /bya bral gcer bu pa des 'di skad gsol/ /gang sngon ring bo'i bskal par tshogs gnyis smon lam rlung gi shing rtas legs drangs pa'i/ /gzugs sku'i nyin byed mi mthun nyes tshogs sgra gcan 774

kha sgo'i g.yang sa las grol zhing / /'khor lo gsum gyi mdzad 'phrin 'od snang zer brgya phyogs brgyar spro bas gang 'dul gyi/ /'gro blo'i mun bsal phan bde'i pad tshal ci yang rgyas der lan brgyar bsngags par 'os/ /thos pa rgya mtsho'i pha mtha' brgal zhing zab don nor bu'i mdzod kyis phyug /gzhan phan brtse bas bsdu bzhi mi 'jigs sbyin la snying stobs mchog mnga' ba'i/ /rgyal sras spyod pa dam pas rab mjes thar 'dod ded dpon khyod ni 'dir/ /'gran zlar 'os zhes gzhan du rtog kyang rnyed min khyod rang dpe zlar 'os/ /e ma thugs rje wa ti las/ /phan bde chu rgyun bzang po ni/ /rab tu stsol mdzad skye dgu'i gnyen/ /phyag na pad+mo'i gzugs kyi sku/ /bem po'i tshul gyis 'gro 'dul ba/ /rang byung mtshan dpe'i dpal 'bar ba'i/ /spyan sngar snang gsal rin chen snod/ /mchod pa'i sprin phung dpag med dang / /lhan cig bstan 'gror phan dang bde'i/ /rgya chen smon lam kun bzang gi/ spyod pa la 'gran bsgrubs mdzad ces/ /snyan pa tshangs gnas bar du khyab/ /phal cher brkam chags 'jur 'gegs kyi/ /mdud pas dam bcings shi spar 'thams/ /sdig sdug gtam ngan khyad bsad nas/ /zang zing ched du srog kyang gtong / /gang khyod 775

legs byas tshul 'di yis/ /dpyod ldan kun la yi rang gi /dpal yon ster mod 'ga' zhig la/ /sdug bsngal zug rngu'ang sbyin pa snyam/ /sngon chad 'byor ldan gzhan dag gis/ /'jug pa lta ci sgon pas kyang / /spobs par ma nus tshul 'di 'dra/ /ci zhes lha rnams ca co sgrog /de phyir rmad byung tshogs gnyis kyi/ /sa bon n+ya gro tas bskyed pa'i/ /bde gshegs mar me mdzad dpal bzhin/ /mngon du gyur la som nyir ci/ /tshul de yi rang bsngags pa yi/ /shis brjod man+da ra yi phreng / /gang gi mgul bar mdzes brgyan slad/ /rten 'byung legs so'i cha rkyen spel/ /rgyal bas yongs bsngags ne pa la yi ljongs/ /'dzam gling mdzes rgyan rten mchog zung la sogs/ /ngo mtshar gnas rten kun la rmad byung gi /legs mdzad spro bzhin rings par 'dir byon nam/ /sngon byon dam pa mang pos nyer bsten pa'i/ /dben pa'i ri ngogs 'chi med bdag po yi/ /skyed tshal rang byung gor mo'i sa srung steng / /bsam gtan zhi ba'i khang bzang nyams dga' bar/ /'khor 'das chos su btags pa'i rtog tshogs kun/ /yan lag drug ldan rdo rje rnal 'byor gyis/ /'dzin med rang sar mnyam nyid klong yangs su/ /grol ba'i ting 'dzin sgo brgyar snyoms 'jug cing / /bzang ngan 776

phyogs rer zhen pa'i lta grub kyis/ /a 'thas kha 'dzin rang rang rgyal bstan du/ /rlom pa'i spyod tshul sprin gyes don dam nyi/ /bsgribs gyur yang dag lam las gzhan du ring / /gang khyod ris med chos tshul chu klung 'bum/ /zab thugs rgya mtshor ro gcig 'gal med du/ /rtogs pa'i gu yangs nyams kyi rlabs phreng can/ /legs bshad lpu dkar cir yang spro de rmad/ /dag pa'i gzigs pa yangs po'i do ra nas/ /bka' mchid ri mo lhug par grol ba'i skyes/ /lha rdzas gos dar rin chen nyi zla'i spun/ /phyag rgyas mi phyed rgyas btab nyams med son/ /de tshe bdag yid lhan skyes bde stong gis/ /myos pa'i spro dga' gzhal med thob gyur pa/ /a ho sngon med dge mtshan 'di ci zhes/ /som nyir byas te bka' drin gang gis gzhal/ /deng bdag lang tsho'i 'khri shing 'khyogs po ni/ /mchog gsum thugs rje'i ljon pa cher brten nas/ /sgo gsum lhug pa 'du shes gsum kho na'i/ /tir+ya ka yi brtul zhugs skyong bzhin lags/ /'khrul snang kun rtog chu ris zad med ngang / /dal rten stong par zad pa'i gzugs brnyan la/ /chos su btags pa'i gnyis 'phung bsgrub brtson pa'i/ /rang tshul gsol bar yid rab zhum par gyur/ /gang thugs snang srid dag pa rab 777

'byams su/ /'char ba'i gzigs ngor dgyes pa bskyed nus pa'i/ /bdag 'drar legs byas yon tan cha tsam yang ma mchis de phyir dbying sa khrel mi 'tshal lo/ /dka' thub tshogs bcas ring pos ngal ba la/ /bltos min byu ra lam chos kyi rkang mgyogs kyi/ /btsan thabs sbyor bas 'pho med bde ba che'i/ /go 'phang bgrod la bdag kyang smon lags na'ang / /dam sdom lhod cing brtson pa ches dman phyir/ /thabs shes shing rta'i 'khor lo chag gyur pas/ /da ni chu rdo bzhin du gyur 'di su/ /yid la gdung ba'i tshor ba ci yang 'phel/ /gang khyod zab lam don gyi gnad tshang kun/ /lon bzhin da dung chos tshul gdams pa mang / /'tshol ba rgya mtsho chu yis mi ngoms bzhin/ /dam pa'i tshul la yi rang thal sbyar ro/ /ring min myur du mjal ba'i dga' ston dang / /thugs kyis mjal ba nam yang lhod min par/ /mi phyed gnyis med phyag rgyas dam 'khyud pa'i/ /legs bshad bdud rtsi'i skyes kyang legs par stsol/ /sna tshogs ljon pa'i phreng ba rab dkrigs lhung lhung snyan pa'i chu sgra can/ /'dab chags gnyis skyes 'phur lding rol pa'i glu sgra dar dir ci yang sgog /zhi ba'i nags klung bag phebs dben pa'i ri ngogs 'gyur med pha wang steng / /ting 'dzin mi g.yo rgyun du 778

'tsho gzhes khyod ni badz+ra tiṣ+ṭhan+tu/ /de skad mu cor tshig gi phreng / /snyan 'gyur don dang mi ldan kyang / /dgyes pa'i bzhad gad 'phel ba'i slad/ /dga' ba'i zlos gar 'di na bsgyur/ /rab dkar lha yi gos bzang dang / /rgyas pa'i mdangs chags bkra shis pa'i/ /rtags kyi ras kha mngon par bkra/ /rnam thar ngo mtshar pu sta gar/ /mi phyed phyag rgyas nyer btab pa/ /rgyal zla'i dkar po'i tshes bzang por/ /yid kyis sprul pa'i pho nya ni/ /skad cig glog ltar 'khyug ste song / /zhes drang srong grub pa'i bste gnas dka' thub kyi brtul zhugs can kyis kun nas rtsen pa'i brag ri mngon par mtho ba'i spo nas phul ba'i zhu yig sarba maṅga lam/ zhes gsol ras mang po dang bcas gnang byung / nyin gcig slob ma rnams la rang skyon dug gi tsher ma rang gis 'don pa'i man ngag rgya khab rnon po 'di byin no//phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad dang /khyad par rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams kyis mi mngon dbyengs nas thugs khrel rung / re zhig bdag gi bya spyod ngan pa 'di la ye shes spyan gyis gzigs nas phyin chad chos bzhin nus par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ 'o mkhas btsun bzang gsum gye yon tan gang yang med pa'i bla btsongs phyi ldir la nang stong ba 779

sngags pa'i rnga khog dang 'dra ba khyod blo kha nang du khug la bsam blo yag po zhig thongs dang / khyod chos pa yin khul byed kyin 'dug pa/ khyod la dal 'byor gyi mi lus rin po che thob/ bla ma dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas dang mjal/ zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos ni thob/ chos kyi sgor zhugs nas yun ring po zhig song / da snga yan chad la nyams len ci 'dra byas/ nyams rtogs ci tsam shar shod dang / rang gi sems la 'dzin rgyu/ gzhan gye mi la bshad rgyu gnyis ka med rung / rang gi sems la 'dzin rgyu zhig yod dgos/ chos kyi nang na/ chos pa rab la zhag bskyed/'bring la zla bskyed/ tha ma la yang lo bskyed thon yong gsungs na/ khyod la zhag bskyed yong gin 'dug gam/ zla bskyed yong gin 'dug de ma byung kyang lo bskyed thon 'dug gam ltos dang /yar bskyed las mar bskyed chen po 'dra byung med dam/ yang thos rtags zhi zhing dul ba yin/ sgom rtags nyon mongs chung ba yin gsungs pas/ khyod la sngar bas sgo gsum zhi dul ci tsam byung 'dug nyon mongs pa chung du song yod mod/ chung du ma song kyang / che ru song / mang du song / thu ru song 'dra med dam ltos dang / yang chos pa rab 'chi ba la brod/ 'bring mi 'tsher/ tha ma mi 'gyod gsungs pa/ khyod da lta 'chi na brod pa 780

zhig byung ngam/ yang na mi 'tsher ba zhig yod dam/ de ma byung kyang mi 'gyod pa zhig dgos kyang / khyod kyi bya spyod 'di la bltas na/ sang gnangs lta bu zhig la byung na/ 'gyod pa skye bzhin 'chi dgos pa 'dra mi yong ngam/ a dzi'i soms dang /yang / tshe 'di la zhen na chos pa min gsungs pas/ khyod kyi sems tshe 'di'i lto gos dang / gnyen nye ba la zhen nas de zhe phugs su bzhag ste/ bla ma dkon mchog gi rdzas/ dge 'dun pa'i dkor gshin zas dad zas kyi me ma mur thams cad phyogs phyogs nas bsdus te rang gi kha la brgyab pas mi chogaganyen nye ba thams cad kyi kha nang du brgyab nas rang gzhan thams cad kyi rgyud bsreg phod dam/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' las/dkor zas 'di lcags gong me 'bar ba khar bcug pa las nyes pa che bar gsungs pas/ khyod la sangs rgyas kyi gsung de mi bden pa'i khungs dang / brtsi mi dgos pa'i gdeng zhig yod dam/ yang / long ba'i drung na mig ldan ltar/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams/ /rtag tu sgrib med spyan gyis gzigs/ /spyod ngan phag tu ma byed ang / /gsungs pas/mi dran dgu dran mi byed dgu byed/ nyon mongs kyi gong bu/sdig pa'i khres po/ ltung ba'i phad bu/ dkor gye rkyal ba/ chos 781

brgyad kyi khol po/ dge ba'i phyogs la bong chad gyen la ded pa lta bu/ mi dge ba'i phyogs la ri gzar gye 'bab chu lta bu/ khyod tshe 'di la shi spar 'thams nas/ dus de ring nyi ma phan chad la/lus ngag yid gsum dug gsum gyi dbang du song / mi dge ba bcu kho na'i dus 'das kyang / da dung chos pa yin khul byed pa'i ham pa chen po 'di deng sang gi skye bo mi nag pa rnams la 'gro yang / sgrib med ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa'i bla ma dkon mchog la 'gro'am mi 'gro soms dang / yang sangs rgyas kyis chos kyi phung bo brgyad khri bzhi stong nyon mongs brgyad khri bzhi stong 'dul ba'i gnyen por gsungs la/ bla mas kyang chos ci byed na'ang nyon mongs pa ci thul gyis zhes ci tsam zhig gsungs/ grogs kyang bzang po 'ga' res ci tsam zhig bshad de rnams kyi tshig la yang brtsi 'jog med par/ da ni zhe sdang gi me 'bar/ 'dod chags kyi chu 'khrugs/ gti mug gi mun pa 'thibs/ nga rgyal gyi ri gzengs/ phrag dog gi rlung 'tshub/ser sna'i mdud pa dam du dam du song yod pa 'di la ltos dang / gzhan phar zhog da khyod kyis tshig ngan dam dum zhig rna bas go na/ de yang mi bzod par khyod kyi ngo mdangs 'gyur lugs/ kha ngan tshig ngan rgyag lugs 'di gcig pu la ltos 782

dang / 'di 'dra khyod la gyes zhes/ bla mas ma gsungs grogs kyis ma bshad/ 'di khyod kyis dran nam/ yang na 'di 'dra gyis zhes khyod la 'dre zhig gis bshad dam/ de min khyod kyi snying la gdon ci zhig zhugs song / khyod spyos 'dra med dam/ da phyin chad 'di 'dra byas na khyod tshe 'dir sdug la phyi mar dmyal bar 'gro ba rin byen nas nyos pa yin mod/ khyod kyis bla ma'i zhabs drangs grogs kyi mtshang brjod/ chos pa'i bla 'tshong /bstan pa'i mig rkyen la gnod pa 'di 'dra byed dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ci yod shod dang / yang / gang la le lo gcig yod pa/ /de la chos kun med pa yin/ /gsungs pas/ khyod ni mtshan gang bor ro nyal byas/ nyin gang bor rnam g.yeng byas/dge sbyor yud tsam re byas nas grub thob 'ong du re ba khyod kyi ham pa la ltos dang he he/ khyod la chos kyi dri mas ma gos tshar 'dug snying nas chos shig byed na/ za dga' 'thung skyid/rnam g.yeng le lo byed la ma dga' bar/ nyin par gyi lto dang mtshan mo'i gnyid chog la nyams len la rem zhig yang gsang sngags kyi sgor zhugs nas nyams su blangs na rab tshe gcig lus gcig la sangs rgyas/ 'bring 'chi kha bar dor grol/ tha mas kyang dam tshig ma nyams na skye ba bdun nam bcu drug tshun 783

chad la sangs rgyas zhes rdo rje 'chang gis gsungs kyang / khyod kyis dam tshig kyang mi bsrung bar/ ja sun re'i mtho dman la bltas nas/ nga thugs la ma btags zer/ bla ma la dad log dang / tshig re re'i mtho dman la bltas nas/ nga la de 'dra bshad dgos pa'i 'os med ces grogs mched la khong khro byed pa 'di gcig pu la ltos/ dam tshig mi bsrung ba de khyod sangs rgyas 'gro snyam nas 'jigs pa yin nam/ ma bsrungs na dam nyams kyi mis mchod pa phul yang mi bzhes shing / 'chi rkyen ngan pas glo bur du shi na rdo rje'i dmyal bar skye ba dang / de dang lhan du lung ba gcig gi chu 'thung tshad kyang nyams grib kyis non nas dmyal bar 'gro zhes rdo rje 'chang sogs kyis gsungs pa go bzhin du/ da dung dam tshig dang sdom pa mi bsrung bar chal le chol le byed pa 'di/ khyod kyis rdo rje 'chang gis gsungs pa de mi bden snyam pa yin nam/ bden kyang dgos pa med snyam pa yin nam/ yang na rdo rje 'chang gi gsung mi brtsi ba de/ khyod rdo rje 'chang las sa tshod mtho ba zhig yin nam/ yang na pho tshod che ba zhig yin nam/ yang na gdon gyis zin nas snying khog na med pa zhig yin nam/de rnams gang rung zhig las ma 'das da khyod dmyal bar 'gro yang / 'gro zhor la 784

lung ba gcig gi chu 'thung tshad po dmyal bar khrid nas ma 'gro bar 'jog rogs gyis yul khams thams cad ma brlag cigade rnams la go rgyu e byung / da dung mi go rna bar mi 'gro sems la mi 'thad par 'dug na/ khog par gdon chen po 'jigs su rung ba zhig zhugs yod thag chod pas/ da re zhig gi bar du sus kyang thul ba mi 'dug a rdzi 'jigs pa la ci drag da khyod 'jig rten mi yi khyu nas sngar thon tshar 'dugachos pa'i gral nas ro ltar bud 'dug da phyin chad slar ro 'tshangs brgyab nas yang bstan pa nang nas bshig gin ma sdod par phyi rol mu stegs pa lta bu'i rjes su song zhig de la yang 'gro ma thub na sug bzhi sa la btsugs nas/ khyi dang dud 'gro'i rtsar phyin la de'i khyu la e 'dres shig ltos/ de ring gi nyi ma phar bzung nas/ chos pa dang 'jig rten mi yi khyu nas khyod rang bton pa yin pas ma sdod cig chos dang 'jig rten gnyis kyi kha lta bzo lta gang yang med bzhin du/ da dung mi yi gral la yar bsnyegs na/ kun gyis de'i gdong la mchil ma thobs shig khyod kyi gdong gi ko ba de 'brong gi ko ba yin nam/yang na ko ba nyis brtseg gam/ yang na dpral ko shin tu mthug pa zhig yin na ma gtogs ngo mi tsha'am/ 'o da ni mi la ngo 785
