tsha yod snying la rus pa yod/ mgo na klad pa yod/ rang gi rang la sha tsha yod pa zhig yin na/ sngar spyod la 'gyod pa skye ran 'dug go /da spyod la yar bskyed 'don ran 'dug go /ran par ma zad 'phyis grabs 'dug go /skyes pa thams cad 'chi lugs la ltos shig bsags pa thams cad 'dzad lugs la ltos shig 'dus pa thams cad 'bral lugs la ltos shigagang la'ang snying bo med lugs la ltos shig bltas nas snying po yod pa zhig byed na/ blo phugs chos la gtod cig chos phugs sprang la gtod cig sprang phugs shi la gtod cig shi phugs grog po skam po la gtod cig dman pa'i sa zungs shigahrul po'i gos gyon cig gyong lto gos gtam gsum la thongs shig na bun gos ltar gyon cig brag phug zhwa ltar sten cigartag tu ri'i bu gyes shig chos byas pa'i lag rjes grub rtags la sgo gsum zhi zhing dul ba dgos/ rang rgyud nyon mongs chung ba dgos/ chos gang shes tshad thams cad nyon mongs pa'i gnyen por thongs la/ dus de ring nas bzung sngar ltar nyon mongs pa gang yang yan par mi gtong bar/ chags sdang khong khro sogs gang skyes kyang de ma thag gnyen pos 'bur 'joms gyes shig rem zhig thul cig choms shig sun 786

phyungs shig mgo non cig rtsa ba nas thon cig mdor na khyod kyi sngar gyi bya spyod nyes tshar 'dug pas/ da phyin chad bla ma'i bka' bzhin chos bzhin 'dul ba bzhin gyis shig mi mngon dbyings nas bla ma yis/ /mi ngan bdag la gzigs su gsol/ /shig la mdzub mo 'dzugs pa bzhin/ /rang gi skyon la mdzub mo 'dzugs/ /rkang ba'i tsher ma 'don pa bzhin/ /rang skyon sgo ru 'don par bya/ /khyod ni dal 'byor mi lus thob/ /bla ma dus gsum sangs rgyas mjal/ /zab cing rgya che'i gdams pa thob/ /thos don bsgoms pa'i lag rjes la/ /sgo gsum zhi zhing dul dgos kyang / /dul du ma song sdug tu song / /nyon mongs chung du 'gro dgos kyang / /chung du ma song che ru song / /sems la yar bskyed thon dgos kyang / /yar bskyed ma thon mar bskyed thon/ /dad zas dkor gyi rkyal ba 'dra/ /ro nyal byed pa'i glang dang 'dra/ /'dod chags che ba'i bya dang 'dra/ /zhe sdang che ba'i sbrul dang 'dra/ /gti mug che ba'i phag dang 'dra/ /nga rgyal che ba'i seng ge 'dra/ /phrag dog che ba'i khyi dang 'dra/ /ser sna che ba'i yi dwags 'dra/ /sdug la rngams pa'i bshan pa 'dra/ /sha khrag za ba'i srin po 'dra/ /bla ma dus gsum sangs rgyas la/ /mchi ma 'khrugs pa'i dad pa 787

med/ /dam gtsang rdo rje mched lcam la/ /lha ru mthong ba'i dag snang med/ /ma gyur sems can thams cad la/ /ba spu g.yo ba'i snying rje med/ /zab dang rgya che'i gdams pa la/ /nyams su len pa'i brtson 'grus med/ /dad gus med pa'i dam dred po/ /dag snang med pa'i khrel med po/ /snying rje med pa'i snying rul po/ /nyams len med pa'i snyom las po/ /rang skyon mi mthong dmus long bo/ /gzhan skyon brjod pa'i lce bde bo/ /dmyal ba'i gting rdo 'gul med po/ /chos med sdig pa'i las gsog pa'i/ /las ngan 'tshab can khyod 'dra zhig /bla ma dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi/ /zhabs 'dren byed pa khyod 'dra zhig /dam gtsang rdo rje mched lcam gyi/ /rkang 'dren byed pa khyod 'dra zhig /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i mig rkyen la/ /gnod pa'i bstan bshig khyod 'dra zhig /chos pa'i gzugs bzung chos min byed/ /chos pa'i mtshang brjod khyod 'dra zhig /srog ma chad pa'i mi ro zhig /'dres ma khyer ba'i smyon pa zhig /mi glud khyod 'dra gang nas byung / /ltas ngan khyod 'dra gang nas byung / /bza' btung gti mug ro nyal byas/ /khyod kyi brtson 'grus 'di la ltos/ /dge ba'i phyogs la bong chad bzhin/ /khyod la 'gro rgyu med la ltos/ /sdig pa'i phyogs la 'bab chu 788

'dra/ /khyod ni gzhan las mgyogs la ltos/ /tshig ngan tsam re'ang mi bzod par/ /khyod kyi ngo mdangs 'gyur la ltos/ /nyes ltung kun gyi phad bu khyod/ /khyod kyi sdom pa su la bskyal/ /sdig pa'i khres po 'khur mkhan khyod/ /khyod kyi dge ba gang na yod/ /skyon gye phung bo chen po khyod/ /khyod kyi yon tan su yis 'phrog /'jig rten chos brgyad khol po khyod/ /khyod kyis lha chos gang nas byas/ /chos pa'i bzo lta med pa khyod/ /khyod ni ngo yang mi tsha'am/ /mjug ma med pa'i khyi rgan khyod/ /da ni khye yi gral du song / /ya so can gyi ba glang khyod/ /yang na dud 'gro'i khyu zhig snyogs/ /gal te mi 'gro 'dug 'dod na/ /sngar gyi de 'dra byed phod dam/ /da ni mi la ngo tsha yod/ /khog pa'i nang na snying zhig yod/ /mgo bo'i nang na klad pa yod/ /rang la sha tsha zhig yod na/ /sngar byas rnams la 'gyod pa skyed/ /da spyod rnams la yar bskyed thon/ /'don par ma zad 'phyis grabs 'dug /skyes pa thams cad 'chi la ltos/ /bsags pa thams cad 'dzad la ltos/ /'dus pa thams cad 'bral la ltos/ /gang la'ang snying po med la ltos/ /snying po med pa'i bya ba spangs/ /snying po'i lha chos byed 'dod na/ /bla ma'i gsung dang rgyal ba'i bka'/ /bzhin du da ni 'bad par rigs/ /bla 789

ma dkon mchog thugs rjes gzigs/ /sngar gyi bya ba nyes nas gda'/ /snying nas 'gyod pas bshags sdom bya/ /chos bzhin nus par byin gyis rlobs/ /'dul ba bzhin du nus par shog /mdo sde bzhin du spyod par shog /mngon pa bzhin du byed par shog /gsang sngags bzhin du bsgrub par shog /ces man ngag rgya khab rnon po 'di slob bu rnams kyi lag tu gtad byas pa/ da phyin chad rnam dpyod shes rab kyi mig gis ltos la/rang la skyon mtshang gi tsher ma zug tshad thams cad rang gis thon byas pas/ khong rnams kyis kyang de bzhin bton pas sdug bsngal zug ju bskyed pa'i skyon gye dug tsher thams cad thon nas/ ring por ma lon par/ ri khrod dben pa'i dga' tshal nas chos mthun gyi zhabs bro rgyag nus pa byung ngo / /de dus phyag mdzod sde pa dbang pos dbus gtsang nas/ chos ldan gyi bya ba mang po bsgrubs nas yar 'ong mjal te gtam snyan mang po bshad pas dga' spro tshad las 'das pa byung / re zhig ngal gsos te bsdad/ de nas bdag gi mtshams grol nas/ bu chen 'jam dbyangs rang grol sogs bu slob 'ga' zhig stod gangs ri la sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin du song / bdag gis skyid grong gi skyes pho mo thams cad la tshe dbang bskur chos bshad 790

mgur dbyangs 'di yang blangs so//skyabs gnas kun 'dus bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /sgo gsum chos dang 'dres par byin gyis rlobs/ /tshe 'dir yun ring mi sdod myur du 'chi/ /'chi chos da lta gyes shig skyid grong pa/ /bla ma dkon mchog mgo bo'i thod bzhin khur/ /'khur mkhan thams cad rgyal lo skyid grong pa/ /pha ma gnyis ka dpral ba'i mig bzhin 'tshos/ /'tsho mkhan thams cad bde'o skyid grong pa/ /sha tsha snying nye'i grogs po spun ltar sten/ /dgos sar nam yang sleb bo skyid grong pa/ /yun ring 'grogs na sangs rgyas skyon yang mthong / /bla ma'i skyon la ma rtog skyid grong pa/mchod ma shes na lha yang gshed du 'bab/ /yul lhar dmar mchod ma gtong skyid grong pa/ /bza' mi shi dus 'gyod pa blun po'i lugs/ /gson dus mthun par 'grogs shig skyid grong pa/ /g.yog por kha yis byams pas ci la phan/ /snying nas lto gos byin cig skyid grong pa/ /tshong ba rnams kyis 'brog nas ra lug nyos/ /mon par dmar 'tshong ma rgyag skyid grong pa/ /bla ma rnams kyis chos la bzang ngan phyes/ /grub mtha'i phyogs ris ma byed skyid grong pa/ /grwa btsun rnams kyis chal le chol le byas/ /bla ma'i zhabs 'dren ma byed skyid grong pa/ /rdzong dpon 791

rnams kyis mi ser thams cad la/ /gsar khral chad pa ma 'gel skyid grong pa/ /g.yog pos mi ser rnams la sdug btang nas/ /dpon po'i zhabs 'dren ma byed skyid grong pa/ /mi ser rnams kyis rdzong dpon su la yang / /ngo log rgyab log ma byed skyid grong pa/ /sngags pa rnams kyis mthu dang ngan sngags kyis/ /rang gzhan gnyis ka ma 'phung skyid grong pa/ /thams cad nang ba sangs rgyas bstan pa yin/ /grub mtha' gzhan la ma sdang skyid grong pa/ /dkor sa zhing khang rnams kyang phan tshun gyi/ /lag nas 'phrog res ma byed skyid grong pa/ /bla mar ha cang dad pa ma chung zhig /byen rlabs 'jug dus med do skyid grong pa/ /bza' mi gnyis gas mnyam bshad ma rgyag cig /gzhan gyi snang ba sun no skyid grong pa/ /ha cang srog gcod las la ma rngams shig /dmyal ba'i gting du 'gro'o skyid grong pa/ /skyes dman gnyis ni sdug bsngal gzhi ma yin/ /rgad pos khyim gsar ma len skyid grong pa/ /tshong ma shes na bu lon 'og tu 'chor/ /don med tshong log ma rgyag skyid grong pa/ /zhing las 'tsho skyong byas na phyug por 'gyur/ /za zhing nyal la ma dga' skyid grong pa/ /za 'dod 'thung 'dod khyi las ltogs pa med/ /nor la ham pa ma che skyid grong pa/ /bsod nams med na brgya 792

bsam gcig mi 'grub/ /'grub med blo sna ma mang skyid grong pa/ /sngon gyi las gsal bla ma dkon mchog mkhyen/ /soms dang don yang 'grub bo skyid grong pa/ /rnam rtog can gyi khyim na lha 'dre mang / /don med rnam rtog ma mang skyid grong pa/ /zhe sdang can gyi mi la dgra bo mang / /don med khong khro ma che skyid grong pa/ /ser sna can gyi sems la bde dus med/ /nor la ser sna ma che skyid grong pa/ /zas la lag pa yangs na bran g.yog 'khor/ /za ma sdug btsir ma byed skyid grong pa/ /mchod sbyin btang na bsod nams shugs la skye/ /mi tshe 'dir yang bde'o skyid grong pa/ /rgyun du jo bor phyag dang skor ba gyis/ /'phags pas rjes su 'dzin no skyid grong pa/ /bya btang sgom chen bzang por mthun rkyen sbyor/ /sangs yang mnyam por rgya'o skyid grong pa/ /gzhan gyi dge bar rjes su yi rang gyis/ /bsod nams rgya chen 'thob bo skyid grong pa/ /dge ba gang byas mjug tu bsngo smon gyis/ /nam yang chud gzon mi 'gro skyid grong pa/ /'di bzhin lha chos byed pa'i skye bo kun/ /'di nas bzung ste skyid do skyid grong pa/ /chos bzhin byed pa'i skye bo pho mo la /chos skyong dkar phyogs lha yis bsrung bar shog /ces blangs pas/ tshong ba dmar bkye mkhan mang po'i sdug rgyun bcad/793

thams cad dge ba la bkod/ mi gcig gis nor med sdug thug nas/ gzhis ka rtse'i sprang phrug mang po la nga'i lung ba de skyid pas ming la skyid grong zer/ der song na skyid ces mgo bskor nas snga phyi byas sprang phrug mang po khrid 'ongs nas/ bcu gsum tsam rong mon pa'i g.yog la btsongs sdug myong du bcugade'i rin blangs nas zos nga song dus sprang phrug gcig khyer 'ong ba des/ btsong rgyu yin pa shes nas nga yod sar bros 'ongs pa'i rjes su kho yang slebs byung ba la/ ngas dngul srang mang po byin te mi btsong mi nyan gzhung dga' ldan pho brang gis snyan na bka' bkyon dang chad pa 'ong / phyi mar ngan song du 'gro zhes chos bshad pas/ khos sngar byas la 'gyod pa'i bshags pa byas/ phyin chad mi mi 'tshong ba'i dam bca' phul bas/ skyid grong gi lung ba'i mi snying rje can thams cad dga' nas bka' drin che zer ba byung / de'i lo yul phyogs de'i skyes pho mo thams cad kyis tshogs mchod dga' ston mang po btang ba'i tshe/ yon bdag pho mo gzhon nu rnams kyis/ rgyal ba rin po che la sku bstod kyi gzhas 'di 'dra len par gda'/ po ta la yi rtse nas/ /bco lnga'i zla ba shar byung / /bco lnga'i zla ba min pa/ /rgyal ba'i zhal ras yin pa/ /po ta la yi rtse nas/ /gser 794

gyi rgya gling bsgyur byung / /gser gyi rgya gling min pa/ /rgyal ba'i gsung snyan yin pa/ /rgyal ba'i zhal ras mjal ba'i mi la ngan song mi 'dug /gsung dbyangs lan cig thos kyang / /phyi mar mi lus thob yong / /zhes sogs dang zhabs bro mang po brgyab pa'i rjes su/ bkra shis par shog g.yang chags par shog zer/ yang rje btsun chos kyi dbang phyug gis skra bcad/ jo mo 'ga' res khong gi gsung gi bkra shis chos bro 'di 'dra rgyag par gda'/ bkra shis dge mtshan 'bar ba'i/ /bkra shis yar ngo'i zla ltar/ /bkra shis phun sum tshogs pa'i/ /bkra shis glu dbyangs len no/ /bkra shis chos ra gru bzhir/ /bkra shis dpon slob 'dzom pa/ /bkra shis skyid la chos 'phel bkra shis zhabs bro brgyab shog /bkra shis da lo dga' ba/ /bkra shis sang phod skyid pa/ /bkra shis 'gyur med rten 'brel/ /bkra shis rtag tu shog cig /gcig gnyis gsum byas nas/bkra shis dpal du 'bar ba lags/ gnyis gsum drug byas nas/ bkra shis bsam pa 'grub lags/ zhes zhabs bro 'khrab byung / gzhan yang glu gar rol mo sna tshogs pa 'khrol bas der 'tshogs pa'i skyes pho mo thams cad sems spro ba byung / de nas nged dpon slob 'ga' zhig yongs 'dzin rin po che'i gdan sa 795

skyid grong bsam gtan gling la mjal du song / 'gyed mang ja btang / mkhan po chos bzang rin po che'i drung nas/ 'phags pa thugs rje chen po'i chos skor zhus/ zhag shas bsdad/ phyag mdzod kyis zhabs tog yag po byas byung / de nas rje mi la'i grub gnas ri bo dpal 'bar la song / gaḥ thog rig 'dzin chen po'i gser gdung la mjal/ tshogs mchod dang mar me phul gsol 'debs smon lam btab/ de nas rag ma byang chub rdzong / rkyang phan nam mkha' rdzong gnyis la mjal/ gnas 'brel bzhag de nas gro thang gi yon bdag tsho yod sar song /chos dang zang zing gi 'brel ba zab mo bzhag dben gnas brag dkar rta sor song / mkhas grub nyis 'dzom rje btsun chos kyi dbang phyug dang mjal/ zhag ma kha shas bsdad/mdun nas khrid brgya dang / dkon mchog spyi 'dus/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor rnams kyi lung zhus/ 'bul ba kha btags dri med 'dom lnga ma gcig gser zho dngul ṭaṃ g.yu byer bcas phul/btsun ma'i tshogs la 'gyed mang ja dang tshogs shig kyang btang / tshur la lam chas dang dpe cha po ti mang po'i bdag rkyen gnang ba byung / de nas mnga' ris rdzong dkar du 'ong /oṃ phug bla ma'i mtshams khang nas grub pa'i dbang phyug 'phyang 796

dkar ba don yod rdo rje rin po cher mjal/ bka' gdams thig le bcu drug gi dbang / bka' gdams pha chos dang bu chos gnyis/ dpe'i lam rim rin chen spungs pa don gyi lam rim be'u bum sngon po sogs dang / do ha skor gsum byang sgra mi snyan gyi tshe sgrub rnams kyi dbang lung zhus/ gser dngul la sogs pa'i 'bul ba legs po phul/ tshur la yang gsol ras dang dpe cha mang po gnang / thugs yid gcig tu 'dres pa byung / de nas ra la'i za 'og phug tu song /zhag kha shas bsdad nas gnas 'brel bzhag gnas la nyams gso btang / de nas gung thang la brgyab ste bya mang po zer ba'i sde dgon chung chung zhig 'dug pa de ru zhag gis bsdad pas 'tsho ba zhabs tog yag po zhig byas/ de nas phyag mdzod sde pa dbang po dpon g.yog 'ga' zhig dpal khud thang spong rong brgyud nas dbus su song / bdag cag rnams kyis bya mang po'i yon bdag tshor chos bshad mgur dbyangs blangs/ bsngo smon bkra shis brjod nas la phyi'i phyogs la chas so//smras pa/ sa steng 'di na 'gran zla ma mchis pa'i sa lam ston mkhan sangs rgyas spyi bor bzhugs/ /sa gsum 'gro la nyin mtshan dus drug tu/ /sa ler gzigs la byin rlabs 797

dngos grub stsol/ /bla ma'i rnam thar lan re dran na yang / /bsod nams tshogs kyang rgya cher gsog pa'i phyir/ /bal yul mchod rten mjal du song ba'i tshul/ /slar yang glu ru len gyis dga' bas nyon/ /nged cag dpon slob mang po hor nang du/ /song nas dpon phrug yon bdag thams cad la/ /chos bshad mgur blangs sdig rgyun gcod du bcug /dge rgyun btsugs pas zas nor mang po phul/ /de'i lo 'brog pas srog gcod ma byas pas/ /gzhung gi tshong ba yar mar 'gro mkhan gyis/ /sha ni dkon po 'dug ces zer ba'ang byung / /gro shod 'go pa blo bzang 'phrin las sogs/ /yon bdag rnams la chos bshad 'gro don byas/ /gser g.yu mu tig rta nor mang po phul/ /gro shod gzhung nas rngon pas ri dwags gtsod/ /gsod mkhan rnams la rgyu nom mang po byen/ /ri dwags stong phrag mang po'i tshe thar byas/ /dga' chos dgon nas phyag mdzod dbang po yis /gser dngul g.yu byer nor rdzas phal che ba/ /khyer nas dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing du song / /sa skya bkra shis lhun po dga' ldan la/ /rin chen gser gyi mchod kong re re phul/ /rgyal ba paṇa chen dpal ldan sa skya sogs/ /bla ma skyes chen yongs la 'bul ba btegs/ /bsam yas gsar bzhengs nang du zhal 798

'debs phul/ /nged rnams rnam rgyal lha rtse brgyud nas song / /glo bo'i rgyal po sde pa rnams la mjal/ /dbang bskur chos bshad lugs gnyis bslab bya byas/ /de bzhin mdzad pa'i yul la bkra shis byung / /chu mig brgya rtsar mjal nas khrus byas 'thung / /sa la me 'bar rdo la me 'bar dang / /chu la me 'bar mthong nas ngo mtsha ra skyes/ /de nas yar 'ong 'ab chen rdzong kha yi/ /yon bdag rnams la rgyu 'bras chos bshad pas/ /skya ser pho mo rnams la phan thogs byung / /rje btsun mi la ras pa'i sgrub gnas mchog /'od gsal phug dang rkang tshugs phug gnyis mjal/ /khang ba ka bzhi gdung brgyad phub shul du/ /bzhengs pa'i mchod rten rnams la phyag skor byas/ /'or ma gru gsum spre pe stan chung gi/ /zhing gi thog tu song nas ltad mo bltas/ /rje btsun chung dus chang gis bzi nas glu/ /len bzhin phebs pa'i lam la zhugs nas song / /skyid grong jo bor mjal nas zhag 'ga' bsdad/ /de nas grogs bzang drung yig g.yu kha dang / /'grogs nas bal yul yangs pa'i mthil du song / /dgun yang sngo ljang me tog sna tshogs bkra/ /zhim mngar shing thog mang po'i kha zas ldan/ /mi rnams shes rgyud 'jam pa'i lha dang 'dra/ /lha gnas shig tu slebs 'dra'i nyams shig 799

shar/ /'dzam gling rgyan gcig phyag mchod zhing gi mchog /mchod rten chen po 'phags pa shing kun dang / /bya rung kha shor rnams su slebs pa'i tshe/ /rab dga'i sa thob lta bu'i dga' spro shar/ /go ṭaṃ stong phrag tsam gyi rgyu song gi /dri bzang bsres pa'i sa dkar na bza' bsgon/ /bstan 'gro yongs la phan pa'i smon lam btab/ /zla ba gcig tsam phyag dang skor ba byas/ /yam bu'i 'phags pa rang byon 'ja' ma lir mjal nas phyag mchod phul nas gsol ba btab/ /rgyal po'i pho brang stag gzigs glang po che/ /ri dwags bse ru rnams la ltad mo bltas/ /skyid grong jo bor gser gyi mchod kong dang / /stong mchod phul nas smon lam rnam dag btab/ /dgun thog dgon gnang dben par mtshams la bsdad/ /gnas der dge sbyor 'phel la spro ba byung / /sos ka mtshams grol skyid grong lung ba yi/ /skya ser pho mor chos bshad dbang bskur bas/ /kun kyang dga' bas glu gar sna tshogs byas/ /de nas gnas chen rnams la mjal bzhin du/ /bsam gtan gling gi mkhan por chos 'brel zhus/ /mkhas grub nyis 'dzom brag dkar sprul ba'i sku'i/ /drung du song nas khrid brgya'i gdams pa zhus/ /oṃ phug dben par grub pa'i dbang phyug mchog /rje btsun don yod 800

rdo rje zhes byar mjal/ /do ha la sogs gdams pa mang po zhus/ /de nas ra la'i za 'og phug tu song / /zhag 'ga' bsdad nas gung thang la brgyud 'ongs/ /bya mang sde par slebs nas zhag gis bsdad/ /phyi nyin la phyi'i phyogs la chas nas song / /mdor na mchod rten gnyis la na bza' bsgon/ /bstan 'gro yongs la phan pa'i smon lam btab/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi rnam thar de ltar lags/ /rjes 'jug rnams kyang de bzhin skyong bar mdzod/ /glu 'di thos tshad skye bo pho mo yis /tshe rabs kun tu bla ma'i rnam thar bzhin/ /sa steng mchod rten lha khang rnams la mjal/ /mchod bstod phyag dang skor ba byed par shog /ces pa'ang bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o//801

la phyi stag gdong ma khra mo gsung gi gnas nas sgrub pa byas tshul/bcu gsum pa bar na khungs btsun pa la phyi stag gdong ma khra mo gsung gi gnas su song nas sgrub pa byas tshul ni/ de yang sa steng 'di na 'gran zla dang bral ba'i gnas chen gsum gyi nang nas yi dam bde mchog 'khor lo'i gsung gi gnas/ sprin dang na bun rgyun du 'khor zhing ngo mtshar 'ja' 'od 'khrigs pa'i zhing / sngon byon mkhas grub du mas sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan btsugs shing / rtogs pa'i chos 'khor bskor ba'i lte ba 'brog la phyi gangs kyi ra ba'i dben gnas bdud 'dul phug tu sgrub pa byed snyam nas/ nged dpon slob mang po dang bcas te be rtse 'dod yon rdzong la 'ongs nas zhag gcig bsdad/ de'i phyi nyin tshur 'ong ba'i lam kha nas/ gnas skor ba 'ga' res/ rtsa ba'i bla ma gtsug gi nor bu bod skyong chos rgyal de mo rin po che'i sku'i me tog 'thor song zhes bshad pa go tshe/ skyo ba tshad las 'das pa yang yang byung ba'i shugs kyis sprul sku myur 'byon gye gdung dbyangs 'di blangs so//802

kye hud snyigs dus bdag cag rnams/ /bsod nams shin tu dman pa'i mthus/ /bstan 'gro'i gtsug rgyan yid bzhin nor/ /rgyal ba'i yang sprul de yang gshegs/ /'dzam gling rgyan gcig bsam yas kyang / /glo bur mkha' la 'ja' ltar yal/ /da ni thugs rje 'od stong can/ /bod skyong chos rgyal nyi ma nub/ /gdul bya'i shes rgyud sa gzhi kun/ /mya ngan grib sos dbang med non/ /mchi ma'i chu yis gdong bkrus kyang / /sems sdug dri ma dag dus med/ /lab/ pas brang gi rnga brdungs kyang / /yi mug gnyid la sangs dus med/ /'chi dus sangs rgyas sar 'dren pa'i/ /'dren mkhan bla ma sngon du gshegs/ /ma rig dmus long bdag cag rnams/ /skal ba ngan pas shul du lus/ /kye ma kye hud ji ltar bya/ / shi na lam sna su yis 'dren/ /mkhyen brtse'i bdag nyid drin can rjes/ /mi mngon dbyings nas bdag la dgongs/ /skal med bdag dang bdag 'dra ni/ /na so rgas nas 'chi la nye/ /ma shi gong 'dir mgon khyod kyi/ /yang sprul 'khrul med myur du byon/ /gser zhal mjal ba'i smon lam 'debs/ /sgon pa bzhin du 'grub gyur cig /ces blangs pa'i mthar bsam pa la/ da ni bla ma skyes chen dam pa 'di 'dra tsho yang gdul bya rtag 'dzin can rnams 803

chos la bskul phyir/ sku na gzhon pa'i dus su glo bur du sku'i me tog 'thor ba'i tshul ston na/ bdag 'dra'i shul lus skal ngan tsho 'chi ba smos ci dgos/myur du la phyi gangs la song nas/rje mi la'i gdan sa bdud 'dul phug mo che ru/ sgrub pa zhig brgyab nas shi na 'gyod pa rang mi snang snyam/ tshur mgyogs par 'ongs nas/ thugs mthun khrims gtsang phan bde'i rtsa lag dam pa 'phel rgyas gling gi dgon pa gnya' nang grod pa phug gi thag nye sar zhag gis bsdad pas/ dgon pa de na mkhas btsun bzang gsum 'dzom pa'i mkhan po skal bzang mkhas grub rin po che bzhugs pa go nas sngon du zhu shog 'di phul lo//lhar bcas 'gro ba'i gtsug rgyan sangs rgyas kyi/ /bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'i skyes bu mchog /lung rtogs yon tan nam mkha' mdzod la mnga'/ /brnyes pa'i bshes gnyen mchog gi zhabs drung du/ /phyogs med rgyal khams thams cad chu bzhin nyul/ /nges med dben par wa skyes bzhin du rgyu/ /'do med sdod pa'i yul yang ma mchis pa'i/ /chos med gnas skor ba ngas 'di skad zhu/ /tshogs gnyis rin chen khams las legs grub pa'i/ /khyed sku g.yo med ri dbang rab brtan cing / /rnam dkar mdzad 'phrin nyi zla'i 'od snang gis/ /804

gdul bya gling bzhi yongs la khyad bo zhes/ /gtam snyan dbyar gyi rnga gsang stong ldir bas/ /phyogs kyi khor yug thams cad gang ba'i mod/ /bdag blo'i col chung gar mkhan gzhon nu yang / /dbang med dga' dang zlos gar lan mang bsgyur/ /phran kyang sgyu lus rta rgan g.yar po la/ /brten nas rgyal khams mang po 'khor zin nas/ /da lta khyed kyi gdul bya'i sa phyogs 'dir/ /sprang po'i 'khor dang bcas te bde bar mchis/ /'tshams zhus 'brel tshad don ldan dge ba'i bshes/ /khyed dang gnas la lan cig mjal 'dod pas/ /drung du slebs dus brtse ba chen po'i sgos/ /rjes su gzung du gsol zhes thal mo sbyor/ /dal 'byor tshang ba'i mi lus rin chen gru/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen mnyan pa khyed 'dra la/ /brten nas bdag kyang 'khor ba'i chu bo las/ /thar pa'i skam sar ci sgol byed par smon/ /zhu yig me tog pad+ma'i dga' tshal la/ /spyan gyi bung ba yud tsam g.yo ba'i rten/ /rin chen gnyis pa lha rdzas bcud kyis gtams/ /rab tu gus pas phyag dang bcas te phul/ /zhes pa 'di nyid phul tshe thugs mnyes mnyes mdzad cing rjes su mjal dus kyang brtse ba chen pos rjes su bzung bdag rkyen chen po gnang / drung nas bla ma lnga bcu pa la sogs pa'i chos 805

'brel zhus/ de nas myos ldan zhes pa sa mo yos lo'i sa ga zla ba'i yar tshes bzang bor bka' brgyud gong ma'i gdan sa/ lha dang drang srong bzhugs gnas/ ma dang mkha' 'gro'i do ra/'du 'dzi grong gi pha rol/ g.ya' dang gangs kyi 'dabs rol/sprin dang na bun rgyun du 'khor ba'i gnas chen 'brog la phyi gangs kyi ra ba ru slebs nas gnas kyi lha mkha' 'gro chos skyong dkar phyogs la mngon par dga' ba rnams la phyag dang mchod pa byas te gnas bstod 'di phul lo//bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro la/ /phyag 'tshal mchod bstod gsol ba 'debs/ /gnas 'dir 'dug pa thams cad la/ /byen rlabs dngos grub bstsal tu gsol/ /sgrub brgyud gong ma bzhugs pa'i gnas/ /rtogs pa'i chos 'khor bskor ba'i sa/ /la phyi gangs kyi ra ba zhes/ /yongs la grags pa ngo mtshar che/ /ri rnams rtse mo gangs kyis mdzes/ /na bun dngul mdog sked la 'khril/ /gangs dang brag gi khong gseng na/ /chu rgyun lhung sgra sgrog bzhin 'bab/ /ri bo ne'u gsing spang gshong na/ /lus mdzes ri dwags bag phebs rtse/ /dri zhim mdog mdzes me tog rtser/ /bung ba 'dus nas glu dbyangs len/ /lo 'dab mdzes pa'i ljon shing khar/ /'dab chags bya yis skad snyan 806

'byin/ /rang byung brag phug nyams dga' na/ /lha dang ḍāk+ki sprin ltar 'du/ /chos skyong srung mas bu bzhin skyong / /bka' brgyud gong ma'i na bza' sogs/ /byin can na bza' lha sku mang / /ri brag rnams kyang lha sku 'dra/ /rang byon zhabs rjes mang po snang / /g.yas dang g.yon na nyi zla bzhin/ /'gro phan 'phel rgyas gling gis mdzes/ /phu na la phyi'i 'brog pa dang / /mda' na rong pa'i yon bdag mang / /rtsi thog shing 'bras sngo tshod dang / /chu shing la sogs mthun rkyen 'dzom/ /'dre gdon dgra jag chom rkun sogs/ /mi 'dod nyer 'tshe'i ming yang med/ /mdor na nyams dga' rig pa dwangs/ /mkha' spyod dag pa'i zhing dang mtshungs/ /chos mdzad yod na gnas 'di sten/ /sten dang dam pa'i lha chos 'ong / /dad can yon bdag gnas 'di skor/ /skor dang las ngan sdig sgrib 'dag /'byor ldan yon bdag gnas 'di mchod/ /mchod dang mchog thun dngos grub 'thob/ /de skad brjod pas thos tshad kun/ /gnas 'dir brten nas 'tshang rgya shog /ces gnas kyi lha mkha' 'gro chos skyong la mchod cing bstod/ la phyi'i yon bdag rnams la tshogs btang bdag rkyen byas/ de nas bdud 'dul phug mo che'i steng phyogs ri ngos sbas pa zhes pa shin tu dben 807

pa'i mtshams khang zhig tu gcig pur mtshams dam po byas bsdad pas/ dge sbyor rnams gong 'phel du byung / khyad par gnas der bsdad nas bzung phra rags kyi rnam rtog thams cad rang sar 'gags nas/ gsal stong bde bas brgyan pa'i rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes chen po'i ngang la rang bzhin shugs kyis 'gro ba zhig byung / dgun dus nyin gcig tshogs mchod cig btang bas phyi dro la phyi'i mdun ri'i steng gi nam mkha'i mthongs na sprin gnyis kyi kha bar nas/ sngar mthong ma myong ba'i 'ja' tshon rgya lam chen po zhig gi tshod tsam zhig gangs mthon mthing rgyal mo'i phyogs su 'then pa'i sne de yang sprin dkar po zhig gi nang du zug pa'i 'ja' tshon gyi lam de la lha mang po phar 'gro tshur 'gro byed pa mthong nas bltas tshe yun ring gnas pa byung / de nas bzung da bar du bod khams skyong ba'i tshe ring mched lngas dngos nyams rmi lam du zhal gzigs yang yang byung las bzhi'i 'phrin las gang dgos rnams bsgrub cing / khyad par mchod rten bya rung kha shor la gser gye na bza' sgon dus 'phrin bcol byas pas grogs khyad par can mdzad de gegs med bde blag tu 'grub pa byung / gnas der tshogs mchod nam btang kyang 'ja' sprin ngo mtshar ba byung ba 808

kun gyis mthong / de tshe ring mched lnga dgyes nas yang yang phebs pa'i rtags yin nam snyam pa byung / de dus lan cig rgya gar rdo rje gdan du song na snyam ste slob ma rnams la bshad pas/khyed phebs na kho tsho thams cad kyang 'gro ba yin zer/ der ngas rtsa gsum lha la tshogs mchod phul/ de lugs kyi gsol ba btab pa'i nub tho rangs nyams dang rmi lam 'dres mar/mkha' 'gro ma stag gi gdong ba can byon nas/ rgya gar la byon na dpon slob mang po'i sku tshe la bar chad 'ong / de bas gdul bya'i zhing bod yul du bzhugs te gnas chen 'di dang 'di 'dra nas bstan 'gro'i don chen sgrubs dang / nged mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis kyang lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs nas rtag tu g.yel ba med par grogs mdzad do zhes gsungs nas mi snang bar gyur to/ /der mkha' 'gro ma'i lung bstan bzhin ma song bar bsdad pa'i nub gcig rmi lam du la phyi gnas nang thams cad thang yangs shing rgya che ba zhig tu gyur te/ phyogs phyogs nas bod dang bal po mon pa a tsa ra sogs mi rigs mi gcig pa skad rigs mi mthun pa mang po zhig 'ong ste la phyi'i thang thams cad gang nas/ rgyal sa lta bur gyur te thams cad yar 'gro mar 'gro byed pa zhig rmis pas/ sems la lo rjes ma 809

la gnas 'dir mi mang po zhig 'du ba 'dra snyam/ lo rjes ma'i sos ka nyin gcig bdud 'dul phug gi thang du song nas/thang gi 'dabs la nye bar kha yar 'khor gyi sdong po rtsa ba gcig la rtse mo gnyis su gyes pa/ yal ga dang lo 'dab phyogs kun tu rgyas pa zhig 'dug pa'i rtsa nas grwa pa rnams la rdo yi khri zhig brtsigs su bcug ste/ 'di yi steng nas gzhan la rjes su chos bshad dgos zhes steng du bsdad de/ phyag mdzod skal bzang 'phrin las sogs zhabs phyi pa 'ga' zhig la/ sdig pa ci yang mi bya zhing / /dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyad/ /rang gi sems ni yongs su 'dul/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin/ /nad med pa ni bde ba'i mchog /dga' ba sbyin pa sbyin pa'i mchog /mya ngan 'das pa bde ba'i mchog /blo gtad thub pa grogs kyi mchog la sogs pa'i chos bshad nas rten 'brel bsgrigs pas kun gyi sems dga' ba byung / de nas bdud 'dul phug gi rje btsun mi la'i sgrub phug ngo ma de la mjal du 'gro ba'i lam sgo'i mchod khang gi rgyab cig na gog nas 'gro dgos sa zhig 'dug pas/ bdag gi bsam pa la/sngon rje mi la bzhugs dus 'di ma yin pa'i 'gro sa'i sgo stabs bde mo zhig yod dgos snyam btsal bas sgrub phug gi thad ga'i 810

mdo nas sgo rnyed de sa ro rdo ro rnams bsal ba'i shul nas/sngon rje mi las thab bzung shul gyi thab rdo rnams mthong bas der 'tshogs pa kun dad gus cher 'phel zhing gnas sgo gsar du phyes song zhes snyam pa sgrog pa'ang byung / de nas nga yang nang der bsdad pas dbyar kha lon pa'i tshe/ sngar gyi rmi lam gye nang ltar/ phyogs phyogs nas las dang skal bar ldan pa'i gdul bya pho mo mang po snga phyir rim can byas 'ongs pa la sdong po'i rtsa nas chos 'khor bskor/ bdud 'dul phug tu mar khu'i rgya mtsho bskyil sdong ras lag ngar tsam btsugs nas/ nyin mtshan med par mar me sbar bas brag phug gi nang kun tsha lam me byung /de dus mkhyen nga/'i spyan yangs byams brtse'i mnga' bdag chu dbar mkhan chen yon tan lhun grub rin po che la skyabs 'jug zhu rten dang bcas te zhu yig 'di phul lo//lhar bcas 'gro ba yongs kyi gtsug gi rgyan/ /mkhas btsun bzang gsum ldan pa kun gye phul/ /bstan 'dzin dbus na rgyal mtshan tog ltar mtho/ /mkhan chen dge ba'i bshes gnyen mchog gi drung / /nges med ri khrod dben pa'i dga' tshal dang / /phyogs med rgyal khams yangs pa'i sa phyogs su/ /chags med rlung ltar 'phyo ba'i rnam 'byor ngas/ /zol med sgo 811

gsum gus pas 'di skad zhu/ /rnam dag thugs bskyed bzang po'i srub shing gis/ /rlabs chen tshogs gnyis chu gter bsrubs pa las/ /mtshan dang dpe byad gzi byin 'od 'bar ba'i/ /mgon khyod gzugs sku'i ri dbang 'khrungs pa mtshar/ /thabs mkhas bsdu bzhi'i bang rim mngon par mtho/ /thugs sras bu slob gser ri'i khrod na brjid/ /rnam dkar mdzad 'phrin nyi zla'i 'od snang gis/ /skal bzang gdul bya gling bzhi yongs la khyab/ /mi mthun rgud pa'i mun pa thams cad bsal/ /phan bde'i drod kyis rgyal khams kun 'tsho zhing / /rgyal bstan me tog pad+ma'i tshal chen po/ /ches cher rgyas shing phyogs brgyar bzhad pa'i mod/ /snyan grags dbyar gyi rnga gsang stong ldir ba'i/ /sgra yis steng phyogs tshangs gnas bar du khyab/ /de nyid thos pas bdag blo'i gar mkhan yang / /dbang med dga' dad zlos gar lan mang bsgyur/ /gus phran sgyu lus nyam chung pad+ma yang / /mchog gsum thugs rje nyi 'od kyis bskyangs tshe/ /mi 'dod nyer 'tshe ba mos ma mnar bar/ /rnam dkar dge sbyor dri ngad 'thul bzhin mchis/ /'tshams zhus bdag gi mi tshe cha gsum byas/ /cha gnyis shor song da ni cha gcig gi /ring la dben pa'i gnas su dge sbyor zhig /812

byed la bar chad med pa'i skyabs 'jug zhu/ /bdag ni deng nas tshe rabs thams cad du/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen khyed dang khyed 'dra la/ /dngos sam nyams dang rmi lam tshun chad du/ /yang yang mjal zhing gsung chos thos par smon/ /de skad skyabs 'jug zhu ba'i yig chung 'di/ /chos mdzad skyes bu rnams kyis gnyen po'i mtshon/ /thogs nas nyon mongs bdud rnams 'dul ba'i sa/ /la phyi bdud 'dul phug nas gus pas phul/ /zhes pa 'di nyid phul bas thugs shin tu mnyes te gnang sbyin yang mang po byung / yang bla ma la mos gus che zhing /chos phyogs la rab tu dga' ba'i rong shar na bzhugs pa'i sde pa bkra shis bde ldan pa la chos kyi mthun rkyen zhig dgos zhes zhu shog 'di phul lo//bla ma mchog gsum mgo yi zhwa bzhin bkur/ /'khor 'bangs sde rigs rang gi bu ltar skyong / /rnam dkar dge la khyim pa'i so nam bzhin/ /brtson pa'i sa skyong mi dbang zhabs drung du/ /nges med ri khrod dben pa'i sa phyogs su/ /yul med ri dwags bzhin du rgyu ba yi/ /chos med chos pa'i gzugs brnyan zhabs dkar pas/ /zol med sgo gsum gus pas 'di skad zhu/ /dad brtson shes rab snying rje dang ldan pa'i/ /mi 813

dbang khyod kyi sngon bsags bsod nams mthus/ /mi khom gnas su bskal pa brgyad khri'i bar/ /btsal kyang rnyed dka'i mi lus rin chen thob/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen nor bus gtsug na mdzes/ /thos pa'i rna lung legs bshad mgul rgyan 'chang / /gtong ba'i gdu bus phyag gnyis brgyan pa'i mod/ /phal ba'i rgyan gzhan zil gyis gnon pa mtshar/ /'phags nor bdun gye rgyal srid sna bdun mnga'/ /'khor 'bangs sde rigs gling bzhir dbang bsgyur tshe/ /sngar med 'khor los bsgyur rgyal byon no zhes/ /lha mi yongs kyis bstod bsngags rol mo 'khrol/ /de nyid thos 'dzin dbang pos tshor ba'i tshe yid brtan mi rung bdag sems shing bal yang / /rab tu dga' zhing spro ba'i dri bzhon gyis/ /lan cig ma yin yang yang phyogs kun bskyod/ /gus phran bdag gis 'byung ba bzhi bo la/ /da res lan cig g.yar ba'i sgyu lus rtar/ /brten nas rgyal khams mang po 'khor zin nas/ /da lta la phyi'i gnas na bde bar mchis/ /'tshams zhus bsod nams che ba'i ded dpon khyod/ /dam chos dar ba'i rin chen gling mchog tu/ /slebs pa'i dus 'dir lag stong ma mdzad par/ /rnam dkar dge ba'i nor bu rin chen longs/ /sgrub brgyud gong ma'i gdan sa 814

la phyi na/ /bsgrub pa gang nus byed pa bdag la yang / /sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen cung zad tsam zhig ni/ /bsgrub rgyu byung na bka' drin shin tu che/ /phran kyang dben pa'i ri la sdod pa'i dus/ /khyed kyi sku tshe'i rgyal mtshan brtan pa dang / /yid la ci bsam thams cad chos bzhin du/ /'grub pa'i skyabs 'jug rtsa gsum lha la zhu/ /bdag gis dben par sgrub la gzhol ba'i mthus/ /ma 'ongs sangs rgyas go 'phang thob pa'i tshe/ /khyed kyis gtso byas 'brel thogs ma lus pa/ /sangs rgyas sa ru 'dren pa'i smon lam 'tshal/ /de ltar tshigs su bcad pa'i yig chung 'di/ /bla ma lha dang ḍāk+ki chos skyong rnams/ /sprin bzhin 'du ba'i gnas mchog khyad par can/ /la phyi'i bdud 'dul phug nas zla tshes phul/ /ces bskur bas mthun rkyen gang dgos rnams bskur nas rjes su tshur 'ong ste chos 'brel kyang zhus so/ /de nas nyams dga' rig pa dwangs pa'i gnas chen der bsdad nas sgrub pa byas dus shin tu dben cing dge sbyor 'phel ba'i shugs kyis ri khrod dben pa'i bsngags brjod kyi glu 'di blangs so//gnas mkha' spyod zhing mtshungs la phyi yi/ /pha bka' brgyud bla ma yi dam lha/ /ma mkha' 'gro chos skyong tshogs rnams 815

la/ /bdag gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i pho brang dngos/ /ma mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i do ra mchog /gnas la phyi dben pa'i dga' tshal du/ /sprang bdag la dge sbyor 'phel po byung / /mar ngan 'gro'i rgyu tshogs sdig pa dang / /dgra nyon mongs tshogs rnams rang sar 'gag /tshul 'dis kyang dben pa'i dga' tshal du/ /rje mi la'i rnam thar skyong snying 'dod/ /rkyen ngan pa gzhan dang ma 'phrad pas/ /sdom dam tshig gtsang ma bsrung rgyu byung / /tshul 'dis kyang dben pa'i dga' tshal du/ /rje mi la'i rnam thar skyong snying 'dod/ /rang nam 'chi cha med yang yang dran/ /tshe 'di yi zhen chags chung du song / /tshul 'dis kyang dben pa'i dga' tshal du/ /rje mi la'i rnam thar skyong snying 'dod/ /rang skyabs 'gro sems bskyed maṇ+ḍal sogs/ /tshogs gang 'dod thams cad gsog rgyu byung / /tshul 'dis kyang dben pa'i dga' tshal du/ /rje mi la'i rnam thar skyong snying 'dod/ /phyag skor ba rdor sems bsgom bzlas sogs/ /las sdig sgrib sbyong thabs byed rgyu byung / /tshul 'dis kyang dben pa'i dga' tshal du/ /rje mi la'i rnam thar skyong snying 'dod/ /skyabs kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /snying thag pas skyabs 'gro byed rgyu byung / /816

tshul 'dis kyang dben pa'i dga' tshul du/ /rje mi la'i rnam thar skyong snying 'dod/ /gzhan brel ba med pa'i lus ngag dal/ /sems rnal du phebs pa'i mnyam bzhag 'phel/ /tshul 'dis kyang dpen pa'i dga' tshal du/ /rje mi la'i rnam thar skyong snying 'dod/ /lam bskyed rim bsgoms na gsal snang thon/ /nang gtum mo bsgoms tshe bde drod 'bar/ /tshul 'dis kyang dben pa'i dga' tshal du/ /rje mi la'i rnam thar skyong snying 'dod/ /lam 'pho ba bsgoms na rtags bzang 'ong / /gcod btang kyang nyams snang sna tshogs 'char/ /tshul 'dis kyang dben pa'i dga' tshal du/ /rje mi la'i rnam thar skyong snying 'dod/ /dus da lta shi yang 'gyod med snyam/ /sems skyid pa'i glu dbyangs len 'dod byung / /tshul 'dis kyang dben pa'i dga' tshal du/ /rje mi la'i rnam thar skyong snying 'dod/ /dus da nas sangs rgyas ma thob bar/ /rje mi la ras pa'i rnam thar bzhin/ /gnas ri khrod dben pa'i dga' tshal du/ /chos tshul bzhin nyams su len gyur cig /ces blangs so/ /de nas gnas kyi sku gsung thugs rten yod pa'i lha khang rnams zhig ral 'thor gsum la song / la phyi'i grwa pa rnams kyis kyang tshugs ma thub par 'thor la khad yod pa la bltas 817

pas sems kyis ma bzod par bstan 'gro la phan pa'i lhag bsam gyis kun nas bslangs te/ phu yi gangs 'dabs la mgron khang / mdo yi chu chen la zam pa/ bar gyi lha khang rnams la nyams gso byas/ chos grwa'i thang dkyil nas 'du khang phug mtha' la lcags ri brgyab pa'i nang du grwa shag mang po gsar rgyag byas/ 'du khang steng du gser gye gañjir dang / nang du mchod rdzas bzhag pa thams cad kyi rgyu song la/ dngul rdo tshad bcu gsum gyi rtsis song / de dag rnams grub nas/ grwa pa snga sor ser khyim du shor ba rnams sdom gtsang byas te/ gnas dang dgon pa'i bdag po rgyal ba 'bri khung pa yab sras gnyis la zhu shog 'di phul lo//'gro ba yong la rtag tu phan pa'i gnyen/ /nyi zla rnam gnyis zung du shar 'dra ba'i/ /sprul pa'i skyes mchog chen po rnam gnyis kyi/ /zhabs kyi pad+mo dri ma med drung du/ /gus phran bya btang snyoms las zhabs dkar pas/ /rang lus pad+ma'i sor bcu'i 'dab ma rnams/ /spyi bo'i ze'u 'bru'i ngos la rab phyogs nas/ /gus pa chen po'i zhu yig dri bsung spro/ /tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho che las legs 'khrungs pa'i/ /mtshan dpe'i gzi 'bar skyabs mgon rnam gnyis kyi/ /gzugs sku dri med nyi zla 818

zung gcig tu/ /mkhas grub rgyu skar yongs kyi rgyan du shar/ /mdo sngags chos kyi 'od snang phyogs brgya ru/ /spros tshe gtam snyan dbyar gyi rnga bo che/ /ldir ba thos pas bdag blo'i gar mkhan yang / /dga' dad zlos gar lan mang bsgyur dgos byung / /gus phran bdag kyang nyams rtogs rtsal zhan rung / /sgrub brgyud bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan rin po che/ /srid pa'i rtse mo'i bar du ches cher du/ /bsgreng ba'i bsam sbyor gong du spel bzhin mchis/ /nyon mongs nad brgya 'joms pa'i sman pa mchog /dag pa'i zhing du 'khrid pa'i ded dpon che/ /'di phyi'i skyabs mgon rje btsun rnam gnyis kyis/ /tshe rabs kun tu rjes su 'dzin pa'i phyir/ /gnas gsum bdag po rgyal ba 'bri khung pa'i/ /dgon gnas khyad 'phags la phyi'i bdud 'dul phug /sngon chad nyams nas yod pa slar yang gsos/ /da dung zhabs tog gang nus byed bzhin yod/ /'brel tshad don ldan skyabs mgon rnam gnyis kyis/ /sangs rgyas mang bos rjes su ma bzung bar/ /yal bar dor ba'i 'khor 'khyams bdag 'dra rnams/ /myur myur sangs rgyas sa la bzhag tu gsol/ /gtan bde'i sangs rgyas sa chen ma non par/ /gnas skabs 'gal rkyen bar chad kun zhi zhing / /mthun rkyen 819

bsam pa'i don rnams yid bzhin du/ /'grub pa'i skyabs 'jug bsngo smon yang dag mkhyen/ /khyed kyi rjes 'jug gnas chen la phyi yi/ /grwa pa rnams kyis sdom gtsang byas yod pas/ /da nas bzung ste tshe rabs thams cad du/ /skyabs mgon gnyis kyis rjes su 'dzin par zhu/ /bdag kyang snga mor mjal 'dod che na yang / /rgyal khams gzhan du 'khyams nas mjal ma thub/ /da ni ring min myur du zhal mjal nas/ /gsung gi bdud rtsi 'thung ba'i smon lam 'tshal/ /de ltar skyabs 'jug zhu ba'i yig chung la/ /gzigs rten stong min tsam gyi lha rdzas bcas/ /sgrub brgyud bstan pa ches cher dar ba'i sa/ /la phyi'i bdud 'dul phug nas zla tshes phul/ /ces phul bas skyabs mgon yab sras gnyis ka thugs mnyes nas gsol ras gnang sbyin rgya chen bo byas byung ngo / /yang bar skabs shig la pha yul mdo smad du 'gro ba'i gnas skor ba zhig byung ba la/ mtsho chen khri gshog rgyal mo'i dbus kyi ri bo'i rtse na bzhugs pa'i rtsa ba'i bla ma bstan 'dzin nyi ma rin po che la zhu shog 'di phul lo//phul byung mkhyen brtse mnga' ba'i gter/ /'brel tshad don ldan dge ba'i bshes/ /mtshan snyan bstan 'dzin nyi ma zhes/ /yongs su grags pa'i zhabs drung du/ /slob bu byams pa chos 820

dar ngas/ /thag ring ri khrod la phyi nas/ /khyed kyi phyogs su lha phyag byas/ /rab tu gus pas zhu yig 'bul/ /mgon khyod dgung lo mtho na yang / /sgu gzugs shin tu bde'o zhes/ /gtam snyan lan cig tsam thos pas/ /lus sems dga' bdes khyab pa byung / /bdag kyang khyed kyi bka' drin gyes/ /sa phyogs gang du phyin na yang / /lus sems bde zhing 'tsho ba 'byor/ /dge sbyor gong du 'phel bzhin mchis/ /'on kyang dge sbyor 'phel na yang / /khyed dang lo mang ma mjal tshe/ /byes pa a mar ma 'phrad bzhin/ /skyo nas mchi ma yang yang shor/ /skom pa rnams kyis chu 'dod bzhin/ /nangs nub med par mgon khyod dran/ /nam zhig khyed dang mjal lam snyam/ /'dod pas gdungs nas bzod glags med/ /gtan gyi skyabs mgon rje btsun khyed/ /sngon gyi thugs bskyed smon lam mthus/ /bdag cag gdul bya'i dad mos ngor/ /yun ring bar du bzhugs las che/ /'on kyang bdag cag bsod nams dman/ /gdul bya rtag 'dzin phyi bshol mkhan/ /'ga' re chos la bskul ba'i phyir/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i tshul bstan na/ /da dung lam sna ma zin pa'i/ /skyabs 'og gdul bya nyam thag rnams/ /grog tshang kha yi rdo blangs bzhin/ /kun kyang skyabs med mgon med 821

'gyur/ /bdag kyang me tog 'thor shul du/ /bung ba kho thag chod pa bzhin/ /gar 'gro 'dir 'gro'i gtad so med/ /kye hud sa phyogs gang du 'khyams/ /'das rjes de 'dra 'ongs tshul la/ /dgongs nas gshegs pa phar la zhog /bsnyung dang bgres pa'i tshul tsarme yang / /nam yang ston par ma mdzad cig /dgung lo brgya phrag du ma'i bar/ /bzhugs zhes gsol ba snying nas 'debs/ /'jigs sar skyel mas bor ba bzhin/ /re sas nam yang ma bslu zhig /phran kyang mar la myur du 'ong / /gzhis dang lam bar gang du yang / /'gal rkyen bar chad mi 'byung bar/ /khyed dang mjal ba'i skyabs 'jug mkhyen/ /gal te tshe 'dir ma mjal na/ /phyi mar rje btsun bla ma khyed/ /gang du mngon par sangs rgyas pa'i/ /'khor gyi thog mar skye bar shog /ces dang / gzhan yang bla ma dpon po slob ma yon bdag rnams la so sor spring yig bskur ba rnams mgur 'bum na gsal lo/ /de nas phyogs phyogs nas ma bsdus bzhin du rang bzhin shugs kyis skal ldan gyi slob ma dang dad can sbyin bdag khams pa gnas skor ba sogs skyes pho mo brgya phrag du ma 'dus pa byung / de dag la drang don las rgyu 'bras kyi chos dang / nges don zab mo stong pa nyid kyi don 822

la sogs pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po bskor/ thabs mkhas bsdu bzhi'i sgo nas 'gro don rgya chen po byas pa'i skabs su lung rtogs yon tan che ba'i rgya rong bla ma dang / blo bzang dar rgyas/ yon tan rgya mtsho/ sangs rgyas rin chen/ dad can bsam dkar bu chen bstan 'dzin 'gyur med/ las shing grub chen/ lo chen pa/ rgyal mo rong gi dge slong sogs dad can slob ma yongs kyis sems la phan pa'i zhal gdams shig dgos zhes bskul ngor mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so//rje chos rgyal ngag gi dbang bo la/ /bdag gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /mgon de yi thugs sras zhabs dkar pas/ /tshig rnar snyan yid 'bab chos kyi glu/ /khyed 'dir 'tshogs lha mi'i snyan du 'bul/ /khrom go re 'tshogs pa kyi ler nyon/ /chos yon tan 'byung gnas dge ba'i bshes/ /bsam sbyor ba'i sgo nas tshul bzhin sten/ /rten dal 'byor mi lus rnyed par dka'/ /da rnyed dus chos kyi snying po longs/ /dgra 'chi bdag nam yong cha med pas/ /rang 'chi brod lha chos byed re ran/ /las rgyu 'bras nam yang bslu ba med/ /sdig mi dge spongs la dge ba sgrubs/ /mar 'khor ba'i gnas na bde ba med/ /sdug 'di las thar pa'i lam la zhugs/ /lam bslab pa 823

gsum gyi nyams len dang / /lung sde snod gsum gyi 'chad nyan gyes/ /rang sangs rgyas go 'phang myur thob nas/ /ma sems can thams cad 'dren pa'i phyir/ /byams snying rje byang chub sems kyi blos/ /lam pha rol phyin drug nyams su longs/ /skabs skabs su thabs mkhas bsdu bzhi'i sgos/ /ma 'gro ba yongs la gang phan gyis/ /mchog sangs rgyas myur du thob pa'i thabs/ /chos gsang sngags nye lam yin pas na/ /lam bskyed rdzogs rdzogs chen nyams su longs/ /rang tshe gcig sangs rgyas 'thob par nges/ /don de ltar nyams su len pa'i tshe/ /gnas dben pa'i dga' tshal nyams dga' sten/ /tshe 'di snang chos brgyad blos btang nas/ /rang gcig pur nyams su len pa gces/ /gtam 'di las byung ba'i dge ba'i mthus/ /ma 'gro kun sangs rgyas myur 'thob shog /yul 'di ru bkra shis g.yang chags shing / /bkra shis pas 'dzam gling khyab gyur cig /ces blangs pas dad can slob ma mang po'i sems la phan pa byung ngo / /de nas chu dbar gyi brin pa pho mo rnams dang yul gnya' nang gi yon bdag phyug po phal che bas ser sna byas nas mchod sbyin mi byed pa'i khar/ lo re bzhin ra lug g.yag gsum mang po bsad nas sdig pa gsog pa rnams la chos bshad nas sdig 824

rgyun bcad de zhal gdams 'di yang byen no//bla ma dkon mchog nam mkha'i skar tshogs tsam/ /bdag gi spyi gtsug 'khor lo'i rgyan du bzhugs/ /bslu med dkon mchog gsum gyi skyabs 'og tu/ /'khod nas rang blor gang shar glu ru len/ /dal 'byor mi lus thob pa lan cig tsam/ /yang yang thob par dka' ba rgyal bas gsungs/ /'chi ba mi rtag nam yong nges pa med/ /myur du lha chos byed pa'i dus la babs/ /tshe 'dir mi lus thob pa mnyam na yang / /phyi mar dge ba can rnams 'od lam la/ /zhugs nas yar la 'gro ba'i dus skabs su/ /sdig can mar la 'gro rnams snying re rje/ /phyug po ser sna can gyes tshe 'di ru/ /rnam dkar mchod sbyin gtong bar ma nus kyang / /lo re bzhin du ra lug g.yag gsum bsad/ /phyi mar dmyal ba'i gting du ma 'gro zhig /lho rgyal 'dzam bu gling du skyes dus 'dir/ /dper na lam gye bzhi mdor slebs pa 'dra/ /yar 'gro mar 'gro'i sa mtshams 'byed pa yin/ /'gro sa nor nyen che'o phyug po tsho/ /de skad gzhan la smra ba'i kha bde po/ /rang la gar 'gro 'dir 'gro'i gdeng med kyang / /gzhan la sha tsha bsam pa dkar po'i gtam/ /yin pas dad can kun gyis nyan par 'os/ /yid mi ches na mkhas grub 825

gzhan la dris/ /rgyal ba'i gsung rab kun la ltos shig dang / /zhabs dkar bla ma'i gtam 'di bden par gda'/ /snyam pa'i yid ches drag po skye bar nges/ /glu 'di thos tshad skye bo pho mo yis/ /ser sna la sogs skyon mtshang thams cad thon/ /dad pa can gyi gtong phod che ru song / /thams cad dam pa'i chos la spyod par shog /ces blangs/ de nas nyin gcig khams bsang byed dus phyi rol gyi snang ba sna tshogs mthong ba'i rkyen byas te/sems la yang 'char sgo sna tshogs pa shar ba ltar mgur 'di blangs so// rab dkar gangs ri dkar po'i rtse mo na/ /rab mdzes sprin dkar gzhon nu gyen du langs/ /thar pa'i lam la 'di ltar 'gro dgos zhes/ /je mtho je mthor song nas mkha' la yal/ /de nyid mthong bas bla ma bde gshegs dran/ /sku drin bsam gyin mchi ma yang yang byung / /ri yi ngos kyi rtsi shing nags gseb na/ /'dab chags bya dang bye'u mang po yis/ /pha mas chung dus 'di ltar bskyangs so zhes/ /skyo ngal med par nyam chung phrug gu gso/ /de nyid mthong bas drin can pha ma dran/ /drin lan 'jal na 'dod pa yang yang byung / /ri bo rnams kyi mgul dang lung ba na/ /na bun smig rgyu lang long g.yo ba yis/ /lus dang longs spyod 'di 826

ltar mi rtag ces/ /g.yo 'gul mang po byed bzhin glo bur yal / /de nyid mthong bas mi rtag 'chi ba dran/ /gang yod sbyin par ོgtong 'dod yang yang byung / /bar snang khams na tsha grang rgyu rkyen las/ /byung ba'i snang stong 'ja' tshon ri mo yis/ /rgyu rkyen 'tshogs las 'di ltar kun 'byung zhes/ /lam lam shar nas bar snang khams la yal//de nyid mthong bas kun rdzob bden pa dran/ /rgya chen spyod la slob 'dod yang yang byung / /steng gi phyogs na spros pa thams cad dang / /bral ba'i mtho la yangs pa'i nam mkha' yis/ /sgrib g.yogs kun bral stong sang rjen pa bstan//de nyid mthong bas don dam bden pa dran/ /zab mo lta ba bsgom 'dod yang yang byung / /mtha' dbus med pa'i mkha' klong yangs pa na/ /phyogs ris med pa'i 'od gsal nyi ma yis/ /gzhan don byed na 'di ltar gyis shig ces//'od zer rtse dga' rgod bzhin gling bzhi bgrod/ /de nyid mthong bas phyogs med 'gro don dran/ /bstan 'gro yongs la phan 'dod yang yang byung / /zhes pa la sogs pa'i mgur dbyangs sna tshogs len bzhin du lo ma me tog 'bras bus brgyan pa'i nags khrod dang /smyug ma'i bsil khang rnams su song nas khams bsang byed dus sems la dga' ba dang skyo ba sna tshogs pa skyes so/ /de nas 827

gser dngul la sogs pa'i nor 'dra byung tshe/ sngon bya rdzi bde mchog ma dang bu bzhis mchod rten bya rung kha shor bzhengs nas srog shing nang du sangs rgyas 'od srung gi ring bsrel ma ga rnya'i bre gang bzhugs su gsol te smon lam btab pas/ ma de nyid dam tshig gi lha mo pra mo ha zhes bya bar sangs rgyas/ bu bzhi bo mkhan slob chos gsum sba mi khri gzher dang bzhir gyur nas/bod du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par mdzad pa'i lo rgyus dang phan yon la bsams nas/ bstan 'gro'i bde thabs su mchod rten chen po de nyid kyi chos 'khor bcu gsum la rin chen gser zangs kyi na bza' zhig bsgron thub na skal ba re bzang snyam/ bal yul gor+ṣa rgyal po la zhu shog 'di phul lo//skye 'gro yongs kyi mgo thog gi nyi ma lta bu'i sa bdag chos kyi rgyal po chen po'i zhabs zung mi 'jigs gdong lngas btegs pa'i rin chen khri yi mdun sa der/ 'dod dgu'i longs spyod 'dzom pa'i yul bzang bal yul dang / phan bde kun gyi 'byung gnas gangs can bod yul gnyis kyi sa mtshams/ yi dam bde mchog 'khor lo'i gsung gi gnas 'brog la phyi gangs kyi ra ba na sdod pa'i bya bral rnal 'byor zhabs dkar pas rab tu gus pa'i lha phyag grangs med byas te yig chung zhig 'bul 'bras/ mi 828

nub rgyal mtshan mthon po'i rtse mo'i yid bzhin gyi nor bu lta bu'i sa bdag ces kyi rgyal po chin po khyed ni rgyal phran blon po dang bcas pa'i spyi bo'i gtsug gi rgyan du bzhugs pa ni/ 'khor 'bangs rgyal khams yongs la bka' drin gyi mchog tu gyur/gus phran bdag kyang bla ma mchog gsum gye thugs rje la brten nas sgyu lus bde zhing sgom sgrub dang / gzhan phan gyi bsam sbyor kyang gong du 'phel bzhin mchis/ mtshams kyi gsol ba 'debs pa'i snying po ni/ ngo mtshar gzigs mo che ba'i dbus kyi ri dbang rtse mo'i lha yi rnam rgyal khang bzang mi yul du 'phos 'dra'i bal yul yam bu'i ngo mtshar rgyal khang gi g.yas g.yon nyi zla rnam gnyis zung du shar ba las kyang mjes pa'i ngo mtshar mchod rten rin po che rnam gnyis kyi nang nas/ bya rung kha shor gyi sku'i stod kyi cha la 'phags pa shing kun dang mtshungs pa'i gser zangs kyi na bza' zhig byung na/ bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i mig rkyen mchog tu 'gyur bar 'dug pas/ de'i phyir bdag gi lhag bsam rnam par dag pas bstan dang 'gro ba yongs la phan pa dang bde ba 'byung ba'i phyir dang / khyad par du yang bal bod gnyis kyi skye 'gro sems can rnams la bde skyid kyi nyi ma gsar du 'char ba'i rgyu kho nar dmigs nas 'dzam gling 829

rgyan gcig phyag mchod zhing mchog 'brel tshad don ldan gsol ba btab na dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i yid bzhin gyi nor bu lta bu'i mchod rten chen po bya rung kha shor zhes mtshan snyan gyi ba dan dkar po phyogs kun tu ches cher g.yo ba 'di nyid sku'i stod kyi cha chos 'khor bcu gsum la/ blta na rab mdzes gzi brjid 'od zer phyogs brgyar 'phro ba'i rin chen gser zangs kyi na bza' phun sum tshogs pa zhig bsgron rgyu byung na snyam yod pas/ lo rjes mar de 'dra'i bskal pa bzang po zhig shar tshe/ sa bdag chos kyi rgyal po chen po bka' blon byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi thugs rab tu dgyes pa'i sgo nas/ de bsgrub chog pa'i rnar snyan yid 'bab kyi gsung gi gnang ba stsol ba dang / khyed kyi mnga' 'bangs zangs kyi thon khungs yod pa rnams nas zangs gang dgos nyos chog pa'i bka' shog dang /gzhan yang bzo bo las ka byed mi sogs/ gang ci'i thad nas grogs ldan mthun 'gyur gang drag mdzad dgos zhes/ da nas bzung ste gsol ba 'debs pa lags/ da res don chen po 'di 'grub pa zhig byung tshe rjes sor 'di nas kyang / rang gi khyer 'khos dang bstun pa'i bka' drin gtang rag dang / chos rgyal blon dang bcas pa'i sku tshe'i rgyal mtshan brtan cing / gnas 830

skabs dang mthar thug gi yid la 'dod pa'i don thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i skyabs 'jug bsngo smon gyi mtshams sbyor yang dag bya zhes zhu yig 'degs rten du/ stong min tsam gyi dngos po gser dngul phran bu lha rdzas bcas gnas chen la phyi gangs kyi ra ba'i dpen gnas bdud 'dul phug mo che nas phul/ zhes pa 'di bla ma skal bzang rgyal po brgyud nas phul bas rgyal po chen po dang / ka shi bim shing sogs rgyal blon rnams gros mdzad nas lan du/ de ltar bsgrub rgyu byung na shin tu legs pas de dus grogs mdzad yong zhes zhal bzhes bzang po gnang ba byung / gnas der sdod dus dad brtson shes rab che zhing dben pa'i ri la sdod pa'i slob bu kun bzang gzhan phan gyes nyin gcig bsam blo 'dra btang tshe/ dzi ltar byas kyang skyid 'dod tshe 'di'i bya ba blo yis ma thongs par zas gos nor rdzas phran bu re mched grogs shig gis khyer song na yang chags sdang gi dug ro rnying ba 'di da dung langs nyen 'dug pas/ 'di chos kyi gnad gang ma shes pa yin nam bla ma la zhu dgos snyam 'ong ste zhu don 'di glu ru phul lo// gang la'ang chags med zhen med kyi/ /bya btang rgyal po zhabs dkar rje//skyid 'dod tshe 'di'i 'dod pa can//bdag la 831

brtse bas cung zad dgongs/ /mgon khyod 'khor ba'i phun tshogs kun/ /sngon nas dug sbrul tshang ltar mthong / /mngon zhen gting nas log pa'i mthus/ /da lta gzhan gyi zas nor rigs/ /ci tsam mdun du phul na yang / /seng ge'i sngon du rtswa bzhag ltar/ /gang la'ang 'dod pa spu tsam med//mi gtsang khyi yis khyer ba ltar/ /su 'dra zhig gis 'khyer na yang / /de la snang rtog mi mdzad pa'i//mdzad pa 'di la rjes yi rang / /bsam gyen dad pa gting nas skyes/ /bdag dang bdag 'dra'i chos pa yis lto 'grangs nyi mas dros tsa na/ /skyid 'dod tshe 'di blos thongs zhes/ /kha bo chen po bton na yang / /rang la nyer mkho'i zas gos nor/ /gzhan gyis dbang med khyer tsa na/ /bzhin 'gyur kha nas tshig ngan shor/ /rdung res yin yang rgyag nyen 'dug /bdag cag rjes 'jug thams cad la/ /khyed bzhin tshe 'di blos thongs pa'i/ /re ba chen po ma mchis kyang / /'on kyang bla ma'i thugs rje yis/ /da dung 'ong ba'i re ba byed/ /da ni tshe 'di blos thongs pa'i/ /gnad kyi gdams pa zab mo zhig /sba gsang med par ston par zhu/ /bstan pa bzhin du bsgoms pa'i mthus/ /tshe blos myur du thongs par shog /ces zhus pa'i lan du/ 'o tshe 'di'i bya ba blos mi thongs par phyi rtsis kyi 'dun ma mang po dran 832

nas chags sdang gi 'khor lo bskor snying 'dod pa de/ mi rtag 'chi ba nyin re bzhin yang nas yang du ma dran pas lan 'dug pas/ de'i gnyen por 'chi ba mi rtag pa/ de'i nang nas kyang nam 'chi cha med 'di tshe 'di'i zas nor la blo ma log gi bar du khyod kyis sngar sems khrid bskyangs pa de bzhin du lo zla ba zhag bgrangs nas nyin mtshan bar ma chad du sgoms dang / tshe 'di la blo ldog par 'gyur zhes mi rtag 'chi ba dran pa'i mgur dbyangs 'di 'jen no//'chi ba nam yong cha med pas/ /do nub yin yang 'chi nyen yod/ /cis kyang dgos pa med snyam pa'i/ /bla ma de la gus phyag 'tshal/ /nam 'chi cha med ma dran par/ /tshe 'di'i skyid 'dod dbang du song / /snying med smyon pa lta bu la//thugs rjes gzigs la byen gyes rlobs/ /dad brtson shes rab snying rje can/ /slob bu kun bzang gzhan phan nyon//mi rtag 'chi ba ma dran na/ /tshe 'di blo yis thongs par dka'/ /mi rtag 'chi ba dran gyur na/ /tshe 'di'i bya ba blo yis thongs/ /mi rtag 'chi ba dran gyur na/ /cis kyang dgos med blo sna skye/ /mi rtag 'chi ba dran gyur na/ /gang la 'dod pa med par 'gyur/ /mi rtag 'chi ba dran gyur na/ /bla ma rnams la dad pa skye/ /mi rtag 'chi ba dran gyur na/ /mched 833

grogs rnams la dag snang 'byung //mi rtag 'chi ba dran gyur na//mi dge sdig pa ngang gi 'dzem/ /mi rtag 'chi ba dran gyur na/ /rnam dkar dge ba'i las la 'bad/ /mi rtag 'chi ba dran gyur na/ /skyo shas rnying rlung yang yang ldang / /mi rtag 'chi ba dran gyur na/ /bsgrub la brtson 'grus chen po 'byung //mi rtag 'chi ba dran gyur na/ /sngar byas sdig la 'gyod pa skye/ /mi rtag 'chi ba dran gyur na/ /phyin chad mi byed dam bca' 'byung / /'chi ba dran pa'i yon tan ni/ /bshad na brjod kyis mi langs pas/ /de phyir skal ldan slob bu khyod/ /da ni nyin mtshan dus drug tu/ /mi rtag 'chi ba dran par mdzod//mi rtag 'chi ba'i nang nas kyang / /nam 'chi cha med yang yang soms/ /sang gnangs mi 'chi nges pa med/ /rjes kyi bsam blos ci zhig bya/ /snyam du tshe 'di blo yis thongs//de ring nyi ma shor bud song //do nub yin yang 'chi nyen yod/ /sang gnangs bya bas ci zhig bya/ /snyam du tshe 'di blo yis thongs/ /bla ma'i thugs rjes ma shi na/ /sos dal sdod rgyu ga na yod/ /snyam du chos la 'bad par mdzod/ /de skad smras pa thos tshad kyis/ /tshe 'di blo yis thongs par shog /ces blangs pas/der 'tshogs pa thams cad kyi mtshang la phog nas/ gsung de bden par 'dug snyam/ 'chi ba yang yang dran par byas pas 834

cis kyang dgos med kyi blo sna rgyud la skyes nas/ tshe blos thongs mkhan gyi bya btang rnal 'byor pho mo mang po byung ngo / /yang nyin gcig bsam pa dkar zhing chos la mos pa/ gtong phod che zhing sgrub la brtson pa'i dge slong ye shes snyan grags kyis gser dngul gnyis las grub pa'i maṇ+ḍal tog dang bcas pa phul nas/zhal gdams dgos tshul gye tshigs bcad 'di phul lo//tshogs gnyis rab rdzogs sku bzhi'i bdag nyid kyi/ /drug pa rdo rje 'chang dang dbyer med pa'i/ /rang don mngon gyur gzhan rgyud nyon mongs kyis/ /'ching ba grol mdzad khyed la gus phyag 'tshal/ /snang srid longs spyod sgrub pa'i mchod pa 'bul/ /mi dge sdig pa byas tshad mthol lo bshags/ /'gro don rgyun mi 'chad la rjes yi rang / /chos 'khor rgya chen skor zhes gsol ba 'debs/ /sku tshe bskal brgya'i bar du zhabs brtan shog /dge tshogs sangs rgyas 'thob pa'i rgyu ru bsngo/ /pha rje dam pa khyed kyi bka' drin las/ /blo kha chos la phyogs pas skyid 'go tshugs/ /bsams na sku drin 'khor thabs ga la yod//sngon chad zab rgyas gdams pa mang gsungs kyang / /da dung rang skyon ngan pa ma thon 'dug /rang skyon thon pa'i zhal gdams bstsal du gsol//zhes phul ba'i lan du/ 'o skyon thams cad tshe blos ma thongs na 835

'ongs pas tshe blos thongs zhes tshe 'di'i mi nor zas gsum 'jig rten bya bzhag blos gtong tshul gyi zhal gdams 'di byin no//chos rje bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /chos bzhin nus par byin gyes rlobs/ /dam chos snying nas mdzad 'dod pa'i/ /dam ldan snying gi slob ma lags/ /pha yul chags sdang 'byung khungs yin/ /skyes pa'i pha yul rgyab tu skyur//chang ni nyes pa'i rtsa ba yin//hub gang tsam yang ma 'thung zhig /sdig zas pha ma'i sha khrag yin/ /shi sha yin yang ma za zhig /skyon gyi che shos bud med yin/ /nam yang 'khor du ma bsten cig /chags zhen 'khor ba'i rtsa ba yin/ /lto gos chags zhen ma che zhig /ser snas yi dwags gnas su skyes//nor la ser sna ma byed cig /dmyal ba'i sa bon zhe sdang yin/ /don med khong khro ma ldang zhig /rnam rtog mang po bdud kyi las/ /rnam par mi rtog ye shes skyongs/ /chos kyi snying po snying rje yin/ /de'i phyir 'di la nan tan mdzod//de ltar byas na gnas skabs bde/ /mthar thug sangs rgyas 'thob par 'gyur/ /zhes smras pas kho rang gi lus nad sems kyi sdug bsngal sogs/ skyon gang yod thams cad rang bzhin shugs kyis thon nas lus sems la dga' bde rgyun mi 'chad du byung / tshe blos btang gi 836

slob ma nyams rtogs kyi yon tan dang ldan pa gzhan don nus pa'i chos pa phun sum tshogs pa zhig byung ngo / /de yang lung rtogs kyi yon tan du ma dang ldan pa'i skal ldan snying gi bu chen phug brag mkhan pos gser dngul sogs dngos bo gang yod phul nas gnas chen 'dir sku gzugs bde ba dang thugs dam 'phel bo e byung zer ba'i lan du/ lus sems bde zhing dge sbyor 'phel tshul gye mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so//sangs rgyas las kyang drin che ba'i//chos rgyal ngag gi dbang po la//gsol ba snying gi dkyil nas 'debs//byin rlabs thugs kyi klong nas stsol/ /grub thob gong ma bzhugs pa'i shul/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i zhing / /la phyi gangs kyi ra ba yi/ /dben gnas bdud 'dul phug pa na/ /rnal 'byor tshogs drug rang grol nga / /lus la na tsha med pas bde/ /ngag la 'gag pa med pas bde/ /sems la sdug bsngal med pas bde/ /bla ma dam pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /lus la gtum mo'i bde drod 'bar/ /ngag la glu dbyangs rang brdol byung / /sems la nyams rtogs nyi ma shar/ /gnas chen 'di yi byin rlabs kyis/ /nyon mongs rnam rtog rang 'gag nas/ /bde gsal mi rtog ye shes kyi/ /ngang du lhan lhan 'gro ba byung / /sgrib med phyi nang zang thal gye/ /mnyam 837

bzhag me long lta bu la/ /dag pa'i snang ba ci yang shar/ /e ma rmad byung skal ba bzang / /tshe 'dir bde zhing skyid 'dod cing / /phyi mar phan pa'i chos 'dod pa'i/ /skal ldan yod na gnas 'dir shog /shog dang bde skyid nyi ma 'char/ /de skad smras pa'i dge ba'i mthus/ /'gro kun bde zhing skyid pa dang / /skyid pa'i sgo nas chos byas te/ /gtan du bde ba 'thob par shog /ces smras/ de nas khyed kyang phug brag nas sku gzugs bde mo e byung dris pa'i lan du 'di skad ces phul byung /mkhyen brtse'i mnga' bdag drin can rje/ /sku bde gsung snyan thugs dam 'phel/ /gnas 'dir bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan btsugs/ /'gro don mdzad pa bka' drin che/ /phran kyang bla ma'i bka' drin gyes/ /lus po shin tu bde na yang / /tshe 'di blo yis ma thongs pas//sems la bde rgyu cher ma byung //gang ma yog par do za bzhin//rang don ma grub gzhan don byas/ /pha rgan nor gyi 'dod pas gdungs/ /bdag la snyad 'tshol mang po byas/ /bdag kyang skyo ba gting nas skyes/ /mgon khyod dran nas gnas 'dir 'ongs//da ni bla ma'i bka' bzhin du//tshe 'di'i bya ba blo yis gtong / /grong yul dgon pa kun spangs nas/ /mi med lung stong dben pa 'grims//dam pa gong ma'i rnam thar bzhin//dam 838

chos zab mo nyams su len//dpal ldan bla ma thugs rje can//tshe blos thongs pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /ri khrod zin pa'i byin gyes rlobs//bsam don 'grub pa'i smon lam 'tshal//zhes phul ba'i lan du/ rgyal ba gong ma'i rnam thar ltar tshe blos btang nas ri khrod 'grims na phan yon che tshul gyi glu 'di blangs so//tshe 'di'i bya ba blos thongs pa'i/ /bla ma gong ma rnams la 'dud//rjes 'jug slob ma thams cad kyis//tshe blos thongs par byin gyis rlobs/ /lung rtogs yon tan du ma dang / /ldan pa'i mkhas pa'i dbang po khyod/ /tshe 'di blo yis gtong snyam pa/ /thugs la shar ba ngo mtshar che/ /tshe 'di'i bya ba blos btang na/ /chos kyi phyed ka tshar ba yin//tshe 'di'i bya ba blos btang na//skyid kyi 'go de tshugs pa yin/ /tshe 'di'i bya ba blos btang na/ /sdug bsngal myang 'phro chad pa yin/ /tshe 'di'i bya ba blos btang na/ /sdom pa dam tshig gtsang ba yin/ /tshe 'di'i bya ba blos btang na//phan sems shugs kyis 'byung ba yin/ /tshe 'di'i bya ba blos btang na/ /tshe gcig sangs rgyas 'thob pa yin/ /tshe 'di'i bya ba blos btang na/ /'gro don rgya chen 'byung ba yin/ /tshe blos btang ba'i phan yon ni/ /bshad na brjod kyis mi lang bas/ /de'i phyir dge ba'i bshes gnyen khyed/ /tshe blos thongs la nyams len 839

mdzod/ /'brel tshad don ldan skyes bu khyod//tshe 'di'i bya ba blos btang nas/ /mi med lung stong 'grims nus na/ /sngar bas lhag par ngo mtshar che/ /mi med lung ba stong ba na/ /sdod sa sgrub phug nyams dga' yod/ /mi med lung ba stong ba na/ /skyo rogs bya dang ri dwags yod//mi med lung ba stong ba na//kha zas shing thog sngo tshod yod/ /mi med lung ba stong ba na//'khor 'das brje ba'i tshong 'dus yod//mi med lung ba stong ba na/ /dga' bde gnyis kyi gter kha yod/ /mi med lung ba stong ba na/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i 'du sa yod/ /mi med lung ba stong ba na//nyams rtogs skye ba'i mthun rkyen yod/ /mi med lung ba stong ba na/ /dam pa gong ma'i gdan sa yod/ /mi med lung ba stong ba na/ /nyams dga'i ltad mo sna tshogs yod/ /mi med lung ba stong ba yi/ /yon tan bshad na brjod mi lang / /de'i phyir rgyal ba'i sras po khyod//lung stong 'grims la nyams len mdzod/ /ces smras pas/ khong gis kyang tshe blos btang nas mi med dben pa'i ri sul rnams su zab rgyas chos kyi nyams len mdzad pas/ nyams rtogs mtha' ru phyin nas/ nyam thag 'gro ba yongs la phan thogs pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen kun gye nang nas mchog tu gyur pa zhig byung ngo / /yang skabs shig skal ldan slob ma brgya phrag mang po la blo 840

sbyong don bdun ma dang / yang de nyid bdag gis rgyal sras rin po che la sogs pa'i dam pa gong ma'i gsung bgros gtam rgyud dang sbyar nas brtsams pa'i rgyal sras sprul pa'i glegs bam gyi lung khrid nyi ma mang por byas pa'i mjug tu kun gyis zhal gdams shig dgos zhes bskul ngor/ zhal gdams bdud rtsi'i thigs pa 'di byin no//bla ma mchog gsum yi dam lhar/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /bde skyid 'gro la phan las byung / /sdug bsngal gnod pa byas na yong / /gzhan la gnod pa byed pa de/ /rang la gnod pa byas pa 'dra/ /gzhan la phan thogs byed pa de//rang la phan thogs dus pa 'dra//gzhan gye skyon mtshang 'bru ba de/ /rang gi skyon mtshang brus pa 'dra/ /gzhan gyi yon tan brjod pa de/ /rang gi yon tan brjod pa 'dra/ /ci 'dra ba yi las byas pa/ /'bras bu de 'dra smin par 'gyur/ /de phyir dus rnams thams cad du/ /bla ma dam pa'i bka' chos ltar//gzhan la gnod 'tshe mi bya zhing / /phan bde'i thabs la 'bad par bya/ /gzhan gyis gnod pa ci byas kyang / /rang gi sems la 'jog mi bya/ /gnod lan 'jal ba'i dus byung kyang / /'jal bar mi bya snying rje sgoms//gzhan gyis tshig rtsub smras na yang / /lan du tshig ngan smra 841

mi bya/ /zha ra sdom shor la sogs pa'i//gzhan gyi skyon mtshang 'bru mi bya/ /gzhan gyi nyes pa shes na yang / /'di yis lan zhes brjod mi bya/ /rang la 'bab pa'i khag ngan rnams/ /gzhan gye thog tu bsgyur mi bya/ /rang gi mi 'dod dgra la sogs/ /shi na snyam pa bsam mi bya/ /dgra gnyen bar ma'i sems can gyi//yon tan mthong tshad brjod par bya/ /mi mang nang nas rang gi mtshang / /gzhan gyis brus kyang khro mi bya//rang gi zas nor longs spyod rnams//gzhan gyis khyer yang 'khon mi btsal//rang gis bu bzhin bskyangs pa'i mis/ /dgra bzhin blta rung byams par bya/ /ma lan bzhin du bkyigs brdung sogs/ /byed mkhan byung rung bzod pa sgoms/ /ma nyes kha g.yog ci byung yang / /sngon gye las yin lan mi bya/ /nag chang brkus rdzun ma byas par byas 'dug zer rung khro mi bya/ /gzhan gyis zer tshad bden dogs med/ /ci 'dra zer yang zer du chug /mi snyan brgya thos stong thos kyang / /de la rtsad gcod ma byed cig /mi 'dod brgya byed stong byed rung / /de la snang rtog ma mdzad cig /khe dang rgyal kha gzhan la byen//gyong dang pham kha rang gis longs//mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i gzugs sku'i rgyu/ /bzod pa yin pas nan tan mdzod//de ltar mdzad mkhan thams cad la/ /yod dgos thams 842

cad rjes na yod/ /gnas skabs bde skyid snyan gsum 'byung / /mthar thug sangs rgyas 'thob par 'gyur/ /glu 'di mthong thos dran reg kun/ /bla med byang chub myur 'thob shog /ces smras pas/ de ltar kun gyis nyams su blangs pas/ mthar rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa'i rnam thar ltar snying rje rtsa ba can gyi bdag pas gzhan gces kyi blo bcos ma ma yin pa rgyud la 'byongs nas khe rgyal gzhan la gtong zhing / pham kha rang gis len nus pa'i chos pa sha stag byung ngo / /yang de'i dus su bla ma la mos gus che ba'i slob bu bstan 'dzin nyi mas zhal gdams de la sogs bla ma'i bka' la bltas nas rang gi rgyud la zhu dag byas pas/ mi mthun pa mang po byung tshe/ sems skyo ba'i shugs kyis tshigs su bcad pa 'di bris nas phul byung /mchog gsum thugs rje'i bdag nyid bla ma la/ /sgo gsum gus pa chen po'i ngang nas 'dud/ /dug gsum dbang song slob bu bstan 'dzin la/ /gsang gsum yon tan med tshul 'di skad zhu/ /bla ma sangs rgyas dngos su mthong lags kyang / /zhal gdams bdud rtsi'i thigs pa la sogs pa'i/ /gsung dang rang rgyud mthun pa dka' mor gda'/ /kye ma las ngan bdag la thugs rjes gzigs/ /dal brgyad 'byor bcu'i mi lus rin 843

chen la/ /don ldan snying po len dgos shes na yang / /don med chos brgyad btsan po'i dbang du song / /kye ma stong log mkhan la thugs rjes gzigs/ /mi rtag 'chi ba bsam tshul shes na yang / /rtag 'dzin mkhan po'i mgo 'phang je mthor song mi rtag bsgom pa lam du ma brgyugs 'dug /kye ma sdug myong bdag la thugs rjes gzigs/ /'dod yon 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs shes na yang / /sgo gsum bya byed sdig pa'i dbang du song / /dad zas gshin zas mthong tshe brnab sems skyes/ /kye ma dkor rkyal bdag la thugs rjes gzigs/ /spros bral rang sems ngo bo stong gsal gye/ /skyong tshul khyed kyi gsung bzhin go na yang / /bdag pas gzhan gces byang sems ma 'byongs 'dug /kye ma rang 'dod can la thugs rjes gzigs/ /rje btsun grub dbang mchog gi snyan lam du/ /skal ldan slob ma'i tshogs kyis bzang rtogs 'bul/ /bu ngan bstan 'dzin nyi ma snying rul ngas/ /nyon mongs ngan rtogs 'bul ba ya re nga / /da ni khyed gsung blo sbyong mchog gyur pa//bdud rtsi'i thigs pa zhes bya'i tshig don rnams//nyams len byed 'dod 'dun pa gting nas yod/ /bka' bzhin bsgrub tshe mthar son skyabs 'jug mkhyen/ /zhes phul ba'i lan du/ snying rje chen po'i sgo nas dus rtag tu khe rgyal 844

gzhan la byin nas/ pham kha rang gis len nus pa'i byang chub sems dpa' zhig byed 'dod na/ thog mar tshe blos btang nas ri khrod dben pa'i gnas su gcig pur byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems gnyis la blo sbyongs dang / 'byongs tshe de ltar 'ong zhes gcig pur dben par bsdad pa'i yon tan gye mgur 'di blangs so//gcig pur byang chub sems bsgoms pa'i/ /sgom chen rnams la gus pas 'dud/ /dben pa'i gnas su gcig pur bsdad/ /byang sems bsgom par byin gyes rlobs/ /mos gus che ba'i slob bu khyod/ /snying nas byang chub sems bsgom na/ /mi rtag 'dod yon nyes dmigs soms/ /tshe 'di'i bya ba blo yis thongs/ /lto gos ngan ngon gang byung sten/ /dben par gcig pur 'dug pa gces/ /gcig pur bsdad na 'gal rkyen med/ /gcig pur bsdad na mthun rkyen 'byor/ /gcig pur bsdad na snang ba bde//gcig pur bsdad na dge sbyor 'phel//gcig pur bsdad na dad gus skye/ /gcig pur bsdad na dam tshig gtsang / /gcig pur bsdad na nyon mongs thul/ /gcig pur bsdad na nges 'byung skye/ /gcig pur bsdad na brtson 'grus 'byung / /gcig pur bsdad na byang sems 'byongs/ /gcig pur bsdad 845

na mkha' 'gro 'du/ /gcig pur bsdad na chos skyong 'khor/ /gcig pur bsdad na nyams rtogs 'char/ /gcig pur bsdad na sangs rgyas 'thob/ /gcig pur bsdad na 'gro don 'ong / /gcig pur bsdad pa'i yon tan ni/ /bshad na brjod kyis mi lang bas/ /de phyir bstan 'dzin nyi ma khyod/ /drang srong bsam gtan bsgom pa bzhin/ /byang chub sems gnyis ma 'byongs par/ /gcig pur sdod la nyams len rem/ /zhes smras pas/khong gis dben pa'i gnas su gcig pur byang chub kyi sems bsgoms pas ring bor mi thogs par myur du snying rje chen po rgyud la skyes nas/ bdag gzhan bde sdug 'byed nus pa'i byang chub sems dpa' zhig byung ngo / /de yang nyin gcig bsam pa bzang zhing shes rgyud 'jam pa'i tshe blos btang gi slob ma dge slong ye shes kyis rin chen gnyis pa'i 'khor lo srang gang lha rdzas dri med phyag dang bcas te/ zhal gdams dgos zhes zhu don tshigs su bcad pa 'di phul lo//mtshan ldan bla ma rin po che/ /brtse bas bdag la cung zad dgongs/ /rab tu gus pas phyag dang bcas/ /rje btsun snyan du 'di skad zhu//sngon chad bdag sogs gus slob la//bshes gnyen bsten tshul nas bzung ste/ /mi slob zung 'jug bar rnams kyi/ /846

so so'i sa bcad go rim dang / /de dang de yi dgongs 'grel rnams/ /rgya che gsal la go bde sogs/ /lan grangs du mar bka' drin bstsal/ /khyad par dbu rdzogs phyag chen dang / /'pho rlung gcod gsum gdams ngag sogs/ /zab dang rgya che'i gdams pa rnams/ /kun la brtse ba chen po'i sgos/ /bstsal ba bka' drin shin tu che/ /da dung bdag 'dra'i slob ma la/ /rang nyid gces par 'dzin pa'i nad/ /'tsho bar byed pa'i sman mchog dang / /dug gsum dgra bo sgrol byed kyi/ /man ngag mtshon cha ngar ma dang / /'dra ba brtse bas gnang bar zhu/ /'di nang blun po'i zhu tshig la/ /'gal 'khru'/ gang mchis spyan sngar bshags/ /dge tshogs bdag dang sems can rnams/ /bla mas rjes su 'dzin phyir bsngo/ /rjes su bzung nas tshe rabs kun/ /khyod mnyes 'ba' zhig byed par shog /ces phul ba'i lan du/'o bdag 'dzin gyi nad sel ba'i sman dang / dug gsum dgra bo sgrol ba'i gdams pa'i mtshon cha'i mchog tu gyur pa ni/ stong nyid snying rje snying po can yin zhes don dam byang chub sems kyi glu 'di blangs so//na mo gu ru/ phyi yi snang ba rmi lam bzhin/ /snang stong sems su ngo 'phrod cing / /nang gi sems nyid stong sang nge / /nam 847

mkha' lta bur ngo sprod pa'i/ /bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /sems kyi ngo sprod dran tsam gyis/ /stong nyid ye shes rjen sangs kyi//rgyud la 'char bar byen gyis rlobs//gza' gtad bral ba'i zhal dkar pa/ /gu yangs yan pa blo bde ngas/ /stong nyid snying rje dbyangs su len/ /dge slong ye shes ma yengs nyon//snang srid 'khor 'das chos rnams kun/ /bar snang stong ba'i 'ja' tshon 'dra/ /rgyu rkyen rten 'brel 'tshogs las snang / /ji ltar snang yang rang bzhin med//sems nyid nam mkha' lta bu yi/ /rgyan du shar ba ngo mtshar che/ /sems ni kha dog dbyibs dang bral/ /btsal na mi rnyed stong ba nyid/ /rang bab bzhag na sa le ba/ /stong sangs nam mkha' yangs pa 'dra/ /de yi ngang la 'jog tsa na/ /sa le hrig ge rjen ne zhog /nam yang sgrib med zang thal le/ /gtad med gu yangs yan par zhog /de ltar mnyam par bzhag tsa na/ /khyab gdal nam mkha' lta bu yi/ /ngang nas chos rnams sa ler shes//sa lam yon tan ci yang 'byung //de ltar ma rtogs 'gro la yang / /tshad med snying rje skye bar 'gyur/ /stong nyid snying rje 'byongs tsa na/ /gzhan don shugs kyis 'grub par 'gyur/ /glu 'di thos tshad shes rgyud la/ /mkha' ltar dri ma med pa yi/ /stong nyid ye shes mngon sum du/ /sgrib med sa ler 'char bar shog /848

ces smras pa bzhin bsgrubs pas byang chub kyi sems gnyis 'byongs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rang gzhan gye don gnyis 'grub pa zhig byung ngo / /de nas bslab gsum rgyan ldan skal ldan snying gi slob bu sbyin pa nor bus/ nyin gcig bdag dang bdag 'dras chos ci byas kyang sangs rgyas mnyes shing sems can mgu ba zhig mi 'ong ba 'di chos ci zhig gi gnad ma shes pas lan pa yin nam snyam nas mno bsam rgya chen po btang tshe/snying rje med na chos kyi rtsa ba rul gsungs pas/ bla ma'i bka' ltar sems can bzang ngan 'bring gsum gang la'ang phyogs ris med pa'i snying rje chen po zhig rgyud la ma skyes pas lan 'dug par go nas zhu don 'di ltar phul lo//dgra dang gnyen la khyad med cing / /gser dang sa rdo khyad med pas/ /sbas pa'i sangs rgyas mi gzugs can/ /'brel tshad don ldan zhabs dkar rje//skyabs mgon khyed kyi thugs rgyud la//snying rje chen po yod stabs kyis/ /byams pa'i gnyen dang sdang ba'i dgra/ /gnyis la khyad par 'byed rgyu med/ /dgra gnyen bar ma thams cad po/ /dper na ma yis bu bzhin skyeng / /khyed kyi mdzad par rjes yi rang //sangs rgyas dngos kyi dad gus skyes/ /bdag cag ma rig dbang du song / /snying rje med pa'i la yogs 849

kyis/ /grogs mched la yang bzang ngan phyes/ /nye ring chags sdang phyogs ris kyis//gcig gis gcig la lkog lab shor//snying rje chen po med stabs kyis/ /zas gos nor la bdag 'dzin skyes//khe rgyal gzhan la gtong ma thub/ /pham kha rang gis len mi nus/ /sngon chad ma shes mthol lo bshags/ /phyin chad bla ma'i bka' bzhin du/ /snying rje rgyud la ci skyes bya/ /skye thabs tshogs gsog sgrib sbyong la/ /'bad bzhin snying rje bsgom par bya/ /rgyud la snying rje ma skyes bar/ /lo zla bgrangs nas bsgom par bya/ /de yang nyin mtshan dus drug tu/ /bsgom pa'i dam bca' drung du 'bul//drin can bla ma thugs rje can//snying rje skye bar byin gyes rlobs//skye ba kun tu snying rje dang //nam yang 'bral ba med par shog /ces phul ba'i lan du/ 'o de yin na khyod kyis go 'dugachos thams cad kyi rtsa ba phar ded na snying rje yin/ bla ma dus gsum sangs rgyas mnyes shing pha ma sems can thams cad mgu bar 'dod na chos gzhan bsgom pa re zhig zhog la/ snying rje 'di ka rang sgoms dang bzang zhes mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so//snying rje chen po'i gter mnga' ba'i/ /bla ma dus gsum sangs rgyas dang / /snying rje'i lha mchog spyan ras gzigs//khyod la rtag tu gus phyag 'tshal/ /snying rje skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /850

sar gnas byang chub sems dpa' yi/ /rigs can sbyin pa nor bu khyod/ /nga la dad gus che stabs kyis/ /chos kyi rtsa ba go nas 'dug /e ma skal ldan snying gi bu/ /pha rjes bu yis zin 'dod na/ /pha nga'i snying gtam 'di la nyon/ /phyi rol pa la ma mchis pa'i//nang nga/'i khyad chos snying rje yin/ /snying rje med pa'i nang pa de/ /phyi rol pa dang khyad par med/ /'jig rten pa las lhag pa yi/ /chos pa'i khyad chos snying rje yin/ /snying rje med pa'i chos pa de/ /'jig rten pa las lod pa yin//snying rje med pa'i sdig can mi/ /gshin rje rnams dang khyad par med//snying rje med na mched grogs la'ang / /mi 'cham 'khon 'dzing rgyag res byed/ /sprang po rnams la sgo rtsam kyang / /mi ster kha ngan rgyag pa mang / /snying rje med pa'i stong nyid de/ /bdag po med pa'i khang stong 'dra/ /ci tsam bsgoms kyang sdug gyong yin/ /bla med byang chub thob mi 'gyur/ /snying rje med pa'i chos pa de//su yis mthong kyang yid mi 'ong //snying rje med pa'i sgom chen la//'gro don sku bsod rgyas pa med//dper na 'dod 'byung nor bu zhig /yod na dgos 'dod kun 'byung ltar/ /rgyud la snying rje chen po zhig /yod na chos gzhan kun kyang 'byung / /mang po bslabs nas ci zhig bya//chos ni gcig la bslab na dga'/ /gcig mchog chos de gang yin 851

na/ /snying rje yin pas nan tan sgoms/ /snying rje che ba'i chos pa de/ /myur du sangs rgyas 'thob par 'gyur/ /snying rje can gyis 'gro ba'i don//chos pa gzhan las lhag pa 'ong //snying rje can de gar song gi /yul la bkra shis gang bsam 'grub/ /snying rje can de gar bsdad kyi//sa la byen chags gang 'dod 'byung / /mdor na snying rje bsgom nus na/ /rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub par 'gyur//snying rje bsgoms pa'i phan yon ni//bshad na brjod kyis ga la langs/ /de phyir skal ldan slob bu khyod/ /nyin mtshan med par snying rje sgoms/ /pha yi rgyud kyi snying rje de/ /slob ma rnams la 'pho bar shog /khyod dang snying rje chen po gnyis/ /nam yang 'bral ba med gyur cig /skye 'gro kun gyi shes rgyud la/ /snying rje chen po'i bkra shis shog /ces smras pa bzhin du snying rje kho na bsgoms pa'i mthus ring por mi thogs par sngar bas brgya stong 'gyur gyi byams snying rje byang chub sems kyi gter kha nang nas brdol te/ ngam ngam rang bzhin shugs kyis bstan 'gro'i don rlabs chen yong ba'i chos pa kun gyi yang rtse thams cad kyis bla mar bkur ba zhig byung ngo / /yang slob bu skal ldan rang grol gangs ri nas 'ongs te gzhan gyi nor byen tshad bdag la phul tshe nor gye 'bul ba mang po 'dug ste nyams rtogs kyi 'bul ba 852

ci 'dra yod byas pas/ 'di skad ces phul byung /gang gi gtsug nor skyabs mgon thugs rje can/ /gang la'ang zhen chags med par byin gyis rlobs/ /gang gsung nyams len byed pa'i skal ldan ngas/ /gang shar nyams rtogs skyes tshul dbyangs su 'bul/ /ka dag gnas lugs brda' yis mi mtshon pa'i/ /kha dog mtshan ma bral ba'i rang bzhin la/ /ga nas bltas kyang ngo bo ngos bzung med/ /nga bdag 'khrul rtog chos kyi dbyengs su thim/ /ca co'i gtam rnams smra bsam brjod las 'das//cha lugs nges med chos lugs kun dang mthun//ja nor la sogs rmi lam sgyu mar snang / /nya chur gnas ltar dbyings rig 'du 'bral med/ /ta thā ga ta'i de nyid bsgoms pa'i mthus//tha mal rig stong rjen par mjal nas byung / /da ni bcos min ngang la wal le ba/ /na so rgas kyang blo bde 'bol ler gda'/ /pa sangs ltar mtho lta ba sa le ba/ /pha rol mthar phyin sgom pa sang nge'i ngang / /ba zho ltar dkar spyod pa dri ma med/ /ma bcos rang byung 'bras bu lhun gyis grub/ /tsā ri gangs ri la sogs gnas chen du/ /tsha grang bde sdug snang stong dbyer med dang / /dza ya'i gsung rnams grag stong brjod bral la/ /wa chu'i rgyun ltar nyams len chad med byung / /zhwa ltar spyi bo'i bla 853

ma'i bka' drin gyis/ /za mar chog shes 'phags nor bdun gyes phyug /'a cag bya bral nged tsho'i bde skyid dang / /ya rabs rnam thar skyong tshul 'di ka lags//ra ba gangs can gnas chen 'khor tshar nas/ /la lung nges med nyul ba'i sprang za/na bdag /sha khrag lus la bar chad ma byung bar/ /sa lam sgo 'dogs rim gyis chod nas byung //ha cang dmigs gtad bcos ma ma dgos par/ /a don chos sku sems la rdzogs nas 'dug /ha ha phran chung nged tsho'i dga' ba la//te he phran chung nged tsha'i skyid pa la//skyid glu 'di yang rigs brgya'i khyab bdag gi /skyid pa'i gser zhal myur du mjal skabs su/ /skyid bzhin spro bzhin zhabs pad drung du phul/ /skyid dga' bde gsum chos la spyod par shog /ces smras pa'i lan du/ 'o dri med dag pa'i sangs rgyas ni/ /rang rig chos sku 'gyur ba med//sa le sing nge wal le ba/ /sprin med ston ga'i nam mkha' bzhin gsungs pa ltar/ chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba rang gi sems kyi gnas lugs stong gsal 'dzin med khyab gdal klong yangs zang thal spros pa'i mtha' brgyad dang bral ba ston gnam g.ya' dag pa lta bu'i chos kyi sku'i dgongs pa mngon sum du rtogs na/ de'i ngang la nam bzhag kyang /rtogs pa nam mkha' 'dra ste 'gyur ba med gsungs pa ltar 854

byung 'dug pas shin tu ngo mtshar che/ 'bul ba de 'dra re yang re ste byung yang byung 'dug da ni khyod la snying gtam bshad rgyu la/ nam mkha' la nyi ma dgos/ ma la bu dgos bya la gshog pa gnyis ka dgos pa ltar/ stong ba nyid gcig pus mi chog de ltar ma rtogs pa'i dgra gnyen bar ma'i sems can thams cad la/bzang ngan phyogs ris med pa'i snying rje chen po skye dgos/de skye ba la stong nyid kyi shugs kyis skyes yod mod snyam nas ma bsgoms par bsdad pas mi yong / khyod kyis sngar stong nyid lo ji tsam gyi bar du bsgoms/ de bzhin du lo zla ba bgrangs nas nyin mtshan med par bsgoms na/ dper na mas bu mes 'tshig pa la snyeng rje skye ba las kyang brgya 'gyur gye/ sems can gyi sdug bsngal bsam tshe shas mi bzod pa lta bu'i snying rje skyes nas sems can gye ngos nas bya spyod ngan pa ci 'dra byas na yang / rang gi ngos nas skyid sdug gang byung kyang sems can gcig kyang yal bar mi 'dor bar byang chub ma thob kyi bar du phan ci thogs bya'o snyam pa'i blo ngam ngam shugs kyis ma skyes kyi bar du snying rje rang sgoms zhes zhal gdams 'di byen no//mkhyen brtse'i mnga' bdag bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can/ /rgyud la skye 855
