bar byen gyis rlobs/ /rtogs ldan nam mkha'i rnal 'byor ba/ /skal ldan bu khyod stong nyid kyi/ /rtogs pa pha dang mnyam par gda'/ /ngo mtshar che'o rigs kyi bu/ /snying rje pha dang mnyam pa zhig /da dung yod snyam mi gda' bas/ /da ni stong nyid bsgoms pa bzhin/ /snying rje nyin mtshan med par sgoms/ /snying rje pha dang mnyam pa zhig /myur ba myur du gyis shig ang / /stong nyid bsgom na rang shugs kyis/ /skabs rer snying rje skye na yang / /de yis chog par mi 'dzin par/ /ched du gnyer la snying rje sgoms/ /dper na a mas gces phrug gi /rkang lag me yis 'tshig pa de//mthong na sha yis mi bzod pa'i//bcos min snying rje skye ba ltar//pha ma sems can thams cad kyi/ /sdug bsngal yid la bsam tsa na//nam yang sha yis mi bzod pa'i//bcos min snying rje skye rag bar//blo yis bcos nas dus rtag tu//snying rje bsgom pa shin tu gces/ /nyam thag sems can su la yang / /phan na lus kyang gtong phod na/ /zas nor ster ba smos ci dgos/ /a mas bu tsha mang po yi/ /nang nas ngan pa de nyid kyang / /snying rjes yal bar mi 'dor bar//zas gos byin nas skyong ba ltar//snying rje can gyi chos pa yis/ /sems can bzang ngan mang po dag /gcig kyang yal bar mi 'dor bar/ /rtag tu byams pas skyong bar 'gyur/ /856

snying rje can rnams sems can gyi/ /don la ma bskul na yang 'jug /zhugs kyang snying rje mi skyo bar//don de mthar phyin byed par 'gyur//stong nyid nam mkha' yangs pa la/ /snying rje'i nyi ma shar gyur na/ / 'gro kun pad+ma'i tshal chen po/ /skyong ba'i rten 'brel 'grigs pa yin/ /stong nyid rabs chad rgan mo la/ /snying rje'i phrug gu 'byung gyur na//'gro kun pha ma nye 'brel kun//skyong rgyu'i skal ba ldan pa yin/ /sems nyid rang byung khyung phrug la/ /stong nyid snying rje chen po yi//gshog pa gnyis ka rgyas tsa na//rnam mkhyen mkha' la 'phur bar nges/ /de phyir skal ldan rang grol khyod/ /snying rje bsgom la 'bad par mdzod/ /stong nyid snying po snying rje che/ /bu yi rgyud la sgye bar shog /ces smras pa'i dgong mo nas bzung ste bsgoms pas bcos ma ma yin pa'i snying rje chen po byung / de'i shugs kyis bdag pas gzhan gces kyi blos sems can gye don rgya chen po byas so/ /yang mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i dge slong rdo rje slob dpon gyes snam sbyar tshun chad kyi nor dngos po gang yod thams cad phul nas 'di skad zhus so//sngon dus ston pa bcom ldan 'das/ /'jig rten khams su byon pa ltar/ /da lta skyabs mgon rin po che/ /snyigs dus 'gro 857

ba'i don la byon/ /'gro la drang don las 'bras dang / /nges don zab mo stong nyid kyi//chos kyi 'khor lo bskor dus 'dir/ /phran kyang mjal ba skal ba bzang / /bskal pa bzang po'i dus skabs 'dir//gdams ngag zab mo ma zhus na/ /rjes nas bla ma su la zhu/ /de phyir rdo rje slob dpon ngas/ /lag gnyis thal mo snying gar sbyar//rab tu gus pas 'di skad zhu/ /ston pa thugs rje chen po yi/ /chos kyi gnad 'gag bden pa gnyis/ /yin zhes zer ba rna bas go /bden gnyis lta ba bsgom pa'i tshul/ /tshig nyung don 'dus go sla ba'i/ /zhal gdams brtse bas gnang du gsol/ /tshe rabs kun tu mgon khyod kyi/ /gsung gi bdud rtsis 'tsho bar smon/ /bden gnyis don la rab sbyangs nas/ /rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub par shog /ces phul ba'i lan du 'di skad ces smras so//tshul khrims ldan zhing dam tshig gtsang / /dben par zab mo'i sgrub la brtson/ /da lta byang chub sems gnyis 'byongs/ /sbas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' khyod/ /sngon nas bden gnyis thugs su chud/ /da lta tshogs gnyis gsog la brtson/ /mthar thug sgu gnyis mngon gyur nas/ /rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub par nges/ /da ni bshad la dgos pa chung / /'on kyang khyed la 858

gsal 'debs dang / /gzhan la phan thogs 'byung ba'i phyir/ /cung zad bshad kyis gus pas nyon//don dam bden pa'i lta ba ni/ /lung dang rigs pa du ma yis/ /yang dang yang du legs dpyad nas/ /phyi rol gzung ba'i yul rnams dang / /nang gi 'dzin pa'i sems gnyis po/ /stong ba yin nam ma yin blta/ /bltas pas rang bzhin ma rnyed tshe/ /chos kun ngo bo stong par blta/ /de ltar lta mkhan rig pa yang / /sngar ltar dpyad nas rang bzhin gyes/ /grub bam ma grub legs par blta/ /blta yul lta mkhan gnyis ka yang / /stong par phyam gyis song ba'i tshe/ /stong sangs ngo bo de nyid la/ /ma yengs blta la lta ba zer/ /da ltar ngo bor blta ba'i tshe/ /blta bya lta byed ma mchis kyang / /ci yin 'di yin med pa yi/ /lung ma bstan dang ma nor cig /phyi gsal nang gsal stong gsal gyi/ /mnyam bzhag nam mkha' lta bu yi//ngang la bzhag nas bsgom pa'i tshe//bsgom bya sgom byed ma mchis kyang / /ma yengs dran pas zin pa gces/ /bying rgod dbang du ma gtong zhig /yod med rtag chad 'gro 'ong dang / /gcig dang tha dad spros pa dang / /bral ba'i stong sangs zang thal gyi/ /gnas lugs ngo bo skyong ba'i tshe/ /spyad bya spyod byed ma mchis kyang / /bu chung bsam med ji bzhin du/ /bag med spyod 859

pa ma byed cig /lta ba'i 'dod 'byung nor bu la/ /sgom pas bye dor yang yang byas//spyod pa'i rgyal mtshan rtser mchod na//'bras bu chos sku'i dgos 'dod 'byung / /kun rdzob bden pa'i lta ba ni/ /lung dang rigs pa du ma yis/ /yang dang yang du legs dpyad na/ /snang srid 'khor 'das chos rnams kun/ /rgyu rkyen rten 'brel tshogs pa las/ /me long nang gi gzugs brnyan bzhin/ /thams cad 'gags med snang bar blta/ /de ltar snang ba'i dus skabs su/ /rang bzhin grub pa rdul tsam med/ /dper na nam mkha'i 'ja' tshon bzhin/ /snang zhing stong la stong zhing snang //snang stong gzigs mor lam lam blta//tshugs thub bden par ma blta zhig /dge ba byas pa'i rgyu rkyen gyis//'bras bu bde ba 'byung la blta/ /sdig pa byas pa'i rgyu rkyen gyes//'bras bu sdug bsngal 'byung bar blta/ /de ltar ma rtogs 'gro ba la/ /byams dang snying rje byang sems sgoms/ /sgyu ma mkhan gye sprul bsgyur ltar/ /mi dge spongs la dge ba sgrubs/ /sems can rnams kyi don gyis la/ /rgyal sras spyod pa rlabs chen spyod/ /de ltar legs par spyad gyur na//'bras bu gzugs sku 'byung bar 'gyur//zhes smras pas/ der 'tshogs pa rnams kyis drang don las rgyu 'bras kyi chos dang / nges don zab mo stong pa nyid kyi chos la yid ches 860

kyi nges shes drag po skyes nas/ lta ba mtho la spyod pa rtsing por ma shor bar lta spyod zung du 'brel ba'i byang chub sems dpa'i rnam thar lhur len pa mang po byung ngo / /de nas slob ma grwa btsun lnga brgya yon bdag pho mo stong phrag tsam 'dus pa'i tshe jong gi mon pa yan chad kyis dad pa byas chos la nyan pa byung / de rnams la sngon byon ston pa'i skyes rabs dang rnam thar lam rim blo sbyong / gangs sngags kyi dbang dang bskyed rdzogs kyi khrid/khyad par 'pho rlung gcod gsum/ phyag rdzogs do ha sogs mdo sngags zab rgyas chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po bskor ba'i mjug tu zhal gdams 'di yang byin no//ston pa sangs rgyas yid bzhin nor bu de/ /kun gyis spyi bor khur dang dgos 'dod 'byung //thos na ngan 'gror mi ltung chos kyi rnga / /byang chub lam rim yin pas yang yang nyon/ /'thungs na nyon mongs nad sel bdud rtsi mchog /theg chen blo sbyong yin pas ngoms med 'thungs/ /rnam dag dbang bzhi'i lha yi chu rgyun gyis/ /sgo gsum ma dag dri ma yang yang khrus/ /yon tan gzhi rten dam tshig gser gyi snod//nam yang gas chag skyon rnams med par gyis/ /bskyed rim gser bsgyur rtsi yis sgo gsum lcags/ /lha sngags ting 'dzin rin chen gser du sgyur/ /861

rdzogs rim gtum mo'i me yis phung khams gser/ /yang yang sbyangs la zung 'jug gser sku bzhengs/ /mdo sngags 'o ma'i mar gyi yang zhun de/ /phyag chen sman mar yin pas dgyes par rol/ /zab gsang mkha' 'gro'i snying gi thig pa de/ /myang na tshe gcig 'ja' lus 'od sku 'grub/ /lus kyi khang ba'i tshangs bug skar khung nas/ /sems kyi bya chung 'phur la gshog rtsal sbyongs/ /rgyun du rang sems stong gsal 'dzin med kyi//nyi mar ldes dang gtan du bde bar 'gyur/ /rnal 'byor snying gtam gser gye thig po 'dis//chos kyis dbul ba'i sdug bsngal sel bar shog /ces smras pas kun gyis rjes su yi rang byas/ rang rang gang mos kyi chos la nyams len byas pas rang don 'grub nas/ gzhan la yang chos rgyun de dag spel bas bstan pa dang 'gro ba mang bo la phan thogs pa'i slob ma bu chen mang po byung ngo / /de dus brag dmar bla ma grub chen ngag dbang lhun grub kyis gtso byas skra bcad nas rab byung bsnyen rdzogs sgrub mkhan gyi skyes pho mo brgya phrag mang po byung nas brag gi gseng rdo g.yam gyi srubs thams cad skras gang ba byung / de nas rong phyogs kyi slob ma yon bdag rnams la khyed rnams kyi yul phyogs kyi ri khrod dgon pa'i thag nye'i bya ri dwags rnams gzhan la gsod du ma 862

bcug na yul phyogs la bkra shis g.yang chags/ mi rnams tshe ring nad med bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan mang po bshad/ gsod mi nyan zhes yul so so la yi ge bskur bas thams cad kyis gang bshad pa ltar bya ri dwags rang gis mi gsod pa tsam du ma zad/ dmag mi ti liṅga dang rngon pa gzhan gyis kyang bsad mi chog bsad na rgyal po'i chad pa 'ong ba'i bka' shog gor+ṣa rgyal po la zhus nas blangs pas/ lo re la bya ri dwags brgya stong mang po gsod pa thams cad tshe thar ba byung / de dus slob ma grwa btsun rnams la 'bras kyi phogs brgyab/ skabs rer 'bras do bo bcu bco lnga re tsam zangs chen po mang por btsos nas/ tshogs brgya tshar mang po btang 'bras kyis mi brgyags pa tsam du ma zad/ khyi rnams kyang brgyags nas mi za ba byung / de dus rgad po rkang ba mi bde ba zhig gis/gzhas 'di 'dra gtong bar gda'/ bskal pa bzang song la/ /bstan pa dar song la/ /bstan pa dar ba'i dar lcog /pho brang rtse la btsugs yod/ /bstan pa byang nas byang du/ /dar ba'i rten 'brel 'grig byung / /bskal pa bzang song la/ /bstan pa dar song la/ /nam mkha' skar mas gang kyang / /nyi zla 'dra 'dra mi 'dug /nyi zla 'dra 'dra yod na/ /'dzam gling 'od kyis khongs 863

dang / /bskal pa bzang song la/ /bstan pa dar song la//sa gzhi mi yis gang kyang / /skyabs mgon 'dra 'dra mi 'dug /skyabs mgon 'dra 'dra yod na/ /rgyal khams bde la bkod dang / /gcig gnyis gsum byas nas/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa dar song gyis/ /bzhi lnga drug byas nas/ /'gro la bde skyid byung song la /zhes zhabs bro brgyab pas/ kun gyis kho'i ming la bskal pa bzang po zhes btags/ de bzhin du gnya' nang pa/ rong gi gnas skor ba tshong pa sogs kyis glu gar dang rol mo sna tshogs pa byas pas/ thams cad kyi sems spro ba byung / rjes su lo re bzhin gnas der las dang skal bar ldan pa'i gdul bya skal bzang pho mo mang po sprin bzhin 'dus pa'i tshe/ skabs re bka' chos 'chad pa'i thog mar/ bla ma dang chos kyi che ba 'byin pa'i phyir/ slob ma kun gyis ser phreng gtong ba'i dus/ dge slob rnams kyis chos gos snam sbyar gyon zhi ba dul ba byas/ gdugs rgyal mtshan ba dan du ma bsgrengs/ rgya gling rnga dung rol mo sna tshogs pa 'khrol ba byas/ de'i rjes su grub chen rnams kyis ral ba'i thor cog rigs mi 'dra ba brgyab/ phyag g.yas gcod kyi ḍā ma ru chen po 'khrol zhing / g.yon pas mi rkang gi gling bu 'bud cing / dga' ba'i gar stabs sna tshogs pa bsgyur ba byas/ de'i 864

rjes su rab byung ma rnams kyis rdo rje dril bu ting shags 'khrol ba/ de'i rjes su btsun ma skra lo can lag na spos dang me tog sna tshogs pa thogs pa byas/ lnga brgya re rim pa bzhin gral bsgrigs te/ mar gyi thang nas yar gye nga'i sdod gnas bdud 'dul phug gi bar du ser phreng btang bas mjug ma rdzogs par dgon pa'i mtha' la skor ba gsum bzhi byas nas bsdad/ nga'i sngun bsus te mar chos ra ru rim pas 'ong ba'i dus su/ der 'tshogs pa'i slob ma yon bdag thams cad la/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i gling zhig tu slebs pa lta bu'i dad gus dag snang dga' spro tshad las 'das pa byung / de deng sang skabs rer dran na nga/nga nyams dga' zhing dgod bro bar gda'/ dbyar kha mi mang po 'dzom pa'i skabs shig mchod rten zhig bzhengs snyam rdo len du bcug pas/ lan cig las 'gro ma dgos par rdo'i mchod rten chung chung zhig nyin gcig la 'grub pas thams cad ngo mtshar bar gyur to/ /de nas khyu mchog ces pa lcags mo sbrul gyi lo smin drug zla bar dad gtong blo gros che zhing bla mas ci gsung bka' bzhin bsgrub pa'i phyag mdzod skal bzang 'phrin las dang / bla ma sbyin pa nor bu/ grub dbang skal ldan rang grol/ phug brag mkhan po/ mda' pa bla ma sogs skal ldan gye 865

slob ma brgya phrag mang po snga phyi rim can byas/ bal yul mchod rten chen po bya rong kha shor la gser zangs kyis na bza' bsgron du 'gro ba'i skabs/ rgyal blon rnams la slar yang tshigs su bcad pa'i zhu shog 'di phul lo//thugs rje'i 'od kyis 'dzam gling yongs la khyab/ /phan bde'i drod kyis rgyal khams thams cad 'tsho/ /'jig rten khams na 'gran zla ma mchis pa'i/ /chos rgyal nyi ma gzhon nu'i zhabs drung du/ /rnam shes sbrang ma 'khor zhing chags pa'i rten/ /rang lus nyam chung pad+ma dkar po yi/ /sor bcu'i 'dab ma spyi bo'i ze'u 'bru'i ngos/ /phyogs nas ngo mtshar gtam gyi dri bsung spro/ /tshogs gnyis rin chen khams las legs 'khrungs pa'i/ /khyed sku g.yo med ri yi dbang bo mchog /bka' blon rgyal phran gser ri'i khrod na brjid/ /'khor 'bangs sde rigs rgya mtsho chen po yi/ /dbus na lhang nge lham mer bzhugs so zhes/ /snyan pa'i ba dan dkar po phyogs kun tu/ /g.yo ba sgra 'dzin dbang bor son pa'i mod/ /bdag sems rab dkar lha bu gzhon nu yang / /dga' dad zlos gar lan mang bsgyur dgos byung / /gus phran bdag gi sgyu lus pad+mo yang / /na 'chi grang reg ba mo'i dgra las rgyal/ /byams dang snying rje'i 'dab ma phyogs bcur rgyas/ /866

gzhan phan dri ngad 'thul bzhin bde bar mchis/ /rab dkar gangs ri dkar po'i rtse mo la/ /rab gsal nyi zla'i 'od zer phog pa na/ /dkar ba'i thog tu ches cher dkar ba bzhin/ /thugs sems dung las rab tu dkar ba yi//rgyal blon byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la/ /chos dang mthun pa'i gtam re zhus na yang / /sngar bas dge stobs gong 'phel 'gro snyam nas/ /byes pas pha mar bslab bya byed pa bzhin/ /blo chung bdag gis tshig 'ga' zhu ba la/ /dgongs tshom med par brtse bas gsan par 'tshal/ /da snga phan chad yul phyogs thams cad la/ /nad mug 'khrug rtsod med par bkra shis shing / /rgyal khams thams cad bde zhing skyid pa 'di/ /rgyal blon kun gyi bka' drin yin par 'khums//da dung chos rgyal chen po blon rnams kyis//'khor 'bangs sde rigs rgyal khams thams cad po/ /dper na ma yis bu bzhin legs bskyangs te/ /rgyal po khri yi thog nas sangs rgya ba'i//mdzad pa sngar bas lhag par mdzod cig ces//lag gnyis thal mo sbyar nas gsol ba 'debs//bya btang nor med sprang po bdag gis kyang / /yangs pa'i rgyal khams spyi dang khyad par du/ /bal bod gnyis kyi skye 'gro sems can la/ /bde skyid nyi ma gsar du 'char ba'i phyir/ /gnam lo da lo sbrul gyi lo nang du/ /867

mchod rten bya rung kha shor sku stod la/ /blta na rab mdzes gser zangs na bza' zhig /bsgon la rgyal po blon dang bcas pa yis//rogs ram gang dgos 'go 'dren gnang dgos zhes/ /sngar yang gsol ba btab pa de bzhin du/ /da dung yin yang thal sbyar gsol ba 'debs/ /bya btang nor med sprang po bdag gis kyang / /chos rgyal chen po bka' blon 'khor bcas kyi/ /sku khams nyi ma bzhin du dwangs pa dang / /sku bsod yar ngo'i zla ltar gong du 'phel/ /'khor 'bangs skar tshogs bzhin du ches cher rgyas/ /snyan grags g.yu 'brug bzhin du phyogs kun ldir/ /mnga' thang rgya yang nam mkha'i pha mtha' dang / /mnyam pa'i skyabs 'jug rtsa gsum lha la zhu//de bzhin 'grub pa'i bsngo smon yang dag bya//zhu yig dung mdog lha bya ngang pa yis//rab dkar lha rdzas dar gyi gshog pa brkyangs/ /bstod bsngags tshigs bcad dbyangs snyan sgrog bzhin du/ /chos rgyal bsod nams rgya mtsho'i drung du 'phur/ /de ltar legs par phul ba'i dge ba'i mthus/ /rgyal blon rnams kyis 'khor 'bangs yongs la byams /'khor 'bangs rnams kyis rgyal blon bkur ba dang / /kun kyang chos la spyod pa'i bkra shis shog /ces zhu rten rab dkar lha rdzas dang bcas te phul ba/ sngon gyi thugs bskyed smon lam gyi 868

mthu grub cing / dad brtson shes rab yangs pa'i rnam dpyod can gor+ṣa rgyal po'i mchod gnas bla ma skal bzang rgyal pos rgyal blon rnams la gang dgos rnams zhus/ ka shisnyim shing gar rnal la sogs pas grogs khyad par can mdzad nas bsgrubs pa'i tshe/ bod na bzhugs pa'i a 'ban gyi sems la dogs pa zhig skyes te/ 'jam dbyangs gong ma rin po che la gre tse phul ba'i nyin/ 'khyer mi de'i rta lha ldan rdzab dong du brgyab nas rta'i rkang ba bcag mi yi lag tshig bud/ gre tse sgam sa la brdabs nas chag pas/a 'ban rnam rtog zos/ gzhung gi sku drag rnams la bla ma zhabs dkar pa 'di mi ci 'dra zhig yin/ 'dis ci byed pa red/ gong ma rin po che la ma zhus na bka' bkyon 'dra mi 'byung ngam byas pas/ bod kyi rgyal blon rnams kyis bla ma zhabs dkar pa 'di chung nas bzung ste chos ma gtogs/'jig rten mi shes pa zhig red/ dbus 'dir 'ongs nas kyang nor rdzas yod tshad kyis mchod sbyin btang dge 'dun la bsnyen bkur zhus/ khyad par lha ldan bsam yas kyi jo bo gnyis la gser gyi mchod kong phul/ deng sang yang gong ma rin po che rgyal ba yab sras rnams kyi zhabs brtan dang / bstan 'gro'i bde thabs su dmigs nas smon lam btab tshad 'grub pa'i bal 869

yul mchod rten chen po bya rung kha shor gyi chos 'khor bcu gsum la rin chen gser zangs kyi na bza' phul nas phyed ka lhag tsam 'grub 'dug zer/ gong ma la dgongs bskor ma phul ba de khong rang chos pa yin pas gong ma'i lugs srol ma shes pa red ces smras pas/ a 'ban gyis bsams bsams nas/ gong ma rin po che la snyan sgron zhig 'bul dgos par gda'/ ma phul na rjes nas mtha' mi 'dis 'khrug pa 'dra bslang na bka' bkyon yong nyen yod byas pas/ de yin na thams cad gros mthun gye sgo nas 'bul zhes/ a 'ban dang bod kyi rgyal blon rnams gros byas nas/ bla ma zhabs dkar pa zer ba'i chos pa bzang po zhig gis/ gong ma'i zhabs brtan dang bstan 'gro'i bde thabs su dmigs nas bal yul mchod rten bya rung kha shor gyi chos 'khor la gser zangs kyi na bza' bsgon par 'dug ste/ sgon tu bcug chog gam mi chog ces phul bas/ de'i lan 'khor rag gi bar du slob ma yon bdag phal cher gyis gong ma rin po che'i bka' ci 'dra zhig phebs 'ong ngam snyam 'jigs lhang nge sdod dgos byung / rjes nas gong ma rin po ches/kho chos pa 'jig rten pa'i lugs mi shes pa'i stabs kyis dgongs bskor ma phul ba la bka' bkyon med/ chos 'khor 870

bcu gsum bsgrub tu ma bcug na/ mtha' mi dogs pa zos nas 'khrug pa slong nyen yod pas/ chos 'khor bcu gsum bsgrub tu chug de nas bod du 'ong ste chos ldan gye bya ba sgrub pa ma gtogs/ mtha' nas bsdad mi chog pa'i bka' phab pas thams cad dga' ba byung / de nas chos 'khor bcu gsum la gser zangs kyi na bza' bsgon tshar 'dug zer ba'i gtam snyan yang go bas/ bsngo ba smon lam brgya phrag byas nas rab tu dga' ba'i shugs kyis glu 'di blangs so//'gran gyis do med shākya'i rgyal po dang / /khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa/ /yab sras rgyud par bcas la gus phyag 'tshal//bstan 'gro'i don chen 'grub par byen gyis rlobs//zla med bla ma rnams kyi bka' drin la/ /brten nas rang blo bde tshul dbyangs su len/ /dang po mtshan ldan bla ma brgya phrag bsten/ /mdo rgyud man ngag gdams pa mang po thob/ /bar du ri khrod dben pa brgya phrag 'grims/ /gang shes nyams len byas nas rang rgyud btul/ /tha ma phyogs med rgyal khams brgya phrag nyul/ /lto gos chos gsum byin nas 'gro don byas/ /da res bstan 'gro yongs kyi bde thabs su/ /dmigs nas mchod rten chos 'khor gser gyes btums//rang gzhan bstan 'gro'i don 871

chen brgya phrag lhag /'grub pa'i bsngo ba smon lam yang dag byas/ /da ni shi yang dga' ste smon lam thebs/ /gson yang dga' ste bstan 'gro'i don chen 'grub/ /tshul 'di bsam na 'dun ma legs nas gda'/ /bka' drin che'o dngos brgyud bla ma rnams/ /da dung bdag gi skyid sdug o rang ma.o/ /byang chub ma thob bar du bdag skyongs shig /'di thos rnams kyis rjes su yi rang byas/ /de mthus bsod nams mnyam du 'thob par shog /ces blangs pas der 'tshogs pa kun dga' zhing spro bar gyur to/ /de nas mchod rten gyi rab gnas la song na ma song na snyam pa'i dgong mo zhig chos rgyal rin po che la gsol ba btab pas/ mtshan mo rmi lam du khong la mjal ba'i zhal nas/da lo rab gnas la ma song na dga'/ 'di ka nas rab gnas kyi dmigs pa byas na gcig yin gsung ba zhig rmis pas bal yul du ma song bar bsdad/ rjes su rab gnas kyi nyin mo mi khri tsho tsam zhig 'tshogs pa la tshogs kyi dga' ston rgya chen po btang / grub dbang skal ldan rang grol gyis der 'tshogs pa rnams la tshe dbang zhig gnang / gzhan bla ma sbyin pa nor bu dang phug brag mkhan po sogs dge ba'i bshes gnyen brgya phrag tsam zhig gis dngos su rab gnas mdzad/ de'i nyin ngas la phyi 872

gangs kyi ra ba nas rab gnas kyi dmigs pa byas me tog 'thor ba dang / slob ma yon bdag rnams kyi dad mos gnyis ka 'dzom pa'i rten 'brel gyis/ de'i nyin gang zag las snang dag pas nam mkha'i mthongs kun 'ja' sprin gyis gang ba'i klong nas bdag gis rab gnas dngos su mdzad pa mthong ba dang /der 'tshogs pa kun gyis nam mkha'i 'ja' sprin gyi klong na 'od kyi gong bu zhig mthong ba dang / bya rgod chen po zhig gis skor ba yang yang byas nas je mtho je mthor song ste mthar la phyi'i phyogs su 'gro ba mthong / de dus mchod rten la rab gnas kyi me tog dngos su babs pa phal cher gyis blangs nas dad rten du 'khyer skad/ de'i rgyu song la bla ma sbyin pa nor bu'i gser zho lnga brgya/ grub dbang skal ldan rang grol nas gser zho bzhi brgya/ sde pa rta go nas gser zho brgya dang brgyad/ de bzhin du sde pa rnam rgyal nas gser zho nyis brgya/ bsod nams dar rgyas kyi gser zho brgya dang lnga bcu/ gnas po nor bu'i gser zho brgyad cu/ gnag dpon bsod nams bza' mi gnyis kyi gser zho lnga bcu sogs gser srang stong phrag gcig lhag gi rtsis song / rgyas par dkar chag thar lam dkar po na gsal lo/873

ngo mtshar mkha' la nyi zla rnam gnyis dang / /sa la mchod rten chen pa rnam gnyis zhes/ /yongs su grags pa 'di gnyis las lhag pa'i/ /phyag dang mchod pa'i zhing mchog gzhan na gang / /sngon byon mkhas grub skyes chen mang po yis//mchod rten chen po 'phags pa shing kun la/ /rin chen gser gyi na bza' yang yang du/ /bsgron pa'i ngo mtshar lo rgyus mang po snang / /mchod rten chen po bya rung kha shor la/ /rin chen gser gyi na bza' bsgron nus kyang / /bdag cag ma 'ongs skal ldan gdul bya yis/ /bsod nams gsog pa'i phyir du bzhag gam snyam/ /bdag kyang snying stobs chung rung cher bskyed nas//sgrub tshe lha mi yongs kyis grogs mdzad pas/ /sngar med rin chen gser zangs na bza' grub/ /gzi brjid 'od zer phyogs brgyar 'phro la ltos/ /dkar po'i phyogs la dga' ba'i lha mi rnams/ /rab tu dga' ba'i rjes su yi rang mdzod/ /dga' ba'i gar gyis skyid pa'i bro chung 'khrob/ /snyan pa'i glu dbyangs len na da longs shig /bsags pa'i nor la snying po ma mchis kyang / /'di 'dra byas na snying po yod do zhes/ /gtam 'di lha mi yongs kyi snyan du 'bul//kun kyang dga' bas gcig nas gcig tu sgogs/ /chos 'khor ji bzhin bre dang bum pa la/ /rin chen gser gyi na 874

bza' sgon cig ces/ /phyi rabs chos mdzad skyes chin thams cad la/ /kha tsam min par snying nas gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag gis ma 'ongs skye ba gzhan dag tu/ /mchod rten yongs rdzogs rin chen gser gyes btums/ /steng du sangs rgyas stong dang rgyud sde bzhi'i/ /lha tshogs dpag tu med pas mtshan par smon/ /'dis mtshon dus gsum bsags pa'i dge tshogs kun//bstan dang 'gro ba yongs la phan phyir bsngo/ /de mthus sangs rgyas bstan pa dar zhing rgyas/ /sems can thams cad bde zhing skyid par shog /'jig rten khams 'dir nad mug 'khrug rtsod sogs/ /mi 'dod nyer 'tshe'i ming yang mi grags shing / /tshe ring nad med lo legs 'bru nor 'phel//bkra shis chen pos sa steng khyab gyur cig /ces smras so/ /gnas der 'gro phan chen po byung tshe/ rong gi mdze po mang pos nga'i snyan pa thos pas/ bdag po yod pa tshos khur nas nad la phan pa'i byin rlabs zhu ru 'ong ba gnas der nyi ma mang por sdod du bcug ngas kyang snying rje chen po'i sgo nas gangs chu la rigs gsum mgon po dang / khyung khra rdo rje go khrab rnams kyi sngags btab nas khog par 'thung du bcug lus kyi phyi rnams la khrus byas sman kyang byen nas klu nad pa mang po drag pa byung bas thams cad kyis bla ma khong sangs 875

rgyas dngos red byen rlabs chen po 'dug zer/ gzhan yang nad pa nad ma mang po 'ong ba re gnyis ma gtogs drag pa byung / de nas bzung rong gi yon bdag rnams kyi dad pa cher song / gang bshad pa'i chos kyi nang bzhin sdig spong dge sgrub la gzhol mkhan bsam gyes mi khyab pa byung / mgar ra ya slong ri dwags gsod mkhan byung tshad la gsol ras mang po byen/chos bshad nas ri dwags mi gsod pa'i dam bca' byas/ sha khye rnams bdag la phul bas skabs shig khye bcu bco lnga tsam zhig byung / mi la rmugs pa dang ri dwags gsod kyis dogs nas khyi rdzi re gnyis re bzhag rjes nas bod du khrid 'ong ste ri dwags mi gsod pa'i yon bdag rnams la byin no/ /gzhan yang khams pa mi gsod mkhan dang / rkus rgyag pa/ grwa btsun sdom pa shor ba/rong pa chang 'thungs nas skyur 'gong rgyag mkhan/ khyem tshang la mi byams par bza' bsdigs byed mkhan gyi rgan rgon sogs mi ngan pa'i rigs rnams/ gzhan la dris nas bshad pa dang /rang gis bltas nas shes pa sogs la/ a rog khyod kyis mi 'dra ma bsad dam/ khyod chang skyon can 'dra min nam zhes bshad pas/ gang bshad khrigs khrigs byung ba dang / yin lags zhes phyag 'tshal nas sngar byas la bshags pa rgyag pa dang / phyin chad 876

mi byed pa'i dam bca' byed mkhan mang du byung / yang rong pa'i rgan mo dad can zhig gis mar chen po zhig khyer 'ong ba la/rgan mo mar chen po khyer 'ongs pa bzang ste/ rgad pos che ba ma 'khyer chung ba khyer e zer byas pas/ mo rang gis mkhyen song 'dug snyam nas zer byung lags zhus pas thams cad bzhad gad thag ge ba zhig byung / yang rong gi yon bdag chang 'thung mkhan zhig gis chang 'thung rgyu khyer 'ongs nas lam kha zhig na sbas te yod pa la/ 'o yon bdag khyod 'ong ba lags/ khyod kyi lam chang gang na sbas yod bshad pas/ khos mkhyen song 'dug snyam nas/ da phyin chad chang chen po mi 'thung lags zer de bzhin du mnyam bzhag gi ngang nas sems la gang shar ba rnams thol byung du bshad pas dad can 'ga' res khong gis gzhan gyi skyon mtshang thams cad mkhyen nas thogs pa med par gsung snang / thugs brtags zhus na mi mkhyen gsung ba de/ ma mkhyen pa ma red ma gsungs pa red/ gsung rgyu yin na mngon shes thogs med mnga' bar 'dug ces dad gus dag snang byed mkhan mang po byung / rong gi dgon pa gsar ba byang chub me tog na 'dug pa'i slob ma dad can bsod nams snyan grags zer ba zhig gi lcags 'brug zla ba bcu ba'i tshes bcu gsum gyi 877

ོmtshan mo rmi lam la/ skyabs mgon zhabs dkar pa yin zer ba dbu ral gtsug tu bcings shing mdzod spu thal chen gyis byugs pa dgung lo nyi shu tsam zhig gi zhal gzigs nas mgur 'di gsungs so//rje dus gsum sangs rgyas 'dus pa'i sku/ /mgon mtshungs pa med pa pad+ma 'byung / /pha de dang dbyer med chos kyi rgyal/ /mi nga yi snying gi dbus su bzhugs/ /bu skal ldan dar cig tshur nyon dang / /dal 'byor gyi rten bzang thob par dka'/ /de yun ring mi rtag 'jig nges pas/ /da dam chos myur du bsgrub na dga'/ /lam rtsa ba'i bla ma dge ba'i bshes/ /de ma nor mtshan nyid ldan pa dgos/ /'di khe nyen che bas nan tan rtogs/ /mtshan ldan de'i rjes su 'jug par gyis/ /bka' mdo rgyud man ngag snying po'i don/ /chos dbu rdzogs phyag gsum gang yin yang / /rang gang mos shig la nyams len gyis//tshe 'di phyir bde skyid nyi ma 'char/ /zhes gsungs/ yang chu dgos na byang chub me tog gi g.yas kyi phyogs na sgrub chu yod ces gsungs pa ltar/nyin gcig btsal bas rnyed byung ba la kun dad cing ngo mtshar bar gyur skad/ gzhan yang rgya gar rdo rje gdan gyi nang pa rnams kyi kha gtam la/ nang pa sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che 'di/878

deng sang rgya gar na chen po med rung / bod na rgya chen po yod pa red/ cho 'phrul smon lam chen mo la dge 'dun khri phrag 'bum phrag mang po 'tshogs pa'i khrod na/ rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas pa'i padhi ta brgya phrag mang po dang / ri phug rnams na bya btang sgom chen pa mngon shes dang dzu 'phrul mnga' ba brgya stong mang po bzhugs pa'i nang nas/ rgya gar gyi grub thob gong ma zhig gi sku'i skye ba/ grub thob zhabs dkar pa zer ba zhabs gar bzhag pa'i yul de rnam dkar dge ba la 'god cing / ri khrod gzhan du phebs tshe ri brag rnams la yang thal byung du thogs pa med par bgrod nus shing / gar phebs sus mi tshor ba/ gzhan gyis nor bslangs na phyag tu sa rdo gang yin yang blangs te gser du bsgyur nas ster ba/ dad pa can gyis gsol ba btab na/dngos nyams rmi lam du yang zhal gzigs pa zhig yod pa de deng sang la phyi gangs kyi ra ba bya ba ru phebs yod pa red/ ci 'dra zhig yod dam/ blta ru 'gro mkhan yod na ang zhes gleng ba'i tshe/ de bden na khong tsho 'gro zhes a tsa ra gzhon pa bzhi nga yod sar 'ongs nas mjal ba'i tshe/ gser dngul 'dra byin pa mi len par de dgos pa min khyed kyi zhal blta ru 'ongs pa yin zhes nyi ma bzhi tsam zhig bsdad nas phyir song ste/ sku'i cha lugs 879

gsung gi 'byon lugs sogs 'di 'dra zhig 'dug ces rgyu mtshan rnams bshad pas/ dad can 'ga' zhig bod phyogs su kha bltas nas phyag kyang byas skad/ yang bal yul na rgya phi ling gi dpon po yod pa'i mdun du/ nga'i grwa btsun gnas skor du song ba 'ga' re'i lag nas dpon po des nga'i mgur ma yod pa rnams blangs te/ shes pa tshor 'don du bcug nas nyan pas/khong sangs rgyas shig yin par snang / 'di ltar chos gsungs na rgyal khrims la yang phan thogs par gda' zhes rgya phi ling gi skad du bsgyur nas yi ger bris te/ khong tsho'i rgyal mo phyi'i rgya mtsho'i gling na bzhugs pa la/ 'di 'dra'i gtam snyan 'dug ces ngo mtshar ba'i skyes su'ang phul bar gda'/ gzhan yang bal po dang mon pa'i mi dregs dang bu bu mo gzhon nu thams cad nyi ma bcu bco lnga'i lam nas mjal du 'ongs pa la lo tsā ba bzhag nas las rgyu 'bras kyi chos bshad pa'i tshe/ dad pa chen po byas zhabs spyi bor blangs mig nas mchi ma gtong bzhin smon lam btab nas log 'gro ba mang po byung / mon pa 'bras khur nas 'tshong du 'ong ba la las/ lam nas pe cag pa zer ba'i 'bu mang po bsad nas za ba rnams la sems can gzhan gsod mi nyan/ shi na dmyal bar 'gro yong ma gsod ces chos 880

bshad pas mi gsod pa byung / khyed rnams skyid par 'dod na 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs la gsol ba thob dang mi nor zas gsum 'dzoms nas skyid po 'ong / gsol ba ji ltar 'debs na/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ zhes 'di ltar gsol ba 'debs dgos zhes ma ṇi bslabs nas/ rjes su yar tshong la 'ong dus 'ga' res ma ṇi pad dbyangs blangs nas 'ong ba byung / de nas lo gsum yang song tshar/ mchod rten bya rung kha shor la yang gser zangs kyi zhabs tog legs par 'grub tshe sems spro/gangs can bod yul yang dran nas 'gro 'dod pa'i shugs kyis skyid pa'i rgyang glu 'di blangs so//mtshan ldan bla ma yi nor bu/ /spyi bo'i gtsug rgyan du bzhugs shig /bya btang rnal 'byor ngas de ring / /skyid pa'i rgyang glu zhig len no/ /lho rgyal 'dzam gling gi rgyan gcig /phyag dang mchod pa yi zhing mchog /ngo mtshar mchod rten ni chen po//bya rung kha shor ni yin snang / /bstan 'gro'i bde thabs su dmigs nas/ /chos 'khor bcu gsum ni yongs rdzogs/ /rin chen gser zangs kyi na bzas/ /g.yogs nas ser po ru btang tshar/ /gnas chen gsum po yi nang nas/ /la phyi 'di ka rang ngo mtshar//nyams dga' mkha' 'gro yi do ra/ /rjes su 'jog pa la 881

phangs kyang / /rnal byor dpon slob kyi tshogs rnams//lha chos mi chos kun 'dzom sa//rgyal ba yab sras kyi bzhugs gnas//dbus gtsang dag zhing du chas 'gro/ /lha ldan bsam yas tshor mjal ba'i/ /skal ldan las can 'dra yod na/ /yul nas ma sdod par shog dang / /nga dang lhan du rang chas 'gro/ /'jig rten mi chos rnams spangs nas/ /dam pa'i lha chos kyi phyir du/ /dbus gtsang dag zhing du 'gro ba'i/ /rnal 'byor dpon slob tsho'i skyid pa/ /skyid pa'i rgyang glu rang len bzhin/ /skyid dga' longs spyod kun 'dzom pa'i//skyid po bod yul gyi dbus su//skyid chos byed pa la chas 'gro /de 'dra'i skyid glu de 'then mkhan/ /tshogs drug rang grol kho yin snang / /glu 'di thos tshad kyi mi la//nam yang skyid po rang shog shog /ces pa la sogs pa'i mgur dbyangs len bzhin rje mi la'i sgrub gnas brag dmar mchong lung dang / spo mtho nam mkha' rdzong / skyid phug nyi ma rdzong rnams la gnas 'brel bzhag brag dmar mchong lung du nyi ma gcig la mi mang pos mtshams khang lnga brgyab/ nang du mtshams pa kha shas bzhagaspo mtho na bzhugs pa'i brag dmar bla ma mchog nas dpon slob kun la zhabs tog legs po byas/ de nas shel phug chu shing rdzong du song nas gnas 'brel bzhag 'o zangs dgon pas 882

zhabs tog yag po byas/ 'du khang steng du gser zangs kyi gañji ra zhig bzhag spro sde rdzong du song sde pa bkra shis bde ldan pa yab sras gnyis kyis zhabs tog yag po byas/ chu dbar dgon du song / rje btsun rin po che'i sku pur thal las bzhengs pa'i rje btsun mthong ba don ldan la mjal mchod 'bul rgya chen bo byas/ der bzhugs pa'i sa thob kyi byang chub sems dpa' yongs 'dzin parnyi ta'i thugs sras chu dbar mkhan rin po che yon tan lhun grub la mjal/ mdun nas blo sbyong bdud rtsi snying po'i khrid/ gcod nam mkha' sgo 'byed dang / thig le bcu drug gi dbang / dge ldan phyag chen gyi lung rnams zhag po bco lnga'i bar du zhus/ mjug tu khong gi zhabs brtan du dmigs nas/sku gsung thugs rten gyis thog drangs gser dngul la sogs pa'i 'bul ba btegs/ tshur la yang gsol ras mang po gnang byung / de nas phyir 'khor gnas chen la phyi ru 'ong / dgon pa gzhung gi bla ma 'phrin las dang mtsho gsham bla ma/ yon bdag rdor skyabs pa/ sangs rgyas la sogs pa'i rong gi slob ma yon bdag rnams kyis nga dbus su 'gro khar tshogs mchod rgya chen po phul/ sku gsung thugs rten gyis gtso byas brgya 'bul mang po byas/ rgya gar du 'gro ba'i khams pa tshong ba mang pos shel gyi 883

bum pa gaṅgā'i chus bkang ba mang po dang / shel gyi mar me'i 'od khang chen po/ li sde pa go'i bla mas khri snyan sa le'i pags pa rwa dang bcas pa phul/ bdag gis mtsho gsham dgon pa la gser zangs kyi gañji ra zhig phul/ gzhan yon bdag rnams la byin rten dbu skra na bza' byen tshe 'di phyir phan pa'i chos bshad kha ta rgyas par byas pa'i mthar/ rong phyogs kyi bla ma dpon po rgan rgon bu dang mna' ma dad can thams cad la phan pa'i zhal gdams 'di byin no//dngos brgyud bla ma rnams la 'dud/ /chos bzhin nus par byin gyis rlobs/ /rong gi dad can thams cad la/ /phan pa'i snying gtam bshad kyis nyon/ /bla mas chang 'thung skyur 'gong brgyab/ /chu de 'go nas ma rnyogs par/ /grwa btsun dang ba 'dren pa'i phyir/ /chos bzhin tshad ldan tshul mthun gyis/ /grwa btsun rnams kyis chang 'thungs nas//spyod ngan chal chol ma byed par//bla ma'i bka' bzhin sdom pa srungs/ /'grig lam kun spyod yag po gyis//dpon pos mi ser thams cad la//don med chad pa ma rgyag par/ /btsan po'i gnya' gnon snyoms chung gi /gzengs bstod thams cad byams pas skyongs/ /rgan rgon 'dod pa cher song nas/ /don med lab lob ma mang bar/ /kha la gang byung lto 884

zo la/ /kha rog sdod la ma ṇi bgrongs/ /khyim tshang nang mi thams cad kyis/ /tshig ngan 'thab mo ma rgyag par/ /gong mas 'og mar gang byams gyes/ /'og mas gong gi kha la nyon/ /bu dang mna' mas rgan rgon la//lan slog sdang po ma byed par//gang yod zas byin gos skon la/ /sos dal bde bar nyal du chug /g.yog po g.yog mor lto mi ster//sdug las mang po ma gtong bar//rang gi bu ltar lto gos byen//skabs rer ngal gsos sdod du chug /sgo na yod pa'i khyi rgan yang / /'khyags dang ltogs su ma 'jug par/ /nangs nub lto blud dro sar zhog /mi zas za dus kham re byin//'o ma 'dren mkhan mdzo mo'i bu/ /dgra ltar ngan gsod ma byed par//snying rjes 'o ma'i phyed ka byen//nam yang rtol bu ma gsod ang / /rang yul bya dang ri dwags rnams/ /rang gis gsod pa phar la zhog /gzhan la'ang gsod du ma 'jug par/ /tshe thar gyis dang yul lha mnyes/ /khyem mtshes g.yas g.yon su la yang / /don med 'khon 'dzing ma byed par/ /skyid sdug gang gi dus su yang / /gcig gis gcig la phan thogs gyis//mi ngan re res skyo ma bcug /yul mi phan tshun ma dkrugs par/ /sngon chad 'khon pa'ang 'grigs su bcug /phyin chad thams cad mthun po gyes//'chi ba nam yong nges pa med//phyug po ser sna ma che bar lo re 885

bzhin du yul phyogs kyi/ /mi la dge rtsa ston mo thongs/ /dga' ston gtong dus thams cad kyis/ /tshig ngan rdung res ma rgyag par/ /bde skyid lha dang 'gran pa'i phyir//glu longs skyid pa'i bro chung 'khrob/ /tshe 'dir bde rung yud tsam yin/ /phyi mar nam 'gro cha med soms/ /don med sdig pa ma gsog par/ /phyi mar phan pa'i lha chos rem/ /rong gi bla ma dpon po dang / /dad can grwa btsun sbyin bdag rnams//nga yis mi brjed sems la 'jog /khyed rnams rgyun du dad gus gyis//da ni tshe 'dir mjal dka' yang / /da dung mjal ba'i smon lam 'debs/ /tshe 'dir dngos su ma mjal na//phyi ma'i yul la mjal bar shog /ces smras pas thos tshad kyi rigs la blo bskyed byung nas sdig la 'dzem zhing dge la brtson pa mang po byung / chos byas pa'i lag rjes su yul phyogs la lo legs dang bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa byung ngo / /yang yon bdag rgan po bre srang tshe ring / dbu mdzad rgya bo la sogs pa la phyi ba rnams kyis gnas chen der sdod ring la zho dar dang mar sogs kyis zhabs tog byas/ 'gro khar phyug po rnams kyis tshogs rgya chen po btang / brgya 'bul byas/ med po rnams kyis kyang rang rang la yod tshod kyis 'brel ba bzhag nas/skyabs mgon rin po ches sngar yang nged la phyi ba rnams la 886

bka' drin che/da dung yang bdag cag rnams kyi mgon du lo re gnyis bzhugs dgos/ gal te mi bzhugs kyang bdag cag rnams la khyed bzhugs pa dang khyad med pa'i zhal gdams zab mo zhig gnang dgos zhes zhus pa'i lan du phan pa'i kha ta rgyas par byas pa'i mthar zhal gdams 'di yang byen no//dngos brgyud bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /ci bsam chos bzhin 'grub par byen gyis rlobs/ /'di phyi gnyis gar phan pa'i gtam zhig bshad//kun gyis yid la zungs shig la phyi ba/ /grwa pa rnams kyis dam tshig sdom pa srungs/ /chang dang bud med spongs shig la phyi ba//mi skya rnams kyis ya rabs bya ba gyis//don med skyur 'gong ma rgyag la phyi ba/ /mo rang ma rnams snyoms chung sdod shes gyis/ /gzhan gyis brnyas bcos ma byed la phyi ba/ /tshong pa byung dus mgo skor ma gtong bar/ /tshong de drang bor rgyob cig la phyi ba/ /gnas skor pa la mjal ka yag po thongs /za 'dod ltogs la ma che la phyi ba/ /mar me 'bul dus gtsang ma gyes la phul//mar khu kha la ma rgyag la phyi ba//sdug rtsa thug kyang sku gsung thugs kyi rten//brkus nas gzhan la ma btsong la phyi ba/ /lto gos med kyang mchod rten nang 'jug bton/ /sku 'dra'i na bza' ma bshu la phyi ba/ /gcig gis gcig la skyo ma 'jug res 887

byas/ /chad pa 'gel res ma byed la phyi ba/ /'go na 'dug pas chang 'thung rdung res brgyab//chu de 'go nas ma rnyogs la phyi ba/ /kha rog bsdad na kha mchu yong don med/ /don med lkog lab ma rgyag la phyi ba/ /dag pa mkha' spyod 'dra ba'i gnas nang nas/ /mdzo mo'i rtol bu ma gsod la phyi ba/ /gnas chen 'di yi bya dang ri dwags rnams//gzhan la gsod du ma 'jug la phyi ba/ /bdud 'dul phug gi ri ngos ljon shing rnams/ /nam yang sus kyang ma gcod la phyi ba/ /rgan rgon skyug bro rnams kyi ro bsregs nas//lha kun mnol du ma 'jug la phyi ba/ /gnas 'di'i lha khang rnams la lo re bzhin/ /nyams gsos thug tshags rem zhig la phyi ba/ /gnas 'dir bzhugs pa'i mtshams pa grwa btsun la/ /mthun rkyen gang thub sbyor cig la phyi ba/ /de ltar byed mkhan thams cad bde zhing skyid//skyid thabs de'i lhag med do la phyi ba//nga ni mi sdod thag ring yul la 'gro/ /khyed rnams de ltar mdzod cig la phyi ba//tshe 'dir mjal ba skad cig yud tsam gda'//phyi mar mjal nas 'bral med 'grogs par smon/ /gtam 'dis la phyi'i mi la phan thogs shing / /gnas 'dir bkra shis g.yang kun 'khyil bar shog /ces byen tshe kun la gsal 'debs su song nas rjes sor ma rabs kyi spyod ngan thams cad bor te/888

ya rabs kyi bya ba byed mkhan mang po byung bas thams cad kyang bsod nams cher song nas bde zhing skyid par gyur to/ /gzhan yang dad can brin pa'i yon bdag pho mo rnams dang / mtsho gsham pa dang / gnya' nang bkra shis sgang gi yon bdag drin can rnams la phan pa'i chos bshad dang kha ta mang po byas nas gyes khar snying gtam 'di dbyangs su blangs so//rje bka' drin gsum ldan bla ma dang / /lha yi dam zhi khro'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /mi 'dir 'tshogs sgo gsum byen gyis rlobs/ /mchog thun mong dngos grub char bzhin snyil/ /dus da res mi lus thob pa 'di/ /dpe lam gyi bzhi mdor slebs pa 'dra/ /kun yar 'gro mar 'gro'i sa mtshams yin/ /lam 'gro sa ma nor yon bdag tsho//rang skyes nas lo grangs ga tsam song mi rgan gzhon ci tsam shi 'dug ltos//da rang yang sang gnangs mi 'chi ba'i//gdeng gang yang med tshul yang yang soms//dgra 'chi bdag dmag dpung slebs pa'i tshe/ /tshe 'di ru zhag gcig sdod dbang med/ /bu bu mo zas nor 'khyer dbang med//tshe 'di nas phyi mar gcig pur 'gro/ /chos byas tshad mtho ris gnas su 'gro/ /sdig byas tshad ngan song gnas su ltung / /don de phyir mi dge'i sdig la 'dzem/ /chos byed na mang po shes mi dgos/ /yar 889

rtsa ba'i bla ma dkon mchog mchod//bar dge 'dun sde la bsnyen bkur gyis//mar dbul por sbyin pa yang yang thongs//dus rgyun du phyag skor kha ton rem//yul brin dang mtsho gsham gnya' nang pa'i/ /mi snyoms chung sems dkar chos dad che//mi ngas kyang la phyir sdod ring la/ /kun 'ong tshe blo kha chos la bsgyur/ /chos byed mkhan pho mo mang po byung / /de bsam na skal ba bzang ngo snyam//nged yon mchod brtse gdung che ru song / /zhag mang por lhan du bsdad pa lags//da 'gro khar 'bral glags mi phod rung / /mig mchi ma gtong bzhin 'bral dgos byung / /kun 'di bzhin brtse gdung ma 'gyur na/ /nga thag ring yul du song na yang / /dngos nyams dang rmi lam gnas skabs su/ /dus da dung mjal lo dad can tsho/ /phal che bas da nas mi mjal yang / /tshe phyi mar mjal ba'i smon lam 'debs/ /ngas 'gro khar smras pa'i snying gtam 'di/ /khyed kun gyis ma brjed sems la zhog /mi nga yang gang du song na yang //khyed kun kyang sems la bzhag nas 'gro/ /gtam de skad smras pa thos tshad kyis/ /chos thams cad mi rtag tshul bsams nas/ /blo rang bzhin shugs kyis chos la 'gyur/ /las sdig spong dge la 'bad gyur cig /ces blangs pas dad can phal che ba'i mig nas mchi ma mang po gtong zhing srog 890

gcod spong ba dang / ma ṇi bgrang ba la sogs pa'i khas len dang / la las rgyan cha btags pa yang bcad nas phul te/skyabs 'jug bsngo smon zhu ba dang / 'ga' res phyag 'tshal zhing skye ba nas tshe rabs thams cad du mjal ba'i smon lam btab nas phal che ba rang rang gi yul du song ngo / /de nas 'gro kha ngo mar slebs tshe drang srong 'phags pa'i bste gnas/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i do ra/ dkar phyogs lha rnams 'du ba'i skyed tshal/ rtogs pa'i chos 'khor bskor ba'i lte ba/ thub bstan rgyal mtshan tshugs pa'i khang bzang / bka' brgyud gong ma bzhugs pa'i sgrub gnas/ sgrub brgyud bstan pa ches cher dar sa/ bsam gtan ngang gis 'phel ba'i dben gnas/ ngo mtshar 'ja' 'od 'khyil ba'i zhing khams/ dag pa mkha' spyod dngos dang mtshungs pa'i gnas chen 'brog la phyi gangs kyi ra ba'i bla ma lha dang ḍāk+ki chos skyong dkar phyogs la mngon par dga' ba'i tshe ring mched lnga sogs yul lha gzhi bdag rnams la dngos su 'byor ba dang yid kyis sprul pa'i tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po phul/ der 'tshogs pa'i slob ma rnams la lto gos sogs lam chas nyer mkho rnams byin/ la phyi'i yon bdag rnams la gsol ras dang bdag rkyen yang byas/ der 'tshogs 891

pa rnams tshogs kyi dga' ston la longs spyod pa'i tshe/ slob ma yon bdag rnams la phan pa'i kha ta 'di ltar byas so/ /'o skol rnams pha yul skyes sa mi gcig kyang sngon gye las dang smon lam gyi dbang gis sus kyang ma bos bzhin du phyogs phyogs nas gnas chen khyad par can 'di ru tshogs te/ lo gsum gyi bar du chos dang zang zing gi 'brel ba zab mo bzhag nas/ da ni mi kun so sor gyes nas phyin chad gnas 'dir mi yong ba bzhin du/ chos thams cad 'di'i rang bzhin can yin/ khyad par 'chi ba mi rtag pa byung nas tshe phyi ma'i yul la yang 'di bzhin du 'gro bas/ da phyin chad khyed rnams gang du song yang drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams ma brjed par dran par gyis la gsol ba thobs/ log lta ma byed/ dam gtsang rdo rje mched lcam rnams ma brjed par dran par gyis la brtse gdung gyis/ lkog lab ma rgyag 'chi ba mi rtag pa ma brjed par dran par gyis la tshe blos thongs/ zas nor gyi gsog 'jog ma byed/ dag snang ma brjed par dran par gyes la chos lugs gzhan la dad gus gyis/ khas ma gtong / snying rje ma brjed par dran par gyis la sprang po su mthong yang ci phan gyis/ gnod pa ma byed/ sems khred ma brjed par dran par gyis la dus rgyun du skyongs/ de ltar ma 892

rtogs pa la legs par ston la nga rgyal ma byed/ bsngo ba ma brjed par dran par gyis la dge ba gang byas kyi mjug tu bsngo smon gyis/ rlom sems ma byed/ de ltar mdzod dang gar song gi yul la bkra shis shing gang bsam gyi don thams cad chos bzhin 'grub nas tshe 'di phyi gnyis ka la bde skyid kyi nyi ma nang nas 'char ba'i dus shig 'ong gi 'di nas kyang nged dpon slob yon mchod 'brel ba thogs tshad thams cad la tshe 'dir mi nor zas gsum 'dzom/ bde skyid snyan gsum byung / skyid pa'i sgo nas dam pa'i chos byed pa'i skal ba dang ldan zhing da dung bkra shis chos mthun gye sgo nas zhal yang yang mjal ba dang / nam zhig 'chi ba'i tshe yang bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha mkha' 'gro chos skyong ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa rnams mngon sum du byon nas lam sna drangs te/ dag pa mkha' spyod mngon par dga' ba bde ba can la sogs pa rang rang gang 'dod pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams rnams su bgrod pa'i skal ba yod pa dang / skye ba 'di yi 'og rol tu nged thams cad dag pa'i zhing khams nyams dga' ba zhig tu mngon sum du mjal te/ kun kyang 'bral ba med par 'grogs nas dga' spro'i gleng mo sna tshogs pa byed bzhin du/ thogs pa med pa'i rdzu 'phrul la brten 893

nas/ dag dang ma dag zhing khams bye ba phrag rab 'byams 'grims nas/ sangs rgyas thams cad mchod cing sems can thams cad 'dren pa'i skyabs 'jug rtsa gsum lha la zhu zhing / de de bzhin du 'grub pa'i bsngo ba dang smon lam gyi mtshams sbyor phun sum tshogs pa sngar yang byas te/ da dung yang bya zhes bsngo smon rgya chen po byas pa'i mthar/ da ni dper na bkra shis kyi me tog gtor ba bzhin dpon slob kun so sor 'thor song na/phyin chad sa kha thag ring pos bar chod/ skye 'chi gnyis la khrigs khrigs med pas e mjal mi shes/ da res go re kyi li 'tshogs pa'i dus 'dir da dung yud tsam sdod rgyu byung na dga' ba la snyam/ sems 'phreng drags pa'i shugs kyis mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so//bla ma dkon mchog gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag gzhan don gnyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /yar mar nas 'ong slob bu yon bdag rnams/ /tshong 'dus mgron po bzhin du yud tsam 'tshogs/ /da ni so sor gyes nas 'gro dus 'dir/ /phan tshun gcig gis gcig la sems 'phreng yang / /mthun par 'grogs nas so sor gyes pa de/ /'jig rten 'khor ba'i chos nyid yin pas na/ /sems ni 'phreng bar gyur kyang bya thabs 894

med/ /skal ldan bu slob dad ldan sbyin bdag kyang / /deng nas bzung ste tshe rabs thams cad du/ /byams pa'i sems kyis nam yang ngas mi brjed/ /da ni khyed rnams rang rang gnas su phebs//'chi ba nam 'ong mi shes chos la 'bungs/ /tshe 'dir da dung mjal ba'i smon lam 'debs/ /sa yang kha thag ring pos bar chod nas/ /tshe 'dir dngos su mjal bar ma gyur na/ /phyi mar dag pa'i zhing nas mjal bar shog /dpon slob thams cad gang du song na yang / /gang bsam don rnams yid bzhin 'grub par shog /ces blangs nas sems skyo bo rang yod tshe/ /dam gtsang rdo rje slob dpon dang ye shes dbang phyug sogs gnas der sdod mkhan rnams kyis/ nga yang 'gro khar slebs mched lcam gzhan rnams kyang phyogs phyogs su 'gro ba'i grabs byed pa mthong tshe/ sems 'phreng zhing skyo ba tshad las 'das pa yang yang byung nas kun gyes gdungs dbyangs 'di phul lo//ngo mtshar rje btsun rin po che/ /mgon khyod sngon nas sangs rgyas kyang / /snyegs dus 'gro ba 'dren pa'i phyir/ /tha mal mi yi gzugs su shar/ /dang por mtshan ldan bla ma bsten/ /bar du dben par nyams su blangs/ /tha mar phyogs med 'gro don mdzad//khyed kyi rnam thar ngo mtshar che//phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas 895

byang sems dang / /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams/ /khyed kyi bstan pa spel grogs su/ /gnas chen 'di ru sprin ltar 'du//nam mkha' 'ja' dang 'od kyis gang / /'og min lta bu'i zhing khams 'dir/ /skal bzang gdul bya las can rnams/ /su yis ma bsdus bzhin du 'dus/ /mgon khyod seng ge'i khri la bzhugs/ /'dir 'tshogs khrom gyi lha mi la/ /zab rgyas chos kyi 'khor lo ni/ /lo gsum bar du skor dus su/ /rdo rje 'chang dang mjal zin pas/ /'og min zhing du phyin na yang / /mjal rgyu 'dis lhag med do snyam//dga' spro tshad las 'das pa byung //da ni bla ma rdo rje 'chang //'gro ba gzhan gye don la chas/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro lta bu yi/ /mched grogs rnams kyang gyes nas 'gro /la la mnga' ris phyogs su 'gro /la la dbus gtsang zhing du 'gro /la la mdo khams smad du 'gro /la la rong gi yul la 'gro /bdag dang bdag 'dra'i lo lon rnams/ /thag ring gnas su bgrod mi nus//mched grogs thams cad 'thor tsa na//yang yang mjal rgyu mi yong snyam/ /bsam tshe skyo shas snying rlung ldang / /mig nas mchi ma yang yang shor/ /'jig rten phyi ma'i yul la yang /las kyi dbang gis so sor 'gro /mjal lam mi mjal mi shes snyam/ /bsam tshe skyo ba yang yang skyes//'dus pa'i tha ma 'bral ba 896

de/ /'jig rten 'khor ba'i chos nyid du//'dug pas skyo yang bya thabs med/ /e ma bla ma rin po che/ /'gro ba'i don du bde bar phebs/ /rgyal khams gang du phebs na yang / /bdag cag thugs nas ma 'dor cig /dam gtsang rdo rje mched lcam rnams/ /rang rang gnas su bde bar phebs/ /sa phyogs gang du song na yang / /dben par sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan tshugs//tshe 'dir bla ma mched grogs la/ /mjal ba'i kho thag chod na yang / /phyi mar bla ma'i thugs rje yis/ /dag pa'i zhing du mjal bar shog /ces phul ba'i tshe/ der 'tshogs pa phal cher gyis mchi ma mang po btang / de'i dus bdag gis 'gro mkhan gye slob ma rnams la bkra shis mnga' gsol gyi mgur 'di 'then no//bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang / /chos skyong srung ma dkar phyogs lha/ /nam mkhar 'ja' 'od klong du bzhugs/ /bkra shis dbyangs snyan sgrog par mdzod/ /dngos dang brgyud pa'i bla ma la/ /smin grol byin rlabs bkra shis yod/ /bkra shis des kyang bkra shis shog /bu slob yongs la bkra shis shog /yi dam zhi khro'i lha tshogs la/ /mchog thun dngos grub bkra shis yod/ /bkra shis des kyang bkra shis shog /bu slob yongs la bkra shis shog /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong la/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi'i bkra 897

shis yod/ /bkra shis des kyang bkra shis shog /bu slob yongs la bkra shis shog /nga rang zhabs dkar bla ma la/ /zab rgyas chos kyi bkra shis yod/ /bkra shis des kyang bkra shis shog /bu slob rnams la bkra shis shog /'dir bzhugs chos mdzad mched lcam la/ /dad pa dam tshig bkra shis yod/ /bkra shis des kyang bkra shis shog /bu slob rnams la bkra shis shog /'dir 'tshogs dkar phyogs lha mi la/ /chos kyi mthun rkyen bkra shis yod/ /bkra shis des kyang bkra shis shog /bu slob rnams la bkra shis shog /'gro mkhan slob ma thams cad la/ /bkra shis g.yang kun chags nas yod/ /bkra shis des kyang bkra shis shog /rgyal khams yongs la bkra shis shog /ces bkra shis kyi me tog phyogs kun tu 'thor ro/ /de nas nga yang chas nas yong tshe la phyi'i yon bdag dang der bzhugs pa'i bu slob skyel ma byed pa rnams la mgul dar g.yogs nas/ phyir log dus sems skyo ba'i shugs kyis yang dbyangs chung 'di blangs so//rtsa ba'i bla ma bka' drin can/ /snying gi dbus nas yar byon la/ /spyi gtsug bde chen rgya mthongs khar/ /bzhugs nas thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /'dir 'tshogs blo sna chos la sgyur/ /chos min blo sna 'gag tu gsol/ /da dung bkra shis chos 898

mthun sgos//yang yang mjal bar byin gyis rlobs/ /rnal 'byor dpon slob 'khor bcas kun/ /pha yul skye sa mi gcig kyang / /sngon gyi las bzang smon lam mthus/ /da lta gnas chen 'di ru 'tshogs/ /lo gsum bar du lhan cig bsdad/ /chos dang 'jig rten zas nor gyis/ /'brel ba bzhag nas thams cad po/ /tshong 'dus mgron po bzhin du gyes/ /mig gis bltas na mi mthong zhing / /skad kyis bos na mi thos pa'i/ /thag ring yul la 'gro ba ltar/ /phyi ma'i yul la'ang 'di ltar 'gro /sa yang kha thag ring pos bar/ /chod tshe bla ma mched grogs kun/ /snga sor gnas chen 'di nyid du/ /thams cad 'tshogs tshul yid la shar/ /de bzhin da lta yod na snyam/ /dran nas ngu ba'i dus kyang 'ong / /de dus bla ma dran bzhin du/ /gsol ba yang dang yang du thobs/ /mched grogs rnams kyang dran bzhin du/ /mchi ma yang dang yang du thongs/ /dngos sam nyams dang rmi lam la/ /bla ma grogs dang mjal bar nges/ /rnal 'byor dpon slob 'khor bcas kun/ /'di dang phyi ma bar do ru//mjal na 'dod pa'i dus skabs su/ /yang yang mngon sum mjal bar shog /yul phyogs kun tu bkra shis shing / /mi nad phyugs nad zhi ba dang / /tshi ring nad med lo phyugs legs/ /thams cad skyid pa'i bkra shis shog /ces 899

blangs pa'i tshe/ dpon slob kun gyis gcig sems gcig la 'phreng zhing / skyo shas tshad med pa skyes nas mchi ma yang yang gtong zhing phyi mig kyang mang po yang nas yang du lta bzhin yar mar so sor gyes te mi rtag pa'i rnam 'gyur bstan nas song ngo / /de la brten nas phal che bas mi rtag pa dran drags nas nyi ma re gnyis la lto yang cher mi dran par skabs skabs su mig nas mchi ma shor ba byung zhing / de'i rjes su thams cad kyis phyogs phyogs kyi ri khrod na chos bzhin byed pa'i gtam snyan mang po thos tshe dga' mgu yi rang bar gyur to//smras pa/ rnam mang mdo sngags chos 'khor bskor mdzad pa'i/ /rnam mkhyen sangs rgyas spyi bo'i rgyan du bzhugs/ /rnam pa kun tu gus pas gsol ba 'debs/ /rnam dag lha chos nus par byen gyis rlobs/ /bla ma'i rnam thar lan re bton na yang / /dad pa med la dad pa skye ba'i phyir/ /la phyi'i gnas su sgrub pa byas pa'i tshul/ /slar yang glu ru len gyis dga' bas nyon/ /de nas dpon slob thams cad tshur la 'ongs/ /be rtse 'dod yon rdzong nas zhag gcig bsdad/ /phyi nyin lam du bod yul chos rgyal mchog /gshegs pa tshor nas gdungs pa'i smre sngags blangs/ /'phel rgyas gling gi dgon pa'i mkhan por 900

mjal/ /bkra shis sgang brgyud la phyi'i gangs la song / /de lo sbas par bsdad nas sgrub pa byas/ /nyin gcig 'ja' tshon sna lnga'i lam chen nas/ /tshe ring mched lnga 'khor bcas zhal gzigs byung / /de dus lan cig rgya gar rdo rje gdan//mjal du song na snyam pa yid la shar/ /mkha' 'gro stag gi gdong can zhal bstan nas/ /rdo rje'i gdan na sngon bzhin bstan pa med/ /song la dgos pa chung zhing bar chad che/ /de bas gnas 'dir bstan 'gro'i don sgrubs dang / /g.yel med grogs mdzad gsungs pa'i nyams snang shar/ /de bzhin mtshan mo 'gro don 'byung ba yi/ /rmi lam legs po zhig kyang rmis pa byung / /rjes ma'i lo la thang nas chos khri brtsigs/ /bdud 'dul phug gi gnas sgo gsar du phyes/ /gnas der bsdad nas skal bzang las 'phro can/ /'ongs pa rnams la chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /lha khang rnying ba nyams gsos gsar ba bzhengs/ /dge 'dun sde btsugs thugs mthun khrims gtsang byas/ /dgon bdag rgyal ba 'bri gung yab sras la/ /rgyu mtshan zhus pas thugs dgyes bdag rkyen byung / /slob ma bu chung rnams kyis dri ba dang / /dris lan tshul du zhal gdams mgur dbyangs blangs/ /byang chub sems kyi gdams pa kun gye mchog /sngon med rgyal sras sprul 901

pa'i glegs bam brtsams/ /skabs shig mi sna mang po tshogs pa la/ /bltas na rgyal sa zhig la slebs pa 'dra/ /kun gyis snyan pa'i glu blangs bro 'khrab pas/ /ngo mtshar dga' spro'i nyi ma gsar du shar/ /dge slong grub chen rab byung btsun ma'i rigs/ /gzhon nu mang pos mchod rdzas sna tshogs thogs/ /ser phreng btang tshe dpa' bo mkha' 'gro yi/ /gling du slebs pa lta bu'i nyams yang byung / /bu chen mang po bal yul mthil du btang / /mchod rten bya rung kha shor chos 'khor la/ /rin chen gser gyi na bza' bsgron du bcug /bstan 'gro yongs la phan pa'i smon lam btab/ /'o zangs mtsho gsham la phyi'i 'du khang gi /steng du'ang gser gyi gañji ra re btsugs/ /gnas der nad pa yod tshad drag pa dang / /byen rlabs che ba'i sangs rgyas dngos red zer/ /sdig can mi yi skyon mtshang bton pa dang / /mngon shes thogs med 'dug zer dad pa skyes/ /mon pa mgar ba ya slong yan chad la/ /sdig rgyun bcad nas ma ṇi 'don du bcug /rong gi ri khrod dben pa'i thag nye nas/ /bya dang ri dwags gsod sa med par byas/ /rgya gar bal yul phi ling tshun chad la/ /grub chen zhabs dkar pa zhes grags pa'ang byung / /sar gnas byang sems chu dbar mkhan por mjal/ /gcod dbang blo sbyong dge 902

ldan phyag chen zhus/ /rong dang la phyi'i slob ma yon bdag la/ /chos bshad mgur blangs smon lam bkra shis brjod/ /yong khar thams cad nga la sems 'phreng zhing / /ngas kyang khong tshor snying rje 'bral ma phod/ /mi yi skye 'chi 'di la nges pa med/ /sa yang kha thag ring pos bar chod nas/ /phyin chad mjal lam mi mjal mi shes snyam/ /kun kyang sems skyo mig nas mchi ma shor/ /mtsho gsham bu dang bu mo 'ga' zhig gis/ /nga yi rjes su 'gro rgyu yin zer nas/ /yar la brgyugs nas la sked bar du yong / /de yi rjes su pha spun rnams kyang 'ongs/ /nga ni lo gsum 'phro nas la phyi 'dir/ /'ong bas phyir la song zhes 'khrid du bcug /ma song sa der bsdad nas mang po ngus/ /ngus pa'i tha mar so sor gyes nas song / /deng sang de yi nang nas gcig tsam la'ang /lan cig 'phrad rgyu byung na dga' ba la/ /'phrad pa phar zhog gnas tshul gsal po zhig /go rgyu med pa 'di 'dra'i dus kyang byung / /mdor na la phyi'i gnas nas sgrub la 'bungs/ /bya rung kha shor chos 'khor gser gyis bskrun/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi rnam thar de ltar lags/ /rjes 'jug rnams kyang de bzhin skyong bar mdzod/ /glu 'di thos tshad skye bo pho mo yis/ /tshe rabs kun tu bla ma'i rnam thar bzhin/ /sgrub la gzhol bzhin mchod rten 903
naspyi

dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing du tshur la 'ongs nas phyogs med 'gro don byas tshul/bcu bzhi pa dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing du tshur la 'ongs nas phyogs med 'gro don byas tshul ni/ sna tshogs zhes pa chu pho rta'i lo khrums zla'i tshes bzang por nged dpon slob mang po dang bcas te/ gnya' nang grod pa phug gi dgon pa 'phel rgyas gling du 'ong / mkhan rin po che dang dge 'dun pa rnams la mjal/ dgon pa'i 'du khang gi steng du gser zangs kyi rgyal mtshan 'khor lo ri dwags pho mo dang bcas pa btsugs/ nang du dngul srang brgya lhag gi dngul kong bzhag 'gyed mang ja btang nas zhabs tog byas/ de nas gnya' nang tshong 'dus su song nas bal bod kun la tshe dbang bskur chos bshad pas/bal bo'i tshong ba mang pos lo re bzhin ra lug bya pho sogs sems can sum brgya res lha la dmar mchod rgyag pa bcad nas dkar mchod du bsgyur/ bshan pa phal cher gyis srog mi gcod pa'i dam bca' phul/ dngul rdo tshad bcu gcig gis lug stong phrag gcig gi srog blu byas/ de'i lo rong du lug 'ded 905

rgyu med pa byung /lug rnams dgon pa 'phel rgyas gling gi 'brog tu tshe thar byas nas bzhag bal rnams dge 'dun pa'i mthun rkyen gdan sogs byas/ dngul rdo tshad dgu yis bod nas snam phrug ther ma sogs grwa chas nyos te/ grwa btsun gos med pa rnams la byin/ de nas yar yong las shing sgrol ma gsung 'byon la mjal/ mchod 'bul byas smon lam btab/ du lung 'ba' ro sogs gnya' nang stod kyi phyug po rnams kyis ra lug mi gsod pa'i dam bca' phul/ sems can stong phrag mang po'i srog skyob byas/ gnya' nang stod smad bar gsum gye blo kha chos la bsgyur te yul khams chos kyis dkar por btang nas/ zur tsho nas lung du song / yon bdag rnams la tshe dbang bskur chos bshad pas/yon bdag rnams kyis 'bul ba mang po phul ba la bsngo ba smon lam byas/ grub thob gtsang smyon pa'i sgrub gnas la mjal/gnas 'brel bzhag de nas sde gzhung brgyud nas ding ri glang bskor du song / pha dam pa'i bzhugs nas der re zhig gi bar du mtshams byas nas bsdad/ pha dam pa'i zhi byed kyi gdams pa po ti chen po bzhi bzhugs pa klog pas/ khong gi byen rlabs kyis sems la phan po byung /de nas zhing ri dang /ding ri'i gzhung gi yon bdag zhe dkar byang pa/ shar lung tshe ring la sogs pa'i 906

yon bdag rnams la chos 'khor bskor bas yon bdag phyug po kha shas kyis lo re bzhin lug nyis brgya sum brgya re gsod pa rnams kyis/ phyin chad nyi shu sum cu re las lhag mi gsod pa'i dam bca' phul/ nyi shu sum cu re gsod pa rnams kyis gnyis gsum re las lhag mi gsod pa dang /re gnyis gsod pa rnams kyis kyang gtan nas mi gsod pa sha nyo rgyu byas/ sdig rgyun phal cher bcad nas lug brgya stong mang po'i tshe thar ba byung / de nas ding ri sgang dkar la song /tsong ye dang mda' dpon lcang lo can gnyis kyis bsu ba byas nang du song / zhag shas bsdad de zhabs brtan rim gro byas/ rgya zas zhim po mang po byin/ rgya mi'i rtsed mo khrang zhi 'khrab dga' dga' spro spro byas/ nyin gcig 'dabs kyi spang gzhongs nas/ mi stong phrag mang po la tshe dbang bsgur chos bshad pas yul la bkra shis po byung / de'i rjes su mda' dpon lcang lo can bsam gling du 'ong / zhabs tog bzang po byas/ ngas khong la sems 'khrid byas gzhan yang chos mang po bshad pas/ de nas bzung khong gi blo kha chos la 'gyur chos ldan gyi bya ba mang po sgrub par gda' zer/ de nas gnas chen rgyal gye shrī 'am/ yongs grags rtsib ri'i bsam gling du 'ongs nas thog mar gnas la bstod pa'i mgur dbyangs 'di 907

blangs so// lha zhi khro rab 'byams 'dus pa'i bdag /rje rgyal ba kun las bka' drin can/ /pha chos rgyal ngag gi dbang po la/ /bus gsol ba 'debs so byen gyis rlobs/ /rje dam pa gong mas bsngags pa'i gnas/ /gnas ngo mtshar rgyal gyi shrī yi//phyi ri brag rnams kyi kha dog dbyibs/ /lha bde gshegs rigs lnga rigs gsum dang / /dpal 'phags pa'i gnas brtan bcu drug sogs/ /sku yig 'bru phyag mtshan la sogs pa'i//ya mtshan pa'i gzugs su snang ba mtshar/ /phyogs mtshams na ri phran mang po yang / /bkra shis pa'i rtags brgyad la sogs pa'i/ /lha'i mchod rdzas sna tshogs tshul du snang / /mtha' kun nas mtsho dang dzing bu sogs/ /dpe yon chab bshams pa las kyang mdzes/ /spyir skye 'gro dad can thams cad kyis/ /phyogs gang nas bltas kyang yid du 'ong / /sgos chos mdzad dam pa'i gzigs snang la/ /gnas mkha' spyod dag pa'i zhing dang mtshungs/ /sngon rgya gar dam pa sangs rgyas dang / /bod gangs can mi la yab sras dang / /rje rgyal ba rgod tshang yang dgon sogs/ /khong rgya bod mkhas grub mang po yis/ /tshe gcig la grub pa thob pa'i sa /dpal bde mchog 'khor lo la sogs pa'i/ /lha zhi khro rab 908

'byams pho brang mchog /gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dang //lha chos skyong dkar phyogs 'du ba'i zhing //gnas 'di yi rtsa gsum lha tshogs la/ /yid gus pas gsol ba 'debs nus na/ /rkyen bar chad sel zhing dngos grub stsol/ /gnas 'di yi yon tan brjod mi lang / /rje bka' brgyud gong ma'i rnam thar bzhin/ /sprang bdag kyang gnas chen 'di 'dra nas/ /chos tshul bzhin bsgrub pa'i smon lam 'debs/ /gzhan phyi rabs gang zag las can rnams/ /tshe 'di yi bya ba blos thongs la/ /gnas 'di ru bzhugs la sgom sgrub mdzod/ /nyams rtogs pa'i yon tan 'char bar nges//gnas 'di ru bzhugs pa'i sgom chen la//khyed yon bdag rnams kyang mthun rkyen sbyor/ /chos bsgrub pa'i mthun rkyen sbyor tshad kun/ /sangs mnyam por rgya ba'i skal ba yod/ /gzhan skal ldan las 'phro can gyi mis/ /gnas 'di la phyag skor mchod 'bul gyis/ /phyag skor ba mchod pa sus phul kyang / /rten mi lus thob pa don ldan 'gyur/ /gnas 'di la bstod pa'i dge ba'i mthus/ /chos bshad sgrub bstan pa dar ba dang / /yul 'di ru lo legs bkra shis shing / /bkra shis pas bod khams khyab gyur cig /ces blangs/ de nas gnas der snga phyi rim pa byas nas tshe blos btang gi grwa btsun stong phrag 'dus/909

yon bdag pho mo stong phrag mang po mjal du byung / sde pa rnam rgyal gyis gser dngul rdo tshad mang po dang / dngul srang lnga bcu re tsam gyi mchod kong gnyis/ tshong dpon bsod nams dar rgyas kyis gser zho nyi shu dngul srang mang po dang / skyid grong khams pa tshe brtan gyis go ṭaṃ brgya re'i rin thang can gyi shel gyi gong bu chen po nang stong ba phyogs thams cad sgrib med du gsal ba'i mar me'i 'od khang gnyis dang rgyang shel gcig chu bo gaṅgā'i chus bkang ba'i bum pa/ sde pa sras kyis dngul rdo tshad bdun tsam gyi rtsis kyi nor rdzas dang rgyan gos/ ko thang gnas po'i bu mos chos byas pa'i mgo rgyan dngul srang drug cu ri ba zhig dang / gzhan yang dad can grwa btsun yon bdag pho mo nyin re bzhin du lus gos dang rgyan cha 'bul mkhan mang po byung / khyad par ja mar dang rtsam pa khal mang po byas 'bul mkhan byung ba rnams kyis khang ba'i nang bkang ba/ khyem gyis bcus nas mtshams pa de dag rnams la phogs brgyab/ ja mar kyang mi bcu bco lnga la ja sgam mar do byas phogs brgyab pas 'ga' res lhag pa byung nas btsong rgyu yang byung skad/ thag ring gi gnas skor ba byung tshad lto gos chos gsum gyi sgo nas bskyangs/ skabs skabs rtsam pa do po bcu bco lnga nyi shu sum cu 910

tsam re badzis nas gyig tse brgyab/ ri rab bang rim ltar brtsigs/ mtha' bskor du sha chang shing thog sogs zas sna mang po bzhag nas tshogs 'khor rgya chen po bskor te/ khyim pa pho mo der 'tshogs pa rnams kyis glu blangs bro 'khrab cing bde skyid lha dang 'gran pa byas/ bsam gling byams chen lha khang nyams gso byas/ steng du gser gyi 'khor lo btsugs/ byams pa'i drung du mar khu'i rgya mtsho la sdong bu lag ngar tsam btsugs nas nyin mtshan med par sbar bas/ lha ldan jo bo'i drung du slebs pa bzhin nang kun dro ba byung / de thams cad kyi rgyu song la dngul rdo tshad bco lnga'i rtsis song / gzhan yang phyag mdzod dang grwa pa mang po song nas ding ri'i glang bskor gyi mchod rten la nyams gso btang de la dngul rdo tshad gcig gi rtsis song / gnas der lo gcig lhag tsam song nas stod phyogs kyi slob ma mang nang bla ma sogs thag ring gi slob ma rnams rang rang gi yul la 'gro khar thams cad la phan pa'i snying gtam mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so//gnas spyi gtsug 'ja' gur 'khyil ba'i dbus/ /gdan seng ges btegs pa'i khri steng na/ /rje rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang / /mtshan brjod par dka' ba'i drin po che/ /pha chos rgyal 911

ngag gi dbang po bzhugs/ /bus mos gus gdung bas gsol ba 'debs//khrom 'dir 'tshogs snang ba chos la sgyur//blo chos min snang ba 'gag tu gsol//nged 'dir 'tshogs skyes sa mi gcig kyang / /sngon las bzang smon lam dag pa'i mthus//dus da res gnas chen 'di ru 'tshogs/ /chos zang zing 'brel ba yang yang bzhag /da mi sdod so sor gyes pa ltar/ /chos thams cad mi rtag 'di dang 'dra/ /dus de ring nyi ma phar bzung nas/ /phar mig gis bltas na mi mthong zhing / /gtam snyan pos bos kyang mi thos pa'i/ /yul so so'i gnas su song tsa na/ /sa kha thag ring pos bar chod nas/ /dus da lta'i 'di bzhin mjal bar dka'/ /tshe phyi mar mjal bar smon na yang / /las bzang ngan mang po bsags pa'i mthus/ /kun mjal lam mi mjal mi shes snyam/ /ngas bsam zhing skyo ba nang nas skyes/ /nged 'dir 'tshogs khrom gyi lha mi rnams/ /sems dga' bzhin 'tshogs pa da res tsam/ /kun go re kyi le 'tshogs dus 'dir/ /nga'i phan pa'i snying gtam 'di la nyon//chung ma las skyes nas da bar la/ /gzhan rgan gzhon mang po shi tshul soms/ /dus deng sang yin yang ngo shes kyi/ /mi mang po shi ba rnams la ltos//rang nam 'chi cha med yang yang soms/ /tshe 'di ru sdod mkhan gcig kyang 912

med/ /tshe phyi mar phan pa chos min med/ /nor bsags nas ma 'jog mchod sbyin thongs/ /chos chen po byed rgyu ma byung kyang / /sdig srog gcod ma byed bshags sdom rem/ /nang zhe sdang gdug pa'i bsam sbyor spongs/ /byams snying rje byang chub sems mchog sbyongs/ /mdo tril gyis dril ba'i snying po la/ /chos byas nas mtho ris mi 'gro yang //sdig khur nas dmyal bar ma 'gro zhig /'di do gal che bas sems la zhog /da khyed rnams sku khams bde bar bzhud/ /kun tshe ring nad med smon lam 'debs/ /nged dpon slob rnams kyang mi sdod par/ /gzhan phyogs med ri khrod 'grim du 'gro/ /dus da dung mjal na 'dod pa'i dus/ /kun yang dang yang du mjal bar smon//sa kha thag ring bas ma mjal na//tshe phyi ma'i yul nas mjal bar shog /'di mthong thos snang ba chos la 'gyur/ /chos byed mis sa steng khyab gyur cig /ces blangs pas nyin re bzhin slob ma brgya phrag mang po song bas chos thams cad mi rtag pa 'di'i rang bzhin las ma 'das snyam sems skyo ba byung / der 'tshogs pa kun kyang skyo bzhin so sor gyes nas song ngo / /de'i rjes su nged dpon slob myo/nga pos gzhi btegs te/ gnas chen rgyal gyi shrī la g.yas skor byas/ dgon pa rnams la 'gyed mang ja btang / dgung lo brgya bzhes pa'i ne'u ring bla 913

ma rin po che la tshe dbang zhus/ gser la sogs pa'i 'bul ba btegs mthar bskor lam na yod pa'i yon bdag rnams la chos bshad pas/ yon bdag phyug po re gnyis kyis lo re bzhin lug bzhi brgya lnga brgya re bsad nas rang gi nang mis zos/gzhan la dpyid ka btsongs pa rnams/ phyin chad bzhi bcu lnga bcu las lhag mi gsod pa'i dam bca' byas/ gzhan lug gsod pa phal che bas sha nyos nas za ba ma gtogs/ rang gi nang nas lug mi gsod pa'i khas len byed mkhan mang po byung /sdig rgyun bcad/ dge rgyun spel nas thams cad kyi blo kha chos la bsgyur/ de nas shel dkar chos sde ru song / rang gi zhon pa'i rta sga stan srab gsum bcas spyi thog tu phul/ gser zangs kyi 'khor lo zhig lha khang gi stang du btsugs/ mang ja dang 'gyed btang / khong rnams kyi thugs mnyes pa byung / nang nas grwa pa phyug po dad can 'ga' res nang du bos nas song dngul srang mang po phul te chos 'brel kyang zhus/ de nas gzhung de'i sde pa rnams brgyud nas mtsho sgo dang drang so ru 'ongs/ sde pa mtsho sgo'i lcam dang / sde pa bkras sde'i ru dpon sogs yon bdag pho mo mang po la tshe dbang bskur chos bshad mgur dbyangs blangs nas thams cad kyi snang ba chos la bsgyur bas/ srog gcod spong 914

ba dang / dge ba sgrub mkhan mang po byung / phyogs de'i phyug po dad can rnams kyis lus gos rgyan cha gser dngul mang po dang khyad par du nas mang po 'bul mkhan byung ba rnams kyi nang nas/ drang so'i dgon pa zung dkar chos sde la 'gyed mang ja btang / bde chen phug tu sdod pa'i mtshams pa rnams la nas kyi phogs brgyab/ de nas yon bdag phyug po zhu lung mgon po dang yul de'i sde pa rnams la dbang bskur chos bshad pas/gser dngul gos dar lus kyi rgyan cha zas nor longs spyod 'bul mkhan mang po byung / de nas bsam pa bzang zhing lha chos la dga' ba'i dad can sbyin bdag phyug po phu dmar bar tsho'i nang du song chos bshad dbang bskur bkra shis brjod pas/khong tshang gis lo re la lug lnga brgya re gsod pa spangs nas/ lo re la lug lnga bcu las lhag mi gsod pa'i dam bca' phul/ ja mar rtsam pa gang 'dod dang / gser dngul g.yu byer spos shel sogs lus kyi rgyan cha yang mang po phul/ de ru dgon byang bla ma rin po che gdan drangs/ byang gter rig 'dzin gdung sgrub/thugs rje chen po gur drag gsum gyi dbang zhus/ gser g.yu gos dar sogs kyi 'bul ba btegs/ yon bdag pho mo rnams la 'gro khar phan pa'i bslab bya 'di ltar byas so//915

gtan gyi skyabs mgon bla ma rje/ /spyi gtsug bde chen rgyan du bzhugs/ /bdag dang slob ma sbyin bdag la/ /thugs rjes gzigs la byen gyis rlobs/ /rigs rus bsod nams dpal gyi mtho//dad gtong blo gros che ba yi//sbyin bdag phu dmar bar tsho la/ /phan pa'i snying gtam bshad kyis nyon//mi lus rin chen thob dus 'dir/ /lha chos myur du ma byas na/ /snyigs dus tshe la nges pa med/ /do nub yin yang 'chi nyen gda'//phyi mar dge ba can gyi mi/ /mtho ris thar pa'i gnas su 'gro/ /mi dge sdig pa byas pa'i mi//ngan song gsum gyi gnas su 'gro/ /da lta gang la 'gro ba'i dbang / /rang gi lag na yod dus 'dir//mar 'gro mi dge'i sdig pa spangs/ /yar 'gro'i dge la 'bad re ran/ /mi dge sdig pa'i che shos ni/ /srog gcod yin pas dug bzhin spongs/ /rang gi nor la ser sna dang / /gzhan gyi nor la ham pa che/ /don med khong khro ldang ba dang / /phrag dog 'gran sems ma byed cig /sngar byas sdig la 'gyod bshags dang //phyin chad mi byed bshags sdom gyis//rnam dkar dge ba'i che shos ni//mchod sbyin yin pas rgyun du thongs/ /bran g.yog rnams la gang byams dang / /khyem mtshes rnams la gang phan mdzod/ /sgo yi khyi dang phyugs la yang / /brdeg brdung ma byed gso skyong rem//sngar byas 916

dge la dga' ba sgoms//phyin chad byed pa'i blo rgya skyed/ /gzhan yang phyag dang kha ton gyis/ /rang sems stong gsal ngang la zhog /ma gyur 'gro la snying rje sgoms/ /bsngo ba smon lam rgya chen thobs/ /lha chos byed na mang mi dgos/ /snying gtam de tshos chog pa yin//de ltar byas pa'i bsod nams kyis/ /tshe rabs kun tu bde bar shog /ces smras pas thams cad rab tu gus pas phyag 'tshal/ dus yang yang mjal ba'i smon lam btab bo/ /de nas dpal ldan sa skya'i chos sde chen por 'ong / rje btsun ma bgres mo dang / khri kun dga' rgyal mtshan dang / dngos grub dpal 'bar rnams la mjal/ zangs kyi dung chen cha gcig sbub chol rgya gling sogs mchod rdzas dang gser dngul g.yu byer sogs nor rdzas phul nas/ tshe dbang phur pa gur drag rnams kyi dbang zhus/ sngar sprul pa'i lha khang chen mo'i nang du phyag mdzod sde pa dbang bo la 'jog tu bcug pa'i gser kong nang du mar me sbar nas smon lam chen po btab/ gzhan gyi lha khang rnams la yang mchod 'bul byas/ dge 'dun sde la mang ja dang 'gyed btang / zhag po bco lnga bsdad phyag dang skor ba byas/ mdos chen gye ltad mo la bltas/ de nas byang gi lha rtse'i phyogs su song sde pa gzhi chen rta nag pa'i nang du song zhag gnyis bsdad/ tshe 917

dbang zhig bskur/ ja mar rtsam pa dngul bcas zas nor mang po phul/ de nas rgyang gi yon po lung du song / zla ba gnyis gsum tsam bsdad pas/ byang lha rtse'i yon bdag brgya stong mang po byung / de rnams la snga phyi rim pa byas/ tshe dbang bskur chos bshad pas thams cad kyi blo kha chos la 'gyur/ 'bul ba mang po byung / der sdod dus mdo smad phyogs nas bla ma pad+ma rang grol dpon g.yog mang po 'ongs/ rgya dngul srang brgyas 'go byas nor sna mang po phul/ tshe dbang zhus pas/ ma cig grub rgyal ma'i lugs kyi tshe dbang bsgur/ sku tshe ring ba'i rten 'brel bsgrigs/khong la phan pa'i bslab bya 'di byas so//bla ma mchog gsum yi dam lha/ /mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams la 'dud/ /rnal 'byor dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi/ /ci bsam 'grub pa'i dngos grub stsol//dad brtson shes rab snying rje can//bu chen pad+ma rang grol dang / /dad can sman pa gnyer ba sogs// skal ldan snying gi slob bu rnams//byang lam brgyud nas 'ong ba'i dus/ /bla ma mchog gsum thugs rje yis/ /kun la nyes skyon ma byung bar/ /dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing du slebs/ /jo shāka rnam gnyis bsam yas dang / /bkra shis lhun por mjal bzhin du/ /phyogs 'dir 'ong ba thos pas spro/ /mi rgan nga yang ma shi bar/ /918

gangs ri bal yul la phyi sogs/ /dben gnas rgyal khams mang po bskor/ /da lta dbus gtsang phyogs 'dir slebs/ /kun gyis dus grwa bsgrigs pa bzhin//sngon gyi las bzang smon lam mthus//slob dpon chen po'i sgrub gnas mchog /rgyang gi yon po lung nas mjal/ /thams cad bkra shis chos mthun sgos/ /mjal tshe dga' zhing spro ba skyes/ /e ma skal ldan slob bu rnams/ /dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing 'di na/ /blta rgyu mjal rgyu mang po snang / /mar la song nas ci zhig bya/ /da ni lo re lo phyed la/ /bsdad na skal ba shin tu bzang / /bag phebs gleng mo zhib tu byed/ /phan pa'i snying gtam rim pas bya/ /'on kyang bla ma'i zhabs tog dang / /mdo smad bstan 'gro'i don bsgrub phyir/ /da lo mar la 'gro na yang / /thams cad lam nas 'grig po gyes/ /rnal 'byor dpon slob 'khor bcas kun/ /'dus nas so sor gyes pa ltar/ /chos rnams mi rtag 'di dang 'dra//de la soms la lha chos mdzod/ /snying ma/sa lha chos byed 'dod na/ /'jig rten chos brgyad blo yis thongs/ /sdom pa dam tshig gtsang ma gyis/ /bla ma'i bka' bzhin sgrub la brtson/ /sgrub pa mdzad pa'i dpon slob rnams/ /da dung tshe mjug 'di nyid la/ /mjal na 'dod pa'i dus skabs su//da lta'i 'di bzhin mjal bar shog /snyigs dus 919

tshe la nges pa med/ /sa yang kha thag ring pos bar/ /chod nas tshe 'dir ma mjal na/ /phyi ma'i yul nas mjal bar shog /ces smras pas khong gis mdo smad na bstan 'gro'i don yod pas mar 'gro dgos tshul gyi rgyu mtshan phul bas/ ngas kyang gnang ba byin/ de dus rtsa ba'i bla ma chos rgyal ngag gi dbang bo'i sras wang bkra shis 'byung gnas mchog la/ pha mes gong ma'i lugs srol bzang po'i nang ltar dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing du lan cig mjal du phebs zhes zhu shog 'di phul lo//sangs rgyas bstan pa'i sbyin bdag mchog /sog po'i rgyal po ching wang zhes//snyan grags dbyar gyi 'brug bzhin du//phyogs kun ldir ba'i zhabs drung du/ /sngon gyi las bzang smon lam gyis//'brel ba'i tshogs drug rang grol ngas//thag ring rgyang nas brtse gdung gi /shugs kyis bskyod nas 'di skad zhu/ /chos rgyal yab yum zhing brjes kyang / /skyes mchog khyed kyis rgyal sa bzung //rgyal khams bde la 'god pa'i gtam//thos pas dga' spro dpag med byung / /bdag kyang chos rgyal bka' drin gyes/ /dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing khams na//lus dang sems la sdug bsngal med/ /dga' zhing spro bzhin bde bar mchis/ /'on kyang chos rgyal yab yum gnyis//dag pa'i zhing du gshegs la skyo//tshe 920

thung nam 'chi cha med pas/ /khyed kyang lha chos mdzad re ran/ /bsod nams can gyi rgyal po khyed/ /sngon gyi pha mes lugs srol ltar/ /dge ba stobs chen bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing 'dir phebs/ /gzhon pa'i dus 'dir ma phebs na/ /rgas dus 'gyod pa skyes nas 'ong / /da lta sku na gzhon dus 'dir//myur du phebs dang skal ba bzang //sngon tshe yum mchog a bī de/ /dbus su phebs tshe 'bul chen btegs/ /mang 'gyed tshad med mdzad pa'i tshe/ /snyan pas sa steng khyab pa byung / /de'i sras skyes mchog khyed nyid kyang //dbus su byon nas 'bul chen btegs/ /mang ja 'gyed rnams de bzhin du//gtong dgos snyam pa thugs la chongs/ /sngon dus chos rgyal yab yum gnyis/ /dbus su 'byon pa'i dus skabs su/ /'gal rkyen bar chad ma byung bar/ /thugs kyi bzhed don 'grub pa ltar/ /khyed kyang de yi rten 'brel gyes/ /dbus su byon pa'i dus skabs su/ /'gal rkyen bar chad mi 'byung bar/ /mthun rkyen bsam don 'grub par nges/ /mi rgan bdag gis snga sor yang / /khyed la zhabs brtan gang shes phul/ /da dung yin yang yang dag bya/ /myur du mjal ba'i smon lam 'debs//de ltar smras pa thos tshad kyis/ /yul la bkra shis g.yang chags shing / /mi la tshe ring nad med 921

par/ /bsam don chos bzhin 'grub par shog /ces 'tshams rtags su gos dang gser gyi ṭaṃ ka g.yu byer sogs rin po che sna tshogs pa'i phreng ba bcas phul lo/ /de nas bla ma pad+ma rang grol phebs kha ru/ sku gsung thugs rten dang rgya gar nas byung ba'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga rten gsum na bza' byen can mang po/ dngul ṭaṃ rdo tshad gcig g.yu bye ru rin po che du mas rdzongs pa byas yang yang mjal ba'i smon lam btab nas phebs so/ /de dus tshong dpon bsod nams dar rgyas kyis gser srang mang po phul ba ma blangs par khong rang la phyir byen nas/ khyod kyis 'di la snon pa gyes la ri bo bkra bzang gi rtse mo'i lha khang gi gu ru gsung 'byon gye drung du/ gser kong zhig phul zhes bskul bas/ der khos gser srang nyi shu'i gser kong bzang po mar me rgyun sbar gyi sbyor 'jags dang bcas te phul ba la bsngo smon gyi rgyas 'debs byas/ de nas rgyang 'bum mo che'i nang du mjal mar mes mchod 'bul byas/ brang mo che'i dgon par song 'gyed mang ja btang / zhag gcig bsdad/ phyi nyin byang lha rtser 'gro zhor la gtsang chus yul dgon la gnod pa la/ rigs gsum mgon po'i tho zhig brtsigs nas rab gnas byas/ chu phar bsgyur ba'i dmigs pa byas bden stobs brjod pas/ rjes su 922

dkon mchog gi thugs rjes chu phar log nas yul dgon la ma gnod pas thams cad kyis grub rtags red ces dad pa gong 'phel du gyur/ de nas rta ko sde pa'i nang du bos rgya nag nas khyer 'ong ba'i gser gyi gañji ra gser dngul rtsam pa sogs zas nor mang po phul/ gser gyi gañji ra byang lha rtse'i grwa tshang gi lha khang zhig gi steng du btsugs/ dgon pa'i dge 'dun pa la mang ja dang 'gyed btang / tshur la yang zhabs tog yag po byas byung / de nas tsha rong du 'ong / sman dgon nas zhag shas bsdad/bla ma mchog gsum nor bu bzhin spyi bor bkur zhing rnam dkar dge sbyor la brtson pa'i dad can sbyin bdag mo tsha rong lcam chos dbyings sgol ma sogs phyogs de'i yon bdag rnams la tshe dbang bskur/ sems khrid byas nas zhal gdams 'di yang byin no//rje rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang / /nyams rtogs pa 'char bar byin gyes rlobs/ /khyed dad can chos dbyings sgrol ma la/ /ngas sems ngo skyong tshul bshad kyis nyon/ /dpe khyung chen mkha' la lding ba bzhin/ /sems stong gsal ngang la rtsol med zhog /dpe nyi ma sprin dang bral ba bzhin/ /sems kun gsal mdangs dang ldan par zhog /dpe bu chung lha khang blta ba bzhin/ /sems 923

gsal la 'dzin pa med par zhog /dpe rgya mtsho rlabs dang bral ba bzhin/ /sems g.yo 'gul med par lhan ner zhog /dpe mkha' la bya 'phur rjes med bzhin/ /sems rnam rtog rang yal rjes med zhog /dpe de ltar mnyam par bzhag tsa na/ /nang sems la nyams rtogs 'di ltar 'char/ /dpe ngos bzung med pa'i bar snang bzhin/ /bshad mi shes stong sang nyams shig 'char/ /dpe khrugs pas rmi lam rmis pa bzhin/ /brjod mi shes gsal ba'i nyams shig 'char/ /dpe na chung bde bas myos pa bzhin/ /smra mi shes bde ba'i nyams shig 'char/ /dpe dur khrod bor ba'i bem ro bzhin/ /bsam mi shes rtogs med nyams shig 'char/ /nyams bde gsal mi rtog gang shar yang / /blo'i 'dzin pa ma zhugs sa ler skyongs/ /don de ltar sems ngo skyong nus na/ /mthar 'chi ba chos skur grol bar 'gyur/ /'di ma brjed snying gi dkyil du chongs/ /gzhan thos tshad rgyud la phan par shog /ces blangs pas der 'tshogs pa rnams kyi sems la phan pa byung / lcam che chung gnyis dang yul mi rnams kyis g.yu byi ru mu tig spos shel dngul srang nyis brgya'i rtsis dang / rtsam pa do po mang po phul bar bsngo ba smon lam gyi mtshams sbyor yang dag byas/ rtsam pa rnams grwa btsun lnga brgya la phogs brgyab nas/924

mar bkra shis lhun po la btang bas nyi ma gnyis gsum tsam la bar ma chad par song tshe/ gzhis ka rtse ba dang / bkra shis lhun po'i grwa pa phal cher gyis 'di 'dra 'ong ba gang red zer/ de bla ma zhabs dkar pa yong gi yod pa red/ 'di rnams de'i grwa btsun red byas pas/ thams cad kyis bla ma zhabs dkar pa zer ba de ci 'dra zhig yod pa yin nam/ lan cig blta dgos snyam yod dus/ nga ngor dgon par song bla ma khri par mjal/'bul ba phul chos 'brel zhus/ dgon par 'gyed mang ja btang / rgya dngul rdo tshad gcig gi dngul kong chen po zhig bzhag de nas mar gzhis ka rtser 'ong dus su bkra shis lhun bo'i grwa pa/ gzhis ka rtse'i yon bdag che chung gnyis ka lam kha na stong phrag gsum tsam zhig gi tshod ltad mo la 'dug pas/ nga yang ngo mtshar ba byung / gzhis ka rtse'i gu ru byang ma nas bsdad/nyi ma mang por mjal ka btang / kha btags skar lnga phyed brgyad mang po byung / de nas bkra shis kun khyab gling du song nas skyabs mgon paṇa chen rin po cher mjal/ shel gyi mar me'i 'od khang go ṭaṃ brgya ri ba'i chen po gcig dngul rdo tshad gnyis rta dang nor rdzas gzhan yang mang po phul/ bkra shis lhun por song nas paṇa chen blo bzang ye shes dang / dpal ldan ye 925
