shes gnyis kyi gser gdung gi drung du dngul rdo tshad lnga'i lhung bzed chen po phyi la gser srang gsum gyis gser tshos brgyab pa gcig dang / dngul rdo tshad gcig gi dngul kong chen po gcig gis sbyor 'jags byas/ dgon pa'i dge 'dun pa sum stong brgyad brgya la mang ja dang 'gyed phyed brgyad re btang / de nas nyin gcig skyabs mgon paṇa chen rin po ches bdag mdun du bos nas/ khyod kyis sngar yang bstan 'gro'i bde thabs su dmigs nas/ mchod rten chen po bya rung kha shor la nyams gso zhabs tog byas pa shin tu legs/ da res yang sngon grub thob thang stong rgyal pos stod hor sogs mtha' dmag gi kha gnon dang / bod kyi bstan 'gro'i bde thabs su dmigs nas gcung gi ri bo cher mchod rten bkra shis sgo mang bzhengs pa yang dus dbang gis chos 'khor bcu gsum me yis nyams song ba/ slar khyed kyi lhag bsam dag pas nyams gso zhig gyis zhes bka' phebs pa bdag gis kyang dang du blangs nas phyag 'tshal skyabs 'jug zhus pas/ der khong gis kha btags nang mdzod cig bdag gi mgul du g.yogs nas ngas kyang bla ma dkon mchog la gsol ba btab yong / khyod kyis skyo ngal sun pa med par brtson 'grus skyed la sgrubs dang / sngon smon thugs 926

bskyed bzang po'i rten 'brel deng 'dir 'grigs pas gegs med bde blag tu 'grub nges gsungs pas/ ngas kyang gsung de tshad mar bzung nas mar yong rgyu bzhag ste/ yar log nas bka' brgyad du song zhag kha shas gnas 'brel bzhag de nas gcung ri bo cher song nas nyams gso byed pa'i mthun rkyen sgrub dus thog mar/ thugs rgyud 'jam zhing chos bzhin mdzad pa'i mgron lha'i bla ma kun bzang snyan grags rin po che grwa btsun mang po dang bcas te 'ong / gser zho bco lnga dngul ṭaṃ brgya phrag g.yu byi ru dngul gye ga'u kha shas phul nas chos 'brel zhus pas/ chos bshad tshe dbang phul/ der khong gis zhal gdams shig dgos zhes bskur ngor mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so//rje bla ma chos rgyal ngag gi dbang / /mgon khyod zhabs pad+mor gus pas 'dud/ /bu bdag dang bdag gi rjes 'jug la/ /thugs brtse bas gzigs la byin gyis rlobs/ /yul byang phyogs mgron lha'i bla ma khyod/ /rten dal 'byor mi lus rin chen thob/ /rje mtshan ldan bla ma mang por mjal/ /chos nyams su len pa skal ba bzang / /spyir 'khor ba'i gnas na bde ba med/ /sgos bsags pa'i nor la snying po med/ /tshe yun thung nam 927

'chi cha yang med/ /da tshe 'di'i bya ba blo yis thongs/ /gnas ri khrod dben pa'i dga' tshal sten/ /rje bla mar snying nas gsol ba thobs/ /sems stong gsal 'dzin med ngang la zhog /gzhan ma gyur 'gro la snying rje sgoms/ /chos nyams su len na mang mi dgos/ /de thugs la chongs shig bla ma lags/ /dus da dung byang chub ma thob bar/ /zhal yang dang yang du mjal bar smon/ /mgon sangs rgyas bstan pa dar ba dang / /ma sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /ces phul lo/ /de nas shing sprel lo'i snon zla la 'go btsugs te phyag mdzod skal bzang 'phrin las dang / la dwags mkhan po/ rta ko sde pa sogs kyis kha 'go byas phyogs phyogs kyi grwa btsun gnas skor ba drug brgya tsam 'dus pas las ka las/ skabs shig stong phrag lhag tsam byung bas/thams cad kyis rtse zhor dgod zhor la mchod rten chen po'i rtsa ba nas rtse mo'i bar du phyi nang gnyis ka nyams gso byas/ chos 'khor bcu gsum dang rtse mo'i gdugs gañji ra dang bcas pa gser zangs las grub pa byas/ grwa btsun drug brgyas nyi ma mang po'i bar du gtsang po'i chu dkyil du rdo mang po spungs nas lcags zam dma' ru song yod pa yar mthor btang / de dag thams cad khrums zla'i nang du legs par grub rjes su mchod 928

rten chen po la rab gnas kyi dga' ston byas pa'i nyin/ grwa btsun yon bdag pho mo stong phrag gsum tsam 'dus rtsam pa do bo lnga bcu'i tshogs dang / dngul rdo tshad nyer lnga'i 'gyed btang / de'i rgyu song la/ bla ma skal ldan rang grol nas dngul rdo tshad lnga bcu/ bla ma sbyin pa nor bu nas dngul rdo tshad bzhi bcu/ bla ma gangs ri ba'i rdo tshad sum cu/ rta ko sde pa'i gser zho brgya la sogs pa'i phyogs phyogs nas slob ma bu chen yon bdag pho mo rnams kyis phul ba rnams khyon bsdoms pas dngul rdo tshad bdun brgya'i rtsis song / rgyas par dkar chag gsal ba'i me long na gsal lo//thog mar mchod rten chen po bzhengs tshul legs/ /bar du kun gyis nyams gso mdzad tshul legs/ /tha ma bsngo ba smon lam 'debs tshul legs/ /thog mtha' bar gsum gang du bltas kyang legs/ /skyabs mgon rgyal ba yab sras thugs rje dang / /slob ma yon bdag rnams kyi dad mos dang / /bdag gi lhag bsam rnam par dag pa'i mthus/ /mchod rten legs par 'grub bo lha mi tsho/ /bzo bo mkhas pas gdugs dang gañjir/ /chos 'khor bcu gsum sangs rgyas stong sku la/ /rin chen gser gyi na bza' bsgron legs pa'i/ /'od snang phyogs brgyar 'phro la 929

da ltos shig /e ma dad can bzo bo mkhas pa rnams/ /kun gyis skyes rtags 'jog na 'di 'dra zhog /gzhan gyis yid smon 'dod pa'i dpon po tsho/ /kun gyis smon rgyu bzo na 'di 'dra gyis/ /mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i bla ma tsho/ /bstan 'gror phan thogs mdzad na 'di 'dra mdzod/ /'dod med nga dang nga 'dra'i ri khrod pas/ /ri la sdod ma tshugs na 'di 'dra gyis/ /'dis mtshon dus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba'i mthus/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa dang / /bstan 'dzin sgyes ma chog thams cad sku khams bzang / /lus can kun la bde skyid 'byung bar shog /phyogs ris med par mi nor zas gsum 'dzom/ /'bad rtsol med par bde skyid snyan gsum 'byung / /mtho dman med par thams cad bde zhing skyid/ /nyin mtshan med par chos la spyod par shog /mchod rten chen por 'brel ba thogs tshad kyi/ /tshogs gnyis rab rdzogs sgrib gnyis kun dag nas/ /gnas skabs bde zhing mthar thug sangs rgyas kyi/ /go 'phang thob nas 'gro kun 'dren par shog /sngon dus grub thob thang stong rgyal po yis/ /mchod rten bzhengs nas smon lam btab pa bzhin/ /da yang mchod rten chen por nyams gso byas/ /smon lam 'debs pas de bzhin 'grub par shog /yul 930

phyogs kun tu mi nad phyugs nad sogs/ /mi 'dod nyer 'tshe'i ming yang mi grags shing / /rtag tu tshe ring nad med lo phyugs legs//thams cad bde zhing skyid pa'i bkra shis shog /ces smras/de dus stod mnga' ris skor gsum gye skal ldan gyi slob ma dad ldan gyi sbyin bdag pho mo rnams la/bdag ni mdo smad phyogs su 'gro don la 'gro ba yin pas khyed yong thub pa rnams nga la 'phrad du shog mi thub pa rnams kyi sems la 'di zungs zhes springs yig tshangs pa'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba 'di springs so //dang por byang chub thugs bsgyed nas/ /bar du tshogs gnyis bsags pa'i mthus/ /tha mar mngon par sangs rgyas pa'i/ /sangs rgyas thugs rje can la 'dud/ /de yi bstan pa spel mkhas pa'i/ /skyabs mgon rgyal ba yab sras sogs/ /bla ma skyes mchog thams cad la/ /rab tu gus pas bdag phyag 'tshal/ /rang la bka' drin sangs rgyas las/ /lhag pa'i rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /rtag tu gus pas gsol ba 'debs/ /byang chub bar du bdag skyongs shig /bya btang tshogs drug rang grol nga / /phyogs 'dir 'ongs nas lo mang song / /da ni rgan po 'chi la nye/ /ma shi na yang mi sdod par/ /mdo khams phyogs su 'gro bar nges/ /'gro khar 'jig rten pa rnams kyang / /bu la kha ta 'jug 931

pa ltar/ /bdag kyang 'gro khar dad can la/ /brtse ba'i bslab bya bshad kyis nyon/ /de yang sngon byon dam pa gong ma'i rnam thar la kha mig yar blta byas/ phyogs med kyi rgyal khams gang bzang dang nges med kyi ri khrod nyams dga' rnams 'grims pa'i bya btang gu yangs blo bde bdag gis skye 'chi 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsams nas/ tshe 'di'i bya ba blo yis btang /dang por mtshan ldan bla ma bsten nas zab rgyas gdams pa nyan/ bar du ri khrod dben pa'i gnas su nyams len byas/ tha ma da lta bstan dang 'gro ba gang la gang phan byas/ khyad par bstan 'gro yongs kyi bde thabs su dmigs nas/ mchod rten chen po bya rung kha shor gyi chos 'khor bcu gsum la rin chen gser zangs kyi na bza' phul/ dus da lta yang mchod rten bkra shis sgo mang la rin chen gser zangs kyi gdugs dang gañji ra chos 'khor bcu gsum 'bul ba'i skabs yin/ de nas ma shi tshe ring byung na dad can snang ba chos la bsgyur phyir yul thag ring mdo khams smad du 'gro nges yin gshis/ da ni bdag gis gson po'i dus kyi kha ta/ shi ba'i dus kyi kha chems 'jog rgyu la/khyed rnams kyis chos thams cad mi rtag mi brtan snying po med cing / khyad par tshe thung nam 'chi cha med yin tshul nyi ma re re 932

bzhin yang dang yang du yid la soms la/ tshe mjug la mgo'i nyi ma tsam pa yun thung ngu 'di'i ring la/ da nga tshe mjug 'dir yun ring po zhig bsdad yong snyam pa ma byed par/ sang gnangs glo bur du shi na ci zhig bya snyam du tshe phyi mar phan pa'i brgyags phye dam pa'i lha chos la nyin mtshan med par 'bad pa gal che/gal te chos rgya chen po ma byung kyang / srog gcod la sogs pa'i don med sdig pa'i las gtan nas ma byed/ dus rgyun du sems can thams cad pha mar sgoms la snying rje skyed/ phan sems bzang po mdzod/ phan pa'i smon lam rgya chen po thobs dang / tshe 'di phyi gnyis gar bde skyid kyi nyi ma gsar du 'char bar gdon mi za/ 'di nas kyang nged dpon slob yon mchod rnams/tshe 'dir bde zhing phyi mar skyid la nam phugs dag pa'i zhing nas mjal te/ phyogs bcu'i zhing khams bye ba phrag brgyar lhan du song nas/ sangs rgyas thams cad mchod cing sems can thams cad 'dren pa'i skal ba yod pa'i skyabs 'jug bsngo smon yang dag bya/ zhes da res bang chen pa 'di rnams kyi gdong la khyed rnams kyi mgo la 'jog rgyu'i sku 'dra/ mgul du 'dogs rgyu'i bsrung mdud/ kha la za rgyu'i dam rdzas/ rna bar sgog rgyu'i snying gtam yi ger bkod nas phul yod pas/ 'byor ba dang 933

dus mnyam du dngos su mjal ba ltar dga' spro tshad med pa mdzod cig /smras pa/ chos rgyal ngag gi dbang bo la/ /snying nas dad pas gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag dang slob ma sbyin bdag la/ /thugs rjes gzigs la byen gyis rlobs/ /stod phyogs mnga' ris skor gsum gyi/ /skal ldan snying gi slob bu dang / /dad can sbyin bdag pho mo la/ /phan pa'i snying gtam bshad kyis nyon/ /phyogs med rgyal khams gang bzang dang / /nges med ri khrod nyams dga' rnams/ /'grims pa'i rnal 'byor zhabs dkar pas/ /skyes pa'i pha yul rgyab tu bskyur/ /dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing du 'ongs/ /stod phyogs mnga' ris skor gsum dang / /bar gyi dbus gtsang ru bzhi'i char/ /mi lo bco lnga tsam zhig song / /de yi bar la chos ldan gye/ /bya ba mang po 'grub pa byung / /bsams na skal ba shin tu bzang / /da ni na so rgas dus 'dir/ /dbus gtsang zhing nas sdod snyam yang / /da lo dad can mang po 'ongs/ /smad phyogs mdo khams sgang gsum du/ /'gro don byed du yong dgos zhes/ /yang dang yang du bskul ba'i tshe/ /de dag kun la snying rje nas/ /'gro ba'i khas len shor bud song / /de nas ma shi tshe ring na/ /gdul bya gzhan la phan pa'i phyir/ /rgya 934

nag ri bo rtse lnga sogs/ /thag ring ri khrod dben pa ru/ /rim gyes rim gyis 'gro bar nges/ /song tshe nged rnams tshe 'di la/ /mjal ba'i dus shig mi 'ong snyam/ /skabs re bsam tshe skyo ba skyes/ /da res lan cig ma thug na/ /phyin chad phrad pa phar la zhog /gnas tshul tsam yang go ba dka'//shi ba zhig dang khyad mi gda'/ /brtse gdung che ba'i drin can ma/ /phyin chad bu la mi thug pa'i/ /thag ring yul la 'gro tsa na/ /sems 'phreng phrad snying 'dod pa ltar/ /bdag kyang slob ma yon bdag la/ /phyin chad nam yang mi thug pa'i//mdo smad phyogs su 'gro kha la/ /lan cig phrad snying 'dod pa byung / /de'i phyir bya lo tshun chad la/ /nga la phrad 'dod dad can kun/ /kha tsam tshig tsam ma yin par/ /dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing du shog /dbus su yong mkhan thams cad la/ /gzhi dang lam bar thams cad du/ /'gal rkyen bar chad mi 'byung zhing / /mthun rkyen bsam don 'grub par smon//sems la yong 'dod shar na yang / /rkyen ngan gzhan gyis dbang du song / /sa yang kha thag ring ba'i mthus/ /phal cher yong 'dra ma thub na/ /gnas tshul yi ge cis kyang thongs/ /bla ma'i bka' bzhin lha chos rem/ /'di nas mjal dang khyad med pa'i/ /skyabs 'jug bsngo smon yang dag bya/ /skye ba 'di yi 'og 935

rol tu/ /thugs yid 'dres pa'i dpon slob rnams/ /mngon dga' dga' ldan bde ba can/ /gang 'dod zhing nas mjal bar shog /phan pa'i snying gtam tshigs su bcad/ /yi ger bkod nas phul ba lags/ /mthong thos tshe ring nad med cing / /chos dang bkra shis 'phel gyur cig /ces springs pa'i rjes su slob ma yon bdag phal che ba 'ongs te dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing nas mdo smad du 'gro khar mjal rgyu byung / de nas 'ong zhor la thar ba gling rin chen sdings sogs lung ba de'i mdo'i bar du yod pa'i sde pa dang / byang lha rtse'i sde pa ta ko'i gzhi ka sogs yul phyogs de'i sde pa phal cher la song nas/ thams cad la chos bshad mgur dbyangs blangs nas snang ba chos la bsgyur/'gro khar dad gtong blo gros che ba'i sde pa rta ko lcam gnyis kyis zhal gdams shig dgos zhes bskul ngor 'di skad smras/dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad las/ /bka' drin che ba'i bla ma lha/ /yang yang dran zhing gsol ba 'debs/ /bsam don 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /'byor ldan bstan pa'i sbyin bdag mchog /rta ko'i sde pa mgon skyabs dang / /dad can lha lcam rnam gnyis kyis/ /phan pa'i snying gtam 'di la nyon/ /skyes pa 'chi zhing 'dus pa 'bral/ /bsags pa 'dzad cing mthon po 936

ltung / /'khor ba'i chos la snying po med/ /snying nas lha chos mdzad re ran/ /rab ni tshe gcig sangs rgyas phyir/ /rnal 'byor mi la ras pa ltar//tshe 'di'i bya ba blo yis thongs//dben par tshe dang sgrub pa snyoms/ /'bring ni dag zhing bgrod pa'i phyir/ /bka' gdams gong ma'i rnam thar ltar/ /sdom pa daca/ tshig gtsang ma srungs/ /dgon par sdod la dge sbyor mdzod/ /tha ma'ang mi lus 'thob pa'i phyir/ khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin ltar//rang gi yul nas sdod na yang / /phyag skor mchod sbyin kha ton rem/ /mdor na dran rgyu ma mang bar/ /dus dang rnam pa thams cad du/ /rang sems stong gsal ngang du zhog /snying rje phan sems che bar mdzod/ /rgyal khams 'grim pa'i zhabs dkar pas/ /phan pa'i snying gtam bshad nas song / /rjes su sdod mkhan rnams kyis kyang / /nam yang ma brjed sems la zhog /da ni sa thag ring pos bar/ /chod nas tshe 'dir mi mjal yang / /phyi mar dag pa'i zhing khams nas/ /mjal nas 'bral ba med par shog /ces gdams pas/ der khong rnams kyis phyag dang skor ba byas/ yang yang mjal ba'i smon lam btab nas 'bul ba mang po phul ba byung / de nas kun mkhyen jo nang tā ra na thā'i gdan sa dga' ldan phun tshogs gling gi 937

dgon par mjal/ 'gyed mang ja btang / gsung 'bum po ti bco brgyad yod pa tshang ma spar nas yong / de nas bo dong bkra shis sgang khro phu'i byams chen sogs la mjal/ mchod 'bul byas 'gyed mang ja btang / de nas slar bkra shis lhun bor song skyabs mgon paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa mchog la mjal/mchod rten nyams gso byas pa'i 'phro na zangs la sogs pa'i lhag ma gang yod dang rta bzang po gnyis gser dngul g.yu byir spos shel sogs lam nas 'gro don byas te gang rnyed rnams phul nas chos 'brel zhus pas/ thugs brtse ba chen po'i sgo nas tshe dbang bskur/ paṇa chen sku sngon ma rnams kyi gsung gi lam rim dang blo sbyong gi lung gnang / rje yab sras gsum dang paṇa chen sku snga phyi rnams kyi gsung 'bum par ma po ti lnga bcu/bde mchog gi bris thang gzims chung du bshams pa gcigapaṇa chen sgu snga ma'i na bza' sku gzan ser po gcig skye bdun ril bu gang mang / nged dpon slob lnga la gos kyi stod 'gags re/ byen rten bsrung mdud mgul dar bcas bdag rkyen chen po byas/ khyad par mdo smad kyi bstan 'gro yongs la phan pa'i bka' shog gnang tshul ni/bskal bzang rnam 'dren bzhi pa mnyam med nyi ma'i gnyen 938

gyi ring lugs 'dzin cing spel ba la snying stobs kyi 'jug pa phul du byung ba/ shākya'i dge slong blo bzang dpal ldan bstan pa'i nyi ma phyogs las rnam rgyal dpal bzang po'i gtam/'dzam gling nor gye blo gros ma'i dkyil 'khor la longs spyod pa'i skye dgu spyi dang / bye brag sog po tsho chen zhe dgus mtshon pa'i sog rigs/ mtsho khri gshog rgyal mo'i nye 'gram/ zi ling /stong skor/ mdo khams sgang drug mgo log rang ngan/ a rig sogs kyi sa'i char 'khod pa'i bla ma/ slob dpon/ grwa rigs/gong ma bdag po chen po'i gser lung gis skabs dbye ba'i mi drag wang / pa'i li/ pa'i si/ gung / ja sag mi ring / ja gi rug chi/ tha bu nang / je sang / mi sang / rda ro kha/ dmangs skye bo ji snyed pa sogs ser skya mchog dman mtha' dag la springs pa/ ji skad du/ phan bde 'byung ba'i gnas gcig pu//bstan nga/ yun ring gnas pa dang / /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ lus can kun la phan bde 'byung ba'i gzhi dang rten ni rgyal ba'i lung rtogs kyi bstan pa rin po che kho nar nges shing / bstan pa de nyid kyang dge 'dun gye sde nas lung sde snod gsum la thos bsam dang /lam bslab pa gsum gyi nyams len la rag las pas na/ zhabs dkar pa bya btang tshogs drug rang grol 'di pa gzhon dus 939

nas dam pa'i chos tshul gyi bgyi ba mi dman pa'i khar/ gangs ri'i ra bas bskor ba'i zhing ljongs 'dis mtshon gnas khyad par can rnams dang / dben pa'i ri khrod sogs su thos sgom gyi sgrub pa lhur len pa/ lhag tu mtha' dmag bzlog thabs su grub chen thang stong rgyal pos bzhengs pa'i dpal ri bo che'i mchod rten dus dbang gis nyams chags su song bar/ legs smon gyi mtshams sbyor dar ba dang / blo gros kyi 'jug pa mi dman pas/stod smad bar gsum la dge bskul gyes mtshon lhag bsam bzang po'i sgo nas/ mchod rten bkra shis sgo mang dang / mtha' bskor lha khang khag la nyams gso dgos rigs dang 'brel ba'i mchod rten rin po che'i bre yan chos 'khor bcu gsum gdugs bcas gser zangs sha stag las grub pa bzo bkod phun sum tshogs pas spud de legs par tshags tshud bgyis pa dang / de 'brel dgon gnas khag tu gser zangs kyi rgyal mtshan dang /chos 'khor sogs gsar sbyor/ gzhan yang jo shāka rnam gnyis dang / 'jam mgon rgyal ba gnyis pa'i gser gdung rin po che dbus/ rten gsum byin can khag la rgyu rin po che las grub pa'i mchod cha dang / mchod 'bul/ ris med dge 'dun gyi sder mchod sprin dang bsnyen bkur stobs pa sogs rgyal ba don kun 940

'grub pa'i sri zhu dang / skye 'gro mtha' dag gi mig rgyan la phan pa'i rnam dkar rlabs chen gyi dge stobs mi dman pa bsgrubs gshis/ bsngags 'os kyi yul du gyur pa bcas/ 'di pa 'khor bcas stod smad bar gsum yul phyogs gang du 'gro 'dug ci byed kyang / gong 'og drag zhan tshang ma nas rang gzhan rnam dkar la gzhigs pa'i 'tsho ba gnas mal sogs mthun rkyen yid bzhin du bsgrub pa dang / dgra jag rkun gsum sogs sems can la gnod 'gal du 'gro rigs spong bas mtshon rnam dkar dge ba'i bskul ma bgyis rigs tshang mas dang du len dgos rgyu yin/ zhes de ltar bsgo ba bzhin sgrub pa rnams la 'di phyi dus gnas kun tu dge ba'i ting nge 'dzin gye skyabs 'jug smon 'dun bzang po rgyun mar bgyid pa yin cing / gal te log par bcad na dam can chos srung rgya mtshos drag po'i chad pas mnar bar 'gyur ba gdon mi za bas bag yod bsten 'tshal/ zhes brda sprod pa'i yi ge shing sprel rgyal zla'i dkar phyogs kyi gral tshes dge bar chos grwa chen po bkra shis lhun po'i dpal gyi sde chen phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i pho brang chen po rgyal mtshan mthon po nas bris/ zhes pa gos chen ser bo kha gsum gyi dkyil du bris te sbug tham chen mo brgyab 941

nas gnang ba byung / 'gro khar dus nam yang thugs dam skyabs 'og nas mi 'dor ba dang slar da dung mjal rgyu yong ba'i skyabs 'jug zhus pas/ de lugs kyi skyabs 'jug bya/ yun ring ma sdod par shog dang mjal yong gsungs/ de nas 'khor grwa btsun lnga brgya dang bcas te nya mo ru 'ongs/ sde pa bstan pa/grub chen chos dar/ chos la sogs kyi zhabs tog yag po byung /chos bshad tshe dbang bskur/ yon bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis byas/ de nas mar rong chung brgyud nas snye mo ru 'ongs/ sde pa bkod chags pas rtsam pa do po brgya lhag gzhan yang rtsam pa mang po 'bul mkhan byung / tshogs rgya chen po btang / rtsam pa'i phogs brgyab/ kun gyes theg tshod khur nas/ thams cad kyis snga phyi rim pa byas lha sa ru song / nga rjes su bsdad yon bdag rnams la chos bshad tshe dbang bskur/ thams cad kyi blo kha chos la bsgyur/ sde pa dmar lam pa dang / bka' blon thon pa'i gzhi ka sogs phyogs de'i yon bdag rnams zas nor longs spyod 'bul mkhan dang chos byed mkhan mang po byung / de nas ri sna dgon par 'ong rtsa ba'i bla ma o rgyan bstan 'dzin rin po che dang mjal/ gser zho lngas 'go bas 'bul ba phul/ dgon par tshogs dang mang 'gyed btang / de nas lha sa ru 'ongs 942

bka' blon zur khang gi nang du bsdad/ khong gis 'go 'dren gzhan dang mi 'dra ba gnang mthun rkyen gang dgos bstsal bas sbyin bdag kun gyi nang nas drin can gyi mchog tu gyur/ de dus mkhan po zhi ba tshe ring chu nad kyis bsnyungs nas gshegs la nye ba zhabs brtan sku rim byas sman btang bas drag pa byung /bka' drin gtang rag tu dngul rdo tshad gnyis phul ba lha sa'i smon lam gyi 'gyed la snon pa byas/ de nas nyin gcig skyabs mgon rgyal ba tshul khrims rgya mtsho'i gser zhal mjal du phyin/sku gsung thugs rten maṇ+ḍal dang /rgya phi ling nas thon pa'i shel gye mar me'i 'od khang zlum po phyogs gang nas bltas kyang sgrib g.yogs dang bral ba chen po gcig gser rdo tshad gcig gis 'go byas dngul rdo tshad lnga'i rtsis kyi nor sna mang po phul/ rigs gsum mgon po dang rten 'brel bstod pa rnams kyi lung zhus/bod kyi rgyal po tshe smon gling pa la mjal/ rgyang shel gcigadangul rdo tshad gcig bcas phul nas chos 'brel zhus/ de nas lha ldan rang gi gnas tshang bka' blon zur khang nang mi la tshe dbang byin/ tshe ring ba'i rten 'brel bsgrigs/ de bzhin du bka' blon thon pa/ bsam 'grub pho brang / rgyal yum don 'grub sgol ma/ sde pa sban tsa lho pa/ mkhan po lcags zam pa 943

sogs kyis bos nas song tshe dbang bskur gang shes kyi chos bshad pas/ thams cad kyi thugs mnyes dngul rdo tshad mang po byin byung ba rnams lha sa'i smon lam 'gyed kyi snon pa byas/gzhan yang yon bdag kha che bal po'i tshong dpon/ tha na rag rgyab rwa yi khang ba phug nas sdod pa yan chad kyis bos nas song / nang du bkra shis brjod pas ṭaṃ ka mang po 'bul mkhan byung / de dus yon bdag kun la tshe ring ba'i zhal gdams 'di byen/'chi med tshe la mnga' brnyes pa'i/ /tshe lha yongs la gus pas 'dud/ /chos ldan bya ba byed rnams kyi/ /tshe srog brtan par byin gyis rlobs/ /tshe ring nad med bde ba'i phyir//bla ma rnams la tshe dbang zhus/ /dkon mchog gsum la gsol ba thobs tshe gzungs 'chi med rnga sgra thon/ /dge 'dun sde la mang ja dang / /ngan slong rnams la sbyin pa thongs//rgan pa rnams la brtsi bkur dang / /nad par sman sbyin nad g.yog gyis/ /gzhan yang brgya rtsa chu sbyin dang //tshe thar srog blu ci mang bya//kha ngan tshig ngan mi smra zhing / /kha ta tshud la bkra shis brjod/ /gang du 'gro 'am 'dug kyang rung / /spyi bor bla ma tshe dpag med/ /sgoms la gsol ba yang yang thobs/ /tshe yi dngos grub stsol bar dmigs/ /phyi snod 944

tshe dpag med kyi zhing / /nang bcud rang gzhan tshe dpag med//snang stong 'od kyi sku ru sgoms/ /sgra rnams dzi shārnyi yi sgra/ /sems nyid 'chi med chos kyi skur/ /bltas nas tshe gzungs ci mang bzla/ /tshe ring nad med bsngo ba dang / /smon lam bkra shis tshigs bcad brjod/ /deng sang tshe la bar chad mang / /de bzhin mdzod dang mi tshe ring / /legs bshad 'di nyid mthong thos kun/ /tshe ring nad med bde skyid shog /ces smras pas phal che bas de bzhin byas pas tshe ring ba byung / de dus lha ldan du stod sgar gyi bstan 'dzin nyi ma snye mo nas bstan 'dzin rang grol sogs sngon sbyangs las 'phro can gyi bu slob bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i don yong ba mang po byung ba la/ dbang dang gdams pa byen nas smin grol gyi lam la bkod/ grwa btsun rnams kyis jo shāka rnam gnyis la skor tshad bsags/ sgyung gnas kyang mang po bsrungs pas dad ldan dang ba 'dren pa byung / zla ba gcig lhag tsam bsdad/ de nas rang gi drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma grub pa'i dbang phyug mkhar rdo chos kyi rdo rje rin po che'i gdan sa khyad par can mkhar rdo bsam gtan gling du song / gnas de'i bsngags pa cung zad cig brjod na 'di lta ste/ de yang rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug rje btsun mi la yab sras kyi bu rgyud zhang 945

g.yu brag 'gro mgon rin po che zhes snyan pa phyogs kun tu grags pa gang des lha ldan jo bo chen po'i zhabs tog mang po mdzad/ phyogs der dge 'dun gyi sde yang mang po btsugs/gnas chen mkhar rdo der bzhugs shing byin gyes brlabs/bstan 'gro'i don yang rlabs chen mdzad/ bka' brgyud kyi bstan pa nyi ma shar ba ltar mdzad gsungs/ de'i rjes su gangs ri'i mgon po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs mi yi gar gye rnam rol rgyal dbang lnga pa byon/ thams cad dbang du bsdus zil gyes mnan/ rje bdeg nyid chen po'i bstan pa nyi ltar gsal bar mdzad/ de'i yang sprul rgyal ba tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho'i dus/ sde srid rin po ches gnas chen der rgyal mtshan gyi tog gi nor bu lta bur rgyal ba'i gzims khang brgyab/ rgyal dbang drug pas zhabs kyis bcags byin gyis brlabs/ khyad par rje bdag nyid chen po'i bstan pa la thugs bsgyed smon lam gyi mthu grub pa'i mtshungs med bzod pa rgya mtsho gnas 'dir yun ring bzhugs nas/ bka' gdams kyi rnam par thar pa lhur bzhes/ bstan 'gro'i don rgya chen mdzad/ sku gsung thugs rten mang du bzhengs sgrub sde btsugs/ de'i sprul sku chos ldan dbang bo dang / de'i sprul sku grub dbang chos kyi rdo rje gnyis kyis kyang 946

sgrub pa snying por byas/ bsgrubs 'bras kyis bstan 'gro yongs la gang phan mdzad/ gzhan yang gnas der chos mdzad sgyes chen dam pa du ma byon nas/ g.yo med zhi gnas kyi mkhar btsan po bzung / 'khrul med lhag mthong gi sgogs rdo chen po 'phangs nas/ bdag 'dzin nyon mongs 'jig rten chos brgyad kyi dgra rnams phye mar 'thag par mdzad pas/ ming don gnyis ka mthun pa'i mkhar rdo bsam gtan gling zhes grags pa'i gnas mchog de nyid kyi yon tan ni/ kha lhor blta dgun dus nyi 'od 'khyil zhing / dbyar sos dus bsil zhing rig pa dwangs pa/ chu me shing la sogs mthun rkyen 'dzom pa/ rgyab brag ri'i rtse mo mtho la mdzes shing / shar logs na bya rgyal rgod po rgyun du gnas pas de nyid mthong tshe/ bya btang sgom chen pa rnams rgyun du brag la gnas dgos snyam pa 'char du 'jug pa/ skabs skabs su na bun dngul gyi mdog 'dra sked la 'khril zhing / zhwa ltar mdzes pa'i rang byung nyams dga'i brag phug che chung mang po yod pas/sngon sbyangs las kyi 'phro can rnams la na bun gos ltar gyon cing brag phug zhwa ltar bsten 'dod 'byung du 'jug pa/ spang gzhongs sman ljongs la me tog sna tshogs bkra zhing bung ba che chung mang pos snyan pa'i sgra dir dir sgrog pa mthong tshe/ gzhung 947

gi bla sman mkhas pa rnams kyang lo ma me tog 'bras bu can gyi sngo sman 'thu ru 'ong du 'jug pa/ sa phyogs gtsang zhing mdog snum dri zhim ri rgyud rnams bzang zhing ri rtser phyin na mthong rgya che bas/ dbyar gyi dus su gzhung gi sku drag lcam sras rnams dang bal po'i tshong dpon gzhon nu rnams kyang khams bsang skyid skyid gtong phyir 'ong du 'jug pa/ rgyab ri'i spang gzhongs kun na 'brog pa'i ru khag gnas pa'i sgo phyugs rnams kyis nus pa can gyi sman sna zos pas/ de'i zho dar 'thung ba rnams kyi rlung mkhris bad gan gyi nad kyang phal cher rang sar zhir 'jug pa/ri khar sos dal sdod pa'i rdzi bo rnams kyis 'gro 'dug gi zhor la snyan pa'i glu dbyangs sna tshogs blangs pas/ gnas der sdod pa'i sgrub pa po rnams kyi rna bas go tshe dgod kha rang dbang med par 'chor du 'jug pa/ ri ngos na chu gtsang yan lag brgyad ldan du ma 'bab cing chu mig 'khyil ba/ chu rnams kyi nang na lcong mo la sogs pa'i srog chags phra mo rnams kyis lus kyi dga' ba'i rnam 'gyur du ma ston bzhin gnas pa/ chu rnams bsil bas cung zad 'thungs kyang skom pa'i gdungs pa sel zhing / shing tu dwangs pas lus yud tsam bkrus na lus kyi dri ma mtha' dag dag nas lus sems la sngar med pa'i bde ba 948

'bar te khams kyang rang dbang med par gseng du 'jug pa/spang dang brag gi bar mtshams su/ rna ba dang gla ba sog spu sdug yid 'ong gi ri dwags du ma bag phebs rgyu zhing bang rtse ba/ lha bya gong mo dang 'jol mo la sogs pa'i yid 'ong bya dang byi'u rnams kyang dga' zhing 'phyo bzhin skad snyan mi 'dra ba sna tshogs bsgyur bas/ gnas der 'ongs tshad rnams kyi yid rang dbang med par 'phrogs nas zhag shas dbang med sdod du 'jug pa/ dbyar zla ba bzhi pa dang lnga pa'i mtshams su bya yi rgyal po khu byug sngon mo yang 'ongs nas mdzes pa'i gzugs kyis dga' ba'i rnam 'gyur ston bzhin yid la 'bab pa'i skad gdangs snyan po yang yang bsgrags tshe/ de'i rkyen byas sngar mi yul du 'khyams pa rnams kyis kyang rang gi pha yul dran zhing /rgas pa'i drin can gyi pha mas gtam gang bshad kyi nang nas phal cher dran du 'jug pa/ khyad par bya btang sgom chen pa tshe blos btang nas ri khrod 'grims pa rnams kyis rang gi drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma'i gdan sa dran zhing / bla mas bka' chos gang gnang ba'i nang nas phal cher dran la/ de'i dus su gsung 'di ltar 'byon zhing dam gtsang rdo rje mched lcam rnams kyang 'di 'dra yod/ chos kyi snyeng mo dang skyo bsangs rtse dgod sna 949

tshogs byas tshul yan chad yid la wa ler dran pas/ sems rtsa gting nas skyo ste rang dbang med par mchi ma mang po 'chor du 'jug pa/ zwa dang rug pa thul ba sgyur po shing 'bras la sogs pa bcud myang na zhim pa'i bro ba can gyi kha zas mod pas/ ri khrod pa rnams kyis kyang rje btsun mi la'i rnam thar dran nas dka' thub kyi zas de 'dra la longs spyod pa'i skal ba 'byung du 'jug pa/ phyag dang mchod pa'i zhing sa gtsug lag khang ngo mtshar ba mang po dang / sku gsung thugs rten byin rlabs can du ma bzhugs pas gnas 'dir yod tshad kyis zhor la phyag mchod skor ba byas pas bsod nams ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis bde blag tu rdzogs su 'jug pa/ phyogs phan tshun gyi nyams dga' rig pa dwangs pa'i ri khrod na bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang /grogs chos bzhin mdzad pa du mas khengs pas/ gang zag las dang po ba rnams la dbang dang gdams ngag gegs sel bogs 'don gang dgos kyang 'ong ba/ mdo na 'dod dgu'i zas nor 'dzom pa'i lha ldan skyid pa'i grong khyer chags pas chos kyi mthun rkyen gang dgos 'bad med lhun grub tu 'ong ba'i gnas phun sum tshogs pa der sngon gyi las bzang smon lam dag pa'i mthu la brten nas/ rgyal khams 'grims pa'i rnal 'byor 950

zhabs dkar pa dpon slob rnams slebs nas/ mkhar rdo bzod pa rgya mtsho'i sgrub phug 'od gsal phug mo che nas bla ma'i bka' bzhin sgrub pa byas dus/ nyams dga' rig pa dwangs pa'i shugs kyis slar yang gnas la bstod pa tshigs su bcad nas smras pa/ byen rlabs stsol ba'i bla ma dang / /dngos grub ster ba'i yi dam lha/ /bar chad sel ba'i mkha' 'gro yis/ /byen rlabs dngos grub char bzhin phob/ /rdo rje gdan dang cha mtshungs pa'i/ /lha ldan sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang / /gangs can mgon po spyan ras gzigs/ /bzhugs gnas pho brang po ta la/ /bsod nams gsog pa'i zhing gi mchog /ser 'bras dge gsum la sogs pa'i/ /dge 'dun sde dang thag nye ba'i/ /dben shanas mkhar rdo bsam gtan gling / /sgrub brgyud bstan pa dar ba'i ri/ /mkhas grub mang po bzhugs pa'i shul/ /mkha' 'gro chos skyong 'du ba'i gnas/ /dkar phyogs lha rnams 'khor ba'i sa/ /sa phyogs gtsang zhing ri bkra legs/ /kha yang lhor blta nyi thag ring / /dbyar dus dri bzhon ldang bas bsil/ /dgun dus nyi 'od 'khyil bas dro//rgyab ri shin tu mtho la mdzes/ /logs la bya rgyal rgod po gnas/ /mthong tshe bya btang ri khrod pa/ /'di ltar 951

gnas dgos snyam pa 'char/ /dngul gyi mdog 'dra'i na bun 'khor/ /zhwa ltar mdzes pa'i brag phug mang / /mthong tshe na bun gos ltar gyon/ /brag phug zhwa ltar bsten 'dod 'byung / /ri ngos spang gzhongs sman ljongs dang / /ljon shing me tog sna tshogs bkra/ /de nyid mthong tshe sman pa yang / /phal cher sngo sman 'thu ru 'ong / /ri rnams mdog snum ri rgyud bzang / /ri rtser phyin na mthong rgya che/ /de phyir sku drag tshong dpon yang / /khams bsang skyid skyid gtong phyir 'ong / /'brog pa'i sgo phyugs rnams kyis kyang / /nus pa can gyi sman zos pas/ /de yi zho dar 'thungs tshad kyi/ /nad rnams phal cher rang sar zhi/ /ri khar sdod pa'i dzi bo yis/ /snyan pa'i glu dbyangs sna tshogs len/ /der bzhugs bya thatang sgom chen pas/ /go tshe dbang med dgod kha 'chor/ /dwangs shing bsil ba'i chu mig na/ /lcong mo la sogs srog chags gnas/ /khrus byas 'thung ba tsam gyis kyang / /khams bsangs rig pa shin tu dwangs/ /ri dwags sna tshogs bag phebs rgyu/ /bya dang bye'us skad snyan sgrog /gnas 'dir 'ongs tshad thams cad kyi/ /yid 'phrog sdod 'dod yang yang 'byung / /dbyar dus khu byug sngon mo 'ongs/ /mdzes pa'i gzugs bstan skad snyan 'byen/ /de dus bla ma pha ma yang / /dran nas dbang med mchi ma 95 2

'chor//zwa dang rug pa thul ba sogs/ /dka' thub zas kyang sna tshogs yod/ /de mthong mi la'i rnam thar yang / /dran nas dka' ba spyod snying 'dod/ /phyag mchod zhing mchog gtsug lag khang / /sku gsung thugs rten byen can bzhugs/ /gnas 'dir yong tshad thams cad kyis/ /phyag dang skor ba zhor la 'ong / /phan tshun ri khrod dben pa na/ /bla ma mched grogs mang po bzhugs/ /gang zag las ni dang po par/ /dbang dang gdams ngag gang dgos 'ongs//mdo na 'dod dgu'i nor 'dzom pa'i /lha ldan skyid pa'i grong khyer chags//'tsho ba'i yo byad gang dgos kyang / /'byor ldan dad can yon bdag mang / /e ma phun sum tshogs pa'i gnas/ /mkhar rdo bsam gtan gling mchog gi /sgrub khang 'od gsal phug mo cher//bdag kyang slebs pa skal ba bzang / /da ni bla ma'i bka' bzhin du/ /bsdad nas bsgrub pa gtso bor byas/ /sgrub pa'i 'bras bus bstan 'gro la//phan pa'i smon lam yang yang 'debs/ /gong ma'i rnam thar skyong 'dod cing //tshe 'di blo yis gtong 'dod dang / /snying nas chos bzhin mdzad 'dod rnams/ /gnas 'dir byon dang lha chos 'ong / /dad can gnas skor byed 'dod dang / /sman pa sngo sman 'thu 'dod dang / /sku drag khams bsang byed 'dod kun/ /gnas 9'i 3

'dir phebs dang 'gro don 'grub/ /gnas 'di bstod pa'i dge ba'i mthus/ /chos pas ri khrod zin pa dang / /yul phyogs kun tu lo legs shing / /kun kyang chos la spyod par shog /ces bstod cing gnas der zla ba dgu tsam bsdad nas sgrub la gzhol ba'i thun mtshams rnams su/ spyir 'dod yon lnga dang /khyad par lto gos bud med lus kyi nyes dmigs bsams nas/lus srog longs spyod gang la yang mi chags par tshe blos btang nas/ dben pa'i gnas su sgrub pa la gzhol dgos tshul gyi legs bshad ya mtshan sprul pa'i glegs bam zhes bya ba brtsams/de dus mdo smad nas tsha po dkar dris dang tshe mgon tshul khrims sogs mang po zhig 'ongs pa rjes su bzung nas dbang dang gdams pa byin/ slob ma bu chen rnams dgon pa'i nang du bzhugs/ grwa btsun phal che ba zhig gis brag dang pha bong chen po mang po'i rtsa ba nas 'dug sa chung chung re bcos te ri dwags bzhin du bsdad/ bcu ba'i lnga mchod kyi gling me sbar dus ri ngos kyi pha bong chen po thams cad kyi steng nas kun gyis mar me mang po sbar bas/ dper na nam mkha' la skar ma shar ba bzhin ri yi ngos thams cad re zhig gi bar du mar me khra chem me gang ba lha ldan gyi dad can rnams kyis mthong bas rjes su yi rang ba 954

byung / byis pa rnams kyis ya gi la ltos zhes ngo mtshar bar gyur/de dus phyogs phyogs kyi bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen slob ma bu chen grwa btsun yon bdag pho mo brgya stong mang po la/ zla ba kha shas kyi bar du/ nyin re bzhin du chos thun re la sgrub thabs rin 'byung gi rjes gnang thams cad dang / bka' gdams thig le bcu drug gi dbang / lam rim chen mo/ bka' gdams glegs bam/ dpe yi lam rim rin chen spungs pa/ don gyi lam rim be'u bum sngon po dang / rang gis brtsams pa'i legs bshad rnams kyi lung khrid byas pas/ slob ma yon bdag thams cad kyi rgyud la phan rgya chen po thogs pa byung / chos bshad grub pa dang dga' ston gye nyin stod kyi bla ma rab rgyas nas rgya dngul rdo tshad bdun gyis 'go byas nor rdzas rdo tshad bco lnga'i rtsis phul/ ru thog chos mdzad nas dngul rdo tshad gnyis kyis 'go byas nor rdzas rdo tshad lnga'i rtsis phul/ bla ma rig 'dzin o rgyan rnam rgyal nas dngul rdo tshad gsum/ gzhan yang slob ma yon bdag mang pos snga phyi rim pa byas nas phul ba la/ gser zho kho na bdun brgya tsam dang / dngul ṭaṃ rdo tshad mang po byung / gser rnams tshe smon gling ba la dngul dang brjes nas lha sa'i smon lam gye 'gyed mang ja'i thebs byas/ de dus grub dbang mkhar 955

rdo rin po che'i sprul sku gdan sar dgod pa la dngul rdo tshad bdun gyi rtsis bya ni/ yar mar la 'gro bsdad mang po dang /phan gang thogs byas pas/ phyag mdzod dang sras mo gnyis kyis rab tu dga' ba'i ngos nas/ mkhar rdo rin po che'i thugs dam gyi rten zhing bkod kyi thang ka bdun dbu zhwa na bza' byin rten khyad 'phags mang po byen byung / de dus ser ra'i 'du khang du dngul srang lnga bcu'i mchod kong chen po zhig bzhag nas mang ja btang / phyogs phyogs kyi slob ma grwa btsun yon bdag pho mo gnas skor ba bcas 'tshogs pa stong phrag mang po byung bas phal che ba la/ ja mar rtsam pa'i phogs dang / skabs skabs su rtsam pa do po bcu bco lnga nyi shu'i tshogs lan mang po btang /bsod nams gsog pa'i zhing mchog ser 'bras dge gsum la snga phyi rim pa byas dpon slob kun gyis ja thug bcu gsum tsam btang / de'i lo smon lam chen mor ja thug gnyis dang dngul ṭaṃ re'i 'gyed btang / sprang po stong phrag gnyis la dngul phyed brgyad re btang / de thams cad la dngul rdo tshad brgya lhag cig gi rtsis song / de ltar tshogs bsags pa rnams phan bde'i 'byung gnas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar zhing ma sems can thams cad la bde skyid 'byung ba'i rgyu ru bsngos nas sos dal 956

bde bar bsdad yod pa'i dus/ nyin gcig nye gnas mkhas pas khong gi dbu zhwa 'di'i brda mtshon zhig gsung dgos zhes bskul ngor 'di skad ces smras/bya btang tshogs drug rang grol gyi/ /mgo la gyon pa'i zhwa yi ming / /pad zhwa pad+ma mthong grol zer/ /mthong tshad don ldan byed pa'i brda//zhwa yi kha dog ser ba de/ /sangs rgyas bstan la zhugs pa'i brda/ /zhwa yi gzengs de mtho ba de/ /dkon mchog dbu 'phang bstod pa'i brda/ /rgyal mtshan tog gis mdzes pa de/ /thub bstan rgyal mtshan bsgrengs pa'i brda/ /'ja' tshon ri mos bskor ba de/ /ye shes lnga dang ldan pa'i brda/ /mdun gye pad 'dab gsum po de/ /'bras bu sku gsum brnyes pa'i brda/ /de yang kha dog sna tshogs de/ /las bzhi 'gro don byed pa'i brda/ /mdun du cung zad gug pa de/ /bla mar mos gus che ba'i brda/ /zhwa de mgo la gyon pa de/ /thams cad spyi bor khur ba'i brda/ /zhwa yi mtshon don brda chos bzhin/ /kun kyang chos la spyod par shog /ces smras/ de nas bla ma rab rgyas la 'gro khar dad rten du rin po che du mas phra rgyan mdzes pa'i jo bo'i sku 'byon gtsang dngul srang brgya'i rgyu song can gcig ru thog chos mdzad la dgon pa'i sbyor 'jags kyi ched du rgya dngul rdo tshad gcig gi 957

dngul kong chen po gcig dang / gzhan yang gang la gang 'tshams kyi 'thon phyag byen nas phal cher rang rang gi yul phyogs kyi ri khrod rnams su sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin du song /gzhan grwa btsun mang po dang bcas te lha ldan du song nas tshogs mchod skabs bla ma sbyin pa nor bus gtso byas slob ma grwa btsun yod tshad kyis phyi skor chen mo la brkyangs phyag 'tshal bas/ skor lam thams cad chod nas gzhan skor mis lam mi rnyed pa tsam byung bas/ da lo'i brkyangs phyag pa'i mang zhig sngar yong mi dran zhes kun gyis gleng ba byung / tshogs mchod ltad mo la bltas/ de nas bzung ste zla ba lnga'i bar du lha ldan du bsdad/nged dpon slob kun gyis smyung gnas bsrungs pas stong phrag mang po song / de yi mthun rkyen rnams lha ldan yon bdag dad can rnams kyis bsgrubs pa byung / sa ga zla ba'i bco lnga'i nyin mchod pa la me tog 'tshong ba kun slob ma grwa btsun rnams kyis nyos nas thugs rje chen po'i dkyil 'khor gyi mtha' la phul bas nang kun khengs pa byung / gzhan yang lha sa nas sdod ring la/ bco lnga gnam gang tshes brgyad sogs la/ phyi skor chen mor 'gro zhor la rtsam pa brdzis nas do po byas khyer nas khye ldom mang por byen/ dkar rtsam sgro ba gsum bzhi re khyer nas sprang po la 958

byin/ nang nas mig long ba/ nad pa 'gro mi thub pa'i nyam thag pa rnams la ṭaṃ ka phyed brgyad tsam re byen/ yang yang song bas skabs shig mi khyi gnyis gas ngo shes nas/ sngon du brgyugs nas bsu ru yong / de bzhin du stod smad bar gsum gye nyam thag sprang po rnams kyi mgon skyabs kho na byas pas/ sprang po mang pos nged tsha'i skyabs mgon zhes bos pas/ gzhan kun gyes kyang skyabs mgon zhabs dkar pa zhes 'bod pa byung / de dus rgya gar gye a tsa ra sha chang sgog tsong bud med sogs mi bsten par/ spyod pa gtsang ma byas nas gnas nges med 'grims nas 'gro ba dpon slob gnyis kyis nga'i snyan pa go nas/ nyin gcig yong nas mjal te/ khyed nor rdzas la chags zhen med par ngan slong rnams la sbyin pa gtong ba shin tu legs/ khyed kyi mdzad pa 'di nged tsho'i rgya gar gyi bla ma bzang po dang 'dra bar gda'/spyod pa yang nged tsho dang mthun par 'dug pas sems dga' ba byung / gzhan bod na bla ma sku yon can mang pa 'dug ste/khyed 'dra ba'i snying rje can dkon par gda'/ bla ma byang chub sems dpa' khyed kyis kho bo la skyabs 'jug dgos/ phyi mar bde ba can nas mjal ba'i smon lam 'debs zhes phyag 'tshal zhabs spyi bor blangs nas slar rgya gar du song ba la nga yang 959

sems 'phreng ba zhig byung / de dus ser 'bras kyi bla rgan 'ga' res/ deng sang skyabs mgon rgyal ba yab sras kyi 'og nas/dga' ldan gser khri las bla ma zhabs dkar skad che bar gda'/ khong la dbang sdud zhed po zhig yod pa min nam zer/nang nas gcig na re/ dbang sdud cig gis kyang de tsam zhig mi yong / khong gi rgyud kyi byang chub sems kyi rten 'brel gyis skye 'gro mang po 'dus pa red zer/ gcig na re kho bos cang mi shes te/ khong gi mdzad pa gang la bltas kyang skyon 'dogs rgyu zhig mi gda'/ gang ltar na'ang khas gtong rgyu zhig ma red zer skad/ de nas yar dga' ldan du song / gser gdung chen mor mjal/ zhag gnyis bsdad/ gser kong mar khus bkang brgya mchod phul/ bstan 'gro yongs la phan pa'i smon lam rgya chen po btab/ de nas bsam yas mchims phu dang brag dmar g.ya' ma lung gnyis la mjal zhag re tsam bsdad nas phyag mchod skor ba byas/ tshogs btang bsngo ba smon lam btab/ de nas bsam yas la song nyi ma bco lngar nyin re bzhin grwa btsun thams cad kyis brkyangs phyag mang po 'tshal/mchod 'bul byas/bstan 'gror phan pa'i smon lam yang yang btab/ mchod rten dmar po'i thag nye'i sde pa lcam gnyis kyis der sdod ring la 960

'tsho ba zhabs tog byas/ 'gro khar mdzod bdun dang dwags po'i bka' 'bum gyi dpe cha phul/ de nas mar lho kha'i gnas chen khyad 'phags rje phag mo gru pa'i gdan sa mthil du song /gnas de'i lha khang chen mo la gzhung dga' ldan pho brang gis nyams gso mdzad pa'i sde pa dpon g.yog rnams kyi grogs byas/dngul rdo tshad gcig tsam gyis zhal 'debs kyang brgyab/gnas der grwa btsun lnga brgya tsam 'dus/ mtshams bsnyen bsgrub tshogs bsags sgrib sbyong kho na byas/ de rnams kyi phal che po la ja mar rtsam pa'i phogs dang / skabs skabs su rtsam pa do bo bcu bco lnga tsam re brdzis nas gyig tse brgyab ste ri rab kyi tshul du brtsigs/ mtha' la tshogs rdzas gzhan mang po bzhag nas tshogs rgya chen po lan mang po btang / de dus mdo smad nas grub dbang rdzogs chen pa rin po che'i bu chen gang shar rang grol dang / nga'i slob ma kun bzang rang grol/ sbyin bdag dpon po ban+de thar sogs yon bdag pho mo mang po slebs nas/bla ma gang shar gyis dngul rdo tshad gcig gis 'go byas thams cad kyis dngul srang brgya phul nas/ dpon pos mdo smad du phebs dgos tshul gyi rgyu mtshan rnams ngag nas zhus/ bu chen kun bzang rang grol gyis zhu shog 'di phul lo//961

phun tshogs tshogs gnyis las bskrun mtshan dpe'i sku//'gro tshogs re skong yan lag drug cu'i gsung / /sgrib tshogs rang grol shes bya kun gzigs thugs/ /legs tshogs kun stsol sku gsung thugs la 'dud/ /rab 'byams rgyal ba'i thugs rje gcig bsdus pa/ /rab dkar gangs ri'i mdangs 'dzin spyan ras gzigs/ /rab rmongs 'gro ngor skyabs mgon zhabs dkar rje/ /rab gsal mtshan snyan 'dzam gling grags des dgongs/ /skal ldan gdul bya'i rang blo dang 'tshams par/ /byin ldan smin grol chos 'khor bskor mdzad pa'i/ /rtogs ldan 'khrul zhig lhun grub rig 'dzin rje/ /dad ldan bdag gi dbyangs 'dir cung zhig gson/ /blo gros rnam dpyod bzang po'i rigs rnams kun/ /ri bong rwa dang rin chen ltar dkon nas/ /kun bzang dgongs bcud rang grol myur lam yang / /ring lam mdzad mkhan de yis zhu ba'i 'bras/ /pha yul pha ma spun sogs blo yis btang / /phal cher bgrod dka'i bshul ring lam brgyud nas/ /pha ma nyam thag 'gro rnams bder 'god phyir/ /pha rgan gdan 'dren zhu snyam dbus 'dir yong / /chos rje dam pa dbus gtsang zhing byon nas/ /chos pas sa steng bkang ba nyams dga' yang / /chos med pha yul gang gis blos btang 'phro/ /chos min 962

sna tshogs byed 'dir nga re skyo/ /sngon dus rgyal dbang mtsho skyes rdo rje yis/ /bod kyi rje 'bangs grogs rnams blos btang nas/ /mi bsrun srin po'i kha gnon mdzad phyir du/ /lho nub rnga yab gling du byon pa bzhin/ /'di lo skyabs mgon rin po che khyed kyang / /dbus gtsang slob ma yon bdag blos btang nas/ /dmu rgod 'gro rnams blo kha chos bsgyur phyir/ /mdo smad pha yul phyogs su 'byon par zhu/ /e ma dgongs shig bla ma rin po che/ /stod phyogs mnga' ris skor gsum slob ma yis/ /gser dngul 'bul chen btegs pas thugs mnyes nas/ /gser dngul dang bral mdo smad blos btang na/ /byang chub sems dpa'i dam bca' mi 'gal lam/ /mdo smad yul gye skya ser pho mo rnams/ /rje la 'phreng bzhin phal cher tshe dus byas/ /da ltar gnas rnams da lo skyabs mgon rje/ /phebs yong bsam pa'i re ba snying nas yod/ /jo sku rnam gnyis rgyal dbang paṇa chen la/ /brtag ril sgril dang lung bstan zhu rgyu'ang med/ /da lo cis kyang a mdor phebs par zhu/ /de nas lo bdun lo bcu tsam bzhugs 'phro/ /dbus gtsang mnga' ris phyogs su phebs dgongs na/ /nged cag slob ma yon bdag thams cad kyis/ /slar yang dbus gtsang zhing 'dir gdan 'dren byed/ /ris med brtse ldan 'gro 963

mgon zhabs drung du/ /nyams med khrims ldan bla ma dge bshes dang / /'dzad med 'byor ldan yon bdag pho mo rnams/ /'bral med rgyun ldan tshogs nas bskor bzhugs tshe/ /chos med sprang po kun bzang rang grol ngas/ /nor med stabs kyis ngag nas zhu ma spobs/ /dri med shog gur zhu tshig rnams bkod nas/ /zla med bla ma'i spyan sngar phul ba'i dges/ /sa gsum 'gro mgon dbus gtsang ru bzhi nas/ /sa cha mdo khams smad du myur byon te/ /sa der gnas pa'i skal ldan gdul bya rnams/ /sa bcu'i dpal la 'god pa'i bkra shis shog /ces phul bas ngas kyang 'gro bar khas blangs/ bla ma kun bzang rang grol bzhugs rgyu byas/ bla ma gang shar la 'ol kha'i gsang ye chos tshan dang / gzhan yon bdag rnams la rten gsum bro kha gang dgos byin/ nga'i dpe cha'i do po phal cher khong rnams kyis khyer nas song / gnas der 'tshogs pa'i grwa btsun thams cad la skabs skabs su lam rim myur lam dang blo sbyong don bdun ma phyag chen lhan cig skyes sbyor/ rdzogs chen ma rig mun sel sogs zab rgyas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ kun gyis rang rang gang mos kyi chos la nyams len byas nas bsdad dus/ dad ldan blo gros mchog mnga' slob bu yon tan rgya mtshos gnas chen 'di la bstod pa zhig dgos 964

zhes bskul ngor gnas la bstod pa'i mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so//pha bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /gnas 'dir 'tshogs yongs la thugs rjes gzigs/ /rje bka' brgyud gong ma'i gdan sa'i mthil/ /lha zhi khro rab 'byams bzhugs pa'i zhing / /ma mkha' 'gro chos skyong 'du ba'i sa/ /gnas khyad 'phags kun bzang nags khrod kyi/ /phyi rgyab ri rgyal po gdan bzhugs 'dra/ /g.yas brag ri rin chen spungs pa 'dra/ /g.yon spang ri glang chen 'gying ba 'dra/ /mdun gtsang po yon chab 'khyil ba 'dra/ /nang lung ba pad dkar kha phye 'dra/ /dbus lha khang pad+ma'i ze'u 'bru 'dra/ /rten khyad 'phags dpag tu med pa bzhugs/ /gnas 'di ni 'og min zhing dang mtshungs/ /rje bka' brgyud rnam thar skyong 'dod kun/ /gnas 'di ru sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan tshugs/ /mchog thun mong dngos grub thob 'dod kun/ /gnas 'di la tshogs dang mchod pa phul/ /las sdig pa 'dag 'dod pho mo rnams//gnas 'di la phyag dang skor ba gyis/ /glu 'di nyid blangs pa'i dge ba'i mthus/ /chos sgrub brgyud kyi bstan pa dar gyur cig /ces gnas bstod phul nas lha mi thams cad dga' bar byas so/ /yang gnas de'i rtsa na 965

'dug pa'i yon bdag rnams kyis char 'beb cig gnang dgos zer ba la/ nga la char 'beb kyi gdams pa ni med de/'on kyang bla ma dkon mchog la gsol ba 'debs zhes bsam pa bzang po'i sgo nas/ bla ma dkon mchog la lo la phan pa'i char phob ces gsol ba btab/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba'i byen rlabs bdag gzhan dus gsum bsags pa'i dge tshogs thams cad nam mkha'i khams la sprin gyi phung po chen por gyur pa'i nang nas char phang lo tsam 'bab pa'i ting nge 'dzin la bsdad pas/ dgong mo 'brug med pa'i char thog chen po brgyab nas yon bdag rnams kyi bsam pa rdzogs pa byung / de nas bzung char nam 'dod dus su babs nas rgyal khams yongs la de'i lo lo yag cig byung / yang dwags po ngh+ru pa'i lcam sgol ma skyid 'dzom gyis rang gi lus kyi rgyan cha kha shas dang zas nor gzhan yang mang po phul nas/ 'khrungs rabs gsol 'debs shig dgos zhes nan tan bskul ba'i ngor 'di skad ces smras so//bskal ba dpag tu med pa'i sngon rol nas/ /myur du mngon par rjogs par sangs rgyas te/ /rgyal ba'i bstan dang 'gro la phan pa'i phyir/ /gang la gang 'dul skur bstan 'gro don 966

mdzad/ /sangs rgyas dus su 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs/ /rgya gar yul du 'jam dpal bshes gnyen mchog /bod yul dbus su dran pa nam mkhar gyur/ /bka' brgyud bstan la mi la ras pa dngos/ /bka' gdams dus su rgyal sras thogs med dpal/ /dga' ldan bstan la blo gros rgyal mtshan rje/ /ris med 'gro ngor thang stong rgyal por sprul/ /da lta'i dus 'dir 'gro mgon zhabs dkar pa/ /ma 'ongs mngon dga' la sogs rigs lnga yi/ /zhing du rigs kyi bdag po de dag gi /drung du sras kyi thu bo re rer gyur/ /'brel thogs gang 'dod zhing du 'dren par 'gyur/ /'das dang ma 'ongs da lta dus gsum du/ /gang la gang 'dul sna tshogs skur bstan nas/ /bstan dang 'gro don mdzad pa'i thugs rje can/ /skyabs mgon yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs/ /phyogs bcu'i zhing khams bye ba phrag brgya ru/ /bskal pa rgya mtshor btsal kyang rnyed dka' zhing / /rnyed pa don che yid bzhin nor bu las/ /lhag pa'i bla mar mjal ba skal ba bzang / /bdag ni deng nas tshe rabs thams cad du/ /mgon po khyod dang nam yang mi 'bral zhing / /gsung gi bdud rtsis bdag rgyud smin grol nas/ /rang gzhan don gnyis lhun gyes 'grub par shog /ces smras pas slob ma yon bdag kun gyi 967

dad pa'i gsos su gyur to/ /yang gnas der chos rgyal lha rgya ri rin po che'i sras mo chos byed du 'ongs pa rab tu byung / mtshan lhag bsam sgrol mar btags/ mo rang gi mgo rgyan lus chas phal cher/ mchod sgam gnyis dang / nang tshang can gyi 'bol gdan bzang po dang bcas te dngul srang brgya lhag tsam gyi rtsis phul/ gzhan zangs ri dang / sgrags kyi chos la sogs chos byed mkhan gyi grwa btsun pho mo mang po byung / de rnams la chos bzhin 'dul ba bzhin byed dgos tshul rgyas par bshad pas/ sdom gtsang gi chos pa mang po byung / gnas de nas 'gro la nye dus grwa btsun rnams kyis bsdus nas tshogs rgya chen po btang /sku gsung thugs rten gyis 'go byas bka' drin gtang rag gi yon rang rang la gang yod rnams phul nas/ skye ba nas tshe rabs thams cad du rjes su 'dzin pa'i skyabs 'jug zhus pa'i dus su/ bdag gis kyang de lugs kyi skyabs 'jug bsngo smon rgya chen po byas pa'i mthar zhal gdams 'di byin no//skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum po la/ /skyabs su mchi'o byin gyis rlobs//skyabs mgon yid bzhin nor bu yis//skyabs dang skyel ma mdzad du gsol/ /rnal 'byor dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi//skyes pa'i pha yul mi gcig kyang / /sngon gyi las bzang 968

smon lam mthus/ /su yis nam yang ma bsdus bzhin/ /la la mnga' ris stod nas 'ongs//la la mdo khams smad nas 'ongs//la la dbus gtsang bar nas 'ongs/ /da lta gnas 'dir yud tsam 'dus/ /da ni 'dus byas mi rtag tshul/ /ston phyir so sor gyes nas 'gro /la la ri khrod dben pa ru/ /sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzugs su 'gro /la la rgyal khams phyogs med kyi/ /gnas chen bzang po bskor du 'gro /la la rang gi pha yul gye/ /drin can pha mar phrad du 'gro /mig gis bltas na mi mthong zhing / /rna bas nyan na mi thos pa'i/ /rang rang yul du log tsa na/ /phyin chad tshe 'dir mjal bar dka'/ /skyes pa 'chi zhing 'dus pa 'bral/ /bsags pa 'dzad cing mthon po ltung / /'jig rten 'khor ba'i chos rnams kun/ /mi rtag mi brtan snying po med/ /'dir 'tshogs skal ldan pho mo kun//'chi ba nam yong mi shes pas/ /tshe 'di'i bya ba blos thongs la/ /thams cad dam pa'i lha chos mdzod//rnal 'byor 'gro kha'i snying gtam 'di//khyed rnams kun gyis snying la zungs/ /tshe ring nad med smon lam 'debs/ /bde zhing skyid pa'i bkra shis shog /ces smras pas thams cad kyis 'dus byas mi rtag pa'i tshul la bsams nas skyo ba skye mkhan mang po byung / de nas 'gro khar slob ma yon 969

bdag mang pos phul ba'i steng nas tshogs rgya chen po btang /thag ring du 'gro mkhan rnams la gos lham lam chas byen rten bsrung mdud rnams byin nas yang sems skyo ba'i shugs kyis mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so//skyabs mgon yid bzhin nor bu mchog /spyi gtsug bde chen rgyan du bzhugs/ /bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas la//mchog thun dngos grub char bzhin phob/ /'dir 'tshogs skal ldan pho mo rnams/ /da ni ring por mi thogs par/ /tshong 'dus mgron po bzhin du gyes/ /rang rang gang 'dod gnas su 'gro /yul phyogs so sor song tsa na/ /sa yang kha thag ring ba'i mthus/ /khyed kun mar la 'ong mi nus//re gnyis tsam re yong na yang / /lam na dgra jag 'jigs pa che/ /chu chen mang po bgrod par dka'/ /nga ni yar la 'ong snyam yang //da lta na so rgas pa'i khar/ /na dang 'chi ba nam yong med/ /'on kyang mchog gsum thugs rje yis/ /gal te ma shi tshe ring na/ /lan cig phrad phyir 'ong thub kyang / /khyed rnams nang nas phal cher zhig /na so rgas nas 'chi ba mang / /gzhon nu rnams tsho sdod snyam kyang / /deng sang tshe la bar chad mang / /gzhon rung sdod pa'i nges pa med/ /gang gi sa nas bsams na yang / /phyin chad mjal bar 970

mi 'gyur snyam/ /bsam zhing skyo ba gting nas skyes/ /snga sor mjal ba'i gnas skabs kyang / /da lta bsams na yud tsam gda'/ /da ni so sor gyes kha ru/ /sems 'phreng 'bral glags mi phod rung //mig nas mchi ma 'khrigs bzhin du/ /sems la phan pa'i snying gtam dang //lus la phan pa'i zas gos re//ster ba ma gtogs bya thabs med/ /khyed rnams phyin chad phrad na yang / /pha ma spun zla phrad pa ltar//gcig gis gcig la brtse gdung gyis/ /lto gos chos kyis phan thogs mdzod/ /sbyin bdag rnams kyis bla ma la//bsams nas slob ma nyam thag dang / /bdag med nad pa sprang po la/ /zas gos nor gyes phan thogs mdzod//dper na bu la phan btags na/ /pha ma gting nas dga' ba ltar/ /nyam thag 'gro la phan btags na//nga yang dga' zhing spro bar nges//bla ma dgyes pa'i bsod nams kyis/ /dad can sbyin bdag su yin yang / /deng nas byang chub ma thob bar/ /dga' bde'i dpal la spyod par 'gyur/ /byams dang snying rje byang chub sems/ /kun gye rgyud la skye bar shog /yul phyogs kun tu lo legs shing / /chos dang bkra shis 'phel bar shog /ces blangs/ gzhan yang 'di phyir phan pa'i bslab bya mang po byas nas slob ma rnams kyi nang nas phal che ba yul phyogs gzhan gyi ri khrod la btang bas/ de 971

kun nged dpon slob rjes na gnas pa rnams la 'phreng nas mig nas mchi ma gtong bzhin du song ngo / /de nas bdag kyang mdo smad la chas dus/ skal ldan snying gi bu mchog bla ma kun bzang rang grol kyang stod phyogs kyi ri khrod la 'gro khar bdag la bde zhus kyi dbyangs 'di phul lo//steng lha lam yangs pa'i rgyan gcig pu/ /khyed bcu gnyis bdag po bde bar phebs/ /gling gzhan gsum 'khor nas ring min du/ /slar 'dzam gling nam mkha'i rgyan shar nas/ /'od 'bum phrag phyogs bcur 'gyed pa'i tshe/ /nga pad dkar gtso byas chu skyes rnams/ /mdog rab gsal 'dab ma bzhad bzhin du/ /lha dkon mchog mchod pa'i smon lam 'tshal/ /bar chu 'dzin 'khrigs dbus rgyan gcig pu/ /khyed g.yu 'brug sngon mo bde bar phebs/ /rdza ri brag 'khor nas ring min du//slar sprin phung 'khrigs pa'e dbus byon nas/ /sgra snyan la ldir ba sgrog pa'i tshe/ /nga rma byas gtso byas gnyis skyes rnams/ /mdog rab mdzes sgo mdongs ngom bzhin du/ /kun dga' ba'i zlos gar bsgyur bar smon/ /sa dbus gtsang ru bzhi'i rgyan gcig pu/ /pha bla ma yab sras bde bar phebs/ /yul mdo smad 'khor nas ring min du/ /slar dbus gtsang yul 'dir myur byon nas/ /chos 'jig 972

rten gsung gleng sgog pa'i tshe/ /nga kun bzang gtso byas slob bu rnams/ /nyams rtogs pa'i yon tan 'bar bzhin du/ /mgon khyod dang zhal mjal smon lam 'tshal/ /slar bkra shis nyi mar zhal mjal dus/ /bkra shis pas phyogs 'di khyab gyur cig /bkra shis pas phyogs 'di khyab pa'i mthus/ /kun chos bzhin spyod pa'i bkra shis shog /ces phul nas grogs slob ma 'ga' dang bcas yar stod kyi gnas chen rnams su sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin du phebs so/ /bdag cag dpon slob rnams kyang gdan sa mthil nas 'thon pa'i nyin gnas der bzhugs pa'i dge 'dun pa rnams kyis mdun gyi ri gdong bar du bskyal nas gyes khar kun skye ba nas tshe rabs thams cad du mjal ba'i smon lam gyi mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so//rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang / /spyi gtsug 'khor lo'i rgyan du bzhugs/ /'dir 'tshogs tshe 'di'i bar chad sol//phyi mar 'gro dus lam sna drongs//rnal 'byor dpon slob 'khor bcas kun/ /'dus nas so sor gyes pa ltar/ /chos rnams mi rtag 'di dang 'dra/ /de la soms la lha chos mdzod/ /rnal 'byor dpon slob 'khor bcas kun/ /da res mjal ba skal ba bzang / /da ni so sor gyes gyur na/ /sa yang kha thag ring dang gcig /nga rnal 973

'byor na so rgas dang gnyis/ /nam 'chi nges pa med dang gsum/ /de gsum 'dzom pa'i dus tshod na/ /phyin chad yang yang mjal ba dka'/ /'on kyang tshe mjug 'di nyid la/ /thugs yid 'dres pa'i dpon slob rnams/ /mjal na 'dod pa'i dus skabs su//dngos su yang yang mjal bar shog /dngos su mjal bar ma gyur na/ /mjal na 'dod pa'i dus skabs su/ /nyams dang rmi lam gnas skabs su/ /yang dang yang du mjal bar shog /gal te tshe 'dir ma mjal na/ /skye ba 'di yi 'og rol tu/ /mngon dga' la sogs sangs rgyas kyi/ /zhing nas mngon sum mjal bar shog /yul phyogs kun tu bkra shis shing / /mi nad phyugs nad rgyun chad nas/ /tshe ring nad med lo phyugs legs/ /thams cad bde zhing skyid par shog /ces blangs pa'i mthar kun bdag la zhe 'phreng bzhin phyir phebs/ nged dpon slob rnams zangs ri sde pa rdo rje dang lcam gnyis kyi gzhis gar song / lam nas mnga' ris grwa tshang la mang ja zhig 'bul du btang / skyabs 'jug zhus/ zangs ri'i gzhis 1ka nas zhag 'ga' bsdad/ tshe dbang bskur/ chos bshad kha ta mang po byas te thams cad kyi snang ba chos la bsgyur/ yon bdag pho mo rnams kyis lus kyi rgyan gos dang / dngul ṭaṃ mang po byen/ ma 974

cig gi gdan sa zangs ri mkhar dmar gye gnas kyi rten rnams la mjal/ mchod 'bul byas smon lam btab/ de nas gtsang po la ko gru btang nas chu yi pha khar song / rtswa chang dga' dang / g.yu khang mkhan po zhi ba tshe ring rnams kyi nang du song /tshe dbang bskur/ sems khrid byas/ tshogs kyi dga' ston phul te glu shes pa rnams kyis glu blangs/ zhabs bro brgyab/ de dus dad can chos drung shes rab sgol mas skyabs 'jug gi mgur dbyangs 'di phul lo//skyabs mgon bka' drin gye 'khor med/ /rje btsun tshogs drug gi rang grol//snying nas gsol ba rang 'debs so/ /thugs rje byin rlabs kun stsol cig /dung dung mos gus kyi ngang nas//chos drung shes rab kyi sgol ma'i/ /lhang lhang gdung shugs kyi dbyangs la/ /snyan dbang dar cig rang gsan 'tshal/ /'khor ba'i nyes dmigs kun bsam zhing / /skyo shas nges 'byung gis rgyud bskul/ /thar pa'i phan yon rnams dran pas/ /dad pas lhag bsam ni rab dkar/ /rgyu 'bras bslu med du nges pas/ /blang dor ma nor bar spyod cing / /ma gyur 'gro kun gyi don du/ /byang chub 'thob pa zhig smon no/ /rgyal kun sku gsum gye ngo bo / /skyabs mgon yid bzhin gyi nor bu/ /'bral med spyi bo ru 975

bsgoms nas//bka' bzhin sgrub pa yis mchod do/ /rjes 'jug bu mo nga'i gtan 'dun/ /skyabs mgon rje btsun khyed ma.o no/ /bdag gis dus gsum gyi dge tshogs/ /gang bsags nus mthu la brten nas/ /nyams dga' dben pa yi gnas su/ /rtse gcig rnal 'byor la brtson zhing / /skyabs mgon rdo rje yi 'chang dang / /thugs yid gcig 'dres/ su gyur te/ /bdag gzhan don gnyis kun lhun grub/ /skyabs 'jug thugs rje yis gzigs shig /mdor na deng nas rang bzung ste/ /ji srid tshe rabs kun 'bral med/ /de srid skyabs mgon rje bla ma'i/ /thugs kyi sras mchog tu bdag gyer/ /gar bzhugs dag pa yi zhing khams/ /ngo mtshar gzhal med kyi pho brang / /byang chub spyod pa ni yid 'ong / /yongs su rdzogs pa ru gyur cig /ces blangs/ gzhan yang mgur dbyangs mang po blangs nas dga' dga' spro spro byas/ de nas mdo smad du 'gro ba'i rdzongs pa la/ mkhan po nas rgyal ba 'jam dpal rgya mtsho'i sku 'gags/ mchod rten gyi gser thang thub dbang gi bris thang / sa skya'i bdud rtsi ril bu las grub pa'i sku 'dra byen can mang po/ sangs rgyas kyi 'phel gdung sogs byin rten khyad 'phags dang / dngul rdo tshad gcig kha btags nang mdzod a yu sha bcas byen/ de bzhin rtswa chang 976

dga' dang g.yu khang sogs nas gser g.yu bye ru'i rgyan cha/ther ma snam bu/ rtsam do mang po bcas byin/ thams cad yun ring 'dris pa'i stabs kyis 'bral ma phod par nyi ma kha shas sdod dgos byung / de nas 'gro khar 'bral mi phod rung / phan tshun kun gyi mig nas mchi ma gtong bzhin du bral nas yar song nas ne'u ring dgon/ deb ri dgon/ lab kyi gnas rnams la mjal/ mang ja 'gyed dang tshogs btang / de nas yar sde pa khang gsar nang du song / tshe dbang bskur chos bshad nas snang ba chos la bsgyur bas/ zas nor mang po byen/de nas lha rgya rir song / chos rgyal rin po che yab yum sras dang bcas pa la mjal/ chos 'brel bzhag de nas chos rgyal rin po ches gser sku li ma byen can gcig skyes rabs so bzhi ba'i thang ka bcu gsum/ bdud rtsi chos sman sogs byen rten mang po dang / gsang ye sogs dpe cha mang po gnang / 'gro khar skyabs 'jug zhu rten kha btags dang bcas te mgur dbyangs 'di phul lo//tshe 'di phyi bar do gang du yang / /blo gtad na mi bslu gtan gyi skyabs/ /rje rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang / /thugs brtse bas bdag la cung zad dgongs/ /spyir snyigs dus sems can tshe 977

thung zhing / /sgos tshe la bar chad rkyen ngan mang / /lus chu bur bzhin du 'jig par sla/ /rang gang la bsam kyang 'chi la nye/ /sprang gang du 'gro 'am 'dug kyang rung / /tshe bar chad med pa'i skyabs 'jug zhu/ /tshe phyi ma'i yul la 'gro dus su/ /yar lam sna drongs zhes gsol ba 'debs/ /lha'i sku gzugs bas kyang zhal ras mdzes/ /lha tshangs pa'i dbyangs las gsung gdangs snyan/ /lha'i gos dar bas kyang thugs 'jam pa'i/ /lha bla ma sku khams bde bar bzhugs/ /tshe 'di phyi bar do gang du yang / /dngos nyams dang rmi lam gnas skabs su/ /zhal mjal zhing gsung chos thos par smon/ /yid smon pa bzhin du 'grub par shog /ces yang yang mjal ba'i smon lam btab nas rong mchad dkar chos sder 'ong / mkhan rin po cher mjal/ phyag rten phul/ dgon par 'gyed mang ja btang / mkhan rin po che nas/ 'dul ba rnam rgyal gser mdog gi phyag dpe zhig gnang /thugs skyo ba'i rnam pa mang po mdzad par gda'/ bdag kyang sems 'phreng bzhin 'ong / de nas chos rgyal lha rgya ri'i rje btsun ma dpon slob gnyis kyis bskyal nas mar gyi thang zhig tu 'ong /mig nas mchi ma mang po gtong bzhin du bzhugs pa dang /bdag cag rnams kyang 'bral mi phod bzhin du gyes nas phyi 978

mig mang po lta bzhin yong / de nas rtse thang du song / rtse thang dgon par 'gyed mang ja btang / yar klung sgrol ma gsung 'byon dang / shel brag slob dpon gsung 'byon sogs rten gang yod la mjal mchod 'bul byas smon lam btab/ phyogs de'i rdzong dpon sbyin bdag rnams la chos bshad smon lam bkra shis brjod pas/ yon bdag rnams kyis zas nor gyi 'brel ba gang bzhag rnams blangs nas grwa nang du song / byams pa gling gi mchod rten chen po dang dgon par mjal mchod 'bul byas mang 'gyed btang / sde pa rdo rjes zhabs tog byas/ rgyal ba rigs lnga'i sku 'dra li ma lnga dang / ja mar rtsam pa gang mkho byin/de nas gsang sngags snga 'gyur bstan pa'i 'byung khungs/ chu 'go gangs la thug pa lta bu'i o rgyan smin grol gling gi dgon par song / khri pa gdung pa rje btsun ma rnams la mjal/ gser dngul g.yu byer gos dar mang bo'i phyag rten phul/ chos 'brel mang po zhus/ dge 'dun pa rnams la 'gyed mang ja btang /zhag po bdun bsdad phyag mchod skor ba byas/ 'gro khar tshur la byin rten gsol ras mang po gnang ba byung / rnying ma'i dgon pa'i nang na de 'dra'i gtsang ma dang skyid po zhig mi 'dug da dung bsdad na 'dod pa rang byung / de nas snga 'gyur bstan pa'i 979

srog shing lta bu'i rdo rje brag la song / sprul sku rin po cher mjal/phyag rten du dngul srang kha shas phul/ chos 'brel zhus/ dgon par mang ja gcig btang / de nas sgrags yang rdzong la mjal mchod 'bul byas/ zung mkhar theg chen gling pa'i sras gnyis la mjal/ sras che ba la chos 'brel zhus/ sras chung bar bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa phul/ thugs yid gcig 'dres byung / de nas lha sa ru 'ong / bka' blon zur khang gi nang du bsdad nas/mdo smad du 'gro ba'i gra bsgrigs/ mkhan po lcags zam pa dang / rgyal yum don 'grub sgol ma sogs sngar gyi slob ma yon bdag mang pos bos nas/ zas nor dang sku gsung thugs rten mang pos rdzongs pa byas/ bdag gis kyang 'gro khar kun gye nang du bkra shis smon lam brjod/ tshe 'di phyir phan pa'i bslab bya byas/ 'gro khar lha sa'i phyogs kyi dad can yongs la phan phyir zhal gdams 'di byen no//bla ma dkon mchog gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag gzhan chos dang mthun par byin gyis rlobs/ /mchod gnas jo bo yid bzhin nor bu gnyis/ /rtag tu mchod bstod bkur cig lha sa pa/ /gtan gyi skyabs gnas rgyal ba yab sras gnyis/ /kun gyi gtsug tu bkur cig lha sa pa/ /bod khams skyong ba'i 980

rgyal po su yin kyang / /de yi bka' khrims rtsis shig lha sa pa/ /bsod nams zhing mchog ser 'bras dge gsum la/ /'gyed phogs mang ja thongs shig lha sa pa/ /'gro kun skye ba sngon ma'i pha ma yin/ /byams dang snying rje sgoms shig lha sa pa/ /lha ldan phyi skor lam gyi khye rgan dang / /sprang por sbyin pa thongs shig lha sa pa/ /bshan pas ra lug g.yag gsum gsod la ltos/ /snying rjes srog blu gyes shig lha sa pa/ /rang gis khab kyis gtsags pa mi bzod par/ /gzhan srog gri yis ma gcod lha sa pa/ /sha yi phyir du sems can grangs med 'chi/ /sdig zas sha la ma dga' lha sa pa/ /mthon po rnams la phrag dog ma che bar/ /thams cad gong du khur cig lha sa pa/ /dma' ba rnams la sdang sems ma che bar/ /thams cad byams pas skyongs shig lha sa pa/ /mnyam pa rnams la 'gran sems ma che bar/ /thams cad mthun par 'grogs shig lha sa pa/ /mi ser med na dpon po su yis bkur/ /khral dang 'u lag ma mang lha sa pa/ /dpon po med na mi ser su yis skyong / /khrel med ngo log ma rgyag lha sa pa/ /bla ma med na chos 'khor su yis bskor/ /slob mas bla ma bkur cig lha sa pa/ /slob ma med na chos 'khor su la bskor/ /bla mas slob ma skyongs shig lha sa pa/ /dam pa'i chos la mi zab gang yang 981

med/ /don med phyogs ris ma che lha sa pa/ /bod du dar ba'i chos lugs gang la yang / /zhabs tog gang nus sgrubs shig lha sa pa/ /rgyal pos chad pa 'gel yang sku drag rnams/ /mthar spyugs btson du ma 'dzin lha sa pa/ /sku drag rnams kyis chags sdang 'gran sems kyis/ /rgyal por zhu log ma 'bul lha sa pa/ /rgya lo'i smon lam tshogs mchod chen mo'i dus/ don med 'khrug gzhi ma slong lha sa pa/ /ser 'bras grwa pa phal cher shed che yang / /gsod pa'i khas len ma byed lha sa pa//rdzong dpon rnams kyis rgan por chad pa bkal/ /rgan pos mi ser ma bcom lha sa pa/ /gcig pos gnod pa gcig po'i zhe la bzhag /gnod lan mjal res ma byed lha sa pa/ /sde pa gzhung gi bka' khrims zhabs 'dren du/ /mtheb gri pa rnams ma 'jog lha sa pa//mtheb gri pa yis phran bu'i nor brku yang / /gos rgyan bcad nas ma 'khyer lha sa pa/ /mtho dman 'bring gsum kun gyis rgyu 'bras rtsis/ /bde skyid nyi ma 'char ro lha sa pa/ /gtam 'di dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing khams kyi/ /mchog dman 'bring gsum yongs la phan par shog /yul phyogs kun tu bkra shis g.yang chags shing / /bkra shis chen pos sa gsum khyab gyur cig /ces pa byen nas las dang skal bar ldan pa'i gdul bya rnams 982

mngon mtho nges legs kyi lam bzang mchog la bkod/ de nas rtse ru skyabs mgon rgyal ba rin po che'i drung du thon phyag zhu ru song / skyabs 'jug zhus pas brtse bas bka' mang po phebs pa byung / 'gro khar snam bu ther ma ja mar sogs lam chas kyi gsol ras/ sangs rgyas kyi 'phel gdung bka' gdams lha bzhi'i byin rten le'u tshan mang po bsrung mdud chen po kha btags nang mdzod bcas bstsal pa byung / bod kyi rgyal po la thon phyag zhus pas/ gsol ras bdag rkyen byin rten mang po gnang / khyad par mdo smad bstan 'gro yongs la phan pa'i bka' shog ni/'jam dbyangs gong ma bdag po chen po'i bka'i lung gis/bod kyi las don khur 'dzin zhwa ser bstan pa 'dzin byed dpal ldan no min han rgyal tshab dga' ldan she re ke thu sha dzin ni bha dar kol hu sa ma ti pak+ṣir 'bod pa'i gtam/ 'dzam bu'i ljon pas mtshan pa'i gling chen por 'khod pa'i skye 'gro spyi dang /bye brag tsho chen zhe dgu/ o rod tsho ba bzhi/ mtsho khri gshog rgyal mo'i 'gram gnas dang / mdo khams sgang drug a mdo stod smad/ lcags mo mgo log rang ngan/ sbra nag sogs kyi sa'i char 'khod pa'i bla ma/ dpon po/ wang / pa'i 7 pa'i si/983

gung / ja sag tha'i ji/ ja'i sang / mi bzang sogs ser skya mchog dman bar mar bcas pa mtha' dag la bzlo ba/ a mdo pa bya bral tshogs drug rang grol zer ba 'di pa sngon goms bzang po'i bag chags kyi mthu brtas pa'i 'khor ba la nges 'byung gi bsam pas yid drangs te dam pa du ma'i drung nas mdo sngags kyi zab chos mang du mnos te dben gnas nges med du sgrub pa la nan tan du gzhol zhing 'brel tshad la chos dang zang zing gi sgo nas 'gro phan rgya cher bgyis par ma zad/bal yul mchod rten chen po bya rung kha shor dang / la stod gcung ri bo che'i mchod rten bkra shis sgo mang gnyis kyi chos 'khor bcu gsum la gser zangs kyi na bzas legs par brgyan song ba dang / lha ldan jo bo rin po che dang / bsam yas jo bo byang chub chen po/ dga' ldan gser gdung rin po che sogs la rin chen dang po las grub pa'i mchod kong gsar bskrun gyis phul thog mar me mchod sprin spel zhing / spu hrengs bshad 'phel gling dang / shel dkar chos sde bcas la gser zangs kyi gañji ra dang / 'khor lo sogs btsugs/ gnas chen la phyi rgyal gyi shrī'i byams chen sogs gtsug lag khang du mar nyams gso legs par bgyis shing / lha ldan smon lam chen 984

mo'i 'dus pa rgya mtshor mang 'gyed kyi bsnyen bkur gya nom phul song bas mtshon rnam par dkar ba'i spyod tshul rlabs chen du bgyis pa sogs sgo du ma nas gzhan phan lhag bsam dkar ba bcas/ slar yang yul phyogs kun tu 'di pas skye 'gro rnams la chos phyogs kyi bslab bya ji ltar 'doms pa rnams yid la rton pa'i dang ba dang lung dang mthun pa'i phan char gang 'gro las/ gnod 'gal log par 'gro ba ma byed/ tshul bzhin du sgrub pa rnams la mchog gsum gyi thugs rje bskul te 'di phyir dge ba'i skyabs 'jug bgyid pa yin/ zhes go bar bya ba'i yi ge kun 'dzin zhes pa sa pho byi ba'i lo'i zla3tshes25dge bar lha ldan ra sa 'phrul snang gi garnyol dang zung du 'brel ba'i thub bstan rnam rgyal tshe smon gling nas bris/ zhes pa gos chen la bris nas tham kha chen pos mnan nas gnang ba byung / bka' blon zur khang mchog nas kun mkhyen pad+ma dkar po'i gsung 'bum po ti bcu tham pa/ gzhan lam chas rtsam pa gang dgos rnams gnang / dga' ldan gser khri rin po che la mjal nas skyabs 'jug zhus pas/ sangs rgyas kyi gser sku li ma gcig gnang nas/ 'di khyed la phul nas bstan pa'i bdag po ru mnga' gsol ba yin gsungs/ 'gro khar rten 'brel yag po 'grigs 985

snyam nas dga'/ de nas mdo smad du 'ong ba'i nyin snga ma de la jo shāka rnam gnyis la mjal nas/ bstan 'gro yongs la phan pa'i smon lam rgya chen po btab pas mtshan mo rmi lam du/ nga dzu 'phrul gyis nam mkhar bya ltar 'phur nas nyi zla'i mtshams bar du song nas/ mdo smad phyogs su ltad mo bltas pas/ mtsho snying dang mu ge thang gnyis stong par 'dug pa mthong nas nga'i bsam pa la/ da nga la rdzu 'phrul ni 'dug mtsho sngon po'i dkyil gyi mtsho snying du/ lha ldan jo bo shākya mu ne rten brten pa dang bcas pa gdan drangs na bzang snyam/ dzu 'phrul gyis lag tu blangs nas/ ma nyams par steng du bzhag pas/ mtsho snying gang ba'i mtha' na sngo ljang ljon shing sna tshogs skyes pa'i rtse la/mtsho snying na gnas pa'i bya rigs mi 'dra ba bdun yod pa thams cad bsdad nas skad snyan sgog cing 'phur lding g.yo ba'i snang ba byung / yang mu ge thang la gong ma rin po che'i mdzod khang zhig gdan drangs na bzang snyam/ gong ma'i mdzod khang zhig rdzu 'phrul gyis lag tu blangs nas ma nyams par mu ge thang dkyil du bzhag pas phyogs bzhi nas chu rgyun bzhi byung ba/ mi dang srog chags mang pos 'thung skyid po byas 'dug pa'i snang ba byung / rmi lam de ni bdag gis chos dang zang zing gnyis kyi sgo 986

nas mdo smad kyi bstan 'gro yongs la phan thogs yong ba'i rten 'brel yin nam snyam pa byung ngo //smras pa/ dbang phyug chen po tshangs pa brgya byin sogs/ /dbang can kun gyi spyi bo'i gtsug gi rgyan/ /dbang phyug brgyad ldan shākya'i rgyal po mchod/ /dbang bskur byen rlobs dngos grub char bzhin phob/ /bla ma'i rnam thar lan re bsams na yang / /rang gzhan don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub pa'i phyir/ /dbus gtsang zhing nas 'gro don byas pa'i tshul/ /slar yang glu ru len gyis dga' bas nyon/ /la phyi'i gnas nas dpon slob mang po dang / /bcas te gnya' nang grod pa phug tu 'ongs/ /dgon pa 'phel rgyas gling gi 'du khang gi/ /steng du gser gyi rgyal mtshan 'khor lo btsugs/ /nang du dngul gyi mchod kong chen po bzhag /tshong 'dus song nas bal po'i tshong pa yis/ /dmar mchod rgyag pa bcad nas dkar mchod bsgyur/ /lha rnams dgyes pa'i rtags su nam mkha' la/ /'ja' tshon shar zhing me tog char ba babs/ /de nas gnya' nang stod smad bar gsum la/ /chos bshad ra lug mang po'i tshe thar btang / /zur tsho ding rir 'ongs nas 'gro don byas/ /srog gcod sdig pa spong mkhan mang po byung / /ding ri'i tsong ye mda' dpon lcang lo can/ /987

gnyis kyis bkur zhing chos kyi 'brel ba bzhag /dam pa'i gdan sa glang bskor gnas su bsdad/ /zhi byed gdams par bltas pas dad pa skyes/ /rgyal gyi shrīr 'ongs nas sgrub la gzhol/ /bsam gling byams chen nyams pa zhig gso byas/ /steng du gser gyi 'khor lo zhig kyang btsugs/ /skal bzang skye bo stong phrag mang po la/ /ngo mtshar zab rgyas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /so sor gyes khar mi rtag skyo mgur blangs/ /dgung lo brgya lhag bzhes pa'i ne'u ring gi /grub dbang bla mar mjal nas tshe dbang zhus/ /shel dkar dgon du gser gyi 'khor lo btsugs/ /gzhung de'i yon bdag rnams la chos bshad byas/ /dgon byang bla mar byang gter dbang lung zhus/ /sa skyar song nas lha khang chen mor mjal/ /rin chen gser kong phul nas smon lam btab/ /rje btsun ma dang bla ma rnams la mjal/ /chos 'brel zhus nas byang gi lha rtser song / /yon po lung nas pad+ma rang grol dang / /mjal nas chos mthun gleng mo sna tshogs mdzad/ /ri bo bkra bzang slob dpon sku mdun du/ /bsod nams dar rgyas gser kong 'bul du bcug /lha rtse'i sde dgon la gnod gtsang po la/ /chu ldog byas pas phar phyogs shig la 'gyur/ /tsha rong phyogs su 'ongs nas 'gro don byas/ /ngor gyi 988

dgon par mjal nas dngul kong phul//de nas gzhis ka rtse ru 'ongs pa'i dus/ /lam nas ltad mo lta mkhan sum stong lhag /'dug pa mthong nas nga yang ngo mtshar skyes/ /bkra shis lhun por mjal nas mang 'gyed btang / /gser gdung gnyis la dngul kong lhung bzed phul/ /paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen par mjal ba'i tshe/ /khyod kyis mchod rten bkra shis sgo mang la/ /lhag bsam dag pas zhig gso gyis shig ces/ /gsungs pas bka' bzhin ri bo che ru song / mchod rten phyi nang gnyis ka nyams gso byas/ /chos 'khor gdugs tog rin chen gser las bskrun/ /slar yang skyabs mgon rin po che la mjal/ /khong gi thugs dgyes tshe dbang bka' chos gnang / /gsol ras bdag rkyen khyer nas lha sar 'ong / /'di phyi'i skyabs mgon rgyal ba rin po che/ /bod kyi rgyal por mjal nas chos 'brel zhus/ /mkhar rdo'i dgon par song nas mtshams la bsdad/ /skabs shig slob ma rnams la chos 'khor bskor/ /mkhar rdo sprul pa'i sku yi khri 'don mdzad/ /smon lam chen mor mang ja ṭaṃ 'gyed btang / /ser ra'i 'du khang nang du dngul kong bzhag /sa ga zla bar smyung gnas mang po bsrungs/ de nas dga' ldan bsam yas mjal du song / /gser gyi mchod kong nang du mar me phul//989

bstan 'gro yongs la phan pa'i sgon lam btab/ /gdan sa mthil du song nas mtshams la bsdad/ /las dang skal bar ldan pa'i gdul bya la/ /chos 'khor bskor nas smin grol lam la bkod/ /de nas mdo smad phyogs kyi gdan 'dren pa/ /byung bas lho kha'i yon bdag rnams la 'phrad/ /zangs ri yar lung smin gling rdo rje brag /sgrags kyi yang rdzong mjal nas lha sar 'ong / /rgyal ba rin po che dang rgyal tshab la/ /thon phyag zhus pas byin rten bka' shog gnang / /jo shākya gnyis la 'gro khar mchod 'bul byas/ /'gro don 'ong ba'i rmi lam yag po byung / /mdor na dbus gtsang phyogs nas 'gro don byas/ /mchod rten bkra shis sgo mang nyams gso byas/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi rnam thar de ltar lags/ /rjes 'jug rnams kyang de bzhin skyong bar mdzod/ /glu 'di thos tshad skye bo pho mo yis/ /tshe rabs kun tu bla ma'i rnam thar bzhin/ /'gro don byed bzhin sa steng lha khang dang / /mchod rten rnams la nyams gso byed par shog /ces pa'ang bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o//990

mdo khams smad 'dir 'ongs nas bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i don chen bsgrubs tshul/bco lnga pa mdo khams smad 'dir 'ongs nas bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i don chen bsgrubs tshul ni/ kun 'dzin zhes pa sa pho bye ba'i lo'i sa ga zla ba'i tshes dgu'i nyin par/ rgyal ba'i gsung rab dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa'i po ti lnga brgya dang /byin rten rgyab gcig sku che chung brgya lhag thang ka brgyad cu/ dpon slob bco brgyad tsam gye lam brgyags dang bcas te lha ldan nas thon bla ma sbyin pa nor bu/ lo chen skal ldan sogs grwa btsun lnga bcu tsam gyes bskyal ba'i lam bar du/ stag lung yab sras dang / rwa sgreng khri chen rin po che'i sprul sku rnams la mjal/ phyag rten phul/ chos 'brel zhus/ rwa sgreng khu byug mchod par bsdad nas thams cad kyis phyag dang skor ba byas/sems la phan pa'i kha ta mang po byas pa'i mthar tshur thang bde sa zhig tu bskyal yong / dbon slob thams cad thang der bsdad/ngas khong tshor bka' bsgo byin rlabs byas nas sgye ba nas tshe rabs thams cad du mjal ba'i smon lam gyi mgur dbyangs 991

'di blangs so//gnas spyi gtsug pad zla'i gdan steng du/ /rje skyabs mgon yid bzhin nor bu bzhugs/ /yid mos gus gdungs pas gsol ba 'debs/ /mchog thun mong dngos grub char bzhin phob/ /las smon lam dag pas mtshams sbyar nas/ /nged dpon slob thang 'dir yud tsam 'tshogs/ /da mi sdod so sor gyes pa ltar/ /chos thams cad mi rtag 'di dang 'dra/ /tshe phyi mar nam 'gro cha med pas/ /khyed skal ldan snying gi slob bu rnams/ /tshe 'di yi bya ba blo yis thongs/ /rje dam pa gong ma'i rnam thar bzhin/ /sdom dam tshig mig 'bras bzhin du srungs//gnas yid 'ong dben pa'i sa phyogs su/ /byams snying rje byang chub sems kyi sgos/ /chos mdo sngags nyams su len par mdzod/ /mi nga ni rang yul mdo smad du/ /mgon thub pa'i bstan pa spel du 'gro/ /las skal bar ldan pa'i gdul bya rnams/ /yar sangs rgyas sa la 'god du 'gro/ /dpe brtse zhing dung ba'i ma bu bzhin/ /kun sems 'phreng 'bral glags mi phod rung / /smad mdo khams bstan 'gro'i don bsgrub phyir/ /stod dbus gtsang slob mar 'bral dgos byung / /rje bla ma dkon mchog thugs rje yis/ /bdag da dung ma shi tshe ring na/ /sa dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing 992

khams su/ /slar myur du 'ong ba'i smon lam 'debs/ /mi'i skye 'chi 'di la khrigs khrigs med//dus da nas tshe 'dir ma mjal na/ /tshe phyi mar dag pa'i zhing khams su/ /kun mjal nas bral ba med par shog /ces blangs nas/ da ni byang thang la skyel mi dgos/ thams cad 'di nas khrigs se sdod la/ nga nam mthong gi bar du ltos la yang yang mjal ba'i smon lam thobs/ ngas kyang khyed rnams sems kyi phugs la bzhag nas 'gro da dung mjal ba'i skal ba yod pas sems ma sdug nga yang rang yul la 'gro ba 'di red khyed rnams kyang re zhig gi bar du rang rang gi yul phyogs kyi ri khrod rnams su song la sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan tshugs dang / bla ma'i zhabs tog pha ma'i drin gzo sems can gye 'gro don de ka yin pas/ kun gyes ma brjed par sems la zungs zhes/ 'bral mi phod bzhin du bral nas 'ong dus/ bla ma sbyin pa nor bus 'go byas slob ma der 'tshogs pa rnams kyi nang nas mchi ma mi gtong ba gcig kyang mi 'dug 'ga' re skad chen pos ngu ba yang 'dug ngas kyang phyi mig mang po lta bzhin 'ong ba'i dus/ thams cad sa de nas yar la langs nas smug phung nge 'dug pa mthong bas 'gro ma phod par kha phyir phyogs te re zhig bsdad nas tshur log 'ongs pas ma mthong ba dang lhag par 993

'dug rgyu zhig byung / khong rnams kyis kyang nam mthong gi bar du mig nas mchi ma g.yo bzhin du bsdad nas/ ma mthong tshe lhag par du mchi ma mang po zhig gtong bzhin so so'i gnas su rim pa bzhin du song ngo / /de nas nags chu kha pa dang / mtsho mo ra/ sde dge ri shor ba rnams kyi yul du song nas 'gro don byas pas/ rta mdzo khal ma bzhi bcu dang mar ltang mang po phul byung / gang yod thams cad khal ma de rnams la bkal nas/gzhung gi gos sgrub pa/ zi ling sgar dpon/ tshong dbon mang po dang 'grogs te byang lam ring mo bcad nas yong / 'bri chu'i thag nyer slebs pa'i tshe/mgo log gi jag pa stong phrag lhag tsam zhig byung nas/ nged rnams dang tshong dpon gzhan thams cad sdeb gcig la blangs so/ /rgyu mtshan bshad skyabs mgon paṇa chen rgyal tshab rnam gnyis kyi bka' shog bstan pas/ sgar dpon gos sgrub pa nged gsum gyi rta mdzo khal dang bcas pa phyir sprad byung /tshong dpon gzhan rnams kyi khal ma blangs do po thams cad bshigs nas snam ther sogs nom pa rnams blangs/sku gsung thugs rten dang byin rten ril bu rnams sa la pho nas jag pa rnams song ngo / /'bri chu rgyas nas ma thar bar zla ba gcig dang zhag bcu tsam sdod dgos byung /de'i bar la shor ma 994

bdun cu rtsa gsum tsam la ngas rtsam thug re byin/ sha 'dra zos nas bsdad kyang / bro kha tshar song na shor ma thams cad mu ges 'chi ba la snying rje nas bla ma ska la ldan rin bo ches snying stobs chen pos lus srog la ma bltas par chu la rab btsal ba'i phyir phebs nas/ chu che ba'i rkyen byas zhing gshegs pas sems la skyo ba tshad las 'das pa byung nas smre sngags 'di ltar thal lo//gdul bya rtag 'dzin phyi bshol mkhan/ /thams cad chos la bskul ba'i phyir/ /gzugs sku mya ngan 'das pa'i tshul/ /ston pa rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /sngon dus ston pa sangs rgyas kyis/ /bdag cag chos la bskul ba'i phyir/ /rtswa mchog grong nas gshegs tshul bstan/ /de dus dgra bcom grangs med gshegs/ /shā ri'i bu dang moṅgal bu/ /gshegs dus dgra bcom grangs med gshegs/ /'dzam gling rgyan drug mchog gnyis sogs/ /rgya bod mkhas grub rnams kyang gshegs/ /dam pa gong ma gshegs shul du/ /chos rgyal ngag gi dbang bo sogs/ /zhal mjal gsung thos bla ma'i rigs/ /gshegs pa'i tshul bsam skyo ba skyes/ /khyad par lho brag mar pa'i sras/ /dar ma mdo sde rtas 'phangs nas/ /gshegs dus khog pa'i snying thon bzhin/ /yab yum thugs khral byung ba ltar/ /de bzhin bla ma rin po ches/ /shor ma thams cad 995
