snying rje nas/ /chu la rab cig e rnyed phyir/ /phebs pas chu yis rkyen byas gshegs/ /kye hud yid bzhin nor bu mchog /glo bur chu la shor ba las/ /lhag pa'i 'gyod pa gting nas skyes/ /mig nas mchi ma char bzhin babs/ /de ltar thams cad mi rtag pa'i/ /tshul la bsams nas lha chos byed/ /lha chos byas pa'i bsod nams kun/ /skal ldan bu la phan phyir bsngo/ /de mthus bla ma rin po che/ /mkha' spyod zhing du skye bar shog /ces mya ngan chen po byas/ mig nas mchi ma yang yang btang bas khong gi thugs rjes sgu gshegs pa'i 'og nas chu la rab cig byung / de dus dbus la yar 'gro ba'i sbra nag khag gsum gye rang gi sngar gyi yon bdag mang po 'bri chu'i phar khar slebs pa la skad btang bas/ nang nas chu pa mang po yod pa rnams kyis mdzo rta mang po khyer yong nas shor ma rnams len rogs byas/ thams cad chu yi pha rol tu nyes skyon med par thon/ sgu gzhogs rnye thams cad mkhyen pa dang / ban gsar rin po cher mjal/'khyams ru'i nor bu sogs sbra nag khag gsum gyi dad can yon bdag pho mo mang por 'phrad pas dga' spro tshad las 'das pa byung / nyin gcig bsdad nas tshe dbang bskur byin rten mang po byen pas/khong rnams kyis ja mar rtsam pa khal rgyab 996

bco brgyad/ de rnams 'gel ba'i khal rta dang bcas byin pas/shor ma thams cad mu ges ma shi bar yul du thon pa yon bdag de rnams kyi bka' drin yin snyam pa rjes su yang yang yid la dran pa byung / de nas mar 'ong sde pa gzhung gi mkhan po nang so tshong dpon yar 'gro rnams la thug de tshos kyang ja mar rtsam pa mang po byen/ de rnams la brten nas shor ma bdun cu lhag tsam 'ig lto gos kyis bskyangs nas 'ongs/ sgar dpon gyis nyin gcig co ne'i phyogs kyi yin pa'i lag rdo ba zhig bzhag btang ba ngas snying rje nas lam bar nas bsdad de/ slob bu grub chen snga dro gcig gi lam du phyir song nas khyer 'ong /thams cad kyis dka' las mang po myong bzhin du 'ongs/ ha tho'i la mgo nas mtsho snying mthong bas/ gnas de na sngar bzhugs pa'i rtsa ba'i bla ma bstan 'dzin nyi ma rin po che dran nas 'di skad ces smras/'di phyi'i gtan gyi skyabs mgon rje/ /mtshan ldan bla ma rin po che/ /bde ba can gyi zhing khams nas/ /thugs rjes gzigs la byen gyes rlobs/ /sngon dus mtsho snying dben pa na/ /yod dus rang yang na so gzhon/ /mtshan ldan bla ma sku khams bzang / /dbus su song rung tshe mjug 'dir/ /bla ma lan cig 997

mjal yong snyam/ /dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing du song / /lo grangs mang por ma mjal tshe/ /skom pa rnams kyis chu 'dod bzhin/ /bla mar mjal 'dod snying nas skyes/ /byang lam ring mo bcad nas 'ongs/ /de ring mtsho snying mthong sa ru/ /slebs dus bla ma mi bzhugs par/ /zhing khams gzhan du gshegs pa thos /skyo shas nges 'byung snying rlung langs/ /da lta bzhugs na dga' ba la/ /mjal nas zhabs tog byed snying 'dod/ /yud tsam mjal rung rab dga'i sa/ /thob pa tsam gye dga' spro yong / /kye hud bdag cag bsod nams dman/ /dpon slob 'dzom pa'i dus ma byung / /sngon dus mtsho snying dben pa ru/ /bzhugs tshul dran nas mchi ma shor/ /phyogs der lha phyag mang po byas/ /gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjes gzigs/ /nam zhig 'chi ba byung dus su/ /bla ma khyed kyang legs byon la/ /bde ba can gye zhing khams su/ /thogs pa med par drang du gsol/ /dag pa'i zhing khams mang por song / /sangs rgyas thams cad mchod byed cing / /ma dag 'jig rten khams 'dir 'ong / /sems can thams cad 'dren par shog /ces smras nas mtsho khar 'ong ngal gso sa nas bsdad tshe/ lha rams pa rnams kyis gtso byas sog phyogs kyi shor ma grwa pa rnams kyis khyed kyi thugs rjes srog thar 998

pa byung zhes thams cad dga' spro tshad las 'das pa byung /bka' drin gtang rag tu dngul phul ba rnams phyir byin nas/rang rang so so'i gnas su 'gro khar gcig sems gcig la 'phreng nas mchi ma mang po gtong bzhin du song ngo / /mtsho sngon pa'i kha nas/ a rig gi slob rwa/ khrom tsha'i gcod pas 'go byas sngar ngo shes pa'i slob ma yon bdag mang por phrad pas sems dga'/ gcod pa la mkhar rdo rin po che'i dgongs gter gyi lha'i thang ka rgyab na yab sras gnyis ga'i phyag tham yod pa zhig dad rten du byen/ a rig gi thag nye na sde dge'i 'brog nga lnga bcu tsam 'dug pas nang du bos nas song bas rta mdzo 'bri g.yag mang po phul/ de rnams la na bza' byin rten mang po byen/ de dus slob bu grub dbang pad+ma rang grol dang khong gi yab a ka dpon g.yog 'ga' zhig la/ dbon tshang ching wang rin po che nas 'tshams zhus yi ge kha btags bcas gnang ba khyer nas mtsho sngon po'i khar 'ong kyang / nga zi ling du song ba dang thug nas ma mjal tshe/ phyir phebs nas sgo me'i phyogs na bsgugs nas bzhugs 'dug nga de dus stong skor brgyud nas zi ling du song / a 'ban la 'tshams zhus phul/ thugs brtse ba'i sgo nas khyod kyis shor ma mang po mu ges 'chi ru ma bcug 999

par/ zas gos kyis bskyangs nas 'ong ba shin tu bzang de la nga sems dga' ba yin gsung ja gos sogs kyi bdag rkyen byas/ de nas tshur sku 'bum du 'ong bla ma khri pa la mjal/ bla ma skal ldan gyi dgongs rdzogs su dmigs nas bla ma yod tshad la mdzo rta kha shas phul nas skyabs 'jug zhus/ dge 'dun gye sde la mang ja dang dong tse khron sum brgya'i 'gyed btang / gser gdung rin po che la bye ru'i phreng ba rin chen du ma'i rgyan ldan dang / rgya dngul srang drug gi dngul kong / mar me brgya mchod bcas phul nas bstan 'gro yongs la phan pa'i sgon lam btab/zhag po bcu gsum la ngal gsos nas bsdad/ phyag skor ba kha shas byas/ de nas tshur nang gi rdis tsha ru 'ongs/ sngags pa mang pos zhabs tog byas/ grub dbang pad+ma rang grol dpon g.yog 'khor bcas la mjal/ rta gcig mar rkyal gcig ching wang gi 'tshams zhus kha btags dang yi ge rnams byin pas sems dga' ba byung / 'tshams rtags la sku gsung thugs rten 'phel gdung byin rlabs rten gsum khyad 'phags na bza' stod 'gags rin chen rgyan gyis mdzes pa'i phreng ba rnams phul/ching wang rin po che la sgu gsung thugs rten sangs rgyas kyi 'phel gdung / byi ru lha rdzas bcas phul bas thugs mnyes/1000

rjes nas bkra shis 'khyil du dngul srang lnga bcu ma gcig bskur byung / de dus sgo me'i phyogs kyi mjal ba mang po rma khar 'ong / phyug po 'ga' zhig gis rta phul bas/ rta gsum ja nag bzhi kha btags mang po byung / de nas rma chu'i tshur khar 'ongs/khri ga'i jo bo'i lha khang la mjal/ mchod 'bul byas zhag kha shas bsdad pas/ jo khang khor yug kun khri ga'i phyogs kyi skya ser pho mo stong phrag mang pos gang ba byung / de rnams la mjal kha btang / thun mong gi chos bshad byas/ rigs gsum mgon po dang dmigs brtse ma/ badz+ra gu ru tshe gzungs rnams kyi lung byas pa'i mjug tu mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so//sangs rgyas thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag cag rjes 'jug yongs la thugs rjes gzigs/ /dge ba'i phan yon snyan pa'i glu ru len/ /khyed rnams ma yengs dga' ba'i sems kyis nyon/ /dkon mchog gsum la spos sam me tog gcig /tsam gyes mchod kyang mi g.yo'i zhing du skye/ /mar me phul bas phyi mar gzugs byad mdzes/ /rab tu gsal ba'i lha mig 'thob par 'gyur/ /dge 'dun rnams la 'khor g.yog phul gyur na/ /tshe rabs kun tu rgyal po chen por 'gyur/ /zhing sa lo tog bcas te phul gyur na/ /mtho ris lha mchog bde ba rab 1001

'phel 'gyur/ /pha ma bkur na smad par mi 'gyur la/ /phyi ma mtho ris gnas su 'gro bar 'gyur/ /kha zas byin pas tshe ring mdog bzang zhing / /stobs ldan zas nor longs spyod che bar 'gyur/ /btung ba byin pas dbang bo kun tshang zhing / /skom dus btung ba zhim po 'thob par 'gyur/ /gon pa byin pas gzugs bzang kha dog legs/ /tshe rabs kun tu gos bzang rnyed par 'gyur/ /bzhon pa byin pas rdzu 'phrul rkang ba bzhi/ /thob cing gang 'dod zhing du 'gro bar 'gyur/ /bzhon ma byin pas stobs che mdog bzang zhing / /'o zho mar sogs longs spyod che bar 'gyur/ /grog tshang chen por sbyin pa btang gyur na/ /yul gru chen po'i rgyal por skye bar 'gyur/ /chos kyi sbyin pa btang na mngon shes 'char/ /tshe rabs dran zhing myur du sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /gru zam lam ngan bcos na tshe rabs kun/ /bde nas bde bar 'gro zhing kun gyes bkur/ /sku gsung thugs rten bzhengs na tshe bsod rgyas/ /gnas skabs bde zhing mthar thug sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /phyag skor byas na lus kyis non tshad kyi/ /sa rdul grangs mnyam 'khor los bsgyur bar skye/ /ma ṇi bton na nad med skye ba dran/ /'chi tshe bde ba can du skye bar 'gyur/ /snying rje che na tshe ring lha chos 'ong / /zhi bar mi gnas sems can 'dren 1002

par 'gyur/ /glu 'di thos tshad sgye bo pho mo yis/ /dge ba byas nas myur du sa ngas rgyas shog /ces blangs pas der 'tshogs pa'i khrom lha mi thams cad rab tu dga' zhing dad par gyur/de dus gnub kham ra'i sngags mang gi 'tshams zhu ba byung nas ja nag mang po phul/ de rnams la dad rten du dbus thang zhig phul/ rang gi pha yul zho 'ong la kha'i dpon po bkra lo tshe lo rnams kyis gtso byas rta ba rkang thang brgya tsam gyi bsu ba byung /mjal bas thams cad sems dga' bar gyur / de nas yar song khri ga'i yul lhar mjal/ gos chen gser dngul gyi mdzub dkres gnyis g.yu bye ru kha shas bcas phul/ bstan 'gro yongs la phan pa'i 'phrin bcol byas/ 'jam mo'i bla ma che chung gnyis dang / sku gzhogs zhabs drung dkar po rnam gsum la mjal/sku gsung thugs rten 'phel gdung byin rten khyad 'phags dang /bla dzab kyi gsol can phreng ba bcas phul/ chos 'brel zhus/tshur la yang khong rnams kyi rta gos la sogs pa'i gsol ras bdag rkyen mang po byung / de nas khri ga'i sde gzhung gi dgon pa rnams la mjal byen rten phul/ sde pa'i skye bo pho mo la chos bshad bsngo smon bkra shis brjod pas/ dad can rnams kyis nas dang dong tse ras kha kha btags phul ba khron sum brgya lhag 1003

tsam gyi rtsis byung ba sku 'bum gyi 'gyed dong tse bskyis pa'i tshab tu sprad/ de nas rim gyis reb gong gser mo ljongs su 'ong /thang la khar rong po'i dgon chen gyi shar thams cad mkhyen pa'i phyag mdzod nang chen rnams kyi rta bsu ba mang po 'byor/ de dang 'grogs nas rong po'i dgon chen du 'ong / rong po'i nang du slebs pa'i nyin par nam mkha' la 'ja' tshon mang po shar ba rgya bod gnyis gas mthong bas/ rten 'brel yag po 'dug ces dad can thams cad sems dga' ba byung / de nas bdag gis thog mar sku gzhogs shar thams cad mkhyen pa rin po cher mjal/ na bza' cha tshang / khri snyan sa le'i pags pa rwa gnyis dang bcas pa/ gser zangs kyi tshe bum tshe dpag med kyi kha rgyan can/ gnas brtan bcu drug gi dbus thang spus gtsang gsum/ gsung 'bum sna tshogs kyi po ti brgyad cu gya brgyad/ rta gcig dre'u gcig g.yag nyi shu rtsa lnga sga dang bcas pa phul/ rigs gsum mgon po dang tshe gzungs yon tan gzhi gyur ma rnams kyi chos 'brel zhus/ rtsa ba'i bla ma gtsug gi nor bu ru bkur/ gzhan yang mkhan chen sprul sku dang / g.yer gshong sprul sku/ rong po tshang / sku gzhogs bsam 'grub/ byang rtse tshang / rdzong dkar che chung / bde chen che chung sogs rong 1004

po'i bla ma thams cad la mjal/ chos 'brel zhus/ nang chen thams cad la g.yag sga dang bcas pa re phul/ dgon pa'i grwa pa rnams la ja lan chen bcu yis 'gyed mang ja btang / de dus reb gong gi bla ma dpon po skya ser pho mo khri phrag mang po mjal du byung / nyi ma mang por mjal kha btang ba'i skabs su dad can gyi bla ma dpon po phal cher gyes/ khyed dang po pha yul nas phebs nas bzung da bar du/ gnas chen gang la phebs/ bla ma dang rten khyad par can ji tsam la mjal/ ltad mo ci 'dra gzigs/ nged rnams la de ring rgyas pa zhig gsung dgos zer ba'i lan du/ rang gis gnas chen rnams 'grims nas nyams len byas tshul/ bla ma dang rten mang por mjal zhing / sa cha yul phyogs kyi mi yi cha lugs mi gcig pa mang po mthong tshul rnams rgyas par bshad pa'i mjug tu mdor bsdus te tshigs su bcad nas smras pa/bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /bsam don 'grub par byen gyes rlobs//rnal 'byor tshogs drug rang grol ngas/ /'khor ba'i chos la skyo ba skyes/ /dang po skyes pa'i pha yul nas/ /thon te rdo bis dgon par song / /yongs 'dzin a rig dge bshes mjal/ /mdun nas dge slong sdom pa blangs/ /tshul khrims chos 1005

kyi rtsa bar go /dgongs bsrung 'dul ba'i nang bzhin byas/ /de nas sog po'i yul du song / /chos rgyal ngag gi dbang bor mjal/ /mdo sngags zung 'brel gdams pa thob/ /sdom gsum mig gi 'bras bzhin bsrungs/ /de nas rtse gzhung dben par song / /lo lnga'i bar du nyams len byas/ /chos rgyal yab yum bka' drin gyis/ /skyid cing nyams rtogs gong 'phel byung / /de nas mtsho snying dben par song / /lo gsum bar du nyams len byas/ /nyams dang rmi lam gnas skabs su/ /bla ma lha las chos nyan thos/ /bya rigs mi 'dra bdun tsam grags/ /nyams dga' snang ba spro ba byung / /de nas rma chen gangs la song / /zla ba dgu la nyams len byas/ /dngos sam nyams dang rmi lam la/ /lha yi zhal gzigs mang po byung / /tshur lam stabs ka yag po zhig /'phrod nas 'brong la zhon rgyu byung / /de nas brag dkar sprel rdzong song / /zla ba drug la nyams len byas/ /gnas de'i nang gi brag ngos kyi/ /rang byung lha sku mang por mjal/ /sbra nag khag gsum yon bdag gis/ /mthun rkyen char bzhin phab pa byung / /a ma shi bas rkyen byas nas/ /dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing du song / /lha ldan jo bo rnam gnyis mjal/ /sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes skyes/ /rgyal ba rin po che la mjal/ /phyag na pad+mo 1006

dngos su mthong / /rgyal ba'i pho brang bo ta la/ /brtsigs pa mi 'dra skyes pa 'dra/ /lha ldan mi yi rgyan gos mdzes/ /lha yi chas dang 'dra'am snyam/ /smon lam tshogs mchod chen mo yi/ /ngo mtshar ltad mo sna tshogs mthong / /de nas phyag mchod zhing gi mchog /dga' ldan gser gdung chen mor mjal/ /rgyal ba blo bzang grags pa la/ /dngos su mjal 'dra'i snang ba shar/ /de nas dpal gyi bsam yas song / /dbu rtse rigs gsum sogs la mjal//mkhan slob chos gsum sgu drin dran//dpag tu med pa'i dad pa skyes/ /bsam yas mdo sde mchod pa yi/ /ngo mtshar ltad mo sna tshogs mthong / /de nas tsā ri rong bskor du/ /song bas skyid sdug gnyis ka myang / /glo ba 'ga' re'i rna ba la/ /ting shags btags pa mthong nas bgad/ /tsā ri'i pho brang g.yu mtsho de/ /g.yu yi maṇ+ḍal bshams pa 'dra/ /grub chen rnams kyis ras rkyang mnabs/ /gangs khrod zhag gis bzhugs pa mthong / /gnas der lo gcig nyams len byas/ /nyams snang rnam pa sna tshogs byung / /tshur lam dwags la sgam por 'ong / /dwags po lha rje'i gdan sar mjal/ /bka' brgyud gong ma'i rnam thar dran/ /gnas der zla ba bzhi tsam bsdad/ /de nas bkra shis lhun por song / /paṇa chen rin po che la mjal/ /bde ldan zhing 1007

mgon dngos su mthong / /gtsug lag khang gi rgya phibs rnams/ /gser gyi nyi ma shar ba 'dra/ /de 'dra'i dgon chen skyid po zhig /'jig rten khams na dkon par gda'/ /de nas stod kyi phyogs su song / /jo bo dngul sku mched gsum mjal/ /spu hrengs mi rnams chos dad che/ /mthun rkyen ster mkhan mang po byung / /de nas gangs dkar te ser song / /lo gsum bar du mtshams la bsdad/ /bug sgor bsdad nas chos bshad byas/ /rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub pa byung / /gangs dkar te se zhes bya de/ /dper na shel gyi mchod rten 'dra//sa der gser gye thon khungs dang / /ka ra bu ram mang po gda'/ /de nas glo yi yul du song / /chu mig brgya rtsa zhes byar mjal/ /chu dang sa rdo'i khong gseng nas/ /rgyun du me zhig 'bar ba mthong / /de nas bal bod so mtshams song / /rang byung wa ti bzang por mjal/ /'phags pa de yi byen rlabs kyis/ /sa de'i mi rnams skyid par snang / /de nas bal yul mthil du song / /mchod rten chen po rnam gnyis mjal/ /dgun yang sngo ljang me tog bkra/ /nyams dga' lha yi yul dang 'dra/ /sna la gser gyi a long gi /rgyan gyis mdzes pa'i bud med mthong / /de nas la phyi gangs la song / /lo gsum bar du nyams len byas/ /lha dang ḍāk+ki'i byen 1008

rlabs kyis/ /gnas der 'ja' sprin sna tshogs mthong / /de nas slar yang dbus su yong / /sngar bzhin bla ma rten la mjal 'gro don byas pas rang don yang / /de yi zhor la 'grub pa byung / /de nas mdo khams smad 'dir 'ongs/ /da res bkra shis chos mthun sgos/ /thams cad mjal ba'i dga' ston la/ /gtam snyan mang po phul ba lags/ /glu 'di thos tshad thams cad kyi/ /rgyud la phan thogs 'byung bar shog /yul phyogs kun tu bkra shis shing / /kun kyang chos la spyod par shog /ces stod dbus gtsang sogs kyi gtam snyan brjod pas thams cad dga' mgu yi rang bar gyur to/ /de'i skabs su sku gzhogs dmag gsar rin po che sku snyung nas gshegs la nye ba dang mjal du song /mjal ba'i rjes su thugs mnyes bzhin du gshegs song bas sems skyo ba tshad las 'das pa byung / rta mdzo gnyis bas dkar chen po gcig gos dar bcas phul ba la/ thugs dgongs rdzogs pa'i bsngo smon byas thams cad la sems gso btang / dgon pa'i bdag po byas/ de na grub dbang nam mkha' rin po che dang / rgod rtse sprul pa'i sku gnyis bzhugs pa dang mjal/ rang gi sngar gye bu chen a lags bde chen gyis nang du bos/ sku gsung thugs rten theg chen gan dril/ rta nor lnga 1009

ras chen brgya/ kha btags brgya dang bcas te phul/ bsngo sgon byas nas blangs/ de nas go'u sde phu'i rje btsun skal ldan rgya mtsho'i sgrub gnas bkra shis nyams dga' ru song nas zhag shas bsdad/ de dus gling rgya'i sde pa gsum dang / 'jam smad pa sde bdun 'khrugs nas me 'bar 'bar dang chu khol khol byas/ mi bco brgyad tsam bsad song ba go tshe mar song nas/ thams cad la byen rlabs byas pas gyod 'dre dang bsam ngan sbyor rtsub thams cad rang sar zhi ba byung / chos dang 'jig rten gye gtam bshad nas bsgrigs pas bar skabs shig sku tshab la dbon tshang bkra lo bzhag nas/ bdag cag dpon slob rnams shel dgon du song nas sku gzhogs chu dmar rin po cher mjal/ sku gsung thugs rten phul nas chos 'brel zhus/ khong gis bdag thag ring gi mgron po ru dgongs 'tsho chas gang dgos gnang / 'gro dus dre'u gcig ras mang po dang gos dar bcas gnang ba byung / de nas yang mar song nas gyod bsgrigs pas mi mang po'i srog bshol ba byung / gser kha'i chu la chad 'gram che bas chu'i thog nas nang 'thab mang po 'chor ba la byin rlabs byas pas/ de'i lo nas bzung chu cher song rgyun 'chad med pa byung / sa der sngar med pa'i rtsi shing nags tshal 1010

mang po 'bad rtsol med par rang bzhin shugs kyis rgyas pas mi thams cad dad pa lhag par skyes grub rtags red zer/ de nas bzung ste chu'i thog nas 'thab rtsod byas mi gsod pa gtan nas byed ma dgos pa byung ngo / /de nas lam dkar po gyen brgyud nas zho 'ong la kha'i rang gi pha yul gnyan rgya ru song / sring mo gnyis dang tsha bo sha nye yul mi rnams la 'phrad pas thams cad kyi sems la dga' spro tshad las 'das pa byung /sde ba'i spyi thog nas ston mo rgya chen po btang ba'i rjes su thams cad kyis nang du bos/ rta nor bco brgyad nas do po bzhi bcu tsam phul/ de nas sngon a ma sdod sa'i khang ba stong pa'i shul du song nas bltas pas/ gru kha zhig na khang chung zhig gi nang nas grib kyis zin pa'i nad ma zhig las mi 'dug pas/ nad mas nga mthong ba dang sems sdug nas ngus/ ngas mo yang snying rje zhing / sngon ma rgan mo yod tshul yid la shar nas/ da lta ma med na med mod de/ ma sdod sa'i khang ba yang zhig nas mi 'dug snyam mchi ma shor/ de dus chos thams cad mi rtag pa 'di'i rang bzhin can red snyam skyo mgur 'di blangs so//bla ma rgyal ba sras bcas kyi/ /ye shes spyan gyes legs gzigs nas/ /a ma rigs drug gar gnas kyang / /bde chen 1011

dag pa'i zhing du drongs//bu nga yul na yod dus su//rang yang na so gzhon par gda'//a ma rang yang rgan mo min/ /yul phyogs gzhan du song na yang / /da dung 'jig rten dkar ngogs 'dir/ /ma la lan cig 'phrad yong snyam/ /drin can a ma yod dus su/ /bu nga thag ring yul la song //bu nga yul du slebs pa'i dus/ /a ma 'jig rten phyi mar song / /ma bu 'dzom pa'i dus ma byung / /bsam zhing a ma dran nas byung / /da lta yod na dga' ba la/ /ma bu phyogs gcig 'dzom snying 'dod/ /yud tsam 'dzom rung shi gson gnyis/ /thug pa lta bu'i dga' spro yong / /kye hud 'khor ba'i chos rnams la/ /mi rtag mi brtan snying po med/ /a ma med na med mod kyang / /sdod sa'i khang ba yan chad med/ /ma dang khang ba gnyis ka yis/ /mi rtag sgyu ma'i brda' chos bstan/ /de la bsams nas rnal 'byor nga'i//sems la skyo ba gting nas skyes/ /snying po med pa'i bya ba spangs//snying po'i lha chos byed snying 'dod/ /lha chos byas pa'i 'bras bu yis//phyi mar dag pa'i zhing khams su/ /ma bu lhan cig 'dzoms nas kyang / /dga' spro'i gleng mo byed bzhin du/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mchod byed cing / /sems can thams cad 'dren par shog /ces blangs pas skyo ba gting nas skyes/ yul gyi kho thag chod/ rang yang 1012

nam zhig la shi 'gro ci shes snyam dge phyogs la brtson pa cher song / rjes su nad ma de shi ba dang / nang du lha khang brgyab mchod rten bzhengs/ ma ṇi chos 'khor bskor nas dge ba'i rgyun btsugs pas/ yul mi rnams kyis kyang / nangs nub kun tu phyag skor mchod 'bul ma chag pa byung / de nas dben gnas bkra shis 'khyel du 'ongs/ dgon pa'i sa bdag zho 'ong bla ma che chung / dpon po nor bu sogs sde ba'i skyes pho mo thams cad yar la mjal du 'ong / thugs rje chen po'i dbang zhus/ de'i nyin nam mkha' 'ja' 'od kyis gang ba mthong nas thams cad kyi dad pa gong 'phel du gyur/ ja mar rtsam pa sogs mthun rkyen gang dgos phul/ de dus rtogs pa mchog ldan 'khrul zhig nam mkha'i rnal 'byor pa mched grogs mchog ldan gyes/ kho la sems ngo skyong tshul gye zhal gdams nyung la 'dus pa zhig gsung dgos zhes bskul ngor 'di skad ces smras/ a khu mchog ldan ma yengs par nyon cig rang lus snang srid snod bcud 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad ming gis phar btags pa tsam ma gtogs rang ngos nas grub pa rdul tsam yang med pa ngo bo gdod nas stong pa nam mkha' lta bu yin pa la/ rnam pa las bzang ngan gyes rgyu rkyen sna tshogs pa bsgrigs 1013

pas rten 'brel la brten nas/ dper na nam mkha'i 'ja' tshon chu nang gi zla ba me long nang gi gzugs brnyan bzhin med bzhin du snang snang bzhin du stong / snang stong sgyu ma'i rnam rol 'di thams cad/ rang gi sems kyis byas/ sems su snang /sems kyi dbyengs su gnas/ sems nyid kyi ngo bo ni gdod nas stong gsal 'dzin med zang thal khyab gdal klong yangs mtha' yas mu med 'byams klas spro sa bral nam mkha' lta bu'i dbyings su/ gu yangs yan par glod nas bzhag pas/ dgra dang gnyen la khyad med gser dang sa rdo khyad med 'di dang phyi ma khyad med pa'i dpal nam mkha' lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa 'byung ngo zhes mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so//rtogs pa ni nam mkha'i khyon ltar du yangs pa'i/ /rtogs ldan gye bla mar gsol ba rang 'debs so/ /thugs rje yi spyan gyes dus kun tu gzigs la/ /thugs yid gnyis 'dres par byin gyis rang rlobs shig /'khor 'das kyi chos rnams thams cad kyi 'byung gnas/ /rang sems kyi gnas lugs stong gsal ni khyab gdal/ /nam mkha' ltar yangs pa'i ngang la rang 'jog dus/ /kha yan du glod nas rang yan du zhog dang / /mnyam bzhag ni nam mkha' lta bu yi ngang la/ /rang bzhin gyis lhod 1014

lhod 'gro ba 'di skyid do/ /de ltar du mnyam par 'jog tshul la mkhas na/ /rtogs pa ni nam mkhar rang shugs kyis mnyam mo/ /nam mkha' las nyi ma 'gags med du 'char bzhin/ /ma rtogs pa'i 'gro la snying rje yang 'char nges/ /rnal 'byor nga klong chen rab 'byams kyi bu rgyud/ /nyams mgur 'dra len na 'di 'dra rang blangs yong / /rtogs pa ni mchog ldan 'khrul zhig gi rnal 'byor/ /sems ngo rang skyong na 'di ltar du skyongs ang / /nam zhig ni 'chi ba chos sku ru grol nas/ /gzugs sku yi 'gro don 'ong ba rang smon no/ /zhes blangs pas kho rang gis kyang de ltar zang thal kha yan du glod nas rang yan du bzhag pas sems la sngar bas gsal cha dang yangs cha che ba byung nas/ de nas bzung gang du sdod kyang snang ba yangs khrol le/ su dang 'grogs kyang shes pa dga' yal le byung / rjes su gshegs khar yang chos nyid yangs pa chen po'i ngang du shes pa dga' yal le gshegs pas nam mkha' g.ya' dag pa sogs 'chi ba chos sku ru grol ba'i rtags yang dag pa byung ngo / /de nas yon mchod thams cad gros byas/ dgon pa nyams yod pa zhig gso byed pa la/ zho 'ong la steng 'og dang / gling rgya tsho 'du tshun chad kyi dad can gye skyes pho mo thams cad 'ongs/ rong 'brog gnyis gas nyams 1010

gso sgrub pa'i sgang la/ bla ma rdo rje 'chang sku gzhogs gser khang rin po che phebs/ dgon pa nyams gso'i zhal 'debs la rta nor mang po gnang / mchod rten gyi gnas zhabs kyis bcags byen gyes brlabs nas/ khong gis mdang nga'i rmi lam bzang / bkra shis 'khyil ba 'di'i ri yi rtse mo'i bar du lha khang dang mtshams khang gis gang nas yod pa zhig rmis gsungs/rjes su khong gi lung bstan nang bzhin byung / phan tshun la chos dam tshig gi 'brel ba gzhan dang mi 'dra ba bzhag thugs yid gcig tu 'dres pa byung / de dus sku gzhogs hor tshang dang /spyang lung sprul ba'i sku/ a lags drag po che la sogs pa'i bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang po phebs nas rta nor mang po phul chos 'brel zhus par zab lam gcod la sogs pa'i rang gang mos kyi dbang lung phul/ gzhan sngags mang dang sgyes pho mo mang por zla ba kha shas la/ skabs skabs bka' gdams thugs rje chen po thig le bcu drug gi dbang / rdor sems phur pa tshe dbang nor dbang la sogs pa'i dbang lung khrid gsum mang po byas/ bsnyen rdzogs kyang mang po bsgrubs pas/ thams cad kyi blo kha chos la 'gyur nas/ sgo me'i blo gros dang / kha rgya'i dge slong / mang ra'i lha bzo/ sog po'i rig grol sogs tshe blos 1016

btang gi slob ma dang jo mo mang po/ sbas pa'i rnal 'byor pad+ma rig 'dzin/ mthong sa'i mtshams pa/ rin chen rdo rje sogs tshe dang sgrub pa snyems pa'i rnal 'byor pa dang / lo mtshams zla mtshams la sdod pa'i ban sngags brgya phrag du ma byung ngo / /lha khang nyams gso la mthun rkyen mkho ba'i dus su/ rang gi nye ba a khu sman pas rta sga stan srab gsum lus gos cha tshang ja lan chen gcig mar log che chung gnyis dang / khong gi zhabs phyi dge slong bstan pa dar rgyas nas kyang ja lan chen gcigadangul srang do/ nas do po lnga ras chen kha shas bcas phul bas phan thogs chen po byung / khong gnyis la lam rim bsdus don gye lung khrid dang / ma bsgoms par 'tshang rgya ba'i 'pho lung byas/ sangs rgyas kyi 'phel gdung dang byin rten mang po byin/phyis lha khang 'grub pa dang / 'bag bzo 'jam dbyangs bkra shis dang khro rgyal 'bum/ lha bzo bsod nams rin chen sogs kyis byas nas/ nang du sgu gsung thugs rten bzhengs/ phyi nang kun tu ri mo sna tshogs bris/ dge 'dun gye sde btsugs/ de rnams kyi rgyu song la/ gser shog dmar ser gnyis ka khri bam dgu/ lha bzo ba rnams la ras lnga brgya/ shing bzo ba rnams la yang ras lnga brgya byen pa sogs khyon bsdoms pas dngul srang 1017

stong phrag gcig lhag gi rgyu nom pa song ngam snyam/ gzhi der phab nas dbus gtsang nas khyer 'ongs pa'i rten phal cher bkra shis 'khyel bar bzhag gzhan sku dang thang ka rnams phyogs phyogs kyi dgon pa rnams la byin/ 'phel gdung sogs byen rten khyad 'phags rnams gzhan gye lha khang brgya rtsa brgyad kyi nang du sku gsung thugs rten bzhengs pa'i nang gzhug dang / gzhan yang dad can rnams la rim gyis byen pas/ rten gsum gyis yul khams thams cad la khyab pa byung / de dus lha khang rnams kyi rab gnas dga' ston rnams byas nas gnas la bstod pa'i mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so//dben pa bsten nas sangs rgyas pa'i/ /sngon byon rgyal ba rnams la 'dud/ /rjes 'jug chos mdzad thams cad kyis/ /ri khrod zin par byen gyis rlobs/ /dbus kyi ri rgyal lhun po'i lho/ /rgya gar rdo rje gdan gyi byang / /dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing gi shar/ /tsong kha'i skyes ri mthon po'i lho/ /reb gong gser mo ljongs kyi sa/ /grub gnas brgyad dang nye ba'i gnas/ /rtsi shing nags tshal rgyas pa'i gong / /spang ri me tog bkra ba'i 'dabs/ /rong dang 'brog pa gnyis kyi mtshams/ /ri bo mtho la yangs pa'i rtse/ /gnas chen bkra shis 'khyel ba zhes/ /gong ma'i 1018

lung gis zin pa'i gnas/ /mkhas grub mang po bzhugs pa'i shul/ /lha dang ḍak+ki 'du ba'i zhing / /gnas 'di'i yon tan shes ma shes/ /gnas 'di'i yon tan ma shes na/ /sa gzhi pad+ma 'dab brgyad la/ /gnam yang 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad 'dra/ /gnas chen 'di yi ri dbyebs ni/ /dper na glang chen 'gyeng ba 'dra/ /bde ba can gyi lha khang de/ /glang chen gtsug gi nor bu 'dra/ /rig 'dzin lha khang byams khang sogs/ /rin chen gser gyi rgyan cha 'dra/ /ri ngos bkra shis rtags brgyad dang / /rgyal srid sna bdun rnams kyang tshang / /shar na khrab chen mtho dang gcig /lho na gnyan dmar brjid dang gnyis/ /nub na rgod rdzong phyug dang gsum/ /byang na ja sgon dmar yag bzhi/ /bkra shis 'khyil bar zhal gzigs nas/ /bsrung zhing skyob pa'i tshul du gda'/ /mtha' bskor nags tshal phreng ba ni/ /yon bdag pho mos bskor ba 'dra/ /g.yas g.yon gnyis su chu bo yang / /gnas rir dar dkar 'then pa 'dra/ /khu byug 'jol mo ri dwags sogs/ /bag phebs rgyu zhing skad snyan sgrog /sil thog rnam pa sna tshogs dang / /zwa dang sgog sogs tshod ma mod/ /sngo ljang ljon shing bsil grib dang / /spang gshong me tog bkra ba mang / /rong gi rtsam pa go re dang / /'brog gi zho dar mar chur mod/ /gzhan 1019

yang mthun rkyen gang dgos kyang / /rong 'brog thag nye btsal yang sla/ /dgra jag gcan gzan gnod pa sogs/ /mi 'dod nyer 'tshe gcig kyang med/ /'dod dgu 'dzom pa'i gnas mchog 'di/ /'dod khams lha yi yul dang 'dra/ /phyogs 'di'i dben gnas thams cad kyi/ /nang nas gnas 'di nyams re dga'/ /'di ru 'dug pa'i gang zag gi /sgrub la bar chad mi 'byung zhing / /rgyud la nyams rtogs nyi ma 'char/ /gnas 'di cung zad bstod pa'i mthus/ /sgrub brgyud bstan pa'i g.yang gi rigs/ /dben gnas 'di ru rab chags nas/ /sgrub brgyud bstan pa dar bar shog /ces blangs pas thams cad kyi nyams dga' snang ba spro ba byung ngo / /de dus gsar rnying kun mkhyen cing gong ma rgyal po'i bla mchod kyi grangs/ sku gzhogs mtshan sgogs mkhan po rin po che rgya nag pho brang na bzhugs pa la/'tshams zhus kyi zhu shog dang / dur khrod brgyad kyi ri mos mdzes pa'i gcod kyi ḍā ma ru/ rkang dung dngul gyes shan pa'i steng du g.yu byer gyes phra bkod pa/ gser zangs las grub pa'i phur bu 'byon gtsang zhig dang sa sna rten sna lha rdzas dri med bcas phul ba'i 'byor lan du rjes su khong gis tshigs su bcad pa'i bka' yi glegs bu 'di bstsal byung /1020

sras bcas rgyal ba'i thugs rje nus pa'i 'phrul/ /'gro la phan bde sgrub pa'i byed po ru/ /yongs shar phyag na pad+mo'i zlos gar 'dzin/ /grub dbang brtan pa'i 'khor lo ga la bar/ /chos brgyad 'ud kyi spu mdog rnam bkra yang / /rnam dkar dge ba'i srog gi gshed ma ru/ /'gro bar ma shes blun po'i ngang tshul can/ /mdza' grogs wa mo 'dra bas 'di skad do/ /ring nas mdza' ba'i nye bar 'brel ba yi/ /mi phyed ma bcos dad pa'i sor mo bcu/ /spyi bor shugs kyis phyogs te snyan tshig gi /me tog phon po de yang phyogs der 'thor/ /tshogs gnyis dpal las bskrun pa'i gang gi sku/ /mtshan dpe dge mtshan yongs su rdzogs pa yi/ /rta ljang dbang bo'i dkyil 'khor mngon gsal zhing / /lugs gnyis mdzad 'phrin snang bas phyogs bcur khyab/ /mdo sngags smin grol lam bzang mtha' dag pa/ /gsal byas thub bstan pad+mo'i dga' tshal du/ /skal bzang sbrang mar tshogs bder spyod pa yi/ /dpal la 'god pa'i grags pa srid rtser 'bar/ /gnas dang smon lam las kyi rkyen 'dzom pa'i mi shigs mdza' bas bcings pa'i rang rtags su/ /shar nub yul gye bskal yang bya ba'i dus/ /gcig tu 'dzom pa 'di ko ngo mtshar rmad/ /rjes brtse'i gangs kyi ri las babs pa yi/ /rten 1021

dang gcod ḍā rkang gling phur bu sogs/ /las bzhi'i 'phrin las 'grub pa'i rten 'brel du/ /bdag blo'i dpyid du smin pas dga' spro thob/ /'dir yang srog 'tsho'i me tog cung rgas kyang / /'tshe byed ba mos ma reg tsam zhig las/ /'di yin 'di min med pa'i rnam g.yeng gi /chu gnyer zad pa med pa'i ngang du gnas/ /slad kyang shākya'i rgyal pos thugs bsgyed bzhin/ /'gro ba spyi dang khyad par dmu rgod rnams/ /'dul ched phyir zhing thugs stobs cher bskyed pa'i/ /'phags chen dam pa'i rnam thar bdag gir bzhes/ /da lta'i 'gro ba'i blo dang 'tshams pa yi/ /mdzad tshul dka' bas mkhas grub phal mo che la la gshegs dang la la sgrub pa la/ /gzhol ba'i zol gyis ngal gso mdzad mod kyang / /nyid ni gzhan don mdzad la zla bral ba'i/ /slar yang thugs bskyed bla nas blar spel te/ /phan bde'i dpal du yun ring 'tsho gzhes dang / /brtse chen klong nas bdag kyang 'dor med zhu/ /zhu tshig don gyi chu bo cher rgyas pa/ /rab dkar dung shog gzhong bar ma shong ste/ /pho nya'i blo mtshor dal gyes bskyil ba'i chab/ /mnyes gshin thugs kyi klung du 'dren par zhu/ /zhes 'degs rten lha rdzas/ na bza'/ sku lcug dbu mnabs bcas zla tshes la yung dgon nas gus pas phul/ zhes 1022

dgyes bzhin bstsal pa 'byor bas dngos su mjal ba lta bu'i dga' spro chen po byung / de nas nub gcig nga'i rmi lam la/g.yu lo bkod pa'i zhing yin zer ba'i sa gzhi khod snyoms shing dri ma dang bral ba rgya che zhing yid du 'ong ba'i mtha' lo ma me tog 'bras bus mdzes pa'i ljon shing sna tshogs pas bskor ba'i dbus na/ rin po che'i khang bzang sum brtsegs mtho ba'i rtse mo gser gyi rgya phibs kyis mdzes pa ser lam me ba/ zhing bkod bris yod pa dang mtshungs pa'i bskor lam du slebs pa'i tshe/ bu mo gzhon nu ma gsum gyis skor ba byas nas 'ongs pas gcig gis/ nga la bltas bltas nas/ mo khyod kyis ngo mi shes mod zer/ mi shes 'dug byas pas/ mo na re/ bu khyod kyi skye ba 'di'i a ma nga yin te/ shi nas 'dir 'ongs/ khyod dang ma phrad par lo mang po song / da res lan cig 'phrad pa bzang / da bu khyod kyang rgas 'dug zer/ ngas a ma rgan mo lo lon pa'i dus skabs de wal ler dran nas ngus pas/ mo yang mig nas mchi ma gtong bar gda'/ gzhan bu mo 'di gnyis gang nas yin dris pas/ nged tsho'i yul gyi sngon sgol ma 'don pa'i rgan mo gnyis kyi ming bshad nas/ de gnyis yin zhes bshad pas/ bu mo de gnyis kyis kyang nga la bltas nas mchi ma gtong bar gda'/1023

ngas kyang a yes rgan mo de gnyis yid la shar nas mchi ma byung / da khyed rnams skyid po byung yod pa bzang / rgyun du gang na bsdad yod dris pas/ nub phyogs bde ba can gyi zhing na yod/ da nangs 'dir rje btsun sgol ma la phyag skor byed du 'ong ba yin/ da khyod kyis 'gro don gyes la shog dang / rjes su zhing khams gang na yod kyang mjal yong zer bu mo gsum po skor ba la song ngo / /bdag kyang skor ba la 'gro snyam pa dang gnyid sad byung / de bsam blo btang na ma rgan mo dang / de'i rogs pa rgan mo gnyis kyis sgol ma mang po bton pa'i thugs rjes de ltar byung ba yin nam snyam nas dga' ba byung / de'i lo dbyar ma ston gyi mtshams la/ mgar rtse grwa tshang gis dgon par bos nas song / dge 'dun spyi thog nas ja lan chen gcig gis 'go byas nor rdzas brgya 'bul byas/ gzhan grwa pa phyug po rnams kyis nang du bos/ ja lan chen mang po phul/ de nas shug nyin ri khrod du song / sku gzhogs mgar rtse tshang nas ja lan chen gcig gos phrug gnyis bcas gnang / mgar rtse chung ba nas/ rta mdzo gnyis dang gos phrug gnyis gnang / bla rgan bstan 'dzin gyis lan chen gcig gzhan grwa pa dang mtha' ba rnams kyis kyang zas nor mang po phul/ phar la 'gyed phogs 1024

mang ja/ bla ma rnam gnyis la 'bul ba phul/ chos 'brel zhus/de nas bzung phan tshun gcig grogs gcig gis byas chos ldan gyi bya ba mang po sgrub rgyu byung / de nas 'brog pa a bar the'u/rkang tsha/ lha zhis/ rang ngan/ rgan rgya/ klu chu thang rnams la rim gyes song bas thams cad kyis lha byon dpal byon byas/ rta bsu btang / spyi thog nas ja thab bzang chos zhus pas/ sde de rnams la so sor tshe dbang dang nor dbang bskur/ gang 'dod kyi chos bshad pas/ thams cad kyi blo kha chos la 'gyur/ rab tu dad pas nor longs spyod yod med gnyis gas phul ba'i/ rta nor brgyad cu/ ja lan chen bdun/ mar ltang che chung sum cu rtsa gsum/ phying dkar sum cu rtsa gcig bal dang ras kha btags mang po byung / de dus lha zhis sa cha nas/ sa thob kyi byang chub sems dpa' bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen stag tshang lha mo'i gser khri rin po cher mjal/ rta gcig phul chos 'brel zhus/ nyi ma lung gi dgon par song / a lags hor tshang la mjal/ de dus kyang rta nor mang po gnang / phar dgon pa la 'gyed mang ja'i dod du rta nor kha shas phul/ rgan rgya ru song dus gnas chen brag dkar la mjal/ nyi ma mang por gnas khang du bsdad gnas 'brel bzhag brag dkar mkha' 'gro ma 1025

la mjal/ rten gsum phul nas chos 'brel zhus/ dgon par mang ja'i dod du rta gcig phul zhag gnyis bsdad nas phyag skor byas/ tshur 'ongs nas ston dgun mtshams la zho 'ong dpyis kyi sde pa la dbang bskur chos bshad nas 'gro don byas pas/ gro nas do po che chung brgya dang lnga bcu/ rta nor nyi shu rtsa stod tsam byung / de nas dgun kha zho 'ong la kha'i sde pa so so ru song nas chos bshad dbang bskur bas thams cad kyis dga' ston gye dus su glu 'di 'dra len par gda'/ glu ba gnam lha rgyal gyis/ gos gcig gis sems can dros ni po/ /dpe bzhag na 'dzam gling nyi ma red/ /zas gcig gis sems can sos ni po/ /dpe bzhag na sbrang dkar rtsam pa red/ /dpon gcig gis sde mgo thub ni po/ /dpe bzhag na gong ma rgyal po red/ /zer/glu ba tshe dbang rgyal gyis/ ri mtho ni tsong kha'i skyes ri mtho/ /bya g.yas kyi 'phur nas g.yon gyi 'bab/ /chu che ni rma chu lu ma che/ /rab gong gi brgyab na zhol gi 'bud/ /dpon che ni gong ma rgyal po che/ /gsung na ning byon na da lo snyan/ /zer/ yang bu mo gnyis kyis skad 'dril byas nas/ nyi ma khus gi bud dus su/ /nyin srib med par dro re ltos/ /zla ba thod gi bud dus su/ /ri thang med la gsal re ltos/ /skyabs mgon dbus gi phebs 1026

dus su/ /kha rgan gzhon med la skyid re ltos/ /zer/ bu tsha gzhon pa zhig gis/ bla ma dgung gi nyi ma red/ /nyin re bsdad gi je gsal red/ /phyag mdzod khus kha'i lab tse red/ /nyin re bsdad gi je phyug red/ /grwa pa gnam gi skar ma red/ /nyin re bsdad gi je mang red/ /zer/ de bzhin du glu dang gar mi 'dra ba rnam pa sna tshogs pa byas pas/ yul mi thams cad dga' zhing spro ba byung / de dus dpon po bkra los dngul rdo tshad gcig dang /nas do po lnga/ dpon po tshe los nas do po nyi shu rtsa lnga/ dngul srang bcu/ gos chen gcig sogs gzhan yod med gnyis gas gang 'dzom phul ba'i/ rta nor sum cu/ nas do po che chung sum brgya lhag tsam byung / dgun kha bkra shis 'khyil ba nas mtshams byas nas bsdad/ sos ka drod bab dus lam rim blo sbyong sems khrid sogs/ chos kyi 'khor lo skor ba'i dus su/chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba snying rje dgos tshul gye zhal gdams mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so//snying rje'i gter chen spyan ras gzigs dbang la/ /snying nas gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /bdag dang mkha' mnyam sems can thams cad kyi/ /rgyud la snying rje skye bar byin gyes rlobs/ /mi la snying rje yod na sangs rgyas yin/ /mi la snying 1027

rje med na gshin rje yin/ /snying rje yod na chos kyi rtsa ba tshugs/ /snying rje med na chos kyi rtsa ba rul/ /mi la snying rje yod na khro yang byams/ /mi la snying rje med na 'dzum yang gsod/ /snying rje yod na dgra yang gnyen du 'gyur/ /snying rje med na gnyen yang dgra ru ldang / /snying rje yod na chos rnams thams cad yod/ /snying rje med na chos rnams thams cad med/ /snying rje yod na nang pa sangs rgyas yin/ /snying rje med na phyi rol pa las thu/ /stong nyid sgom yang snying rje snying po dgos/ /chos pa snying rje'i rang bzhin can zhig dgos/ /nang pa sangs rgyas khyad chos snying rje yin/ /chos rnams kun gyi snying po snying rje yin/ /snying rje chen po yid bzhin nor bu 'dra/ /snying rje chen pos bdag gzhan re ba skong / /de phyir chos pa 'jig rten pa rnams kyis/ /snying rje sgoms dang sangs rgyas 'thob par 'gyur/ /glu 'di thos tshad skye bo pho mo yis/ /snying rje chen pos 'gro la phan par shog /ces blangs pas kun gye rgyud la phan thogs byung nas/ mas bu la byams pa ltar/ snying rje chen po'i sgo nas sems can nyam thag la byams pa'i chos pa mang po byung / dbyar kha bdag dang sku gzhogs mgar rtse rin po che/ bla rgan bstan 'dzin sogs nged dpon slob mang po dang bcas te rdo bis dang se cang gnyis kyi 1028

gyod chen lo bco brgyad la ma 'grigs par phan tshun gyi mi rta brgyad cu lhag tsam bsad tshar nas/ da dung gsod res rkyang byed pa rgya'i mi dpon bod kyi bla dpon gang gis kyang bsgrigs ma thub par lus yod pa de nyid bsgrig tu song / phan tshun gnyis ka la bshad nas rim gyis 'grig pa byung / de'i bar la phyogs de na sangs rgyas 'od srung gi ring bsrel bai ḍūr+ya'i lhung bzed gang nang na yod pa'i mchod rten rnam dag chen mo zer ba zhig 'dug pa de nyams yod pa la nyams gso byas/ rab gnas dga' ston gyi nyin mchod rten chen mo'i rtsa ba nas chos bshad dus/ rgya sog po za lar yan chad dad pa skyes nas chos la nyan/ rjes su nged tsho'i ka cu'i sangs rgyas gsung dang bod kyi bla ma zhabs dkar pa'i gsung gnyis gcig red zer skad/de dus zi ling do the ye sa bskor du phebs pas/ ngas sprang po mang por sbyin pa gtong ba dang / khyad par lam bar nas mgo log gi jag pas blangs pa'i shor ma mang po 'chi ru ma bcug par gsos nas 'ong ba dang / yul khams la phan thogs pa gsan nas/ ya rdzi ru phebs dus bdag mdun du bos/ khyed kyi rgyu mtshan rnams go bas sems dga' ba byung khyod chos pa dga' mo zhig red gsungs/ bdag rkyen du gos chen gcig 1029

dang ja nag gcig me long bcas gnang nas/ da phyin chad kyang sngar rgyun ltar 'gro don gyes/ khyad par sbra nag khag gsum gnya' skya rul gyi jag pa rnams la jag la ma 'gro/ gong ma'i gsung rtsis zhes re re shod dang sa sgo tshor phan par gda'/khyed ri bo rtse lnga la mjal du phebs na ngas phan thogs bya gsungs/ ngas khong la zhus nas ya rdzi'i btson ma mang po thar bas/ rgya za lar yan chad kyis dad gus byas so/ /de nas rje btsun skal ldan rgya mtsho'i sgrub gnas shar rdzong du song / zhag mang por gnas 'brel bzhag rdo yi mchod rten gcig kyang brtsigs/ grwa tshang 'dabs nas chos ra zhig brgyab/ nang du gnas chung chos skyong gi sku mkhar cig brtsigs nas/ dgon pa dar rgyas yong ba'i 'phrin bcol byas/ sde pa thams cad la tshe dbang bskur chos bshad pas thams cad dad par gyur/ zas nor longs spyod mang po 'bul mkhan byung / grwa tshang la zhabs tog zhus/ nas do po mang po bkra shis 'khyil du bkal 'ongs pas phan thogs chen po byung / de nas thog mar gling rgya ru song /thams cad la chos bshad dbang bskur mgur dbyangs blangs/thabs du ma'i sgo nas blo kha chos la bsgyur bas thams cad rab tu dad pas gro do po brgya/ nas do po che chung nyis brgya tsam 1030

byung / de dus skal ldan slob bu 'gyur med grogs bzang stobs tshang mtshams pa dang 'grogs nas rgya nag ri bo rtse lngar gnas mjal byed du song / gzhan thams cad kyis zhabs phyi byas nas/ 'jam smad pa sde pa bcu/ nyang / dar grong / byang chub/skyid tshang / tsho 'du/ rgyal po/ 'phrang yar nang / bses do ru nyin/ chu ma/ sha brang / blon chos/ hor nag la kha/ rong po'i sde bdun/ rgya khres tsi bzhi po sogs reb gong gser mo ljongs kyi yul sde stod smad bar gsum thams cad la rim gyis song /yon bdag pho mo thams cad la chos bshad dbang bskur/ khyad par 'dzin rten 'di'i bslab bya mang po byas/ 'thab rtsod 'khrug slong thams cad kyi rgyun bcad/ rnam dkar dge rgyun mang po btsugs/ khyad par lha khang dang / ma ṇi chos 'khor/mchod rten med sa thams cad la sku gsung thugs rten bzhengs su bcug go /reb gong dgu nyin srib kyi sbyin bdag pho mo mchog dman bar gsum thams cad kyis rab tu dad pas zas nor mang po phul ba la/ nas do po stong phrag gcig dang sum cu/ rta mdzo 'bri g.yag ba glang rnams bsdoms pas nyis brgya/ mar do po che chung bcu gsum/ ja lan chen lnga/ dngul rdo tshad gnyis/dā dmar shong lan ras dang kha btags stong phrag mang po byung /1031

de dus slob ma yon bdag rnams kyis ci bsam 'grub pa'i smon lam 'di ltar btab bo// dkon mchog byen rlabs sems la 'jug par shog /dge tshogs snod bcud yongs la smin par shog /phyi snod thams cad dag pa'i zhing du shog /nang bcud sems can lha dang lha mor shog /yul phyogs rtswa med rnams la rtswa skyes shog /lung ba chu med rnams la chu rdol shog /sa cha shing med rnams la shing sgyes shog /zhing sa lo med rnams la lo yag shog /rmang po bu med rnams la bu sgyes shog /dbul po nor med rnams kyis nor 'thob shog /glen pa go med rnams la blo bskyed shog /ban sngags chos med rnams la chos 'phel shog /bla ma slob ma yon bdag mjal bar shog /bkra shis chos mthun sgo nas mjal bar shog /chos ldan bya ba byed dus mjal bar shog /rang gzhan don gnyis sgrub dus mjal bar shog /mi phyugs rgas khar skyid dang 'phrad par shog /pha ma rgas khar chos dang 'phrad par shog /thams cad 'chi khar lam sna zin par shog /ci bsam thams cad lhun gyes 'grub par shog /ces sgon lam btab pas yon bdag thams cad kyang rab tu dga' nas/ de de bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig ces mthun 'gyur byed mkhan 1032

byung / bdag yar nang 'dam bu brag dkar na yod dus su/sku gzhogs rdzong sngon rin po che phebs pa dang mjal/ khong gis bdag la rta gos dung dkar sogs zas nor mang po phul/phar khong la rten gsum byen can mang po dang / chos 'brel phul nas khyed kyis bstan 'gro'i bde thabs su dmigs nas/byams khang zhig bzhengs na legs tshul zhus pas/ de ltar bzhengs rgyu byung / de dus mgar rtse a lags che chung gnyis la mjal/ phar tshe dbang dang byin rten phul/ tshur la rta gos sogs zhabs tog phun sum tshogs pa byas thugs yid gcig 'dres byung / skabs der 'dam bu brag dkar gnas sgo ru mtshams khang zhig bzo ba'i las grogs la/ a lags chung ba phebs pa mtshams khang steng nas thog tshad gsum gyi sa la lhung yang nyes skyon gang yang ma byung bas/ thams cad kyis skyabs mgon gye thugs rjes khong gi grub rtags bstan pa red skyon med pa ngo mtshar che zer ba byung / 'ga' res yul ba tsho la a lags lhung song ba red ma zer 'phur song gyis shod zer dgod par gda'/ rjes su yang yang mjal zhing sku gsung thugs rten kyang mang po bzhengs rgyu byung / dmag gsar du song dus skal ldan slob bu mkha' 'gros thugs rje chen po nam 1033

mkha' rgyal po'i lha khang bzhengs pa'i rab gnas la bos rab gnas dga' ston la rta mdzo gnyis mar rkyal gcig ras brgya bcas phul/ bsngo smon gye mtshams sbyor byas/ go'u sder song dus grub dbang rdzogs chen pa yab sras rnams la mjal/ sku gsung thugs rten 'phel gdung sogs byin rten mang po phul/chos 'brel zhus/ tshur la khong gis rta gos ja mar mkho ba gnang / de nas rong po'i dgon chen la rgya lo'i sgon lam chen mo'i dus/ gro do po bzhi bcu rtsa stod kyi go re btsos nas tshogs la brgyab ja thug yag po btang / 'jam dbyangs kun gzigs kyi drung du dngul srang brgya dang brgyad kyi dngul kong chen po gcig dang / rag gi bdun tshar chen po bcas bzhag lug ra pad dkar chos gling du/ rten gye gtso bo jo bo dang byams 'jam dbyangs byas lha khang chen po gcig bzhengs/ de'i rgyu 'gro la nas do po brgya lhag gro do po bcu/ gser shog dmar ser gnyis ka khri bam bcu gsum/ lha bzo'i yon la ja lan chen bco brgyad kyi rtsis/ shing bzo rnams la ras chen lnga brgya'i rtsis/ gzhan yang ja mar sogs rgyu nom pa mang po song sa dkar shar jo khang thebs su/ dngul srang bzhi bcu/ ja lan chen lnga'i rtsis song / sku gzhogs mtshan sgogs mkhan rin po 1034

che'i rong po'i lha khang zhal 'debs su gro nas do po sum cu rtsa gsum/ sku gzhogs bses rin po che'i phyag mdzod la/ mgar rtse'i byams khang nyams gso'i ched du/ nas do po nyi shu rtsa lnga/mdzad brgya dpag bsam 'khri shing gi thang ka sum cu rtsa gcig bzhengs pa'i yon du/ rta nor sum cu/ gro nas do po bcu gnyis/ dngul srang bcu dgu byin/ gong gsham la gos chen bco lnga/ de'i nang ma la ras khra bcu song / sprang po mang po la snga phyi byas/ nas do po brgya lhag cig gi sbyin pa btang /de'i phyi lo dbyar dus skal ldan slob bu mkhas pa a chung gnam rdzong la mtshams byed du song bas rjes su dge sbyor dang nyams rtogs 'phel po byung 'dug mkhan po dang ma chen kun dga' bstan 'dzin gnyis/ bkra shis 'khyil bar bsdad nas lha khang rnams kyi 'phro rnams bsgrubs/ o rgyan dang grub chen la sogs pa'i grwa pa rnams kyis zhabs phyi byas nas/ zho 'ong la steng 'og gi rta pa brgyas khug ya'i gser gzhong bar du bskyal/ de ru zhag gcig bsdad/ thams cad kyis rta rgyug btang / glu blangs gar sna tshogs byas/ de nas skyel mi rta pa kun phyir log nged dpon slob mang po dang bcas te/ sbyang lung gi 'brog tu song /spyi thog nas tshe dbang zhus pas/ dbang bskur chos bshad/1035

jag khrims bsdams/ nor yod med gnyis ga'i sbra nang du song /bsngo smon bkra shis brjod/ rta nor dang mar bsod yag po phul/de nas mdo pa'i 'brog tu song / rta bsu ba mang po byung / rta rgyug btang / rtsed mo sna tshogs byas/ spyi thog nas chos zhus/mi bzhi brgya lnga brgya tsam la/ tshe dbang dang / dzam lha'i rjes gnang byas chos bshad mgur dbyangs blangs/ jag pa mang pos jag mi byed par khas blangs/ jag khrims dang rkus khrims bsdams/ phyug po thams cad kyis nang du bos/ bsngo smon kha g.yang bkra shis brjod/ rta nor mar chur mang po phul/ spyang lung dang mdo pa'i 'bul ba rta nor bzhi bcu/ rkyal mar bcu bzhi yod pa bkra shis 'khyil du khyer 'ongs nas lha khang sogs kyi mthun rkyen byas/ de nas mgon shul/ dpyi ba/ dme shul/mgar rtse rnams la song / sde pa so sor dbang bskur chos bshad pas/ thams cad kyis dad pas dngul rdo tshad dang /rta nor mang po phul/ de nas sog yul rtse gzhung du song / sku gzhogs la kha rin po cher mjal/ sku gsung thugs rten 'phel gdung byen rlabs khyad 'phags phyag dpe mang po phye rtsam rta gos bcas phul/ chos 'brel zhus/ khong gis thugs brtse ba'i sgo nas tshur la gsol ras su/ dngul srang lnga bcu ma gnyis/1036

ras brgya/ rta mdzo bcu gsum/ rta sga bzhi/ zhabs phyi pa rnams la'ang lug mang bo gnang / bla brang gi sku gzhogs sde pa tshang la mjal/ phye rtsam rta gos phul/ chos 'brel zhus/ gsol ras gos gcig kha btags bcas gnang byung / de nas dpon tshang ching wang rin po cher mjal/ phye rtsam rta gos rten gsum tshe sgrub ril bu bcas phul/ tshur sder kha gos chen kha btags bcas gnang / rjes su mjal rgyu byas/ de dus sbra nag khag gsum dang / hor sde gnyis 'khrug pa'i dus yin pas/ de'i don la phyir myur du 'ong dgos byung / sog po'i yon bdag mang pos gdan 'dren byas kyang 'gro ma thub/ na mo wan stod na hor yod pa'i nang du tshur 'ongs/ hor dpon pos gtso byas rta pa mang po bsu ru byung / sde thog nas chos zhus/ 'tshogs pa stong phrag lhag tsam la tshe dbang nor dbang byas/ chos dang 'jig rten 'di'i bslab bya mang po byas pa'i mthar mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so//chos 'jig rten mkhyen pa'i bla ma la/ /bdag gsol ba 'debs so byen gyes rlobs/ /ngas phan pa'i snying gtam glu ru len//khyed 'jig rten pa rnams dga' bas nyon/ /gtam bshad pa'i thog mar 'dzum gyis bsus/ /gtam rjes su 'jog dus 1037

'dzum la zhog /gtam dgos don gang yin gsal por smros/ /gtam mang nyung ran par shod cig ang / /zas zhim por ngo yod gzhan la byin//nor bzang por dgra yod btsan sar sbos//gros byas par g.yang yod kun dang bstun/ /gtam bshad par don yod rgyu mtshan nyon/ /rku byas na tha mar sprang por 'gro /jag byas na tha mar mtshon khar 'chi/ /gyod byas na tha mar 'gyod po 'ongs/ /mi bsad na phyi mar dmyal bar skye/ /mi phyi thag thung dang grogs ma byed/ /khog nag pa'i mi la blo ma 'dri/ /'dris chung ba'i mi la blo ma 'gel/ /gal chung ba'i mi la gtam ma smra/ /gtam mkhas na lha mi 'tshogs sar shod/ /gos yag na khrom chen dkyil du ngom/ /bu bzang na rgyal khams bde la bkod/ /chos byed na gzhon nu'i dus su gyes/ /sman 'chal mor ma 'grogs mi kha 'du/ /khra bye la ma gso sdig pa gsog /zas mi 'phrod ma za pho ba na//ri gnyan sar ma gnyid lha 'dres gnod/ /dgos nges pa'i grogs po 'dzum gyis bsus/ /gros 'dri na nyams can rgan la dris/ /khong phyug po rnams kyis chog shes sten/ /nor med pa rnams kyis za shes gyes/ /gtam mi la 'phog pa khar ma 'don//rang 'gras pa'i dgra dang thag ma nye/ /zas mi zhim pa la sna ma gnyer/ /ja zhim po chang la hub ma che/ /1038

zas za dus rgan rim gyis la zo/ /las byed dus gzhon rim gyes dang bzang / /lha dkon mchog mchod na bsam don 'grub/ /rje bla ma bsten na lha chos 'ong / /sgom sgrub pa byas na nyams rtogs 'char/ /byams snying rje che na 'gro don 'ong / /glu 'di nyid thos tshad skye bo yis/ /chos 'jig rten gnyis ka shes par shog /ces blangs pas kun dad cing gus par gyur to/ /de dus sprin 'ja' nyi ma dus gcig la 'dzoms nas sbrang char 'jam po 'bab cing / g.yu 'brug sngon mo zhig sa la babs nas chu 'thungs slar nam mkha' la sgra dbyangs sgrog bzhin 'gro ba mthong tshe thams cad kyis bltas nas ngo mtshar che zer/ rgad po zhig na re/ g.yu 'brug sngon mo 'di nam mkha' na lhang lhang grag pa thos kyang / mthong yong snyam pa ma byung ste/ da lo sa la babs nas mthong rgyu byung / skyabs mgon rin po che stod nyi ma dbus gtsang na snyan grags 'brug bzhin grag pa thos kyang mjal 'ong bsam pa ma byung ste/ da lo sa 'dir phebs nas mjal rgyu byung / bskal pa bzang po ma red na ci red/tshe 'dir 'di'i phan gye bskal pa bzang po zhig mi 'ong zer/dga' dga' byed par gda'/ de nas jag dpon ngan pa mang po la gsol ras bdag rkyen mang po byin nas jag mi byed par 1039

khas len du bcug jag khrims bsdams/ sbra nag dang kha gnyis kyi 'khrug pa mnan nas/ rim pas 'grig tu bcug rta mdzo 'bri g.yag zu la/ dā bu/ wa lpags/ mar chur 'bul mkhan mang po byung / de dus rjes na yod pa'i zhabs phyi grwa btsun rgya sprang dang bcas yod tshad la lto gos kyi jebs su/ rta nor che chung bdun cu rtsa lnga byin/ 'phyi gsod yan chad la 'phyi ba mi gsod pa'i dam bca' 'bul du bcug nas rta re byen pas yon bdag kun kyang ngo mtshar bar gyur/ de dus rang gzhan kun la phan pa'i smon lam 'di btab bo/ /bdag dang gzhan gyi 'dis mtshon pa'i dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge tshogs rnams/ sems can zas med pa la zas/ gos med pa la gos/ grogs med pa la grogs/ bu med pa la bu/ rta med pa la rta/ bzhon ma med pa la bzhon ma/ gnas khang med pa rnams la gnas khang du gyur nas/ sems can thams cad bde bar gyur cig skyid par shog cig gzhan yang rang gzhan gyis dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge tshogs rnams/ sems can bla ma med pa la bla ma/ chos med pa la chos/grogs med pa la grogs/ dben pa med pa la dben gnas/'tsho ba med pa la 'tsho bar gyur nas/ thams cad la chos 'ong 1040

bar gyur cig sangs rgyas par gyur cig bdag gis tshe rabs thams cad du/ /sems can rnams la phan par shog /nam yang 'gro la mi phan zhing / /gnod pa'i lus su mi skye shog /tshe rabs kun tu sems can la/ /phan thogs 'byung ba'i lus 'thob shog /'gro kun skyid na skyid grogs dang / /sdug na sdug grogs byed par shog /sems can yal bar 'dor ba'i blo/ /nam yang sems la mi sgye shog /sems can gcig kyang ma lus par/ /de srid 'gro don byed par shog /'gro kun sangs rgyas go 'phang la/ /bkod nas 'gro don mthar phyin shog /de ltar byas pa'i bsod nams kyis/ /bdag kyang 'bad med sangs rgyas shog /bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyi//bsam don yid bzhin 'grub par shog /smon lam ji ltar btab pa bzhin/ /de de bzhin du 'grub par shog /ces smon lam dri ma med pa'i mtshams sbyor byas/ de nas bon rgya ru song / rta pa mang po bsu ru 'ong / rta rgyug byas/ yul du slebs nas sde thog nas chos zhus/ yul mi thams cad la dbang bskur chos bshad de kun gye snang ba dam pa'i chas la bsgyur/ dad can thams cad kyi nang la bos nas song / smon lam bkra shis brjod pas/ rta nor lug gsum lhag par du mar chur 'bul mkhan mang po byung ba dang /1041

rong po'i dgon chen la rta nor bdun cu/ rkyal mar nyi shu rtsa gnyis/ ja thug gi rgyur dngul srang bcu drug reb gong sgrub sde bco brgyad/ mar nang rdo bis dgon pa tshun chad kyi dgon pa che chung thams cad la/ rta mdzo 'bri g.yag bsdoms pas brgya lhag rkyal mar nyi shu tham pa/ dngul srang lnga bcu/ kha btags mang po dang bcas btang / bla brang bkra shis 'khyil la 'gyed phogs mang ja gya nom pa bcas grwa pa mang pos khyer bas/ nged tshang gi grwa pa sna tshogs pa yin gshis/ nang na bla brang gi tshogs nas phud btang ba'i dam nyams gcig yod pa de nged tshos ma shes par rgyus yod byed du btang bas/ de 'phud mkhan tshos mthong nas grwa pa dam nyams de'i lag nas 'thung tshul med ces gtong du ma bcug par phyir log byung / 'ga' res de yin par ma shes par grub mtha'i phyogs ris byas nas ma 'thungs pa red zer/ gang yin yang dge ba'i kha 'gegs shig byung / gtong ma thub par 'gyod pa skyes/ gzhan mang ja rgyag pa'i zhal 'debs byas so/ /de nas yon bdag gle ba/ dpal mchog bdud shul sogs la rim pa bzhin du song / thams cad kyis rta bsu byas/ yul du song nas chos bshad dbang bskur bas/ thams cad kyi nang du bos/ dngul srang lnga bcu ma 1042

mang po dang / rta nor lug gsum gang mang 'bul mkhan byung /de nas mang ra kha stod na 'dug pa'i gra tsha'i phyag rdor skor dang / ban shul gnyis la song / thab bsu ba byung / thud dang zhun sde thog nas lnga bcu lhag bcas phul/ chos zhus par dbang dang gdams pa byen/ thams cad kyi nang du song / rta nor mang po phul/ de nas grub dbang pad+ma rang grol/ mang ra smad kyi 'khyams ru rkang rtsa'i yon bdag rnams dang bcas kyi bsu ba byung / khong gi sgar khar song / ston mo chen po byas/ zhun thud brgya phrag du ma phul/ khrom lha mi stong phrag mang po 'tshogs pa la tshe dbang nor dbang rgyas par byas/ las rgyu 'bras bden pa'i chos bshad/ 'jig rten 'di yi bslab bya bstan te mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so//lhar bcas 'gro ba yongs kyi gtsug gi rgyan/ /skyabs mgon yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag dang slob ma yon bdag pho mo la/ /thugs rjes gzigs la byen gyes brlab tu gsol/ /'di phyi gnyis gar phan pa'i snying gtam bya/ /khyed rnams ma yengs nyon cig yon bdag tsho/ /tshe 'dir rgyal khams thams cad bde 'dod na/ /gong ma rgyal po'i bka' khrims brtsis na legs/ /phyi ma'i yul la bde zhing skyid 'dod na/ /1043

sangs rgyas gsung bzhin rgyu 'bras brtsis na legs/ /'di phyi gtan gyi skyabs mgon bla ma la/ /gsol ba snying nas btab na byin rlabs 'jug /nam yang bslu med dkon mchog gsum po la/ /snying nas skyabs 'gro gyes dang ci bsam 'grub/ /rgas pa'i pha ma yan na drin can med/ /drin gzo gyis dang bu la bsod nams skye/ /gshin por dge ba byed dus ra lug g.yag /bsad nas chos log nam yang ma bco zhig /mna' ma len dus sdig po mang po byas/ /ston mo chen po nam yang ma rgyag cig /nyes pa yod rung med rung gling btab nas/ /snyoms chung lag nas zas nor ma 'phrog cig /kun gyis nag can jag pa yan par btang / /nyes med mang po rgya la ma sprod cig /sdug rtsa thug nas rang nyid 'gro dgos kyang / /a mchod bzung nas 'tshab tu ma sprod cig /jag dang rkun ma 'khon gyi gzhi ma yin/ /phyin chad gang gi sa nas bcad na bzang / /dbyar kha lon na 'phyi ba gsod pa sogs/ /don med sdig pa'i las la ma rngams shig /rang gis skyi bshus tsam yang mi bzod par/ /mi rta khye la gri yis ma rgyag cig /gnyan po dug sdong lta bur gnod bskyal nas/ /na tsha god kha'i rgyu la ma 'bad cig /don yal nor zad sprang por 'gro ba'i rgyu/ /dud chang yin pas gtan nas ma dga' zhig /1044

dpe ngan gzhan la bton na rang la 'khor/ /dpon pos gzu log khrims log ma byed cig /btsan po yin yang btsan tshod mi zin par/ /snyoms chung rnams kyi lag nas ma 'chi zhig /chung mas g.yog por brdung tshod mi zin par/ /dme rgan cho lo nam yang ma len zhig /khyem mtshes 'gran sems can gyis bstod ra bas/ /pha mas ngan mtshang brus shing brdungs na dga'/ /ci tsam bshad kyang kha la mi nyan pa'i/ /'khor g.yog mang po yod las med na dga'/ /gyod sna kha mchu mang po 'gre mkhan gyi/ /bu las rabs chad pho mo yin na dga'/ /bzang tshang g.yog 'khor kun la mi byams pa'i/ /mna' ma bdud mo yod las med na dga'/ /phu ru ka ca gcog pa'i byis pa'i rigs/ /nang du 'jog las phyi sgor phud na dga'/ /bza' bsdigs thug pa rgyun du skol mkhan gye/ /rgad po rnams kyi kha la thal ba rgyob/ /nam yang ngo la skyid cig bzung yod pa'i/ /rgan mo rnams kyi ngo so yar la bstod/ /mi tshe skyid dang chos la gzad gyur na/ /mi lus thob pa don dang ldan par 'gyur/ /glu 'di thos tshad yon bdag pho mo yi/ /snang ba dam pa'i chos la 'gyur bar shog /yul phyogs 'di ru bkra shis g.yang chags shing / /g.yang nor mang pos sa steng khyab gyur cig /ces blangs pas thams cad dad pa skyes/1045

jag pa rkun ma mang pos jag brkus bcad/ jag khrims dang rkun khrims bsdams/ bsnyen gnas smyung gnas lnga mchod dus/ bzang tshes bcu sogs kyi rgyun btsugs/ grub dbang pad+ma rang grol nas rta nor bco lnga lug lnga bcu byin pa'i nang nas phyed ka phyir phul/ de nas mang ra'i rkang rtsa 'khyams ru rang ngan hris nag thar shul zhabs drung gi ru sde rnams la rim gyes song bka' bsgo byin rlabs byas/ rgan rgon tshor 'pho lung / bsngo smon bkra shis brjod pas/ nyin re la rta nor bzhi bcu lnga bcu dang / lug kyang mang po 'bul mkhan byung / dngul kyang rdo tshad mang po byung / de'i thog nas rwa rgya dgon la rta mdzo 'bri g.yag che chung lnga bcu/ mar rkyal brgyad/ nas do po drug la mo bde chen dgon pa la/ rta mdzo 'bri g.yag che chung lnga bcu/mar rkyal bcu/ ja thug gi dod du dngul srang bcu/ khri ga'i jo bo chen po'i drung du dngul srang nyis brgya'i mchod kong chen po gcig bzhag nas/ stong mchod phul smon lam rgya chen po btab/khri ga'i phyogs kyi dgon pa sum cu so drug tsam la/ mdzo re dang dngul srang gang re phul/ gzhan dgon pa'i las tshan 'bul sdud pa 'ong ba rnams la rta mdzo nyi shu tsam song / slob bu mkhas pa dang tshe mgon gnyis kyis a chung gnam rdzong gi lha khang 1046

nyams gso byas pa'i nang du rta gcig mar chur do po gnyis phul/ bde chen dpon slob rin po che la mjal/ rta gos gnyis phul chos 'brel zhus/ a rig dge bshes rin po che'i sprul sku la mjal/ byin rten dang rta gcig phul nas skyabs 'jug zhus/ma phyag sprul pa'i sku mjal du phebs pa la thig le bcu drug gi dbang lung phul/ rta gcig gnang ba phyir phul/ de'i dgun zhabs phyi pa mang po chu bzang du bsdad/ ngas rma 'gram ma phyag dgon nas mtshams byas/ dge 'dun pa rnams la 'gyed phogs kyi dod du/ rta nor bdun byin/ 'du khang nang du rje bdag nyid chen po'i sgu gcig bzhengs/ de'i lo grwa btsun slong mkhan mang po la snga phyi byas rta mdzo 'bri g.yag brgyad cu/ chu bzang nas sprang po mang po la/ dngul rdo tshad dgu dang / rta rgod ma bcu gsum gyi rtsam pa nyos nas byen/ des ma 'dangs par lug brgya lhag tsam byen pas sprang po mu ges 'chi thag chod brgya lhag cig gi tshe thar ba byung / de'i tshe dbus gtsang mnga' ris phyogs kyi slob ma yon bdag rnams la phan pa'i spring yig snyan pa'i ba dan dkar bo zhes bya ba/ rang gi slob bu bkra shis lhun po khams lho kha brgyud nas dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing du 'gro ba la bskur tshul ni/1047

'dzam gling rgyan gcig phyag mchod zhing gi mchog /jo shāka rnam gnyis rgyal ba yab sras la//gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje spyan gyis gzigs/ /bsam don chos bzhin 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /thog mar dge ba'i bshes la bka' chos zhus/ /bar du ri khrod dben par dge sbyor byas/ /tha ma slob ma yon bdag dge la sbyar/ /thog mtha' bar du dge ba'i zhabs dkar pas/ /dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing nas mdo smad du/ /slebs nas lo lnga tshun la chos ldan gye/ /bya ba legs po mang po bsgrubs tshul gye/ /snyan pa'i ba dan dkar po phyogs kun g.yo/ /dbus gtsang mnga' ris phyogs na gnas pa yi/ /skal ldan slob ma dad can sbyin bdag sogs/ /dkar po'i phyogs la dga' ba'i lha mi rnams/ /rab tu dga' ba'i sems kyis ma yengs nyon/ /dpal ldan bla ma dkon mchog thugs rje dang / /bdag gzhan dus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba'i mthus/ /khyed rnams thams cad bde zhing skyid pa'i sgos/ /rnam dkar dge la gzhol bzhin yod las che/ /bdag cag dbon slob 'khor dang bcas pa la lam skabs rnams su mi 'dod sna tshogs shig /byung yang rgyal ba yab sras thugs rje yis/ /mdo khams phyogs su bde bar slebs pa byung / /yul 'di'i skya ser drag zhan thams cad la/ /rgyu 'bras 048

gtso bor bton nas chos bshad pas//reb gong stod kyi jag pa rkun ma dang / /reb gong smad kyi 'thab rtsod thams cad chod/ /rong po'i bskor mtha'i 'phrog bcom kun zhi nas/ /da lta'i dus 'dir yul la sngar med kyi/ /bde skyid nyi ma gsar du shar ba byung //kun kyang dga' ba'i gtam snyan phyogs bcur sgog /yul phyogs 'di yis rang rang 'byor tshad kyi/ /zas nor longs spyod mang po 'bul mkhan byung / /byung ma thag nas gsog 'jog ma byas par/ /phyogs 'di'i dge ba'i bshes la zhabs tog zhus/ /sku gsung thugs rten rnams la mchod pa phul/ /dge 'dun sde la 'gyed phogs mang ja btang / /ngan slong stong phrag mang por sbyin pa btang / /tshe thar srog blu'i rigs kyang mang po byas//khyad par bstan 'gro yongs kyi bde thabs dang / /skyabs mgon rgyal ba yab sras zhabs brtan du/ / dmigs nas lha khang nyams pa mang po gsos/ /rten bzhengs sngar med dgon dang grong yul la/ /gtsug lag khang kyang mang po bzheng du bcug /khyon bsdoms lha khang brgya dang rtsa brgyad 'grub/ /sku rten che chung gnyis la khri phrag gcig /gsung rten mdo rgyud bstan bcos glegs bam stong / /thugs rten mchod rten che chung brgya phrag lhag /gzhan yang dben par mtshams khang mang po dang / /sku 1049

'bum tsha 'bum mang po rgyag mkhan dang / /mtshams dang sgrub pa byed mkhan mang po byung / /mdor na dngos sam brgyud nas bstan 'gro la/ /phan thogs rgya cher byung ba'i lo rgyus rnams/ /snyan grags 'dod pa'i blo yis ma bcings par/ /dkar po'i phyogs la dga' ba'i lha mi dang / /khyad par rang gi bla ma mched grogs dang / /slob ma yon bdag khri phrag 'bum phrag rnams/ /dga' zhing spro ba 'phel ba'i mchod sprin du/ /spros pas mthong thos dkar phyogs lha mi kun/ /rab tu dga' bas rjes su yi rang mdzod/ /bsod nams mnyam por 'thob pa'i skal ba yod/ /da dung ma shi tshe ring byung gyur na/ /lo re lo gnyis bsdad nas yul phyogs 'di'i/ /bstan dang 'gro ba yongs la gang phan byas/ /chos ldan bya ba thams cad mthar thon tshe/ /slar yang grogs bzang dang bcas dbus gtsang gi /'byor ldan bsod nams gsog pa'i zhing gi mchog /jo shāka rnam gnyis rgyal ba yab sras dang / /ser 'bras dge gsum slob ma yon bdag la/ /mjal du yong dgos snyam pa yid la shar/ /'dod pa'i nang bzhin dbus su myur slebs nas/ /jo bo yid bzhin nor bur mchod pa phul/ /rgyal ba yab sras gnyis la zhabs tog zhus/ /bstan 'gro yongs la phan pa'i smon lam 'debs/ /'brug gi lo 1050

la gtam snyan dbyar gyi rnga/ /dbus gtsang phyogs su ldir ba'i rten 'brel la/ /brten nas char chu dus babs lo phyugs legs/ /rgyal khams thams cad bde zhing skyid par shog /skyabs mgon rgyal ba yab sras thugs rje dang / /slob ma yon bdag rnams kyi dad mos dang / /bdag gi lhag bsam rnam par dag pa'i mthus/ /yid la smon pa'i gnas kun myur 'grub shog /ces pa dang / gzhan yang spring yig ka la piṅka'i sgra dbyangs/ nyams mgur khu byug sngon mo'i skad snyan/ 'dun ma legs pa'i mgur dbyangs gdangs snyan pi wang gling bu/ dam chos gser 'od dam pa'i rnga sgra zhes bya ba rnams bskur ba mgur 'bum na gsal/ de dag rnams slob ma yon bdag rnams kyi lag tu 'byor bas dngos su mjal ba lta bu'i dga' spro tshad las 'das pa byung skad/ de'i lo rjes ma de la slob bu grub chen dang / dbon po dkar dris stag yan rnams chu bzang nas bsdad nas jo bo'i lha khang brgyab/ de'i rgyu song la dngul rdo tshad gsum gye gser shog dang tshon rtsi/ lha bzo'i yon la/ rta mdzo 'bri g.yag nyi shu dang / lug lnga bcu/ dngul srang bcu gsum/ shing bzo rnams la/ rta nor nyi shu dngul srang nyi shu rtsa lnga song / nged dpon slob mang po chu bzang nas phar 'bal 1051

phyogs su song / gser lag dgon pa'i rgya za'i khri pa rin bo cher mjal/ dgon pa gsar rgyag mdzad pa'i thebs su rta nor bco lnga/ ja lan chen phyed/ rkyal mar gcig dang bcas phul nas chos 'brel zhus/ de nas sngar gyi yon bdag rnying ba/ bong stag ban lo/ chos skyabs/ sbra che'i rin chen byams kyi nang dang / rgya za'i dpon po skal lo/ yul skyong chos spyon/ kho nag dpon po rnams kyi ru skor la rim gyis song / thams cad la tshe dbang bsgur/ chos bshad smon lam brjod pas/ dngul rdo tshad dang / rta gos nor lug mang po 'bul mkhan byung / khyon bsdoms pas 'brog pa thams cad kyis rgyu nom pa phul ba'i tho la/ rta mdzo 'bri g.yag che chung stong phrag gcig dang sum brgya/lug stong dang bdun brgya/ rgyal mar brgya dang brgyad cu/ chu ra do po brgya/ ja lan chen bcu/ dngul rdo tshad sum cu so gsum/ bhu la ko bubs bdun cu/ bhu la'i lham drug cu/ wa lpags bzhi bcu/ ras dang dā bu lnga brgya lhag kha btags che chung stong phrag mang po byung / de dus slob ma yon bdag rnams la phun sum tshogs pa'i bkra shis 'di brjod do//oṃ swa sti/ sangs rgyas nam mkha' gang ba'i bkra shis shog /chos kyis bar snang gang ba'i bkra shis shog /dge 'dun sa 1052

gzhi gang ba'i bkra shis shog /skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum gyi bkra shis shog /mthon po'i nam mkha' la yang bkra shis shog /dma' mo'i sa gzhi la yang bkra shis shog /yangs po'i bar snang la yang bkra shis shog gnam sa bar snang khyab pa'i bkra shis shog /nam mkha'i char ba 'bab pa'i bkra shis shog /bar snang 'ja' sprin 'khrigs pa'i bkra shis shog /sa gzhi lo phyugs legs pa'i bkra shis shog /bde skyid nyi ma 'a ཿnga ba'i bkra shis shog /pha ma bu gsum 'dzom pa'i bkra shis shog /mi nor zas gsum 'dzom pa'i bkra shis shog /lto gos chos gsum 'dzom pa'i bkra shis shog /bde skyid snyan gsum 'dzom pa'i bkra shis shog lha mis dga' ston 'gyed pa'i bkra shis shog /snyan pa'i glu dbyangs len pa'i bkra shis shog /skyid pa'i bro chung 'khrab pa'i bkra shis shog /dga' ba'i gar yang bsgyur ba'i bkra shis shog /lha yi yul bzhin bde ba'i bkra shis shog /rdzogs ldan dus bzhin skyid pa'i bkra shis shog /rtag tu dga' zhing spro ba'i bkra shis shog /thams cad phun sum tshogs pa'i bkra shis shog /ces brjod pas 'bal mang ra'i sa cha rtswa mi skye sa thams cad la rtswa yag po sgyes/lung ba chu med sa thams cad la chu rdol ba sogs bkra shis po 1053

byung bas kun sngar bas dad cing gus par gyur to/ /de nas shing bza' thams cad mkhyen pa'i sprul sku rin po cher mjal rta gcig phul/ rje btsun 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho rin po che'i sprul skur mjal rta gcig phul/ bla brang a lags mgon po la mjal rta gcig phul/ drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma rgyal mkhan chen rin po che'i sprul sgu rgya za'i a khu ban+de tshang gi nang na 'khrungs yod pa dang mjal/ rta mdzo bco lnga lug lnga bcu dngul srang bcu ja mar chu ra do po bcas phul/ gtsang dgon pa la/ rta mdzo 'bri g.yag che chung sum cu/ rkyal mar bzhi ja lan chen gcig bcas phul/ de dus reb gong dang sbra nag khag gsum po ma 'grigs par 'khrug grabs byas pas/ byang rtse mkhan rin po che dang nged rnam gnyis kyis bar nas gzu byas te/ rtsod pa chos phyogs su zhi bar byas pas mi mang po'i srog thar ba byung /de nas dben gnas bkra shis 'khyel bar 'ongs nas mtshams byas nas bsdad dus/ sha chang bud med sdig pa'i nyes dmigs bsams nas spang dgos tshul gye lung 'dren mang po yod pa'i rmad byung sprul pa'i glegs bam zhes bya ba brtsams/ dbyar kha sku drin 'khor med rtsa ba'i bla ma chos rgyal ngag gi dbang bo yab yum rnams dang po bzhugs pa'i gdan sa rnams dran nas 1054

mjal snying 'dod de/ sa bzang sog phyogs su song / thog mar chos rgyal rin po che'i sras la mjal 'tshams zhus phul/ tshur la yang gos chen sogs kyi bdag rkyen gnang ba byung / de nas sa thob kyi byang chub sems dpa' sku gzhogs la kha rin po che la mjal/ zla ba gcig lhag bsdad sku mdun nas klong chen snying thig gi chos skor las/ rig 'dzin 'dus pa mkha' 'gro bde chen rgyal mo gnyis kyi dbang lung zhus/ phar la bka' gdams thig le bcu drug gi dbang dang / sgrub thabs rin 'byung gi rjes gnang rnams phul/ khong la gsang ba rgya can gye po ti gsum sogs mkho ba'i phyag dpe mang po dang / phye rtsam phran bu bcas phul/ tshur bdag la rta nor bco lnga/ lug lnga bcu/ ras yug sum cu/ ja mar sogs mkho chas rnams gnang / yang zab lam gcod kyi bstan pa'i bdag po rje btsun bsod nams grags pa'i yang sprul mchog la mjal/ gsol rtsam zhig phul nas zhi ba lam zab gcod kyi lung zhus/ kha brda' mang po byas pas thugs mnyes bo byung / gsol ras bdag rkyen yang gnang /de nas sog po'i mgo pa tsig ge sogs dad can yon bdag mang pos bos/ der song nas tshe dbang byas chos bshad lugs gnyis kyi bslab bya'i mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so//1055

thams cad mkhyen la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag gzhan yongs la thugs rjes gzigs/ /lha chos mi chos lugs gnyis la/ /phan pa'i bslab bya bshad kyis nyon/ /su zhig 'ongs kyang mthong ma thag /bzhin mdangs 'dzum bzhin 'tshams 'dri gyes/ /mgron po gang yong lha bzhin bkur/ /ja chang byin la gtam snyan smros//dran tshad kha ru ma 'don par//smra tshod zungs la ran par smros/ /ngag 'jam blo khog yangs pa'i sgos/ /rang gzhan don gang yin yang sgrubs/ /lo rgyus don dag ma bshad na/ /phas kyang mi go rgyu mtshan shod/ /yag nyes zhib tu ma bshad na/ /bus kyang mi nyan kha ta chug /ma byin bu yang mi 'khor bas/ /'khor g.yog gnyen la zas gos byen/ /ma bslabs sus kyang mi shes pas/ /lugs gnyis gang la'ang mkhas par slobs/ /spyi mi dgra ru ma len par//gnyen du khug dang rang la bzang bzang po'i che ba 'don mi dgos/ /dman sa bzung rung kun gyis bkur/ /ngan pas che tshugs bzung na yang / /gzhan gyes mthong na zhe khrel 'phya//kha bzang gtam pas gnyen mi dga'//sems la zhog la phan thogs gyis/ /kha po che bas dgra mi thul/ /thabs mkhas 'jam pos btul na bzang / /ser sna che yang nor mi gsog /phar gtong tshur len shes pa dgos/ /'dun mar chung ma mkhas 1056

na yang / /gros dbang khyo gas bzung na mdzes//grogs po bzang la brtsi bkur gyis/ /nam dgos dus su slebs nas 'ong / /'dzom na skyid de khyag pa dang / /phongs na sdug kyang khyag pa dgos/ /ma bsam pa la thag ma gcod/ /gang gi thog tu 'bab mi shes/ /ma 'grub bar la kha po de/ /ma smra ci 'gyur shes pa dka'/ /ngan la smad ra ma che dang / /phyi nas bzang po yong na'ang thang / /bzang la bstod ra ma snga dang / /phyi nas ngan par 'gro yang srid/ /bsdigs brdung drag po g.yog la yang ma byed 'khor mkhan gcig mi 'ong / /dbang can drag po su la yang / /ma byed zhe la bzhag nas gnod/ /brnyas smod mtshang 'bru grogs la yang / /ma byed sems la gnod pa yin/ /sde pa spyi yi don sgrubs dang / /rang don shugs kyis 'grub nas 'ongs//mdor na rgyu 'bras zhib tu rtsis/ /lha mi'i bde skyid ngang gis 'byung / /legs bshad 'di nyid thos tshad kyis//mi la phan thogs 'byung bar shog /ces blangs pas kun gye snang ba chos la 'gyur nas/ rta nor mar chur mang po 'bul mkhan byung / de nas rtse gzhung dben pa'i dga' tshal thā yan chi ru song / zhag ma bdun bsdad/ mtshams khang la nyams gso btang / nang du sangs rgyas kyi sku khru gang yod pa zhig bzhengs/ lha bzo la mdzo 10 7

gcig phul/ gnas der gtsang a rig gi mjal ba mang po 'ongs nas mar chur mang po 'bul mkhan byung / chos bshad bsngo smon byas/ slob bu rig grol dang / khams pa grub chen gnyis la lo re'i phogs byen nas mtshams la sdod du bcug de nas chos rgyal yab yum dang po bzhugs pa'i gdan sa nyin mtha' yan chad la song nas phyag byas gsol ba btab/ bla ma dran pa'i gdung dbyangs 'di blangs so//gzugs sku chos kyi dbyings su bsdus/ /mi mngon dbyings na bzhugs pa yi/ /zhal mjal gsung thos bla ma rnams/ /thugs rjes dgongs la byin gyis rlobs/ /sngon dus zhal mjal gsung thos pa'i/ /rang gi yul phyogs bla ma rnams/ /da lta bzhugs na dga' ba la/ /mjal nas zhabs tog byed snying 'dod/ /da lta gcig kyang mi bzhugs par/ /dag pa'i zhing khams gzhan du gshegs/ /nang nas bla ma gcig yin kyang / /mi bzhugs shul lus skal chad po/ /bsam zhing mchi ma char bzhin babs/ /bla ma thams cad rim pas dran/ /mi bzhugs de yang mi bzhugs snyam/ /bsam zhing bsam zhing shes pa 'phyo/ /khyad par chos rgyal yab yum gyi/ /zhal ras gsung dbyangs mdzad spyod dang / /sku drin che tshul dran pa'i mod/ /sems sdug mya ngan 1058

yang yang byung / /shul lus rang yang 'chi la nye/ /ma shi gong 'dir lha chos byed/ /phyi mar dag pa'i zhing khams nas/ /bla ma rnams dang mjal bar shog /ces blangs pas bla ma re re bzhin dran pa byung / khyad par chos rgyal yab yum gnyis yid la wal ler dran pas sems skyo ba tshad las 'das pa byung mig nas mchi ma mang po shor ro/ /de nas tshur 'ong zhor la reb gong stod kyi shug 'dus grub gnas la mjal/ zhag po kha shas la gnas 'brel bzhag kha sog la kha/ dkar ron khog btsan mo thang sogs phyogs de'i rong 'brog gi yon bdag rnams kyis bos/ nang du song rta nor mang po phul/ smon lam bkra shis brjod yul mi thams cad phyogs gcig tu 'tshogs su bcugachos bshad mgur dbyangs blangs te blo kha chos la bsgyur/ de nas rdzong dkar rdzong sngon bde chen dgon pa rnams la mjal/lha khang la mar ske phul/ 'gyed mang ja btang / sku gzhogs rdzong sngon tshang gi byams khang thebs la rta gcig dang byin rten mang po phul/ tshur la sku gsung thugs rten rta gos bye ru mang po bcas gnang ba byung / de nas yang bkra shis 'khyil bar 'ongs nas mtshams byas bsdad dus/ 'dod yon ma spangs rgyan du rol ba'i bla ma skyes chen dam pa rnams dang / gsang sngags 1059

rim gnyis nyams su len pa'i rnal 'byor pa rnams la dad gus dag snang sbyong dgos tshul lung rigs kyi lam nas drangs pa'i dag snang sprul pa'i glegs bam zhes bya ba brtsams/ de'i rjes nas yang lo gcig hris nag dang gcan za'i thang gi 'brog la 'gro don la song / tris nag bla ma sogs yon bdag thams cad la tshe dbang nor dbang byas/ las rgyu 'bras kyi chos bshad/ phan pa'i gtam rnams mgur dbyangs su blangs so//lugs gnyis mkhyen pa rnams la 'dud/ /legs nyes shes par byen gyes rlobs/ /lha mi'i bde skyid 'byung ba'i phyir/ /phan pa'i glu dbyangs len la nyon/ /sdug pa'i mi la ma 'phya dang / /sdug po rang la 'ong nyen yod/ /skyid dus mi la ma ngom dang / /skyid po gzhan la 'ong yang thang / /gros nyes byung la 'gyod pa 'dra/ /ma bskyed nor 'khrul rang la'ang yong / /phan btags pa la drin ma 'dren/ /byen pa ngo med yal nas 'gro /mi kha byams dang spyod pa la/ /rag las mdzad spyod mi dang bstun/ /rdzun dang g.yo sgyu ma byas na/ /gang la song yang lto gos rnyed/ /kha nyung lag pa gtsang ba na/ /gang du bsdad kyang mi yis byams/ /'dod pa chung zhing chog shes na/ /su dang 'grogs kyang mthun po 1060

'ong / /mi ngan ma rabs lag tu dbang / /ma 'jog kun la sdug las gtong / /mi bzang ya rabs mtho sar zhog /de la brten nas rang gzhan bde/ /yon tan yod tshad bu la slobs/ /nam phugs pha bu gnyis ka skyid/ /drin can bla ma pha ma la ci mnyes gyes dang ci bsam 'grub/ /mtho dman bar gsum gong du khur/ /lha mi thams cad dga' bar 'gyur/ /bsam pa bzang pos gzhan gyi don/ /bsgrubs na rang nyid shugs kyis skyid/ /mi gshis yag po lha 'dra ba/ /gang du song yang kun gyes bkur/ /mdor na don dag gang byed kyang / /rgyu 'bras dpang por zhog la gyis/ /de ltar byas na tshe 'dir bde/ /phyi ma lha mi'i go 'phang 'thob/ /glu 'di thos tshad thams cad kyi/ /rgyud la phan thogs 'byung bar shog /phyogs dus kun tu bkra shis shing / /tshe ring nad med bde skyid shog /ces blangs nas yul phyogs la phan pa'i byin 'bebs byas/ bkra shis brjod pas/ de nas bzung na tsha god kha thams cad zhi zhing gcan za'i thang la sngar med pa'i rtswa yag po skyes pa byung nas/ yon bdag kun dad cing gus par gyur te/ jag brkus 'jog pa dang srog gcod spong ba/dge ba'i khas len byed mkhan mang po byung / 'bul ba rta nor brgya dang lug bdun cu byung / de dus gnyer pa o rgyan dpon 1061

g.yog kha shas bcas dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing la mchod 'bul du 'gro bar byas nas/ rgya dngul rdo tshad bcu/ bhu la/ khe bu su/ gos chen g.yu byer kha btags mang po/ rta mdzo sum cu so gsum bcas song dus/ dbus gtsang gi slob ma yon bdag mchog dman bar ma yongs la dge ba'i gsal 'debs su legs bshad nor bu'i phreng ba 'di phul lo//lhar bcas 'gro ba yongs kyi gtsug gi rgyan/ /rgyal ba yab sras gnyis la ba/sol ba 'debs/ /lha mi yongs la thugs rje spyan gyis gzigs/ /bdag gzhan don gnyis 'grub par byin gyes rlobs/ /blo dman bdag 'dras legs bshad 'doms pa la/ /blo ldan rnams kyang nyon cig dbus gtsang pa/ /dal 'byor mi lus yid bzhin nor las lhag /don med chud zos ma gtong dbus gtsang pa/ /snyigs dus tshe thung nam 'chi nges pa med/ /tshe 'di'i blo rgya ma che dbus gtsang pa/ /yengs ma lam la mi tshe zad nas 'gro /phyi ma'i sa lam 'chos shig dbus gtsang pa/ /dkon mchog skyabs su bsten na 'di phyir bde/ /rtag tu skyabs 'gro gyes shig dbus gtsang pa/ /jo bo yid bzhin nor bu rnam gnyis la//mchod bstod gsol ba thobs shig dbus gtsang pa/ /bod kyi lha skal spyan ras gzigs dbang yin/ /kun gyes ma ṇi 1062

bgrongs shig dbus gtsang pa/ /'di phyi'i skyabs gnas rgyal ba yab sras yin/ /snying nas gsol ba thobs shig dbus gtsang pa/ /gtan gyi bde thabs rgyal ba'i gsung rab yin/ /ston pa'i gsung bzhin sgrubs shig dbus gtsang pa/ /rgyal khams bde la 'god mkhan gong ma yin/ /gong ma'i bka' khrims rtsis shig dbus gtsang pa/ /bla mas ci gsungs bsgrubs na ci bsam/ 'grub/ /ci gsungs bka' bzhin sgrubs shig dbus gtsang pa/ /bsod nams gsog pa'i zhing mchog dge 'dun yin/ /ser 'bras dge gsum mchod cig dbus gtsang pa/ /pha ma bkur na bu la bsod nams skye/ /rgyun du lha bzhin bkur cig dbus gtsang pa/ /phyag dang skor bas nad gdon sdig sgrib 'dag /lha ldan bsam yas skor cig dbus gtsang pa/ /rnyed tshad bsags nas bzhag na dgra 'dres 'khyer/ /ma gsog sbyin pa thongs shig dbus gtsang pa/ /bla ma dpon pos phyug po'i ngo bzung nas/ /gzu log khrims log ma byed dbus gtsang pa/ /rgyal blon kun gyes drang por thag bcad nas/ /'bangs kyis zhu log ma byed dbus gtsang pa/ /ya rabs gong du bkur na kun la byams/ /go sa mthon por skyol cig dbus gtsang pa ma rabs mtho sar slebs na dman la sdang / /las tshan mthon por ma bsko dbus 1063

gtsang pa/ /khyim mtshes chags sdang can gyis bstod ra bas/ /pha mas smad ra dga' 'o dbus gtsang pa/ /dran tshad kha ru bton na kha mchur 'thug /don med lab lob ma mang dbus gtsang pa/ /g.yog po g.yog mos gang bcol go chod dgos/ /rku dang rdzun la ma dga' dbus gtsang pa/ /skyabs mgon rgyal ba yab sras zhabs brtan du/ /tshe thar srog blu gyes shig dbus gtsang pa/ /srog gcod mang na char ba 'bab pa dka'//dbyar kha srog gcod ma byed dbus gtsang pa/ /ban sngags bon dang 'gras na byad kha sdang / /'di la dogs zon gyis shig dbus gtsang pa/ /dge tshogs 'joms shing dmyal bar 'gro ba'i rgyu/ /zhe sdang khong khro ma mang dbus gtsang pa/ /dge rtsa 'phel zhing sangs rgyas 'thob pa'i rgyu/ /bsngo smon rgya chen gyis shig dbus gtsang pa/ /ngo mtshar legs bshad nor bu'i phreng ba 'di/ /skyes kyi mchog tu bsgur ro dbus gtsang pa/ /ya rabs rnams kyi mgul pa'i rgyan du longs/ /rgyan gye mchog tu 'gyur ro dbus gtsang pa/ /gtam 'di rgyal khams gang du sgog na yang / /thos tshad thams cad bde zhing skyid par shog /rgyal khams yongs la bkra shis lo yag cing / /lo yag snye mas sa steng khyab gyur cig /ces pa dang / gzhan yang rgyal ba yab sras kyi zhu shog /jo shāka rnam 1064
