gnyis kyi gso/la 'debs/ man ngag gser gye thur ma/ skyo mgur pi wang rgyud mangs bskur ba rnams mgur 'bum na gsal lo/ /de nas dgu rong phu pa ru song / chos bshad 'gro don byas pas/ dgu rong phu mthil gnyis kyi yon bdag rnams kyi dre'u sga stan srab gsum lnga/ mdzo mo 'bri g.yag ba glang bcu/ra lug gnyis ka sum cu byung / dgu rong ma ṇi thang gi lha khang rgya za lar gyi dmag gis me brgyab nas bsregs song ba slar gsar rgyag byed par khas blangs/ sangs rgyas kyi sku li ma gcig dang 'dzam bu gling gi sa sna rten sna byin/ de nas shing dkar/dgur steng / snang ra rnams la song nas dbang bskur chos bshad pas thams cad kyi snang ba chos la 'gyur/ chos rje don rin po che'i rab gnas phog pa'i snang ra'i gser khang gi rten gye gtso bo thub dbang la mjal nas mchod 'bul byas/ yon bdag rnams la lha khang gi phyi'i lcags ri rnams gro mag gis btums su bcug mchod rten chen po la nyams gso btang /de nas lo rdo rje brag dang ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma rnams bya rgod du sprul nas bris par grags pa'i lo ba'i gser yum la mjal/ skya ring mchod rten la rab gnas byas/ de nas ri snying por song zhag po mang po bsdad/ sngags pa dad can mang po la 1065

sems khrid byas/ chos 'khor chen po'i lha khang rgyab la nyams gso btang / dgon bdag dkon mchog dang der 'dug pa'i dge slong rnams la phan thogs byas/ sbrul lce dang rdo ring la song / ma ṇi lha khang la rab gnas bkra shis brjod/ hor pa shitris nag 'khyams tshang / lto tshang / zho 'dzom la kha/ ke'u chu la sogs pa'i phyob/sa de'i sde pa mang por song nas tshe dbang bskur chos bshad mgur dbyangs 'di yang blangs so//bla ma dkon mchog byin rlabs can/ /'dir 'tshogs sgo gsum byin gyis rlobs/ /dpon po pho skyes bud med la/ /dgos pa'i glu dbyangs len gyis nyon/ /kha yi smra ba bzang dang gcig /khog gi bsam pa yag dang gnyis/ /gtam rnams drang por smra dang gsum/ /bsam mno legs par gtong dang bzhi/ /nye ring mi byed pa dang lnga/ /rang 'dod chung dang drug po 'di/ /dpon po rnams la dgos pa yin/ /gtong phod rab tu che dang gcig /gdong btsan shin tu drag dang gnyis/ /blo kha mi 'gyur brtan pa gsum /'gran zla byung na thub dang bzhi/ /lus sems stobs rtsal che dang lnga/ /tshod zin po dang drug po 'di/ /pho sgyes rnams la dgos pa yin/ /cho rigs shin tu btsun dang gcig /khrel yod ngo tsha che dang gnyis/ /nor gye gsog tshul shes dang 1066

gsum/ /'khor g.yog skyong la mkhas dang bzhi/ /khyo ka gzhan mi bsten dang lnga/ /grogs lhar mthong dang drug po 'di/ /bud med rnams la dgos pa yin/ /dpon po pho sgyes bud med la/ /dgos pa drug gi glu dbyangs 'di/ /tshogs drug rang grol blangs pa yin/ /thos tshad yongs la phan par shog /ces blangs nas kun gye snang ba chos la bsgyur bas/ yon bdag pho mo rnams kyis rab tu dad pa'i sgo nas/ dre'u bzhi/ mdzo mo gnyis/ ba gling bzhi bcu/ nas do po nyis brgya/ gdan dkar bco lnga/ ja nag bco brgyad/ me mda' bcu gsum/ dkar yol sum cu/ g.yu bye ru mang po bcas phul ba byung / de dus bde chen dgon pa la 'bri g.yag sum cu/ rkyal mar gnyis/ lug lnga bcu/ jo bo'i lha khang nyams gso'i ched du dong tse khron brgya ja mar rtsam pa bcas phul/ gzhan phyogs de'i dgon pa che chung yod tshad la/rta nor re gnyis/ gsum bzhi bcas byin pas bzhi bcu song /de nas rma pha rir song nas a dar chags ka dang shes bzhin gnyis 'khrugs nas/ mi mang po gsod pa thabs du ma'i sgo nas 'grig tu bcug de dus khong gnyis kyi rtsod gzhi/ gzhi gsar sde pa'i nang gi sdong po chen po zhig gi khog pa'i nang gi bsil grib la bsdad nas khams bsangs byas yod pas/ nga'i rtsar rgya 1067

sog po rgad po zhig 'ongs nas yun ring zhig gi bar du bltas nas/ kho na re/ khyod snga mo zhig nas nga'i rna bas go gin bsdad la mjal yong bsam pa ma byung / da res mjal ba dang nga yang sems dga' ba zhig byung / sngon yin na a rig dge bshes bla ma bzang po de bzang zer/ deng sang a lags zhabs dkar khyed bzang gi zer/ nga la nor cang med de/ khyod nga yod sar ja zhig 'thung du 'gro zer/ nga song nas kho'i nang du ja 'thung go re zos nas/ kho la nged tsho nam zhig la shi 'gro mi shes/ nang mi tshor bza' bsdigs 'dra ma byed/ sems yag po gyis dang / ma shi na nor rnyed yong / tshe mjug sdug po mi yong /bya byis tsho cher song na pha bu kun tshe mjug skyid po 'ong zhes kha ta byas/ 'gro khar bsngo smon byas/ bkra shis dbyangs byas brjod tshe/ bud med rgya mo zhig 'dug pa de yang dad nas mig nas mchi ma zhig gtong bar gda'/ khos nga tshur bskyal nas/ a lags da dung 'dir re re shog zer/ ngas ya ya ma shi na yong / da khyod bde mor byas pas/ da a lags bde mor zer nas nang du phyir song / yang de dus a dar chags ga'i thang gi lha khang gsar bzhengs bu chen bstan 'dzin nyi mas byas pa'i rgyu song la/ rta nor bco brgyad/ gser shog khri bam 1068

gcig dang stong bam gsum/ ja mar rtsam pa mang po song a dar chags ga'i dpon pos dre'u gcig me mda' shang lang ja nag gcig bcas phul/ khya ra mgos rta gcig dang g.yu byi ru mang po phul/ de bzhin du phyogs de nas ba glang gro nas sogs zas nor mang po 'bul mkhan byung / de nas bya khyung dgon par mjal/ rta mdzo 'bri g.yag che chung bzhi bcu/ rkyal mar bzhi/ ja nag bzhi rnams phul nas 'gyed mang ja btang / de dus sku gzhogs lcang skya thams cad mkhyen pa mchog dang / chu bzang rin po che rnam gnyis la 'tshams zhus su slob bu grub chen dang gnas brtan gnyis btang dus zhu shog 'di phul lo//mtha' dbus med pa'i mkha' klong yangs por 'od gsal nyi zla zung du shar ba bzhin lho rgyal 'dzam gling dpal du shar ba'i lcang skya thams cad mkhyen pa mchog dang / chu bzang rin po che rnam gnyis kyi zhabs zung gser gyi 'khor los mtshan pa'i drung du/ rgyal khams 'grims pa'i rnal 'byor zhabs dkar pas rab tu gus pas lha phyag grangs med bcas te gsol ba 'debs 'bras/ skyabs mgon rje btsun rnam gnyis gzugs sku bde zhing thugs bskyed rgya chen po'i sgo nas/ bstan 'gro'i don rlabs po che mdzad pa skye 'gro yongs la bka' drin 1069

kun gyi nang nas rab dang phul dang mchog tu gyur lags/ phran kyang bla ma mchog gsum gyi thugs rje la brten nas/ lus sems bde tshe/ bya rgod lad mo bye'us byed bzhin dam pa gong ma'i rnam thar rjes su kha mig yar blta byas rgyal sras kyi spyod pa la ci nus su slob bzhin mchis/ 'tshams zhu/ skyabs rje dam pa gnyis kyis bstan 'gro'i bde thabs su dmigs nas/sngar med pa/'i ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i gtsug lag khang rten brten pa gsar du bzhengs pa kun thugs kyi bzhed pa ltar 'bad med lhun gyes grub tshe/ lha mi yongs kyis mgrin gcig tu/ dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing gi sngon chos rgyal srong btsan sgam ba'i dus su bzhengs pa'i lha ldan ra sa 'phrul snang gi gtsug lag khang rten brten pa mdo smad gdul bya'i dpal du 'phos pa dang 'dra zhes gtam snyan dbyar dus kyi 'brug bzhin/phyogs kun tu ldir ba lan cig ma yin par yang yang thos pas/dad gus dag snang mjal 'dod rnams dbyar gyi mtsho ltar rgyas shing / kha tsam min par rab tu dga' bas rjes su yi rang byung /slar yang ched gsol/ da dung yang bstan 'gro'i don du sku tshe brtan cing rnam dkar mdzad pa 'phrin las rnams lo re bzhin gong 'phel mdzad du gsol zhes lag gnyis thal mo sbyar nas 1070

gsol ba 'debs/ 'di nas kyang bstan pa'i srog shing 'dzin pa'i skyes mchog rnam gnyis la dus rgyun du rang gi gang shes kyis zhabs brtan 'bul/ skyabs mchog rnam gnyis kyis kyang bdag dang bdag 'dra'i gdul bya mtha' dag byang chub ma thob kyi bar du skye ba nas tshe rabs thams cad du rjes su 'dzin pa'i skyabs 'jug zab yangs thugs kyi klong nas nam yang mi 'dor ba mkhyen mkhyen zhes 'tshams zhus mtshon byed rta bzang po gnyis/ dre'u gcig dri ma med pa'i lha rdzas zung bcas dgon gnas dam pa bya khyung nas zla tshes bzang bor phul/ slar yang tshigs su bcad de smras pa/mtha' dbus med pa'i mkha' klong yangs po ru/ /'od gsal nyi zla zung gcig shar ba bzhin/ /lho rgyal 'dzam gling dpal du legs shar ba'i/ /skyabs mgon rnam gnyis zhabs kyi pad+mo'i drung / /phyogs med rgyal khams nges med ri khrod rnams/ /'grims pa'i rnal 'byor gu yangs blo bde ngas/ /rab tu gus pas lha phyag grangs med bcas/ /lag gnyis thal mo sbyar nas 'di skad zhu/ /skyabs mgon rnam gnyis sngon nas sangs rgyas kyang / /snyigs ma'i dus 'dir gdul bya'i snang ngo ru/ /gsum ldan ngur smrig 'dzin pa'i tshul bzung nas/ /bstan dang 'gro 1071

don mdzad pa bka' drin che/ /phran kyang bla ma mchog gsum thugs rje la/ /brten nas lus sems shin tu bde ba'i mod/ /bya rgod lad mo bye'us byed pa bzhin/ /gong ma'i rnam thar rjes su 'jug bzhin mchis/ /sngon dus chos rgyal dus su bzhengs pa yi/ /ra sa 'phrul snang rten dang brten par bcas/ /mdo khams smad du 'phos 'dra'i gtsug lag khang / /ring por ma thogs myur du 'grub 'dug ces/ /gtam snyan dbyar gyi 'brug bzhin grags pa de/ /yang yang thos pas dad gus dag snang dang / /myur du mjal 'dod rjes su yi rang rnams/ /lan cig ma yin yang dang yang du byung / /da yang gsol ba 'debs pa'i snying po la/ /skyabs mgon rnam gnyis sku tshe brtan pa dang / /bstan dang 'gro don gong 'phel mdzod cig ces/ /kha tsam min par yang yang gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag dang bdag 'dra'i gdul bya ma lus pa/ /deng nas bzung ste byang chub ma thob bar tshe rabs kun tu skyabs mgon rnam gnyis kyis/ /'bral med rjes su 'dzin pa'i skyabs 'jug zhu/ /skyabs 'jug zhu rten stong ba min tsam du/ /rta dre'u gsum dang lha rdzas dri med bcas/ /phan bde'i 'byung gnas bya khyung dgon chen nas/ /zla tshes bzang por rab tu gus pas phul/ /zhes pa 'di khyer nas song /1072

khong gnyis phyir 'khor nas rgyu mtshan rnams bshad pas mjal 'dod cher song / bdag gis re zhig gi bar du bya khyung gser gdung sogs la mchod 'bul byas/ bla ma rnams la mjal/skyabs 'jug zhus/ phyag skor byas gnas bsdad/ de nas phar song do sho la sogs pa'i sde pa kha shas la song / 'gro don byas gro nas dang dong tse 'bul mkhan mang po byung / zhong shan lha chen dpal 'bar la mjal/ mchod 'bul byas smon lam btab/ de nas mi nyung nyung byas yar gser khang du song nas zhag gcig bsdad/ phyir nyin snga mo nas tsong kha'i skyes ri'i g.yas phyogs kyi ri rtse nas phar nang du rkang thang la song /phar nang nas dre'u zhon nas chu bzang du song / sku gzhogs lcang skya thams cad mkhyen par mjal tshe dpag med kyi sku gcig theg mchog mdzod kyi glegs bam gcig rang nyid zhon pa'i dre'u sga srab dang bcas pa phul nas/ blo sbyong mdzon cha'i 'khor lo'i 'grel ba'i lung zhus/ sku gzhogs chu bzang rin po cher mjal/ gos gcig phul chos 'brel zhus/ khri rgya nag pa'i sprul sku rin po cher mjal/ gos gcig phul skyabs 'jug zhus/de nas lha khang 'grub pa'i dga' sto na la skyes lha'i lab tse bstod du sku gzhogs lcang skya rin po che/ chu bzang tshang rgya 1073

nag gser khri'i sprul sku/ ra gor tshang / rje drung tshang / shar tshang sogs bla chen mang bo phebs nas lab tse bstad lha bsang btang ba'i rjes su/ thang nas gur phub ston mo chen po byas dus/skyabs mchog lcang skya rin po che nas bdag la mgur dbyangs shig longs zhes bka' bstsal pa bzhin/ phun sum tshogs pa lnga'i mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so//byen rlabs stsol ba'i bla ma rje/ /dngos grub ster ba'i yi dam lha/ /bar chad sel ba'i mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ /spyi gtsug 'khor lo'i rgyan du bzhugs/ /'dir 'tshogs dkar phyogs lha mi la/ /byin rlabs dngos grub char bzhin phob//bde skyid phun sum tshogs dus 'dir/ /nyams dga' spro ba'i mgur dbyangs len/ /gnas 'di ngo mtshar dag pa'i zhing / /mgon 'di lcang skya rdo rje 'chang / /'khor 'di las can dag pa'i 'khor/ /chos 'di bla med theg chen chos/ /dus 'di rdzogs ldan nyin mo'i dus/ /bkra shis phun sum tshogs pa lags/ /phun sum tshogs pa'i gnas mchog 'dir/ /bla ma yi dam sprin ltar gtibs/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro 'ja' ltar bkra/ /chos skyong srung ma glog ltar 'khyugs/ /byen rlabs dngos grub char ltar babs/ /snyan dang grags pa 'brug bzhin ldir/ /'dod yon 1074

longs spyod mtsho ltar 'khyil/ /bde skyid nyi ma bzhin du shar/ /nyams rtogs yon tan zla ltar rgyas/ /bkra shis phun sum tshogs pa lags/ /phun sum tshogs pa'i glu dbyangs 'di/ /thos tshad bde zhing skyid par shog /bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa'i sgos/ /lha chos byed pa'i bkra shis shog /ces pa dang / gzhan yang sngar tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i skabs su len pa'i ngo mtshar skyid pa'i glu dbyangs cung zad bcos nas 'di ltar blangs so//ngo mtshar byin rlabs zhu ba la/ /dngos dang brgyud pa'i bla ma yod/ /byin rlabs gzhan la re dgos med/ /'o skol rnams tsho'i dga' ba la/ /mchog thun dngos grub ster ba la/ /yi dam zhi khro'i lha tshogs yod/ /dngos grub gzhan la re dgos med/ /'o skol rnams tsho'i dga' ba la/ /'gal rkyen bar chad sel ba la/ /gnas gsum mkha' 'gro chos skyong yod/ /lha srung gzhan la re dgos med/ /'o skal rnams tsho'i dga' ba la/ /tshe gcig sangs rgyas thob pa la/ /gsang sngags smin grol gdams pa yod/ /sangs rgyas mi rgya je tshom med//'o skol rnams tsho'i skyid pa la/ /bla med byang chub sgrub grogs la/ /dam gtsang rdo rje mched lcam yod/ /sangs yang mnyam bor rgya ba lags/ /'o skol rnams tsho'i skyid pa la/ /bsod nams gsog pa'i zhing mchog 1075

tu/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rten bzhengs yod/ /bsam don yid bzhin 'grub pa lags/ /'o skol rnams tsho'i skyid pa la/ /skyid pa'i glu dbyangs blangs pa yis/ /bla ma mched lcam mnyes gyur cig /dkar phyogs lha mi dga' bar shog /yul 'dir bkra shis 'byung gyur cig /ces blangs pas der bzhugs pa'i bla dpon thams cad thugs mnyes/ lcang skya rin po ches kha btags nang mdzod cig gsol ras su gnang ngo / /gzhan yang rab gnas brgya dang brgyad 'grub pa'i mjug tu nga la yang rab gnas dang bkra shis brjod dgos gsungs nas byas pas/khong rnam gnyis nas thugs rab tu dgyes pa'i sgo nas rgya dngul rdo tshad gcig dang / rta gcig gos chen gnyis/ byi ru'i rgyan gyis mdzes pa'i phreng ba kha btags nang mdzod gnyis bcas bstsal pa gzhan rnams blangs dngul phyir phul nas/ lha khang la stong mchod dge 'dun la mang ja ngan slong la sbyin pa gtong du bcug nas skyabs mgon rnam gnyis la zhabs brtan dang smon lam gyi mtshams sbyor yang dag byas/ khong tshang gi tsha bo tsha mo gnyis la rgya 'dres gnod pa la bka' bsgo byin rlabs byas pas drag pa byung / dpal ri'i phyogs kyi yon bdag 'ga' res khong tsho'i yul phyogs la phebs zhes gdan 'dren byas 1076

kyang / da res yong mi thub par gda'/ rjes nas 'ong e thub blta zhes ma song / de dus bdag gi bsam pa la lcang skya rin po che dang lhan du rgya nag ri bo rtse lnga la lan cig gnas mjal du song na stabs bde snyam khong la zhus pas/ sgyes mchog dam pa khong gi zhal nas/ khyed dbus nas mdo smad 'dir bsam bzhin du 'gro don la byon nas phyogs 'di'i 'gro don thams cad bzhag nas/ rgya nag ri bo rtse lngar phebs na gnas mjal zhig los 'ong ste/ 'gro don mi 'ong / de gang yin na khyed kyis rgya skad sog skad gnyis kyi gcig kyang mi shes pa'i stabs kyis/ skad rigs ma go na gcig gis gcig la phrad kyang /dud 'gro dud 'gror phrad pa dang 'dra/ de bas sangs rgyas grangs med byon pas ma thul ba'i rong ngo/ reb gong dang rma chu'i pha ri tshur kha nas mi ngan gyong po rang gar sdod mi thub par/don dag phran tshegs re'i phyir mi mang po gsod pa 'di rnams la sngar yang phan thogs po byung 'dug da dung kyang lo kha shas 'di rnams la 'gro don byas na/ ri bo rtse lngar mjal ba las kyang brgya 'gyur gyis phan yon 'di be+e bar 'dug khyed dgung lo yang bgres par gda'/ rgya nag yul tsha ba yang che/ 'byung bzhi la yang e 'phrod mi shes/ sku tshe la bar chad 'dra yang mi 1077

yong ba'i nges pa med/ de bas rang yul 'dir bzhugs nas chu 'phrod 'gro don yang 'dir 'phel bar 'dug pas/ nga'i bsam pa yin na yul phyogs 'dir bzhugs na legs zhes gsungs/ de bzhin du shar thams cad mkhyen pas kyang / khyed phyogs gzhan la ma 'byon/ khyed kyi sngon gye thugs bskyed smon lam dang / 'phral du thabs mkhas pa'i stabs kyis/ reb gong stod smad bar gsum la sngar phan thogs po byung / da dung yang lo kha shas skyo ngal sun pa ma byed par phyogs 'di'i gdul bya gyong po 'di rnams la phan btags na/ dus gsum rgyal ba dgyes pa'i mchod sprin du 'gyur bar ma zad/ snyigs/ dus bla ma nga lta bu yang sems dga' bar 'dug gsungs tshe/ ri bo rtse lngar 'gro ba'i bsam sbyor bor nas/ khong rnam gnyis kyi gsung bzhin tshur 'ongs rma pha ri'i kha sgang la 'gro don byed dus/ rje btsun gser khang rin po che'i sras kyi thu bo a lags blon chos tshang gis tshigs su bcad pa'i glegs bu 'di bdag la bstsal byung /gnyug sems lhan skyes spros bral 'od gsal mthong / /gang snang sgyu ma'i yo lang ji bzhin rtogs/ /dgag sgrub spang blang bral ba'i rnal 'byor pa/ /sngags 'chang chen bo gang de'i zhabs drung 1078

du/ /nyam chung ban sprang rgad pos drang gtam zhu/ /'di snang chos brgyad spyon pa'i zlos gar dang / /srid pa'i ngang tshul me 'obs ltar mthong ste/ /skyo shas nges 'byung drag pos rgyud bskul nas/ /bstan pa'i sgor zhugs gsang sngags yang rtser mjal/ /gcig pur ri dwags rmas ma ji bzhin du/ /nges med bas mtha'i dben gnas 'grims 'grims nas/ /thos bsam sgom pas phyi nang sgro 'dogs bcad/ /nyams rtogs klong brdol gzung 'dzin sgog las grol/ /shugs 'byung spyod pa'i dgag sgrub spang blang bral/ /dbang med byams brtse lhag bsam bzang po'i mthus/ /ris med bstan 'gror phan pa'i thabs brtson te/ /bsdu ba rnam bzhis gdul bya smin grol mdzad/ /sku gsung thugs rten rim gro dpag med brgyas/ /dge 'dun rnams la bsnyen bkur zhabs tog bsgrubs/ /thabs mkhas spyod pas 'thab rtsod bsdums pa dang / /dag snang nor bu'i 'od kyis khyab pa sogs/ /khyod kyi rmad byung rnam thar mdzad 'phrin la/ /bdag kyang bsam pa thag pas yi rang skyes/ /deng sang snyigs ma las kyang cher snyigs te/ /snyigs dus ngan pa'i rang mtshang bdo dus 'dir/ /phan btags lan du drin lan gnod mjal sogs/ /ngan dgu'i g.yo khram sgo 'dogs byed na yang / /bzod pa'i go bgos 1079

bdag pas gzhan gces kyi/ /snying stobs chen pos bstan 'gror phan phyir du/ /kun bzang 'jam dbyangs spyan ras gzigs dbang sogs/ /ya rabs dam pa'i rnam thar skyong bzhin du/ /bskal pa rgya mtsho'i bar du bzhugs par zhu/ /bdag gis kha ton cung zad bgyis pa sogs/ /bsam sbyor dge ba phra rags gang byas rnams/ /bstan dang 'gro ba kun la gang phan dang / /bla med byang chub thob pa'i skyabs 'jug zhu/ /zhu rten lha rdzas zung bcas gus pas phul//dge bas ma gyur 'gro kun bde gyur cig /ces pa bstsal pa'i lan du slar 'tshams zhus kyang phul nas dag snang sbyong re byas/ kha sgang gi lo ser bas brdung ba la/ byen rlabs byas pas ser lam chad pa byung / de dus shākya bu rgyud kyi slob ma yon bdag rnams la zhal gdams 'di byen no//sngon byon skyes mchog thams cad la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /'gro mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis/ /mi yi chos lugs la brten na/ /lha yul bgrod pa thag mi ring / /lha dang mi yi chos lugs la/ /brten na thar pa gam na 'dug /gsung ltar lha mi'i chos brten na/ /nges legs thar pa 'thob par 'gyur/ /de phyir thog mar mngon mtho yi/ /lha mi'i rten 1080

bzang thob pa'i thabs/ /ngo tsha khrel yod ldan pa'i sgos//mi dge bcu la rgyun du 'dzems/ /pha ma nye 'brel 'gro rnams la/ /byams dang brtse ba'i mig gis ltos/ /thams cad dam pa'i chos la bskul/ /mi dge sdig las ldog par bya/ /bla ma dkon mchog mchod pa dang / /phongs pa rnams la sbyin pa thongs/ /rgan pa rnams la sri zhu dang / /pha ma gnyis la bkur bste bya//thag ring mgron por phan thogs dang / /yun ring nad par nad g.yog bya/ /gru zam lam ngan bco ba dang / /chu la rag dang mgron khang rgyag /lam 'phrang chu las sgol 'don dang / /dgra jag che sar skyel bsu bya//ra lug bya dang ri dwags nya//gsod pa mthong na srog blu bya/ /mchod rten lha khang sku gzugs la/ /phyag skor dad pas thal mo sbyar/ /dwangs pas blta zhing gus pas mchod/ /rnying ba gso zhing zhig ral bco//nye ring med par sems snyoms shing / /snyan par smras nas chos la bskul/ /rte dang 'thab rtsod tshig spong zhing / /gzhan gyi yid dang mthun par bya/ /'ga' res mi snyan tshig smra yang / /rtsub mo'i tshig gis lan mi gdab/ /rtag tu khog pa yangs par bya/ /gzhan la mi gnod ci phan sgrubs/ /g.yo sgyu zol zog mi bya bar/ /rgyun du rang sems drang por bya//bzang po'i drin rnams mi brjed cing / /phyi thag bsri nga 1081

zhing gzhung bzang bsten/ /gzhan sems mi dkrugs phrag dog spongs/ /'gran sems chags sdang 'thab rtsod dor/ /'byor ba'i tshe na dregs mi bya/ /gzhan la khyad du gsod pa spongs/ /dbul kyang zhum par mi bya zhing / /sngon gye las su blta bar bya/ /chos dang 'jig rten phal cher mthun/ /kun mthun chos mthun gnyis ka gyis/ /mdor na sdig spongs dge ba sgrubs/ /rtag tu bsam pa bzang po mdzod/ /'jig rten dge ba can rnams kyis/ /rnam thar bzang po 'di ka skyongs/ /gdams pa bdud rtsi lta bu 'dis/ /rang gzhan yongs la phan par shog /ces byin pas kun gye sems la phan po byung / de nas mar nang tsho lnga'i phyogs la tshur 'ong / dad can sngags chang rta mgrin sogs tsho lnga'i sngags mang gis zhabs tog yag po byas chos bshad byas pas sdig spong dge ba sgrub mkhan dang / mgur chung gi mchod rten sogs sku gsung thugs rten bzheng mkhan mang po byung / de dag thams cad la sangs rgyas kyi 'phel gdung sogs rten khyad 'phags mang po byin/ rma pha ri tshur kha'i yon bdag rnams rab tu dad pas rta gsum/ mdzo mo 'bri g.yag ba glang sum cu/ ra lug nyi shu/ ja nag lnga/ gdan dkar bcu/ nas do po brgya/ dkar yol btags mang po byung / de'i nang nas rma 1082

pha ri dang tshur kha'i dgon pa rnams la/ rta mdzo 'bri g.yag ba glang bsdoms pas sum cu tsam phul/ gzhan dgon dang grong yul so sor lha khang brgya dang brgyad/ gsung rab ma ṇi chos 'khor mchod rten brgya phrag du ma bzheng du bcug nas snga phyi rim can du/ gser dngul rta mdzo 'bri g.yag ba glang ra lug ja ras gos dar gro nas byin pa rnams brtsis na grangs kyis mi zin pa tsam zhig song / de dus rang gzhan kun la phan pa'i smon lam 'di ltar btab/bdag dang gzhan gyi 'dis mtshon pa'i dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge ba'i mthu la brten nas/ spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che 'di phyogs dus gnas skabs kun tu dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig sgos mkha' mnyam gyi sems can thams cad la bde skyid tshad med pa 'byung bar gyur cig yang sgos khyad par can du bdag dang slob ma sbyin bdag rnams kyi tshe nyi zla dang mnyam par gyur cigabasod nams ri rgyal dang mnyam par gyur cig snyan grags nam mkha' dang mnyam par gyur cig 'gro don sangs rgyas dang mnyam par gyur cig sdug bsngal gye ming tsam yang mi thos par gyur cig bde skyid dang skad cig tsam yang mi 'bral bar 1083

gyur cig nam zhig bdag gis sems can gyi/ /sdug bsngal thams cad sel nus shog /nam zhig dbul po'i sems can rnams/ /'byor ba chen po 'jog nus shog /nam zhig sha dang khrag bcas pas/ /sems can 'gro don nus par shog /nam zhig dmyal bar yun ring du/ /gnas nas phan thogs nus par shog /nam zhig srid zhi'i 'byor ba yis/ /sems can re ba yongs skong shog /nam zhig sangs rgyas sems can gye/ /sdug bsngal nges par 'byin nus shog /nam yang 'gro la mi phan zhing / /gnod la dga' bar ma gyur cig /nam zhig bdag gzhan bde sdug gnyis/ /brjes nas 'gro kun bde gyur cig /sems can thams cad bde dang ldan/ /sdug bsngal kun dang 'bral bar shog /nam yang bde dang mi 'bral zhing / /btang snyoms tshad med la gnas shog /ces byang chub sems dpa'i rnam rtog brgyad dang / tshad med bzhir mthun pa'i smon lam dri ma med pa'i mtshams sbyor yag po byas/ gzhan yang mgar rtse'i 'du khang nang du dngul srang bcu gsum gyi mchod kong gcigabakra shis 'khyil ba'i lha khang nang du dngul srang nyi shu rtsa lnga'i rin gyi li ting bdun tshar/ sbub chal/ dung dkar bzhag pa sogs phyogs phyogs kyi lha khang rnams la mchod cha mang po bzhag 1084

lha sku rnams la gos dang kha btags chen po'i na bza' mang po phul nas smon lam btab/ lug bdun brgya bkra shis 'khyil bar ded 'ongs nas tshe thar byas bzhag de rnams kyi bal gyis mthun rkyen byas/ lug gzhan rnams 'bul sdud pa slong mkhan yod tshad la byin nas mi gsod par byas/ bkra shis 'khyil ba nas yul med kyi grwa btsun snyoms chung dang / gzhan sprang po bdag med drug cu bdun cu tsam re lo mang po'i bar du gsos/lo re bzhin bzhi pa'i bco lnga la/ dge 'dun pa dang skyes pho mo brgya phrag mang po la smyung gnas bzung / bzhi pa'i nyi shu'i nang la reb gong sngags pa phur thogs stong dang lnga brgya la bka' brgyad chos thog nyi ma lnga re bzung / de'i ja mar gyi thebs su mdzo mo dang 'bri brgya lhag cig bzhag yod pa/ nor dgra 'dre 'bod pa'i g.yab mo yin gsungs pa ltar/ tsa yi a mchog gi jag pas ded song ba'i rjes su phur thogs stong gi babs sa song / phyogs de thams cad mthu la 'jigs nas bshags pa dang bcas te phyir la sprad kyang / de nas bzung nor bsags pa chos su mi 'gro bar 'dug snyam de thams cad mchod sbyin du btang bas/ nor med tsa na dgra dang bral gsungs pa ltar/ dgra jag rkun gsum med par 'jam cag 1085

ger gnas rgyu byung / de nas chos thog gi sbyin bdag zho 'ong dang / 'jam gling gis1 byas/ lo re bzhin ston nas bsod/dbyar mar bsod/ gshin po'i don du bsngo 'brel 'bul ba sogs zhabs tog yag po byas byung / yang gaḥ thog bla ma rin po che chu bzang nas phebs pa dben gnas bkra shis 'khyel bar gdan drangs/ zhabs tog yag po byas/ sngags mang la zhi khro'i dbang dang / nged dpon slob sum cu tsam la snying thig ya bzhi'i dbang lung yongs rdzogs gnang / bka' drin gtang rag tu sgrol ma'i sgu gcig lam rim thar pa'i rgyan/ bka' gdams mchod rten gcig rta gcig dre'u gcig mdzo bzhi sga dang bcas te phul/ de'i rjes su 'brel tshad don dang ldan pa'i sar gnas kyi byang chub sems dpa' gser khang rin po che rong por phebaca/ pa dang mjal/ phyag rten du thugs rje chen po'i sku gcig dang 'brug pa kun legs kyi rnam thar gcig rta gos gnyis bcas phul/ de'i rjes su rong po'i dgon chen gye tshogs mang gis gsang 'dus dang bde mchog gi dbang mo che zhus pas gral du bsdad nas nyan/ rjes su gnyan thog gis gdan drangs/ thugs rje chen po'i rjes gnang zhus par yang nyan/nyin gcig sku mdun du song bas/ zhal gsung mang po phebs/1086

thugs brtse brtse mdzad/ gsol ras gos chen ser po gcigagos gzan dmar po gcig ka ra shing thog sder kha mang po kha btags chen po gnyis dang blo sbyong nyi ma'i 'od zer zhig bcas bstsal byung / de nas bkra shis 'khyel du 'ongs nas bsdad yod dus khong gi slob ma bslab gsum rgyan ldan blo bzang dar rgyas dang byams pa mkhas grub sogs tshe blos btang gi dge 'dun pa drug tsam la/ bka' brgyud kyi chos skor phyag rgya chem po dang / nā ro chos drug snyan brgyud skor gsum/ lus med mkha' 'gro'i chos skor dgu dang 'khrul 'khor rnams kyi lung khrid rgyas par byas pas/ rjes su bu chen blo bzang dar rgyas kyis zhal gdams shig dgos zhes bskul ngor ngo mtshar che ba'i zhal gdams 'di byin/'gro la bu gcig ltar brtse ba'i/ /ston pa sangs rgyas zhal snga nas/ /sems can rnams la phan btags na/ /khong la phan thogs byas pa 'dra/ /sems can rnams la gnod byas na/ /khong la gnod pa byas pa 'dra/ /dper na bu la phan btags na/ /ma yi sems ni dga' ba ltar/ /sems can su la phan btags kyang / /khong gi thugs ni dgyes par gsungs/ /bu la gnod pa byas gyur na/ /ma yi sems kyis khrel ba ltar/ /sems can su la 1087

gnod byas kyang / /khong gi thugs kyis khrel bar gsungs/ /de phyir gnod 'tshe mi bya bar/ /phan bde'i thabs la 'bad par bya/ /spos dang me tog mar me sogs/ /sangs rgyas mchod pa'i mchog ma yin/ /sems can rnams la phan btags na/ /sangs rgyas mchod pa'i mchog tu 'gyur/ /de phyir sangs rgyas mchod pa'i phyir/ /sems can rnams la phan thogs bya/ /de ltar mchod na sangs rgyas dgyes/ /sems can thams cad dga' bar 'gyur/ /sems can mgu bya ma gtogs pa//rgyal ba dgyes pa'i thabs gzhan med/ /gsungs pa'i tshig rkang 'di gnyis po/ /dpyad na gnad 'gags zab par go /sangs rgyas dgyes par byas gyur na/ /khong gis dgyes bzhin rjes su 'dzin/ /khong gis rjes su bzung tsa na/ /gtan du bde zhing skyid par 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas sems can kun dga' ba'i/ /dge ba 'di lhag gzhan na med/ /nam zhig 'bad rtsol ma byas kyang / /rang gi tshogs rdzogs sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /rang gzhan gnyis ka 'tshengs pa yi/ /gdams pa 'di ni ngo mtshar che/ /ngo mtshar che ba'i zhal gdams 'di/ /thos tshad rgyud la phan par shog /ces gdams/ gzhan yang reb gong grub pa thob pa'i gnas chen brgyad dang / rje btsun skal ldan rgya mtsho'i sgrub gnas sogs 1088

dben gnas rnams su skabs skabs song nas/ zla re zla phyed zhag po bdun re tsam la mtshams byas nas gnas 'brel bzhag byin 'bebs byas/ smon lam bkra shis brjod/ mtshams khang med sa ru mtshams khang chung chung re phub nas ri khrod dben pa'i bsngags brjod kyi mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so//reb gong gser mo ljongs 'di yi/ /gnas chen brgyad du sngon byon pa'i/ /grub thob brgyad la gsol ba 'debs/ /ri khrod zin par byin gyis rlobs/ /e ma gna' dus bzang po nub/ /kye ma da dung ngan pa shar/ /gna' mi mkhas pa thams cad 'das/ /da mi blun po mang po sgyes/ /lha chos dar gyi mdud pa grol/ /mi chos sog ma'i phon thag chad/ /rgyal khrims gser gyi gnya' shing chag /gtso bo gros kyi rgya mtsho bskams/ /dpa' bo stag gi ri mo yal/ /mo btsun ngo tsha'i g.yang lugs bud/ /ya rabs rnams kyi srol mi 'dzin/ /ma rabs rnams kyi spyod pa skyong / /phugs kyi khe la mi bsam par/ /'phral gyi rtsis grangs zhib tu gtong / /legs pa'i srol bzang mi 'dzin par/ /nyes pa'i dpe ngan mang po 'dren/ /mkhas pa'i gzhung lugs mi 'dzin par//blun pos bshad pa'i rjes su 'brangs/ /bzang po'i do ya mi byed par/ /ngan pa'i kha ya byed dus 'dir/ /dam pa 1089

gong ma'i rnam thar bzhin/ /tshe 'di blo yis gtong dus yin/ /grub thob gong ma'i bzhugs gnas su/ /zab mo'i sgrub la gzhol dus yin/ /e ma sngon gyi mkhas grub kyis/ /mchog gi dngos grub brnyes pa'i sa/ /ri khrod dben pa'i dga' tshal na/ /tshe 'di'i bya bas g.yeng ba med/ /lha yul dbang bo'i skyed tshal na/ /lha dang lha mo rtse ba bzhin/ /sman lngongs nags tshal spang gzhongs na/ /bya dang ri dwags bag phebs rtse/ /ngo mtshar dag pa'i zhing khams na/ /sangs rgyas byang sems bzhugs pa ltar/ /nyams dga'i ljon shing bsil grib na/ /chos mdzad sgyes bu dam pa bzhugs/ /grub pa thob pa'i gnas brgyad dang / /rje btsun skal ldan sgrub gnas nas/ /bla med byang chub sgrub mkhan gye/ /rgyud la nyams rtogs nyi ma 'char/ /de phyir ban bon sngags gsum gyi/ /nang nas las ldan sgyes bu rnams/ /rang rang phyogs kyi gnas chen nas/ /sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan btsugs na legs/ /glu 'di thos tshad chos mdzad rnams/ /rang gi yul nas mi sdod par/ /shin tu dben pa'i gnas bsten nas/ /sgrub pa snying por byed par shog /ces blangs pas ban bon sngags gsum phal cher gyis gnas chen rnams su mtshams bsnyen sgrub byas/grong nas lo re bzhin ma ṇi chos thog btsugs/ gzhan thams 1090

cad la rang rang gi yul nas lus ngag yid gsum gyes dam pa'i chos mang po byed rgyu'i skal ba bzang po byung / de ltar yul khams thams cad dam pa'i chos kyis dkar lam mer btang nas/ a mdo'i phyogs kyi sgyes pho mo yongs la phan phyir/ mi chos gnad kyi phreng ba zhes bya ba'i mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so//drin can bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /bsam don chos bzhin 'grub par byen gyis rlobs/ /lha chos byas na mi chos zhor la 'ong / /rtag tu lha chos gyis shig a mdo pa/ /dkar po'i chos la phyi bshol ma byed par/ /myur ba myur du sgrubs shig a mdo pa/ /za 'dod spyid 'dod dga' na chos mi 'ong / /dka' spyad snying rus gyis shig a mdo pa/ /su yi don du dka' ba spyad na yang / /ngas byas sdug yus ma che a mdo pa/ /mdze sprang la sogs su yis chos zhus kyang / /gdams ngag lhug par ston cig a mdo pa/ /'ga' res nyams tshod blta phyir chos 'dri yang / /phul du phyin pa ston cig a mdo pa/ /zang zing sgyu ma'i nor la ma blta bar/ /dam chos thang ma rdol cig a mdo pa/ /nges par gang la gsang bar 'os pa rnams/ /lkugs pa'i tshul gyis ma bshad a mdo pa/ /chos pa 'phung ba'i 'gab 'dre chags sdang 1091

yin/ /nye ring chags sdang ma che a mdo pa/ /zas nor yod dus ser sna ma che bar/ /rang spyod mi la byin cig a mdo pa/ /zas nor med dus log dom ma len par/ /za shes 'thung mkhas gyis shig a mdo pa/ /rnam 'gyur btsog pa su la'ang ma ston par/ /thams cad 'dzum gyis bsus shig a mdo pa/ /grong dgon gang na'ang don med smra mchu mang / /gtam ngan gang la'ang ma nyan a mdo pa/ /stod smad sa cha gang na'ang dgra rkun mang / /sems chung dogs zon gyis shig a mdo pa/ /khrel med mi la nam yang blo ma gtod/ /blo gtad thub par 'grogs shig a mdo pa/ /dus ngan mi la re ba ma che bar/ /lha la gsol ba thobs shig a mdo pa/ /sa phyogs gang du 'gro 'am 'dug kyang rung / /kun la mthun par mdzod cig a mdo pa/ /rang gi nor la chags zhen che na yang / /gzhan gyi nor la ma rngams a mdo pa//rwang nyid las dang 'dun mar mkhas na yang / /spyi don kun la dris shig a mdo pa/ /rang gis bsags pa'i nor rdzas yin na yang / /mang po'i khrod du ma ngom a mdo pa/ /rang nyid kun gyis yar la bkur na yang / /che ba'i nga rgyal ma che a mdo pa/ /rang nyid dge ba'i bshes su mnga' gsol yang / /khas dman rnams la ma brnyas a mdo pa/ /gzhan gyi bla ma dpon po brgya 1092

ngan rung / /phyag dang zhe sa mdzod cig a mdo pa/ /rang dang mnyam pa'i gang zag su byung yang / /rang gi gong du bkur cig a mdo pa/ /bya ba gang la'ang 'dod chung chog shes dang / /rtag tu dman sa zungs shig a mdo pa/ /mdor na mtho bkur dma' ba byams pas skyongs/ /mnyam la mthun par 'grogs shig a mdo pa/ /de ltar chos dang mthun pa'i bya ba gyis/ /mis smon bdag skyid 'ong ngo a mdo pa/ /bdag ni deng nas tshe rabs thams cad du/ /sems can kun gyi don la mkhas par shog /glu 'di mthong thos dran reg thams cad kyis/ /rang gzhan don gnyis tshe 'dir 'grub par shog /yul phyogs kun tu bkra shis lo legs shing / /bkra shis chen pos sa steng khyab gyur cig /ces blangs pas chos pa 'jig rten pa phal che ba zhig la blo bskyed chen po byung ngo / /de dus sde pa re re bzhin song nas nyi ma kha shas rer bsdad nas 'gro khar yon bdag kun gyes skyel thung byas pa'i sar/ thams cad la bka' bsgo byen rlabs byas kha ta bcug pas mthar yon bdag pho mo kun gye sems la phan pa'i zhal gdams/ gnas spyi gtsug 'ja' gur ma zhes bya ba'i mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so//gnas spyi gtsug 'ja' gur 'khyil ba'i klong / /gdan seng 1093

ges btegs pa'i khri steng na/ /rje rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang / /mtshan brjod par dka' ba'i drin po che/ /pha chos rgyal ngag gi dbang bo bzhugs/ /bu mos gus gdungs pas gsol ba 'debs/ /mi 'dir 'tshogs snang ba chos la sgyur/ /blo chos min snang ba 'gag tu gsol/ /nged 'dir 'tshogs skyes sa mi gcig kyang / /sngon las bzang smon lam dag pa'i mthus/ /mi la la dbus gtsang zhing nas 'ong / /mi la la khams kyi phyogs nas 'ong / /mi la la mdo khams smad nas 'ong / /dus da res gnas 'dir yud tsam 'tshogs/ /chos zas nor 'brel ba yang yang bzhag /yun mi ring so sor gyes pa ltar/ /chos thams cad mi rtag 'di dang 'dra/ /tshe 'di ru sdod mkhan gcig kyang med/ /tshe phyi ma'i yul la 'gro dus su/ /chos ma gtogs gang gis kyang phan pa med/ /khyed 'dir 'tshogs yon bdag pho mo rnams/ /dus da nas nam 'chi nges med soms/ /tshe 'di la zhen chags ma che bar/ /tshe phyi ma'i sa lam lha chos rem/ /chos ma nus na yang sdig la 'dzems/ /dus rgyun du bsam pa dkar po gyis/ /mi nga yang gang du song na yang / /tshe 'di phyir phan pa'i skyabs 'jug bya/ /da yon bdag pho mo bde bar bzhugs/ /nga rnal 'byor mi sdod chas nas 'gro/ /dus da dung tshe mjug 'di nyid la/ /slar 1094

yang nas yang du mjal bar shog /dus snyigs ma'i tshe la nges pa med/ /sa kha thag ring pos bar chod nas//dus da nas mjal rgyu ma song na/ /tshe phyi ma'i yul nas mjal bar shog /'di dad can yon bdag pho mo la/ /ngas 'gro khar snying gtam smras pa yin/ /glu 'di nyid thos tshad pho mo kun/ /dus gtan du bde zhing skyid par shog /yul 'di ru bkra shis g.yang chags shing / /bkra shis pas sa gsum khyab gyur cig /ces blangs pas der 'tshogs pa thams cad la nges 'byung dang skyo shas skyes/ phal cher la lus kyi ba spu g.yo zhing mig nas mchi ma 'khrigs pa'i dad pa skyes nas/ skye ba nas tshe rabs thams cad du mjal ba'i smon lam 'debs bzhin/ phyag dang skor ba byas pa'i mthar gyes nas phyogs phyogs su song ngo / /de'i lo a byes ja sgon gyi sgrub gnas gsar du bcos nas/ nang du song zhag po bdun tsam zhig la bsdad pas/ nyin gcig drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma rje btsun 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho rin po che dran nas/khong gi gdung rten la mjal du song bas/ gdung rten zhig nas sa phung zhig tu gyur pa mthong tshe/ 'dus byas kyi chos thams cad mi rtag pa 'di'i rang bzhin du 'dug snyam sems la skyo ba skyes/ bla ma rje btsun snying nas dran te phyag 'tshal/ sa phung de 1095

la mgo gtugs nas mjal bas mig nas mchi ma shor ba byung /de nas tshogs mchod cig phul/ gsol 'debs tshar mang po bton/ smon lam rgya chen po btab/ phyag dang skor ba mang du byas yun ring bsdad nas/ 'gro khar sa phung de la mgo gtugs nas bla ma dran pa'i gdungs dbyangs 'di blangs so//rje drin can bla ma rin po che/ /mtshan snyan pa 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho la/ /bus mos gus gdungs pas gsol ba 'debs/ /phas mi mngon dbyings nas gzigs shing dgongs/ /ngas dang po bla ma'i sku la mjal/ /sku mi rtag gshegs pa'i tshul bstan nas/ /ngas bar du bla ma'i gdung la mjal/ /gdung mchod rten zhig pa'i tshul bstan nas/ /ngas tha ma sa phung zhig la mjal/ /da phyin chad sa mthar 'khyams tsa na/ /sa'i phung po 'di yang gang nas mthong / /ngas bsam zhing drin can bla ma dran/ /khyod dran pa'i mod la sems sdug nas/ /gdong mig nas mchi ma dbang med shor/ /dus de ring rtag 'dzin can gyi bur/ /spyir 'dus byas chos rnams mi rtag par/ /dpe 'di bzhin tha mar 'jig tshul dang / /sgos 'byung bzhi 'dus pa'i sgyu lus kyang / /dpe 'di bzhin 'jig pa'i brda' ru go /rang tshe mjug la mgo'i nyi zer tsam/ /yun thung ngu 'di yi ring 'di 1096

la/ /tshe 'di yi bya ba mi byed par/ /tshe phyi mar phan pa'i lha chos byed/ /rje rtsa ba'i bla ma thugs rje can/ /zhing dag pa rab 'byams gar bzhugs kyang / /bu 'chi khar byon la sems gso mdzod/ /khyed gar bzhugs zhing der bdag drongs shig /zhing de nas bzung ste dpon slob gnyis/ /dus nam yang 'du 'bral med par shog /rje dpal ldan bla ma'i byen rlabs kyis/ /yul 'di ru rtag tu lo legs shog /ces blangs pas der grwa slob sbyin bdag 'ga' re yod pa rnams la yang nges 'byung dang dad gus skyes pa byung ngo / /de nas tshur 'ong ste grub gnas la rab gnas byen 'bebs bkra shis brjod nas/ dam pa gong ma'i zhabs kyis bcags byin gyis brlabs pa'i dben gnas bkra shis 'khyel bar 'ong / lo mtshams la bsdad nas/thugs rje chen po sems nyid ngal gso ltar/ sems 'od gsal gyi ngang la ngal gsos so/ /bla mas ci gsung bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i mkhan rin po che dpon slob rnams kyis/ stod kyi bkra shis dge 'phel reb gong dmag gis gtor ba/ slar dgon pa gsar rgyag byas/ rgyal ba byams pa'i sku che ba gcig bzhengs/de'i rgyu 'gro la/ gser shog khri bam gcig dang stong bam bdun/rta mdzo 'bri g.yag nyi shu/ lug sum cu/ phye rtsam do po bzhi bcu 1097

rtsa lnga/ mar ltang bcu/ ja lan chen gnyis song / a lags bstan 'dzin nyi ma/ rab byung / nu byes rnams kyis smad kyi dgu rong gi lha khang rgya dmag gis me la bsregs pa'i shul du slar gsar rgyag byas/ de'i rgyu song la/ ras chen nyis brgya dang brgyad cu/ phye rtsam do po bzhi bcu tsam/ grod mar brgyad/ ja lan 'du phyed lhag tsam song / phyag mdzod grub chen dang bstan 'dzin sogs grwa btsun mang pos/ bar gye rang nyid gnas pa'i bkra shis 'khyel gye dgon pa'i mtha' la tsha 'bum dang man thang brgyab nas tshogs gsog sgrib sbyong byed rgyu'i skal ba byung / bdag gis nyin re la gung tshigs re byas nas/gnas lugs kyi ngang la mnyam par bzhag rjes thob tu tshe sgrub bskyed rdzogs sprul bsgyur la sogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo brgya phrag du ma phyes so/ /de dus bdag gis bsam blo 'di ltar btang / 'jig rten gtam dpe la/ lo lnga bcu lon na tshe med/bya pho 'go ma grag na nam med zer ba bzhin/ da ni rang lo lnga bcu rtsa drug lon tshar/ mgo bo dkar por song / mig dmar por song / 'chi ltas thams cad mgo la slebs 'dug da lta lus la na tsha sem/sa la sdug bsngal med par/ rig pa gsal smra lce bde ba'i dus 'dir slob ma rnams la ster rgyu 'dra yod na 1098

byen/ bshad rgyu 'dra yod na bshad yag byas na bzang snyam/rang nyid gson pa'i dus kyi kha ta/ shi ba'i dus kyi kha chems kyi go chod pa'i zhal gdams mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so//byin rlabs stsol ba'i bla ma dang / /dngos grub ster ba'i yi dam lha/ /bar chad sel ba'i mkha' 'gro mar/ /phyag 'tshal mchod bstod gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag dang slob ma sbyin bdag la/ /rtag tu thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /sku gsung thugs kyis byin gyis rlobs/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol/ /rnal 'byor tshogs drug rang grol ngas/ /nam 'chi nges pa med snyam nas/ /da ni ma shi gong 'di la/ /slob ma rnams la gang mkho ster/ /sdom pa dam tshig shin tu gtsang / /'dod chung chog shes shes rab che/ /snying rus che ba'i slob ma la/ /dam pa gong ma'i sgrub gnas ster/ /rgyal ba gong ma'i rnam thar bzhin/ /tshe 'di'i bya ba blo yis btang / /dben par sdod nus slob ma la/ /sgrub brgyud bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan ster/ /sgrub pa byas pa'i rang rgyud thul/ /byams dang snying rje byang sems 'byongs/ /'gro don nus pa'i slob ma la/ /bshad chos gser gyi 'khor lo ster/ /chung nas dad dang snying rje ldan/ /thos bsam bsgom la brtson pa che/ /shes rab che ba'i slob ma la/ /mdo rgyud man ngag dkor 1099

mdzod ster/ /gzhon dus thos bsam phyogs med mdzad/ /grub mtha' gang la'ang dag snang 'byongs/ /phyogs ris bral ba'i slob ma la/ /dbu rdzogs phyag gsum nor bu ster/ /chos kyi skal ba mi ldan zhing / /nor gyi bsod nams ma mchis pa'i/ /nyam thag mgon med slob ma la/ /'phral gang bde ba'i zas nor ster/ /bya btang tshogs drug rang grol ngas/ /nam 'chi cha yang med snyam nas/ /da lta smra lce bde dus su/ /slob ma rnams la kha chems 'jog /chos dad che ba'i slob ma rnams/ /lo 'ga'i 'phro nas nor dad skyes/ /khe tshong 'dre 'dul grong chog byas/ /chos pa'i zhabs 'dren ma byed cig /sgrub pa mdzad pa'i slob ma rnams/ /lo 'ga'i 'phro nas gsog 'jog byas/ /khab dang skud pa'i rtsis grangs btang / /sgrub brgyud bla btsong ma byed cig /'gro don mdzad pa'i slob ma yis/ /lo 'ga'i 'phro nas rang don bsgrubs/ /chos pa gzhan la phrag dog byas/ /chos bshad chud zos ma gtong zhig /thos bsam byas pa'i slob ma yis/ /lo 'ga'i 'phro nas phyogs ris byas/ /gzhan gye chos la smad ra btang / /chos spong las ngan ma gsog cig /sdom pa gtsang ba'i slob ma yis/ /lo 'ga'i 'phro nas nag chang bsten/ /'jig rten skye bo mi nag las/ /lod pa'i bya ba ma byed cig /shul du 1100

lus pa'i slob ma yis/ /zhag 'ga'i 'phro nas mya ngan sangs/ /zas nor steng nas mi 'grig par/ /bla ma'i zhabs 'dren ma byed cig /thams cad nges par 'chi ba yin/ /'chi dus gang gis kyang phan pa med/ /phan nges dam pa'i chos yin pas/ /kun gyis dam pa'i lha chos mdzod/ /gson pa'i dus kyi kha ta yin/ /shi ba'i dus kyi kha chems yin/ /zhal gdams kun gyi mthar thug yin/ /'di bzhin byas na legs pa yin/ /thos tshad dad can pho mo yi/ /rgyud la phan thogs 'byung bar shog /tshe 'dir 'brel thogs ma lus pa/ /phyi mar nga yis 'dren par shog /yul phyogs kun tu lo phyugs legs/ /chos dang bkra shis 'phel bar shog /legs tshogs yon tan ma lus pa/ /yar ngo'i zla ltar rgyas par shog /ces blangs pas slob ma phal che ba'i sems la phan po byung nas rjes su tshe blos btang ste ri khrod 'grims mkhan yang mang po byung ngo / /gzhan yang nyin gcig mnyam bzhag gi ngang la rang bzhin shugs kyis song bas/ bde gsal mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin gye ros myos nas yun ring song ba'i mthar nga'i slob ma dad can thams cad la bsgom mi dgos par 'di bzhin du gnas lugs kyi ngang du 'gro ba zhig byung na ci ma rung snyam / rang gi nyams la shar ba'i bla ma mchog gsum nor bu ma 1101

zhes bya ba'i mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so//bla ma dang mchog gsum yid bzhin gyi nor bus/ /byin rlabs dang dngos grub char bzhin du phob cig /snang so ni gang bde gu yangs kyi yan pa/ /blo bde ngas skyid pa'i rgyang glu zhig len no/ /chos kun gyi rtsa ba rang sems la bltas tshe/ /stong sangs shig ma gtogs ngos bzung ni mi 'dug /phyi nang yang med par zang thal du gyur snang / /phyogs ris su ma chad khyab gdal du 'dug go /gza' gtad dang bral ba bar snang dang mtshungs shing / /mtha' dbus dang bral ba nam mkha' dang 'dra ba'i/ /gnas lugs kyi lta ba yangs po yi klong du/ /snang so ni gang bder glod nas rang btang bas/ /chos dbyings kyi thang ka yangs po ru slebs song / /mtha' yas dang mu med stong dbyings su byams pas/ /rang sems dang nam mkha' snang grags kun 'dres nas/ /so so ru yod med blo zhig kyang ma byung / /don dam gyi dbyings su ro gcig tu 'dres kyang / /kun rdzob tu so sor snang ba 'di ngo mtshar/ /gsal zhing ni dwangs la rnyogs pa dang bral ba'i/ /'od gsal gye bde bas gting nas rang myos tshe/ /dga' spro yi bro gar 'khrab snying rang 'dod cing / /shugs 'byung gi glu dbyangs len 'dod rang skyes 1102

byung / /de ltar du ma rtogs mkha' mnyam gyi 'gro la/ /phyogs med kyi snying rje rang shugs kyis skyes byung / /chos dbyengs kyi nam mkha' yangs po yi klong du/ /rang sems kyi khyung chen 'dzin med du 'phyo snang / /gnas 'gyu yi dran bsam brag 'phrang du ma chud/ /blos byas kyi lta bsgom thag rnyi yis ma zin/ /bying rgod kyi char sprin rlung po dang ma 'phrad/ /kun khyab kyi mig yangs phyogs brgya ru g.yo bzhin/ /lhod lhod rang 'phur nas 'gro ba 'di skyid do/ /mnyam bzhag ni nam mkha' lta bu yi klong na/ /'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i snang grags kyi chos kun/ /snang bzhin du stong zhing stong bzhin du snang ngo / /snang bzhin du stong ba'i rtag mtha' dag bral zhing / /stong bzhin du snang ba'i chad mtha' dang bral lo/ /rtag chad kyi mtha' gnyis rang shugs kyis bral ba'i/ /mtha' bral gyi lta ba yangs po yi klong nas/ /skyid glu 'di rang bzhin shugs kyis rang thon song / /stong nyid kyi lta ba nam mkha' las yangs shing / /byams pa dang snying rje nyi zla ltar shar nas/ /bstan pa dang 'gro ba mtha' dag la phan pa'i/ /smon lam ni rgya chen yang yang du 'debs so/ /nad yams dang mu ge 'khrug rtsod kun zhi nas/ /thams cad po bde zhing skyid po rang shog shog /ces blangs pa'i rjes su chos thams cad sgyu ma rmi 1103

lam lta bu'i stong nyid kyi rtsis zin par byas nas/ tshogs gsog pa dang sgrib pa sbyong ba sogs tshegs chung ngu'i sgo nas tshogs gnyis bde blag tu rjogs pa'i thabs rgyal sras kyi spyod pa rnams la ci nus su bslabs nas/ dge tshogs rnams gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi smon gnas rnams su 'dun pa drag pos bsngos nas/ smon lam dri ma med pa'i mtshams sbyor dang /bkra shis pa'i tshigs bcad mang pos mtha' brgyan par byas so//smras pa/ 'gro ba yongs la bu gcig ltar brtse zhing / /'gro don rgyun mi 'chad pa'i thugs rje can/ /'gro mgon thub pa'i dbang por gsol ba 'debs/ /'gro don rgya chen 'byung bar byin gyes rlobs/ /bla ma'i rnam thar gzhan la sgog 'dod pa'i/ /dad can slob ma rnams la phan pa'i phyir/ /mdo khams smad du 'gro don byas pa'i tshul/ /slar yang glu ru len gyis dga' bas nyon/ /lha ldan ra sa 'phrul snang gtsug lag khang / /thag nye bka' blon zur khang zhes bya yi/ /nang nas zla ba bzhi pa'i tshes pa dgu'i/ /nyin par thon te byang gi rwa sgreng bar/ /dbus gtsang slob ma rnams kyis bskyal nas 'ongs/ /de nas dpon slob thams cad thang zhig nas/ /so sor gyes khar 'bral glags 1104

ma phod par/ /kun gyis nga la bltas nas mang po ngus/ /ngas kyang snying rje mig nas mchi ma shor/ /phan tshun gcig gis gcig la sems 'phreng bzhin/ /so sor gyes nas yong tshul da lta yang / /skabs re dran tshe mig nas mchi ma shor/ /de nas byang lam ring mo bcad nas 'ong / /'bri chu'i thag nyer slebs tshe mgo log gi /jag pa byung nas tshong dpon thams cad blangs/ /nyi ma gcig la thams cad sprang por btang / /'bri chur ma thar kha nas yun ring bsdad/ /bla ma skal ldan dpon slob gsum tsam gyes/ /chu la rab re e rnyed blta ba'i phyir/ /phebs pas chu yi rkyen byas zhing gzhan gshegs/ /kun kyang sems sdug mchi ma mang po btang / /gshegs pa'i 'og nas chu la rab cig byung / /dbus pa yar 'gro chu yi phar khar slebs/ /de rnams grogs byas chu yi pha rol son/ /sbra nag khag gsum yon bdag drin can gyes/ /ja mar rtsam pa khal rgyab bco brgyad dang / /de nyid 'gel ba'i khal rta bcas te byin/ /de la brten nas thams cad 'ong rgyu byung / /de dus mu ges 'chi ru mi 'jug pa'i/ /sbra nag khag gsum yon bdag drin can gye/ /drin de nam yang brjed pa'i dus ma byung / /skabs re dran tshe kha nas drin can shor/ /sde pa gzhung gi mkhan nang tshong dpon la/ /thug 1105

pas des kyang gsol ras mang po gnang / /de dag rnams la brten nas shor ma kun/ /khri gshog rgyal mo'i mtsho yi thag nyer slebs/ /ha tho'i nyag kha'i mtsho snying dben pa mthong rje btsun bstan 'dzin nyi ma yid la dran/ /sku drin bsams nas mig nas mchi ma shor/ /mtsho snying phyogs su lha phyag mang po 'tshal/ /bde ba can nas mjal ba'i smon lam btab/ /de nas sa sgo'i zi ling a 'ban la/ /'tshams zhu byed du song ba'i dus skabs su/ /shor ma thams cad 'chi ru ma bcug par/ /bskyangs nas zi ling bar du 'ong ba la/ /thugs mnyes gsol ras bdag rkyen mang po byung / /de nas sku 'bum gser gdung chen mor mjal/ /mchod pa phul nas gsol btab smon lam gyes/ /mtshams sbyar dge 'dun sde la mang 'gyed btang / /nyi ma kha shas bar du ngal gsos bsdad/ /de nas khri kha brgyud nas rong por slebs/ /thams cad mkhyen pa sku gzhogs shar la mjal//de yi nyin par nam mkha' 'ja' 'od kyis/ /gang ba rgya bod gnyis gas mthong nas dad/ /'gro don 'ong ba'i rten 'brel lha yis bsgrigs/ /dbang bskur chos bshad mgur dbyangs blangs pa yis/ /jag rkun 'phrog bcom dmag 'khrug rgyun chad nas/ /sku gsung thugs rten gsar du bzheng mkhan 1106

dang / /ban sngags mtshams la sdod mkhan mang po byung / /kun gyis sdig spong dge sgrub kho na byas/ /rong 'brog rnams la byin rlabs byas pa'i mthus/ /yul la bkra shis mi la tshe ring zhing / /nor la g.yang 'khyil zas la bcud byung nas/ /kun la bde skyid nyi ma bzhin du shar/ /yon bdag kun kyang dad pa lhag par skyes/ /yod med gnyis gas zas nor 'brel ba bzhag /gser dngul rta nor gos dar gro nas sogs/ /gsog rgyu yin na lo gcig phyug por 'gyur/ /lcang skya thams cad ma.o pa chu bzang dang / /gaḥ thog bla ma 'gro mgon gser khang sogs/ /bla ma rnams la chos zhus 'brel ba bzhag /dge 'dun sde mchod dbul por sbyin pa btang / /de ltar byas pas mchog dman thams cad dga'//rang yang sa chu 'phrod cing skyid po byung / /mi lo dgu tsam bar du bsdad na yang / /kun la yud tsam zhig gi snang ba shar/ /mdor na mdo khams smad du 'gro don byas/ /lha khang kho na brgya dang brgyad tsam bzhengs/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi rnam thar de ltar lags/ /rjes 'jug rnams kyang de bzhin skyong bar mdzod/ /glu 'di thos tshad skye bo pho mo yis/ /tshe rabs kun tu bla ma'i rnam thar bzhin/ /'gro don byed cing rten rnying nyams gso byas/ /med sar lha khang gsar du bzheng bar shog /ces 1107

pa'ang bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /da ni rnam thar mdor bsdus te mjug tu smon lam dri ma med pa'i mtshams sbyor bya ba ni/ sngon bsags bsod nams kyi mthus tshe 'dir dal 'byor gyi mi lus gtsang ma thob/ chung nas da lta'i bar du/ bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen brgya phrag du ma'i zhabs rdul spyi bor bsten nas/ mdo sngags zung du 'brel ba'i zab cing rgya che ba'i gdams pa mang po yang dang yang du zhus/stod kyi gangs dkar te se man chad nas smad kyi mtsho snying ma hā de ba yan chad kyi ri khrod dben pa brgya phrag du ma 'grims nas nyams len byas/ de nas grong dgon brgya phrag du mar song nas/bstan pa dang 'gro ba yongs la gang phan byas te/ de yang lo nyi shu rtsa gcig nas bzhi bcu'i bar du gung tshigs 'chag med byas/ sgyung gnas sum brgya lhag tsam bsrungs/ yig brgya bye ba gcig dang / ma ṇi sa ya gcig gis gtso byas kha ton bzlas brjod kyang mang po bton/ lo nyi shu nas sum cu'i bar du rang don sgrub pa gtso bo byas/ sum cu nas lnga bcu'i bar du gzhan don gtso bor byas/ stod mnga' ris skor gsum/ bar dbus gtsang ru bzhi/ smad mdo khams sgang gsum nas/ mi lo dgu re tsam bsdad nas skyo ngal med par 'gro don byas/ dus rgyun du 1108

sdom gsum gtsang ma byas nas bsrungs/ sha chang sgog tsong tha ma kha rnams gtan du spangs/ zas dkar gsum mngar gsum ja mar rtsam gsum la brten nas/ stod smad bar gsum la song tshe/skyes pho mo thams cad la nam 'chi cha med yin/ do nub sang gnangs tsam la yang shi 'gro na'ang thang mod/ las rgyu 'bras brtsi dgos/ ma brtsis par glo bur du shi na sdig can rnams dmyal bar skye zhing / dge ba byas pa rnams mtho ris su skye bas na/ de'i phyir sdig la 'dzems shing dge la 'bad dgos/ khyad par dus dang rnam pa thams cad du byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems la blo sbyong dgos/ sdig zas pha ma sems can gye sha 'di zos na nyes pa che bas spang dgos/ gal te spong ma thub na rnam gsum dag pa'i sha ma gtogs/ sha'i ched du srog gcod gtan nas byed mi rung / sdom pa dang dam tshig gtsang ma byas bsrungs nas mdo sngags zung du 'brel ba'i zab rgya'i chos la thos bsam sgom gsum tshul bzhin byed dgos zhes nan tan byas bshad pa'i lag rjes su/ yul stod smad bar gsum nas las 'bras brtsi zhing tshul khrims dang ldan pa/ bsam pa bzang zhing gnas lugs kyi don rtogs pa/ bskyed rdzogs kyi nyams len la rang byan tshud cing yi dam lha'i zhal mthong ba/ gzhan 1109

gye skyid sdug legs nyes shes shing / bstan 'gro'i don yong ba'i slob ma bu chen mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa brgya phrag lhag dang / nam yang sha mi za ba'i chos pa snying je can bdag pas gzhan gces kyi byang chub kyi sems la blo 'byongs pa sum brgya lhag dang / pha yul mi gcig pa phyogs phyogs nas 'dus pa'i tshe blos btang gi slob ma grwa btsun ri khrod zin pa sdom pa dam tshig gtsang ba stong dang brgyad brgya byung / gzhan yang phyag mchod skor ba kha ton bzlas brjod la brtson pa'i dgon pa'i dge 'dun pa dang / yi dam lha'i bsnyen sgrub la brtson pa'i grong sngags dang / bsnyen gnas smyung gnas bsrung zhing ma ṇi 'don pa'i khyem pa pho mo bgrang las 'das pa byung / ra lug g.yag dang bya ri dwags khri phrag 'bum phrag mang po'i tshe thar ba dang /sprang slong dang gnas skor pa bshul ring mgon po/ yun ring nad pa/ nag can btson du bzung ba/ phan tshun 'thab nas gsod pa sogs/ 'chi la nye ba lnga brgya lhag tsam gye mi yi srog skyob rgyu'i skal ba byung / mdo smad 'dir 'ongs nas kyang /chos 'jig rten rgyu nom pa thabs du ma'i sgo nas mi mang po gsod pa'i sde 'khrug chen po bco brgyad kyi dmyal ba'i bang kha gtan pa sogs/ mdor na dngos sam brgyud nas bstan 'gro 1110

la phan thogs rgya chen po byung / 'gro don la gang du 'gro yang yid kyis yul phyogs mthong tshad la bkra shis byas/ ri khrod mthong tshad la byen 'bebs byas/ rten mthong tshad la rab gnas byas/ mi mthong tshad la dbang bskur byas/ sems can shi tshad la smon lam btab/ gzhan yang sems can bde ba med pa mthong na byams pa/ sdug bsngal can mthong na snying rje/ sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba mthong na dga' ba/ nye ring chags sdang can mthong na btang snyoms bsgoms nas ngag tu/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cigasems can thams cad sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig sems can thams cad sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig sems can thams cad nye ring chags sdang gnyis dang bral ba'i btang snyoms la gnas par gyur cig ces brjod bzhin du song / chos ldan gyi bya ba gang byas rnams kyi mjug tu/ phan bde 'byung gnas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar zhing sems can thams cad la bde skyid nyi ma bzhin du 'char ba'i bsngo ba smon lam btab pa'i mthu las/ spyir rgyal khams thams cad sgos rang nyid song ba'i yul khams kun la char chu dus su babs/ lo phyugs rtag 1111

tu legs/ mi nad phyugs nad chad/ tshe dang bsod nams rgyas/gnas skabs tshe 'dir bde zhing phyi mar skyid la/ nam phugs dag pa'i zhing nas mjal te/ sangs yang mnyam por rgya ba'i skal ba bzang po byung ba lags so/ /smras pa/ mnyam med rgyal ba shākya thub pa dang / /dbyer med chos rgyal ngag gi dbang bo rje/ /'bral med spyi gtsug 'khor lo'i rgyan du bzhugs/ /'dzad med byen rlabs dngos grub char bzhin phob/ /bdag gi phyi nang gsang ba'i rnam thar dang / /mgur 'bum mthong thos dran reg 'gro ba kun//gnas skabs bde zhing mthar thug sangs rgyas kyi/ /go 'phang myur du 'thob par byen gyis rlobs/ /blun pos rang gi rnam thar brtsams pa la/ /mkhas pa dgyes pa'i sdeb sbyor ma mchis mod/ /'on kyang dad can yongs la phan pa'i phyir/ /slar yang tshigs su bcad nas dbyangs su len/ /sngon byon sangs rgyas byang sems mkhas grub nas/ /da lta'i rtsa ba'i bla ma yan chad kyi/ /rnam thar tshul bzhin skyong bar 'dod pa yi/ /skal bzang las 'phro can rnams dga' bas nyon/ /skye ba sngon ma rnams su rang nyid kyis/ /tshul khrems gzhi bzung sbyin sogs grogs byas nas/ /smon lam dri ma med pa'i mtshams sbyar mthus/ /tshe 'dir rnyed 1112

dka'i mi lus rin chen thob/ /chung ngu'i dus nas chos kyi bag chags sad/ /bla ma dkon mchog gsum la dad pa che/ /cher song 'brel tshad don ldan dge ba'i bshes/ /mang po bsam dang sbyor bas tshul bzhin bsten/ /mdo rgyud man ngag gdams pa mang po zhus/ /so thar byang sems sngags kyi sdom pa bsrungs/ /sha chang sgog tsong tha ma kha rnams spangs/ /dkar gsum mngar gsum ja mar rtsam par brten/ /stod kyi gangs dkar te se man chad nas/ /mtsho snying ma hā de ba yan chad kyi/ /ri khrod dben pa khyad 'phags mang po nas/ /bshad dang sgrub pa'i bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan btsugs/ /stod smad bar gsum rgyal khams mang por song / /las dang skal bar ldan pa'i gdul bya la/ /zab dang rgya che dam pa'i chos bstan nas/ /gdul bya mngon mtho nges legs lam la bkod/ /rang don mngon gyur gzhan don nus pa yi/ /mkhas shing grub brnyes bu chen brgya dang brgyad/ /byams dang snying rje byang chub sems 'byongs pas/ /sha mi za ba'i chos pa sum brgya lhag /tshe 'di blos btang dben par sgom byed pa'i/ /sgom chen pho mo stong dang brgyad brgya byung / /phyag mchod skor ba dge sbyor mdzad pa yi/ /dgon pa'i dge 'dun khri phrag mang po dang / /bsnyen sgrub smyung gnas ma ṇi 'don mkhan gyi/ /grong 1113

sngags khyem pa bgrang las 'das pa byung / /ra lug bya dang ri dwags nya la sogs/ /sems can 'bum phrag mang po'i tshe thar byas/ /ltogs 'khyags nad gdon dgra yis gtses pa yi/ /nyam thag mi yang lnga brgya'i tshe srog bskyabs/ /sde 'khrug chen po byas nas mi rta bsad/ /dmyal ba'i bang kha phyes pa bco brgyad gtan/ /mdor na bla ma dkon mchog thugs rje yis/ /bstan 'gro yongs la phan thogs rgya chen byung / /chos ldan bya ba gang byas thams cad kyi//mjug tu bsngo ba smon lam rgya chen btab/ /'brel thogs gnas skabs bde zhing mthar thug tu/ /sangs yang mnyam por rgya ba'i rten 'brel 'grigs/ /da ni na so rgas pas gtugs na yang / /'gyod pa med pa'i rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub/ /mdor na skyes nas bzung ste nga drug bar/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi rnam thar de ltar lags/ /phyi rabs rjes 'jug slob ma bu rgyud rnams/ /bla ma'i rnam thar de bzhin skyong bar mdzod/ /rgyal ba shākya thub pa'i bu rgyud bzhin/ /bstan dang 'gro ba yongs la phan par shog /slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas bu rgyud bzhin/ /bka' gter dag snang chos kyis phyug par shog /mnyam/ med jo bo rje yi bu rgyud bzhin/ /gsung rab ma lus gdams par 'char bar shog /rgyal ba blo bzang grags pa'i bu 1114

rgyud bzhin/ /bslab gsum nor bu'i rgyan gyis mdzes par shog /sa skya parnyita yi bu rgyud bzhin/ /gzhung lugs bshad srol 'gran zla bral bar shog /rje btsun mi la ras pa'i bu rgyud bzhin/ /sgrub la dka' spyad snying rus che bar shog /pha cig dam pa rgya gar bu rgyud bzhin/ /rkyen ngan thams cad lam du slong bar shog /ma cig lab kyi sgrol ma'i bu rgyud bzhin/ /bdag 'dzin nyon mongs rtsad nas chod par shog /rang nyid mthong thos dran reg 'gro ba kun/ /gnas skabs bde zhing mthar thug sangs rgyas shog /rnam thar mgur 'bum mig gis mthong tshad kyi/ /ngan song gsum gyi skye sgo chod par shog /rnam thar mgur 'bum rna bas thos tshad kyi/ /phyi mar lha mi'i lus rten thob par shog /rnam thar mgur 'bum dran dang reg pa kun/ /rang nyid gar bzhugs zhing der skye bar shog /rnam thar mgur 'bum 'dri zhing 'don tshad kyi/ /rgyud la byin rlabs zhugs nas grol bar shog /rnam thar mgur 'bum nang bzhin byed rnams kyi/ /bsam don thams cad chos bzhin 'grub bar shog /rnam thar mgur 'bum grong dgon gar gnas kyang / /nor bu gnas bzhin dgos 'dod 'byung bar shog /rnam thar mgur 'bum khyer ba'i sa phyogs su/ /chos dang bkra shis dge 1115

legs 'bar gyur cig /ces tshigs su bcad pa'i smon lam gyis mtha' brgyan pa'o// de ltar tshig lhug dang tshigs bcad gnyis kyi sgo nas rang gi rnam thar rgyas par bris nas 'grub pa dang / nyin gcig slob ma yon bdag mang po la lung byas pas/ der 'tshogs pa'i las dang skal bar ldan pa'i gdul bya lha mi rnams kyi rgyud la dad gus dag snang nges 'byung khyad par can skyes nas/ lus kyi ba spu g.yo zhing mig nas mchi ma 'khrigs pa mang po byung ngo / /de dus nyang gi mtshams pas/ skyabs mgon rin po ches da res rnam par thar pa rgyas par gsungs pa bka' drin che lags/ khyed kyi sku tshe gcig la rang gzhan gyi don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'i rnam thar 'di lta bu zhig gang gi sa nas bsams na dka' mod/'on kyang rjes su zhugs nas de'i cha 'dra tsam re e 'ong blta bas/ dus dang rnam pa thams cad du thugs dam skyabs 'og nas mi 'dor bar zhu lags byas pas/ der 'tshogs pa rnams kyang dga' mgu yi rangs te/ bdag la bstod nas phyag dang skor ba byas so/ /zhes snyigs dus 'gro ba yongs kyi skyabs mgon zhabs dkar rdo rje 'chang chen po'i rnam par thar pa rgyas par bshad pa/ skal bzang gdul bya thar 'dod rnams kyi re ba skong 1116

ba'i yid bzhin gyi nor bu bsam 'phel dbang gi rgyal po zhes bya ba 'di ni/ skal ldan gyi slob ma dad ldan gyi sbyin bdag pho mo thams cad kyis bskul ngor/ phyogs med kyi rgyal khams dang nges med kyi ri khrod 'grims pa'i rnal 'byor pa tshogs drug rang grol gyis/ sman ljongs nags tshal rgyas pa'i gong rol/spang gzhongs me tog bkra ba'i 'dabs rol/ rong dang 'brog pa gnyis kyi sa mtshams/ ri bo mtho la yangs pa/ nyams dga' rig pa dwangs pa'i dben gnas bkra shis 'khyil ba nas sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dad brtson shes rab snying rje dang ldan pa'i skal ldan slob bu sangs rgyas rin chen gyis bgyis pa 'dis kyang bstan pa dang 'gro ba sems can thams cad la phan pa dpag tu med pa thogs par gyur cig sarba maṅga lam̐//1117

mjug byang /oṃ swa ste/ bstan pa'i bdag po ston pa sangs rgyas dang / /de yi gsung rab mdo sngags dam pa'i chos/ /de nyid 'dzin skyong spel mkhas dge 'dun sde/ /bslu med dkon mchog gsum gye shis pas skyongs/ /rnam 'dren stong gi nang nas pad dkar ltar/ /bsngags pa'i 'dren pa mnyam med zas gtsang sras/ /de yi rjes 'jug chos mdzad zhabs dkar pas/ /rnam thar dad can rnams la phan phyir sbyar/ /yi ge gcig las brgya stong khri 'bum sogs/ /dka' tshegs med par mang por 'phel ba'i 'phrul/ /par yig yin par go nas rnam thar gyi/ /par yig 'phud la thams cad spro bar gyur/ /lhag bsam rnam dag mkhan pos kha 'go mdza da/ /dbon po rab byung sogs kyis mthun rkyen bsgrubs/ /dbu mdzad bskal bzang skyabs kyis par yig bris/ /zhu dag byed la sangs rgyas rin chen bsngags/ /stag yan kun dga' sogs kyis par shing bcad/ /rgya bzo gcig gis par shing legs par bcos/ /par dpon bla spyon bsam 'grub hor nag dang / /rgya mtsho snyan grags pad+ma drug gis brkos/ /par gye 1118

yon rnams stod smad bar gsum gyi/ /slob ma sngags 'chang yon bdag rnams kyis sbyar/ /par shing re la dong tse khron re phul/ /'tsho ba zhabs tog dga' ston legs par byas/ /skal bzang gdul bya'i shes rgyud zhing sa la/ /legs tshogs yon tan lo yag bskrun pa'i phyir/ /chos sbyin 'dzad med par gyi chu bo 'di/ /dben gnas bkra shis 'khyil ba'i rtse na bzhugs/ /'dis mtshon dus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba'i mthus/ /slob ma yon bdag rnams kyis gtso byas pa'i/ /ma gyur 'gro ba'i tshogs rdzogs sgrib byang nas/ /myur du sangs rgyas go 'phang thob par shog /de ma thob pa'i tshe rabs thams cad du/ /dal 'byor rten thob bla ma bzang dang mjal/ /mdo sngags chos la thos bsam sgom gsum byas/ /rang gzhan don gnyis lhun gyes 'grub par shog /gzhan yang char chu dus 'bab lo phyugs legs/ /'dod dgu'i zas nor longs spyod thams cad 'dzom/ /rgyal khams thams cad bde zhing skyid pa'i sgos/ /nyin mtshan chos la spyod pa'i bkra shis shog /ces par byang nyung 'dus 'di ni zhabs dkar pas sbyar ba'o/ / / /su maṅga li bha wan+tu sarba dzāg s+t+waṃ//1119
